- Perform Client Due Diligence to evaluate the customer from a compliance perspective and ensure that all established procedures are followed while providing a great customer experience

- Continuously improve streamlined processes to manage the end-to-end onboarding process from a financial crimes risk perspective

- Work with the Airwallex Compliance Team to ensure Airwallex’s adherence to local and global compliance policies and procedures

- Stay up-to-date on AML-related news and emerging regulatory developments Perform period reviews and support audits

You are:

- Relentlessly curious - Your analytical skills are second to none and the concept of deriving data-driven insights invigorates you… but you don’t succumb to analysis paralysis

- Process driven - You enjoy developing, documenting, and following procedures to ensure they are efficient, scalable, and defensible

- A team player - You are a natural in building relationships with your colleagues… but you enjoy working independently as much as you enjoy working with a team

- A master prioritizer - You leverage sound judgment to quickly assess all the tasks at hand and expertly prioritize them

- Inquisitive by nature - You know when to dig a little deeper to get to the bottom of a problem and solve it; in doing so, you ask the right questions necessary to arrive at a sound, risk-based decision

You have:

- 4-5 years of process-oriented experience requiring meticulous attention to detail and well-honed written and verbal communications; bank or fintech experience strongly preferred

- Relevant knowledge of European/Israeli AML Directives and subsequent implementations into local laws, with understanding of the AML/CTF regulations, principles, and typologies

- Proven track record of managing personal performance against objective targets and using data and analytics to make decisions

- Proficiency in the use of Excel and other Office / G Suite tools, case management systems, and third-party data-oriented SaaS vendors

- Comfort with a fast-paced, dynamic environment is a must; past exposure to a high-growth and/or globally distributed startup is also valuable

- Preferably an AML certification (e.g. ACAMS, ICA)

- Language Skills: English and Hebrew (Required), Arabic (Highly Desirable).

title: Enterprise Account Executive - West
description:
WHO WE ARE

Atlan is building the context layer for enterprise AI. Enterprises are pouring money into AI and most of it dies in production because the AI does not understand the business context around the data. That is the problem Atlan solves.

Gartner has named context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and calls context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents, naming Atlan one of three vendors already building it. We are also the only vendor named a Leader across all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the foundation the context layer runs on.

Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on.

What You'll Own

- Run full-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles with sophisticated data and AI leaders (CDO, SVP of Data, CIO) at large accounts, backed by a base of roughly 400 enterprise customers.

- Self-generate pipeline across the West Coast (US). You own account strategy and deal orchestration end to end with BDR, Sales Engineer and Partner support.

- Build direct relationships with partner field teams (Snowflake, Databricks, and other ISVs/SIs). Atlan is partner-led but almost always closes direct contracts, so these are relationships you build yourself, not leads you passively receive.

- Sell across three connected layers: the established metadata and governance foundation, AI-ready data and governed workflows, and the newer strategic motion (Context Layer, Context Lakehouse, context agents, and Agent Registry).

- Help build the motion itself. Messaging, target-account strategy, executive relationships, and qualification discipline are all still being established here; you'll help codify at least one repeatable play the wider team can inherit.

- Get embedded in the technical and CIO ecosystem: show up at meetups, founder circles and roundtables, not only in scheduled meetings.

What Makes You a Match

- You've carried a bag with a genuine AE track record. You're comfortable with technical nuance and can go deep with a CDO or CIO audience, whether that credibility comes from a Sales Engineer/technical background, a technical degree, or years of selling infrastructure-level products.

- You've successfully sold different technologies or into different buyer types across your career, whether that background is in enterprise application software, AI-native products, or infrastructure.

- You operate with high agency: you take action without being told, build your own messaging when there isn't a playbook yet, and aren't intimidated by gaps in your own knowledge.

- You're genuinely using and upskilling in AI day to day: real personal curiosity, not performed fluency.

- How you talk about past deals matters: we're listening for whether you solved a real business outcome for the customer, not whether you sold a point solution or feature.

- Ideally based in California, though we'll consider strong candidates elsewhere on the West Coast.

Bonus

- You've built something from scratch before, whether that's a new territory, a new segment, or a new motion at a prior company. It shows you don't need an existing playbook to succeed.

- Experience selling a genuinely technical, infrastructure-level product to sophisticated enterprise buyers.

- Comfort operating in a partner-led, multi-stakeholder deal environment (e.g., Snowflake or Databricks field co-selling).

Atlan is committed to transparent, fair and equitable compensation practices.

Local Pay Range: $330,000-$360,000 OTE USD

This role is also eligible for equity and Atlan's full benefits package. Actual compensation is based on factors including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, and relevant certifications and specialized training.

WHY ATLAN?

Joining Atlan means being part of a global movement to help data teams do their life’s best work. Here’s what you can expect:

- Competitive Compensation:  We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.

- AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.

- Health & Wellness: From Day‑1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in.

- Flexible Time Off & Leave Policies: We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact.

- Accelerated Growth & Learning: Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery.

- Global, Remote-First, High-Trust:  Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15+ countries, in a trust-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership over how you work.

More About Us

Atlan is building the shared context layer that enterprises need so AI can operate on trusted, governed context. The conversation has moved from data leaders asking:  “Can we trust the data in our stack?” to businesses asking: “Can we trust AI inside the business?”

We are the missing infrastructure for businesses becoming AI-forward - the connective tissue between their data stack, operational systems, and AI agents.

To learn more, visit www.atlan.com http://www.atlan.com and follow us on LinkedIn. https://www.linkedin.com/company/atlan-hq/posts/?feedView=all

Equal Opportunity Employer

Atlan is committed to building an inclusive, diverse, and authentic workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Recruitment Fraud Alert
Your safety is important to us. Be cautious of recruiting emails from domains other than @atlan.com http://atlan.com. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links — visit atlan.com/careers http://atlan.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

Atlan will never ask candidates to make a payment to apply for or obtain a position. We also will never request financial information, passwords, or other sensitive information from candidates. If you receive a communication that you believe may not be legitimate, do not send money or sensitive information. Please report the same on privacy@atlan.com.

Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

Summary:
Provides strategic and high-level administrative support to the CEO and other senior executives. Manages complex schedules, high-stakes communications, and sensitive cross-functional initiatives. title: Junior Creative Designer
description:
ROIcamp is a media buying team that works exclusively with the dating vertical. The parent company has been building and monetizing dating products since 2011; the team is 40+ people and fully remote. We buy traffic on Meta, Google, TikTok, push and native placements, and we measure ourselves on paying users rather than on leads.
About the role
This is an entry into performance design, and commercial experience is not required. ROIcamp has driven traffic to its own dating products since 2011, and buyers need dozens of creative variations every week: fresh copy, new first frames, resizes, versions for different GEOs. A creative is a single advertising unit, an image or video with its copy; a GEO is the country or region a campaign targets.
Those variations are the school itself: every layout you touch reports its own numbers, CTR, the share of people who click the ad, and CVR, the share of them who convert. You do not wait for an opinion: the tracker, the system that records clicks and conversions per creative, shows which of twenty versions actually spent budget. A Creative Producer works alongside you, setting briefs, catching mistakes early, and going through your results each week.
At the start the work is mostly variations on mechanics that already perform: new copy on statics, placement resizes, and localizations. Your own concepts come with experience.
What you'll do
Build variations of working creatives from briefs: new copy on statics, alternative video first frames, colors, and composition.
Resize creatives for Meta and TikTok placements, including stories, feed, and Reels, without losing the point of the layout.
Adapt creatives for Tier-1 and Tier-2 GEOs together with localization, changing the copy, the face, and the context.
Handle simple editing tasks such as subtitles, cutaways, and trimming UGC footage, meaning video shot to look like an ordinary user's rather than a studio's.
Generate images with AI tools. We teach this from zero and the company pays for the subscriptions.
Keep the creative library in order through consistent naming and versioning, so anyone finds the right file in a minute.
Join the weekly review of numbers: which of your variations performed, which did not, and what follows.
Requirements
A portfolio in any form, whether study work, course projects, or personal experiments. The main criterion is neatness.
Confident Figma skills: components, auto-layout, and a steady pace.
Deadline discipline, because a 24–48 hour pipeline does not wait for inspiration.
Readiness to judge your own work by numbers rather than by likes in a feed.
Nice to have
Basic video editing in CapCut or Premiere.
First experiments with AI image generation.
An understanding of how an ad differs from an illustration.
What we offer
Hundreds of tests on real budgets rather than invented case studies, with numbers on every creative you make.
Paid AI subscriptions and training on generation tools.
Mentoring from the Creative Producer without micromanagement: a clear brief, a deadline, a debrief.
Fully remote work from day one.
Growth path
Junior to middle designer with your own concepts is a realistic horizon of 6–12 months if the numbers on your variations support it. After that the paths split toward motion design or the Creative Producer track. The creative department works next to buying, farming, and analytics, so you can see early where you might grow.
Compensation
$500–800 base to start, with a review once your variations spend consistently. Payouts on a fixed date every month.
Hiring process
A 30-minute screening call, then a portfolio review, then a compact test of up to 2 hours building variations on an existing creative, then an offer. The whole process takes up to 7 business days.

title: Product Designer UX/UI (m/w/d)
description:
*Gestalte die digitale Welt von morgen als UX/UI Designer!*

Digitale Produkte, Apps und Webprojekte sind die Welt, in der du arbeiten möchtest?

Dich faszinieren Technologie, Design und das Nutzererlebnis, und du möchtest digitale Produkte mitgestalten, ohne selbst in die tiefen von Codeschichten einzutauchen?

Dann ist die Rolle eines Product Designers UX/UI genau das Richtige für dich!

Wir, die Digitale Leute School, bilden Product Designer (UX/UI) in unseren Bootcamps aus und vermitteln sie in Einsteigerpositionen. (Weiterbildung)

Unser nächster Kurs startet bald und wir haben noch Plätze frei!

Starte als Quereinsteiger:in, Umsteiger:in, Junior:in oder Associate Designer (UX/UI) in die Product Designer Weiterbildung und finde dann deine erste Stelle.

--------
Aufgaben
--------

*Die Inhalte*

*Steuerung von Designprozessen*

Als UX/UI Designer arbeitest du eng mit einem Team von Entwickler:innen, Stakeholder:innen und anderen Beteiligten zusammen, um nutzerzentrierte Lösungen zu schaffen. Du nimmst an regelmäßigen Teammeetings teil, bei denen ihr euch über Fortschritte austauscht und sicherstellt, dass das Design den Erwartungen entspricht.

*User Research & Nutzer*

Du führst qualitative und quantitative Forschungen durch, um die Bedürfnisse der Nutzer:innen zu verstehen. Dabei nutzt du Methoden wie Interviews, Umfragen und Datenanalysen, um Personas und Customer Journeys zu erstellen, die den Designprozess leiten.

*Prototyping & Wireframing*

Du entwickelst Ideen und visualisierst sie in Form von Wireframes und interaktiven Prototypen, um diese mit Nutzer:innen zu testen und zu optimieren. Deine Konzepte helfen Teams und Stakeholdern, Designideen klar zu verstehen und weiterzuentwickeln.

*Usability-Tests & Design-Optimierung*

Du planst und führst Usability-Tests durch, um sicherzustellen, dass deine Designs intuitiv und benutzerfreundlich sind. Durch die Auswertung von Testergebnissen sammelst du Feedback, das direkt in die Optimierung der Benutzeroberfläche einfließt.

*Produkt- & User Experience Design*

Du gestaltest das Erlebnis und die Benutzeroberfläche des Produkts, damit es sowohl gut aussieht als auch einfach zu bedienen ist. Du erstellst Prototypen und Designs, die zeigen, wie das Produkt und aussehen soll und funktioniert.

*Tracking & Analyse*

Du beobachtest, wie Nutzer:innen mit dem Produkt umgehen, um herauszufinden, ob das Design funktioniert. Mit diesen Informationen kannst du das Design weiter verbessern und sicherstellen, dass es den Bedürfnissen der Nutzer entspricht.

-------------
Qualifikation
-------------

* Du bist begeistert von Design und Technologie und liebst es, digitale Erlebnisse zu gestalten
* Du arbeitest gern im Team und freust dich, gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern
* Du hast Spaß an agilen Arbeitsmethoden (z. B. Scrum, Kanban) und iterierst Designs schnell
* Du kannst deine Designideen klar kommunizieren und Stakeholder von deinem Konzept überzeugen
* Du zeigst Eigeninitiative, bringst kreative Lösungen ein und arbeitest pragmatisch
* Du hast ein starkes Gespür für Nutzerbedürfnisse und gestaltest Lösungen, die den Unterschied machen
* Du gehst mit Mut und Neugier an Herausforderungen heran und findest innovative Ansätze für komplexe Probleme

--------
Benefits
--------

* Wir bilden dich innerhalb von 4 Monaten remote/online zum UX/UI Designer aus ( *deutschsprachig* )
* Wir unterstützen dich, schon während der Weiterbildung ein Unternehmen zu finden, das dir einen Jobeinstieg während oder nach dem Bootcamp bietet
* Die Ausbildung ist berufsbegleitend möglich
* Du bekommst einen Mentor, der Dich durch das Programm führt und wirst die Arbeit in Product Teams simulieren
* Nach vier Monaten kannst Du als Product Designer / UX/UI Designer mit Zertifikat in digitale Produktteams einsteigen und weißt, was die Aufgaben eines Product Designers sind

Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und deine Bewerbung.

-----------

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team
--------

The Sales & Marketing team, also known as Direct Acquisition, owns how iwoca reaches UK small businesses – across paid and organic marketing channels and direct sales.

The team is autonomous and cross-functional, bringing together Marketing, Sales, Brand, and AcquiTech – iwoca's acquisition technology team, which includes software engineering, product, design, and data science. As a Data Scientist, you'll work with people across each function.

The role
--------

As a Data Scientist in the Direct Acquisition team, you'll design experiments and build the statistical models that shape how iwoca reaches its next customers. Your findings feed directly into how we invest in sales and marketing.

You'll work alongside the team's data scientist, who mentors you closely as you take on more ownership.

*

*Experimentation*. You'll design and evaluate experiments so decisions on sales and marketing rest on evidence.

*

*Modelling.* You'll build models that solve the team's business problems, with input on approach and solution design.

*

*Community and mastery.* You'll join iwoca's wider data science community – analysts, data scientists, and statisticians – to align on methodology and develop your expertise across acquisition.

The requirements
----------------

Essential:
----------

*

*Statistical foundations.* You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree (or recent/final-year Master's) in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or similar. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

*

*Research mindset.* You're curious about new methods and actively look for better ways to do things. You try them out, not just read about them.

*

*Judgement*. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. You defend your reasoning under challenge, and challenge others' when the evidence points elsewhere.

*

*Analytical ownership.* You take workstreams from framing to a landed decision, with support on solution design where you need it. You like to move fast, iterate, and update on new evidence rather than chase perfection.

*

*AI fluency.* You use AI as a primary tool. You prototype with it, automate with it, and use judgement on where it helps and where it doesn't.

*

*Communication*. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in sales and marketing.

Bonus:
------

*

*Domain experience.* You have worked on marketing, sales, or customer acquisition problems.

*

*Causal inference and experimentation*. You have designed or analysed experiments where distinguishing signal from noise mattered – A/B tests, quasi-experiments, or lift studies.

*

*Marketing mix or attribution modelling*. You have used or contributed to models that quantify channel impact or optimise spend.

*

*Bayesian methods*. You have used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work.

*

*Production ML*. You have built and shipped supervised ML models end to end – exploration, training, deployment, monitoring.

*

*Python*. The stack the team uses.

The salary
----------

We expect to pay from £40,000 to £60,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture
-----------

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices
-----------

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

*

Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

*

Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits
------------

*

Flexible working hours.
-----------------------

*

Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

*

A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

*

25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

*

A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

*

Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

*

3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

*

An employee equity incentive scheme.
------------------------------------

*

Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

*

Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

*

Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

*

A learning and development budget for everyone.

*

Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Junior Fullstack Engineer (m/w/d) TS, React, Next.js & AI  100% Remote

--------
Aufgaben

title: Junior QA Engineer (Tracking & Analytics)
description:
ROIcamp is a media buying team that works exclusively with the dating vertical. The parent company has been building and monetizing dating products since 2011; the team is 40+ people and fully remote. We buy traffic on Meta, Google, TikTok, push and native placements, and we measure ourselves on paying users rather than on leads.
About the role
Media buying rests on one quiet condition: the numbers have to be true. The Meta algorithm optimizes toward the events we send it, a buyer's bonus is calculated from the conversions the tracker recorded, and the decision to scale a campaign is made from a cohort in BI. When an event fires twice, arrives late, or loses its subid, all three mechanisms start running on false data, and it usually surfaces a week and several thousand dollars later.
This role exists so that week never happens. ROIcamp has worked in the dating vertical since 2011, and one lesson from that time is that tracking should be verified by someone other than the person who configured it. You report to the Tech Lead and work closely with the analyst and the buying team.
This is not an entry-level position. We have a separate Junior QA Engineer opening for that. Here we are looking for someone who has already tested web products or worked inside ad accounts and has at least once had to work out why a conversion never arrived.
What you'll do
Verify the event map on landing pages: that every event fires exactly once, at the right moment, and carries a complete set of parameters.
Test conversion delivery across all channels at once: the pixel in the browser, the Conversion API on the server, the postback into the tracker, and the event in GA4. A mismatch between them is our bug, not a platform quirk.
Follow parameters end to end through click, landing, registration, subscription and payment, checking that the subid stays the same at every step. A subid is the identifier that ties a conversion back to a specific buyer and campaign.
Catch duplicate firings and verify deduplication by event_id, since an event counted twice damages both the reporting and the algorithm's training.
Reconcile numbers between the ad account, the tracker and the BI dashboard, locate the source of the discrepancy, and describe it so an engineer can reproduce it after a single read.
Test landings and prelanders before traffic goes live: layout, loading speed and forms across devices, browsers and GEOs. A prelander is the short intermediate page between the ad and the main offer page.
Check redirects, rotation rules and the correctness of deeplink transitions into the app.
Catch regressions after updates. Every bug that gets through becomes a new line in the test matrix, which is yours to maintain and extend.
Requirements
Around a year of web testing experience, or an adjacent role where you regularly investigated why data did not add up.
Hands-on exposure to advertising: you have seen an ad account from the inside and understand where a conversion in a report comes from.
Confident use of DevTools: the Network tab, reading requests, parameters, cookies and redirect chains.
A grasp of basic web mechanics: GET and POST, query parameters, response codes, and the difference between a client-side and a server-side event.
Willingness to read JSON without hesitation and to write findings up in a structured way rather than as "something is broken".
Consistency: the test matrix gets completed even when everything appears to be fine.
Nice to have
Google Tag Manager and GA4, either configured yourself or at least understood well enough to read someone else's container.
Experience with a tracker such as Keitaro, Binom or any equivalent.
Postman or a similar tool for checking postbacks by hand.
Basic SQL, enough to pull a number from a table yourself instead of asking the analyst.
An understanding of mobile attribution and mobile measurement partners such as AppsFlyer.
English sufficient for reading platform documentation.
What we offer
Work on the live tracking behind dating traffic rather than a training environment: real volumes, real GEOs, real event counts.
Rare expertise at the intersection of QA, advertising and analytics. There are few such specialists on the market, and they gain value faster than general testers.
A visible result: you can see how much budget a broken event you found protected.
Direct access to the Tech Lead and the analyst, so questions get settled in one message rather than three approvals.
Fully remote work, full salary from day one, and payouts on a fixed date.
Growth path
The shortest path from here leads to the tracking infrastructure engineer: first you verify someone else's event map, then you design your own. The second direction is marketing analytics, since you already work with the same cohorts as the BI analyst, only from the other side. We discuss both moves at the six-month review and measure them by results rather than by tenure.
Compensation
$300 to $500 base, depending on how independently you can handle tracking from the start. Salary review after six months. Payouts on a fixed date each month.
Hiring process
A 30-minute screening call, then a practical task on a test landing page with broken tracking (up to two hours, reviewed together), then an interview with the Tech Lead, then an offer. The whole process takes up to 8 business days from your application.

title: Junior Localization Manager
description:
ROIcamp is a media buying team that works exclusively with the dating vertical. The parent company has been building and monetizing dating products since 2011; the team is 40+ people and fully remote. We buy traffic on Meta, Google, TikTok, push and native placements, and we measure ourselves on paying users rather than on leads.
About the role
Our principle is simple: copy on a creative or a landing page should read as written for that GEO, not as translated into it. A creative is a single advertising unit, an image or video with its copy; a GEO is the country or region a campaign targets.
ROIcamp has monetized dating products in Tier-1 and Tier-2 markets since 2011, and the gap between a literal translation and a living adaptation shows up as a conversion gap all the way down the funnel to rebill, the repeat automatic payment from a user who subscribed earlier.
An American, a German, and a Pole flirt in different words, and your job is to catch that difference inside short advertising phrases. Languages you do not speak are covered by native freelancers, and step by step you become the person who manages them: briefs, review, deadlines. No commercial experience is required. You report to the Creative Producer.
What you'll do
Localize creative copy for Tier-1 and Tier-2 GEOs, working from English as the base: short phrases, headlines, and on-image text.
Adapt landing pages, meaning not only the words but the tone, the slang, and the cultural triggers of a specific market.
Brief native freelancers with context, examples, and clear expectations, then accept their work against a checklist.
Proofread everything bound for production, since a single mistake on a landing page dents the trust of an entire GEO.
Maintain a glossary and a bank of phrasings that have already proven their conversion for each GEO.
Compare copy variants with buyers by the numbers and explain which message lifted CVR, the share of visitors who convert, and why.
Requirements
Written English at B2 or above, your everyday working language.
A feel for short-form copy. Examples are enough to show it, and study work counts.
Pedantic attention to detail, because in this niche a typo costs money.
Self-organization in remote work, with many small parallel tasks that each carry a deadline.
Nice to have
A second European language: German, French, Spanish, or Polish.
Any translation or copywriting experience, in whatever format.
Curiosity about marketing, and about why one headline gets clicked and another does not.
What we offer
A skill measured in conversion rather than in style alone.
Management practice already at the junior level, through coordinating native freelancers.
Numbers on every copy variant you produce, with CTR and CVR per GEO visible in the tracker, the system that records clicks and conversions.
Fully remote work in a tight loop with designers, buyers, and the analytics team.
Real influence on the team's results, since a winning adaptation gets scaled across the whole market.
Growth path
There are two directions. The first goes deeper into localization: your own GEO expertise, a pool of native freelancers under your management, and the localization hub for the traffic team. The second leads into performance copywriting: from adaptations to your own messages and creative hypotheses. In both cases the argument for promotion is the conversion of your texts.
Compensation
$400–600 base at entry, reviewed against the measurable results of your localizations. Payouts on a fixed date, monthly.
Hiring process
A 30-minute screening call, then a compact test of up to 90 minutes in which you adapt three messages for different GEOs, then an offer. A decision within 5 business days.

A 30-minute screening call, then a short practical task on attention to detail that asks you to find the problems on a test landing page, then an offer. The whole process takes up to 5 business days.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
------------------
About SAAF Finance
------------------

SAAF Finance is a technology-driven lending platform building the data and automation backbone for modern mortgage and loan origination. Our Data Engineering team designs and maintains the pipelines and platforms that power analytics, underwriting insights, reporting, and AI-driven decisioning across the business. We're looking for early-career engineers who are curious, eager to learn, and want to build real-world data systems from day one.

--------------
About the Role
--------------

As a Data Engineer (Entry Level), you'll work closely with senior engineers to build and maintain data pipelines, write and optimize SQL, and support our cloud-based data warehouse. This role is ideal for freshers or engineers with up to 2 years of experience who want strong mentorship and hands-on exposure to modern data engineering tools and practices.

-----------------------------------

Assist in building and maintaining data pipelines under the guidance of senior engineers.

*

Write, test, and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate data.

*

Support batch data ingestion and basic ETL/ELT workflows using Python.

*

Help maintain data quality by running basic checks and flagging inconsistencies.

*

Learn and work within our cloud data warehouse (Snowflake/Databricks) under supervision.

*

Document your work — data flow notes, basic technical specs, and test cases.

*

Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality.

*

Collaborate with analytics and business teams to understand data needs.

*

Take a proactive approach to learning new tools, languages, and best practices.

*

Communicate progress and blockers clearly with your team.

What You Will Need
------------------

For Freshers (0 years experience):
----------------------------------

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, IT, or a related field.

*

Basic understanding of SQL — able to write simple SELECT, JOIN, and aggregation queries.

*

Basic knowledge of Python programming.

*

Basic awareness of data warehousing concepts (tables, schemas, ETL at a conceptual level).

*

Understanding of relational databases and data structures.

*

Strong willingness to learn, good analytical thinking, and attention to detail.

*

Good verbal and written communication skills.

For 1–2 Years Experienced:

1–2 years of hands-on experience in a data engineering, analytics engineering, or similar role.

Working knowledge of SQL, including joins, aggregations, and basic performance tuning.

Familiarity with version control (Git/GitHub/Bitbucket).

Basic understanding of any cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

*

Good problem-solving skills and ability to work in an agile team environment.

------------
Nice to Have
------------

*

Academic or internship project experience involving data pipelines or analytics.

*

Exposure to workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow.

*

Basic familiarity with streaming concepts (Kafka) or NoSQL databases.

*

Exposure to BI/visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker).

*

Basic knowledge of Docker or containerization concepts.

------------

In this role, you'll support the delivery of product seeding and creator gifting campaigns for some of the world's leading consumer brands.

Your focus will be identifying the right creators, coordinating outreach, managing product shipments, and ensuring campaigns run smoothly from planning through to reporting. You'll work closely with Campaign Managers, Creator Managers and Client Solutions teams to generate authentic creator content and build long-term creator relationships.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with around 1–2 years' experience in influencer marketing, PR, social media or digital marketing who is highly organised, proactive and passionate about the creator economy.

This is a freelance engagement. You'll invoice monthly at an agreed day rate, be responsible for your own tax arrangements. The initial engagement is six months with potential to extend based on campaign demand.

--------------------

--------------------

Creator Research & Selection
----------------------------

Build creator shortlists using internal tools and external platforms.

Review creator content, engagement and audience quality.

Maintain accurate creator records and campaign databases.

------------------------------------------

Support negotiations around gifting, usage rights and campaign participation.

*

Manage creator communications throughout the campaign lifecycle.

*

Build positive relationships that encourage future collaboration.

Product Seeding & Logistics
---------------------------

*

Ensure accurate shipping information and delivery tracking.

*

Monitor product dispatches and resolve delivery issues where required.

*

Keep campaign trackers updated with shipment and creator status.

Campaign Delivery
-----------------

*

Support Campaign Managers with day-to-day campaign execution.

*

Track creator deliverables and ensure content is submitted on time.

*

Monitor campaign timelines and proactively flag risks or delays.

*

Help ensure all campaign documentation is accurate and up to date.

Reporting & Administration
--------------------------

*

Track creator participation and content delivery.

*

Compile campaign reports using performance and engagement data.

*

Maintain campaign trackers, budgets and status documents.

*

Support post-campaign reporting and internal retrospectives.

----------------------
What We're Looking For
----------------------

*

Available to start immediately.

*

Approximately 1–2 years' experience in influencer marketing, creator marketing, PR, social media or digital marketing.

*

Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail.

*

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

*

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

*

A proactive, solutions-focused mindset.

*

Experience using project management tools such as Asana or similar is an advantage.

*

Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.

*

A genuine passion for social media, creators and digital culture.

Fluency in English is essential. Professional proficiency in either Spanish or German is highly desirable.

Creator outreach is completed accurately and on schedule.

Product shipments are coordinated efficiently with minimal issues.

Campaign trackers remain organised and up to date.

Creators receive timely communication and an excellent experience.

title: UX/UI Designer
location: Remote, Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Cuba, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Haiti, Honduras, Mexico, Nicaragua, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, Puerto Rico, Uruguay, Venezuela
description:
Infilla is looking for a UX/UI Designer to design and deliver intuitive web experiences and native mobile apps for code enforcement and inspections products, while scaling design quality and judgment across the company.

Infilla’s mission is to make more housing happen faster by making permitting unremarkable. The U.S. is short 4-7 million homes, and local permitting is one of the top bottlenecks with approvals taking months to years. Infilla is building the modern permitting platform that helps local governments review projects faster, more consistently, and more transparently. Customers include San Francisco, New York City, and the State of Delaware, among others. We’re backed by Basis Set Ventures, Base10 Partners, Urban Innovation Fund, SHAKTI VC, 20Growth, Bloomberg Beta, and 20+ founders/operators who’ve built products at scale.

*WHAT YOU’LL DELIVER*
---------------------

*

Design and deliver the Inspections MVP to live customers within 3 months of start, and Code Enforcement within 5.

*

Maintain the Infilla design system after the contractor build, across web and mobile components, so engineers and coding agents implement from it without translation and with minimal drift as new surfaces ship.

*

Enable engineers to independently ship UI that meets the bar through shared design principles, a working critique practice, and a design system that makes the consistent choice the easy one.

*WHAT YOU’VE DONE BEFORE*
-------------------------

*

You’ve designed, shipped, and iterated on 0-to-1 B2B mobile apps that real users use

*

You’ve independently owned cross-platform, end-to-end designs without a design manager

*

You use AI in the work itself, daily
------------------------------------

*WHAT YOU’RE GREAT AT*
----------------------

*

*Product judgment & scoping -* Takes a fuzzy problem and decides what makes the MVP and what waits. Grounds decisions in how the work is actually done rather than in what similar products look like.

*

*Design craft -* Makes intuitive experiences that hold up in real conditions, across native mobile and dense desktop, from information architecture through visual detail.

*

*Systems thinking -* Designs products that fit a coherent whole — thinks in models and workflows rather than just screens, and keeps the design system consistent as new surfaces ship.

*

*Design enablement -* Makes other people better at design without doing the work themselves. Co-creates the principles and holds the bar when engineers ship UI unassisted.

*

*Ownership in ambiguity -* Makes progress without a spec, a PM, or a clear brief. Decides and moves rather than waiting for the requirements to firm up.

*NICE TO HAVE, NOT NEEDED*
--------------------------

*

You’ve designed for deskless workers, government staff, or less technology-savvy users

*

You’ve designed AI product surfaces
-----------------------------------

*

You’ve maintained design systems
--------------------------------

*

You’ve designed products that meet WCAG AA 2.1 accessibility standards

*

You have experience with brand design or marketing design work

*

You are a former founder, beyond being a solopreneur or consultant

Research shows women & minorities are more likely to consider themselves unqualified if they don’t meet every single requirement in a job description. This represents what we’re ideally looking for, but everyone is unique. We hire for strengths & potential, not lack of weakness or a perfect resume fit.

*DETAILS*
---------

*

This is a full-time remote role based in either LatAm. If you'd prefer to start on a contract basis, we're open to that

*

You will join as 2nd designer and report to the Founder & CEO

*

Competitive salary based on experience and working location

*

US-based employee benefits: meaningful equity, healthcare / vision / dental insurance, 401K, and 26 days of PTO including federal holidays

*THE PROCESS*
-------------

We aim to make this happen in 2 weeks:
--------------------------------------

*

Initial call with Savanna to assess mutual fit (20 min)

*

Design portfolio deep dive with Daria to assess design craft (60 min)

*

Jam session #1 with Phi to assess product judgment & scoping (60 min)

*

Team day onsite (virtual onsite for remote candidates)
- Jam session #2 with Carl to assess systems thinking (60 min)
- Scaling design taste conversation with Brandon to assess design enablement (30 min)
- Founder conversation with Jenny to assess ownership in ambiguity (45 min)

*

Reference checks (manager, PM peer, designer peer, engineering peer)

*HOW WE WORK*
-------------

*

*Ideas > Hierarchy* - Best idea wins regardless of source. Be intellectually honest.

*

*Kind > Nice* - Share clear, helpful feedback often. Voice your concerns and listen.

*

*Courage > Comfort* - We do the right thing, even when hard or uncomfortable.

*

*Hours > Weeks* - Solve it in hours, not "eventually." Speed is our biggest edge as a startup.

*

*Fix > Flag* - See a problem, own it, and fix it — don't wait for someone else to.

*LEGAL*
-------

Infilla is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation at any point in the interview process, let us know and we'll make it work.

title: Lead UI/UX Designer - Mobile Casual F2P Games
description:
The Opportunity
---------------

UserWise is looking for an experienced *Lead UI/UX Designer* to own the UI/UX discipline for a a mobile Free-to-Play game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.

This is a *hands-on leadership role* for someone who can translate game and product designs into clear flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes before significant art or engineering work begins. You will stay ahead of production, validate interactions early, identify usability problems before they become expensive production problems, and follow features through implementation to ensure the intended player experience survives into the final game.

You will also mentor and work alongside an existing UI/UX Designer, helping establish stronger UX processes, patterns, and quality standards across the project.

This is not a management-only role. We are looking for someone who is comfortable getting directly into the work — mapping flows, wireframing screens, building prototypes, iterating on UI, reviewing builds, and solving problems alongside Game Design, Art, Product, Engineering, and Production.

What You’ll Do
--------------

* Own the overall *UX quality and UI/UX discipline* across the game.
* Translate game and product concepts into clear user journeys, flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes.
* Stay ahead of production by resolving major interaction and usability questions before features move into Art and Engineering.
* Rapidly prototype and compare UX solutions before committing significant production time.
* Own information architecture, navigation, screen hierarchy, interaction patterns, usability, and player comprehension.
* Design intuitive experiences for gameplay, progression, onboarding, rewards, LiveOps, social features, and monetization.
* Proactively identify UX problems through design reviews, prototypes, and playable builds.
* Follow features through implementation and work with Engineering to preserve design intent.
* Improve the *Game Design → UX → Art → Engineering* workflow so features move through production with clearer intent and fewer late-stage redesigns.
* Establish reusable UX patterns, UI components, interaction standards, and documentation.
* Mentor and work in parallel with another UI/UX Designer while remaining directly involved in execution.
* Partner closely with the Art Director to define and evolve the visual language of the UI, translating the game’s overall art direction into a cohesive, scalable interface system.

*Requirements*

What We’re Looking For
----------------------

* Senior or Lead-level experience designing UI/UX for shipped games.
* Strong shipped experience with *mobile Free-to-Play games* , ideally casual or mass-market titles.
* A portfolio demonstrating both *UX thinking and finished game experiences* , not just polished UI screens.
* Strong ability to turn complex game systems into simple, intuitive player experiences.
* Excellent understanding of mobile interaction design, information architecture, hierarchy, readability, feedback, and usability.
* Experience designing F2P systems such as progression, rewards, FTUE, events, LiveOps, and monetization.
* Strong wireframing and interactive prototyping skills.
* Strong proficiency with *Figma* or equivalent modern product-design tools.
* Strong UI design fundamentals and the ability to take work beyond low-fidelity UX when needed.
* Strong product judgment and a proactive approach to identifying and solving experience problems.
* Experience mentoring or providing design direction to other UI/UX Designers.
* Experience collaborating closely with Game Designers, Artists, Engineers, Product Managers, and Producers throughout feature development.
* Familiarity with Unity-based game production is highly valuable.
* Comfort using AI-assisted or rapid-prototyping tools to explore and validate design solutions faster is a plus.

Portfolio
---------

A strong portfolio is essential for this role.

We are particularly interested in examples that demonstrate:

* Shipped mobile and F2P game experiences
* User flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes
* Evolution from early UX concepts to final shipped UI
* Gameplay, onboarding, progression, rewards, LiveOps, or monetization UX
* Examples where you simplified a complex feature or solved a meaningful usability problem
* Your individual contribution versus the work of the broader team

Case studies showing *how you arrived at a solution* are especially valuable. We want to understand the problem, the alternatives you explored, the decisions you made, and how the experience evolved through implementation.

*Benefits*

Why Join UserWise
-----------------

* Own the UX of a flagship mobile game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.
* Have significant influence over the product while it is still actively being shaped.
* Work in a lean team where UI/UX is central to the game experience rather than a downstream production function.
* Establish the UX processes, standards, and design systems that guide the project.
* Experiment with rapid prototyping and AI-assisted workflows to increase iteration speed and design quality.
* 100% remote, flexible work with a small, experienced team.

What We Offer
-------------

* Market-competitive compensation
* Paid Time Off
* Performance Bonus
* Annual Performance Reviews

title: Middle Product Designer (UI-first)
description:
Про компанію

Ми — Trendy ELD, компанія, що працює у сфері ELD (Electronic Logging Devices) та рішень для USA logistics. Допомагаємо перевізникам та водіям дотримуватись вимог FMCSA, автоматизувати процеси та ефективно керувати своїм автопарком.

Шукаємо Middle Product Designer з сильним UI / Visual Craft та продуктовим мисленням.

Нам потрібен дизайнер, який не просто створює макети, а може самостійно вести фічу від бізнес-запиту до production: розібратися в задачі → продумати flow → створити prototype → зробити UI → пройти розробку → перевірити результат та ітерувати.

Основні робочі задачі:
Створювати та розвивати UI для SaaS-продуктів (web + mobile).
Працювати з dashboards, admin panels, tables, forms, complex workflows, onboarding та іншими складними продуктовими сценаріями.
Перетворювати бізнес- та продуктові вимоги на зрозумілі, масштабовані та зручні рішення.
Опрацьовувати UX-складову: workflows, edge cases, JTBD та взаємозв’язки між різними частинами продукту.
Розвивати існуючі продукти, працювати з design system, legacy та продуктовими обмеженнями.
Готувати дизайн до розробки та тісно взаємодіяти з Dev-командою.
Перевіряти реалізацію дизайну після розробки та контролювати відповідність готового рішення макетам і продуктовим вимогам.
Створювати інтерактивні прототипи та використовувати AI / no-code / code-інструменти для швидкої перевірки ідей.

Що для нас буде важливо
Сильний UI-first підхід і високий рівень visual craft.
Product mindset — бажання зрозуміти проблему та знайти найкраще рішення, а не просто «намалювати екран».
Розуміння сучасного product workflow та ролі дизайнера на різних етапах розробки.
Уміння спрощувати складні сценарії, створювати зрозумілі workflows та передбачати edge cases.
Здатність бачити вплив дизайнерських рішень на весь продукт, а не лише на окремий екран чи фічу.
Досвід розвитку існуючих SaaS-продуктів та роботи з legacy.
Здатність вести задачу від проблеми та гіпотез до релізу й наступних ітерацій.
Готовність використовувати сучасні AI та no-code/code-інструменти у роботі.
Самостійність, відповідальність та вміння аргументувати свої рішення.
Готовність до тісної роботи з Product та Dev-командами.
English — Intermediate+.

Що буде у фокусі ролі
У першу чергу важливо повністю закривати дизайн-напрям продуктів — від UI до UX та всіх операційних продуктових сценаріїв.

Водночас у ролі буде можливість поступово виходити за межі класичного UI/UX та долучатися до Product Discovery і створення нових великих продуктових ініціатив:
участь у формуванні та перевірці нових продуктових гіпотез;
дослідження потреб користувачів та Customer Research;
участь у Product Discovery;
дослідження та перевірка Product-Market Fit;
поступове розширення зони відповідальності відповідно до досвіду та інтересів.

Як будемо працювати
Передбачається дуже тісна співпраця з Product Manager: спільний пошук рішень, брейншторми, обмін досвідом та знаннями, обговорення продуктових і організаційних питань.
Також важлива постійна взаємодія з розробниками — від підготовки дизайну до реалізації та перевірки готового функціоналу.

Ми шукаємо не просто дизайнера, який працює ізольовано над макетами, а саме партнера для розвитку продукту.

Ми пропонуємо
Фіксовану ставку у $.
Віддалений формат роботи.
Гнучкий графік у межах Business Hours — 10:00–18:00 за Києвом.
12 днів оплачуваної відпустки на рік.
6 оплачуваних днів лікарняних на рік + до 10 додаткових днів у разі екстрених ситуацій.
Часткове або повне покриття додаткового навчання — підтримуємо професійний розвиток і готові інвестувати в нього.
Можливість впливати на процеси та розвиток продукту — ми відкриті до нових ідей, пропозицій та викликів.
Гнучкий підхід до роботи — ми цінуємо ініціативність і завжди готові обговорювати нові запити, підходи та способи зробити роботу ефективнішою.
Команду, що активно розвивається, де цінують проактивність не лише у великих задачах, а й у щоденній роботі.
Відкриту комунікацію — якщо бачиш, що процес можна покращити, маєш ідею чи пропозицію, ми готові її почути та разом знайти найкраще рішення.
Можливості для професійного та кар’єрного зростання разом із компанією.

Якщо тобі близький підхід UI-first + Product Thinking і хочеться створювати не просто красиві, а сильні продуктові інтерфейси — будемо раді познайомитися.

title: Freelance Brand Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Brand Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create strong visual identities for real-world brands and products. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in brand strategy, visual identity, and design systems to create cohesive, modern, and impactful brand assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in brand asset creation, visual identity development, and maintaining brand consistency.

What We Do
----------

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role
--------------

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Brand Designer, your focus will be on brand asset creation, visual identity, and brand consistency. We need a core specialist dedicated to building a strong visual foundation. You will serve as the architect of the brand identity, modernizing aesthetics and ensuring that all visual touchpoints look cohesive across various mediums using industry-standard design tools.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Develop foundational brand assets, including logos, complete visual identities, and comprehensive color schemes.
* Create, systematically organize, and deliver necessary variations of core brand elements.
* Act as the strict gatekeeper for brand consistency across all internal and external materials, including pitch decks and social media kits.
* Build scalable, long-lasting visual systems that align with modern design standards.
* Enforce design quality through cross-platform validation, ensuring brand aesthetics translate flawlessly across both digital and print mediums.

How to get started
------------------

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

*Educational qualifications*

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in brand design, graphic design, art direction, or visual communications is desirable.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, Communication Design, or related creative fields is a plus.

*Academic and/or Professional Experience*

Candidates must have a strong portfolio heavily focused on brand identity creation, logo design, and comprehensive brand guidelines. We are looking for specialists with a deep understanding of how core branding translates seamlessly across different digital and print mediums. A strategic, detail-obsessed approach and the ability to work independently to build long-lasting visual systems are essential.

*Technical Skills (Essential)*

* Brand Identity Creation: Expertise in building foundational assets from scratch, including scalable logos, distinct color palettes, and typography systems.
* Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma for crafting and managing core design assets.
* Cross-Medium Adaptation: Proven ability to translate brand DNA perfectly across varied formats, from digital social media kits to corporate pitch decks and print materials.
* Brand System Architecture: Strong organizational skills to develop clear brand guidelines, style guides, and structured asset libraries for wider team use.

*Additional requirements*

* A strategic, detail-obsessed mindset focused on long-term brand equity.
* Strong dedication to visual consistency and functioning as a true brand gatekeeper.
* Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot independently and deliver high-quality assets.
* Portfolio showcasing branding work (logos, identity systems, guidelines) must be included in the CV
* English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations
-------------------------

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation
------------

On this project, contributors can earn up to *$34 per hour equivalent* , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

title: Digital Designer (Marketing, Social Media, Video and AI Content)
description:
About UN1Q

UN1Q is a pre-launch startup building an advanced fitness, nutrition, and wellness coaching platform across mobile, web, smartwatch, and AI-powered experiences.

Our product combines structured coaching, complex personalization systems, exercise and nutrition planning, mindset development, health and activity data, and increasingly AI-powered functionality.

As UN1Q approaches market launch, we are looking for a versatile and creative Digital Designer who can help shape how the UN1Q brand is presented across marketing, social media, presentations, video, and other customer-facing channels.

The role covers several interconnected creative areas:

Social media content
Marketing and advertising creatives
Corporate, commercial, and investor presentations
Graphic and visual design
Video editing and motion graphics
AI-assisted image and video generation
Website and digital assets
Occasional support for product and UI/UX design

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly creative and technically capable Digital Designer who can work across marketing, social media, presentations, video, and AI-generated visual content.
The primary focus of this role will be producing high-quality visual content that represents UN1Q across its marketing and communication channels.

You will create everything from social media campaigns and presentations to advertising creatives, website assets, motion graphics, and AI-generated promotional videos.

You will work closely with Marketing, Product, Management, and other teams to translate concepts, campaigns, product functionality, and business requirements into polished and engaging visual communication.

Knowledge of mobile and web UI/UX is valuable and may occasionally be required, but UI/UX is not the primary focus of this position.

Key Responsibilities

Social Media & Content Design
Create high-quality visual content for UN1Q social media channels.
Design:Social media posts
Stories
Reels and short-form video
Carousels
Promotional graphics
Educational content
Product announcements
Campaign creatives

Adapt content appropriately for different platforms, placements, formats, and aspect ratios.
Create strong visual hooks and clear, mobile-friendly communication.
Maintain visual consistency while ensuring content remains varied, modern, and engaging.
Work with Marketing to turn campaign ideas and messaging into effective visual content.

Marketing & Brand Design

Create visual assets for digital marketing and advertising campaigns.
Produce:Paid social advertising creatives
Website and landing-page visuals
Digital banners
Email marketing graphics
Promotional materials
Product-launch assets
Brand communications

Develop multiple creative variations for campaigns and A/B testing.
Adapt creatives based on campaign requirements and performance.
Maintain and evolve UN1Q's visual identity across customer-facing channels.
Ensure consistent use of typography, colors, imagery, layouts, and overall visual language.

Presentations

Design professional, visually engaging presentations for:Investors
Partners
Corporate clients
Internal stakeholders
Product demonstrations
Sales and business development

Translate complex information, product functionality, data, and business concepts into clear visual stories.
Create charts, diagrams, infographics, layouts, and other presentation assets.
Maintain consistent presentation templates and visual standards.
Improve existing presentations and transform rough content into polished, presentation-ready materials.

AI Image & Video Generation

Incorporate generative AI tools into the creative production workflow.
Generate and refine:Marketing imagery
Campaign concepts
Characters and scenes
Backgrounds
Product visuals
Social media assets
Promotional videos

Produce AI-assisted video content for social media, advertising, product campaigns, and brand storytelling.
Work with text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, and image-to-video workflows.
Understand prompting, reference-image workflows, visual consistency, and iterative generation.
Maintain consistency between characters, products, scenes, and brand elements across generated content.
Combine AI-generated material with conventional editing, compositing, typography, sound, and motion graphics to produce professional finished assets.
Critically evaluate and refine AI-generated outputs rather than using raw generations without appropriate creative control.
Keep up to date with emerging AI image, video, and creative-production technologies.

Video Editing & Motion Design

Edit short-form marketing and social media videos.
Create motion graphics, animated typography, transitions, and promotional animations.
Combine filmed, stock, product, graphic, and AI-generated material into cohesive finished content.
Adapt video content for social media and advertising formats.
Support storyboarding, shot planning, and creative concept development where required.
Apply an understanding of pacing, visual hooks, retention, music, sound, and storytelling to short-form content.
Graphic Design & Creative Production
Create high-quality graphic assets using professional design software.
Work with photography, illustrations, typography, icons, graphics, and other visual elements.
Retouch and manipulate images where required.
Prepare assets correctly for digital platforms, presentations, marketing campaigns, and websites.
Maintain organized source files, templates, brand assets, and reusable creative resources.
Ensure final deliverables meet appropriate quality and format requirements.

Collaboration & Delivery

Work closely with Marketing on campaigns, content, and creative direction.
Collaborate with Management and Business Development on presentations and commercial materials.
Collaborate with Product teams when product visuals or UI assets are required.
Understand briefs and independently translate them into strong creative concepts.
Manage several parallel creative requirements and priorities.
Take ownership of assigned work from initial concept through final production.
Work quickly when required while maintaining appropriate visual quality and consistency.

Requirements

4+ years of professional experience in Digital Design, Graphic Design, Marketing Design, Visual Design, Content Design, or a comparable multidisciplinary creative role.
A strong professional portfolio demonstrating high-quality commercial creative work.
Strong proficiency with Adobe Photoshop.
Strong proficiency with Adobe Illustrator or comparable vector-design software.
Experience with Adobe After Effects or comparable motion-design software.
Strong video-editing capabilities using Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or comparable professional tools.
Strong understanding of:Typography
Layout
Composition
Color
Visual hierarchy
Branding

Experience creating social media content and digital marketing creatives.
Experience designing professional presentations.
Experience creating advertising and campaign assets.
Experience with image editing, manipulation, retouching, and compositing.
Experience with motion graphics and short-form video production.
Hands-on experience using modern AI image-generation tools.
Hands-on experience using AI video-generation tools and workflows.
Ability to combine AI-generated content with traditional design and editing workflows.
Strong ability to evaluate and refine AI outputs rather than relying entirely on automated generation.
Ability to maintain visual and brand consistency across different types of content.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple creative projects simultaneously.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced startup environment.
Strong communication skills in English.

Important

This is a multidisciplinary digital and content design role, with the immediate priority being:
Marketing, social media, presentations, graphic design, video editing, and AI-generated content.
We are looking for a designer with strong traditional design fundamentals who is also comfortable using modern AI tools to significantly expand and accelerate the creative-production process.
AI tools should be treated as an extension of the designer's creative capabilities rather than a replacement for design knowledge, visual judgment, and professional editing skills.
The role may occasionally support product, web, and mobile UI/UX requirements; however, UI/UX is not the primary responsibility of this position.

The Following Will Be Considered an Advantage
Experience with Figma.
Experience with product design and UI/UX.
Experience designing mobile applications.
Experience designing responsive websites and web applications.
Understanding of iOS and Android design principles.
Experience working with design systems and reusable UI components.
Experience designing smartwatch or wearable interfaces.
Experience with UX research or usability principles.
Experience working directly with software developers.
Advanced Adobe After Effects and motion-design skills.
3D design, animation, rendering, or compositing experience.
Photography or videography experience.
Illustration skills.
Experience developing brand identities and visual guidelines.
Experience creating data visualizations and infographics.
Experience producing investor or fundraising presentations.
Experience producing B2B sales and commercial presentations.
Experience creating content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and similar platforms.
Understanding of performance-marketing creative principles.
Experience creating and evaluating creative variations for A/B testing.
Advanced experience with AI-assisted image and video production.
Experience maintaining character, product, or scene consistency across AI-generated content.
Experience with AI voice, lip-sync, avatar, or generative motion workflows.
Experience with fitness, wellness, health, lifestyle, or technology brands.
Experience working in startup or fast-scaling environments.

Why Join Us?

Competitive compensation package aligned with your experience, creative ability, and contribution to the company.
Join a fast-growing and fast-paced startup environment where creative requirements continuously evolve and you will work across a wide range of projects.
Take meaningful ownership of how UN1Q is visually presented across social media, marketing, presentations, video, and digital channels.
Work across multiple creative disciplines rather than being restricted to one narrow area of design.
Work alongside an experienced team across Marketing, Product, Technology, Business Development, and Management.
Work directly with a hands-on CEO who understands the product from start to finish, including its scientific methodology, business logic, user experience, and long-term vision.
Gain hands-on experience with rapidly evolving AI image and video-generation technologies and apply them to real commercial creative production.
Help develop the visual identity of a new consumer technology brand as it moves into the market.
Join UN1Q at an exciting stage as we move from pre-launch development into market release, customer acquisition, growth, and expansion.

title: Principal Product Designer
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

*Principal Product Designer – Infrastructure*

*Your opportunity*
------------------

As a Principal Product Designer on New Relic's Infrastructure design team, you'll set the design vision for how engineers understand and operate the systems underneath their applications — cloud environments, Kubernetes, hosts, network performance (including eBPF-based instrumentation), and databases, partnering directly with VP- and SVP-level engineering and product leadership to shape a roadmap with measurable business impact. You'll work across the US and India to turn dense infrastructure telemetry into interfaces that hold up when something is actually on fire.

We care more about how you think than what you've already shipped. This role is built for someone with genuine, demonstrated curiosity about how complex technical systems work — someone who has a track record of digging into unfamiliar domains, asking good questions of engineers, and building real fluency rather than treating the underlying technology as a black box. Direct observability experience is a plus, not a prerequisite. The expectation for this role is someone who generates the ideas required to solve a problem even when it's ambiguous, and who leads through that complexity rather than waiting for someone else to define it.

You'll set craft and design-system standards across the Infrastructure design team, mentor senior and mid-level designers beyond a single direct pod, and be a visible design leader recognized by teams inside and outside the department as we evolve how we use AI in our own design workflow. This is a remote role based in India, working in close daily overlap with a US-based team.

*What you'll do*
----------------

* *Infrastructure & complex data visualization* : Design dashboards and visualizations that make cloud, Kubernetes, host, network, and database telemetry legible — reducing cognitive load for engineers troubleshooting under pressure.
* *System coherence & fail-safe UX* : Champion coherence across the Infrastructure surface, designing interaction patterns that guide platform engineers and SREs safely through incident response and root-cause investigation.
* *Own the product vision* : Lead the creation of new product vision for Infrastructure with a clear line to business revenue impact, serving as the primary design point of contact across product, engineering, and go-to-market.
* *Go deep on the technology* : Build real fluency in the systems you're designing for — cloud architecture, container orchestration, network protocols, eBPF, database internals — through direct conversations with engineers, hands-on exploration, and a genuine appetite for the technical detail most designers skip.
* *User research* : Plan and run interviews and usability testing with SREs, platform engineers, and DevOps practitioners to validate design direction and keep the roadmap grounded in how these users actually work.
* *AI-forward evolution* : Partner with engineering and product to bring AI-assisted diagnostics and anomaly detection into the infrastructure experience, applying the same curiosity to new AI tooling that you bring to the underlying systems.
* *Team leadership & craft* : Set the craft bar across Infrastructure design, mentor senior and mid-level designers, and represent the team's design perspective directly to VP and SVP stakeholders.
* *Design at scale* : Drive large-scale, cross-team design initiatives within Infrastructure, and partner with principal designers across Product Platform and Growth & Monetization to keep the broader platform coherent as it expands.

*This role requires*
--------------------

* 12+ years of professional experience in product or UX design, with a portfolio showing complex, data-heavy B2B SaaS or enterprise work.
* Demonstrated, innate curiosity about technology — evidence that you've taught yourself unfamiliar technical domains in past roles, not just applied design process to whatever was handed to you.
* Experience designing for technical personas (software engineers, SREs, DevOps, platform engineers), or a clear, credible path to ramping into this audience quickly.
* Real skill in user research: interviews, usability testing, and synthesis that changes product direction, not just validates it.
* Advanced proficiency in Figma and experience building or contributing to component-based design systems at scale, including a demonstrated ability to design systems-level solutions rather than instance by instance.
* Solid grasp of WCAG 2.1 AA and assistive technologies, with the ability to independently troubleshoot accessibility issues and mentor others on accessible design practices.
* Ability to connect design work to business outcomes — mapping initiatives to KPIs/OKRs and making the case for design decisions in terms product and engineering partners respect, including a track record of tying design work to measurable revenue impact, not just usability metrics.
* Strong written and verbal English, and comfort working with a distributed team across US and India time zones.
* A track record operating independently across multiple teams in a complex environment, with real experience partnering directly with VP- or SVP-level stakeholders on strategic initiatives.
* An external professional presence in the design community — conferences, writing, mentorship beyond New Relic — consistent with the seniority of this level.

*Bonus points if you have*
--------------------------

* Direct experience in observability, infrastructure monitoring, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI), or adjacent developer-facing tooling.
* Prior exposure to designing for AI-assisted or LLM-based tools, and comfort prototyping with AI-native tools (Figma AI, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.).
* A working understanding of frontend fundamentals (HTML, CSS, React) that makes engineering handoff smoother.
* Strong facilitation skills for cross-functional design sprints and workshops.

*BUSINESS GOALS*
----------------

This hire addresses cognitive overload during infrastructure incident response — the gap between a high-level "something's wrong" signal and the granular cloud, cluster, host, network, or database trace that explains why. As New Relic's Infrastructure suite absorbs more surface area (AI-agent observability, expanding eBPF coverage, deeper database monitoring), we need a design leader who can set a portfolio-level vision for that complexity — one with a credible line to business revenue and adoption, not just a well-designed feature. The end goal is the same one driving the whole design org right now: bringing AI into the diagnostic workflow to cut customer mean-time-to-resolution.

*What are the key milestones or business outcomes this person must deliver in Year 1 to be considered a successful hire?*

* Unify infrastructure workflows: audit and connect monitoring and mitigation pathways across cloud, Kubernetes, host, network, and database surfaces, establishing a portfolio-level design vision with measurable adoption and revenue impact, not just shared visual patterns.
* AI-assisted diagnostics: deliver initial UX architecture and human-in-the-loop interaction models for AI-assisted anomaly detection and root-cause analysis in Infrastructure.
* Process maturation: help standardize cross-functional design review between design, product, and engineering on complex telemetry pipelines (OpenTelemetry, eBPF-based instrumentation).
* Research cadence: stand up a continuous research loop with SREs and platform engineers to keep the roadmap grounded in real operating conditions, not assumptions.
* Executive partnership: build a working relationship with VP/SVP engineering and product leadership, and with peer principal designers across Product Platform and Growth & Monetization, so Infrastructure's design vision holds together with the rest of the platform.
