title: Product Design Lead - Design System
location: Remote, India; Remote, London, United Kingdom; Remote, Nigeria
description:
*Who we are*

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial ecosystem, helping 10 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, and business management tools since 2019. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, it powers most of the country’s Point of Sale (POS) transactions. Through its subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes $22 billion monthly for its customers while operating profitably.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

*About This Role*
We are looking for a Product Design Lead-Design System who thinks at a system level and understands how to create a scalable UI ecosystem that spans multiple products, teams, and platforms. You are not just designing static screens; you are building the foundation of our product user interfaces.
In this role, you will take full ownership of our component libraries, interaction models, and cross-platform design consistency. You will act as the bridge between design and engineering, ensuring that our visual assets translate seamlessly into clean, reusable, and accessible production code.

*Responsibilities*

* *UI Craft & Visual Excellence:* Maintain an exceptionally high standard for layout, typography, colour, spacing, visual hierarchy, and overall digital finish across all reusable elements.
* *Component Architecture* : Design, build, and maintain robust component libraries (buttons, inputs, cards, navigation, forms, tables, etc.) that scale seamlessly across products.
* *Interaction & Motion Design:* Define interactive behaviors and state transitions (e.g., hover, focus, disabled, loading, and mobile behaviors) to ensure components feel alive and intuitive.
* *Design Token Management:* Structure and maintain design tokens (colours, spacing, typography, border-radius, shadows) to drive consistency between design environments and code.
* *Figma Library Architecture:* Organize complex variants, properties, and components within Figma to empower other product designers to build quickly and accurately.
* *Engineering Collaboration:* Partner closely with engineering teams to navigate technical constraints across Web, React, Flutter, Android, and iOS/Native app environments.
* *Documentation & Governance:* Create clear, comprehensive usage guidelines and documentation outlining when, why, and how components should (and should not) be used.

*Experience & Background*

* Proven Design System Track Record: Extensive experience building, scaling, and maintaining production-ready design systems rather than just standalone product features.
* Cross-Platform Expertise: Deep understanding of the constraints and guidelines governing multiple platforms, including Web, iOS, and Android.
* Systems-Thinking Mindset: A portfolio demonstrating how individual design decisions impact multiple products, scale sustainably, and optimize designer/engineer workflows.
* Front-End Alignment: Strong familiarity with how developers inspect, build, and consume components in code repositories.

*Skills & Competencies*

* Expert Figma Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of Figma libraries, auto-layout, components, variants, variables, and library publication.
* Accessibility Champion: Solid grasp of accessibility standards (WCAG), contrast requirements, and inclusive design principles.
* Technical Literacy: Familiarity with component-driven frameworks (React, Flutter) and Atomic Design methodology.
* Communication & Documentation: Excellent writing and presentation skills, with an ability to translate complex design system choices into clear executive-level updates and technical guidelines.

*What Success Looks Like in This Role*

* High Adoption & Efficiency: Design and engineering teams actively use the system, resulting in significantly accelerated product shipping cycles.
* Flawless Cross-Platform Consistency: A unified look, feel, and interactive behavior across all customer-facing touchpoints (Web, Android, iOS).
* Best-in-Class Documentation: A central, living source of truth that leaves no ambiguity regarding design tokens, component rules, or brand compliance.
* Scalable Architecture: A foundational library that handles future product expansions, rebrands, or theme changes with minimal friction.

*Why Join Us*

* Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.
* Fully remote work culture and support for professional development.

*What to expect in the hiring process*

* Application & portfolio review: we assess your experience, leadership impact, and Design System case studies that demonstrate strategic thinking, process, and measurable outcomes.
* Preliminary phone call with recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, leadership experience, and expectations.
* Interview with senior leadership: a deep dive into your leadership approach, design philosophy, and ability to drive impact. This includes a discussion on past projects and collaboration with cross-functional teams.
* Design leadership challenge: a scenario-based assessment to assess both strategic thinking and leadership skills while balancing UX/UI expertise.
* Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership to assess alignment with our vision, strategic thinking, and team-building philosophy.

*How to apply:*

Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your leadership in managing design teams, driving strategy, and delivering user-centred solutions with measurable business impact. We want to see case studies that demonstrate how you have led and developed designers, prioritised and managed projects, and fostered a high-performing team culture. Your portfolio should highlight how you have used research, data, and experimentation to inform decisions, optimise workflows, and drive success metrics.

**************************
*Roles & Responsibilities*
**************************

***********************************
Job Title – Senior Graphic Designer

**************

We are seeking a highly creative, strategic, and forward-thinking *Senior Graphic Designer* to help shape and elevate our brand across every touchpoint. This role is ideal for a multidisciplinary designer who excels in branding, visual storytelling, collateral development, video editing, motion graphics, website design, presentation design, environmental graphics, and scalable self-service creative solutions.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional design craftsmanship with a deep understanding of typography, audience engagement, and brand strategy. They are equally comfortable developing executive-level presentations for the C-suite, creating enterprise design systems, editing videos, building Canva templates, and leveraging AI-powered tools to improve efficiency and creative impact.

This role requires a collaborative creative partner who can work directly with executive leaders, translate complex business concepts into compelling visual narratives, and ensure brand consistency across all channels.

*Brand Leadership & Visual Storytelling*

* Serve as a steward of the brand, ensuring consistency across all internal and external communications.
* Translate complex ideas, data, and business strategies into compelling visual stories.
* Develop creative concepts that support marketing campaigns, executive communications, customer engagement, events, and strategic initiatives.

* Brochures
* One-pagers
* White papers
* Case studies
* Infographics
* Sales enablement materials
* Event materials
* Signage
* Direct mail
* Promotional assets

* Create integrated campaign assets that deliver a consistent brand experience across multiple channels.
* Maintain exceptional attention to detail and design quality throughout all project phases.

*Typography & Design Excellence*

* Apply best practices in layout, visual hierarchy, color theory, spacing, and accessibility.
* Elevate the quality of creative work through thoughtful design decisions and strong visual craftsmanship.
* Transform complex information into engaging, easy-to-understand visual experiences.

*Executive & C-Suite Communications*

* Design executive-level PowerPoint presentations for leadership meetings, board presentations, customer engagements, keynote presentations, and corporate events.
* Partner directly with executive leaders and C-suite stakeholders to develop impactful visual communications.
* Translate strategic initiatives, business results, and organizational priorities into compelling presentation narratives.
* Create reusable presentation templates, slide libraries, and storytelling frameworks that support executive communications.

*Video Editing & Motion Graphics*

* Edit short-form and long-form video content for marketing, social media, events, product launches, webinars, and executive communications.
* Create motion graphics, animated explainers, title sequences, transitions, and branded video assets.
* Repurpose video content into multiple formats for use across various channels.
* Support video production efforts through storyboarding, asset creation, editing, and post-production.

*Website & Digital Experience Design*

* Design and maintain web pages, landing pages, microsites, and digital experiences.
* Collaborate with marketing, content, and development teams to improve user experience and visual consistency.
* Ensure designs follow accessibility standards and responsive design best practices.

description:

* *Printer & IoT Fleet Validation:* Own end-to-end quality for Workspace ONE's Printer & IoT device management capabilities across both the legacy connector model and the modern MQTT/AWS IoT architecture, from enrollment through decommissioning.

-------------------------
*What We Are Looking For*
-------------------------

* *UEM/MDM Depth:* Deep architectural understanding of platforms like Workspace ONE, Intune, or JAMF—enrollment pipelines, policy engines, compliance state machines, certificate lifecycle, and OS-level MDM protocols.

*Printer & IoT Management — Role-Specific Skills*

* *Firmware Management Validation:* Ability to test firmware push/pull workflows delivered through MQTT or OEM connectors, including OTA-style updates that replace manual OEM tools (e.g., Zebra PPME).

* *Telemetry & Alerting Pipeline QA:* Ability to verify printer/IoT device data (status, firmware version, error states, consumables) flows correctly into Workspace ONE Intelligence via the ETL pipeline, and that resulting alerts and dashboards are accurate.
* *Sampling, Check-In & Escalation Readiness:* Understanding of scheduled sampling/check-in sync flows and ability to validate and collect escalation artifacts (device-side logs, IoT service logs, broker logs) for troubleshooting.

* Leadership experience mentoring others and driving quality initiatives across teams.
* Curiosity & Systems Thinking with a drive to understand how things work end-to-end.

* Supportive leadership prioritizing clarity, empathy, and growth.
* Impactful work shaping modern management for millions of devices globally, including the fast-growing printer and IoT device fleet.
* Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and a culture rewarding technical excellence.

description:
*Who we are*

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

*Hiring and how we work*

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

*See yourself at Twilio*

Join the team as Twilio’s next Product Data Analyst (L3)

*About the job*

This position is needed to help uncover and deliver product data, analysis, and insights that empower stakeholders at all levels to maximize the impact of data in decision making. Our team is expanding to provide meaningful, data-backed insights from which to develop and grow our industry leading communications products.You will own analytics workstreams end to end from ambiguous problem statements to deliver insights in a fast moving environment.

*Responsibilities*

In this role, you’ll:

* End-to-End Analytics: Own complex projects from scoping ambiguous problems to delivering actionable, data-driven insights.
* Product Strategy: Partner with PMs to define metrics, build reporting dashboards, and inject data into product planning.
* Technical Execution: Apply SQL and visualization tools (Looker, Tableau) to translate complex data into clear stakeholder recommendations.
* Data Standardisation: Maintain and document metrics, datasets, and models using Confluence and Datahub to ensure a single source of truth.
* Project Management: Balance multiple concurrent initiatives with clear prioritization and proactive status updates.
* Quality Assurance: Maintain rigorous data quality standards through robust validation and transparent quality control.
* AI-Driven Efficiency: Integrate modern AI tools into daily workflows to speed up SQL coding, analysis, and documentation.

*Qualifications*

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:*

* Professional Experience: 4+ years of experience in quantitative analysis, business intelligence, or data analytics, with a proven track record of converting complex, ambiguous data into actionable business results.
* Core Technical Skills: 4+ years of hands-on experience writing, optimizing, and performing quality assurance (QA) in SQL or relational database languages on a regular basis.
* Data Visualization: Proficiency with modern BI tools, with a strong preference for Tableau and Looker (LookML).
* Structured Problem Solving: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to decompose vague problem statements into clear, executable data strategies.
* End-to-End Ownership: Demonstrated ability to independently manage deliverables from initial requirement gathering through to stakeholder delivery with minimal guidance.
* Project Delivery: Exceptional organizational skills with a track record of juggling multiple competing priorities and driving tasks to completion with reliable follow-through.
* Communication & Stakeholder influence: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate analytics insights into clear narratives and action items that influence stakeholder decisions

*Desired:*

* AI & Innovation: Experience leveraging LLMs/AI tools to accelerate analytics workflows, combined with a strong curiosity to continuously upskill as technology evolves.
* Data Engineering & Infrastructure: Familiarity with data warehousing concepts, ETL processes, and distributed computing frameworks such as AWS Glue, Spark, DBT, Athena.
* Advanced Analytics: Proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn) or R for statistical modeling, regression analysis, hypothesis testing, and causal inference.

*Location*

This role will be remote, and based in India (only in Karnataka, Tamil nadu, Maharashtra, Telangana, Delhi)

*Travel*

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

*What We Offer*

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

*Twilio thinks big. Do you?*

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

*.*

*Stay alert to recruitment fraud*

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

. **

*Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.* We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

The work you do will directly shape how we price, how we allocate capital, and how we support executive decision-making through financial insights and planning.

title: Account Executive II - Nordics
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for an Account Executive to join our Commercial Nordics Sales Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help drive the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals and be part of a collaborative and successful sales unit as we scale Pleo's expense management solution. If you're excited about converting new business and are passionate about SaaS outbound sales this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to our Sales Manager and work closely with teams in SDRs, Customer Success and Marketing. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to achieving revenue goals. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across product to ensure success

What you’ll be doing

As an Account Executive, you will:

- Own the entire sales cycle - from outbound to qualification, product demos and deal conversion.

- Achieve new business revenue targets - focusing on building new relationships.

- Collaborate closely with the Customer Success team - to ensure the customers in your portfolio successfully adopt with Pleo.

- Become an expert in expense management.

- Give outstanding product presentations - acing those demos to get deals closed.

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You’re comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and enjoy taking ownership.

- You’re able to collaborate effectively across teams and stakeholders.

- You’re proactive, pragmatic, and motivated by making a tangible impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You’re looking for a role with very limited ambiguity or change.

- You prefer to work independently without much cross-functional collaboration.

- You’re not comfortable taking ownership and driving things forward proactively.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

- Close your first key deals to drive impact in new business revenue

- Build your own pipeline

- Grow your skills in SaaS sales and expense management, taking on new challenges as Pleo continues to scale

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in [specific area].

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

2. Hiring Manager Call: 45 mins to meet with Sales leadership, here they will look to discuss your experience and relevance in greater detail. Understanding strengths and weaknesses.

3. Pleo Challenge: A 60 mins, here we look to dive deeper. This interview will be split into 2 sections 30 min mock Discovery Call, and a 15 min Pleo presentation as an Account Executive with 15 min Q&A.

4. Final Interview; 30 mins with a Senior Sales Leader.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a [job title], we received a total of XXX applications but only XX were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

- CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

- Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

- Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Applied AI Intern - Warsaw
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. Snowflake is building the data and applications platform for the AI era. We are looking for an Applied AI Intern to join our engineering team in Warsaw and help build, evaluate, and deploy AI applications for real customer use cases.

You will work with experienced AI engineers and researchers on production-oriented systems such as AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, LLM integrations, and data applications. You will gain experience taking a solution from prototype to production and contributing to reusable engineering assets and platform improvements.

What We Offer

- Paid, full-time internship on the Applied AI engineering team

- Mentorship, regular feedback, and support from experienced AI engineers and researchers

- Hands-on work with Snowflake Cortex, Snowpark, Python, SQL, and modern AI development tools

- Exposure to the engineering lifecycle, including design, implementation, evaluation, testing, deployment, and monitoring

- Opportunities to present your work, collaborate with Product and Engineering, and be considered for future full-time or internship roles

What You Will Do

- Build and iterate on AI pipelines, agents, and data applications within team-led customer or product engagements

- Turn business goals into engineering tasks, prototypes, and measurable outcomes with guidance from senior engineers

- Contribute to evaluation frameworks, test datasets, observability, and experiments that improve AI quality

- Help productionize solutions through reliability, safety guardrails, monitoring, and human-review workflows

- Collaborate with customer data science and engineering teams while writing clean, tested Python and SQL

- Participate in design reviews, code reviews, debugging, documentation, and other software development activities

What We Expect

- Currently pursuing or recently completed (within the last 12 months) a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field

- Interest in ML, LLMs, generative AI, RAG, AI agents, or data-intensive applications

- Strong programming skills in Python

- Familiarity with version control, testing, debugging, and code reviews

- Ability to work independently on well-scoped tasks, collaborate effectively, and communicate technical ideas clearly

Nice to Have

- A project involving LLMs, RAG, agents, machine learning, or data systems

- Experience with Snowflake, Snowpark, Cortex, Streamlit, Spark, or AWS, Azure, or GCP

- Understanding of distributed systems, model serving, or inference infrastructure

- Experience creating evaluation datasets, test suites, benchmarks, or observability for AI systems

- Previous internship, research, open-source, or personal software engineering experience

What You Will Learn

- How to build and deploy production-oriented AI applications, including agents, RAG systems, and LLM integrations

- How to define quality metrics, evaluate AI behavior, and use structured testing to identify failure modes and prevent regressions

- How to apply reliability, safety, monitoring, observability, and human-in-the-loop practices

- How to scope ambiguous problems, make engineering trade-offs, collaborate with customers, and present technical work

Internship Details

- Location: Warsaw, Poland

- Duration: Minimum 4 months; 6 months recommended; up to 12 months supported

- Working arrangement: Full-time

Join the Security Platform team at the heart of this revolution, where YOU will lead the charge in building the identity and access foundation that customers trust to protect their most sensitive data and AI workloads. Identity and access management is both the foundation and the catalyst for Snowflake's bold mission — and your work will directly shape how thousands of organizations govern access at global scale.

As a Senior Product Manager in our fast-moving, hands-on, customer-focused team, you'll drive innovative IAM and authorization solutions that give customers precise control over who can see, do, and build on their data. You'll have ownership of delivering cutting-edge capabilities including role-based access control (RBAC), privilege management, identity governance, authentication policy enforcement, and AI-powered access intelligence experiences.

You will team up with talented engineers, collaborate across functions, and shape the roadmap for IAM products that not only meet industry best practices but set new standards for least-privilege access in the cloud data ecosystem.

AS A SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

- Own and manage the product roadmap for Snowflake's role-based access control (RBAC) and IAM platform, including privilege management, identity governance, and authentication policy enforcement

- Translate complex authorization and identity requirements into detailed product specs and user stories for the Snowflake platform

- Leverage AI to deliver intelligent access governance experiences on Snowflake, from privilege recommendations and access intelligence to anomaly detection

- Shape how Snowflake governs access for AI agents and non-human identities, an emerging frontier in identity security

- Engage directly with security and IAM teams at enterprise customers to deeply understand their access control pain points, compliance requirements, and governance workflows

- Define and track success metrics for adoption of IAM features including role hierarchies, privilege grants, and policy enforcement

- Collaborate with engineering and cross-functional teams (compliance, legal, enterprise security) to ensure successful product launches

OUR IDEAL SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER WILL HAVE:

- 5+ years of product management experience with successful product launches

- Deep understanding of identity and access management concepts: RBAC, ABAC, privilege management, least-privilege principles, identity governance, and authentication policies

- Technical credibility to engage in architectural discussions around authorization models, token-based identity, and directory integrations (SAML, SCIM, OAuth, OIDC)

- Experience defining and launching IAM or access control products in a cloud or SaaS environment

- Familiarity with enterprise IAM compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, ISO 27001) and how access governance feeds into audit workflows

- Strong customer empathy and problem-solving abilities, especially the ability to translate compliance and security team needs into elegant, scalable product solutions

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills across both technical and non-technical stakeholders

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

- Experience with agentic AI identity, non-human identity governance, or authorization for autonomous workloads (MCP, workload identity)

- Familiarity with AI-driven access intelligence, continuous least-privilege enforcement, or identity threat detection

- Exposure to building products that serve CISOs, VPs of Identity, and enterprise security buyers

- Understanding of Zero Trust architectures and modern authentication standards (FIDO2, WebAuthn, passkeys)

title: Director, India
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

Job Posted: September 2026

Location: India

Hi there!

We're looking for a Director, India to serve as the senior-most, India-based leader of Zapier's India entity, acting as both a statutory Board Director and General Manager. This is a pivotal role at a formative stage of our India presence: you'll ensure full legal, tax, and regulatory compliance for our India entity while also serving as the bridge between Zapier's global strategy and its execution on the ground.

You'll report to Ryan Roccon, our Chief Operating Officer and Chief Financial Officer, and partner closely with our India-based managers, our Operating Committee, and our external advisors at Deloitte. You'll own India operations as the accountable local leader, drive delivery and performance across India-based functions, and represent the entity to auditors and regulators. If you're looking for a role where you can build governance rhythms and operating discipline from the ground up while being the trusted face of a company's India presence, this is it.

- Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

- Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

- Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

- Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

- Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/

About You

- You have 15-20+ years of experience, including 5+ years in India site leadership, GM, COO, or country-head-type roles for multinational companies.

- You have strong business acumen and the ability to manage stakeholders in a global, matrix organization, where functional teams report to global leaders while maintaining a dotted-line relationship to you.

- You have strong knowledge of and exposure to financial, legal entity, and statutory compliance, audit, tax, and transfer pricing, gained through demonstrated experience working with Big 4 firms and/or legal counsel on India entity matters.

- You have strong people leadership and hiring instincts, with experience across hiring, performance management, employee relations, and exits in an Indian context.

- You're comfortable taking on statutory director responsibilities and signing off on board and compliance documents, including the personal liability that comes with it.

- You build positive working relationships and trust quickly with India-based teams, delivery managers, and the global executive team, and develop a deep understanding of the business, strategy, operations, and priorities.

- You're an effective communicator who can drive results and hold your ground in a complex, matrixed environment while remaining people-focused.

- Nice to have: prior experience setting up or scaling a Global Capability Center in India.

Things You'll Do

- Serve as the primary liaison between Zapier's India operations and global leadership, ensuring alignment and coordination and escalating key issues to the executive team.

- Lead overall India operations, translating global strategy into local execution and providing regular updates to US leadership.

- Serve as the senior-most site leader for all India-based employees, establishing governance rhythms and driving a high-performance, high-autonomy, values-driven 100% remote team.

- Act as a statutory Board Director for Zapier India: attend board meetings, approve minutes and resolutions and sign statutory filings.

- Ensure full statutory, tax, and financial compliance of the Indian legal entity, and serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors and Indian regulatory authorities.

- Partner with Deloitte and internal finance on tax filings, audits, transfer pricing, and other regulatory matters.

- Own all India people decisions: hiring, compensation, performance, and terminations, while functional managers continue to run day-to-day work for their teams.

- Partner with HR on people strategy, talent decisions, employee relations, and local policy implementation, and ensure compliance with Indian labor law, including POSH and state-specific requirements.

- Manage local vendor relationships for Zapier's India presence.

- Identify, monitor, and mitigate key risks to Zapier's India operations.

HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. title: UI Engineer (New Grad)
description:
*Mission:* Live at the intersection of app runtime & security. Protect applications in a fundamental way so that developers can build great application services and not be constantly looking over their shoulder. BlueRock is changing the landscape of App runtime security.

--------
The role
--------

You will work within the control plane development team on BlueRock's operator consoles: the React front ends that engineers and security teams use to manage large fleets of protected nodes, see what AI agents are actually doing across those fleets, and author the policy that constrains them.

The domain is AI and agentic systems, viewed from the operations and security side. When an agent calls an MCP server, spawns a subagent, runs a shell command in a sandbox, or burns $40 of tokens in an afternoon, our UI is where a human sees it, understands it, and decides what to allow. That means the interesting problems are visibility problems (how do you show a thousand agent sessions so a person can find the one that matters) and control problems, such as how you author an enforcement policy without a mistake taking production down.

The work is mainly done with AI. Claude Code. Cursor, Codex are part of the normal toolchain here for reading unfamiliar code, drafting changes, and reviewing diffs. Getting good at directing it. Knowing what to delegate, what to verify yourself, and how to tell a plausible answer from a correct one — is part of the job and part of what you will get better at.

------------------------
What the work looks like
------------------------

You start close to the product, on work that is scoped enough to finish and real enough to matter:

*

Fixing UI bugs across the consoles and the Windows, Mac, Linux clients' UI layout and overflow, tooltips and popovers, empty and zero states, things that are technically correct and still confusing.

*

Filling in the gaps in a flow, such as navigation, validation, and the guard that stops someone saving a policy draft in a state that makes no sense.

*

Building and refining components in our design system, and migrating the apps onto them.

*

Data-dense views: dashboards, metric cards, charts, time-range and filter controls over large agent and fleet datasets.

*

Shipping behind feature flags, and gating what isn't ready yet.

*

You will get experience of and work within cloud environments, giving you exposure to the control planes and management platforms that power our systems.

This is how you learn the codebase and earn the room to take on bigger pieces. It is where you start, not where you stay.

-----------
Growth path
-----------

This is an early-career role, not a low-expectation one. We are hiring for engineering rigor and expecting to move you up quickly. Roughly how that goes:

*First few months: land changes safely.* Scoped bugs and small features in the consoles and in our design system. You learn the component library, the theme tokens, the API layer, and how to verify your own work.

*Next: own a surface.* Take a feature area end to end: the policy authoring flow, a dashboard, the trace viewer. That includes the design decisions, not just the implementation. You decide what the empty state says, how the progressive disclosure works, what a dense table looks like at 1200px. We will pair you with design where it helps and expect your own judgement where it doesn't.

*Then: pick your depth.* Two directions are open, and you choose:

*

*Design-leaning front end.* Interaction and information design for dense operational data: visualization, charting, the shape of the design system itself, contributing patterns other engineers build on.

*

*Full stack.* The UI is the front of a system that runs from an agent on someone's laptop, through the sensors and services that collect and enforce, into a cloud control plane and the management platform on top of it. If full stack is the career you want, the path is real: follow your own features down a layer at a time, into the API, the data layer, and the services behind it. Some of that is TypeScript, some is Rust, and we will support you picking up whatever you need on the job.

Nothing about this is a rigid ladder. It is what we will actively make room for.

-----
Stack
-----

React with TypeScript, Vite, Ant Design plus our own design system (tokens, light and dark themes), GraphQL, charting libraries for the data-dense views, and Vitest and Playwright for tests. Further back it is a mix of TypeScript and we also have applications and services that run on the desktop across Mac, Windows, and Linux, making this a multi-platform, multi-environment setup. Rust services over graph and columnar stores, on open telemetry standards.

You do not need prior experience with all of it. You do need to be comfortable with TypeScript and React and willing to read code before changing it.

--------------
What we expect
--------------

We are not looking for years on a CV. We are looking for the habits of a careful engineer, which plenty of people have on day one of their first job and some never pick up:

*

*Diagnose before you change.* Find the actual cause, which is usually a layer away from the symptom, and be able to explain why your fix addresses it. A change that makes the symptom disappear is not the same as a fix.

*

*Small, deliberate diffs.* Solve the problem in front of you. Don't refactor adjacent code on the way past, and don't build the abstraction you may need later.

*

*Fix it in one place.* When the same bug shows up in three panels, the fix belongs in the shared component, not copied three times. Knowing where a change belongs is most of the skill.

*

*Verify, then claim.* Run it, look at it, check both themes and a narrow viewport, get types and lint clean, write the test where a test is what proves it. Then say plainly what you checked and what you did not. This applies double to AI-assisted work: you own the diff, whoever drafted it.

*

*Say when you're unsure.* A requirement with two readings is a question, not a guess. Surfacing a problem early is always cheaper than discovering it in review.

------------
Requirements
------------

*

A computer science or software engineering education, or self-taught work that clearly demonstrates the same rigor. Data structures, testing, version control, and the ability to reason about and own code you did not write.

*

Working TypeScript and modern React: hooks, composition, state that lives at the right level, and an understanding of why a re-render happens.

*

CSS that holds up: flexbox and grid, overflow and scroll containers, responsive behaviour, why a tooltip or popover ends up clipped.

*

Git as a working tool. Branches, readable commits, responding to review without taking it personally.

*

Careful attention to visual detail. Much of this work is noticing that something is two pixels wrong, or that a label is technically correct and still confusing.

*

Genuine interest in the AI and agentic space, and in the operational and security questions it creates.

Nice to have: an internship, a substantial personal or open-source project, a component library or design system you have contributed to, GraphQL, charting libraries, Playwright or another E2E framework, design training or a portfolio, or experience with dense data-heavy tooling.

------------
Not required
------------

Years of professional experience. We are comfortable with this being your first or second engineering job. Also not required but nice to have: backend, security, or infrastructure experience, or any knowledge of our domain — fleet management, telemetry, agent observability, policy enforcement. We will teach that.

*About BlueRock:*

BlueRock is a well-funded, early stage cybersecurity company founded by experienced security minded entrepreneurs. Our mission is to change the game in cybersecurity. Attackers are exploiting in hours. The dependency tree is exploding. Developers are drowning in vulnerability debt. BlueRock changes the game, enabling organizations to shift from chasing CVEs and exploits to proactively protecting the foundations of applications and computing, so that developers can build great applications without looking over their shoulders.

title: Design Intern
description:
**About the role**

Go Fish is seeking a motivated, curious, and collaborative emerging designer to join our team through an immediate Design Apprenticeship. This opportunity is open to outstanding remote candidates.

As a Design Apprentice, you will work alongside Art Directors, Designers, Strategists, and Copywriters to help create thoughtful, high-impact work for a diverse range of clients. You will gain hands-on experience across brand, digital, print, paid media, and social, while building the craft, confidence, and professional judgment to grow as a designer.

This is a hands-on opportunity to learn within a collaborative agency environment. You will contribute to real client work, receive guidance from experienced creative leaders, and develop your skills through feedback, mentorship, and day-to-day practice.

You will learn how strategic thinking, visual design, writing, and production come together to create cohesive brand experiences across channels.

**What you'll do**

* Support Art Directors and Designers in concepting and producing strategic client deliverables across brand identity, UI/UX, print, paid media, and organic social.
* Create and adapt visual assets that are thoughtful, polished, on-brand, and appropriate for their intended channel.
* Collaborate with Strategy and Copywriting teams to bring visual and written storytelling together in clear, compelling brand narratives.
* Participate in creative brainstorms, research, concept development, and design reviews.
* Support the creative team with internal marketing materials and other strategic projects as needed.
* Organize files, prepare production-ready assets, and help maintain a high standard of accuracy and quality throughout the design process.
* Explore approved AI-assisted tools and emerging technologies to support research, ideation, concept exploration, moodboarding, and efficient production workflows.

**Skills and Experience You'll Bring and Develop**

**Design Craft and Tools**

* A portfolio that demonstrates strong visual thinking and a foundation in graphic design, visual communication, marketing, or related work.
* Working proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, especially Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.
* A foundational understanding of typography, color, layout, visual hierarchy, and core design principles.
* Interest in working across a range of formats, including brand identity, digital design, social media, print, and campaign creative.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted creative workflows, such as using ChatGPT or Claude for research and ideation, and appropriate tools for visual exploration and moodboarding.
* An ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs critically and use these tools responsibly, with respect for client confidentiality, intellectual property, accessibility, and brand standards.

**Collaboration and Growth**

* Currently pursuing, recently completed, or able to demonstrate equivalent experience in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
* Curiosity, initiative, and a genuine desire to develop your design craft.
* A collaborative, thoughtful approach to feedback and a willingness to ask questions.
* Strong organizational skills and close attention to detail.
* The ability to manage multiple tasks, communicate progress clearly, and seek support when needed.

**Why Join Us**
You'll work alongside talented people who are passionate about solving problems, helping clients grow, and delivering meaningful results. We're a collaborative, fast-moving team where curiosity is encouraged, ideas are welcomed, and great work is recognized.

We believe the best work happens when people are trusted to take ownership, supported in their growth, and empowered to bring their unique perspectives to the table. Whether you're just getting started or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact while continuing to learn and grow.

**Additional Information**

No agencies, please.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to succeed. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Please note that this job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications, which may change based on business needs.

At this time, we are unable to sponsor or transfer employment visas for this position.

title: Product Design Intern, 2027 Summer U.S.
description:

Overview
--------

*Working at Atlassian*

Atlassians have the flexibility to work where they can collaborate most effectively with their team, whether at home, one of our global offices, or both.

As a distributed-first company, all interviews are conducted virtually. We hire in any country where we have a legal entity. Learn how we work at go.atlassian.com/distributed.

Atlassian’s Intern program combines hands-on technical design training, professional growth opportunities, dedicated mentorship, and building strong professional connections. This holistic approach empowers students to hit the ground running and sets them up for a successful and impactful career at Atlassian.

This role is located in the Pacific Time Zone (PT). You must be willing and able to work out of this time zone to qualify.

This position is not eligible for F1 and J1 students. It is not available for any work sponsorship.

Our paid internship program runs for 12 weeks between May/June 2027 - August/September 2027.

*Your Future Team*

Atlassian helps teams unleash their potential through the Teamwork Graph, the intelligent context layer powering 85% of the Fortune 500. Over 300,000 customers globally, including NASA, SpaceX, Netflix, Spotify, Airbnb, and the Atlassian Williams Racing Formula 1 team, all use our apps to build AI-first experiences through a transformed SDLC.

As a Product Design Intern, you’ll work on real design challenges that solve for the beautiful mess of modern work and gain firsthand insight into how we are transforming the way work gets done in an AI-first company. Atlassian Design turns complex teamwork into clear, connected, and inclusive experiences. You’ll work alongside designers, product managers, and engineers across our global organization, learning how to understand real customer problems, explore and test ideas, communicate decisions, and turn them into high-quality technical prototypes with our world-class AI tooling.

We’re building an AI-native company and rethinking how people and intelligent systems work together. Our teams are exploring new interaction models for AI, including Rovo and AI-powered experiences across Jira, Confluence, and our wider cloud platform. If you’re curious, collaborative, and excited to make a difference while learning from a global design community, Atlassian is the place to start your career and help build the future of teamwork.

----------------
Responsibilities
----------------

*Responsibilities*

*

Apply strong interaction, visual, and systems-design craft to turn ambiguous customer problems into simple, accessible product experiences across Atlassian products.

*

Partner with product managers, engineers, researchers, and senior designers to understand customer needs, evaluate technical constraints, and make informed design decisions.

*

Use research insights, product data, technical prototyping and usability testing to explore assumptions, iterate quickly and improve the quality of shipped experiences.

*

Contribute to design systems, patterns and documentation while learning how AI and connected teamwork shape modern collaboration at scale.

*Minimum Qualifications*

Able to commit to a 12 week full-time (40hrs/week) program during Summer 2027

*

Currently enrolled full-time in a 4-year bachelors or 2-year masters degree program and returning to the program after the completion of the internship, graduating by June 2028

*

*Please note: At this time, this role is only open to entry-level candidates with less than a year of professional experience (this does not include internships/co-ops)*

*Preferred Qualifications*

*

Experience with user-focused design

*

Demonstrate the ability to plan while juggling multiple simultaneous projects

*

Experience collaborating with team members, like engineers and product managers, and other designers

--------------
Qualifications
--------------

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

title: Junior Product Marketing Manager
description:
Inception-1 — продуктова AI-компанія. Ми створюємо AI-продукти, які допомагають людям відчувати себе менш самотніми. Наша місія — будувати цифровий досвід, що поєднує технології з емпатією.
Ми відкриваємо цю роль вперше і розглядаємо кандидатів з мінімальним досвідом від 6 місяців. Якщо ти хочеш рости в продуктовому маркетингу, думаєш аналітично і не боїшся експериментувати — ми всьому навчимо.

Чим ти будеш займатися:

Вчитися будувати маркетингові воронки: від ідеї та дослідження до запуску та аналізу результатів.
Допомагати генерувати продуктові гіпотези та брати участь у їх тестуванні.
Аналізувати дані та шукати точки зростання на різних етапах воронки.
Вивчати конкурентів і ринок.
Допомагати створювати маркетингові меседжі, які відображають цінність продукту.
Взаємодіяти з командами UA, Affiliates, SEO, email-маркетингу.

Ми шукаємо тебе, якщо:

Маєш від 6 місяців досвіду в маркетингу, продукті або суміжній ролі — неважливо де, важливо що ти вже пробував/-ла.
Тобі цікаво розбиратися в аналітиці, метриках і тому, як воронки впливають на бізнес.
Мислиш структуровано і любиш працювати з даними.
Маєш рівень англійської Upper-Intermediate+.
Відкритий/-а до нестандартних тем і готовий/-а працювати в AI-ніші.
Вмієш і хочеш використовувати AI-інструменти у своїй роботі.

Важлива умова для участі в конкурсі: Разом із резюме просимо надіслати власноруч створену маркетингову QUIZ-воронку для будь-якого продукту — побудовану за допомогою AI-інструментів. Це не має бути ідеально: нам важливо побачити твій підхід до мислення та вміння працювати з AI.

Що ти отримаєш:

Навчання та менторство — реальні задачі з першого дня, підтримка досвідченої команди.
Можливість вирости до самостійної ролі в команді.
Динамічне середовище зі швидкими рішеннями та культурою експериментів.

Умови:

Можливість працювати віддалено. Гнучкий графік.
Підтримка з релокацією за потреби.
Онлайн-корпоративний лікар, після випробувального терміну — медичне страхування.
20 днів оплачуваної відпустки, необмежені лікарняні.
Компенсація навчання, корпоративна бібліотека, бізнес-школа для співробітників.
Безкоштовні тренування: біг, волейбол, бокс, йога. Знижки на абонемент у спортзал.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test - SDET
description:

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical test infrastructure and help shape quality engineering practices across a modern, fast-moving technology environment. You will design scalable automation frameworks and testing strategies for complex product capabilities while influencing architectural decisions around test design. The position combines advanced software engineering, test automation, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD optimization. You will work closely with engineering teams to shift quality earlier in the development lifecycle and build reliable, maintainable testing processes. Beyond hands-on technical work, you will mentor junior SDET engineers and contribute to technical reviews and engineering standards. This is a high-impact opportunity for an experienced SDET who enjoys solving complex automation challenges and improving quality at scale.

-----------------

* Architect, build, and maintain scalable test frameworks and infrastructure, making informed architectural decisions around test design patterns, abstractions, and maintainability.

* Design and implement API testing and orchestration across REST and GraphQL services, including integrations with UI-based workflows.

* Produce and maintain advanced test reporting using solutions such as Allure, Playwright HTML reports, and custom reporting frameworks.
* Conduct technical code reviews and contribute to engineering standards, best practices, and architectural decisions.
* Mentor SDET I engineers, helping them strengthen their automation, software design, and testing capabilities.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve test infrastructure, developer productivity, automation reliability, and overall engineering quality.

Requirements
------------

* Extensive hands-on experience with Playwright, including deep knowledge of its fixtures architecture and scalable test automation practices.
* Strong experience designing object-oriented test frameworks using layered patterns such as Page Object Model (POM), Page Component Object Model (PCOM), and other reusable abstractions.
* Proven experience with API testing and orchestration using REST and GraphQL, particularly when integrated with UI workflows.
* Advanced TypeScript expertise, including generics, decorators, advanced typing patterns, type inference, and complex asynchronous programming.
* Strong understanding of concurrency, asynchronous execution, race-condition prevention, and reliable automation in distributed or parallel environments.
* Solid software design knowledge, including domain-driven design and design patterns such as Factory, Builder, Facade, and Composite.
* Hands-on AWS experience, including EC2 configuration, CloudWatch log analysis, cloud environment debugging, and management of test infrastructure.
* Strong Docker experience covering containerization, docker-compose, image management, and container-based testing environments.
* Proven ability to debug, optimize, and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
* Expert-level knowledge of Git, GitHub, and distributed version control workflows.
* Advanced experience with test reporting solutions such as Allure, Playwright HTML reports, and custom reporting approaches.
* Strong understanding of test infrastructure architecture, framework scalability, performance optimization, and the npm ecosystem/package management.
* Terraform experience is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to make sound technical decisions in complex testing environments.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineering practices and work effectively across teams.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor less experienced engineers and provide constructive technical feedback.

* 49 days of paid time off.
* Comprehensive benefits, including PTO, retirement, and wellness plans.
* Professional development support and opportunities for continued technical growth.
* Remote workspace setup bonus.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
------------------
*Company Overview*
------------------

Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.

Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.

Position Summary
----------------

This is a role for someone early in their career who wants both hands-on IT and real software/infrastructure engineering experience. As part of a small, high-trust local team, you'll be the go-to person in the Lisbon office for day-to-day IT support - onboarding new hires, setting up hardware, keeping meeting rooms and workstations running - while also picking up real engineering work: automation scripting, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS infrastructure support alongside a distributed engineering team. You'll learn fast, work directly with senior engineers, and grow from executing well-defined tasks into owning small pieces of infrastructure independently.

The Role at a Glance
--------------------

* Be the local IT point of contact for the Lisbon office - onboarding, hardware, and everyday support.
* Learn and apply core SRE practices - scripting, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure - under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Split your time between hands-on specialist work and hands-on engineering work; grow into more of the latter over time.
* Build a foundation in Linux, AWS, and automation that sets up a long-term engineering career path.

What You'll Do & the Impact You'll Own
--------------------------------------

Measured by growth and reliability, not tenure - within 6-12 months

* Own IT specialist duties for the Lisbon office: Handle new-hire onboarding end to end - hardware provisioning, account setup, workstation configuration, and welcome/orientation support - so new colleagues are productive from day one.
* Keep the local office running: Support workstations, conference rooms, and A/V equipment; manage local IT inventory and procurement; act as the first point of contact when something in the office isn't working.
* Provide day-to-day technical support: Troubleshoot common issues - login problems, device setup, network connectivity, basic Linux/Windows/macOS issues - and know when to escalate to the broader distributed team.
* Learn and contribute to automation: Write and maintain simple scripts and Ansible playbooks under guidance to reduce repetitive manual work; progressively take on larger pieces of automation as your skills grow.
* Support CI/CD and cloud infrastructure: Get hands-on with GitLab pipelines and AWS building blocks (IAM, EC2, basic networking) by shadowing and then assisting senior engineers on real infrastructure tasks.
* Build strong fundamentals: Develop working knowledge of Linux systems administration, version control, and cloud basics through real tickets and projects, not just documentation.
* Document and communicate clearly: Keep clear records of issues and fixes so recurring problems get solved once, not repeatedly; communicate status and blockers proactively to the wider (mostly remote) team.

What You'll Need
----------------

* Experience: 0-2 years in an IT support, systems administration, or junior engineering role (internships and academic projects count).
* Linux fundamentals: Comfortable in a Linux/Unix environment - command line, file permissions, basic networking, and troubleshooting common issues.
* Scripting: Working knowledge of at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or similar) and eagerness to write more of it.
* IT support mindset: Comfortable being hands-on with hardware and being the local face of IT - patient, clear communicator, good with people who aren't technical.
* Cloud curiosity: Basic familiarity with a cloud platform (AWS preferred) and genuine interest in learning infrastructure and automation - formal production experience not required.
* Ownership and reliability: Able to work independently as the only (or one of very few) on-site technical resource, while staying closely connected to a distributed, remote-first team.
* Language: Fluent English (written and spoken); Portuguese is a plus for local vendor and office coordination.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field; equivalent practical experience considered.

Nice to Have
------------

* Exposure to configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef).
* Familiarity with Git and CI/CD concepts (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar).
* Coursework, certifications, or personal projects involving AWS (Cloud Practitioner or higher).
* Prior experience in a hardware/device support or IT helpdesk role.

*Recruiting Security
* Emails from genuine Arcesium recruiters who are employees of the company will always come from the @arcesium.com domain. In some cases, you may also be contacted by independent search firms engaged to recruit on our behalf; emails from their employees should always come from their firm's applicable domain. We'll never ask for your banking information or any payment as part of the recruiting process. If something seems off or you're contacted by an unexpected third party, please reach out to us at careers@arcesium.com (US/UK), careers-india@arcesium.com (India) or careers-europe@arcesium.com (Portugal/Sweden).

Arcesium is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Junior Software Engineer, AI Agent Platform
description:
*Company Overview*
------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Aperçu de l’entreprise
----------------------

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.

*Department Overview*
--------------------

Hyper, a Motorola Solutions Company, is a leader in conversational, agentic AI designed to reduce the burden on understaffed public safety answering points (PSAPs) by handling non-emergency calls. It is revolutionizing emergency response systems through cutting-edge AI technologies. Our first product is reducing 911 wait times by alleviating administrative work from highly trained 911 telecommunicators.

Job Description
--------------

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join the AI Agent Platform team behind Hyper’s emergency response products (Motorola Solutions announced that it acquired Hyper on April 9, 2026).

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers across real-time AI pipelines, telephony, backend infrastructure, and product surfaces. You’ll help influence architecture, build core product features, and shape how our team uses AI agents to move faster without compromising reliability, security, or product quality. We encourage engineers to use AI agents in their own work. But because this is mission-critical software, humans still own quality, judgment, and what ships.

What You’ll Do
--------------

*

Build real-time voice AI features for emergency response workflows.

*

Design and operate LLM-powered systems that support human 911 telecommunicators.

*

Own features across the stack, from backend services and AI pipelines to frontend interfaces and internal tools.

*

Work on low-latency audio processing, streaming systems, telephony integrations, and human-in-the-loop AI workflows.

*

Help integrate speech models, LLMs, and emerging AI technologies into production systems.

*

Build strong habits around tests, code review, observability, and security from day one.

*

Help write and improve evaluation, testing, and observability for AI-assisted systems.

*

Participate in on-call responsibilities (with support and shadow rotations to start), backed by clear runbooks and blameless post-incident reviews.

*

Ask questions, dig into how things work, and bring fresh perspectives to the team.

You Might Be a Fit If
---------------------

*

You’re curious about working across backend, infrastructure, AI, and product, even if you haven’t done it all yet.

*

You use AI tools daily, but you do not confuse speed with quality.

*

You care about quality — you write tests, read documentation, and try to understand a system before you change it.

*

You take feedback well and act on it.
-------------------------------------

*

You have strong product instincts and care about the humans using what you build.

*

You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where you’ll have real ownership early — and you’re comfortable asking for help.

*

You want to work on AI systems that matter beyond demos.

Relevant Experience
-------------------

We don’t expect you to have shipped production systems. We care most about engineering fundamentals, learning velocity, curiosity, and how you think. Coursework, internships, research, and personal projects all count.

Relevant exposure may include:
------------------------------

*

Projects involving LLMs, AI agents, AI pipelines, RAG systems, evals, or prompt test harnesses.

*

Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech, Voice Activity Detection, endpointing, interruption handling, noise filtering, diarization, or audio streaming.

*

Telephony and voice infrastructure, including PSTN, SIP trunking, PBX, and call routing.

*

Real-time communication systems using WebRTC, WebSockets, RTP/SRTP, media streaming, or low-latency audio transport.

*

Programming in Elixir, Go, Python, Rust, or similar languages.

*

Familiarity with PostgreSQL or relational data modeling.

*

Exposure to cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP

*

Docker, Kubernetes, or similar deployment environments.

*

Internships or co-ops in software engineering, infrastructure, or AI/ML roles.

You do not need experience in all of these areas. Most successful candidates will have experience in a few and curiosity to learn the rest

Basic Requirements
-----------------

Bachelor's degree
-----------------

Experience with LLMs, AI agents, AI pipelines, RAG systems, evals, or prompt test harnesses.

Travel Requirements
------------------

Under 10%

Relocation Provided
------------------

None

Position Type
------------

New Grad

Referral Payment Plan
--------------------

Yes

Що потрібно від тебе:

Мінімум 6 місяців досвіду на посаді LinkBuilder з акцентом на західні ринки. Розглядаємо також без досвіду, але обов'язкові базові знання та проходження курсів у напрямку лінкбилдингу

Впевнене користування інструментами Ahrefs, Seranking
Сильні комунікативні навички та вміння керувати підрядниками й проектами.
Скурпульозність до виконання задач
Відповідальність та організованість, готовність до рутинної роботи.

Чим ти будеш займатися:

Крауд маркетинг для українських та англомовних проектів
Закупівля посилань на площадках (prposting,collaborator ітд.)
Outreach
Перевірка індексації посилань
Пошук нових можливостей для безкоштовного лінкбілдингу
Пошук контактів вебмайстрів та письмова комунікація з ними
Самостійна реєстрація акаунтів
Звітність про виконану роботу

Культура та команда:

Ми створюємо середовище, в якому твої ідеї будуть почуті. Наша команда складається з амбітних фахівців, які люблять свою справу, але не забувають про work-life balance. Ми за здорову комунікацію, швидкий фідбек і ріст кожного члена команди.

Якщо ти шукаєш роботу в дружній команді, де кожен має значення, і хочеш працювати над цікавими проєктами — чекаємо на тебе!
