title: UI Designer - Fintech (Design System)
description:
Somos una fintech especializada en remesas y pagos transfronterizos, 100% remota, con presencia en LATAM y Europa. Actualmente somos un equipo talentoso trabajando para hacer que mover dinero entre fronteras sea simple, rápido y humano.
Sobre el rolBuscamos un/a UI Designer que se una a nuestro equipo de Product Design para liderar la creación, gobernanza y escalabilidad de nuestro Design System. Serás quien traduzca la identidad de Retorna en componentes, patrones y lineamientos consistentes, y quien se asegure de que ese sistema realmente se use, se mantenga y crezca junto con el producto.
Vas a trabajar codo a codo con equipos de tecnología, entendiendo restricciones técnicas y de implementación, y con el equipo de diseño de Growth Marketing, asegurando que cada pieza que sale a producción (producto o campaña) hable el mismo idioma visual. Valoramos especialmente experiencia previa en fintech y productos digitales, ya que entender los matices de estos entornos (regulación, confianza del usuario, complejidad de flujos) es clave para diseñar un sistema que realmente sostenga el crecimiento del negocio.
Tareas
- Diseñar, documentar y mantener los componentes y patrones del Design System (tipografía, color, espaciado, componentes de UI, estados, accesibilidad).

- Definir la gobernanza del sistema: quién puede proponer cambios, cómo se versionan los componentes y cómo se comunican las actualizaciones al resto del equipo.

- Colaborar estrechamente con equipos de tecnología para asegurar que los componentes se implementen fielmente en código y detectar brechas entre diseño y desarrollo.

- Trabajar de la mano con el equipo de diseño de Growth Marketing para que las piezas de campaña se apoyen en el Design System sin perder velocidad ni flexibilidad creativa.

- Auditar de forma periódica el uso del sistema en producto y marketing, identificando inconsistencias y oportunidades de simplificación.

- Escalar el sistema a medida que Retorna crece: nuevos flujos, nuevas plataformas, nuevos mercados, sin perder coherencia visual ni de experiencia.

- Diseñar interfaces de producto de alta calidad cuando el trabajo lo requiera, aplicando y retroalimentando el propio Design System.

Requisitos
- 3+ años de experiencia en UI Design, idealmente con experiencia liderando o construyendo un Design System desde cero o escalando uno existente.

-
Es muy relevante contar con experiencia previa en el sector fintech y en productos digitales, entiendes la velocidad, la regulación y la ambigüedad propias de estos entornos.

- Manejo sólido de Figma, incluyendo componentes, variantes, auto layout y librerías compartidas.

- Capacidad de comunicarte con equipos técnicos sobre tokens de diseño, componentes reutilizables y restricciones de implementación.

- Experiencia colaborando con equipos de marketing o growth, entendiendo que la consistencia de marca no debe frenar la velocidad de esos equipos.

- Criterio para balancear consistencia con flexibilidad, sabes cuándo un patrón debe ser rígido y cuándo debe dejar espacio para la excepción.

- Autonomía para trabajar 100% remoto en un equipo distribuido en múltiples países.

Beneficios
- 100% remoto

- Impacto directo en la base sobre la que se construye todo el producto de Retorna.

- Colaboración cercana con tecnología y growth marketing, con visibilidad real de tu trabajo en todo el negocio.

- Cultura people-first, con foco en resultados y flexibilidad.

- Días libres ilimitados

- Feriados locales

¿Te imaginas construir la base visual y de experiencia sobre la que crece toda una fintech? Si te motiva pensar en sistemas más que en pantallas sueltas, y quieres tener un impacto real en cómo millones de personas mueven dinero entre fronteras, este es tu momento.
Aplica ahora, comparte tu portafolio y cuéntanos cómo abordarías la gobernanza de un Design System en crecimiento. 🚀

Smart Tech Contracting recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

description:

We are looking for an AI Product Manager (Team Lead) to join our team.

Ability to define product metrics, run A/B tests, analyze funnels, and make decisions based on data.

* Take full ownership of one product area: define goals, align them with business objectives, and achieve them together with the team.

title: Junior Data Analyst
description:
CerebriOS is a software company building B2B SaaS products that help businesses make better decisions, streamline operations, and get more value from their data. Our products combine practical business workflows with intuitive technology designed for everyday use.

We are looking for a Junior Data Analyst to support our growing Data and Analytics team and help turn business data into useful insights. You will work with structured data, prepare reports, identify trends, and support more experienced analysts with ongoing analytical projects.

This role is a strong opportunity for someone at the beginning of their analytics career who enjoys working with numbers, solving problems, and learning how data can support business and product decisions.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
----------------

*

Collect, clean, and organize data from different sources

*

Prepare recurring reports and basic dashboards

*

Analyse data to identify trends, patterns, and inconsistencies

*

Support senior analysts with ad hoc analysis and research

*

Perform data quality checks and investigate discrepancies

*

Help define and track business and product metrics

*

Maintain spreadsheets, reports, and analytical documentation

*

Translate business questions into basic data analysis

*

Present findings and summaries in a clear and understandable format

*

Collaborate with Data, Product, Engineering, and Operations teams

*

Support improvements to reporting and data processes

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
-----------------------

*

0–2 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, business analysis, or a related field

*

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

*

Comfortable working with spreadsheets and structured data

*

Basic understanding of data analysis concepts and statistics

*

Strong attention to detail and data accuracy

*

Ability to communicate findings clearly
---------------------------------------

*

Strong written and verbal English communication skills

*

Willingness to learn new tools and analytical techniques

*

Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

NICE TO HAVE
------------

*

Experience with SQL
-------------------

*

Experience with Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas and pivot tables

*

Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools

*

Basic knowledge of Python or another programming language

*

Experience working with SaaS, technology, or analytics products

*

Understanding of Agile or Scrum environments

*

Academic background in Business, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS
-------------------------

*$55,000–$70,000 annually* , depending on experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.

CerebriOS offers a remote-first working environment, professional development opportunities, and a benefits package designed to support our team. Full details of compensation, benefits, and other employment terms will be discussed during the interview process.

HIRING PROCESS
--------------

Application review → introductory conversation → practical discussion → conversation with the team/manager → offer.

We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with clear communication throughout the process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
-----------------

CerebriOS is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

If you need an accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please let us know and we will work with you to make the process accessible.

*Location:* Remote

*Seniority Level:* Junior

*Salary Range:* 55,000 - 70,000 USD (gross, annually)

title: Junior Solution Architect
description:
*Job Summary*

As part of the customer account team or ecosystem team, a Junior Solution Architect at Red Hat is a technical person who collaborates with customers and helps them to be successful by using Red Hat products and services. The role of a Junior Solution Architect is to understand our customers’ challenges and requirements and address them with Red Hat technologies and solutions.

Do you thrive on solving complex problems and explaining technical concepts in an engaging way? If so, this is your chance to launch your career at the cutting edge of enterprise open source!

*What you will do*

As a Junior Solution Architect, you’ll participate in the FASTER Program , Field Accelerator for Sales and Technical Emerging Roles (we do love a good acronym), a comprehensive 10-month onboarding and development program designed to provide you with the deep technical knowledge, customer engagement skills, and industry insights needed to excel. You'll gain hands-on experience with Red Hat's portfolio, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to real-world customer solutions from day one. This cohort-based program starts in September 2027.

*Through this experience, you will:*

*

Learn all about Red Hat and how we support our customers to address their technical developmental and strategic business challenges with our portfolio and services

*

Build a strong support network of your Peers, Manager, Mentor and other Red Hatters within and outside of your team

*

Develop technical skills in the Red Hat portfolio that span Cloud, Automation and AI solutions by completing training programs and attaining industry-recognized certifications

*

Apply your technical skills as you engage in meaningful customer interactions, experiences and job shadowing opportunities

*

Shadow and assist more experienced Solution Architects as they deliver proof of value to our customers and partners through presentations, demonstrations, workshops and pilot projects

*

Enhance your professional capabilities through real-world experiences working directly with customers and participating in skill development opportunities

*

Gain understanding of the processes and tools associated with enterprise-level solution architecture

*

Focus on your personal and professional development as you grow your career at Red Hat

*

Support the Sales organization’s goals to deliver customer business value, advance opportunities by obtaining technical wins, educate customers, and increase sales pipeline and revenue

*What you will bring*

*

Passion and curiosity for open source technology and desire to build a career within the Tech industry and expertise in emerging technologies

*

Strong technical skills in computer science, IT, AI, or related fields gained through university programs, upskilling bootcamps, certificate programs, military experience, etc.

*

Demonstrated experience applying technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills in an Enterprise IT-related project

*

Motivation to engage in self-directed learning on new technologies

*

Experience with any of Red Hat products (Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Red Hat OpenShift, Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, Red Hat AI platform) and/or related Open Source technologies (e.g. Fedora, Podman, Ansible, etc.) is also preferred

*

Exposure to scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) or programming languages (e.g., Java, Go) is a plus

*

Desire to be customer-focused, understanding customer needs and helping them achieve their goals

*

Willingness to travel to customer sites depending on assignments and to work both in-person from a Red Hat office location and remotely

*

Effective communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills

*

Ability to work independently and collaboratively with internal teams and external customers

*

Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English

*Why Red Hat?*

*

Unparalleled Onboarding and Development: Set yourself up for long-term success through our structured development program (FASTER), which provides you with dedicated mentorship, hands-on practice activities, certifications, and exposure to a wide range of technologies

*

Impactful Work: Contribute to solutions that empower businesses worldwide and shape the future of open source

*

Open Culture: Work in a collaborative environment where your ideas are valued

*

Career Growth: Take advantage of opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement within a global organization

Ready to kickstart your career with a global open source leader? Apply Now!

Remember: You don’t need to have experience with every skill listed to join Red Hat. This role is part of a developmental program designed to help you grow and develop your skills. If you’re excited about this opportunity but feel you still have some learning to do, we encourage you to apply—we’re looking for passionate individuals eager to learn and grow with us.

Red Hat will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.

The salary range for this position is $47.60 - $76.12. Actual offer will be based on your qualifications.

*Pay Transparency*

Red Hat determines compensation based on several factors including but not limited to job location, experience, applicable skills and training, external market value, and internal pay equity. Annual salary is one component of Red Hat’s compensation package. This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, and/or equity. For positions with Remote-US locations, the actual salary range for the position may differ based on location but will be commensurate with job duties and relevant work experience.

*About Red Hat*

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

*Benefits*
● Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
● Flexible Spending Account - healthcare and dependent care
● Health Savings Account - high deductible medical plan
● Retirement 401(k) with employer match
● Paid time off and holidays
● Paid parental leave plans for all new parents
● Leave benefits including disability, paid family medical leave, and paid military leave
● Additional benefits including employee stock purchase plan, family planning reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, transportation expense account, employee assistance program, and more!

*Note:* These benefits are only applicable to full time, permanent associates at Red Hat located in the United States.

*Inclusion at Red Hat*
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

title: QA Engineer (Junior-Friendly) — Cloud Security Platform - Upwind
description:
QA Engineer (Junior-Friendly) — Cloud Security Platform
Java · Selenide · AWS / Azure / GCP · Kubernetes · Terraform
Start here, and go deep
Upwind is a cloud security platform. Companies connect their AWS, Azure and GCP environments to us, and we tell them what's dangerous — vulnerable container images, misconfigured permissions, exposed identities, live attacks in progress.
It's a big product, and nobody arrives knowing it. You'll learn it with us — the cloud, the Kubernetes, the security domain, the automation. That's the deal: you bring the curiosity and the fundamentals, we teach you the rest.
What you'll be working on
Testing features by hand
Learn a feature area properly, then write test plans for it — onboarding flows, dashboards, scanners, integrations
Turn plans into clear, prioritized test cases with real steps and expected results
Check new features against what product actually asked for, and verify fixes before they ship
Run regression rounds before releases
Writing automation
Write WebUI tests in Java + Selenide, in a framework that already exists — you'll be adding to it and learning the patterns, not building from zero
Gradually automate the areas you've been testing manually, so your time moves to more interesting work
Investigate failing tests: is it a real bug, or is the test unstable? Learn to tell the difference fast
Getting hands-on with cloud
Set up your own test environments: connect AWS accounts using Terraform and CloudFormation, onboard Azure and GCP projects
Deploy our sensors onto Kubernetes clusters and Linux servers
Generate QA workloads and check the platform reacts the way it should
Compare what the UI shows against the real underlying data — this is where the most interesting bugs hide
Reporting what you find
Write bug reports engineers can pick up immediately: steps, expected vs actual, impact, environment, and evidence
Learn to spot when five bugs are really one bug with one cause
What we need from you
Some commercial QA experience — internship, junior role, or a year or two of manual testing
Basic Java — you've written and debugged code, and you can read someone else's without panic. You don't need to be a developer.
Some exposure to test automation. If you've written Selenium or Selenide tests in a course or a small project, that counts.
Test design fundamentals: equivalence classes, boundary values, negative cases — the ISTQB material, understood rather than memorized
Curiosity about how things work under the hood: you've opened browser devtools and looked at what requests a page makes
Basic Linux comfort: you can SSH into a machine and read a log file
Git and Jira
English good enough to work in a distributed team every day
Genuinely optional
Cloud experience of any kind · Kubernetes · Terraform · a security course or CTF you did for fun · SQL · CI/CD
If you have none of these, that's fine. If you have one, tell us about it.
What we care about more than your CV
You want to know why. "It's broken" is where you start, not where you stop.
You'll set things up yourself rather than waiting for someone to hand you an environment.
You write clearly. A vague bug report costs the team a day; a good one saves it.
You want to learn cloud security properly. Not eventually. Now.
What you'll walk away with
Java automation experience in a real production suite. Hands-on AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes and Terraform. A working understanding of how cloud attacks and defenses actually operate.
That combination takes most people years to assemble. You'll build it here, with people who'll teach you.
Bring the curiosity. Apply.

title: Junior ML-инженер
Junior Payroll Assistant
description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

*Corporate Secretary* : Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

*Accounting & Bookkeeping* : Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

*FinTech payments* : Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

*Requirements*

Mission of the role
-------------------

To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines.

The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation.

Key outcomes In the first 6–12 months
-------------------------------------

Outcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency
-----------------------------------------------------

Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls.

Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month.

Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing
--------------------------------------------------

Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission.

Ensure *100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines* , including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements.

Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy.

Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness
------------------------------------------

Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries.

Consistently achieve a *CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month* while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day.

Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required.

Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement
---------------------------------------------------

Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues.

Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times.

*Must-have experience*

* Minimum *1–2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience*.
* Experience working in a *bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre* is preferred.
* Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of UK payroll processes, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and workplace pension processes.
* Experience with payroll software such as *BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar* is an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics.
* Practical experience or strong interest in using *AI tools, automation, and IT applications* to improve daily workflows.

*Must-have attributes*

*Ownership & Accountability:* Takes full responsibility for assigned payrolls and client accounts, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and proactively resolves issues or roadblocks.

*Humility:* Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required.

*Structured Thinking:* Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements.

*Data Driven & Attention to Detail:* Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients.

*Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way:* Able to communicate clearly and professionally when dealing with sensitive payroll issues, missing information, delays, or difficult client situations while maintaining a constructive client relationship.

*AI & Tech Savvy:* Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, automation, and technology to make payroll processes more efficient and effective.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

We will be looking for candidates who have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

*Ownership:* This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

*Humility:* There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

*Structured Thinking:* Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

*Attention to detail:* You'll be managing multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and workstreams. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing, inconsistent, or likely to cause an issue.

*Excellent listener and clear communicator:* We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

*The interview process*

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than *3 weeks from start to finish*.

*TA Screen / One-way Video Interview:* Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview to assess spoken and written communication, relevant UK payroll experience, motivation, and initial background.

*Technical Round:* A 30-minute interview and practical assessment with the Hiring Team to assess UK payroll knowledge, payroll processing experience, attention to detail, ability to work with payroll data, and understanding of UK payroll processes and deadlines.

*Soft Skills Round:* A 30-minute chat with a member of the leadership team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values, including ownership, humility, structured thinking, communication, and ability to handle challenging situations.

*Reference Verification:* Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

*Requirement for background screening*

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

* Your education
* Any criminal history
* Any political exposure
* Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

*Benefits*

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

*Humility and kindness:* Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

*Flexibility:* You’ll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

*Financial benefits:* We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

*Personal growth:* You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

title: Junior QA Tester
description:
*Junior QA Tester · Scape*
ScapeWorld Entertainment · Hired in Ireland

*About us*

We are Scape, a Swedish game studio of about 30 people, fully remote by choice. We are launching Gravity on Steam Early Access later this year: a precision climbing game where 100 players share one server, one tower, and one long way down. Gravity is the first game inside Scape, a growing platform of multiplayer games where a player's identity carries across all of them; Scape itself follows. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios, and Ubisoft.

Every bug a player never meets started as a report someone wrote well, and we are looking for the person who writes them.

*The role*

You join the QA team and report to the Lead QA. Your job is to test Gravity the way players run it: packaged builds installed through the Steam client from a branch, never the editor. You run the test plans the Lead QA sets, hunt for what breaks, write bug reports a developer can act on without having been there, and confirm fixes once they land. It is not a playtest seat and it is not a lead seat: you do not decide what ships or how bugs are prioritised, and you do not need to. Some of what you chase only shows up with other players in the instance, so you will test with the team as often as alone.

*What you will own*

*

Running smoke tests, quick tests, log in tests and the Steam pass on every candidate build you are given

*

Your bug reports in Jira, from first sighting to a report that reproduces from its own text

*

Reproduction work on defects a developer could not reproduce, and returning them with corrected steps

*

Fix validation on the defects you verify, including regression on the features around them

*

The test record for every run you make: plan, build, branch, configuration, result

*

Loading every candidate build against our archive of saves from earlier versions

*You*

*

You understand the software testing lifecycle: test cases, test plans, regression testing, smoke testing

*

You write clear, reproducible bug reports: numbered steps to reproduce, expected against actual result, severity and likelihood set with care

*

You have used a bug tracker such as Jira, Bugzilla, Azure DevOps or TestRail

*

You notice things: edge cases, exploits, inconsistencies, the thing that is slightly off

*

You communicate well with developers and designers, in writing above all, because that is how a remote team works

*

You read and write English well enough to work in it all day; it is the language of every ticket and every conversation

*Helpful, not required*

*

A basic understanding of how games are built: client and server, builds, patches

*

You run your own day without needing to be asked twice

*

You love games, and climbing, falling and trying again sounds like a good time

*What we offer*

A real game heading to Steam, a lead who teaches, and bugs that matter from your first week.

We are a self-motivated team, remote by choice and flexible in how we work, and we run on people helping each other rather than watching each other. No timesheets, no theatre: everyone here is trusted to own their part, and supported when they need a hand. And we are early. Gravity is heading to Steam with everything still ahead of it. Joining now means building something with a real chance of becoming big, and being one of the people it belongs to when it does.

*Practical*

*

Remote. We are a distributed team, and your working day overlaps CET.

*

Full time, hired in Ireland.

*

Recruitment is ongoing.

*How to apply*

Apply through the link; a few short questions are part of the application form. If we shortlist you, the next step is interviews and a short unpaid take-home, a bug hunt on a build with your written reports, about two hours. We reply to everyone at every step.

*Disclosure*

This application will be evaluated with the help of an AI tool that checks your CV and application against the criteria for this role. A human recruiter always makes the final decision. The AI does not reject or accept anyone on its own. If your application isn't taken forward, you can ask us for an explanation of how the AI was used in that decision. See our Candidate Privacy Policy below for full details, or contact us at privacy@br.ink with any questions.

title: Junior Account Manager (French speaker) - Remote
description:
*About Finom*

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.

We recently closed a *€115 million Series C equity round* (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.

Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.

At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

About the Role
--------------

As an Account Manager, you’ll own a book your own portfolio of high value customers (around 1000+ clients) across European markets. This isn’t a passive support role. We want someone who treats their portfolio like a sales territory - building best in class relationships and working with their clients to maximise the value of their Finom account.

This person will prioritise outreach with our data triggers for those customers who need attention.

You’ll be measured on what matters: keeping your portfolio in a positive growth state, making customer churn a non starter, and impacting business growth.

This position is critical to Finoms expansion across our Revenue Function and the team is overseen by the Chief Revenue Officer. If you are a hungry, self motivated individual, who is looking for a role they can grow and make their own - this is your seat.

*Important - hiring is only possible if you are resident in one of these countries: Spain, Poland, Cyprus, Portugal, Hungary, Greece, Serbia, Turkey, Bulgaria & eastern EU.*

Responsibilities
----------------

* Actively managing and engaging the portfolio through a multi channel communication strategy
* Building strong relationships with decision-makers and becoming a trusted point of contact for clients.
* Driving revenue growt, retention and product adoption across Finom’s product suite.
* Identifying and executing upsell, cross-sell and referral opportunities and avoid churn
* Using account data, usage signals and portfolio trends to prioritise outreach and identify opportunities or risks
* Monitoring account health and proactively intervening with at-risk clients to prevent churn.
* Maintaining accurate Salesforce pipeline, activity and account tracking
* Using Modjo/AI tools call intelligence to continuously improve performance and share best practices with the team.
* Supporting clients throughout all lifecycle stages
* Following relevant AML, transaction-monitoring and internal processes.

Requirements
------------

* Minimum *1-2 years in a Sales, Account Management, Customer Success position in B2B SaaS or Fintech*
* Strong communication skills - you know how to open a conversation and create urgency without being pushy and put the customer first
* Commercially focused - you think in terms of revenue per account, expansion potential, balancing customer satisfaction with business goals
* You use data to make decisions - whether that's spotting a usage drop before it becomes a churn risk or identifying the right moment to have a plan upgrade conversation
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where the playbook is still being written in places
* *French Native (or almost) and perfect fluency in English*
* Prior experience with Salesforce or similar tools is a benefit

What we offer
-------------

* *Full remote* from one of the following countries:
* Spain, Poland, Cyprus, Portugal, Hungary, Greece, Serbia, Turkey, Bulgaria & eastern EU
* *Base salary* from 24.000 EUR to 36.000 EUR gross per year, based on experience
* *Annual bonus* based on targets achieved - up to 12K x year
* *Stock Options*
* *Work & Swim* from Cyprus

*What You Will Get In Return*

*Make a genuine impact on the product*

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.

*Work in the EU*

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

*Become a stock options holder*

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.

*Receive unwavering support and care*

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.

*Work & Swim program*

Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

*Equal Opportunity Statement*

At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Junior Operations Manager:in Messstellenbetrieb (w/m/d)
description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

*Deine Aufgaben*
----------------

*

Du übernimmst die eigenständige Klärung von Fällen, bei denen es rund um den Zählertausch zu Abweichungen oder Problemen gekommen ist.

*

Du analysierst Prozess- und Datenschiefstände zwischen Enpal, Netzbetreibern und Lieferanten und findest heraus, wo und warum ein Fehler entstanden ist.

*

Du recherchierst fehlende Informationen, holst die richtigen Ansprechpartner ins Boot und führst Fälle lösungsorientiert bis zum Abschluss.

*

Du kommunizierst regelmäßig mit Netzbetreibern und weiteren externen sowie internen Partnern – per Telefon und E-Mail.

*

Du erkennst relevante Details in Gesprächen und Nachrichten und leitest daraus ab, welche Informationen oder nächsten Schritte tatsächlich benötigt werden.

*

Du koordinierst notwendige Korrekturen, beispielsweise bei falsch gemeldeten Zählern, fehlerhaften oder fehlenden Daten sowie erforderlichen Nachrüstungen oder erneuten Zählertauschen.

*

Du arbeitest dich tief in unsere Prozesse und Systeme ein und nutzt die vorhandenen Informationen, um Klärfälle schnell und strukturiert zu lösen.

*

Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Fehler und bringst deine Erkenntnisse ein, um Prozesse langfristig besser und zuverlässiger zu machen.

*

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Fälle und gehst Problemen proaktiv auf den Grund, anstatt sie lediglich abzuarbeiten.

*Dein Profil*
-------------

*

Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, ein Studium oder bringst relevante Berufserfahrung mit – gerne auch als Quereinsteiger aus Bereichen wie *Customer Service, Sales, Hotellerie, Einzelhandel oder vergleichbaren serviceorientierten Tätigkeiten*.

*

Du hast Spaß daran, Problemen auf den Grund zu gehen und dich auch durch komplexere Sachverhalte zu arbeiten.

*

Du kommunizierst sicher und freundlich – sowohl am Telefon als auch schriftlich per E-Mail.

*

Du kannst gut zuhören, stellst die richtigen Fragen und erkennst auch zwischen den Zeilen, welche Informationen für die Lösung eines Falls wirklich relevant sind.

*

Du arbeitest strukturiert und sorgfältig und behältst auch bei einer größeren Anzahl parallel laufender Fälle den Überblick.

*

Du bist hartnäckig und lässt dich von einem komplizierten Fall nicht so schnell abschütteln, *du bleibst dran, bis eine Lösung gefunden ist*.

*

Du arbeitest gerne eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt.

*

Du hast eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität und findest dich schnell in neue Prozesse, Systeme und Themen ein.

*

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab.

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

*Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen*
------------------------------

*

*Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn* - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

*

*Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt* - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

*

*Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus -* Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.

*

*Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit* - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

*

*Dein Kick-start bei Enpal* - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

*

*Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit* - ** Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

*

*Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam* - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

*

*Dein Extra-Boost* - ** 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. title: UX/UI Designer
description:
*Happy Mammoth* is a rapidly expanding natural food tech company with a presence in the United States, Australia, and Europe. We are experts in crafting, manufacturing, and promoting gut health foods, digestive aids, and microbiome-focused supplements. Our mission is to empower clients to embrace lasting health transformations and rediscover vibrant living.

We are currently looking for a *UI/UX Designer (focus on UI with UX experience)* to join our vibrant, diverse team of international innovators, where creativity knows no bounds.

As our UI/UX Designer, you'll shape how customers experience our website and campaigns — designing pages and creatives that are visually polished, intuitive to navigate, and built to convert. You'll bring strong UI craft paired with a solid UX foundation, turning briefs and rough concepts into high-quality designs that balance beautiful visual design with real business impact.

*Top Reasons to Work at Happy Mammoth*

* *A Strong Salary Package:* We'll pay you well because your skills and hard work deserve the best.
* *Paid Holidays:* Take all the time you need to binge-watch your favorite shows, explore new places, or just relax. It's on us!
* *Work from Anywhere:* Whether it's your couch, a trendy café, or a co-working space by the beach (lucky you), the world is your office.
* *Join a Vibrant Team:* Teamwork makes the dream work! You'll be part of a global crew that's as talented as they are friendly.
* *Flexible Working Hours:* Manage your schedule how it fits best for you — late-night productivity, early morning hustle, or everything in between.
* *Opportunities for Growth:* We'll give you free books, courses, and all the resources you need to level up your skills and keep excelling.
* *Dynamic Work Environment:* No two days are the same here. Embrace new challenges and excitement every day in a diverse, fast-paced workplace.
* *Make a Difference:* Join our mission to help clients improve their health and live more fulfilling lives. It's not just a job - it's a chance to make a real impact!

*Key Points*

* This is a full-time, fully remote contractor role.
* We are seeking someone preferably with a background in B2C/e-commerce or DTC design.
* Although the role is remote, the candidate must be available during EU hours (GMT).

*This role is embedded within our e-commerce team and is dedicated to designing and optimizing our DTC storefront — not general product or brand design.*

*Key Responsibilities*

* Design and improve product pages, ensuring they are visually compelling, clear, and easy to navigate.
* Create campaign creatives that communicate our message clearly and encourage users to take action.
* Redesign and improve existing areas of our website, identifying opportunities to improve the user experience, engagement, and conversion.
* Take briefs, ideas, and campaign concepts and turn them into polished, high-quality designs.
* Use your UX knowledge to determine where key information, CTAs, trust elements, benefits, and other conversion elements should be placed.
* Think through the user journey when designing new pages, making sure the flow feels natural and without friction.
* Help keep our visual design consistent across the website and different campaign experiences.
* Adapt and improve designs quickly based on feedback and business priorities.
* Ensure designs are responsive and work well across desktop and mobile.

*Requirements*

* Proven experience as a UX/UI Designer, with a strong portfolio of digital and web design work — specifically for e-commerce or direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands.
* *Required: minimum 2+ years designing for e-commerce or DTC brands* — this is a must-have, not a nice-to-have. Experience in health, wellness, or supplements is a strong plus.
* Strong UI design skills, with excellent attention to detail and a high standard for visual quality.
* Good understanding of UX principles and conversion-optimised design.
* Ability to balance strong visual design with user experience and business goals.
* Good understanding of conversion principles and how design can influence user behavior and decision-making.
* Experience designing responsive websites for both desktop and mobile.
* Strong proficiency in Figma.
* Ability to take a concept or rough brief and turn it into a polished, well-thought-out design.

*Location*

Please note: due to operational constraints, we are unfortunately unable to consider candidates based in the US, the UK, or the Netherlands at this time.

*Application Requirements*

CVs must be submitted in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
*UX/UI Designer – Figma, Product Design & User Experience | Remote*

*Position Type:* Full-Time, Remote
*Working Hours:* U.S. Client Business Hours

*About the Role*

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a *UX/UI Designer* to create intuitive, visually polished, and high-performing digital experiences across web and mobile products.

This is more than a visual design role. You’ll own the design process from *user research and UX strategy through wireframing, prototyping, high-fidelity UI design, design systems, and developer handoff*.

You’ll work closely with *Product Managers, Engineers, QA, and leadership* to understand user problems and translate them into digital experiences that are easy to use, scalable, accessible, and aligned with business objectives.

If you combine strong UX thinking with polished UI execution and enjoy solving real product problems through design, this role is a strong fit.

*What You’ll Own*

*User Research & UX Strategy*
-----------------------------

* Conduct user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and behavioral analysis
* Identify user needs, pain points, and friction across digital experiences
* Translate research into:

* Personas
* User journeys
* User flows
* Information architecture
* Wireframes

* Use behavioral and analytics tools such as:

* Hotjar
* FullStory
* Google Analytics

* Combine qualitative and quantitative insights to identify UX opportunities
* Recommend improvements based on user behavior, research, and product goals

*Wireframing & Prototyping*
---------------------------

* Create low-fidelity wireframes to validate concepts and workflows
* Build interactive prototypes for usability testing and stakeholder review
* Develop high-fidelity product mockups using:

* Figma
* Adobe XD
* Sketch

* Rapidly iterate based on:

* User testing
* Stakeholder feedback
* QA findings

* Clearly communicate interaction patterns and intended product behavior
* Move concepts efficiently from early exploration to production-ready design

*UI & Product Design*
---------------------

* Design clean, modern, and user-friendly interfaces
* Create responsive experiences across:

* Desktop
* Tablet
* Mobile

* Balance usability, aesthetics, accessibility, and business objectives
* Design user flows and conversion paths that minimize friction
* Apply strong visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, and layout principles
* Ensure interfaces are visually polished and production-ready
* Maintain consistency across features and product experiences

*Design Systems & Scalability*
------------------------------

* Build and maintain scalable design systems and component libraries
* Establish consistent standards for:

* Typography
* Color
* Spacing
* Layouts
* Components
* Interaction patterns

* Create reusable components that improve design and development efficiency
* Maintain organized design files, assets, specifications, and documentation
* Ensure consistency across products, features, and platforms
* Evolve design systems as product requirements grow

*Accessibility & Usability*
---------------------------

* Apply *WCAG accessibility standards* throughout the design process
* Consider:

* Contrast
* Readability
* Keyboard accessibility
* Responsiveness
* Overall usability

* Conduct usability reviews
* Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows
* Improve:

* Task completion
* Navigation
* Conversion paths
* Overall product usability

* Incorporate accessibility into designs from the beginning rather than treating it as a final check

*Product & Engineering Collaboration*
-------------------------------------

* Work closely with:

* Product Managers
* Developers
* QA
* Leadership

* Participate in sprint planning, product discussions, and feature prioritization
* Collaborate with engineering throughout implementation rather than only at handoff
* Deliver developer-ready designs using:

* Figma Dev Mode
* Zeplin
* InVision Inspect

* Provide clear specifications, assets, and interaction documentation
* Review implemented designs
* Identify and resolve inconsistencies before release
* Help ensure the final product accurately reflects the intended user experience

*Requirements*

* *2+ years of professional UX/UI or Product Design experience*
* Strong portfolio demonstrating:

* UX problem-solving
* UI craftsmanship
* Responsive design
* Product design thinking

* Advanced proficiency with:

* *Figma*
* Adobe XD
* Sketch

* Experience creating:

* User flows
* Wireframes
* Interactive prototypes
* High-fidelity interfaces
* Responsive layouts
* Design systems

* Strong understanding of:

* UX and usability principles
* Interaction design
* Accessibility
* Responsive design
* Mobile-first design

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Ability to clearly explain and defend design decisions
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a remote product environment
* Availability during *U.S. client business hours*

*Preferred Experience*

* Experience designing:

* SaaS products
* Mobile applications
* E-commerce platforms

* Experience building or maintaining scalable design systems
* Familiarity with:

* HTML/CSS fundamentals
* Developer workflows
* Agile/Scrum environments

* Experience with behavioral analytics tools such as:

* Hotjar
* FullStory
* Google Analytics

* Experience conducting A/B tests or design experiments
* Understanding of *Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)*
* Experience collaborating directly with engineering teams through implementation

*Tools & Technology*

*Figma | Figma Dev Mode | Adobe XD | Sketch | Zeplin | InVision Inspect | Hotjar | FullStory | Google Analytics | HTML/CSS | Design Systems | Prototyping & Usability Testing Tools*

*What Makes You a Strong Fit*

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Think about user journeys and product problems, not just individual screens
* Combine strong visual design skills with practical UX thinking
* Can clearly explain the reasoning behind your design decisions
* Are comfortable using research and data to challenge assumptions
* Understand how UX impacts adoption, engagement, conversion, and satisfaction
* Collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Care about consistency, accessibility, and the small details that make products feel polished
* Can iterate quickly without sacrificing design quality
* Understand how designs translate into real products during development
* Take ownership from initial research through final implementation

*What a Typical Day Looks Like*

Your day may begin by reviewing user behavior, product feedback, or upcoming feature requirements to identify UX opportunities and potential friction.

Throughout the day, you could create user flows and wireframes, build and test interactive prototypes, design polished interfaces in Figma, or refine the product’s design system.

You’ll collaborate closely with Product and Engineering during sprint execution, incorporate feedback from usability testing and QA, and prepare developer-ready designs with clear specifications and interaction details.

You’ll also review implemented features to ensure the final experience maintains the intended design quality and consistency.

In short: *you turn user needs and business requirements into intuitive, scalable, accessible, and visually polished digital products.*

*Key Metrics for Success*

* Improved product usability and user satisfaction
* Increased engagement and product adoption
* Reduced friction across critical user journeys
* Improved task completion and conversion flows
* Consistent implementation of design systems
* Reduced design-related development revisions
* On-time delivery of developer-ready designs
* Strong accessibility and responsive design standards
* High-quality implementation of approved designs
* Positive feedback from users and internal stakeholders

*Why This Role Stands Out*

* End-to-end ownership of UX and UI design
* Opportunity to influence real product strategy and user experience
* Close collaboration with Product and Engineering leadership
* Opportunity to build and improve scalable design systems
* Use of research and analytics to influence product decisions
* Hands-on involvement from discovery through implementation
* Fully remote environment aligned with U.S. clients
* Strong career progression into:

* Senior Product Designer
* Lead UX/UI Designer
* Design Systems Lead
* Head of Product Design

*Interview Process*

* Initial Application
* *Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview*
* Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
* Portfolio Review + Practical Design Task
* Client Interview
* Offer & Background Verification

*Spark Hire Video Interview – Required*

As part of the application process, *all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire*.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a *Spark Hire invitation by email* with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is *required to be considered for the next stage*. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

*Apply Now*

If you have a strong *UX/UI portfolio* , are highly proficient in *Figma* , and can take a product from research and wireframes through polished, developer-ready UI, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help create digital products that are *intuitive, accessible, scalable, visually polished, and genuinely enjoyable to use*.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
