Глибокі знання та практичний досвід: UX/UI Design, Product Design, App Design, E-commerce UX.
Робота з дизайн-системами: досвід створення, підтримки та розвитку масштабних дизайн-систем.
Дослідження та аналітика: проведення usability-аудитів, UX-досліджень, робота з аналітикою та результатами A/B-тестів.
Мислення та бачення: наявність хисту, розвиненого візуального бачення, таланту до дизайну та креативу.
Командний гравець: успішний досвід тісної співпраці з продуктовою командою (PO, аналітики, розробники).

Що ви будете робити:
Розвивати продукт: вести продуктовий дизайн сайту АЛЛО та покращувати загальний користувацький досвід.
Проєктувати: створювати UX/UI для нових функцій та оптимізувати існуючі користувацькі сценарії.
Творити зміни: брати безпосередню участь у масштабному редизайні сайту та розвитку його ключових розділів.
Забезпечувати консистентність: розвивати та підтримувати дизайн-систему компанії.
Аналізувати та покращувати: проводити UX-аудити, виявляти «болі» користувачів, аналізувати зворотний зв’язок і результати тестувань для підвищення конверсії.
Взаємодіяти з командою: щільно співпрацювати з Product Owner, бізнес-аналітиками, розробниками та QA.
Супроводжувати процеси: вести дизайн-рішення від етапу постановки задачі до релізу та контролювати якість їх впровадження (design QA).

Що ми пропонуємо:
Роботу над масштабним національним продуктом, яким щодня користуються мільйони людей.
Професійну продуктову команду.
Всі необхідні інструменти для реалізації ваших найсміливіших дизайн-ідей.
Гідна зарплата + бонуси за результат
Графік з 9:00 до 18:00 (або з 10:00 до 19:00), сб, нд — вихідні
Знижки на техніку та першочерговий доступ до новинок
Медичне страхування, спорт, англійська мова
Можливість професійного та кар'єрного росту у великій національній компанії

Чекаємо на ваше резюме обов'язково разом із портфоліо!

title: Product Designer - UX/UI & Design Systems (Remote)
description:
*Product Designer (UX/UI + Design Systems | SaaS) – Remote*
-----------------------------------------------------------

*Position Type:* Full-Time, Remote
*Location:* Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Mexico
*Working Hours:* U.S. Business Hours

*About the Role*
----------------

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a *Product Designer (UX/UI)* to own the end-to-end product experience across modern web and mobile applications.

This is a product-focused design role that goes beyond creating beautiful interfaces. You’ll combine user research, product thinking, UX strategy, UI design, and scalable design systems to build intuitive, high-performing digital products that improve usability, engagement, and customer satisfaction.

Working closely with Product Managers and Engineers, you’ll transform user insights into polished, developer-ready experiences while continuously optimizing products through research, analytics, and experimentation.

If you think in user journeys, product flows, and scalable systems—not just screens—this role is for you.

*Responsibilities*
------------------

*UX Research & Product Discovery*
---------------------------------

* Conduct user research, interviews, usability testing, and behavioral analysis.
* Translate research findings into personas, user journeys, workflows, and user flows.
* Identify friction points and recommend UX improvements.
* Leverage product analytics tools such as Mixpanel and Amplitude to inform design decisions.
* Collaborate with Product Managers to validate assumptions and prioritize user needs.

*UX/UI Design*
--------------

* Design wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces.
* Create responsive experiences across web and mobile platforms.
* Deliver polished, user-centered designs aligned with modern SaaS design principles.
* Produce developer-ready assets using Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch.
* Iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback and user insights.

*Design Systems & Scalability*
------------------------------

* Build, maintain, and evolve scalable design systems and reusable component libraries.
* Establish standards for typography, spacing, color systems, iconography, and interaction patterns.
* Ensure consistency across products, features, and customer touchpoints.
* Improve collaboration between design and engineering through standardized design practices.

*Accessibility & User Experience*
---------------------------------

* Design accessible experiences that align with WCAG 2.1 standards.
* Ensure responsive usability across devices, browsers, and screen sizes.
* Improve navigation, information architecture, and interaction design.
* Create intuitive experiences that reduce friction and improve engagement.

*Product Optimization & Experimentation*
----------------------------------------

* Conduct A/B testing on user flows, layouts, and interaction patterns.
* Analyze user behavior and product performance metrics.
* Optimize conversion, engagement, onboarding, and retention through iterative improvements.
* Continuously refine designs using analytics, usability testing, and customer feedback.

*Collaboration & Developer Handoff*
-----------------------------------

* Work closely with Product Managers and Engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Deliver developer-ready specifications using Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin, or similar tools.
* Create clear interaction documentation, design specifications, and implementation guidance.
* Participate in sprint planning, design reviews, and product discussions.

*What Makes You a Great Fit*
----------------------------

* You think like a product designer—not just a visual designer.
* You balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.
* You enjoy solving complex product problems through thoughtful design.
* You use research and data to guide design decisions.
* You’re collaborative, organized, and comfortable working in Agile environments.
* You care deeply about usability, accessibility, and scalable design systems.

*Required Experience & Skills*
------------------------------

* 2+ years of experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating:

* UX problem-solving
* Product thinking
* High-quality UI execution
* Responsive product design

* Proficiency with:

* Figma
* Adobe XD
* Sketch

* Experience creating:

* User flows
* Wireframes
* Interactive prototypes
* Design systems

* Strong understanding of:

* UX principles
* Accessibility standards
* Usability testing
* Responsive design

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

*Nice to Have*
--------------

* Experience designing:

* SaaS products
* Consumer applications
* Enterprise software

* Experience building scalable design systems.
* Basic front-end knowledge of:

* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript

* Familiarity with:

* Mixpanel
* Amplitude
* Product analytics platforms

*What Success Looks Like*
-------------------------

* Product experiences are intuitive, engaging, and user-friendly.
* Design systems remain scalable, consistent, and widely adopted.
* User friction decreases while engagement and retention improve.
* Design assets are delivered on time and developer-ready.
* Product teams collaborate efficiently with minimal implementation issues.
* User feedback and analytics consistently inform design improvements.

*Interview Process*
-------------------

* Initial Phone Screen
* Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
* Portfolio Review & Practical Design Task
* Client Interview
* Offer & Background Verification

*What Happens After You Apply*
------------------------------

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from *Spark Hire* to record your *Intro Video*. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows hiring managers to evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

*Apply Now*
-----------

If you’re passionate about designing intuitive product experiences, enjoy solving user problems through research and thoughtful design, and want to help build scalable SaaS products, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape digital experiences that users love.

title: Senior eCommerce UX/UI Designer - EU
description:
*About WON*

WON is building the next generation of AI transformation for enterprise organizations. We are not another AI tools vendor. We build AI-native systems, combined with deep human judgment and category expertise, that fundamentally change how our clients operate, make decisions, and serve their customers.

Within that, our design practice works with premium DTC and ecommerce brands doing $50M to $500M+ in revenue: brands with strong products and strong followings that are still leaving growth on the table. We are not a “make it pretty” agency, and we are not another CRO shop running button tests. We combine deep behavioral insight with quantitative truth, then ship exceptional work fast, and we are building the AI-native systems that let us do it at a pace and scale traditional design teams cannot match.

AI powers our systems. Taste powers our design. The two compound each other: automation gives you the speed, and your judgment decides what is actually good.

This role reports to the VP of Design and works within the design roadmap they set.

*What You’ll Own*

*

End-to-end execution of high-conversion experiences, full customer journey redesigns, and high-performance growth creative, scoped by the design roadmap and delivered in close collaboration with the VP of Design

*

The WON design standard: clean, premium, behavior-driven, detail-obsessed, and fast to ship

*

Adoption of WON's AI-native design systems, including Claude Design and Figma MCP, to move from concept to shippable work faster

*

Automated asset creation built on our Figma component libraries, so variations and scale stop being manual work

*

Contributing to the expansion of WON’s design agents and workflows, flagging what should be automated next

-------------------------
*How Success Is Measured*
-------------------------

*

Conversion and AOV move measurably on the experiences you touch

*

Customers move further through the funnel because of design decisions you made

*

High-quality design ships fast, with less time lost between concept and production

*

Component libraries and AI-assisted workflows reduce manual design work over time, not just for you but for the whole team

*

Your work becomes the most reliable design output at WON, the standard new hires are measured against

----------------------
*Key Responsibilities*
----------------------

*

Design high-conversion sites and landing pages that still feel premium, the kind that belong in the top 1%

*

Design the full customer journey: acquisition landing flows, onboarding, collection architecture, PDP storytelling, cart and checkout, retention and member UX

*

Design growth creative: paid social landing pages, advertorials, quiz flows, product education, bundles and upsell, offer frameworks that feel intentional, not desperate

*

Build and maintain component libraries and design systems that scale across brands and campaigns

*

Use Claude Design, Figma MCP, and automated asset generation to reduce production time without reducing quality

*

Continuously evaluate your own workflow and flag what should be turned into a repeatable system or agent

*

Present work with conviction, backed by session replays, cohort behavior, and voice of customer

------------
*Must-Have:*
------------

*

5+ years in digital design, agency or in-house

*

Strong ecommerce / DTC experience

*

A portfolio of modern, premium work, not template-driven

*

Mastery in Figma

*

Strong typography instincts, real ones

*

Taste that holds up under scrutiny: you can articulate why a design decision is right, not just that it feels right

*

Comfortable being measured by impact, not just output

*

Familiarity with AI design tools such as Claude Design or Figma MCP, or genuine interest in building them into your workflow

---------------
*Nice-to-Have:*
---------------

*

Designed for high-end brands (beauty, apparel, wellness, premium food)

*

Experience working within Shopify ecosystems

*

Built component libraries and design systems from scratch

*

Contributed to CRO programs that produced measurable performance gains

*Portfolio / Proof of Work Expectation*

*We Value*

*

Modern, premium design work, not template-driven

*

Evidence your design decisions moved a real metric: conversion, AOV, or funnel progression

*

Systems thinking: component libraries and reusable frameworks, not just one-off screens

*

Comfort presenting and defending design decisions with data

*How We Work / Culture*

*

Design is treated as a growth system, not a decoration function

*

Insights come first: every decision is grounded in customer behavior and tied to KPIs

*

AI and automation are used to eliminate manual production work, not to replace judgment

*

High clarity, ownership, and craft are core values: work ships fast instead of dying in Figma

*Why Join WON*

*

Build design systems that move revenue for brands doing $50M to $500M+ in revenue

*

Work at the intersection of design, behavioral insight, and AI-native workflows

*

High ownership over execution, with a clear roadmap and a VP of Design invested in your growth

*

Collaborate with a founder-led team with taste and urgency, and full access to the truth: session replays, cohort data, voice of customer

*

Help build the AI design systems, including Claude Design, Figma MCP, and automated component workflows, that define how WON designs at scale

*If you want to be a career designer, this probably isn’t for you. If you want to become an elite operator-designer who builds work that changes brands and makes numbers move, we’d love to meet you.*

title: Sr. UI/UX Designer
description:
*Company Overview*
SCS Global Services is a pioneer and leader in the field of sustainability standards and third-party certification, working across the economy in the natural resources, built environment, food and agriculture, consumer products, and climate sectors for over 40 years. As a Benefit Corporation, we are committed to socially and environmentally responsible business practices, and through the application of sound science, we are driving positive change.

*Job Overview*
SCS Global Services is seeking a Senior UI/UX Designer to lead the design of intuitive, professional, customer facing web applications across the SCS technology portfolio. This role applies modern service design principles including customer journeys, service blueprints, and human-centered experience design, to shape how manufacturers, verification bodies, auditors, and platform partners interact with SCS digital products. The Senior UI/UX Designer will work closely with Project Management, Application Development, and business stakeholders to translate certification and audit workflows into clear, usable, and professional digital experiences.

*Essential Duties and Responsibilities*

* Design intuitive, professional looking user interfaces for internal and customer facing web applications
* Develop customer journey maps and service blueprints that document end-to-end interactions across user roles (manufacturers, verifiers, auditors, certification bodies, and platform partners)
* Apply modern service design methods to align digital experience design with the underlying business and operational processes
* Conduct user research and usability testing to validate design decisions and identify opportunities to improve the customer experience
* Create user flows, wireframes, high fidelity designs, and interactive prototypes to communicate and validate design solutions
* Partner with Project Managers and Application Development teams to define problems, evaluate solutions, and make informed product decisions
* Work closely with development teams throughout implementation to ensure the delivered experience meets design intent and user needs
* Promote consistency, usability, responsiveness, and accessibility across web and mobile experiences
* Translate complex, multi-role certification and audit workflows into clear, accessible user experiences
* Stay current with emerging UX practices, technologies, and design tools and evaluate opportunities to improve our products and design process

*Minimum Qualifications*

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience) *and*
* 5+ years of professional experience as a UI/UX Designer working on customer-facing web applications
* Strategic Thinking: connects design decisions to product strategy and long-term user impact
* People Management: experience coaching, developing, and managing designers at different levels
* principles to create user-friendly products that meet business objectives
* Extensive experience in Lean UX
* Proven ability to produce customer journey maps and service blueprints as part of the design process
* Strong portfolio demonstrating modern, professional interface design for business or enterprise web applications
* Proficiency with Figma and/or Claude Design
* Proficiency in service design methodology and human-centered design principles
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional product and engineering teams
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting design work to non-design stakeholders

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience designing for certification, audit, compliance, or other multi-role B2B workflow platforms
* Familiarity with accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) for web applications
* Experience contributing to or maintaining a formal design system
* Proven success working in a fully remote, distributed team environment

The above description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Additional duties outside of normal responsibilities may be required from time to time as assigned.

*Working Remotely*
SCS Global Services is recruiting all open roles to be remote; allowing our employees the ability to work flexibly and allowing SCS Global Services as a company to diversify the experience and perspectives of our growing workforce. This is a home-office based role and may include travel with local, domestic, and/or international trips. Details will be clarified during the recruitment process.

*Estimated Annual Salary*
$85,018.60 - $130,000.00

*EEOC Statement*
SCS Global Services provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. SCS Global Services complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

title: UI/UX Director
description:
UI/UX Director.

Datmos brings together passionate experts who combine creativity and data to craft inspiring eCommerce experiences.

Driven by a shared passion for excellence , we help visionary brands grow by aligning commerce strategy, digital experience, and technology implementation to deliver innovative, data-driven digital commerce solutions.

Datmos is seeking a visionary, hands-on UI/UX Director to lead our digital design team and elevate the quality of our web and e-commerce products. In this executive-level role, you will be the direct manager of our UX and UI designers, serving as the ultimate guardian of design excellence, craftsmanship, accessibility, and technical feasibility.

You are a unique hybrid: a master of UI design with a strong background in front-end development, paired with a deep appreciation for the strategic business value of UX. Beyond creative leadership, you thrive in high-stakes sales pitches, lead strategic conversations with clients, and seamlessly juggle operational realities - including estimation accuracy, capacity planning, forecasting, and budgets.

Key Responsibilities

1. Creative & Technical Direction

* UI & Front-End Bridge: Bridges the gap between design and technical execution, drawing on your front-end expertise to push aesthetic boundaries while respecting web performance, responsive layouts, and technical constraints.
* Mobile-First Thinker: Implements a mobile-first approach to design that includes responsive websites, mobile applications, and omnichannel experiences. A leader who understands that CX lives across all touchpoints.
* Data-Driven: Understands how data can make or break a mandate and uses data to inform strategy and approach to any mandate. Is able to read complex data sets and extract insights that are critical for the design process.
* Design Systems & Architecture: Oversees the creation and governance of scalable design systems, component libraries, Figma Variables , and design tokens to streamline front-end handoffs and scale design system implementations to multiple clients.
* Platform & E-Commerce Mastery: Provides strategic oversight for complex web projects built on platforms like Shopify and Adobe Commerce , as well as interactive frameworks like , and familiarity with HTML, CSS, JS. The CX Director does not need to be a developer, but must understand the differences, benefits, and challenges between these frameworks as they affect design mandates.
* Quality & Standards: Enforces strict visual consistency, micro-interactions, motion design standards, and universal accessibility standards (WCAG) across all deliverables.
* AI Integration & Optimization: Continuously monitors AI advancements and emerging tools to optimize design team efficiency, integrating new technologies into daily workflows and creative direction.

2. Team Leadership & Operations

* Direct Management & Mentorship: Leads, mentors, and grows a multidisciplinary team of UX and UI designers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, autonomy, and craftsmanship.
* Resource & Capacity Planning: Oversees effort estimation, project allocation, capacity forecasting, and workload balancing to hit deadlines without compromising quality.
* Budget & Process Optimization: Collaborates with project management to track creative budgets, eliminate delivery bottlenecks, and continuously refine internal design processes.

3. Strategic Client Relationships & Business Growth

* Sales & Pitching: Plays a leading role in proposals and new business pitches, articulating bold creative concepts, technical viability, and design ROI to win key accounts.
* Client Advisory & Feedback Leadership: Leads high-level strategic discussions with executive stakeholders, translating business goals into exceptional digital strategies and expertly guiding client feedback iterations.
* UX Value Advocacy: Demonstrates and communicates the business impact of human-centered design, user research, and strategic UI/UX to both internal teams and external clients.

Qualifications & Key Requirements

* Experience: 10+ years in digital design (agency environment preferred), with a proven track record in a creative leadership or executive role.
* UI & Front-End Background: Expert-level UI design skills backed by practical experience in front-end development (HTML/CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks like React.js ).
* Tooling & Systems Expertise: Master-level proficiency in Figma (advanced prototyping, variables, auto-layout) and Adobe Creative Suite.
* E-Commerce Ecosystems: Solid working knowledge of e-commerce platforms (e.g., Shopify , Adobe Commerce ) and their technical capabilities.
* UX & Accessibility Literacy: Deep understanding of user research, information architecture, responsive layouts, and WCAG accessibility guidelines.
* Operational & Financial Acumen: Demonstrated ability to manage team capacity, forecast workload, estimate task effort, and respect project budgets.
* Client & Pitching Excellence: Exceptional storytelling, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to distill complex problems into compelling client-facing strategies.

Nice to have

*Basic Qualifications:*

title: Marketing Designer
description:
We're looking for a Marketing Designer to shape how Alertive shows up in the market.

You'll bring our brand and product to life across campaigns, content, presentations, events and digital channels, while helping us evolve our visual identity as the business grows.

The foundations of our new brand are in place, but there's plenty still to shape. You'll work closely with the Head of Marketing to take ideas from initial concept through to finished execution, contributing to the creative thinking rather than simply receiving finished briefs.

We're a small marketing team, so the role is broad and your work will be highly visible. We're looking for someone who enjoys that variety, has strong creative judgement, is curious about technology and wants the freedom to make an impact. You'll own Alertive's day-to-day visual identity and help develop how the brand and product come to life as we grow. That means:

* Developing campaign concepts and creative across social, digital, presentations, customer stories, events and sales materials
* Evolving our visual identity, illustration system, templates and brand toolkit
* Working with Marketing and Product to understand how Alertive works and translate our technology, features and healthcare workflows into clear and compelling creative
* Developing video content across customer stories, product content, events, social and campaigns
* Helping shape our WordPress website, from campaign landing pages to improving how our proposition and product are presented
* Using AI and emerging creative tools to explore ideas, improve workflows and accelerate production
* Building reusable approaches that make recurring creative work faster and more consistent

You'll have plenty of freedom to contribute ideas, challenge briefs and identify opportunities to improve our creative output. We're looking for a designer who enjoys breadth and is comfortable moving between different types of creative work.

You'll ideally bring:

* 3+ years' experience in a design role, ideally within an in-house, B2B or similarly fast-moving environment
* A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent typography, layout and visual judgement across different formats
* Strong Adobe Creative Suite skills, particularly Illustrator and InDesign
* The ability to take work from an early idea through to polished final execution
* An understanding of audiences, campaigns and commercial objectives
* Genuine curiosity about technology and an interest in getting under the skin of digital products to find creative ways to bring them to life
* Confidence using AI as part of your creative workflow and an appetite for experimenting with new tools
* The ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines without compromising attention to detail
* Confidence taking an incomplete brief, asking the right questions and turning it into something useful
* The ability to explain your creative thinking and work collaboratively with people who aren't designers

You don't need everything on this list, but we'd particularly like to hear about experience with:

* Video editing and simple branded motion graphics
* WordPress and Elementor
* Figma, particularly components and auto-layout
* Building or maintaining design systems, template libraries or brand toolkits
* Photography
* Healthcare, healthtech or another technically complex sector

*Job Type:* Full-time, Permanent
*Schedule:* Monday to Friday, with flexible working supported as a default
*Location:* Hybrid. You'll need to be able to travel to London, Birmingham or Derby for regular team and company meetings, as well as occasional events where required.
*Reports to* : Head of Marketing
*Salary:* Up to £40,000 depending on experience We're a small company doing work that genuinely matters, and we want the people here to feel both valued and connected to what we're building.

People at Alertive are trusted to lead their work, think independently and contribute beyond the boundaries of their job description, while working closely with colleagues who care deeply about solving real problems for NHS staff.

You'll have genuine ownership of Alertive's day-to-day creative output and direct access to the people making decisions. The Head of Marketing has overall responsibility for the Alertive brand and final sign-off on marketing creative, but we want you to bring your own judgement, ideas and expertise to the work.

We support flexible working as a default, not a perk. You can also expect a competitive benefits package including private health insurance, 25 days' annual leave, enhanced parental leave, life insurance and a 5% pension contribution.

Applications should be submitted to talent@alertive.co.uk with a CV and portfolio.

We're interested in the thinking behind your work as much as the finished result, so show us projects you can talk us through rather than simply your prettiest pieces. We'd particularly like to see examples across different formats, including video or web work where you have it.

We are an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you need any adjustments during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Senior Graphic Designer (Static Ads)
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Graphic Designer (Static Ads) based in United Arab Emirates.*

This is a senior-level creative role focused on producing high-performing static advertising for fast-growing e-commerce brands.
You’ll turn concise briefs and brand guidelines into scroll-stopping concepts that communicate clearly and capture attention quickly.
The role combines strong visual craft with a performance mindset, where great design is measured by both quality and its ability to drive results.
You’ll work primarily independently while collaborating with an experienced design team through focused feedback and creative reviews.
Speed and consistency are essential, with an expectation of producing approximately 9–10 polished composites each day.
You’ll also use AI extensively to accelerate ideation, explore creative directions, and develop variations without compromising design quality.
This opportunity is ideal for a highly skilled designer who enjoys creative experimentation, tight deadlines, measurable outcomes, and a high level of ownership.

Accountabilities
----------------

* Create high-quality static advertising creatives using strong typography, visual hierarchy, composition, and layouts designed to capture attention and communicate messages quickly.
* Translate concise briefs and brand guidelines into multiple creative variations suitable for rapid testing across different e-commerce brands and categories.
* Use Photoshop as the primary production tool for compositing, typography, retouching, and fast, precise creative execution, while leveraging Figma for layouts, systems, and collaborative feedback.
* Incorporate AI tools extensively into the creative workflow to ideate, explore visual styles, generate variations, and improve production efficiency while maintaining a high level of craft.
* Consistently produce approximately 9–10 approved composites per day while balancing speed, accuracy, consistency, and creative quality.
* Iterate quickly based on feedback, simplifying concepts and messaging to focus on the elements most likely to drive attention and performance.
* Bring a senior creative perspective to concept development, challenging safe or predictable executions and proposing stronger directions that can improve advertising performance.
* Maintain organized, consistent, and production-ready design files with strong attention to detail and file hygiene.
* Communicate timelines, blockers, priorities, and tradeoffs proactively through written channels such as Slack and email.
* Meet agreed weekly performance targets while maintaining a consistently high quality bar and minimizing unnecessary revision cycles.
* Progress toward defined 30-, 60-, and 90-day performance expectations, including reaching full production capacity, reducing revision rates, contributing creative direction, and taking ownership of increasingly demanding briefs and brand launches.

------------
Requirements
------------

* *Experience:* 5+ years of professional graphic design experience with advertising creative at the center of your work, supported by a portfolio of shipped ads or conversion-focused visual work across multiple brands or categories.
* *Advertising Expertise:* Demonstrated experience creating advertisements is required; experience with Facebook, paid social, DTC, or performance marketing environments is a strong advantage.
* *Photoshop:* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop is essential, particularly for compositing, typography, retouching, and rapid production under tight deadlines.
* *Figma:* Comfortable using Figma for layouts, components, design systems, feedback, and collaborative reviews.
* *AI-Assisted Design:* Fluent use of AI tools within your creative process, with examples of AI-assisted work in your portfolio and a clear understanding of where AI can meaningfully improve ideation and production without replacing good design judgment.
* *High-Volume Production:* Proven ability to sustain a demanding daily creative output over an extended period, ideally within a creative agency or direct-to-consumer brand environment.
* *Performance Mindset:* Strong understanding of what makes advertising effective and converts, with the confidence to challenge briefs and recommend stronger creative approaches rather than focusing solely on aesthetics.
* *Communication:* Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate clearly, precisely, and professionally through written channels and meetings.
* *Organization:* Thoughtful and methodical approach to creative production, with strong attention to detail, file organization, consistency, and deadlines.
* *Prioritization:* Ability to remain calm under pressure, manage competing priorities, and consistently meet daily and weekly production targets without compromising quality.
* *Collaboration:* Comfortable working in an approximately 80% independent and 20% collaborative environment, while actively seeking and responding constructively to feedback.
* *Creative Judgment:* Strong visual instincts, curiosity, adaptability, and the confidence to move beyond predictable concepts while working within practical creative constraints.

--------
Benefits
--------

* Starting compensation of *$2,000 USD per month* , with the opportunity for higher compensation for exceptional talent.
* Fully remote, full-time contractor position with a predictable Monday–Friday schedule.
* Working hours of *9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time (ET)*.
* Clear priorities, structured feedback loops, and regular check-ins.
* High-volume, real-world performance creative projects across e-commerce categories including health, apparel, pet, and fitness.
* Significant autonomy over your creative work alongside collaboration with an experienced design team.
* Opportunity to expand your AI-enabled design capabilities and develop scalable creative systems.
* International exposure through a global professional network.
* Back-office support covering payroll, onboarding, and HR administration.
* Opportunity to sharpen both creative craft and performance-oriented advertising expertise through rapid testing and iteration.

title: Senior Product Technical Support Engineer
description:
*Role: Senior Product Technical Support Engineer*
*Location: Indore, MP (Remote)*
*Note: Candidate should be comfortable and willing to work night shifts.*

*Job Summary:*
We are looking for a *Senior Product Technical Support Engineer* with strong hands-on debugging and problem-solving skills to support and troubleshoot a large-scale *Ruby on Rails monolithic application*. You will work across the application, database, integrations, and hosting layers to diagnose complex production issues and ensure a reliable customer experience.
*Key Responsibilities*

* Troubleshoot complex *production issues* across Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, background jobs, APIs, and third-party integrations using logs, stack traces, database queries, and debugging tools.
* Perform *root cause analysis (RCA)* for production incidents and work closely with Engineering, Product, QA, and Customer Support teams to drive issues to resolution.
* Diagnose *PostgreSQL* issues including slow queries, data inconsistencies, database locks/deadlocks, connection issues, indexing, and data-related problems.
* Troubleshoot *REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, data synchronization, and third-party integrations* , including *Stripe and AWS S3*.
* Support and troubleshoot applications hosted on *Heroku* , including dynos, workers, deployments, configuration/environment variables, logs, build failures, and application performance.
* Investigate *Stripe payment, subscription, refund, and webhook-related issues* , including discrepancies between Stripe and application data.
* Analyze customer-reported issues, trace problems through the application and database layers, reproduce issues, and provide appropriate fixes or workarounds.
* Make small-to-medium *code fixes, SQL queries, scripts, configuration changes, and production fixes* where required.
* Monitor recurring production issues and proactively identify opportunities to improve *application stability, performance, monitoring, and support processes*.
* Create and maintain *technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, runbooks, and RCA reports*.

*Required Skills & Experience*

* *4+ years of experience* in technical support, application support, production support, or a similar engineering role.
* Strong hands-on experience with *Ruby/Ruby on Rails* and debugging web applications.
* Strong knowledge of *PostgreSQL and SQL* , including query analysis and troubleshooting.
* Experience with *Heroku* or similar cloud application hosting platforms.
* Good understanding of *REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, webhooks, and third-party integrations*.
* Experience working with *AWS S3* and cloud-based services.
* Familiarity with *Stripe APIs, payments, subscriptions, and webhooks* is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge of *Git, background jobs, caching, Linux/Unix, and application performance troubleshooting*.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, Product, QA, and Customer Support teams.

*Good to Have*

* Experience supporting *large monolithic Rails applications* in production.
* Experience with monitoring/logging tools and production incident management.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, automated deployments, and application performance monitoring.
* Experience writing scripts or automation to reduce repetitive support and troubleshooting activities.
* *Keywords:* Ruby on Rails, Ruby, PostgreSQL, SQL, Heroku, AWS S3, Stripe, REST API, Webhooks, Production Support, Application Support, Technical Support, Troubleshooting, Root Cause Analysis, RCA, Incident Management, Debugging, SaaS, Cloud, Git.

title: Lead Product Partnerships Manager (Contract)
description:
*Lead Product Partnerships Manager (Contract)*

*Location:* Remote, US | Duration: 12-month contract

*Hours:* 40hpw (full time), available for synchronous collaboration 15:00- 20:00 UTC

*Background Information*

The Wikimedia Foundation (WMF) seeks an experienced Lead Product Partnerships Manager to increase the global reach of Wikipedia's products and knowledge in a rapidly changing web landscape. The successful candidate will serve as a front-facing representative for external partnerships where the primary value is directly tied to product integration and new distribution opportunities for the Product and Technology (P&T) department, working within P&T with our org-wide partnerships cohort.

This person will cultivate relationships to grow the reuse of Wikimedia content in new products and spaces, as well as fostering increased presence of our content with existing reuse partners via adoption of Wikimedia attribution tools provided. Key audiences include AI providers, social/EdTech platforms, and other companies seeking product integration. This is a highly independent and self-directed lead position requiring candidates to possess existing, strong connections in the soft and hardware tech space.

*Scope of Work*

* *New Product & Technology Partnerships Cultivation:* Identify and secure new partnerships with existing and new technology platform partners. Collaborating closely with Product and Design teams, define and execute on a portfolio of non-commercial value exchange partnerships that advance the P&T department’s strategic goals, exploring areas such as new product development and integrations; data- and lead-sharing; and/or in-kind donations of technical products/services..
* *Attribution and Content Reuse:* Assist in designing and and securing pilots with high-priority Wikimedia content reusers to drive attribution visibility by adopting the Wikimedia Attribution Framework and API.
* *Cross-organizational Collaboration:* Coordinate across teams and departments (WME, Legal, Communications, Fundraising, Content Enablement, Community Resources & Partnerships) to build and maintain an up-to-date partner and opportunity pipeline. Be the voice of Product and Technology in cross-departmental discussions of the reuser and partner ecosystem.
* *Execution and Coordination:* Manage partnership processes and artifacts, including drafting LOI/MOUs (zero-dollar contracts), CRM management, creating pitch decks, and coordinating with other Partnerships staff across departments and teams.
* *Industry Engagement:* Attend relevant conferences, events, and gatherings to represent the needs of our organization and share back industry intelligence on product and technology trends. Monitor technology news to identify new launches that may impact our goals or provide new partnership opportunities.

*Deliverables/Responsibilities*

* Creating LOI/MOUs (zero-dollar contracts)
* CRM management in concert with Partnerships cohort across the organization
* Creating & refining pitch decks
* Creating, refining, & implementing pitch strategy (developing lists of friendlies, managing comms & scheduling with partners)
* Strong product and technical fluency to align the P&T product roadmap for high-scale reusers, ensuring alignment on data formats, reliability SLAs, and repeatable "Partner Kits".
* Coordinating with other Partnerships staff across departments/teams
* Attending partner conferences/events
* Monitoring for new partnership opportunities around new product releases

*Skills*

* Proven experience forming and managing high-level, multi-stakeholder partnerships, particularly in the technology and/or media industry, with demonstrated independence and self-direction expected in a lead role.
* Existing Network: Strong connections across the media and technology ecosystem, particularly within AI, social, media, and EdTech platforms
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the proven ability to influence both internal and external stakeholders, and operate in a complex, consensus-driven, cross-cultural environment.
* Analytical mindset to uncover and independently analyze insights from partners and market conditions.
* Experience in program/project management, including workflow management, managing comms and scheduling with partners, and note-taking and following up on action items.
* A passion for the mission and values of the Wikimedia movement.

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

*As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries ***. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. description:

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is building it's UK business from the ground up. We are looking for a Director of Partnerships to be the senior commercial owner of Ramp’s partner ecosystem in the UK: creating the relationships, market presence, and repeatable routes to revenue that help make Ramp a category-defining company in the region.

Reporting to the VP of Channel Sales, you will operate as a founder for Partnerships in London. You will build a focused partner strategy, develop executive-level relationships, and turn the right relationships into durable commercial outcomes. You will work closely with the UK go-to-market team and cross-functional leaders across Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to make partnerships a meaningful driver of market entry and long-term growth.

This is not a role for someone looking to inherit a mature playbook. The right person is entrepreneurial, commercially sharp, and comfortable creating clarity where there is none. They can move from a first meeting with a senior executive to a clear point of view, an internal plan, and disciplined follow-through.

What You'll Do

- Own and execute Ramp’s UK partnerships strategy, identifying the partner categories and individual relationships that can accelerate awareness, pipeline, customer value, and long-term market position

- Build and maintain senior relationships across the UK ecosystem, including accounting, private equity and venture capital firms, professional-services and consulting firms, financial institutions, technology partners, and other high-leverage channels

- Work alongside the UK Channel Partner Managers, aligning the broader ecosystem strategy with Ramp’s dedicated motions and creating leverage across shared relationships

- Develop a focused partnership plan for priority relationships: articulate the joint value proposition, define the commercial path, and create mutual accountability for progress

- Generate measurable commercial impact by sourcing and influencing pipeline, creating warm paths to target customers, and supporting strategic deals through partner relationships

- Represent Ramp with credibility at executive meetings, industry events, and partner forums, building the company’s reputation as a serious, long-term UK partner

- Serve as the internal voice of the UK partner market, translating relationship intelligence, customer needs, and market dynamics into actionable input for Sales, Product, Marketing, and leadership

- Build the operating cadence for the function, including account plans, partnership scorecards, executive briefs, pipeline visibility, and clear follow-through across internal and external stakeholders

- Help shape Ramp’s broader UK and European go-to-market strategy as the market, team, and partnership portfolio grow

What You Need

- 10+ years of experience in sales, partnerships, business development, alliances, or go-to-market leadership, with a demonstrated record of building senior relationships and driving commercial outcomes

- A proven track record of owning revenue, quota, influenced pipeline, or similarly concrete commercial goals in a complex B2B environment

- Executive presence and sound judgment: you can earn credibility with senior partner leaders and represent Ramp confidently in consequential conversations

- A builder mindset. You have launched a territory, vertical, business line, or partner motion, and know how to create a plan and operating rhythm from a blank page

- The ability to turn broad relationships into specific opportunities, navigate multiple stakeholders, and maintain momentum through long sales and partnership cycles

- Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to decide where Ramp should invest and make a clear, data-informed case to senior leadership

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to build a compelling partnership narrative and align cross-functional teams around it

- AI fluency as a daily habit. Ramp is a builder culture: if you do not instinctively reach for AI before doing things manually, this role will be a hard adjustment

- Ability to work five days per week from Ramp’s London office, with willingness to travel across the UK and continental Europe as needed

Nice to Haves

- Experience selling or partnering into private equity, financial services, consulting, enterprise technology, or high-growth software companies

- Experience in fintech, financial software, payments, spend management, or the office of the CFO technology ecosystem

- An established UK network of senior commercial, investment, operating, or technology leaders

- Experience building a new market or international go-to-market motion

- Fluency in an additional European language

Why Ramp

- Own one of Ramp’s most important external-facing growth mandates as we build the UK business

- Work directly with senior leaders across Channel, Sales, Product, and Marketing, with the autonomy to shape the market strategy and the accountability to deliver commercial outcomes

- Build at the intersection of fintech, AI, and enterprise software at a company redefining how businesses manage spend

Premier League partnerships will focus on senior executive relationships, curated hospitality, strategic introductions, and enterprise pipeline influence.

This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on role for someone who combines strong partner management with excellent commercial judgement and execution.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own the activation and commercial performance of Ramp’s current UK football-club partnerships.

- Build intentional, club-specific commercial plans using agreed partnership assets. Plans may include target-account lists, events, campaigns, warm-introduction routes, and clear success measures.

- Partner with club commercial teams to identify and engage relevant local businesses, corporate partners, suppliers, business-club members, owners, and finance leaders.

- Plan and deliver matchday hospitality, executive dinners, business-networking events, and other activations that create high-quality meetings and introductions for Ramp.

- Lead club-led outreach and campaigns, ensuring audiences are relevant, appropriately permissioned, and measurable.

- Coordinate introductions and follow-up with Ramp’s Sales team so club activity becomes meaningful sales opportunities.

- Track performance from club activity through qualified lead, accepted meeting, application, and activated customer.

- Run regular partner operating reviews and quarterly business reviews; use results to improve activation plans and hold teams accountable to agreed commitments.

- Coordinate internal teams across Marketing, Growth, Sales, Events, Product, and Engineering to support club activations and customer onboarding.

- Build a deep understanding of Ramp’s products, customer value, and workflows so you can represent Ramp credibly with club partners and prospects.

WHAT YOU NEED

- 5+ years of experience, including 3+ years in partnerships, business development, partner sales, account management, or commercial strategy.

- A track record of building trusted senior relationships and delivering measurable commercial results through partners.

- Strong event, hospitality, campaign, and go-to-market execution skills.

- Excellent judgement when identifying high-quality prospects, shaping warm introductions, and coordinating multiple stakeholders.

- Comfort using performance data to improve plans, report results, and manage to goals.

- Excellent written, verbal, and listening skills.

- A highly collaborative working style and the ability to work effectively across teams.

- The ability to manage stakeholders across different functions and keep complex activity moving.

- UK-based, with flexibility to travel more than 60% of the time and to support evening and weekend matchday and event commitments.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience working with UK football clubs, sports properties, business communities, sponsorships, or commercial partnerships.

- Experience creating B2B pipeline through events, hospitality, account-based campaigns, or partner networks.

- Familiarity with the UK small and medium-sized business market and finance-leader audience.

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

工作职责：

1. 负责拓展并签约跨境客户，通过多种获客方式（直客、转介绍、展会、商务渠道合作等）寻找潜在客户，达成营收目标；

3. 关注以下垂直化行业动态：广告及相关泛娱乐、OTA、在线教育等。熟悉每个以上细分行业的支付痛点，并能在准确搜集行业产品需求后，与公司内部产品团队进行有效的沟通，积极形成更为完善、有针对性的行业综合解决方案，提升客户体验，增强客户粘性；

4.推动客户从注册、KYC、上线到持续交易的全流程，确保客户稳定使用；

5.关注客户交易合规性，具备基本的风险识别意识，能在销售过程中把控交易合理性与真实性；

6.持续维护客户关系，洞察客户潜在交易机会，提升客户生命周期价值；

7. 保持对行业相关领域内各类信息的敏感和追踪，及时反馈并建议，探索并推广新的商业合作模式，为公司业务带来可持续发展。

任职要求：

1. 大学本科及以上学历；

2. 三年以上销售工作经验，有跨境支付、跨境电商、独立站服务商、ERP、海外广告代理等相关行业经验者优先；

3. 有极强的自我驱动力，以结果为导向，对结果负责；

4. 具备优秀的客户沟通能力，能够与客户建立良好的合作关系；

5. 优秀的学习能力和沟通能力，思维敏捷、有良好的应变能力和承压能力；

6. 具有敏锐的市场洞察力和准确的分析能力，能够有效开发并维护客户资源。

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We build the semantic layer at the core of the Snowflake platform — the system that lets customers define logical data models (tables, dimensions, metrics, and the relationships between them) once, and then query them consistently across BI tools, SQL, and AI agents. Semantic Views turn raw physical schemas into governed, reusable business definitions, so that "revenue," "active customer," or "gross margin" mean the same thing no matter who or what is asking. We own the semantic model itself, compiler elements and query rewriter that expand semantic queries into optimized SQL over petabyte-scale data, and the surfaces that expose this layer to Cortex Analyst and the broader agent ecosystem. Our work sits at the intersection of query language, metadata, and AI-driven analytics, and it is foundational to how Snowflake customers get trustworthy answers from their data.

AS A PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

- Fluency in Java or another similar object-oriented language is preferred.

- A track record of identifying and implementing creative solutions to complex, ambiguous problems.

- Ability to work effectively across engineering teams in multiple locations.

- BS in Computer Science; Masters or PhD preferred.

At Oula, our product doesn't sit alongside our EHR â it integrates directly into it. Someone has to hold both at once.

We're looking for a technically-minded Product Manager to own and evolve our core technology stack â including our EHR, patient portal, and care management platform. What You'll Own

title: Junior Data Analyst
description:
About HiredBuddy
At HiredBuddy, we connect domain specialists and subject-matter experts with leading AI research labs to shape and train the next generation of artificial intelligence. We focus on high-quality data annotation, RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback), and model evaluation across various domains, ranging from STEM and software engineering to linguistics and data science.
Position Overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Junior Data Analyst based in the United States to join our growing remote team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in monitoring dataset quality, analyzing annotator performance metrics, optimizing labeling pipelines, and delivering insights that improve our AI training data pipelines.
This is an ideal role for an early-career analyst passionate about the intersection of data, machine learning, and AI operations.
Key Responsibilities
- Data Quality Assurance: Audit, clean, and validate large datasets generated by our network of AI trainers and domain experts to ensure high precision and adherence to guidelines.
- Performance & Metrics Tracking: Analyze annotator accuracy, turnaround times, and throughput using SQL, Python, and BI dashboards to help optimize operations.
- Pipeline Optimization: Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Operations, AI Specialists, and Product) to identify bottlenecks in data labeling pipelines and recommend data-driven solutions.
- Reporting & Dashboards: Build, maintain, and update daily/weekly operational reports and dashboards for internal stakeholders and client leads.
- Guideline Calibration: Analyze edge cases and error patterns in dataset outputs to help refine project annotation instructions and rubrics.
Qualifications & Skills
- Education: Bachelorâs degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
- Technical Skills:
- Proficiency with SQL for data querying, aggregation, and analysis.
- Practical knowledge of Python or R for data manipulation (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
- Experience with visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
- Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills (Pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, complex formulas).
- Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a high degree of attention to detail when working with complex datasets.
- Communication: Ability to clearly translate data findings into actionable insights for non-technical team members.
- Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
Nice-to-Haves
- Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, data annotation workflows, or RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback).
- Prior experience or internship experience in an operations-focused analyst role.
What We Offer
- 100% Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the US.
- Cutting-Edge Industry Exposure: Gain hands-on experience at the forefront of AI model training and evaluation.
- Growth Opportunities: Direct mentorship and opportunities to advance within a fast-growing tech environment.
- Competitive Compensation: Hourly/Salaried rate commensurate with experience.

description:
Campaigns

-  Full Time
-  Remote / Occasional Travel
-  Salary $75,000 - $100,000

Organization Overview

Greenlight America is the leading grassroots campaign force powering the nation's clean energy transition at the local level. Our team supports local residents and organizations working to get clean energy built in their communities. Since our founding in 2023, we have enabled volunteers to advance thousands of megawatts' worth of utility-scale projects across the country, helping hundreds of communities to say yes to the benefits of a clean energy future.

Position Overview

Greenlight America is hiring a Program Administration Manager to help lead program administration and operations for our growing campaigns department.

The Program Administration Manager supports the Senior Director of Campaigns in running a growing department. They build department-wide systems, support internal communications, and lead special projects, while also managing core operational functions and providing executive support to the Senior Director. Greenlight's campaigns department has scaled quickly, growing from a single person to more than 30 staff in under three years. This role is well suited to someone excited by that stage of growth, who is comfortable identifying gaps in fast-built systems and bringing the structure and sophistication needed for the department's next chapter. The successful candidate will be a highly organized, proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes initiative to build better systems, and brings strong professional judgment. They will genuinely enjoy working as part of a team and build trust easily across people and functions. The Program Administration Manager reports to the Senior Director of Campaigns.

Primary Roles And Responsibilities

Program Administration â 50%

- Design and improve department-wide systems and structures, working closely with the Senior Director to identify gaps and build practical, scalable solutions.
- Serve as the lead for the department retreat and other all-team convenings, from logistics through content flow.
- Design onboarding, structure, and support systems for a new department internship/fellowship program.
- Establish and maintain a regular department communication cadence (e.g. weekly updates, department call recaps), including best practices and norms for internal comms.
- Draft and/or coordinate internal communications on behalf of the Senior Director, including the weekly department update.
- Maintain organized department files, shared resources, and documentation so the team can work efficiently.
- Support culture and engagement efforts for the department, in partnership with the Senior Director.
- Provide light-touch executive support to the Senior Director, including coordinating travel logistics and arranging team gestures for staff.
- Take on ad hoc special projects at the Senior Director's direction as departmental needs evolve.

Campaign Operations Management â 50%

- Coordinate with Ops on the campaigns department's budget management, including designing better systems for tracking expenditures, flagging variances, and working with staff and finance to keep spending on track.
- Identify gaps in departmental operations systems and processes and develop practical solutions that scale with the team's growth.
- Manage campaign operational workflows such as contractor invoicing and train campaign staff on those workflows.
- Build and maintain campaign systems for accurate expense categorization, ensuring campaign staff understand and follow financial protocols.
- Proactively coordinate work across campaign staff, operations staff, and other key stakeholders using clear, direct, and thoughtful communication.
- Drive adoption of financial and operational practices through effective communication, rollout, and follow-up.
- Serve as a responsive point of contact for campaign staff, contractors, and others, addressing operational questions with a caring, helpful approach.
- Support onboarding coordination for new campaigns department hires.

Experience And Qualifications

We are especially interested in candidates with the following qualifications:

- 3+ years of relevant program administration or operations experience, ideally in a nonprofit, campaign, or mission-driven environment.
- Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with a track record of building and implementing systems and processes. Familiarity with project management and automation tools (e.g. Asana, Zapier) is a plus.
- Experience rolling out new processes and driving adoption with a team, including situations without direct management authority.
- Experience with budget management and financial tracking; comfort working with spreadsheets and financial data.
- Experience working with a senior leader to translate department priorities and goals into action.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting communications on behalf of senior leaders.
- Comfort and experience building relationships, communicating, and coordinating work with staff across an organization, including leadership and staff outside the assigned department.
- Demonstrated ability to act as a responsive point of contact to field incoming questions, support problem-solving, and resolve issues in a way that builds trust.
- Exercises discretion and good judgment when handling sensitive information.
- Excitement for taking systems built in a fast-growing organization and bringing them to the next level of maturity and sophistication; comfortable identifying problems and building solutions from scratch.
- Proactive, self-directed work style with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- Comfort in a fast-growing organization where processes are still being built and flexibility is required.
- Passion for accelerating the clean energy transition.

Compensation And Benefits

The base annual salary for this position is $75,000-$100,000. We offer an excellent benefits package which includes 100% employer paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision insurance, unlimited paid time off, monthly technology stipend, and retirement contributions through 401k and Roth plans.

description:
Logistics at full potential. At GXO, we’re constantly looking for talented individuals at all levels who can deliver the caliber of service our company requires. You know that a positive work environment creates happy employees, which boosts productivity and dedication. On our team, you’ll have the support to excel at work and the resources to build a career you can be proud of.
As the Lead Industrial Engineer, Warehouse Design, you will be responsible for leading the development of a design package that may include material flow diagrams, facility layouts, material handling equipment designs, automation designs, storage media designs, process designs, slotting, pick path analyses. Also, you will have overall responsibility for managing all engineering activities during the implementation phase including automation and material handling vendor management and systems and equipment installation and testing.
Pay, benefits and more.We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.
What you’ll do on a typical day:
- Collaborates with Data Analytics team to analyze client data to determine order profiles, storage media application, product slotting, velocity, SKU affinities, ABC analysis

- Prepares engineering calculations and documents to describe solution and detailed operating concepts such as storage and shipping capacity, facility sizing, zoning, slotting, waving, etc. and facilitates reviews with key work stream leads including engineering peers, WMS Implementation, and operations

- Designs the overall facility layout, storage media, and flow paired with the appropriate equipment supporting the Concept of Operations.

- Supports the business development process by supporting the solutions team’s response to RFPs including developing materials and presenting to potential clients

- Evaluate and compare manual and automated warehouse solutions, develop detailed ROI, payback, and use these insights to drive data‑based warehouse layout, process, and design recommendations

- Leads detailed engineering process on new business awards to take the design from conceptualization to full detailed design ready for implementation by performing data analyses, developing material handling specifications, working with vendors to obtain quotes, and generating a detailed, engineered AutoCAD layout with fitment into the selected facility

- Joint Planning Sessions with client and conducts gap analysis to ensure issues are resolved; identifies changes to the scope when they occur and provides necessary documentation and escalation

A project in your portfolio we can open at a link, not just look at

Any exposure to UI or UX principles

Experience in branding, marketing design, or any visual design discipline

Adobe Photoshop / Illustrator / After Effects, Webflow, Jitter, Framer, Make (or alternatives)

description:

* Support CRM and ticket management workflows using tools such as HubSpot and Azure DevOps.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives across operations and delivery.
* Attend client calls and internal stand-ups, capturing actions and following up on outcomes.

*Requirements*

ESSENTIAL

* 0-2 years of experience in a business analysis, project coordination or operations support role (internships and placements count).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — you can translate technical detail into clear, client-friendly language.
* Organised and detail-oriented, comfortable managing multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
* Familiarity with project management or issue-tracking tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira or Trello.

* A collaborative mindset and willingness to learn in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Comfortable working remotely and aligning to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).

DESIRABLE

* Experience working in a software, SaaS or technology company.
* Familiarity with agile delivery methodologies (Scrum or Kanban).
* Experience with CRM platforms such as HubSpot.
* Understanding of product development lifecycles and stakeholder management.
* Experience producing user-facing documentation, guides or training materials.

* Education: We value skills and experience over formal qualifications.
* Working arrangements: Fully remote from India, aligned to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).
* Start date: Flexible.

*Benefits*

WHAT WE OFFER

* Competitive package depending on experience
* Potential share options
* Professional development including conference attendance and CPD support
* The opportunity to work across operations, product delivery and client management at one of the UK's fastest-growing healthtech companies
* Remote working with a collaborative, supportive team
* Hands-on exposure to the full product lifecycle in an AI startup

At QuantumLoopAI, you will join a team that is building AI-powered products used by hundreds of organisations across the UK. We move fast, take ownership, and celebrate wins together. Our culture values:

* Impact over optics. We measure success by real outcomes, not busy work

COME WORK WITH US

title: Junior Recruiter- Healthcare
