title: Junior Revenue Operations Associate
description:
*Job Title:* Junior Revenue Operations Associate
*Location:* Remote – Mexico or Colombia (Mexico City or Bogotá Preferred)
*Type of Contract:* Full-Time | Remote
*Salary Range:* Market Rates
*Language Requirements:* Professional English proficiency

Our client is seeking a highly motivated Junior Revenue Operations Associate with strong analytical skills and an interest in CRM and business operations to join their growing team. You will play a key role in maintaining accurate revenue data, supporting CRM operations, and improving day-to-day processes. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of their Revenue Operations function across their growing organization.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Maintain and update customer and revenue-related records within their CRM system, ensuring data is accurate, complete, and up to date.
* Support CRM workflows, data-entry processes, and ongoing improvements to operational systems.
* Perform data validation and quality checks to identify inconsistencies, missing information, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Prepare and organize revenue-related reports and analyses using Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, and other business tools.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide accurate revenue and operational information and support day-to-day business needs.
* Contribute to the development, documentation, and maintenance of standardized Revenue Operations processes.
* Explore and support the implementation of new tools, technologies, and automation opportunities that help their team scale efficiently.

*Must-Have Qualifications*

* 1 -3 + year of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, Data Operations, or a similar analytical role.
* Hands-on experience working with CRM platforms and maintaining structured customer or business data.
* Strong proficiency in Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel, including formulas, data manipulation, and reporting.
* Working knowledge of SQL for querying and analyzing data.
* Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to maintain data accuracy and consistency.
* Analytical and curious mindset with the ability to investigate problems, learn new platforms, and identify practical process improvements.
* Professional English communication skills, both written and verbal.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience with Salesforce; Salesforce administration experience is a plus.
* Experience working with sales or revenue technology platforms.
* Experience documenting workflows, processes, or standard operating procedures.
* Exposure to data automation or other tools used to improve operational efficiency.
* Experience working in a technology, SaaS, startup, or other fast-paced environment.
* Based in Mexico or Colombia, with a preference for candidates in Mexico City or Bogotá.
* Valid U.S. visa and willingness to participate in occasional U.S. travel, if needed, is a plus but not required.
* Comfortable participating in occasional in-person team meetings or gatherings as their LATAM operation develops.

title: Junior Cloud Security Validation Engineer
description:
We're looking for a skilled and motivated Cloud Security Validation Engineer with strong experience in Java, using Selenide or Selenium, to join our team at Upwind- a fast-growing cloud security startup. This role is focused primarily on automation (80%), with some manual testing (20%).

This is a startup environment: priorities shift quickly, release cycles are tight, and you'll often be juggling several testing efforts at once. The ideal candidate thrives under this kind of pressure- someone who is stress-resilient, comfortable working in short time frames and rapid iteration cycles, and skilled at prioritizing effectively when multiple tasks compete for attention.

The ideal candidate has solid knowledge of software testing methodologies, experience building and maintaining automation frameworks for web applications, and a genuine interest in cloud computing and security- since our product operates directly in that space.

*This is a fully remote position.*

*﻿* Responsibilities:

* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Java (Selenide or Selenium) for web applications.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (dev, product, DevOps) to understand fast- changing requirements and ensure adequate test coverage under tight deadlines.
* Design, implement, and execute automated test cases to verify functionality, performance, and scalability of web applications.
* Identify, prioritize, and report defects, working closely with development teams to drive resolution — often across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Participate in test planning, estimation, and review sessions, adapting quickly as priorities evolve.
* Continuously improve and refactor automation test suites for speed, stability, and maintainability.
* Apply sound judgment to prioritize testing efforts when time and resources are constrained.
* Stay current with industry trends in test automation, cloud technologies, DevOps practices, and cybersecurity.

Requirements
------------

* Minimum 1 year of commercial (paid, professional) experience as an AQA Engineer or similar role — required.
* Strong proficiency in Java and familiarity with Selenide or Selenium WebDriver.
* Basic understanding of OOP concepts.
* Experience developing and executing automated test suites for web applications.
* Proficiency in web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and HTTP protocols.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to prioritize effectively under pressure.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity startup environment — comfortable handling multiple parallel tasks and shifting priorities without losing quality.
* Stress resilience and adaptability; able to stay focused and effective under short deadlines.

title: Junior Sales Development Representative
description:
*About Us:*

Rootstock Software® is disrupting the ERP space! We are a worldwide provider of cloud ERP on the Salesforce Cloud Platform. When combined with Salesforce CRM, Rootstock Cloud ERP offers manufacturing, distribution, and supply chain organizations a single platform to grow and manage their businesses. Rootstock Cloud ERP is a flexible, modern, and digitally connected system that transforms companies to deliver a more personalized customer experience, efficiently scale operations, and out-service the competition.

Rootstock Software® serves customers throughout North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific and is available exclusively on the Salesforce Platform (Force.com) via the Salesforce AppExchange, the world’s most-popular marketplace for business apps. Organizations now have insight on what is happening or what will happen at each step of the manufacturing, distribution, and supply chain processes.

*This is a remote position, based in the United States or Canada.*
Please, no agencies/recruiters.

*Summary:*

As a Rootstock Junior Sales Development Representative, you will play a foundational role in generating new business opportunities and pipeline for our sales team. You will identify critical decision-makers within target manufacturing and distribution organizations and qualify opportunities through outbound calling, email, LinkedIn, and other channels, working closely with an experienced team of Senior SDRs and Account Executives.

This role pays $90,000–$100,000 OTE, and is compensated based on qualified opportunities generated, not raw activity volume. Our comp plan rewards outcomes: the meetings and opportunities that actually advance our pipeline, not just calls dialed or appointments booked. This means your success is measured by the quality of what you bring to the pipeline, and paid accordingly.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their sales career who wants to build a strong foundation in technology sales, supported by structured onboarding, a modern sales tech stack, and close coaching from both peers and leadership. You are enthusiastic, competitive, coachable, and hold yourself accountable to your results.

*Responsibilities* *:*

* Generate outbound interest through a consistent daily cadence of calls, emails, and social touches (LinkedIn) to prospects within assigned target accounts and territories.
* Qualify and book meetings that convert into qualified opportunities, in partnership with the Account Executive team.
* Use our sales technology stack — Salesforce, Outreach, Nooks, ZoomInfo Copilot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Claude — to research accounts, execute outreach, and maintain accurate pipeline records.
* Research target accounts to understand business operations, leadership structure, and pain points relevant to ERP and manufacturing software buying decisions.
* Participate in structured onboarding and ongoing coaching from the Director of Demand Generation and Senior SDR teammates, including weekly one-on-ones and team strategy sessions.
* Collaborate with Account Executives on pipeline handoff, opportunity qualification standards, and account-level strategy.
* Contribute to team meetings covering pipeline progress, messaging, and go-to- market strategy.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce in accordance with Rootstock's CRM standards.

*Requirements* *:*

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in a sales, customer-facing, or outbound prospecting role is a plus but not required.
* Interest in technology or software sales; ERP or B2B SaaS exposure a plus. Familiarity with Salesforce or another CRM a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Strong research and analytical instincts, with curiosity about how businesses operate.
* Highly motivated, coachable, and comfortable being measured on outcomes rather than activity.
* A desire to build and grow a long-term career in sales.

This position is commission eligible.

We offer our team members competitive compensation, world-class benefits, work-life balance (flexible schedules, telecommuting, vacation time off), and the opportunity to work alongside an amazing and supportive team!

Rootstock values diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. *
*

title: Junior Project Manager, IT
Junior AI/ML Engineer (GenAI, AWS)
description:
*

Provectus is an *AWS Premier Partner* and an *Anthropic Strategic Partner* , working at the frontier of applied AI. We help enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes — through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide.

*

Our work centers on two verticals — *Financial Services & Insurance* and *Healthcare & Life Sciences* — where we deploy five pre-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each Blueprint rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code and tuned to a client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture.

*

Our team holds 100+ AWS certifications, is Claude Code certified, and co-delivers Anthropic's Agentic SDLC program, Cowork Activation, and AI Blueprint engagements.

----------------------
*Where this role sits*
----------------------

You will work in a senior pod alongside an FDE, an FDX, and Senior AI Engineers — contributing to real delivery work while building toward independent ownership.

Requirements:
-------------

*Mindset*

*

Proactive and self-directed; you push for clarity rather than waiting for a ticket.

*

Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

*

Comfortable with some ambiguity, with support from senior team members as you take on more.

*

B2+ English, comfortable collaborating across distributed, multicultural teams.

*Technical depth*

*

Hands-on experience building or contributing to RAG systems, ideally in a production or near-production setting.

*

Solid engineering fundamentals; Python and/or TypeScript proficiency. Productive in an unfamiliar codebase with some ramp-up support.

*

Practical AWS experience (Lambda, S3, ECS, or similar); ready to grow into Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore .

*

Some experience with containers and CI/CD in real projects.

*

Exposure to evaluating non-deterministic systems — you've contributed to or run test/eval cycles, even if you haven't owned a full eval suite end-to-end.

*

Basic working knowledge of model/agent monitoring concepts.

*

Awareness of cost and latency trade-offs when working with LLMs.

*

Some hands-on exposure to the Claude ecosystem (Claude Code, CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills files) is a plus, or strong ability to ramp up quickly.

*

Practical experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or OpenAI) in real projects.

*

2+ years of software or ML engineering experience, including some exposure to production systems.

*

Solid AI/ML foundations — you understand what the models do well enough to reason about common failure modes.

Nice to Have:
-------------

*

Experience in one of the industries: financial services, insurance, healthcare.

*

Consulting, professional services, or other embedded customer-facing delivery.

*

AWS and Claude Code Certifications (or actively pursuing them).

*

A2A: Interest in agent-to-agent interoperability concepts.

*

CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).

*

Practical experience with one or more use cases from the following: NLP, LLMs, and Recommendation engines.

*

Experience in an additional language (Go, TypeScript, or Rust).

*

Experience with Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Kafkа.

*

Experience with the Claude ecosystem — Claude Code, CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills files. Spec-driven development — writing the intent, constraints, and acceptance criteria before you let an agent build.

*

MCP: you can say why an agent would prefer it to a REST integration, having authored a server is an additional plus.

Responsibilities:
-----------------

*

Build and contribute to RAG system components under senior guidance, with growing autonomy.

*

Write tests and help build out evaluation harnesses for the features you work on.

*

Write production code across the stack (AI, backend services, data pipelines) with code review support.

*

Help integrate AI components into backend services and RESTful APIs.

*

Support deployment of systems to AWS (containerized, CI/CD), taking on more of this independently over time.

*

Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and client handover materials.

*

Participate in technical discussions and architectural decisions, with an eye toward taking on more of this independently.

*

Support model evaluation efforts and help investigate and improve failure modes.

*

Take on increasing ownership of components and technical decisions as you grow in the role.

What We Offer:
--------------

*

The chance to shape how leading enterprises across LATAM, Europe, and North America adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment

*

A forward-deployed model working in small, senior teams alongside FDE and FDX

*

A growing AI delivery practice where you help build the tooling and frameworks, not just use them

*

Remote-friendly culture

*

Internal training programs with full support for Claude, AWS, and other professional certifications, conference attendance

*

Career growth; we actively develop our engineers

*

Access to the latest AI tools and premium subscriptions

*

Long-term B2B collaboration

*

Private medical insurance or a budget for your medical needs

*

Paid sick leave, vacation, and public holidays

*

Equipment and all the tech you need for comfortable, productive work

How we hire:
------------

*

Intro conversation. The role, your background and aspirations, tech questions.

*

Technical interview with live engineering sessions. Real problems, your own editor, you may use an LLM assistant

*

HR Interview. Soft skills and expectations

*

HM interview. Tech questions; a live engineering session is also possible

title: Junior Sportsbook Manager
description:
Ми шукаємо Junior Sportsbook Manager, який працюватиме безпосередньо з Head of Sportsbook та допомагатиме розвивати й підтримувати щоденну роботу букмекерського продукту.

Основний фокус позиції — Sportsbook Retention & CRM. Також роль передбачає роботу із запитами гравців та Support-командою, комунікацію зі sportsbook provider та Risk team, аналіз ключових показників і поступове залучення до операційних процесів Sportsbook.

Це можливість для людини, яка цікавиться спортом, iGaming та CRM і хоче швидко розвиватися у напрямку Sportsbook.

Основні задачі

Retention & CRM — основний фокус
Планування щотижневого та щомісячного retention-плану для Sportsbook у декількох GEO.
Підготовка контенту для Email, SMS, Pop-up та In-App messages.
Постановка задач та координація роботи з Design і CRM командами.
Участь у підготовці та запуску sportsbook retention-кампаній.
Аналіз результатів кампаній та пошук можливостей для їх покращення.

Sportsbook Operations
Взаємодія з Support-командою щодо вирішення sportsbook-запитів від гравців.
Комунікація зі Sportsbook Provider щодо операційних та технічних питань.
Аналіз основних sportsbook-метрик: turnover, bets, GGR, margin.
Підтримка щоденних операційних процесів та забезпечення стабільної роботи sportsbook-продукту.

У міру розвитку в ролі
Після отримання необхідного досвіду та навчання зона відповідальності поступово розширюватиметься:
Аналіз betting activity гравців та виявлення потенційних risk patterns: bonus hunting, arbitrage, multi-accounting тощо.
Участь у розробці та запуску sportsbook-бонусів і промо-механік.
Взаємодія з Risk team щодо окремих кейсів.
Самостійне ведення окремих sportsbook та retention-задач і проєктів.

Що ми очікуємо від кандидата
Щирий інтерес до спорту та базове розуміння принципів роботи букмекерської контори.
Англійська на рівні A2–B1 — для письмової комунікації зі sportsbook provider та роботи з базовими запитами гравців.
Готовність швидко навчатися та розбиратися в операційних процесах Sportsbook.
Грамотна письмова мова та вміння створювати зрозумілі й цікаві спортивно-орієнтовані retention-комунікації.
Самостійність, уважність та вміння працювати з декількома задачами одночасно.
Базові навички роботи з Excel / Google Sheets.
Готовність працювати за гнучким графіком 5/2, включаючи вечірні години та вихідні залежно від спортивного календаря.

Досвід у Sportsbook, iGaming, CRM або Retention буде перевагою, але ми також відкриті до кандидатів без прямого досвіду, якщо є сильна мотивація та готовність швидко навчатися.

Що ми пропонуємо
Роботу безпосередньо з Head of Sportsbook та можливість отримати практичний досвід у Sportsbook та iGaming.
Чіткий розвиток у напрямках Sportsbook, Retention, CRM, Analytics, Risk та Product.
Поступове розширення зони відповідальності та можливість самостійно вести окремі задачі й проєкти.
Можливість вирости в універсального спеціаліста у сфері Sportsbook.
Гнучкий робочий графік з урахуванням спортивного календаря.
Динамічне середовище, де можна бачити прямий вплив своєї роботи на продукт та бізнес.

title: Junior Media Buyer (FB)
Junior Applied AI Engineer
description:
As trusted partners of AWS and Databricks, we help organisations design, build and scale intelligent systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. We lead from the front in Generative and Applied AI adoption — guiding clients from uncertainty to confident, production-grade delivery.

This is a key role in our Engineering practice — the building work that takes AI from concept to production. As an Applied AI Engineer you'll support the design, build and deployment of applied AI systems under the guidance of senior engineers, learning our tools, patterns and standards as you grow. It's a role for someone technically curious and eager to learn, with clear progression into more senior engineering roles.

The role is remote based in UK with the occasional travel to company events.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* *Delivery & impact:* Contribute to defined build tasks within a delivery; complete AI features to standard, with support from the team.
* *AI & engineering craft:* Build fundamentals across the tech stack; apply established patterns and follow engineering standards under review.
* *Collaboration:* Work effectively within the team; participate in code reviews and technical discussions to improve engineering quality.
* *Growth & capability:* Learn actively and grow your capability; contribute to internal knowledge sharing as you develop.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
-------------------------------

*Essential*

* Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
* Experience developing and deploying machine learning and/or generative AI solutions in production environments.
* Foundations in programming (Python and/or a related language) and a genuine eagerness to learn.
* Understanding of machine learning, predictive analytics, and generative AI concepts.
* Clear communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* A collaborative, curious mindset and clear communication.

*Desirable*

* Exposure to GenAI/LLMs, RAG, cloud platforms (AWS and/or Databricks), or modern data/ML tooling.
* Personal, academic or open-source projects that show your interest in applied AI.

Benefits
--------

* Remote-first working with flexibility around client needs.
* Opportunity to work on meaningful AI projects across multiple industries.
* A collaborative culture focused on learning, excellence and continuous improvement.
* Competitive salary with clear progression pathways.

title: Junior Systems Administrator
description:
fusionSpan is a dynamic, fast-paced hybrid and remote work environment that prioritizes innovation, trust, and community in everything we do. We are a team of highly-committed individuals inspired by technology's impact on society, and we recognize our work's role in the well-being of our nonprofit clients and the communities they serve

As an AI-first organization, we keep our eyes tuned to the horizon, finding new ways to leverage cutting-edge technologies in ways that drive improvements in operational efficiency and impact, both for our clients and for our internal team.

This is a long term *b2b contract*. You will be working *remotely from Poland* with US-based team members. We would want some flexibility with hours, so a typical day would be from 11.00 to 19.00 or from 12.00 to 20.00 CEST/CET.

--------
Overview
--------

We are looking for a sharp, curious, technically-minded Junior Systems Administrator to join our team. This is an early-career position designed for a high-potential individual who is eager to manage and evolve the backbone of our business operations.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and software integration. You will be responsible for the health, security, and connectivity of our core platforms, ensuring that data flows cleanly across our ecosystem.

A note on experience with our specific platforms. This is a technical role and it requires real technical ability. You need to be able to read and write code, reason about how systems talk to each other, and work confidently in a command line, a log file, and an API. What you do not need is prior experience in Salesforce, AWS, or any other product on this page. Those are learnable, and we will teach them to you. If you have a solid technical foundation and a track record of picking up unfamiliar systems quickly, do not screen yourself out because you have never touched a Salesforce org.

--------------------
Key Responsibilities
--------------------

Investigation, Requirements, and Solutioning
--------------------------------------------

* Problem Investigation: Take ambiguous requests and unclear symptoms, trace them back to root cause, and explain what you found in plain language.
* Requirements Gathering: Sit with stakeholders across the business, ask the questions that surface what they actually need (not just what they asked for), and turn that into a clear set of requirements.
* Solution Design: Evaluate options, weigh tradeoffs, and recommend an approach. Then build it, test it, and see it through.
* Documentation: Maintain clear, up-to-date technical documentation for system architecture, integration mappings, and workflow logic.

Systems & Cloud Administration
------------------------------

* Salesforce Administration: Act as a junior admin for the Salesforce environment, managing user permissions, configuration changes, and custom object maintenance.
* AWS Support: Assist in the administration of Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, ensuring cloud services are secure, patched, and performing optimally.
* System Security: Implement and monitor security best practices across all managed platforms to safeguard company and client data.

Integrations & Automation
-------------------------

* API Management: Work directly with REST/SOAP APIs to maintain and troubleshoot integrations between diverse software platforms.
* Platform Connectivity: Manage the connective tissue between Salesforce and our core tools: Slack, BambooHR, and QuickBooks.
* Scripting & Automation: Write logic and scripts that automate manual workflows and improve data synchronization.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve integration failures or API bottlenecks to ensure high system availability.

Stakeholder Management & Prioritization
---------------------------------------

* Communication: Act as a technical bridge between internal teams and external clients, translating business requirements into technical solutions.
* Prioritization: Manage a diverse queue of technical tasks, balancing immediate support needs with long-term infrastructure projects.

-----------------------
Required Qualifications
-----------------------

Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science (preferred), Information Technology, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related technical field.

Technical Proficiency:

* Working proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (JavaScript preferred, Python or similar accepted). You should be able to write a script that calls an API, parses the response, and handles an error, and you should be able to read code someone else wrote.
* A solid understanding of API architecture: what REST and SOAP are, how authentication works, what a payload looks like, and how two systems exchange data.
* Comfort working in a technical environment: command line, log files, stack traces, and vendor documentation.
* Foundational understanding of core IT and cloud concepts such as networking basics, user access and permissions models, and security practices.

How You Work:

* Demonstrated ability to investigate a problem you have never seen before and work it to a conclusion, rather than escalating at the first dead end.
* Strong instincts for requirements gathering: you ask clarifying questions early and you are comfortable pushing back when a request does not make sense.
* Proven ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly and independently. You should be able to point to something technical you taught yourself and what you built with it.
* Ownership. You follow through on what you pick up, and you speak up when something is going sideways.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to manage expectations for both internal stakeholders and clients.
* Ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment.

-------------------------------
Technologies You Will Work With
-------------------------------

Prior experience in these specific platforms is not required. We train on all of them. They are listed so you know what the environment looks like.

* Salesforce
* Amazon Web Services (AWS)
* REST and SOAP APIs
* JavaScript for automation and scripting
* Slack, BambooHR, and QuickBooks integrations
* API testing tools such as Postman

------------------------
Preferred Qualifications
------------------------

While this is an early-career role, professional IT experience, internships, help desk or support work, and personal development projects are all highly valued. Direct exposure to the Salesforce ecosystem, the AWS Management Console, or API testing tools is a plus and will shorten your ramp, but it will not outweigh technical fundamentals and the ability to learn.

This is a position that will allow you to grow your career in a high-growth US-based company. Needs good English communication skills. The position is 100% remote.

*About fusionSpan*

fusionSpan is a fast-paced, high-energy global firm with a highly motivated team. This role will experience high work demands under tight timelines requiring a flexible and adaptable approach to daily priorities. We are open to qualified candidates worldwide even though our job opportunities are posted for a specific region.

Check out our Great Place to Work Certified Badge here.

fusionSpan employees working remotely are expected to have their camera on during all virtual meetings.

*Our Company Values:*

* *Trust:* We believe trust is the foundation of success, and build it through unwavering integrity, transparency, and open communication. We deliver on promises, address challenges directly, and hold ourselves accountable to excellence in all interactions with clients, partners, and teammates.
* *Innovation:* We understand that excellence and innovation go hand-in-hand and are committed to developing forward-looking, creative solutions that meet our clients’ evolving needs and move the industry forward. We embrace change, celebrate creativity, and prioritize quality to create a new standard of performance.
* *Community:* We are a community-first organization committed to creating a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and respect
where each voice is heard and all contributions are valued. We prioritize responsible and sustainable practices on our path to positively impact those we serve.

title: Junior Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC) is seeking a motivated **Junior Cybersecurity Analyst** to join our team supporting a major state & local government customer. This entry-level position provides an excellent opportunity for recent graduates or early-career professionals interested in building a career in cybersecurity. Working closely with senior engineers and architects, the selected candidate will focus on **Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)** solutions while receiving cross-training on wider cybersecurity tools and services.

You will join a dynamic, fast-paced environment where we prioritize learning, collaboration, and technical growth. This role reports to the Technical Director and supports the implementation, operation, and maintenance of cybersecurity systems that are critical to our customers' mission.

*Essential duties of this position include:*

* Assist with the configuration, deployment, and management of **Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)** solutions like **CrowdStrike or SentinelOne** to protect infrastructure.
* Collaborate with senior engineers to support **SIEM** (e.g., **Microsoft Sentinel**) and **NDR (Network Detection and Response)** systems.
* Participate in monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving security incidents as part of an expert team of cybersecurity professionals.

Recent completion of a Bachelor’s degree** in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, CYSA+) may supplement academic qualifications.

Up to **2 years of relevant hands-on experience**, including internships, coursework, or entry-level positions in cybersecurity, information technology, or network security.

title: Junior Operations Manager:in Messstellenbetrieb (w/m/d)
description:

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

----------------

Du übernimmst die eigenständige Klärung von Fällen, bei denen es rund um den Zählertausch zu Abweichungen oder Problemen gekommen ist.

*

Du analysierst Prozess- und Datenschiefstände zwischen Enpal, Netzbetreibern und Lieferanten und findest heraus, wo und warum ein Fehler entstanden ist.

Du recherchierst fehlende Informationen, holst die richtigen Ansprechpartner ins Boot und führst Fälle lösungsorientiert bis zum Abschluss.

Du kommunizierst regelmäßig mit Netzbetreibern und weiteren externen sowie internen Partnern – per Telefon und E-Mail.

*

Du erkennst relevante Details in Gesprächen und Nachrichten und leitest daraus ab, welche Informationen oder nächsten Schritte tatsächlich benötigt werden.

*

Du koordinierst notwendige Korrekturen, beispielsweise bei falsch gemeldeten Zählern, fehlerhaften oder fehlenden Daten sowie erforderlichen Nachrüstungen oder erneuten Zählertauschen.

*

Du arbeitest dich tief in unsere Prozesse und Systeme ein und nutzt die vorhandenen Informationen, um Klärfälle schnell und strukturiert zu lösen.

*

Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Fehler und bringst deine Erkenntnisse ein, um Prozesse langfristig besser und zuverlässiger zu machen.

*

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Fälle und gehst Problemen proaktiv auf den Grund, anstatt sie lediglich abzuarbeiten.

*Dein Profil*
-------------

*

Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, ein Studium oder bringst relevante Berufserfahrung mit – gerne auch als Quereinsteiger aus Bereichen wie *Customer Service, Sales, Hotellerie, Einzelhandel oder vergleichbaren serviceorientierten Tätigkeiten*.

*

Du hast Spaß daran, Problemen auf den Grund zu gehen und dich auch durch komplexere Sachverhalte zu arbeiten.

*

Du kommunizierst sicher und freundlich – sowohl am Telefon als auch schriftlich per E-Mail.

*

Du kannst gut zuhören, stellst die richtigen Fragen und erkennst auch zwischen den Zeilen, welche Informationen für die Lösung eines Falls wirklich relevant sind.

*

Du arbeitest strukturiert und sorgfältig und behältst auch bei einer größeren Anzahl parallel laufender Fälle den Überblick.

*

Du bist hartnäckig und lässt dich von einem komplizierten Fall nicht so schnell abschütteln, *du bleibst dran, bis eine Lösung gefunden ist*.

*

Du arbeitest gerne eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt.

*

Du hast eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität und findest dich schnell in neue Prozesse, Systeme und Themen ein.

title: Senior UI/UX Designer
description:
*UI/UX Designer 2 – AI
*

*About the Role
*

We are looking for a *Senior UI/UX Designer – AI* to help define the next generation of intelligent experiences across Intermedia's products.

In this role, you will design experiences that make artificial intelligence useful, intuitive, trustworthy, and approachable for business users. You will work at the intersection of *UX strategy, interaction design, generative AI, conversational experiences, and enterprise software* , turning sophisticated AI capabilities into simple experiences that solve real customer problems.

You will partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML teams, Engineering, Research, and other designers throughout the complete product lifecycle—from customer and market research through concepts, prototyping, development, launch, and post-launch analysis.

This is not simply a role for adding AI features to existing interfaces. You will help define *how users interact with AI across our products* , including copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, recommendations, summarization, intelligent automation, and agentic experiences.

*
Responsibilities
*

*AI Experience Design*

* Design intuitive user experiences for AI-powered capabilities across web, desktop, mobile, and administrative interfaces.
* Explore new interaction models for generative AI, including conversational interfaces, copilots, AI assistants, intelligent recommendations, content generation, summarization, and AI-driven workflow automation.
* Design experiences for emerging *agentic AI* capabilities where AI systems can reason, recommend actions, execute tasks, and coordinate multi-step workflows on behalf of users.
* Translate complex AI functionality into simple, understandable interactions appropriate for everyday business users.
* Determine when AI should proactively assist users versus when users should explicitly initiate or control AI functionality.
* Design effective patterns for prompts, suggestions, generated content, AI actions, confirmations, feedback, and human intervention.
* Create experiences that communicate what an AI system is doing, why it made a recommendation, and what actions it has taken or intends to take.

*UX & Product Design
*

* Own design initiatives from discovery and concept development through prototyping, implementation, launch, and post-launch optimization.
* Conduct user research, usability studies, interviews, competitive analysis, and workflow analysis to understand customer needs and behaviors.
* Translate customer problems and product requirements into user journeys, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
* Develop and validate design hypotheses through rapid prototyping and user testing.
* Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows through thoughtful UX and intelligent automation.
* Use qualitative and quantitative data to evaluate experiences and recommend improvements.
* Work closely with Product Management to ensure designs address meaningful customer problems and measurable business outcomes.

*AI Trust & Responsible Design*

* Design AI experiences that establish appropriate levels of *trust, transparency, and user control*.
* Clearly distinguish AI-generated information and actions where appropriate.
* Design graceful experiences for uncertainty, incomplete information, errors, hallucinations, and situations where the AI cannot confidently complete a request.
* Create effective confirmation, undo, escalation, and human-in-the-loop patterns for AI-driven actions.
* Design feedback mechanisms that allow users to evaluate, correct, or improve AI-generated results.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Legal teams to incorporate responsible AI principles into the user experience.
* Help establish UX guidelines for consistent and responsible use of AI throughout Intermedia products.

*Design Systems*

* Contribute to and evolve Intermedia's design system to support AI-powered experiences.
* Define reusable patterns and components for conversational interfaces, AI recommendations, generated content, AI actions, status indicators, feedback mechanisms, and agentic workflows.
* Ensure new AI capabilities integrate naturally with established product experiences rather than feeling like disconnected features.
* Maintain consistency across products while identifying where emerging AI interactions require new design paradigms.
* Partner with designers and developers to ensure design-system components are practical, scalable, accessible, and consistently implemented.

*Collaboration & Leadership*

* Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML engineers, software engineers, architects, researchers, and other designers.
* Facilitate design workshops and collaborative discovery sessions to explore customer problems and AI opportunities.
* Clearly communicate design rationale, research findings, user needs, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Challenge assumptions and advocate for customer-centered solutions when technology or implementation considerations begin driving the experience.
* Provide design leadership and mentorship to other designers and help raise the overall quality of UX across the organization.
* Collaborate effectively across multiple teams and product areas to create coherent end-to-end customer experiences.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, interaction patterns, and design practices and translate relevant developments into practical product experiences.

*Our Expectations*

* 5+ years of professional UI/UX, Product Design, or Interaction Design experience, ideally designing complex SaaS or enterprise software.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, complex workflows, interaction design, and thoughtful problem solving.
* Excellent knowledge of usability, UX/UI, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and human factors principles.
* Strong ability to analyze complex requirements and turn them into simple, elegant solutions.
* Experience conducting or participating in user research and usability testing.
* Strong proficiency with *Figma* , prototyping tools, and modern design-system practices.
* Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering in an Agile software-development environment.
* Strong communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.
* Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the broader product and customer experience.

*AI Experience & Knowledge
*

We don't expect you to be an AI engineer, but we do expect curiosity and practical fluency with modern AI technologies.

The ideal candidate has:

* Experience designing products or features powered by generative AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation.
* Understanding of large language models (LLMs) and the opportunities and limitations they introduce into product experiences.
* Familiarity with conversational UX and natural-language interfaces.
* Understanding of concepts such as prompts, context, AI-generated content, confidence and uncertainty, hallucinations, and AI feedback loops.
* Familiarity with AI agents and emerging patterns for designing systems that can perform multi-step actions on behalf of users.
* Experience thinking through trust, transparency, explainability, privacy, and user control in AI experiences.
* A strong interest in experimenting with new AI tools and interaction models.

*Advantages*

* Experience designing enterprise communications, collaboration, contact center, productivity, or workflow-automation products.
* Experience designing AI copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, or agentic workflows.
* Experience developing or contributing to large-scale design systems.
* Experience with voice and multimodal interfaces.
* Understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design.
* Familiarity with HTML/CSS and the technical constraints of modern web applications.
* Experience using AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.
* Experience working with globally distributed Product and Engineering teams.

As a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI, you will help ensure that AI at Intermedia is not simply powerful technology—it is a *valuable and trusted customer experience*.

Success means:

* Customers immediately understand how AI can help them.
* Complex AI capabilities feel simple and natural to use.
* Users remain informed and in control when AI recommends or takes actions.
* AI features integrate seamlessly into existing customer workflows.
* Common AI interaction patterns become consistent across Intermedia products.
* Research and customer feedback meaningfully influence AI product decisions.
* Product and Engineering teams view Design as a strategic partner in determining *what AI experiences should be built* , not simply how they should look.

Ultimately, you will help establish the design language and interaction principles that shape how customers experience AI across Intermedia's portfolio.

title: Regular/Senior Visual Designer
description:
About the project
-----------------

*Qt Group* develops cross-platform tools used by software teams across many industries. You will join the Design Tools Unit (DTU), helping create consistent and polished experiences for designers and developers within the Qt ecosystem.

*We are hiring a Regular or Senior Visual Designer* who combines strong visual skills with a structured approach and experience working within established design systems.

What you will do
----------------

*At both levels, you will:*

* Design product screens, components, and interfaces, with close attention to visual hierarchy, colour, typography, and spacing.
* Work within Qt’s shared design system, using existing components and design tokens consistently.
* Identify and communicate edge cases or gaps in the design system.
* Create visual materials for marketing, documentation, and learning content.
* Collaborate closely with UX designers and engineers.
* Clearly communicate design decisions and implementation expectations.
* Support engineers throughout the delivery process, including during implementation—not only at handoff.
* Translate UX concepts and interaction decisions into polished, consistent visual designs.
* Maintain a consistent visual quality across different product surfaces.

*At the Senior level, you will additionally:*

* Set and maintain the visual direction for assigned product areas.
* Help the wider team understand and consistently apply established visual standards.
* Contribute to the development and governance of the shared design system.
* Review component usage, identify inconsistencies, and document design decisions.
* Propose improvements to the component library when genuine product needs are not covered by the existing system.
* Ensure visual consistency across multiple products as they evolve.
* Identify dependencies and potential design conflicts across adjacent product areas.
* Involve UX partners early and help shape how UX and visual design work together during the design process.

About Spyrosoft
---------------

Spyrosoft is an authentic, cutting-edge software engineering company, established in 2016. In 2021 and 2022, we were among the fastest growing technology companies in Europe, according to the Financial Times. We were founded by a group of tech experts with established backgrounds in software engineering, who created an ‘engineer-to-engineer’ workplace, powered by enthusiasm, fairness and authentic relationships. Having a unique offering, which bridge the gap between technology and business, we specialise in technology solutions for industry 4.0, automotive, geospatial, healthcare & life sciences, employee experience & education and financial services industries.

Regular Visual Designer
-----------------------

* At least 2 years of experience in visual and UI design.
* A portfolio demonstrating strong visual execution across product interfaces and supporting visual assets.
* Experience working with an established, multi-product design system.
* Good command of Figma.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with UX designers and engineers.
* Ability to explain design intent clearly during handoff and implementation.
* Confidence in translating UX intent into visual design without unnecessarily redefining the interaction.

Senior Visual Designer
----------------------

* At least 5 years of experience in visual and UI design.
* A portfolio demonstrating both strong hands-on design skills and the ability to maintain quality at a system level.
* Proven experience contributing to and governing a large, multi-product design system.
* Professional-level Figma skills.
* Ability to communicate and justify design decisions to engineers throughout the delivery process.
* Experience working within larger product teams, with responsibility for cross-product consistency and systemic design thinking.
* Ability to understand how individual design decisions affect related products, components, and workflows.

Nice to have
------------

* Experience designing developer-facing, technical, or complex digital products.

title: Product Designer, Partnerships and Brand Experience
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Designer, Partnerships and Brand Experience based in Canada.*

The Product Designer will shape compelling experiences at the intersection of partnerships, product design, go-to-market initiatives, and brand expression.
You’ll help turn ambitious ideas into tangible product concepts, interactive prototypes, and polished experiences that create value for customers and partners.
The role places a strong emphasis on prototyping, motion, visual design, storytelling, and high-quality production craft.
You’ll work closely with Business Development, Sales, Product, Marketing, Engineering, Data, and Brand teams to bring new opportunities from concept to execution.
Beyond partnerships, you’ll help translate evolving brand principles into consistent, engaging experiences across the broader product.
The environment combines startup-style experimentation with the resources and scale of an established product organization.
This is an opportunity for a versatile designer who thrives on ambiguity, enjoys making ideas tangible, and wants to influence both business outcomes and product experiences.

Accountabilities
----------------

* Lead significant portions of the product experience and take ownership of the design work and business outcomes associated with key initiatives.
* Transform ambiguous or early-stage ideas into compelling product and business concepts, helping establish clear opportunities, success criteria, and execution plans.
* Conduct user research, lightweight usability testing, and validation activities to help scope, prioritize, and refine product initiatives.
* Create interactive prototypes, product concepts, demos, and motion-rich experiences that help communicate and validate new partnership and go-to-market opportunities.
* Develop polished micro-interactions, transitions, animations, and other visual details that elevate the quality and usability of product experiences.
* Help translate brand-system principles into product through motion, iconography, interaction patterns, and visual design.
* Collaborate with Business Development, Sales, Go-to-Market Operations, Product, Marketing, Engineering, Data, Applied Science, and Brand teams to develop and deliver effective solutions.
* Use strong visual storytelling and presentation skills to communicate concepts, align stakeholders, and influence product and business decisions.
* Coordinate across teams to establish shared understanding, maintain alignment, and keep initiatives moving from early exploration through execution.
* Drive high-impact initiatives from initial concept through scale, while evaluating performance against success criteria and thoughtfully sunsetting initiatives that no longer demonstrate sufficient value.
* Share research findings, customer insights, and design learnings to inform future product decisions and encourage a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement.

------------
Requirements
------------

* 3–5 years of professional product design experience, supported by a strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality digital product work.
* Combination of agency and in-house product design experience, with the ability to adapt between strategic exploration and hands-on execution.
* Advanced proficiency in Figma, including the ability to create everything from low-fidelity flows to highly polished, interactive prototypes.
* Demonstrated experience with motion design, micro-interactions, transitions, and animation, with exceptional attention to timing, detail, and visual craft.
* Experience translating brand systems into digital product experiences through visual design, motion, iconography, and interface refinement.
* Strong product-design fundamentals and the ability to balance user needs, business objectives, brand considerations, and technical constraints.
* Understanding of technical feasibility and the ability to partner effectively with engineers to turn design concepts into production-ready experiences.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and visual storytelling skills, with the ability to explain design rationale and influence diverse stakeholders.
* Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where priorities evolve and new opportunities need to be explored quickly.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across product, business, marketing, engineering, data, and brand functions.
* Curious, proactive, and outcome-oriented mindset, with an appetite for experimentation and continuous learning.
* Ability to connect deep user insights with broader product and business opportunities and use those insights to guide design decisions.
* Candidates should be based in Ontario or British Columbia, Canada.

--------
Benefits
--------

* *Compensation:* Expected total cash compensation of $131,800–$170,500, including base salary and variable pay where applicable.
* *Remote work:* Fully remote role for eligible candidates based in Ontario or British Columbia.
* *Flexible environment:* Work within a product organization that combines the autonomy and experimentation of a startup-style team with the scale of an established company.
* *Career development:* Collaborate with experienced designers, researchers, engineers, product managers, and cross-functional specialists while expanding your product and design expertise.
* *Creative ownership:* Significant opportunity to influence product experiences, partnership initiatives, brand expression, and new business opportunities.
* *Cross-functional exposure:* Work closely with teams spanning partnerships, sales, marketing, product, engineering, data, applied science, and brand.
* *Inclusive culture:* Join an equal-opportunity workplace committed to diversity, accessibility, and creating an environment where people with different backgrounds and perspectives can thrive.
* *Meaningful impact:* Help create experiences that connect customers with trusted professionals while contributing to new growth opportunities and the evolution of the broader product experience.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
ASRC Federal Technology Solutions is seeking a Graphic Designer to support the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Readiness Support Center in Mobile, Alabama.
The RSC develops and maintains the training and exercise program that prepares national cadres of teams and individuals to perform mission-essential duties in the federal disaster response environment, supporting FEMA Stafford Act missions, Flood Control and Coastal Emergencies under Public Law 84-99, Dam Safety, and Silver Jackets and Flood Risk Management programs.
The Graphic Designer produces the visual and text-based communication products that carry this training content to emergency managers, responders, and federal, state, tribal and local partners. This is a senior individual-contributor role.
Key Responsibilities

Design fact sheets, infographics, brochures, booklets, visual aids, and multi-page reports supporting the Contingency Responder curriculum, training, and exercise products
Create graphics that explain technical concepts for USACE dam and levee projects to non-technical audiences
Develop animation and motion graphic elements for short-form video products
Draft and revise text-based copy, scripts, and content that is clear, compelling, accessible to varied audiences, and grammatically correct
Produce all deliverables in both an editable version for USACE use and a non-alterable version formatted for public release across multiple digital platforms
Incorporate government review comments through up to five rounds of edits per product, tracking each comment and its resolution
Ensure all electronic and information technology deliverables meet Section 508 accessibility standards at 36 CFR 1194
Adapt materials for broad audiences, including multi-language production and audience segmentation to tailor resources to the intended end user
Maintain internal quality control documentation in a form auditable by USACE personnel
Contribute to monthly progress reports identifying tasks required, performed, and completed

Required Qualifications

5-7 years of professional graphic design experience
Bachelor's degree in graphic design or a related field, or an equivalent professional portfolio
Demonstrated proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, specifically Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign
Demonstrated experience producing Section 508 compliant materials
Strong written English: grammar, spelling, capitalization, and punctuation sufficient to identify and correct errors independently
Ability to pass E-Verify and provide two valid forms of government-issued identification
Must be able to pass Tier 1 investigation
Ability to obtain and maintain a Common Access Card

Preferred Qualifications

Prior federal or Department of Defense experience, including familiarity with DoD branding standards
Experience in emergency management, flood risk, or public safety communication
Motion graphics production using Adobe After Effects or equivalent
Experience developing materials in multiple languages
Web design experience
Familiarity with ESRI products and map overlays

Work Environment

Normal working hours are 0630 to 1715, Monday through Friday, excluding federal holidays
Occasional work outside normal hours may be required to meet deliverable deadlines
Contractor personnel identify themselves as contractors in all interactions, display company identification, and include the company name in their email display
This is a non-personal services position. The incumbent is supervised by ASRC Federal, not by government personnel

* Usability
* Accessibility

title: SEASONAL - Graphic Designer & Illustrator
description:
*ABOUT UNRIVALED*

Unrivaled is a premier professional women’s 3v3 basketball league showcasing the top players in the sport. Our mission is to elevate the profile of women’s basketball through exceptional talent, groundbreaking partnerships, and unparalleled fan experiences.

*JOB OVERVIEW*

Unrivaled is seeking a Graphic Designer and Illustrator who can help define the organization's look and feel across social media platforms during the 2026–2027 season. The engagement is expected to begin end of September, 2026, and continuing through approximately mid-March 2027, subject to completion of the agreed scope of services. The services are expected to be performed remotely, except as otherwise agreed by the parties.

This role is for a designer who is equally comfortable *e* xecuting against an established brand system and creating something completely original from a blank canvas. We are asking all applicants to provide us with work from their professional portfolio.

*KEY RESPONSIBILITIES*

Social & Real-Time Sports Graphics

* Design high-volume, high-quality graphics for Unrivaled's social platforms.
* Create game-day graphics, matchups, starting lineups, scores, statistics, standings, player milestones, breaking news, transactions, schedules, and results.
* Develop graphics around cultural moments, player performances, rivalries, and emerging storylines.
* Work quickly during live events while maintaining a high creative standard.
* Build adaptable templates that allow the creative and social teams to move quickly without making the brand feel repetitive.

Illustration & Original Creative

* Create original illustrations of Unrivaled players, teams, moments, and league stories.
* Develop poster-style artwork, editorial illustrations, player portraits, typography treatments, and campaign artwork.
* Translate player personalities and basketball culture into distinctive visual concepts.
* Create artwork that can extend beyond social into merchandise, apparel, posters, arena environments, and physical installations.
* Bring an identifiable artistic point of view while still working within the larger Unrivaled brand.

Brand & Marketing

* Support major league campaigns including player announcements, schedules, ticketing, tune-in, playoffs, special events, and league initiatives.
* Help evolve Unrivaled's visual identity while maintaining consistency across platforms.
* Create key art that can become the foundation for larger integrated campaigns.
* Collaborate with Marketing and Content to translate strategic ideas into strong visual concepts.
* Help establish design systems and templates that can scale across a fast-growing organization.

Players & Clubs

* Develop distinctive creative treatments for Unrivaled players and clubs.
* Create graphics that celebrate player personalities, achievements, fashion, culture, and interests beyond basketball.
* Help differentiate the visual identity of individual teams while ensuring they remain connected to the overall Unrivaled brand.
* Create player-focused artwork that athletes are excited to share on their own platforms.

Partnerships

* Collaborate with the Brand Partnerships team to create sponsor-integrated graphics and campaigns.
* Find creative ways to incorporate partner brands without compromising the quality or authenticity of Unrivaled creative.
* Develop original visual concepts that can elevate partnership pitches and existing sponsorship programs.
* Adapt league creative into partner-specific deliverables across social, digital, broadcast, and live events.

Live Events & Arena

* Design graphics for arena video boards, LED displays, signage, concourses, player areas, and fan experiences.
* Support creative needs for Unrivaled road events and special events.
* Think beyond the phone screen and understand how artwork translates into physical environments.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

* 3-7+ years of professional design experience
* Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional graphic design and illustration skills.
* Experience creating sports, entertainment, fashion, music, gaming, or culturally relevant creative.
* Strong command of typography, composition, color, photography, and visual hierarchy.
* Ability to create original illustration—not simply manipulate photography or existing assets.
* Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
* Experience with motion design, After Effects, 3D, or animation is a significant plus.
* Familiarity with emerging AI-assisted creative tools is a plus, particularly when used to accelerate ideation and production rather than replace original creative thinking.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, and evolving social formats.
* Ability to work quickly in a live sports environment.
* Comfortable receiving creative direction while also bringing original ideas to the table.

Design schema and data models that hold up as tenants, volume, and product surface grow.

Improve latency and throughput with production evidence: profile it, fix it, prove the win.

Raise the engineering bar around you through design review, code review, and mentoring.

Work directly with product and operations to turn a customer's real process into product.

Evaluation harnesses for LLM features, and cost control at volume.

Regulated domains such as identity, payroll, healthcare, fintech, or compliance.

HR tech, marketplaces, or other high-volume operational products.

Experience in an AI-first, fast-moving product environment.

Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude.

FirstWork is an applied AI company building the HR operations platform behind frontline hiring, the largest, least automated, and most heavily regulated labour market in the world. One system carries a worker from application through onboarding, compliance verification, training, and payroll, for hundreds of enterprise customers.

title: Staff Product Manager – Marketing OS, LeadGen Covert Team
description:
-----------------
*About HighLevel*
-----------------

*About us*
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. *Our people*
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

*Our impact*
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

----------------
*About the Team*
----------------

The *Marketing OS – LeadGen Covert Team* owns the products and platform capabilities that help agencies attract, engage, capture, qualify, and understand leads across digital and offline customer journeys.

The team is responsible for:

*

Forms and form-building experiences

*

Surveys and customer data-collection workflows

*

Quizzes, assessments, and interactive lead-generation experiences

*

QR Codes and offline-to-online lead acquisition

*

Chat Widget and conversational lead capture

*

External Tracking across third-party websites and digital properties

Lead capture, submission, attribution, and behavioral analytics

Templates, integrations, embeddable experiences, and extensibility

These products are critical entry points into the HighLevel Marketing OS. They connect customer interactions across websites, landing pages, physical locations, campaigns, and external properties with HighLevel’s CRM, automation, analytics, and communication capabilities.

---------------------
*Why Join HighLevel?*
---------------------

*

*Ownership:* It is never somebody else’s job.

*

*Customer focus:* We are passionately focused on adding value for our users.

*

*Speed:* We use lean principles and go to market in weeks rather than quarters.

*

*Experimentation:* Good ideas are tested quickly, measured, and improved iteratively.

*

*Growth:* You will help scale a global B2B SaaS platform and build products used by millions of businesses.

*

*People:* We take care of our team so our team can take care of our users.

---------------
*Role Overview*
---------------

As *Staff Product Manager – Marketing OS, LeadGen Covert Team* , you will shape the future of lead generation at HighLevel.

You will own product vision, strategy, and execution across a portfolio that includes Forms, Surveys, Quizzes, QR Codes, Chat Widget, External Tracking, and adjacent lead capture and attribution capabilities.

Your mandate will be to transform these products into a cohesive LeadGen platform that enables agencies and SMBs to create high-converting acquisition experiences, collect better-quality data, understand visitor behavior, and activate every lead through HighLevel’s CRM and automation ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role with organization-wide influence. You will work across multiple product and engineering teams, establish shared platform foundations, and influence how HighLevel competes in lead generation, conversational engagement, behavioral tracking, and marketing attribution.

Your work will directly impact product adoption, lead volume, lead quality, engagement, conversion, retention, and overall platform growth.

-----------------------

*

*Own the LeadGen strategy:* Define the long-term vision, product strategy, and roadmap across Forms, Surveys, Quizzes, QR Codes, Chat Widget, and External Tracking.

*Build a unified platform:* Create shared experiences and foundations across builders, templates, publishing, data models, integrations, analytics, and reporting.

*

*Connect the customer journey:* Partner with CRM, Workflows, Conversations, Analytics, and Payments teams to connect interactions with downstream business outcomes.

*

*Lead External Tracking:* Define how HighLevel captures visitor behavior, conversions, identity, attribution, and campaign activity across third-party websites.

*

*Establish analytics foundations:* Create consistent event taxonomies, instrumentation standards, and reporting across the LeadGen portfolio.

*

*Drive AI-assisted creation:* Deliver AI-powered creation, copy generation, logic recommendations, qualification, insights, and conversion optimization.

*

*Improve cross-device experiences:* Ensure creation and consumption experiences are intuitive, responsive, accessible, and performant across desktop, mobile, and tablet.

*

*Influence technical architecture:* Partner with Engineering on builders, embeddable widgets, APIs, submission pipelines, tracking scripts, identity resolution, and event infrastructure.

*

*Lead cross-functional execution:* Align Product, Engineering, Design, Data, AI, Security, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships around shared outcomes.

*

*Shape go-to-market strategy:* Influence product positioning, pricing, packaging, messaging, launches, enablement, onboarding, and customer education.

*

*Operate hands-on:* Write strategy documents and PRDs, conduct discovery, analyze data, validate concepts, prioritize initiatives, and resolve ambiguity.

*

*Own measurable outcomes:* Drive improvements in adoption, activation, publishing, engagement, completion, conversion, attribution coverage, and retention.

------------
*Experience*
------------

*

8+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, MarTech, CRM, analytics, growth, or customer-engagement platforms.

*

Proven experience owning a large-scale customer-facing product, product suite, or platform.

*

Experience defining multi-year product strategies across multiple interconnected product areas.

Strong understanding of lead generation, customer acquisition, conversion optimization, qualification, and growth loops.

Experience building embeddable products such as widgets, scripts, SDKs, forms, or externally hosted experiences.

Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, CRM integrations, field mapping, workflow automation, and identity resolution.

Experience partnering with Engineering on complex frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure systems.

Strong product judgment, analytical ability, and UI/UX sensibility.

Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across teams without direct authority.

Excellent written and verbal communication, decision-making, and stakeholder leadership skills.

Experience building form builders, survey platforms, chat products, interactive content, or behavioral analytics tools.

description:
--------
About us
--------

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

----------
Our people
----------

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

----------
Our impact
----------

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

--------------
About the Role
--------------

HighLevel is looking for a *Senior Product Manager to own and evolve Custom Objects - a foundational part of our CRM platform.*

Businesses operate around more than Contacts, Companies, and Opportunities. A real estate business may need Properties, an automotive business Vehicles, and an insurance business Policies. Custom Objects allow customers to model these unique business entities, define relationships between them, and use that data across workflows, reporting, integrations, and other HighLevel products.

We're looking for a *technically strong Product Manager with deep understanding of databases, data modeling, APIs, and integrations* who can work closely with Engineering to take this platform to the next level.

---------------
What You'll Own
---------------

* Define the *product strategy and roadmap for Custom Objects* and the evolution of HighLevel's CRM data model.
* Build scalable capabilities for creating custom entities, fields, records, relationships, associations, and permissions.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture on *data models, schemas, APIs, scalability, data integrity, performance, and platform extensibility*.
* Make Custom Objects a first-class citizen across *Workflows, Reporting, Contacts, Companies, Opportunities, Forms, Integrations, AI, and other HighLevel products*.
* Evolve our API, webhook, import/export, and synchronization capabilities so customers and developers can reliably integrate Custom Objects with external systems.
* Translate complex customer requirements into *reusable platform primitives rather than one-off solutions*.
* Drive the product lifecycle from customer discovery and technical design through delivery, adoption, and iteration.
* Define and own success metrics across adoption, usage, API consumption, platform reliability, and customer outcomes.

----------------------
What We're Looking For
----------------------

* *7+ years of Product Management experience* , with significant experience building platform, CRM, data, developer, infrastructure, or integration products.
* Strong understanding of *relational databases, entity-relationship modeling, schemas, metadata, and one-to-one / one-to-many / many-to-many relationships*.
* Strong understanding of *APIs, webhooks, data synchronization, integrations, imports/exports, and data mapping*.
* Ability to reason about *data integrity, scalability, performance, backward compatibility, and system-level trade-offs*.
* Proven ability to work deeply with Engineering and Architecture on technically complex products.
* Strong product judgment - able to simplify sophisticated platform capabilities into experiences that are intuitive for SMB customers.
* Ability to operate in ambiguous problem spaces and align Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and GTM teams around a clear direction.

-----------
Strong Plus
-----------

Experience building products in one or more of the following areas:

* CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Dynamics
* Flexible data platforms such as Airtable, Notion, or Coda
* API or developer platforms
* Integration/iPaaS platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or Tray.io
* Database, ERP, CDP, data infrastructure, or systems-of-record products

Hands-on familiarity with *SQL, APIs, data modeling, or integration architecture* is highly valuable.

---------------------
What Great Looks Like
---------------------

You're someone who doesn't just ask:

"What features should we build?"

You ask:

"What capability or primitive should exist in the platform so this problem is solved consistently across the CRM, APIs, Workflows, Reporting, Integrations, and AI?"

You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to *go deep with engineers, understand architectural trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and jointly arrive at scalable solutions.*

The decisions you make will help shape how HighLevel models and connects customer data across the entire platform.

-------------
EEO Statement

This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

Fully Remote • Product Development

Our company works with organizations to promote data protection best practices within their organization as well as establish compliance with standards such as PCI DSS and regulations such as the European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).More than 225,000 users in 100+ countries look to our company for tools, technology, and strategic security support. Founded in 2008 with a decade of service to the hospitality industry, we are a privately held company with regional offices across the United States and internationally. We are currently seeking an AI Applications Engineer - AI Integration to add to our team.

Accountability Summary
----------------------

As an AI Applications Engineer - AI Integration, you will build the next generation of AI-powered applications for cybersecurity and compliance intelligence. This will include designing and developing backend services that aggregate data across multiple systems, integrate AI capabilities, and deliver predictive insights to enterprise customers.You will work on a multi-tenant SaaS platform that supports organizations with complex hierarchies and high data demands. Your role will include designing APIs, building AI-powered data processing pipelines, and optimizing large-scale database operations to enable real-time business intelligence.

Duties and Responsibilities
---------------------------

The AI Applications Engineer - AI Integration will be responsible for the following tasks:

* Design and build REST APIs in Node.js and PHP to deliver dashboard data and AI-driven insights.
