title: Frontend Developer
description:
Join Data Eminence as a remote Frontend Developer and help build responsive, interactive, and user-friendly web applications. You'll transform designs and requirements into functional interfaces, develop reusable components, optimize application performance, and ensure a consistent user experience across devices. This role is ideal for entry-level developers with strong programming fundamentals and an interest in modern web technologies.

Full Description

Data Eminence is seeking a motivated Frontend Developer to join our growing development team. In this role, you will build and maintain modern web interfaces that are responsive, accessible, and optimized for performance.

You will collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, product teams, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver high-quality web experiences. This is an excellent opportunity to gain practical experience with modern frontend frameworks, APIs, version control, testing, and web development practices while working remotely.

Your key responsibilities will include:

* Developing responsive and interactive web applications
* Building reusable and maintainable UI components
* Translating UI/UX designs and wireframes into functional interfaces
* Writing clean, efficient, and well-structured frontend code
* Working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frontend frameworks
* Integrating frontend applications with REST APIs and backend services
* Ensuring websites and applications work effectively across browsers and devices
* Optimizing application performance, loading speed, and responsiveness
* Identifying and resolving frontend bugs and technical issues
* Implementing form validation, user interactions, and dynamic interfaces
* Collaborating with designers to maintain visual consistency and usability
* Using Git and version control systems to manage development work
* Participating in code reviews and following development best practices
* Writing and maintaining technical documentation when required
* Testing frontend functionality and resolving compatibility issues
* Staying updated with modern frontend technologies, frameworks, and development practices

We believe in learning by doing. You'll gain hands-on experience with modern JavaScript frameworks, component-based development, API integration, responsive design, Git, testing tools, performance optimization, and AI-assisted development tools.

This is a hands-on role where problem-solving, attention to detail, clean coding practices, and a strong understanding of web fundamentals are essential. You'll have opportunities to work on real-world applications and contribute to creating engaging and reliable digital experiences.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field
* 0-2 years of experience in frontend development or a relevant internship
* Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
* Familiarity with React, Angular, Vue.js, or another modern frontend framework
* Understanding of responsive and mobile-first web design
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs and frontend-backend integration
* Familiarity with Git and version control
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
* Understanding of browser compatibility and web performance concepts
* Familiarity with TypeScript is a plus
* Basic knowledge of UI/UX principles is beneficial
* Experience with Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, or similar frameworks is a plus
* Familiarity with frontend testing tools is beneficial
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently
* Ability to collaborate effectively with designers, developers, and product teams in a remote environment

Benefits

* Competitive salary
* Fully remote work flexibility
* Paid time off and holidays
* Professional development opportunities
* Company-provided equipment
* Opportunities to work with modern frontend frameworks, development tools, and AI-powered technologies

title: Engineering Manager, Authorization - India
description:

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

*JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.*
--------------------------------------

About the role:

As an Engineering Manager, you manage 1-2 teams, demonstrating strong domain ownership over product features, frameworks, and timely delivery. What you’ll be doing:
---------------------

Safely deliver modern identity features by enforcing a "secure-by-default" culture with strict testing and progressive rollouts.

Act as a proactive systems-planner, bridging high-level vision and tactical alignment by negotiating complex downstream dependencies (network, database, devices) far ahead of development cycles.

Steer the architectural roadmap to transition components into scalable, cloud-native frameworks and drive scalability initiative to handle queue spikes, database at scale, and data-residency requirements.

Evolve core directory protocols (LDAP/RADIUS) to handle increasing enterprise traffic spikes by transitioning existing systems into highly scalable, self-healing cloud architectures.

Key Responsibilities:

Manage 1-2 teams of experienced professionals, exercising responsibility for staffing, budgets, and consistently delivering medium-term outcomes on predictable timelines.

Integrate with teams to earn technical respect, establish psychological safety, provide real-time coaching for career growth, and aggressively resolve priority conflicts to keep teams unblocked.

*

Establish deep operational oversight with rigorous, non-negotiable release protocols.

*

Build collaborative stakeholder relationships and execute tactical change management strategies with urgency to remove barriers and solve complex problems.

*

Act as a hands-on expert for auth services, directing via raw metrics and maintaining transparent cross-functional communication.

*

Integrate automated AI workflows for routine tasks to free up engineering bandwidth.

Champion Spec-Driven Development governance where engineers use robust specs and AI code-assistants (Cursor/Copilot), while retaining strict accountability for test coverage and code quality.

*

Provide clarity by articulating how the team's work fits into wider departmental goals to ensure crystal clear direction.

We’re looking for:
------------------

*

12+ years of software engineering experience, including 8+ years as an Individual Contributor (scaling to Staff Engineer or Tech Lead) and 4+ years in direct Engineering Management.

*

Domain expertise in Identity & Access Management (IAM), authentication protocols, and related platform architecture.

*

Demonstrated ability to apply sound technical judgment to navigate ambiguity, resolve complex problems, and drive decisive courses of action in high-stakes environments.

Preferred Qualifications:
-------------------------

* University Degree or equivalent experience.

#LI-PD1

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

*You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.*

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

*Language:*
JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

*Why JumpCloud?*
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud. Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

*Scam Notice:*
Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

title: Staff Product Manager – Marketing OS, LeadGen Covert Team
description:
---------------
About HighLevel
---------------

*About us* HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes. To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

*Our people* With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

*Our impact* Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

--------------
About the Team
--------------

The *Marketing OS – LeadGen Covert Team* owns the products and platform capabilities that help agencies attract, engage, capture, qualify, and understand leads across digital and offline customer journeys.

The team is responsible for:

* Forms and form-building experiences
* Surveys and customer data-collection workflows
* Quizzes, assessments, and interactive lead-generation experiences
* QR Codes and offline-to-online lead acquisition
* Chat Widget and conversational lead capture
* External Tracking across third-party websites and digital properties
* Lead capture, submission, attribution, and behavioral analytics
* Templates, integrations, embeddable experiences, and extensibility

These products are critical entry points into the HighLevel Marketing OS. They connect customer interactions across websites, landing pages, physical locations, campaigns, and external properties with HighLevel’s CRM, automation, analytics, and communication capabilities.

-------------------
Why Join HighLevel?
-------------------

* *Ownership:* It is never somebody else’s job.
* *Customer focus:* We are passionately focused on adding value for our users.
* *Speed:* We use lean principles and go to market in weeks rather than quarters.
* *Experimentation:* Good ideas are tested quickly, measured, and improved iteratively.
* *Growth:* You will help scale a global B2B SaaS platform and build products used by millions of businesses.
* *People:* We take care of our team so our team can take care of our users.

-------------
Role Overview
-------------

As *Staff Product Manager – Marketing OS, LeadGen Covert Team* , you will shape the future of lead generation at HighLevel.

You will own product vision, strategy, and execution across a portfolio that includes Forms, Surveys, Quizzes, QR Codes, Chat Widget, External Tracking, and adjacent lead capture and attribution capabilities.

Your mandate will be to transform these products into a cohesive LeadGen platform that enables agencies and SMBs to create high-converting acquisition experiences, collect better-quality data, understand visitor behavior, and activate every lead through HighLevel’s CRM and automation ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role with organization-wide influence. You will work across multiple product and engineering teams, establish shared platform foundations, and influence how HighLevel competes in lead generation, conversational engagement, behavioral tracking, and marketing attribution.

Your work will directly impact product adoption, lead volume, lead quality, engagement, conversion, retention, and overall platform growth.

---------------------
Your Responsibilities
---------------------

* *Own the LeadGen strategy:* Define the long-term vision, product strategy, and roadmap across Forms, Surveys, Quizzes, QR Codes, Chat Widget, and External Tracking.
* *Build a unified platform:* Create shared experiences and foundations across builders, templates, publishing, data models, integrations, analytics, and reporting.
* *Improve lead capture:* Drive capabilities that increase visitor engagement, completion rates, lead quality, qualification, routing, and follow-up.
* *Connect the customer journey:* Partner with CRM, Workflows, Conversations, Analytics, and Payments teams to connect interactions with downstream business outcomes.
* *Lead External Tracking:* Define how HighLevel captures visitor behavior, conversions, identity, attribution, and campaign activity across third-party websites.
* *Establish analytics foundations:* Create consistent event taxonomies, instrumentation standards, and reporting across the LeadGen portfolio.
* *Drive AI-assisted creation:* Deliver AI-powered creation, copy generation, logic recommendations, qualification, insights, and conversion optimization.
* *Improve cross-device experiences:* Ensure creation and consumption experiences are intuitive, responsive, accessible, and performant across desktop, mobile, and tablet.
* *Influence technical architecture:* Partner with Engineering on builders, embeddable widgets, APIs, submission pipelines, tracking scripts, identity resolution, and event infrastructure.
* *Lead cross-functional execution:* Align Product, Engineering, Design, Data, AI, Security, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships around shared outcomes.
* *Shape go-to-market strategy:* Influence product positioning, pricing, packaging, messaging, launches, enablement, onboarding, and customer education.
* *Operate hands-on:* Write strategy documents and PRDs, conduct discovery, analyze data, validate concepts, prioritize initiatives, and resolve ambiguity.
* *Own measurable outcomes:* Drive improvements in adoption, activation, publishing, engagement, completion, conversion, attribution coverage, and retention.

----------
Experience
----------

* 8+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, MarTech, CRM, analytics, growth, or customer-engagement platforms.
* Proven experience owning a large-scale customer-facing product, product suite, or platform.
* Experience defining multi-year product strategies across multiple interconnected product areas.
* Strong understanding of lead generation, customer acquisition, conversion optimization, qualification, and growth loops.
* Experience with products such as forms, surveys, quizzes, chat widgets, analytics, attribution, tracking, or interactive content.
* Familiarity with behavioral tracking, including page views, clicks, scrolls, field interactions, submissions, abandonment, and conversion events.
* Understanding of event taxonomies, analytics instrumentation, data pipelines, experimentation, and marketing attribution.
* Experience building embeddable products such as widgets, scripts, SDKs, forms, or externally hosted experiences.
* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, CRM integrations, field mapping, workflow automation, and identity resolution.
* Experience partnering with Engineering on complex frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure systems.
* Strong product judgment, analytical ability, and UI/UX sensibility.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across teams without direct authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, decision-making, and stakeholder leadership skills.

------------
Nice to Have
------------

* Experience with AI- or LLM-powered creation, conversational, or optimization products.
* Experience building form builders, survey platforms, chat products, interactive content, or behavioral analytics tools.
* Experience with first-party tracking, customer identity, attribution, consent management, or data governance.
* Background in high-volume event ingestion, real-time analytics, experimentation, or personalization systems.
* Experience building products for marketing agencies, SMBs, creators, or multi-location businesses.
* Prior experience working in a remote, globally distributed product organization.

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset.

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

At Sleek, we are on a mission to streamline operations and elevate customer experience through intelligent automation and modern engineering.

*About the Role:*

We are looking for a sharp, commercially-minded, and execution-oriented Product Manager to own the growth trajectory of our two core emerging products: the Sleek Business Account (SBA)—a licensed, fledgling digital business account in Singapore and our new proprietary In-House Payroll Solution

This is a senior-level, highly autonomous, hands-on builder role. You will not have a dedicated marketing department; you will own the product strategy, project management, and go-to-market execution from top to bottom. If you have deep neo- banking roots, love driving organic growth loops, and thrive in lean, rapid-deployment environments, this role is built for you.

*Mission of the Role*

To aggressively scale revenue for the SBA and Payroll products by driving rapid customer adoption, expanding AUM for SBA, and increasing the volume of active employees utilizing the Payroll system.

*Key Outcomes (First 6–12 Months)*

* Accelerate customer adoption rates for both SBA and Payroll.
* Significantly expand the AUM of the SBA and grow the total number of employees onboarded to the Payroll software.
* Directly increase Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) through strategic product monetization,such as value-added foreign exchange (FX) transactions *.*
* Successfully navigate ambiguities to deliver product commitments on time, partnering intimately with key stakeholders and a dedicated engineering squad.

*Requirements*

*Must-Have Experience*

* *5 to 10 Years in Product Manager Roles:* Proven track record of robust, hands-on product management within a Neobank, Digital Bank, or high-growth Fintech environment.
* *0-to-1 Product Delivery:* Demonstrated success taking tech products from ideation to launch and scaling them as an individual contributor.
* *Commercial & Growth Competency:* Experience driving user adoption, managing legacy data migrations, and optimizing commercial metrics like Assets Under Management (AUM) and FX/transaction revenues
* *AI & Tech Literacy:* Fluent with AI applications and structurally familiar with AI evaluations (evals) to drive automated feature development alongside engineering.
* *Analytical Problem Solving:* Exceptional skill in working backwards from aggressive growth targets using structured, data-driven frameworks.

*Must-Have Attributes*

* *Extreme Ownership & High Agency:* A self-starter who operates autonomously, moves fast under heavy ambiguity, and takes absolute accountability for outcomes.
* *Commercial Mindset & Customer Empathy:* Deeply understands user pain points while simultaneously thinking strategically about monetization and business growth.
* *The "Builder" Mentality:* Combines high-level product vision with a grounded, humble approach to doing the tactical, ground-level execution yourself.
* *Cross-Functional Execution:* Ability to handle both product strategy and hands-on Go-To-Market (GTM) execution without dedicated marketing support.
* *Collaborative Diplomat:* A low-ego communicator who builds trust, bridges engineering and commercial teams, and aligns leadership to drive consensus.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

*Ownership:* This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

*Humility:* There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

*Structured Thinking* : Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

*Attention to detail* : You’ll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.

*Excellent listener and clear communicator* : We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn’t their first language. For you to excel, you’ll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

*About the interview process*

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages (note that the order might be different to what you read below).

We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish. Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

A ~30 minute chat with our Talent Acquisition team to learn more about you, your background, and what you’re looking for.
A ~60 minute technical interview with the Product Team
A ~60 minute AI skills interview with the AI Lead.

A final interview with our CRO, giving you the opportunity to ask any final questions and hear more about our vision and priorities.

*Reference verification*
Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

*Requirement for background screening*

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

- Your education

- Any criminal history

- Any political exposure

- Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

*Benefits*

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

*Humility and kindness* : Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

*Flexibility* : The role will be fully remote, with work from home five days a week However, if you are based in Singapore, the role will follow a hybrid model. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

*Financial benefits* : We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

*Personal growth* : You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

title: Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for an Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics to own the integrity, visibility and management of Airwallex’s payment costs, starting with card scheme fees and interchange fees across Visa and Mastercard.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will be the subject matter expert on scheme economics, translating complex and rapidly changing network rules into accurate system configurations, financial outcomes and business decisions. You will ensure we understand what every payment should cost, that those costs are accurately reflected across our systems and financials, and that we systematically identify opportunities to improve payment economics as we scale.

Over time, the remit will expand across other card schemes, local payment methods and the broader payments cost base.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own scheme economics and rule interpretation: Maintain deep expertise across scheme fees, interchange and network rules. Interpret scheme bulletins, operating regulations and fee schedules, translating changes into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

- Ensure accurate payment cost configuration: Translate complex scheme rules into fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic. Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure cost calculation, allocation and customer billing accurately reflect current network rules across markets and payment flows.

- Protect payment cost integrity: Establish robust governance, testing and controls across scheme configurations. Reconcile expected costs against actual network charges, identify anomalies and leakage, and drive root-cause resolution.

- Build granular visibility into payment economics: Develop robust models and analytics across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types, creating a clear view of unit economics, margin drivers and cost movements.

- Drive structural cost and margin optimization: Identify, quantify and execute opportunities to improve economics through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration, and other levers. Partner with Product, Finance and Commercial teams to prioritize the highest-value opportunities.

- Shape pricing and commercial decisions: Translate underlying payment economics into recommendations for customer pricing, product design, new market launches and commercial strategy, ensuring growth is supported by sustainable unit economics.

- Build scalable infrastructure and automation: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to strengthen cost engines, fee allocation logic, dashboards and automated controls. Apply AI and advanced analytics to accelerate rule interpretation, detect anomalies and surface optimization opportunities.

- Own complex scheme economics issues: Serve as the escalation point for scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions, working directly with Visa, Mastercard and other payment partners where required.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- 7+ years of relevant experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or related roles, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech.

- Deep knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules.

- Strong ability to operationalize complex payment rules, translating fee schedules and network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls.

- Experience with payment cost systems and controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations.

- Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modeling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs.

- Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to connect detailed payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimization.

- Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale.

- Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners.

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

As a Senior User Experience Designer, you will be responsible for executing high-quality designs for our financial products, ensuring they are intuitive, accessible, and effective. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor junior designers, and champion user-centred design within the organisation. This role requires a strategic mindset, deep UX/UI expertise, and the ability to translate complex financial concepts into seamless user experiences.

*What you’ll do*

* Define and execute design strategies that align with business objectives and user needs.

* Conduct advanced user research, usability testing, and A/B experiments to validate and refine design solutions.
* Partner closely with product managers and engineers to ensure seamless implementation of designs.
* Design scalable UI components and contribute to our evolving design system.
* Advocate for accessibility (A11y) and inclusive design principles, ensuring our products serve a diverse user base.
* Create and refine micro-interactions and motion elements to improve user engagement and usability.
* Use data-driven insights to continuously improve the user experience and optimise for business impact.
* Mentor and guide junior designers, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.
* Stay ahead of fintech trends and best practices to drive product innovation.

* Mastery of visual design, typography, grids, layout, and colour theory.
* Expertise in interaction design, information architecture, and user flows.
* Deep understanding of designing for both mobile and web platforms, ensuring responsive and adaptive experiences.
* Strong knowledge of behavioural psychology and how it influences user decision-making.
* Extensive experience conducting usability testing, user interviews, and heuristic evaluations.
* Ability to synthesise qualitative and quantitative insights into impactful design decisions.
* Familiarity with UX analytics tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Hotjar, etc.).
* Proficiency in atomic design principles and building scalable UI frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of motion design tools (Lottie, After Effects, Principle) to create dynamic user experiences.
* Experience mentoring and guiding junior designers.
* Ability to articulate design rationale and influence stakeholders across teams.
* Comfortable working in agile, fast-paced product teams.
* Figma mastery - deep experience with auto layout, design tokens, component variants, interactive prototypes, and scalable design libraries.
* Proven experience in fintech and/or SaaS environments, with a strong understanding of industry challenges and user behaviours.

*What you’ll get*

* A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will impact millions of users.
* Career growth opportunities.
* A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources.

*What to expect in the hiring process*

* Application & portfolio review: we look for strong UX case studies that showcase process, research, impact, and leadership.
* Preliminary phone call with the recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, interests, and expectations.
* Interview with a design team member: a discussion about your experience, approach to design, alignment with our mission, and a portfolio walkthrough.
* Design Challenge: an advanced exercise to assess problem-solving, UX/UI craft, and strategic thinking.
* Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership about your ability to think strategically, collaborate across teams, and drive business and user impact through design.

Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your best work - preferably with fintech or SaaS-related projects. Your portfolio should clearly demonstrate impact, including measurable improvements in user experience, business metrics, or engagement. We want to see end-to-end product thinking, including research, wireframes, prototypes, and final execution.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
*UX/UI Designer – Figma, Product Design & User Experience*
----------------------------------------------------------

*Position Type:* Full-Time, Remote
*Working Hours:* U.S. Client Business Hours, with flexibility for sprint reviews and design handoffs

*About the Role*
----------------

We’re hiring a *UX/UI Designer* to create intuitive, visually polished, and user-friendly digital experiences across web and mobile products.

You’ll work across the full design lifecycle — from understanding user needs and mapping journeys to creating wireframes, interactive prototypes, high-fidelity interfaces, and scalable design systems.

You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to turn business requirements and user insights into digital experiences that are easy to use, accessible, and built for engagement.

This role is a strong fit if you combine *UX problem-solving with strong UI design skills* and enjoy taking products from early concepts through developer handoff and iteration.

*What You’ll Own*
-----------------

*UX Research & User Experience*
-------------------------------

* Conduct user interviews, usability testing, surveys, and behavioral analysis
* Identify user pain points, friction, and opportunities for improvement
* Translate research into user personas, journeys, flows, and actionable design recommendations
* Analyze user behavior using tools such as *Hotjar, FullStory, and Google Analytics*
* Design experiences that balance user needs with product and business objectives

*Wireframing & Prototyping*
---------------------------

* Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes
* Develop low-fidelity concepts through high-fidelity product designs
* Work primarily in *Figma* , with experience in Adobe XD or Sketch also valuable
* Rapidly iterate based on user testing, stakeholder feedback, and product requirements
* Clearly present and explain design decisions to stakeholders

*UI & Product Design*
---------------------

* Design clean, modern interfaces for web and mobile products
* Create responsive experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile
* Apply strong principles of:

* Typography
* Layout and spacing
* Color
* Visual hierarchy
* Interaction design

* Design intuitive onboarding, navigation, dashboards, workflows, and conversion paths

*Design Systems*
----------------

* Build and maintain reusable components and scalable design systems
* Establish consistent patterns for layouts, components, spacing, and interactions
* Maintain style guides and design documentation
* Ensure visual and functional consistency across products and features

*Accessibility & Usability*
---------------------------

* Apply *WCAG 2.1 AA* accessibility best practices
* Design with contrast, keyboard navigation, screen readers, and responsive behavior in mind
* Identify usability issues before they reach development
* Continuously improve experiences based on testing and product feedback

*Developer Handoff & Collaboration*
-----------------------------------

* Partner closely with product managers and engineers throughout the development lifecycle
* Prepare developer-ready specifications, assets, and documentation
* Use tools such as *Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin, or InVision*
* Review implemented features for design accuracy and consistency
* Participate in sprint planning, design reviews, critiques, and Agile ceremonies

*What Makes You a Strong Fit*
-----------------------------

* You think about the *user experience* , not just how a screen looks
* You have a strong eye for polished, modern UI
* You can explain the reasoning behind your design decisions
* You enjoy solving complex user and product problems
* You’re comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly
* You collaborate effectively with product and engineering teams
* You care about consistency, usability, accessibility, and detail

*Required Experience & Skills*
------------------------------

* *2+ years of professional UX/UI, Product Design, or Digital Product Design experience*
* Strong proficiency in *Figma*
* Experience designing responsive *web and/or mobile products*
* Strong understanding of:

* UX principles
* User flows
* Interaction design
* Usability
* Responsive design

* Experience creating:

* Wireframes
* Interactive prototypes
* High-fidelity interfaces
* Design systems

* Strong portfolio demonstrating both *UX thinking and UI execution*
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product managers, developers, and stakeholders
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Ability to work remotely during U.S. client business hours

*Nice to Have*
--------------

* Experience designing *SaaS products, mobile apps, or e-commerce platforms*
* Familiarity with HTML/CSS and frontend development concepts
* Experience with user analytics and behavior tools such as Hotjar or FullStory
* Experience conducting usability tests or user research
* Knowledge of A/B testing and conversion optimization
* Experience maintaining large or scalable design systems
* Familiarity with Agile product development environments

*What a Typical Day Looks Like*
-------------------------------

You may start by reviewing user feedback or analytics to identify UX improvements, then create wireframes or prototypes for an upcoming feature.

Throughout the day, you’ll collaborate with product managers and engineers, refine high-fidelity designs, update reusable components, review implemented features, and prepare designs for developer handoff.

You’ll continuously use feedback, testing, and product data to improve usability and create better experiences.

*In short:* you turn user needs and product requirements into intuitive, accessible, and visually engaging digital experiences.

*Key Metrics for Success*
-------------------------

* Improved usability and user satisfaction
* Reduced friction and user errors
* Increased task completion and engagement
* On-time delivery of design assets for development
* Consistency between designs and implemented products
* Strong adoption and scalability of design systems
* Positive stakeholder and user feedback

*Interview Process*
-------------------

* Initial Application Review
* *Intro Video via Spark Hire*
* Portfolio Review + Practical Design Task
* Client Interview
* Offer & Onboarding

*What Happens After You Apply*
------------------------------

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from *Spark Hire* to record your Intro Video.

It’s a short, self-recorded video completed on your own time and is the final step needed to complete your application.

Instead of repeating your background across multiple screening calls, you get to introduce yourself once and show hiring teams how you communicate before the first interview. If there’s a strong fit, your first live conversation can focus on the role rather than starting from scratch.

*Don’t overthink it.* You can record your responses multiple times, and discarded takes are not shared.

Please keep an eye on both your *inbox and spam folder* for the Spark Hire invitation.

*Apply Now*
-----------

If you:

* Love solving user problems through design
* Have a strong *Figma and UX/UI portfolio*
* Enjoy creating polished web and mobile experiences
* Understand both *user experience and visual design*
* Thrive in collaborative product environments

We’d love to hear from you.

title: UX Designer

---------------

We are looking for a full-stack UX Designer to help shape customer experiences across our digital health and ecommerce platforms. Reporting to the Director of User and Experience Design, you will own the design process end to end — research, UX design, design systems, and UI — shaping how customers discover, engage with, and trust our digital products. In a single week you might move between user interviews, flows, component specs, and polished production screens. This is a hands-on IC role for someone who loves the craft and the pace.

We move fast. Priorities shift. Context switching is part of the job. We want a scrappy mindset, strong judgment, and the sense to know when to push for perfect and when to ship, learn, and iterate.

* *UX research and testing:* Plan and run user research, including interviews and usability testing. Turn customer pain points and behaviors into insights and design decisions.
* *Design systems and components:* Contribute components, patterns, and tokens that scale cleanly between design and development.

* *Collaboration and communication:* Work closely with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional partners. Communicate design decisions clearly and advocate for the customer without slowing the team down.

*Experience and Skills*

* Sound judgment on when to aim for perfect versus good enough to ship and learn.

title: SEASONAL - Graphic Designer & Illustrator
description:
ABOUT UNRIVALED
---------------

Unrivaled is a premier professional women’s 3v3 basketball league showcasing the top players in the sport. Our mission is to elevate the profile of women’s basketball through exceptional talent, groundbreaking partnerships, and unparalleled fan experiences.

JOB OVERVIEW
------------

Unrivaled is seeking a Graphic Designer and Illustrator who can help define the organization's look and feel across social media platforms during the 2026–2027 season. The engagement is expected to begin end of September, 2026, and continuing through approximately mid-March 2027, subject to completion of the agreed scope of services. The services are expected to be performed remotely, except as otherwise agreed by the parties.

This role is for a designer who is equally comfortable *e* xecuting against an established brand system and creating something completely original from a blank canvas. We are asking all applicants to provide us with work from their professional portfolio.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
--------------------

Social & Real-Time Sports Graphics
----------------------------------

* Design high-volume, high-quality graphics for Unrivaled's social platforms.
* Create game-day graphics, matchups, starting lineups, scores, statistics, standings, player milestones, breaking news, transactions, schedules, and results.
* Develop graphics around cultural moments, player performances, rivalries, and emerging storylines.
* Work quickly during live events while maintaining a high creative standard.
* Build adaptable templates that allow the creative and social teams to move quickly without making the brand feel repetitive.

Illustration & Original Creative
--------------------------------

* Create original illustrations of Unrivaled players, teams, moments, and league stories.
* Develop poster-style artwork, editorial illustrations, player portraits, typography treatments, and campaign artwork.
* Translate player personalities and basketball culture into distinctive visual concepts.
* Create artwork that can extend beyond social into merchandise, apparel, posters, arena environments, and physical installations.
* Bring an identifiable artistic point of view while still working within the larger Unrivaled brand.

Brand & Marketing
-----------------

* Support major league campaigns including player announcements, schedules, ticketing, tune-in, playoffs, special events, and league initiatives.
* Help evolve Unrivaled's visual identity while maintaining consistency across platforms.
* Create key art that can become the foundation for larger integrated campaigns.
* Collaborate with Marketing and Content to translate strategic ideas into strong visual concepts.
* Help establish design systems and templates that can scale across a fast-growing organization.

Players & Clubs
---------------

* Develop distinctive creative treatments for Unrivaled players and clubs.
* Create graphics that celebrate player personalities, achievements, fashion, culture, and interests beyond basketball.
* Help differentiate the visual identity of individual teams while ensuring they remain connected to the overall Unrivaled brand.
* Create player-focused artwork that athletes are excited to share on their own platforms.

Partnerships
------------

* Collaborate with the Brand Partnerships team to create sponsor-integrated graphics and campaigns.
* Find creative ways to incorporate partner brands without compromising the quality or authenticity of Unrivaled creative.
* Develop original visual concepts that can elevate partnership pitches and existing sponsorship programs.
* Adapt league creative into partner-specific deliverables across social, digital, broadcast, and live events.

Live Events & Arena
-------------------

* Design graphics for arena video boards, LED displays, signage, concourses, player areas, and fan experiences.
* Support creative needs for Unrivaled road events and special events.
* Think beyond the phone screen and understand how artwork translates into physical environments.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
----------------------

* 3-7+ years of professional design experience
* Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional graphic design and illustration skills.
* Experience creating sports, entertainment, fashion, music, gaming, or culturally relevant creative.
* Strong command of typography, composition, color, photography, and visual hierarchy.
* Ability to create original illustration—not simply manipulate photography or existing assets.
* Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
* Experience with motion design, After Effects, 3D, or animation is a significant plus.
* Familiarity with emerging AI-assisted creative tools is a plus, particularly when used to accelerate ideation and production rather than replace original creative thinking.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, and evolving social formats.
* Ability to work quickly in a live sports environment.
* Comfortable receiving creative direction while also bringing original ideas to the table.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to craft.

Unrivaled is an equal opportunity organization. All qualified individuals will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

title: Social Graphic / Motion Designer (Contract)
description:
Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company’s award-winning active play system, is purpose-built to get families moving year-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities.

Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. Nex has been recognized by Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, TIME’s Best Inventions, and Parents’ Best Entertainment System for Families, and has earned Red Dot, IDEA, and Core77 international design awards. We encourage you to explore Have Fun and Is Motion Gaming Back?, as they offer a deeper look into our culture, values, and explain how our approach to motion gaming differs from previous generations.

To protect yourself from recruitment scams, please note that Nex communicates through official company emails ending in @nex.inc. If you receive a suspicious email or message, please do not respond and report it immediately to us.

*Location: San Jose, California or Hybrid*
*Compensation: USD 45.00 - USD 85.00 per hour (Estimated 15–20 hours/week)*
*Type: Part-Time Contract*
*Report to: Social Lead*

About this Role
---------------

We are seeking a creative and detail-oriented Social Graphic/Motion Designer to join our growing Brand and Marketing team on a part-time contractor basis.

This role is responsible for designing best-in-class social creative — from static graphics and carousels to motion assets and campaign support — across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn. You will build and maintain scalable templates and design systems, elevate short-form video with motion graphics, and help evolve Nex's social visual identity.

This is a great opportunity for someone with strong visual instincts and platform-native design sense who wants to help build a mission-driven brand at the intersection of movement, family, and technology.

Core Responsibilities
---------------------

* Design and produce best-in-class social creative across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and LinkedIn, including carousels, static graphics, Stories, motion assets and campaign support.
* Create motion graphics, animations and graphic treatments that elevate short-form video content and improve overall creative quality.
* Support game launches, IP partnerships, seasonal campaigns and always-on content with polished, social-first design assets.
* Develop and maintain editable templates and scalable creative systems that enable faster, more efficient content production.
* Partner closely with the internal creative and social team to evolve and uphold Nex's social visual identity, templates and creative toolkit.
* Optimize creative specifically for social platforms, ensuring assets are designed for engagement, readability and mobile-first consumption.
* Adapt campaign creative into platform-specific social assets while maintaining consistency across channels.
* Collaborate with the Social Lead, content creator and agency partners to bring creative concepts to life from storyboard through final execution.
* Stay current on evolving social design trends, motion styles and platform creative best practices to continuously elevate the brand's visual presence.
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment, balancing quick-turn reactive requests alongside larger campaign deliverables.

Required Qualifications
-----------------------

* 2–4+ years of experience in social graphic design and motion design, ideally for a consumer, gaming, or entertainment brand.
* Strong portfolio of social-first creative (carousels, Stories, static graphics, motion assets) across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects) or equivalent design and motion tools.
* Experience building and maintaining editable templates and scalable creative systems.
* Strong understanding of mobile-first, platform-specific design best practices.

Preferred Qualifications
------------------------

* Experience in gaming, family, or consumer tech brands.
* Experience supporting game launches, IP partnerships, or seasonal campaigns.
* Familiarity with short-form video editing or motion graphics for social.
* Experience collaborating with agency partners and cross-functional creative teams.

What Sets You Apart
-------------------

* Strong visual and brand instincts with platform-native design sense.
* Ability to translate concepts into polished, on-brand execution quickly.
* Highly organized, comfortable managing multiple deliverables at once.
* Excited about building a new category around active, family-first play.

#LI-remote

*We Offer*
----------

* Competitive compensation package.
* Flexible working hours and vacation policy.

title: Freelance Senior Graphic Designer
description:

Contract / Project-Based · Remote-Friendly (Chicago/Evanston, IL or St. Louis, MO preferred)

About Us
Creative Edge, Inc. — operating in part as NeigerDesign, A Creative Edge Company — is a full-service marketing and creative agency with offices in Cape Girardeau, MO, St. Louis, MO, and Evanston, IL and a distributed team. We work across branding and design, digital marketing, video production, and web services for clients ranging from local businesses to large healthcare non-profits to national associations and organizations. As our workload grows, we're expanding our trusted bench of freelance senior graphic designers who can integrate seamlessly with our in-house creative team and step into projects as needed.

The Role
We're looking for an experienced, versatile graphic designer who is equally comfortable developing a new creative concept an extending an established visual system.

You'll work directly with our Creative Director and internal design team on a range of client assignments, including brand identity, print and editorial design, marketing collateral, presentations, digital creative, and production.

This is a hands-on senior design role. We're looking for someone who can take a thoughtful creative brief or established direction, understand the objective, make strong design decisions, and carry the work through to a polished, production-ready result without requiring extensive art direction along the way.

What You'll Do

* Develop original design concepts based on creative briefs, client objectives, and brand strategy.
* Extend established creative directions and brand systems across new materials and applications.
* Design print and digital collateral, including brochures, reports, publications, sell sheets, signage, trade show materials, presentations, advertising, and digital assets.
* Support brand identity projects, including logo development and refinement, visual identity systems, brand guidelines, and related applications.
* Take projects from initial concept through refinement, production, and final delivery.
* Prepare accurate, print-ready files and coordinate with printers and production vendors when needed.
* Work collaboratively with our Creative Director and internal team, incorporating feedback while bringing your own design judgment and problem-solving to the work.
* Manage assigned work and deadlines reliably within a fast-moving agency environment.

What We're Looking For

* 5+ years of professional graphic design experience, with agency experience strongly preferred.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating both conceptual thinking and polished execution across a range of brand identity, print, editorial, and digital work.
* Strong typography, composition, visual hierarchy, and attention to detail.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop.
* Experience taking print projects through production and preparing files for professional printing.
* Ability to work within established brand guidelines while also developing original visual concepts when the assignment calls for it.
* Comfortable working independently from a creative brief or established direction without requiring highly detailed art direction.
* Strong organizational skills, communication, and reliability in a deadline-driven agency environment.
* Experience with presentation design and platforms such as PowerPoint and Canva is a plus.

Engagement Details

* Contract structure : Project-based Statement of Work (SOW) under a standing Master Service Agreement; this is not a W-2 position.
* Location : Remote-friendly. Designers in the Evanston/Chicago metro area are preferred for occasional in-person collaboration.
* Engagements : Assignments may range from individual deliverables and production support to multi-week campaigns and larger creative projects.
* Rate : Based on experience and project scope; engagements may be quoted hourly or by project.
* Workflow : Freelancers receive scoped access to relevant project tools, files, brand guidelines, and a designated internal point of contact.

Interested?
Click " Apply for this Job " and send us your portfolio, résumé or professional background, location, availability, and typical freelance rate or rate range. We're especially interested in seeing work that demonstrates how you think as a designer—not just how you execute. Portfolios should include examples of brand identity, print/editorial design, and broader campaign or marketing applications rather than primarily social media content.

Questions about this role can be directed to Zack Koeller at zack@creativeedge.tv.

title: Marketing Design Lead
description:
Brand and marketing design · Remote (India) · Full-time · 6 to 8 years of experience

-------------
Why this role
-------------

Firstwork is judged on how it looks the moment it reaches someone. A deck in a meeting with a senior client. A one-pager forwarded to a decision maker. The website an investor opens before a call. In each of these moments, the work has to match the quality of the company behind it, and that standard needs an owner.

That is this role. You lead marketing design at Firstwork and own the visual standard of everything the company puts in front of the market. It is a brand and marketing role, not a product design one, and it is hands-on. You lead the standard by producing the work yourself, not by directing others, and you work closely with the founders and the marketing team, with the room to take your own calls and hold the line on quality without being asked.

What you'll do

You lead marketing design at Firstwork and own the full surface, end to end.

*

Presentations and enablement. Much of our business runs through decks: sales, partnerships, and investment. Alongside them, the one-pagers, case studies, and product materials the team uses to win and keep business, and this is where craft is noticed first

*

Our website runs on Webflow, and you design and extend it as we grow, keeping the identity consistent across new pages and campaigns

*

Events and campaigns. The look and the materials for the moments where our work meets the market, in person and online

*

Motion and video. Product explainers, short films, and social content, where motion is used to make something clearer, not for its own sake

*

Brand consistency. You keep the identity coherent across every surface, and you evolve it with care rather than diluting it

*

The standard. You are the reason the quality of everything we publish rises and stays high

What we're looking for

*

A hands-on foundation in graphic design and, ideally, illustration, so you produce the finished work yourself and do not depend on someone else to turn your ideas into the final output

*

Production range. You can take a piece from idea to finished output across presentation, print, digital and motion, without a drop in quality

*

A strong command of typography, layout, color and hierarchy. You build and hold a visual system rather than simply decorate

*

An editorial, considered sensibility, comfortable in a direction that sits closer to art and print than to typical software design

*

A clear point of view you can defend, taking direction from good judgment rather than ego

*

Dependable and fast, including against fixed deadlines, with nothing unfinished or careless leaving your desk

*

Open to feedback, giving and taking it honestly in service of the work

*

Fluency with the modern design stack. Figma at the center, with the motion and web tools the work needs, and we will ask to see how you work

If you have wanted to own the full visual standard of a company that genuinely cares about craft, with a portfolio of finished, published work that speaks for itself, and you already hold that bar yourself, this is that role.

How to apply

To apply, share your portfolio and your LinkedIn. We review both carefully, and if there is a fit we will reach out for a phone call.

From there, expect two to three rounds, including a brief assignment and first conversations with the team. We would like to see your work.

Firstwork is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Product team at Airwallex is a group of passionate builders and problem-solvers who are obsessed with crafting customer-centric solutions that empower businesses to operate anywhere, anytime.

As the payments landscape undergoes its biggest paradigm shift in decades, our Payments Platform Team is expanding beyond legacy card rails to build the next-generation infrastructure for global commerce. We combine deep technical expertise with first-principles product thinking to design intuitive, highly scalable rails that bridge traditional fiat processing, autonomous AI execution, and stablecoin settlement.

THE ROLE

As a Staff Product Manager, Agentic Payments, based in our San Francisco office, you will lead the core strategic bets driving Airwallex's future processing engine. You will work across several key initiatives, such as our one-click-checkout tool Airi) and build out our Stablecoin Acceptance and Agentic Commerce products

In this role, you won't just optimize authorization rates—you will design how AI agents buy, sell, and settle globally, seamlessly bridging fiat card networks with instant stablecoin liquidity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will lead high-impact, zero-to-one and scale initiatives across three core payment vectors:

1. Agentic Commerce & Autonomous Payments Architecture

- Define Machine-to-Machine Payment Protocols: Build standard API/SDK primitives and execution layers enabling AI agents to programmatically initiate, authorize, and verify payment transactions without manual human friction.

- Integrate Airi into Core Payments: Partner with our AI/ML engineering teams to deploy Airi across the checkout lifecycle—utilizing LLMs and predictive models for real-time routing, intent detection, dynamic risk scoring, and automated fraud defense.

- Programmable Spending & Identity: Architect fine-grained authentication, spend controls, and identity verification mechanisms specifically tailored for autonomous software agents acting on behalf of businesses and consumers.

2. Stablecoin Acceptance & Hybrid Settlement

- On-Ramp / Off-Ramp Orchestration: Architect robust stablecoin (USDC, USDT, etc.) payment acceptance rails, enabling merchants to accept digital dollars globally with instant, low-cost clearing and automated conversion into local fiat currencies.

- Unified Checkout Infrastructure: Embed stablecoin payment flows natively alongside traditional payment methods (Card Schemes, Local Payment Methods) within our single API integration, giving merchants zero-friction access to Web3 liquidity.

- Capital Efficiency & Treasury Integration: Collaborate with Treasury and Liquidity Risk teams to leverage stablecoins for instant cross-border merchant payouts and balance-sheet optimization.

3. Scalability, Resilience & Industry Leadership

- Build Next-Gen Foundations: Ensure our underlying payment engines scale to handle massive transaction volumes with 99.999% uptime, strict fault tolerance, and near-zero latency.

- Drive Ecosystem Standards: Represent Airwallex in global standards bodies, scheme working groups, and developer communities defining protocol specs for agentic commerce and crypto-fiat settlement.

WHO YOU ARE

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- 8+ years of professional experience in Product Management, with significant exposure to high-growth, fast-paced fintech or tech environments.

- Proven track record building and scaling core payment infrastructure, acquiring products, card scheme integrations, or blockchain/stablecoin payment systems.

- Strong technical background with a Bachelor's degree or higher (preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Deep Domain Expertise: Hands-on experience with payment authorization flows, ISO 8583/20022 messaging, card scheme rules, or blockchain-based token standards (ERC-20, Solana SPL) and stablecoin architecture.

- AI & Agentic Systems Native: Demonstrated understanding of LLMs, tool-use agents, multi-agent workflows, and how software agents interact with APIs to execute real-world economic actions. Familiarity and interest in agentic commerce and payment standards and protocols, like x402, A2A, AP2, and UCP.

- Technical Mastery: Exceptional capability to engage in deep architectural discussions with principal engineers, review API contracts, and evaluate transaction protocols.

- First-Principles Thinking: Ability to decompose highly complex, unstructured problems (like autonomous machine payments) into clear, execution-focused product roadmaps.

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. title: Intern Product Designer (AI Prototyping)
description:
*We're on the lookout for an Intern Product Designer to join our Product Design team. Your main focus will be to learn, under the guidance of a mentor, how to design useful apps in Figma/AI and how to turn those designs into working prototypes with the help of AI tools.*

We work with well-established companies and sometimes with startups in their early stages, which makes the job full of variety. You will have your own mentor who will help you onboard and upskill, and you'll be on a commercial project from day one.

This is a new kind of internship for us. Next to the classic design craft, you'll spend a lot of time building and not only drawing, so that what you hand over is a link to something that works and not just a Figma file.

Who we’re looking for:
----------------------

*

You have a basic background in design and a portfolio to show us *(no commercial projects required)*

*

You have basic knowledge of Figma
---------------------------------

*

You've already used AI to turn a design idea into something that actually runs, even if it was only an experiment for yourself *(nothing commercial required, projects that never shipped are totally fine)*

*

You know what tools like Claude Code, Cursor, v0 or Lovable are for and you've played with at least one. We don't expect you to have mastered them, you'll learn the rest here

*

You can say why something looks the way it does, not just that it looks good

*

You're proactive, and open to feedback
--------------------------------------

*

You're eager to learn and grow
------------------------------

*

You speak Polish at a C1 and English at a C1 level (it's a must)

*

You have *student status*

Bonus points if you:
--------------------

*

A project in your portfolio we can open at a link, not just look at

*

You're a student or graduate of graphic design, product design, or a similar creative field

*

Any exposure to UI or UX principles
-----------------------------------

*

Experience in branding, marketing design, or any visual design discipline

*

Adobe Photoshop / Illustrator / After Effects, Webflow, Jitter, Framer, Make (or alternatives)

What you’ll learn - here's what to expect:
------------------------------------------

*

You'll work with a mentor on a real commercial project, experiencing the full process from idea to execution

*

Your mentor will onboard you, assign tasks, support your progress, and review your work

*

You'll design in Figma and turn your designs into working prototypes, most often with Claude Code

*

You'll receive real, meaningful tasks, not just design support work

*

You may join client meetings and even present your work, with mentor support

*

You'll get exposure to the scrum process and learn how to work closely with developers and Product Owners

*

After some time, there's a possibility of moving to a different project

*

Throughout the internship, you'll receive continuous feedback and support from our entire design team

Recruitment Process:
--------------------

* CV and Portfolio Review
*

Design Task
-----------

*

Phone Call with Our Recruiter (15 min)
--------------------------------------

*

Technical/Soft Skills Interview with Your Future Mentor and Department Head (includes live task review) (1.5h)

*

Decision and Feedback 🥳
-----------------------

Perks & Benefits:
-----------------

* Paid 3-month internship with real responsibilities
* Option to extend the cooperation
* Path toward a Junior Product Designer role
* Regular feedback, mentoring, and shadowing opportunities
* Access to our internal Delivery Talks, Design Talks, and Tech Talks
* A friendly, feedback-driven culture where you can ask anything and grow fast

If you’re looking for a place to *truly learn what Product Design is all about* - through practice, with real projects and the support of a mentor - this internship might be a perfect fit.
