title: Deputy Head of Financial Crime
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Deputy Head of Financial Crime to join our financial Crime Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help safeguard the firm against financial crime risks, lead critical remediation initiatives, and drive control enhancements as part of our Financial Crime Operations team as we scale our business spend management platform. If you're excited about building robust, future-proofed compliance frameworks and leading high-performing operational teams and are passionate about financial crime prevention and regulatory excellence, then this is the opportunity for you!

WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You’ll report to the Associate Director of Financial Crime Operations and work closely with teams in Compliance, Risk, Legal, Operations, and Product. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to mitigating AML, CTF, Sanctions, ABC, and Fraud risks while supporting sustainable business growth. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across the wider organisation, external auditors, and regulatory bodies to ensure success.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Deputy Head of Financial Crime, you will:

- Drive Compliance oversight and quality assurance: Oversee day to day financial crime reports, disclosures, risk assessments sign-off, and regulatory outputs while monitoring metrics and KPIs to address emerging risks and operational bottlenecks.

- Lead Complex Remediation & Projects : Act as the primary lead for financial crime remediation programs, regulatory look-backs, control enhancements, and tech integrations from scoping through to execution and root-cause analysis.

- Provide Strategic Leadership Coverage: Deputise for the Associate Director of Financial Crime Operations during absences, representing the function at executive committees, board meetings, and in regulatory engagements.

- Direct Team Leadership & Capability Building: Directly lead, coach, and empower the FinCrime Operations team, driving resource planning, talent development, and a high-performing, accountable culture.

- Foster Cross-Functional & Regulatory Relationships: Work closely with internal Risk, Legal, and Business units, as well as external auditors and regulators, to embed effective financial crime controls across the business.

WHAT YOU BRING

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- Deep Financial Crime Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of AML, CTF, Sanctions, ABC, and Fraud frameworks within a 1LOD environment.

- Strategic & Operational Leadership: Proven track record of direct team management, coaching, resource allocation, and providing trusted counsel to senior stakeholders and boards.

- Remediation & Program Management: Hands-on experience leading multi-workstream remediation projects, regulatory look-backs, and complex control improvements.

- Regulatory Acumen: Strong understanding of evolving regulatory landscapes and experience engaging directly with regulatory bodies and external auditors.

- Data-Driven Problem Solving: Strong analytical mindset to identify root causes, track KPIs, and optimize operational processes.

- A background in Financial Services, Fintech, or regulated payment institutions with at least 8+ years in financial crime/compliance, including 3+ years in a formal leadership role.

WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You enjoy balancing high-level strategic influence with hands-on operational execution and team leadership.

- You thrive in dynamic environments where you can lead complex remediation projects and shape evolving compliance frameworks.

- You want high visibility, direct deputising experience, and ownership over key regulatory and board-level interactions.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You prefer a purely advisory role without direct team management or operational execution responsibilities.

- You are uncomfortable working in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities or managing regulatory ambiguity.

- You prefer maintaining existing processes rather than actively driving process optimization and control overhauls.

HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

- Lead key control enhancement and remediation initiatives to drive impact in our overall risk mitigation and operational efficiency.

- Collaborate with Operations, Risk, and Tech teams to improve fin-crime detection systems and workflow processes.

- Grow your skills in executive stakeholder management and strategic governance, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in fintech risk governance

THE LOCATION

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45-minute deep dive with the Associate Director of Financial Crime Operations focusing on operational experience, leadership, and technical expertise.

3. Challenge and Panel interview: We will send you a take home assignment to present into a panel interview

4. Final Interview: A final conversation senior leadership

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a total a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

- CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

- Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

- Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45-minute deep dive with the Associate Director of Financial Crime Operations focusing on operational experience, leadership, and technical expertise.

3. Challenge and Panel interview: We will send you a take home assignment to present into a panel interview

4. Final Interview: A final conversation senior leadership

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a total a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

- CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

- Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

- Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

- Accelerate Insights with AI: Leverage Snowflake Intelligence and AISQL daily to automate manual reporting and speed up your insight discovery process. You will use our native AI features to streamline complex workflows, allowing you to focus less on manual data prep and more on driving strategic insights.

- Build Scalable Reporting & Tooling: Translate your data findings into automated, high-visibility dashboards that Product and Finance leaders rely on for decision making. The dashboards you build will be maintained by Snowflake’s business intelligence team.

- Optimize Cloud Spend & Infrastructure: While revenue is your focus, you’ll also identify and resolve abnormalities in infrastructure spend to maintain healthy margins. Provide recommendations to reduce COGS/OpEx and improve cost efficiency.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

- Strong Financial & Analytical Skills: Proven ability to build financial models, analyze qualitative and quantitative data, and juggle competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Bachelor’s Degree: In Finance, Economics, Data Science or a related field.

- 2–5 Years of Experience: Background in Finance, Investment Banking, or Consulting. Experience in SaaS, Cloud, Data, or Fintech environments—especially partnering with Product, Engineering, and Sales as a finance analyst—is strongly preferred.

- Data Driven Insights (SQL Preferred): You have a high aptitude for navigating technical systems and data structures. While you don’t need to be a SQL expert on day one, you possess the ability to quickly become proficient in understanding complex schemas and data logic. Prior experience with financial modeling tools and BI platforms is a plus.

- Revenue & Margin Analysis Experience: Experience analyzing revenue, COGS, and margin trends. Familiarity with Salesforce or other GTM systems to reason about historical and forward-looking trends is highly beneficial.

- Ownership & Problem-Solving Mindset: Adept at working through ambiguity and taking initiative. Anticipate next steps, coordinate with stakeholders, and push projects forward.

- Exceptional Communication: Able to translate complex data into actionable insights for non-technical audiences. Comfortable presenting to VP/C-level leadership.

title: Growth Marketing Design Lead
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

Job Posted: September 2026

Location: NAMER

Hi there!

As our Growth design Lead you'll lead the creation of a high-velocity experimentation engine that drives measurable business impact across the top of our funnel. You'll help define and execute an AI-first design strategy that connects world-class creative with core growth metrics — ensuring continuous optimization across acquisition, conversion, and activation. Operating at the intersection of design, data, and marketing, you'll translate behavioral and search insights into scalable, on-brand experiences, establish rigorous testing frameworks, and partner closely with Growth Marketing, Web/Engineering, Brand, and Data to accelerate conversion and revenue outcomes through disciplined, data-driven execution.

If you have a strong track record of driving growth through experimentation, bring deep design and product thinking, understand SEO and conversion rate optimization, and have a forward-looking perspective on how AI can unlock customer and business value, we'd love to hear from you!

- Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

- Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

- Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

- Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

- Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/

About You

- You have 10+ years of experience in growth, product, or marketing design, with a strong portfolio of shipped, top-of-funnel work that drove measurable business impact (lead generation, conversion lift, acquisition). Your portfolio shows both craft and outcomes.

- You drive growth through experimentation. You've designed and run A/B and multivariate tests, built and scaled experimentation programs, and moved quickly from hypothesis to live experiment without dropping your quality bar.

- You understand SEO and conversion rate optimization deeply, and you design with them in mind. You know how information architecture, landing page structure, page speed, and content strategy affect discoverability and conversion. You also stay ahead of how AI is transforming organic search and discovery, evolving site architecture and content strategy to remain optimized for SEO and localized (GEO) behaviors.

- You think in systems and you strengthen the ones that already exist. You've designed for CMS-driven platforms and modular frameworks, and you've built and contributed to reusable components inside a shared design systems so the whole team ships faster and more consistently.

- You've owned lead-capture experiences — forms, gated content, and CRM-integrated workflows — and you're fluent in growth metrics like MQLs, CAC, and LTV and lead qualification workflows.

- You're AI-first in your craft. You actively use AI tools (e.g., Cursor, v0, Claude, Figma AI) to accelerate research, generate variants, prototype faster, and increase design velocity — and you have a forward-looking view on how AI can unlock customer and business value.

- You're deep in Figma: auto-layout, AI prototyping, and a track record of contributing to design systems there rather than working around them. You hold a high bar for usability, accessibility and brand integrity, and you treat brand and conversion as the same goal.

- You're a seasoned operator and a force multiplier. You've worked at the scale and pace of a fast-growing company, you own ambiguous, high-impact work end-to-end, and you mentor and level up other designers.

- You communicate and collaborate well. You partner naturally with growth marketers, brand designers, writers, engineers, and data, and you can articulate the "why" behind design decisions in terms of both user experience and business outcomes.

- You embody our values. At Zapier, our values https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier are at the heart of how we work together and how we think about our customers. In our remote setting, they help develop trust and ensure we work and collaborate to democratize automation.

Things You'll Do

- Own and define the end-to-end visitor-to-lead experience across our marketing site and campaigns — shaping how prospects discover, learn about, and decide to try Zapier.

- Build a high-velocity experimentation engine for the top of our funnel — designing, running, and scaling A/B and multivariate experimentation programs across landing pages, campaigns, and conversion surfaces.

- Define and execute an AI-first design strategy that connects world-class creative with core growth metrics, and continuously optimizes for acquisition, conversion, and activation.

- Own conversion rate optimization from a design perspective: form hypotheses, design experiments, and iterate based on test results, funnel data, and growth metrics (MQLs, CAC, LTV).

- Refine site-wide information architecture to improve discoverability, navigation, and conversion efficiency, and evolve our content strategy for SEO and AI-driven search (GEO).

- Design high-performing lead-capture experiences — forms, gated content, and CRM-integrated workflows — and partner with marketing and revenue ops to improve lead qualification and handoff.

- Extend the systems we already have (the web design system, the email design system, brand guidelines) so they serve growth and experimentation needs. You decide whether the pattern earns a place in the system and build the component in Figma.

- Partner closely with Growth Marketing, Brand, Web/Engineering, and Data to translate behavioral and search insights into scalable, on-brand, accessible experiences. You'll be active in what Brand Studio ships: critique, design review, and the systems.

title: Junior Graphic Designer
description:
Junior Graphic Designer

Build the craft. Learn the brief. Deliver with care.

We’re looking for a Junior Graphic Designer to join our creative team and build their design career through varied, real-world client work.

This is an early-career opportunity for someone with strong design foundations, a good eye for detail and most importantly, the curiosity and ambition to keep getting better.

You’ll work alongside experienced designers to create clear, engaging and high-quality work across digital, print, learning, campaigns and presentations. You’ll have the support of a Design Lead who’ll provide creative direction, regular feedback and coaching as you develop your craft and creative judgement.

Whether you’re a recent graduate or have already started building professional design experience, this is a role where you can learn by doing and contributing to great work while steadily taking on more responsibility as your confidence and capability grow.

What you’ll bring

We’re less interested in you already knowing everything and more interested in the foundations you’re bringing and where you can go from here.

You’ll thrive in this role if:

* You have a good foundation in visual design, including layout, typography, hierarchy, colour and imagery.
* You care about visual quality, clarity and the small details that make work feel considered.
* You can work confidently from established brand guidelines, templates and creative direction.
* You think about the audience and purpose behind a piece of work, rather than design for design’s sake.
* You’re curious, ask thoughtful questions and are willing to explore different approaches.
* You welcome feedback and can turn it into stronger work next time.
* You’re organised, dependable and communicate early when you need help or something might affect a deadline.
* You enjoy collaborating and want to learn from the people around you.
* You’re interested in new design tools, techniques and better ways of working.
* You have a portfolio that demonstrates strong design fundamentals and your potential to grow.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll support the creative team in delivering clearly defined pieces of design work for a range of clients and projects.

Working from briefs, brand guidelines and creative direction, you’ll develop ideas into effective visual outputs, prepare work carefully for review and delivery, and build the professional habits that make you a dependable member of a creative team.

You’ll learn to manage your own assigned work and deadlines, check your work carefully before sharing it and take ownership of straightforward design challenges.

You’ll also be encouraged to experiment. We want you to explore ideas, learn from mistakes, listen openly to feedback and apply what you’ve learned to the next piece of work.

As your experience grows, so will your independence. You’ll become increasingly comfortable handling familiar design work without step-by-step guidance and taking on a wider range of creative challenges.

What success looks like

You don’t need to arrive with all the answers.

Success in this role means producing thoughtful, accurate work, following through on your commitments and showing clear development in your craft and judgement.

We’ll see that in the quality and consistency of your work, the way you respond to feedback, how reliably you manage your responsibilities and how positively you contribute to the wider team.

Most importantly, we’ll see you learning — needing less guidance on familiar work over time and becoming increasingly confident in the decisions you make.

What you get

We built our benefits package around what you’ll need to do your best work.

Flexible, remote-first working, with offsites too — Life happens and we get that. If you need to flex, we'll always aim to support that. Work from wherever you do your best thinking. Quarterly in-person team days keep the relationships real.

Travel Insurance — We believe in the importance of face-to-face time at Quadmark, and we want our approach to allow you to spend time with each other, and with clients, when you need to.

Private Medical Insurance — In the UK, we partner with Vitality. Our health and life cover comes with great rewards that help you stay healthy. Because we want you to feel your best.

EAP and mental health support — Access to a confidential Employee Assistance Programme and mental health resources.

Enhanced leave — Depending on your location, it's enhanced beyond statutory. We offer 25 days' leave in the UK specifically. For everyone, we shut down for the holidays too — that’s three extra days of paid leave at the end of the year.

Sound like you?

If you’re at the beginning of your design career, care about making ideas clear and want to develop your craft alongside an experienced creative team, we’d love to see what you can do.

Send us your CV and portfolio and tell us a little about why this feels like the right next step for you.

title: Product Owner
description:
*The Role:*
-----------

We are looking for a Product Owner who will take full ownership of a defined product surface within our platform — whether that is shared infrastructure, a new product being built from scratch, a specialized law enforcement workflow, or a data-driven analytics experience. You will work as a trio alongside a lead engineer and a junior engineer, using our AI-augmented software development lifecycle to deliver at a pace that traditionally required much larger teams. This is not a traditional product manager role: you own scope, priority, and delivery accountability in one seat, and you produce complete, engineering-ready specifications that your engineering pair can build from directly.

*Responsibilities:*
-------------------

*

Own your product surface end to end — deciding what gets built, when it ships, and how it serves your users or consuming teams, with full accountability for scope, priority, and quality

*

Produce engineering-ready specifications for all features — complete user flows, visual designs, data requirements, edge cases, and acceptance criteria — using AI tools as a core part of your workflow; engineering builds from your specifications directly, without ambiguity about what the experience should be

*

Make priority decisions and defend them — customer success, sales, and leadership will bring you requests; you decide which enter the roadmap and which don’t, with clear reasoning and transparent communication

*

Maintain deep fluency with your customers — whether they are law enforcement practitioners, agency administrators, internal platform consumers, or data science teams — through direct engagement, user research, and ongoing relationship-building

*

Conduct or commission user research as needed — interviews, usability testing, workflow observation, product analytics review — and engage internal subject matter experts to ground product decisions in direct evidence rather than assumptions

*

Partner directly with your engineering pair as a trio; bring clarity on what to build and why while they bring clarity on how to build it and what is feasible

*

Own post-launch adoption and feedback — evangelize new capabilities, train internal teams, track feature adoption, gather user feedback, maintain documentation, and iterate based on real-world usage rather than handing off after launch

*

Support enterprise sales conversations with substantive product and domain knowledge when needed — not just feature lists, but the depth that builds customer confidence

*

Leverage AI tools and technologies across all aspects of your work — research, specification, design, analysis, prototyping, and documentation

*Requirements:*
---------------

*

title: (Junior) Group Marketplace Account Manager:in (m/w/d)
description:
Du liebst es, strategische Projekte zu organisieren und umzusetzen? Als (Junior) Group Marketplace Account Manager:in (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für mehrere Marktplätze (z. B. OTTO, Zalando, About You, Asos oder Allegro) – und das für alle Marken der SNOCKS Group gleichzeitig (SNOCKS, OCEANSAPART, femtis und künftig auch Les Lunes). Statt dich auf eine Brand zu konzentrieren, baust du echte Marktplatz-Expertise auf: von Listings über Werbekampagnen bis zur Performance-Analyse. Du bringst neue Marken auf deinen Marktplätzen live, verhandelst Deals und Aktionen und bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Marktplatz, internen Teams und externen Partnern.

*Deine Aufgaben*

*

*Marktplatzverantwortung Cross-Brand:* Du übernimmst die operative und strategische Planung und Steuerung mehrerer Marktplätze – nicht pro Marke, sondern über alle Marken der SNOCKS Group hinweg in verschiedenen Märkten.

*

*Kampagnen- und Listing-Management* : Du optimierst unsere Produktlistings und bist für die Steuerung unserer Werbekampagnen zur Umsatzsteigerung verantwortlich.

*

*Deals & Account Management* : Du verhandelst Konditionen und Aktionen mit deinen Marktplätzen und verantwortest den gesamten Prozess von der Verhandlung bis zur Umsetzung.

*

*Onboarding neuer Marken* : Du bringst neue Marken auf deinen Marktplätzen liveund entwickelst eine passende Strategie. Dabei arbeitest du viel mit internen und externen Stakeholdern.

*

*Performance & Optimierung:* Dein Fokus liegt auf der laufenden Performance-Auswertung und KPI-Steuerung sowie der Optimierung von Werbekonsolen und -kampagnen, wobei wir hier stark KI-getrieben arbeiten.

*

*Produktpräsentation & Monitoring* : Du sorgst für eine optimale Darstellung unserer Produkte, behältst Bestände im Blick und begleitest Testprogramme einzelner Marktplätze.

*

*Schnittstellen- und Lagerbestandsmanagement:* Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Logistik und Supply-Chain-Management zusammen, um einen reibungslosen Ablauf zu gewährleisten, überwachst die Bestände und koordinierst mit dem Supply-Chain-Team, um immer optimal aufgestellt zu sein.

*

*Berufserfahrung* : 1-3 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Management von Online-Marktplätzen wie OTTO, Zalando, About You, Asos oder ähnlichen. Erfahrung im Fashion-Bereich ist von Vorteil.

*

*Ausbildung* : Studium oder Ausbildung im Bereich E-Commerce, Marketing oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss.

*

*Technische Skills* : Fundierte Kenntnisse in Google Sheets und idealerweise Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie Asana. Erfahrung mit der Middleware Tradebyte (oder vergleichbaren Lösungen wie Channel Engine oder Channel Advisor) sowie im Einsatz von KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag ist von Vorteil.

*

*Analytisches Denken* : Du wertest Verkaufsdaten aus, denkst strategisch und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab – auch wenn du mehrere Marken und Marktplätze gleichzeitig im Blick behältst.

*

*Kommunikationsstärke* : Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen verschiedenen Teams und Partnern und kannst komplexe Themen klar vermitteln.

*

*Eigeninitiative und Kreativität* : Du arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert, bringst innovative Ideen zur Performance-Optimierung mit und gehst Probleme gerne kreativ an.

*

*Sprachkenntnisse* : Du hast fließende Deutsch- und sehr sichere Englischkenntnisse.

46.000 - 56.000 € / Jahr

Faktoren, die das Gehalt einer/eines Mitarbeitenden innerhalb dieser Spanne beeinflussen können sind unter anderem bisherige Erfahrung, Skills und Qualifikationen, die mit eingebracht werden und während des Bewerbungsprozesses bewertet werden.

On top profitierst du natürlich von unseren Benefits: Hier kannst du dich unter anderem auf ein eigenes Weiterbildungs- & Reisebudget sowie einen monatlichen steuerfreien Sachbezug freuen.

Diese Spanne spiegelt wider, was wir zum jetzigen Zeitpunkt für diese Stelle als faire Bezahlung einschätzen, kann sich durch unsere stetige Weiterentwicklung aber auch anpassen.

Dich erwartet ein modernes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Du-Kultur von Tag eins. Wir glauben an flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsmethoden. Unsere Teams bestehen aus motivierten Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.

*

*Goodies für dich* : Von Jobrad-Leasing über Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket bis hin zu betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (Arbeitgeberzuschuss 50%) - bei uns profitierst du von vielen Extras. On top gibt’s Mitarbeitenden-Rabatt in unserem Snocks Coffee und einen steuerfreien Sachbezug (50€ / Monat), den du flexibel für deinen Wocheneinkauf oder z.B. eine Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club einsetzen kannst.

*

*Arbeiten, wie’s zu dir passt:* Du arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist. Remote ist Standard, aber wenn du doch mal Lust hast, ins Büro nach Mannheim, Hamburg oder Berlin zu kommen, gibt’s dafür ein Monatsbudget.

*

*Echte Flexibilität* : Ob Workation mit Freund:innen oder Kolleg:innen, morgendliches Yoga oder eine Sport-Session mittags – bei uns kannst du Arbeit und Privatleben easy miteinander verbinden.

*

*Onboarding* : Du startest nicht mit leeren Händen, sondern bekommst top Hardware, alles was du zum Arbeiten brauchst, und kannst dir im Welcome Shop coole Produkte von unseren Partnern & Friends aussuchen.

*

*Du weißt nicht weiter?* Wir unterstützen dich mit unseren Weiterbildungsangeboten und individuellen Development Budgets! Und wenns nicht ums Berufliche geht, kannst du deinen Zugang zur Gesundheitsplattform nilo.health nutzen, um dir den Support zu holen, den du brauchst.

*

*Einfach (dir) mal was Gutes tun* : Ob „Social Day“, um dich sozial zu engagieren, oder „Power Days“, wenn die Periode mal richtig zuschlägt – diese Tage gibt es on top zu deinem Urlaub.

*

*Alle zusammen* : Wir sind ein Team aus A-Playern, die nach Wachstum streben, und leben den Team-Spirit bei unseren grandiosen SNOCKS Group Events oder einfach beim nächsten After-Work.

*

*Office-Leben* : Bei uns wird’s nie langweilig: ob Tischtennis, Fifa oder Mario Kart nach der Arbeit, gemeinsames Kochen und Lunch, frisches Obst, Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine oder die Müsli-Bar. Und das Beste: Dein Haustier darf natürlich auch mit ins Office!

*

*Wir kleiden dich ein* : Noch keine Produkte der SNOCKS Group in deinem Kleiderschrank? Das ändern wir! Du erhältst jedes Jahr einen 360€ Gutschein von uns sowie weitere tolle Rabatte und Angebote wie bspw. Corporate Benefits.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
--------------------
The BSA2A initiative
--------------------

Helsing’s mission is to protect our democracies. Delivering sovereign AI and mission-critical software capability requires exceptional engineering talent at every level.

Following our recent funding and the success of early-career engineers across our teams—including talent from our Formula Student partnerships—we are opening 20+ roles across our *Deployed AI* and *Software Engineering* teams.

Traditional recruitment often places artificial barriers in front of early-career builders. Resumes rarely tell the full story of your technical depth, intuition, or drive. To solve this, we are piloting a direct, craft-first hiring path: *Bring Something Awesome to Apply (BSA2A)*.

(This route is designed specifically for early-career engineers. It is entirely optional, you may still apply via our standard job listings if you prefer.)

-----------
The process
-----------

At the core of our technical interview philosophy is *Bring Something Awesome (BSA)*. A dedicated session where candidates present an ambitious technical project they have designed, built, or contributed to.

With *BSA2A* , we are bringing this step to the very front of the application. Instead of an initial CV and recruiter screen, you apply by submitting a short (maximum 10-minute) prerecorded video walkthrough of something technically compelling you have built. We look for:

*

*Engineering depth & craft:* High-quality code, solid architectural choices, and systems-level thinking.

*

*First-principles problem solving:* The ability to deconstruct complex technical challenges autonomously.

*

*Clear technical communication:* The ability to explain the how and why behind your trade-offs succinctly.

Candidates selected through BSA2A move into an accelerated, streamlined technical assessment:

*

*Expression of Interest:* Complete the short form below to confirm your eligibility. Our team will review submissions.

*

*Video Submission:* Eligible candidates receive a private link with detailed guidance to upload their 10-minute BSA walkthrough. Every video is evaluated directly by a Helsing engineer not an algorithm or automated keyword filter.

*

*Technical Interviews (2 × 60 mins):*

*

Round 1: *BSA Deep Dive & Systems Design*. An interactive, technical exploration of your project and system trade-offs.

*

Round 2: *Live Coding*. Practical, real-world algorithmic and problem-solving assessment.

*

*Final Interview (30 mins):* A conversation with engineering leadership focused on mission alignment, collaboration, and how you work.

>
>
>
> Note: The initial form below is simply an expression of interest. *You do
> not need your video recorded to submit this form.* If your profile is
> eligible, we will send you dedicated instructions and a submission window.
>
>
>

-------------------------
Why apply via this route?
-------------------------

*

*Evaluated on proof of work, not pedigree:* Your code, architectural choices, and technical curiosity take centre stage—not university ranking, buzzwords, or CV formatting.

*

*Play to your strengths:* Your application is assessed directly by Helsing engineers on what you can actually build, not how well you format a CV. Putting your real-world work front and centre gives you the highest signal—and the highest probability of success.

*

*Accelerated timeline:* A focused, high-signal path that bypasses standard preliminary screens and reduces the overall interview cycle by two full stages.

------------
*Who we are*
------------

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

----------
*The role*
----------

At Helsing we develop and deliver AI-based capabilities and the enabling infrastructure that allow semi-autonomous platforms to localise, navigate, and perceive the world in real time. We build software that is subject to significant and unorthodox technical constraints, must operate in a wide variety of constantly-changing environments, and has to support an ever-growing list of challenging use-cases. What we build ultimately ends up in the hands of real people in high-risk, high-stress situations, so *must* be both reliable and frictionless. Taken together, this brings a whole host of interesting engineering challenges across a wide variety of fields that you’ll help us solve.

--------------
The day-to-day
--------------

Find more information on the day-to-day: Deployed AI Engineer and Software Engineer.

*Please note, you need to apply via this page to be considered for the BSA2A process.

-----------------------
You should apply if you
-----------------------

*

Communicate well in English, both verbally and in writing, with the ability to articulate complex architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

*

Love figuring things out, digging deeper and deeper into unfamiliar systems until it finally clicks, and you understand how they work.

*

Enjoy collaborating with others, including reviewing code and pair programming.

*

Are comfortable solving problems *with code*.

*

Feel like ethical considerations are an inherent part of software engineering.

*

*You can reason about and write code independently, without relying on LLMs.* Helsing operates in environments where LLM use isn't always permitted, so our interviews are designed to let strong engineers succeed on the strength of their own thinking.

------------
Nice to have
------------

*

Experience with Python and Rust.

*

Are familiar with backend interface tools like REST, GraphQL, gRPC/Protocol Buffers, and Arrow.

*

Knowledge of container-based, cloud-native and edge application architectures.

*

Hardware interfaces (e.g., Arduino).

*

Robotics (e.g., control systems).

Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

------------------------------------------------------------------
*Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields*
------------------------------------------------------------------

*

Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.

*

The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.

*

Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.

*

In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.

*

We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.

---------------
*What we offer*
---------------

*

*Competitive salary*

*

*Relocation support* : up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

*

*Learning* : €500/£450 yearly allowance

*

*Health & wellness* : gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

*

*Social* : regular company events and monthly social allowances

*

*Enhanced parental leave* : 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers

*

*Family support:* 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

These are the core benefits across all locations, there may be additional benefits in certain locations.

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here.

What We're Looking For

What You'll Do

As a Junior Recruiter at Parnall Law, you are the front door to our talent pipeline — finding, engaging, and screening the people who will help our firm fight for our clients.

Identify, attract, and secure exceptional talent for our team, in line with our 5 Ts.

Contribute to driving every stage of our hiring process, turning great candidates into great hires.

title: Junior Legal Counsel
description:
*About Finom*

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.

We recently closed a *€115 million Series C equity round* (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.

Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.

At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

Finom is a fast-growing European fintech, and our legal team is growing with the business: more customers, more colleagues, more vendors, more marketing, more markets. The result is a steady, high-volume flow of day-to-day legal work that today lands on the desks of senior lawyers who should be spending their time on complex regulatory and strategic matters.

That is why this role exists. As our Junior Legal Counsel, you will be the first line of defence for routine, high-volume legal work across four domains — commercial contracting, data protection and privacy, employment, and intellectual property — and you will own it end to end. It is a genuine generalist seat: from day one you will see the breadth of work that a law-firm associate, or a junior lawyer in a large in-house team, would wait years to touch.

You will report directly to our Head of Corporate Legal Affairs and work side by side with a small, senior, hands-on team of 4. There is no backlog hidden in a folder waiting for you — the work is being done today, just by the wrong people. Your first months are about getting to know Finom and then taking work off your colleagues, one category at a time, with their full support behind you.

What You Will Be Doing
----------------------

*Own the day-to-day legal queue*

*

Draft, review and negotiate NDAs and standard commercial agreements — including our own templates, short-form partnership agreements, amendments, renewals, order forms, SOWs and subscriptions — within agreed playbooks and fallback positions.

*

Answer legal and contract queries from the business (HR, Finance, Marketing, Procurement, IT and others):

*

Handle standard vendor engagements — contract reviews, drafting DPA’s, following the playbooks our senior counsel maintain.

*Run privacy operations*

*

Own data subject access requests and other data subject rights requests: intake, tracking, coordinating with the business and drafting the response.

*

Review vendor DPAs and standard clauses, and carry out transfer and one-time assessments within an agreed framework.

*

Keep our privacy records, including our RoPA, accurate and current.

*Support employment, corporate and marketing*

*

Prepare standard employment documentation from templates: contracts, addenda, references and routine HR queries within policy.

*

Be the first point of contact for basic corporate housekeeping, and prepare corporate documents from precedent for senior review.

*

Review marketing and content against our approved guidelines — claims, disclaimers and use of third-party IP.

*Be the first answer — and build the layer that scales*

*

Give first-pass answers and first-pass research on the everyday questions that arrive from non-lawyers over Slack (“is a letter of intent binding?”, “how much notice do we need on a three-month contract in Poland?”, “do we need to label AI-generated content?”), resolving what is clearly in scope and escalating what isn’t.

*

Keep our registers and trackers reliable — signed contracts in Jira, Zip and Google Drive, the PoA register, the template library — so “did we ever sign this?” is answered from a system rather than a Slack search.

*

Build and maintain the templates, playbooks and FAQs behind all of the above. This is how the role scales, and you will have protected time each week for it.

You will have real autonomy across all of the above. Higher-stakes matters — personal data breach notifications, DPIAs, material negotiated contracts, complex employment questions, regulatory positions and anything setting a new company-wide precedent — sit with senior counsel, who will involve you so you learn how those calls get made.

Who You Are
-----------

*

*Educational requirement.* You hold a law degree from a recognised university (LL.B., LL.M. or local equivalent). Bar admission is welcome but not required.

*

*Early in your career.* 0–3 years of relevant experience in a law firm, an in-house legal team or a regulatory body. Substantive trainee and internship experience counts.

*

*Grounded in at least one relevant area.* Demonstrable exposure to corporate or commercial contracting, employment law, data protection and GDPR, or IP — and real curiosity about the others.

*

*Fluent in English.* You work in professional English every day, in writing and in conversation.

*

*Reliable under volume.* You are organised, you keep a queue moving, and you don’t let things go quiet. People always know where their request stands.

*

*Comfortable with ambiguity.* Requests here arrive as a message from someone who isn’t a lawyer. You are happy to frame the question yourself rather than wait for it to be framed for you.

*

*Pragmatic and commercial.* You look for the compliant route rather than defaulting to no.

*

*Genuinely up for the work.* For the first 12–18 months, high-volume standard work is the core of this job — and the reason you will build unusual breadth fast. You find that satisfying rather than beneath you.

*

*Humble, eager and easy to work with.* You give and take feedback well, you communicate clearly, and you can talk about what you did rather than what your team did.

Why This Role, and Why Finom
----------------------------

*

*Breadth from day one.* Commercial, privacy, employment and IP — not the narrow slice you would get as a law-firm associate or in a large in-house team at this stage.

*

*Real ownership immediately.* You own your matters end to end, not fragments of someone else’s.

*

*Senior lawyers within reach.* A small, flat team means direct access to experienced counsel, close supervision where you want it, and mentorship we take seriously.

*

*You build, not just execute.* The template and playbook layer doesn’t exist yet. You will create it, and it will outlast you.

*

*A clear path forward.* Finom is growing quickly, and so are the legal topics that come with it. There is a visible route to grow with the organisation, and we will invest in getting you there.

Good to Know Before You Apply
-----------------------------

We would rather be straight with you now than have you find out in month three.

*

The work is high-volume, and some of it is repetitive. NDAs, standard contracts, DSARs and marketing reviews are the job, not a distraction from it.

*

Our process is partly documented and partly in people’s heads. There are templates but no complete playbook, and intake isn’t yet in one channel. You will be building some of that as you go.

*

The pace is high and context-switching is constant. Requests come from several directions and are rarely framed as clean legal questions.

*

You will be broad before you are deep. Four domains at once means generalist first, specialist later — a real trade-off, and one worth being explicit about.

Our hiring process
------------------

*

*Short test task* with your application (in case your CV matches the requirements), so we assess your work and not just your CV.

*

*Screening call* with our Talent Partner (30 minutes).

*

*Interview* with the Head of Corporate Legal Affairs and a senior member of the legal team (45 minutes), focused on your legal thinking.

*

*Team and culture conversation* with two of your future colleagues (30 minutes).

*

*Offer*

*What You Will Get In Return*

*Make a genuine impact on the product*

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.

*Work in the EU*

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

*Become a stock options holder*

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.

*Receive unwavering support and care*

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.

*Work & Swim program*

Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

*Equal Opportunity Statement*

At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

*Design Analysis & Annotation*

* Annotate editorial, poster, and marketing design assets using defined project schemas
* Review short video clips and document relevant visual and compositional characteristics
* Apply precise design terminology when describing visual elements and relationships
* Identify hierarchy, balance, emphasis, rhythm, proportion, and other compositional principles
* Maintain consistent annotation quality across diverse design formats and styles

*Typography, Layout & Visual Hierarchy*

* Analyse typography, layout systems, grids, spacing, colour, and visual hierarchy
* Deconstruct completed designs into their underlying compositional structures
* Identify relationships between text, imagery, graphic elements, and negative space
* Assess whether design decisions support clarity, communication, and intended visual impact
* Apply professional editorial and marketing design standards when evaluating assets

*Structured Metadata & Design Systems*

* Populate structured metadata describing geometry, hierarchy, style, and typographic systems
* Evaluate brand systems, templates, and recurring visual patterns
* Identify consistent and inconsistent applications of design-system principles
* Document compositional relationships in a structured and repeatable format
* Help ensure annotations are suitable for large-scale design datasets

*Motion, Framing & Visual Flow*

* Apply composition and cinematography terminology when evaluating short video content
* Describe framing, movement, visual flow, and spatial relationships accurately
* Identify changes in composition or hierarchy across motion sequences
* Evaluate how visual elements guide viewer attention over time
* Translate motion and composition observations into clear structured annotations

*Quality Standards & Annotation Frameworks*

* Create exemplar annotations that establish quality benchmarks for project datasets
* Identify ambiguous cases, missing categories, and annotation-schema edge cases
* Document gaps or inconsistencies that may require guideline refinement
* Collaborate with project leads and quality reviewers as annotation standards evolve
* Maintain strong consistency and attention to detail across framework updates

* Professionals with 7+ years of experience or substantial art-direction expertise may be well suited to quality-leadership responsibilities
* Portfolio demonstrating advanced typography, colour, layout, grid systems, and visual hierarchy

* Familiarity with Canva or other production platforms is also valuable
* Ability to articulate design concepts precisely using established design and composition terminology
* Strong written English for detailed annotation and structured documentation
* Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field is advantageous; equivalent professional portfolio and experience are also relevant
* Motion design, video editing, or cinematography experience is beneficial
* No prior experience in AI training or model evaluation is required

*Engagement Details*

Warum wir?

Bei The Quality Group arbeiten über 1.200 Menschen mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: Ernährung neu zu denken - gesünder, smarter und mit echtem Mehrwert für die Community.

description:

*Compensation range:* $2,000 AUD - $3,000 AUD/Monthly

*Engagement type:* Independent Contractor Agreement

*Work Schedule:* This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

With substantial real-world ad spend already in market and multiple brands requiring fresh creative, the business is building out its content capabilities with above-market pay for the right creative talent.

*Role Overview:* Our client is looking for an experienced Graphic Designer & Content Specialist who can work directly with the founder across multiple Australian brands spanning mortgage lending, skincare, and daily multivitamin supplements.

This is not a role for someone who needs to be trained from the ground up. We’re looking for a creative operator who can take an idea, turn it into high-quality content, use AI to accelerate production, and understand what makes digital advertising perform.

*What You’ll Do*

* Create high-quality static and video creative for Meta ads, email marketing, and social media across multiple brands.
* Produce mortgage advertising focused on non-bank specialty lending and debt consolidation.
* Turn raw skincare footage into polished 15–20 second video ads, alongside static creative.
* Create content for a growing daily multivitamin supplement brand.
* Develop multiple creative variations from winning concepts, hooks, formats, and visual angles.
* Review creative performance and use insights such as hook/hold rate, CTR and other Meta Ads Manager data to inform new iterations.

*AI & Creative Technology — Required*

* AI Image: Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Nano Banana or equivalent
* AI Video: Veo, Sora, Runway or equivalent

You should be able to explain how you use AI as part of your actual production workflow, not simply demonstrate that you have experimented with AI tools.

*Required Software*

Professional experience with:

* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Adobe After Effects or CapCut for high-volume production
* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Figma
* Canva — genuine requirement

Experience working with Canva brand kits is particularly important. This role requires someone comfortable moving between professional Adobe workflows and fast, practical Canva production.

*What We’re Looking For*

* Strong commercial graphic design and video editing experience.
* Experience creating live digital advertising creative, not just portfolio pieces.
* Strong understanding of what makes an ad visually compelling and attention-grabbing.
* Ability to take a winning creative and quickly develop multiple meaningful variations.
* Comfortable working with performance data and using it to improve creative output.
* Strong understanding of short-form video, hooks, pacing and retention.
* Highly proficient across the required design, video and AI tools.
* Able to work independently, move quickly, and produce finished work without extensive hand-holding.
* Strong attention to brand consistency while being willing to test new creative directions.

*Work Arrangement & Expectations:*

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

* Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
* Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

title: Senior Staff Design Quality Engineer
description:
CooperSurgical is a leading fertility and women’s healthcare company dedicated to putting time on the side of women, babies, and families at the healthcare moments that matter most in life. As a division of CooperCompanies, we're driven by a unified purpose to enable patients to experience life's beautiful moments. Guided by our shared values – dedicated, innovative, friendly, partners, and do the right thing – our offerings support patients throughout their lifetimes, from contraception to fertility and birth solutions, to women’s and family care, and beyond. We currently offer over 600 clinically relevant medical devices to healthcare providers, including testing and treatment options, as well as an innovative suite of assisted reproductive technology and genomic testing solutions. Learn more at

The Senior Staff Design Quality Engineer will provide technical leadership to ensure the successful development of Cooper products and ongoing operational support. This individual will be expected to apply his/her knowledge of design controls, risk management, verification and validation principles and quality engineering techniques to ensure safe and effective products are developed and manufactured in accordance with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements and customer requirements.

The Senior Staff Design Quality Engineer provides expert guidance on scientific and technical data as it pertains to product and product testing and lead teams to identify and solve complex product problems. This position partners cross-functionally with R&D, Operations, Regulatory, Supplier Quality, and Clinical teams, and provides mentorship (including coaching, reviewing, training, delegating work) to peers, leads and less experienced DQEs, and cross-functional engineering teams.

* Design Quality Leadership

* Represent the Quality function on product/process development teams.
* Mentor other discipline as needed in the Quality Engineering methodology.
* Ensures that design control requirements are being met in an effective manner, including those for design verification, validation, specification and procedure development, risk management, design reviews, and design changes. May serve as independent reviewer during design reviews, or conduct DHF audits, as required.
* Owner/Approver of one or more processes within the scope of Design Quality.

* Supplier Engagement

* Manage supplier new tooling to ensure final components are qualified at the supplier and on time utilizing PPAP tool.
* Participates in supplier selection process and specification reviews with suppliers to ensure that purchased items meet Cooper’s specifications.
* Specifies quality characteristics and inspection plans for components, subassemblies, and finished devices with the Engineering Team.
*

Review/Approval of PPAP. May serve as PPAP lead.

* CAPAs/Non conformances/HHE

* Lead or Participate in the investigation of complex product problems. Identify and manage corrective actions resulting from problem investigations.
* Evaluates and dispositions nonconforming materials and products used in pilot and clinical builds.
* Conducts or supports health risk assessments in support of the Health Hazard Evaluation, Reporting or Recall processes.

* Design

* Participate in design reviews to evaluate designs and to help identify alternative design solutions.
* Hands on participant in early stages of product development including but not limited to physician interaction, product engineering, competitive product testing, and prototype testing.
* Provides input to design and manufacturing documentation including material specifications, drawings, inspection procedures, and manufacturing procedures, to ensure that the resulting products can be adequately manufactured and tested
* Contributes to design input requirements from experience with previously reported problems, Cooper’s products, competitive devices and/or other similar products.
* Approves deviations and design changes, conducts impact assessments, and defines/approves implementation plans.

* Verification & Validation

* Participate in the development of the master test plans (I.E. trace matrix, VMP….) that encompass design verification, design validation and process validation activities.
* Creation, evaluation, and validation of product and process test methods.
* Evaluates test protocols and reports to ensure that the testing is sufficient to meet regulatory requirements and quality objectives.

* Risk Management

* Defines risk management strategy throughout product lifecycle including construction of the Risk Management File, Risk Management Planning, and benefit-risk evaluations.
* Identifies and manages risk throughout the development process with the use of FMEAs and/or other risk management tools, ensuring effective integration of risk activities throughout product realization process and feedback into design improvements and maintenance of the product risk profile. This includes leading the Risk management efforts of the design process and working with design team and management team on managing product and process risks.

* Process Improvement and Project Management

* Leads strategic initiatives as aligned with organizational quality objectives. May manage a cross functional team to execute plans.
* Actively identifies and leads opportunities for improvements across all cross functional departments.
* Promotes continuous improvement in design control and risk management activities and use of quality tools with design team and other departments.

* Regulatory

* Comply with applicable FDA and international regulatory laws/standards and the Cooper’s Code of Conduct.
* Maintain knowledge of current regulatory requirements and standards as they pertain to the development and release of medical devices. Implement new or updated standards into existing procedures.
* Represent Cooper as needed in FDA, notified body, internal, and other audits.

* Technical Mentorship

* Serve as a technical mentor to QEs, providing guidance on complex quality engineering topics.
* Promote continuous improvement and consistent application of design quality tools and methodologies.
* Acts as a recognized subject matter expert in one or more DQE domains across the organization.

* Thorough knowledge of statistics and how to apply, evaluate, and provide recommendation from the data.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

* Advanced working knowledge of FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485, EU MDR.
* Demonstrated knowledge in the application of medical device design controls, verification/validation, risk management principles per ISO 14971, and the use of risk assessment tools such as FMEA, Hazard Analysis.
* Intermediate skill in the use of Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Advanced preferred.
* Ability to read and understand highly technical material.
* Proficient in reading and writing in English
* Self-motivated and committed to a team approach
* Strong interpersonal, organizational and project management skills. Ability and experience interfacing with senior leadership and external stakeholders.
* Strong oral, presentation and technical writing skills
* Demonstrated skills in decision making, problem solving, negotiation, and influencing without direct authority preferably across a broad spectrum of Quality Engineering responsibilities
* Proven experience leading cross-functional teams in a medical device development environment.
* Experience with Change Control, Non-conformance, Deviation, Complaints, HHEs and/or CAPAs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with acute attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Knowledge in Knowledge in application of IEC 62304 preferred.
* Knowledge in one or more ISO 10993, IEC 62366, ISO 11607, ISO 11137, or ISO 11135 preferred.

*Experience:*

* 10+ years experience in Quality Engineering in the medical device industry with a Bachelors Degree, or 8+ years with a Masters Degree, experience in related engineering areas, e.g. R&D; or Manufacturing may also be applicable if experience includes work responsibilities listed above.
* Hands ‑ on experience in medical device product development in concept through commercialization, and/or leading design changes, improvements or remediation initiatives in sustaining operations. Knowledge in women’s health a plus.
* This role require 50% travelling - Globally
