title: Product Manager II - Payment Orchestration
description:
--------
About Us
--------

HighLevel is an AI powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, comprised of agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel empowers users with all the tools needed to capture, nurture, and close new leads into repeat customers. As of mid 2025, HighLevel processes over 4 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 250 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.

----------
Our People
----------

With over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

----------
Our Impact
----------

As of mid 2026, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

--------------
About the Role
--------------

The Payments Platform team at HighLevel builds and scales the *payment orchestration layer* that powers every transaction across our ecosystem from invoices and subscriptions to point-of-sale and mobile checkout. The orchestration platform is the engine that *routes payments across providers, processes transactions, generates receipts, and ingests webhook events at scale* , making it one of the most business-critical systems we run. This role is a rare opportunity to own core payments infrastructure that hundreds of thousands of businesses depend on every day.

We are seeking a *Product Manager II, Payment Orchestration* , who will own the roadmap and execution for HighLevel’s orchestration platform spanning the *orchestrator, transaction lifecycle, receipts, and webhook ingress*. You will be responsible for the reliability, breadth, and developer experience of the platform that every payment surface at HighLevel is built on top of.

The ideal candidate combines *product judgment with technical fluency, comfortable* reasoning about *payment routing, PSP integrations, idempotency, and event delivery* , while keeping adoption, transaction success, and customer trust at the center of every decision. This is a role for someone who wants to go deep on payments infrastructure and translate that depth into measurable product outcomes.

*Your mission:* To build a reliable, extensible, and provider-agnostic payment orchestration platform that maximizes transaction success and powers fast, secure, and seamless payment experiences across HighLevel’s global customer base.

--------------
What You’ll Do
--------------

* *Own the Orchestration Roadmap & Execution* – Define and deliver the roadmap for the payment orchestration platform, spanning the *orchestrator, transaction lifecycle, receipts, and webhook ingress* , with a strong focus on reliability, coverage, and transaction success.
* *Drive Payment Routing & Provider Strategy* – Improve *authorization rates and cost efficiency* through smart routing, provider selection, retries, and failover across multiple PSPs and gateways.
* *Own the Transaction Lifecycle* – Lead the end-to-end handling of *authorizations, captures, refunds, voids, and disputes* , ensuring correctness, idempotency, and state integrity at scale.
* *Deliver Reliable Webhook Ingress* – Build robust inbound webhook processing that *normalizes, deduplicates, and reliably fans out provider events* to downstream services with strong delivery guarantees.
* *Ship Trustworthy Receipts & Records* – Own accurate, well-formatted *receipts and transaction records* that give customers and their end users clear, trustworthy proof of every payment.
* *Elevate Platform APIs & Developer Experience* – Partner with engineering to design *clean, well-documented payment APIs and events* that internal teams and product surfaces can build on with confidence.
* *Champion Reliability & Observability* – Treat *uptime, latency, and error rates* as first-class product metrics, driving instrumentation, alerting, and reconciliation to keep the platform accurate and dependable.
* *Ensure Scale, Security & Compliance* – Own *PCI, risk, and data-integrity considerations* , ensuring the platform stays secure, scalable, and compliant as volume grows.
* *Collaborate Cross-Functionally* – Work closely with engineering, design, data, risk, support, and partner-facing teams to align the platform with the needs of every payment surface it powers.
* *Leverage Payments Data for Decisions* – Use metrics such as *authorization rates, transaction success, failure reasons, latency, and reconciliation gaps* to prioritize the roadmap and measure impact.
* *Own Outcomes, Not Just Features* – Deliver measurable improvements in *transaction success, platform reliability, and provider coverage* , and in the experience of the teams building on the platform.

-----------
Who You Are
-----------

* *Payments & Platform Experience* – You have built and shipped features within a payments, fintech, or platform/infrastructure ecosystem, delivering *secure, reliable systems that operate at scale*.
* *Technically Fluent* – You can hold your own with engineers on *APIs, webhooks, idempotency, routing logic, and failure modes* , and you use that fluency to make sharper product decisions.
* *Reliability-Minded* – You care deeply about correctness, uptime, and edge cases, and you design for the *failure paths - retries, timeouts, duplicates, and reconciliation* , not just the happy path.
* *Customer- & Developer-Centric* – You balance business goals, risk, and trust, keeping the needs of both end customers and the internal teams who build on your platform at the center of your decisions.
* *Strategic and Execution-Focused* – You can shape a clear roadmap for your area while staying deeply involved in execution to ensure ideas translate into shipped, measurable impact.
* *Highly Data-Driven in Ambiguity* – You are comfortable working with messy, incomplete data - *transaction logs, failure reasons, and provider quirks* - to find patterns and derive actionable insights.

-----------------
What You’ll Bring
-----------------

* *4+ years of Product Management experience* , with a focus on *payments, fintech, platform, or API/infrastructure products* ,
* *A track record of shipping impactful platform or infrastructure features* that improved reliability, coverage, or transaction success in a high-scale environment.
* *A working understanding of payment systems* PSP/gateway integrations, the *authorization-to-settlement lifecycle, webhooks, idempotency, and reconciliation*.
* *Strong technical fluency* , with the ability to partner closely with engineering on *API design, event models, and system trade-offs*.
* *Familiarity with SaaS and platform growth levers* , including adoption of internal platforms, developer experience, and reliability as a driver of customer trust.

------
Bonus:
------

* You have worked on a *payments or fintech platform processing significant transaction volume across multiple providers* , and can clearly articulate your impact on *reliability, authorization rates, and customer trust*.

-----------------------
Why should you join us?
-----------------------

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.

Join us at High Level, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an experienced HRIS Analyst to join Ramp's People team during an active Workday implementation. Reporting to our Senior HRIS Manager, you'll play a hands-on role in configuration and system support, partnering closely with our implementation partner and cross-functional teams through go-live and hypercare.

This is an opportunity to help strengthen the data integrity, controls, and employee experience that support Ramp as we scale. You'll bring a solutions-focused, collaborative approach and strong systems thinking to a fast-moving, high-growth environment. The ideal candidate is naturally curious, understands how People data flows across systems, and looks for ways to streamline processes as they build them, staying flexible as priorities evolve along the way.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Support the configuration, testing, rollout, and ongoing maintenance of Workday modules, including HCM, Benefits, Advanced Compensation, Time Tracking, and Absence

- Partner with key stakeholders across the business to gather requirements, run testing cycles, resolve issues, and ensure cutover readiness

- Run data validation and audits across HRIS and downstream systems, ensuring data integrity, security, and compliance through regular reporting

- Support system releases and enhancements, including testing changes, documenting outcomes, and triaging issues as they arise

- Train and enable team members and system users on existing and new processes and functionality

- Build and maintain SOPs and job aids that make recurring HRIS processes accurate, scalable, and easy for others to support

- Support AI transformation initiatives involving Workday, partnering with People, IT, Finance, and business stakeholders to evaluate and implement AI-driven solutions

WHAT YOU NEED

- 3–5+ years of hands-on Workday experience, including configuration and production support

- Direct experience with one or more Workday modules: HCM, Benefits, Advanced Compensation, Time Tracking, or Absence

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to reconcile data, identify root causes, and troubleshoot discrepancies across systems.

- Strong attention to detail and track record of managing employee data with sound judgment, accuracy, and appropriate controls

- Ability to translate business requirements into configuration, testing, and documentation

- Proactive problem-solver who takes initiative to resolve issues with minimal oversight

- Strong communication skills and the ability to partner cross-functionally across People, Finance, IT and business stakeholders

- Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience supporting a Workday implementation post-production stabilization

- Familiarity with Workday reporting, integrations, or security concepts

- Exposure to automation tools or AI-assisted workflows

- Background in a high-growth tech or fintech environment, ideally with global scope

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

We provide expert guidance and support to all areas of the business, proactively identifying, mitigating, and managing legal, compliance and financial risks.

The Global Regulatory Compliance Team forms part of the second line of defence (2LOD) at Airwallex whilst operating within the larger LRC function.  We are a proactive and trusted business partner committed to enabling Airwallex’s growth and strategic goals by providing an advisory and oversight role. This role has a specific focus on our business in Korea. This role will be a key member of the Global Regulatory Compliance Team, with a reporting line to the Director, Regulatory Compliance, Asia (based in Singapore).

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As Manager, Regulatory Compliance, Korea you will deliver on the regulatory engagement strategy for Airwallex in the region and manage our existing payment services and money remittance regulatory compliance program. You will maintain our licensing responsibilities and coordinate with all internal and external parties as necessary to ensure compliance. This includes communication of regulatory requirements, cross-functional collaboration to productize solutions and offerings, implementation and execution of processes, filing of all requisite reports, renewal of registrations and licenses, and interfacing with regulators. You will analyse new and existing products and provide guidance to ensure that our 2LOD controls are fit for purpose and comply with regulatory obligations and guide the first line business to enable the maturity of both customer-facing and internal back-office processes and product features.

Responsibilities:

- Support the Airwallex Group’s expansion by managing the regulatory compliance components of licence authorisation processes

- Act as a key stakeholder in relation to licence applications, business plan updates and information requests between Airwallex and our regulators

- Ensure that our regulatory compliance and integrity risk reporting obligations are maintained in Korea and support and / or manage regulatory requests

- Advise the business with respect to regulatory change initiatives with a particular focus on how to effectively manage compliance risk attached to new laws and regulations in the jurisdictions we operate

- Develop policies, processes and provide advice in relation to regulatory risk obligations that exist within the first line business

- Manage regulatory compliance risk within the Airwallex Risk Management Framework and associated escalation process (inc. the Group Risk Committee)

- Advise the business in relation to conduct risk and ethics matters (where appropriate) relating to our financial services licences

- Deliver the Compliance Monitoring Program; Conduct targeted and thematic reviews on a wide range of topics to ensure appropriate organisational maturity

- Deliver the Airwallex Group’s Compliance Training for employees and conduct ad-hoc training to specific business areas as required

- Conduct ‘Proactive Special Ops’ projects to unlock business or operational issues to enable Airwallex to achieve its strategic goals more rapidly

WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 6 years of compliance experience in a regulated financial institution, FinTech, legal / consulting firm, or combination of the above

- Familiarity with financial regulatory laws, rules, regulations and industry best practices in Korea but also more broadly across the Asia region.

- Data proficiency - ability to work with data and leverage it for strategic decision-making

- Ability to operate strategically and think creatively to solve complex regulatory compliance challenges

- Superior communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex topics to a wide range of stakeholders including regulators, executive leadership, and front-line staff

- Experience with developing and/or maintaining a compliance program within a financial institution, preferably in respect of payments activity

- Exposure to licensing processes, regulatory expansion, and RegTech or technology-driven compliance solutions

- Understanding of financial products and related conduct risk, ethics, and controls

Preferred Qualification:

- Demonstrable experience dealing with the FSC and FSS in Korea and other financial services regulators across the Asia region

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an Account Executive to join our new SME team, selling into the eCommerce, SaaS and Professional Services industries. These are fast-growing businesses operating internationally, and we're the only fintech with the payment infrastructure, software and AI layer to streamline how they get paid, manage treasury and pay suppliers from one system. Your job is to understand their priorities, surface where their finance systems are holding them back, and build the case for change.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

PIPELINE AND NEW BUSINESS GENERATION

- Territory planning: prioritising accounts and the people worth reaching out to, as well as identifying routes in through partners or leadership connections.

- Owning your outbound strategy: building a hypothesis on what a business is prioritising and where things are likely breaking, then getting to the right people. Our product evolves quickly, so we need reps who develop new angles as they open up.

- Running a proven sales process, and iterating on it: understanding a business's priorities, the challenges preventing them from executing, and building the ROI case with the customer.

- Forecasting: using MEDDPICC to know where you are in a deal, where the gaps are, and to forecast accordingly.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

- Implementation and account management: coordinating implementation and handover, including the mutual action plans that keep everyone aligned on timelines and get the customer adopting quickly.

- Product: relaying customer insight to the product team and influencing roadmap priorities.

- Marketing: working together on ABM campaigns, competitive positioning and customer case studies.

WHAT YOU BRING

EXPERIENCE

- Ideally 3+ years of B2B software or fintech sales experience, with at least 1 year in an outbound closing role.

- If you have 2+ years in an outbound lead generation role and have been deliberate about upskilling for a move into closing, apply and tell us how.

SKILLS AND MINDSET

- Curious: about the industries we sell into, the people we sell to, and our own product. You want to understand how things actually work, not just what to say about them. You think on your feet and you're clear and concise with your communication.

- Perceptive: you read a room, and you have genuine empathy for the people you're selling to and working alongside.

- Driven: the motivation comes from you. You want to get better, and you keep working through the stretches where results lag effort.

- Honest: you bring problems forward early rather than letting them surface late, and you're upfront when you don't know something.

- Coachable: you take feedback and act on it quickly, while being critical enough about what you hear to apply it selectively.

title: Growth Engineer
description:
💙 ABOUT BOUNCE...

Bounce is building cloud storage for the physical world, starting with the largest global luggage storage network in existence. Bounce’s marketplace connects travelers with 30,000+ small business locations worldwide for hyper-local short term baggage storage. With more locations globally than Burger King, and more locations in New York City than Starbucks, Bounce has served 3M+ users and stored 10M+ bags, and paid over $10M to small business partners.

To achieve this, Bounce is a fast-paced and scrappy team. We believe that experimentation fuels innovation, so we move quickly, testing new ideas and adapting in real time. If you’re ready to make an impact in a high-energy, close-knit, and collaborative environment - Bounce is the place where you can move fast, think big, and shape the future of travel. Join us as we make the world a lighter, more accessible place! Bounce has been named the Inc5000’s fastest-growing travel company in the USA in 2024 and is proudly backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, and Sapphire. (Learn more about Bounce's Series B HERE https://techcrunch.com/2024/11/12/bounce-grabs-19m-to-expand-its-traveller-convenience-network/ and also learn about our Japan Expansion HERE https://techcrunch.com/2024/11/12/bounce-grabs-19m-to-expand-its-traveller-convenience-network/)

WHAT IS THIS ROLE...

Bounce is seeking a Growth Engineer to join our Lisbon office. In this role, you will help scale the Bounce marketplace by building systems and product experiences that drive user acquisition, activation, and conversion across our platform.

You will take ownership of real customer problems and turn them into simple, delightful experiences across both backend and frontend. Much of the work focuses on scaling acquisition channels, building growth systems, and creating product experiences that help more users find and use Bounce.

A key part of the role involves experimentation and data-driven iteration. You’ll run A/B tests, analyze user behavior, and continuously improve conversion funnels and growth loops through rapid experimentation and product improvements.

We’re looking for a generalist who thrives in ambiguity, loves shipping, and enjoys owning a feature from concept to production — collaborating closely with Product, Design, and teams across the company.

HOW PRODUCT GETS BUILT AT BOUNCE

At Bounce, we focus on serving our customers and partners rather than solely on technological innovation.

We work in fast-paced 1-week cycles. Projects are usually scoped down to fit into one or two cycles. Projects are led by individuals, but are a shared effort across the entire team. There will always be aspects of any project that will require collaboration, feedback, and guidance—we expect you to ask for help.

An ideal candidate is excited by all aspects of this software-building process, not just writing code. We’re a small team that thrives off of individuals who can take features from an idea to live on production. This is not a role where issues will be assigned to you and you churn through them.

WHERE YOU COME IN...

- Collaborate with global teams to support new product innovations and business initiatives, continuously exploring new ventures from both an engineering and product standpoint.

- Write high-quality code for our mobile and web applications.

- Assume strong ownership of products and services, and continuously improve and maintain existing code and architecture.

- Work in a fast-paced environment and shoulder the responsibility and commitment of the production environment.

- Work with Elixir, React Native, Expo, React, NextJS, and Typescript, and introduce other technologies when beneficial.

- Bring a passion for staying on top of industry trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, and participating in internal and external technology communities.

YOUR PROFILE...

- Relevant experience developing and shipping code for production systems

- Generalist that strives for velocity and loves owning a feature from start to finish by contributing across the stack.

- Proficient coding skills in one or more of the following - Javascript, Typescript, Elixir, or Ruby.

- Experience with frontend frameworks and technologies, including but not limited to React, React Native, Javascript, CSS, etc.

- Proven experience in building maintainable and testable code bases, including API design and unit/integration testing techniques.

- Commitment to creating an exceptional end-user experience, with attention to the smallest details that can elevate their interaction with our platform.

- Current knowledge of relevant technologies and an ability to implement them effectively.

- Understanding of CI/CD pipelines.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Commercial Analytics)
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Please note: applications will be open until Thursday 24th September 2026 09.00 CEST.
We will no review any applications before the closing date so everyone has equal chances to be selected. Use this time to submit a high quality application that will showcase your strengths.

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Growth Intelligence team at Pleo. In this role, you'll design and maintain the integration architecture and data contracts that connect our commercial and GTM data layer (the pipelines linking our CRM, billing, and customer success tooling to a central BigQuery warehouse) and be part of the team as we scale our commercial data foundations to support RevOps, Customer Success, and the AI products built on top of them. If you're excited about untangling complex, multi-system architecture and are passionate about building data foundations the whole business can trust, then this is the opportunity for you!

WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You’ll report to the Senior Manager of Growth Intelligence and work closely with the RevOps and the BAT (Business Architecture & Technology) teams to understand what commercial operations needs from data. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to keeping Pleo's commercial and GTM data trustworthy and well-governed. You’ll also partner with Analytics Engineers to ensure pipeline outputs are modelling-ready, and engage upstream with tool owners and engineering teams to push data quality and schema discipline closer to the source.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will:

- Design, build, and maintain data pipelines between commercial tools (HubSpot, Zuora, Vitally) and our BigQuery data warehouse.

- Own reverse ETL flows: enrich or define data in the warehouse and push it back into operational tools like HubSpot, keeping definitions consistent across systems.

- Implement and maintain data contracts with clear ownership, SLAs, and schema agreements between data producers (tool owners, product engineers) and data consumers (analysts, RevOps, AI tooling).

- Partner with RevOps and the BAT team to understand operational data requirements and translate them into reliable, governed pipelines.

- Build monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they surface in dashboards, operational reports, or downstream models.

- Simplify integration architecture by centralising data flows through the warehouse, reducing point-to-point tool integrations and the maintenance burden that comes with them.

- Work with Analytics Engineers to ensure pipeline outputs are structured and documented for downstream modelling.

- Engage upstream with tool owners and engineering teams to move data quality and schema discipline closer to the source.

Our commercial data stack connects subscription billing (Zuora), CRM (HubSpot), and customer success tooling (Vitally) to a central BigQuery data warehouse. You can expect to work with the following tech stack: BigQuery, Python, HubSpot, Zuora, and Vitally plus dbt, Fivetran/Census, or Airflow depending on your background.

WHAT YOU BRING

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- Proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines in a commercial or GTM data environment.

- Strong understanding of CRM data models, APIs, and field management (HubSpot or comparable experience).

- Hands-on experience with reverse ETL patterns: pushing warehouse-enriched or warehouse-defined data back into operational tools.

- Extensive BigQuery experience.

- Experience implementing data contracts in a production environment.

- Python proficiency for pipeline development, transformation logic, and tooling.

- Git-based workflows and CI/CD experience for data engineering code.

WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You are equally excited by deep technical work as you are by collaborating with business stakeholders.

- You can comfortably work with a wide variety of data sources and can operate within a complex multi-system environment.

- You truly shine at solving problems and driving alignment between GTM/commercial stakeholders.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You prefer to work on platform matters that are one step removed from the business.

- You have never collaborated with senior stakeholders on GTM / commercial analytics work.

- You need a very defined roadmap and backlog to operate efficiently. You'll need to adapt to rapid changes and be part of the roadmap definition discussions in this role.

HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

- Become familiar with our data ecosystem and codebase.

- Support to drive a HubSpot reimplementation project from the data side.

- Collaborate with Data Platform & Analytics Engineers as well as GTM teams to improve or commercial analytics efforts.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

2. Core skills tests: An async coding exercise through our CoderPad third party platform.

3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute chat with your Manager to deep dive into your technical experience and impact.

4. Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute live interview with two colleagues to assess your architecture and problem solving skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a Senior Data Engineer, we received a total of 543 applications but only 15 were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

- We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

- Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to join our Talent Acquisition team at Pleo. In this role, you'll manage high-volume, mid-to-senior hiring across the organisation, partnering with teams across Tech, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Product and other functions.

You'll own multiple searches at once and play a key role in building strong, proactive talent pipelines that keep our hiring moving. You'll bring structure, pace and consistency to the recruitment process, using repeatable and scalable approaches while still creating a thoughtful experience for every candidate.

If you're someone who loves being organised, thrives when managing multiple priorities, enjoys proactive sourcing and gets satisfaction from turning complex hiring needs into well-run recruitment processes, we'd love to meet you.

WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You’ll report to our Head of Talent Acquisition and work closely with hiring managers and stakeholders across Pleo, including senior leaders and functional teams across various business areas.

You'll be part of a collaborative team that values high-quality delivery, strong partnership and continuous improvement. You'll work closely with the wider People team and cross-functional partners to make sure our hiring processes are efficient, consistent and deliver a great experience for candidates and hiring teams.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Talent Acquisition Partner, you will:

- Own full-cycle recruitment across a high volume of mid-to-senior roles, managing multiple requisitions simultaneously across different functions.

- Build proactive talent pipelines through sourcing, market mapping, talent research, referrals and personalised outreach - rather than relying on inbound applications alone.

- Develop and use repeatable sourcing and recruitment processes that enable us to hire efficiently and consistently at scale.

- Partner closely with hiring managers to understand requirements, agree hiring plans and keep searches moving from briefing through to offer.

- Manage a busy recruitment workload with excellent organisation, prioritisation and attention to detail, ensuring no candidate or stakeholder falls through the cracks.

- Create engaging, personalised outreach that gets the attention of passive candidates and builds interest in Pleo.

- Use recruitment data and dashboards to track pipelines, identify bottlenecks and understand where searches need more focus.

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date recruitment data and processes in tools such as Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Notion and Google Sheets.

- Use emerging AI and recruitment technology, including tools such as Claude, to improve research, sourcing, workflows and overall recruitment effectiveness.

- Support effective and consistent technical hiring processes, including the use of tools such as CoderPad for assessments where relevant.

- Champion inclusive hiring practices and ensure consistency and fairness throughout the recruitment process.

WHAT YOU BRING

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- Proven experience managing a high volume of mid-to-senior recruitment requisitions simultaneously, ideally across multiple functions.

- Strong proactive sourcing skills, with a track record of building talent pipelines from scratch and engaging passive candidates.

- A highly organised and structured approach to recruitment. You naturally keep track of multiple searches, candidates, stakeholders, interviews and next steps without losing attention to detail.

- Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with hiring managers while keeping them accountable to the recruitment process.

- Excellent communication skills and a candidate-first mindset, with the ability to create a great experience even when managing a high volume of candidates.

- A data-led approach to recruitment and confidence using metrics to monitor pipeline health, identify challenges and improve hiring outcomes.

- An interest in using AI and emerging technology to make recruitment more efficient, effective and scalable.

- Experience working in a fast-paced and scaling environment.

- Experience using tools such as Ashby and Claude (preferred).

WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You enjoy managing lots of moving parts and get satisfaction from keeping complex recruitment processes organised and on track.

- You're a proactive sourcer who enjoys finding great people who aren't actively looking and figuring out how to get them excited about Pleo.

- You like having a clear process, but you're also constantly looking for ways to make it more efficient, scalable and effective.

- You enjoy variety and want to recruit across different functions rather than specialising in one talent market.

- You thrive in a fast-paced environment where you'll have a meaningful number of roles to own and plenty of opportunity to make an impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You prefer working on a small number of highly specialised or executive searches at a time.

- You rely primarily on inbound applications and aren't energised by proactive sourcing and pipeline building.

- You find managing multiple concurrent requisitions and competing priorities challenging.

- You prefer an environment where every search is highly bespoke rather than one where repeatable, scalable processes are important.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll have the opportunity to:

- Broaden your recruitment expertise by hiring across a range of functions, seniority levels and talent markets, building a more rounded understanding of how different parts of a scaling business hire.

- Sharpen your sourcing craft by developing stronger market-mapping, research and outreach skills, and learning how to build talent pipelines in increasingly targeted and creative ways.

- Build stronger commercial and business partnering skills by working directly with hiring managers and senior stakeholders, developing your ability to understand business needs and influence hiring decisions.

- Become more data-driven in your approach by using recruitment data to assess pipeline health, diagnose challenges and make better decisions about where to focus your time and effort.

- Develop your ability to operate at scale by learning how to balance pace, quality and candidate experience across a complex portfolio of searches (a valuable skill for anyone looking to grow in Talent Acquisition).

- Develop your use of AI and technology in Talent Acquisition by experimenting with tools such as Claude and learning how to use technology thoughtfully to improve research, sourcing, candidate engagement and recruitment workflows.

- Build your understanding of modern technical hiring through exposure to different technical roles and assessment approaches, including tools such as CoderPad where relevant.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE HIRING PROCESS

- Intro Call (Bea)

- Hiring Manager Interview (Krupa or Camilla whilst Krupa is OOO)

- Pleo Challenge (Fannie or Anna Claudia, Julieta, Jenelle or Pepa - whilst Krupa is OOO OR Krupa, Fannie or Anna Claudia or Julieta, Jenelle or Pepa)

- Final (Krupa, if HM interview happens whilst Krupa is OOO)

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a role like this we received an incredible volume of applications and could only speak with so many people. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

- CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

- Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

- Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager - AppEx
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are hiring a Senior /Technical Program Manager for our Application Experience (AppEx) organization. AppEx is the engineering org that builds the surfaces developers and data engineers love — from Streamlit and Notebooks to Native Apps, Cortex Code, Snowpark drivers, and the developer platform that ties it all together. This TPM will drive high-visibility programs that span multiple AppEx teams and define how tens of thousands of developers experience Snowflake's capabilities every day.

AS A SENIOR / STAFF TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER, YOU WILL:

- Own and drive complex, cross-functional programs across AppEx engineering teams — spanning application surfaces, developer tooling, AI-powered experiences, and the underlying platform — from scoping through delivery

- Partner with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and Principal Engineers to define program roadmaps, surface dependencies, and build execution plans that hold up under real-world complexity

- Serve as the connective tissue across AppEx sub-orgs (Applications, Notebooks, Native Apps, Drivers, AIML, Developer Platform) to keep programs aligned and unblocked

- Establish and maintain clear reporting cadences — tracking milestones, risks, decisions, and engineering health — and proactively escalate when things need leadership attention

- Drive cross-org alignment on shared APIs, integration points, and developer-facing feature launches that touch multiple Snowflake product surfaces

- Identify systemic friction in how AppEx teams plan and deliver; design lightweight processes and tooling-backed workflows to improve engineering velocity and predictability

- Represent AppEx programs to senior leadership with crisp, data-backed status and recommendations

OUR IDEAL SENIOR / STAFF TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER WILL HAVE:

- 7+ years of technical program management experience at a cloud software company, with a track record of owning complex, cross-team programs end-to-end

- Deep familiarity with developer-facing products or platform engineering — you understand what it takes to build great developer experiences and the challenges that come with shipping at scale

- Demonstrated ability to work directly with engineers and architects, going deep on technical design when needed while keeping program execution on track

- Strong cross-functional leadership skills: you've driven alignment across Engineering, Product, Design, and Go-to-Market without formal authority

- Comfort operating in ambiguity — you can define structure where none exists and make progress while not all the answers are clear yet

- Excellent written and verbal communication; you're effective in front of engineers, executive stakeholders, and everyone in between

- Experience with modern cloud-native software development lifecycle, including CI/CD, release management, and API-first development

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

- Hands-on experience with Snowflake, data platforms, or developer tooling products (Streamlit, Notebooks, Native Apps, Spark, etc.)

- Prior exposure to AI/ML product development programs or agentic application delivery

- Experience driving developer ecosystem programs — SDKs, drivers, or developer relations-adjacent work

- Familiarity with program management tooling (Linear, Jira, Shortcut) and data-driven program health dashboards

- Prior experience in a high-growth, post-IPO technology company environment

WHY JOIN THE APPEX TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

AppEx is one of the most cross-cutting and high-visibility engineering organizations at Snowflake. The team owns the developer-facing surface area — the products developers open every morning to build, analyze, and deploy. From Streamlit's growth as a first-class app framework, to Notebooks as a unified analytics environment, to Native Apps enabling Snowflake's application ecosystem, to Cortex Code bringing AI-native development to the data cloud — AppEx ships the surfaces that define how the world experiences Snowflake.

As the first TPM embedded in AppEx, you'll have a greenfield opportunity to shape what great program management looks like in this org — building the foundations, tools, and operating rhythms that will scale with the team. This isn't a seat at the table; it's an invitation to build the table.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

title: STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER, Frontier Security Team
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. We seek AI-native engineers who are curious about emerging capabilities, rigorous about measured results, and motivated to redefine how software is built and operated.

Snowflake’s Frontier Security AI teams develop production-grade LLM applications, intelligent agents, AI infrastructure, and evaluation systems for enterprise customers. Our products must meet a high bar for quality, security, reliability, and efficiency while operating over sensitive data at large scale.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to lead the design and development of our Agentic Harness and agent evaluation platform. The Agentic Harness provides the runtime, tools, context, state, policies, and observability required to build and operate production AI agents. The evaluation platform measures how well those agents complete real customer tasks and detects regressions before they reach production.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will build production systems, establish architecture across team boundaries, and define the metrics and engineering practices used to improve agent quality. You will work with product, infrastructure, applied AI, security, and modeling teams to take new AI capabilities from prototype to dependable customer value.

WHAT YOU WILL DO IN THIS ROLE

• Architect and build the Agentic Harness that executes complex, multi-step AI workflows across models, tools, data, and services.

• Design stable interfaces for tool execution, context construction, state management, memory, permissions, retries, fallbacks, and human review.

• Own agent quality end to end by building evaluation harnesses, representative datasets, automated graders, experiment pipelines, and release gates.

• Convert ambiguous reports such as “the agent feels worse” into measurable failure modes, reproducible tests, and durable fixes.

• Analyze production agent trajectories to identify failures in reasoning, retrieval, tool use, context, orchestration, and application code.

• Close the loop between production incidents, root-cause analysis, evaluation coverage, and regression prevention.

• Develop offline and online measurements for task completion, correctness, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability, and cost.

• Build simulation and replay infrastructure for golden-set tests, adversarial scenarios, model comparisons, and large-scale experiments.

• Improve agent efficiency through model routing, prompt and semantic caching, context compaction, tool-result management, and token optimization.

• Productionize new model capabilities as secure, observable, multi-tenant services with clear operational controls.

• Establish standards for evaluation design, including sampling, ground-truth quality, grader calibration, leakage prevention, and statistical significance.

• Define technical direction across multiple teams and lead projects whose scope extends beyond a single service.

• Mentor engineers, raise the quality of architecture reviews, and remain directly involved in implementation and debugging.

REQUIREMENTS

• 9+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex production systems.

• Direct experience shipping and operating LLM applications, AI agents, or model-backed workflows in production.

• Strong background in distributed systems, service architecture, high-throughput APIs, concurrency, and failure handling.

• Experience building an agent runtime, workflow engine, developer platform, evaluation system, or similar infrastructure.

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate nondeterministic systems without relying on a single aggregate score.

• Fluency in Python and strong proficiency in at least one systems or application language such as Java, Go, Rust, or TypeScript.

• Hands-on knowledge of tool calling, structured generation, retrieval, context engineering, prompt management, and model APIs.

• Experience with production observability, including structured traces, replay, metrics, logs, and incident diagnosis.

• Ability to balance agent quality with latency, reliability, security, and inference cost.

• Track record of setting technical direction and delivering results across organizational boundaries.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Clear written and verbal communication with engineering, product, and leadership audiences.

BONUS EXPERIENCE

• Building evaluation or observability infrastructure for agentic coding, data engineering, or analytics systems.

• Designing human-evaluation programs, scoring rubrics, annotation workflows, or grader-calibration methods.

• Working with multi-agent orchestration, long-running agents, asynchronous workflows, or durable execution.

• Developing synthetic tasks, simulations, adversarial tests, red-team exercises, or safety guardrails.

• Building retrieval systems that use vector search, hybrid search, semantic indexing, ranking, or caching.

• Operating multi-tenant systems that process sensitive enterprise data.

• Working with model training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, or feedback-driven optimization.

• Evaluating and onboarding frontier models based on measured product outcomes.

• Experience with databases, SQL engines, data platforms, Kubernetes, or cloud-native infrastructure.

YOU MAY BE A PARTICULARLY GOOD FIT IF YOU

• Treat evaluation as part of product engineering rather than a final validation step.

Beforest has a carefully developed brand identity and comprehensive brand guidelines. You should be comfortable interpreting them and applying them thoughtfully across different formats and touchpoints, while developing work that feels fresh and recognisably Beforest.

*What* ** *you’ll* ** *do*

You’ll work closely with the Lead Brand Designer, Creative Director and Content Lead across the day-to-day design needs of Beforest and its brands.

The work will span brand communication, ad campaigns, presentations, social media, digital, print design, experiences and other brand touchpoints.

You will be expected to:

* Take ownership of briefs from initial understanding through to final delivery.

* Develop design solutions across different formats, audiences and platforms.

* Apply and extend the Beforest brand system consistently across all communication.

* Create cohesive brand experiences across physical and digital touchpoints.

* Manage and assist on multiple projects, establish timelines and deliver reliably.

* Coordinate directly with marketing, communications, business intelligence and other internal teams.

* Present work clearly, incorporate feedback and take projects through successive rounds of refinement.

* Prepare accurate, production-ready work and maintain an organised design workflow.

*What* ** *we’re* ** *looking* ** *for*

*2–3 years of professional design experience.*

You should have:

* A strong portfolio that demonstrates ideas, visual judgement and a high level of craft.

* Excellent foundations in typography, composition, hierarchy, colour and visual systems.

* A razor-sharp eye, sensitive to colour, form, type and detail.

* The ability to crack a brief, wrestle with complexity and make it stunningly simple.

* The ability to handle a layout with confidence and know when to push and when to leave space.

* Excellent working knowledge of *Adobe Creative Suite, Figma and Canva*.

* Fluency with contemporary *AI tools* for research, exploration and execution.

* The ability to work independently, while being open to feedback, critique and constantly evolving.

*A* ** *little* ** *about* ** *Beforest*

Beforest creates large, professionally managed collectives where people can own land and a home while sharing a much larger living landscape.

Instead of developing land plot by plot, we plan the whole landscape together: where homes go, how water moves, what gets farmed and what stays forest. The idea is simple: create places that become ecologically and economically richer over time.

Our work extends beyond the collectives into forest-friendly produce, hospitality and regenerative construction. So as a designer, your canvas can move from a coffee pack to a website, a film, a sign in a forest, a supper club or the experience of an entire place.

The role offers a wide range of work to begin with, and room to grow as we grow.

*
*
*
*

*P.S. Beforest walks are part of the perks.*

*​* To apply please send us your *portfolio and CV*.

Your portfolio matters considerably more than a long cover letter. We want to see how you think, what you notice and the quality of work you choose to put your name on.

title: Junior Interior Design & Procurement Assistant
description:
About the Role

Our client is seeking a highly organized, visually talented Design Intern or Junior Interior Design & Procurement Assistant to support our *hospitality, commercial, and residential interior design projects*.

This person will work closely with our design team across both the creative and administrative sides of a project. We are looking for someone who is technically capable, exceptionally organized, comfortable working independently, and has a strong eye for elevated, thoughtful interior design.

*3D rendering experience and an efficient, easy-to-use rendering workflow are essential.* The ideal candidate can take architectural drawings, inspiration, specifications, and design direction and efficiently translate them into compelling 3D visuals without requiring extensive oversight.

The position will also provide critical support with FF&E sourcing, specifications, procurement tracking, vendor management, and project documentation.

Key Responsibilities

3D Rendering & Design Support
-----------------------------

· Create high-quality interior 3D renderings efficiently and accurately.

· Translate design direction, floor plans, elevations, inspiration imagery, and specifications into visual presentations.

· Produce renderings appropriate for residential, hospitality, and commercial environments.

· Make revisions to renderings quickly as designs evolve.

· Read and understand architectural and CAD drawings.

· Assist with space planning and design documentation.

· Sketchup and/or Revit drafting experience is highly desirable.

FF&E Research & Specifications
------------------------------

· Research furniture, fixtures, equipment, lighting, plumbing, hardware, materials, accessories, artwork, and other FF&E based on direction from the lead designer.

· Identify products that meet project aesthetic, dimensions, performance requirements, budget, lead time, and intended use.

· Understand that specifications may differ substantially between residential, hospitality, and commercial applications.

· Research alternate products when selections are unavailable, outside budget, or do not meet project requirements.

· Maintain accurate product information, including dimensions, finishes, pricing, lead times, vendor information, links, and relevant technical specifications.

Specification Books
-------------------

· Create and maintain comprehensive project specification books.

· Ensure each selection contains all relevant information needed for purchasing, installation, construction coordination, and client approval.

· Maintain accurate and current product details as selections change.

· Organize specifications so information can be easily accessed by designers, architects, contractors, installers, purchasing teams, and other project partners.

· Maintain consistency and accuracy across drawings, specifications, schedules, and procurement documentation.

Procurement Tracking
--------------------

· Maintain detailed procurement trackers from specification through final delivery and installation.

· Track quotes, approvals, purchase orders, deposits/payments, production status, estimated ship dates, shipping, receiving, damages, backorders, replacements, and installation status.

· Follow up proactively on outstanding quotes, orders, samples, and lead times.

· Flag delays, discrepancies, or missing information before they become project problems.

· Maintain exceptionally accurate project records.

Vendor & Trade Account Management
---------------------------------

· Research and establish new vendor, manufacturer, and trade accounts.

· Complete account applications and organize required documentation.

· Maintain vendor contacts, account information, discount structures, ordering requirements, minimums, and trade program information.

· Communicate professionally with vendor representatives regarding pricing, availability, samples, specifications, lead times, and order information.

Required Skills

· Strong 3D interior rendering skills and demonstrated rendering portfolio.

* Licensed Interior Designer

· Ability to produce renderings efficiently and make revisions without a cumbersome workflow.

· Ability to read and interpret architectural and CAD drawings.

· Strong understanding of interior design, scale, proportion, materials, finishes, and spatial relationships.

· Excellent internet and product research abilities.

· Exceptional attention to detail.

· Strong organizational and documentation skills.

· Comfortable working with spreadsheets, project trackers, shared drives, and cloud-based systems.

· Strong written English and professional vendor communication.

· Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines independently.

· Comfortable receiving design direction and translating it into completed work without requiring constant supervision.

Preferred Skills

· Revit experience.

· SketchUp and/or other professional interior rendering software.

· Previous experience with an interior design or architecture firm.

· FF&E specification and procurement experience.

· Hospitality and/or commercial design experience is particularly valuable.

· Familiarity with the U.S. interior design, furnishings, fixtures, and materials markets.

· Experience working with U.S.-based vendors, manufacturers, and trade accounts.

Ideal Candidate

The right person is both *creative and highly organized*.

We are looking for someone who understands that excellent interior design depends not only on beautiful ideas, but also on accurate documentation and excellent execution.

You should be comfortable moving between a creative assignment such as producing a beautiful rendering and a highly detailed assignment such as verifying dimensions, updating a specification book, researching an alternate fixture, organizing vendor information, or tracking an order.

Because our client works across hospitality, commercial, and residential environments, we value someone who is curious and adaptable rather than limited to a single project type.

You are proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented, and comfortable asking thoughtful questions when necessary—but your natural instinct is to research, problem-solve, and move the work forward.

*Requirements*

This is a full time job

Up to $8/hr

100% Remote

title: Staff Test Engineer
description:
Overview
--------

Join an amazing team that is consistently recognized for our achievements and culture, including our most recent Forbes award of being one of America's Best Midsize Employers for 2026!

In this role, you’ll serve as a quality leader in Mercury’s Personal Lines domain. You’ll build and scale automation frameworks and test coverage across UI and API layers using Java and Selenium, while mentoring junior QA teammates and helping elevate a team that supports a fast-moving environment. This is a strong fit for someone with deep white-box and automation testing experience who is excited to bring modern, AI-enabled approaches to scripting and test design.

Position Summary:
-----------------

As a Staff Test Engineer, you will take ownership of the TE strategy for larger and more complex software projects, working closely with development, product, and engineering teams. You will design and implement robust test plans, develop and maintain automated test scripts, and drive continuous improvement in testing processes and maximizing testing efficiency through automation. Your deep technical expertise will help optimize test frameworks, mentoring senior engineers while ensuring high levels of test coverage and quality assurance across products. You will play a critical role in ensuring product quality and stability through proactive risk management and process improvements.

Geo-Salary Information
----------------------

*An in-person interview may be required during the hiring process*

State specific pay scales for this role are as follows:

$94,458 to $179,048 (CA, NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA)

$85,871 to $162,771 (NV, OR, AZ, CO, WY, TX, ND, MN, MO, IL, WI, FL, GA, MI, OH, VA, PA, DE, VT, NH, ME)

$77,3283 to $146,494 (UT, ID, MT, NM, SD, NE, KS, OK, IA, AR, LA, MS, AL, TN, KY, IN, SC, NC, WV)

In CA: Typical hiring range is $123,078 to $170,941

The expected base salary for this position will vary depending on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills and location.

Responsibilities
----------------

Essential Job Functions:
------------------------

* Develop Test Plans and Strategies: With the goal of minimizing production defects, lead the creation and execution of high-level test strategies for complex projects. Ensure that all test plans align with business objectives and deliver comprehensive test coverage. Drive the adoption of an automation-first approach for large sized feature and integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Design and Execute Test Cases: Take ownership of designing and executing high-complexity cross-functional test cases that cover a range of testing types. Develop and manage comprehensive testing strategies across large-scale projects, ensuring alignment with overall development and business goals.
* Perform Manual and Automated Testing: With the goal of minimizing production defects, lead both manual and automated testing efforts in a medium sized functional area, focusing on improving automation coverage. Take ownership of automation strategy and ensure automation components are scalable and maintainable.
* Documentations for Process and Bug Report: Identify complex defects and provide detailed analysis in bug report. Enforce defect tracking, progress updates, timely resolution and effective communication across teams. Implement defect management best practices and ensure overall quality. Lead quality initiatives to ensure defects are minimized in future releases. Establish and lead best practices for maintaining test documentation across upstream and downstream functional areas.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration and Communication: Collaborate cross-functionally with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to ensure complex requirement's clarity including upstream and downstream functional areas, accountable for all features meeting quality standards and ensure software meets requirements across the product.
* Continuous Improvement: Implement and Drive Continuous Improvement Practices. Lead small process improvement initiatives across medium sized features . Champion best practices for leveraging test automation, continuous integration, and continuous delivery. Use quantitative metrics to demonstrate the impact of improvements on software quality and testing efficiency.
* Continuous Learning: Establish yourself as an expert in emerging testing technologies and methodologies. Evaluate, propose, and integrate industry-leading tools and practices into the team’s workflow. Influence the strategic direction of the testing function within the organization.
* Mentor TE Team Members on Product knowledge: Provide mentorship and leadership to less experienced engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions, help team members troubleshoot complex issues, and guide product knowledge development for junior engineers.
* Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving Skills: Proactively identify and address obstacles or bottlenecks across multiple projects or teams. Take ownership of complex issues and guide the team in overcoming challenges, ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality software focus on task level, but not limited to project level.
* Test Strategy Review: Develop and review comprehensive test strategies, ensuring alignment with business and technical goals. Take responsibility for the overall direction of test strategies across projects, aligning with organizational objectives.
* Test Case Review: Review and approve test cases for multiple teams, ensuring thoroughness and accuracy. Provide feedback on test case design and coverage, driving improvements across the organization.
* Monitor and Analyze Testing Metrics: Continuously track, analyze, and interpret testing metrics to assess effectiveness and quality. Make data-driven recommendations to enhance testing processes, test coverage, and defect management.
* Drive and Develop Test Engineering Strategies and Policies: Drive and define the strategic direction for test engineering across the project. Develop policies, standards, and best practices to ensure testing quality, consistency, and alignment with business goals.
* Test Automation Effectiveness and Coverage: Collaborate with SET team to define and implement automation priorities for large, complex projects or across multiple teams. Ensure the team is leveraging automation to maximize testing efficiency. Improving automation coverage.

Qualifications
--------------

Education:
----------

Minimum:
--------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems or other related fields Or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Experience:
-----------

Minimum:
--------

* 8+ yrs industry experience, hands-on experience leading testing teams on medium-sized projects
* 3+ yrs of experience writing complex automation tests

Preferred:
----------

* 7 or more years of white box testing experience
* 5 or more years of experience in automation testing
* 3 or more years of experience with Java or Python
* 3 or more years of experience testing UI and APIs
* Exposure to Insurance Industry
* Exposure to leveraging AI in testing

Knowledge and Skills:
---------------------

Minimum:
--------

* Experienced with the following:

* Time Management: Ability to lead the management of multiple, large testing projects across different teams or business units. Ensures high-level coordination and timely delivery while maintaining quality standards.
* Collaboration and Communication: Ability to lead discussion for task-specific collaboration, conveying precise technical details, responding to immediate issues, and ensuring clarity in resolving task and project-level challenges.

* Proficient with the following:

* Testing Methodologies: Able to define and drive best practices across the team, ensuring that test methodologies are scalable and efficient.
* Attention to Detail: Has exceptional ability to detect and resolve subtle, complex defects that could significantly impact user experience, application performance, or business objectives.
* Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving Skills: Able to demonstrate expertise at solving highly complex issues and system-level problems. Leads troubleshooting efforts across multiple teams and defines strategies for long-term solutions that address root causes.
* Requirements Analysis: Ability to analyze complex product requirements and works independently to define the testing approach. Partners with stakeholders to ensure all aspects of the requirements are covered by testing, addressing ambiguities and gaps.
* Defect Tracking Management and Documentation tools: Expert in managing defects and ensuring efficient resolution. Skilled at identifying trends and driving improvements.
* Automation Scripting: Ability to write and maintain more complex automated test scripts using tools like Selenium, TestNG, or similar.
* API Testing: Advanced skills in API testing and validating complex API functionalities using tools like Postman, SoapUI, and custom scripts.
* Adaptability and Flexibility: Proficient leading adaptation to changing requirements, code designs and implementation changes, new technologies, methods to solve problems, shift priorities, workstyle and responsibilities.
* Product Knowledge: Leads domain-specific strategy development, ensuring testing efforts are aligned with industry standards, customer needs, and business objectives. Acts as a subject matter expert for testing in specific domains.

About the Company

Why choose a career at Mercury?
-------------------------------

At Mercury, we have been guided by our purpose to help people reduce risk and overcome unexpected events for more than 60 years. We are one team with a common goal to help others. Everyone needs insurance and we can’t imagine a world without it.

Our team will encourage you to grow, make time to have fun, and work together to make great things happen. We embrace the strengths and values of each team member. We believe in having diverse perspectives where everyone is included, to serve customers from all walks of life.

We care about our people, and we mean it. We reward our talented professionals with a competitive salary, bonus potential, and a variety of benefits to help our team members reach their health, retirement, and professional goals.
