title: Junior Automation Engineer
description:
Centurion Systems is proud to be part of the global *F* *AAC Technologies Group.
*
At FAAC Technologies, working in *Research & Development* means designing what’s next.

You’ll dive into a wide range of products. You’ll be at the crossroads of technology and creativity, in an environment that values continuous learning, knowledge-sharing, and cross-functional collaboration.

Every idea counts. Every challenge is a chance to grow in your discipline and beyond
*
The Opportunity*

A Junior Automation Engineer supports the development of AI and automation solutions that improve how the company’s departments operate. Working under the guidance of experienced engineers, the role assists with identifying automation opportunities, building and deploying solutions, and maintaining the company’s internal AI platform.

The position offers hands-on exposure to software engineering, AI technology and business processes across the organisation.

*Main Responsibilities*

* Work alongside assigned business departments, including Sales, Human Resources, Finance, Technical Support, Production and Marketing, to observe, document and map existing processes under the guidance of a senior engineer.
* Assist in identifying, scoping and prioritising opportunities where AI and automation can reduce manual effort, cycle time or error rates within departmental processes.
* Build, test and deploy well-defined automation agents and workflows on the company’s internal AI platform, following the agreed agent manifest, data classification and approval standards.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of an internal AI platform, including the model gateway, agent runtimes, retrieval services, tool integrations and user access surfaces.
* Implement and maintain integrations between the AI platform and business systems such as ERP, CRM, ticketing and knowledge sources, using the shared integration and action layers rather than direct system access.
* Assist with the day-to-day operation of the platform by monitoring usage, cost and performance, resolving routine issues and escalating incidents in line with defined procedures.
* Prepare and maintain evaluation and regression test sets for deployed automations, and run them before changes are released.
* Apply the company’s data classification, access control, privacy and audit requirements to every automation built, ensuring restricted information remains within approved boundaries.
* Document business processes as they are found, solutions as they are built, and the reasoning behind design decisions, so that knowledge is retained and transferable.
* Provide first-line support and hands-on guidance to departmental users of deployed automations, gathering feedback and feeding it back into improvements.
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions and knowledge-sharing sessions, actively seeking and acting on feedback from senior engineers.
* Maintain awareness of developments in AI models, tooling and automation practice, and share relevant findings with the team.
* Communicate progress, risks and blockers clearly and proactively to the responsible manager and to departmental stakeholders.

*
Key Competencies: Behavioural Attributes*

Self-motivated

Takes ownership of assigned work, maintains high standards and progresses tasks independently between review points.

Learning mindset

Demonstrates a willingness to learn and stay informed about developments in AI, automation and software engineering.

Business curiosity

Shows genuine interest in understanding how different departments and business processes operate.

Adaptability

Adjusts effectively to changing requirements, technologies and departmental environments.

Problem-solving

Applies logical and analytical thinking to understand problems, identify causes and propose practical solutions.

Attention to detail

Produces accurate, high-quality work and follows required quality, testing and security standards.

Team player

Collaborates effectively with engineering colleagues and stakeholders across the business.

Time management

Prioritises tasks, manages deadlines and seeks support when needed to maintain progress.

Communication skills

Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues and asks questions to ensure understanding.

Initiative

Identifies opportunities to improve processes, systems and ways of working.

Professionalism

Demonstrates accountability, reliability and discretion when handling sensitive information.

Positive attitude

Maintains a constructive, solution-focused approach and responds positively to challenges.

Cross-functional willingness

Is comfortable working across company departments and learning processes outside of engineering.

*
*

*Key Competencies: Functional Skills* *
*

Programming fundamentals

Competent in Python and at least one additional typed programming language, such as Java, TypeScript or C#, with the ability to write clear and maintainable code.

AI application development

Understands large language models, prompting, retrieval-augmented generation and agent workflows, and can apply these concepts to practical problems.

Systems integration

Able to work with APIs, databases and integration layers to connect platforms and business systems.

Process analysis

Able to observe and document business processes and identify suitable automation opportunities.

Platform operations

Working knowledge of version control, containers, CI pipelines and monitoring tools.

Platform toolchain

Exposure to tools such as LiteLLM, Qdrant, pgvector, Langfuse, Docker, vLLM or demonstrable equivalents.

Data handling and security

Understands and applies data classification, access control and privacy requirements.

Testing and evaluation

Able to develop and run tests that confirm automation solutions continue to behave as expected.

Documentation

Produces clear and accurate documentation of processes, designs and operating procedures.

Troubleshooting

Uses a structured approach to diagnosing issues and escalates matters appropriately when needed.

*
Required Qualifications and Experience*

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Electronic Engineering or a related field.
* Zero to two years’ experience in software development, automation, data engineering or a related discipline. Relevant academic, internship or project experience will be considered.
* Practical exposure to Python and at least one AI or large language model framework or API.
* Working knowledge of version control, relational databases and web APIs.
* Understanding of software development methodologies, including Agile and Scrum.
* Exposure to Linux, containerisation, cloud or on-premises infrastructure will be advantageous.
* Relevant AI, cloud or software development certifications will be advantageous

* *ASR:* дообучать и оценивать модели распознавания русской речи на телефонном аудио (8 кГц, шумы, перебивания). Считать WER/CER и разбирать ошибки.
* *TTS:* улучшать естественность и скорость синтеза, работать с голосами, ударениями и нормализацией текста (числа, адреса, телефоны).
* *AMD (Answering Machine Detection):* отличать живого человека от автоответчика, голосовой почты и IVR за первые секунды звонка.
* *VAD и turn-taking:* определять конец реплики и перебивания, чтобы агент не молчал и не говорил поверх собеседника.
* Собирать и размечать датасеты из реальных звонков, строить пайплайны предобработки аудио.
* Оптимизировать инференс (latency, стриминг, ONNX/TensorRT, квантизация) вместе с backend-командой.
* Ставить эксперименты, сравнивать open-source модели и честно докладывать результаты.

-----------
Что мы ждём
-----------

* Уверенный Python и опыт с PyTorch.
* Понимание основ ML/DL: функции потерь, переобучение, метрики, валидация.
* Базовые знания цифровой обработки звука: частота дискретизации, спектрограммы, mel, MFCC.
* Опыт хотя бы с одной речевой моделью или фреймворком: Whisper, GigaAM, NeMo, ESPnet, wav2vec2, Vosk, VITS, XTTS, Silero или похожие. Подойдут и пет-проекты, курсовые, Kaggle.
* Умение работать с Linux, git и GPU-окружением.

------------
Будет плюсом
------------

* Опыт стримингового ASR или TTS с низкой задержкой.
* Знакомство с телефонией: SIP, кодеки G.711/Opus, особенности 8 кГц аудио.
* Опыт классификации аудио: AMD, VAD, speaker/emotion recognition.
* Опыт с ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, Triton, vLLM.
* Понимание LLM-агентов и того, как ASR → LLM → TTS складывается в диалоговую систему.
* Публичные проекты на GitHub, статьи, хорошие места в соревнованиях.

-----------------
Что мы предлагаем
-----------------

* Реальные задачи в продакшене: ваши модели будут работать в тысячах живых звонков, а эффект будет виден в метриках.
* Доступ к GPU и реальным данным для обучения.
* Небольшая команда без лишней бюрократии: идеи быстро доходят до продакшена.

description:
We are a tech startup creating and producing digital AI models for Tier-1 markets (USA, Europe). We have cutting-edge generative pipelines and a well-established infrastructure at our disposal. We are currently in an active scaling phase and are opening a position in our R&D Traffic Department.
We are looking for a smart enthusiast with a deep interest in AI models and their monetization. Your mission is to take full ownership of one specific traffic source (e.g., Twitter), study its algorithms inside and out, and build a systematic pipeline for attracting targeted traffic.

Why this role is for you: You won't be joining a ready-made system — you'll be building it with us. Our CEO will provide you with resources, test budgets, private training sessions, and consultations with niche market experts. What we expect from you is analytics, hands-on work, and the drive to take over an entire direction.

What you'll be doing:
Research & R&D: Take specialized courses (which we pay for), read closed forums, and translate theory into practice.
Manual work at the start: Manage a network of accounts via anti-detect browsers, warm up profiles, post daily, and interact with the audience (imitating a real human).
Technical setup: Work with proxies, bypass social media rate limits, and prevent shadow bans.
Analytics: Collect conversion data, find working “bundles” and content formats that generate the best response.
Scaling: Once the manual approach proves profitable, help transfer the algorithm to automation (scripts/AI agents).

Who we're looking for:
Passionate about the AI niche: You understand the virtual creator market, follow trends, and want to earn from it.
Tech-savvy: You know (or can quickly learn) what an anti-detect browser, mobile proxy, User-Agent, and cookies are.
English: Solid B2+ (reading Western forums, communicating in English with the audience on behalf of the model).
Self-sufficient: You don't wait for every step to be spoon-fed. Account banned? ➡️ Go find the reason ➡️ Propose a new solution ➡️ Implement it.

Big pluses (not required):
Proven experience in traffic generation (arbitrage) in grey/dating niches from sources like Reddit, Twitter, Tinder, Badoo, Bumble, Snapchat.
Experience with Instagram, Threads, TikTok, and YouTube algorithms is an additional advantage.

Conditions:
Format: Fully remote, full-time.
Compensation: Base salary $400–$600/month (during the initial training and manual testing period) + later a % of profit (RevShare) or bonuses for hitting KPI targets on qualified leads.
Career growth: Once you find a profitable approach and scale it stably, you can grow directly into a Team Lead role, building your own team for that traffic source.

If you're ready to dig into algorithms, endure bans in search of that winning formula, and become a top specialist in AI traffic — apply.

In your cover letter, briefly describe your traffic experience (if any) and why the AI model niche attracts you.

title: UI/UX Product Designer
description:
We're hiring a mid-senior UI/UX Product Designer on a remote monthly retainer to own product design for client apps at Bolder Apps. You'll work directly with US-based founders and product owners, then hand clean, buildable specs to engineering teams that ship with AI-augmented workflows. We want someone who has run design end to end in an agency or product studio, not someone who only produces mood boards. If you can hold a client call, make hard product trade-offs, and leave Figma files engineers actually build from, we want to talk.

*About Us*

Bolder Apps is a product development studio that partners with US-based startups and established companies to build and scale innovative digital products. We specialize in AI-powered development, full-cycle product creation, and engineering team augmentation. Our mission is simple: build bolder, faster, and smarter.

*Our Culture & Values (read before applying)*

We move fast. We take ownership. We work with AI, not against it. And we expect everyone to bring ideas, not wait for instructions.

There are no daily checklists, no micromanagement, and no corporate politics. Instead, you'll have autonomy, trust, and a team that's always ready to help you grow. At Bolder Apps, impact matters more than titles, and curiosity matters more than seniority.

If you want a place where you can level up fast and actually see your work making a difference - welcome aboard.

*Responsibilities*

* Own product UI/UX for client mobile and web apps from discovery through handoff, across more than one engagement when the pipeline needs it
* Run client-facing design reviews, workshops, and async critique during US business hours, including the small talk that keeps trust intact
* Turn messy briefs into flows, wireframes, high-fidelity screens, and interactive prototypes that answer the product question, not just look finished
* Build and maintain design systems and component libraries so the next feature does not reinvent buttons, spacing, or states
* Partner with PMs and engineers on scope cuts, edge cases, empty states, loading, errors, accessibility, and platform conventions (HIG and Material)
* Produce Figma files engineers can build from: named layers, variants, auto-layout, redlines or tokens, and export-ready assets
* Use AI design and research tools to move faster, then review the output yourself before it reaches a client or a sprint
* Flag design risk early when the brief is unclear, the timeline is fake, or the product ask conflicts with platform or technical constraints

*Requirements*

* Shipped product design. 4+ years designing production mobile and/or web products that went live. Portfolio shows full case studies with problem, constraints, your decisions, and the shipped result, not isolated pretty screens.
* Client-facing craft. You have sat on calls with founders or product owners, defended choices without getting defensive, and kept the relationship warm while saying no to bad ideas. Agency or consultancy experience preferred.
* Figma fluency. Components, variants, auto-layout, variables or tokens, prototyping, shared libraries, and clean file structure. Engineers should not need a meeting to decode your file.
* Systems thinking. You design for reuse. Patterns, states, and edge cases are part of the job, not an afterthought before handoff.
* Mobile and web literacy. You know what changes between iOS, Android, and responsive web, and you catch when a web pattern will fail on a phone.
* AI-augmented workflow. You use tools like Figma AI, Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, or similar to accelerate exploration and copy, and you catch when the output is almost right but wrong.
* English at C1 or above. Client calls and written feedback go out in your voice, not through a translator layer.
* US hours overlap. Available through roughly 5 PM EST for live client coordination. Async work is welcome; ghosting the client's day is not.
* Ownership habits. You estimate honestly, surface blockers early, and finish what you commit to. You do not disappear and resurface with surprises.

*Benefits*

* Fully remote and async-friendly, with required overlap through ~5 PM EST for client sessions
* Monthly retainer structure with recurring client product work for designers who deliver clean files and calm client calls
* Real autonomy over how you run discovery, critique, and Figma process. We do not hand you a rigid design playbook
* Direct line to PMs, engineers, and decision-makers. No theater layers between you and the people who own the outcome
* Tooling budget for Figma seats, prototyping, and AI tools you need to move fast
* A peer network of product-minded designers and builders working across overlapping client projects

* Experience designing and maintaining websites or landing pages within HubSpot CMS, including familiarity with HubSpot themes or frameworks such as Sprocket Rocket
* Strong interest in accessibility, design systems, emerging design technologies, and continuous improvement

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.*

title: UX/UI Designer, Reach
description:
As the UX/UI Designer, Reach, you will lead the end-to-end design of Riverside's Reach platform and the next generation of our portfolio assessments, including CogAT and the Iowa Assessments, building the user experience from the ground up alongside Engineering, Product, and Psychometrics partners. You'll define how students, educators, and administrators interact with a platform that doesn't exist yet, then continue to own and evolve that experience once Reach is live.

This is a 0-to-1 build. There is no existing product to iterate on, so you'll establish the UX framework, interaction patterns, and design system from scratch rather than improving what's already there. You'll report to the Product Director, and partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Psychometrics, and Content teams to bring the platform to market, then to support and expand post-launch.

Role Summary and Responsibilities
---------------------------------

UX Strategy, Research & Interaction Design

* Own end-to-end UX strategy for Reach, defining personas, journey maps, and information architecture from a blank slate, with no legacy patterns to inherit or design around

* Lead user research and discovery (interviews, usability testing, workflow analysis) with students, educators, and administrators and internal stakeholders, to validate assumptions before design work begins

* Translate research findings into user flows, task flows, and interaction models that hold up across student, educator, and administrator experiences

* Build wireframes and interactive prototypes to test concepts with users and stakeholders before committing to high-fidelity design

* Define the information architecture and navigation model for a multi-role assessment platform, so each user type can find what they need without friction

* Turn assessment data into clear, actionable displays (score reports, dashboards, configuration screens) that educators can use to make decisions in seconds, not minutes or hours.

* Design the onboarding and in-product guidance experience for educators and administrators

* Establish and track UX success metrics (task success, usability scores). Use metrics to help inform product roadmap for new features and improved useability.

Visual & UI Design

* Build and maintain a scalable design system and component library from day one, so design and engineering share a single source of truth as the platform grows

* Own high-fidelity visual design for every screen (typography, spacing, color, real content) once flows are validated

* Design accessible, responsive UI compliant with WCAG standards, built in from the start rather than retrofitted later

* Design print and PDF layouts for generated reports and assessment materials

* Partner with Engineering on design specs and developer handoff, and conduct design QA to ensure shipped work matches intent

Ongoing Ownership

* Continue to support, iterate, and expand the Reach design system and UX as new assessments and features are added post-launch

*Requirements*

Must-Have Qualifications
------------------------

* 4-7 years of experience in product, UX, or UI design, with meaningful depth in both user experience and visual/interaction design

* Proven experience as a founding or lead designer on a 0-to-1 or greenfield build, defining UX frameworks, interaction patterns, and design systems from scratch, not just refining an existing product

* Strong foundation in UX research methods (interviews, usability testing, surveys), with the ability to translate findings into personas, journey maps, and actionable specs

* Experience building and maintaining a design system or component library from the ground up

* Proficiency in Figma (or comparable) for flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes, from low to high fidelity

* Experience designing for multi-role, multi-stakeholder platforms and complex, data-heavy interfaces (dashboards, score reports)

* Working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and responsive design principles

* Comfortable operating with a high degree of ambiguity and limited existing structure

Preferred Qualifications
------------------------

* Experience in K-12 education, assessment, or clinical/behavioral health products

* Familiarity with AI-assisted design or product workflows

* HTML/CSS or React/Next.js familiarity, for closer engineering collaboration

* Experience mentoring designers or setting design standards adopted across multiple product teams

Physical Requirements
---------------------

* Remote

* Occasional travel for off-site team meetings or conferences

* May require stationary positions, sitting or standing, for extended periods

Disclaimer
----------

The above statements describe the general nature and level of the work performed by people assigned to this role. This list does not cover all possible duties, tasks, or responsibilities. Riverside Insights may amend or change responsibilities to meet the needs of the business as necessary.

*Benefits*

Why Join Our Team?
------------------

At Riverside Insights, achieving real results for students and educators is more than talk, it is what we do. As we grow, so will you, offering the chance to expand your skills on an ambitious, solution-focused team. Join us in making great work possible, where your well-being and dedication to making an impact go hand in hand. If you are ready for an ambitious, collaborative environment, Riverside is the place for you.

title: 2107 UX/UI Designer - Identity & Authentication
description:
*Position: UX/UI Designer - Identity & Authentication*

*Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)*

*Contract Type: Full-time, Permanent*

*Time Zone Alignment: Central Time (CT) / Eastern Time (EST)*

🧭 About Inallmedia.com

Inallmedia.com is a global technology and design firm focused on building impactful digital solutions through remote, distributed teams across LATAM. We partner with international clients across industries, providing long-term technical expertise, product innovation, and team augmentation.

🚀 Project Overview

You will join a specialized Identity & Authentication design team focused on end-to-end user account management and security experiences across multi-sided consumer and enterprise platforms. In this role, you will audit existing account entry points, consolidate security settings, and design seamless sign-up/sign-in experiences using an established enterprise design system. You will partner closely with senior designers and engineering teams to transform complex authentication routing logic into intuitive, accessible, and frictionless user flows.

🔍 Key Responsibilities

* *End-to-End Product Design Delivery:* Own the complete product design cycle (problem framing, user flows, wireframes, rapid MVP explorations, interactive prototypes, and production-ready designs) for account management and security features across web and mobile web platforms.
* *Cross-Flow Systems & Audit Mapping:* Conduct current-state audits and map user flows across entry points, routing logic, sign-up/sign-in flows, and account settings to identify and fix UX inconsistencies.
* *Complex Multi-Path & Edge Case Design:* Design complex, branching user flows tailored to varied account conditions, ensuring comprehensive coverage of error, recovery, empty, loading, and edge states.
* *Engineering Specs & Handoff:* Produce detailed, production-ready engineering handoff documentation (design redlines, state specifications, interaction guidelines) and participate in technical scoping and refinement directly with engineers.
* *Design System Stewardship:* Utilize, apply, and responsibly extend enterprise-scale design systems (Figma) to maintain design consistency across all digital surfaces.
* *UX Quality Assurance & Testing:* Conduct lightweight usability validation, draft interface copy in alignment with content standards, and perform design QA throughout implementation and launch.

💡 Must-Have Skills

* *Portfolio Requirement:* Mandatory portfolio submission demonstrating shipped, engineering-implemented product software, complex multi-path flows, and strong visual/interaction craft.
* *Experience & Seniority:* 3–5 years of dedicated UX/UI product design experience shipping production software in close partnership with Product Managers and Software Engineers.
* *Design Tooling & Systems:* Mastery of Figma, interactive prototyping skills, and extensive experience working within an established enterprise-scale design system.
* *Technical Literacy:* Ability to reason about complex technical flows directly with engineers—specifically authentication mechanics, session states, routing logic, and system dependencies.
* *UX Craft & Edge-Case Handling:* Proven strength in systems thinking, handling error/recovery states, accessible UI design, and producing comprehensive engineering handoff specs.
* *Collaboration Tooling:* Familiarity with standard team collaboration tools, such as Jira, Confluence, or Slack.

* *Identity & Security Domain:* Specialized experience designing authentication, identity verification, account security, sign-in/sign-up, or trust-related user flows.
* *Data-Informed Design & Research:* Experience using product metrics, experimentation (A/B testing), and lightweight usability testing to iterate on designs.
* *Accessibility & Global Standards:* Experience designing for international audiences or regulated industry compliance standards.
* *AI-Assisted Design Workflows:* Experience utilizing AI tools to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, user research synthesis, or spec documentation.
* *Contractor Adaptability:* Track record of ramping up quickly into complex product domains and operating autonomously on defined initiatives.

🌐 Time Zone & Collaboration The role requires collaboration with teams aligned to Central Time (CT) and Eastern Time (EST). Flexibility to overlap with North America business hours is required in this remote-first setup.

💬 Language All interviews, documentation, and daily communication will be in English.

#LI

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:

Our platform combines AI-powered tools and practical career solutions to help job seekers create stronger applications, improve their professional profiles, and navigate their job search with greater confidence.

We are growing our product team and are looking for a thoughtful and user-focused *Product Designer (UX/UI)* to help us create simple, intuitive, and engaging experiences across the CareerSwift platform.

--------------

As a *Product Designer (UX/UI)* , you will work across the product design process, from understanding user needs and mapping user flows to creating wireframes, prototypes, and polished interfaces.

Design intuitive user experiences and interfaces across the CareerSwift platform.

Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.

Work with Product and Engineering teams to translate requirements into effective design solutions.

Proficiency with Figma or similar design tools.

*

Strong attention to detail and ability to balance user needs with business requirements.

*

Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, and other teams.

Experience designing SaaS, AI, technology, or consumer digital products.

*

Familiarity with design systems and component libraries.

*

Experience conducting usability testing or analyzing user feedback.

*

Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and how digital products are built.

Compensation
------------

*$60,000 - $80,000 per year* , depending on experience and qualifications.

Additional benefits and employment details will be discussed during the hiring process.

What We Offer
-------------

*

Fully remote work environment.
------------------------------

*

Opportunity to shape the experience of an innovative AI-powered product.

*

Close collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.

*

Opportunity to see your designs move from concept to real product.

*

Collaborative and supportive team environment.

*

Opportunities for professional growth as CareerSwift expands.

*Apply today and help us create a simpler, smarter, and more intuitive job search experience.*

*Location:* Remote

*Salary Range:* 60,000 - 80,000 USD (gross, annually)

title: Product Designer
description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a digital product studio that specializes in turning ideas into extraordinary digital experiences. This client is a dynamic, remote-first team of savvy professionals known for pushing creative boundaries and delivering high-quality, user-centered products through a collaborative and lean approach.

This client is building a bench of talented product designers for upcoming client work. They are looking for mid-to-senior-level freelance designers who can bring strong UX thinking, sharp visual design skills, and a collaborative spirit to the team.

*What they're looking for*
--------------------------

If you're a seasoned product designer with a passion for digital excellence, this opportunity is for you. You’ve honed your craft over the years, with a deep understanding of UX design, visual storytelling, and collaborative product development.

You’re equally comfortable working independently and alongside a cross-functional team. You manage your time well, take ownership of your work, and make confident decisions with minimal oversight. You’re fluent in tools like Figma and Adobe Suite, and you bring a user-first mindset to everything you do — whether designing mobile apps or contributing to product strategy.

If you're the type of designer who pushes creative boundaries, communicates clearly, and still knows how to have a little fun in the process — they’d love to hear from you.

*The Details*
-------------

As a Product Design Contractor, you’ll contribute to a range of client-facing projects, collaborating with the Chief Creative Officer and team across the following areas:

* Digital Product Design (Web & App): Shape intuitive experiences by applying research, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that elevate functionality and user engagement.
* User Research & Discovery: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to inform feature planning and prioritization. Help build products grounded in real user needs and business goals.
* User Experience (UX): Apply UX methodologies like journey mapping, user flows, and usability testing to define products beyond UI — ensuring seamless and strategic user experiences.
* Visual Design: Lead visual direction on select projects, producing compelling layouts and assets that translate beautifully across platforms — from product to marketing.
* Presentation Collateral: Design high-impact presentation decks and visuals that bring ideas to life for clients and stakeholders.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering and product teams by providing annotated designs, QA support, and input during handoff and development.
* Additional Design Support: Contribute to project-related needs like case studies, marketing assets, and content design for social media or internal documentation.

*Qualifications*
----------------

* 4–6 years of experience in product and visual design, with a strong focus on digital experiences across web and/or mobile
* Solid understanding of UX principles, including user research, usability testing, and translating insights into design decisions
* Demonstrated ability to own features or tracks of work with minimal oversight — from wireframes to high-fidelity execution
* Comfortable leading or contributing to discovery phases and helping define product direction in collaboration with strategy and engineering
* Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, with experience working in a Mac environment
* Familiarity with remote collaboration tools such as Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, Jira, and Harvest
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a team-first mindset and the ability to clearly articulate design rationale
* Organized, proactive, and able to manage your own time in a fast-paced, remote work environment
* Bonus: experience working in client-facing or agency settings where flexibility, autonomy, and cross-functional teamwork are key

*What to Expect from the Process*
---------------------------------

This is a contract-based role and part of an ongoing effort to build relationships with experienced designers for future client projects. Interviews are being conducted on a rolling basis, and while there may not be immediate openings, strong candidates will be added to the contractor roster and considered as new work becomes available.

Hiring timelines are directly tied to the sales pipeline, so project start dates vary. The team is committed to matching the right designer to the right project — and they will reach out when there’s a fit.

*About the Client*
------------------

This client is a digital product studio that brings together design, technology, and creativity to build meaningful experiences. They believe in pushing boundaries, working collaboratively, and delivering high-quality products that they are proud of.

The remote-first culture values autonomy, trust, and open communication. The team is always exploring new ideas, evolving their process, and building products that move the needle for their clients.

This position is remote and open to all candidates, but applicants based in New York City are prioritized for potential in-person collaboration.

CTIS is looking for a creative and detail-oriented Part-Time Graphic Designer to support our proposals, business development, recruiting, and corporate communications.

The ideal candidate will have strong design skills and be comfortable creating polished, professional materials, particularly presentations and proposal graphics. Experience supporting federal contracting proposals is a plus.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Create and edit PowerPoint presentations, proposals, capability statements, brochures, flyers, and other corporate materials.
* Develop graphics, charts, diagrams, and infographics to support proposals and presentations.
* Help turn technical and business information into clear, professional visuals.
* Support recruiting and business development materials as needed.
* Maintain consistent CTIS branding.
* Work with Proposal, Business Development, Recruiting, and Leadership teams.
* Manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

*Qualifications*

* 2+ years of graphic design experience.
* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
* Strong PowerPoint skills.
* Good understanding of layout, typography, branding, and visual communication.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.
* Professional design portfolio required.

*Preferred*

* Experience creating proposal or RFP graphics.
* Experience supporting a federal contractor or government client.
* Familiarity with technical or business development materials.
* Experience with Canva, Acrobat, or similar tools.

*How to Apply*

Please submit your *resume and portfolio/work samples* demonstrating relevant graphic design experience. Candidates with experience supporting *federal contractors or government proposals* are encouraged to highlight that experience in their application.

*Work Arrangement*

This is a fully remote, part-time position. Candidates local to the DMV area are preferred and may occasionally be asked to come into the office when needed, but regular in-office work is not required.

*Pay - 40$/hr*

title: Senior Graphic Designer, Brand & Creative
description:
*(100% Remote) · Full-Time Independent Contractor · U.S. Business Hours*

Imagine being the person who decides what a company looks like. Every campaign that ships carries your hand. Every recruiter’s deck, every ad, every reel — one voice, one look, unmistakably ours. That’s this role.

*ABOUT THE ROLE*

You’d be joining a firm building the financial backbone for ambitious companies — and a talent brand that has to stand out in a crowded market to win the best accounting and finance professionals in the Philippines and the U.S.

As Senior Graphic Designer, you own the visual identity. Not the execution queue — the identity itself. You take a business goal and return to a creative direction, then produce the work that proves it: static campaigns, motion pieces, employer branding assets, ads, decks, and social systems. You set the rules for how the brand shows up, and you make sure everything that ships follows them.

This is a senior creative seat. It is not a production design role, and it is not a request-taker position. The person who thrives here is a brand owner: someone who develops the concept, builds the system, produces the work, and raises the bar on everything around it.

*The Ideal Candidate*

*

You think in campaigns and systems, not one-off files.

*

You can take a one-line brief — or no brief — and come back with a direction worth defending.

*

You move fluently between static and motion, and you know when each one wins.

*

You have taste, and you can explain it in plain language to non-designers.

*

You ship on a weekly cadence without sacrificing craft.

*

You do your best work in writing and async, across time zones.

*WHAT YOU’LL OWN*

*

*Visual Identity.* The look is yours to define and protect. Own and evolve the brand’s visual system — typography, color, layout, iconography, photo and video treatment — and keep every asset that ships consistent with it.

*

*Creative Direction.* Direction before execution. Translate business and hiring goals into creative concepts, then art-direct them through to final delivery — including work produced by freelancers, agencies, and internal contributors.

*

*Campaign Design.* Campaigns that look like campaigns. Build full visual campaigns across recruitment marketing, employer branding, and internal programs — key visuals, adaptations, and rollout kits sized for every placement.

*

*Motion & Video Graphics.* Make it move. Produce motion graphics, animated social cuts, lower thirds, kinetic type, and title packages, and cut short-form video for social where needed.

*

*Social & Digital Assets.* Feed the channels without diluting the brand. Design recurring social content, paid ad creative, and digital assets built as reusable templates and systems, not one-off posts.

*

*Presentations & Collateral.* Make the story look like the company behind it. Design pitch decks, one-pagers, reports, and internal collateral to a publish-ready standard.

*

*Design Operations.* Build a system that survives volume. Maintain source files, component libraries, brand guidelines, and templates so the team can self-serve the simple things and you stay on the hard things.

*

*Quality Control.* Nothing ships off-brand. Review and approve creative output across the organization, and give clear, direct feedback that raises the standard.

*WHAT YOU’LL BRING*

*

5+ years in graphic design, brand design, or art direction — with senior or lead-level ownership (required)

*

A portfolio showing original concept development, not just execution of others’ briefs (required)

*

Expert command of Adobe Creative Suite — Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign (required)

*

Expert command of After Effects for motion graphics, and Premiere Pro for video editing (required)

*

Strong Figma skills for design systems, components, and collaborative handoff (required)

*

Working proficiency in Canva for templated assets the wider team will use (required)

*

Demonstrated experience owning a brand’s visual identity end to end (required)

*

Ability to produce a high volume of polished work weekly without quality drift (required)

*

Excellent written communication — most direction and feedback happens in writing across time zones (required)

*

Ability to prioritize and manage time in a remote work environment (required)

*Preferred (Nice to Have)*

*

Employer branding, recruitment marketing, or talent brand experience

*

3D or advanced motion work (Blender, Cinema 4D)

*

Experience designing for paid social performance, not just brand

*

Illustration or custom type capability

*

Comfort using AI tools to accelerate ideation and production

*

Experience directing photo and video shoots

*PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENT*

Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed. Send a link that shows both static and motion work, and include at least one case where you developed the concept yourself — tell us the goal, your direction, and the result.

*HOW WE WORK*

*Quality First* Every asset that ships is accurate, on-brand, and publish-ready.

*Security Matters* Candidate, employee, and company information is handled with the highest level of confidentiality.

*Reliable Collaboration* We work closely through Slack, Zoom, shared documentation, and predictable communication rhythms.

*Continuous Improvement* We constantly look for ways to improve processes, eliminate inefficiencies, and support business growth.

*WHY CAS IS DIFFERENT*

We are not a gig platform. We are not a freelance marketplace. We are not short-term staffing.

We aren’t looking for someone to fill a design queue. We’re looking for someone who wants to own what this brand looks like for the next five years.

At CAS, you’ll enjoy:

*

Competitive USD compensation based on experience

*

Permanent remote work

*

Full company equipment provided (laptop, monitor, accessories)

*

15 days PTO annually + local holidays

*

Guaranteed annual increases

*

Referral rewards up to $1,000

*

Monthly flexible stipend (CAS Flex Perks)

*

Structured onboarding and career development

*

Creative ownership with a real seat at the strategy table

*

A culture built around ownership, continuous learning, and innovation

*CONTRACT & EXCLUSIVITY*

This is an independent contractor engagement. Full-time exclusivity is required — candidates must not hold other part-time or freelance engagements once hired. Conflict-of-interest checks may apply.

*READY TO TAKE THE NEXT STEP?*

Your next big career move starts here.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
As the Senior Graphic Designer will create engaging and creative graphics to visually represent high-quality brands. You will be responsible for all aspects of graphic design, from planning to managing print and digital projects. The senior graphic designer works alongside the design manager and other departments to ensure that all content is on-brand, and consistent in terms of style, quality, and tone of voice.

*What You Will Do:*

* Take ownership of complex design projects, independently managing execution from concept to final delivery while ensuring quality, efficiency, and adherence to timelines
* Manage and maintain relationships with external vendors, agencies, and print partners, ensuring smooth execution of design projects, negotiating terms, and overseeing quality control
* Mentor and guide junior designers, providing mentorship and technical support to elevate team performance and skill development
* Develop and refine creative concepts, ensuring consistency in visual storytelling across marketing, advertising, and product design initiatives
* Collaborate closely with internal teams to design and develop marketing assets, promotional materials, packaging, and in-store displays
* Ensure seamless project management, maintaining design timelines and prioritizing multiple projects with minimal oversight
* Stay ahead of industry trends, emerging technologies, and design innovations, integrating new methodologies to enhance efficiency and creative output
* Oversee quality control for design execution, ensuring high standards in file preparation, resolution accuracy, and production specifications
* Work with minimal supervision, demonstrating a proactive and solution-oriented mindset
* Utilize design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Sketch, Microsoft Office Suite, and G-Suite
* Continuously refine and optimize design processes, improving efficiency and ensuring consistency in brand representation
* Create, refine, and manage design templates and assets for consistent, scalable use across campaigns

*What We Are Looking For:*

*

6+ years of in-house or corporate graphic design experience, preferably in consumer products

*

Strong portfolio with related work samples in graphic design, typography, and layouts

*

Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, AI Design) and standard proficiency in Microsoft Office/G-Suite

*

Deep understanding of consumer production printing processes (including color and material limitations) and multiple manufacturing processes

*

Proven experience working with licensed brands and developing productive relationships with internal cross-functional teams and external vendors

*

Exceptional project management and communication skills with the ability to easily adapt to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment

*Nice To Have:*

*

Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Fashion Design, Art, Illustration, or a related field is a plus

*

Prior experience creating comprehensive style guides

*

Experience working in a global company

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee, but provide the primary duties and responsibilities of the role. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

*What We Offer*

The base salary may vary based on experience, role tenure, performance, industry, and location. Eligibility for the annual performance incentive may apply. Jazwares is a multi-state employer, so the salary range may not apply to other states.

Our benefits package includes basic medical insurance that is 100% company-paid for employees and their children, employee basic life and AD&D insurance, a 401(K) retirement program with Jazwares matching up to 4% of pretax or post-tax deferrals, short and long-term disability, and tuition reimbursement.

Our work environment provides a flexible work schedule that includes Monday through Thursday on-site, with an optional WFH on Fridays, up to 20 workdays fully remote each year, and Time Off for vacation and sick leave. Through Jazwares Cares, you will have the opportunity to volunteer for up to 16 hours a year on community service projects.

*Reasonable Accommodations*

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

*Working at Jazwares*

At Jazwares, we believe an innovative idea can come from anywhere and anyone. Through our three pillars, we foster innovation and encourage creativity in every area of our business.

* *Passion* : Our conviction and enthusiasm show in our products, relationships, and commitment to our community.
* *Collaboration* : We share one vision worldwide, constantly striving to improve and innovate together.
* *Humility* : We recognize the value in others and treat everyone with respect. Our strength lies in our people and talent.

*Don't miss out on this extraordinary opportunity to be part of the fastest-growing toy company in the industry. Connect with us today, and let's shape the future of play together!*

JAZWARES is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, sex, religion, national or ethnic origin, citizenship status, ancestry, disability, age, military status, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law. Jazwares is committed to providing reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities.

*Who We Are*

Jazwares, a Berkshire Hathaway company, is a leading global toy manufacturer with a robust portfolio of owned and licensed brands. Founded in 1997, Jazwares celebrates imaginative play with a progressive focus on identifying new and relevant trends to transform into high-quality products for consumers of all ages. Jazwares engages consumers through innovative play experiences with popular brands such as Squishmallows™, Pokémon™, Hello Kitty™, Star Wars™, Five Nights at Freddy’s™, Disney™, BumBumz™, and BLDR™. In addition to toys, offerings include costumes, games, and pillows. Headquartered in Plantation, Florida, Jazwares has offices worldwide and sells its products in over 100 countries. For more information, visit and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

*Recruitment Safety*

Please be wary of unsolicited communications from individuals or websites you are not familiar with, or any communications requesting sensitive personal data or information. All official Jazwares employment information will come from our company email ending in *@jazwares.com*. Jazwares will never request any monetary payments at any point during its hiring process. If you have any questions about any unsolicited communications, you can reach out to jazlegal@jazwares.com. We look forward to you experiencing a safe and enjoyable application process at Jazwares!

title: Multimedia Graphic Designer
description:
About Kobo
----------

Kobo is a nonprofit technology organization that creates and supports open-source tools and services to improve how data is collected, managed, and used in humanitarian, development, and human rights work.

Through our initiatives, Kobo advances equitable data solutions. We equip communities and organizations with the technology, training, insights, and services they need to turn field data into real-world change. Our primary platform, KoboToolbox, is used by over 35,000 nonprofit organizations worldwide to collect more than 25 million surveys per month, driving impactful, data-driven decisions to solve the world’s most complex problems.

Role Summary
------------

The Multimedia Graphic Designer will play a critical role in advancing Kobo’s external communication and fundraising goals by creating compelling visual content that tells powerful stories, engages new and existing donors, and builds brand awareness. This position combines traditional graphic design with video production, photography, animation, and audio to produce engaging digital content for all of Kobo’s web, social media, and online learning channels. In this newly created position, the Multimedia Graphic Designer will bridge art and technology. In this role, they will also identify and coordinate with external video and photography providers as needed, for example, for the creation of impactful donor-focused videos to showcase Kobo’s impact in supporting humanitarian organizations on the ground.

The ideal candidate is a creative storyteller with a passion for mission-driven work, skilled at translating complex impact data and beneficiary stories into visually engaging assets that inspire giving. They are an expert in brand storytelling and stewardship.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

Graphic Design & Branding
-------------------------

* Design and produce a wide range of fundraising and communications materials, including donor communications, social media imagery, brochures, impact infographics, digital banners, digital content for two websites, and dynamic presentation decks via PowerPoint or a similar tool.
* Maintain and evolve organizational brand standards (including presentation templates and corporate stationery) to ensure consistency across all visual communications, while adapting designs for different donor audiences (e.g., high-net-worth individuals, foundations, corporate partners, or potential customers).
* Create campaign-specific visuals that support major gift cultivation, individual giving programs, and online donor engagement.
* Develop and manage a digital asset library (photos, videos, animation, graphics, templates) for efficient reuse across teams.
* Manage the organization's brand architecture and create and maintain brand guidelines; collaborate with teams and stakeholders to build cohesive visuals aligned with the organization's goals.
* Assist with donor-facing digital tools, such as campaign landing pages, e-newsletters, and virtual event materials.
* Support a mobile-first website strategy with dynamic visual content and ensure accessibility standards.

Videography and Photography
---------------------------

* Plan and produce professional videography and photography material for field programs, storytelling, and impact documentation. This includes personally capturing content as well as recruiting and supervising external partners on the ground. Edit and finalize all photo and video assets.
* Produce compelling images and footage that authentically represent the organization’s work, with sensitivity to cultural contexts and privacy considerations (especially in humanitarian or global health contexts).
* Edit and optimize photo/video content for various uses: websites, social media (such as Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn), grant proposals, and stewardship materials.
* Edit and assemble raw footage, incorporating sound effects and adding visual special effects.
* Create engaging social media visuals, short-form videos, and motion graphics to drive donor acquisition, storytelling, and awareness campaigns.

Requirements
------------

Need to Have:
-------------

* Proficiency in tools such as Figma (a primary tool we utilize), Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Lightroom), or other relevant tools (e.g., Affinity, Canva, CapCut).
* Experience in creating dynamic business or donor pitches using software such as PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote, or others.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating multimedia and graphic design with a concentration of digital assets, photography, and videography work along with traditional graphic design elements.
* Experience with social media content creation.
* Experience with web design.
* Knowledge of print production and digital optimization best practices.
* Passion for Mission: Demonstrated commitment to the organization’s cause (e.g., humanitarian aid, global health, or development work).
* Significant overlap in daily working availability with US East Coast business hours

Bonuses:
--------

Advanced Technical Skills
-------------------------

* Some working knowledge of 3D modeling and texturing tools like Blender, Cinema 4D, or Maya.
* Experience utilizing AI tools responsibly to quickly scale variations of ad creatives and assets.

Strategic & Leadership Capabilities
-----------------------------------

* Experience designing direct-response marketing materials and executing A/B testing.

title: Marketing Designer
description:
Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology company building AI-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry. Freight forwarders manage thousands of shipments, rates, exceptions, and operational decisions every day. The challenge is not a lack of data. It is knowing what needs attention, what is going wrong, and what action to take next.

Portcast uses AI and data to help freight forwarders surface shipment exceptions, identify cost and margin risks, and make better decisions across the shipment lifecycle. Our products help teams improve operational efficiency, protect margins, and make faster, more informed decisions. Our vision is to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.

Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.

*ABOUT THE ROLE:
*
We are looking for a Marketing Designer to be the design engine behind our marketing. You'll turn briefs and copy into polished, on-brand assets across the full funnel, landing pages, case studies, social and paid creative, event materials, product collateral, and video, often at speed and across several formats at once. You'll partner closely with content and growth marketing (copy and content sit with the Content Marketing Manager; the visual craft is yours) to keep a consistent visual system across everything we publish, and raise the bar on how the Portcast brand shows up.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:
------------------------

*

A consistent, high-quality visual system across everything Portcast publishes, with assets shipped quickly and on-brand across web, print, social, paid, and video, so marketing can move fast without design becoming a bottleneck or losing craft.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN:
----------------

* Design landing pages, case study PDFs, product one-pagers, and sales/product collateral.
* Produce social creative (LinkedIn-first), including post series and campaign templates.
* Build paid media and creative for LinkedIn and Google campaigns across personas.
* Create event and webinar assets: banners, booth graphics, decks.
* Produce and edit video content end to end, short-form social clips, product feature videos, webinar/event recaps, and launch teasers, from raw footage to polished, on-brand output.
* Maintain and extend the Portcast brand system: components, tokens, templates.
* Support HTML email/newsletter production and light web design handoff.
* Iterate quickly across multiple design and content review rounds.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:
-----------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent.
* At least 3+ years in a design role, ideally in-house at a B2B SaaS product-based startup or at an agency doing B2B marketing, with a portfolio that shows real range across web, print, social, campaign, and video work.
* Fast, high-craft execution: You produce polished work quickly, often across several formats at once, without letting speed erode quality. You take direction and iterate well, but you hold your own opinions on what "good" looks like.
* Detail-obsessed: Pixel alignment, spacing, and consistency matter to you. You catch the small things others miss and hold the visual bar across everything that ships.
* Figma (advanced): You work fluently with components, variants, auto-layout, and shared libraries, and you keep the design system clean and reusable.
* Adobe Creative Suite: Strong in Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign, including multi-page, print-ready layouts for case studies and collateral.
* Design fundamentals: A strong grasp of typography, layout, grid systems, and brand consistency, and the ability to design for web and print formats interchangeably.
* Creative at scale: You're comfortable designing social and paid ad creative at volume from templates, keeping everything on-brand across personas and campaigns.
* Video editing and production: You can take a project from raw footage to finished, high-quality output, cutting, pacing, color, captions/subtitles, motion titles, and sound. You're fluent in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (or equivalent DaVinci Resolve / Final Cut), and CapCut or similar for fast short-form social edits.
* Web and email handoff: A basic understanding of HTML/CSS, enough to work within existing markup for email and web handoff, not necessarily coding from scratch.
* Brand systems: Working knowledge of brand systems and design tokens, and how to keep every asset on-system as the brand scales.
* Advanced motion design: animation and motion work (Lottie, complex After Effects, 3D/Blender).
* Presentation design: high-polish decks in PowerPoint or Google Slides.
* AI design tooling: familiarity with image generation, AI-assisted layout, prompt-based workflows, and AI video.
* Webflow basics: building or maintaining pages in Webflow, not just designing them.
* Curiosity for the logistics domain: Experiencein logistics, supply chain, transportation, or freight technology is valued, but so is a genuine curiosity to understand our market in depth.
* AI-forward mindset: You consistently apply AI across design workflows and actively experiment with new tools as they emerge.
* Startup builder mentality: You thrive in lean, fast-moving environments where ownership is high and resources are limited.
* Strong communicator: You communicate clearly across a diverse, distributed, cross-cultural team. You can be opinionated, but you engage with other views and compromise when it's right.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:
---------------------

*

Own the visual craft end to end: You'll own how Portcast looks and feels across everything we publish, with real influence over the brand and few layers between an idea and what ships.

*

Build in an industry still defining modern B2B marketing: Logistics and supply chain tech is at an exciting stage of digital transformation, with significant room to rethink how enterprise software is marketed and how it looks. You'll bring fresh ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and help shape what great design looks like in this space.

*

Work at the intersection of AI, design, and logistics: We have a strong product, established enterprise customers, and a real opportunity to sharpen how we show up. You'll get to push AI-forward design and video workflows, not just execute templates.

*

Small by design, fully distributed across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Your work directly shapes launches, customer perception, and how the market sees Portcast.

OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO:
---------------------------------------

*

Curiosity: We dig into why a design worked or didn't, how a freight forwarder actually operates, and what makes our brand land with customers.

*

Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait to be told what to make, and we stay on a piece until it's genuinely on-brand and right.

*

Raising the bar: We don't settle for assets that are merely fine. We hold a high standard for craft, polish, and the experience our brand creates.

*

Effectiveness: We focus on design that drives real marketing outcomes, pipeline, launches, and brand perception, not just output. We prioritize the right work and make practical trade-offs.

Join us at Portcast and help shape the future of the logistics and shipping industry through design that is as sharp as the product behind it.

*Who are we and what do we do?*

BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.

With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.

Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.

As a Team Lead - Sales Development at BrowserStack, you will lead a dynamic and growing Sales Development team in a fast-paced environment. description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

You will serve as a front-line manager for a team of Sales Development Representatives, responsible for outbound prospecting and pipeline generation across Ramp’s SMB segment.

You will lead and evolve the SMB sales development motion by providing 1:1 coaching, onboarding, training, and mentorship; setting team strategy; and partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Executive Leadership to drive pipeline and business outcomes.

As a member of the Sales Leadership team, you will play a critical role in developing SDR talent, scaling effective outbound practices, and continuously refining Ramp’s SMB go-to-market motion.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build and scale the SMB SDR function by evolving team operating rhythms, playbooks, coaching standards, and processes for an open-territory outbound motion.

- Set and maintain a high-performing culture by overseeing daily SDR activity, pipeline generation, and quota performance to ensure key performance metrics are met.

- Hire, onboard, and train new SDRs on Ramp’s products, buyer personas, competitive landscape, prospecting strategy, and tools through hands-on methods including role-plays.

- Develop and execute career-growth and leadership plans for direct reports, including daily 1:1 mentorship and coaching on time management, objection handling, prospecting tactics, active listening, and pipeline creation.

- Coach SDRs on effective multichannel outbound prospecting, including account research, relevant messaging, call execution, and using AI tools to improve efficiency and quality.

- Partner with AEs and Sales and Marketing counterparts on pipeline-generation, territory, and prospecting initiatives that support SMB business objectives.

- Report on team performance, pipeline health, and forecasts to senior leadership.

- Improve team output and efficiency over time by identifying opportunities to optimize systems, processes, enablement, and AI-supported workflows.

- Establish and maintain a library of prospecting resources, best practices, and training materials for the SMB SDR team.

- Represent the SMB Sales Development team cross-functionally with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Product, and other departments.

ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As our Fincrime Ops Senior Manager in GC and SEA, you will be responsible for our first-line financial crime operations team. This team leader is expected to drive standards in transaction monitoring and sanctions screening through TM risk assessment completion, rule tuning, segmentation, and profiling to ensure our current and future customers have a seamless experience across all of Airwallex’s product suite, all while protecting Airwallex from financial and reputational risk. We expect you to have strong attention to detail and to develop and apply a comprehensive understanding of AML/CTF related functions.

You Are:

- A natural leader, with strong leadership skills that enable you to influence and motivate those around you

- Process-driven, ensuring we create procedures to build efficient and well-documented workflows

- A team player who can also work independently

- A master prioritiser with the ability to assess all of the tasks at hand and make the decision on the order in which you complete each task

- You have an investigative and curious nature that allows you to know when to dive deeper to get to the bottom of a problem

- You ask the right questions and make risk-based decisions

This role is based onsite in our Singapore office.

Responsibilities:

- Understand the regulatory landscape and compliance requirements to further improve our investigations and rules

- Analyse and investigate patterns and trends

- Manage SLAs and deadlines to meet team and company goals

- Act as the point of escalation and responsible for stakeholder management

- Conduct investigations on suspicious transactions

- Ensure adherence to local and global compliance policies and procedures

- Take a data driven approach to problem solving

- Handle special projects and ad hoc incoming requests, including deep dives on issues

- Lead and inspire a team of transaction monitoring analysts, including both local and remote team members

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in the relevant field

- 5+ years of compliance experience working in a transaction monitoring function, financial crime management, AML investigations, or other relevant experience

- AICB, CAMS or CFE certifications strongly preferred

- Process-oriented experience requiring meticulous attention to detail and deep investigative skills with well-honed written and verbal communications

- Fintech experience strongly preferred

- Proven track record of managing performance against objective targets and using data and analytics to make decisions

- Prior leadership experience in managing a team of analysts is a plus

- Strong analytical skills with proficiency in SQL preferred

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. This is a high-impact role for an engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems, writing production software, and giving other engineering teams reliable self-service platforms. You will work across application, data, machine learning, security, and infrastructure teams to establish the technical foundations for the company’s next stage of growth.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Design, build, and operate highly available data and AI infrastructure on Kubernetes and public cloud platforms.

- Develop scalable platforms for streaming, batch processing, and real-time data workloads using technologies such as Kafka, Spark, and Flink.

- Build and evolve AI infrastructure, including AI gateways, model-routing layers, traffic management, rate limiting, authentication, observability, and usage controls.

- Develop self-service capabilities that enable data, AI, and application teams to deploy and operate workloads safely and independently.

- Partner with engineering teams to translate emerging data and AI requirements into durable platform capabilities.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 5+ years in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, owning production systems end to end

- Strong experience designing, operating, and troubleshooting production Kubernetes environments.

- Experience building or operating distributed data infrastructure with technologies such as Kafka, Spark, or Flink OR experience developing AI infrastructure such as AI gateways or model-routing platforms.

- Hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud platform, such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure.

- Strong knowledge of cloud and container networking, including DNS, load balancing, ingress, service discovery, TLS, routing, and network security.

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE
