* Ein Umfeld, in dem Du AI nicht rechtfertigen musst

Wir schauen auf Neugier, Tempo und Ambition, nicht auf die Anzahl der Berufsjahre. Ob frisch von der Uni oder mit ersten 1 bis 2 Jahren Marketing-Erfahrung: Absolventinnen und Absolventen sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

title: Junior DevOps Engineer (Docker → Kubernetes)
description:
🧩 Junior DevOps Engineer
------------------------

100% zdalnie | Contelizer · Easyitem.com · sklepy PrestaShop

💡 *O projekcie*
Rekrutacja prowadzona jest przez *Contelizer Sp. z o.o.* Odpowiadasz za infrastrukturę trzech obszarów naraz — to nie jest rola przy jednym produkcie:

* *Easyitem.com* — nowoczesna platforma SaaS dla firm e-commerce, łącząca moduły PIM, OMS i WMS w jednym ekosystemie. Automatyzuje obsługę sprzedaży, logistyki i integracji marketplace — od mikro-firm po duże sklepy internetowe.
* *Contelizer.pl* — utrzymanie i rozwój środowisk naszej własnej platformy.
* *Sklepy PrestaShop* — produkcyjne środowiska sklepów: wydajność, cache, deploye, backupy, reagowanie na incydenty.

Pracujemy w środowisku konteneryzowanym i zorientowanym na automatyzację, z naciskiem na niezawodność, monitoring i CI/CD.

⚙️ *Tech stack*

*Infrastructure / DevOps:* Linux (Debian/Ubuntu), Docker, Ansible, Terraform
*Orchestration:* Docker Swarm (dziś) → *Kubernetes* (migracja w toku)
*CI/CD:* GitLab CI/CD (czasem Jenkins)
*Monitoring & Logging:* Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Sentry
*Databases:* PostgreSQL, MySQL
*Aplikacje, które utrzymujesz:* PHP 8 / Symfony / PrestaShop (PHP-FPM, Composer, cron, cache)
*Networking:* Nginx / Traefik, Cloudflare
*Version control:* Git (GitLab)

🚧 *Co teraz robimy: przechodzimy na Kubernetes*
Nasza produkcja stoi dziś na Dockerze i Docker Swarmie, ale jesteśmy w trakcie migracji na *Kubernetes* — i to jest nasze najważniejsze zadanie na najbliższe miesiące. Docelowo na klastrze ma wylądować wszystko: Easyitem.com, Contelizer.pl i sklepy PrestaShop. Nie szukamy administratora gotowego klastra. Szukamy kogoś, kto przejdzie tę drogę razem z nami: od pierwszych manifestów, przez testy na klastrze, po wdrożenie produkcyjne. Jeśli Kubernetesa znasz na razie z własnego k3s, kind albo minikube — to jest dobry moment, żeby nauczyć się go na realnym systemie, z mentorem i bez rzucania na głęboką wodę.

💼 *Co oferujemy*

* Praca w 100% zdalna (elastyczne godziny i pełna swoboda miejsca pracy)
* Wsparcie i mentoring doświadczonego DevOpsa — realny rozwój krok po kroku
* Udział w wdrożeniach i automatyzacji na produkcji
* Udział w migracji produkcji z Docker Swarm na *Kubernetes* — od manifestów po wdrożenie
* Możliwość rozwoju w kierunku SRE / Cloud / Security
* Praca w nowoczesnym środowisku (IaC, monitoring, CI/CD)
* Realny wpływ na infrastrukturę i dobór narzędzi
* Przyjazna atmosfera i kultura techniczna — zero mikro-zarządzania, pełna odpowiedzialność za zadania

📬 *Proces rekrutacji*

1️⃣ *Sprawdzamy CV i profil techniczny*
Wybieramy kandydatów najbardziej dopasowanych do technologii i projektu.

2️⃣ *Wysyłamy zadanie rekrutacyjne DevOps*
Krótkie zadanie polegające na uruchomieniu aplikacji w Dockerze i opisaniu, jak przeniósłbyś ją na Kubernetesa.
Zadanie należy odesłać w ustalonym czasie.

3️⃣ *Zapraszamy na rozmowę techniczną*
Omówienie rozwiązania, podejścia i sposobu myślenia.

4️⃣ *Decyzja*
Niezależnie od wyniku wysyłamy feedback.

🟢 *Must have*
-------------

🖥️ Bardzo dobra znajomość systemu *Linux (Debian/Ubuntu)* — usługi, logi, procesy, uprawnienia
🐳 Doświadczenie z *Dockerem* — uruchamianie usług, własne obrazy, docker-compose
☸️ *Kubernetes — podstawy* : kubectl, pod / deployment / service, pisanie manifestów YAML. Wystarczy klaster lokalny (minikube / k3s / kind) albo własny projekt — nie wymagamy doświadczenia produkcyjnego
🔧 *Ansible* — pisanie prostych playbooków i automatyzacja konfiguracji
🏗️ *Terraform* — podstawowe IaC / tworzenie infrastruktury jako kodu
💻 *Bash* — pisanie skryptów i automatyzacja w powłoce
🗄️ Podstawowa administracja *MySQL lub PostgreSQL* (instalacja, backup/restore)
🐘 *Uruchamianie aplikacji PHP* — PHP-FPM, Composer, cron, cache. Nie musisz pisać w PHP, ale musisz umieć taką aplikację postawić, zaktualizować i zdiagnozować
🌐 Wiedza z zakresu sieci:

* *firewalle* (iptables/ufw)
* *TCP/IP, DNS*
* ⚖️ *load balancer / reverse proxy* (Nginx / HAProxy / Traefik)

🔁 *Git* — praca z branchami i merge requestami
📘 *Angielski* — do czytania dokumentacji technicznej

🔹 *Nice to have*
----------------

☸️ *Kubernetes w praktyce* — Helm, ingress controller, limity i zasoby, przenoszenie usług na klaster
🧩 *Docker Swarm* — dziś stoi na nim nasza produkcja
🛒 *PrestaShop lub inne sklepy e-commerce od strony infrastruktury* — wydajność, cache, deploye, okna sprzedażowe
🚀 *GitLab CI/CD* lub *Jenkins*
📈 *Prometheus i Grafana* — monitoring i alerting
🌩️ *Cloudflare* (DNS / proxy / reguły bezpieczeństwa)
☁️ Podstawowa znajomość *chmury* (OVH / AWS / GCP / Azure)
🧭 *Nginx* jako reverse proxy / load balancer
🔐 Podstawy *bezpieczeństwa Linux* (TLS/SSH, hardening)

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
About Huzzle
------------

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talents with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech.

Unlike an outsourcing agency, we place you directly with a client where you’re hired in-house as a valued member of their team.

About the Company
-----------------

You’ll be joining a growing international company building digital products used by customers across multiple markets. The team values thoughtful product design, intuitive user experiences, and high-quality execution.

You’ll work closely with product managers, developers, and business stakeholders to turn complex requirements into polished, user-friendly digital experiences.

*Role Type: Full-time*

*Engagement: Independent Contractor*

Job Summary
-----------

We’re looking for a versatile UI/UX Designer / Product Designer with 3-5+ years of experience, who can own the design process from early UX thinking and wireframing through high-fidelity UI, prototyping, design systems, and developer handoff.

The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with solid UX thinking. You should be comfortable solving complex product problems, creating modern and intuitive interfaces, and working independently with international teams in a fully remote environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced designer who wants meaningful ownership over digital products rather than focusing solely on graphic design or visual execution.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Own the end-to-end design process, from discovery and user flows through wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity UI, and developer handoff.
* Translate product requirements and business objectives into intuitive, user-centered experiences.
* Create polished interfaces for responsive web and/or mobile products.
* Develop user flows, information architecture, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and final UI designs.
* Build and maintain reusable components, design systems, and UI libraries in Figma.
* Conduct or incorporate user research, usability feedback, analytics, and stakeholder insights into design decisions.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
* Prepare clear, detailed designs and specifications for engineering handoff.
* Review implemented designs and work with developers to ensure design quality and consistency.
* Identify UX issues and opportunities to improve usability, accessibility, conversion, and overall product experience.
* Communicate design decisions clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

*Requirements*

* 3–5+ years of professional UI/UX, Product Design, or equivalent experience.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating real-world web and/or mobile product design.
* Advanced proficiency with Figma, including Auto Layout, components, variants, and reusable design systems.
* Strong understanding of UX fundamentals, including user flows, information architecture, wireframing, prototyping, and usability.
* Strong visual design skills with excellent understanding of typography, spacing, hierarchy, layout, and visual consistency.
* Experience designing responsive web and/or mobile interfaces.
* Experience creating and maintaining design systems and component libraries.
* Comfortable incorporating user research and usability feedback into design decisions.
* Strong understanding of accessibility and user-centered design principles.
* Experience collaborating with developers and preparing designs for engineering handoff.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and communicate effectively in a fully remote environment.

Portfolio Signs We Prioritize:
------------------------------

Your portfolio should demonstrate how you think, not just how your designs look.

Strong candidates will ideally show:

* Clear case studies explaining the problem, process, decisions, and outcome.
* The progression from wireframes → prototypes → final UI.
* Experience with SaaS platforms, dashboards, mobile apps, marketplaces, or other complex digital products.
* Complex user journeys and product workflows rather than primarily marketing or landing pages.
* Strong consistency in typography, spacing, hierarchy, grids, and visual systems.
* Responsive design across different screen sizes and devices.
* Design systems, component libraries, and reusable UI patterns.
* Evidence that products were actually built and shipped.
* Clear reasoning behind important UX and UI decisions.

Nice-to-Haves:
--------------

* Experience designing SaaS or B2B products.
* Basic understanding of HTML/CSS.
* Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite, Framer, or similar design tools.
* Experience using product analytics or participating in A/B testing.
* Previous experience working with UK, US, Canadian, European, or Australian companies.
* Experience collaborating with distributed or international product and engineering teams.

*Benefits*

💰 Competitive compensation based on experience, skills, and portfolio strength.

🌎 Fully remote role with the opportunity to work with an international team.

🚀 Work on real digital products where your design decisions have a measurable impact.

🧩 Build and improve scalable design systems and product experiences.

📈 Long-term career growth with opportunities to take on greater design ownership.

🏆 Performance-based incentives and recognition for exceptional work.

title: UI/UX Designer

Our technology lets you preview products in your own room before you buy them. Imagine you want to redesign your home and have been searching for new tiles for your kitchen, or a new rug for your living room. You definitely want to make sure it will look good in your space. We enable you to do that through our proprietary cutting-edge technology, presented in an extraordinarily simple and accessible way. Try our rug demo now! Simply upload a picture of your room using your mobile phone, and slide the rug under your coffee table:https://www.roomvo.com/rugdemo...

Reporting to the Director of Design & Innovation, you'll be joining a team guided by a seasoned leader renowned for pioneering innovation and fostering a culture of excellence. This is more than just a reporting relationship; it's an opportunity for mentorship and growth. Together, you will strategize, execute, and continuously refine our product design, ensuring that it not only meets but exceeds user expectations. By working closely with the Director, you'll be in the prime position to make significant contributions, influence decision-making, and shape the future direction of our design and user experience initiatives.

*About our Stacks*
Design: Figma (Main design tool), Adobe Creative Suite, Maze (UX tool)
Engineering: TypeScript, Next.js, React/Redux, Python, Django, PostgreSQL

*What you'll do:*

* Create cutting edge experiences: Design UI and UX flows in Figma using the tool’s latest features.
* Systematize Creativity: Apply a methodical approach to design, cleverly reusing existing concepts while considering the engineering implications.

title: UI/UX Designer (Remote Opportunity)
description:
Mind Computing is seeking a fulltime, 100% remote *UI/UX Designer* to support a project with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). The ideal candidate will apply Human Centered Design (HCD) principles to develop and enhance user-centric applications with a strong focus on usability, accessibility, and user experience. The candidate must reside within the continental US.

*Responsibilities:*

* Collaborate with Business Analysts, developers, testers, and stakeholders to translate business and technical requirements into effective UI/UX solutions.
* Develop research-oriented questions and use indirect user insights to inform design decisions when direct access to users is limited.
* Create wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes using Figma to communicate design concepts and support development.
* Serve as a UI/UX accessibility subject-matter resource, providing guidance to cross-functional teams on accessible design practices and Section 508 compliance.
* Incorporate accessibility and compliance considerations throughout the design process and prior to production release.
* Review accessibility findings and provide clear, actionable guidance for identifying and remediating Section 508 issues.
* Support accessibility testing, audits, and remediation efforts by reviewing findings, recommending design solutions, and validating corrected implementations.
* Incorporate feedback from developers, testers, stakeholders, and users into iterative design improvements within an Agile delivery environment.
* Contribute to team objectives and take on additional responsibilities as needed.

*Qualifications:*

* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Human Computer Interaction (HCI), or a related field.
* Proven experience as a UI/UX Designer with a portfolio demonstrating accessible web or application design work.
* Strong understanding and practical application of Human Centered Design principles in complex, constraint driven environments.
* Demonstrated experience designing accessible user interfaces and advising cross-functional teams on Section 508 compliance and remediation.
* Translate accessibility and compliance requirements into practical recommendations for team members with varying levels of accessibility expertise.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Business Analysts and stakeholders and translate research and user insights into practical design solutions.
* Proficiency with Figma and experience working within Agile development teams.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to clearly explain design and accessibility recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

*Additional Qualifications:*

* Prior government/federal experience.
* Experience supporting VA, DHA, HHS, or other federal/government projects.
* Familiarity with VA Digital Service guidelines, USWDS, and federal accessibility standards and expectations.
* Experience supporting accessibility testing, audits, and remediation.
* Experience contributing to or working within a design system, including UI patterns, components, and documentation.

* 401k with Employer Match
* PTO + Federal Holidays
* Corporate Laptop

* Remote Opportunity

title: Senior UI/UX Designer | Logos
description:
Hi!

We are *Boosta, a holding tech company* that creates, develops, and invests in digital businesses with global potential. Today, we collaborate with over 800 specialists from different parts of the world, and millions of users use our products and services.

We’re currently looking for a *Senior UI/UX Designer* to join Logos — a business developing an AI-powered self-discovery platform.

At the core of the product is AI as a personal companion that supports users on their journey of self-discovery. The product’s key value is helping people gain clarity about who they are, what they want, and why they make certain decisions. Its mission is to help people live happier lives by changing the way they understand themselves and perceive the world.

*As a Senior UI/UX Designer, you will:*

* Lead the entire design direction and report directly to the CEO — be the sole owner of design decisions and priorities.
* Own end-to-end design for mobile and web, working closely with developers and the CEO.
* Build and maintain one design system shared across platforms.
* Own conversion across App Store → onboarding → paywall → activation.
* Design the core Self Map experience — the product’s differentiator.
* Bake AI tools into the daily workflow to ship faster every sprint.

*We’re looking for someone who:*

* Has end-to-end product design experience — no separate UI executor needed.
* Has simultaneous depth in mobile and web.
* Has experience in Growth & CRO design — onboarding, activation, paywall flows.
* Understands the core principles and approaches of A/B testing: how hypotheses are formed and what makes a valid test.
* Has English at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or higher: the product targets the US market, so UI copy, onboarding microcopy, and ad creatives must read naturally and be polished for a native audience.
* Has team-building fundamentals — has hired, briefed, or managed designers/contractors before; is ready to build and lead a design team as the company scales toward a Head of Design / CDO path.
* Has experience building design systems / component libraries for multi-platform reuse.
* Uses an AI-native workflow — Figma AI/Make or equivalent, generative tools, design-to-code.

*Here’s what our hiring flow looks like:*

* Step 1. Pre-screen with the Recruiter.
* Step 2. Short interview with the CEO.
* Step 3. Test Assignment, if needed.
* Step 4. Bar-Raising Interview.
* Step 5. Reference Check.
* Step 6. Job Offer.

* Join the product at an early stage and grow with it as it scales.
* Take ownership of your area with the freedom to make decisions and drive change.
* Build your function from scratch — from processes and approaches to the team.

* Take care of your health with medical insurance and psychologist session reimbursement.
* Get involved in socially important initiatives, including our Ukrainian Victory Support program.

*Join us in building a product that will help millions of people better understand themselves.*

title: Visual Designer (AI-Native)
description:
---------------
*About AegisAI*
---------------

We’re a team of ex-Google engineers and product leaders who built some of the largest defensive platforms on the planet—Safe Browsing and reCAPTCHA. Now, we’re striking out on our own to tackle an even bigger challenge: stopping the new wave of adversarial AI threats already hitting organizations today.

Backed by Battery Ventures, Accel, and Foundation Capital, we’re going after a *$7B+ market* ripe for disruption. Traditional rules-based security tools and bloated enterprise software don't stand a chance against AI-driven social engineering. We’re building native, agentic AI systems that think and adapt like human security analysts.

----------
*The Role*
----------

We are looking for an AI-Native *Visual Designer* to define and elevate the visual identity of AegisAI.

This is not a traditional design role where you wait weeks for briefs, push pixels manually, or pass off static Figma mockups. You will be expected to operate as an *AI-native creator* —leveraging cutting-edge AI tools (Midjourney, Runway, Stable Diffusion, ComfyUI, ChatGPT/Claude, generative code, and beyond) to multiply your speed, experiment ruthlessly, and turn complex AI and security concepts into sharp, compelling, category-defining visual assets.

You’ll work directly alongside our founders, Head of Product, and GTM teams to craft everything from product launch visual assets, dark-mode technical brand systems, enterprise web experiences, interactive threat reports, and high-stakes deck designs.

----------------
*What You’ll Do*
----------------

*

*Own the AegisAI Visual Identity:* Scale and evolve our brand identity into a bold, high-precision aesthetic that reflects our position as the category leader in agentic AI security.

*

*Leverage AI-Native Design Workflows:* Integrate generative visual models, AI vector generation, and automated design workflows directly into your daily stack to go from idea to polished execution in hours, not weeks.

*

*Translate Technical Complexity into Visual Clarity:* Synthesize dense security topics—like multi-agent orchestration, threat graph analysis, and zero-day payload evasion—into intuitive, stunning visual metaphors, diagrams, and motion graphics.

*

*Build Web & Product Collateral:* Design high-converting marketing pages, interactive landing pages, campaign graphics, and executive deck narratives that convert Fortune 500 CISOs and security leaders.

*

*Partner Across the Arena:* Work side-by-side with GTM, Product, and Engineering in real-time fast feedback loops. No red tape, no endless feedback committees—just execution.

------------------------
*What We’re Looking For*
------------------------

*

*AI-Native Mindset:* You don't view generative AI tools as a threat or a gimmick—they are integrated into your primary design stack. You know how to prompt, fine-tune, iterate, and polish AI-generated media to produce production-grade, pixel-perfect visuals.

*

*3–6+ Years of Design Experience:* A strong background in brand identity, visual design, communication design, or graphic design, ideally at a high-growth tech startup, top agency, or category-defining tech company.

*

*Exceptional Aesthetic Bar:* A portfolio demonstrating mastery over typography, layout, color theory, data visualization, and motion design. You build work that looks premium, sharp, and futuristic, yet grounded and trustworthy.

*

*Technical & Domain Curiosity:* You don't need to be a security researcher, but you live to understand complex systems. You are excited to learn how LLM reasoning, threat vectors, and multi-agent systems work so you can visually explain them.

*

*High Agency & Speed:* You think in days and hours, not quarters and months. You thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments where you own your decisions and ship continuously.

*Note to Candidates (Portfolio Requirement)*
--------------------------------------------

Please include a link to your portfolio or work samples with your application.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We care deeply about craftsmanship, taste, and speed. Your portfolio should showcase finished visual work as well as breakdown examples of your design process—specifically how you integrate AI tools (generative images, motion, workflows, or vector generation) alongside traditional design software to achieve polished, production-grade results.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------
*Why This Is Hard (a.k.a. Why It’s Fun)*
----------------------------------------

*

*The field evolves daily.* Generative design tools and security threats change every week. What worked last month will be obsolete tomorrow.

*

*Translating "Invisibles" into "Visuals."* AI agents and email threat vectors exist in background infrastructure. Making abstract, high-level AI concepts visually striking and intuitive is a unique design challenge.

*

*There’s no playbook.* We are creating a new visual language for agentic AI defense. You’ll be in the arena shaping a global brand from day one.

---------------
*Why We’ll Win*
---------------

*

*We’ve done this before.* Our team built core defense tech protecting billions of users (Safe Browsing, reCAPTCHA). This is our third time building a category-defining security company.

*

*AI and design are in our DNA.* We don't bolt AI on—it’s built into our product and our internal operations from day one.

*

*Top 1% Team.* We only hire top performers who are hungry to build at the bleeding edge.

*

*Flat, flexible, and fast.* No politics, no bureaucracy. Just high-output people solving hard problems together.

title: Sr. Product UI/Visual Designer - FO Applications
description:
*About the Role*

We're looking for a Senior Product UI Visual Designer to take our product experiences from rough structure to polished, production-ready visual design. Our products are trading systems, trading idea research management systems, and risk management systems built for the Front Office at hedge funds and asset management firms - data dense, highly transactional tools used by traders, portfolio managers, and analysts every day. You'll work primarily from wireframe schematics and rough AI-generated prototypes - turning that early-stage thinking into interfaces that are visually refined , consistent, and true to the CWAN Design System. This role also has a standing responsibility beyond individual projects: partnering with the team that maintains the CWAN Design System to propose, define, and document new design standards as our product surface area grows.

You'll sit at the intersection of craft and consistency - someone who can make a screen look and feel right, and who also cares about codifying why it's right so the whole design system gets stronger over time.

*What You'll Do* : *Visual design execution*

*

Interpret wireframes, low-fidelity schematics, and rough AI-generated prototypes and translate them into high-fidelity, production-ready visual designs.

*

Apply and enforce our existing visual design standards - typography, color, spacing, iconography, elevation, and layout grids - across every screen you touch.

*

Make sound design judgment calls when a wireframe or AI prototype is ambiguous, incomplete, or visually inconsistent, resolving gaps without waiting for direction.

*

Prepare polished, developer-ready Figma files with clear specs, redlines , and component usage so engineering can build from your work with minimal back-and-forth.

*

Partner with product designers, product managers, and engineers to review work in progress and ensure visual quality holds up from concept through shipped feature.

*Design system contribution*

*

Work directly with the CWAN Design System team to identify gaps where current standards don't cover a new pattern, component , or use case.

*

Propose new or updated visual design standards (components, tokens, patterns, documentation) based on recurring needs you encounter in project work.

*

Contribute polished, system-ready component and pattern designs - not just one-off screen solutions, so new standards are reusable across the product.

*

Document rationale and usage guidance for new standards so other designers can apply them consistently without re-litigating the decision.

*

Give and incorporate feedback in design system reviews, and help audit existing product surfaces for drift from current standards.

*What We're Looking For*

*

5+ years of experience in product/UI visual design, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong visual craft (typography, layout, color, hierarchy) applied to real product interfaces.

*

Proven ability to take low-fidelity input - wireframes, sketches, or AI-generated concepts and elevate it into refined, standards-compliant visual design.

*

Deep fluency in Figma, including components, variants, auto layout, and design tokens/variables.

*

Working knowledge of design systems: how components, tokens, and documentation fit together, and how design decisions scale across a product.

*

Sharp eye for visual consistency and the judgment to know when a new pattern deserves a system-level standard versus a one-off exception.

*

Strong collaboration and communication skills - comfortable presenting and defending design decisions to designers, PMs, and engineers.

*

Comfort designing for dense, data-heavy professional workflows where information hierarchy, precision, and speed of comprehension matter as much as visual polish.

*

Adept at using AI tools to streamline design work and make updates to designs — e.g., familiarity with Claude to make updates to Figma designs, evaluate and refine AI-generated prototypes, draft design system documentation, and speed up day-to-day production work.

*Nice to Have*

*

Experience designing financial services software - ideally trading systems, trading idea /research management systems, or risk management systems - for the Front Office at hedge funds or asset management firms.

*

Experience contributing directly to a formal design system or component library, in any capacity.

*

Front-end literacy (HTML/CSS fundamentals) sufficient to have informed conversations with engineers about implementation.

*

Experience with motion or interaction design for UI components.

*

Familiarity with Claude Design, and the ability to create and/or update Claude Code prototypes.

*Tools & Ways of Working*

Figma is our primary design tool, and the CWAN Design System is the shared source of truth for components, tokens, and patterns. AI tools — including Figma AI Design Agent, Figma Make, and Claude — are part of our everyday workflow, from making updates to Figma designs and evaluating rough AI-generated prototypes to speeding up documentation and production work, and proficiency with them is expected. Familiarity with Claude Design and Claude Code prototypes is a plus. You'll work closely with the CWAN Design System team on standards work, and with product designers and engineers on day-to-day screen work — often moving between the two in the same week.

*What we offer:*

*

Business casual atmosphere in a flexible working environment

*

Team-focused culture that promotes innovation and ownership

*

Access cutting-edge investment reporting technology and expertise

*

Defined and undefined career pathways, allowing you to grow your way

*

Competitive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits

*

Maternity and paternity leave

*

Personal Time Off and Volunteer Time Off to give back to the community

*

Work from anywhere 3 weeks out of the year

*

Work from home Fridays

*Why Join Us?* This is an incredible opportunity to lead a passionate engineering team that is shaping the future of investment management technology. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, apply now!

*Salary Range*

$156,400.00 - $210,841.00

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. For this role, benefits include: health/vision/dental insurance, 401(k), PTO, parental leave, and medical leave, STD/LTD insurance benefits. Clearwater Analytics is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.

title: Freelance Brand Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Brand Designer to join the Tendem project (**https://tendem.ai/**) and create strong visual identities for real-world brands and products.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in brand strategy, visual identity, and design systems to create cohesive, modern, and impactful brand assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in brand asset creation, visual identity development, and maintaining brand consistency.

*What We Do*

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

*About the Role*

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Brand Designer, your focus will be on brand asset creation, visual identity, and brand consistency. We need a core specialist dedicated to building a strong visual foundation. You will serve as the architect of the brand identity, modernizing aesthetics and ensuring that all visual touchpoints look cohesive across various mediums using industry-standard design tools.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Develop foundational brand assets, including logos, complete visual identities, and comprehensive color schemes.
* Create, systematically organize, and deliver necessary variations of core brand elements.
* Act as the strict gatekeeper for brand consistency across all internal and external materials, including pitch decks and social media kits.
* Build scalable, long-lasting visual systems that align with modern design standards.
* Enforce design quality through cross-platform validation, ensuring brand aesthetics translate flawlessly across both digital and print mediums.

*How to get started*

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

*Educational qualifications*

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in brand design, graphic design, art direction, or visual communications is desirable.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, Communication Design, or related creative fields is a plus.

*Academic and/or Professional Experience*

Candidates must have a strong portfolio heavily focused on brand identity creation, logo design, and comprehensive brand guidelines. We are looking for specialists with a deep understanding of how core branding translates seamlessly across different digital and print mediums. A strategic, detail-obsessed approach and the ability to work independently to build long-lasting visual systems are essential.

*Technical Skills (Essential)*

* Brand Identity Creation: Expertise in building foundational assets from scratch, including scalable logos, distinct color palettes, and typography systems.
* Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma for crafting and managing core design assets.
* Cross-Medium Adaptation: Proven ability to translate brand DNA perfectly across varied formats, from digital social media kits to corporate pitch decks and print materials.
* Brand System Architecture: Strong organizational skills to develop clear brand guidelines, style guides, and structured asset libraries for wider team use.

*Additional requirements*

* A strategic, detail-obsessed mindset focused on long-term brand equity.
* Strong dedication to visual consistency and functioning as a true brand gatekeeper.
* Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot independently and deliver high-quality assets.
* Portfolio showcasing branding work (logos, identity systems, guidelines) must be included in the CV
* English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

*Project time expectations*

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

*Compensation*

On this project, contributors can earn up to *$34 per hour equivalent* , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

title: Brand Designer & Illustrator
description:
Voucherify is looking for a versatile, self-driven Brand Designer & Illustrator to own and grow our visual identity across every touchpoint.

About the role

Voucherify is the Incentive Optimisation Engine for modern growth teams. We help brands like John Deere, Breville, Michelin, and Vodafone move beyond static discounts and loyalty theatre with flexible, API-first incentives that drive real revenue. Built for teams tired of bloated platforms and "points fatigue," Voucherify enables faster experimentation and continuous optimisation across promotions, referrals, loyalty, and rewards.

We're founder-led, bootstrapped, and product-obsessed, powering 350+ brands across ecommerce, retail, and digital services. In a crowded, technical category, how we look and sound is a real competitive edge, not decoration.

We're looking for a designer who wants to be the person behind the Voucherify brand. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a lot of range. One day you're illustrating a campaign hero, the next you're shipping a landing page in Webflow, cutting a short animated clip for LinkedIn, or designing a hoodie people actually want to wear. You'll have real ownership, a direct line to leadership, and the freedom to raise the bar on everything we put out into the world.

Watch: What (the heck) is Voucherify?

What you'll do

As our Brand Designer & Illustrator, you'll be the guardian and evolver of the Voucherify brand. You'll turn a technical, API-first product into visuals that are clear, memorable, and a bit unexpected. You'll work closely with Marketing, Sales, and Product, but you'll set the visual direction yourself.

Your responsibilities:

* Own the brand: Look after and develop our visual identity, including guidelines, illustration style, iconography, and templates, and keep it consistent as we grow.

* Create performance visuals: Design ad creatives and social media assets across LinkedIn, paid channels, and campaigns, then iterate on them based on what performs.

* Shape our website: Contribute to web design in Figma and handle simple builds and updates in Webflow, from landing pages to campaign pages and page refreshes.
* Bring things to life in motion: Produce lightweight video and motion formats: short social clips, animated explainers, product teasers, and event visuals.
* Design marketing and sales collateral: Build reports, whitepapers, ebooks, one-pagers, case studies, decks, and email/CRM templates.
* Extend the brand into the physical world: Create merch, company swag, event booths, and print materials that carry our identity beyond the screen.

About You

* Versatile designer and illustrator with 2+ years of experience in brand, marketing, or digital design, ideally in B2B SaaS or tech.
* Fluent in Figma , with hands-on Webflow experience (or a strong willingness to get there fast). You're comfortable designing for the web and implementing simple pages yourself.
* Comfortable across formats. Digital, print, video, and merch don't scare you, and you know how to adapt one idea to many.
* Curious about motion. You're at ease with lightweight animation or video editing tools.
* A true owner. You thrive with autonomy, manage your own priorities, and don't wait to be told what good looks like.
* A clear communicator who can explain design decisions, push back when needed, and collaborate well with non-designers.

Compensation & Benefits of working @Voucherify

* Agency: Real ownership of the brand with executive trust. We value autonomy and give you the freedom to do your job your way.
* Stability: We are fully bootstrapped and committed to profitability. You and our clients are our only shareholders, which means a healthy work-life balance and long-term security.
* Senior Team: Join a "small but mighty" team where your work is visible from day one. You'll get plenty of support during onboarding and have a direct line to company leadership.
* Fully Remote: Manage your own schedule. Whether it's a home-cooked lunch or errands between tasks, we care about results, not clock-punching.

title: Motion Designer
description:
*Role Summary*

We are seeking a driven Motion Designer with a sharp eye for detail and a passion for crafting fluid, high-impact digital experiences. In this role, you will bring interfaces, brands, mockups, and concepts to life, partnering closely with design and development teams to translate ideas into compelling motion systems.

You bring a distinct creative voice to every project while maintaining an open, collaborative approach to feedback and creative direction. Thriving in a fast-paced environment, you take ownership of your workflow, balance competing priorities, and consistently deliver refined work that elevates the final output.

Core Responsibilities
---------------------

*Concept Development & Motion Strategy*

*

Define Motion Systems: Establish motion languages, styleframes, animation systems, and visual standards to guide work across campaigns, UI interfaces, digital products/experiences, and branded content.

*

Visual Storytelling: Translate creative concepts into storyboards, styleframes, and visual explorations that effectively communicate vision and strategy to clients and internal teams.

*

Project Delivery & Pitching: Shape project visual and motion directions from initial concept through delivery, contributing directly to creative reviews, client pitches, and studio innovation initiatives.

*Design Execution & Production Craft*

*

Multi-Format Animation: Conceptualize and execute high-quality interface animations, UI motion, product prototypes, and typographic animation.

*

Brand Consistency: Ensure all deliverables align strictly with client brand guidelines while optimizing assets for platform-specific technical requirements and latest design trends.

*

Content Production: Edit short- and long-form video content for diverse channels, adding motion graphics, typography, transitions, sound design, color grading, and visual effects.

*Cross-Functional Collaboration & Client Engagement*

*

Integrated Partnership: Work closely with Creative Directors, Designers, Developers and Producers to craft cohesive end-to-end user experiences.

*

Stakeholder Communication: Articulate design decisions clearly to a wide range of clients—from early-stage startups to established global brands.

*Innovation, R&D & Process Optimization*

*

AI & Workflow Integration: Explore and implement AI-assisted motion workflows, automation, and emerging technologies to boost production efficiency and expand creative boundaries.

*

Motion Thought Leadership: Maintain a deep curiosity for emerging tools, techniques, and visual design trends to continuously elevate team standards and output.

Job Requirements
----------------

The following are qualifications, experience, and skills required to be successful in this role:

*

3–5+ years of motion design experience within a fast-paced agency or corporate environment (or equivalent practical experience), backed by a strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating exceptional craft, timing, narrative storytelling, and styleframe creation.

*

Mastery in Adobe After Effects, expertise in 3D software and alternative animation tools such as Cavalry, Rive and Figma Motion is a strong plus.

*

Outstanding skills in 2D animation, interface motion, and video editing for maximum engagement across platforms;

*

Strong visual judgment and confidence contributing to creative concepts, motion languages, and visual systems from initial direction to final delivery.

*

Active curiosity and openness to exploring AI-assisted creative workflows, automation tools, and modern post-production techniques to elevate output.

*

Excellent organizational, presentation, and interpersonal skills with full English proficiency, capable of articulating creative decisions clearly to internal teams and diverse clients.

title: Graphic Designer & Marketing Assistant
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Graphic Designer & Marketing Assistant based in United States.*

This role combines graphic design, branding, digital content creation, and marketing support within a fully remote environment. You will help develop and maintain a cohesive visual identity while producing engaging assets across websites, social media, email, and other digital channels. The position offers broad creative ownership, from developing brand guidelines and visual systems to supporting content calendars and marketing communications. You will work across multiple projects, balancing creativity, consistency, deadlines, and audience engagement. The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, and comfortable using modern design and AI-powered marketing tools. This is an opportunity to contribute directly to brand visibility while developing your skills across both design and marketing.

Accountabilities:
-----------------

* Support the development and implementation of complete visual brand identities.
* Develop color palettes, typography systems, imagery standards, templates, and other branded assets.
* Create and maintain brand guidelines and visual standards to ensure consistency across marketing channels.
* Design website graphics, banners, social media templates, promotional materials, and other digital marketing assets.
* Produce engaging graphics, educational content, announcements, and marketing collateral aligned with brand standards.
* Manage multiple creative and marketing projects while maintaining quality, consistency, and deadlines.
* Repurpose existing content into new visual formats and marketing materials.
* Plan, manage, and maintain social media content calendars.
* Create, design, and schedule content across relevant social media channels.
* Support ongoing social media management and digital content initiatives.
* Monitor social media performance and prepare reporting insights to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Assist with email marketing campaigns, newsletters, and other digital communications.
* Support website content updates and basic website graphic requirements.
* Use AI-powered design and marketing tools to improve content production and workflow efficiency.
* Recommend creative approaches and design improvements that strengthen brand visibility and audience engagement.
* Identify opportunities to improve digital presence and audience interaction.
* Stay informed about design trends, social media developments, and current marketing best practices.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand brand vision, target audiences, positioning, and marketing objectives.
* Incorporate feedback effectively while maintaining strong ownership of assigned projects.
* Help ensure marketing communications remain professional, visually consistent, and audience-focused.

Requirements:
-------------

* Experience in graphic design, digital marketing, content creation, branding, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of visual branding, brand consistency, and digital content development.
* Experience creating and managing content for social media platforms.
* Experience developing marketing materials, branded assets, promotional content, and digital graphics.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and ongoing marketing initiatives simultaneously.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of projects, and manage priorities in a remote environment.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to translate ideas into clear marketing content.
* Familiarity with social media analytics, performance tracking, and reporting.
* Experience using AI-powered design and marketing tools.
* Proficiency with Canva and Canva Pro.
* Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite.
* Experience with social media management and scheduling platforms.
* Familiarity with email marketing platforms and digital communication tools.

title: Product Designer
description:
*****************************
*Product Designer at Restate*
*****************************

Restate () is a lightweight runtime that turns *AI agents, workflows, and backend services into durable processes* - so teams can focus on their logic, not failure mechanics.

*The role:* We're looking for a Product Designer to shape Restate's core product experience.

This role covers both, the core Restate UI with the design system behind it and the visual work that makes durable execution understandable to developers.

You'll work directly with the engineers who build the product and with the wider founding team.

-----------------
*The opportunity*
-----------------

*Front-row seat to the biggest infra shift in decades*

Durable runtimes like Restate are becoming the *next foundational infrastructure component* - and increasingly a *critical piece for AI applications*. As systems become more agentic, long-running, integration-heavy, and failure-prone, durable execution turns reliability from a bespoke engineering tax into a default property. In this role, you’re not watching that shift from the sidelines - you help build the platform that enables it.

*State-of-the-art tech, built from first principles*

Restate re-imagines durable execution as a lightweight self-contained stack - no database required - and ships as a *single Rust binary* with an optimized custom storage layer, low latency orchestration, and an analytics engine for observability.

*Enterprise Traction*

Restate is already used by *Fortune 500 companies* , including *Tier 1 banks* running *critical financial workflows* , and also by *cutting-edge AI and infra startups* pushing the boundary of what “production-grade agents” mean. You’ll work on problems where reliability, correctness, and operational simplicity are existential.

*Work with world-class engineers*

You’ll partner directly with engineers who’ve built and operated foundational systems at scale - *creators of Apache Flink* , and leaders from *Meta’s messaging infrastructure*. You’ll have the chance to work with incredibly talented individuals who care deeply about their craft.

----------------
*What you’ll do*
----------------

On the core product:

*

Design the core Restate UI: from whiteboarding sessions with engineers to shipping. You won't be writing the production code, but you stay with it until it's right.

*

Make dense information readable: execution timelines, retries, queues, state, failures. Our users are engineers working out what happened, usually in a hurry, and deciding what they see first is most of the work.

*

Keep one mental model: developers meet the same concepts in the UI, the SDKs and the docs. They should be named and presented the same way wherever someone runs into them.

*

Bring durable execution to life visually: the current Restate product is loved for its simplicity in breaking down a technically complex product. You'll make sure we keep shipping at the same design bar.

Around the product:

*

Explain Restate's architecture visually: interactive and animated explanations that make the key differentiators clear.

*

Motion as a first-class medium: Restate is a living, durable system, and we want to design with motion to convey that.

*

Ship across surfaces: developer-facing content, blog illustrations, social visuals, and more.

*

Keep it coherent with the product: the visual language that explains Restate from the outside and the one inside the product should be the same language.

Across both:

*

Build scalable design systems: reusable components and patterns for architecture diagrams, code visualizations, and interactive elements that others can benefit from.

*

Work closely with design and engineering: skip the traditional handoff and iterate together, from first sketch through to shipped.

------------------------
*What we’re looking for*
------------------------

*The profile*

We're looking for a product designer with strong opinions and a portfolio that backs them up, covering both halves: complex product work you've designed, and visual work that explains something technical. You should be comfortable operating with significant autonomy, working directly with the founding team, and pushing back when the team is wrong.

You don't have to write production code. You do have to understand what you're designing for well enough to have the argument with an engineer and sometimes win it.

Must-haves:

*

Product design depth on complex software. Several years designing tools, dashboards, or platforms. Not only marketing sites and consumer apps.

*

Information design. Turning a lot of data into something a person can read quickly. Hierarchy, density, progressive disclosure, and knowing what to leave out.

*

Visual storytelling for technical concepts. Show us how you've made something complex feel obvious.

*

Brand and campaign craft. Layout, typography, illustration, launch visuals. Work that stands up next to the best in developer tools.

*

Motion design ability. Motion as a way to communicate state, time, and dynamism.

*

Design systems. Reusable components and patterns others can build on, and the discipline to keep them coherent over time.

*

Strong design sensibility. A high visual bar you can hold across the product and the work that explains it, without waiting for someone to set the direction first. We're not precious about which tools you get there with.

*

Technical curiosity. You don't need a distributed systems background, but you should be able to follow what the product does and design from understanding rather than from a screenshot.

*

Writing. Labels, empty states, error messages, headlines.

*

AI literacy. You're using AI to multiply your own impact and to unblock yourself.

Nice-to-haves:

*

Prior work on a developer tools, infrastructure, or AI product. Familiarity with the developer audience and what "great" looks like in this space.

*

Experience building or contributing to a design system in production.

*

Prototyping in code, or enough HTML and CSS to communicate an idea precisely.

Not a fit:

*

You've only designed complex software, or only made things look good from the outside. We need both.

*

You expect a finished brief, or heavy direction. We need someone who arrives with a point of view and designs.

*

You want to lead a design team rather than be the senior IC doing the work yourself.

*

You're not interested in technical subject matter. Our surface area is wide, and the role lives or dies on translating it.

----------------------------------
*Engagement, location, and travel*
----------------------------------

*

Location: remote in Europe preferred; US remote for exceptional candidates

*

Travel: minimal; occasional team offsites.

Strong hands-on capabilities across both web design and web development.

Proficiency with Webflow, Framer, Wix Studio, or comparable no-code/low-code platforms.

Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, responsive design, visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, and layout.

*

Strong understanding of corporate and enterprise branding and the ability to apply digital brand guidelines consistently.

*

Excellent visual design skills, with a strong eye for detail, interactions, animations, and overall digital presentation.

Experience creating polished websites, landing pages, and microsites to a professional visual standard.

*

A strong portfolio demonstrating projects that showcase both design and development capabilities.

*

Experience working with B2B, technology, SaaS, enterprise, or corporate brands is an advantage.

*

Strong creative and conceptual thinking, with the ability to contribute ideas and influence digital visual direction.

*

Ability to translate business objectives into distinctive, credible, and user-friendly digital experiences.

*

Comfortable working independently and taking ownership across ideation, design, development, and deployment.

*

Strong communication, stakeholder-management, organization, and time-management skills.

Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure *AI agents, LLM-powered applications, and the data they access*.

Use AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, and problem-solving.

Experience building performant tables, timelines, dashboards, or other interfaces handling large datasets.

Strong frontend testing experience across *unit, component, and end-to-end testing*.

description:

Our client is a global leading, end-to end enterprise volunteer engagement platform powering over 100 million volunteer hours. They exist to connect communities to events and causes they are passionate about. Used by over 3 million volunteers across 26 different countries, their SaaS platform powers mass volunteer programs across the globe for Not-for-Profits, local government, sporting federations, and major events. Our all in one solution helps our clients to recruit, retain, reward and train their volunteers, whilst also ensuring compliance.

Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast-

scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and

accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high

performing global teams simple, fast, and cost-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers,

designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.

Join our client’s Product Design Team as a Senior Product Designer and help shape the experience of a global volunteering platform. You'll work alongside passionate designers, engineers, and product managers to solve real problems and create intuitive experiences that make a genuine impact.

In this role, you'll transform customer insights into compelling designs that drive business growth and elevate user satisfaction. If you're looking for meaningful challenges, a collaborative team environment, and opportunities to innovate and grow your craft, we'd love to hear from you.

* Lead the end-to-end design process — from discovery and research through to high-fidelity design and delivery
* Conduct user research and usability testing to gather insights, validate solutions, and continuously improve the platform
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to experiment, innovate, and iterate quickly in an agile environment
* Champion the customer voice in every decision, turning insight into shared team understanding
* Create journey maps, user flows, information architecture, and interactive prototypes that inform product decisions
* Balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints to deliver products that drive satisfaction and growth
* Identify and prioritize UX improvements across the platform and contribute to our evolving design system
* Ensure accessibility, usability, and desirability across all platform experiences
* Track product performance through analytics and user feedback, and iterate against it
* Partner with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to shape strategy, roadmap, and delivery

What You'll Need

* Experience & craft
* 5+ years of product design experience, ideally in B2B SaaS or growth-stage companies
* A portfolio that shows your process and reasoning, not just finished screens
* Strong UI craft with a passion for accessible, functional interfaces
* Experience designing complex workflows for web, mobile, or native applications
* Product & problem-solving skills

Nice to have:

* Defining and designing AI-based solutions

title: Product Manager
description:
*About the role*
----------------

We are looking for a Product Manager to own treasury for our HCM (Human Capital Management) platform, the systems that move money reliably across currencies, banking partners, and borders so our global clients can trust that payroll lands correctly, every time. You will own execution across the full product lifecycle for treasury and funds flow, from discovery through delivery, working cross-functionally with engineering, finance/treasury operations, compliance, and go-to-market.

This is a role for someone who has done this before – You have owned a roadmap involving money movement, banking rails, or payments infrastructure, and you know how to turn ambiguity, and the real constraints of financial regulation, into a clear plan without.

You will report directly to our Head of Product.

*What You'll Do*
----------------

*Product development*

* Drive discovery, market research, competitive analysis, and roadmap development across the treasury and funds-flow lifecycle, funding models, banking partnerships, payment rails, and FX
* Own the product experience for billing, invoicing, credit memos, and payment application, working closely with finance and business operations
* Translate strategy into clear, actionable requirements and user stories engineering can build from
* Own product documentation (business cases, use cases, technical requirements, and expected ROI) with particular attention to compliance and risk implications
* Make sure every release lines up with both customer needs and company goals, without compromising financial controls

*Stakeholder engagement*

* Turn feedback from internal stakeholders (finance, treasury ops, compliance) and external customers into concrete prioritization decisions
* Act as the connective tissue between engineering and the rest of the business, keeping treasury features aligned with market needs and regulatory requirements
* Partner with engineering, QA, design, compliance, and banking partners to plan, build, and launch
* Run Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews) and keep them useful, not performative
* Work with QA to define testing strategy and protect release quality, especially around fund movement and reconciliation

*Market awareness & research*

* Stay sharp on treasury, banking, and payments trends, regulatory shifts, customer pain points, and the competitive landscape
* Use that knowledge to keep the roadmap a step ahead, not just reactive

*Documentation & reporting*

* Keep clear, current documentation for project plans, timelines, requirements, and status
* Communicate progress and learnings to stakeholders on a regular cadence
* Develop external-facing content on treasury-related features and functionality for customers

*What You’ll Bring*
-------------------

* 3-5 years of experience in product management or a closely related role at a technology or SaaS company
* A track record of owning the product lifecycle and shipping impactful B2B solutions, ideally involving payments, treasury, or money movement
* Strong collaboration and communication skills. You will work fluidly across engineering, design, finance, and compliance teams
* Comfort turning complex business and regulatory needs into clear technical requirements
* Real experience in Agile environments, including hands-on sprint planning and backlog grooming
* A customer-first mindset balanced with strategic thinking and tactical execution
* A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and fast pace
* Experience in treasury, payments, fintech, or banking infrastructure is strongly preferred; HCM or enterprise software experience is a plus
* Familiarity with billing, invoicing, AR, and pricing models (tiered pricing especially) in a B2B context
* Exposure to ERP systems — ERPNext experience is a plus

Product experience in cybersecurity, including *DLP, CASB, SIEM, EDR, CSPM/CNAPP, or AI security*.

Strong practical knowledge of a major cloud provider, including services, IAM, and inventory/audit APIs.

Engineering background or hands-on scripting experience, particularly *Python*.

Experience introducing AI-assisted or agentic workflows into product teams.

AI is a core part of how this team works.

title: Product Manager
description:
*About the Client*

Our client is a global leading, end-to-end enterprise volunteer engagement platform powering over 100 million volunteer hours. They exist to connect communities to events and causes they are passionate about. Used by over 3 million volunteers across 26 different countries, their SaaS platform powers mass volunteer programs across the globe for Not-for-Profits, local government, sporting federations, and major events. Our all in one solution helps our clients to recruit, retain, reward and train their volunteers, whilst also ensuring compliance.

*About Teamified*

Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast-scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high performing global teams simple, fast, and cost-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers, designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.

*About The Role*

We're looking for a mid-level Product Manager to join us in working directly with customers to understand their pain points and turning individual tasks into solutions that scale across our whole customer base. This role sits across web and mobile, with a strong focus on compliance and platform consistency, and partners closely with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting, and Support.

This is a role for someone who is genuinely curious about customers and how the product works in their hands, who can hold their own in a triad, and who's comfortable making prioritization calls backed by evidence rather than instinct alone.

*What you'll work on*

* Work directly with customers to understand pain points and use cases, with a particular focus on customer-raised asks and requests
* Translate individual customer problems into solutions that can be rolled out to the broader customer base, not just the requesting account
* Understand and solve for compliance requirements across both web and mobile platforms
* Translate web features into mobile features, ensuring parity and platform-appropriate design
* Define and prioritize projects and tasks based on evidence and stakeholder consultation
* Proactively report on progress and challenges to stakeholders and leadership
* Own and drive product briefs, working in close collaboration with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting (SC), and Support
* Run gap analyses across multiple areas of the platform to identify where it falls short of customer or compliance needs

*Requirements*

*What you bring*

* 3-5 years of experience in Product Management (or equivalent experience translating customer needs into shipped features)
* Genuine curiosity about customers and how they use the product
* Ability to clearly articulate problems, proposed solutions, and recommendations, including the trade-offs behind them
* Strong communication skills, confident and articulate with customers, internal stakeholders, and engineers alike
* Demonstrated experience working within a triad model (Product, Engineering, UX) and directly with customers
* Solid instincts for user experience, knowing what makes a feature usable, not just functional
* Comfort working across both web and mobile product surfaces

*Nice to have*

* Experience with AI tools applied to product workflows
* Data-driven decision making
* Experience defining and measuring success metrics for shipped features
* Ability to uncover common themes across disparate customer feedback

*Why this role matters*

This PM sits close to the customer, translating real, individual problems into solutions that hold up across the whole platform and customer base. The work directly shapes how consistent, compliant, and usable the product feels across web and mobile, and gives you real ownership over problems from discovery through to delivery.

*Benefits*

* Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time.
* Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
* A collaborative, no-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
* A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
* Health insurance
* Leave Benefits
* 13th Month Pay

If you possess the required skills and are eager to contribute to our team's success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. *Apply now!*

ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

You will serve as a front-line manager for a team of Enterprise Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) responsible for outbound prospecting and pipeline generation across Ramp’s largest and most strategic accounts.

As Ramp expands its upmarket presence, you will help build and evolve the Enterprise go-to-market motion from the ground up. You will lead and develop high-performing SDRs who manage named books of business and navigate complex, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles.

Key responsibilities include coaching and developing SDRs, setting team strategy, and partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and executive leadership to drive enterprise pipeline and business outcomes. As a member of the Sales Leadership team, you will play a critical role in shaping, scaling, and refining Ramp’s Enterprise growth strategy.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build and scale the Enterprise SDR function, including team structure, playbooks, and processes for a named-account motion.

- Foster a high-performing team culture by managing daily activity, quota attainment, and key performance metrics.

- Hire, onboard, and train SDRs on Ramp’s products, enterprise buyer personas, competitive landscape, and sales tools.

- Create and execute career-development and leadership plans for direct reports, including regular 1:1 coaching on time management, objection handling, enterprise prospecting, and active listening.

- Coach SDRs through complex, multi-threaded enterprise outbound motions, including account research, executive-level messaging, and strategic pipeline generation.

- Partner with Sales and Marketing to develop and execute initiatives that advance company objectives.

- Report on team performance and forecast pipeline to senior leadership.

- Improve team output and efficiency by continuously optimizing systems, processes, and operating rhythms.

- Represent the Enterprise Sales Development team in cross-functional forums and with leaders across the organization.

WHAT YOU NEED

- At least 2 years of quota-carrying individual-contributor sales experience, with a consistent record of exceeding goals.

- At least 3 years of experience building and leading sales development teams, with a demonstrated record of exceeding team goals.

- Success in fast-paced, results-oriented go-to-market environments (ideally within SaaS) and a history of outperforming quota in outbound sales.

- Experience managing or selling into enterprise accounts with complex, longer sales cycles.

- A passion for hiring and talent development, with a thoughtful approach to team planning and career growth.

- Ability to articulate contractual, technical, and financial value propositions to customers, including executive stakeholders.

- Proficiency with data-analysis tools, as well as familiarity with email and call-automation platforms.

- Ability to use data to inform decisions, build scalable systems, and identify process improvements that increase conversion and efficiency.

- Strong collaboration, communication, influence, and presentation skills.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience selling financial-services products in a full-cycle sales role.

- Experience building an Enterprise SDR function from the ground up or scaling a team within a new segment.

- Experience at a high-growth startup.

- Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university.
