title: Risk & Control Manager
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

We're looking for a Manager to join our Risk & Control team at Pleo. In this role, you'll operate as a key part of our Second Line of Defence, helping to strengthen the risk management framework that underpins everything we do — from our product to our regulatory relationships. You'll work at the intersection of risk expertise and business partnership, offering thoughtful challenges and practical guidance to our First Line teams as we continue to scale. If you're excited by the prospect of shaping how a fast-growing FinTech approaches risk maturity, and are passionate about building robust, pragmatic control environments, this is the role for you.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Risk Manager, you will:

- Strengthen our risk framework – Contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Pleo's 2LOD risk management framework, ensuring it remains aligned with regulatory expectations and our evolving business strategy.

- Review and challenge the First Line – Execute effective oversight activities of the 1LOD, assessing the quality of risk identification, control design, and ongoing management across the business.

- Be a trusted risk partner – Act as a go-to advisor for business teams and 1LOD stakeholders, providing expert guidance on risk topics, regulatory change, and the broader control environment.

- Drive insightful risk reporting – Support the development and preparation of clear, data-informed risk reports for senior management and relevant governance committees, surfacing key risk exposures and control gaps.

- Support regulatory engagement – Contribute to interactions with regulators on risk and control matters, drawing on your subject matter expertise to support well-prepared, credible responses.

WHAT YOU BRING

YOU’LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE:

- Solid financial services experience – Around 5–7 years of experience in a regulated financial services environment (FinTech, banking, payments, or similar), with at least 3 years focused on risk or control management.

- Credit risk experience - A solid understanding of the assessment and management of credit risk

- A strong risk and control foundation – A professional background rooted in risk management and control functions, with hands-on experience in execution and assurance activities. Experience spanning both 1LOD and 2LOD is a real plus.

- The ability to influence – A proven track record of engaging and influencing stakeholders on complex or sensitive risk topics, with the confidence to challenge constructively and the credibility to be heard.

- Clear, collaborative communication – The ability to translate risk concepts into practical, accessible language for a range of audiences, from technical teams to senior leadership.

- A pragmatic, solutions-oriented mindset – A passion for finding workable answers to real risk challenges, rather than defaulting to theoretical frameworks alone.

Highly desirable: Experience at both a FinTech and a traditional banking or payments institution is something we'd particularly welcome. And while 5–7 years is our general expectation, exceptional candidates with around 4 years of deeply relevant experience are encouraged to apply.

This role is not suited to candidates whose background is primarily in professional services/consultancy, internal audit, or compliance without substantial risk and control experience.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You'll report directly to our Head of Risk and Control and work closely with First Line teams across the business. Our Risk & Control function is collaborative by design — you'll have regular exposure to senior stakeholders and the opportunity to partner with teams spanning Product, Operations, Finance, and Compliance to drive a culture of sound risk management across Pleo.

HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE
IN YOUR FIRST 12 MONTHS AT PLEO, YOU’LL:

- Get under the skin of Pleo's risk landscape and take ownership of key 2LOD review and challenge activities across priority business areas.

- Play an active role in evolving our risk framework as the company continues to scale — contributing your expertise to initiatives that will shape how we manage risk for years to come.

- Build strong relationships across the business, establishing yourself as a credible and trusted voice on risk matters.

We're committed to helping you grow here — whether that means deepening your technical expertise, expanding your regulatory knowledge, or stepping into broader leadership responsibilities as the team develops.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25+ days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Junior Product Manager
description:

title: Junior Full-Stack Web Developer
description:
***************************
Junior Full-Stack Developer
***************************

*Full-Time | $7-$10 USD/Hour Starting*
*Remote | Philippines or Indonesia*

--------------
About the Role
--------------

We are looking for a smart, resourceful junior full-stack developer who wants the opportunity to grow into a major engineering role.

This position is designed for someone early in their career who already understands the fundamentals of web development but has the potential to become much more. You do not need to know everything yet. We care more about your problem-solving ability, technical curiosity, communication skills, and willingness to learn.

You will work across our SaaS platform—building features, fixing bugs, improving user workflows, and testing your own work. Initially, you will receive smaller, clearly defined assignments. As your skills and understanding of the product grow, you will be given greater responsibility and more complex projects.

We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company—not someone looking for a short-term freelance project.

----------------
Responsibilities
----------------

Full-Stack Development
----------------------

* Build and improve frontend and backend features.
* Fix bugs throughout the application.
* Create and update user interfaces, forms, validation rules, and workflows.
* Work with APIs, databases, and third-party integrations.
* Read and understand an existing codebase.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-organized code.
* Use Git to manage code changes and collaborate with the engineering team.
* Participate in code reviews and apply feedback from senior developers.
* Assist with deployments and post-deployment verification.

Testing and Product Quality
---------------------------

* Test your own work thoroughly before submitting it for review.
* Reproduce and investigate customer-reported issues.
* Identify edge cases and unexpected user behavior.
* Write clear bug reports with reproduction steps, screenshots, or videos.
* Perform regression testing to ensure changes do not break existing features.
* Recommend improvements to usability, performance, and reliability.

------------
Requirements
------------

* *You must be able to independently read, understand, and evaluate code.
* *Do not apply if you rely on Claude to generate code that you cannot explain, debug, or verify yourself.***
* Basic full-stack web development experience.
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Git.
* Familiarity with frontend frameworks such as React.
* Basic understanding of backend development, APIs, and databases.
* Ability to troubleshoot problems using browser developer tools and logs.
* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

* Ability to work independently and manage assigned tasks.
* Willingness to work overnight locally during U.S. business hours.
* Reliable computer and internet connection.

------------------------
Preferred Qualifications
------------------------

* Familiarity with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
* Experience building personal, school, freelance, or professional web applications.
* Experience working with REST APIs and relational databases.
* Familiarity with SaaS applications and subscription-based products.
* Experience with Asana or similar project-management tools.
* A GitHub profile, portfolio, or working application that demonstrates your abilities.
* Previous experience working with a remote international team.

Professional experience is helpful, but it is not required if you can demonstrate strong technical ability through projects or practical work.

-----------------------
What We Are Looking For
-----------------------

The ideal candidate:

* Learns quickly and actively searches for solutions.
* Can take a problem from investigation through implementation and testing.
* Is comfortable admitting when they do not know something.
* Accepts feedback without becoming defensive.

What Success Looks Like

* Questions are thoughtful, specific, and asked early.
* Mistakes are learned from and are not repeatedly made.
* Knowledge of the platform grows steadily.

* Responsibility and compensation can increase as technical ability and contribution grow.

title: Junior Computer Vision / ML Engineer
description:
🚀 Project Description
Facie is an early-stage AI product working with face image analysis.
We are looking for a strong Junior Computer Vision / ML Engineer to build a reliable mechanism for measuring facial geometry from photos.

The first challenge is straightforward to describe but non-trivial to solve: given a face photo, accurately measure numerical parameters of different facial features, such as eye dimensions, mouth dimensions, nose geometry, jaw proportions, distances between facial landmarks, and other geometric characteristics.

This is a greenfield CV problem.
You will not receive a predefined model or a detailed list of experiments to execute. We expect you to explore several possible approaches, quickly validate them, discard what does not work, and find a solution that is good enough to move into the product.

At phase 1 - our engineering philosophy is simple:
20% of effort that delivers 80% of the result is often better than spending weeks searching for theoretical perfection.

✅ You are:

Confident with Python
Understand core Machine Learning concepts
Have practical experience with Computer Vision OR can demonstrate serious interest in the field
Can work with existing open-source models and libraries
Comfortable reading unfamiliar code and quickly running existing projects
Understand basic model inference and API concepts
Able to turn an unclear problem into several testable hypotheses
Comfortable when the first approach does not work
Able to explain how you would validate whether an experiment actually works
Focused on finding a practical solution rather than endlessly optimizing one approach
Comfortable using Git and working with an engineering team
Commercial Computer Vision experience is not required.

If your primary background is general ML or software engineering, we would still like to talk if you can demonstrate genuine interest in CV through things such as:
university or online CV courses
pet projects
GitHub projects
Kaggle
research or thesis work
reproduced papers
personal experiments

➕ Will be a plus:

OpenCV
PyTorch or TensorFlow
MediaPipe or other face landmark solutions
Experience with face detection, landmarks or segmentation
Understanding of 2D / 3D geometry
Experience reading and implementing research papers
Docker
Model serving or inference pipelines
Experience exposing ML functionality through an API
Experience designing reproducible ML experiments
Experience with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex or similar AI development tools

♟️ What We Expect from You:

Experiment-first thinking - generate several possible approaches instead of betting everything on the first idea
80/20 mindset - optimize for time-to-market and find the simplest solution that provides enough accuracy for the product
Ownership - do not wait for someone to define every next experiment for you
Validation mindset - always ask how we know that a result is actually correct, especially when perfect ground truth does not exist
Fast iteration - prototype, measure, learn, discard weak approaches and move forward
Engineering judgment - understand when ML is needed and when deterministic geometry or conventional code is a better solution
AI adoption - actively use modern AI coding tools when they help you iterate faster
AI skepticism - understand and verify AI-generated code instead of blindly trusting it
Clear communication - explain what you tried, what failed, what worked and what you recommend trying next

🔑 Responsibilities:

Research different approaches for measuring facial geometry from images
Build quick prototypes and experiments
Evaluate existing Computer Vision models and open-source solutions
Compare multiple approaches using measurable criteria
Design practical validation methods when perfect ground truth is unavailable
Analyze failure cases and identify why particular approaches fail
Select solutions based on accuracy, complexity and time-to-market
Build a reproducible facial geometry measurement pipeline
Document experiments, conclusions and technical decisions
Prepare successful solutions so they can be integrated by Software Engineers
Ideally, help turn successful prototypes into an inference service or API
Proactively suggest the next experiments instead of waiting for detailed tasks

🤖 AI-assisted Engineering

We actively use modern AI development tools.
You are welcome to use Cursor, Claude Code, Codex or similar tools to write code, explore libraries, integrate models and accelerate experiments.
We do not care whether every line of code was written manually.
We do care whether you understand:
what you are testing
why you selected a particular approach
whether the result can be trusted
how you validated it
what the generated code actually does
what you would try next if the approach fails

🍩 What We Offer:

Part-time or Full-time depending on the candidate
Remote work
A real Computer Vision problem with direct impact on the product
Significant ownership of the CV direction
Freedom to experiment with different technologies and approaches
Access to paid AI development tools where needed
Direct communication with the founder and engineering team
Opportunity to build a Computer Vision system from the greenfield stage into production
Opportunity to grow from Strong Junior toward independently owning an ML / CV product area

🗣 Recruitment Process:

Intro Interview → Live Problem-Solving Session → Small Practical Experiment → Final Interview

💻 Live Problem-Solving Session (Optional)

This is not LeetCode and not a theoretical ML exam.
You will receive a previously unseen Computer Vision problem and will be asked to think aloud and visualize your approach using a whiteboard, Paint, FigJam or a similar tool.
We want to understand:
how you decompose an unclear problem
how many reasonable approaches you can generate
what you would test first
how you prioritize experiments
how you validate results
what you do when the first few approaches fail
when you decide that a solution is good enough to ship

🧪 Practical Experiment (Optional)
Selected candidates will receive a small Computer Vision experiment.
You can use:
AI coding tools
Google
documentation
open-source models
existing libraries
research papers
We are not testing your ability to code without assistance.

We are testing your ability to turn an ambiguous CV problem into a working and validated solution quickly.

The expected output is a small working prototype plus a short explanation of:
approaches considered
approach selected
why it was selected
how the result was validated
discovered limitations or failure cases
what you would try next with one additional day

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
---------------------

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:

title: Senior Application Support Engineer – US (Remote)
description:
*About Us*

Zact is a Fintech innovator dedicated to a singular idea : Organizations need simpler expense and payment management systems that align the spending employee with finance and accounting while providing inherent guardrails and continuous reconciliation with financial systems.
Zact enables all parts of the company to Pay by the Rules.

*About the Role*

We are building out a dedicated Application Support function for our commercial card and payments platform — a GCP-hosted, microservices-based SaaS product used by banking clients. This *Senior Application Support Engineer* will be the technical anchor of that team, leading a team of two junior analysts.

This is an investigative, system-thinking, and automation-first role. You will own complex incident triage end-to-end, build the monitoring and alerting foundation, and systematically automate the repetitive tasks that slow support teams down. You will also be the primary technical point of contact for banking client escalations and the person who builds the knowledge infrastructure the whole team runs on.

*Location*

* Zact is a global company with multiple locations across US, Europe and India.
* We provide 100% Remote Working Option.
* Candidates applying for this role should be located in the United States.

*What Makes This Role Different From a Standard Support Position*

You will lead the team and work the queue alongside them — this is a hands-on lead role, not a supervisory one. Beyond ticket handling, you are expected to identify patterns, eliminate root causes permanently, and help design and build the back-office tools and support functions the team needs. You will have real influence over how the product is monitored and how engineering is held accountable for supportability.

*What You’ll Own*

*Incident leadership & triage*

* Lead triage of complex, multi-service incidents — from first signal to root cause, with a documented timeline throughout
* Use GCP Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, and distributed tracing to trace failures across microservice boundaries
* Write MySQL queries to investigate transaction, card, and account data issues in production read replicas — following strict change-control at all times
* Own post-incident reviews (PIRs): root cause, contributing factors, timeline, and preventive actions
* Act as the senior technical escalation for banking client issues — calm, precise, and solution-oriented

*Monitoring & observability*

* Design and maintain the team’s alerting strategy in GCP Cloud Monitoring — setting thresholds, reducing alert noise, and ensuring the right signals fire at the right severity
* Build and maintain dashboards (Grafana, GCP Monitoring, or equivalent) covering transaction throughput, API error rates, service latency, and MySQL query performance
* Define and track SLIs/SLOs for key product flows — payments authorisation, settlement processing, card management — and surface degradation early
* Instrument new services in partnership with engineering: ensure every new microservice ships with adequate logging, structured log fields, and correlation IDs

*Back-office tooling & automation*

* Help design and build the internal back-office tools and support functions the team needs to operate effectively — this is not off-the-shelf tooling configuration; it includes scoping, designing, and writing the tools from scratch where needed
* Example: an internal investigation dashboard that pulls GCP log context and MySQL transaction data for a given incident ID in one view
* Example: automated log correlation scripts that surface the root cause of a known error pattern in under 2 minutes
* Example: MySQL query templates that auto-populate with a transaction ID and return the full investigation snapshot
* Example: alert-to-ticket automation that pre-populates incident records with log context and affected service
* Write and maintain automation tooling in Python and/or Bash — scripts, schedulers, data reconciliation jobs
* Build internal CLI tools or runbook-linked scripts that junior analysts can invoke safely without senior oversight
* Identify manual reconciliation or reporting tasks that can be replaced by scheduled queries or GCP Cloud Functions
* Own the tooling roadmap for the support function — prioritise what gets built next based on toil volume and incident frequency

*Client technical support*

* Serve as the senior technical point of contact for all customer-facing product issues that escalate beyond first-line resolution
* Write clear, jargon-free incident communications for banking client operations teams during and after incidents
* Work directly with client technical teams (bank IT, card ops) to diagnose integration issues, file format mismatches, or API usage errors
* Maintain a client-facing known-issues log and service status communication cadence

*Documentation & knowledge management*

* Build and own the team’s runbook library — step-by-step investigation procedures for every known failure pattern across the product suite
* Write and maintain a MySQL query reference for common support investigations (transaction lookup, card status, spend limit checks, settlement reconciliation)
* Document every new incident type in a known-issues catalogue: symptom, root cause, resolution, recurrence trigger, and prevention status
* Produce onboarding materials that bring a new junior analyst to independent productivity within 6 weeks
* Maintain a living architecture reference showing how services connect, what each service owns, and which logs to check first for each component

*Team leadership — hands-on*

* Lead a small, global support team — you are a working lead, not a manager removed from the queue; you will handle tickets alongside the analysts based on volume and complexity
* Mentor and develop two junior application support analysts — review their investigations, coach their SQL and log techniques, and build their confidence on live incidents
* Run daily standups and weekly incident reviews across time zones — keeping a distributed team coordinated and nothing falling between shifts
* Define team support processes: ticket triage criteria, severity classification, escalation thresholds, SLA tracking
* Partner with engineering and product to represent the support team’s perspective — surfacing recurring issues, requesting observability improvements, and advocating for supportability in new releases

*Technology Environment*

* *Cloud platform:* Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* *Log & monitoring:* GCP Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Pub/Sub; Grafana
* *Database:* MySQL — production read replicas for investigation; strict change-control for any writes
* *Architecture:* Microservices — REST APIs with correlation ID tracing across service boundaries
* *Scripting & automation:* Python (primary), Bash — for tooling, automation, and log parsing
* *Ticketing:* Internal ticketing system (Jira or equivalent)
* *Product domain:* Commercial card programs — card issuance, authorization, settlement, spend controls, reporting
* *Client environment:* Banking clients (community and regional banks) — regulated, SLA-bound, audit-sensitive

*What We’re Looking For*

* 8+ years in application support, platform operations, or a technical operations role with a team leadership component
* MySQL proficiency — writing complex queries, reading execution plans, diagnosing slow queries, understanding index behaviour
* GCP experience — hands-on with Cloud Logging (log queries, log-based metrics), Cloud Monitoring (alerting policies, uptime checks), and ideally Cloud Functions or Pub/Sub
* Microservice troubleshooting — comfortable tracing a failure across 3–5 services using correlation IDs and structured logs
* Python or Bash scripting — you have written automation tools that saved real time, not just one-off scripts
* Methodical incident investigation — you document as you go, form hypotheses, test them, and do not guess
* Strong written communication — incident updates, PIRs, client communications, and runbooks are all part of your normal output
* Experience building or significantly contributing to a team knowledge base or runbook library

*Nice to Have*

* Experience with distributed tracing tools — Cloud Trace, Jaeger, Zipkin, or equivalent
* Grafana dashboard authoring
* Exposure to SRE practices: SLO definition, error budgets, toil reduction
* Familiarity with GCP Cloud Functions, Cloud Scheduler, or Workflows for automation
* Experience administering Zendesk — configuring ticket views, SLA policies, macros, triggers, automations, and reporting; familiarity with Zendesk API or webhook integrations is a bonus
* Background in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment — fintech, banking, healthcare, or telecoms
* Familiarity with commercial card concepts (authorisation flows, settlement, BIN management, spend controls) — helpful but fully trainable

*Note on Domain Experience*

Prior fintech or banking experience is helpful but not a requirement. What matters is depth in GCP, MySQL, and microservice troubleshooting — and the instinct to automate. We provide structured onboarding into the product domain and a growing runbook library to support ramp-up.

*Working Hours & Expectations*

* Standard shift of 8–10 hours per day, with some overlap with US hours.
* Remote-friendly; in-person collaboration expectations to be discussed by region

title: Junior Information Security & Compliance Analyst

* Collect, organize, and continuously refresh audit evidence for SOC 2 and PCI DSS – owning the evidence repository so that auditor and customer requests can be answered efficiently

* Support SOC 2 and PCI DSS audit cycles – track requests, meet internal due dates, and prepare materials for auditor communications led by senior staff

* Maintain the policy and procedure library including version control, the annual review calendar, approval records, and employee attestation tracking

* Support vendor risk assessments – collect SOC 2 reports, DPAs, and security questionnaires, maintain the vendor inventory, and flag gaps for senior review

* Build and maintain security and compliance metrics reporting – open vulnerabilities, SLA performance, access review status, and training completion

* Write and maintain runbooks, SOPs, and checklists for recurring work so that it is repeatable and transferable

**Requirements and Qualifications**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills – able to ask a busy system owner for evidence and actually get it, and to write documentation an auditor will accept

* Sound judgment and discretion handling sensitive, regulated, and confidential information including customer PII and NPI

* Coachability and genuine curiosity about security – willing to be taught and willing to say "I don't know" early rather than let an item quietly slip

* Health, dental, and vision plans

title: Junior Solutions Architect
description:
*About the Organization*
Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.

Redhorse transforms the way government utilizes data and technology. We are seeking a Junior Solutions Architect to support the technical design, development, and delivery of IT and cloud solutions. In this role, you will collaborate with lead architects, system engineers, and cross-functional teams to translate mission and user requirements into secure, scalable, and resilient technical architectures. This position supports federal and Department of Defense (DoD) engagements, offering an opportunity to contribute directly to modernizing critical public-sector systems using cloud-native and DevSecOps principles.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* *Technical Design & Architecture:* Assist in the design and modeling of end-to-end architectures, system integration diagrams, and technical specifications for federal IT programs.
* *Requirements Analysis:* Collaborate with technical leads and stakeholders to decompose functional, operational, and mission requirements into structured solution designs and technical user stories.
* *Artifact Development:* Produce and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including system-of-systems diagrams, interface control documents, and architectural blueprints for government review.
* *System Integration:* Support the integration of multi-tier software applications, cloud hosting infrastructure, data engineering pipelines, and emerging artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) workflows.
* *Engineering Collaboration:* Partner with software development, infrastructure, and test teams to provide architectural guidance, troubleshoot technical challenges, and ensure compliance with design standards.
* *Security & Compliance Alignment:* Incorporate federal security baselines into architectural designs, supporting compliance with NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), FedRAMP, and DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (IL2–IL6).
* *Process Enablement:* Apply cloud-native design patterns, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and Agile development methodologies to support continuous delivery.

Required Skills
---------------

* *Security Clearance & Eligibility:* Active DoD Secret security clearance and U.S. Citizenship (mandated by federal contract requirements).
* *Professional Experience:* 4+ years of professional technical experience in software engineering, systems engineering, cloud engineering, or solutions architecture.
* *Cloud Platforms:* Demonstrated experience designing, configuring, or deploying solutions within cloud computing environments (AWS preferred).
* *Application Architecture:* Working knowledge of microservices architectures, full-stack design patterns, and API integration standards (REST, GraphQL).
* *Infrastructure Automation & Containers:* Practical experience using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* *DevSecOps & CI/CD:* Hands-on experience with automated CI/CD pipelines, version control workflows, and integrated security scanning practices.
* *Communication & Documentation:* Demonstrated ability to create clear technical documentation and communicate complex technical concepts effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Desired Skills
--------------

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (or equivalent industry certification from Azure or GCP).
* Prior experience delivering technical solutions within federal government or DoD contract environments.
* Experience utilizing collaboration and data platforms such as GitLab, Jira, and Databricks.
* Exposure to modern data architectures (e.g., data lakes, distributed data processing, ETL/ELT pipelines, Apache Spark).
* Familiarity with AI/ML integration concepts (e.g., retrieval-augmented generation [RAG], LLM APIs, MLOps workflows).
* Experience operating within Agile frameworks (e.g., Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).

The salary range provided for this position represents the anticipated base salary for successful candidates. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, skills, security clearance level, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in Redhorse's comprehensive benefits programs and may be eligible for performance-based or other incentive compensation, where applicable.

Redhorse Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by contacting Talent Acquisition at Talent-Acquisition@redhorsecorp.com

title: Junior Legal Counsel
description:
Envoy Global is a proven innovator in the global immigration space. Our mission combines our industry-leading tech platform with holistic service to streamline, simplify and expedite the immigration process for employers and individuals.

We have an opening within Envoy's growing Legal team for a *Junior Legal Counsel* to join us on a full-time basis. This role provides legal support to the in-house legal team across multiple jurisdictions in EMEA, applying a sound grounding in legal concepts and legal research to advise internal teams on straightforward matters and to assist, under supervision, on more complex matters. The role negotiates and drafts a range of commercial contracts, including in German, and coordinates with internal stakeholders to gather facts and timelines for legal projects, tracks matters through to resolution, and flags issues requiring senior input. The role requires adaptability, sound judgement on when to escalate, and the ability to work across different legal systems and languages.

*As an International Junior Legal Counsel, you will assist in managing legal matters related to our global subsidiary entities as we continue to grow organically and through M&A, including:*

*

*Advise internal teams and* *triage requests.* Serve as a first point of contact for internal legal queries; provide clear, practical advice on straightforward matters using approved guidance, playbooks and precedent, and identify and escalate more complex or high-risk matters to senior counsel with a recommended course of action.

*

*Assist on complex matters under supervision.* Support senior counsel on complex or novel legal matters and projects; carry out preparatory analysis, draft initial positions and options, and help implement agreed strategy, working within clearly defined supervision and escalation lines.

*

*Negotiate and* *draft contracts, including* *in* *German*. Draft, review and negotiate commercial contracts, NDAs and related agreements, including with German-speaking counterparties, adapting company templates and precedent to the deal at hand, and flag any departure from approved positions to senior counsel before agreeing terms.

*

*Track matters and coordinate stakeholder engagement.* Maintain trackers and dashboards reflecting the lifecycle status of contracts, renewals and corporate filings across multiple jurisdictions, and alert stakeholders to upcoming deadlines and required actions; engage with internal stakeholders across jurisdictions to gather facts, documents and timelines for legal matters and projects, and follow up on outstanding information to keep matters on schedule.

*

*Provide practical legal* *input to commercial* *and* *operational teams*. Respond to day-to-day legal queries from commercial, finance and operational stakeholders; explain legal concepts in clear business language, and route matters requiring senior input to the appropriate lawyer.

*

*Conduct legal research and pr* *oduce practical advice.* Perform legal research on statutes, regulations, case law and industry guidance relevant to ongoing matters; identify risks and key developments, and translate findings into clear, structured advice for internal stakeholders and senior counsel, including issue framing, citations and practical implications for the business.

*

*Improve contract templates and playbooks.* Identify opportunities to improve contract templates, clause libraries and negotiation playbooks; propose process improvements that reduce turnaround time and improve consistency across jurisdictions.

*

*Provide corporate governance support.* Assist with maintaining corporate records and statutory registers across multiple jurisdictions, preparing routine resolutions and filings, organizing board materials, and ensuring governance documents are accurate, up to date, and properly stored. Assist with annual compliance tasks under attorney supervision. Assist with responding to KYC and due‑diligence requests by preparing corporate information packs, coordinating cross‑functional input, and ensuring accurate, timely submissions.

*To apply for this role, you should possess the following skills, experience and qualifications:*

* 2-3 years’ experience as a lawyer, ideally in commercial or corporate legal practice, at an international in-house team and/or at a law firm.
* Proven experience drafting, reviewing, negotiating and redlining contracts, including NDAs, commercial agreements and other legal documents, in both English and German.
* Business fluency in German, with the ability to advise, negotiate and draft in German as well as English.
* Strong project‑management skills, with the ability to manage a high volume of contracts and contribute to strategic legal initiatives.
* Demonstrated capability conducting legal research and translating findings into clear, practical advice for internal stakeholders.
* Excellent time‑management and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing deadlines efficiently.
* Ability to advise independently on straightforward matters and collaborate effectively with senior counsel on complex ones, within a fast-paced, cross-border team environment.
* Experience maintaining and improving document templates, clause libraries, and standard forms.
* Strong problem‑solving skills, with the ability to identify issues early, escalate appropriately, and propose practical solutions.
* Ability to adapt quickly to different legal systems, cultures, and ways of working in an international environment.

In return, you will work for a supportive, employee-focused organization that encourages staff to achieve a work-life balance, teamwork, and communication on a global scale with other offices.

*This role is 100% remote, working from home within the United Kingdom.*

*If you feel that you meet our requirements, we look forward to hearing from you asap!*

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
*Location Qualifications:* Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Minneapolis area.

*About the position*

As an L1 Software Engineer at Showpad, you're joining at a foundational level — and that's intentional. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. You'll work within a collaborative engineering team, executing tasks with guidance, solving well-scoped problems, and deepening your understanding of what it takes to build great software at scale.

Your goal is to understand Showpad's codebase and systems, sharpen your computer science fundamentals, and progress quickly in your journey as a software engineer. You'll never be left to figure things out alone.

*Why Showpad*

Real product, real impact. Ship code to a live SaaS platform used by enterprise sales teams globally. Your work reaches customers from day one.

Mentorship built in. Dedicated pair programming with senior engineers. Code reviews designed to teach, not just gatekeep.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Write clean, modular, and maintainable code on prescribed tasks — with guidance from your team — and grow into tackling more complex problems over time.
* Adopt a test-first mindset from day one: unit tests and end-to-end coverage are part of how you ship, not an afterthought.
* Follow CI/CD and monitoring practices, learning to spot and troubleshoot basic issues in a real production environment.
* Participate in code reviews — your questions are just as valuable as your answers at this stage.
* Contribute across the full SDLC: from design discussions to deployment, you'll touch every phase of how software gets built.
* Communicate proactively about your work status so the team stays aligned and unblocked.
* Pair program with more experienced engineers, especially on bug fixing and domain exploration.
* Use internal and external resources to solve problems, and proactively seek guidance from senior engineers when needed.

*Are you our next Junior Engineer?*

We don't expect you to know our stack on day one. Here's what sets the strongest candidates apart:

* Solid computer science fundamentals — data structures, algorithms, and how systems work under the hood.
* Exposure to at least one object-oriented or functional programming language.
* A working understanding of version control (Git) and collaborative development workflows.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing concepts (even if you haven't used them extensively yet).
* Strong written and verbal communication — you can explain your thinking clearly in a PR comment or a standup.
* A growth mindset: you actively seek feedback, apply it, and show up curious every day.
* Comfort with ambiguity — you can ask good clarifying questions and document decisions as you go.

*Company Highlights:*

Welcome to the new era of revenue effectiveness. The merger of Showpad and Bigtincan is creating the first AI-powered platform to strengthen the entire field selling motion.

By unifying two industry-acclaimed solutions for content, readiness, engagement, and intelligence into a single operating system, we are delivering unrivaled scale and accelerated growth for our 2,000+ combined customers worldwide, including leaders in manufacturing (Dow, Dupont), healthcare (Fujifilm, Kaiser Permanente, Johnson&Johnson), CPG (Smucker’s, Mitsubishi, Stanley Black & Decker), and enterprise tech (HID, CultureAmp, LastPass).

Acclaimed by analysts and adored by customers, we’re recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ Revenue Enablement Platforms, honored by Gartner as a Customers’ Choice in Revenue Enablement Platforms, and, together, endorsed by nearly 3,000 5-star customer reviews on G2.

United, we’re focused on powering the next generation of field selling success through a more holistic engine that creates lasting value for our customers and a new vision for our category.

title: Junior Account Executive, New Markets
description:
*About Valsoft*

Valsoft builds and scales vertical market software companies. We partner with strong teams, invest in the long term, and run disciplined operating systems to drive sustainable growth across our portfolio.

*About BluSynq*

BluSynq is changing the way operators run their front desk. Our AI-powered agent connects to the tools a business already uses and answers questions, books appointments and closes deals — automatically, 24/7 — over voice, text and email. We are a fast-scaling, tech-driven business inside the Valsoft / Aspire Software portfolio, working closely with DockMaster, the leading marina management platform.

*The Opportunity*

*This is a first or second sales job, and a real one.*

We're hiring a Junior Account Executive to take BluSynq into new markets.

BluSynq already has a natural home inside DockMaster's marina customer base. *That is not your territory.* Yours is everything outside it: independent operators who have never heard of us, and the adjacent industries where the same problem exists. If a business loses money every time the phone rings and nobody picks up, it's a prospect.

*You won't be doing it alone.* A dedicated Sales Development Representative works alongside you, building target lists and running first-touch outreach to book qualified meetings into your calendar. From that first meeting on, the deal is yours: discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation and close.

You'll still create pipeline of your own. The best sellers always do, and in a new market a rep who only works booked meetings never learns why the market says no. But you have a partner at the top of the funnel, and a real say in who they call.

You will not be building the go-to-market strategy. That's the point. The talk tracks, demo flow, pricing and CRM process are being built for you by the senior seller and the COO. What you will do is find out which industries outside our home market actually buy — and that read is worth as much to us as the revenue.

You'll be coached directly, weekly, on live calls and recorded ones. If you're hungry, coachable and willing to pick up the phone yourself when the calendar looks thin, this is a seat where you can be closing your own deals inside 60 days and running a full territory inside a year.

*Where You'll Sell*

Every deal you close is a net-new logo. You'll work two fronts:

• *The marine market we don't already serve* — independent marinas, boatyards, yacht clubs, waterfront venues and dealerships that are not DockMaster customers.

• *Adjacent industries with the same front-desk problem* — appointment-driven, phone-dependent, owner-operated businesses, including:

– RV parks, campgrounds and glamping sites

– Self-storage and boat/RV storage facilities

– Marine and powersports dealerships and their service departments

– Entertainment attractions, waterparks and event venues

– Home and field services — HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, pool service

– Auto service and repair shops

– Clinics, veterinary practices, salons and spas

Part of the job is proving which of these are real. You and your SDR will run structured tests in new verticals, two at a time, and report back on what lands and what doesn't. Any prospect that turns out to be a DockMaster customer gets routed to the DockMaster team — those accounts are covered separately, and the rules of engagement will be written down for you before day one.

*What You'll Do*

*Work with your SDR to open new markets*
----------------------------------------

• Partner daily with your SDR: agree the target account criteria, review the lists they build in ZoomInfo and LinkedIn, listen to their calls, and tell them what is landing so the meetings get better.

• Accept, qualify or reject every meeting they book against criteria you have both signed up to — with feedback either way, same day. That loop is how the top of the funnel improves.

• Self-source a meaningful share of your own pipeline — phone, email, LinkedIn and the occasional trade show — so you are never dependent on someone else's calendar.

• Research every account before the call, so the first 20 seconds are about their business and not about us.

• Learn a new industry's vocabulary fast enough to sound credible to an operator who has run that business for twenty years.

• Log every touch in HubSpot the same day, tagged by vertical and lead source. Clean CRM is how we tell a good market from a bad one, and SDR-sourced from self-sourced.

*Own the sales cycle*
---------------------

• Own every deal from the first meeting to signature. Once a lead is handed to you, it is yours — the forecast, the follow-up and the outcome.

• Run discovery calls using our qualification framework, and get to the operator's actual problem: missed calls, after-hours bookings, staff time lost to the phone.

• Deliver the BluSynq demo and connect what the prospect just heard to time saved and revenue captured.

• Build and send proposals, handle standard objections, and close.

• Hand new customers to Onboarding and Customer Success cleanly, with the context they need to get the customer live fast.

*Report back and get better every week*
---------------------------------------

• Come to your 1:1 with your numbers, your recorded calls and the one thing you want to fix.

• Give a clear read on each vertical you test: who answered, what landed, what they pushed back on, whether it's worth more of our time.

• Feed real objections, competitive mentions and pricing pushback back to the team so the playbook improves.

• Contribute to talk tracks and sequences once you've earned an opinion by making the calls.

*Ramp and Expectations*

*First 30 days — learn the product and pick your ground*
--------------------------------------------------------

• Certified on the BluSynq demo and able to deliver it unassisted.

• Two target verticals agreed with the COO and your SDR, with lists built and outbound live in both.

• A working rhythm established with your SDR: shared qualification criteria, a weekly list review and a same-day feedback loop on every meeting booked.

• HubSpot hygiene at 100%: every activity logged, every next step dated, every account tagged by vertical.

*Days 31–60 — run the cycle*
----------------------------

• Consistently hitting weekly activity targets and holding a live discovery calendar.

• Running your own demos and building qualified pipeline in both test verticals.

• Converting SDR-booked meetings at or above our benchmark, with self-sourced opportunities on top.

• First closed deal on the board.

• An early, evidence-based read on which of the two verticals is responding.

*Days 61–90 — carry a number*
-----------------------------

• Full quota carrying, with 3x pipeline coverage against it.

• A repeatable weekly rhythm: SDR review, self-sourced prospecting, discover, demo, propose, close.

• Hitting the agreed self-sourced share of pipeline alongside SDR-sourced volume.

• A documented view of which verticals convert, which to drop, and a third in test.

• Forecasting your own deals accurately enough that we can plan around them.

*KPIs you'll be measured on*
----------------------------

• Discovery calls held per week at full ramp: 8–10 across SDR-booked and self-sourced.

• Self-sourced outbound activity: ~25 quality touches a day, including live cold dials.

• Share of your pipeline you sourced yourself, against a ratio agreed in week one.

• Speed and quality of your feedback loop with the SDR — every booked meeting dispositioned same day.

• New-logo closes and new ARR — all of it net-new, none of it from the DockMaster base.

• Demo-to-close conversion against a team benchmark you'll be given in week one.

• Verticals tested per quarter, with a written read on each.

• Pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy and CRM data quality.

*What We're Looking For*

*Required*
----------

• 0–2 years of experience in a sales, customer-facing or target-driven role. A first sales job is welcome.

• Genuinely comfortable making a cold call — no referral, no inbound form, no existing relationship.

• Resilient about rejection, because opening a new market means a lot of it before the first yes.

• Clear, confident communicator — on the phone, on video and in writing.

• Coachable: you take feedback, apply it the same week, and ask for more.

• Willing to be a partner to your SDR rather than a passenger — giving them direction and feedback, not just taking their meetings.

• Organised and self-directed enough to run your own day in a remote role without someone counting your hours.

• Curious about how different kinds of businesses actually operate, and interested in getting good at software sales as a craft.

• Legally able to work in Canada and available to work North American business hours.

*Preferred*
-----------

• Any exposure to cold outbound — SDR/BDR work, retail, hospitality, call centre, recruiting, fundraising, or another role where you had a number and a script.

• Experience selling into more than one industry, or into small owner-operated businesses where the buyer is the owner.

• Experience with a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce or similar) and prospecting tools like ZoomInfo — helpful, not required. We'll teach it.

• Familiarity with marinas, boating, RV parks, campgrounds, storage, dealerships or another owner-operator business. Knowing the customer is worth more here than knowing SaaS.

• Interest in AI and automation, and the ability to explain it to someone who doesn't care how it works — only what it does for them.

*What We're Not Asking For*

• SaaS experience. We'd rather have a fast learner with the right instincts than someone with three years of bad habits.

• A university degree in anything specific.

• An existing book of business or industry contacts.

*Why Join*

• You're not farming someone else's customer list. Every logo you close is a new one.

• You have a dedicated SDR feeding the top of your funnel from day one — rare in a first AE seat — and you own the deal from the first meeting onward.

• Sell a product prospects can hear working in the first two minutes of a demo, in markets that haven't been called on yet.

• Real influence in your first year on which industries BluSynq goes after next — your data decides it.

• Short sales cycles: you'll get more at-bats in a year here than in three years selling enterprise software, which is how sellers actually get good.

• Direct, weekly coaching from a senior seller and the COO — not a 40-person SDR floor.

• A defined path: this seat is built to grow into a full Account Executive territory, with clear milestones rather than a vague promise.

• Competitive base salary with uncapped commission.

• Backed by Valsoft / Aspire Software — the stability of a global portfolio with the pace and ownership of a startup.

#BluSynq #DockMaster

title: UI/UX Designer
UX/UI Designer
description:
Company Overview
----------------

APPLICATIONS FROM OUTSIDE CANADA WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.

We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview
-----------------

We’re looking for a UX/UI Designer to design thoughtful, high-quality digital experiences across a range of client engagements. This role is ideal for a curious, collaborative designer who enjoys solving real problems and bringing ideas to life — from early concepts through polished delivery.

In this role, you will partner closely with client product teams and our internal team to turn complex ideas into clear, intuitive, and engaging experiences. You’ll be joining real, in-flight work where quality and delivery speed matter, collaborating with experienced designers and growing the instincts that come from shipping things that matter.

Why This Role Matters
---------------------

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do
--------------

Craft & Delivery
----------------

* Design end-to-end UX/UI deliverables from early exploration and concepting through high-fidelity execution
* Create wireframes, prototypes, and polished interface designs that balance usability, business goals, and technical constraints
* Build, evolve, and maintain design systems that support consistency, scalability, and flexibility across products
* Conduct UX research activities including usability testing and user interviews to inform design decisions
* Use Figma confidently for design, prototyping, documentation, and collaboration
* Bring an AI-forward mindset to your design work, using tools like Figma AI and Claude to improve efficiency, creativity, and design quality

Collaboration & Communication
-----------------------------

* Partner closely with client product teams to understand problems, shape solutions, and deliver meaningful outcomes
* Collaborate with engineers, strategists, and delivery leads to bring designs to life effectively and efficiently
* Participate in agile workflows and balance multiple projects, clients, and industries while maintaining a high bar for craft

Leadership & Influence
----------------------

* Take ownership of design work end-to-end and follow through with craft and consistency
* Contribute to internal initiatives such as marketing, pitches, and the evolution of the design practice
* Stay curious and keep growing — bring new ideas, experiment often, and embrace continuous improvement

What You’ll Bring
-----------------

* 2+ years of professional experience as a UX/UI Designer working on digital products or platforms
* Strong hands-on design skills with deep proficiency in Figma
* Experience building and maintaining design systems in real-world product environments
* Working knowledge of UX research methods including usability testing and user interviews
* Experience working directly with clients or cross-functional product teams
* A collaborative mindset with comfort giving and receiving design feedback
* Ability to adapt to design approaches across different industries, users, and problem spaces
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for AI-assisted design tools and workflows (e.g., Figma AI, Claude)
* Experience with motion design, advanced prototyping tools, front-end concepts, or workshop facilitation is a plus

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are
------------------------------

* *A doer.* You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
* *A fast learner who knows you don't know everything.* The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
* *Direct in a way that makes the work better.* You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
* *Obsessed with craft.* You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
* *Built for ownership.* You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
* *All in.* You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
* *Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight.* Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
* *Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do.* Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

title: Visual Designer (AI-Native)
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Visual Designer (AI-Native) based in United States.*

The Visual Designer will define and elevate the visual identity of an emerging AI security category.
This is a highly hands-on role combining brand identity, visual communication, web experiences, motion, and technical storytelling.
You will use generative AI, automated workflows, and traditional design tools to move rapidly from concepts to polished production assets.
Working closely with founders, Product, Engineering, and GTM teams, you will shape how complex AI and security concepts are understood visually.
Your work will span product launches, technical brand systems, interactive web experiences, threat reports, campaigns, and executive presentations.
The environment is fast-moving and highly collaborative, with significant ownership and short feedback loops.
You will help establish a new visual language for agentic AI security while continuously experimenting with emerging creative technologies.

Accountabilities:
-----------------

* Own and evolve the visual identity and design language across brand, marketing, product, and communications.
* Establish a distinctive, precise, modern visual system that communicates advanced AI security concepts with clarity.
* Integrate generative AI tools, AI-powered vector generation, automated workflows, and other emerging technologies into daily design processes.
* Use tools such as Midjourney, Runway, Stable Diffusion, ComfyUI, ChatGPT, Claude, generative code, and related technologies to accelerate creative exploration and execution.
* Transform AI-generated concepts and media into polished, production-ready visual assets.
* Translate complex security concepts, including multi-agent orchestration, threat graphs, and adversarial techniques, into compelling visual metaphors and communication systems.
* Create diagrams, data visualizations, motion graphics, and other visual storytelling assets for technical subjects.
* Design high-quality marketing pages, interactive landing pages, campaign assets, and digital experiences.
* Develop compelling visual narratives and executive presentations for senior security and technology audiences.
* Create product launch materials and supporting visual collateral across multiple channels.
* Develop dark-mode technical brand systems and other visual frameworks suited to modern security products.
* Produce interactive threat reports and other content that makes complex technical information accessible and engaging.
* Partner directly with Product, Engineering, GTM, and leadership teams throughout the creative process.
* Participate in rapid feedback cycles and iterate quickly based on stakeholder and user needs.
* Maintain a consistently high level of craftsmanship, visual consistency, and attention to detail.
* Explore emerging design technologies and identify opportunities to improve creative workflows and output.
* Continuously refine design processes to increase speed without compromising quality.
* Help establish a scalable visual language and design system for a growing technology category.

Requirements:
-------------

* 3–6+ years of professional experience in visual design, brand identity, communication design, graphic design, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong experience developing visual identities and communication systems, ideally within a high-growth technology startup, leading agency, or innovative technology environment.

title: Landing Page Designer

At Homestead, the Landing Page Designer creates high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns across multiple direct-to-consumer brands. This role owns the art direction and visual execution of assigned landing pages, translating approved strategy, copy, and assets into polished desktop and mobile designs that are on-brand, conversion-minded, and production-ready.

This is a primarily internal role that partners closely with Paid Account Managers, the Lead Designer, and the Director of Design. The designer is expected to exercise strong creative judgment, maintain excellent file hygiene, manage design-stage tasks reliably, and contribute thoughtful recommendations when design, asset, or UX issues affect the final page.

* Identify technical, asset, or UX constraints and recommend practical solutions or alternatives when they affect the final execution.
* Participate in structured internal review loops, respond well to feedback, and implement revisions efficiently.
* Contribute feedback on team processes, workflows, templates, and design standards to help improve quality and efficiency over time.
* Support landing page work across paid clients and flex across brands or priorities as workloads shift.

Qualifications
--------------

* 2+ years designing high-volume landing pages for DTC brands.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating performance-driven creative.
* Proficiency in Figma (required) and Replo (required).
* Strong understanding of conversion hierarchy, landing page best practices, and mobile-first design.
* Familiarity with paid ad platforms such as Meta and Google.
* Experience contributing to A/B testing and interpreting performance data.
* Excellent communication and time-management skills.
* Strong attention to detail, file organization, and visual polish.
* Ability to manage multiple brands, deadlines, and revisions without sacrificing quality.
* Agency experience is a plus.
* Exposure to email and SMS creative systems is a plus.
* Experience with accessibility best practices, including ADA and WCAG, is a plus.

This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be able to work standard business hours (9:00am–5:00pm) in ET, CT, MT, or PT time zones.

Homestead is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities.

Створення якісних візуальних матеріалів для digital-продуктів і маркетингових кампаній.

Знання та практичний досвід у UI/UX дизайні.

title: Backend Engineer – Ruby on Rails (AWS / PostgreSQL)
description:
*Location:* Kochi, Kerala / Remote *Job Type:* Full-Time *Experience Level:* Senior

*Role Overview*

cloud infrastructure (AWS) and relational databases (PostgreSQL). In this role, you will be

responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable server-side web applications. You

*Required Qualifications*

* *Ruby on Rails:* Expert-level understanding of Ruby syntax, object-oriented programming, and the Rails framework (MVC architecture, ActiveRecord, ActiveJob).
* *Database Management:* Strong proficiency with *PostgreSQL* , including database design, indexing, query optimization, and troubleshooting.
* *Cloud Computing:* Hands-on experience with the *AWS* ecosystem and deployment pipelines. Familiarity with managing cloud environments and ensuring robust system security.
* *Version Control:* Proficiency with Git and GitHub/GitLab in a collaborative, team-based setting.
* *Problem-Solving:* Excellent analytical skills with a proactive approach to tackling complex technical challenges.
* *Communication:* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

*Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)*

* Experience with modern front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3).
* Familiarity with background job processing and queuing systems (e.g., Sidekiq, Redis).
* Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

AIMA delivers flexible, bespoke solutions that help healthcare organizations optimize operations, reduce overheads, and accelerate payments. The company serves a broad range of healthcare specialties. AIMA focuses on sustainable business growth for clients by aiming to increase income by at least 25% and reduce claims processing time by up to 90%. Its service portfolio includes medical coding and billing, accounts receivable, credentialing and enrollment, automation and AI, administrative services, data entry, technology solutions, and resourcing and infrastructure services. AIMA enables healthcare professionals to focus on patient care while benefiting from improved efficiency and profitability.

As a Backend Engineer – Ruby on Rails (AWS / PostgreSQL) at AIMA, you will design, develop, and maintain backend services that power our healthcare revenue cycle management platforms. In this full-time remote role, you will build and optimize RESTful APIs, integrate third-party services, and ensure scalable, secure, and performant data handling using Ruby on Rails, AWS, and PostgreSQL. You will also participate in architecture discussions, contribute to technical standards, and help enhance deployment and monitoring practices across our cloud infrastructure.

*Qualifications*

* Professional software development experience, with focus on Ruby on Rails or similar web frameworks.
* Solid understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns.

title: Freelance Brand Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Brand Designer to join the Tendem project (**https://tendem.ai/**) and create strong visual identities for real-world brands and products.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in brand strategy, visual identity, and design systems to create cohesive, modern, and impactful brand assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in brand asset creation, visual identity development, and maintaining brand consistency.

*What We Do*

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

*About the Role*

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Brand Designer, your focus will be on brand asset creation, visual identity, and brand consistency. We need a core specialist dedicated to building a strong visual foundation. You will serve as the architect of the brand identity, modernizing aesthetics and ensuring that all visual touchpoints look cohesive across various mediums using industry-standard design tools.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Develop foundational brand assets, including logos, complete visual identities, and comprehensive color schemes.
* Create, systematically organize, and deliver necessary variations of core brand elements.
* Act as the strict gatekeeper for brand consistency across all internal and external materials, including pitch decks and social media kits.
* Build scalable, long-lasting visual systems that align with modern design standards.
* Enforce design quality through cross-platform validation, ensuring brand aesthetics translate flawlessly across both digital and print mediums.

*How to get started*

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

*Educational qualifications*

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in brand design, graphic design, art direction, or visual communications is desirable.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, Communication Design, or related creative fields is a plus.

*Academic and/or Professional Experience*

Candidates must have a strong portfolio heavily focused on brand identity creation, logo design, and comprehensive brand guidelines. We are looking for specialists with a deep understanding of how core branding translates seamlessly across different digital and print mediums. A strategic, detail-obsessed approach and the ability to work independently to build long-lasting visual systems are essential.

*Technical Skills (Essential)*

* Brand Identity Creation: Expertise in building foundational assets from scratch, including scalable logos, distinct color palettes, and typography systems.
* Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma for crafting and managing core design assets.
* Cross-Medium Adaptation: Proven ability to translate brand DNA perfectly across varied formats, from digital social media kits to corporate pitch decks and print materials.
* Brand System Architecture: Strong organizational skills to develop clear brand guidelines, style guides, and structured asset libraries for wider team use.

*Additional requirements*

* A strategic, detail-obsessed mindset focused on long-term brand equity.
* Strong dedication to visual consistency and functioning as a true brand gatekeeper.
* Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot independently and deliver high-quality assets.
* Portfolio showcasing branding work (logos, identity systems, guidelines) must be included in the CV
* English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

*Project time expectations*

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

*Compensation*

On this project, contributors can earn up to *$50 per hour equivalent* , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.
