title: Graphic Designer (Marketing)
description:
JoVE is the world-leading video platform for scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students worldwide use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including leaders such as Harvard, MIT, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company

*
The Role
*

JoVE is looking for an experienced Graphic Designer to join our in-house Marketing team. This role is primarily focused on graphic design and marketing collateral production, supporting teams across JoVE with high-quality, brand-consistent digital and print assets.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented designer who can independently interpret marketing briefs, translate business requirements into effective visual solutions, manage multiple projects, and incorporate AI-assisted workflows to improve speed and efficiency while maintaining JoVE's brand standards.

*Responsibilities:

*

* Design and produce marketing collateral including flyers, brochures, social media graphics and carousels, email banners, presentations, event materials, booth graphics and adaptations, landing page assets, and other campaign deliverables.
* Adapt approved designs across different formats, platforms, audiences, campaigns, and languages while maintaining visual and brand consistency.
* Prepare professional print-ready artwork, with a strong understanding of bleed, trim, safe areas, resolution, color modes, and large-format production requirements.
* Build and update HubSpot landing page sections using Rich Text modules, HTML, and CSS.
* Use HTML/CSS knowledge to modify layouts, troubleshoot responsive or styling issues, and review, debug, and optimize AI-generated code when required.
* Use AI-assisted design tools to rapidly prototype first-draft concepts, helping teams establish and approve a visual direction before final production.
* Prototype landing page sections visually using AI where appropriate, then translate approved concepts into functional HTML/CSS for HubSpot.
* Identify opportunities to integrate AI into design and production workflows to reduce repetitive work and improve turnaround times without compromising quality or brand consistency.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Studio, Brand, Events, Sales, and other internal teams, incorporating stakeholder feedback accurately and delivering work within agreed timelines.
* Translate marketing objectives and business terminology into clear design hierarchy, visual communication, and production requirements.

*Requirements*

* 4-6 years of experience in graphic and marketing design, supported by a portfolio covering digital campaigns, social media, print collateral, presentations, events, and brand-consistent design work.
* Strong understanding of layout, typography, visual hierarchy, composition, and corporate brand systems.
* Strong proficiency in Canva, which will be the primary tool for day-to-day design production.
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, particularly for booth graphics, vector artwork, large-format, and print production.
* Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop for image editing and asset preparation.
* Practical knowledge of HTML and CSS, with the ability to troubleshoot and modify code rather than relying solely on AI-generated output.
* Experience with HubSpot landing pages or similar CMS platforms is strongly preferred.
* Comfortable using generative AI and AI-assisted creative tools for visual exploration, prototyping, coding assistance, and workflow optimization.
* Able to use AI as a productivity tool while applying independent design judgment, quality control, and brand guidelines to the final output.
* Excellent attention to detail, communication, organization, and the ability to manage multiple projects with minimal supervision.

*Benefits*

* A competitive compensation package.
* We are fully remote!
* You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
* Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
* Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

You'll work closely with marketing, sales, and product teams to bring campaigns to life while ensuring every asset reflects our brand and drives business results. * Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise across digital, print, presentations, and web design.

* Experience designing demand generation campaigns, account-based marketing (ABM), trade shows, webinars, and sales enablement.

title: Marketing, Social Media & Design Executive
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Marketing, Social Media & Design Executive based in Israel.*

This is a hands-on marketing role focused on strengthening digital presence, brand visibility, and audience engagement. You will take ownership of LinkedIn strategy, content creation, social media activity, and employer branding. A key part of the role is promoting vacancies, attracting candidates, and supporting recruiters with personal branding. You will also contribute to email marketing, website content, SEO, and digital campaigns. Working closely with recruiters and business stakeholders, you will turn market insights and internal expertise into compelling content. The role offers broad exposure across recruitment marketing, B2B communications, social media, and business development support.

Accountabilities
----------------

* Own and execute a consistent LinkedIn strategy designed to increase reach, engagement, followers, and brand visibility.
* Create, schedule, and publish engaging LinkedIn content, including vacancies, market updates, team news, success stories, events, new hires, and company milestones.
* Support recruiters and consultants with LinkedIn activity, personal branding, content ideas, job promotion, reposting, and audience engagement.
* Promote job opportunities consistently across LinkedIn and other relevant social media channels.
* Manage and develop activity across additional platforms such as Instagram and Glassdoor.
* Monitor social media performance and use analytics to continuously improve content and publishing strategies.
* Stay informed about LinkedIn and wider social media trends, platform developments, and emerging content formats.
* Develop recruitment marketing campaigns that support candidate attraction, client engagement, and business development objectives.
* Create compelling content around vacancies, hiring trends, placements, testimonials, case studies, and recruitment success stories.
* Develop employer-brand content highlighting culture, team activities, events, promotions, anniversaries, and employee achievements.
* Work with recruiters to improve the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of job advertising and social promotion.
* Build and maintain a structured content calendar covering LinkedIn, social media, blogs, newsletters, market updates, and recruitment campaigns.
* Produce thought-leadership and market content covering salary insights, hiring trends, market intelligence, and relevant industry developments.
* Turn recruiter expertise and internal knowledge into engaging content for social media and wider marketing channels.
* Create and refresh marketing materials such as consultant profiles, client information packs, case studies, testimonials, and market overviews.
* Support website content management, including keeping job pages and vacancy information accurate and up to date.
* Support SEO initiatives and digital activities designed to improve website visibility and organic traffic.
* Plan and deliver email marketing campaigns for client and candidate audiences.
* Track and report on social media, website, and campaign performance, identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct competitor research focused on LinkedIn activity, content strategy, audience growth, and engagement.
* Create marketing materials, proposals, and digital assets that support business development activity.
* Use LinkedIn, online communities, groups, events, and digital networks to identify opportunities for candidate attraction and business development.
* Collaborate closely with recruiters and other stakeholders to ensure marketing activity supports wider commercial and recruitment objectives.

Requirements:
-------------

* Strong hands-on experience managing LinkedIn for a business, brand, or professional services organisation.
* Demonstrable experience creating LinkedIn posts, campaigns, and content that drive engagement and visibility.

*You'll have the opportunity to:*
---------------------------------

* Oversee development for new and existing products and assets on the Salesforce platform, as well as strategic tools for Salesforce implementation services
* You will work with tools like Claude and Codex, as well as with various features within Salesforce (Lightning Web Components, Flow, Console, Apex, etc)

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?
-------------------------------------------------------------

* Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.

About the role

Airwallex is looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Sourcing to lead our strategic approach to third-party spend globally.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will shape category and vendor strategies, lead our most important commercial negotiations, and identify opportunities to optimize our vendor portfolio and cost base. The role spans major indirect spend categories, with particular focus on technology, software, cloud and other strategically important vendors.

This is a strategy-led, highly analytical role. We are looking for someone who can anticipate needs rather than react to procurement requests, challenge demand and requirements where appropriate, and balance cost discipline with quality, technical capability, risk and long-term strategic value. Procurement operations and transactional processes are supported separately.

What you'll do

Set category and vendor strategy

- Develop category strategies across major areas of third-party spend, informed by business priorities, market dynamics, cost drivers and the vendor landscape.

- Build a forward-looking view of Airwallex's vendor portfolio, identifying opportunities to consolidate, rationalize, re-source or deepen strategic relationships.

- Shape sourcing decisions early, including requirements, vendor selection, commercial models, build-versus-buy considerations and longer-term vendor strategy.

Lead strategic sourcing and negotiations

- Lead Airwallex's most important sourcing initiatives and vendor negotiations, from market assessment and commercial evaluation through contracting and renewal.

- Develop rigorous negotiation strategies using benchmarks, usage and demand data, competitive alternatives, total cost of ownership and detailed vendor economics.

- Optimize the full commercial structure, including pricing, commitments, contract duration, payment terms, renewals, price increases and service levels.

Drive value and cost discipline

- Build and prioritize a pipeline of opportunities across pricing, demand, utilization, specifications, vendor consolidation and commercial structures.

- Challenge whether spend is necessary and appropriately sized, rather than focusing solely on negotiating lower prices.

- Quantify and track commercial outcomes, ensuring negotiated value translates into realized financial impact and informs budgeting and forward planning.

Build strategic sourcing capabilities

- Establish clear frameworks and best practices for sourcing, supplier selection, negotiation, strategic vendor management and renewals.

- Build a reliable source of truth across vendors, spend, contracts, commitments, renewals and key commercial risks.

- Bring external benchmarks and market intelligence into decision-making, while establishing appropriate governance for Airwallex's most strategic vendors.

What we're looking for

- 8+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, category management, procurement, commercial strategy or a related field, ideally within technology, fintech or another fast-growing global business.

- Strong track record of personally leading complex, high-value negotiations and delivering material commercial outcomes.

- Deep experience in technology and software sourcing; exposure to cloud, data, professional services or other major indirect categories is highly desirable.

- Strong strategic, analytical and financial capabilities, including experience evaluating pricing structures, usage, total cost of ownership and vendor economics.

- Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to balance cost, capability, speed, risk and longer-term strategic value.

- Ability to operate from strategy through execution, from developing a category roadmap to working through the detail of a complex pricing model or contract.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to influence senior internal stakeholders and vendor executives.

- High ownership and comfort building structure and best practices in a fast-moving environment.

title: Customer Support Senior Associate
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Customer Support Senior Associate you will:

- Spend your time interacting directly with our customers over chat, email and phone, providing them with an effective, easy and enjoyable Pleo experience.

- Troubleshoot and resolve customers issues related to the Pleo product, and escalate to the appropriate internal team where needed

- Provide feedback and support cross-functional teams on product development based on customer insights

- Share learnings and contribute to our knowledge base to ensure growth and knowledge sharing across the team, and beyond

What you bring
You’ll thrive in this role if you:

- Love providing fantastic, high-touch customer support on live chat, email and phone

- Have a persistent and analytical approach to problem-solving

- Are able to explain complicated problems in the simplest terms

- Have a genuine desire to work in a fast-paced, fast-changing and collaborative environment

- Are tech-savvy, resilient and curious

- Have experience with Support tools such as FreshWorks, Intercom or Zendesk

- Have experience with accounting, bookkeeping, financial technology or other relevant product within SaaS

- Have fluency in written and spoken English and at least one additional European language (preferably German, Danish, Swedish or Spanish)

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Customer Support Lead and work closely with teams across all departments in Pleo. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to giving our customers the best experience possible. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across other departments such as Customer Success & Product to ensure success.

How you’ll develop in this role
In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

- Learn and understand the Pleo product deeply

- Help 500+ users with their Pleo experience

- Act as the voice of the customer internally

- Take on new product challenges as the company continues to scale and evolve

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on more advanced support tasks, stepping into leadership, or becoming a subject matter expert within a certain product area.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office 🍜

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer hybrid working options

- Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far ❤️‍🩹

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work 👶

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Account Executive
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake
Snowflake is the world's leading AI Data Cloud company, powering the future of data and artificial intelligence. Our mission is to mobilize the world's data — breaking down silos and enabling every organization to unify, govern, and unlock the full value of their data at scale. Built on a single, fully managed platform that is Easy, Connected, and Trusted, Snowflake empowers enterprises to run all of their data, AI, and application workloads — from advanced analytics and machine learning to generative AI and agentic applications — without moving data out of a secure, governed environment.
With thousands of customers across every major industry worldwide and a consumption-based model that scales with value delivered, Snowflake is one of the fastest-growing enterprise platforms in the cloud era. We believe that there is no AI strategy without a data strategy — and we are building the platform that makes both possible.

Account Executive Team
The Account Executive team works closely with internal cross-functional teams and partners to deliver Snowflake's value to customers and serve as trusted advisors on long-term data strategy. The Korea sales organization operates across four industry-aligned teams to drive deep vertical expertise and customer intimacy. As part of our continued investment in Korea, we are seeking a Global Account Executive (GAM) to lead the strategic relationship with Global Electronics customer — one of the most iconic and globally significant technology and manufacturing conglomerates. This individual will represent Snowflake across customer's diverse business divisions and serve as the single point of executive accountability for the account.

The Impact You Will Make

- Champion data innovation across a global conglomerate: Lead Snowflake's data cloud strategy for the global Electronics customer, driving adoption and expansion across its diverse business divisions — including semiconductors, mobile, display, home appliances, and enterprise IT — in partnership with customers and ecosystem partners.

- Become a Snowflake expert: Conduct discovery calls, deliver customised demos, and present tailored solutions to prospects and stakeholders across multiple Samsung business units.

- Be the trusted advisor: Deeply understand the global Electronics customer's existing and future IT roadmap, digital transformation priorities, and industry-specific challenges to position Snowflake as a strategic platform partner.

- Drive full-lifecycle sales execution: Own pipeline generation, opportunity progression, and deal closure across the global Electronics customer account — landing new use cases, expanding existing deployments, and deepening platform adoption.

- Build and execute a strategic account plan: Develop and maintain a comprehensive account plan with targeted stakeholder mapping, opportunity pipeline, and quarterly/annual revenue targets. Proactively identify whitespace and cross-sell opportunities across business divisions.

- Cultivate executive relationships: Build and sustain trusted relationships with CxOs, IT executives, Line-of-Business leaders, and key decision-makers across the global Electronics customer's corporate and divisional leadership.

- Orchestrate cross-functional collaboration: Lead engagement across Snowflake's internal teams — including Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Product, Marketing, Legal, and Finance — as well as regional and global counterparts, to deliver a seamless and unified customer experience.

Who You Are

title: AI Deployment Strategist
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake's Forward Deployed Engineering team embeds directly inside enterprise customers' environments to design, build, and deploy production AI systems. We lead with AI transformation programs and expand into high-impact use cases built by our engineers and researchers. This work is specific, technical, and consequential — we do not do pilots that never ship.

As an AI Deployment Strategist, you are the partner enterprise customers turn to when they are serious about transforming how their business runs on AI. You sit inside the FDE product org, working alongside the engineers and researchers who deliver these programs.

The revenue is the result of trust, not a pitch.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Understand the customer's business. Sit with C-level executives (CEO, COO, CFO, and beyond), and their teams on where AI changes how they operate. Learn how they make money and where the friction is. Find the problems worth solving and bring a point of view they cannot get from their own staff.

Turn strategy into programs. Translate executive conversations into real engagements. Qualify opportunities rigorously, structure commercial commitments honestly, and author Statements of Work that reflect what Snowflake's FDE team can actually deliver. Work with legal to navigate IP, data rights, and contract terms specific to custom AI engagements.

Grow the relationship. Expand from a first engagement into a portfolio across business units. Done well, these become Snowflake's deepest enterprise relationships.

Qualify field-originated pipeline. Serve as the filter for opportunities originated by Snowflake's field AE organization. Evaluate each for FDE fit across technical complexity, deployment readiness, and commercial viability. Protect FDE capacity. Improve conversion.

Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside AEs on contracting and commercials. You own the engagement scope, product pricing, and delivery commitments. They own the primary commercial relationship.

Partner with Marketing. Collaborate on field enablement, go-to-market campaigns, and thought leadership that builds awareness for FDE's offerings.

Feed signal back. Bring what you hear in qualification — customer pain points, use case patterns, competitive dynamics — directly to FDE product and engineering leadership.

Earn trust over the long run. Make the call that serves the customer, including when an FDE engagement is not right for them. You will be more valuable to Snowflake because of it.

WHAT YOU BRING

A track record as a trusted advisor to senior executives. You have built and held C-suite relationships independently. You bring a point of view, not a pitch.

Fluency in both technology and business strategy. You can hold a conversation on AI architecture and on the P&L, and translate between the two. You earn technical credibility with engineers and customer CTOs in the same meeting.

Experience scoping and closing complex enterprise engagements. You have written and negotiated Statements of Work for custom technical solutions. You understand scope risk and structure commitments that are honest about what will and will not be delivered.

A consistent track record in enterprise software or technical solutions, working alongside a field sales organization to qualify and close.

The judgment to navigate multi-stakeholder procurement, legal, and security review without reading as a salesperson.

AI-native in practice. You use frontier AI tools in your daily work and can speak credibly to a customer about what they change at the operational level. You’re comfortable building executive level slides and technical demos to exemplify the AI path to outcome.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Frontend Web Application Developer
description:
Location: Remote
Availability: 35-40 hours per week
Working hours: US East business hours
Reporting to: Lead developer

KoboToolbox has an immediate opening for a Frontend Web Application Developer to fill a full-time position of approximately 35-40 hours per week, for a commitment of at least 1 year. As a member of our team, you will share in the challenge and excitement of writing code used by over 32,000 organizations around the world. These organizations create data-driven change through the collection and analysis of more than 20 million surveys per month.

Only candidates who already have experience working on large web applications will be considered. Beyond technical acumen, we are seeking a team member who demonstrates curiosity, initiative, and a cooperative approach to problem solving and decision-making.

If you're passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

- Searching and reading an extensive, long-lived code base to understand existing behavior and conventions.

- Recognizing when existing conventions may no longer be the best approach and suggesting improvements aligned with contemporary best practices.

- Writing robust, concise, and reusable code with accompanying tests and documentation.

- Reviewing other developers' code and providing constructive feedback.

- Incorporating feedback from code reviews to improve your skills and align with team standards.

- Using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining responsibility for code quality and correctness.

- Efficiently investigating bug reports from the support team, creating well-scoped fixes or actionable plans for resolution.

- Scoping, prioritizing, estimating, and organizing work into manageably sized tasks.

- Attending regular video-conference check-ins with other members of the technical team.

- Communicating with the public in conjunction with our support staff or directly through forums, issue trackers, etc.

- Contributing to discussions about design and architecture collaboratively with the larger team.

- Performing other related duties as directed by the lead developer.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

- Professional experience writing, deploying, and maintaining client-side code for real-world, API-driven single-page applications.

- Proficiency with TypeScript, React, and related technologies, including styling, state management, and efficient data exchange over HTTP.

- Unflinching ability to work with legacy technologies such as Backbone and CoffeeScript.

- Recent experience giving and receiving code reviews.

- Ability to independently set up and troubleshoot a local development environment, knowing when to ask for help on genuine roadblocks.

- Interest in data collection (surveying), particularly in humanitarian emergencies and other challenging contexts, and a desire to improve our platform for our users.

- Proficiency with spoken and written English.

- Fluency with Git.

- Overlap with working hours in the Eastern time zone.

- Average availability of at least 30 hours per week, preferably 35 hours or more.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with the following is preferred but not required to apply:

- Using Docker and Docker Compose in a development environment.

- Programming in Python, ideally with Django (and particularly Django REST Framework).

- Building user-facing LLM integrations.

- Surveying with XLSForm, ODK XForm, and OpenRosa.

- Integrating with Stripe for payment processing.

An added note on qualifications... We know that people from underrepresented groups including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and others are less likely to apply for a role if they don't meet every qualification listed. We're more interested in your potential and growth mindset than a perfect checklist match. If this role excites you and you meet many, but not all, of the qualifications, we'd still love to hear from you.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Benefits

- Meaningful Work Environment: Join a team that believes work should be meaningful as well as fun, tackling global challenges through innovative data collection and management tools with a proven impact for lasting change.

Full Time Employee Benefits (U.S. candidates only):

- Financial Security: 401(k) retirement plan with 100% match up to 2%.

title: Senior Shopify Developer
description:
We are hiring a contract-based Senior Shopify Developer to contribute to our Design and Development Team.

Original Job posting link here

🌎About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer — Development At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX — Design When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Plus, our partner organizations

- Lightphone

- Mill

- IngredientAI

🔮 Who we’re looking for:

We're looking for a Senior Shopify Developer who balances deep e-commerce expertise with modern frontend engineering. You'll build pixel-perfect, hyper-performant storefronts ranging from custom Liquid themes to headless Hydrogen/Next.js implementations working alongside our design team to create world-class shopping experiences.

In this role, you’ll work across a variety of client projects to find cost-effective, high-quality, and pragmatic solutions to complex e-commerce challenges. Responsibilities will include:

- Collaborating closely with Technical Leads and Designers to meet clients' custom e-commerce and technical needs.

- Building and maintaining high-performance storefronts using both custom Liquid (Online Store 2.0) and modern headless architectures (Shopify Storefront API, GraphQL, Hydrogen/Remix, Next.js).

- Implementing responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect interfaces based on design specifications, with meticulous attention to product interaction details and motion design.

- Integrating custom storefronts with headless CMS platforms (Sanity, Contentful), payment gateways, subscriptions, search, and third-party e-commerce APIs.

- Optimizing e-commerce performance, focusing heavily on Core Web Vitals, image/video asset delivery, bundle size, and runtime efficiency across high-traffic collection and product pages.

- Architecting scalable, reusable component libraries and design systems tailored for commercial platforms.

- Writing clear documentation for store management, custom app integrations, and codebase maintenance.

- Participating in project team rituals, including Sprint Planning, daily standups, code reviews, and retrospectives.

The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart”, by carefully managing their workflow and staggering features that have dependencies intelligently. They prefer deep work but are OK coming up to the surface now and then for top level / strategic conversations.

We believe people with backgrounds or interests in design, art, music, food or fashion tend to have a well rounded sense of design & quality, so a variety of hobbies or side projects is a big nice to have!

🔑 Must-Have Competencies:

We’re always pitching for new and exciting technology niches. Some of the areas below are relevant to us!

- 8+ years writing highly performant frontend code with an obsession for 95+ Lighthouse scores and optimal Core Web Vitals.

- Deep Shopify Ecosystem Mastery: Proven experience building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON templates, Online Store 2.0) as well as headless storefronts using the Shopify Storefront API (GraphQL) and frameworks like Hydrogen/Remix or Next.js.

- Modern Frontend Tech: Expert-level experience with TypeScript and modern CSS methodologies (Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules) alongside robust animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion).

- Headless CMS & Integrations: Extensive experience merging Shopify with headless CMS platforms like Sanity, Contentful, or Prismic, as well as third-party services (Klaviyo, Recharge, Algolia/Searchspring, Stripe).

- Platform & Hosting: Fluency in industry-standard PaaS platforms including Vercel, Netlify, and Shopify Oxygen.

- Architecture & State Management: Experience with state management solutions (Zustand, Redux, Pinia) and API integration patterns for cart state, multi-currency, and checkout flows.

- Quality & Accessibility: Experience building accessible (WCAG compliant), responsive interfaces with a strong commitment to SEO best practices, testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), and maintainable code.

- Performance Optimization: Practical knowledge of WebSockets, caching strategies (Redis, CDN-level/Cloudflare), and advanced image delivery networks.

💪 Nice-to-Have Competencies:

- Custom App Development: Building bespoke Shopify Apps using Node.js, Remix, GraphQL Admin API, and Shopify CLI.

- Shopify Plus & Enterprise Features: Hands-on experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout Branding API, Shopify Scripts, and B2B configurations.

- Tracking & Analytics: Setting up server-side tracking, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Customer Privacy APIs without hurting site load times.

- WebGL, Canvas & 3D: Experience building interactive graphics, 3D product visualizers, or canvas animations using Three.js or ``.

- Full-Stack & API Design: Experience across backend/database layers (PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL API design, and authentication flows (OAuth, JWT).

- Client-Facing & Management: Direct experience working with clients to clarify requirements, defining product roadmaps, or leading engineering teams.

💸 Compensation

Our pay scale ranges from $40/hr to $120/hr pending seniority (& team leadership experience), and our projects are rarely less than 8 full time weeks at 40 hours per week.

We prefer long standing relationships with highly accountable and communicative team members, so we encourage candidates to expect longer term engagements.

🎤 How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

👩‍🏭 How we work:

We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason Sanctuary works differently to most shops:

- Transparency & Ownership: We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. We’re proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.

- 150% Carbon Negative: Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.

- Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).

- Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.

- Remote Friendly: Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.

- Ideas & Products: In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

→ Read more on our Substack, over here, or our Medium, over there.

Important Reminders

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! Thank you! :)

title: Freelance Graphic Designer
description:

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in logo design, branding, visual communication, typography, and layout to transform ideas into professional, polished creative assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, layout design, and creating diverse marketing materials.

*What We Do*

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

*About the Role*

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Graphic Designer, you'll work across a variety of visual design tasks, with a particular focus on logo design, brand identity, and visual concept development. You may also work on layouts, infographics, social media templates, one-pagers, and other marketing and communication assets. We are looking for a versatile designer who can translate ideas and brand concepts into clear, distinctive visual solutions while maintaining a high level of craft and consistency across different formats.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Design distinctive, professional logos and visual identity concepts based on different brand requirements and creative briefs.
* Explore and develop multiple logo directions, using strong conceptual thinking to translate brand ideas into effective visual symbols and systems.
* Apply branding principles across different assets to maintain a consistent and recognizable visual identity.
* Create clean layouts, modern infographics, and clear visual hierarchies to ensure readable and engaging content.
* Design reusable templates for social media channels, marketing materials, and impactful one-pagers.
* Elevate everyday materials by working deeply with advanced typography, grid systems, and thoughtful composition.
* Transform raw data and concepts into professional, polished visual assets tailored to specific marketing and communication goals.
* Enforce design quality standards through systematic verification of visual alignment, color usage, and layout consistency prior to delivery.

*Important note*

Please submit your CV in English. *Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with relevant graphic design work. Portfolios featuring strong logo design and visual identity projects will be particularly important for this role.* Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.

This is project-based freelance work. Tasks are available only when projects are active. You may be invited to one or more projects depending on your profile and current opportunities.

*How to get started*

Simply apply to this post, complete the qualification process, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills — on your own schedule.

*Requirements*

*Educational qualifications*

* At least 1-2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, digital design, or visual communications is desirable.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related creative fields is a plus.

*Academic and/or Professional Experience*

Candidates must have a strong portfolio demonstrating professional graphic design work, with relevant examples of logo design, branding, or visual identity development. We are particularly interested in designers who can demonstrate the ability to create original logo concepts and translate brand ideas into effective visual solutions. A broader portfolio showcasing formats such as social media graphics, marketing collateral, infographics, and one-pagers is also highly valued. We are looking for versatile specialists with an exceptional grasp of typography, visual composition, color, and grid systems. An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented approach is essential, along with the ability to work independently to solve visual challenges.

*Technical Skills (Essential)*

* Logo & Identity Design: Proven ability to develop original logo concepts and visual identities, from initial exploration through polished final execution.
* Branding: Strong understanding of brand identity principles, including typography, color, visual language, consistency, and practical application across different formats.
* Concept Development: Ability to interpret creative briefs and translate abstract brand ideas into distinctive, relevant, and visually effective concepts.
* Layout & Typography: Exceptional grasp of typography, precise grid systems, and visual composition to elevate everyday materials.
* Visual Asset Creation: Proven ability to structure information cleanly through modern infographics and compelling social media templates.
* Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma to handle a wide spectrum of visual tasks.
* Format Versatility: Seamlessly switch between designing impactful one-pagers and highly engaging digital templates, adapting to the constraints of each medium.

*Additional requirements*

* An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented mindset.
* Strong dedication to delivering visually polished, professional-grade assets.
* Self-directed work ethic with the ability to manage diverse visual tasks simultaneously.
* *Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with graphic design examples. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant graphic design cases, will not be considered.*
* English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

*Project time expectations*

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

On this project, contributors can earn up to *$34 per hour equivalent* , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

title: Manager, Product Design: AI Products
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity
----------------

AI is a top strategic priority for New Relic, and the Bengaluru design team is at the center of it. The team works across three closely related product clusters: autonomous incident response (SRE Agent, Autopilot, and Intelligent RCA), the intelligence and platform layer that powers them (Ground Truth, Agentic Platform, and New Relic AI), and AIOps for event correlation and incident management. These products share a common design challenge: users need to trust systems that act autonomously, and building that trust through good design is genuinely hard work.

This is an on-site role in Bengaluru. Your designers are there, and many of your engineering and product partners are too. Being present — in standups, reviews, and the quick conversations before a decision gets made — is part of how you'll build the relationships that make design effective. You'll also collaborate with design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain, so operating across time zones and communicating well in writing are part of the job.

You'll manage a small team of designers and own the quality of the work across these products. The design questions here don't have established answers — how do you make an autonomous system legible? How do you build user trust in AI-generated root cause analysis? How do you design a handoff from machine decision to human judgment? If you're already working in AI product design, or actively building toward it, and you want to lead a team on problems where the playbook doesn't exist yet, this is that role.

What you'll do
--------------

* *Manage and develop your designers* — run consistent 1:1s including regular career development conversations, give direct and specific feedback, set clear expectations for each person, and invest in their growth. Build a team culture where people feel they belong and different perspectives are welcome. You'll represent your team in calibration conversations and advocate for their work and careers within the broader design org.
* *Own design quality across AI Products* — review work critically, raise problems before they reach partners, and make sure the team is solving the right problems at the right level of craft. For these products, that means consistently asking: does this design make the system legible? Does it earn trust or just assert it?
* *Keep the user's perspective in the conversation* — design managers at New Relic are the voice of the user in product and engineering discussions. For AI products, that means bringing user research and real-world usage patterns into roadmap conversations, and pushing back when a feature optimizes for the AI's capability rather than the user's understanding of it.
* *Partner with PM and Engineering* — work with your product and engineering counterparts as a peer. Hold the design perspective, push back when the direction needs it, and communicate design's value in terms the business tracks: adoption, incident resolution time, customer retention.
* *Keep the team focused and on track* — manage incoming work, maintain visibility into what's in flight, help the team balance competing priorities, and set clear expectations with PM and Engineering partners about what's possible and when.
* *Help your team design for AI well* — bring a genuine point of view on AI interaction design: trust, transparency, human-in-the-loop moments, designing for systems that act before the user asks. Use AI tools actively in your own workflow — Figma AI, Claude, Gemini, and others — and help your team develop theirs for faster prototyping, better research synthesis, and exploring directions that would take weeks with traditional tools.
* *Contribute IC design work when the work calls for it* — you're an experienced designer, and these products are complex enough that there will be moments where the team needs your hands on a problem. Roll up your sleeves when it's the right call; delegate when it isn't.
* *Hire well* — contribute to recruiting when the team has open roles. Use each hire to bring in diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and build the kind of team where different viewpoints make the work better.
* *Connect Bengaluru to the rest of the design org* — bridge your team to design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain. Apply New Relic's design standards and practices locally, and make sure your team isn't developing in isolation from the broader design org direction.

This role requires
------------------

* 8+ years of product design experience, with meaningful time on technically complex B2B or enterprise software — products with real technical users and high stakes in production
* 2–4 years of direct people management — you've run 1:1s, given honest performance feedback, and developed designers at different career stages
* Genuine curiosity about AI product design — ideally you're already working in this space. You have a developing point of view on trust, transparency, and human-in-the-loop design, and you can evaluate whether a design makes an autonomous system legible and trustworthy. You're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and contribute design work on problems where the answers aren't settled
* Experience working in ambiguity — defining problems and shipping to learn, not waiting for a complete brief before starting
* Experience working across time zones — comfortable with async communication and able to build real working relationships with partners you won't always see in person
* A clear design point of view and the confidence to use it — you can evaluate work, give specific feedback, and hold a position with a PM or engineering partner who pushes back
* Strong written and verbal communication in English — this is a distributed org and clear communication is how work stays connected across it
* Comfort working in code-adjacent tools — the AI products team works actively in Claude Code and VS Code, and you'll need to be able to engage with the work and evaluate it at that level
* A portfolio showing your design process and how you reason through hard problems — not just finished screens, but how you think and what tradeoffs you made

Bonus points if you have
------------------------

* Hands-on experience designing AI-native products — agentic workflows, autonomous systems, AI confidence visualization, human-in-the-loop flows, or building user trust in AI-generated outputs
* Experience with observability, incident response, or developer-facing infrastructure products
* Familiarity with design systems and when to work within them vs. when to push on them
* Experience hiring and growing a design team over time

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com.

We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid.

*Our hiring process*

In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Procurement Architect
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is looking for an experienced Solutions Architect, Procurement (Pre-Sales, Enterprise) to serve as the technical and functional expert for Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) within our Solutions organization. This role is designed for someone who brings deep procurement domain expertise, technical implementation knowledge, and architect-level solution design skills to accelerate Ramp’s most complex, high-value enterprise evaluations.

You will support enterprise Account Executives and Solutions Consultants in running sophisticated procurement cycles end-to-end — leading deep discovery, validating technical requirements, designing future-state workflows, and creating pre-sale implementation plans that ensure a seamless handoff to onboarding. You will act as Ramp’s primary procurement SME in the sales cycle and will partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Post-Sales Solutions to influence roadmap and shape how Ramp’s procurement offering evolves.

This is a highly visible, customer-facing role ideal for former P2P implementers, procurement architects, or senior-level SCs with technical depth.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

LEAD TECHNICAL DISCOVERY AND SOLUTION DESIGN

- Conduct deep-dive discovery sessions on procurement workflows, vendor management, sourcing, approvals, catalog strategy, and 3-way match requirements

- Map customer procurement requirements to Ramp’s capabilities, identifying gaps and designing scalable workarounds

- Analyze ERP configurations and data structures (Vendor Master, PO, Invoice, Receipt) to ensure compatibility with Ramp’s deployment patterns

DRIVE TECHNICAL VALIDATION AND PRE-SALE IMPLEMENTATION PLANNING

- Build pre-sale implementation plans (phases, timelines, dependencies) to eliminate re-discovery during onboarding

- Conduct integration assessments, including API workflow validation, SFTP/data exchange requirements, and security/permissions modeling

- Create workflow prototypes, configurations, and proof-of-concepts when needed to accelerate technical validation

PARTNER WITH SALES TO WIN COMPLEX ENTERPRISE DEALS

- Operate as the procurement technical lead in enterprise opportunities

- Join high-value and complex P2P evaluations as the primary procurement SME, either as an overlay or as the lead SC for procurement-first deals

- Quantify customer pain, run gap analyses, and translate procurement challenges into measurable ROI and value propositions

INFLUENCE PRODUCT AND GTM STRATEGY

- Provide structured feedback to Product on gaps, customer needs, and market trends

- Help shape Ramp’s procurement roadmap and competitive positioning

- Maintain a bird’s-eye view of the procurement technology landscape to inform strategic decisions

ENSURE SEAMLESS HANDOFF TO ONBOARDING

- Document all procurement requirements, decisions, and implementation guidance in a standardized format

- Partner closely with Implementation and Technical Consulting teams to ensure they begin activation without additional discovery

- Maintain consultative availability throughout onboarding when complex escalations arise

TRAVEL

- Travel up to 30%+ for onsite discovery workshops, executive briefings, and solution validation sessions

WHAT YOU NEED

- 8+ years of experience in Procurement, P2P, ERP, or similar technical implementation roles

- Deep understanding of end-to-end procurement processes, including sourcing, procurement operations, vendor management, AP, bill pay, and contract workflows

- Hands-on experience designing or implementing P2P solutions (Coupa, Ariba, Zip, Ivalua, Workday, NetSuite, etc.)

- Strong technical acumen — API experience required, plus familiarity with SFTP, integrations, data migration, SCIM/SAML, and ERP financial objects

- Experience running enterprise evaluations with C-suite and VP-level stakeholders

- Exceptional communication and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex workflows into clear solutions

- Ability to design future-state workflows and build pre-sale implementation plans

NICE TO HAVE

About the Role

As a member of Ramp’s Financial Crimes Compliance Team, you will play a key role in executing Ramp’s Anti–money laundering (AML) and sanctions compliance program. You will be responsible for conducting investigations, preparing unusual and suspicious activity reports (UARs, SARs), driving process improvement, and supporting AI and automation initiatives for the AML program.

This role is primarily focused on comprehensive investigations arising from escalated transaction-monitoring alerts and internal referrals. You will evaluate the customer relationship and relevant activity holistically, document clear and defensible risk conclusions, and prepare high-quality SARs and UARs when appropriate. You will flex into other Financial Crimes Compliance workflows as business needs evolve, including sanctions, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and enhanced due diligence reviews.

You will also help strengthen how Financial Crimes Compliance operates. This is an opportunity for someone who combines rigorous risk-based judgment with a builder mindset: improving review workflows, quality standards, and procedures while partnering with Product, Engineering, Design, Data (PEDD) to develop the tooling, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities that will allow Ramp to scale responsibly.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment, has strong analytical and investigative skills, and is excited about building scalable processes to support Ramp’s growth.

What You’ll Do

- Lead comprehensive investigations of escalated transaction-monitoring alerts and internal referrals, maintaining appropriate case documentation, making defensible risk-based decisions, and meeting regulatory reporting obligations.

- Recommend account actions or restrictions based on financial crimes risk, and present findings and recommendations to the Account Review Board.

- Draft and file SARs and prepare applicable partner reporting, ensuring narratives are clear, evidence-based, timely, and confidential.

- Conduct secondary and peer reviews of investigations and filings, strengthening quality, consistency, and investigator judgment.

- Identify and drive practical improvements to investigation workflows, procedures, quality standards, tooling, and training.

- Partner with Compliance, Risk, PEDD, and Operations to build scalable workflows, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities.

- Flex into other Financial Crimes Compliance work, including sanctions, PEPs, customer due diligence, and enhanced due diligence reviews, as program needs require.

What You Need

- Minimum 5 years of experience in BSA/AML advisory or operations teams, with at least 2 years in BSA/AML investigations

- Demonstrated experience drafting and filing SARs and making recommendations to leadership on account actions such as offboarding or risk acceptance

- At least 1 year of experience conducting secondary or peer reviews of financial-crimes investigations

- Deep knowledge of money-laundering and terrorist-financing typologies, with the ability to apply that knowledge to Ramp’s products, payment flows, and business-customer risk.

- Demonstrated experience improving financial-crimes processes, procedures, controls, tooling, training, or quality standards.

- AI fluency, including the ability to design repeatable, validated multi-step AI-assisted workflows with clear inputs, outputs, review checkpoints, and defined processes to identify, correct, and improve unreliable results.

- Prior Fintech experience

Nice to Haves

- Experience working with bank partners, card issuers, payment partners, or other regulated financial-services partners, including diligence requests, audits, reporting, or operational escalations.

- ACAMS certification or an equivalent qualification.

- Experience delivering automation or AI-assisted workflow improvements in a regulated compliance environment.

title: Manager, Account Management, SME & Growth, France
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a Manager, Account Management, France to lead and develop a team of four Account Managers responsible for retaining, supporting and expanding Airwallex’s French customer base.

This is a highly hands-on player-coach role. You will own the team’s post-sale operating model across Onboard, Adopt, Prove Value and Expand, while remaining directly involved in strategic accounts, customer escalations, onboarding quality and expansion opportunities.

You will work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations to improve customer outcomes and make Airwallex easier to adopt and grow in France.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

LEAD AND COACH THE TEAM

- Manage and develop four Account Managers through focused 1:1s, account reviews, call coaching and development plans.

- Set clear standards for account planning, stakeholder coverage, customer communication, CRM hygiene and commercial execution.

- Improve individual performance through real customer situations, not activity reporting alone.

- Build a team that can operate with increasing autonomy and consistent judgement.

OWN CUSTOMER OUTCOMES AND PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

- Segment the portfolio by customer value, complexity, risk and expansion potential.

- Define the right coverage model: high-touch for strategic and high-potential accounts, more scaled motions for lower-complexity accounts.

- Ensure priority customers have clear success outcomes, stakeholder maps, adoption plans and expansion hypotheses.

- Improve the leading indicators of NRR: onboarding progress, time-to-value, product adoption, stakeholder coverage, customer health and expansion pipeline.

- Improve the lagging outcomes: retention, GRR, NRR, satisfaction and advocacy.

DRIVE EXPANSION AND ACCOUNT GROWTH

- Build a repeatable, customer-led expansion motion across accounts, payments, FX, cards, Spend, payouts and related products.

- Ensure expansion is based on validated customer needs, business triggers and demonstrated value—not product pitching alone.

- Personally support strategic renewals, upsells, cross-sells and executive customer conversations.

- Partner with Sales on handovers, pre-sales support and opportunities requiring specialist or new-business involvement.

BUILD THE OPERATING SYSTEM

- Create practical playbooks for onboarding, adoption, customer health, level 2 support, renewal and expansion.

- Establish weekly reviews for risks, strategic accounts, escalations and expansion opportunities.

- Improve visibility and predictability through clear CRM standards, account plans, health reviews and forecasting.

- Build a closed-loop Voice of Customer process with Product, Operations, KYC, Risk and Support.

- Turn recurring customer friction into process improvements rather than repeated individual escalations.

ORCHESTRATE COMPLEX CUSTOMER ISSUES

- Own the customer-facing coordination of important level 2 issues involving Support, KYC, Risk, Product or Operations.

- Structure escalations with clear context, business impact, owner, next step and customer communication.

- Influence internal teams to find workable solutions without bypassing controls or making unsupported commitments.

This role owns customer outcomes and orchestration. It is not a support queue-management role, and it does not replace the specialised ownership of Support, KYC, Risk or Compliance.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within 90 days, you have mapped the portfolios, priority accounts, risks and expansion opportunities; established the team cadence; and created visibility on the main customer and operational issues.

Within 6–12 months:

- priority accounts have clear plans, stakeholder coverage and next-best actions;

- onboarding, adoption, escalation and expansion playbooks are consistently used;

- leading indicators such as time-to-value, adoption, health coverage and expansion pipeline improve;

- GRR, NRR, customer satisfaction and retention improve against an agreed baseline;

- recurring customer issues are reduced through better processes and cross-functional ownership;

- the four Account Managers show stronger autonomy, commercial judgement and consistency.

WHO YOU ARE

- 5+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Expansion or a related B2B commercial role.

- 2+ years of direct people management, ideally leading a team of 3–8.

- Proven ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, customer health or comparable outcomes.

- Experience working with NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, adoption, time-to-value or customer satisfaction metrics.

- Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, spend management, ERP or another complex operational environment.

- Strong customer-facing experience with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Procurement, E-commerce, founders or senior executives.

- Evidence of building or improving customer processes, playbooks, account segmentation, health reviews, handovers or escalation routines.

- Ability to influence Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations without direct authority.

- Fluent French and professional English.

- Strong commercial judgement, ownership and comfort working in ambiguity.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

- Payments, fintech, banking, FX, cards, spend management or financial infrastructure.

- KYC, AML, Risk, Compliance or regulated customer operations.

- Strategic or multi-entity customers across France and international markets.

- Pre-sales, onboarding design or solution development.

- Travel, E-commerce, SaaS, Technology or Professional Services.

THE PROFILE WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You are a hands-on manager who enjoys customer conversations, coaches through real situations and creates structure where processes are not yet mature. You combine customer empathy with commercial discipline, solve root causes rather than simply escalating issues, and turn customer insight into better team performance and repeatable growth.

This is not a pure support-management role, a purely strategic Customer Success role or a passive relationship-management position.

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

We're a small, elite, builder-focused team inside Airwallex, moving at startup speed with a scaled company's infrastructure and distribution behind us.

What you’ll do

Your job is to get the right people to our website and keep them engaged once they've raised their hand. That's the whole charter: top of funnel, and lifecycle.

Today almost none of that machinery exists. There's no attribution set up, no landing page library, no lifecycle program, no paid motion running at any real scale. You'll have the opportunity to build it all. You'll be in the ad platforms, in the CMS, in the tag manager, writing the email sequences and reading the numbers the next morning.

This is a hands-on-keys role on a team small enough that what you ship this week shows up in the pipeline next week. You'll work directly with our CEO, Chief of Staff, Product Marketer, and Founding GTM hire.

This role is based in San Francisco.

Responsibilities:

- Own paid acquisition. Manage our agency relationship and hold them to results. Own budget pacing, channel mix, creative testing, and reporting. Our Founding GTM hire will help identify which channels are producing; you're the one who executes against that and makes the spend work.

- Build the measurement spine. Pixels, UTM conventions, event tracking, attribution. Right now we can't cleanly answer "where did that lead come from" — that's your first month. Everything downstream depends on you getting this right.

- Ship landing pages and run conversion rate optimization. Build pages fast, test them, kill the losers. You own the funnel from click to signup: page structure, form design, CTAs, and the experiment cadence that improves them.

- Own lifecycle marketing end to end. Design and run the onboarding, nurture, and re-engagement programs. You'll build the sequences, set the triggers, and own the metrics. Messaging gets reviewed before it ships, but the program is yours.

- Grow our distribution. Our Product Marketer writes the T:0 newsletter; you're responsible for the list it goes to actually growing. Same for every other owned channel.

- Own technical SEO and organic social publishing. Site structure, speed, indexing, schema, and getting content out the door on the channels where our audience is.

- Report on all of it. Bring a clear weekly read on what's working, what isn't, and what you're changing. We'd rather see a fast, honest read than a polished one that's a week late.

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

- 3+ years in growth, performance marketing, demand gen, or a similar hands-on role. We care far more about what you've personally shipped than where you did it.

- You've run paid campaigns yourself — built them, funded them, optimized them — not just sat in the readout.

- You're comfortable in the plumbing: tag managers, UTM hygiene, analytics tools, a CMS or landing page builder. You don't need to be an engineer, but nothing on that list should scare you. We use Webflow for our website and Hubspot for marketing automation right now

- You're genuinely analytical. You can pull a number, know whether to trust it, and say plainly what it means.

- You move fast and you'd rather launch something scrappy today than something perfect next month. This is a team where the bottleneck should never be you.

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience marketing to founders or early-stage startups.

- Experience at early stage (pre-seed/seed/series A) startup

- You've built lifecycle programs from zero, not just maintained someone else's.

- You use AI tools aggressively to move faster — research, copy drafts, creative iteration, analysis.
