Build the future of the AI Data Cloud. Join the Snowflake team.

At Snowflake, we’re on a mission to help our customers unlock the full potential of their data. As an Account Engineer, you’ll play a key role in delivering technical expertise and building relationships with prospects and customers as they explore the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. This is a fantastic opportunity to grow your career, develop your skills, and make an impact in a supportive and dynamic environment.

You’ll work alongside experienced team members, contributing to a variety of customer engagements, from technical evaluations to inspiring future-state architectures. This role blends technical problem-solving, collaboration, and customer focus, making it an exciting step for someone looking to grow into a technical customer-facing role.

What You’ll Do

- Support Customer Engagements: Assist in presenting Snowflake’s technology and vision to diverse audiences, from technical contributors to business leaders. Develop your skills in aligning technical solutions with business outcomes.

- Contribute to Technical Wins: Collaborate with customers to plan and execute technical evaluations and proof-of-concept demonstrations, supported by senior team members. Help tailor solutions to customer needs while learning how to communicate business value effectively.

- Learn & Build Relationships: Partner with customers and technical champions to foster trust and collaboration. Build your expertise in championing Snowflake’s capabilities and contributing to long-term customer success.

- Develop Technical Expertise: Gain hands-on experience through tailored demos, hands-on labs, and Snowflake’s extensive learning resources. Stay informed about industry trends, competitive offerings, and emerging technologies.

- Collaborate for Success: Work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Snowflake’s partner ecosystem to ensure customers realize the value of Snowflake.

- Grow as a Professional: Take advantage of mentorship opportunities, on-the-job learning, and a team that’s invested in your development.

The Team You’ll Join & The Culture We Foster

At Snowflake, we prioritize collaboration, curiosity, and a growth mindset. You’ll be part of a supportive team where learning and development are celebrated. We foster a culture of inclusion, empathy, and mutual respect, ensuring everyone has the opportunity to contribute and thrive. This role is dedicated to supporting our Enterprise Growth team.

What You Bring (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational Experience: Some experience in a technical role (e.g., Solution engineering, solutions architecture, or software development), preferably in SaaS, data analytics, or cloud technology.

- Willingness to Learn: A passion for solving problems and eagerness to grow your technical and business skills.

- Technical Aptitude: Basic familiarity with SQL and/or Python, or a strong willingness to learn.

- Communication Skills: Ability to communicate effectively with diverse audiences, both written and verbal.

- Customer Focus: A desire to understand customer challenges and deliver meaningful solutions.

- Team Player: A collaborative approach to working with peers, partners, and customers.

- Location: You are located on the West Coast.

What Sets You Apart (Preferred Qualifications)

- Working with modern data technologies like Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, BigQuery etc (including CI/CD tooling, Spark, containers, DevOps tools, orchestration tools, Git).

- Understanding public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their services.

- Familiarity with data science, machine learning workflows, or governance tools.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

- On Target Earnings (OTE) Range including base + commission bonus: $140,000 - $183,750

- Snowflake offers competitive base salary, variable compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits including 401(k), health/dental/vision, flexible PTO, and professional development budget.

We are looking for an experienced attorney to join Snowflake's Legal team as Director, Assistant General Counsel - Litigation. This role will report to Snowflake’s Senior Director, Associate General Counsel - Employment & Litigation.  This is an in-person role based in Menlo Park, CA or Atlanta, GA. This is not a remote position.

Responsibilities

Litigation Management and Advising

- Working collaboratively with our Legal team, outside counsel, and cross-functional stakeholders, manage disputes and litigation matters across their full lifecycle — from initial case assessment through resolution.

- Lead and manage internal investigations on matters involving legal risks to Snowflake, including coordinating with the People team, Security organization, and other relevant functions.

- Manage and coordinate responses to subpoenas, garnishment orders, domestic relations orders, statutory requests for information, and requests from government and law enforcement agencies.

- Review and advise on litigation-related contractual provisions in commercial agreements, including dispute resolution, governing law, venue, arbitration, limitation of liability, and indemnification clauses.

- Advise business stakeholders on litigation risks and issues involved in business disputes; pragmatically weigh legal risks and benefits of complex situations and propose practical, business-oriented solutions with tact and maturity.

- Manage outside counsel relationships, including matter staffing, billing review, and strategic direction of litigation.

- Partner with privacy counsel and other specialists on disputes involving data, security, or regulatory matters.

Process & Infrastructure

- Lead efforts to create, improve, and scale processes and procedures related to the handling of litigation matters for a rapidly growing, global company, including litigation hold protocols, matter tracking, reporting, and knowledge management.

- Partner with legal operations on litigation-related technology, data, and workflow improvements.

- Develop and maintain internal resources, templates, and playbooks to support consistent and efficient litigation management.

Requirements

- JD from an accredited law school, active membership in at least one state bar, and ability to practice in the jurisdiction in which this position is located.

- Minimum of 8 years of legal experience, with substantive in-house litigation management and law firm experience; people management experience a plus.

- Proven experience managing complex litigation matters; class action experience a plus.

- Demonstrated ability to manage outside counsel, control litigation budgets, and set case strategy.

- Experience conducting and coordinating internal investigations.

- Experience managing responses to subpoenas and government/law enforcement inquiries.

- Ability to explain complicated legal concepts in plain language.

- Strong organizational skills, exceptional judgment, and comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

- Fosters team collaboration through high-quality work, a positive attitude, and clear, solution-focused communication.

- Provide support in developing, overseeing, and executing projects related to global mobility.

- 4+ years of corporate experience in global relocation and immigration, including managing international assignments.

- Expert knowledge of U.S. immigration regulations and compliance.

- Strong relocation management and organizational skills.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to interact with all levels of the organization, including global partners and senior stakeholders.

- Ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately handle sensitive information with discretion.

title: Finance Manager, Marketing
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

Job Posted: September 21, 2026

Hi there!

We're looking for a Finance Manager to be the dedicated finance partner for Zapier's marketing organization. This is a unique opportunity to own the full financial picture for one of the most strategically important spend areas at the company - headcount, budget, and channel investment while playing a key role in connecting marketing activity to pipeline and revenue outcomes. You'll report into the Head of GTM Finance and partner closely with marketing leadership, working closely with Sales FP&A and Corporate FP&A to establish a clean interlock between marketing, sales, and company level financials.

- Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

- Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

- Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

- Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

- Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/

ABOUT YOU

- You have a strong investment banking background with exposure to GTM motions, or 8+ years of experience in marketing FP&A or GTM finance - either path with a solid understanding of how sales pipeline converts to closed-won revenue

- You're comfortable owning a budget end to end, including headcount, spend actuals, and purchase orders, and communicating variance clearly to non-finance stakeholders

- You have a strong grasp of channel-level marketing economics (pipeline generation vs. brand), cost per pipe, and how to connect spend to downstream pipeline and revenue outcomes

- You're comfortable with ambiguity - able to structure a loosely-defined problem yourself rather than needing it handed to you fully scoped

- You have good judgment and a bias toward surfacing issues and opportunities proactively, not waiting to be asked

- You actively use AI tools to work more efficiently, with the judgment to know when to go deep manually and when to lean on the tool

- You're a strong written and verbal communicator, able to turn a complex analysis into a short, clear executive takeaway with guidance from your manager

- Experience with Google Sheets, a data warehouse (Databricks or Snowflake), NetSuite, Zip, and HubSpot is preferred

THINGS YOU’LL DO

- Own marketing FP&A end-to-end: headcount planning, budget building, and actuals tracking, so marketing leadership always has a clear, current view of where things stand against plan

- Own channel allocation analysis (demand generation vs. brand) and drive ROI-by-channel reporting

- Work on sales pipeline forecasting based on spend, as part of setting GTM targets and ARR modeling, flagging risks to pipeline coverage or targets early

- Serve as an embedded business partner to marketing leadership - not a once-a-month reporting function, but someone marketing trusts to think through decisions with in real time

- Track purchase orders and vendor commitments against budget, flagging overspend risk before it happens

- Analyze the connection between marketing spend, pipeline generation, and closed-won revenue, working cross-functionally with Sales and RevOps

- Partner with the Data team to establish and govern pipeline reporting definitions (leads, MQLs, opportunities) so the funnel is consistent end to end

- Use AI to automate recurring finance processes, building skills and agents that can run parts of month-end close and re-forecasting cycles

HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here https://zapier.com/legal/data-privacy.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.

APPLICATION DEADLINE:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_lXQvKwuU4xXEbye7EW_En8iv1ZIMlQNmT7B2Mzbo24/edit?gid=0#gid=0 for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

description:
About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The RoleWe are looking for a Mobile UI Designer to create elegant, intuitive and high-performing mobile experiences for BJAK's AI Neobank and financial products.

This role is for someone who loves designing mobile interfaces that feel effortless, responsive and visually refined. You'll work alongside engineers and product managers to create experiences used daily by millions of users.
What You'll Own
- Design beautiful and intuitive interfaces for iOS and Android applications.

- Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes and production-ready UI.

- Design mobile experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and financial services.

- Build and maintain mobile design systems and reusable components.

- Work closely with developers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.

- Optimize interfaces for usability, accessibility and platform guidelines.

- Iterate designs using analytics, usability findings and product feedback.

- Ensure consistency across different devices, screen sizes and operating systems.

What We're Looking For
- 2+ years of experience designing mobile applications.

- Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality mobile UI work.

- Expert proficiency in Figma and interactive prototyping.

- Deep understanding of iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design.

- Strong understanding of mobile usability, responsive layouts and interaction design.

- Excellent attention to typography, spacing, colour and visual hierarchy.

- Ability to simplify complex financial workflows into clean mobile experiences.

- Portfolio is required.

Design Stack
- Figma

- FigJam

- Design Systems

- Auto Layout

- Interactive Prototyping

- iOS Human Interface Guidelines

- Material Design

The Kind of Builder We Want
- Thinks mobile-first.

- Obsesses over visual polish and interaction quality.

- Notices small UI inconsistencies before users do.

- Cares about accessibility, responsiveness and performance.

- Collaborates closely with engineers to deliver high-quality products.

- Takes pride in shipping pixel-perfect interfaces.

This Role Is Not For
- Designers whose experience is primarily marketing or branding.

- People who design without considering real user behaviour.

- Designers unfamiliar with mobile platform conventions.

- Individuals who struggle to collaborate with engineers.

- Candidates who cannot explain the rationale behind their design decisions.

LocationThis role is remote, but candidates must be based in China. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in China.
LanguageEnglish is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.
Interview ProcessOur process is designed to move fast:
- Portfolio review

- Practical design task (if applicable)

- Role-specific interview

- CEO / Final interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Junior Product Designer based in India.*

Join a remote-first Product team focused on creating intuitive digital experiences for customers managing a global workforce.
You’ll contribute across the full product design lifecycle, from early concepts and user flows to polished interfaces and shipped experiences.
Working closely with product managers, engineers, and operations teams, you’ll turn real user problems into simple, effective solutions.
You’ll help evolve a growing design system while gaining hands-on experience with scalable product design practices.
The role combines mentorship with meaningful ownership, making it well suited to someone building their career in product or UX design.
You’ll have the opportunity to work on complex B2B workflows and transform them into clear, approachable user experiences.
Strong design thinking and portfolio quality are valued more than a specific number of years of professional experience.

Accountabilities
----------------

*

Design user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity user interfaces for new and existing product features.

*

Take design concepts from early exploration through implementation and final shipped experiences.

*

Contribute to and maintain the product design system in Figma, ensuring components, patterns, and interactions remain consistent as the platform evolves.

*

Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers throughout the development lifecycle, from requirements gathering through implementation and quality assurance.

*

Conduct lightweight user research and usability checks to understand user needs and identify opportunities for improvement.

Incorporate user and stakeholder feedback into iterative design solutions.

Create polished, developer-ready designs and specifications that clearly communicate intended interactions and visual details.

Solid understanding of user-centered design principles, information architecture, interaction design, and usability fundamentals.

Strong attention to detail and an interest in creating consistent, polished user experiences.

Comfortable working independently and asynchronously within a distributed, remote-first team.

Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and operational stakeholders.

Recent graduates, bootcamp graduates, self-taught designers, and candidates at other early stages of their design careers are welcome to apply.

A proactive, curious mindset with a willingness to learn, seek feedback, and take increasing ownership of design work.

Fully remote position based in India.

Remote-first and distributed working environment.

*

Direct collaboration with product, engineering, and operations stakeholders.

*

Mentorship and support designed to help develop your product design career.

Meaningful ownership of product experiences and features.

Opportunity to contribute to and learn from an evolving design system.

*

Exposure to complex B2B SaaS, workforce management, onboarding, and payroll-related workflows.

Opportunity to build experience across the complete product design lifecycle.

Flexibility and autonomy within an asynchronous working environment.

SMX is currently looking for a highly motivated *Software Engineer - Front End Web Application* s to contribute to the design, build, support, and implementation of the Budget and Spend (BAS) solution. This is an exciting role where you will work with some of the most interesting and powerful agencies in the world. This role is remote supporting a Washington, DC based customer and requires a Public Trust clearance.

*Essential Duties & Responsibilities:*

SAC is an all-in-one cloud product offered as software as a service (SaaS) for business intelligence (BI), planning, and predictive analytics. Using SAC Analytics Designer as a platform the team at SMX develops interactive web applications ranging from widgets & dashboards to sophisticated planning and analytic applications. This position will work with the team to develop new features as well as enhance existing features of the BAS web application built using SAC Analytics Designer.

* Build enterprise planning and reporting applications using SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) or other web technologies such as *JavaScript*
* Review application requirements and interface designs
* Develop and implement highly interactive UI/UX components
* Monitor and improve front-end performance.
* Document application changes and developing updates
* Provide feedback on the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs
* Optimize web applications for scalability and speed
* Participate in code reviews and communicate effectively with team members.

*Required Skills & Experience:*

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field (Software Engineering, Web Development) or equivalent job experience
* 2 years of software engineering experience working across front-end web technologies ( *JavaScript,* HTML5, CSS, etc.)
* Understanding of JavaScript and all its intricacies
* Knowledge of REST APIs, experience creating and consuming APIs, as well as ability to work with different data formats such as XML and JSON.
* Experience in Object Oriented Programming/Design, Web Development and debugging
* Proven ability to work independently as well as collaboratively
* Strong programming skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Public Trust
* U.S. citizenship required to maintain a federal clearance

*Desired Skills & Experience*

* SAP Analytics Cloud Experience
* Experience with Federal, State, Local, or Higher Education organizations
* Firm understanding of standard SDLC, lean, and agile practices

title: Junior Software Developer
description:
CerebriOS is a software company building B2B SaaS products that help businesses make better decisions, streamline operations, and get more value from their data. Our products combine practical business workflows with intuitive technology designed for everyday use. We bring together technology, data, and business expertise to create solutions that are scalable, reliable, and easy to use.

We are looking for a *Junior Software Developer* to join our engineering team and contribute to the development and improvement of our B2B SaaS products. This is an opportunity to build practical software skills while working alongside experienced developers on real product features, integrations, bug fixes, and technical improvements.

The ideal candidate is curious, detail-oriented, and eager to learn. You will receive guidance from more experienced team members while gradually taking ownership of development tasks and contributing to the full software development lifecycle.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
----------------

*

Develop and maintain software features under the guidance of senior developers.

*

Write clean, readable, and maintainable code.

*

Fix bugs and investigate issues reported by QA, support, or engineering teams.

*

Work with APIs and integrate application components and services.

*

Participate in code reviews and apply feedback to improve your work.

*

Write and maintain basic unit and integration tests.

*

Assist with debugging and troubleshooting application issues.

*

Collaborate with product, QA, design, and other engineering team members.

*

Update technical documentation and development notes.

*

Learn and apply software development best practices, coding standards, and security principles.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
-----------------------

*

0–2 years of professional software development experience, including internships or relevant projects.

*

Knowledge of at least one programming language such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, or C#.

*

Basic understanding of software development principles and object-oriented programming.

*

Familiarity with Git and version-control workflows.

*

Understanding of REST APIs and basic web development concepts.

*

Ability to troubleshoot problems and learn from technical feedback.

*

Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.

NICE TO HAVE
------------

*

Experience building personal, academic, or open-source software projects.

*

Familiarity with React, Node.js, or another modern development framework.

*

Basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases.

*

Experience with automated testing or CI/CD workflows.

*

Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or similar development tools.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS
-------------------------

*$60,000–$78,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.*

CerebriOS offers a remote-first work environment, hands-on learning opportunities, and the chance to work alongside experienced engineers on practical SaaS products. Team members are encouraged to develop their technical skills, take on increasing responsibility, and contribute ideas throughout the product development process.

HIRING PROCESS
--------------

Application review → recruiter screen → technical discussion or practical coding exercise → final team interview → offer.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
-----------------

CerebriOS is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity and consider qualified candidates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

*Location:* Remote

*Salary Range:* 60,000 - 78,000 USD (gross, annually)

title: Junior Field Service Engineer - Electrical
description:
Join us in Advancing the Environmental Global Impact within the Rail Industry

For nearly 40 years, ZTR has designed, developed and released products that have a positive environmental impact within the Locomotive Industry. Planning for an environmentally sustainable future means taking action today in preparation for tomorrow. Everyone has a role to play and we take ours seriously.

ZTR offers a casual working environment and a group of friendly and talented industry leaders passionate about combating climate change. We encourage and support employees to find long-term success and explore opportunities that play into their strengths and passions. We value lateral moves as much as vertical promotions; we believe all roles should develop your skills, broaden your experience, and help you continue on a journey to build a rewarding career at ZTR.

What You’ll be Doing

As the Junior Field Service Engineer – Electrical you will be joining our talented support team and providing quality technical support to our customers by troubleshooting PLC based solutions, and occasionally travelling to our customer sites to perform commissioning and installation of our equipment.

This role is based in the United States , in North Little Rock, Arkansas, and reports directly to the Technical Service Manager in London, Ontario, Canada.

Due to the nature of work, the successful candidate will be required to live in close proximity to either Little Rock, AR.

New graduates are welcomed to apply!

As a Junior Field Service Engineer - Electrical, you will:

* Program, configure and troubleshoot ZTR locomotive operation, products, and solutions

* Provide excellent Customer Service and Support in both field and telephone support
* Travel to customer sites for commissioning & installation of ZTR equipment
* Provide on-site technical training and presentations to customers
* Perform sales support and project management tasks as assigned

Minimum Qualifications:

* Mandatory Requirement: Two year or Advanced Diploma in Electrical Engineering Technology or Electrical Engineering degree
* Minimum 2+ years of relevant experience
* Experienced with PLCs
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong interpersonal and customer service skills for a variety of audiences
* Ability to work autonomously at customer sites and manage project scope & cost
* Exceptional organizational and data entry skills required for related administrative tasks
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 25% to customer sites for on-site commissioning and/or installation of ZTR equipment

Please apply even if you don’t qualify for all responsibilities or skills, we still want to hear from you!

Why Choose ZTR?

ZTR offers a positive working environment and a group of friendly and talented industry leaders passionate about driving environmental and financial benefits for our clients. We encourage and support employees to find long-term success and explore opportunities that play into their strengths and passions. We value lateral moves as much as vertical promotions; we believe all roles should develop your skills, broaden your experience, and help you continue on a journey to build a rewarding career at ZTR.

At ZTR, we continuously promote a healthy balance between work, fun and family. This is a place where employees make a difference in our company and within our customers’ organizations. You will have the ability to direct your career path at ZTR as we are rapidly growing with numerous opportunities for professional growth and development.

ZTR Control Systems provides accommodations for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require accommodation, please contact Human Resources. We will address information received regarding the accommodation needs of applicants in confidence.

title: Junior Business Analyst - Product
Junior Penetration Tester
description:
Iterasec works with clients worldwide, helping them find vulnerabilities and secure their products. Our projects range from mobile/web applications to complex modern cloud and automotive stacks. We work with both small product companies as well as Fortune 500 enterprises.

We are looking for a talented and motivated Junior Pentester who will join our security team to work on penetration testing and vulnerability/cloud security assessment projects.

We expect a short motivation letter where you can explain your skills, achievements and motivation.

Required skills

* Solid non-commercial cybersecurity experience, such as HTB/THM
* Junior-level cybersecurity certifications would be a plus.
* Comfortable with basic application security testing and common vulnerabilities (like OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25) and cybersecurity fundamentals
* Strong basic IT skills: Linux, networking (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP etc.)
* Some experience in scripting/coding languages, such as Java, JS, Python, Shell, etc.
* Strong drive to learn and develop cybersecurity skills
* Technical English (Intermediate)

We offer

* Good salary + bonus system
* Rewarding environment: brilliant team ready to share knowledge and collaborate
* Support in obtaining professional certifications, such as BSCP, OSCP, eWPTX, cloud certifications, etc.
* Courses and conferences which are relevant to the position are sponsored by the company.
* We are a remote-first company with full WFH support and a flexible work schedule.

Responsibilities

* Execute penetration tests and security assessments as part of a team, including internal/external networks, web and mobile applications, Windows and Linux environments, cloud architectures, IoT devices, and more
* Create assessment documentation and reports, clearly identifying vulnerabilities and associated remediation steps
* Conduct security research

Senior Frontend Developer (Remote)
description:

--------------

Our client is looking for a highly skilled Senior Frontend Developer to join their thriving, fully remote engineering team. You will play a key role in building and refining user interfaces for cutting-edge web applications, ensuring a seamless and responsive user experience. This position is ideal for a developer passionate about clean code, modern web technologies, and collaborative problem-solving within a distributed work environment. You will work closely with UX/UI designers and backend engineers to translate visual concepts into functional, high-performance features. This role offers the chance to lead technical initiatives and mentor junior developers in a supportive, remote-first culture.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Develop, test, and deploy responsive and accessible user interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, Angular).
* Collaborate with designers to implement pixel-perfect UIs and ensure cross-browser compatibility.
* Optimize application performance, focusing on speed, scalability, and maintainability.
* Write clean, well-documented, and reusable code, participating actively in code reviews.
* Troubleshoot and resolve frontend bugs and issues reported by QA or users.
* Contribute to architectural decisions and help define frontend development best practices.

Requirements
------------

* 5+ years of professional experience in frontend development .
* Strong expertise in HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
* Proficiency with at least one major frontend framework like React, Vue.js, or Angular.
* Experience with state management libraries (e.g., Redux, Vuex) and build tools (e.g., Webpack, Vite).
* Familiarity with RESTful APIs and asynchronous request handling.
* Excellent problem-solving abilities and experience working in an Agile, remote setting .

Benefits
--------

* Highly competitive salary with annual performance reviews.
* Fully remote work arrangement, allowing you to work from anywhere.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
* Generous allowance for home office setup and professional development.
* Collaborative and innovative engineering culture with regular virtual team events.

title: Junior Legal Counsel @ Mercuryo
description:
--------------------------------------------
Mercuryo: Enabling Seamless Digital Payments
--------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------------------
Building the Future of Regulated Fintech Solutions
--------------------------------------------------

Mercuryo is seeking a *Junior Legal Counsel* to support its U.S. legal and regulatory operations, with a primary focus on the multi-state Money Transmitter License (MTL) project and commercial contracting. This role is integral to ensuring Mercuryo’s compliance and operational excellence as a regulated payments company operating in a fast-paced, global fintech environment.

The Junior Legal Counsel will work closely with senior legal and compliance leaders to advance MTL licensing, conduct regulatory research, and manage application and post-licensing workstreams. Responsibilities include preparing and organizing legal materials for NMLS and state submissions, drafting application responses, and coordinating timely communications with internal and external stakeholders.

The role also involves reviewing and redlining commercial agreements, maintaining contract trackers, and ensuring all documentation aligns with Mercuryo’s regulatory obligations and risk standards. Additional duties include supporting the drafting and maintenance of policies and procedures required for regulated payments operations, monitoring legal developments, and providing concise, actionable guidance to business teams.

Ideal candidates will have 3-5 years of relevant legal experience in fintech, payments, banking, financial services, or digital assets, with strong legal research, writing, and contract review skills. Experience with U.S. money transmission licensing, NMLS filings, and regulated payments companies is highly valued. The position reports to the Head of Legal, US, and operates remotely within the United States.

title: Junior Pentester
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Junior Pentester based in Brazil.*

Join a global security team where you’ll build hands-on experience across modern penetration testing engagements.
You’ll work alongside experienced offensive security professionals across web applications, APIs, mobile, cloud, networks, and LLMs.
The role combines manual testing with AI-assisted security workflows, giving you exposure to emerging approaches in offensive security.
You’ll receive structured mentorship while developing your testing methodology, reporting, and client communication skills.
As your expertise grows, you’ll take on increasingly complex engagements and greater ownership.
This is an opportunity to strengthen your offensive security craft while contributing directly to the security of a diverse customer base.

Accountabilities
----------------

*

Conduct penetration testing engagements across web applications, APIs, mobile applications, cloud environments, LLMs, and networks using established methodologies and internal playbooks.

*

Combine manual testing techniques with AI-assisted tools for activities such as reconnaissance, payload generation, and initial vulnerability triage.

*

Validate AI-generated results manually, assess their accuracy, and understand the limitations of automated security tooling.

*

Identify, validate, and document security vulnerabilities with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, risk ratings, and practical remediation recommendations.

*

Assist senior penetration testers with engagement scoping, preparation, and other pre-engagement activities as required.

*

Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal testing templates, skills, plugins, MCPs, checklists, and technical documentation.

*

Gradually take ownership of more complex testing engagements as your technical expertise and confidence develop.

------------
Requirements
------------

*

1–2 years of experience in penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, or a closely related offensive security role; internships, freelance engagements, and bug bounty experience are also relevant.

*

At least one of the following certifications: *BSCP or OSCP*.

*

Foundational knowledge of web application security, including the OWASP Top 10, authentication and session management vulnerabilities, and common injection flaws.

*

Practical interest in offensive security demonstrated through self-study, security labs, CTFs, bug bounty programs, personal projects, coursework, or similar activities.

*

Comfortable incorporating AI tools into security workflows and able to critically validate AI-generated results rather than relying on them without verification.

*

Interest in emerging AI-related attack surfaces and how AI-powered features can introduce new security risks.

*

Security research, responsible disclosures, technical blog posts, conference talks, or other public security contributions are a plus, regardless of scale.

*

Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain technical security concepts clearly to different audiences.

*

A curious, self-driven, collaborative mindset and a genuine desire to continuously expand your offensive security toolkit.

--------
Benefits
--------

*

Competitive base salary.

*

Exceptional private healthcare.

*

Early equity opportunity in a fast-growing company.

*

Fully remote, work-from-home model.

*

Flexible paid time off.

*

Company-provided laptop.

*

Monthly wellness and home Wi-Fi stipend.

*

Structured career progression from junior to mid-level penetration tester, with clear development milestones and regular feedback.

*

Mentorship from experienced offensive security professionals.

*

Training, certification, and conference budget to support continued professional development.

*How Jobgether works:*

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

title: Junior Influencer Campaign Manager
description:
*Full-Time | Remote (Chili, Argentina and Mexico Only Applicants)*

*About The Sociable Society (TSS)*
At The Sociable Society, we connect social media personalities with world-renowned brands to create direct consumer marketing campaigns that target niche audiences. We take a personal, human-first approach to ensure our innovative Brand and Creator partnerships result in creative campaigns that captivate and enrich audiences, every time.

We are forward-thinking, digitally-minded entrepreneurs and we bring this attitude to our work environment and work ethic. We are looking for a team member who will contribute to *our creative, entrepreneurial mentality*. We offer flexibility in your work, and the opportunity to grow with us as a company.

*About the Role*
We’re looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented *Junior Campaign Manager* to support our Creator Management team. This role is focused on maintaining internal systems, creator data, and operational processes that help our team scale efficiently. This is an entry-level opportunity with a clear path to growth into a Campaign Manager role.

*The Day to Day:*

*Creator & Roster Management*

* Maintain accurate creator records, rosters, and internal databases
* Update and manage creator rosters and profiles
* Support onboarding and offboarding processes for creators
* Ensure all creator information is current, organized, and accessible

*Administrative & Operational Support*

* Support day-to-day operations for the Creator Management team
* Maintain trackers, reports, and internal documentation

* Coordinate product gifting and PR opportunities with creators
* Track and document gifting partnerships
* Communicate opportunities between internal teams and creators

*Growth & Research Support*

* Build and maintain creator referral and prospect lists
* Support team initiatives through research and data organization

*What We’re Looking For*

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively
* Interest in influencer marketing or the creator economy
* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Experience with spreadsheets or data tracking is a plus
* Fluent verbal and written English communication skills are required. This role requires frequent verbal and written communication with English-speaking clients, creators, and team members.

*Growth Opportunity*
This role is designed as a stepping stone into a Campaign Manager position, with opportunities to grow into a more campaign-focused role over time.

*Why Join TSS*

* Work with top creators and global brands
* Flexible, fully remote work environment
* Opportunities for professional development and growth.
* Collaborative, supportive, and fun team culture.

title: Junior Customer Service Representative (Bilingual English/Spanish - Omnichannel)
description:
*About Valatam*

At Valatam, we connect top bilingual talent from Latin America with leading global companies. Our people are the heart of our business, and we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work® (2025–2026)—proof that an exceptional employee experience leads to outstanding client results.

*About the Role*

We are seeking a high-performing *Junior Bilingual Customer Service Representative (CSR)* to join our growing remote team. This is a 100% remote, entry-level, full-time position open to candidates located anywhere in Latin America.

In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for routine customer inquiries across multiple channels. If you are a proactive, detail-oriented professional looking to build a career in bilingual customer support and remote virtual assistance, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

*Key Responsibilities*

* *Multichannel Customer Support:* Respond to routine inbound and outbound customer inquiries via phone, email, and live chat in a professional and timely manner.
* *Account & Troubleshooting Assistance:* Help customers with basic account updates, general inquiries, and standard technical or process troubleshooting.
* *Issue Escalation:* Identify complex or high-priority customer requests and escalate them smoothly to senior team members.
* *Follow-ups & Workflow Support:* Track pending communications, send routine reminders, and ensure all customer inquiries are resolved efficiently.
* *CRM & Data Entry:* Accurately update customer profiles, interaction logs, and records in internal databases and CRM tools.
* *Cross-Department Collaboration:* Work closely with internal teams to gather the necessary information to resolve customer queries.
* *Administrative Operations:* Provide general administrative support to the customer service department as needed.

*Requirements*

* Fluent English (C1/C2) and Spanish.

* 1 – 2 years of experience in administration or virtual assistance.
* Familiarity and comfort with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.
* Good communication and problem-solving skills.
* Quiet home office, stable internet (≥ 10 Mbps down / 2 Mbps up), and backup connection.
* Bachelor’s or Associate’s degree preferred.

*Benefits*

*Our Core Values at Work*

We live by *ACTION* (get things done), *CARE* (help others and do things right), *OUTSTANDING* (operate at the highest standards), *DEPENDABLE* (own every commitment), and *ENERGY* (bring positivity every day). You’ll thrive here if these values resonate with you.

UI/UX Designer — Creative Video Platform

About the project

We are building a platform for filmmakers, actors, videographers, and other video creators to showcase their work, build a professional portfolio, share projects, and understand how people interact with their content.
The product combines a portfolio platform, video sharing, and deep real-time analytics in one place.
Creators can upload finished work or works in progress, share individual projects with specific people, create their own portfolio website, and see detailed engagement data — including who viewed their work and how they interacted with it.

The product is being developed across Web and Apple mobile applications.

What we're looking for

We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can help us create a product that feels genuinely exciting and different.
This is a creative product for a creative audience. We don't want another generic SaaS dashboard or CRM-style interface.

We are looking for someone who can bring:
Strong visual design and attention to detail
Creative thinking and the ability to create a real WOW effect
A strong understanding of UX and user flows
Experience designing modern web and/or mobile products
Ability to create visually distinctive interfaces while keeping them intuitive and usable
Understanding of typography, layout, motion, interactions, and visual hierarchy
Ability to take a product idea and turn it into a polished experience
Willingness to experiment and propose your own ideas rather than simply follow specifications

What you'll work on

Depending on the project stage, your work may include:
Designing the creator portfolio experience
Designing project and video presentation pages
Creating sharing and privacy flows
Designing analytics and engagement experiences
Designing mobile application screens for iOS
Creating responsive web experiences
Developing and maintaining a consistent design system
Improving existing UX flows
Working with the development team to make sure designs are implemented accurately
Communicating directly with the client and incorporating feedback
Exploring new ideas and concepts for the product

What we value most

Creativity > templates.
We are particularly interested in designers whose portfolios demonstrate strong visual thinking and original product design.
Experience with creative industries, media, video, entertainment, portfolios, or creator platforms is a plus, but not required.
What matters most is what you can create.
We would rather see 3 exceptional projects than 20 generic dashboards.

Work format
Part-time
Hourly payment
Remote
Flexible schedule
Work as part of a development/design team
Direct collaboration with the client
Long-term cooperation is possible

Important

Please include your portfolio when applying.
We are especially interested in seeing:
Web and iOS mobile products you've designed

Products where you were responsible for UX as well as UI
Examples that demonstrate your personal design thinking

If your portfolio mainly consists of standard admin panels, CRM systems, tables, and dashboards, this probably isn't the right project for you.

title: Senior UI/UX Designer - New Games (1-year contract)
description:
---------
Our Story
---------

Founded in 2009, we’re one of the world’s leading game studios, and proud of our extremely international team, consisting of more than 50 different nations. We are part of Playtika and the global leader in the category of Hidden Object Games. With June’s Journey, we’re providing joy for millions of players around the world every day.

-----------
How we work
-----------

Our aim is to keep doing so for many more years, if not decades. In order to be able to do so, we’ve defined a distinct way of how we’re working at Wooga, so that all relevant aspects intertwine and have a positive impact on the game. No matter if you’re part of a game team or support the success of Wooga as part of a central team, all 250+ employees from around the world can make an impact. We’re proud of the environment we’ve built, and believe you’ll enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry.

Our drivers: Speed, Focus, Ownership, and Impact, guide our working style at Wooga and help us make a deliberate choice to focus on what is important to us, while working towards a shared goal.
These drivers shape how we work together and what we expect from ourselves and our leaders.

--------------
About the Role
--------------

We're looking for a Senior UI/UX professional with deep experience in casual mobile F2P games; someone who understands what makes games intuitive and compelling, and who can translate that understanding into clean, effective design. We're looking for someone who finds as much satisfaction in a polished UI screen as in a well-validated UX flow, and is comfortable owning their work end-to-end.

We’re a small team, and our process moves from quick prototyping through marketing validation to building a vertical slice and, if that succeeds, towards a launch. You'll shape UX early - helping validate that a concept is intuitive, and take on UI design and production as we build toward the various releases, with UX considerations continuing to surface as new features are added.

*Good to know:*

* This is a 1-year fixed-term contract
* While (re)location to Berlin is preferred, we will consider also remote applications. Please note that working hours will be standard Berlin working times (roughly 9 to 18).

-------------
About the job
-------------

* Design and create UI screens, icons, flows, buttons, and game components for early-stage casual F2P mobile games, staying true to a defined art direction
* Maintain and evolve UI style guides and design systems for consistency across screens and features
* Own UX for new game prototypes, ensuring mechanics (even reimagined ones) are intuitive and easy to onboard into
* Translate game design and monetization requirements into clear, player-friendly interfaces
* Collaborate closely with artists, game designers, product managers, and engineers
* Work independently to scope, prioritize, and own delivery of work
* Report directly to the Creative Director of New Games

---------
About you
---------

* Prior experience in the mobile gaming industry
* Strong UI design and execution skills, and sharp UX instincts, with the ability to shift fully into whichever the project phase demands, from concept-stage UX validation to UI production
* A solid grasp of onboarding, retention, and monetization-friendly design patterns
* 2D art skills for UI execution (icons, popups, liveops screens, and supporting visual elements in a defined art style)
* A portfolio demonstrating this range across UI production, UX validation, and supporting art
* Ability to work autonomously and drive ambiguous problems to resolution, while incorporating feedback from the Creative Director and cross-functional partners
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain decisions clearly to various cross-disciplinary stakeholders
* Proficiency with standard design tools (e.g., Figma, Photoshop, or equivalent) as well as Unity for implementation and testing
* Comfort working in a small team, prototyping, wearing multiple hats, and shifting between conceptual and hands-on work is essential

*Please note: Research has shown that some under-represented groups in the gaming industry (eg: women) tend to apply only if they meet every single requirement. Here at Wooga, the desire to learn and the willingness to solve problems are more important to us than your experience on paper. We encourage you to apply even if you do not think that you tick all the boxes - thinking outside of such boxes and embracing the diversity of mindsets and backgrounds is what we believe makes our teams thrive.*

-----------
Our Promise
-----------

* Shape the future! Challenge the status quo and team up with a diverse group of experts (over 50 nationalities!) working on crafting the world’s best games.
* We offer a generous relocation package and home search support if you are not already located in Berlin. Did we mention that we also cooperate with Kindergartens?
* Make use of a significant education budget and extra days off for self-development. Join our meet-ups, talks, brown bag lunches, internal trainings, workshops and many others.
* Enjoy the yoga, mindfulness app, sports and transport subsidies. And a Purpose Day to donate your time to a worthy cause!
* Did you know that German is the third most commonly taught language worldwide? Learn it too! We offer German language classes for you and your significant other.
* With our hybrid work model you will work in the office with your teams twice a week, to encourage in-person collaboration and team bonding The other three days you can choose if you want to work from home or from the office. We also offer 10 days a year to work from abroad.

At Wooga we are committed to providing a friendly, safe and welcoming environment for everyone who works here or with us, regardless of gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, religion (or lack thereof) and game preferences. Be yourself, we like you that way!

By clicking “Submit Application” you acknowledge that you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy

title: UX: Staff Product Designer, Design Systems - Visual
description:
*Location* : Home // Office // Flexible

*Team* : Design Language Systems // Product Platform Product Line

--------------
About the Team
--------------

People love using HubSpot because it’s an essential product that gives them the tools and insights they need to grow their business. Trellis is HubSpot's enterprise design system — the shared foundation that powers every product surface across CRM, Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Commerce Hub, Breeze AI, and the growing portfolio of agentic experiences. Trellis is not a style guide or a Figma library. It is the connective tissue between design intent and product reality at scale: a living system of tokens, components, patterns, documentation, and tooling that thousands of designers and engineers across HubSpot depend on every day to build with speed, quality, and consistency.

We are at a defining inflection point. AI is fundamentally expanding what a design system is. In the AI-native era, Trellis must be machine-readable as well as human-readable: tokens need semantic structure that AI tools can reason about, documentation needs to serve both the designer using Figma and the AI coding tool generating product UI. This is the environment you're stepping into, and it is exactly the right moment to shape how HubSpot builds.

---------------
About this Role
---------------

The Staff Product Designer — Tokens & Visual Language is the foundational design role on the Trellis team. You are the DRI for the token architecture that every component, every pattern, and every product surface built on Trellis depends on. You are also the steward of HubSpot's product design language — the visual grammar of color, typography, spacing, iconography, and motion that makes HubSpot's product experiences feel coherent, polished, and distinctly HubSpot.

*This is not a role where you maintain what exists.* You will inherit a token foundation and evolve it to meet requirements that didn't exist when it was built: multi-theme support, dark mode, density scaling, AI-generated product surfaces that need token constraints baked into their toolchain, and a platform that is migrating five major product surfaces simultaneously. You will make architectural decisions that cascade across the entire system — decisions that require the judgment to be right, the craft to be defensible, and the authority to hold the quality bar when product team urgency pushes against it.

We’re looking for a strategically-minded, outcomes-oriented design leader to own and evolve our Design System. In this role, you’ll:

* Design and steward the three-tier token graph — global, semantic, and component-specific — ensuring it scales to meet multi-theme, multi-platform, and multi-density requirements across the full HubSpot product surface
* Make and defend architectural token decisions: naming conventions, tier boundaries, semantic abstraction levels, and the tradeoffs between flexibility and constraint that determine how well the system scales
* Manage token migrations without breaking downstream consumers — designing safe, phased rollout processes and the governance model that keeps consuming teams aligned
* Own the visual language of Trellis: the system-level decisions in color, typography, spacing, iconography, and motion that make HubSpot's product experiences feel intentional, cohesive, and distinctly HubSpot
* Serve as the "final eye" on visual quality: hold the aesthetic quality bar for a system consumed by hundreds of designers, and navigate disagreements about visual direction with clarity, craft evidence, and authority
* Develop and communicate design principles and tenets that give your team and consuming designers a framework for navigating visual decisions without requiring alignment overhead on every choice
* Lead the effort to make the Trellis token layer machine-readable: structuring token names and documentation in formats that AI coding tools, MCP integrations, and generative UI systems can consume and apply correctly
* Partner with product teams across Hubspot as the token and visual language authority — helping them build on the system correctly and surfacing friction points that indicate the system needs to evolve
* Collaborate with engineers on implementation fidelity: understand the technical constraints that shape token decisions, and advocate for design intent within those constraints credibly and practically
* Contribute to Trellis governance: participate in the contribution review process, hold the quality standard for design language decisions that originate in product teams, and help shape the policies that prevent token drift across the platform

----------------------
Who we’re looking for:
----------------------

You’re known for your expert-level design craft and ability to lead multiple projects at a time. You’ve worked hands-on leading teams to evolve the content, visual, interaction, motion and illustration assets and patterns that bring a brand ethos to life in our digital product ecosystem. You’re a compelling presenter with a clear and informed POV. You’ve built solid relationships with your cross-functional partners, demonstrating a deep understanding of strategy and business goals. You're well-known for your vision and thought leadership and everyone on the team looks to you for long-term thinking.

* Prior hands-on ownership of a multi-tier token architecture at enterprise scale — has designed and shipped a token system for a multi-product or multi-platform environment, not just implemented tokens within one
* Demonstrated track record of making consequential token architecture decisions and owning their downstream effects: naming, tier structure, semantic abstraction, and breaking change management
* Full command of visual design as a systems discipline — understands how color, typography, spacing, iconography, and motion function as a unified language rather than independent decisions, and can articulate the principles behind each
* Experience evolving a mature design language: knows how to push it forward without breaking it, has navigated the tension between brand evolution and system consistency, and can make those tradeoffs visible to stakeholders
* Portfolio that demonstrates the aesthetic output of their token and systems work — not just technically correct token architecture, but a coherent, high-quality visual product
* Has formed their own design tenets and can deploy them to navigate ambiguous visual decisions without extensive alignment overhead
* Working knowledge of or demonstrated interest in machine-readable design systems — understands W3C DTCG token format, the role of semantic naming as machine-readable intent, and how token documentation can be structured for AI tool ingestion
* Stays engaged with the evolution of design token standards and tooling: Tokens Studio, Style Dictionary, Figma Variables API, and emerging MCP/AI integrations — and can make informed Trellis pipeline decisions as the ecosystem evolves
* Approaches the AI tooling layer with both curiosity and rigor: excited about what becomes possible, clear-eyed about what needs to be designed deliberately
* Operates with Staff-level autonomy: capable of identifying the right problem, proposing the right solution, and driving it to resolution without requiring close direction
* Comfortable partnering with engineering on implementation fidelity — understands technical constraints well enough to advocate for design intent credibly, and to recognize when design decisions need to adapt to engineering reality
* Can communicate token architecture decisions to non-specialist stakeholders — makes the invisible infrastructure of a design system legible to product leadership without oversimplifying it
* Has experience as a quality bar holder: has held the visual standard for a system used by many designers, navigated disagreement with clarity, and done so in a way that builds trust rather than creating friction

-------------------
About UX at HubSpot
-------------------

Our UX team is a passionate and diverse group of more than 200 product designers, content designers, researchers, and design ops folks who build consumer-grade experiences while solving enterprise-level problems. We’re set up to work as equal partners to our peers in product management and engineering. And we design and deliver a crafted experience to our customers by setting a high bar on ease of use. We’re investing deeply in building whole and healthy UX teams across all of our disciplines so we can better solve problems for our customers.

We involve our customers in every step of our development process. And we strive to deliver a B2B product that’s just as easy to use as the best B2C products on the market. When our customers grow, we grow, too!

*Pay & Benefits*

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Department: Sales & Marketing
Reports To: Senior Director of Marketing
Location: Remote

*POSITION SUMMARY*
The role of the Graphic Designer is to take concepts and ideas and create visual representations, in both print and electronic media. The ideal candidate will have expert knowledge of current design software and be skilled in every step of the design process, from concept to final deliverable. This position collaborates with multiple teams across the company and should be able to take written or spoken ideas and convert them into a design that connects. The successful candidate will have a thorough understanding of branding and marketing and be able to find the right style and layout for every project.

*RESPONSIBILITIES*

* Work on a wide range of projects and media, using various software programs such as the Adobe Creative Suite and Canva to visualize and develop innovative graphic designs that meet business goals
* Obtain input from managers to ensure that designs meet organizational standards and brand expectations, express ideas accurately, and represent the company or client appropriately
* Working independently as well as cooperatively with marketing team to meet deadlines, stay within budget, and schedule project implementation based on workload, which may include five or more simultaneous projects
* Examine existing processes, identify flaws, and create solutions that improve design capabilities
* Update and maintain internal databases for designs, photography, and video
* Collaborate, brainstorm, and strategize with multiple teams or clients on a wide range of materials that may include web pages, presentations, programming collateral, signage, internal communications, newsletters, and marketing materials
* Translate strategic direction into high-quality design within an established brand identity
* Develop concepts by hand or with software, and execute original content by determining the ideal usage of color, text, font style, imagery, and layout
* Manage the design and uploading process for all project materials, based on best practices for using a content management system
* Use trend intelligence and knowledge of historical and current markets when designing and executing specific classifications

*REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS*

* 5 + years of experience (academic and professional) with design software, including Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, Dreamweaver
* Exceptional creativity and innovative design skills
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Organizational and time-management skills for meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* Desire to continue building skill set with education and training

*PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS*

* 3 + years of experience in professional graphic design.
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in graphic design, art, or related discipline
* Knowledge of web design software/webflow

*JOB DETAILS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS*

* Ability to sit and work at a desk for extended periods of time, using a computer and other office equipment.
* Ability to perform fine motor tasks, such as typing or using a mouse, for extended period of time.
* Travel is not required for this role.
* This is a staff position.
* This is an Exempt position.
* This is a Full-Time position.
* This is a Remote position.

*COMPENSATION, BENEFITS AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION*

* The anticipated annual salary range for this position is $60,000 – $70,000 per year. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as the candidate's experience, skills, and internal equity. For Colorado-based applicants, the pay range and benefits listed above apply in accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act.
* 4 Medical plans with employer contributions for employees and dependents
* Dental and Vision insurance
* Life Insurance and AD&D
* Voluntary Life Insurance

Vero Broadband was formed to fill a need in unserviceable and underserved communities where access to affordable, reliable broadband simply does not exist. Our goal is to bring the highest quality fiber optic-based broadband services to these communities. In addition, Vero strives to enhance communities by becoming an active partner in these communities by adding jobs, supporting local causes, and helping improve the connectivity of schools and rural healthcare as well.

title: Senior UX Interface Designer
description:
We are seeking a Senior UX Interface Designer with a genuine, discerning visual sensibility who can recognize the difference between a screen that merely functions and one that commands attention, builds trust, and makes an athlete want to keep coming back. This is not a role for someone who executes a design system without aesthetic judgment. We need a designer who has a point of view, can defend it, and can elevate our product visually while remaining disciplined within our design constraints.

This role owns the Presentation Layer — how the product is formatted in terms of fonts, graphics, and animation, along with intuitive navigation. Key focus areas include innate visual design sensibility applied to a premium dark-surface consumer product; identity-driven, personalized experiences that adapt to each user's performance profile; high-quality motion and interaction design that communicates performance and progress; and action-oriented workflows that eliminate passive data consumption.

This is a startup environment where the ideal candidate thrives building from 0->1, is comfortable with ambiguity, and takes ownership rather than waiting for direction. We move fast, hold a high visual standard, and ship against hard dates. We also leverage modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery; comfort in these environments is a must.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities
----------------------------

Visual Design Leadership (Defining Responsibility)
--------------------------------------------------

* Own the overall aesthetic standard of the product: typography application, spatial rhythm, depth hierarchy, color restraint, icon quality, and component polish
* Ensure the product reads as a premium consumer tool — not a clinical health app, generic fitness tracker, or scaled-up spreadsheet
* Apply visual judgment to commercial surfaces (marketplace, subscription tiers, upsell moments) while maintaining trust in the system
* Build and maintain the authoritative Figma (or equivalent) design system: token library (colors, type ramps, spacing, radius, motion), component library, and identity cell documentation

Identity-Driven & Personalized Experience Design
------------------------------------------------

* Design the identity recoloring moment in onboarding as the signature emotional beat of the product — a real-time ambient palette transition that feels intentional, earned, and beautiful
* Ensure the primary dashboard identity symbols function coherently as both the user's visual identity expression and the entry point to the AI coaching layer
* Design the shareable identity card in both quiet (clean, restrained) and expressive (gamified, bold numbers) aesthetic modes
* Ensure scoring loops, streak mechanics, and progression tier displays feel motivating and identity-consistent — not a generic gamification model

Motion Design & Interaction (Critical)
--------------------------------------

* Design and spec all animated moments, including the readiness score arc animation, the pre-launch cinematic welcome experience, identity ambient recolor, mission/achievement completion states, AI coaching insight reveals, and score/pillar change reveals
* Define motion standards for the full product: screen transitions, micro-interactions, press states, loading states, skeleton screens, empty states, and error states
* Produce implementation-ready motion specs for multiple devices: Bodymovin/Lottie files, timing curves, duration values, and engineering handoff notes

UX/UI Design Across the Full Screen Inventory
---------------------------------------------

* Design action-oriented experiences that tell the user what to do next; every screen should have a clear direction rather than a passive display of data
* Translate complex biomarker, wearable, and AI-generated data into interfaces that are immediately readable and emotionally resonant — not dense, clinical, or overwhelming
* Design the dashboard priority engine as the product's daily engagement surface — one that feels like a coach, not a notification list
* Design an AI coaching modal as a distinct experience layer, and maintain high-fidelity designs across iOS, Android, and Web simultaneously (design once, build anywhere)

*Cross-Platform Consistency & Engineering Collaboration*

Ensure a unified visual and interaction experience across iOS, Android, and Web — respecting platform-specific behaviors without fracturing the design system

Education & Experience
----------------------

* 5+ years of experience in UX/UI and product design, with at least 2 years designing for mobile (iOS/Android) at a consumer product company

Must Demonstrate
----------------

* Understanding of color as a functional system communicating status, identity, causality, and trust
* Proficiency in Figma or equivalent — component libraries, auto-layout, design tokens, prototyping, and developer handoff
* Proficiency in motion/animation tools (Lottie, After Effects, Framer, or equivalent) with demonstrated ability to spec animations for engineering implementation
* Comfort with AI-assisted development tools such as Lovable, Cursor, or similar, and willingness to adopt new tooling quickly

Preferred Qualifications
------------------------

* Experience designing for health, fitness, performance, or biomarker applications
* Experience designing consumer commerce surfaces in a trust-sensitive context, including in-app purchases, subscription tier presentations, or health/telehealth marketplaces
* Familiarity with React Native / Expo design constraints: safe areas, platform-specific scroll physics, gesture models, and native component behavior
* Light front-end knowledge (TypeScript, React Native, CSS) sufficient to assess implementation fidelity and communicate specific divergence from design intent
* Experience designing gamification and progression systems: achievement states, streak mechanics, leaderboard displays, tier progression
* Familiarity with identity-adaptive or multi-theme design systems: real-time palette shifts, persona-keyed visual treatments, multi-tier token management
* Experience with cinematic or motion-heavy product moments (brand launch surfaces, product reveal animations, celebration states) and demonstrated ability to art-direct sound, motion, and timing together

Certifications
--------------

* Applicable certifications are a plus

Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Fast-paced, milestone-driven startup environment with hard ship dates; role leverages AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Lovable, and equivalents) to accelerate design and development velocity
* This position is a remote work from home role
