title: Brand Designer
description:
*Highbeam is building the future of business banking and cash management.*

Our platform combines AI agents, automated financial workflows, and integrated financial products that save brands time and money.

Customers have generated billions in sales and include well-known brands such as Cuts, Tushy, Rocco, Sabah, Still Here, Alice Mushrooms, Original Grain, birddogs, and more.

Our team includes alumni of Shopify, Square, Toast, Rippling, and McKinsey.

We’ve raised $42M in equity from Acrew, FirstMark, Mayfield, and Two Sigma Ventures.

*****************
*About this role*
*****************

We're hiring a brand and motion designer to build Highbeam's visual identity from the ground up — and make it move. You'll work closely product and GTM and work alongside our founders on how the company presents itself. This is a full-stack brand role. Identity, campaigns, motion, illustration: you define them, systematize them, and ship them yourself.

Since we've never hired for this role before we're hoping this to be a *contract to start engagement* with the hopes of it converting to full time. Which also means we're *open to remote* candidates as well.

*********************
*What you'll work on*
*********************

*

*The rebrand.* Highbeam is a serious financial platform that doesn't yet look like one. You'll help rebuild the identity from the foundations — type, color, logo, illustration, the visual expression of our voice — and turn it into guidelines and kits the rest of the team can actually use without asking you first.

*

*Marketing surfaces*. , launch campaigns, lifecycle email, social, paid creative, sales and event collateral. You'll take concepts from idea to shipped, and bring in external partners when the work is bigger than one person.

*

*Motion.* Launch films and social video on the marketing side; transitions, empty states, onboarding, and Luma's thinking states on the product side. You'll define how Highbeam moves and hand production-ready assets to engineering.

*

*Illustration and 3D.* Cash flow, working capital, ad spend, an AI analyst reasoning about someone's money — abstract concepts that need a visual language before they're understandable. You'll build the system that explains them.

*************
*Who you are*
*************

*

4+ years in brand design, graphic design, or art direction, ideally on consumer or modern tech brands. We're open to a wide range of experiences and seniority for the right talent.

*

A portfolio with exceptional visual execution across surfaces — web, mobile, social, email, print. A portfolio is required; applications without one won't be reviewed.

*

Obsessive about fundamentals: type, layout, color, composition, hierarchy — and able to apply them across disciplines rather than only the one you trained in.

*

Real motion chops. After Effects, Cavalry, Rive, or equivalent, with comfort shipping to an engineering team and responding to format, sizing, and performance requirements.

*You'll thrive at Highbeam if...*

*

You love working in-person with a high-performing team

*

You enjoy working in an idea-meritocratic, low-ego environment

*

You are proactive and self-directed, and you excel in ambiguous, fast moving environments

*

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
Job Summary

We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to take on Koru's most ambiguous, highest-leverage design problems, the ones that span multiple client accounts, cross multiple teams, or don't have a defined brief yet. You'll set the standard for design quality and AI-informed practice across the accounts you touch, and operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where creating structure is part of the job, not something handed to you.

We're also looking for genuine fluency with AI in product design and not just familiarity with AI tools, but real judgement about when AI actually helps a user and when it quietly doesn't, backed by a track record of shipping AI-powered features responsibly, and comfort using AI tools as part of your own workflow, not just designing AI for others.

Key Responsibilities

*Owning ambiguous, high-leverage work*

* Lead and ship large, cross-team or cross-account projects independently, often without a fully defined brief, adjusting scope as it changes rather than waiting for someone to hand you clarity.
* Diagnose problems nobody has framed yet, spotting opportunities before they're assigned, not just executing what's already on the roadmap.
* Set the quality bar and visual direction for an account or product line without personally executing every piece of it.
* Apply deliberate leverage: know when a task is worth doing yourself versus building something, a pattern, a template, documentation, that helps everyone doing similar work after you.
* Own design decisions across multiple surface areas or product lines at once where needed, not just a single feature in isolation.

*Shaping how Koru designs with AI*

* Set AI UX standards for a client or product line, and build or maintain the pattern library and evaluation checklists other designers use.
* Treat AI as a multiplier for your own design process, not a shortcut around it: use AI tools to speed up exploration and prototyping without letting them substitute for your own judgement.
* Actively evolve Koru's own AI design practice as the field moves

*Influence without authority*

* Build followership across teams through consistently clear thinking, not seniority or volume.
* Mentor designers across projects, not just your own team, and act as a sponsor as well as a mentor, advocating for people in rooms they're not in, not just guiding them one to one.
* Get Koru treated as a strategic partner through the calibre of your thinking as much as your output.

*Contributing beyond the project*

* Lead initiatives that expand Koru's visibility or offerings
* Extend and improve Koru's own internal design frameworks and processes, not just follow them.

*Requirements*

*Experience*
------------

* 8+ years of experience in product or UX design, the majority of it operating at a senior level or beyond.
* A portfolio that shows genuine breadth of scope, not just polished screens, but measurable business outcomes and evidence of leading ambiguous, cross-functional work end to end. Strong enough to stand on its own without a verbal walkthrough.
* Experience with B2B products and enterprise applications; HealthTech experience is a strong plus.
* Real, hands-on experience designing AI-powered features or AI-native product ideas, not just using AI tools day to day. We'll ask you to speak to this specifically, ideally with a portfolio piece that shows it.
* Comfortable prototyping in code, or close enough to front-end development to validate ideas without waiting on engineering.

*Skills*
--------

* Craft & judgement - deep design skill combined with the judgement to know when to apply it personally and when to build something that scales it to others.
* AI fluency - genuine, applied understanding of AI capability and limitation in product design, not just enthusiasm for the space.
* Influence without authority - a proven ability to set direction and raise the bar for people who don't report to you.
* Business acumen - comfortable operating as a strategic partner to client leadership, not just a design resource.
* Communication - able to make a case clearly enough that people who don't already agree with you can be moved.

*Benefits*

*Why join us?*
--------------

* Own Koru's hardest, most ambiguous design problems, the ones that don't fit neatly inside one project or one team.
* Shape how Koru designs with AI, for clients and internally, at a formative moment for the practice.
* Be part of a collaborative, high-performance team that values your expertise and ideas.
* Work remotely with flexibility, on meaningful, challenging work.

*How to Apply*
--------------

Please submit your resume, portfolio, and a 5-minute introductory video. In the video, walk us through your most interesting project, where you are in your career right now, and what you're hoping to get out of your next role. We'd rather hear this in your own voice than read it in a cover letter.

title: Tech Lead, Ramp Travel
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Ramp Travel team builds the travel booking and management platform built-in to Ramp. We build the capabilities that allows travelers to stay productive on the road: flight and hotel search, booking and checkout, our agentic travel assistant, and on-the-go mobile trip guidance. We also own the capabilities that ensure companies are spending their travel dollars effectively: travel policy evaluation, supplier and TMC integrations and benchmarking, and data insights.

Growing the sophistication and global reach of the Travel product is a top strategic priority at Ramp. The work this team does directly enables Ramp to to support some of the largest and most interesting customers in the world.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Lead, mentor, coach, and grow the Ramp Travel engineering team (~6 engineers today).

- Own delivery across our travel management surfaces: search and inventory, quoting and repricing, checkout, policy evaluation, loyalty, post-booking servicing.

- Own reliability and correctness of a system dependent on third parties: supplier APIs, GDS and aggregator content, TMC and OBT integrations.

- Partner with Product, Design, Ops, Partnerships, and Sales on enterprise travel commitments.

- Set the team's practices for AI-assisted development and ship agentic booking features.

- Hire. The team is expected to grow.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 2+ years managing engineers, team size roughly 5 to 15.

- High levels of ownership. Comfortability taking difficult ambiguous problems and driving successful execution.

- Has built something 0→1 and then scaled it.

- Willing to be hands-on. This is a six-person team, and everyone at Ramp is a builder.

- Current enough technically to lead a design review and evaluate an architecture proposal.

- Strong product judgment and comfort talking to customers.

- Has owned a transactional system with external dependencies: booking, payments, marketplace, or logistics.

PREFERRED

- Corporate travel domain experience, such as: corporate online booking tools (OBTs), integrations with travel content sources (GDS/NDC), and front-end traveler experiences.

- Enterprise B2B fintech or T&E background.

- Has rolled out agentic dev tooling to a team, or shipped LLM-backed features.

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual membership

- 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

- Pet insurance

- In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

- Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

CANADA

- Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

- Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

- Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

- Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

- Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

UNITED KINGDOM

- Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

- Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

- Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: Software Engineer, Ecosystem
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Join our Ecosystem team, a cross-functional group of engineers and product partners building the platforms and integrations that connect Airwallex with the software our customers rely on every day. We own strategic accounting, marketplace, payment plugins, and open‑banking integrations, as well as the infrastructure that powers our public APIs that enabling third-party partners to build on top of. You’ll work closely with backend, product, design, and go‑to‑market teams to ship secure, reliable experiences that simplify financial operations for businesses of all sizes and unlock new use cases on top of the Airwallex business account.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies and contribute to the growth and success of our company. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain the ecosystem platform, build and integrate APIs to connect with external financial institutions and third-party platforms (accounting, HR, ERP, marketplace, etc.), and develop scalable solutions to support our ecosystem strategy.

You will also have the chance to work closely with product managers and designers to deliver innovative features and functionalities, as well as contribute to the technical roadmap and provide input on new technologies and best practices.

This role is based in Singapore.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Platform Architecture & Strategy: Lead the high-level design and long-term technical roadmap for the App Marketplace or Extension Framework.

- Extensibility Frameworks: Design and implement the core SDKs, webhooks, and UI-extension patterns that allow third-party developers to embed their functionality directly into the Airwallex platform.

- Technical Excellence: Establish and enforce rigorous internal coding standards, observability patterns, and security protocols for the entire team.

- Developer Experience (DX): Champion the needs of external developers by building world-class documentation infrastructure, sandboxes, and tooling.

WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field

- 2+ years of experience in developing Internet applications, large financial systems, or e-commerce platforms

- Proficient in coding or scripting languages (Java/Kotlin/C++/Python, etc.)

- Deep familiarity with the standard library, idiomatic usage, and best practices of your primary programming languages.

- Ecosystem Experience: Direct experience building or maintaining a public-facing developer platform, app marketplace, or extension framework.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Architectural Patterns: Deep expertise in Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to manage complex business logic and microservice boundaries.

- Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with cloud-native tech stacks, including Docker, Kubernetes, and advanced observability tools.

- Emerging Tech: Experience integrating AI/LLM models to automate integration workflows or enhance developer tooling.

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

You’ll join the POS team, which helps merchants and software platforms accept in-person payments through Airwallex terminals and connected POS systems. We work across commercial, risk, operations, solutions engineering, product and engineering teams to make POS launches reliable and scalable across Southeast Asia. The team is customer-focused, technically minded and hands-on, with opportunities to take ownership early and grow through exposure to complex payment and platform challenges.

What you'll do
As a POS CSM, you will be the day-to-day partner for connected merchants and POS platforms throughout the POS lifecycle, from KYC and KYB onboarding through terminal provisioning, implementation, launch and ongoing support. You will combine customer relationship management with practical payments operations and technical troubleshooting to help merchants go live smoothly and operate with confidence. This role is based in Singapore.

Responsibilities:

- Support connected merchants through KYC and KYB onboarding, payment enablement and information requests, working with Risk and Operations teams to resolve blockers and keep launches on track.

- Explain onboarding requirements clearly and coordinate the collection of accurate business, ownership, store and location information.

- Act as the primary day-to-day contact for merchants and POS platforms, managing operational queries, implementation milestones, testing and go-live readiness.

- Coordinate the POS terminal lifecycle, including registration, assignment, activation, pairing, deployment, replacement, deactivation and termination.

- Ensure terminals are linked to the correct connected account, merchant location and POS environment, while maintaining accurate records across internal and customer systems.

- Provide first-line technical support for the Airwallex POS platform, including terminal configuration, connectivity, payment flows, POS integrations, APIs and webhooks.

- Investigate and troubleshoot terminal, POS application, integration and payment issues by gathering relevant logs, transaction IDs, device details and API responses.

- Distinguish between merchant configuration, POS platform, hardware, connectivity and Airwallex product issues, escalating appropriately to Product, Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Risk or Operations.

- Support merchants using standalone and cloud-connected POS modes, helping them understand the relevant setup and operational requirements.

- Track onboarding progress, terminal status, activation, transaction readiness and support trends to identify risks and improve merchant outcomes.

- Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, standard operating procedures and implementation playbooks to improve support quality and scale operations.

- Capture recurring merchant and platform feedback and translate it into actionable recommendations for Product and Engineering.

- Partner with Sales and Account Management on post-launch engagement, customer retention, product adoption and expansion opportunities.

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory for this role.

Minimum qualifications:

- 2 to 4 years of experience at a large payment service provider, payments processor, fintech or payment technology company, ideally in POS provisioning, merchant operations, implementation, technical support, customer success or technical account management.

- Hands-on experience supporting POS terminals, payment acceptance, merchant onboarding or connected-account operations.

- Working knowledge of KYC and KYB processes, payment enablement and merchant compliance workflows.

- Practical experience with POS terminal provisioning or lifecycle management, including activation, assignment, replacement, deactivation or related operational processes.

- Ability to troubleshoot technical issues methodically and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to manage multiple merchant and platform stakeholders.

- Excellent attention to detail, organisation and follow-through.

- Comfort working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with evolving processes and priorities.

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience at a PSP such as Adyen, Stripe, Checkout.com http://Checkout.com, Worldpay, Fiserv, Global Payments, Nuvei or a similar provider.

- Experience supporting POS platforms, restaurant technology, retail systems, marketplaces, SaaS platforms or other connected-merchant models.

- Familiarity with payment APIs, SDKs, webhooks, payment intents, terminal IDs, activation codes and transaction troubleshooting.

- Basic understanding of card-present payments, authorisation, capture, refunds, disputes, payment failures and reconciliation.

- Experience with tools such as Salesforce, Jira, Zendesk, Looker, Postman or similar operational and technical platforms.

- Experience creating standard operating procedures, dashboards, implementation playbooks or internal training materials.

- Mandarin or another Southeast Asian language is a plus.

title: Office Manager
description:
Navi captures everything a pilot sees and hears and turns it into automated debrief intelligence. The platform is live at flight schools, business jet operators, and the U.S. Air Force. All of it runs out of one office in San Francisco — and you're the person who makes that office work.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is the first operations hire at Navi, and it's a role you grow into as fast as you can carry it. You own the physical company: the space, the vendors, the supplies, the food, the visitors, the gear. You also give the founders back their time — calendars, travel, expenses, and the hundred small things that would otherwise eat a founder's afternoon.

You'll be the first person in the office and the reason everyone else's day is frictionless. Engineers shouldn't be ordering monitors. Founders shouldn't be booking flights. You handle it before anyone has to ask.

This is not a role where you wait for a ticket. You notice, and you fix it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Run the San Francisco office day to day — space, supplies, snacks and meals, mail, equipment, and everything else that keeps a team of builders heads-down

- Own vendor and building relationships — landlord, cleaners, caterers, IT, furniture, whatever we need next

- Host everyone who walks through the door — customers, pilots, investors, defense partners, candidates — and make Navi feel as sharp in person as it does in the product

- Support the founders directly — calendar management, travel booking, expense reports, and keeping the week from falling apart

- Own Navi merch end to end — inventory, reorders, quality, and getting the right gear to customers, events, new hires, and the team

- Get new hires set up before day one — desk, laptop, badge, swag, and a first week that feels intentional

- Plan team offsites, dinners, and the rituals that hold a fast-moving company together

- Build the systems that make all of this repeatable as the team doubles, and then doubles again

ABOUT YOU

- 2–4 years in an office management, operations, executive assistant, or hospitality role — you've kept something real running

- Ridiculously organized, with a system for everything and nothing dropped

- You anticipate. You see the problem a week out and it's solved before anyone notices there was one

- Comfortable owning a founder's calendar and travel, and exercising judgment on their behalf

- Warm and unflappable in person — you're the first impression Navi makes on a four-star general and on a 19-year-old student pilot

- You take pride in the details: how the office smells, how the hoodie fits, how the coffee tastes

- You want to be onsite, every day, because the job is the room

NICE TO HAVE

- Startup experience, especially as an early or first ops hire

- Experience with vendor negotiation or merch and apparel sourcing

- Comfort with modern tooling — Ashby, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, Brex or Ramp

- Event planning, hospitality, or aviation background

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Every hour a founder or engineer spends on logistics is an hour not spent shipping. This role is leverage: you take the entire operational surface of the company onto your shoulders so the rest of the team can go fast. And every person who ever visits Navi — the customer deciding whether to deploy, the candidate deciding whether to join, the investor deciding whether to write the check — forms their impression in a room you built.

WHAT YOU'LL GET

- Early-stage equity — real ownership in a category-defining company

- Flight training — earn your pilot's license on us

- The first ops seat at a company that will need a whole operations function, and a role that scales with it

- Impact you can see — you're building the place where aviation's new standard gets made

HOW WE WORK

- Find a way. We don't wait for permission or perfect information. Ideas come from anywhere regardless of title. Figure it out, ship it, iterate.

- Creativity over control. First principles over process. We'd rather have a creative solution that's 80% right today than a perfect one next quarter.

- Update fast. Come in with a hypothesis, throw it away when the data says otherwise. Ego has no place here.

- Intensity with focus. We work hard because the mission demands it. Clarity on what matters is how we make that sustainable.

title: Transaction Monitoring Analyst
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

INTRO

At Pleo, we’re on a mission to revolutionise the way businesses manage company spending. No more outdated processes, clunky spreadsheets, or frustrating delays - we believe spend management should be seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike. We’re creating tools that promote autonomy, foster trust, and let businesses focus on what truly matters.

Our culture is built on transparency, collaboration, and a deep commitment to innovation – which is reflected in our spending solution. At Pleo, you’ll join a passionate team shaping the future of work, all while having some fun along the way.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Transaction Monitoring Analyst to join our AML Transaction Surveillance team at Pleo. In this First Line of Defense role, you will play a crucial part in maintaining the safety and integrity of our platform by actively preventing Financial Crime. If you're excited about keeping the bad guys out of the game and have high personal ethics, then this is the opportunity for you!

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Transaction Monitoring Analyst, you will:

- AML Case Handling & Investigations: You will be responsible for handling the alerts and completing the investigations using our automated transaction surveillance system. Deep dive into complex cases, utilising your expertise and multiple tools to unravel the intricacies of financial transactions and detect suspicious activities.

- SAR escalations : Deliver high quality Financial Crime investigation reports and escalate potential Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) to Second Line of Defense.

- Risk Committee Presentations: Write high quality reports and deliver presentations to the Risk Committee. Your insights will guide strategic decisions and influence our approach to managing financial crime risks.

- Fin-Crime Prevention Projects: Participate in ad hoc internal projects aiming at the enhancement of our surveillance framework.

WHAT YOU BRING

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- A background of 2+ years in AML investigations within a FinTech, traditional financial institution, or regulatory body.

- A solid understanding of AML scenarios and EU & UK AML Regulations.

- Expert Investigator: Exceptional ability to follow up, assess, and investigate complex financial activities with a keen eye for detail.

- Effective Communicator: Outstanding communication skills, capable of presenting findings in a clear and concise manner.

- Proactive Mindset: Self-driven and meticulous, always on the lookout for anomalies and risks, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

- Team player: Able to share knowledge and assist the rest of the team with the investigations.

WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You’ll report to our Transaction Surveillance Team Lead and work closely with other teams in Operations as well as with Second Line of Defense. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to anti money laundering.

HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 2 months at Pleo, you’ll:

- Become proficient in using the automated AML alert detection and case management systems.

- Master the retrieval of customer and transaction data from various tools.

- Build deep expertise in our Transaction Surveillance Policies and Procedures.

- Establish relationships with key stakeholders across the First and Second Lines of Defense.

- Maintain strict adherence to quality standards for all case investigations.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in Fin-Crime prevention.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

2. Hiring Manager interview: a 60-minute chat with your Manager to deep dive into your technical experience and impact.

3. {Optional} Final interview: a 30-minutes chat with our Director of FinCrime Operations.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a Transaction Monitoring Analyst, we received a total of 230 applications but only 10 were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

- We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

- Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

- Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Transaction Monitoring Analyst to join our AML Transaction Surveillance team at Pleo. In this First Line of Defense role, you will play a crucial part in maintaining the safety and integrity of our platform by actively preventing Financial Crime. If you're excited about keeping the bad guys out of the game and have high personal ethics, then this is the opportunity for you!

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Transaction Monitoring Analyst, you will:

- AML Case Handling & Investigations: You will be responsible for handling the alerts and completing the investigations using our automated transaction surveillance system. Deep dive into complex cases, utilising your expertise and multiple tools to unravel the intricacies of financial transactions and detect suspicious activities.

- SAR escalations : Deliver high quality Financial Crime investigation reports and escalate potential Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) to Second Line of Defense.

- Risk Committee Presentations: Write high quality reports and deliver presentations to the Risk Committee. Your insights will guide strategic decisions and influence our approach to managing financial crime risks.

- Fin-Crime Prevention Projects: Participate in ad hoc internal projects aiming at the enhancement of our surveillance framework.

WHAT YOU BRING

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- A background of 2+ years in AML investigations within a FinTech, traditional financial institution, or regulatory body.

- A solid understanding of AML scenarios and EU & UK AML Regulations.

- Expert Investigator: Exceptional ability to follow up, assess, and investigate complex financial activities with a keen eye for detail.

- Effective Communicator: Outstanding communication skills, capable of presenting findings in a clear and concise manner.

- Proactive Mindset: Self-driven and meticulous, always on the lookout for anomalies and risks, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

- Team player: Able to share knowledge and assist the rest of the team with the investigations.

WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You’ll report to our Transaction Surveillance Team Lead and work closely with other teams in Operations as well as with Second Line of Defense. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to anti money laundering.

HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 2 months at Pleo, you’ll:

- Become proficient in using the automated AML alert detection and case management systems.

- Master the retrieval of customer and transaction data from various tools.

- Build deep expertise in our Transaction Surveillance Policies and Procedures.

- Establish relationships with key stakeholders across the First and Second Lines of Defense.

- Maintain strict adherence to quality standards for all case investigations.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in Fin-Crime prevention.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

2. Hiring Manager interview: a 60-minute chat with your Manager to deep dive into your technical experience and impact.

3. {Optional} Final interview: a 30-minutes chat with our Director of FinCrime Operations.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a Transaction Monitoring Analyst, we received a total of 230 applications but only 10 were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

- We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

- Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

- Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

FoundationDB https://www.foundationdb.org/ (FDB) is an open source, highly scalable database capable of ACID transactions at high frequencies and low latencies. FDB has been a core component in Snowflake's unique shared-metadata architecture since 2014, making possible Snowflake's vision to build the greatest data warehouse for the cloud. FDB performs millions of transactions per second across thousands of processes. The FDB team builds features on open-source FDB that improve the performance, scale, reliability and operability of the product.

We are looking for an outstanding Senior Software Engineer with a passion for large scale databases and distributed systems to help us take FoundationDB to the next level. FoundationDB powers all of Snowflake’s products and services and is rapidly evolving to meet Snowflake’s future needs. We are growing at a fast rate and we need to scale FoundationDB by at least one order of magnitude over the next few years. Additionally, new workloads are emerging that need FoundationDB’s reliability, high availability and strong consistency semantics. These workloads will require innovation to re-architect the core components of our system.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

- Identify strategically important problems, inefficiencies or opportunities for impactful improvements

- Own the end to end delivery of your projects, from identifying a solution, to design, implementation, test and safe production rollout

- Design and implement critical high performance systems to handle the ever growing request rate of our database

- Build the next generation transaction system, caching, storage engine and multi tenant capabilities

- Evangelize best practices in database usage and end-to-end architecture.

- Analyze and understand performance and scalability bottlenecks in the system and solve them.

- Pinpoint problems, instrument relevant components as needed, and ultimately implement solutions.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

- 6+ years hands-on software engineering experience.

- Systems programming skills including multi-threading, concurrency, etc. Fluency in C++, C, or Java is preferred.

- Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems or web services

- Experience with scalable Key-Value stores such as FoundationDB, RocksDB/LevelDB, DynamoDB, Redis, etc. a plus.

- Strong CS fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

- Track record of delivering highly complex projects in the distributed systems space

- Intense curiosity, willingness to question and passion for making systems better

- Strong technical problem solving, communication, and collaboration skills

- Excitement by the challenge of hard technical problems

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

JOB INTRODUCTION:

Lead the strategy, development, and execution of key product initiatives that drive customer value and support business objectives. Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver impactful product solutions, ensuring alignment with market needs and company goals.

KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Serve as the product domain expert for dealership retail workflows, including vehicle sales, desking, F&I (Finance & Insurance), credit application and approval processes, lender integrations, compliance requirements, and deal funding lifecycle.

- Experience working in the automotive industry and dealership management systems, with strong subject matter expertise in dealership retail operations, including desking, F&I products, finance workflows, credit bureau integrations, lender submission processes, regulatory compliance, and vehicle sales transactions.

- Experience building scalable, user-facing, B2B products supporting dealership retail, vehicle sales, F&I, finance, and credit workflows for Canadian automotive dealerships.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- 6–8 years of experience in product management, including ownership of major product lines or features

- Strong background in SaaS, cloud platforms, or enterprise technology products

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred

- Proven success in developing and scaling products in cross-functional environments

- Strong analytical, leadership, and communication skills

- Experience with Agile methodologies, product lifecycle tools, and data-driven decision-making

- Bilingual French and English required because the role involves regular communication with English-speaking colleagues, stakeholders and cross-functional teams located outside Quebec.

PERKS & BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation and generous stock options

- 100% employer-paid top-of-the-line medical, dental and vision coverage

- Be part of an early stage, hyper-growth start-up with the opportunity to grow and prosper

- Work on the latest and coolest technologies – everything is home-grown and built ground-up

- A dynamic work environment with a strong sense of community and collaboration

- The open and transparent culture that encourages innovation, rewards performance and discourages hierarchy

- Exciting opportunities for career growth and development

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE:

Diriger la stratégie, le développement et la mise en oeuvre des principales initiatives liées aux produits afin de créer de la valeur pour les clients et de la soutenir les objectifs d’affaires. Collaborer de façon transversale avec différentes équipes afin de livrer des solutions produits ayant un impact réel, tout en assurant leur alignement avec les besoins du marché et les objectifs de l'entreprise.

RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES:

- Agir en tant qu'expert(e) du domaine produit pour les processus de vente au detail en

concession, notamment la vente de véhicules, le desking, les produits F&I (Finance et

Assurance), les demandes et approbations de crêdit, les intégrations avec les prêteurs, les exigences de conformité réglementaire et le cycle de financement des transactions.

- Posséder une experience dans l’industrie automobile et les systems de gestion de

concession, ainsi qu’une solide expertise des operations de vente au detail en concession, notamment en matière de desking, de produits F&I (Finance et Assurance), de processus de financement, d’intégrations avec les bureaux de credit, de processus de soumission aux prêteurs, de conformité réglementaire et de transactions de vente de véhicules.

- Avoir de l'expérience dans la conception de produits B2B évolutifs et destinés aux

utilisateurs, qui soutiennent les activités de vente au détail des concessions automobiles canadiennes, notamment la vente de véhicules, les produits F&I, le financement et les processus de credit.

QUALIFICATIONS DE BASE:

- 6 à 8 ans d'expérience en gestion de produits, incluant la responsabilité de lignes de

produits ou de fonctionnalités majeures

- Solide expérience avec les produits SaaS, les plateformes infonuagiques (cloud) ou les

produits technologiques destinés aux entreprises.

- Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, en informatique, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe; un diplôme de niveau supérieur est un atout

- Expérience démontrées dans le développement et la mise à l’échelle de produits dans les environnements interfonctionnels.

- Excellentes compétences analytiques, en leadership et en communication

- Expérience avec les méthodologies Agile, des outils de gestion du cycle de vie des produits et la prise de décision fondée sur les données

- Bilinguisme (français et anglais) requis — ce poste exige des communications régulières avec des collègues, des parties prenantes et des équipes transversales situées à l'extérieur du Québec et s'exprimant en anglais.

AVANTAGES SOCIAUX:

- Rémunération concurrentielle et généreuses options d'achat d'actions

- Couverture médicale, dentaire, et des soins de la vue haut de gamme, entièrement payée par l'employeur

- Faire partie d'une jeune entreprise en démarrage à forte croissance, offrant de nombreuses possibilités d’evolution et de réussite

- Travailler avec les technologies les plus récentes et les plus innovantes — tout est conçu et développé à l'interne, depuis les fondations

- Un environnement de travail dynamique, empreint d'un fort esprit de communauté et de collaboration

- Une culture ouverte et transparente qui favorise l'innovation, reconnaît la performance et limite les structures hiérarchiques.

- Excellentes possibilités de développement et d’avencement professionnel

title: Automation Strategist, Customer Success
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

AI Fluency Assessment https://ai-fluency-hub.vercel.app
Take our 10 minute AI Fluency Assessment by clicking the link above. See how your skills stack up against our sales bar, get a personalized tier, and walk away with actionable next steps to level up your AI skills.

Job Posted: 09/22/2026

Location: USA & Canada

Level: IC4

Hi there!

Zapier’s mission is to make automation and AI accessible to everyone. Our enterprise customers are adopting automation as a strategic capability, not just a tool. They need expert partners who can help them orchestrate processes, unlock new use cases, and scale their impact.

We’re looking for an Automation Strategist to join our Customer Success organization as the core role working with customers on our enterprise plan. This role blends strategic advisory, orchestration design, and value-focused relationship expansion. As an Automation Strategist, you will help customers shape their automation strategy, identify and deploy high-value use cases, and guide them toward meaningful AI-enabled transformation.

This role moves beyond classic Customer Success, focusing on consulting, systems thinking, orchestration, executive alignment and continuous value discovery, rooted in our team’s mission of delivering value through clarity, impact, curiosity, and approachable expertise.

- Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

- Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

- Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

- Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

- Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/

ABOUT YOU

- You see opportunity in ambiguity and building things that scale

- You experiment, learn quickly, and iterate openly, unafraid to make, and revise, bets.

- You enjoy creating playbooks as much as running them.

- You appreciate that each customer is unique, yet you build frameworks that scale across them.

- You use AI in your work today — not occasionally, but as part of how you operate at a high level. You can point to workflows you’ve built, how your approach has evolved through iteration, and the impact on quality, efficiency, and experience — while intentionally applying AI for the right outcomes, setting a high bar for outputs, and taking ownership of what ships.

- You’re a strategic, customer-centric problem solver.

- You’re relentlessly focused on the outcome and willing to learn new approaches or challenge the status quo to deliver value for our enterprise customers.

- With 5+ years in SaaS (customer success, consulting, solutions, enterprise product or similar process and system strategy roles), customers see you as a valuable extension of their team

- You have thoughts on how modern businesses should operate, including where inefficiencies hide and how automation + AI unlock leverage.

- You can operate across audiences, from executive sponsors to execution teams running sprint-style projects.

- You connect business goals to product solutions

- You’re skilled at discovering what customers actually need (not just what they say),

- You communicate automation value in terms of ROI, efficiency, scalability, and risk reduction

- You think in systems, logic, and orchestration frameworks, but don’t get bogged down in technical details.

- You own the outcome, project managing stakeholders internally (TAM, product, support) and externally (customer execution teams, Line of Business Leaders) to deliver realized, quantifiable value.

- You’re an exceptional communicator

- You communicate strategy and insights with clarity, empathy, and precision.

- You know when to use async vs. live to balance ideal outcomes and speed, employing Slack, email, workshops, executive briefings, texts, and standups.

- You leverage automation and AI yourself to execute with clarity, speed, and alignment..

- Data guides your decisions.

- You interpret usage patterns, account signals, and customer behavior to inform strategy.

- You collaborate with data science and RevOps to shape MVP → mature data products and workflows.

- You combine early data signals with strong first principles thinking to make decisions and evaluate progress.

- You embody our cultural anchors

- You lead customer engagements with clarity, dependability, approachable expertise, focusing on delivery meaningful value.

- Internally you exercise good judgement and demonstrate our values of collaboration with purpose, accountability, recognition.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Guide Customers’ Automation Strategy

- Build deep relationships that uncover goals, challenges, and priorities.

- Advise on automation governance, best practices, and cross-functional program structure, process and design.

- Help customers set goals and adopt AI-orchestrated processes across lines of business.

- Discover and Deploy High-Value Use Cases

- Identify impactful automation opportunities through exec alignment, influencer mapping, and citizen-developer input.

- Work with customer stakeholders, SAs and TAMs to co-design implementation patterns that ensure scalability and long-term success.

- Translate business problems into orchestration strategies that deliver measurable value.

- Capture the prior state and descriptive metrics that help you quantify the impact of the work.

- Drive Customer Outcomes

- Demonstrate ROI and unlock new value paths through expanded automation usage.

- Accelerate renewal and expansion by deepening customer maturity and outcomes.

- Collaborate Across Zapier

- Partner with Sales, Support, Product, and others to deliver a unified customer experience.

- Share insights that influence roadmap decisions, positioning and GTM strategy

- Build a World-Class Program

- Help scale the methodologies, frameworks, and assets that define automation strategy at Zapier.

- Do the best work of your life as we build Zapier for Enterprise from a subset of the business to the default choice of enterprises globally

HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We’re looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.
After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we’re excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone’s identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.
We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.
The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.
This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.
What you'll do
- Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

- Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

- Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

- Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

- Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

- Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

- Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

- Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for
- Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

- Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

- AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

- High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

- Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

- Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit
- Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

- MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

- Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting
- Competitive, top-of-market compensation

- You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

- Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

- Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

Please mention the word **WINNERS** and tag RNC4yNDYuMTM1LjM1 when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNC4yNDYuMTM1LjM1). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

title: UI & Visual Designer
description:
JOB OVERVIEW
------------

Plan A Technologies is looking for a *UI & Visual Designer* with exceptional craft to take approved design directions and scale them across complete products. This is a specialist role, not a junior one.

Where a Lead Product Designer establishes the direction and the first defining screens, you build the rest of the product to that standard: every state, every breakpoint, every edge case, at a level of consistency and polish that survives handoff to engineering. A direction is only as good as the two hundred screens that follow it, and those screens are yours.

If you are the designer other designers ask about typography, spacing, and why a screen feels right, this is the role.

*Please note:* you must have at least 4+ years designing production UI, and an exceptional visual portfolio is required to be considered. For this role, visual quality is a hard gate.

JOB RESPONSIBILITY
------------------

*

Extend approved design directions across full products, taking a set of defining screens to the complete surface area.

*

Produce high-fidelity UI at volume without losing consistency, hierarchy, or craft.

*

Build and maintain design systems: components, variants, tokens, and the documentation that keeps them usable by other people.

*

Design the parts most people skip. Empty states, error states, loading, permissions, edge cases, and responsive behaviour across breakpoints.

*

Create prototypes, micro-interactions and motion that clarify behaviour rather than decorate it.

*

Keep Figma files organised, named and structured so engineers and other designers can work from them without asking you questions.

*

Partner with developers through implementation and hold the bar on fidelity.

*

Flag where a direction breaks down in production so the Lead can resolve it before the problem spreads across the product.

EXPERIENCE
----------

*

4+ years designing production UI for web, mobile, or both.

*

An exceptional portfolio. We look specifically at typography, layout, hierarchy, colour, spacing, and consistency held across a large number of screens, not at a handful of hero shots.

*

Expert-level proficiency in Figma: auto-layout, components, variants, variables, and library management.

*

Demonstrated design system work, ideally systems you maintained rather than only consumed.

*

Strong command of responsive design and state design.

*

Experience with Material Design and Human Interface Guidelines (HIG).

*

Working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG), including contrast, focus states and touch targets.

*

Speed with consistency. You can produce a high volume of screens without the twentieth one drifting from the first.

*

Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

*

Initiative and drive to do great things.

*NICE TO HAVE*

*

Motion design, whether After Effects, Rive, or Figma prototyping at depth.

*

Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite.

*

Illustration or iconography.

*

Gaming or casino UI experience.

*ABOUT THE COMPANY/BENEFITS*

Plan A Technologies is a global engineering firm created to solve the toughest tech challenges facing today’s businesses. Founded by software entrepreneurs Aron Ezra and Slav Kulik, Plan A helps organizations analyze their tech ecosystem to identify exactly what needs to be improved across their products and infrastructure—and then builds the solutions to fix it.

Rather than offering theoretical ideas or software that never launches, Plan A combines elite engineering talent with custom-built, proprietary AI agents to deliver fast, secure, production-ready solutions. Its capabilities span proprietary AI agent deployment, custom software development, application modernization, data platforms, cloud migrations, systems integration, and practical technical advice.

With more than 500 successful product deployments completed worldwide, Plan A helps organizations of every size—from ambitious startups to global enterprises—modernize their systems, automate complex operations, and stay ahead of the technology curve.

*Read more about us here:* www.PlanAtechnologies.com .

*Location:* Work From Home 100% of the time, or come in to one of our global offices. Up to you.

*Great colleagues and an upbeat work environment:* You'll join an excellent team of supportive engineers and project managers who work hard but don't ever compete with each other.

*Benefits:* Vacation, Brand New Laptop, and More: You’ll get a generous vacation schedule and other goodies.

*If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!*

title: Junior CRO Manager
description:
**********
*About us*
**********

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at:

****************
*About the role*
****************

RubyLabs is looking for a hands-on Junior CRO Manager to join one of our product growth teams. You'll work directly with our Senior CRO Manager, turning a fast-moving testing roadmap into live experiments, new landing pages, and new funnels.

This is an execution role first. You'll take hypotheses from idea to live test - building the designs yourself with AI tools, setting up the experiments, and keeping the pipeline moving - while bringing your own test ideas to the table. The more your judgment proves out, the more of the roadmap you own.

*Responsibilities*

*

Build new landing pages and funnels: create alternative landing page variants and funnel flows to test messaging, structure, and offers.

*

Prepare designs with Claude: turn hypotheses into experiment mockups and variants using AI tools, without waiting on a designer.

*

Set up experiments: configure A/B tests, define success metrics, and verify tracking before anything goes live.

*

Manage the experiment pipeline: keep tickets clear and prioritized, brief engineers, and follow each test from setup to rollout.

*

Contribute test ideas: study the funnel, competitors, and user behavior, and bring hypotheses to the roadmap alongside the senior's.

*

Support analysis and documentation: help read results, document learnings, and keep the testing roadmap current.

*Qualifications*

*

1+ years of hands-on experience in CRO, growth, product, or digital marketing - you've built pages, run or supported tests, or shipped funnel changes before.

*

Design sense: you can tell a clean, convincing page from a cluttered one, and you can build one yourself with the tools at hand.

*

Bias for shipping: you'd rather get a solid variant live today than polish it for a week, and you keep the cycle moving.

*

Proactive: you don't wait for the next ticket; you spot what needs doing and do it.

*

Strong English: clear written and verbal communication. You'll write hypotheses, tickets, and summaries daily.

*

Good judgment on conversion opportunities: you can look at a landing page or funnel step and sense what's worth testing and why.

*

Comfortable with ambiguity: priorities shift, briefs are incomplete, and data is messy. You make a sensible call and keep moving.

*

AI-native habits: you already use Claude or similar tools in your work and want to push further.

*

Attention to detail: experiments live or die on setup, and you check twice.

*Nice to Have*

*

Experience with landing page builders, no-code tools, or basic HTML/CSS.

*

Familiarity with Mixpanel, Google Analytics, GrowthBook, or similar.

*

Exposure to subscription or SaaS funnels.

*

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

*What We Offer*

*

Direct mentorship from a Senior CRO Manager and a full view of how a high-volume experimentation process runs.

*

Ownership that grows with results: start with execution, earn your own tests.

*

Autonomy and speed: small team, fast decisions, no bureaucracy.

*

The latest AI tools as a core part of daily work, not a side experiment.

*

Room to grow into a CRO Specialist role as you deliver.

**********
*Location*
**********

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

**********
*Benefits*
**********

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

*

*Remote Work Environment:* Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

*

*Unlimited PTO:* Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

*

*Paid National Holidays:* Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

*

*Company-provided MacBook:* Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

*

*Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:* Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here:

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

*******************
*Interview Process*
*******************

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

*

Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

*

Technical Interview (60 minutes)

*

Final Interview (30 minutes)

*******************
*Life at Ruby Labs*
*******************

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

title: Junior SRE / DevOps Engineer
description:
Position Overview
We are looking for a Junior SRE / DevOps Engineer to join our infrastructure team and help support Kubernetes environments, CI/CD pipelines, application deployments, and production systems.
This role is a good fit for someone who already has basic hands-on experience with Linux, containers, Kubernetes, and CI/CD and wants to grow into an SRE / DevOps position.
Responsibilities
Support Kubernetes-based environments.
Assist with application deployments and CI/CD pipelines.
Work with Jenkins pipelines.
Support Java application build processes using Maven (mvn).
Help troubleshoot deployment and infrastructure issues.
Monitor applications and infrastructure.
Work with logs, metrics, and alerts.
Assist with infrastructure automation.
Maintain technical documentation.
Work with developers and senior DevOps/SRE engineers on production issues and improvements.
Required Skills
Basic Linux administration skills.
Basic understanding of Kubernetes.
Understanding of Docker and containers.
Basic experience with Jenkins or another CI/CD system.
Basic understanding of Maven (mvn) and Java application build processes.
Understanding of Git.
Basic networking knowledge: DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS.
Ability to read logs and troubleshoot basic application or infrastructure issues.
Basic scripting skills with Bash or Python.
Willingness to learn and work with production infrastructure.
Nice to Have
Experience with Helm.
Experience with Prometheus and Grafana.
Basic knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools.
Knowledge of Dremio.
Basic understanding of Apache Arrow.
Experience with PostgreSQL or object storage.
Understanding of SRE concepts such as monitoring, alerting, availability, and incident response.
What We Expect
We do not expect a Junior engineer to know everything.
The important things are strong fundamentals, willingness to learn, and the ability to investigate problems instead of only following predefined instructions.
The engineer will work together with more experienced team members and gradually take more responsibility for CI/CD, Kubernetes, monitoring, and production infrastructure.

title: Junior Shopify Developer (Part-time)

Working closely with a Senior Shopify Developer, the Junior Shopify Developer will assist with theme updates, page development, storefront enhancements, troubleshooting, testing, and new feature implementation.

Fully Remote | 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM EST | Part-time

*

Assist with Shopify theme updates, customization, and ongoing storefront enhancements.

*

Build and update landing pages, collection pages, product pages, and other storefront content.

*

Implement design changes and website updates provided by internal teams.

Make content, layout, styling, and functionality updates across the Shopify storefront.

Support the implementation of new website features under the guidance of the Senior Shopify Developer.

Ensure development work aligns with established designs and storefront requirements.

Troubleshoot and resolve website bugs, styling issues, and basic functionality problems.
