Assist with maintaining Shopify apps and third-party integrations.

*

Test website changes and new functionality before updates are published.

*

Identify and communicate potential issues that could affect the customer experience.

*

Help maintain a responsive, functional, and user-friendly storefront across desktop and mobile devices.

*

Support ongoing website optimization and maintenance initiatives.

Team Collaboration & Development Support
----------------------------------------

*

Work closely with the Senior Shopify Developer to complete assigned development tasks accurately and on time.

*

Collaborate with marketing, ecommerce, and creative teams when implementing website and content updates.

*

Communicate progress, challenges, and development needs clearly with relevant team members.

*

Ask questions and seek clarification when requirements or technical expectations are unclear.

*

Stay organized while managing multiple development tasks and priorities.

*

Incorporate feedback into development work and continuously strengthen technical capabilities.

--------------
Qualifications
--------------

Experience
----------

*

1–3 years of experience working with Shopify.

*

Hands-on experience making updates to Shopify themes and storefronts.

*

Experience building or updating landing pages, collection pages, and product pages within Shopify.

*

Experience troubleshooting basic website, styling, or storefront functionality issues.

*

Previous experience working with ecommerce websites is preferred.

*

Experience using Git or another version control tool is a plus.

Skills
------

*

Working knowledge of Shopify and Liquid for implementing and customizing ecommerce storefront functionality.

*

Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for making content, layout, and styling updates.

*

Basic to intermediate JavaScript skills for supporting storefront functionality and interactive website elements.

*

Familiarity with Shopify apps, third-party integrations, and theme customization.

*

Strong understanding of responsive web design principles and the ability to support consistent experiences across desktop and mobile devices.

*

Strong attention to detail when implementing, reviewing, and testing website updates.

*

Good problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot development and storefront issues.

*

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple development tasks and priorities.

*

Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with technical and cross-functional teams.

*

Strong communication skills with a willingness to ask questions, receive feedback, and continuously learn.

-----------------------
What Success Looks Like
-----------------------

*

Development tasks are completed accurately and within established timelines.

*

Website updates and new functionality are implemented with minimal bugs or issues.

*

The Shopify storefront remains responsive, functional, and user-friendly across devices.

*

Strong collaboration is maintained with the Senior Shopify Developer and cross-functional teams.

*

Storefront improvements consistently meet quality and design expectations.

*

Communication remains reliable, and technical capabilities continue to develop over time.

-----------
Opportunity

title: Junior/Mid Software Engineer
description:
*Junior/Mid SOFTWARE ENGINEER (1 to 5 years of experience)*

*
*

*Overview*

We're looking for a Software Engineer who can operate independently within an Agile team, take ambiguous requirements from concept to production, and bring architectural judgment to how we structure and process data at scale. This is not a developer from a particular tech stack, but rather a true software engineer who can and will work with any number of languages without restriction.

We are only accepting candidates currently residing in the state of Florida, preferably in the greater Tampa/St. Petersburg area, at this time.

*
*

*Responsibilities*

* Work within a Scrum/Agile team through the full sprint cycle — backlog refinement, sprint planning, capacity estimation, daily standups, sprint review, and retrospectives.

* Participate in requirement refinement sessions with product owners and stakeholders, turning ambiguous asks into well-scoped, estimable stories.

* Apply modern software design patterns and enforce separation of concerns across the codebase, ensuring components remain loosely coupled and independently testable.

* Design and build proofs of concept (POCs) to validate new approaches before committing to full implementation.

* Design and implement systems that handle structured (CSV, relational), semi-structured (JSON), unstructured, and schema-bound formats like Avro, including the tradeoffs between them for storage, processing and schema evolution.

* Contribute to big data architecture and design patterns — batch and/or streaming pipelines, data partitioning, and scalable processing approaches.

* Collaborate with UI/UX on interface design decisions, ensuring frontend implementation aligns with usability and design intent.

*
*

*Required Qualifications*

* Proven experience working in Scrum/Agile teams, including sprint planning, capacity estimation, and iterative delivery.

* Strong grasp of modern design patterns (e.g., strategy, factory, repository, observer) and the "separation of concerns" principle — able to explain not just what it is, but why it matters for maintainability and testability.

* Experience with UI/UX collaboration and requirement refinement.

* Hands-on experience with structured, semi-structured, unstructured, and schema-based data formats (CSV, JSON, Avro).

* Big data technology experience (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Hadoop ecosystem or equivalent) and associated design patterns.

* Demonstrated experience building and validating POCs.

* Experience designing and building microservices architectures — service decomposition, inter-service communication (REST/gRPC/event-driven messaging), API contracts and independent deployability.

* Strong understanding of data layer and persistence design patterns — repository pattern, unit of work, CQRS, data access layer abstraction, ORM vs. raw query tradeoffs, caching strategies and both relational (SQL) and NoSQL database design.

* Experience with cloud platforms — AWS, Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) — including core compute, storage, and managed data services on at least one major provider.

*Desirable*

* Proficiency in one or more modern languages beyond your primary stack — Python, Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Rust, TypeScript/Node.js or C# — with the versatility to pick up new languages as project needs evolve.

* Multi-cloud exposure across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and familiarity with cloud-native patterns (containers, Kubernetes, serverless, managed data/streaming services).

title: Junior Cash Inward – Treasury
description:
** *Join Amity AI Holdings!*

At Amity, we are driven by a powerful vision: to revolutionize the way businesses connect and engage with their customers and employees. Our dedication to innovation and cutting-edge technology has led us to craft a suite of groundbreaking solutions that cater to the digital needs of modern enterprises.

With a focus on enhancing communication, productivity, and customer satisfaction, our core offerings include Enterprise AIChatbot Platform that streamlines interactions, AI-based generative Chatbots that learn and adapt, and pre-built social features designed to enhance the engagement of apps and websites. But we don't stop there. We understand that engaged employees are the heart of successful organizations, and that's why we also offer building blocks for creating captivating employee experiences. These experiences foster collaboration, boost morale, and contribute to a vibrant company culture.

Hundreds of enterprises, including Kasikorn Bank, True ID, and Airasia, have already experienced the transformative power of our AI solutions. Amity Solutions platforms are used to send over 27 million messages per month and enable employee interactions for over 600 thousand end users.

For more information about Amity visit our website: **

*Your Impact:*

* Responsible for monitoring, validating, and recording company cash collections (Cash Inflow) across corporate bank accounts, online payment gateways, and incoming customer cheques. Collaborates closely with the Accounts Receivable (AR) team to match customer settlements and support receipt/tax invoicing. Prepares daily inward bank reconciliations, maintains structured financial collection archives, and liaises with external parties, notably external auditors, to supply collection evidence and bank confirmations.

*Your day-to-day responsibilities:* **

*2.1 Cash Inflow Monitoring & Cheque Deposit*

* Monitor daily bank statements via Corporate Internet Banking platforms to identify incoming receipts, remittances, and electronic transfers from corporate clients and partners.
* Coordinate with the Accounts Receivable (AR) team and commercial sales operations to reconcile unidentified receipts against outstanding billings and payment advices.
* Manage incoming customer cheques, arrange timely bank deposits, and track cheque clearing turnaround times.

*2.2 Receipts & Invoicing Support*

* Coordinate issuance of official receipts, tax invoices, and withholding tax deduction certificates relating to cash collections.
* Post daily cash receipts and bank charges into the accounting/ERP system under corresponding revenue categories and GL accounts.

*2.3 Bank Reconciliation & Exception Clearing*

* Perform Daily Inward Bank Reconciliations between corporate bank statements and general ledger entries.
* Investigate, track, and clear unidentified or unapplied cash receipts (Unapplied/Unidentified Cash) in a timely manner to minimize reconciling items.

*2.4 Document Archiving & Audit Support*

* Systematically index, archive, and safeguard collection records (daily bank statements, credit advices, pay-in slips, tax invoice/receipt copies, WHT slips, and reconciliation sheets) in hard copy and digital formats.
* Liaise directly with external and internal auditors to pull bank statements, receipt vouchers, and assist in procuring bank confirmations and audit test-of-details samples.

*2.5 Reporting & Banking Operations*

* Generate Daily Cash Inflow Summaries for treasury management to facilitate daily liquidity positioning and cash flow forecasting.
* Liaise with banking partners on statement retrieval, inward wire investigations, payment return corrections, and general operational queries.
* Execute other treasury and financial reporting assignments as directed by supervisors.

*Your profile:*

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related fields.

* 0 – 2 years of experience in Treasury, Accounts Receivable, or Cash Inflow functions (New graduates with high potential are welcomed).

* Fair to good command of written and spoken English (able to comprehend financial paperwork and draft English email correspondences).

* Familiarity with Corporate Internet Banking tools (e.g., SCB Business Net / Anywhere, K BIZ, Bualuang iBanking).

* Solid grasp of cash management mechanisms, bank settlement procedures, and daily bank reconciliation principles.

* Prior experience using ERP systems such as SAP or Microsoft Dynamics 365 is highly preferred.

* Strong organizational skills for financial documentation, rigorous numeric accuracy, and professional audit-support etiquette.

* Proficient in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, PivotTable, arithmetic lookup formulas).

*What’s in it for you:*

* Flexible work set up - we all gather as a team for one week every month at the office, for the rest of the month you are free to come to the office or work from home
* Private Health Insurance (including Dental coverage)
* Unlimited paid leave vacation and free massage at the office
* Check out more about our company, Bangkok team and our benefits:

Maintains rigorous cheque register controls, acts as the primary contact for Business Units (BUs) to resolve disbursement issues, manages systematic financial document filing, and coordinates with external parties—including internal and external auditors—to prepare supporting audit samples, ensuring timely, accurate, and transparent disbursements.

*2.1 Payment Verification & BU Coordination*

* Verify accuracy, completeness, and validity of payment requisitions (Payment Vouchers, supplier invoices, tax invoices, withholding tax certificates, and beneficiary bank details) against the corporate Approval Matrix before execution.
* Act as the focal point of contact with Business Units (BUs) and requisitioning teams to clarify discrepancies, address missing/incorrect documentation or approval gaps, and follow up promptly to adhere to payment run schedules.

*2.2 Cheque Management & Control*

* Prepare and print cheques with full supporting voucher packages for authorized bank signatories in accordance with corporate mandates.
* Maintain a comprehensive, real-time Cheque Register logging cheque book issuance, cheque numbers, payee details, payment due dates, and cheque clearing status.
* Control the dispatch and release of cheques to vendors/payees, verifying powers of attorney and official identification while securing signed receipts/acknowledgments.
* Manage cheque exceptions including voided/cancelled cheques, stale-dated cheques, stop payment orders, and replacements under strict control procedures. Monitor unpresented/outstanding cheques on a periodic basis.

*2.3 Electronic Payment Execution*

* Prepare, process, and upload disbursement batches via Corporate Internet Banking platforms (domestic/international transfers, direct credits, payroll) aligned with scheduled payment cycles.
* Monitor daily transaction statuses to promptly investigate and resolve rejected or failed transfers with internal stakeholders and partner banks.

*2.4 Accounting Posting, Systematic Filing & Audit Support*

* Record disbursement entries (bank transfers and cheques) accurately into the accounting/ERP system by correct account codes and cost centers. Prepare Daily Outward Bank Reconciliations.

* Serve as direct liaison with external stakeholders—specifically internal and external auditors and Revenue Department officers—to retrieve, organize, and provide payment audit samples and supporting evidence during statutory audits and period-end closings.

*2.5 Banking Liaison & Liquidity Support*

* Liaise with commercial bank relationship teams and branch operations regarding cheque book replenishments, stop payment requests, and transaction documentation inquiries.
* Consolidate payment figures to support periodic cash outflow forecasts and perform other treasury-related ad-hoc tasks assigned by supervisors.

*Your profile:*

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related fields.
* 0 – 2 years of relevant experience in Treasury, Accounts Payable, or Cash Outward functions (Motivated new graduates are welcomed).
* Fair to good command of written and verbal English (competent in handling bilingual financial documents and professional email communications).
* Hands-on experience with commercial Corporate Internet Banking platforms (e.g., SCB Business Net / Anywhere, K BIZ, Bualuang iBanking).
* Practical knowledge or experience in physical cheque issuance, cheque register maintenance, and custody controls.
* Prior experience using Tier-1 ERP systems such as SAP or Microsoft Dynamics 365 is highly preferred.
* Strong document management discipline with keen attention to detail and familiarity with audit documentation readiness.
* Professional communication and problem-solving skills; proficient in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, PivotTable, basic financial formulas).

*What’s in it for you:*

* Flexible work set up - we all gather as a team for one week every month at the office, for the rest of the month you are free to come to the office or work from home

title: Senior UX/UI Designer
location: Remote, Newcastle upon Tyne , Tyne and Wear
description:
*The Role

Please note this position will require 2 days per week on site in London.*

--------------
UX/UI Designer
--------------

User Research & Insight
-----------------------

* Use a range of *research, testing and validation techniques* to shape concepts and improve designs from the earliest stages.
* Work alongside researchers and wider product teams to turn *customer feedback, research findings and behavioural insight* into clear design opportunities.
* Test assumptions and hypotheses throughout the design process, ensuring decisions are grounded in *evidence rather than opinion*.
* Combine qualitative research with *product data and customer behaviour* to understand pain points and identify areas for improvement.

UX & Product Design
-------------------

* Own the design of *end-to-end digital experiences* , considering the complete customer journey rather than individual screens or features.
* Translate complex requirements into clear *user journeys, information architecture, wireframes, interaction models and user flows*.
* Take ideas from early concepts and sketches through to *well-defined, intuitive digital experiences*.
* Design with the wider ecosystem in mind, understanding how individual journeys connect across *different products, services and digital channels*.
* Work closely with Product, Research and Engineering teams to balance *user needs, commercial priorities and technical feasibility*.
* Use research insights, behavioural trends and product performance data to guide *design decisions and prioritisation*.
* Partner with Product Managers and Product Owners to identify opportunities, influence product direction and establish measures of success.
* Ensure experiences meet appropriate *accessibility, usability and inclusive design standards*.

UI Design & Prototyping
-----------------------

* Create *high-fidelity interface designs and interactive prototypes in Figma* , turning UX concepts into polished digital experiences.
* Use prototypes to explore different approaches, communicate interaction behaviour and test ideas before development.
* Design responsive experiences for *web and mobile* , considering different screen sizes, devices, platforms and accessibility needs.
* Refine designs through an iterative process, incorporating *user testing, stakeholder input and feedback from development teams*.
* Create and apply *reusable components, interaction patterns and design standards* that improve consistency across products.
* Contribute to the continued development and adoption of *design systems and component libraries*.
* Work closely with developers to make sure designs are practical to implement and that the *finished product reflects the intended experience*.
* Champion strong standards across *visual design, interaction design, accessibility and overall design quality*.

Collaboration & Ways of Working
-------------------------------

* Work as part of a *cross-functional product team* , partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Research and other Design specialists.
* Clearly communicate design thinking and rationale, using *research, customer insight and data* to support recommendations.
* Facilitate collaborative sessions and design discussions to explore problems, generate ideas and build alignment.
* Contribute throughout the product lifecycle, from *discovery and problem definition through to design, validation and delivery*.
* Help create a consistent customer experience across products by championing shared *design principles, patterns and ways of working*.

* Strong experience across *UX, Product or UI Design* within digital products and services.
* Experience translating *user research, testing, customer insight and data* into practical design solutions.
* Proven ability creating *customer journeys, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity UI designs and interactive prototypes*.
* Advanced experience with *Figma* , including responsive web/mobile design and prototyping.
* Experience using and contributing to *design systems, component libraries and reusable patterns*.
* Strong understanding of *accessibility, inclusive design and user-centred design principles*.
* Comfortable working in *Agile, cross-functional teams* , collaborating with Product, Research and Engineering from discovery through to delivery.

* An open and genuine communicator
* Able to take responsibility for your actions
* Always learning and wanting to improve
* Takes responsibility for own development
* Love what you do
* Value and support your team
* Embrace who you are
* Open minded and willing to explore new ideas

We value our team and to attract exceptional people, we offer an excellent package! In 2023, 2024 and 2025 we were recognised as one of the Best Workplaces in Tech by Great Place To Work UK, the global authority on workplace culture.

As a Leighton employee you can look forward to:

* A competitive salary this will be dependent on experience.
* A contributory pension scheme
* Private healthcare
* 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays and the opportunity to buy or sell holiday
* A flexible approach to working hours
* Continuous personal development, career path and training
* And more....

title: UX: Staff Product Designer, Design Systems - Visual
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a UX: Staff Product Designer, Design Systems - Visual based in United States.*

This is a foundational Staff Product Design role focused on shaping the visual language and token architecture of an enterprise-scale design system. You will own the design decisions that influence components, patterns, and product experiences across a broad, multi-product ecosystem. The role combines deep visual craft with systems thinking, requiring you to balance flexibility, consistency, scalability, and implementation realities. You will help evolve the system for multi-theme, dark mode, density scaling, and AI-generated product experiences. You will also play a key role in making design systems increasingly machine-readable for AI coding tools, MCP integrations, and generative UI workflows. Working closely with designers, engineers, product teams, and leadership, you will establish standards and principles that enable teams to move faster without compromising quality. This is an opportunity to influence design infrastructure at significant scale while serving as a trusted visual quality bar and design systems thought leader.

Accountabilities:
-----------------

* Own and evolve a three-tier design token architecture spanning global, semantic, and component-specific tokens, ensuring it can support multi-theme, multi-platform, and multi-density requirements.
* Make and communicate architectural decisions around token naming, tier boundaries, semantic abstraction, flexibility, constraints, and long-term scalability.
* Lead safe token migration strategies that minimize disruption for downstream teams and establish governance practices that keep consuming teams aligned.
* Own the system-level visual language across color, typography, spacing, iconography, and motion, ensuring product experiences remain cohesive and distinctive.
* Serve as the final visual quality bar for the design system, evaluating visual direction and resolving disagreements through clear principles, strong craft, and evidence.
* Develop design principles and tenets that help designers make consistent visual decisions without requiring extensive alignment for every choice.
* Lead initiatives to make the token layer machine-readable, including structuring token names and documentation for AI coding tools, MCP integrations, and generative UI systems.
* Partner with product teams across the organization as an authority on tokens and visual language, helping teams use the system effectively while identifying friction that should inform future evolution.
* Collaborate closely with engineers to maintain implementation fidelity, understand technical constraints, and advocate credibly for design intent.
* Contribute to design-system governance, including contribution reviews, quality standards, and policies that prevent token drift across the product platform.
* Provide Staff-level leadership across multiple projects, identifying high-impact problems, developing solutions, and driving initiatives through to completion with a high degree of autonomy.

Requirements
------------

* Demonstrated hands-on ownership of a multi-tier token architecture at enterprise scale, ideally within a multi-product or multi-platform environment.
* Proven experience making consequential token architecture decisions involving naming conventions, tier structures, semantic abstraction, and breaking-change management.
* Expert-level visual design craft with a systems-oriented understanding of color, typography, spacing, iconography, and motion as interconnected elements of a unified visual language.
* Experience evolving a mature design language while balancing brand evolution, system consistency, scalability, and stakeholder needs.
* A portfolio demonstrating high-quality visual product outcomes resulting from design-system and token work, not only technically sound architecture.
* Ability to establish and apply design principles or tenets to ambiguous visual challenges while reducing unnecessary alignment overhead.
* Working knowledge of machine-readable design systems, including W3C DTCG token formats, semantic naming, and documentation structures suitable for AI tool ingestion.
* Familiarity with the evolution of design-token standards and tooling, including Tokens Studio, Style Dictionary, Figma Variables API, and emerging MCP and AI integrations.
* Curiosity about AI-powered design tooling combined with strong judgment about where human design decisions and deliberate system constraints remain essential.
* Staff-level autonomy, strategic thinking, and the ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive execution without close direction.
* Strong understanding of engineering constraints and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers on implementation fidelity.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex design-system architecture to non-specialist stakeholders and senior product leaders.
* Proven experience serving as a visual quality bar for a system used by many designers, including the ability to navigate disagreement while maintaining trust and strong relationships.
* Experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and design partners and a strong understanding of business and product strategy.

Benefits

* Some roles may be eligible to participate in an equity plan through restricted stock units (RSUs).
* Remote work opportunity within the United States, with flexibility across home and office environments.

title: Brand Designer (Digital)
description:
Cloaked is a consumer privacy and identity platform on a mission to give people back control of their personal data. We let anyone generate unlimited identities - masked emails, phone numbers, and payment cards - scrub their information off data-broker sites, and shield themselves from spam, scams, and breaches, all from one app. Backed by a $375M Series B, we've protected 10M+ identities and removed 1B+ records from the data brokers who profit off personal information. Now we're building the AI-native future of privacy: autonomous agents that monitor, manage, and defend your digital footprint for you.

----------------
*About the role*
----------------

We’re looking for a *Brand Designer (Digital)* to lead brand and visual design for Cloaked's white-glove protection offering - our concierge-led service for high-net-worth individuals, family offices, and top executives who've chosen dedicated protection over self-serve.

This offering has its own identity, distinct from our core consumer product: premium, understated, and built to earn trust with an audience that expects it. You'll own everything a client sees, from the onboarding experience to the physical materials that arrive at their door, and steward the visual system that holds it together - working directly with the lead for the offering.

This is a *four-to-six-month contract engagement* with the intent to convert to full-time for the right fit.

-------------------
*What will you do?*
-------------------

Build the visual system

*

Develop and steward the brand - typography, palette, logo and lockups, photography, layout language - so it reads as authoritative and premium, with restraint over flash

*

Maintain the brand system and guidelines as a living reference the team can work from

Design the client experience

*

Design the client-facing onboarding sessions: Figma presentations, screen recordings, and animations that make the concierge journey feel considered and easy to follow

*

Explore and design product-interface concepts - UI mockups and flows for onboarding, interactive tutorials that teach the product, and the on-screen moments shown in client presentations

Make the physical artifacts

*

Design tangible, high-touch collateral: leather-bound folders with foil-stamped logos, printed briefs and dossier presentation, and QR-to-digital experiences that bridge print to the app

*

Design intentional, on-brand merchandise for clients and events - considered pieces that reinforce the positioning, not merch for merch's sake

Work closely with the team

*

Meet weekly with the lead to review progress and set priorities

--------------------------------------------
*What skills and experiences will help you?*
--------------------------------------------

*

A portfolio showing brand systems you've built or substantially shaped, not just applied

*

Strong typographic judgment and a point of view on what reads as premium versus what reads as loud

*

Fluency in Figma, including presentation and prototype work

*

Motion and animation skills sufficient to show product flows clearly

*

Print production experience - you know how to prepare files that come back from the printer looking the way you intended

*

Comfort designing UI, even if product design isn't your primary discipline

*

Experience working independently as a contractor with minimal art direction

----------------------
*What's nice to have?*
----------------------

*

Work with luxury, private banking, high-end hospitality, or other high-net-worth audiences

*

Specialty print experience: foil stamping, embossing, bookbinding, or bespoke packaging

*

Experience designing sub-brands that sit alongside a parent brand without competing with it

*

Exposure to security, privacy, or identity products

*

Merch and physical product design

*

Background working in a startup or high-growth environment

------------------
*What do we like?*
------------------

*

Self-starters who take ownership and proactively look for ways to improve things

*

Restraint - the audience is sophisticated and can tell when something is trying too hard

*

Comfort with chaos: priorities shift, context is incomplete, and you move anyway

*

A pragmatic bias toward shipping and iterating over perfecting in isolation

*

Strong communication, and the ability to explain a design decision rather than just present it

*

Genuine care about craft, including in the details nobody asked about

---------------
*What we offer*

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Senior Product Designer needed to own end-to-end design for key surfaces of a digital-health platform used by clinicians and patients in real care settings. You'll run research, shape interaction and visual design, and ship high-quality experiences in a domain where clarity, accuracy, and usability genuinely matter. You'll work directly with a cross-functional squad — product, engineering, and clinical stakeholders — to identify user problems, frame solutions, prototype and validate them, and ship. This is a hands-on senior role for a designer who's comfortable leading design in a squad and raising the bar for others through critique, mentorship, and design-system contribution.

What You'll Do:
Plan and run user research with patients, clinicians, and internal stakeholders to surface real problems before designing solutions
Synthesise research into clear problem statements, journey maps, and design principles that align the squad
Own end-to-end design — from rough concepts through to production-ready specs, with clear interaction and state documentation for engineers
Create high-fidelity prototypes to test assumptions and communicate intent before development begins
Design for multiple form factors (web, iOS, Android) with a consistent cross-platform experience
Contribute new components and patterns to the design system, with thorough documentation and accessibility notes, and drive convergence across the product without introducing unnecessary churn
Partner with engineering during implementation — review builds, flag deviations, and keep design intent intact
Facilitate and take part in design critique, giving and receiving direct, constructive feedback
Work with QA and clinical teams to validate shipped experiences against design specs and clinical requirements
Support and mentor more junior designers through critique, pairing, and regular 1:1 feedback

What We're Looking For:
5+ years of product design experience shipping consumer or enterprise software, with a portfolio that demonstrates end-to-end ownership
Proven ability to plan and run user research (interviews, usability tests, contextual inquiry) and translate findings into design decisions
Expert-level Figma skills — component libraries, auto-layout, prototyping, and design-system contribution
Systems thinking — the ability to design coherent experiences across multiple surfaces (web, mobile, embedded) without losing sight of detail
A track record of working closely with product managers, engineers, and clinical or domain experts to scope and ship features
Clear, confident communication — you can present and defend design decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and you're comfortable working asynchronously
Strong visual and interaction design craft with a high bar for detail, balanced with pragmatism about product and engineering constraints
An ownership mindset and comfort with ambiguity — you stay accountable from first sketch through post-launch iteration, and you bring structure to loosely defined problems

Nice to Have:
Experience designing for regulated or safety-critical domains (healthcare, fintech, medtech, or similar)
Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and designing inclusively
Exposure to design systems at scale — tokens, theming, documentation, and component governance
Background in data-dense or clinical dashboard design
Experience working in distributed, async-first teams across multiple time zones
Familiarity with FHIR or healthcare data structures
Hands-on use of AI-assisted design or prototyping tools

What Success Looks Like:
Strong usability and satisfaction scores for the product surfaces you own
High research quality — clear insights and fast movement from question to decision
A healthy design system — good adoption, component coverage, and complete documentation
Effective cross-functional partnership — engineering and product happy with the design collaboration
Designers you mentor growing and becoming more effective

title: Product Designer
description:
Lead Product Designer
---------------------

THE DESIGN PHILOSOPHY
---------------------

At Fyxer, design starts with human behaviour — not screens, not components, not flows.

We believe the best product decisions come from understanding why people do what they do, and working backwards from there. That's not a principle we put on a wall. It's how we make decisions.

WHAT YOU'RE WALKING INTO
------------------------

We're not starting from zero. We have a creative designer on the team, a visual identity built with Red Antler, a design system and a product that real users depend on every day.

What we don't yet have is a senior product design voice — someone who is the instinctive first call across the company when a product, experience, or communication decision needs a human-behaviour lens on it.

That's this role. You'll report to our Group PM and work as the soled designer, an early PM hire, and engineers directly. You'll be the most senior product design hire we've made — with real influence not just over what gets built, but over how this company thinks about the people it builds for.

If you believe that understanding people is the hardest and most important part of design — and that everything else follows from that — this is the role for you.

What we care about, in order
----------------------------

01 — HUMAN BEHAVIOUR FIRST
--------------------------

You think in motivation, habit, and friction before you think in screens. You understand why people do what they do — and you use that to make product decisions, not just design decisions.

02 — CRAFT AND EXECUTION
------------------------

You ship. You work directly with engineers and move fast without losing the quality that makes a product feel premium. You've used Figma, ShadCN, and Tailwind long enough to know their edges.

03 — AI-NATIVE WORKFLOWS
------------------------

You understand how modern engineers build with AI tools, and you think about design in that context. We care about principles, components, and systems that plug seamlessly into engineering workflows rather than living in static documentation. You're comfortable working close to implementation and helping create experiences that stay coherent even as teams move quickly with AI-assisted development.

What you'll be working on
-------------------------

Fyxer is an AI-powered productivity platform. You'll be designing interfaces where the AI does real work — live transcription, deeply personalised drafts, complex cross-surface workflows. These aren't CRUD forms. They're experiences that need to feel effortless despite genuine complexity underneath.

A large part of this role is interaction design. We’re building products with genuine complexity underneath them, and we care about making those experiences feel calm, intuitive, and coherent across every touchpoint.

*

A real-time notetaker that generates live transcripts and surfaces insights in context

*

Personalised AI draft generation that adapts to each user's communication style

*

A seamless web and mobile web experience that makes AI feel like a natural daily habit

*

Custom internal tooling that gives our engineering team design-aligned components and workflows

Who you are
-----------

*

You have 5+ years designing in high-growth, early-stage environments where structure was something you built, not inherited.

*

You'll work closely with an early PM hire — this is a foundational relationship you'll help define, not a dynamic you're inheriting.

*

You understand technical constraints well enough to have a real conversation with an engineer — not just hand over a Figma file.

*

You've worked with or designed around AI-generated outputs and you've thought carefully about what that does to UX.

*

You run your own user research. You talk to users, watch session recordings, and use what you find to defend — or change — your design decisions.

*

You move fast because you're good, not because you cut corners.

The stack
---------

*

Design: Figma, Miro, Lucide
---------------------------

*

Component alignment: ShadCN, Tailwind CSS, V0

*

Insight: PostHog (surveys, session recording, analytics)

*Why Fyxer?*
------------

We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.

*

*Autonomy:* We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

*

*Velocity:* You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

*

*Scale:* This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage.

*The Fyxer Reality:*
--------------------

*

*The Trajectory:* We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32.

*

*The Evidence:* Ranked *7th in Andreessen Horowitz’s list of top AI apps*. Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We are the outlier.

*

*The Culture of Agency:* We hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.

*

*Zero Bureaucracy:* No slow-motion decision-making. No "alignment" meetings for the sake of it.

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

Compensation Range: £100K - £140K
---------------------------------

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
------------
*Who we are*
------------

Glow and Bellesa Boutique are two sexual wellness brands under one roof, and this role designs for both. Bellesa Boutique is the established name, a curated shop with a loyal audience and a voice of its own. Glow is the newer brand: serious tech, playful discovery, made for everyday life. We believe intimate care belongs in the same conversation as skin, sleep, and mind, and we design like it.

We're a small, fast team with a strong point of view about how this category should look and feel, who care deeply about design, craft, and pushing our work forward in thoughtful, meaningful ways.

---------
*The job*
---------

We’re looking for a Senior Designer who truly lives design — someone who’s always researching, collecting references, exploring new ideas, and bringing a sharp point of view to both brand and digital work. You’ll help shape art direction, design engaging emails, and bring our brand world to life across multiple mediums.

This role sits at the center of our creative team. You’ll partner closely with the Head of Design to lead projects, elevate the work, mentor designers, and contribute to the standards, culture, and direction of the design team. It’s a hands-on role where your craft, curiosity, and attitude will have a real impact on the organization. We're looking for someone with taste, an opinion, and the confidence to say "here's a better idea" and then make it.

If you want a long-term home where you can grow, push the work, and be part of a supportive, collaborative team, you’ll fit right in.

*What You’ll Do*

* Break down complex brand and digital briefs into structured, actionable plans in partnership with the channel owner and Head of Design
* Lead art direction on campaigns from early concept to final delivery
* Lead website design projects across UX and UI, from wireframes to handoff
* Create bold, intuitive, brand-forward digital and print experiences
* Build and maintain scalable design libraries
* Present work clearly and confidently to internal teams
* Collaborate closely with developers for smooth handoff and production
* Contribute to creative strategy, storytelling, and visual direction
* Provide guidance and feedback to junior/mid-weight designers and freelancers

------------------------
*What we’re looking for*
------------------------

* 5+ years of digital design experience in a creative studio or similar environment
* A portfolio that shows bold, effective work across email, web, and brand, ideally for DTC or lifestyle brands.
* A portfolio that shows strong typography design, and elevated brand sensibility
* High Proficiency Figma skills and comfort working inside complex components and systems
* High proficiency across Adobe CC; motion (After Effects or similar) is a big plus
* An instinct for experimenting with new tools, techniques, and workflows in service of better, more inventive design
* A curiosity for AI tinkering and image generation
* Experience designing responsive interfaces and understanding accessibility best practices
* Ability to juggle multiple projects, stay organized, and deliver on deadlines
* Someone who values communication, low ego, curiosity, and being part of a supportive team
* A designer who cares about craft — the pixels, the pacing, the storytelling, the details
* A long-term mindset: you want a home base, a crew, a place to grow

*Nice to haves*

* Motion, animation, micro-interaction design
* Writing instincts (conceptual thinking, naming, presentation decks)
* Print production and supervision experience or interest

*Perks*

* Fully remote!
* Competitive benefits & time-off policies
* A chance to challenge yourself creatively alongside a supportive team, learn from experienced mentors, and be an important part of a vibrant team that values design-lead strategy.

--------------
*How to apply*
--------------

Send a portfolio link and a short note, a paragraph or two, on a brand that handles a taboo category with real taste, and one decision its design team got right.

title: Product Manager - Retail & Insights
description:
**

*About dunnhumby*

dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.

*Product*

Our Product team owns the vision, strategy and roadmap for the dunnhumby platform — the data, science and software that powers retailers and brands around the world. We work at the intersection of customer data, AI, and commercial impact, building products that turn insight into measurable growth.

**

*Job Purpose:*

Work closely with the product squad to define and deliver user-centric insight and analytics products that help retailers and their supplier and CPG partners make better, faster decisions with customer data. You will build a deep understanding of how these clients work — the questions they are trying to answer and the journeys they move through — and translate that into clear product requirements that make those journeys effective and intuitive, end to end.

Alongside this, you will develop a platform mindset: thinking beyond individual features to reusable, scalable data and insight capabilities — including those delivered through APIs and integrations into client systems — that serve users well while supporting long-term scalability and reuse. The two sides of this role carry equal weight: the platform exists to enable the client's insight journey, not the other way around.

*Key Accountabilities*

*Contribute to shaping the end-to-end experience*

* Build a strong understanding of the end-to-end user journey for retailer and supplier users, from the initial business question through to the decision or action enabled by the product.
* Contribute to product decisions by bringing together validated client needs, user behaviour, commercial context, and relevant data and platform considerations.
* Work closely with design and research teams to help shape insight experiences, outputs, and interactions that are clear, intuitive, and reduce the effort required to reach meaningful answers.
* Consider the broader client workflow beyond the product interface, including exports, reporting, and downstream analysis, so the product supports practical business use.

*Drive your squad*

* Work closely with engineering, data science, and design counterparts to define and deliver scalable capabilities aligned to the wider product and platform strategy.
* Define product increments that maximise reuse through APIs, shared data services, and configurable frameworks rather than point solutions.
* Collaborate across Product domains so insight, data, and delivery work together into a coherent client experience.

*Execute with Excellence*

* Own the execution roadmap for the product and its underlying data and insight capabilities, improving both client outcomes and operational efficiency.
* Write clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and — where relevant — API contracts, data mappings, and integration specifications.
* Act as a primary point of contact for client and partner stakeholders, ensuring requirements are communicated, understood, and delivered successfully.
* Define and manage the lifecycle of features and data integrations from discovery through implementation, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.
* Ensure product requirements weigh both the user experience and the underlying data quality, integration, security, and privacy considerations.
* Identify and frame product problems before they are fully specified — validating the underlying client and user need rather than only executing a defined brief.

*Measure what matters*

* Measure adoption, reliability, scalability, and the operational performance of the product and its capabilities.
* Define and monitor both client outcomes and non-functional requirements including data quality, latency, uptime, observability, security, and resilience.
* Prioritise work that improves the client's path to an answer, alongside automation, consistency, and platform scalability.

*Build your product maturity*

Working with Product Leadership to develop and strengthen the following:

* *Bring others on the journey:* Communicate product strategy, roadmap, and priorities across technical, commercial, and client-facing stakeholders.
* *Know our business:* Understand how insight products contribute to retailer success, supplier outcomes, and long-term product strategy.
* *Comprehend the market:* Build knowledge of retail, customer data, measurement, and the insight needs of retailers and their suppliers.
* *Understand your users:* Develop deep understanding of retailer and supplier users, analysts, and the decisions they are trying to make.
* *Create awareness:* Support go-to-market activities by enabling capabilities that accelerate client adoption.

*Platform & Technical Collaboration*

* Apply platform-first thinking to define reusable, scalable data and insight capabilities.
* Work closely with engineering and data teams to design API-first solutions and integration approaches.
* Translate business and user requirements into clear API specifications, data models, workflows, and system behaviours.
* Evaluate data-sharing models, integration options, and privacy and compliance requirements that shape how insight reaches clients.
* Contribute to long-term platform architecture that lets insight and data capabilities be reused across products and clients.
* Collaborate with engineering to deliver secure, performant, observable, and maintainable capabilities.

*Qualifications & Experience*

*Essential*

* Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or a related discipline.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or a related discipline.
* *Minimum of 5 years’ product management experience, with 7+ years preferred* , gained in roles with clear ownership of product strategy, discovery, delivery, and outcomes.

* Working knowledge of APIs, data schemas, and system integration principles.

* Ability to prioritise effectively and deliver large, ambiguous initiatives from discovery through to implementation and adoption.

title: Product Led Growth Manager
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Led Growth Manager based in India.*

This is a high-impact growth product role focused on building and optimizing self-serve acquisition journeys for technical audiences.
You’ll own the customer funnel from signup and trial through activation, conversion, expansion, and product-led sales handoffs.
You’ll also serve as product owner for the website and application experience, shaping priorities and working closely with engineering and design.
The role combines product management, experimentation, analytics, lifecycle growth, and developer-focused experiences.
You’ll work with engineers, data teams, AI builders, marketing, customer success, RevOps, and sales to turn insights into measurable growth.
The environment is remote-first, globally distributed, highly autonomous, and focused on rapid experimentation and iterative delivery.
Success will be measured through improvements in activation, paid conversion, self-serve revenue, expansion, funnel velocity, and qualified sales opportunities.

Accountabilities
----------------

*

Own the self-serve growth funnel end-to-end, defining, measuring, and improving signup, trial, activation, paid conversion, and expansion journeys.

*

Act as product owner for the website and product UI, establishing the roadmap and priorities for experiences that capture demand and improve funnel performance.

*

Partner with engineers and designers to ship iterative improvements to the website, application, and customer journey.

*

Design and run conversion experiments, developing hypotheses, launching A/B tests, analyzing results, and scaling successful approaches.

*

Optimize product-led growth journeys originating in developer ecosystems, open source, documentation, SDKs, code examples, and emerging AI-agent ecosystems.

*

Develop a deep understanding of developer workflows and identify ways to improve the first hands-on experience and accelerate activation.

*

Build customer data and segmentation frameworks using product usage and firmographic signals to support personalized onboarding, content, and nurture programs.

*

Collaborate with RevOps to identify product-qualified accounts and determine when sales engagement can support expansion or account-managed relationships.

*

Work closely with product marketing, marketing, customer success, sales, and RevOps to align teams around a shared growth funnel.

*

Use data and customer insights to continuously identify new growth opportunities and prioritize the next set of experiments.

*

Track and communicate performance across activation, conversion, revenue, expansion, funnel velocity, and the quality of qualified opportunities passed to sales.

------------
Requirements
------------

*

5–8+ years of experience in growth, growth product management, lifecycle marketing, or funnel-focused product roles.

*

Proven success driving growth within B2B SaaS, developer-focused products, or businesses operating a self-serve or product-led growth model.

*

Strong understanding of how technical users and developers evaluate, adopt, and expand their use of software tools.

*

Experience working with developer tools, APIs, data products, open-source ecosystems, or other technical audiences.

Track record of improving activation, free-to-paid conversion, expansion, and/or churn reduction through product and lifecycle initiatives.

Strong analytical skills, including defining growth metrics, instrumenting funnels, segmenting users, interpreting product signals, and combining quantitative insights with customer feedback.

*

*

Opportunity to work as part of a self-motivated, multicultural, globally distributed team.

Exposure to cutting-edge open-source technologies and tools.

Opportunities to attend conferences and connect with colleagues around the world.

International, collaborative environment with significant cross-functional exposure.

description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The next chapter of Ramp's growth runs straight through the customers we already have: 80,000+ finance teams who adopted us for one thing and haven't yet seen what the rest of the platform can do for them. Account Management owns that opportunity - and this role owns the team building the motion to capture it.

You'll lead a group of 5-8 Account Managers, each carrying a book of ~300 Mid-Market customers with real latitude over how they grow it. This is a build role, not a maintain role: the playbooks, coaching systems, and performance bar you set are the ones this team runs on next year. Your ceiling is set by how well you turn individual AM judgment into a repeatable, scalable motion that grows the segment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build and run a high-performing team of 5-8 Account Managers - setting the bar for culture, morale, and daily execution.

- Get embedded in the relationships that matter. Engage directly with key customers and top accounts alongside your team, especially where trust is being built or repaired.

- Own the number. Manage quota performance and pipeline generation across your team to hit spend activation, product activation, retention, and expansion goals.

- Forecast and report team performance to senior leadership with clear-eyed visibility into what's working and what isn't.

- Hire and develop the next generation of AMs - training on product, buyer personas, competition, and tooling through role-plays, game film, and real deal work.

- Coach relentlessly. Run daily 1:1s, dissect call feedback, lead enablement sessions, and build career paths for every rep on your team.

- Turn what works into a system. Continuously refine team processes and tooling to improve output and efficiency as the segment scales.

- Represent Account Management cross-functionally, partnering with Sales, CX, CSM, Risk, and Product to remove blockers and drive outcomes.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- Minimum 3 years of quota-carrying sales or account management experience as an individual contributor, with a proven, consistent track record of exceeding goals (new business or cross-sell/upsell experience mandatory)

- Minimum 3 years building and leading account management or sales teams, with a track record of exceeding goal (new business or cross-sell/upsell experience mandatory)

- Prior success in fast-paced, results-oriented GTM environments, ideally at SaaS or AI companies

- A genuine passion for hiring, with a thoughtful approach to team planning and development

- Ability to articulate contractual, technical, and financial value to customers, including executive leaders

- Strong track record negotiating, structuring, and executing complex agreements

- Proficiency with data analytics tools (Salesforce, Looker, Excel) and a bias toward using data to drive decisions

- Strong collaboration and influencing skills, backed by excellent communication and presentation ability

- High agency and adaptability - no two days are the same, and the only constant is change

- A desire and willingness to jump headfirst into complex, challenging problems for the good of the business.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience at a high-growth startup

- Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual membership

- 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

- Pet insurance

- In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

- Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

CANADA

- Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

- Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

This role offers a unique opportunity to join as a fourth member of the Airwallex commercial team in The Netherlands. We are seeking an experienced Account Executive to build and maintain relationships with new and existing strategic clients, owning the full sales cycle and supporting multiple go-to-market and international expansion strategies.

You will be accountable for increasing revenue, new client acquisition and representing Airwallex in client meetings and events across The Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg (and beyond...).

Furthermore, you are commercially-minded, analytical, and a Fintech enthusiast who is driven by forging relationships and becoming a trusted advisor to our customers, delivering thought leadership insights and solutions that help them grow powered by Airwallex products and solutions.

- Develop and execute a sales plan to achieve and exceed sales targets

- Build and maintain relationships with new and existing clients

- Manage the sales process from start to finish, including lead generation, prospecting, and closing deals

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, product, and operations, to ensure customer success

- Conduct presentations and product demonstrations to potential clients

- Negotiate contracts and pricing with clients, leading complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements and multi-product sales

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related field

- Ability to speak and write in English and fluent in Dutch

- 4+ years of experience in sales, preferably in the fintech or payments industry selling technical products

Airwallex’s Infrastructure & Productivity team is on a mission to turn everyday software engineers into superheroes. The team builds and maintains the internal platforms, tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure that power Airwallex’s global engineering organization, serving hundreds of engineers across multiple offices and time zones.

The team is now pioneering a bold new direction: an AI agent ecosystem where goal-oriented agents continuously operate across every repository — automating infrastructure operations, incident response, database management, and DevOps workflows. Built on Quartermaster, our internal agent platform, these agents autonomously plan, reason, and execute multi-step tasks against real infrastructure. You will be joining at the ground floor of this initiative, building the intelligent systems that fundamentally change how infrastructure work gets done at Airwallex.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Infrastructure AI team, you will design, build, and operate goal-oriented AI agents that automate SRE, DevOps, and DBA workflows across Airwallex’s global infrastructure. You won’t be doing operations work yourself — you’ll be building the AI systems that do it. Your agents will autonomously investigate incidents, provision infrastructure, manage databases, execute deployments, and handle the operational tasks that traditionally require human intervention.

You will work on top of Quartermaster, Airwallex’s internal agent platform, building domain-specific agents that interact with real infrastructure tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, cloud APIs, databases, monitoring systems). This role requires you to think deeply about agent architecture — planning and reasoning loops, tool selection and execution, safety guardrails, human-in-the-loop escalation, and how to make autonomous systems reliable in production infrastructure environments.

This hybrid role is based in Seattle, WA.

Responsibilities

- Build goal-oriented infrastructure AI agents: Design and implement autonomous agents on the Quartermaster platform that handle SRE, DevOps, and DBA workflows — including incident investigation and remediation, infrastructure provisioning, deployment orchestration, database operations, and capacity management.

- Design agent architectures for safety and reliability: Build robust agent loops with planning, reasoning, tool-use, error recovery, and human-in-the-loop escalation. Infrastructure agents touch production systems — they must be safe, auditable, and predictable.

- Integrate agents with infrastructure tooling: Give agents the ability to interact with real systems — Kubernetes, Terraform, cloud APIs (AWS, GCP, Aliyun), monitoring/observability platforms, databases, and CI/CD pipelines — through well-designed tool interfaces.

- Evaluate and improve agent performance: Define metrics for agent effectiveness (task completion rate, accuracy, time-to-resolution, escalation rate). Build evaluation frameworks to measure whether agents reliably achieve their goals.

- Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with SRE, DevOps, and platform engineering teams to identify the highest-value workflows for agent automation. Understand real operational pain points and translate them into agent capabilities.

- Shape the future of infrastructure AI at Airwallex: Contribute to the technical vision for how AI agents will transform infrastructure operations. Stay at the forefront of agentic AI developments and bring new ideas into the team.

- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in backend languages such as Python, Go, Java, or Kotlin.

- Infrastructure and cloud knowledge: Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Aliyun), container orchestration (Kubernetes), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), and CI/CD systems. You understand the domain the agents will operate in.

- Strong system design skills with the ability to architect reliable, safe, and scalable agent systems that interact with production infrastructure.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working effectively across cross-functional teams in a global environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems: You have designed and built AI agents that autonomously plan, reason, and execute multi-step tasks using LLMs. This includes agent loop design, tool-use orchestration, and managing agent state and memory. This is a core requirement, not a nice-to-have.

- Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom agent frameworks) and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).

- Experience with observability and monitoring systems (Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, ELK stack) — either building them or building agents that interact with them.

- Experience with database administration or automation (schema migrations, query optimization, backup/recovery) — knowledge that helps build effective DBA agents.

title: Senior Fullstack Data Analyst (Commercial analytics)
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Please note: applications will be open until Friday 2nd October 2026 at 08.00 CEST.
We will not review any applications before the closing window so please don't rush and take the time you need to submit a high quality application.

Growth Intelligence owns the commercial data layer that powers Pleo's GTM engine from acquisition, retention and, propensity modelling to customer health. The team supports RevOps, Customer Experience, Customer Success, and senior commercial leadership with the data and models they need to make faster, smarter decisions.

As a Senior Full Stack Data Analyst, you sit at the intersection of commercial analytics and customer intelligence. You build end-to-end analytics solutions (retention models, growth analyses, activation funnels, and GTM dashboards) that directly influence how Pleo acquires, onboards, retains, and grows its customer base.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You will report to the Senior Manager of the Growth Intelligence team. You will partner primarily with Customer Experience, Sales, and Success teams. You will also work closely with the onboarding and self-serve product teams as well as colleagues across Growth Intelligence and the broader data community, including Data Scientists in your team and Analytics Engineers who own the modelling layer your analysis depends on.

For extra context, you'll also be leveraging technologies including SQL, dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Amplitude, HubSpot, Zuora, or Vitally.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Build and maintain the analytics layer for customer acquisition, onboarding, growth, and retention: propensity models, growth dashboards, activation funnels, and the commercial reporting GTM teams depend on day-to-day.

- Partner with Customer Experience, Sales, and Success teams to understand their data needs and deliver dashboards and analyses that drive operational decisions.

- Conduct in-depth analysis of customer behaviour, commercial performance, and retention patterns to surface trends, risks, and growth opportunities (owning the insight and narrative, not just the output).

- Support the onboarding and self-serve product teams with data on activation, engagement, and friction, translating product behaviour into insights that improve the customer journey.

- Design and analyse experiments to test growth hypotheses and optimise key commercial metrics within Pleo's experimentation methodology, ensuring statistical rigour.

- Build analytics explicitly designed for self-serve and AI access

- Contribute metric definitions and domain knowledge to the semantic layer, working with Data Services & Governance to ensure GTM metrics are consistently defined across BI tools and AI tooling.

- Engage with data colleagues across Intelligence to share knowledge, maintain standards, and contribute to a culture of craft.

WHAT YOU BRING

- Proven experience working across both insights generation and analytics engineering in a SaaS environment (fintech is a big plus).

- Solid proficiency with Python, SQL and dbt: you write clean, tested models, understand layered architecture, can manipulate and analyse data to uncover insights.

- BigQuery experience, including complex transformations and performance considerations.

- BI tool proficiency such as Looker and LookML

- Commercial mindset: you understand GTM metrics, customer lifecycle stages, and how data connects to revenue outcomes.

- Strong data visualisation skills: you build dashboards that GTM stakeholders actually use, not just ones that look good.

- Understanding of how analytics outputs serve AI tools and self-serve analytics as first-class consumers: you design for machine access as well as human access, and know why metric consistency matters as AI tooling scales.

- Comfort with Git-based workflows and CI/CD practices for analytics code.

- Strong ownership and delivery discipline: you manage multiple projects with close attention to detail and follow through.

- Solid understanding of data contracts: schema agreements, ownership, and SLAs between data producers and downstream consumers.

THIS ROLE IS NOT A GOOD FIT IF

- You prefer to specialise deeply in one area rather than wear multiple hats. This role requires you to move between analysis, analytics engineering, experimentation, and stakeholder management.

- You are not comfortable engaging directly with demanding commercial stakeholders and translating their needs into data solutions without a fully defined brief. You'll often need to shape the question as much as answer it.

- You need clean problem definitions before you can start. The commercial data environment here is genuinely complex. Definitions evolve, ownership is shared, and the right answer sometimes requires negotiation as much as analysis.

YOUR FIRST 6 MONTHS

By the end of your first six months, you'll have built things that GTM teams are actively relying on.

- Growth Intelligence's core analytics layer: activation funnels, customer health reporting, retention signals will be in better shape than when you arrived. You'll know which models and dashboards matter most, where the gaps are, and have fixed at least some of them in ways that reduce manual work for RevOps, CS, and CX.

- You'll have contributed real metric definitions to the semantic layer, agreed with Data Services & Governance on what canonical GTM metrics actually are, and made that stick downstream. Analysts and AI tools will be getting consistent answers rather than each team maintaining their own version.

- You'll have a genuine working relationship with the commercial stakeholders you serve — RevOps, Customer Experience, Customer Success — and they'll have a clear sense of what to bring to you and what to expect back.

- And you'll have shipped at least one piece of analysis or tooling that changed a commercial decision or enabled something that wasn't possible before, not just improved the plumbing, but unlocked actual use.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
