title: Senior Fullstack Data Analyst (Commercial Analytics)
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Please note: applications will be open until Friday 2nd October 2026 at 08.00 CEST.
We will not review any applications before the closing window so please don't rush and take the time you need to submit a high quality application.

Growth Intelligence owns the commercial data layer that powers Pleo's GTM engine from acquisition, retention and, propensity modelling to customer health. The team supports RevOps, Customer Experience, Customer Success, and senior commercial leadership with the data and models they need to make faster, smarter decisions.

As a Senior Full Stack Data Analyst, you sit at the intersection of commercial analytics and customer intelligence. You build end-to-end analytics solutions (retention models, growth analyses, activation funnels, and GTM dashboards) that directly influence how Pleo acquires, onboards, retains, and grows its customer base.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You will report to the Senior Manager of the Growth Intelligence team. You will partner primarily with Customer Experience, Sales, and Success teams. You will also work closely with the onboarding and self-serve product teams as well as colleagues across Growth Intelligence and the broader data community, including Data Scientists in your team and Analytics Engineers who own the modelling layer your analysis depends on.

For extra context, you'll also be leveraging technologies including SQL, dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Amplitude, HubSpot, Zuora, or Vitally.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Build and maintain the analytics layer for customer acquisition, onboarding, growth, and retention: propensity models, growth dashboards, activation funnels, and the commercial reporting GTM teams depend on day-to-day.

- Partner with Customer Experience, Sales, and Success teams to understand their data needs and deliver dashboards and analyses that drive operational decisions.

- Conduct in-depth analysis of customer behaviour, commercial performance, and retention patterns to surface trends, risks, and growth opportunities (owning the insight and narrative, not just the output).

- Support the onboarding and self-serve product teams with data on activation, engagement, and friction, translating product behaviour into insights that improve the customer journey.

- Design and analyse experiments to test growth hypotheses and optimise key commercial metrics within Pleo's experimentation methodology, ensuring statistical rigour.

- Build analytics explicitly designed for self-serve and AI access

- Contribute metric definitions and domain knowledge to the semantic layer, working with Data Services & Governance to ensure GTM metrics are consistently defined across BI tools and AI tooling.

- Engage with data colleagues across Intelligence to share knowledge, maintain standards, and contribute to a culture of craft.

WHAT YOU BRING

- Proven experience working across both insights generation and analytics engineering in a SaaS environment (fintech is a big plus).

- Solid proficiency with Python, SQL and dbt: you write clean, tested models, understand layered architecture, can manipulate and analyse data to uncover insights.

- BigQuery experience, including complex transformations and performance considerations.

- BI tool proficiency such as Looker and LookML

- Commercial mindset: you understand GTM metrics, customer lifecycle stages, and how data connects to revenue outcomes.

- Strong data visualisation skills: you build dashboards that GTM stakeholders actually use, not just ones that look good.

- Understanding of how analytics outputs serve AI tools and self-serve analytics as first-class consumers: you design for machine access as well as human access, and know why metric consistency matters as AI tooling scales.

- Comfort with Git-based workflows and CI/CD practices for analytics code.

- Strong ownership and delivery discipline: you manage multiple projects with close attention to detail and follow through.

- Solid understanding of data contracts: schema agreements, ownership, and SLAs between data producers and downstream consumers.

THIS ROLE IS NOT A GOOD FIT IF

- You prefer to specialise deeply in one area rather than wear multiple hats. This role requires you to move between analysis, analytics engineering, experimentation, and stakeholder management.

- You are not comfortable engaging directly with demanding commercial stakeholders and translating their needs into data solutions without a fully defined brief. You'll often need to shape the question as much as answer it.

- You need clean problem definitions before you can start. The commercial data environment here is genuinely complex. Definitions evolve, ownership is shared, and the right answer sometimes requires negotiation as much as analysis.

YOUR FIRST 6 MONTHS

By the end of your first six months, you'll have built things that GTM teams are actively relying on.

- Growth Intelligence's core analytics layer: activation funnels, customer health reporting, retention signals will be in better shape than when you arrived. You'll know which models and dashboards matter most, where the gaps are, and have fixed at least some of them in ways that reduce manual work for RevOps, CS, and CX.

- You'll have contributed real metric definitions to the semantic layer, agreed with Data Services & Governance on what canonical GTM metrics actually are, and made that stick downstream. Analysts and AI tools will be getting consistent answers rather than each team maintaining their own version.

- You'll have a genuine working relationship with the commercial stakeholders you serve — RevOps, Customer Experience, Customer Success — and they'll have a clear sense of what to bring to you and what to expect back.

- And you'll have shipped at least one piece of analysis or tooling that changed a commercial decision or enabled something that wasn't possible before, not just improved the plumbing, but unlocked actual use.

Snowflake are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer for the Netherlands market who can solve our customer’s most complex problems. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to best support them in their evaluation and ultimately help our customers choose Snowflake as their solution.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

- Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

- Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

- Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

- Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

- Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

- Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

- Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

- Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

- Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

- Proactively contribute and help co-develop Account & territory plans and execute while engaging with the broader internal/external ecosystem.

ON DAY ONE YOU WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

- Solution engineering/solution architect experience in a Saas environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

- Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

- Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

- Hands on experience with SQL

- Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

- Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

- Fluency or Native Dutch.

PREFERRED (BUT NOT REQUIRED) TO HAVE:

- Hands on experience with Python

- Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

- Experience with AI, data science and machine learning technologies

People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solution Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.

Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations
Our objective is to organise anyone's life.
Â
RoleAs a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.
You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.
Â
What You'll Own- Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

- Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

- Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

- Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

- Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

- Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

Â
What We're Looking For- Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

- Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

- Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

- Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

- Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

- Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

Â

- Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

- AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

Tech Stack- TypeScript

- React.js / Next.js

- HTML / CSS

- WebSockets / streaming APIs

- Node.js

- REST / GraphQL APIs

title: Junior Product Manager, PreK-12
description:
Role: Jr. Product Manager, PreK-12
Team: Product
Reports to: VP, Product
Location: Flexible (Fully-Remote or Hybrid | Offices in NYC and Miami)

WHO WE ARE

The ASU+GSV Summit
Now in its 18th year, the ASU+GSV Summit is the world’s most important gathering of “PreK to Gray” education and workforce leaders. Held every April in San Diego, the 2026 event drew over 7,000 registrants to tackle the transformation of learning and skills delivery through generative AI, virtual reality, and other emerging technologies.

Frequently referred to as the “Davos of Education,” the ASU+GSV Summit brings together over 850 speakers each year, engaging in over 300 conversations around the future of learning and skills at scale. Past keynote speakers have included former President George W. Bush, Secretary Condoleezza Rice, Prime Minister Tony Blair, Sal Khan, Priscilla Chan, Ruby Bridges, Gloria Steinem, Jane Fonda, and countless others who have inspired our community to take bold action. Leading partners such as Google, Microsoft, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Gates Foundation, Walton Family Foundation, ClassDojo, and others help power this community. Through ongoing engagement and a global stage at ASU+GSV, you’ll help bring together the boldest thinkers reimagining what’s possible for the future of PreK-12 education.

As of July 2025, GSV Summit became part of Hyve Group's portfolio, joining forces with Bett to create the largest and most impactful education innovation community in the world, now reaching an audience of over 100,000 participants across five events on four continents.

WHO IS THE PRODUCT TEAM?

The Product Team is the creative and strategic engine behind the ASU+GSV Summit experience. We design and deliver the program of ASU+GSV, through curated content and experiences that inspire action: from high-production keynotes with global thought leaders to provocative panels, interactive workshops, community activations, and live product demos.

We bridge marketing, strategic partnerships, and community engagement to craft seamless, high-impact experiences for our attendees and partners. We collaborate closely with education leaders, practitioners, entrepreneurs, investors, policymakers, researchers, and thought leaders to shape the conversations that matter most in “PreK to Gray” learning.

Our work is structured around three core verticals—PreK-12, Higher Education, and Workforce—but the real power is in what we call “the magic in the mix.” Program often develops across verticals, so every team member takes a collaborative approach. We lean in to build the right program for the right audience at the right time, staying agile to launch new programs and rethink existing ones as needed.
ROLE OVERVIEW
We’re looking for a highly organized, execution-focused Jr. Product Manager to support the PreK-12 team at the ASU+GSV Summit. Reporting to the VP, Product and working closely with the Director, K12 Product, this role is about turning strategy into flawless execution. You will support in managing the details, logistics, and follow-through that bring the PreK-12 program to life.

Each year, 1,100+ PreK-12 leaders from 530+ districts and schools join us to explore the most pressing opportunities and challenges in PreK-12 education—from classroom innovation and educator support to school leadership, digital learning, and student outcomes.

You’ll partner closely with the Director, K12 Product to execute the PreK-12 content program, and collaborate with the SVP of Community, the VP of Educator Engagement, and the broader K12 community team to bring programming to life for our growing network of PreK-12 leaders. The role blends project management, program logistics, and cross-team coordination—requiring thoughtful collaboration, extreme precision, consistent follow-through, and a genuine curiosity about the PreK-12 landscape, including how AI is beginning to reshape it. That deep curiosity and eagerness to build understanding and discernment is what supports our team’s purpose: elevating the most cutting edge research, founders, and ideas, identifying the stars of tomorrow, and curating provocative conversations that push forward the most pressing challenges impacting the future of learning.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
As the Jr. Product Manager, PreK-12 you will be responsible for:

Program Execution & Project Management

* Support the development and execution of the PreK-12 program under the direction of the Director, K12 Product—from researching emerging topics and identifying compelling voices to developing session concepts and bringing them to life at ASU+GSV Summit: ensuring that they are timely, relevant, and high-impact.

* Across the product team, we work with 850+ speakers and 200+ partners to curate more 300 sessions each year, in addition to numerous bespoke community activations and experiences.

* Supporting end-to-end program logistics: from speaker outreach and confirmation to session scheduling, run-of-show details, and final delivery.
* Track and maintain accurate program documentation, session details, and speaker logistics with exceptional organization. No detail is too small.
* Maintain the PreK-12 program calendar and pipeline, in coordination with partnership and community team to ensure a holistic approach, proactively flagging risks and dependencies

Partnership Support

* Support the Director, K12 Product and the partnerships team in coordinating partner deliverables and activations tied to PreK-12 programming.
* Track partner commitments and help ensure timely execution of partner-related program elements.
* Help prepare materials and briefs for partner program involvement.

Community Collaboration

* Partner closely with the SVP of Community, the VP of Educator Engagement, and the broader K12 community team to execute community engagement initiatives that support PreK-12 programming, in-person and year-round.
* Help coordinate educator engagement touchpoints—webinars, community activations, and outreach—that feed the PreK-12 content pipeline.
* Capture and organize community insights to help the Director, K12 Product surface emerging leaders, trends, and conversation topics.

Relationship Management & Stakeholder Communication

* Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for PreK-12 speakers, moderators, and partners—managing logistics, scheduling, and communications with professionalism and responsiveness.
* Support the Director, K12 Product in engaging PreK-12 superintendents, principals, educators, EdTech founders, and policymakers to inform program development and ensure content reflects the opportunities, challenges, and perspectives shaping the field.

Technology & Process Excellence

* Use Airtable, Cvent, generative AI, and other tools to streamline workflows and enhance program delivery.
* Identify and test new technologies that can improve efficiency, attendee experience, and business outcomes.

WHO YOU ARE
Experience

* Bachelor’s degree
* 1–2 years of previous experience in program/product management or a similar role that requires excellent attention to detail and ability to translate from strategy to execution
* PreK-12 education or EdTech experience a strong plus

Skills & Qualities

* Highly Organized & Detail-Oriented: You track dozens of moving pieces without dropping a thread, and you build the systems to keep everything on track. No detail is too small.
* Execution-Focused: You’re energized by getting things done—turning plans into action and keeping programs moving forward through prompt, reliable follow-through.
* Collaborative & Coachable: You understand that great program execution depends on keeping multiple teams aligned and are an effective team-player working across teams on shared projects and initiatives. You take direction and feedback well, and are eager to learn the PreK-12 landscape.
* Community Builder: You think about programming through the eyes of the people in the room and are curious about what will make a conversation useful, surprising, and relevant to different PreK–12 audiences
* Strong Communicator: You write and speak clearly and professionally—whether confirming a speaker, updating a partner, or briefing your manager.
* Calm Under Pressure: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and stay composed as details shift in the weeks leading up to Summit.
* Curious About Education & AI: You’re genuinely interested in how AI and technology are reshaping PreK-12 education, and eager to grow your expertise in the sector.
* Proactive Problem-Solver: You anticipate issues before they become problems and bring solutions, not just questions, to your manager.
* Tech-Forward & Tech-Savvy: You’re facile with tools like Airtable, Cvent, Google Workspace, and AI-powered platforms that boost efficiency and enhance program delivery.

This role requires a willingness to travel and work extended hours in the weeks leading up to the Summit, as well as supplemental travel throughout the year.

GSV is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Junior Business Analyst - Growth and Lead Generation
description:
We are looking for a Junior Business Analyst to support our outbound B2B business development and modern online marketing activities and help identify new business opportunities across international markets. This role is a strong fit for someone who combines hands-on lead generation experience with strong analytical, logical, and creative thinking abilities. While at least one year of relevant experience is required, we place significant emphasis on your ability to learn quickly, which we consider more important than actual experience, as well as the ability to generate ideas, creatively evaluate different approaches, identify and reason about potential challenges, and make sound, data-driven judgments and assumptions. For us, relevant abilities and potential are much more important than previous work experience.

Requirements:

At least 1 year of experience in B2B Lead Generation, Sales Development, Business Development, or a similar/relevant role(s).
Very strong logical and analytical skills, with the ability to brainstorm, evaluate, and reason about ideas, approaches, and experiments in a data-driven way to determine which are most likely to be effective and why.
Strong brainstorming and creative problem-solving, logical/analytical abilities. You should be comfortable generating multiple ideas and logically assessing their potential.
Very strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. You should be comfortable adapting and frequently reprioritizing as needed, as we receive new information or decisions.
Strong written English communication skills. Advanced spoken or presentation skills are NOT essential, as the role does not involve external sales calls unless you want to take them on.
Experience with B2B cold email outreach and/or B2B LinkedIn prospecting, preferably using creative approaches, in an analytical, data-driven way.
Strong attention to detail, precision, and accuracy.
Experience using outbound automation tools such as Apollo, LinkedIn Helper, Woodpecker, Lemlist, or similar platforms.
Experience generating B2B leads and building prospect pipelines.

Nice to Have:

Strong interest in and willingness to grow in modern sales and marketing.
Affinity for analytics, logical reasoning, numbers, precision, technology, and attention to detail.
Academic background or track record demonstrating strong performance, ideally from a top business, mathematics, physics, IT, technology, or similar university.
Experience working with international clients or prospects, particularly in the US, UK, Western Europe, Nordics, Canada, Singapore, Australia, or similar markets.
Experience in software/technology, recruitment, marketing agencies, or professional services.
Understanding of IT services and technology-related industries.
Previous experience with modern online marketing channels and tools, even at an introductory level, such as SEO, GEO/LLM SEO, Reddit, or similar.
Basic HTML/CSS or other technical skills.
Previous experience working directly with senior sales or marketing professionals, directors, founders, or other decision-makers.
A dynamic personality and an interest in working in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

Brainstorm creative ideas for new sales and marketing channels, initiatives, and experiments.
Analyze and evaluate sales and marketing ideas, experiments, and approaches, using logical reasoning and available data to determine what is likely to be effective.
Identify and research potential B2B clients and execute outreach campaigns to generate new business opportunities.
Execute outbound campaigns across B2B sales channels, including LinkedIn and email, as well as creative inbound marketing channels.
Generate qualified leads and schedule meetings for the sales team.
Maintain CRM records and prospect databases and handle related sales administration/organization, including agreement processing, follow-ups, and written communication with prospects and clients.
Conduct written negotiations with prospects and clients when required, mostly via emails/IMs.
Run multiple sales and marketing initiatives simultaneously, closely monitor their performance, and adapt or improve them based on market feedback and input from the founding team.
Support marketing activities including SEO, GEO, Reddit ranking, keyword research, link building, and similar initiatives. We use Ahrefs and a range of other modern marketing tools.
Perform basic technical tasks related to marketing and sales activities, including WordPress and HTML changes or configuration of differnt/similar kind.
Support ongoing business development and lead generation initiatives.
Work directly with company management and collaborate across departments.

What We Offer:

We’ll provide extensive training, particularly in modern B2B sales/lead generation and marketing. You’ll work directly with the founding team, which provides a significant opportunity to learn and grow. At the same time, this requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, adaptability, and effective communication. You’ll be working alongside a team of high performers in a fast-paced environment, with plenty of opportunities to take on new responsibilities and develop your skills.

* *Data-driven After-Sales:* Du analysierst die Kampagnen-Performance, erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings und präsentierst die Ergebnisse überzeugend vor unseren Kunden.

* *Background:* Idealerweise hast du erste praktische Erfahrung im Online-Marketing, einer (Media-)Agentur, im HR-Marketing/Employer Branding oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld – *auch motivierte Quereinsteiger*innen sind bei uns herzlich willkommen!*
* *Kommunikationsstärke:* Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie echte Freude am direkten, beratenden Kundenkontakt.
* *Organisationstalent:* Ein hervorragendes Zeitmanagement, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, in dynamischen Phasen die richtigen Prioritäten zu setzen.
* *Markengespür & Kundenfokus:* Ein geschultes Auge für gutes Design, Kreativität und ein tiefes Verständnis für die unterschiedlichen B2B-Kundenbedürfnisse.
* *Mindset:* Hohe Eigenmotivation, der Wille zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung und die Leidenschaft, ein stark wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen mit der Vision „Besseres Lernen für alle“ aktiv mitzugestalten.

title: Junior Full-Stack Developer (React OR Laravel)
description:
Стек:
Frontend: TypeScript, React, RTK Query, Tailwind-variants, Zod, i18n.
Backend: PHP 8+, Laravel 12 (Event-Driven архітектура).
Інші проекти: C#, ASP.NET Core.
(Вам не обов'язково знати все на ідеальному рівні. Очікуємо впевнене знання TypeScript/React та базове розуміння ООП на C# або PHP).
Що потрібно буде робити:
Design-First розробка: Перед написанням коду ти складатимеш короткий Tech Doc українською, який відповідатиме на питання "Як я буду це реалізовувати" (опис API контрактів, стейту та куди піде яка логіка). Коротше - краще. Можеш описати за 2 речення - гуд.
Розробка: Писати фічі на React та бекенді.
Робота з llm-gate: Виправляти свій код за зауваженнями LLM-бота до того, як його перевірятиме Lead.
Кого ми шукаємо (Вимоги):
Впевнене володіння TypeScript та React.
Базове розуміння патернів проектування, REST API, роботи реляційних БД (PostgreSQL).
Вміння читати чужий код та документацію англійською мовою.
Дисципліна: готовність працювати в рамках лінтерів, строгих типів та дизайн-документів
Умови:
Невелика команда (3-4 людини).
Повністю віддалена робота.
8 годинний день
Повна відсутність бюрократії - процес керується виключно через GitLab, Trello і 4 дейлі-мітинги на тиждень.
На мітингах завжди з камерою. Один раз на тиждень у сорочці 👔.

Важливо для відгуку:
обов'язково додай посилання на свій код (бажано на React, Laravel або C#). Посилання НА файл! Де, на твою думку, найцікавіша реалізація.
Нам неважливо, чи допомагав тобі LLM його писати, але ви маєте розуміти кожен рядок. На співбесіді ми будемо розбирати цей код, і потрібно буде аргументувати свої архітектурні рішення... або їх відсутність.
Якщо з вами було обговорено час співбесіди, тоді буде обов'язеове питання на тему tailwind-variants. Якщо ви не будете знати про що йдеться мова, на цьому інтервю буде завершено.
На співбесіді не буде жодних теоретичних питань на тему алгоритмів чи "data structures" - ми говоримо лише про реальну архітектуру та ваш код та tailwind variants.

Якщо ви бекендер - напишіть `BACKEND`, або будьте готові до питань тільки по фронту

title: Junior Backend Engineer (Europe)
description:
-------------
About Kalepa:
-------------

Insurance is a $7T global industry built on professional labor: underwriting, claims, pricing, operations, and distribution. Kalepa is building AI that can perform that work.

We create professional-grade AI systems for insurers: software that can read, reason, decide, and act inside real workflows and operate over long-time horizons. Kalepa begins by augmenting professionals with the tools to succeed at their jobs. That earns us the right to learn from real decisions, capture decision traces, and automate what can be automated successfully over time.

Our products are already in production with leading insurers, driving measurable outcomes and expanding across functions. The opportunity is far broader than any single workflow: to build the AI operating system for decision-making across insurance. For people who want to work on AI that matters, in a sector where correctness, trust, and real-world impact count, Kalepa is just getting started.

Kalepa is backed by leading investors such as IA Ventures and Inspired Capital, and our team brings experience from Facebook, Palantir, Google, Amazon, McKinsey, Mastercard, and Uber.

-------------------------------
Our Values (This is important):
-------------------------------

Many organizations have a dusty list of corporate values that no one ever follows. Kalepa is not one of those companies. Our values are designed to unlock the potential of our employees.

Success at Kalepa is bred from five core principles:

* *Hustle and Determination* - We hire people who take full ownership of their craft and relentlessly pursue excellence with speed and determination. We choose the hard problems and do not give up. This is the foundation of how we work and how we win.
* *Deliver Customer Impact* - We're obsessed with customer impact. Every feature, every line of code, every decision is measured against one question: does this help insurers make better decisions? If it doesn't drive speed, accuracy, or profitability for our customers, we don't build it.
* *Meritocracy* - We're building something exceptional, and that requires exceptional people and ideas. We have a high bar but we reward excellence with rapid growth. If you're the best at what you do, you'll thrive here.
* *Transparency* - We value honest, transparent communication over politics. We challenge ideas, not people. We say what needs to be said, even when it's hard. This is how we solve problems fast and find the truth.
* *Experiment Relentlessly* - Many of the problems we face have never been solved before. We tackle them by testing quickly, measuring rigorously, and iterating until we find the path forward. Speed of learning is our advantage.

In addition to our NY office, we have remote employees speaking 10+ languages across the globe. But we invest in bringing our people together both for regional meetups and global offsites (2021 - Playa Del Carmen | 2022 - Rome | 2023 - Buenos Aires | 2024 - Lisbon | 2025 - Cartagena).

Kalepa’s culture isn’t for everyone, and that’s ok. But for the people who are a fit, they can’t imagine working elsewhere.

Salary range: $60k – $70k USD*

We are looking for smart engineers who love to code, seek challenging problems, and appreciate recognition for excellent work.

As an engineer at Kalepa, you'll work on real product and R&D systems at the intersection of software engineering and applied AI. You will contribute to backend services, data and ML pipelines that support our product used by commercial insurance underwriters.

You'll help build and improve systems that ingest, process, and reason over large volumes of structured and unstructured data, including documents, third-party sources, and model outputs. This is hands-on engineering work on problems that matter to the business, with ownership of features end to end.

You'll collaborate closely with experienced full-stack, backend, ML, and platform engineers, and you'll be expected to contribute to how production systems are designed, built, tested, and operated at scale. We're a small team where individual contributions have an outsized impact on both our technology and our business.

*You'll Be a Good Fit If You:*

* Have approximately 1 year of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production systems
* Have strong fundamentals in at least one programming language and know Python
* Have a degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Enjoy writing code and solving non-trivial technical problems
* Are curious about AI, data, and real-world applications of machine learning
* Take ownership and are comfortable working with ambiguity
* Move fast, learn quickly, and value high standards
* Appreciate direct feedback, meritocracy, and transparency

*What We Offer:*

* Competitive salary based on experience level*
* Significant equity options package
* Direct work on core systems at a fast-growing AI startup, with a steep learning curve
* Fully remote work from Europe
* Onsite team events in Warsaw and global team offsites
* Real responsibility and production impact from day one
* Mentorship from senior engineers
* 20 days of PTO a year
* Gym, phone, and learning stipend reimbursement

*The salary range listed is an estimate and will vary based on a variety of factors. Final compensation will be determined during the offer stage based on relevant experience, performance during the interview process, and geographic location, and may therefore differ from the posted range.

title: Junior QA engineer
description:
About us
Friendly Technologies builds device management software that telecom operators and ISPs use to manage millions of routers, gateways, and IoT devices (LwM2M, MQTT, OMA-DM, TR-069/TR-369 USP, CoAP, and HTTP protocols).

About the role
Want to move into QA from system administration or ISP support? This role is for you. You don't need QA experience. We'll teach you testing; you bring strong networking and hands-on hardware skills.

What you'll do
Test our platform against real network hardware: routers, switches, firewalls, and CPE devices
Set up and maintain test environments on Linux and Windows servers
Reproduce, troubleshoot, and document issues reported by customers
Check protocol behavior (TCP/IP, SNMP, HTTP, and others) with tools such as Wireshark
Run basic database checks in Oracle and MySQL
Write clear bug reports and test cases in English, and work closely with developers and support

What we're looking for
English good enough to speak, read, and write technical documentation
Strong networking fundamentals
Hands-on experience with routers, switches, firewalls, and similar hardware
Experience managing, configuring, and troubleshooting Windows and Linux servers
Understanding of layer 3–7 protocols (TCP/IP, SNMP, etc.)
Basic knowledge of Oracle and MySQL (simple queries are enough)

Nice to have
Experience as a system administrator or ISP technical support engineer

What we value
You learn on your own and enjoy figuring things out
You communicate clearly and work well in a team
You want to grow professionally
You can occasionally work outside normal hours, e.g., for customer issues in other time zones

What we offer
Training in QA methods and telecom device management protocols
Work with real carrier-grade equipment and international customers

title: Junior Project Manager - Global

*What you'll do*

You will help coordinate the different workstreams required to turn a theatrical concept into a high-quality, repeatable live experience.

When you join Fever, you are joining a company that will invest in your professional development. You will:

title: Junior Media Buyer (Ad Operations) Part-Time | Remote (Latam)
description:
Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We help individuals from around the world connect with great companies that are looking for their specific skill set. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located.

*About the company*
Our client is a direct-to-consumer protective gear brand built for action sports: mountain biking, motocross, and snow sports. They design and sell CE Level 2 certified equipment for riders who want real protection without giving up style. Their growth runs on a high-output creative engine: a whitelisted creator program, an in-house AI creative team, and an external senior media buyer who launches and scales what the team builds.

*About the role*

You will build approved creative into Meta Ads Manager and keep the creator payout system accurate. The senior media buyer owns strategy, budgets, and turning ads on. You own everything before that: every ad set built correctly, named correctly, and ready to launch on time.

This is a hands-on Ads Manager role, not an upload-only role. You need to already know how to build campaigns, ad sets, and ads in Meta, including attribution settings, placements, page and Instagram identity, and URL parameters. Most builds run through AdManage.ai, an AI bulk upload tool that sits on top of Ads Manager. You will be trained on the internal systems. You will not be trained on Ads Manager.

This is an execution role, not a decision-making role. Every build follows a written spec: which campaign, which settings, which name, which copy, which identity. Every count follows a written rule per creator. Every pay check follows a fixed checklist. You do not choose settings, change budgets, turn ads on or off, rename things your own way, decide what a creator is owed, or improvise when something is unclear. If the spec does not cover it, you stop and ask.

The two traits that matter most are accuracy and speed. A wrong setting or a missed detail costs a launch day. A miscounted video or a wrong ad name means a creator gets paid wrong.

*What you'll do*

Meta Ads builds, which is the majority of the role:

* Build approved creative from the tracker into the correct Meta campaign with the correct settings, naming, identity, copy, and URL parameters, following the written spec
* Check the funnel stage of every video before building so nothing lands in the wrong campaign
* Keep the creative tracker matching Meta at all times
* Hand off built ad sets to the senior media buyer ahead of his Tuesday and Thursday launches
* Fix Meta upload errors yourself: resolve or remove broken ads the same day and report what happened

Creator payouts and systems:

* Count delivered creator videos and keep the retainer tracker accurate
* Run a weekly check that the ad spend in the pay tracker matches Meta before Finance pays creators, and flag anything that does not match
* Keep the creative tracker, Drive folders, and Motion dashboards organized and accurate
* Flag inconsistencies, missing assets, or broken steps as soon as you see them

*What we're looking for*

* 1 to 2 years of hands-on Meta Ads Manager experience. You have personally built and launched campaigns
* Follows written direction exactly, without reinterpreting or improvising. This is the number one requirement
* Extreme attention to detail. You build to the spec and check your work before you say it is done
* Fast. Creative arrives daily and needs to be built the day it is approved
* Comfortable owning a recurring process with financial consequences. You would rather flag and hold than guess
* Handles Meta upload errors on your own using the error procedure, and asks the moment something falls outside it
* Strong with Google Sheets and Drive, and quick to learn new tools such as Motion and AdManage
* Reliable and consistent. Same hours every day, with status updates in Slack when something is done or blocked

*Requirements*

* Strong organizational instincts and real attention to detail. Small errors here turn into payout errors later
* Comfort working in Google Sheets, including formulas and reporting
* Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, or the ability to learn the upload workflow quickly
* Someone who follows a process exactly, but speaks up when the process itself is broken
* Reliable, self-directed, and consistent once training wheels come off

* *Details*

* Part-time, 4 hours per day, Monday to Friday
* Your 4-hour shift must fall within 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST, the same shift every day
* Fully remote
* One-week paid trial, then contract
* First two weeks are SOPs, Loom walkthroughs, and supervised builds. After that you own the build queue and the weekly pay check independently

*Benefits*

* Work From Anywhere
* Salary paid in US$
* International Brands Exposure

title: (Junior) Softwareentwickler
description:
# (Junior) Softwareentwickler

## Aus einer guten Idee ein echtes Produkt machen

Wir, die EGB-Gruppe, stehen für zuverlässige Stromversorgung, intelligente Energielösungen und innovative Services. Mit unseren 7 Standorten sind wir deutschlandweit im Einsatz – auf Großbaustellen ebenso wie bei der Entwicklung smarter Lösungen rund um Strom, Energieverbrauch und Metering.

Von der temporären Stromversorgung auf der Baustelle bis zur digitalen Erfassung und intelligenten Auswertung von Verbrauchsdaten: Wir verbinden praktische Erfahrung mit modernen Technologien und entwickeln daraus Lösungen, die unseren Kunden echten Mehrwert bieten.

Dabei setzen wir auf die Expertise und das Engagement unserer rund 110 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir unser Unternehmen kontinuierlich weiter – und schaffen zunehmend digitale und intelligente Lösungen, die nicht nur unsere eigenen Prozesse verbessern, sondern das Potenzial für **neue Softwareprodukte und Märkte** bieten.

**Dafür suchen wir dich als (Junior) Softwareentwickler (m/w/d)**

## Das erwartet Dich

Unsere ersten KI- und Softwarelösungen sind bereits da. Jetzt wollen wir daraus professionelle, marktfähige Produkte entwickeln und neue Geschäftsfelder erschließen und unser Unternehmen noch digitaler machen.

Dafür bieten wir dir viel Gestaltungsspielraum, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, von Anfang an Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Du bringst bestehende Lösungen auf das nächste Level und gestaltest aktiv mit, was daraus entsteht.

Deine Aufgaben:

* Du digitalisierst unsere internen Unternehmensprozesse und entwickelst ebenfalls externe Softwareprodukte weiter und optimierst die bestehende KI-Intrastruktur zu professionellen, skalierbaren Produkten weiter.
* Du identifizierst neue Potenziale für KI und Digitalisierung für unsere Branche und entwickelst daraus konkrete Softwareproduktideen und Lösungen.
* Du verbindest technisches Know-how mit einem Blick für Nutzer, Markt und Geschäftsmodelle.
* Du evaluierst neue KI-Technologien und entscheidest, welche davon echten Mehrwert für unser Unternehmen und unsere Kunden bieten.

## Das bieten wir Dir

* **Geregelte Arbeitszeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance:** Bei uns kannst du dich auf feste Arbeitszeiten verlassen, die dir genug Freiraum für deine persönlichen Bedürfnisse und Freizeitaktivitäten lassen.
* **Attraktive außertarifliche Vergütung:** Wir bieten dir einen AT-Vertrag mit einer leistungsgerechten und marktgerechten Vergütung.
* **Unterstützung bei deinen persönlichen Entwicklungszielen:** Wir fördern deine Weiterentwicklung und bieten dir Perspektiven, dich fachlich und persönlich zu entfalten.
* **Moderne Büroausstattung:** Du arbeitest mit neuestem IT-Equipment in einem angenehmen Arbeitsumfeld.
* **Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad, Firmenfitness, Mitarbeiterkarte und Teamevents:** Neben einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und einem Jobrad profitierst du von Firmenfitness und einer monatlichen Aufladung deiner Mitarbeiterkarte für Sachbezüge. Regelmäßige Teamevents sorgen für einen guten Zusammenhalt.
* **Flache Hierarchien und eine offene DU-Kultur:** Bei uns pflegen wir eine kollegiale Atmosphäre und kommunizieren auf Augenhöhe.
* **Viel Raum zur Mitgestaltung:** Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen, Verantwortung übernehmen und den Aufbau unserer digitalen Produkte aktiv mitgestalten.

## Das bringst Du mit

* Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Software Engineering, Data Science, KI oder einem verwandten Bereich - überzeugende Praxisprojekte zählen bei uns mehr als Zeugnisse
* Erfahrung darin, technische Lösungen von einem Prototyp in einen stabilen, produktiven Einsatz zu überführen - inklusive Deployment, Monitoring und Support
* Ein gutes Verständnis für moderne KI-Technologien, REST-APIs, Datenverarbeitung und generative KI beziehungsweise LLMs
* Freude daran, mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen zusammenzuarbeiten - von Vertrieb und Einkauf über die Baustelle bis zur Energiedatenanalyse
* Eine eigenständige, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, eine Unternehmerisches Denken und Lust darauf, etwas Neues aufzubauen sowie die Bereitschaft, Dinge auch selbst zu dokumentieren: Du bekommst Projekte, die du maßgeblich mitgestalten kannst
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

**Technisch bist du hier zuhause:**

* Sicherer Umgang mit KI-Assistenten, bevorzugt mit **Claude Code**
* Kenntnisse im den Bereichen Künstliche Intelligenz, moderne Webentwicklung (**Node.js** und **Angular**/**React**) und in relationalen und zeitbasierten Datenbanken (**MySQL**, **MS-SQL**, **InfluxDB**)
* Kenntnisse im Umgang mit **Linux**-Servern, **Docker** und **Git**
* Grundkenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik und **Firewalls**, idealerweise hast Du schon mit einer Firewall wie **pfSense** gearbeitet
* Grundkenntnisse in der **Azure**-Welt sowie mit Authentifizierung über **OIDC**, **OAuth2** und **JWT**, idealerweise mit **Keycloak**
* Wünschenswert sind erste Berührungspunkte zur **Energiewirtschaft** und Erfassung von Messdaten, Lastgänge, Zählerinfrastruktur von **IoT**-Sensorik über **MQTT**

**Besonders wichtig:** Du bringst technisches Verständnis und praktische Entwicklungserfahrung mit. Du kannst bestehende Lösungen eigenständig weiterentwickeln, neue Technologien sinnvoll einsetzen und aus ersten Ideen professionelle, marktfähige Produkte entwickeln.

Du musst nicht jeden Punkt abdecken. Wir besetzen die Stelle nach Erfahrung: Wenn du den Großteil mitbringst und beim Rest **neugierig** bist, sprich uns an - auch wenn du erst wenige Jahre Berufserfahrung hast.

## Deine Chance

Wenn du Lust hast, **KI nicht nur auszuprobieren, sondern daraus echte Produkte zu entwickeln**, bist du bei uns richtig.

Bei uns findest du bereits bestehende Lösungen, ein praxisnahes Umfeld und kurze Wege. Was noch fehlt, bist **Du**, um aus diesen Ansätzen professionelle Produkte zu machen und gemeinsam mit uns neue Märkte zu erschließen.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Junior Business Development Manager (Eastern Europe)
description:
About the Role
--------------

Imagine this - you are helping Destinus expand across one of the most strategically important and fast-moving defense markets in Europe. This is a hands-on opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to build strong commercial expertise in aerospace and defense. You will gain direct exposure to complex sales cycles, public procurement, tenders, customer engagement, and market development while contributing to Destinus' growth across Eastern Europe.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

--------------

* Support the development of new business opportunities across Eastern Europe, with a particular focus on defense, aerospace, UAVs, and government customers

* Research regional markets, defense priorities, procurement programs, competitors, and potential partners to identify new opportunities

* Assist senior Business Development colleagues throughout the full commercial cycle, from initial opportunity identification to proposal and contract stages

* Build and maintain relationships with customers, government stakeholders, local partners, and other key players across the region

* Support the preparation of proposals, tenders, presentations, commercial offers, and other customer-facing materials

* Track public tenders, procurement opportunities, defense programs, and relevant regulatory developments across Eastern European markets

* Coordinate with engineering, product, legal, finance, and operations teams to ensure commercial opportunities are supported by solid technical and business cases

* Help organize customer meetings, demonstrations, industry events, and trade shows across the region

* Maintain accurate information on opportunities, customer interactions, next steps, and commercial priorities

* Travel across Eastern Europe when required to meet customers, partners, and stakeholders

*Requirements*

What You'll Need

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, International Relations, Economics, Engineering, Aerospace, Defense Studies, or a related field

* Initial experience in business development, sales, consulting, defense, aerospace, government affairs, or a similar environment through employment, internships, or relevant projects

* Strong interest in the defense and aerospace industries and motivation to develop a career in an international commercial role

* Understanding of Eastern European markets and their business environment

* Strong research and analytical skills with the ability to turn market information into clear commercial insights

* Confidence communicating with different stakeholders in an international environment

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Romanian or another Eastern European language is highly valued

* Ability and willingness to travel regularly across the region

* Experience with government procurement, tenders, UAVs, aerospace, or defense technology is a plus but not essential

Who You Are
-----------

You are ambitious, curious, and commercially minded. You enjoy getting close to customers, understanding what drives a market, and turning information into opportunities. You take ownership without waiting to be told every next step, learn quickly, and are comfortable working in a fast-moving international environment. You are ready to build your network, develop your commercial instincts, and grow alongside a company that is pushing aerospace and defense technology forward.

description:
*About Nysonian*

Nysonian is a 9-figure consumer products company built around two brands: NOBL and Flo Pilates. We grew revenue 8x in 2025 and are building the next phase of the US-based business across physical products, software, and subscription experiences.

NOBL is a functional travel brand built around a simple idea: travel products should solve real problems, not just look better. Every feature is designed to eliminate friction from the travel experience — from seamless organization and easy access, to tracking, connectivity, and protection.

Flo Pilates brings studio-quality Pilates into the home through connected fitness hardware, content, and subscription experiences.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
elearnio is a learning platform for digital preboarding, onboarding and continuous training. Companies use us to combine their own content, mandatory compliance training and external courses into structured learning experiences for their employees, partners and customers. Our customers are primarily mid-sized businesses in the DACH region.

We are a small, remote-first team. Decisions get made by a handful of people who all know the product, so there is very little between having a good idea and it being agreed.

We are looking for a *Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)* to work remotely from anywhere within EU time zones. You will be our only designer, and you will own how elearnio looks and feels. That is a broad remit. Every screen our customers touch is your responsibility, across a platform that covers a lot of ground.

If you need a design team around you to do your best work, this is the wrong role. If you have been the design function in a small product company before and enjoyed the ownership that comes with it, let us talk.

-----
Tasks
-----

* Own the visual and interaction design language of the entire platform, and hold it together across a product that keeps growing
* Turn product concepts into wireframes, then into build-ready design files with states, edge cases, responsive behaviour and interaction detail
* Own our design system: the component library, tokens, and keeping it honest against what is actually implemented in the frontend
* Design to WCAG 2.1 AA. Accessibility comes up more and more in DACH procurement, and we would rather build it in than retrofit it
* Run design QA together with our QA team, so what ships matches what was designed
* Run customer interviews and usability tests, in support of discovery and to validate your own concepts
* Build up genuine depth in our product and in corporate learning and development as an industry, so your decisions come from understanding the domain rather than from generic patterns
* Write the microcopy that goes with your designs, in English and ideally German
* Grow into driving design-led topics yourself, from proposal through to concept

*How we work together*

Being clear about this up front, because it is the thing candidates most often get a surprise about.

* *Product discovery and concepts sit with our Head of Product.* He runs that process and writes the specs, so you will not be starting from a blank page. But what we build and why is decided as a team, and talking to customers is something several of us do.
* *You own how it gets designed.* Interaction, layout, visual language, the design system, and the quality of what actually ships. Within the problem, the solution is yours, and you are expected to push back when the proposed approach is the wrong one.
* *Design-led topics become yours to drive.* Not on day one. But once you know the product and the industry, we would expect you to bring your own proposals for the things design should be leading, whether that is navigation, information architecture or a visual overhaul, and to take them through the concept phase yourself rather than waiting for a spec. That is what we are looking for at senior level rather than mid.

------------
Requirements
------------

* Several years designing complex, logic-heavy B2B or SaaS products, including at least one you shaped visually over a longer period
* Strong visual craft. Typography, hierarchy, spacing and information density in data-heavy interfaces, and the judgement to make a dense admin tool feel calm
* Deep fluency in a modern design tool, including building and maintaining component libraries
* Comfortable designing for localisation. The interface ships in 15 languages. You will design in German and English, but layouts need to hold up when strings run considerably longer or shorter
* Responsive and mobile design, including users who only ever access the platform on a phone
* You can run interviews and usability tests yourself, and turn what you hear into design decisions
* Fluent English

*Nice to have*

* German good enough to run customer interviews in it
* Experience designing within an established product, not only greenfield work

*Not part of this role*

Brand, marketing and website design. This is a product role, full stop. If your portfolio is mainly campaigns, landing pages and visual identity, we are probably not a good match.

--------
Benefits
--------

* Real ownership: you are the design function, and the product will visibly carry your decisions

* We believe in the power of working remotely. It is your choice from where you work, anywhere within EU time zones

*Your application*

Please send a portfolio. We are looking for two things: evidence of visual and interaction craft in a complex interface, and at least one case study that shows your reasoning from problem to shipped result. If you have worked on tying a growing product together, we especially want to see that.

We get to know each other, you walk us through one project from your portfolio in depth, and we talk through how you would approach a real elearnio design problem. A discussion, not an exercise. elearnio is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We believe our team should reflect a rich diversity, so we encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. title: Web Designer
description:
About Ferla

Ferla is a U.S.-based company with two growing brands: Ferla Bikes, focused on commercial and specialty bikes, and Ferla Family Bikes, focused on premium electric cargo and family bikes.
We are looking for a talented Part-Time Web Designer to join our team remotely and help us continuously improve both websites.
This is an ongoing position for someone who is creative, detail-oriented, and comfortable working directly inside Shopify and WordPress—not just creating mockups.

What You'll Do
Design and improve pages for both Ferla websites
Build and redesign Shopify and WordPress pages
Work extensively with WordPress + Elementor
Create product pages, collection pages, landing pages, and promotional pages
Improve existing pages to make them cleaner, more modern, and easier to navigate
Improve UX/UI and overall customer experience
Optimize designs for desktop, tablet, and mobile
Create strong visual hierarchy and clear calls-to-action
Work with product photos, banners, icons, graphics, and other website assets
Maintain consistent branding across both websites
Work closely with our e-commerce, marketing, sales, and development teams
Take references or rough concepts and turn them into polished webpages
Recommend improvements when you identify UX or design problems
Required Skills

Must have:
Strong web design experience
Shopify
WordPress
Elementor
Responsive/mobile design
UX/UI fundamentals
E-commerce website design
Landing and product page design
Basic HTML/CSS knowledge
Strong attention to typography, spacing, layout, and visual consistency

Nice to have:
Figma
Adobe Photoshop
Adobe Illustrator
Basic understanding of SEO
Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
Experience working with U.S. e-commerce brands

Who We're Looking For
We're looking for someone who can do more than make a page look attractive.
You should understand how to organize information, simplify complicated pages, guide customers toward the right action, and create a consistent experience across an e-commerce website.
You should be comfortable receiving a task such as:
"This product page has too much information and is difficult to navigate. Review it, propose a better structure, and redesign the page."
We want someone who can take ownership of that assignment rather than needing step-by-step design instructions.
Schedule

This is a part-time remote position with a flexible schedule.
We are looking for someone interested in working with us on an ongoing basis rather than completing a single project.
Some overlap with U.S. business hours for meetings and communication is preferred.
How to Apply
Please include:
Your portfolio
2–3 examples of websites or pages you personally designed
Your experience with Shopify
Your experience with WordPress/Elementor
Your hourly rate or preferred monthly compensation
Your availability per week
Your time zone

Please do not apply without examples of your previous web design work.

Candidates who move forward may be asked to complete a small paid test task based on one of our existing Ferla website pages.

title: Brand Designer
location: Remote or In-Office in San Francisco
description:
-----------
About Clerk
-----------

Clerk is on a mission to solve the user identity layer once and for all. We are a globally distributed team dedicated to providing best-in-class developer infrastructure to build the next generation of AI software. Today, we provide developers with full-stack React components and hooks like , , , useUser, and useOrganization. These APIs allow developers to build hard-to-get-right infrastructure for user identity, organization management and billing flows. We believe that a component is worth a thousand APIs.

----------------
What you will do
----------------

You’ll join Visual Designers, UI Engineers, and fellow Product Designers on the Clerk Design team to own and uplevel the Clerk brand. You’ll optimize for customer delight, flexibility, and ease-of-use within a complicated, technical domain.

We will expect you to:

*Bring innovative approaches to brand design*. Use new approaches to bring digital experiences to life and create scalable tools that increase high quality brand output

*

*Not settle for less than pixel-perfection*. You’ll work with a world-class UI Engineering team to bring your Figma frames to life. You set the bar for quality.

*

*Elevate our design culture*. You’ll support and expand the Clerk Design visual language, asset library, brand design system, and design processes.

-----------
Who you are

You’re a Senior(+) level Brand Designer or Visual Designer with experience working in deverloper tools, AI or infra related brands. You love your craft. You push UI Engineers to build experiences they’re unsure if they’re capable of (and you expect them to do the same for you).

*You’re in the Americas.* The Clerk Design team is spread across the globe; Product Design currently spans UTC+1 to UTC+5:30. You live in a location that is ±3 hours within U.S. Mountain Time (MDT, UTC−06:00).

*You have technical fluency.* You have a deep understanding of designing interactive software on the web. You don’t need to author production-ready front-end code, but it’s a big plus if you can.

*Health Coverage* – We care about your well-being. That's why we offer top-tier health insurance to ensure that your health needs are fully met.

title: Motion Designer
description:
PlayOn Sports is the parent company of NFHS Network, GoFan, and MaxPreps. As we continue to unify GoFan, NFHS, and MaxPreps from a brand perspective, our creative team is searching for a Brand Designer to join us in our mission to be the only destination for all things high school sports.

This Motion Designer lives and breathes motion graphics and digital sports culture. You aren't just making mind-blowing motion graphic content; you are building visual systems that help our brand(s) and content series(s) feel branded and authentic. Whether it is high-energy motion graphics for a highlight reel, the next NFHS product video, or the motion bible for the next evolution of the MaxPreps brand, you’ll be the gatekeeper of all things Playon Motion graphic content.

*The outcomes you’ll deliver:*

* Elevate the brand perception of the NFHS Network and MaxPreps by delivering high-quality, consistent motion assets across all social and internal channels.
* Drive new subscriber growth and improves subscriber retention.

*In this role, you can expect to*
---------------------------------

* *Bring Brand to Life with Motion:* Develop motion graphics elements, including lower thirds, title cards, transitions, and animated overlays, to make our video content feel like a major sports broadcast.
* *Build and Maintain Motion Identity Systems:* Help maintain and expand our brand guidelines, ensuring we use motion correctly across all touchpoints.
* *Collaborate Cross-Functionally:* Work closely with the Social Media and Performance Marketing teams, and the B2B and Broadcast teams to develop creative that actually converts.
* *Stay Ahead of the Curve:* Proactively research design trends and emerging social formats to keep our brand relevant to Gen Z and Millennial audiences.

*To thrive in this role, you have*
----------------------------------

* 3-6 years of experience in motion graphics and social content creation (agency or in-house sports-related companies)
* *A Killer Portfolio:* Show us you can do short-form and long-form motion, preferably in sports. Brand development experience is a plus.
* *Compositing & Post-Production:* Seamlessly integrate 3D elements with 2D motion graphics, live-action footage, and typography using Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro.
* *Mogrt & Template Architecture:* Expertise in developing robust After Effects templates, Premiere Pro MOGRTs, and Essential Graphics panels with clean, intuitive custom controls.
* *Advanced Expressions:* Deep command of After Effects expressions (JavaScript) for building responsive text bounding boxes, automated layout scaling, and conditional property rigs.
* *Pipeline Optimization:* Streamlining handoffs between motion design and editing workflows with lightweight, fast-rendering, and foolproof multi-aspect-ratio assets.
* *3D Design & Motion Graphics:* Conceptualize, model, texture, light, and animate complex 3D assets and visual effects using software such as Cinema 4D (with Redshift/Octane) or Blender.
* *Social Fluency:* An innate understanding of what works on TikTok vs. Instagram vs. YouTube—and the ability to design specifically for those nuances.
* *Speed and Precision:* The ability to balance high-quality craftsmanship with the fast-paced nature of an in-house creative team, manage deadlines, and handle multiple projects simultaneously.
* *Passion for High School Sports!* You understand why a buzzer-beater in a small-town gym matters just as much as a pro championship.

*HOW YOU PLAY*

* *Ownership over Participation* – You don’t just "make things move"; you solve problems. You take responsibility for the final visual outcome, even on tight deadlines.
* *Team over Stars* – You accept feedback gracefully and collaborate to ensure the work meets business goals, not just your personal aesthetic.
* *Growth over Comfort* – You’re eager to learn new tools (like AI design workflows or new animation plugins) to keep your skills sharp and our brand evolving.
* *Fairness over Popularity* – You make design decisions based on what’s best for the brand and the audience, even if it means moving away from a "cool" trend that doesn't fit our mission.

PlayOn is where high school sports come to life. Through GoFan, NFHS Network, and MaxPreps, we give every fan a front-row seat to the moments that matter most: the buzzer-beaters, the comeback wins, the senior nights, the rivalries that define a town.

We built our technology for the people who live and breathe high school athletics — the parents who never miss a game, the alumni still cheering from across the country, the communities that show up week after week. From buying tickets to watching a live stream to reliving the highlights, we make it simple to stay close to the sports and the athletes you love most.

Backed by KKR, we build the technology that powers high school athletics from the inside out: Schools trust us to handle ticketing, streaming, fundraising, concessions, merchandise, and more so the people running programs can stay focused on the athletes and fans we all serve together.

We're a growth-stage company on a mission to make high school sports more accessible, more memorable, and more connected than ever before.

When being there means everything, we make sure you never miss a moment.

*Why You'll Love Working at PlayOn*

Product, potential, and people. We’re a leader in the high school event space, constantly evolving our product to meet the needs of administrators. We focus on solving real challenges, learning quickly, and creating impactful solutions.

This is a growth-stage company, meaning your contributions have real impact. You’ll have opportunities to grow your skills, tackle meaningful problems, and make a difference in the lives of schools and the students and fans they serve.

Our culture is built on accountability, collaboration, growth, and fairness. We don’t just show up—we show up for each other. Everyone wears the same jersey, and we play hard, make the extra pass, and cheer one another on. Losses teach us, challenges motivate us, and persistence drives us forward. We value integrity over shortcuts, choosing to do what’s right even when it’s hard. Together, we strive to be better every day—because we know that’s how we win as a team.

*The Benefits We Offer*

Multiple medical insurance plans to choose from
Dental, vision life and disability insurance
Employee Emergency Fund
Company equity (stock options)
Open PTO policy
401K plan with company match
Hybrid/flexible work environment

Note: Must be a full-time employee to participate in the company’s employee health benefit plan. Part-time employees and interns are not eligible to participate

We are looking for an experienced *Lead Graphic Designer* to drive creative quality and AI-powered production workflows in our graphic design team.

**Your main tasks will be:**

* Lead and oversee the graphic design team, ensuring high creative quality across all deliverables
* Review, approve, and provide feedback on all internal and freelance design output before delivery
* Work hands-on on complex or high-priority design tasks
* Continuously improve and rebuild design production workflows using AI tools and automation
* Increase creative production speed and scalability without compromising visual quality
* Drive adoption and effective use of AI-powered design workflows within the team

* Help establish scalable creative processes, templates, and production standards
* Balance creative quality, production efficiency, and business deadlines in a fast-paced environment

**We expect from you:**

* 5+ years in graphic and web design, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead role with responsibility for final creative quality review.
* Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into real production workflows with measurable improvements in speed, scalability, or output quality.
* Experience building or improving scalable production systems, including template systems, modular asset frameworks, AI-assisted pipelines, and automation of repetitive design operations.
* Proven track record of reducing production cycle time or unit cost through AI tools and workflow automation.
* Experience in fast-paced environments such as startups, scale-ups, performance-driven in-house teams, or high-volume agencies.

* Understanding of web and email layout principles, responsive behaviour, and technical constraints required for proper handoff to development teams.
* Strong experience maintaining brand consistency and applying brand guidelines across high-volume production environments.
* Senior-level visual craft in composition, typography, colour, hierarchy, and layout with the ability to review and direct others’ work.
* Strong experience adapting creative concepts across multiple sizes, formats, placements, and platforms.
* Practical experience with AI image generation tools such as Flux, ComfyUI, Stable Diffusion, NanoBanana, Imagen, or equivalent.
* Experience with prompt engineering, reference-based generation, and production-oriented AI workflows.
* Experience maintaining character and style consistency using tools such as LoRA, IP-Adapter, ControlNet, or similar technologies.
* Experience using AI for creative production acceleration including variations, adaptations, upscaling, background generation/editing, and style transfer.
* Experience with workflow automation tools such as Make, n8n, Figma plugins, or similar systems.
* Expert-level Figma skills including auto-layout, components, scalable systems, and production workflows.
* Basic After Effects knowledge is desirable for collaboration with adjacent motion design teams.

**What do we offer:**

title: Freelance Presentation Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Presentation Designer to join the Tendem project (**https://tendem.ai/**) and create high-quality presentations for real-world use cases.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, information design, and storytelling to create clear, engaging, and professionally designed presentations. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, information design, and storytelling.

*What We Do*

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

*About the Role*

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Presentation Designer, you will focus on storytelling and visual hierarchy. We need a specialist who knows how to communicate complex information beautifully, turning raw data and narratives into compelling, highly persuasive slides and one-pagers. You will use tools such as PowerPoint, Keynote, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma to create polished, presentation-ready deliverables.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Design high-stakes pitch decks and professional one-pagers tailored for specific audiences.
* Translate complex data into clear visual storytelling with a strong focus on minimalism and precise information hierarchy.
* Elevate presentations using custom fonts, elegant animations, and perfect visual consistency.
* Enforce a polished, persuasive, and premium corporate-meets-creative style across all deliverables.
* Execute formatting quality standards through meticulous validation of visual alignment, pacing, and brand adherence before final delivery.

*How to get started*

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

*Educational qualifications*

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, presentation design, visual storytelling, or data visualization is desirable.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communications, or related creative fields is a plus.

*Academic and/or Professional Experience*

Candidates must have a strong portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization (not just basic templates). We are looking for specialists who have a deep understanding of pacing, storytelling, and information design. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently to transform complex narratives into premium visuals are essential.

*Technical Skills (Essential)*

* Presentation software: Expertise in PowerPoint, Keynote, etc., for building complex, dynamic, and perfectly animated decks.
* Design tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop) or Figma to create custom graphics and layouts.
* Data & information design: Ability to translate complex data and multi-level hierarchical structures into clear, minimalist visual storytelling.
* Typography & animation: Advanced skills in working with custom fonts and smooth, elegant animations for premium deliverables.

*Additional requirements*

* Hands-on experience creating high-end, premium corporate-meets-creative style layouts.
* Strong attention to detail and absolute commitment to visual perfectness.
* Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot design challenges independently.
* English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)
* *Your CV must include a link to your portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant presentation cases, will not be considered.*

*Project time expectations*

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

*Compensation*

On this project, contributors can earn up to *$50 per hour equivalent* , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.
