description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The SME & Growth Business team at Airwallex is a passionate group of collaborators and business champions dedicated to empowering small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to thrive in the global economy. We combine deep financial expertise with a growth mindset, working closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored solutions that streamline cross-border payments and unlock new revenue streams. As a team, we are driven by a desire to make a positive impact and are constantly innovating to find new ways to support the success of our SME customers.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

We're not just looking for someone who can hit their targets, we're looking for someone who embraces creativity and thinks outside the box. We're looking for someone who is passionate about learning and constantly seeks improvement. We're committed to providing our SDRs with the training and support they need to succeed, because we believe our SDRs are AE’s in training.

This role is remote based in the US.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Researching and identifying potential clients across multiple industries

- Reaching out to prospects through various channels (email, phone, social media) and understanding their needs

- Presenting our innovative solutions and crafting compelling value propositions

- Qualifying opportunities and scheduling appointments for our Account Executives, teaming up with them to land accounts

WHO YOU ARE

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

- You hold a bachelor's degree or have earned your stripes through hands-on experience. What matters most is that you're genuinely excited about tech and what Airwallex is building.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience or eagerness to work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where you're building things from the ground up

- Prior experience with outreach — whether through cold calling, fundraising, real estate, sports, internships, campus programs, etc

- A resourceful, figure-it-out mindset — you don't wait to be told what to do and find a way to get results

- Strategic thinker and able to drive 'partnership' conversations vs. 'sales' conversations

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- You have strong analytical skills and an organized way of thinking and working

- Knowledge of GSuite and sales tech tools like Salesforce, Outreach, Zoominfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

title: Staff Fullstack Data Analyst
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Please note:

Applications will be open until 3rd October 2026 at 10.00 CEST.
We will not review any application before the closing window so, please, don't rush to apply and ensure you use the time to submit a high quality, personalised application.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Growth Intelligence owns the commercial data layer that powers Pleo's GTM engine — acquisition, retention, propensity modelling, and customer health. The team supports RevOps, Customer Experience, Customer Success, and senior commercial leadership with the data and models they need to make faster, smarter decisions.

As a Staff Full Stack Data Analyst, you are the senior technical voice for commercial analytics at Pleo. You set the architectural direction for Growth Intelligence's analytics layer, define what good looks like for the team, and shape how GTM data is structured, governed, and consumed by people and increasingly by AI tools.

You bring technical depth, commercial instinct, and organisational reach in equal measure. You move between architecture reviews and executive presentations, between defining metric contracts and mentoring the analysts who implement them. You don't just answer questions - you identify the right ones, and you make sure the answers compound over time.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You will report to the Senior Manager of the Growth Intelligence team. You will partner closely with senior commercial leadership, Customer Experience, Sales, and Customer Success teams; the onboarding and self-serve product teams; Data Scientists and Analytics Engineers across the broader data organization; and Data Services & Governance on standards and semantic layer ownership. You will be a visible, senior presence across the entire data community at Pleo.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own the architectural direction of the analytics layer for customer acquisition, onboarding, growth, and retention. You'll be making systemic decisions about how models are structured, layered, and governed, not just what gets built next.

- Identify and resolve upstream data quality issues at source, treating quality gaps as governance and contract problems, articulating the business risk they create, and driving the org-level changes needed to fix them durably.

- Define canonical GTM metric definitions in the semantic layer, in partnership with Data Services & Governance while ensuring RevOps, CS, CX, BI tools, and AI tooling are working from the same source of truth, and holding that standard over time.

- Partner with senior commercial leadership to shape the questions worth answering.

- Lead in-depth analysis of customer behaviour, commercial performance, and retention patterns.

- Design and govern the team's approach to experimentation ensuring statistical rigour, scalable methodology, and clear criteria for what constitutes a meaningful result.

- Build analytics explicitly architected for self-serve and AI access: structured, documented, and reliable enough for business teams, conversational analytics tools, and AI features to consume autonomously.

- Mentor and develop analysts on the team through code reviews, design discussions, and deliberate knowledge-sharing, raising the collective standard of analytical craft.

- Contribute to engineering and analytical standards across the broader data community, participating in cross-team reviews and helping define what production-grade analytics looks like at Pleo.

For extra context, you'll also be leveraging technologies including SQL, dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Amplitude, HubSpot, Zuora, or Vitally.

WHAT YOU BRING

- Prior experience operating at Staff or Lead level in data analytics or analytics engineering roles in a fast-paced SaaS organisation.

- Expert knowledge of SQL and dbt: you write clean, tested, well-architected models and can make and defend layering decisions for a team, not just yourself.

- Solid proficiency with Python for data analysis and manipulation.

- Comfort with Git-based workflows and CI/CD practices for analytics code.

- BigQuery fluency, including performance optimization and cost considerations at scale.

- Mastery of a modern BI tool such as Looker or Omni.

- Commercial specialisation: you have worked in a commercial analytics focused role and understand GTM metrics, customer lifecycle economics, and how data connects to revenue outcomes at a strategic level.

- Systems thinking on data quality: you approach quality gaps as governance questions, identify root causes upstream, and drive fixes that last rather than patches that don't.

- Strong understanding of data contracts: schema ownership, SLAs, and the organizational dynamics required to make producer-consumer agreements stick.

- Understanding of how analytics outputs serve AI tools and self-serve analytics as first-class consumers: you design for machine access as well as human access, and you know why metric consistency becomes critical as AI tooling scales.

- Track record of advising senior GTM stakeholders around shaping the question as much as answering it, and communicating risk and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical leaders.

- Experience mentoring analysts and raising team capability

WHY THIS ROLE IS A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You excel at turning large, interconnected and complex problems into well structured, clearly defined and pragmatic solutions. If you are comfortable navigating ambiguity within a fast-paced SaaS organisation, and can generate clarity, you'll find this role very exciting.

- You find hands-on technical work as exciting as stakeholders management, delivery management and governance strategy.

- You have operated as a Technical Lead for Commercial / Growth Analytics within a 500+ people SaaS organisation and understand the recurring topics, challenges and goals businesses of our scale experience.

This role is NOT a good fit for you if:

- You prefer to specialise deeply in one technical area rather than wear multiple hats. This role requires you to move between architecture, analysis, experimentation, stakeholder management, and mentoring.

- You are not comfortable operating at senior leadership level and shaping ambiguous commercial questions into solvable data problems. You'll often need to define what success looks like before you can measure it.

- You need clean problem definitions before you can start. The commercial data environment here is genuinely complex: definitions evolve, ownership is shared, and the right answer sometimes requires organisational negotiation as much as analysis.

- You think of standards and governance as someone else's job. At this level, you are part of how the organisation decides what good looks like.

HOW YOU'LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

- By the end of your first six months, you will have left the analytics layer in structurally better shape, not just fixed individual dashboards, but addressed the underlying quality, governance, and architectural gaps that were causing repeated pain for RevOps, CS, and CX teams.

- You will have driven at least one meaningful governance outcome: canonical GTM metric definitions agreed with Data Services & Governance, embedded in the semantic layer, and actively used so that analysts, BI tools, and AI features are working from the same numbers.

- You will have established yourself as a trusted partner to commercial leadership, not just the person who delivers the analysis, but the person they bring in when they're not sure what question to ask.

- You will have shipped something that changed what was possible: not improved plumbing, but unlocked a capability or decision that couldn't have happened without you.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

2. Core skills test: an async technical exercise designed to assess your coding fundamentals.

3. Hiring Manager interview: a 60-minute experience-based interview to deep dive into your domain knowledge, technical expertise and ability to lead initiatives.

4. Pleo Challenge: a live practical and technical case study designed to assess your domain knowledge, problem solving, and insights generation skills.

5. Final interview: a 30-minute conversation with a senior leader focusing on your behavioural skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

- We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. - Design and govern the team's approach to experimentation ensuring statistical rigour, scalable methodology, and clear criteria for what constitutes a meaningful result.

- Mentor and develop analysts on the team through code reviews, design discussions, and deliberate knowledge-sharing, raising the collective standard of analytical craft.

- Contribute to engineering and analytical standards across the broader data community, participating in cross-team reviews and helping define what production-grade analytics looks like at Pleo.

- Solid proficiency with Python for data analysis and manipulation.

- Comfort with Git-based workflows and CI/CD practices for analytics code.

- BigQuery fluency, including performance optimization and cost considerations at scale.

- Mastery of a modern BI tool such as Looker or Omni.

- Commercial specialisation: you have worked in a commercial analytics focused role and understand GTM metrics, customer lifecycle economics, and how data connects to revenue outcomes at a strategic level.

- Strong understanding of data contracts: schema ownership, SLAs, and the organizational dynamics required to make producer-consumer agreements stick.

title: Product Counsel
description:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

JOB INTRODUCTION:

Provides legal counsel on privacy, product development, and regulatory compliance, enabling Tekion to deliver innovative solutions while maintaining trust and meeting global legal obligations. Acts as a strategic partner to product, engineering, and business teams in building privacy-forward, legally compliant products and services.

KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Advises on product design and implementation to ensure compliance with global privacy laws, including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and emerging regulations.

- Partners with Product and Engineering teams to embed privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default into product development lifecycles.

- Reviews and negotiates privacy-related provisions in commercial agreements, including data processing and cross-border transfer clauses.

- Conducts privacy impact assessments (PIAs), data protection impact assessments (DPIAs), and risk analyses for new features and initiatives.

- Monitors and interprets changes in privacy, AI, and digital regulation to ensure proactive compliance.

- Develops and maintains internal policies, guidance documents, and playbooks related to privacy and product compliance.

- Collaborates with Security, Compliance, and IT teams on incident response, data governance, and user rights management.

- Provides privacy and product counseling across business units, including on marketing, analytics, cookies, and mobile technologies.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- 6–9 years of legal experience, with a focus on product counseling and privacy law

- Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited institution; active bar membership in good standing

- Strong knowledge of global data privacy laws and regulatory frameworks

- Experience advising product and engineering teams within a technology company

- CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPT, or similar certifications preferred

- Excellent communication, collaboration, and project management skills

PERKS & BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation and generous stock options

- 100% employer-paid top-of-the-line medical, dental and vision coverage

- Great benefits including unlimited PTO, parental leave and free snacks and beverages

- The opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley’s most dominant and successful companies

- Be part of an early stage, hyper-growth start-up with the opportunity to grow and prosper

- Work on the latest and coolest technologies – everything is home-grown and built ground-up

- A dynamic work environment with a strong sense of community and collaboration

- The open and transparent culture that encourages innovation, rewards performance and discourages hierarchy

- Exciting opportunities for career growth and development

title: Junior Product Analyst, Quality Assurance and Delivery - Remote
location: Remote, Eden Prairie, Minnesota, United States
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start *Caring. Connecting. Growing together.*

*Position Summary*

The Product Analyst Quality Assurance and Delivery is responsible for ensuring the quality, readiness, and successful execution of product releases and operational delivery activities. This role serves as a central coordinator across business and technology teams, driving disciplined issue management, testing oversight, release readiness, and change control processes.

The position focuses on execution, quality assurance, and delivery governance by ensuring established processes are followed, risks are identified and escalated, and product changes are implemented with minimal disruption. The Product Analyst, Quality Assurance and Delivery, partners closely with stakeholders, development teams, and operational partners to support successful delivery outcomes.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

*Primary Responsibilities:*

* Quality Assurance and Testing Oversight

* Create and manage release testing artifacts, including test cases, test scripts, and execution tracking to support quality assurance objectives
* Monitor and oversee testing activities to ensure completeness, accuracy, and adherence to established quality standards
* Track testing progress, defect resolution, and readiness milestones
* Review testing results and identify potential quality risks requiring remediation prior to release
* Support continuous improvement of testing processes and quality controls

* Issue Management

* Manage issues through the full lifecycle from intake, prioritization, tracking, resolution, validation, and closure
* Maintain issue logs and provide regular reporting on status, trends, and risk areas
* Coordinate with appropriate teams to drive timely issue resolution
* Escalate unresolved issues and risks according to established governance processes

* Release Readiness and Delivery Coordination

* Coordinate release readiness activities across business and technology teams
* Verify completion of required testing, approvals, documentation, and operational readiness tasks
* Support release implementation activities and post-release validation
* Monitor release outcomes and facilitate resolution of post-deployment issues

* Configuration, Delivery & Operational Governance

* Support configuration management, change control, and release governance processes, ensuring changes are documented, approved, traceable, and risks are mitigated
* Coordinate cross-functional delivery activities, manage dependencies, facilitate readiness reviews, and communicate risks, impacts, and status to stakeholders
* Track delivery and quality metrics, support compliance and audit activities, and drive continuous process improvements to enhance delivery effectiveness and consistency

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

*Required Qualifications:*

* 3+ years of experience in quality assurance (QA), user acceptance testing (UAT), and product release approval processes
* 3+ years experience with SLDC tools such as aha, jira, confluence
* Experience coordinating work across multiple teams and stakeholders
* Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), testing methodologies, and release processes
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Proven solid organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Proven solid written and verbal communication skills

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Relevant certifications in Agile practices, software quality assurance, or test automation are preferred
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments
* Experience with testing, defect management, and release management tools
* Knowledge of change management and configuration management practices

*Key Competencies:*

* Attention to Detail
* Quality Focus
* Process Discipline
* Risk Identification and Escalation
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Execution and Follow-Through
* Organization and Prioritization
* Problem Resolution
* Operational Excellence

*What Success Looks Like:*

* Issues are resolved and escalated appropriately with minimal impact to delivery timelines
* Product releases are executed smoothly and meet readiness criteria
* Testing activities are complete, defects are addressed, and quality standards are met
* Change control and configuration processes are consistently followed
* Dependencies and risks are proactively managed and communicated
* Stakeholders have confidence in the quality and stability of delivered solutions

*All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $60,200 - $107,400 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

*Application Deadline:* This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

UnitedHealth Group is a drug - free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.

title: Junior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Semarchy is looking for a Junior Site Reliability Engineer to help keep our SaaS products and infrastructure reliable and scalable. Reporting to the VP of IT Operations and Security, you'll work alongside senior engineers, software developers and support teams to keep our systems running well and available.

This is a great role for someone with a few years of hands-on cloud or DevOps experience who wants to grow their SRE skills in a production SaaS environment.

Responsibilities
----------------

1. Reliability and Availability

* Help build and maintain systems that support high availability, fault tolerance and disaster recovery across our cloud environments.
* Track SLOs and SLIs for critical services, and help improve them over time.

2. Infrastructure and Automation

* Write and maintain automation scripts and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform) to cut down on manual operational work.
* Set up and tune monitoring, alerting and logging so issues get caught early.
* Follow security and change-management practices that support our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments.
* Help remediate vulnerabilities and keep infrastructure patched and hardened.

3. Incident Response and Post-Mortems

* Take part in on-call rotations, with support from senior team members, to respond to incidents and outages.
* Contribute to post-incident reviews and follow through on the actions that prevent repeat issues.
* Write and keep up-to-date documentation and runbooks.

4. Performance and Cost

* Monitor system performance, capacity and cloud spend, and flag areas to optimize.
* Help carry out capacity upgrades and performance improvements.

Requirements
------------

* 2–3 years in an SRE, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure or similar role.
* Hands-on experience with AWS (e.g., EC2, EKS, RDS, S3).
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containers (Docker, Helm a plus).
* Some experience with an IaC tool such as Terraform, CloudFormation or Pulumi.
* Familiarity with monitoring, alerting and logging tools (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).
* Scripting in Python, Go or Bash.
* Good troubleshooting skills and eagerness to learn from incidents.

*Nice to Have*

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD).
* Experience with cloud security monitoring tools (e.g., AWS GuardDuty, Wiz).
* Familiarity with Agile, DevOps and DevSecOps practices.

​​​​

Benefits
--------

We are committed to making Semarchy an even better place to work, and this means creating a high performing environment where everyone can do their Best Work, where they can Grow in their career path, and Be Accountable – to each other and Semarchy.

Semarchy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer (EEO) that celebrates difference and diversity. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: (Junior) Customer Support Specialist
description:
Als Teil unseres neu geschaffenen Customer Operations Teams bist Du die essenzielle Schnittstelle zu unseren Nutzern. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Operations Lead zusammen und betreust Kunden über zwei unserer innovativsten Marken hinweg: *Oskar.de* (digitale Vermögensverwaltung und Altersvorsorge für Familien) und unsere neue Plattform *DMK – Deutsche Mietkaution GmbH* (digitale Kautionslösungen).

Wir befinden uns auf einem starken Wachstumskurs. Deine Mission ist es, unseren Kunden schnellen, kompetenten und empathischen Support zu bieten, während wir im Hintergrund die Prozesse skalieren und automatisieren.

*

*Frontline Hero:* Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden (Mieter, Vermieter, Familien, Anleger) und bearbeitest eingehende Anfragen souverän über unsere Support-Kanäle (E-Mail, Chat, Telefon - Zendesk).

*

*Zwei Welten, eine Mission:* Du begleitest Nutzer bei der Depoteröffnung, erklärst die Funktionsweise von ETF-Sparplänen (Oskar) und hilfst Mietern und Vermietern bei der digitalen Anlage und Verpfändung ihrer Mietkaution (DMK).

*

*End-to-End Ownership:* Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung für Deine Tickets. Du recherchierst, löst Probleme eigenständig und begleitest den Kunden, bis sein Anliegen zu 100 % geklärt ist.

*

*Schnittstelle zu Partnern:* Du kommunizierst reibungslos mit unseren Backend-Partnern (z. B. unserer Depotbank / Baader Bank), um komplexe technische oder transaktionale Kundenanliegen schnell zu eskalieren und zu lösen.

*

*AI-Training & Feedback:* Du arbeitest in einem modernen „AI-First“-Umfeld (z. B. mit Zendesk) und hilfst dabei, wiederkehrende Kundenfragen zu erkennen und daraus gezielt Makros, FAQs und internes Wissen weiterzuentwickeln. So unterstützt Du den Operations Lead dabei, Chatbots, Automatisierungen und Self-Service-Lösungen kontinuierlich zu verbessern und jeden Tag ein Stück smarter zu machen.

*

*Background:* Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, ein Studium oder bereits relevante Berufserfahrung im Kundenservice – idealerweise im FinTech-, Banking- oder Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld. Erfahrung mit KYC (Know Your Customer), AML (Anti-Money Laundering), Identitätsprüfung, Konto-/Depoteröffnung oder regulatorischen Prozessen ist ein klarer Pluspunkt.

*

*Kundenobsession & Empathie:* Du hast eine Engelsgeduld, kannst komplexe Finanzthemen einfach und verständlich erklären und bleibst auch in stressigen Momenten freundlich und lösungsorientiert.

*

*App- & Tech-Affinität:* Du fühlst Dich in digitalen Tools (CRM-Systeme: Zendesk, Ticketing, Slack) zu Hause und hast Spaß daran, in einem extrem schnelllebigen, digitalen Umfeld zu arbeiten.

*

*Zendesk:* Zendesk Affinität im Roll-Out und Einführung des Tools und anschließend Erstellung von Makros, Automations und AI Tools ist ein riesen Plus.

*

*Finanz-Erfahrung:* Du weißt, was ein ETF ist, interessierst Dich für den Kapitalmarkt und hast Lust, Dich tief in die Themen Vermögensaufbau und digitale Immobilien-Lösungen einzuarbeiten.

*

*Eigeninitiative:* Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse, bringst eigene Ideen ein und denkst lösungsorientiert. Du möchtest nicht nur Aufgaben abarbeiten, sondern aktiv mitgestalten, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Team neue Themen voranbringen.

*

*Kommunikationsstärke:* Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Deutsch (auf Muttersprachniveau) für die Betreuung unserer Kunden im DACH-Raum und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse für unsere internen Tools mit.

*

*Deutschlandweites Remote-Work:* Wir bieten Dir volle Flexibilität – arbeite von überall aus Deutschland in einem modernen, digitalen Setup.

*

*Wachstum & Impact:* Du bist von Anfang an beim Launch neuer Produkte (wie DMK) dabei und begleitest unsere Skalierung auf die nächsten Hunderttausenden Nutzer hautnah.

*

*Karriere-Sprungbrett:* Du arbeitest direkt mit erfahrenen Gründern und dem Operations Lead zusammen. Wenn Du Dich beweist, gibt es bei uns steile Entwicklungs- und Aufstiegschancen.

*

*Benefits:* Zuschuss für den öffentlichen Nahverkehr und Vermögenswirksame Leistungen (natürlich mit Oskar VL!).

title: (Junior) Marketplace Advertising Manager:in (m/w/d)
description:
Du liebst Zahlen, bekommst bei einem sinkenden TACoS gute Laune und willst lernen, wie man Werbung auf Marktplätzen richtig skaliert? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Bei der SNOCKS Group verantwortest du die Advertising-Kampagnen auf Amazon, Zalando, OTTO, About You & Co. und sorgst dafür, dass jeder Werbe-Euro maximal viel bewegt. Das Beste: Du musst noch kein Profi sein. Wir bringen dir alles bei, was du brauchst.

Deine Aufgaben
--------------

*

*Kampagnen aufsetzen:* Du legst Werbekampagnen auf unseren Marktplätzen (Amazon, Zalando, OTTO, About You u. a.) an und baust sie strukturiert auf.

*

*Kampagnen steuern:* Du hast deine Kampagnen täglich im Blick, justierst Budgets und reagierst schnell, wenn sich etwas verändert.

*

*Gebote optimieren:* Du optimierst Gebote datenbasiert und findest die perfekte Balance zwischen Reichweite und Profitabilität.

*

*Keywords recherchieren:* Du findest heraus, wonach unsere Kund:innen wirklich suchen, und machst daraus Kampagnen, die performen.

*

*Reportings bauen:* Du erstellst und pflegst Reportings, leitest daraus klare Learnings ab und teilst sie mit dem Team.

*

*Berufserfahrung:* Erste Erfahrung im Performance Marketing, E-Commerce oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich. Erste Berührungspunkte mit Marktplatz-Advertising sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

*

*Studium* : Studium oder Ausbildung im Bereich E-Commerce, Marketing oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du richtig Bock hast, schnell und viel zu lernen.

*

*Analytisches Denken und Zahlenaffinität:* Du hast starke analytische Fähigkeiten und fühlst dich im Umgang mit großen Datenmengen wohl. Excel, Google Sheets und der Einsatz von AI schrecken dich nicht ab, im Gegenteil.

*

*Motivation* : Du hast richtig Bock, eigene Ideen einzubringen und unser Advertising aufs nächste Level zu bringen.

*

*Teamplayer:in* : Du arbeitest gerne im Team, teilst dein Wissen und holst dir Feedback, statt allein vor dich hinzuwerkeln.

*

*Lösungsorientiert* : Wenn eine Kampagne nicht läuft, fragst du nicht einfach nur „Warum?", sondern „Was probieren wir als Nächstes?"

*

*Belastbar* : Auch wenn es mal hektisch wird, behältst du einen kühlen Kopf und die Prioritäten im Blick.

*

*Sprache* : Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

----------------

42.000 - 49.000 € / Jahr

Faktoren, die das Gehalt einer/eines Mitarbeitenden innerhalb dieser Spanne beeinflussen können sind unter anderem bisherige Erfahrung, Skills und Qualifikationen, die mit eingebracht werden und während des Bewerbungsprozesses bewertet werden.
On top profitierst du natürlich von unseren Benefits: Hier kannst du dich unter anderem auf ein eigenes Weiterbildungs- & Reisebudget sowie einen monatlichen steuerfreien Sachbezug freuen.

Diese Spanne spiegelt wider, was wir zum jetzigen Zeitpunkt für diese Stelle als faire Bezahlung einschätzen, kann sich durch unsere stetige Weiterentwicklung aber auch anpassen.

Dich erwartet ein modernes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Du-Kultur von Tag eins. Wir glauben an flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsmethoden. Unsere Teams bestehen aus motivierten Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.

* *Goodies für dich:* Von Jobrad-Leasing über Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket bis hin zu betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (Arbeitgeberzuschuss 50%) - bei uns profitierst du von vielen Extras. On top gibt’s Mitarbeitenden-Rabatt in unserem Snocks Coffee und einen steuerfreien Sachbezug (50€ / Monat), den du flexibel für deinen Wocheneinkauf oder z.B. eine Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club einsetzen kannst.
* *Arbeiten, wie’s zu dir passt:* Du arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist. Remote ist Standard, aber wenn du doch mal Lust hast, ins Büro nach Mannheim, Hamburg oder Berlin zu kommen, gibt’s dafür ein Monatsbudget.
* *Echte Flexibilität:* Ob Workation mit Freund:innen oder Kolleg:innen, morgendliches Yoga oder eine Sport-Session mittags – bei uns kannst du Arbeit und Privatleben easy miteinander verbinden.
* *Onboarding:* Du startest nicht mit leeren Händen, sondern bekommst top Hardware, alles was du zum Arbeiten brauchst, und kannst dir im Welcome Shop coole Produkte von unseren Partnern & Friends aussuchen.
* *Du weißt nicht weiter?* Wir unterstützen dich mit unseren Weiterbildungsangeboten und individuellen Development Budgets! Und wenns nicht ums Berufliche geht, kannst du deinen Zugang zur Gesundheitsplattform nilo.health nutzen, um dir den Support zu holen, den du brauchst.
* *Einfach (dir) mal was Gutes tun:* Ob „Social Day“, um dich sozial zu engagieren, oder „Power Days“, wenn die Periode mal richtig zuschlägt – diese Tage gibt es on top zu deinem Urlaub.
* *Alle zusammen:* Wir sind ein Team aus A-Playern, die nach Wachstum streben, und leben den Team-Spirit bei unseren grandiosen SNOCKS Group Events oder einfach beim nächsten After-Work.
* *Office-Leben:* Bei uns wird’s nie langweilig: ob Tischtennis, Fifa oder Mario Kart nach der Arbeit, gemeinsames Kochen und Lunch, frisches Obst, Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine oder die Müsli-Bar. Und das Beste: Dein Haustier darf natürlich auch mit ins Office!
* *Wir kleiden dich ein:* Noch keine Produkte der SNOCKS Group in deinem Kleiderschrank? Das ändern wir! Du erhältst jedes Jahr einen 360€ Gutschein von uns sowie weitere tolle Rabatte und Angebote wie bspw. Corporate Benefits.

title: Junior Project Manager
description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

*As part of the Fever Originals team, you will use data and insights to create one-of-a-kind events and experiences that allow people to have unforgettable moments.*

*Who you'll work with*

You will join one of our offices around the world to work in teams and directly interact with our partners, providers, and venues.

In this role you will help Fever grow its pipeline of original events. To do so, you will interact with all departments of Fever, from Marketing to Operations.

The team you’re about to join consists of people that are motivated, young, and fun. On top of having multicultural backgrounds, people in the team are all top profiles: McKinsey, Amazon, Google, KKR, Cirque du Soleil, PSG, and Roland Garros.

Employees are expected to be in the office Monday to Thursday with possibility to work from home on Fridays.

*What you'll do

As a Project Manager, you will work with your team lead to develop, launch and manage your events, from A to Z. Together with the other departments, you will define the way to scale this event to all our other markets.
You will be responsible for owning the strategic planning, execution, and reporting for our key strategic scalable experiences.
*

When you join Fever, you are joining a company that will invest in your professional development. You will receive training and coaching on how to:

* *Provide a detailed analysis of business opportunities and inefficiencies; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high-quality experiences are delivered.*
* Work with the Fever marketing team to make sure events make an impact: both in terms of ticket sales and coverage
* Manage, report on, and grow revenue from scalable events
* Grow the scalable experiences against team targets
* Help to scale the events to our other cities through developing and sharing best practices (opportunity for travel)
* Foster and grow the Fever Partner Network: including venues and event organizers
* Communicate product needs (Fever usability) and process needs to HQ, work with product/engineering to deliver on themRepresent Fever at local events and with local PR

*Preferred Qualifications
*

* 1+ years in a project management role or consulting background. This is not a position for an events background.
* Fluent English.
* Huge appetite for learning and the ability to pick up new skills quickly. You will also have strong analytical, relationship management, and organizational skills.
* You'll be solution-focused, identifying problem areas and then creating plans to find resolutions.
* You'll have strong communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships.
* Highly organized and efficient
* Curious and keen to push boundaries and try new concepts
* Great networking skills and the ability to make smart partnerships happen
* Able to communicate with events partners, brands, agencies, and talent on efforts
* Ability to think strategically when faced with an events partnership brief or with our proprietary data on what events work
* Able to handle large amounts of work and parallel work-streams
* Collaborative and willing to get hands dirty and work on all required events tasks
* Knowledge of promotional tools such as Facebook and Instagram is a plus
* Strong academic background is a plus

You can expect to join a group of diverse, hardworking team players, where a cultural fit is someone willing to stay humble and learn and can work nimbly. We welcome applications with unusual backgrounds with the expectation that the applicant will have acquired hard or soft skills and maturity throughout their experiences.

*What you'll get*

* Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
* Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance (total compensation of around 70-75k)
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Gympass Memberships
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
* Work in a location in the heart of Manhattan
* Responsibility from day one with strong opportunities for professional growth
* Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!

*Our hiring process*

* A 30 min video call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers, to better understand your career plan, assess cultural fit and answer any questions you may have
* A 60 min online test with three topics: logic, analytics and written understanding
* A 30 min interview with your future manager
* A 45 min video call with your future manager, including questions about your profile and a business case presentation (to be prepared in advance)

On average our process lasts 20 working days and offers usually follow within a week.

title: Junior Business Analyst
description:

Responsibilities
----------------

SafeGuard Services (SGS), a subsidiary of Peraton, performs data analysis, investigation, and medical review to detect, prevent, deter, reduce, and make referrals to recover fraud, waste, and abuse. We are looking for a *Junior Business Analyst.*

*What You’ll do:*

The position requires the individual to conduct research on internal case workload data and other sources of information; to create and revise reports that are responsive to customer requirements and ad hoc requests for information. The position is also responsible for supporting management by providing information, insight and recommendations for operational and systems changes needed to maximize efficiency and effectiveness of operations. The position is also needed to support contract teams and provide outreach and training as directed by management.

*The most competitive candidates will have:*

* Ability to analyze data to identify and compare norms, trends and patterns.
* Ability to present issues of concern, and citing regulatory violations to support findings
* Ability to communicate effectively, internally and externally
* Ability to prioritize work to effectively adhere to strict timeliness requirements.
* Ability to handle confidential material.
* Ability to conduct self-directed research to uncover problems in workload reporting, data input, information input or operational efficiencies.
* Ability to attend meetings, training and conferences, overnight travel required in some instances.
* Ability to support other in-office teams, as location permits.
* Ability to work independently and as a member of a team to deliver high-quality work.
* Telework available from Eastern Time Zone.

--------------
Qualifications
--------------

*Basic Qualifications:*

* 2 years with BS/BA; 0 years with MS/MA; 6 years with a HS Diploma.
* Strong computer skills including Microsoft Access, Excel, reporting extracts, and Web Intelligence or equivalent.
* Strong proven analytical ability and basic knowledge of report editing and analysis
* Proven Ability to work with a variety of systems, sources of data and analytic tools
* Excellent organizational and communication skills
* US. citizenship required

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Healthcare experience
* Medicaid/Medicare experience

----------------
Peraton Overview
----------------

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. title: Junior Softwareentwickler / Applikationsmanager (m/w/d) – Medizinische IT
description:
# Junior Softwareentwickler / Applikationsmanager (m/w/d) – Medizinische IT

**Du kennst Medizin – und möchtest beruflich stärker in Richtung IT?**

Vielleicht hast du als **MFA, ZFA, MTA/MTL, im Labor, in einer Arztpraxis oder einem anderen medizinischen Bereich** gearbeitet und anschließend eine Umschulung oder Weiterbildung in der IT absolviert.

Oder du bist ein **IT-affiner Quereinsteiger aus dem medizinischen Umfeld**, beschäftigst dich bereits intensiv mit Software, Anwendungen oder Programmierung und möchtest jetzt den nächsten Schritt gehen.

Für ein etabliertes Unternehmen aus dem **medizinischen Laborumfeld in Bremen** suchen wir einen

**Junior Softwareentwickler / Applikationsmanager (m/w/d)**

Dabei suchen wir ausdrücklich **keinen fertigen Senior-Entwickler**. Viel interessanter ist für uns die Kombination aus **medizinischem Verständnis, technischem Interesse und Lust darauf, sich in der IT weiterzuentwickeln.**

## Deine Aufgaben

In dieser Position bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen **Medizin, Labor und IT**.

Du lernst die eingesetzten Anwendungen und Prozesse kennen und entwickelst dich – abhängig von deinen Stärken und Interessen – sowohl im **Applikationsmanagement als auch in der Softwareentwicklung** weiter.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:

* Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Anwendungen
* Unterstützung der Anwender bei technischen und fachlichen Fragestellungen
* Analyse von Fehlern und Unterstützung bei deren Behebung
* Aufnahme von Anforderungen aus dem medizinischen und labortechnischen Umfeld
* Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in technische Lösungen
* Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung und Anpassung von Software
* Testing und Dokumentation neuer Funktionen und Änderungen
* Unterstützung bei der Digitalisierung bestehender Prozesse
* Zusammenarbeit mit IT, Labor und weiteren Fachbereichen
* Schrittweise Übernahme eigener Themen und Projekte

## Warum dein medizinischer Hintergrund interessant ist

Eine Software kann technisch funktionieren und trotzdem am Arbeitsalltag der Anwender vorbeigehen.

Genau hier ist dein bisheriger beruflicher Hintergrund ein echter Vorteil.

Wenn du selbst in einer **Praxis, einem Labor, Krankenhaus oder vergleichbaren medizinischen Umfeld** gearbeitet hast, kennst du viele Abläufe, Anforderungen und Herausforderungen bereits aus erster Hand.

Dieses Wissen möchten wir mit IT verbinden.

## Besonders interessant sind für uns

Zum Beispiel ehemalige oder aktuelle:

* Medizinische Fachangestellte (MFA)
* Zahnmedizinische Fachangestellte (ZFA)
* Medizinische Technologen für Laboratoriumsanalytik (MTL)
* Medizinisch-technische Assistenten (MTA)
* Biologisch-technische Assistenten (BTA)
* Mitarbeiter aus Labor und Diagnostik
* Mitarbeiter aus Arztpraxen oder Krankenhäusern
* vergleichbare medizinische oder naturwissenschaftliche Fachkräfte

Besonders spannend ist dein Profil, wenn du anschließend beispielsweise eine **Ausbildung oder Umschulung zum Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung** absolviert hast.

Aber auch andere Wege in die IT sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

## Was du technisch mitbringen solltest

Du musst noch nicht alles können. Erste Kenntnisse in der **Softwareentwicklung, Anwendungsbetreuung oder allgemeinen IT** solltest du allerdings bereits mitbringen.

Diese können aus einer Ausbildung, Umschulung, Weiterbildung, deiner bisherigen Tätigkeit oder eigenen Projekten stammen.

Viel wichtiger ist, dass du:

* technische Zusammenhänge schnell verstehst
* Spaß daran hast, Probleme zu analysieren und Lösungen zu finden
* dich gerne in neue Anwendungen und Technologien einarbeitest
* sowohl mit Anwendern als auch mit Entwicklern kommunizieren kannst
* Lust darauf hast, Verantwortung für Anwendungen und Prozesse zu übernehmen

## Medizin oder IT? Warum nicht beides?

Bei dieser Position musst du deinen bisherigen beruflichen Weg nicht hinter dir lassen.

Im Gegenteil: **Deine Erfahrung aus dem medizinischen Umfeld kann genau das sein, was dich von klassischen Junior-Entwicklern unterscheidet.**

Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, dein vorhandenes Fachwissen mit IT und Softwareentwicklung zu verbinden und dich langfristig im Bereich **Softwareentwicklung und Applikationsmanagement** weiterzuentwickeln.

Auch wenn dein Lebenslauf nicht nach dem klassischen Weg in die Softwareentwicklung aussieht, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

**Manchmal ist der beste Entwickler für medizinische Software eben jemand, der vorher selbst auf der anderen Seite des Bildschirms gesessen hat.**

## Interesse geweckt?

Dann schick deine aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen **in einer PDF-Datei** an **Christian Peters** unter [**christian.peters@griepenstroh.com**](https://mailto:christian.peters@griepenstroh.com).

Bitte gib dabei auch deinen **möglichen Starttermin und deine Gehaltsvorstellung** an.

**Die Stelle passt doch nicht ganz zu dir?**

Dann vernetze dich gerne über unsere **Connect-Plattform**:

[**https://jobs.griepenstroh.com/connect**](https://jobs.griepenstroh.com/connect)

So bleibst du über unsere aktuellen Vakanzen auf dem Laufenden und wir können dich kontaktieren, sobald eine Position dabei ist, die wirklich zu dir passt.

title: Lead UX/UI Designer
description:
Lead UX/UI Designer

Heptic Arena — Full-Time — Remote (Europe)

About Prism Studio

Prism Studio is a Malta-based game development studio making bold, player-first games. We're a small, cross-disciplinary team working remotely across Europe, with a culture built on ownership, trust and self-management. Our first title, Heptic Arena, is a third-person PvPvE arena shooter set in an intergalactic game show. We're now building it with our community through closed playtests on the road to Early Access.

About the Role

We're looking for a Lead UX/UI Designer to own the user interface and player experience of Heptic Arena across PC and console. You'll report to the Creative Director and set the UI vision, standards and direction for the game. You'll also stay hands-on: designing screens, building assets and working in engine day to day.

This is a player/coach role. There's no line management, but you'll mentor junior designers and freelancers, review their work and raise the quality bar across the team. You'll be the go-to person for UI and UX decisions, working closely with art, design, engineering and production.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, Manage, Define and maintain Heptic Arena's Players UX,UI visual language and design system (components, typography, iconography, colour, motion,accessibility guidelines.

Lead UI/UX across the full player journey: front end, HUD, menus, progression, store, social features and onboarding.

Propose, Concept, Design, prototype and deliver: wireframes, user flows, screen maps, mockups and final UI assets, from early concept through to polish.

Work closely with Game Design and Engineering on implementation in Unreal Engine, and resolve UX trade-offs and technical constraints early.

Use playtest feedback, analytics and A/B testing to find UX problems and iterate on solutions.

Mentor junior designers and freelancers through design reviews, feedback and clear briefs.

Estimate, plan and prioritise UX/UI work with Production, Execute and control development, create and distribute UX/UI tasks in Jira.

Own UX/UI documentation in Confluence and keep it the single source of truth for the team.

Set up review and QA processes so that the implemented UI meets our quality, consistency and accessibility standards.

Represent UI/UX in leadership and cross-discipline discussions, and advocate for the player's experience.

About You

* 5+ years of experience in game UI/UX design, including at least one shipped PC or console title.
* A strong portfolio of PC/console game UI work (not mobile), showing both systems-level thinking and polished visual execution.
* Deep knowledge of UI design principles, information hierarchy and usability, especially for real-time, action-heavy games.
* Hands-on experience implementing UI in Unreal Engine (UMG/Common UI preferred)
* Expert use of design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Miro, Axure, Adobe XD or similar.
* Experience building and maintaining a UI design system or style guide.
* Proven ability to guide and mentor other designers and give clear, constructive feedback.
* Strong communication and documentation skills, and confidence presenting and defending design decisions to stakeholders.
* Comfortable with Jira,, Confluence and Google Workspace
* Self-driven and organized, able to thrive in a remote, self-managing team.
* Based in or near the Central European time zone (CET ± 2 hours).

Nice to have

* Experience with UI animation and motion design, such as After Effects, Rive or in-engine animation.
* Experience with multiplayer, live-service or competitive shooter UI, including HUDs, scoreboards, matchmaking, stores and battle passes.
* Knowledge of console platform UI guidelines.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards for games.
* Experience running or analysing usability tests.

Life at Prism Studio

We work as one unit with one common goal. Our purpose is to build a cross-disciplined team where everyone is self-managing, wherever they are in the world. We collaborate in an open, friendly way, as a global team built on talent and communication.

title: Visual Information & Graphic Designer

The contractor shall provide professional visual information and graphical design services to support OCCA and to other offices with high demands for visualization, marketing, briefing, and presentations. Incorporate feedback and make adjustments to meet the requirements as outlined by the Agency branding guide, OCCA leadership and respective customers. Deliverables include but are not limited to visual concepts for wide range of uses, infographics, placemats, briefings, slick sheets, posters, trifolds, logos, templates, web banners, animations for web page and social media signage.

This support will include the following:

* Planning, designing, and managing the production of visual communication and graphic material to convey specific messages or concepts and clarify complex information for consumption by a wide array of internal/external stakeholders.
* Using a customer focused, design thinking methodology that is repeatable across the DCSA and each mission-specific portfolio.

* Developing graphics as necessary to support webpage content and support development of page design to make navigation easier and more conducive to operational support capabilities.

SkySpecs is making this possible by automating wind farm operations and maintenance with advanced robotics paired with our custom-built asset performance management software, Horizon. SkySpecs launched the world’s first completely autonomous blade inspection product in 2016 with a custom-designed drone system. Since then, SkySpecs has inspected over 90% of US wind turbines and expanded globally, becoming the world leader in understanding turbine blade health. Identifying issues with turbine blades is only the first step. In 2019, SkySpecs launched Horizon, a platform for SkySpecs to offer a multi-layered solution for customers that includes: data collection, wind turbine blade engineering expertise, and a place for all stakeholders to collaborate to manage and analyze massive amounts of data, spot trends, and create plans for high-cost repair campaigns. In 2021, SkySpecs acquired two companies specializing in wind turbine drivetrain monitoring and financial management, further expanding our asset management portfolio. Ultimately, this will help reduce the cost and risk of operations for the industry.
*
What will you be getting into?*

The HSEQ Assurance Analyst supports SkySpecs’ global HSEQ function through data-driven operational assurance and compliance activities. The role reviews inspection imagery and other operational data to identify potential safety concerns and compliance trends, while supporting customer compliance platforms, HSEQ systems, and routine compliance activities.

*As HSEQ Assurance Analyst, you will:*

*Operational Assurance & Analysis:*

* Conduct systematic reviews of inspection imagery to assess observable compliance with defined HSEQ requirements.
* Review other operational monitoring data introduced through the HSEQ assurance program.
* Record and analyse assurance findings to identify recurring trends, behaviours and areas of increased operational risk.
* Maintain accurate assurance records, trackers, metrics and dashboards.
* Escalate significant findings, potential non-compliance and emerging trends to the appropriate HSEQ representative for further review.

*HSEQ Compliance & Support*

* Maintain customer compliance platforms, including ISNetworld, Veriforce, ComplyWorks, Achilles and other customer-specific systems.
* Coordinate the collection and maintenance of HSEQ documentation, records, certifications and supporting evidence.
* Support routine HSEQ reporting, audit preparation, action tracking and management-system activities.
* Maintain accurate HSEQ records and assist with general compliance and administrative activities.
* Work collaboratively with all stakeholders to support continuous improvement

*Requirements of the job:*

* Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately review high volumes of imagery and operational data.
* Strong analytical and organisational skills with the ability to identify patterns and trends.
* Good written and verbal English communication skills.
* Confident using spreadsheets, databases, dashboards and online systems.
* Ability to consistently apply defined criteria and accurately record findings.
* Ability to work independently and effectively within a fully remote environment with flexible hours to accommodate work schedules across all North American and European time zones.

*Desirable Experience:*

* Previous HSEQ, compliance, quality or assurance experience.
* Experience with customer compliance platforms such as ISNetworld, Veriforce, ComplyWorks & Achilles.
* Experience reviewing imagery, telematics or operational data.
* Experience within renewable energy or another safety-critical industry.
* Awareness of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001

*Perks of the Job:*

* Time Off: Generous leave policy—among the best in the industry.
* Global Team: Work with teammates across 5 countries and diverse backgrounds.
* Impact: Help build the backbone of clean energy digital infrastructure.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is building institutional partnerships with the GSI (Global System Integrators), Big-Four consulting firms, and global advisory firms that shape finance transformation, ERP modernization, and technology decisions for the CFOs and finance leaders we serve. These organizations are often in the room when enterprise clients are redesigning their finance stack, selecting technology, or moving from strategy into implementation.

This portfolio spans the largest global professional services firms (e.g., Deloitte) and GSIs (e.g., Infosys). They are complex organizations with distinct service lines (e.g., ERP, Tech Modernization, Finance Transformation) each with its own leadership, incentives, and economics, so earning credibility inside one is as much about navigating the firm as it is about the relationship.

This role will own Ramp's relationship with that network of firms, building firm-specific go-to-market motions that can include executive engagement, account mapping, co-sell, implementation alignment, thought leadership, and events. Ramp's relationships here are early and largely informal today, so this person will be responsible for the relationship, the partnership thesis, and the operating motion that makes a firm a meaningful Ramp partner over time.

What You'll Do

- Own Ramp's relationships with a portfolio of the largest global professional services, GSIs, and consulting firms, serving as the primary relationship owner

- Map each firm and build credibility with the partners, practice leaders, alliance teams and client-service teams who matter most

- Turn executive introductions into structured partnerships, developing the partnership thesis, executive sponsor plan, target practices and client wedge for each firm

- Negotiate and close the first formal agreements between Ramp and these firms

- Build market-facing proof points with Ramp's leadership, marketing and product teams, including executive events, thought leadership and shared client stories

- Coordinate execution across Ramp, bringing the right Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, Product, AI Solutions and executive sponsors into each firm relationship

- Establish and maintain the operating cadence: relationship maps, firm plans, account maps and next steps

What You Need

- 6+ years of experience in consulting, alliances, partnerships or an adjacent role. Time inside a top-tier professional services or global consulting firm (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, BCG, Deloitte) is strongly preferred.

- Exceptional executive presence. You can hold a room with senior leaders, earn trust quickly, and be trusted to represent Ramp in meetings without support

- Fluency in how large, matrixed professional services firms actually work, including how practices are incentivized and how a technology partner earns internal endorsement

- Proven ability to run many workstreams and complex stakeholder management

- A builder's instinct. You are energized by an empty page, comfortable without a playbook, and bring structure to ambiguity

- Excellent written and verbal communication, and the judgment to calibrate between an executive conversation and a working session

title: Employment Counsel, Americas
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

About the team

Legal & Licensing at Airwallex sits at the heart of the decisions that shape how Airwallex grows. This team backs the visionary builders transforming Airwallex into a generational financial company, sharing the journey of product development and sales alongside our business partners. You’ll help shape a global licensing footprint most fintechs wish they had, while making sure our brand and data architecture stay best-in-class for customers entering the agentic economy and ready for its regulatory demands. The hard part is helping the business move fast on product, revenue, and new-market expansion without compromising the regulatory discipline that protects the moat.

What you’ll do

You'll be the Employment Counsel for Airwallex in the Americas, and a hands-on partner to our People & Talent team on the issues that carry the most risk: terminations, workplace investigations, employee relations, and the policies that govern how 3,000+ people across 20+ markets work. You'll own US employment law directly and coordinate advice across other jurisdictions with our external counsel panel. Because Airwallex operates through licensed entities in most of its markets, you'll also work on questions that a generalist employment lawyer rarely sees:  contractor and EOR classification across borders, remote work and mobility exposure, and conduct and remuneration matters in regulated entities. This role suits someone who wants to build the playbooks and templates a scaling employment function runs on, not just answer tickets.

This role is based in San Francisco, New York, or Seattle.

Responsibilities:

- Advise the People & Talent team and business leaders on the full employee lifecycle, including hiring, contracts and variations, performance management, accommodations, leaves, wage and hour compliance, and terminations.

- Lead workplace investigations and sensitive employee matters end-to-end, working with the cross-functional People and Legal working group.

- Draft, refresh, and own employment-related policies and templates.

- Manage employment disputes, agency charges, and litigation, instructing and controlling external counsel and associated legal spend.

- Coordinate multi-jurisdiction employment advice across APAC, EMEA and the Americas, including contractor and employer-of-record arrangements, cross-border remote work and mobility risk.

- Advise on compensation, benefits, and equity matters in a private company context.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

- J.D. degree (or foreign equivalent) and active membership in at least one US state bar (California, Washington, or New York preferred)

- 5+ years of employment law experience at a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department, with demonstrated employment counseling experience beyond litigation alone

- Experience advising on and coordinating employment law advice across multiple jurisdictions

- Experience leading workplace investigations and managing employment disputes, agency charges, or tribunal matters

- The ability to translate complex legal and risk issues into clear, succinct, and actionable guidance for non-legal audiences

- High motivation and the ability to operate independently and pivot quickly within a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business

- Experience with contractor classification, employer-of-record populations, or cross-border remote work and permanent establishment risk

- A learner's mentality: you are consistently looking to take on new and diverse challenges and expand your knowledge and practice beyond your current areas of expertise

- Comfort operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
