title: Director, Finance Business Partnering
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Director of Finance Business Partnering to join us at Pleo. In this role, you'll lead our entire Finance Business Partnering (FBP) team, driving strategic decisions, financial performance, and resource allocation across our entire business - connecting Go-To-Market (GTM), Product & Offering, and Enablement into one coherent financial lens. As we scale, you will establish a new standard for strategic finance, balancing rigorous challenges with valued operational support to the business.
If you're excited about bringing commercial and strategic insight to high-growth teams, developing a talented finance team, and leveraging modern data and AI workflows to transform decision-making, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our CFO and work closely with C-suite and senior leaders across the entire organization (including the Chief Revenue Officer, Chief Product & Technology Officer and Chief People Officer and their respective leadership teams). You will directly lead and develop our team of Finance Business Partners, fostering a culture of ownership and strategic impact.
You’ll also operate as a close partner to the Director of Finance Platform to ensure Business Finance and Finance Platform operate with unified standards, zero friction, and one coherent voice.

What you’ll be doing

As Director of Finance Business Partnering, you will:

- Drive Strategic Finance Partnering Across All Functions: Serve as a trusted strategic peer to C-level executives, translating operational and commercial realities into robust financial plans.

- Bridge Product, Monetization & GTM: Connect product roadmap investments and feature choices directly to monetization, commercial deal structures, and go-to-market execution.

- Lead Financial Planning & Performance Support: Drive annual budgeting, scenario modeling, resource allocation, and forecasting cycles across all business areas, shifting conversations from backward-looking reporting to forward-looking, decision-oriented action.

- Lead & Evolve the FBP Team: Coach, mentor, and elevate a well-performing team of Finance Business Partners, setting clear capability standards, and fostering a curious, data- and impact-driven culture.

- Leverage Data & Modern Workflows: Practical application of modern BI, analytics, and available AI tools to enhance and streamline commercial modeling, reduce manual work, and deliver faster insights.

To put things into context, we are actively focusing on rapid and sustainable topline growth, efficiency, and connecting product investment directly to bottom-line growth. You can expect to work with modern commercial data, BI, and AI-driven workflows alongside standard ERP, CRM, and FP&A tools.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- Broad Finance Business Partnering Leadership: Senior experience leading finance business partnering across multiple major functions (GTM, Product, and/or central enablement functions) within a SaaS or scale-up environment.

- Proven Finance Business Partner excellence: Proven track record designing and implementing best-in-class FBP frameworks across SaaS/scale-up environments. You know how to best define end-to-end partnerships across GTM, Product, and Enablement, establishing clear financial insights, decision-making, and accountability while leveraging modern data and AI workflows to elevate team output.

- SaaS & Subscription Economics Fluency: Deep fluency in recurring revenue drivers, growth/efficiency trade-offs, and core SaaS metrics (ARR, CAC/LTV, retention, payback, sales capacity, pipeline, and product margin economics).

- C-Suite Influence & Communication: Proven ability to partner with and challenge executive leadership, framing choices clearly and turning complex data into structured, actionable guidance.

- People Leadership & Capability Building: A track record of assessing, coaching, and developing an existing finance team, helping individuals elevate their strategic impact through organizational change.

- Strategic Planning & Commercial Judgment: High proficiency in budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, and business case development in fast-paced, ambiguous scale-up environments.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You want to lead end-to-end finance business partnering with senior business leaders, directly shaping how product, commercial, and operational strategy translate into resource allocation and growth.

- You enjoy building and mentoring teams, establishing high standards, and helping finance professionals grow into strategic business partners.

- You thrive in fast-paced scale-up environments, turning ambiguity into structured, data-led choices without needing rigid enterprise playbooks.

How do you drive impact:

In your first 6-12 months at Pleo, you will step in to stabilize and elevate our entire Finance Business Partnering function. You’ll start building trust across C-level leadership, and establishing a seamless interface with Finance Platform. As you’ll settle, you’ll connect our product roadmap decisions to commercial execution, will drive higher standards for executive decision-making and lastly, you’ll build a high-performing FBP team equipped for Pleo’s next stage of international scale.

The location

Please note: We can hire on hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert (Denmark, United Kingdom, Spain and Portugal) but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- We offer 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards)

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

- Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

- Hiring Manager: A 45-minute chat with our CFO about the role and needs.

- Pleo Peer Interviews: Two separated 60-minute Peer chats with our Senior stakeholders with some real life case scenarios.

- Final Stage: A 30-minute chat with our CRO and our CPO.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a senior Finance leader, we received a high volume of applications, but only a selective group were invited to an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

- CV writing and content: We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Snowflake Postgres team is building a managed Postgres experience inside Snowflake. This role is focused on the control plane, where you have the opportunity to work on both on distributed systems at scale and also to work on research grade optimizations at various layers of the software stack including but not limited to provisioning, managing, securing, and operating Postgres in Snowflake. You will work on core backend systems that sit at the intersection of distributed systems, database infrastructure, security, and operational excellence.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Design and build backend services that power provisioning, lifecycle management, and configuration of Snowflake Postgres instances.

- Develop features in the access and user model, including authorization, secure administration flows, and customer-facing management capabilities.

- Improve the reliability, observability, and operability of asynchronous workflows and background systems that keep the service healthy.

- Partner with product, security, and adjacent engineering teams to deliver simple customer experiences on top of complex infrastructure.

- Investigate production issues, participate in on-call, and drive fixes that improve resilience and reduce operational burden.

- Contribute to technical design, code review, and mentoring while helping raise the engineering bar across the team.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

- 2+ years of experience building production software in backend, infrastructure, or distributed systems environments.

- Experience designing and operating reliable services in production, including debugging, monitoring, and incident response.

NICE TO HAVE:

- Experience with identity, authorization, RBAC, or other security-sensitive systems.

- Experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

- Experience with workflow orchestration, control plane systems, or highly asynchronous service architectures.

WHY JOIN THIS TEAM?

- Work on a strategic product area that expands Snowflake into transactional and operational database workloads

- Build systems that directly shape how customers create, manage, and secure Postgres inside Snowflake

- Tackle a mix of product engineering, infrastructure, reliability, and security problems.

- Join a collaborative team with meaningful ownership, strong technical challenges, and room to grow

title: Customer Value Manager - Ontario
description:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

JOB INTRODUCTION:

The Customer Value Manager is the primary owner of the customer relationship and long-term success of assigned dealership accounts within Tekion’s Customer Value Services organization. This is not a support role with a retention overlay. It is a strategic value leadership role responsible for understanding each dealer’s business goals, connecting those goals to measurable outcomes within the Tekion platform, and ensuring value is visible, documented, and expanding over time. The Customer Value Manager serves as the strategic quarterback for every account in the portfolio. This role leads the ongoing customer relationship across operational and executive stakeholders, owns the Customer Value Plan (CVP) for each account, drives outcome-focused Value Reviews, maintains visibility into portfolio health and risk, and helps ensure renewals and expansion opportunities are supported by a clear, data-backed value narrative. The Customer Value Manager partners closely with Customer Value Architects, who provide product expertise and maturity diagnostics, and with Virtual Value Managers, who help support account activity between strategic touchpoints. Together, these roles help close the gap between what a dealer purchased and the value they are actually realizing.

KEY ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Own the customer relationship across assigned dealership accounts, building and maintaining trusted relationships with operational contacts, general managers, dealer principals, and other key stakeholders

- Develop, maintain, and execute a Customer Value Plan for every account in the portfolio, ensuring plans remain current, actionable, and aligned to dealer priorities and business outcomes

- Lead regular Value Reviews that replace traditional QBRs with structured, outcome-focused conversations grounded in dealer performance, platform adoption, operational progress, and realized value

- Partner with Customer Value Architects (CVAs) to interpret Dealer Maturity Model (DMM) positioning, product adoption data, workflow maturity, and module utilization in order to shape account strategy and identify value gaps

- Translate platform usage, operational performance, and maturity progress into a compelling value narrative that helps customers understand where they are realizing value and where additional opportunity exists

- Maintain visibility into portfolio health through active management of account health indicators, maturity assessments, customer risks, renewal status, and expansion potential

- Forecast renewal readiness across the portfolio, ensuring each renewal is anticipated, supported by documented evidence of realized value, and aligned with Sales-led execution

- Identify and surface expansion opportunities in partnership with Sales by understanding customer needs, value realization progress, operational gaps, and growth potential across accounts

- Represent the voice of the customer internally by escalating risks, highlighting friction points, advocating for improvements, and informing internal priorities that improve customer outcomes

- Partner with Virtual Value Managers (VVMs) to ensure account documentation, operational support activity, weekly account digests, and proactive dealer touchpoints help reinforce broader customer strategy

- Ensure Customer Value Plan documentation, account records, and customer interaction history remain current, accurate, and useful for internal alignment and execution

- Monitor customer progress against agreed goals and maturity milestones, helping dealers move forward in a structured way across the Tekion Dealer Maturity Model

- Coordinate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, Enablement, Implementations, and other internal teams as needed to remove blockers, align account strategy, and improve customer outcomes

- Operate effectively in a high-growth environment where portfolio size, segment design, account structures, and team configurations may evolve over time

- Travel to dealership sites and customer engagement events as needed to strengthen relationships, support value conversations, and improve understanding of dealer operations

- Support broader Customer Value Services goals by improving retention readiness, expansion visibility, customer trust, and measurable value realization across the portfolio

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

title: Sr Professional Services Strategy & Ops Program Manager
Sales to UX Design Career Changer
description:
About the Program:Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.
Apprenticeship Requirements:This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work
Apprenticeship Program Learnings:Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.
How to Apply:The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

title: Junior Client Success Manager
description:
* *You own the relationship.* The doctor emails you, Slacks you and gets on calls with you.
* *You turn requests into briefs.* Every client ask becomes a ClickUp task the team can act on without a follow-up question, with the why attached. "Build a new landing page" is not a brief. "The heatmap shows people stop scrolling before the CTA, so the CTA moves above the fold" is.
* *You narrate the numbers.* In two minutes, in plain English: what is working, what is not, and what is next.
* *You catch problems first.* The client never discovers an issue we have not already told them about.
* *You spot the next win.* Not a pitch. Arithmetic out loud with the client's own numbers until the next step is obvious.

You do not run the ads or build the funnels. You brief them and QA them. And if all you do on a call is read a report, you are not doing the job.

*What a good month looks like
*

* Every client in your book got a response within one business hour of reaching out and a real answer or a timeline within a day.
* Every client request became a ClickUp task with enough context that nobody had to come back to you to ask what it meant.
* You ran the client calls yourself. The CEO was not on them.
* Your pod's daily client updates went out accurate, because you read them before they shipped and corrected the one that was wrong.
* No client surprised anyone with a problem, and no client cancelled without the risk being visible weeks earlier.
* You brought at least one expansion case built on a client's real numbers, or explained why the timing was wrong.

*How we work
*

* Reply to clients within 1 business hour, even if it is "got it, looking into it," with a real answer or a timeline within 24. Reply to internal Slack within 10 minutes.
* Decisions live on the ClickUp task or in the client channel. Never in DMs.
* Monday all-hands, 9:00 to 10:30 AM Eastern.

* *Fluent written and spoken English.* Our clients are US doctors. You will write to them and speak with them every day.
* *You own outcomes.* You have handled client relationships and can tell us what you kept, what you lost and why.
* *You bring bad news early, with a plan.* You do not wait to be asked.
* *You write clearly and fast.* If your writing needs a second pass to be understood, this is the wrong seat.
* *You can hold a doctor's respect.* Calm, direct, prepared, unbothered by pushback.
* *You use AI every day* (Claude or similar) and can show us how.

We will teach you the ads and funnel side. Being curious about it is a must. You need to work *9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern* , with your camera on.

*Skunks on the table
*

Every line is true. If one makes you want to close the tab, that is useful for both of us. If they make you lean in, you are probably who we are looking for.

* *This is a fully remote position.* If you do not have a quiet, productive place to work from home with reliable power and internet, this is not the right role for you.
* *Going quiet is the one thing that does not work here.* Missed a deadline? Tell us. Stuck? Say "I hit a wall." Problems get named the same day, in the open.
* *No recipe, and the structure keeps moving.* We are "building the plane while flying it," and pods, seats and clients change as we grow. The first 2 to 3 weeks are quiet. The people who thrive start digging before anyone asks.
* *The CEO is direct.* Plain feedback, expected back. He loves being challenged and hates silence.
* *Doctors push back, and quality beats volume.* Our clients are smart, busy and spending their own money, so you hold your ground with evidence. A cheap lead who cannot afford a $4,000 treatment is not a win. Compliance is non-negotiable: no guarantees, no definitive claims.
* *You are the last set of eyes.* Errors that should have been caught in QA come out of the pod's bonus pool, just as retention and expansion grow it.

*Our values:* give a shit · better before bigger · sincere candor · move fast and fix it · prove it works · unimpeachable character.

* *Junior Client Success Managers start at $1,500 USD per month* , plus a share of the pod's monthly bonus pool.
* *Grow into leading a pod.* Earn your own book, then lead the pod that runs it.
* *CSM to Strategist.* This is a real step people here have been offered.
* *Earn more by carrying more.* Cover more than one seat in your pod well and you earn more than one seat's share of the bonus.
* *Learn a niche most marketers never touch.* Doctors as clients, four- and five-figure treatments. People who get good at this are rare, and they get paid like it.
* *Room to build, zero micromanagement.* See a better way to run things? Say so and run it.

*Terms:* full-time independent contractor, paid semi-monthly in USD. Six paid US holidays, with time off approved in advance. Fourteen-day notice, either party. Location flexible, Eastern hours fixed.

Benefits

*Das erwartet dich bei INSIGHT:*

title: Junior Marketing Analyst
description:
Ми шукаємо Junior Marketing Analyst, який допомагатиме команді перетворювати дані на зрозумілі висновки та рішення для digital-маркетингу.
У цій ролі ти будеш працювати з даними рекламних кампаній, аналізувати ключові показники, готувати звітність і допомагати команді краще розуміти ефективність маркетингових активностей.

Наші очікування
Аналітичне мислення: вміти працювати з даними, знаходити закономірності та формулювати зрозумілі висновки.
Системність: вміти структурувати великі масиви інформації та тримати порядок у даних і звітності.
Орієнтація на бізнес-результат: розуміти не лише цифри, а й те, що вони означають для бізнесу та маркетингу.
Уважність до деталей: помічати неточності, перевіряти дані та відповідально працювати з цифрами.
Візуалізація: вміти перетворювати складні дані на зрозумілі таблиці, графіки та презентації.
Ініціативність: не просто збирати дані за запитом, а помічати цікаві тенденції та пропонувати, що варто дослідити додатково.

Основні задачі
Збирати та структурувати дані з різних джерел для подальшого аналізу.
Аналізувати ефективність рекламних і digital-кампаній та ключові маркетингові показники.
Працювати з даними GA4 та аналізувати трафік і поведінку користувачів.
Готувати регулярну та оперативну звітність для команди й керівництва.
Проводити план-факт аналіз, визначати відхилення та шукати причини.
Візуалізувати результати в таблицях, графіках і презентаціях.
Досліджувати ринки, конкурентів і продукти та готувати аналітичні висновки.
Брати участь у контролі маркетингових бюджетів і формуванні маркетингової стратегії.
Допомагати автоматизувати регулярну звітність та аналітичні процеси.
Працювати з командами маркетингу, продукту та іншими крос-функціональними командами.

Вимоги
Вища освіта у сфері математики, економіки, статистики, аналітики або суміжних напрямках.
Досвід роботи в digital-сфері або рекламній агенції.
Впевнене володіння Google Sheets / Excel.
Досвід роботи з даними з різних джерел та аналітичними інструментами.
Розуміння основ роботи GA4 та аналітики трафіку.
Вміння працювати з великими масивами даних, знаходити закономірності та робити висновки.
Вміння зрозуміло презентувати результати аналізу.

Буде плюсом
Знання SWOT, ABC-аналізу та інших маркетингових підходів до аналізу.
Базові навички SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
Базове знання Python (NumPy, Pandas).
Досвід роботи з Power BI.
Досвід автоматизації звітності та роботи з даними з різних платформ.

Ми пропонуємо:
Роботу з великими міжнародними брендами;
Професійний розвиток в одній із найсильніших команд на ринку digital реклами;
Досвід роботи зі світовими брендами;
Гідна оплата праці;
Гнучкий графік: пн-пт, з 9−11:00 — 18−20:00;
Роботу в команді, у якої є чому повчитися і яка завжди готова прийти на допомогу;
Соц.пакет: оплачувані лікарняні, відпустки, компенсація навчання, корпоративна англійська, Mental Care-program;

Дуже чекаємо тебе в нашій newage.team, колего!

Job Summary:
------------

Engaging UX/UI Designers to participate in a dynamic project focused on video annotation for advanced robotic arm tasks.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

As a contributor, you will assess and annotate videos of robotic arms completing various procedures, ensuring each session is accurately graded according to established guidelines. This opportunity is ideal for detail-oriented professionals interested in the intersection of UX/UI, video analysis, and AI training.

Scope of Work
-------------

* Review video footage of robotic arms completing specific tasks and annotate sessions as instructed.
* Apply detailed, accurate tags and grading based on provided guidelines and project requirements.
* Utilize video annotation tools to mark key actions, behaviors, and outcomes within each session.
* Document observations and rationales clearly and concisely for each annotated task.
* Collaborate with project trainers and fellow contributors to ensure consistency and quality across annotations.
* Provide feedback to enhance labeling guidelines and annotation processes as the project evolves.
* Meet project deliverables by organizing and submitting completed annotations within requested timeframes.

Preferred Qualifications
------------------------

* Background in UX/UI design, web design, video/music editing, photography, filmmaking, audiovisual production, robotics, or engineering (mechanical/electronics).
* Proven experience with video annotation or data labeling, ideally for AI training or machine learning purposes.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with a track record of producing high-quality, precise work.
* Strong written communication skills for clear documentation and collaboration.
* Familiarity with video annotation tools and digital content review workflows.
* Experience in collaborative project environments and comfort working with remote teams.
* Interest in robotics, advanced technologies, or AI-driven projects is a strong plus.

A very attractive and competitive package is offered.

3+ years in e-commerce design, ideally DTC

Strong Figma skills: clean components and proper auto-layout
Comfort with losing tests. Data settles it.

Why join: your work goes live on real traffic and gets measured in revenue, you get a direct line to decision-makers, you'll work across multiple brands, and the salary is competitive.

Interested? Reply with your best work.

title: Product / UI-UX Designer погодинка 5 to 8 usd per hour
description:
Вакансія: Product / UI-UX Designer (від 3 років досвіду). Проєктна погодинна співпраця зі змінним навантаженням 5$ to 8$ per hour
Coding House Studio — сервісна компанія, яка спеціалізується на розробці та тестуванні програмного забезпечення. Ми надаємо якісні IT-послуги та бізнес-рішення клієнтам у США та Північній Америці.
❤️ Про роль
Шукаємо дизайнера для роботи над проєктами наших клієнтів та внутрішніми продуктами компанії. Це проєктна співпраця за потреби, а не повна зайнятість: задачі з'являються тоді, коли стартують нові проєкти або в наявних виникає запит на дизайн.
Робитимеш дизайн мобільних застосунків (iOS/Android), веб-застосунків і сайтів, а також кастомні дизайн-задачі під запит: презентації, лендінги, банери, брендові матеріали. Працюватимеш у команді з розробниками, QA та проджект-менеджером — від перших вайрфреймів до передачі макетів у розробку та авторського нагляду.
✅ Ми будемо раді співпраці, якщо ти:
Маєш комерційний досвід у продуктовому/UI-UX дизайні від 3 років
Маєш портфоліо з реальними мобільними та веб-проєктами (не тільки концепти)
Впевнено працюєш у Figma: компоненти, auto layout, змінні, дизайн-системи
Розумієш гайдлайни iOS (HIG) та Android (Material), знаєш різницю в патернах платформ
Вмієш робити адаптивний/респонсивний дизайн під різні breakpoints
Готуєш макети до передачі в розробку: специфікації, стани, edge cases, ассети
Розумієш базові обмеження фронтенду і вмієш домовлятися з розробниками
Знаєш англійську на рівні intermediate+ (для роботи з документацією та комунікації в команді)
Не боїшся проявляти ініціативу та маєш гарні навички роботи в команді
Маєш резервне живлення для інтернету й комп'ютера щонайменше на 8 годин на випадок екстрених ситуацій
Тобі підходить формат зі змінним навантаженням: у різні періоди задач може бути більше, менше або не бути зовсім
Буде плюсом:
✨ Досвід роботи в сервісних ІТ-компаніях та зі змінними вимогами клієнтів
✨ Досвід побудови дизайн-систем з нуля
✨ Базова графіка/брендинг: іконки, ілюстрації, презентації, маркетингові матеріали
✨ Навички прототипування та мікроанімацій (Figma prototype, Rive, Lottie, After Effects)
✨ Досвід роботи з аналітикою, A/B тестами або user research
✨ Розуміння accessibility (контраст, розміри тач-таргетів, читабельність)
✨ Вміння самостійно презентувати рішення клієнту англійською
❓ Формат співпраці
Проєктна співпраця за потреби (project-based, on-demand). Ми залучаємо тебе до конкретних клієнтських проєктів і внутрішніх задач, коли для них потрібен дизайн.
Кількість годин змінюється. Вона залежить від того, скільки проєктів активні саме зараз. В один місяць може бути майже повна завантаженість, в інший — лише кілька задач або перерва між проєктами. Фіксованого чи гарантованого мінімуму годин немає.
Навантаження погоджуємо наперед. Перед кожним проєктом або задачею обговорюємо обсяг, терміни й очікувану кількість годин, щоб ти міг(ла) спланувати свій час.
Оплата: 5–8 $ на годину. Рахуємо тільки фактично відпрацьовані години.
Цей формат добре підходить, якщо тобі потрібна гнучка часткова зайнятість або ти поєднуєш її з іншими проєктами. Якщо шукаєш стабільну повну зайнятість, він тобі, найімовірніше, не підійде.
❓ Графік роботи
За домовленістю, щоб робочі години перетиналися з часом клієнтів у Північній Америці. Команда з України працює з 17:00 до 23:00 за київським часом.
❓ Як проходить відбір
Відгук на вакансію: переглядаємо резюме та портфоліо (обов'язково додай посилання)
Перше онлайн-інтерв'ю
Тестове завдання
Фінальне інтерв'ю, якщо буде потрібно
Офер — і ласкаво просимо до команди!

title: Marketing Web Designer (UX/UI)
description:
*About the Role*

We're looking for a mid-level designer with highly refined visual craft to shape and optimize a high-traffic B2B marketing website. This is a marketing and brand web design role, not a product design role: you'll turn creative briefs into polished, on-brand pages that look enterprise-grade from day one, while forming your own point of view on direction and backing it with data. You'll also help evolve a Figma-based design system, with a growing focus on how AI tools can strengthen consistency, documentation, and scale.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Design polished, on-brand, conversion-focused pages and experiences for the marketing website and related digital touchpoints
* Uphold and elevate brand standards across all marketing assets, delivering a cohesive, high-craft visual experience
* Build, document, and maintain components within a Figma design system, keeping it consistent and scalable as the site grows
* Create wireframes, mockups, and prototypes that communicate design intent clearly to stakeholders
* Partner with marketing, content, analytics, and engineering teams to align designs with business goals and ensure high-fidelity implementation
* Design with accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) in mind to ensure inclusive experiences
* Use analytics, heatmaps, and session replay data to identify opportunities and refine pages over time
* Support experimentation by designing and helping analyze A/B tests, translating results into clear recommendations
* Explore AI-assisted tools and workflows to speed up and strengthen design-system work

*Qualifications*

Required:

* 4–6 years of experience in marketing or brand-focused web design, ideally in a B2B or SaaS context
* Demonstrated taste and visual refinement: your craft needs to be enterprise-grade from day one
* A portfolio of live, shipped marketing websites that shows strong typography, layout, and visual polish (product UI case studies alone will not meet the bar)
* Advanced Figma proficiency as your daily working tool, including building and maintaining design systems and component libraries
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to feedback
* Comfortable working quickly while delivering quality on time

Preferred:

* Hands-on experience designing and analyzing A/B tests or experiments
* Familiarity with conversion rate optimization fundamentals and using analytics to inform design decisions
* Experience with heatmapping and session replay tools (e.g., ContentSquare, Hotjar)
* Experience with AI-assisted design tools (e.g., Claude Design) or using AI to accelerate design-system work
* Experience designing on a marketing or growth team

*Key Details*

* Start date: Flexible
* Duration: 6 months, with strong potential for extension based on performance
* Location: Remote (U.S.)
* Work schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week
* Pay rate range: $65–$74/hr + benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401k)
* Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
* Engagement: W2 Contract role through Maleda Tech.

title: Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
ViaBill is a Copenhagen-based fintech offering flexible payment and consumer credit products to shoppers and merchants in Denmark. Our products include a consumer app, the ViaBill card, and a merchant-facing platform used by thousands of webshops and stores.

We're looking for a Product Designer to join our Lead Product Designer as the second designer on the team. You'll own specific product areas end-to-end, from understanding the problem through to shipped UI. You'll work within our shared design system and closely with product, commercial and engineering. This is a hands-on role with real ownership, in a small team where your work goes live quickly.

What you'll do
--------------

* Own design for defined product areas, including our merchant-facing platform and parts of the consumer experience, from problem framing and user flows to final UI and implementation.
* Pick up design needs from across the business when they come up, from web and campaign pages to visual assets for internal and external use, and bring the same craft to them as to product work.
* Explore several design directions before converging, present them clearly to non-design stakeholders, and drive decisions to closure.
* Design within our design system and contribute to it, working with our Lead Product Designer on component standards and consistency.
* Run lightweight usability testing and use product and funnel data to improve live flows.
* Design flows that are clear and compliant at the same time. In consumer credit, disclosures, consent and application steps have to work for both the customer and the regulator.
* Deliver clean, well-structured handoff and stay involved with developers through implementation and QA.

What we're looking for
----------------------

* 2–4 years designing shipped web and mobile products; fintech, e-commerce or B2B SaaS a plus.
* Portfolio with 2–3 case studies showing problem, alternatives explored, decision, and outcome.
* Strong Figma skills, including components, variants and auto-layout, and experience working inside an existing design system.
* Clear, confident written and spoken English; comfortable presenting and defending design choices.
* Based in the EU with CET working-hours overlap.

You'll fit well here if you like owning outcomes rather than tickets, share early work instead of waiting until it's polished, and can hold a view and change it when the evidence says so.

*Nice to have*

* Experience designing regulated or multi-step flows, such as onboarding, applications, payments or identity verification.
* Experience designing for both consumers and business users.
* Basic prototyping in code or motion design.

What we offer
-------------

* Ownership of real product areas from day one, with a direct line to the COO and short decision paths.
* A small, international team where design has a seat at the table.
* Fully remote work within the EU, with occasional trips to Copenhagen for team gatherings.

We're a small team, so no two weeks look the same. One week you might be deep in a mobile app flow, the next shaping a landing page or a piece of brand work. If you enjoy range as much as depth, you'll like it here.

How we hire
-----------

* Short intro call (30 min)
* Portfolio walkthrough with our product team (60 min)
* Design task, or a deep-dive into one of your past projects
* Final conversation with our COO

title: Visual Designer

title: Sr. Staff Product & Visual Designer, Technology Workflows
description:
At ServiceNow, we embrace representation in and from all professional and personal backgrounds and cultures. This diversity inspires passion and creativity among our teams and propels innovation in our products.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Product Designer (Design Technology & Craft Lead) to serve as an elite, hands-on craft visionary bridging advanced visual design, fluid motion choreography, and front-end code. This role sits within our Technology Workflows organization, directly shaping flagship, next-generation AI platforms, and design frameworks.

This is not a traditional systems-architecture or wireframing UX role. We are seeking an exceptional practitioner who blurs the boundary between high-end digital aesthetics and front-end engineering. You will be the team’s creative technical anchor: setting the benchmark for visual depth, kinetic responsiveness, and production-grade prototypes. Working shoulder to shoulder with product designers, design systems teams, and engineering peers, you will define and codify how our AI experiences look, move, and respond across complex enterprise workflows.

You must be obsessed with craft excellence, unapologetic about visual polish, and driven to turn complex technical interactions into fluid, responsive, consumer-grade software.

*What you get to do in the role:*

* Build Reference-Grade Prototypes: Develop high-fidelity, interactive code prototypes and sandboxes (React, modern CSS/Tokens, WebGL/Canvas) that test and prove out next-generation UX for AINPX and Lux before production handoff.
* Pioneer AI Kinetic Systems: Codify motion design patterns, timing curves, elevation models, and dynamic state transitions (such as AI thinking, streaming, settling, and ambient feedback) into production-ready specifications.
* Partner with Design Systems: Collaborate directly with centralized Design Systems engineering teams to translate motion guidelines, visual tokens, and micro-interactions into scalable components used across ServiceNow workflows.
* Elevate Team Craft through Direct Pairing: Champion a player-coach culture by embedding directly with product designers on critical paths. Pair-design interactions, run code-backed workshops, and actively raise the visual and kinetic craft floor of the broader team.
* Bridge Design and Engineering: Serve as the definitive technical translator between design vision and front-end execution, ensuring that intended motion physics and pixel-perfect visual nuance survive into production code.
* Thrive in an AI-Native Workflow: Rapidly experiment with code-backed AI design tools, algorithmic prototyping, and generative interaction paradigms to accelerate design cycles and unlock new interface capabilities.

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 10+ years of experience as a Product Designer, Design Technologist, Creative Technologist, Motion Designer, or Hybrid Visual/UI Designer working on complex web applications.
* A portfolio showcasing world-class visual craft, sophisticated motion/animation choreography, and real interactive prototypes.
* Proven proficiency in modern front-end web technologies (HTML5, modern CSS/SCSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, React) and component-based workflows.
* Deep expertise in kinetic design and prototyping tools (Framer, Principle, After Effects, Rive, or code-based animation libraries like Framer Motion or GSAP).
* Experience designing and engineering for dynamic AI interactions, including agentic state visualization, streaming tokens, and responsive real-time feedback loops.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with and influence cross-functional peers across Product, Design, and Front-End Engineering.

*Basic Qualifications:*

* Experience scaling tokens and kinetic animation systems within enterprise-grade design systems.
* Strong background in micro-interaction design, spatial elevation, accessibility (such as reduced motion support), and performance profiling for web rendering.
* Familiarity with AI-native developer tooling, code-backed design environments, or LLM API integrations for rapid prototyping.
* Prior experience delivering consumer-grade polish to complex enterprise, developer, or data-intensive workflows.
* Bachelor's degree in Design, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or equivalent practical experience.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of *$171,900 - $300,800* , plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

*Work Personas*

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

*Equal Opportunity Employer*

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

*Accommodations*

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

*Export Control Regulations*

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
--------------------
Hi, We’re CompanyCam
--------------------

We’re a simple-to-use photo documentation and productivity app for contractors of every industry. Packed with intuitive functionality, CompanyCam facilitates unparalleled communication and accountability across a contractor’s entire business. By providing a consumer-grade, game-changing experience, we help contractors build trust within their company and with their users.

CompanyCam is a fun, energetic team united by our core values of *Show Up* , *Grow Up* , and *Do Good*. As soon as you join our team, you'll notice that we trust our employees to do what's best for our product, customers, and team members and empower them to make the right calls.

--------
The Role
--------

The Senior Graphic Designer plays a pivotal role in shaping design at CompanyCam, elevating how brand, product, and campaigns communicate and feel across every channel. You'll blend high-end craftsmanship with creative leadership, transforming visual content, aligning it to strategic objectives, and strengthening overall brand consistency. Working cross-functionally with brand, product, and marketing teams, you'll help define how design supports both user experience and brand expression, mentor others, build scalable systems, and push design forward through new tools and storytelling approaches. Reporting into creative leadership, you'll move fluidly between independently owning projects from brief intake to final delivery, and collaborating closely with design leadership to produce high-caliber, on-brand work that drives strategy forward.

Location: We welcome both local and remote applicants for this role. Local (Lincoln, NE) is preferred. Candidates must permanently live and work in the U.S. to be considered.

----------------
*What You'll Do*
----------------

*

Own projects independently from brief to final delivery, making sound creative decisions within a brief's parameters with minimal supervision or revision cycles

*

Create visual assets for digital and print media including campaigns, product launches, web, social, email, and events, working primarily in Adobe Creative Suite with supplemental use of Figma

*

Apply strong typography, layout, and color skills to adapt designs across channels while keeping visual consistency and production readiness

*

Use AI tools to accelerate production work like asset generation, format adaptation, and templating, freeing up your time for the creative judgment no tool replaces

*

Partner with Marketing, Product Design, and Internal Brand teams, collaborating with motion designers, copywriters, and marketing partners to turn strategy into cohesive visuals

*

Present design concepts and gather feedback, iterating efficiently across multiple stakeholders

*

Ensure all creative aligns with brand guidelines, auditing deliverables for consistency in typography, color, and tone

*

Maintain and evolve shared design systems and asset libraries across Adobe Libraries, Figma, Canva, and Bynder

*

Pressure-test every brief before execution begins, surfacing gaps and creative risks before they become revision loops

*

Model high creative standards and lead the team's AI tool adoption, building and sharing workflows that help everyone move faster

------------------------
*The Impact You'll Have*
------------------------

*At CompanyCam, your work makes a real impact.* Whether you're writing code, supporting customers, or designing experiences, your contributions directly shape the product we deliver and the people we serve. We're building something that helps real people solve real problems—and we believe that kind of work is best done by a team that reflects the world around us. *In this role, you’ll drive impact by:*

*

Strengthening brand consistency across every channel, so our marketing, product, and internal communications feel like one cohesive voice

*

Building scalable design systems and templates that empower non-designers to create confidently and stay on-brand

*

Mentoring and raising the bar on craft across the creative team, setting the standard for what great design looks like at CompanyCam

*

Turning strategy into visuals that move the business forward, working hand in hand with Marketing and Product Design

-------------------
*What You'll Bring*
-------------------

*

Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field required

6 to 8 years of professional graphic design experience, with a strong portfolio showing a variety of work

*

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), with supplemental Figma experience

*

Advanced understanding of design fundamentals including color theory, typography, layout, and visual storytelling

*

Excellent collaboration and presentation skills, capable of aligning diverse stakeholders around creative ideas

*

Demonstrated mentorship and leadership within a creative team

*

Experience in a corporate in-house environment or large-scale brand management, preferred

*

Working knowledge of motion graphics and video editing tools such as After Effects, preferred

*

A continuous growth-mindset, with a focus on learning, embracing challenges, and continuously improving.

*

A knack for creativity and innovation, bringing fresh ideas to the table and solving complex problems.

-----------------------
Benefits & Compensation
-----------------------

This is a salaried position at CompanyCam. Our starting salary range is *$70,000-$80,000* per year and is based on experience. We also offer meaningful equity and other benefits.

CompanyCam is an equal-opportunity employer committed to respect, inclusion, and growth. We work hard, take responsibility, and support each other. Great ideas come from all backgrounds, and we carefully consider every applicant without regard to personal characteristics or traits. Even if your work experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply. What really matters to us is your potential, your passion, and your commitment to learning, innovation, and contributing meaningfully to our team.

For any accommodations or technical issues related to the online application or interview process, please email jobs@companycam.com and we’ll respond promptly. Please do not include any medical or health information in your message.

*Note:* Resumes sent to this email will *not be reviewed or responded to*. To be considered for a position, you must apply directly through our careers page.

title: Senior AI Product Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced *AI Product Manager* who can operate at the intersection of product, technology, client engagement, and execution. This is a high-ownership, enterprise-facing role for someone who is excited by the opportunity to shape cutting-edge AI applications, work directly with international clients, and translate complex business problems into scalable AI-enabled products.

The AI Product Manager will lead the definition, shaping, and execution of enterprise AI products and features for global clients. This role requires a rare mix of product judgment, AI fluency, consulting maturity, and hands-on problem solving. You will work closely with clients, engineering teams, designers, and delivery leaders to identify opportunities, define product direction, manage expectations, and bring AI-first solutions to life.

The ideal candidate understands how to apply GenAI and agentic patterns in enterprise contexts, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and is hands-on enough to prototype ideas, validate concepts quickly, and sharpen requirements through action. This is not a purely roadmap or coordination role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, engage credibly with clients, and get into the detail when needed.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Own the product definition and execution of enterprise AI applications, workflows, and features from discovery through release and adoption.
* Work directly with clients and internal stakeholders to identify business problems, frame opportunities, and convert them into clear product requirements and delivery plans.
* Shape AI-first user experiences, including copilots, assistants, agentic workflows, decision-support tools, and human-in-the-loop enterprise applications.
* Translate ambiguous business needs into structured product artifacts such as problem statements, user journeys, PRDs, acceptance criteria, prioritization frameworks, and release scope.
* Partner closely with engineering, UX, architecture, and delivery teams to ensure product intent is translated into practical, scalable solutions.
* Drive workshops, requirement discovery sessions, stakeholder reviews, demos, and alignment discussions with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.
* Build lightweight prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and product mock flows using modern AI tools, no-code/low-code methods, vibe coding, and basic design/prototyping techniques where useful.
* Help define and refine AI use cases involving agents, orchestration, retrieval, workflow automation, and enterprise system integration.
* Maintain a sharp eye for detail across business requirements, product behavior, user experience, and delivery quality.
* Manage client expectations proactively by balancing ambition, technical feasibility, timelines, and delivery realities.
* Support value realization and account growth by identifying follow-on product opportunities, expansion areas, and innovation pathways within client accounts.
* Contribute to a product and delivery culture that values speed, clarity, experimentation, accountability, and customer impact.

*What Success Looks Like in This Role*

* Enterprise AI products and features are clearly defined, well-prioritized, and shipped with strong adoption potential.
* Clients see you as a credible product partner who understands both business value and execution constraints.
* Product requirements are crisp, actionable, and reduce ambiguity for delivery teams.
* AI use cases move beyond demos into usable workflows that solve real operational problems.
* Teams make faster, better decisions because product direction, scope, and trade-offs are well managed.
* Client confidence improves through strong communication, attention to detail, and disciplined expectation management.
* You help create momentum for account expansion by spotting practical product and AI opportunities that clients want to invest in.

*Requirements*

* 7–14 years of experience in ProApplication formDesign the application form for this role.duct Management, Business Analysis, Consulting, Enterprise Software, Digital Products, or related technology roles.
* Demonstrated experience working on software products, platforms, or enterprise applications in client-facing environments.
* Good understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts, with practical exposure to AI-enabled product design and delivery.
* Exposure to building or shaping *agent-based / agentic workflows* or AI-driven assistants/copilots in a product or solution context.
* Strong experience in requirements discovery, user story definition, prioritization, stakeholder management, and cross-functional execution.
* Ability to engage confidently with enterprise clients, business users, engineering teams, and senior internal stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and present with clarity.
* High attention to detail and the ability to manage product quality and client expectations in parallel.
* A hands-on mindset with the willingness to prototype, experiment, and validate ideas quickly rather than rely only on documentation.
* Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-evolving environments where AI capabilities, client needs, and product direction are still being shaped.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Prior experience in a consulting or client advisory environment is highly desirable.
* Exposure to enterprise domains and business applications is preferred.
* Experience supporting *farming-led account expansion* , identifying opportunities within existing accounts, or helping grow strategic client relationships is a strong plus.
* Background as a Software Engineer or strong technical foundation is preferred.
* Familiarity with enterprise workflow systems, platform integrations, business process automation, or complex multi-stakeholder applications is a plus.
* Experience creating basic prototypes independently using AI coding tools, prompt-based development, wireframing, or lightweight design tools.
* Strong educational background from top-tier institutions is preferred, including *IIMs* , *IITs, BIT Mesra, BITS Pilani, top NITs,* or equivalent institutions.

*Skills and Capability Areas*

* AI product thinking and practical GenAI application
* Agentic workflow understanding and AI feature conceptualization
* Enterprise product management and requirements rigor
* Client-facing communication and consulting maturity
* Hands-on prototyping, experimentation, and validation
* Cross-functional collaboration with engineering, UX, and delivery
* Strong execution discipline and attention to detail

*Who Will Thrive Here*

* You are likely to thrive in this role if you are someone who enjoys building in fast-moving environments, likes solving messy enterprise problems, and can move comfortably between strategy and execution. You are structured but not rigid, hands-on but not narrow, and client-focused without losing product depth. You bring ownership, curiosity, and pragmatism. You know how to earn trust in a room, ask the right questions, and turn ambiguity into action.

title: Senior Corporate Paralegal
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Corporate Paralegal to join Ramp's Legal team and own the operational backbone of how we govern and structure  the company. Ramp runs a growing portfolio of U.S. and non-U.S. entities — including regulated and licensed subsidiaries — across a business that ships constantly and raises, acquires, and expands on short notice. You will be the person who keeps that machinery accurate, current, and audit-ready.

This is a broad generalist role. You'll sit at the center of corporate governance, entity management, equity administration, and litigation/employment and you'll partner directly with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Compliance, Equity Admin, and People, and outside counsel. We are a small, high-leverage team supporting a company that moves quickly, so you'll cover a lot of ground and be trusted to run matters independently.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Corporate governance: Prepare board and stockholder meeting materials, agendas, minutes, written consents, resolutions, secretary's certificates, and incumbency certificates. Track and calendar governance obligations across the entity portfolio.

- Entity management: Own the full lifecycle of entity administration — formations and dissolutions, foreign qualifications, annual reports, franchise tax filings, registered agent management, signatories, officer and director lists, post-integration cleanup.

- KYC, UBO, and diligence: Respond to KYC/UBO and diligence requests from bank partners, regulators, auditors, insurers, and counterparties, and build reusable packages.

- Equity support: Support equity administration, option and RSU grants, board approvals of equity awards, secondaries, and equity plan recordkeeping in partnership with Finance and People.

- Transaction support: Run diligence support, signature collection, closing checklists, closing binders, and post-closing obligations for financings, credit facilities, M&A, real estate, and insurance renewals.

- Commercial and cross-functional support: Assist with powers of attorney, delegations of authority, and corporate approvals needed by the business.

- Employment support: Support employment- and immigration-related requests and filings.

- Litigation support: Support subpoena and law enforcement requests, legal holds, e-discovery, and document production. Review and respond to garnishment orders and UCC liens. Serve as Ramp’s custodian of records and as Ramp’s representative in small claims court cases.

WHAT YOU NEED

- 6+ years of corporate paralegal experience at a major law firm and/or in-house at a high-growth technology or financial services company.

- Deep working knowledge of corporate governance, entity formation and maintenance, corporate recordkeeping, and secretary's office functions.

- Excellent drafting skills across resolutions, consents, certificates, and corporate documentation, with genuine precision — you catch the wrong entity name, the stale date, and the missing signature block.

- Demonstrated ability to independently run multiple time-sensitive workstreams without dropping threads or waiting to be asked.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills and the judgment to work directly with executives, board members, outside counsel, and cross-functional partners.

- Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and processes are still being built — and a bias toward action.

- High judgment around confidential and sensitive corporate information.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience at a fintech, payments, or regulated financial services company, including support for licensed entities (money transmitter, EMI, or similar).

- Experience supporting venture financings, secondaries, M&A integration, or IPO readiness.

- International entity management experience across EMEA, APAC, LATAM, or Canada.

- Experience with equity administration and cap table platforms (e.g., Shareworks).

- Experiencing with litigation or employment matters.

- Notary Public commission (NY or CA), or willingness to obtain one.

- ABA-approved paralegal certificate.

- A track record of using AI or automation to eliminate manual legal work.

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual membership

- 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

- Pet insurance

- In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

- Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

CANADA

- Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

- Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

- Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

- Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

- Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

UNITED KINGDOM

- Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

- Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

- Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

title: UX/UI Design Intern — Barcelona Only — University Agreement Required

* *Growth-Oriented Design:* Experiment with paywalls, onboarding, and in-app flows that improve activation, retention, and monetization.
* *Design System & Handoff:* Maintain and improve the design system, ensure Figma files are clean and ready for dev handoff.
* *Data-Driven Creativity:* Collaborate with analysts to interpret data and apply insights to design improvements and experiments.

*WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (90 Days)*

* You’ve launched at least one *A/B-tested UX or UI experiment* that improved a key metric.

* You’re seen by your squad as the *owner of usability and polish* — not just aesthetics.
* The Product Owner trusts your work to go straight from Figma to dev without supervision.

🧠 *WHAT YOU’LL DO (Day-to-day)*

* Design user journeys, wireframes, and interactive prototypes in *Figma*.
* Collaborate daily with *Product Owners, Developers, and Analysts* to align on priorities and refine UX.
* Analyze product data and user behavior to inform design decisions.
* Conduct user tests, competitor research, and UX audits.
* Improve onboarding flows, paywalls, and retention loops.
* Ensure design handoffs are clean, annotated, and efficient.
* Participate in design critiques and contribute to Carrots’ evolving design standards.

🛠️ *WHAT YOU MUST HAVE (Hard Requirements)*

Non-negotiable. Please apply only if you meet all.

* Currently *enrolled in a university in Spain* and able to sign a *“convenio de prácticas.”*
* Based in *Barcelona* or willing to work on-site/hybrid during the internship.
* Proficient in *Figma* and solid understanding of UX/UI principles.
* Strong portfolio showcasing *web or mobile app projects* (personal or academic).
* Ability to balance *creativity with usability* — you design for growth, not just beauty.
* Curious and proactive — you find ways to improve flows before anyone asks.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
* Full-time availability for *at least 6 months.*

*NICE-TO-HAVE (Great to see)*

* Experience designing for *mobile apps* (iOS/Android).
* Familiarity with *A/B testing* , *user research* , or *usability testing*.
* Understanding of *growth design* — paywalls, pricing, activation, retention.
* Familiarity with *Amplitude, Firebase, or Looker* for data-informed design.
* Prior internships or freelance work in UX/UI.
* Strong visual storytelling and presentation skills.

🧩 *HOW WE WORK*

* *Structure:* Each app squad = Product Owner, UX/UI, Developers, Product Analyst.
* *Stack:* Figma, Firebase, Amplitude, Looker, Notion.
* *Cadence:* Weekly sprints, data-driven design reviews, fast iteration cycles.
* *Culture:* High speed, high standards, zero drama. We ship — and learn — fast.

*WHAT WE OFFER (Compensation & Benefits)*

We offer a high-impact, high-autonomy role with a reward structure aligned to the company's growth in Barcelona.

* *Paid Internship:* This is a *remunerated full-time position* designed to give you real ownership and impact — not just “student tasks.”

* *Career Trajectory:* A *Tailored career plan* with performance reviews and salary calibrations every 6 months.

Stop applying to “design internships” where you’ll spend months fixing icons and resizing buttons.

Here, you’ll *ship end-to-end app designs, real features, test real experiments, and design experiences that reach millions of users.*

Come build real things from day one. Worst case? You’ll leave smarter.
