The best AI shouldn’t live behind a closed wall. Askdodo is building consumer AI on *frontier open-source models* — so users get cutting-edge capability without being locked into one lab’s stack.

*Privacy is how we ship it:* no surveillance tax, user control, private by design. Open models are the mission; privacy is the foundation that makes that mission trustworthy.

We’re hiring a *founding Product Manager* — someone early in their career who can own product end-to-end with the founders. Marketing and public brand stay with the founding team; you make the product impossible to leave.

What you’ll do
--------------

*

Own core product loops: chat + API experience, onboarding, retention, and privacy UX that users actually understand

*

Turn “private by design” into clear product decisions (not marketing copy)

*

Ship fast with eng — specs, prioritization, experiments, launch notes

*

Talk to users (power users, privacy-conscious builders, early adopters) and turn signal into roadmap

*

Partner with founders on positioning when product needs a public narrative

Must-haves
----------

*

*Technical background* (CS / eng / math / physics degree or equivalent technical work)

*

Experience or internships at an *AI / consumer software* company (or shipping consumer products with real users)

*

Passion for *consumer products* — you obsess over craft, clarity, and delight

*

Comfortable in US / Bay Area startup culture

*

Early-career founding energy (new grad to ~2–4 years) — IC who still ships, not a process PM

*

Curious about open source LLMs and privacy

Nice-to-haves
-------------

*

Built or shipped an AI feature, agent workflow, or consumer app (0→1 signal)

*

Comfortable reading technical docs / APIs (OpenAI-compatible stacks a plus)

*

Cross-cultural experience

*

Some public presence (writing, demos, podcasts) is a bonus

Not a fit
---------

*

Pure brand / CMO / social-first marketers (founders cover that)

*

Enterprise B2B PMs with no consumer DNA

*

Non-technical PMs who can’t partner deeply with eng

*

Big-co process owners who need heavy process to move

How to apply
------------

Apply via Handshake / Crimson Careers, or email ** with:

*

Your résumé

*

A short note on one consumer or AI product you shipped (or would ship) and why open-source LLMs matter to you

*About the Company:*

AskDoDo is a frontier AIGC and AI Agent platform that prioritizes high degrees of freedom and extreme privacy protection. We target core overseas markets including Europe, the US, Japan, and Korea, offering end-to-end generation services across text, images, video, and novels.
We uphold “Uncensored Capability” as a core value. Built on anonymity, end-to-end encryption, transparent routing, and deeply integrated open-source models, we commit to collecting no user data and completely eliminating privacy risks.
Our vision is to build a powerful multi-model Coding-Agent that enables AI to autonomously complete complex tasks in real code and tool environments — becoming a truly trusted and empowering productivity tool for developers and creators worldwide.

*Why Join Us*

*

*Own the core, not a cog* : You will lead the end-to-end development of the AI Agent layer from 0 to 1 — defining how AI autonomously completes tasks in real environments and directly shaping AskDoDo’s most critical user experience.

*

*Flat structure, top-tier rewards* : Extremely flat team (Shanghai office) with direct reporting to the business lead. We are strictly merit-based and offer highly competitive compensation (benchmarked against core levels at major tech companies, with a million-RMB annual base) plus significant early-stage equity.

*

*Proven DNA, unlimited upside* : The founding team has validated overseas B2C success and a clear commercial path. As a member of the early elite team, your career growth and leadership opportunities have no ceiling.

*

*Pure geek vision* : This is a geek’s mission to defend technical freedom and privacy. Push the limits of AI autonomous coding with the hardest-core technology and deliver truly secure Privacy AI to users worldwide.

title: Engineering Operations Manager
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

*Engineering Operations Manager*

The Engineering Operations Manager owns the tools, processes, and integrations that support the Product Engineering and Technical Program Management organization. The role is shifting from tool administration toward engineering productivity and operations: reducing friction in engineering workflows, building the integrations and AI-assisted SDLC tooling that make that possible, and serving as the technical lead for junior team members working in that space.

The ideal candidate is a fully competent, independent technical contributor who can also mentor less experienced colleagues. They are comfortable learning new technologies, building integrations, evaluating AI-assisted output critically, and driving adoption of better ways of working across diverse teams.

*Key Responsibilities*

* *Tooling Platform Strategy & Automation -* Own the roadmap and architecture for Jira, Confluence, Jellyfish, and future engineering tools. Push configuration and administration work toward automation and self-service rather than performing it manually. Where manual administration remains necessary, delegate it to the junior team member or automate it — it should not be the primary use of this role's time.
* *Integrations & AI SDLC -* Build and maintain integrations between engineering systems using REST APIs, webhooks, and scripting. Direct and evaluate AI-assisted SDLC work, including prompt and spec writing, output evaluation, and connector or tool development. Serve as technical lead and review point for the Jr Developer, Engineering Operations role on this work.
* *Executive Reporting -* Turn Jira and Jellyfish data into reliable metrics and executive-ready reporting. Maintain the roadmap-to-delivery mapping (Initiatives, Features, confidence ratings, SME verification) as an ongoing discipline rather than a one-time exercise.
* *Program & Release Support -* Support program and release management with tooling, data, and process guidance across the SDLC.
* *Process Standardization -* Define and enforce consistent tool usage patterns across engineering, product, and TPgM teams to improve collaboration and efficiency.
* *Engineering Productivity & Cross-Functional Partnership -* Partner with engineering and product leadership to reduce friction in day-to-day workflows, treating engineers as the customer of this team's tools and processes rather than as subjects of administration.
* *Technical Mentorship -* Provide technical direction, code and configuration review, and skill development for junior team members working on integrations and AI SDLC.

*Qualifications*

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 4+ years of experience in engineering operations, tooling, integrations, or process management.
* Working proficiency in Python and REST API integration patterns: auth flows, pagination, rate limits, retry logic.
* Git and PR-based workflow.
* Practical experience using an LLM as a working tool, including where it fails.
* Strong written communication spanning executive narrative and technical writing (specs, prompts, evaluation criteria).
* Demonstrated ability to mentor or provide technical guidance to less experienced team members.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Self-starter, comfortable operating without an established right answer.

*Preferred Skills*

* Experience administering *Atlassian tools* (Jira, Confluence) — now context for the role, not its core.
* SQL for reading data: joins, aggregation, filtering.
* Experience with MCP or connector development, agentic patterns, and tool or skill design.
* Familiarity with *Jellyfish* or comparable engineering intelligence platforms.
* Experience with Agile methodologies and software development life cycle processes.
* Secrets and credential hygiene across systems.

title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
You are at the front lines of med tech innovation. You’ll join a top talent, fun, diverse, tight-knit team of experienced professionals who have worked in healthcare and technology across multiple functions. We think big and bold, and relentlessly execute. We strive to use the latest technologies and apply them to medical software development.

You provision and manage our product infrastructure. You work hand-in-hand with product engineers, algorithm developers and application engineers to efficiently implement, deploy and operate cloud infrastructure in development and production. You show creative thinking and proactively come up with ideas and strategies to improve our software, infrastructure and product performance.

Our technical stack is build on AWS, Terraform (HCL), Ansible and Bash / Python.

We are looking for someone at a junior to mid-level of experience eager to join a fast growing team offering opportunities for personal development and growth.

This is a remote or hybrid position on time zones between US Eastern Time and Eastern European Time.

*Your responsibilities:*

* You provision and manage our product infrastructure across the product life-cycle, from development to production
* You develop, deploy and maintain cloud based architectures and systems using Infrastructure as Code
* You set up logging, telemetry and alerts to monitor application performance and our production systems
* You ensure our infrastructure and data are secure by implementing access controls, managing secrets and enforcing network security configurations
* You automate deployments and operational tasks, and develop scripts and playbooks for incident recovery
* You work in close collaboration with the platform team, product engineers and algorithm developers, with the goal to provide robust and well-documented infrastructure for deployment in products
* You provide guidance on industry best practices around design, testing, security and operations

*Requirements*

You’re a passionate cloud/platform engineer, generalist and hobbyist. You come from a background in software engineering, IT administration or cybersecurity engineering. You’re interested in building and maintaining cloud infrastructure, automation, monitoring and secure production systems. Privacy and security are top of mind for you, and you understand the importance of cybersecurity and compliance in healthcare.

You work fast without compromising on quality. You take a problem solving approach to infrastructure and operations. You get your motivation from developing cloud architectures that power products impacting people’s lives.

To succeed in this role, *you must have* :

* Background in Software Engineering, IT Administration, Cybersecurity Engineering or equivalent through experience
* Experience configuring resources with a major cloud provider such as AWS, Azure or GCP, either manually or using Infrastructure as Code
* Experience with Linux administration and scripting
* Understanding of the OSI network stack
* Ability to work as a team, make architectural decisions together, and provide and receive feedback

Additionally, *it will help to have* :

* Proficiency in an Infrastructure as Code language or framework such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Serverless Framework or Pulumi
* Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker, Podman or Kubernetes
* Experience or interest in DevOps and CI/CD
* Experience with Bash and/or Python
* A practical approach to prototyping: build the golden path first, then refine it to cover the remaining use cases
* Preference for understandability over elegance

Extra *bonus points* for:

* AWS certification in Cloud Computing, Security, DevOps, Development or Networking
* Work experience in a healthcare environment
* Experience with standards and frameworks such as SOC2, ISO 62304, HIPAA, ISO 13485, HITRUST or MDR

*Benefits*

Bloomlife is an award-winning start-up recognized for our vision to rethink prenatal care and impact the lives of families globally including winning Richard Branson’s Extreme Tech Challenge, J&J Quickfire Challenge Winner, MedTech Innovator Award, Ideas from Europe Finalist, CLIO Award Finalist, and speaking at the White House Precision Public Health Summit. Bloomlife also got FDA clearance for its prenatal wearable for monitoring maternal and fetal heart heart rate, setting new grounds to move prenatal check-ups from expensive hospital environments to the patient’s home.

You will join a dynamic and international team who’s passionate about using technologies for a better living. You are an early member of a growing start-up with recent successes and get to experience first hand the excitement of start-up life. Your work will be highly visible to company founders, directly shape our products and impact people’s lives, and open opportunities for personal and career development.

We offer a flexible work environment, remote work culture and a compensation package combining salary and stock options.

title: Marketing Web Designer (UX/UI)
description:
*About the Role*

We're looking for a mid-level designer with highly refined visual craft to shape and optimize a high-traffic B2B marketing website. This is a marketing and brand web design role, not a product design role: you'll turn creative briefs into polished, on-brand pages that look enterprise-grade from day one, while forming your own point of view on direction and backing it with data. You'll also help evolve a Figma-based design system, with a growing focus on how AI tools can strengthen consistency, documentation, and scale.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Design polished, on-brand, conversion-focused pages and experiences for the marketing website and related digital touchpoints
* Uphold and elevate brand standards across all marketing assets, delivering a cohesive, high-craft visual experience
* Build, document, and maintain components within a Figma design system, keeping it consistent and scalable as the site grows
* Create wireframes, mockups, and prototypes that communicate design intent clearly to stakeholders
* Partner with marketing, content, analytics, and engineering teams to align designs with business goals and ensure high-fidelity implementation
* Design with accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) in mind to ensure inclusive experiences
* Use analytics, heatmaps, and session replay data to identify opportunities and refine pages over time
* Support experimentation by designing and helping analyze A/B tests, translating results into clear recommendations
* Explore AI-assisted tools and workflows to speed up and strengthen design-system work

*Qualifications*

Required:

* 4–6 years of experience in marketing or brand-focused web design, ideally in a B2B or SaaS context
* Demonstrated taste and visual refinement: your craft needs to be enterprise-grade from day one
* A portfolio of live, shipped marketing websites that shows strong typography, layout, and visual polish (product UI case studies alone will not meet the bar)
* Advanced Figma proficiency as your daily working tool, including building and maintaining design systems and component libraries
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to feedback
* Comfortable working quickly while delivering quality on time

Preferred:

* Hands-on experience designing and analyzing A/B tests or experiments
* Familiarity with conversion rate optimization fundamentals and using analytics to inform design decisions
* Experience with heatmapping and session replay tools (e.g., ContentSquare, Hotjar)
* Experience with AI-assisted design tools (e.g., Claude Design) or using AI to accelerate design-system work
* Experience designing on a marketing or growth team

*Key Details*

* Start date: Flexible
* Duration: 6 months, with strong potential for extension based on performance
* Location: Remote (U.S.)
* Work schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week
* Pay rate range: $65–$74/hr + benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401k)
* Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
* Engagement: W2 Contract role through Maleda Tech.

title: Visual and Motion Designer / Marketing Designer (Contract )
description:
**Who We Are**

Founded in 2024, Ares Interactive is a privately held company built by a group of experienced leaders and veterans from some of the most respected organizations in interactive entertainment. Our team brings deep expertise across game development, publishing, and live operations, and shares a commitment to building exceptional player experiences.

We are growing and looking for talented individuals who want to help shape the future of our company. We believe great people are our most important asset. We work with passion and purpose, while supporting one another with professionalism and respect, creating an environment where everyone can do their best work.

**About the role**

Ares Interactive, the parent company of Berlin-based mobile gaming studio Swift Games, is seeking an Visual & Motion Designer (Contractor) to support marketing and creative production across our portfolio of games. Swift Games, recently acquired by Ares, continues to operate as an integral development studio within the group.

You will be responsible for creating a wide range of compelling visual assets, from thumb-stopping video ads to polished app store graphics. The ideal candidate has a sharp eye for design, mastery of After Effects and Photoshop, and is excited to leverage AI to boost efficiency and creativity.

**What you'll do**

* Design and edit high-impact, thumb-stopping video ads for social media, ad networks, and other marketing channels.
* Create a variety of marketing assets for our mobile games, including marketing statistics and App Store Optimization (ASO) graphics.
* Work closely with the Creative Manager to translate performance data and UA feedback into actionable creative concepts.
* Design all assets with their purpose in mind, focusing on clarity, contrast, and user engagement to maximize impact.
* Embrace and explore AI tools to accelerate production workflows and innovate on creative ideation.

**Requirements & Background**

* A strong portfolio showcasing your experience in video editing and static design, preferably for mobile apps or games.
* Expert proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Adobe Photoshop.
* A solid understanding of design fundamentals, especially color theory, contrast, and composition.
* Experience creating marketing assets specifically for the mobile gaming/app ecosystem (ASO, video ads, statics).
* Experience building and utilizing AI-integrated workflows.

**Nice to Have**

* 3D skills using software like Blender or Maya.
* Experience with Unity for recording gameplay.

**Does this sound like a fit? Apply today!**

Ares Interactive is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Graphic Designer
location: Remote, Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District
description:
We're looking for a Graphic Designer to own the visual voice of our brand across social and marketing. In this role, you'll shape how we show up in feeds, in ads, and in culture: turning fast-moving markets and real-world moments into scroll-stopping creative. You'll work at the intersection of brand, growth, and content, moving quickly on reactive, news-driven posts while keeping everything pixel-perfect and unmistakably on-brand. To thrive here, you need to move fast without sacrificing craft.

Responsibilities
----------------

* *Social-First Creative:* Design daily content for social platforms (X, Instagram, TikTok) — posts, stories, and banners that turn live markets and trending moments into share-worthy visuals.
* *Drive Growth:* Produce "scroll-stopping" creative for paid performance campaigns — ad sets, static and animated units, and landing pages built to drive installs, sign-ups, and conversion.
* *Brand Stewardship:* Maintain a consistent, sharp visual identity while showing the versatility to adapt tone across channels, audiences, and cultural moments.
* *Reactive Speed:* Jump on breaking news and trending markets to ship timely, on-brand creative within hours — not days.
* *AI-Powered Production:* Integrate AI tools into your workflow to explore new styles, generate variations at scale, and streamline production without lowering the quality bar.
* *Light Motion:* Bring static designs to life with basic animation and short-form video for social and ads.

Requirements
------------

* *Experience:* 3+ years of professional graphic design experience, ideally within a high-growth startup, agency, or consumer/gaming brand.
* *Technical Mastery:* Expert-level proficiency in Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator). You're comfortable with layout, typography, and building scalable design systems.
* *Social & Performance Instincts:* A proven eye for what performs on social and in paid media. You understand platform formats, hook viewers instantly, and design for engagement and conversion — not just aesthetics.
* *The AI Edge:* Proven experience (or a deep, active interest) in using AI-assisted creative tools to enhance output and production speed.
* *Motion Fluency:* Working familiarity with After Effects or similar tools to produce basic animation and short-form video.
* *Speed & Craft:* A master of prioritization who can turn around high-quality assets under tight timelines. You move fast without letting quality slip.
* *Growth Mindset:* You thrive in fast-paced, on-site environments, welcome constructive feedback, and are always looking for ways to optimize your craft.

*Bonus: interest in sports, internet culture and a pulse on what's trending.*

title: Brand Designer
description:
Douro Labs is the core development team behind the Pyth Network. We're looking for a brand designer to produce high-quality visual work across our digital channels, events and products.
You will help to shape how Douro Labs and Pyth show up to the world.

This role is for a hands-on designer who loves making things: a versatile creator who effortlessly shifts from designing quick digital campaign graphics to crafting full-scale event booth experiences on short notice

You will work closely with our Brand Design Lead to bring our visual identity systems to life across every touchpoint, from web and social to event materials, while also supporting our Product Design Lead on product-side graphics in the short term.

*Location:* Remote (US-based, PST preferred)
*Type:* Full-time
*Reports to:* Head of Design

*About Our Team and Your Role*

We are a well-rounded team: half of us are tech whizzes, while the other half excel in building partnerships with institutional clients, prime brokers, and the global financial infrastructure community. Craft and clarity are key to how we communicate.

Remote Work: Our team is spread across the globe, from the US and South America to Europe and Asia. We are a digital-first organization where remote work is the norm.

Startup-level Speed: We thrive in the dynamic DeFi space and need a designer who can move quickly without compromising quality. You'll be comfortable with shifting priorities, short timelines, and finding smart ways to get more done.

The Mission: In this role, you will craft the visual foundation for Pyth Pro, our institutional offering tailored for prominent banking institutions, trading platforms, and global financial networks. You will play a pivotal part in expanding the Douro Labs brand beyond Web3 natives into traditional markets, creating impactful work that reaches key market participants, developers, and industry leaders on a weekly basis.

*About the Role*

This is a production-focused brand design role. You'll receive art direction, creative direction, and project assignments primarily from the Brand Design Lead, secondarily from the Product Design Lead. At the outset, your time will be split roughly 75% brand and 25% product.

As the design team grows, this role is expected to shift toward supporting the Brand Design Lead full-time, with a deeper focus on brand, campaign, and event work.

*Responsibilities:*

*Digital Production*

*

Design social media assets,Collateral for sales and internal communications, and content for web

*

Support marketing initiatives surrounding new product releases, exchange integrations, and major ecosystem events

*

Apply brand guidelines consistently across all digital channels

*

Adapt and resize assets across formats and platforms

*Event Design*

*

Design promotional materials for conferences and events

*

Create booth graphics, signage, and printed collateral

*

Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to deliver event assets on time

*Product Support*

*

Support the Product Design Lead on product-side graphics, illustrations, and visual assets

*

Help keep visual consistency between brand and product surfaces

*Tools and Workflows*

*

Feel free to utilize any tool of choice, provided deliverables maintain high standards and remain neatly structured in Figma using shared libraries and organized files

*

Bring AI tools into your daily workflow to speed up production and explore new ideas

*

Experiment with new tools and techniques and share what works with the team

*

Help build templates and systems that make recurring work faster

*About You*

*You must excel in at least one of the following:*

*

*Motion design*

*

*Framer*

*

*Illustration and iconography
*

*

3 to 5 years of experience as a graphic or brand designer

*

Strong generalist skills across layout, typography, color, and composition

*

Proficient in Figma, with a portfolio that shows range across digital and print

*

AI-forward mindset, seamlessly integrating platforms like Claude and Firefly into daily practice to explore new visual frontiers

*

Self-organizing and proactive, able to manage your own workload and deadlines

*

Clear, warm communicator who takes direction well and speaks up with ideas

*

Resourceful experimenter and problem-solver who enjoys figuring things out

*

Crypto/DeFi or financial infrastructure familiarity a plus, not required

*Think you've got what it takes to build the most talented team in the world? We'd love to meet you.*

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Our Story
Founded in 2008, Hightower is a wealth management firm that provides investment, financial and retirement planning services to individuals, foundations and family offices, as well as 401(k) consulting and cash management services to corporations. Hightower’s capital solutions, operational support services, size and scale empower its vibrant community of independent-minded wealth advisors to grow their businesses and help their clients achieve their financial vision. Based in Chicago with advisors across the U.S., we operate as a registered investment advisor (RIA).

Your Future Team As a Graphic Designer, you will be responsible for executing design projects for our nearly 150 advisor practices as well as corporate stakeholders. You’ll work collaboratively with the marketing team, advisor businesses, and corporate stakeholders to execute design projects. The ideal candidate will have in-depth knowledge and experience in UI/UX design principles. This role reports directly to the Manager of Brand and Design and works both collaboratively and independently in a fast-paced environment while organizing multiple projects.

What You’ll Do

Design and revise a wide variety of design projects, ranging from presentations, social graphics, stationery, brochures, requests for proposals, print/digital ads, email assets, websites, and more, using various software programs to visualize and develop innovative graphic designs that meet business goals.
Develop presentations and social media templates that can be shared with and updated by advisors
Ensure that all designs are aligned with the related visual guidelines.
Maintain an organized digital asset library, ensuring easy accessibility and efficient workflow for design files.
Design and create graphic elements, including logos, icons, and illustrations, as needed, maintaining an internal database of design files.
Work closely with printers and other external vendors to ensure the successful production and delivery of printed materials.

1-3+ year of experience as a Graphic Designer or a similar role, showcasing a portfolio of previous design projects
Proficiency in industry-standard design software such as Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop), Figma and Canva
Understanding of design principles, typography, color theory, and layout techniques
Excellent creativity and ability to develop visually compelling designs
Able to work well under time pressure
Knowledge of current design trends, new technologies, and best practices in graphic design.
Familiarity with web design principles and basic HTML/CSS knowledge

In-office Monday through Thursday and work from home on Fridays
Free brand-new gym in the Chicago office

HSA employer contributions
Student loan assistance
Pet insurance
Base salary of $60,000-$70,000 plus discretionary bonus (exact base salary amount will be dependent on experience)

AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER: Hightower is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital status, national origin, citizenship, veteran status, ancestry, age (over 40), physical or mental disability, medical condition (cancer-related), gender identity or expression, genetic information including sickle cell or hemoglobin C trait, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local law.

You are a U.S. citizen, U.S. permanent resident or possess other unrestricted U.S. work authorization and will not require sponsorship for U.S. work authorization now or anytime in the future.

title: Graphic Designer, WW
description:
Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by

1) providing the best services for homebuyers

2) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance

3) to protect the whole home.

As a leader in the home services software-as-a-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title: *Graphic Designer*

Location: *Colombia*

Workplace Type: *Remote*

This role is employed through RemoFirst, Porch Group's Employer of Record partner in Colombia. Your employment will be legally administered through RemoFirst, while your day-to-day work is led by Porch Group.

*Job Summary*

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we’d love you to be a part of it as a *Graphic Designer*

We produce advertising for businesses across print and digital channels. This role is responsible for designing and producing those advertisements at volume, on deadlines set by our print schedule.

The work is primarily production design: building advertisements to established templates and specifications from written instructions and client-supplied materials. Client-supplied text, images, and copy are frequently weak. Improving that material into advertising that actually works is a core part of the role.

*What You Will Do As A Graphic Designer*

* Design print advertisements to established templates and specifications
* Prepare press-ready files, including bleed, CMYK conversion, resolution, and font handling
* Design email and social advertising creative
* Execute revisions and corrections to existing advertisements, frequently on short notice
* Proofread all work prior to release
* Enter and maintain advertisement data accurately
* Coordinate with the sales team on questions, revisions, and production issues
* Work directly with clients by phone and email to collect assets, make changes, clarify requirements, and confirm approval

*AI Tools*

We use AI tools in our production workflow and expect a working familiarity with them:

* Generative fill and expand, for resizing, extension, and image cleanup
* Drafting and iterating advertising copy with a language model, to strengthen copy and shorten design time

Deep expertise is not required.

Please describe the tools you use and how you apply them in your application.

**

*What You Will Bring As A Graphic Designer*

* A degree in graphic arts, design, or a related field is welcome but not required.
* 3+ years of experience in print and digital advertising design
* Advanced InDesign proficiency. InDesign is the primary program in our workflow and this requirement is firm
* Working proficiency in Photoshop and Illustrator
* Experience preparing files for commercial press
* English proficiency at a C1 level or higher, written and spoken. This role includes live phone calls with US-based clients, taking direction and confirming changes in real time
* Strong proofreading skills in English
* Ability to manage an independent workload against a production calendar
* Willingness to work from written direction and adapt to process changes
* Experience in direct mail, coupon, or offer-based advertising
* Experience designing within small, fixed ad dimensions and tight copy limits
* Familiarity with co-op or multi-advertiser print formats
* High-volume production experience, producing many advertisements for many small businesses rather than a few large campaigns
* Experience working with global and/or US based business teams
* Workspace: A quiet space to work, an internet connection of at least 30 Mbps download | 10 Mbps upload

*Portfolio*

Provide a portfolio of your design work. Print samples are required, and advertising work is preferred

title: Senior Environmental Graphic Designer
description:
At NewGround, we believe the right environment can change how people work, connect, and succeed. As a leading design and delivery firm, we partner with our clients to turn vision into reality. Our work is powered by clear communication, true collaboration, bold innovation, service-driven thinking, and a commitment to excellence, all centered in our defining core values. In the role of *Senior Environmental Graphic Designer* , you will help lead the development of meaningful branded experiences, translating ideas, stories, and identities into creative environmental graphics that strengthen the connection between people, brand, and place.

The *Senior Environmental Graphic Designer* is responsible for the design and management of graphic programs from concept through production, including brand identity development and expansion, exterior and interior signage, retail communications, wayfinding, artistic displays, and historical exhibits. This position provides experienced creative leadership across assigned projects, collaborates closely with multidisciplinary project teams, supports the professional development of junior staff, and helps ensure design solutions are delivered accurately, efficiently, and in alignment with client objectives and NewGround's standards for quality and excellence.

*KEY RESPONSIBILITIES*

* Lead the design and management of assigned graphic programs from concept through production.
* Develop innovative, original, and brand relevant design content.
* Participate in and contribute to internal project kickoffs, brainstorming sessions, design reviews, and other collaborative project meetings.
* Collaborate with the Design team in the development of presentation content and project storytelling.
* Present concepts and designs to internal teams, the Director of Branded Environments, and clients as appropriate.
* Obtain brand identity materials, historical assets, and other resources from clients as needed to support project development
* Coordinate and collaborate with the Creative Director, Branded Environments team, Program Management, Project Architects, Interior Designers, and other project team members.

* Collaborate with production designers, vendors, printers, installers, construction teams, and field staff to ensure accurate, timely, and cost effective execution of design intent.
* Assist with project scoping, budgeting, resource allocation, scheduling, and balancing departmental project needs.
* Support the professional development of junior staff through guidance, collaboration, feedback, and knowledge sharing.
* Attend and contribute to meetings with clients, consultants, contractors, and vendors as appropriate.
* Partner with the Director of Branded Environments to advance departmental and organizational goals and support the development, management, and continuous improvement of departmental processes.
* Contribute to Business Development efforts through project storytelling, presentations, creative expertise, and other support as appropriate.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

*EXPECTATIONS*

* Demonstrate a high level of creative thinking, design execution, and attention to detail while maintaining alignment with client objectives, brand standards, and project requirements.
* Communicate and present ideas clearly, confidently, and professionally to internal teams, clients, consultants, contractors, vendors, and other project stakeholders.
* Provide experienced creative guidance while collaborating effectively with designers and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Demonstrate initiative, accountability, organization, adaptability, and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Anticipate project needs, identify potential challenges, and work collaboratively to develop practical and creative solutions.
* Contribute positively to the development of junior staff, departmental processes, workplace culture, and the overall effectiveness of the Branded Environments team.
* Foster a positive, collaborative environment that encourages ideas, constructive feedback, professional growth, and NewGround's core values.
* Maintain a strong commitment to quality, client service, continuous improvement, and successful execution of design intent.
* Travel up to 30%, or as needed, to support client meetings, project needs, installations, and other business requirements.

* Four to eight years of professional experience as a Graphic Designer, Environmental Graphic Designer, or in a related design role.
* Bachelor of Arts, Bachelor of Fine Arts, or degree in Visual Communications, Graphic Design, or a related discipline preferred.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, and Acrobat, with continued development of Adobe Creative Suite expertise.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft platforms, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Strong knowledge of graphic design principles, environmental graphics, branding, production processes, media, and current design trends.
* Advanced knowledge of production processes and experience working with third party printers, vendors, fabricators, and installers.
* Experience in a creative agency, architecture firm, multidisciplinary design environment, or in house design team preferred.

Freelance collaboration with the opportunity to become a long-term contractor.

Flexible, fully remote work on your own schedule.

Award-winning 24/7/365 customer support? Check. A platform trusted by growing brands and seasoned pros alike? Absolutely. The idea that “great marketing needs to be expensive”? Our 150,000+ customers prove that wrong every day.

title: Software Engineer, New Grad

*This is a fully remote position* , open to candidates based in India.

*Pay:* $180,000–$250,000/yr

*Job Type:* Full-time

*Location* : Remote

This is a fullstack software engineering role designed for recent graduates and early-career engineers looking to accelerate their growth by building production systems. You'll contribute to — and grow into owning — core internal platform capabilities and product features end-to-end.

You'll work across internal tools, services, workflows, and AI-powered products that support our engineering, operations, and recruiting platforms. As you grow, you'll take increasing ownership of critical systems while collaborating closely with experienced engineers.

*What You'll Own*

* Contribute to the design and development of end-to-end fullstack systems powering critical internal workflows and platform capabilities.
* Build clean, maintainable backend services and APIs while learning scalable engineering best practices.
* Develop high-quality frontend interfaces used by internal teams and end users.
* Participate in data modeling and database optimization efforts, including schema design and query performance.
* Collaborate with product, operations, and design teams to translate ideas into reliable, production-ready features.
* Improve engineering quality through code reviews, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement.

description:
*About usHighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.
*
Our peopleWith over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.
*
Our impactEvery month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.
We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
*
Role Overview:As the Staff Product Manager for HardPhones, SIP, IVR, and Call Center, you will own the strategy, execution, and architectural evolution of HighLevel's enterprise voice and contact center infrastructure. You will lead the products and platforms that power SIP communications, physical IP phones, IVR experiences, voice routing, our multi-provider communications middleware, and native Call Center (CCaaS) features.

You will define the roadmap for building a carrier-agnostic voice platform that enables reliable, scalable, and intelligent voice communications across multiple CPaaS providers. Crucially, this scope extends into Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS). You will architect and scale our native Call Center features, developing sophisticated routing logic, agent workspaces, and queue management systems.

This role sits at the intersection of communications infrastructure, telecom engineering, voice automation, contact center operations, and platform scale. You will partner closely with Engineering, Operations, Product, Support, and external communication providers to build the next generation of HighLevel's voice platform.
*
Key Responsibilities:*

* Own the vision, strategy and execution for HighLevel's HardPhone, SIP, IVR, Call Center and Enterprise Voice platforms.
* Build a scalable, provider-agnostic communications platform that abstracts multiple CPaaS providers through a unified architecture.
* Architect and scale sophisticated Automatic Call Distributor (ACD) capabilities, including skills-based routing, priority queues, ring groups, overflow rules, business hours and failover logic.
* Design intuitive softphone experiences across web and mobile, along with real-time supervisor dashboards for monitoring, coaching and workforce management.
* Own the complete lifecycle of HardPhone provisioning, including Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP), remote configuration, firmware management, inventory management and device lifecycle operations.
* Drive the evolution of IVR and Voice AI, including drag-and-drop workflow builders, conversational AI, speech recognition, call transcription, agent assistance, and call summarization.
* Build enterprise telephony capabilities including call recording, voicemail, conferencing, whisper/barge, monitoring, queue management and compliance recording.
* Define extensible Voice APIs, SDKs, webhooks and event frameworks that enable seamless integrations with third-party applications and ecosystem partners.
* Lead customer migration initiatives, including provider migrations, number portability, hosted phone onboarding, and enterprise telephony transitions, while minimizing customer disruption.
* Partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Compliance, Support and Go-to-Market teams to deliver highly reliable, globally scalable voice products.
* Establish and monitor platform KPIs including call completion rates, SIP reliability, provisioning success, IVR containment, routing efficiency, call quality (MOS), queue abandonment, agent utilization, billing accuracy, platform availability and customer satisfaction (CSAT).
* Develop and execute the long-term roadmap for enterprise telephony, AI-powered communications, multi-vendor architecture and next-generation voice experiences, ensuring HighLevel maintains competitive parity and platform leadership.

*Requirement:*

* 8+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of communications, telecommunications, voice infrastructure, CPaaS, CCaaS or enterprise platform products.
* Deep understanding of SIP, RTP, WebRTC, VoIP, IVR, enterprise telephony, and contact center ecosystems.
* Proven experience building communications infrastructure or voice platform products at scale, including Automatic Call Distributor (ACD), intelligent routing and Call Center functionality.
* Strong understanding of SIP endpoint management, HardPhone provisioning, remote device management, and telephony lifecycle management.
* Experience working directly with CPaaS providers, telecom operators, hardware vendors, or communications infrastructure platforms.
* Experience building multi-provider routing, abstraction layers, middleware, or API-first platform products.
* Experience designing scalable multi-tenant platforms and highly available distributed systems serving enterprise customers.
* Strong understanding of intelligent routing, least-cost routing (LCR), provider redundancy, failover mechanisms, and global telephony architecture.
* Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills, with experience defining platform KPIs and using analytics to drive product strategy.
* Demonstrated ability to define long-term platform strategy, influence executive stakeholders, and lead cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Infrastructure, Finance, Operations, and Go-to-Market teams.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and prioritization skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.

*Nice-to-Have:*

* Familiarity with SIP infrastructure technologies.
* Experience building conversational AI, speech recognition, voice automation, AI-powered call routing or agent assist capabilities.
* Familiarity with STIR/SHAKEN, CNAM, E911, number portability, hosted numbers (BYOC/BYON), and regulatory compliance across global telephony markets.
* Experience building contact center (CCaaS) capabilities such as workforce management, quality monitoring, call recording, coaching, and supervisor tools.
* Experience working with event-driven architectures, APIs, SDKs, and developer platforms for communications products.
* Understanding of enterprise security, privacy, and compliance requirements for voice platforms, including GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or similar standards.

*Core KPIs:*

* Voice Platform Reliability – SIP session success rate, call completion rate, provider failover success.
* Call Center Efficiency – Queue Abandonment Rate, Average Handle Time (AHT), Agent Utilization.
* HardPhone Provisioning – Device onboarding success rate, provisioning time, firmware deployment success.
* IVR Performance – IVR containment rate, workflow completion, conversational AI adoption.
* Routing Efficiency – Least-cost routing optimization, latency reduction, provider utilization.

*Why Join HighLevel?At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company. Join us at High Level, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.*****

- Demonstrated ability to balance execution and velocity with in-depth research, statistical understanding, and scalable design.

- Track record of mentoring and investing in the development of scientists, engineers, and peers.

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Accounts team’s mission is to make Miro the nerve center for innovation inside the world’s largest companies. We partner with Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises to help them accelerate product development, improve cross-functional alignment, and transform how teams move from strategy to execution.

This team sits at the center of Miro’s evolution from a collaboration product to an AI-powered innovation workspace. Our Strategic AEs operate as account CEOs, leading cross-functional account teams across Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Value Advisory, Professional Services, Product, Marketing, Partners, and executive leadership.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Winning in Strategic Accounts is not about managing a territory or closing isolated deals. It is about building multi-year account strategies, identifying the customer’s most important business initiatives, and expanding Miro into mission-critical workflows across Product, Engineering, Design, IT, Operations, and transformation teams.

As a Strategic AE, you will own a focused portfolio of Miro’s largest enterprise customers. You will be expected to understand each account’s industry context, operating model, executive priorities, political landscape, renewal dynamics, and expansion potential. You will create pipeline through disciplined account-based execution, build executive alignment around measurable outcomes, and orchestrate Miro’s internal resources to turn strategic opportunities into durable enterprise partnerships.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

→Own a portfolio of named strategic accounts

Develop and execute deep account strategies across 3–10 global enterprise customers. Identify priority business initiatives, critical workflows, executive buyers, Champions, renewal moments, competitive risks, and multi-product expansion opportunities.

→Drive workflow-led expansion

Position Miro around high-value enterprise workflows such as product strategy, roadmapping, customer discovery, prototyping, planning, agile execution, technical diagramming, portfolio visibility, and innovation governance. Connect Miro’s platform to measurable customer outcomes, including faster product cycles, stronger alignment, improved productivity, and better execution across distributed teams.

→Build executive alignment and business cases

Engage senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Design, IT, Transformation, Finance, and the C-suite. Create compelling business cases that tie Miro to named customer initiatives, quantified pain, strategic priorities, and long-term value realization.

→Orchestrate complex account teams

Lead cross-functional PODs across Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Value Advisory, Professional Services, Product, Marketing, Partners, BDRs, and senior leadership. Align the team around clear account objectives, executive engagement plans, validation events, and expansion plays.

→Create and manage strategic pipeline

Maintain a disciplined account-based pipeline generation motion. Use executive outreach, customer workshops, field marketing, partner collaboration, BDR support, and renewal planning to stay multiple quarters ahead on pipeline coverage.

→Operate with rigorous sales discipline

Apply MEDDPICC and Command of the Message at an expert level. Build customer-validated problem statements, develop real Champions, secure Economic Buyer access, quantify business impact, and use mutual plans to drive complex opportunities forward.

→Shape how Miro wins in the enterprise

Bring field intelligence back to Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and leadership. Help refine Miro’s enterprise narrative, identify repeatable expansion patterns, mentor peers, and contribute to regional go-to-market strategy.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

10+ years of SaaS sales experience, including significant experience selling to Fortune 500 / Global 2000 enterprises with 10,000+ employees.

Proven success owning a small number of strategic named accounts and driving complex expansion motions across multiple business units, geographies, personas, and executive stakeholders.

Track record closing and expanding $250K–$1M+ enterprise opportunities, ideally including multi-product, multi-year, or transformation-oriented deals.

Strong ability to build executive relationships across Product, Engineering, Design, IT, Transformation, Finance, and C-level stakeholders.

Deep MEDDPICC and Command of the Message discipline, including strong qualification, Champion development, Economic Buyer engagement, quantified pain, decision-process management, and value-based selling.

Experience orchestrating cross-functional deal teams across SE, CS, Services, Value Advisory, Product, Marketing, Partners, BDRs, and executive sponsors.

Strong account planning discipline, with the ability to translate customer strategy into named initiatives, workflow opportunities, stakeholder maps, pipeline plans, and measurable expansion outcomes.

Comfort operating in complex, ambiguous enterprise environments where success requires persistence, business acumen, internal leadership, and the ability to create belief with both customers and internal teams.

AI fluency and curiosity, with a track record of leveraging AI tools to improve account research, stakeholder mapping, territory strategy, opportunity planning, customer insights, and overall sales productivity.

What's in it for you

We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. - Design, develop, execute, and maintain test cases and test scripts for functional, regression, integration, and system testing

description:

URL: http://bbemarketing.com/

We’re looking for a creative, curious designer who can turn entertainment and sports industry data into compelling social content. You’ll come up with ideas, identify relevant news, create graphics, write captions, and check the information before it’s published.

Our audience includes entertainment and sports professionals. We need someone who understands what would make these people stop, read, share, or join the conversation.

What You’ll Do

- Generate original content ideas. Find interesting angles in our data and industry developments, including infographics, comparisons, agency breakdowns, rankings, and recurring series. Bring ideas proactively and experiment with new formats.

- Create the graphics yourself. Design clear, engaging infographics, carousels, and news graphics that communicate information effectively and look polished on social media.

- Choose the right news stories. Review incoming industry news and decide which stories matter to our audience, why they matter, and how we should present them.

- Write the copy. Create headlines, on-graphic text, hooks, and captions in clear, confident English suited to an industry-professional audience.

- Review researchers’ work. Check the data and supporting sources provided by our research team. Verify names, agency relationships, dates, totals, percentages, and other details. Flag inconsistencies and work with researchers to resolve them.

- Own the final quality check. Make sure the graphic and caption match the verified data, the headline is supported, and the finished post is accurate and easy to understand.

- Manage the content calendar. Balance planned content with timely responses to relevant industry news.

- Learn from performance. Review what resonates with our audience and use those insights to improve future content.

What We’re Looking For

- A strong graphic design portfolio, especially infographics, editorial graphics, social media carousels, or other information-focused content.

- The ability to take a post from initial idea through design, caption writing, and final review.

- Strong creative and editorial judgment. You can look at a dataset or news story, identify an interesting angle, and explain why our audience would care.

- Excellent written English, including the ability to make complex information clear and concise.

- Strong attention to detail and comfort working with spreadsheets, checking percentages, and reviewing sources.

- Proficiency in the design tools needed to produce polished graphics and organized, editable files.

- Initiative and curiosity. You regularly bring forward ideas, explore possibilities, and improve concepts through feedback.

- Strong organization, reliable communication, and the ability to manage deadlines independently.

title: Course Writer and Editor: UX, UI, and AI
description:
Headquarters: Denmark

URL: https://ixdf.org/about/careers

You're the one people trust with the words, whether you're writing them or fixing them. You noticed that you loved it, and that you were unusually good at it. You turn rough, complex ideas into words people understand.

Now you get the opportunity to work with some of the most respected designers alive, and help share their knowledge with hundreds of thousands of learners around the world.

A great hook pulls your readers in, makes them see themselves in the topic, and shows them why it matters in their lives. That's your craft. Abstract ideas don't stay abstract for long, because you find the example that makes an idea concrete. You're structured and systematic, yet creative, and you'll rewrite a sentence six times until it says exactly what you mean.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

If you're also curious about how great design and the responsible use of AI improve people's lives, read on. As one of our Course Writers and Editors, you'll shape how our courses and Master Classes read and flow.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes include Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads at Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe.

You’ll be involved in all stages of course and Master Class creation, including key decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you to take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. You’ll be in a team with minimal distance between word and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education
IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us take online education to new heights and make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, we’re not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team
We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

-
Our Course Writers and Editors: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the user’s perspective. This is the role described here.

-
Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI: lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

-
Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.

We’re a flexible team, and you’ll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Writer and Editor, own how our courses and Master Classes read: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish. Our Education Designers hand you the structure and the exercises, and they'll often hand you draft headings and hooks along with them. The final wording is yours. You'll work closely with our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, the Education Designers, and the Course Directors, and you'll have a real say in what we make. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

-
Be a core part of our Editorial Team. You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create educational content for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with skills in timeless, human-centered design and AI.

-
Make an impact as you decide how every course sounds. The title people want to click, the first paragraph that hooks them, the on-screen words that make our learners remember and apply what our experts teach. Our Education Designers create the structure and draft the headings, hooks, and quizzes. You finalize the scripts, hooks, headings, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish, and you give proactive feedback on the structure.

-
You don't need a design background. Most of our writers and editors start without one, and that can be an advantage because you're coming to design the way many of our learners do. In your first year you'll learn it from the inside, working through it sentence by sentence with the people who teach it, until you know what a course participant needs.

-
Write for a diverse, global audience. Some of our courses and Master Classes serve experienced designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields, and many are not reading in their first language. Often, you'll write for all of them at the same time. Getting that balance right without watering anything down is a rewarding editorial challenge.

-
Be the voice of IxDF. Our reputation lives in every sentence we publish, and many of those sentences will be yours. Represent a global movement dedicated to design education, and take pride in it. It's a big responsibility, and a rewarding one.

-
Set and raise the standard for our assessments, so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests. Our Education Designers decide what a question has to test. You write the wording that does both.

-
Balance the big picture with the smaller details. Expect to focus on one large course creation project per month, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published. You'll also write and edit articles, course descriptions, and supporting material, and help our Growth team and our two founders get the voice right in campaigns and social copy.

-
Turn expert material into lessons. Once you've built an understanding of design, you'll take a one-hour Master Class transcript and the learning goals for what the lesson must teach, then turn the strongest sections into a finished lesson. We produce 3 Master Classes per month, so new expert material arrives continuously.

-
Our courses combine written and video lessons. You'll work closely with the video team, giving constructive feedback on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from.

-
Find room for improvement by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios learners produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Small, incremental edits are why our material surpasses even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do.

-
We’re committed to excellence, and we seek a like-minded enthusiast to join us. This role is not for the average. Ahead of you is a highly rewarding and enriching journey.

-
Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentation so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

-
You won't do this alone. You'll work with our Education Designers, Course Directors, your Team Lead, and our Co-Founder to pressure-test the material: you'll add what's missing, delete what's redundant, and suggest how to improve the structure. You'll be working with people who have anything from 4 to 40 years of design experience, ready to share their knowledge. We'll also help you upskill so you can grow a designer's eye alongside your editor's ear. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll develop personally and professionally.

-
We're proud to have assembled a remarkable team of unicorns who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

Do You Share IxDF's Vision?
People don't just buy our courses; they invest in a better version of themselves and a career they truly love. That's why every course we create and every sentence we write must do more than just inform. It must reflect the high-quality research and hands-on skills we teach.

-
Show the dream outcome: Help people imagine a future of creative, meaningful work, fulfillment, and impact through a career in design and AI.

-
Strengthen belief in success: Build confidence through real stories, practical case studies, and hands-on templates.

-
Overcome barriers: Write in a way that's crystal clear, human, and motivating. Connect and lead the way.

You'll educate, inspire, energize, and support. Whether you write a course article or give editorial feedback on a video, you'll help designers thrive in the age of AI.

About You

-
You have at least 4 years of professional writing or editing experience.

-
What matters far more than the number is the quality of the work you can show us: a course, an article series, a set of scripts, documentation, a newsletter. We’re excited to hear what it was, why you wrote it the way you did, and how long it took you to create.

-
You're a master communicator with a sharp eye for detail and strong skills in language, tone, and flow.

-
You can take a complex idea and write it so a beginner gets it on the first read.

-
You know how to hook someone with a title and a first line, and you know the difference between a hook that's earned and a hook that's cheap.

-
You collaborate with AI in everything you do. You use AI to write, research, and create faster, and you know how to take human leadership, so the outcome is 100% yours and better than you could have created without AI.

-
You’re eager to help people build UX and UI skills because you know they’re more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

-
You can write for a career changer and for an experienced designer without losing either one.

-
You have an exceptional talent for creating structure, and you take pride in organizing processes and tasks in a way that's efficient and clear.

-
You're genuinely curious about UX and UI design, and you're motivated to learn how great design shapes experiences and solves problems.

-
You're genuinely curious about how AI is changing design work and design education, and you look for new ways to use it in your own work.

-
You're kind, and you have the social intelligence and empathy to engage well with very different kinds of people.

-
You're fluent in written and spoken English, your grammar is exact, and you understand the power of tone, brevity, and microcopy.

-
You take full ownership of your work and see it through. You move comfortably across ad hoc projects of varying complexity, and you stay consistent when the work turns repetitive.

-
You’re enthusiastic about learning by doing and are committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills.

-
You spot problems before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

-
You value teamwork, prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals and harmony in the workplace.

-
You work well with great responsibility and freedom inside a well-documented, structured system. Accuracy and attention to detail are key on an online learning platform, where every tag must be correct and every piece of text formatted to our upload system. It's in your nature to meticulously double-check that everything is in order.

-
You're self-motivated, and you love creative freedom, independent judgment, and the responsibility that comes with both.

-
You’re driven by the desire to make a positive impact in the world and to improve the lives of others.

-
You're located in a time zone between UTC+0 (London) and UTC+4 (Dubai), which covers Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

Bonus Points
None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

-
You've taught in classrooms or workshops, or you've created educational material.

-
You have your own blog or social media page where you create and share original content.

-
You’ve collaborated with video production teams.

-
You've written quiz or assessment questions.

-
You've worked with an LMS or an online learning platform.

-
You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in communications, journalism, literature, or a similar field.

What We Can Offer

-
A highly valued role: You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes.

-
Reach and impact that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field. Your words will be read year after year, by hundreds of thousands of people who build better careers and design a better world for all of us. An education you can't buy: free access to every IxDF course and Master Class, and a job that requires you to study the work of the best designers alive in order to edit it. Most people pay for this. You'll be paid for it.

-
Access: the designers whose books you'd normally buy are the people whose words you'll be shaping, and in some cases the people you'll be in a studio with.

-
Studio shoots: once you know our courses well, usually after your first year, you'll be a real asset on a studio production, and you'll be welcome to join us when we meet our experts in professional studios around the world. Some of us love that part and go every time; others keep travel to a minimum. Both work for us. On average we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

-
Autonomy: Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in. You decide how our courses read.

-
A global, purpose-driven team: Work remotely alongside passionate professionals from all over the world, united by a common mission to create the best possible design and AI education in the world and make it accessible for everyone.

-
Our co-founder and co-CEO, Rikke, will work closely with you. She and our other co-founder, Mads, built IxDF from nothing, with no investment capital, so we would stay free to make world-class design education affordable to everyone. She was the sole editor and video editor for many of our early years, so she's shaped our course planning, expert interviews, video shoots, and content editing from the inside. She's still hands-on in everything we do, and she still films educational videos herself, in places like the US, the North Pole, and Nepal.

-
A full-time position within a fully remote organization. Video-based collaboration with your colleagues from elsewhere on the planet, and we get together in person each year, on a team trip or a studio production.

-
Bi-weekly knowledge-sharing sessions and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work.

-
A work culture with no fluffy titles, political agendas, or corporate drama. Your colleagues value your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver. If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF.

-
A daily mission to help impact, empower, and enrich the lives of millions of people by creating affordable high-end design education for everyone across the planet. It'll be yours too.

-
A company where the distance between idea and execution is minimal. We're a highly agile organization with zero bureaucracy or corporate politics – and with exceptional order and efficiency.

-
A company culture where passion meets high performance and excellence. To help us improve the world, and yourself in the process, you'll need grit, strong work ethic, long-term thinking, and self-discipline.

-
We thrive because we have a hands-on attitude and a bias towards action as opposed to fluff-filled, unrealistic strategies. You'll need crisp execution skills yourself and the ability to impress your colleagues with concrete results, just like they'll impress you.

-
If you want even more opportunities to show the world what you can do, you’re in luck! When you're willing to do the hard work of learning and growing, then you’ll find virtually limitless opportunities with us.

-
We built online design education before people believed in it. AI is now changing what designers do, and they carry a bigger responsibility than ever. You'll be at the forefront of teaching designers to work with AI and to design responsibly for it. You'll help set a direction that shapes both the designers we teach and the people who use what they build. Together, we'll design a better world.

How to Learn More and Apply

To submit your application as well as learn more about our Work Culture and Values, please visit https://ixdf.org/about/careers

Please apply as soon as you can. We’re firm believers in “the sooner, the better” and we look forward to working with you!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ixdf-interaction-design-foundation-course-writer-and-editor-ux-ui-and-ai-1
