ABOUT THE TEAM

The Marketing team at Airwallex drives brand awareness and customer engagement through innovative and strategic campaigns. We work to communicate the value of our financial solutions, attract new customers, and strengthen relationships with existing ones. By leveraging data-driven insights and creative strategies, we ensure Airwallex stands out in a competitive market. Our team is passionate about telling the Airwallex story and supporting the company’s growth and success.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Most strategy roles hand you a slide deck. This one hands you the keys.

You'll get the kind of access most people wait a decade for: a direct line to the growth engine, work that spans every function, and the freedom to own ambiguous, high-stakes problems end to end.

And you won't do it the old way. We arm our people with AI to move faster than teams ten times our size, modeling, researching, and shipping at a pace that creates an unfair advantage.

If you want to do the best work of your career on problems that actually matter, build with us.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Own the lifecycle growth strategy for Airwallex’s self-serve small-business customers, helping them move from onboarding and KYC through activation, first transaction and deeper product adoption. You’ll turn customer, product and behavioural data into practical growth opportunities, then design and run evergreen campaigns, experiments, automations and AI-enabled workflows that improve conversion, go-live activation and expansion across products without dedicated sales coverage.

- Lead Lifecycle Strategy: Design the end-to-end lifecycle engagement and build scalable lifecycle journeys for self-serve customers in EMEA and products without dedicated sales coverage.

- Own Digital Channels for Self-Serve: Lead the strategy and operational health for email, push, and in-app messaging. Ensure these high-impact channels are optimized to deliver personalized engagement and consistent growth across managed regions.

- Drive End-to-End Campaign Execution: Transform high-level lifecycle strategies into high-performing programs. Design and optimise evergreen campaigns, experiments and automations that improve conversion, go-live activation and expansion. Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Data and regional teams to turn customer, product and behavioural data into measurable growth opportunities

- Regional Funnel Accountability: Take full ownership of E2E growth metrics within your region. Leverage deep-dive quantitative analysis to identify high-impact opportunities for experimentation, ensuring data-driven decision-making at every touchpoint.

- Drive Regional Experimentation: Initiate and lead a high-velocity experimentation roadmap within your region, testing innovative tactics to uncover local growth levers and scale successful pilots into global frameworks.

- User-Centric Communication: Champion a "customer-first" messaging philosophy, delivering personalized and compelling content that resonates with users and reduces friction throughout the lifecycle.

WHO YOU ARE

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

- 5+ years of experience leading growth initiatives across the customer lifecycle.

- Experience in a product-led growth (PLG) environment, with a strong customer-first and customer-centric mindset.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign, product and behavioural data, identify trends, prioritize campaign ideas and develop data-backed recommendations.

- Experience working with high volumes of data and communicating clearly through data and analytics.

- Hands-on experience designing and executing lifecycle or CRM programmes that drive customer conversion, activation, retention and product adoption.

- Experience running A/B tests and applying structured experimentation to improve performance.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

- Clear and structured communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners, especially across Sales, Marketing and Data Science.

- A proactive and results-oriented approach, with a track record of getting things done and delivering impact in fast-paced environments.

- Bachelor’s degree.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in B2B, SaaS, fintech or product-led growth; high-scale B2C experience will also be considered.

- Experience with AI-enabled tools, agents, workflow automation or connecting multiple tools to improve execution.

- Experience with SQL or close collaboration with data teams.

- Hands-on experience in lifecycle or CRM marketing.

- Experience working across global markets and turning regional initiatives into scalable global programmes.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

- You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

- You default to action. You'd rather course-correct in motion than wait for perfect clarity.

- You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager and Evangelist
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

BUILD WHATS NEXT FOR AI AND DATA IN KOREA

This is not a typical product marketing role.

At Snowflake, you’ll help shape how the Korea market understands, adopts, and accelerates the future of the AI Data Cloud. You’ll sit at the intersection of product marketing, technical evangelism, go-to-market strategy, and industry influence-bringing together customers, partners, sellers, and marketers around one of the most important technology shifts of our time.

If you thrive on turning complex technology into market momentum, love being in front of customers and communities, and want to make a visible impact in one of the world’s most exciting growth regions, this role was built for you.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

Snowflake is scaling fast, and Korea is a strategic growth market. In this role, you won’t just support the business-you’ll help define how Snowflake wins in-region.

You’ll be the voice of Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud across the market, translating innovation into relevance for customers, shaping go-to-market strategy, and influencing adoption at scale. With more than 13,000 customers already using Snowflake to modernize data access, accelerate analytics, and unlock data-driven insight, you’ll help drive the next wave of growth powered by AI.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead Snowflake’s Product Marketing and Evangelism efforts across the Korea market.

- Build and execute go-to-market strategies and innovative programs that strengthen Snowflake’s market position and accelerate growth.

- Evangelize the AI Data Cloud through speaking engagements, social media, video, and community engagement across customers, partners, media, analysts, and broader industry audiences.

- Develop compelling messaging, content, and sales enablement assets for Snowflake teams and partner teams.

- Partner cross-functionally with demand generation, content marketing, sales, product management, and global stakeholders to align and execute regional go-to-market plans.

- Own and lead end-to-end product launches for Koreaa, including internal and external briefings, spokesperson support, enablement content and sessions, and alignment with marketing and PR on launch campaigns and events.

- Build market and competitive intelligence, and serve as a thought leader on the trends shaping the industry.

- Champion diversity and belonging as part of how we work, lead, and grow as a company.

WHAT MAKES YOU A STAND OUT

You’re equal parts strategist, storyteller, and technologist. You can move comfortably from executive conversations to technical narratives, from launch planning to live evangelism, and from market insight to field execution.

Our ideal candidate brings:

- 12-15+ years of experience spanning technology, product, and market-facing roles, with strong exposure to data management and AI/ML.

- Strong cross-functional leadership skills, including the ability to influence without authority and work effectively with senior stakeholders.

- Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging internal leaders, external stakeholders, and public audiences.

- Excellent writing skills, with the ability to distill complex ideas into clear, compelling presentations and plans.

- A track record of working on complex data solutions and demonstrating architectural or technical leadership.

- An analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret information and turn it into actionable insight.

- Strong understanding of both the technical foundations and business value of modern data technologies, across on-premises and cloud environments.

- Experience with database products.

- A BS/BA or equivalent practical experience.

- A proven history of partnering with field GTM teams—across marketing, sales, and solution engineering—to create high-impact content and messaging that connects with diverse personas, from technical practitioners to C-level executives like the CMO, CFO, and CRO.

- Deep insight into the unique technological landscape and market dynamics across Korea

- Professional fluency in regional languages including Bahasa, Mandarin, Cantonese or Thai is strongly advantageous, complementing English proficiency.

WHY SNOWFLAKE

Snowflake is growing quickly, and we’re building a team of people who challenge conventional thinking, move with urgency, and create meaningful impact. We care deeply about our people, customers, culture, and values-and we’re looking for people with the growth mindset to solve for today while building for the future.

If you want a role with visibility, influence, and the opportunity to shape one of the most important categories in enterprise technology, this is your moment.

READY TO MAKE YOUR IMPACT

Join Snowflake and help define how the AI Data Cloud wins in Korea.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Key Art Design Intern
description:
The Refinery is an entertainment marketing agency specializing in key art, digital, and social creative. We’re looking for a talented, visually driven designer who is passionate about film and television, excited by entertainment design, and curious about the rapidly evolving role of AI in the creative process. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable pushing pixels in Photoshop and experimenting with new creative technology.

*This is a 3-month, full-time paid internship designed for an emerging designer who wants hands-on experience.* You’ll work closely with our team to learn the many stages of developing entertainment creative—from initial concepts and visual exploration through polished comps and final production.

*If selected to move forward to the first round, you’ll receive a link to The Refinery’s Key Art Design Internship Contest, where you’ll be given a brief to design a movie poster. This creative exercise gives us an opportunity to see how you approach concepting, composition, storytelling,*

*What You’ll Do*

* Support Art Directors and Creative Directors in developing key art for entertainment projects.
* Create thumbnails, concepts, layouts, typography, moodboards, and visual treatments from creative direction and references.
* Build and refine comps using Photoshop, provided assets, photography, stock, and other source material.
* Assist with compositing, masking, cleanup, color adjustments, revisions, and mechanical preparation.
* Prepare concept and sketch presentations and contribute creative ideas to pitch decks.
* Follow established file organization, naming, production, and color-conversion workflows.
* Incorporate generative AI into concept development, visual exploration, compositing, and image-making workflows.
* Use AI tools to rapidly prototype creative directions, visual treatments, and image variations.
* Support hybrid AI + Photoshop workflows, including inpainting, outpainting, asset replacement, enhancement, and upscaling.
* Develop a critical eye for AI artifacts and maintain consistency in composition, lighting, texture, depth of field, and visual style.
* Stay current with emerging AI tools and creative technologies, and explore new ways to improve creative workflows and adapt artwork across formats.

description:

---------

Intern - Product Design - Bothell, WA - Summer 2027

Job Description
---------------

*Intern – Product Design – Bothell, WA – Summer 2027*

Are you interested in an Internship opportunity with Philips? We welcome individuals who are currently pursuing an undergraduate (BS) and/or graduate (MS) degree to participate in a 3 month paid intern opportunities at our site in Bothell, WA. *Your role:*

As a Design Intern working with our Oral Healthcare Payer and Digital Solutions, you will support UX Designers to design user experience for behavior change programs, mobile, and desktop software products: translating business requirements and user needs into interaction frameworks, concepts, scenarios, workflows, and wireframes. You will conduct desktop research, create user interface concepts, mockups, prototypes, and documentation with the product teams.

* *Product concept* : Conduct and lead analysis of user and stakeholder needs. Create frameworks and interaction concepts across domains. Define role of product within a broader ecosystem. Establish design principles and guide teams with clarity and accuracy.
* *Information architecture* : Create information architectures and workflows. Create functional designs for application screens (wireframes and prototypes).
* *Interface & usability* : Apply and define interface and interaction principles in conjunction with guidance from existing design language documentation. Define and apply usability principles specific to the contexts of use.
* *Visualization:* Crafting experiences, prototypes, and demos that together create a great experience in alignment with the Philips brand and design language. Use appropriate skills (sketching, prototyping and specification) to define and communicate interaction concepts to marketing, software development, and customers.
* *Technical* : Identification of opportunities and constraints inherent in technology and platform decisions and ability to illuminate the impact of technology choices on user experience and product quality.

*You're the right fit if:*

* Currently enrolled in a BS major studying User Experience Design, Product Design, or related design competencies
* You are interested in designing for consumer space, mobile health, or healthcare domain
* You are passionate about the positive impact design can make for people and business
* You have a positive outlook, and a collaborative nature

* You can see ideas through to fruition

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help improve the lives of others.

* Learn more about our business.

US work authorization is a precondition of employment. The company will not consider candidates who require sponsorship for a work-authorized visa, now or in the future.

title: Junior Business Development Associate
description:
*Intro*
-------

At MO, we challenge the status quo and help government leaders shape the future. We engineer scalable, human-centered solutions that help agencies deliver their mission faster and better. Our teams blend product, design, AI, data, and modern software practices to modernize legacy systems, build new digital platforms, and deliver mission-ready products that drive sustainable change.

We live by our values—Integrity, Excellence, Courage and Curiosity. They guide how we build, collaborate, and lead. From cloud infrastructure and data engineering to AI integration and service design, we connect technology and experience to deliver outcomes that scale.

We’re building a company where technologists, designers, and builders can serve the mission, grow their craft, and help shape the future of digital government. At MO, your work doesn’t just make a difference—it advances the mission and helps build a more capable, trusted, and human government.

We believe AI is fundamentally changing how we build solutions and drive outcomes for our clients. We thoughtfully leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery, improve decision-making, reduce manual work, and produce higher-quality deliverables. We value curiosity, experimentation, and a willingness to continuously evolve how we work as AI capabilities advance.

*Overview*
----------

MO is seeking a Junior Business Development Associate to support federal growth across AI, digital modernization, product, design, data, cloud, and mission technology markets. This role will support pipeline research, CRM management, opportunity tracking, partner and customer research, capture preparation, and weekly growth operations.

The ideal candidate is organized, curious, accountable, and eager to learn federal business development in a fast-moving GovCon environment. Success in this role requires disciplined follow-through, clean data, strong research, clear communication, and the ability to help MO build a more consistent, measurable, and actionable federal growth engine.

What You'll Do
--------------

Pipeline and CRM Management
---------------------------

*

Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records for opportunities, contacts, partners, agencies, contract vehicles, and customer interactions.

*

Track opportunity stages, due dates, next steps, owners, estimated values, probability, and capture status.

*

Support weekly pipeline reviews by preparing updates, identifying stale opportunities, and flagging missing information.

*

Ensure every qualified opportunity has a clear owner, next action, timeline, and decision point.

*

Maintain clean records for opportunities across VA, DHA, HHS (CMS/CDC), and other federal markets aligned to MO’s growth strategy.

Market and Opportunity Research
-------------------------------

*

Conduct research on federal agencies, programs, contract vehicles, recompetes, forecasts, budgets, incumbents, and procurement activity.

*

Monitor sources such as SAM.gov, agency forecasts, SPRUCE (VA), GSA, NASA SEWP, FPDS, GovWin or similar tools, and relevant industry updates.

*

Research target customers, mission priorities, organizational structures, vendor ecosystems, and buying patterns.

*

Identify opportunities aligned to MO’s capabilities in AI, product, design, data, cloud, service design, software engineering, and digital modernization.

*

Prepare concise research summaries for BD and leadership review.

Capture and Pursuit Support
---------------------------

*

Support early-stage capture activities by gathering information on customers, incumbents, competitors, partners, and contract history.

*

Assist with opportunity qualification using MO’s bid/no-bid criteria.

*

Help prepare pursuit briefs, call plans, partner profiles, customer summaries, and meeting prep materials.

*

Track action items from capture meetings and ensure follow-up items are documented and completed.

*

Support coordination between BD, capture, proposal, delivery, and executive stakeholders.

Partner and Customer Engagement Support
---------------------------------------

*

Identify and track strategic partners, small business partners, primes, subcontractors, technology partners, and teaming opportunities.

*

Support customer and partner meeting preparation, including background research, agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up documentation.

*

Maintain contact lists and relationship maps for key agencies and accounts.

*

Draft follow-up emails, meeting notes, and outreach materials as needed.

*

Support conference, industry day, and networking event preparation and follow-up.

What You'll Bring
-----------------

*

Experience or exposure to federal contracting, GovCon, business development, capture, proposals, or agency research.

*

Familiarity with SAM.gov, FPDS, GovWin, GSA eBuy, NASA SEWP, agency forecasts, or similar platforms.

*

Experience using HubSpot, Salesforce, Monday.com, Microsoft Dynamics, Airtable, or similar CRM/project management systems.

*

Understanding of VA, HHS, CMS, DHA, CDC, or related health and civilian markets.

*

Interest in AI, digital transformation, software delivery, product strategy, human-centered design, data, or cloud modernization.

*

Experience working in a structured, metrics-driven, accountability-focused business environment.

Perks
-----

*

A dynamic, high-trust environment with a diverse, mission-driven team

*

Competitive compensation commensurate with experience

*

Meaningful opportunities for career growth and learning

*

Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, and vision)

*

401(k) with company match
-------------------------

*

Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
-----------------------------

*

Company-sponsored short- and long-term disability, plus life insurance

*

Company-sponsored parental leave
--------------------------------

*We're MO*
----------

We build with purpose, deliver with precision, and measure success by the impact we create — for our clients, our teams, and the mission. All MO leaders are expected to lead with humility, embody our core values in their leadership, and to hold their team accountable to the same. MO leaders are expected to ensure we are always growing by tackling hard problems, being strategic, and learning from others.

If you’re excited to work with us but not sure you check every box, apply anyway! You may be just right for this role or another one.

MO is an equal opportunity employer. All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of any required background, reference, or security clearance checks consistent with applicable law and client contract requirements. title: Generalist, Product-Minded Software Engineer (Junior - Mid level)
description:
At Epignosis our mission is simple yet bold: To make learning technologies accessible to every business, regardless of geography, sector, or company size. And we've been doing just that for more than two decades, empowering millions of people to grow, learn, and thrive through technology that's both powerful and affordable.

We're rapidly becoming one of Greece's largest SaaS companies, serving 12,000+ companies and 22+ million learners worldwide with solutions like TalentLMS (an award-winning cloud LMS built for simplicity), eFront (an enterprise LMS), TalentCards (a mobile app for deskless training), and TalentHR (a lightweight HRIS for people operations).

Our success is built on a team that believes that work should matter — not only to you, but to the world around you. We're looking for people who light up when solving hard problems, who care deeply about their craft, and who want to build something that genuinely helps people grow.

We're looking for exceptional junior and mid-level Software Engineers who think beyond the code, care about the products they build, and love turning ideas into polished experiences. You'll thrive here if you're self-motivated and creative, combine strong engineering judgment with product thinking, learn quickly, and have a genuine feel for great UX and high-quality software.

You'll join a team that moves at a fast pace, delivering high-quality software while making thoughtful decisions that stand the test of time. We expect strong engineering skills for your experience level and will give you the opportunity to work hands-on with AI and emerging technologies.

Your work will span everything from early prototypes to products used by tens of thousands of organizations and millions of people worldwide — directly shaping how they learn, work, and grow.

*Responsibilities*
------------------

As a Generalist, Product-minded Software Engineer you will:

* Own product development end-to-end—from understanding the problem and shaping the solution to building, launching, and iterating.
* Understand and analyze user and stakeholder feedback, translating it into practical product improvements.
* Turn ambiguous ideas into clear priorities, focused scopes, and working prototypes.
* Shape exceptional UI and user experiences across the product, with attention to clarity, consistency, and craft.
* Build across the stack, taking on frontend, backend, integrations, and infrastructure as needed.
* Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, quality, and scope to deliver value quickly.
* Collaborate closely with design, product, and business teams, contributing to both what we build and how we build it.
* Ship reliable, intuitive experiences and own testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.
* Measure how products perform, learn from real usage, and take responsibility for outcomes.

*Requirements*

* *Be a builder.* Turn ideas into working software—and have projects to show for it.

* *Be an exceptional engineer for your experience level.
*

*Bonus points for:*

* Experience across multiple technologies and programming paradigms.
* Familiarity with asynchronous programming.
* Open-source contributions you can point us to.

*Benefits*

* *Competitive salary and bonuses.* Strong base pay plus performance rewards at personal, team, and company levels.

* *Daily meals and food allowance.* Breakfast and catered lunch at our offices, plus a monthly meal allowance you control.
* *Commute covered.* OASA transport card or parking space near the office, whichever works for your commute.
* *Hybrid work*. Work from home and from our modern office in the heart of Athens.
* *Learning budget for your growth*. Coaching sessions, conferences, university degrees, creative pursuits — we fund it. Continuous learning is our mission and that includes you.

title: Junior Influence Marketing manager
description:
Softsich is an international product tech company that develops scalable B2B digital platforms. We’re on the lookout for a proactive Junior Influencer Marketing Manager who’s ready to grow with us and support our influencer marketing initiatives.
From finding relevant creators to tracking campaign results, you’ll help keep our influencer campaigns organized and running smoothly. Working closely with your Team Lead, you’ll gain practical experience in influencer communication, performance analysis, and campaign operations.

Your key responsibilities will include:

* Researching and selecting influencers based on campaign requirements, audience relevance, and platform fit.
* Maintaining structured influencer lists and delivering research tasks on time.
* Communicating with influencers, providing clear updates, and coordinating campaign materials and deadlines.
* Supporting campaign launches and daily execution, ensuring all required materials are ready.
* Updating campaign trackers, verifying data accuracy, and preparing reports according to internal procedures.
* Monitoring traffic and campaign metrics, flagging performance drops or unusual results, and escalating issues promptly.
* Reviewing campaign performance with your Team Lead to identify trends and understand results.
* Preparing and double-checking payment information for accurate and timely submission.
* Keeping documentation up to date and following internal workflows and standard operating procedures.

* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate with different teams and stakeholders.

* A proactive approach to solving problems, flagging blockers, and asking for clarification.

title: AI Developer
description:

This role is ideal for a junior to mid-level full stack developer with experience in the Microsoft .NET ecosystem (C#, .NET) and modern web technologies, such as React or Angular. In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, testing, and delivery of scalable applications that integrate AI capabilities to improve business processes, analytics, and user experiences. * Application Development: Build and enhance full-stack AI applications using .NET and modern front-end frameworks under the guidance of senior engineers.

* Front-End Development: Develop responsive, user-friendly interfaces using modern web technologies, with a preference for React.
* Agile Delivery: Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, development tasks, testing, and iterative product delivery.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with data scientists, analysts, developers, and product stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions.

* Documentation: Maintain technical documentation, implementation notes, and knowledge transfer materials for supported features.

* Proficient use of applicable technology
* Ability to follow technical instructions and guidelines
* Ability to document daily activities and system functions
* Able to work in team environment
* Demonstrated ability to communicate verbally and in writing throughout all levels of organization both internally and externally
* Ability to travel as required by business and on-call availability
*

Able to lift up to 50 lbs

title: Junior Backend Developer
description:
Hello,
We are called People More because we treat our employees with respect, but also because the projects we work on are for people and should be easy and pleasant to use. We are technological, but we look at the bigger picture :)
The company is made up of people with a huge client base in the country and abroad, for whom we build projects from scratch (UX, UI, frontend, backend, mobile) or in part. We work directly for our clients and also support our partners in their own solutions. This ensures a wide range of projects and the ability to change! We work with clients all over the world.
For the project that we are working on with our partner, we are looking for *Junior Backend Developer.*

*Your duties will include:*

* Support the development of backend services using Kotlin and Spring Boot
* Participate in implementing new functionalities within the Accounting Engine platform
* Collaborate with senior developers and architects on technical solutions
* Contribute to code reviews and software quality initiatives
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and technical discussions
* Write and maintain automated tests
* Learn and apply best engineering practices, including TDD and Domain-Driven Design
* Work in an AI-assisted software development environment

*Requirements that must be met:*

* Commercial experience in software development (1-3 years preferred)
* Knowledge of Kotlin or strong Java experience with willingness to work in Kotlin
* Understanding of Spring Boot fundamentals
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs and microservices
* Familiarity with relational databases and SQL
* Understanding of software engineering principles and clean code
* Very good English and Polish

*What we offer:*

* We are open and honest and we solve problems instead of generating them.
* Maybe it’s obvious, but we really respect our employees and associates. We used to be software developers, too, and we appreciate that job!
* A small team
* An international working environment and international projects
* Private medical care
* Sports card
* Training courses
* Work that is 100% remote (unless you prefer another system)

We have an office in Krakow, but if you like to work remotely, that’s absolutely fine. We are OK with fully remote work. For us, you can be located anywhere. :)

*Why it’s a good idea to work with People More?*

* If you are not satisfied with your work or your tasks, we’ll find a way out together!
* If you get bored, we will offer you a new product and new, fascinating tasks
* We will work on your brand together: you will get an opportunity to attend conferences, including as a speaker, and we will help you publish in recognized magazines and online
* We will facilitate your access to challenges that are usually difficult to get
* At any time, you can talk directly to the board of People More—we talk your language because the company’s founders are software developers and designers!

*What does the recruitment process look like?*

* A friendly remote initial interview
* A remote technical talk
* The decision to work together!

description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Junior System Administrator (Monitoring Team) based in United States.*

As a Junior System Administrator, you’ll help maintain the health and reliability of products and infrastructure in a monitoring-focused operational environment. You’ll respond to a high volume of alerts, investigate issues using monitoring tools, and resolve or escalate incidents according to established procedures. The role offers hands-on exposure to Linux and Windows environments, as well as monitoring platforms such as Grafana and Zabbix. You’ll work alongside primary and senior duty administrators and contribute to incident response when critical issues arise. Accountabilities
----------------

* Monitor the health and performance of products and infrastructure, responding to approximately 150–250 alerts during a typical shift.

* Follow runbooks, operational instructions, and established processes when performing first-level troubleshooting.
* Troubleshoot Linux and Windows servers and investigate common infrastructure and monitoring issues.
* Support primary and senior duty administrators during day-to-day operations and participate in response activities during major incidents.
* Take responsibility for primary duty shifts independently after completing the onboarding process.
* Collaborate effectively with a distributed team working across multiple locations and time zones.
* Maintain accurate and responsible operational practices, paying close attention to alerts, incidents, and follow-up actions.

Requirements
------------

* 2+ years of experience in system administration, infrastructure monitoring, NOC/duty operations, technical support, or a related technical role.
* Confident Linux command-line skills, including connecting to systems through SSH/VPN, navigating hosts, and executing Bash scripts.
* Hands-on user-level experience with *Zabbix and Grafana* , including working with metrics, hosts, host groups, and dashboards.
* Solid understanding of monitoring fundamentals and basic infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Experience using Jira and Confluence for issue tracking, documentation, and team collaboration.
* Ability and willingness to work a rotating schedule, including a standard 5/2 schedule with 8-hour shifts and 2/2 day-and-night shifts when covering for the primary duty administrator.
* English proficiency at *B1 level or higher* , with sufficient communication skills to collaborate with an international technical team.
* Strong attention to detail and a responsible, reliable approach to operational work.
* Ability to follow established procedures while remaining capable of identifying issues and escalating them appropriately.
* Willingness to learn, develop technical expertise, and take increasing ownership of monitoring and infrastructure operations.

Benefits

* Fully remote, full-time work opportunity.
* Initial compensation level or salary range shared with candidates during the recruitment process before employment begins.

* *7 wellness days* per year for personal, household, or recovery needs.

The position also provides exposure to monthly bookkeeping, financial documentation, and asset management. You will work closely with finance and other internal teams, contributing to organized and reliable financial processes. * Prepare monthly payslips and verify that all payroll information is complete and accurate.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams to confirm salary details, adjustments, and other payroll information.
* Ensure payslips are delivered accurately and on time to employees, talent, and clients.
* Assist the Chief Accountant with monthly bookkeeping and other accounting-related activities.
* Prepare finance-related documents, letters, and official orders using established internal templates.
* Maintain and regularly update the fixed asset register.
* Support the finance team with administrative, documentation, and other operational tasks as required.

* Previous experience in finance, accounting, operations, or a related field.
* Final-year students and recent graduates with a background in Finance are also encouraged to apply.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* High level of attention to detail and accuracy, particularly when handling financial and payroll information.
* Strong sense of responsibility, ownership, reliability, and proactive approach to work.

title: Junior IT Administrator
description:
*About the Role*

We're hiring a Junior IT Administrator to support the IT operations of two growing businesses across Australia and the US. This is a hands-on, early-career role for someone who is technically grounded, security-conscious, and eager to build real-world experience across Microsoft 365 administration, SaaS platform management, Power Automate, telephony, and IT security.

You'll work directly with management and department heads across time zones. Training will be provided for specific platforms and internal processes — but you need to be self-directed, detail-oriented, and capable of handling confidential information with good judgment.

This role grows with you. As your skills develop, so will your responsibilities.

*What You'll Do*

*** Microsoft 365 Administration*

* Manage users, groups, licenses, mailboxes, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive access
* Handle onboarding and offboarding in M365 and connected systems
* Troubleshoot M365 issues — Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, MFA, login, and access
* Maintain accurate records of user accounts, permissions, and access changes

*SaaS Platform Administration*

* Administer Zoho Vault (password vault): user access, shared vaults, credential hygiene
* Monitor and maintain Backupify (SaaS backup): backup health, alerts, and recovery requests
* Administer telephony platforms (Dialpad / VoipLine): user setup, call routing, troubleshooting

*Power Automate*

* Support creation, monitoring, and troubleshooting of Power Automate Cloud Flows and Desktop automations
* Document flow logic, triggers, dependencies, and expected outputs
* Help identify manual processes that can be converted into structured workflows

*IT Security & BYOD Checks*

* Conduct basic security checks for remote team members on BYOD devices
* Verify MFA setup, antivirus protection, OS updates, and secure storage practices
* Create security awareness materials: phishing guides, password hygiene, safe browsing
* Escalate security concerns or policy violations to management

*Documentation & General Support*

* Maintain SOPs, user guides, onboarding/offboarding checklists, and knowledge base articles
* Provide remote IT support across departments, time zones, and both companies
* Coordinate with external vendors when escalation is required

*What We're Looking For*

*Required*

* Intermediate working knowledge of Microsoft 365 Administration (users, groups, licenses, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
* Familiarity with Power Automate Cloud Flows or Power Automate Desktop
* Good understanding of IT security basics: MFA, password hygiene, phishing awareness, antivirus
* Strong documentation skills and attention to detail
* Clear written communication — especially for non-technical audiences
* Ability to work independently and know when to escalate
* Comfortable reporting directly to management and communicating updates professionally
* Comfort using time-tracking tool (Hubstaff)

*Preferred (Nice to Have)*

* Experience with Zoho Vault, LastPass, 1Password, Bitwarden, or similar password vault tools
* Experience with Backupify or other SaaS backup platforms
* Experience with Dialpad, VoipLine, RingCentral, or similar telephony systems
* Background supporting remote or international teams
* Experience creating SOPs, troubleshooting guides, or knowledge base articles
* Basic knowledge of DNS/email authentication (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC) — a plus, not required at hire
* Interest in automation, AI tools, and SaaS operations
* BYOD & Remote Work Requirements

*This is a fully remote role. You must provide and maintain your own equipment. At minimum:*

* Reliable laptop or desktop suitable for daily IT administration work
* Stable high-speed internet connection (backup connection preferred)
* Updated operating system and active antivirus/endpoint security
* Ability to use MFA/authenticator apps and secure password management
* Willingness to comply with company BYOD, confidentiality, and data security policies

*Contractor Rate Reference*

Rates below are for 42 hrs/week (approx. 182 hrs/month) with no statutory Philippine benefits. Pure contractor arrangement — the rate quoted is the all-in cost to the contractor.

*Junior Contractor – Independent Level*

Suitable for someone with around 2–4 years of experience who can work independently, has solid Microsoft 365 administration skills, and has experience or awareness working with SaaS tools. The expected monthly rate is AUD 1,093–1,300.

*Strong Junior Contractor – Advanced Level*

Suitable for someone with around 3–6 years of experience who requires minimal supervision and has experience with Power Automate and multiple SaaS tools. The expected monthly rate is AUD 1,400–1,900.

title: Social Media Designer — B2B Posts & Visual Content
description:
Day Translations is hiring a remote Social Media Designer to create clear, distinctive visual content for our global language-services brand. This is an ongoing contractor opportunity for a designer who can turn strong ideas into effective social posts.

You will work with our Social Media Manager, who owns the content calendar, research, copy, publishing and community engagement. Your focus is designing the visual assets and delivering files that are ready to publish.

WHAT YOU WILL CREATE
• Branded social graphics, multi-slide carousels, infographics, quote cards, campaign visuals, thumbnails and covers.
• Platform-specific versions for channels such as LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, Pinterest and YouTube.
• Reusable templates that keep our visual identity consistent while allowing fresh, original ideas.
• Simple motion graphics or short-form video assets if those are among your skills. Motion and video editing are helpful extras, not prerequisites for this design role.

HOW WE WILL WORK
• The manager supplies a clear brief, approved copy, audience, objective and deadline. You propose a visual direction and flag any missing information.
• Create professional, human-made designs that communicate translation, interpreting, localization, language and culture clearly. Use original work and properly licensed assets; avoid generic AI-generated final artwork.
• Apply our brand guidelines consistently, including typography, color, spacing and visual hierarchy. Keep text readable on mobile and check contrast, spelling, alignment, safe areas and export quality.
• Deliver publish-ready exports in the agreed dimensions, plus organized editable source files and any necessary asset or font information.
• Incorporate agreed feedback, track versions and meet the publishing calendar’s deadlines.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
• A portfolio showing strong social-media design, typography, layout and visual storytelling. B2B or professional-services work is especially useful.
• Confidence in your preferred professional design tools, such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma or Canva. You do not need to use every tool; the quality of your work and editable handoff matter most.
• Ability to turn business concepts into approachable visuals, follow a brief, explain design decisions and collaborate reliably in English.
• Individual applicants who will personally create the work. Tell us your availability, time zone and usual turnaround times.

HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED
On-time delivery of the agreed assets; accurate approved copy; consistent brand styling; readable, correctly sized exports; organized editable source files; and completed agreed revisions. The manager handles posting and performance reporting, with your support in testing better creative ideas.

HOW TO APPLY
Submit your résumé and portfolio, including three examples you personally designed. Explain your contribution and include a carousel or multi-slide post if available. Share the tools you use, whether you also offer motion or video editing, your monthly compensation expectation in USD, weekly availability and start date.

Complete the application questions and the required 60-second Loom video in English. Briefly show one portfolio item, explain why you made the main design choices, and describe how you take ownership of your work and the company’s success. You may add an optional second section in another language. Make sure the link can be viewed without requesting access.

We are separately hiring a Social Media Manager. This application is for the person who designs the posts.

title: Packaging Designer– Games
description:
*The Opportunity:*

As a Packaging Designer, you'll help shape the visual identity of some of the world's most recognizable games and entertainment brands. From the earliest concept sketches through final production, you'll create packaging, games content and supporting creative assets that connect with consumers and tell a compelling brand story.

You'll collaborate with cross-functional partners across Marketing, Product Design, Engineering, and our Asia development teams to bring innovative ideas to life. Whether you're presenting concepts to leadership, art directing photography, building 3D package mockups, or refining the smallest design detail, you'll play an important role in creating packaging that stands out on shelf and online.

We're looking for a designer who is equal parts creative thinker, visual storyteller, and collaborative teammate—someone who's excited to push ideas forward while balancing business objectives, consumer insights, and production realities.

*What Your Impact Will Be:*

* Design innovative packaging from concept through production for Mattel Games brands and licensed properties.
* Develop compelling visual storytelling that strengthens brand identity and drives consumer engagement.
* Create packaging and product graphics, digital assets for both retail and e-commerce experiences.
* Partner with Marketing, Product Design, Engineering, Copywriting, and Brand teams to bring cohesive creative solutions to life.
* Art direct illustration, retouching, and external creative partners.
* Create 3D package visualizations and physical mockups to communicate design intent.
* Collaborate closely with global development teams to ensure design quality from concept through production.
* Stay connected to consumer, design, entertainment, and cultural trends to inspire fresh creative solutions.

*What We’re Looking For:*

* 3+ years of experience in packaging, graphic, or consumer product design.
* Degree in Graphic Design, Industrial Design, Visual Communication, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Exceptional visual design skills with a strong portfolio demonstrating packaging and brand storytelling.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign).
* Experience with 3D visualization tools such as Adobe Dimension, Blender, or similar.
* Strong understanding of typography, color, composition, and consumer-focused design.
* Ability to balance creativity with production requirements and business objectives.
* Comfortable presenting ideas and receiving constructive feedback in a collaborative environment.
* Excellent communication, organization, and project management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Curiosity about trends in design, gaming, entertainment, culture, and retail.
* Passion for creating memorable experiences for consumers through thoughtful design.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. Also, interested in signing up for job alerts? Do so here!

*How We Work:*
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

* *We collaborate:* Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* *We innovate:* At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Design taste comes first. We’re looking for a designer with strong visual judgment, solid design
fundamentals, and a clear understanding of UI/UX. You should know what makes an interface feel clear, coherent, and well considered, and be able to explain the decisions behind it.

We design and build with AI, directly in working interfaces. No Figma, no traditional handoff. Designers ultimately own the frontend that goes into production.

We use React, but prior React expertise is not required. We can teach the technical workflow. What matters most is your design judgment, curiosity, and willingness to turn ideas into working products.

*What you’ll own*

*Design direction and visual craft*
Bring a clear point of view to typography, layout, spacing, hierarchy, color, and motion. Explore distinct directions and refine them into a coherent experience. Recognize when a design is genuinely considered rather than simply polished.

*UI/UX and interaction design*
Understand the user’s task, organize information clearly, and simplify complex flows. Consider navigation, feedback, accessibility, and interaction states, not just the ideal screenshot.

*AI-assisted exploration and execution*
Use AI to explore ideas, create interfaces, and accelerate iteration. Critique and improve the output rather than accepting the first result. Your design judgment should drive the tools.

*From design to production*
Develop the actual components and interfaces that ship, with guidance as you learn our technical workflow. Stay involved through release and keep improving the experience rather than handing it off to be rebuilt.

*Quality and consistency*
Build reusable patterns, test how the interface feels in use, and catch inconsistencies before review. Turn recurring feedback into clear design rules rather than fixing the same issue repeatedly.

*What you’ll bring*

*Strong design taste and fundamentals.* A well-developed eye for composition, typography, spacing, proportion, color, and visual hierarchy. You can explain why a design works and identify what needs refinement.

*Solid UI/UX understanding.* You design around user needs, clear navigation, and understandable
interactions. You can balance visual expression with usability and accessibility.

*Experience creating with AI.* You’ve made design work using AI and can show it. The tools, medium, and project type are open; thoughtful personal experiments are welcome.

*Curiosity and willingness to learn.* You want to turn designs into working products and learn the technical side with support. A frontend engineering background is not a prerequisite.

*Ownership and self-critique.* You review your own work, respond thoughtfully to feedback, and bring recommendations, not just variations. You notice problems and follow through on improvements. We care about the quality of your thinking and work, not a particular degree, previous title, or list of tools.

*How we work*

Explore, build, use, critique, and refine. We review working experiences and welcome thoughtful
disagreement. We’ll help you learn our implementation process; strong fundamentals and the ability to make good design decisions are what we’re hiring for.

*What success looks like*
As you learn the workflow, you become able to take a design from an idea to a usable, polished production interface. Your work brings stronger visual consistency, clearer interactions, and fewer issues that need to be identified for you.

*What we offer:*

* *Founding-team seniority.* You work directly with our CEO, CDO, COO, and CTO.
* *Work that ships.* Our cycle time is weeks, not quarters. You will see your work in production and hear from the people who use it.
* *Fortune 500 access.* Clients include names like Disney, Caterpillar, Ryanair, Zalando, Norstella, and Insight Partners.
* *Senior Advisor network* from Google, Walmart, Salesforce, Omnicom, Hilton, and others — available to pressure-test your thinking.
* *Competitive salary + options + outcome-linked bonus* tied to the engagements you support.
* *Remote-first setup (EU or US).* Flexibility where it earns its keep.

----------------
🚀 Hiring Process
----------------

* Interview with Steven (hiring manager) - 1h
* Test task (brief and design using AI during the call) - 2h
* Founder’s interview- 1h

title: Events Graphic Designer (PH)
description:

Our purpose is simple: to unlock sustainable success for aesthetic entrepreneurs, at every stage of their journey.

-------------------------
*Events Graphic Designer*
-------------------------

We're looking for a highly creative, detail-oriented Events Graphic Designer to support all event-related design production, creative formatting, and visual asset optimization for our Event Creative Team. You'll work closely with our internal Creative, Events, and Practice Success teams to deliver high-quality design materials — for social media, event campaigns, print assets, and templates — for live events across a fast-growing network of aesthetics practices.

You'll also be stepping into a role with real room to grow: from executing day-to-day creative requests, to owning entire template systems and workflows that scale across our full event calendar.

-----------------------------
*Our objectives for the role*
-----------------------------

*

Own end-to-end creative production for assigned events — social, SMS, print, and signage — delivering on-brand assets independently and within expected turnaround times.

*

Build and scale reusable creative systems (e.g., "Event in a Box" template sets, modular templates) that reduce repetitive design work across a growing event calendar.

*

Organize and expand our reusable visual asset library into a clean, accessible system the whole team can pull from.

*

Drive measurable, ongoing improvements in creative turnaround time and output volume as the practice network grows — without a corresponding increase in headcount.

*

Proactively bring new creative trends, formats, and ideas to the team, and contribute informed recommendations to quarterly campaign planning.

--------------------
*We're looking for:*
--------------------

*

Hands-on design experience (Canva or similar) producing social graphics, SMS funnel images, and print assets, with strong command of platform specs across Instagram (feed/stories/reels), web, and print.

*

A track record of independently managing a high-volume creative request queue, hitting turnaround expectations without sacrificing quality, brand alignment, or copy accuracy.

*

Experience building reusable, template-based design systems that scale beyond a single event or project.

*

Comfort incorporating AI-assisted creative tools into a core design workflow.

*

Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the judgment to work independently on routine requests while proactively flagging timelines, bottlenecks, and creative needs to the Meta/Creative team.

*

A genuine interest in creative variety — you're energized by touching dozens of distinct event themes rather than repeating the same brand deck.

--------------
*Why Join us?*
--------------

*

If you're a designer who gets bored doing the same brand deck over and over, this is the opposite of that. You'll touch dozens of live events across a growing network of aesthetics practices, every one with its own theme, energy, and story to tell visually.

*

You'll work hands-on with AI creative tools as part of your core workflow, and you'll see your work go live fast — on social, on SMS, in print, at real events — not sit in review.

*

Above all, we're in this to empower small business owners to own and grow their businesses. If you succeed, Med Spas will remain the opportunity for independent owner-operators instead of being dominated by a small number of large chains. If that speaks to you, speak to us.

*

We have much left to build. But given the market feedback we're getting and our founding team's company-building experience, we think we are writing the first chapters of a real success story.

*

Competitive salary

At Moxie, we believe in creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, trusted, and included. Our team lives by our values: *act as owners, give more than we take, move with speed and care, and simplify and learn every day.*

We welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply. If you require any accommodations to fully participate in the interview process, please let us know, we’re happy to assist.

* Own the money movement product surface across on-ramps, off-ramps, pay-ins, payouts, and the underlying payment infrastructure.

* Own the end-to-end performance and evolution of money movement capabilities, from customer-facing flows through settlement and reconciliation.

* 4+ years of product management experience for Senior-level consideration, or 7+ years for Lead-level consideration.
* Proven experience shipping payment rails in emerging-market or high-growth fintech environments.
* Hands-on experience with payment methods such as on-ramps, off-ramps, ACH, SWIFT, wire transfers, or card acquiring.
* Experience managing payment products across multiple PSPs or banking partners simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of settlement, reconciliation, treasury, liquidity, transaction processing, and payment operations.
* Comfortable combining customer-facing product ownership with operational and financial infrastructure responsibilities.

description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Singapore

The Opportunity: Be Part of Our Growth Team

Our Growth Team sits at the heart of Airwallex’s mission, focusing on user acquisition and strategic market expansion. We leverage data and cutting-edge technologies to craft seamless, intuitive experiences that help millions of users discover, engage with, and benefit from our products.

From new-user funnels to onboarding optimizations, our Growth team is all about experimentation, rapid iteration, and driving sustainable business impact. Whether it’s designing scalable architectures for high-traffic pages, building robust A/B testing frameworks, or integrating global marketing platforms, the Growth team’s contributions directly shape how we attract and retain customers worldwide.

- Work with cross-functional teams—including Design, Product, and Marketing—to deliver delightful user experiences.

- Develop rapid prototypes to validate hypotheses about user acquisition and engagement.

- Champion frontend best practices, ensuring high standards of code quality, security, and performance.

- Integrate secure coding practices and frameworks to protect user data, maintain high standards of privacy, and comply with global regulations.

- Proactively identify and address potential vulnerabilities, preventing unauthorized access and safeguarding critical data.

- Data-Driven Mindset: You thrive on metrics and experiments. A/B testing, funnel optimization, and hypothesis-driven development are second nature to you.

- User-Focused Innovator: You understand that product success hinges on a seamless user experience. You embrace user research and leverage empathy in design thinking.

- Collaborative Leader: You excel in a team environment, providing mentorship and supporting peers. You enjoy working with cross-functional partners to achieve common goals.

- Adaptable & Curious: You stay ahead of the curve, learning new technologies and industry best practices. When the fintech landscape shifts, you shift with it—strategically and swiftly.

- Security-Conscious: You recognize the importance of safeguarding user data and proactively embed security principles in your development process.

- Ownership Mentality: You’re self-motivated, eager to take on new challenges, and consistently push boundaries to deliver impactful solutions.

Why Join Us

- Impact: Contribute directly to the core engine of user growth in a company that is reshaping global financial services.

- Growth: Advance your career with opportunities to spearhead projects, explore emerging technologies, and mentor rising talent.

- Innovation: Join a team that boldly experiments, challenges the status quo, and continuously evolves to lead in an ever-changing fintech landscape.

- Culture: Work in an inclusive, open environment that values diverse ideas and collaboration.

- Benefits: Enjoy competitive compensation, comprehensive health coverage, and a flexible work environment designed to support work-life balance.

Ready to Shape the Future of Global Finance?

Join us in our journey to remove barriers to entry for businesses around the world, one innovative product at a time. Apply now and help us build the future of fintech together!

description:

About the team

T:0’s mission is to make finance run itself. We are turning accounting into autonomous infrastructure that closes the books, reconciles, and reports continuously, so the people who own the outcome can stop worrying about busy work and start focusing on strategic decisions. We're a small, elite, builder-focused team inside Airwallex, moving at startup speed with a scaled company's infrastructure and distribution behind us.

What you’ll do

You own what we say about T:0 and who we say it to — and then you write it, ship it, and put it in front of customers. This is a production role as much as a thinking role. In a given week you might rewrite the homepage, cut a two-minute product walkthrough, draft the newsletter, build a competitive one-pager for a live deal, and interview three customers. The positioning work matters enormously but it only matters once it exists somewhere a customer can see it. You'll work directly with our CEO, Product teams, Chief of Staff, Growth Marketer, and Founding GTM hire.

This role is based in San Francisco.

Responsibilities:

- Own the ICP and know the customer better than anyone here. Run customer interviews and win/loss conversations continuously, not as a quarterly project. Sit in on sales calls. Turn what you hear into messaging that lands, and tell the product team what you're learning.

- Own positioning and messaging. Build the core narrative — what T:0 is, why it matters, why it's different — and the frameworks that keep the website, sales deck, launches, and content saying the same thing. Then test it: real message testing against real prospects, not internal debate.

- Write the website. You own the copy on every page. Our Growth Marketer owns the page builds, the tests, and the traffic — you own the words.

- Make product content. Product walkthroughs, explainers, demo videos, launch assets. Scrappy and fast in-house is the default; we'll bring in outside help when something genuinely needs production polish. You should be comfortable recording a clean screen walkthrough yourself.

- Run product launches. Build a repeatable launch motion and run it — narrative, assets, internal enablement, timing, and a real read on whether the launch worked.

- Own the blog and SEO content strategy. Decide what we should rank for, write the briefs, and write the pieces that matter. Growth handles technical SEO and distribution.

- Write the T:0 newsletter. Growth grows the list; you make it worth reading.

- Own competitive. Know who we're up against, keep the comparison current, and arm the sales team with something they can actually use on a call.

- Build sales enablement materials. One-pagers, objection handling, competitive battlecards, demo narratives. Our Founding GTM hire runs enablement with the Airwallex sales org — you build what they run.

- Own pricing and packaging. Partner with the CEO and Product on how we price, what's in each tier, and how we explain it.

- Collect and use customer proof. Quotes, reviews, case studies, logos. Get them, and get them in front of buyers.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

- 5+ years in product marketing, or an adjacent role where you personally owned positioning and shipped the assets that came out of it.

- You're an exceptional writer. This is the single highest bar in the process. We'll ask for samples and a short written exercise.

- A track record of high output. We'll ask you to walk us through what you shipped in a recent 90-day stretch — we're looking for volume and velocity, not one flagship deliverable.

- You've done real customer research and can show how a specific insight changed specific messaging.

- You can hold your own on a technical product. You don't need a finance or accounting background, but you need to be someone who gets deep on how things work rather than staying at the surface.

- You operate without a brief. Nobody here will hand you a prioritized queue.

Preferred qualifications:

- Fintech, accounting, or founder-finance-stack experience.

- You've been the first or only product marketer somewhere.

- Comfortable recording and lightly editing your own product videos.

- You use AI tools aggressively — research, drafting, competitive monitoring, content iteration.

- Experience marketing to founders and early-stage operators.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
💙 ABOUT BOUNCE...

Bounce is building cloud storage for the physical world, starting with the largest global luggage storage network in existence. Bounce’s marketplace connects travelers with 30,000+ small business locations worldwide for hyper-local short term baggage storage. With more locations globally than Burger King, and more locations in New York City than Starbucks, Bounce has served 3M+ users and stored 10M+ bags, and paid over $10M to small business partners.

To achieve this, Bounce is a fast-paced and scrappy team. We believe that experimentation fuels innovation, so we move quickly, testing new ideas and adapting in real time. If you’re ready to make an impact in a high-energy, close-knit, and collaborative environment - Bounce is the place where you can move fast, think big, and shape the future of travel. Join us as we make the world a lighter, more accessible place! Bounce has been named the Inc5000’s fastest-growing travel company in the USA in 2024 and is proudly backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, and Sapphire. (Learn more about Bounce's Series B HERE https://techcrunch.com/2024/11/12/bounce-grabs-19m-to-expand-its-traveller-convenience-network/ and also learn about our Japan Expansion HERE https://techcrunch.com/2024/11/12/bounce-grabs-19m-to-expand-its-traveller-convenience-network/)

ABOUT THE ROLE…

Bounce is seeking a Full Stack Engineer to join our Lisbon office. This role will play a pivotal part in crafting new products atop our platform and expanding the efficacy of the Bounce marketplace.

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will take ownership of real-world customer problems, crafting intelligent and efficient solutions across both backend and frontend. You will have the opportunity to own projects in various areas, such as our consumer apps, growth engines, and partner tools.

We are looking for a generalist who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys owning a feature from concept to completion, contributing across the entire technology stack.

Our ultimate goal is to build a large-scale, shared technology platform that supports various products capable of rapid iteration and exploration.

HOW PRODUCT GETS BUILT AT BOUNCE

At Bounce, we focus on serving our customers and partners rather than solely on technological innovation.

We work in fast-paced 1-week cycles. Projects are usually scoped down to fit into one or two cycles. Projects are led by individuals, but are a shared effort across the entire team. There will always be aspects of any project that will require collaboration, feedback, and guidance—we expect you to ask for help.

An ideal candidate is excited by all aspects of this software-building process, not just writing code. We’re a small team that thrives off of individuals who can take features from an idea to live on production. This is not a role where issues will be assigned to you and you churn through them.

WHERE YOU COME IN…

- Collaborate with global teams to support new product innovations and business initiatives, continuously exploring new ventures from both an engineering and product standpoint.

- Write high-quality code for our mobile and web applications.

- Assume strong ownership of products and services, and continuously improve and maintain existing code and architecture.

- Work in a fast-paced environment and shoulder the responsibility and commitment of the production environment.

- Work with Elixir, React Native, Expo, React, NextJS, and Typescript, and introduce other technologies when beneficial.

- Bring a passion for staying on top of industry trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, and participating in internal and external technology communities.

YOUR PROFILE…

- 4+ years of relevant experience developing and shipping code for production systems

- Effectively integrates AI tools into daily operations to enhance productivity, while staying current with advancements in AI in software development practices.

- Generalist that strives for velocity and loves owning a feature from start to finish by contributing across the stack.

- Proficient coding skills in one or more of the following - Javascript, Typescript, Elixir, or Ruby.

- Experience with frontend frameworks and technologies, including but not limited to React, React Native, Javascript, CSS, etc.

- Proven experience in building maintainable and testable code bases, including API design and unit/integration testing techniques.

- Commitment to creating an exceptional end-user experience, with attention to the smallest details that can elevate their interaction with our platform.

- Current knowledge of relevant technologies and an ability to implement them effectively.

- Understanding of CI/CD pipelines.

- You're confident in leveraging AI tooling to elevate your productivity.

title: Senior Regional Marketing Manager

Miro is looking for an experienced and ambitious senior regional marketing manager to contribute to the strategy, execution and localized impact of our marketing efforts in North America. This is a critical role responsible for driving significant pipeline and revenue growth in a key market.

Reporting to the Head of Regional Marketing (AMER), you will collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, and all marketing functions to deliver high-performing regional marketing programs.

This person needs to identify pipeline gaps, create a strategy to fill the gap via field marketing programs, partner with the GTM team and internal marketing teams to execute the strategy, and relentlessly track and hunt the pipeline and meetings that come as a result through to closed-won revenue.

- Collaborate with digital marketing and demand generation teams to leverage digital tactics for field execution and event follow-up strategies

- Work closely with regional partners and the partner marketing team to incorporate the partner ecosystem into regional plan and field events

- Regularly report on regional performance metrics, campaign ROI, and pipeline contribution to GTM and marketing leaders.

- Own and manage the marketing budget for owned programs, demonstrating a strong ROI for all expenditures.

What you’ll need

- 7+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing

- A proven track record of designing and executing full-funnel marketing campaigns (online and offline) that result in measurable pipeline and revenue growth.

- Deep understanding of the AMER B2B technology landscape, buyer personas, and customer journey.

- Strong analytical skills and proficiency in using CRM (e.g., Salesforce) and marketing automation platforms (e.g., Marketo).

- Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams (Sales, Product, Global Marketing).

- Strong understanding of regional campaign management and measurement

- Outstanding skills in project management and prioritization

- Demonstrated ability to act decisively in ambiguous situations to move work forward effective

You'll have some examples of how you're using AI to maximize business impact today, the curiosity and confidence to test different agents, automations, and tools, and a drive to share successful approaches with the team. What's in it for you

We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.
