What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

We’re looking for Sales Development Representative to join our team covering the Nordics region coverage includes Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland.

In this role, you'll help drive Pleo’s growth and be part of the team responsible for expanding our footprint in spend management solutions as we scale our cutting-edge SaaS platform.

What you’ll be doing

As a Sales Development Representative you will:

- Build a pipeline through cold calling, social and email outreach to senior finance leaders.

- Qualify potential deals before passing them to Account Executives.

- Nurture relationships with Prospects.

- Use best in class tools for creative prospecting.

- Enable others and share best practices to learn as a team.

- Work towards achieving daily and weekly revenue targets and key performance

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- Previous professional experience in a customer-facing or sales-related role (preferably sales, finance, consulting)

- Driven and ambitious individual looking to grow quickly in sales

- Proactive and ready to take on own initiatives to drive results

- Comfortable with cold calling & getting out of your comfort zone

- Thrive on sales targets and constantly seek new ways to go the extra mile where needed

- A team player who goes out of their way to help colleagues succeed

- Entrepreneurial and creative mindset, ready to learn and grow every day

- Thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and excited to grow alongside the company

- Fluent in English (company language) and Danish or Swedish (Essential)

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

- You’ll report to our SDR Manager Europe and work closely with our in region Account Executives, as well as our marketing and partnerships teams. Our team of 4 is highly collaborative and dedicated to business growth.

How you’ll develop in this role

- In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

- Lead initiatives to drive impact in expanding Pleo’s presence in the Benelux market.

- Grow your skills in sales and outbound strategies, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale its operations across Benelux.

- We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in sales.

Show me the benefits!

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Access to LinkedIn Learning - acquire new skills, stay abreast of industry trends and fuel your personal and professional development continuously

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

2. An Interview with the Hiring Manager - 45 mins.

3. Our Pleo Challenge - 60 mins -  A case study/role play with our panel to demonstrate your ability

4. A bar raiser interview - 30 mins To allow you to showcase what extra value you can add to Pleo's growth journey!

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for SDRs, we received many applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

- CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

- Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

- Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Account Executive, Latam
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Our sales team is expanding and we are seeking a qualified Account Executive with expertise in the ability to manage and expand key accounts. In this role you will use your executive presence and sales skills to strategically manage and expand customers.

Your role will encompass prospecting, developing, and closing business within a timely manner while focusing on the clients’ requirements.

This role is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high visibility, high impact projects. You will be successful in this role if you are able to act with autonomy, take accountability and be open to new perspectives and ideas. Our team carries a deep curiosity to learn and are always looking for innovative ways to meet and exceed our customers needs.

AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

- Become an expert on Snowflake’s product and conduct discovery calls, customized demos, and presentations to prospective customers

- Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap to drive the Snowflake solution within the marketplace

- Prospect qualification and the development of new sales opportunities and ongoing revenue streams

- Gain trust, expand, and deepen sales opportunities with accounts in your region

- Achieve sales quotas for allocated accounts and/or territory on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory & account list

- Work closely with cross functional teams including sales engineering, professional services, marketing, legal and finance.

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

- 6+ years field sales experience with consistent success meeting or exceeding sales objectives selling technical solutions and software products into the enterprise market.

- A track record in expanding current accounts

- Demonstrable experience executing enterprise complex sales strategies and tactics within one of the following spaces Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Data Science and/or AI/ML

- A familiarity with solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities.

- The ability to build our product and company like it’s your own, specifically defining and executing sales plans to meet strategic & financial targets, leveraging industry, partner & Go-to-Market knowledge

- This ability to provide open, honest and respectful feedback creating an inclusive work environment

- A reputation for Making Each Other Better: Resulting in long standing relationships with internal cross functional partners and the ability to create an inclusive work environment

- Proven ability to independently manage, develop, and close new client relationships.

- Experience hitting multi million $ revenue targets on an annual basis.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Database Engineer II
description:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

JOB INTRODUCTION:

The Database Engineer II plays a key role in supporting and optimizing Tekion’s database environments. This role develops, maintains, and scales database solutions that ensure performance, availability, and security. It involves cross-functional collaboration, hands-on development, and growing ownership of key database operations.

KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Designs and implements database solutions, including schema changes, stored procedures, and indexing strategies.

- Performs performance tuning, query optimization, and diagnostics to resolve system bottlenecks.

- Monitors and manages database health, backups, and failover procedures across environments.

- Automates recurring maintenance and data processing tasks using SQL and scripting tools.

- Collaborates with development, DevOps, and product teams to align database design with application needs.

- Participates in code reviews, documentation, and the enforcement of best practices.

- Supports incident response and root cause analysis for database-related issues.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- 4–6 years of experience in database engineering or administration

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

- Proficiency in SQL, scripting (e.g., Python, Bash), and data management tools

- Experience with database performance tuning, monitoring, and recovery strategies

- Familiarity with relational and NoSQL platforms (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB)

- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work across engineering and infrastructure teams

PERKS & BENEFITS

- Opportunity to work with some of the smartest minds to solve complex challenges at scale.

- Impactful role in shaping and securing a global, cloud-native & AI driven platform.

- Innovative, collaborative, and fast-paced culture.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

As a Technical Program Manager, you'll be the execution engine for our engineering org's day-to-day operations. You'll own the operating cadence, manage critical initiatives from intake through launch, drive alignment and standardization across teams, and build the frameworks that help engineering leaders make faster, better-informed decisions. You're not an engineer, but you're deeply comfortable in an engineering environment—and you'll work across teams where you have no direct authority, moving things forward through clear thinking, reliable follow-through, and influence.

- Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

- Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

- Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

- Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

- Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/

ABOUT YOU

You have a track record of running cross-functional programs end-to-end—taking ownership from concept through execution and close, across teams where you didn't have direct authority.

You're comfortable operating in ambiguity and fast-paced change; you don't wait for a perfect process to exist, you build it as you go.

You're technically fluent with modern operations tools (Jira, Coda, Slack, modern AI tools) and can write clear technical documentation like architecture decision records without needing an engineer to translate for you.

You have experience building frameworks, intake systems, or governance models that teams actually used beyond their original scope—you know what sticks.

You've worked in or closely with engineering organizations, ideally in an operations capacity (running operating reviews, managing incidents, supporting org health and change).

You're data-comfortable, proactive, and good at communicating asynchronously and adjusting your message for different audiences—you keep people informed before they ask.

You're a generalist by nature, can pick up unfamiliar domains quickly, and have a low ego about what kind of work needs doing.

Bonus: You've done Atlassian or Jira administration, or you're comfortable learning tooling ecosystems quickly.

THINGS YOU’LL DO

- Establish and run the engineering operating cadence: stand up and facilitate monthly operating reviews, planning cycles, and cross-functional decision forums; maintain visibility into what's coming and what needs coordination.

- Design and manage the intake process for engineering initiatives: define what gets started, ensure every initiative has a clear goal, success metric, responsible team, and strategy alignment, and close the loop on outcomes.

- Drive standardization and reduce duplication across engineering teams: define shared templates, standards, and operating norms; track commitments across teams and follow through to completion.

- Partner on strengthening incident and operational excellence: support the maturation of incident management practices, postmortem discipline, and cross-team follow-through on action items.

- Steward engineering organization health and engagement: own the end-to-end cycle for engagement and pulse surveys, drive the cadence to close loops on feedback, and support the operational side of calibration and performance review cycles.

- Program-manage organizational changes and readiness for major shifts in how the org works; ensure operational prerequisites (access, provisioning, tooling) are addressed and that teams are ready to move.

- Run the product feedback and AI tooling governance loop: route product feedback with evidence to the right stakeholders; help establish how the engineering org makes decisions around autonomous AI actions against critical systems.

- Own current portfolio initiatives: stabilize and evolve systems like the changelog and results-tracking system, Product Readiness Framework, and design operating-model support—ensuring they actually solve the problems they were built to solve.

- Work closely with engineering leadership, engineering managers, product, and design to coordinate across zones and keep the org operating smoothly even as priorities shift.

HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. title: Brand Design Manager
description:
Headquarters: Armenia Yerevan, EMEA, Armenia

URL: http://replika.com

About ReplikaReplika is an AI companion loved by 35M+ users around the world. We’re redefining what it means to connect with technology – emotionally, intelligently, and personally. From mobile to VR, we’re building an experience that feels less like software and more like someone who gets you.
We’re scaling fast and taking on bold challenges to become the most human AI on the planet.
About the role

Brand Design ManagerWe’re building a brand-new product from scratch, and we need someone to design what it actually is — not the buttons, the product. This is a conceptual role: you invent the functions, the moments, the way the whole thing works and feels, from a blank page. You’re not polishing UI. You’re deciding what the product does and why it matters in someone’s life. Move fast, ship working concepts, learn, and go again. We care less about a perfect pixel and more about ideas nobody else would have had.
What You’ll Be Doing- Design the product itself, not just the interface — the functions, the experience, the way it works, invented from a blank page.

- Turn our AI and technical capabilities into functions that actually change someone’s day — their outlook, perspective, productivity, or the experiences they have.

- Bring the ideas. Unique concepts, new mechanics, things that don’t exist yet. This role lives or dies on originality.

- Ship working concepts fast. A rough thing people can feel beats a beautiful deck describing it. Prototype, test, learn, repeat.

- Hold the “one of a kind” bar — reject the obvious, the derivative, the good-enough, and push for the version only this product could be.

- Work directly with product, engineering, and the founders to take a concept from idea to something real in the product.

What We’re Looking For- A concept-first designer. You design what a product does and how it feels, not just how it looks. You’ve invented product experiences, not just executed someone else’s spec.

- Genuinely original ideas. You can point to things you’ve made that were new — concepts other people hadn’t thought of, that actually worked.

- A deep sense for great products. You know what makes something amazing and one of a kind versus competent and forgettable, and you can say exactly why.

- You turn capability into meaning. Handed a raw technical ability — say, a new AI capability — you can see the function it should become, the one that improves a user’s life.

- A bias for speed. You ship working concepts fast and learn from them. You don’t disappear for weeks to perfect a pixel.

- Comfortable at ground zero. Blank page, no patterns, no spec — that’s where you do your best work.

- Hands-on and self-directed. You bring the ideas and drive them. Nobody’s hovering.

Bonus Points- Experience with AI, conversational, or emotionally engaging products — turning novel technology into human experiences.

- You’ve taken a product concept from nothing to something people actually used and loved.

- A body of work that shows range and originality — concepts, prototypes, products — not just screens.

- You prototype in whatever gets the idea across fastest: Figma, motion, code, paper, Keynote, whatever works.

- You already use AI tools to explore ideas and move faster.

What You’ll Get- Competitive compensation.

- Flexible job schedule and generous vacation policy.

- Unlimited access to the latest AI coding assistants.

- No corporate bs.

- Direct impact on millions of worldwide users within months.

- Push the boundaries of applied AI in a consumer setting.

- Fully remote.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/replika-brand-design-manager

title: Junior Clinical Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
*🍊Our mission*

Great science regularly stalls in the clinic, not because the science is wrong, but because the company behind it lacks the capital, infrastructure, or focus to take it all the way through. Today’s clinical-stage biopharma model is broken, and as a result promising treatments never reach patients.

Our mission is to fix this: we’re building the next generation of biopharma by in-licensing clinical-stage therapeutic assets and developing them through Lindus Health’s integrated, technology-first clinical trial infrastructure. We’re a new initiative, but we’re building on a proven foundation - the same infrastructure that has delivered 82% of Lindus Health’s sponsor trials on or ahead of timeline, across 40+ completed trials across the US and Europe.

We’re in-licensing 5-7 clinical-stage, typically Phase-2-ready assets, funded directly from Lindus Health’s balance sheet. We’re targeting deal close on our first assets through 2026, with first trials launching in H1 2027.

*🍊 About the role*

The Forward Deployed Engineer is an embedded member of the trial team, delivering the technical solutions assigned studies need. You build the study across the Citrus ecosystem, set up and manage its integrations and data pipelines, and help produce the databases, data, and artifacts a trial depends on, accurate and compliant.

This is a technical role. You write code, build the automation and tooling that keep quality high, and take part in the fire team, with platform work done under software engineering oversight. Trial delivery is the priority and the technical work serves it.

*🍊 About you*

*We'd like to hear from you if…*

*

You have 3-6 years of experience in software, data, or systems work, through a degree in a technical field or hands-on work, and can deliver independently once pointed at a problem; experience in clinical trials or life sciences is a plus

*

You are a capable engineer; you are proficient in coding and AI tools. Experience with Django admin and/or relational databases is valued

*

You are precise and thorough, with the attention to detail to spot gaps and ambiguities before they become problems

*

You are driven to understand and solve problems, and comfortable collaborating across technical and non-technical teams

*

You can prioritize effectively and keep track of several things at once without letting them slip

*

You are interested in working in a regulated environment, and can build systems and produce documentation that holds up under audit or inspection

*

You thrive in a startup environment that challenges the norms of typical biotechs, with high agency and a bias for action

*

You are passionate about our mission: changing how the healthcare industry operates and how new health treatments are developed

*🍊 What you'll focus on*

*

Build assigned studies across the Citrus ecosystem from approved designs, covering data collection forms, participant schedules, logic and edit-check rules, and user access

*

Set up and manage the integrations and data pipelines a study depends on

*

Run quality checks, build validation and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to confirm the build matches the specification, and coordinate go-live

*

Make approved changes to live studies, keeping them accurate and compliant as trials evolve

*

Take part in the Citrus trial technical support team, owning tickets for data corrections and the data warehouse and helping to debug Citrus under software engineering oversight

*

Build automated and agentic workflows that produce high-quality, compliant data

*

Make contributions to the core Citrus codebase where needed, with software engineering oversight

*

Provide technical review and input into Data Architects' designs, then build from them and work with the full trial team to deliver studies, flagging gaps or ambiguities early

*

Conduct all activities in line with relevant regulations and Lindus SOPs, and keep documentation to a standard that holds up under audit or inspection

*Competitive salary,* plus meaningful *stock options*

*27 days annual leave in addition to 11 National Holidays*

title: Junior Data Analyst (FinTech)
description:
Шукаємо Junior Data Analyst у FinTech-проєкт, який допоможе команді працювати з даними щодо трафіку, партнерів, оферів та клієнтських воронок.

Це позиція для людини, якій цікаво не просто зібрати цифри в таблицю, а розібратися, чому змінився показник, де виникла проблема та що з цим можна зробити.

Що потрібно буде робити

* Збирати та зводити дані з Affise, партнерських кабінетів, Метрики та внутрішніх систем
* Аналізувати воронку: від відмови в МФО до переходу на вітрину, заявки та видачі
* Порівнювати ефективність партнерів та оферів за різними джерелами, сегментами та позиціями на вітрині
* Аналізувати CR, EPC/EPS, дохід та інші ключові показники
* Шукати причини падіння конверсії, втрат трафіку та змін у доході
* Аналізувати якість відмовного трафіку: причини відмов, скорбалли, типи клієнтів та інші параметри
* Оцінювати результати змін на вітринах та в маршрутизації трафіку
* Аналізувати ефективність CRM-каналів: SMS, Viber, Push, автодозвін
* Перевіряти розбіжності між нашою статистикою та даними партнерів, шукати проблеми у подіях і трекінгу
* Готувати щоденні та щотижневі звіти за різними GEO
* Формулювати гіпотези та рекомендації на основі даних і після впровадження перевіряти результат

Що важливо

* Впевнений рівень Excel / Google Sheets
* Вміння працювати з великими обсягами даних та знаходити закономірності
* Аналітичне мислення: важливо не просто помітити зміну показника, а розібратися в її причині
* Вміння зрозуміло пояснювати висновки та цифри людям без аналітичного бекграунду
* Уважність до деталей та бажання самостійно докопуватися до причин
* Знання SQL буде плюсом
* Досвід роботи з Affise буде плюсом
* Досвід у FinTech, CPA, affiliate або кредитних продуктах буде плюсом

Що пропонуємо

* Роботу у FinTech-проєкті з великим обсягом даних та реальними бізнес-задачами
* Можливість розвиватися у напрямку Data / Product / Business Analytics
* Роботу безпосередньо з бізнесом та командою, де результати аналітики використовуються для прийняття рішень
* Можливість впливати на процеси через власні висновки та рекомендації

title: Junior Operations Manager Automotive (m/w/d)
description:
Du willst keine Rolle, in der du nur Tickets abarbeitest. Du willst Prozesse verantworten, Probleme lösen, bevor sie eskalieren, und im direkten Kontakt mit Käufern und Verkäufern etwas bewegen. Als Operations Specialist steuerst du die
komplette Fahrzeugabwicklung auf der CarOnSale-Plattform, von Transportbuchungen bis Dokumentenversand.

*Standort:* Zentral in Berlin – Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro, hybrid mit 3 Tagen Office und 2 Tagen Homeoffice.

Über uns
--------

CarOnSale ist die KI-gestützte Plattform für den B2B-Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Europa. Über 40.000 Käufer aus mehr als 20 Ländern handeln auf unserer Plattform – und 85 % des Inventars ist exklusiv bei uns. Wir verbinden Software, Pricing-Intelligenz, Logistik und Finanzierung in einer Schicht – als Betriebssystem für eine ganze Branche.

*One Platform. One Profit Engine.*

Deine Aufgaben
--------------

* Du betreust OEM-, Flotten- und Mobilitätskunden in Deutschland und Österreich operativ von vorne bis hinten – Kunden, die nicht wie klassische Autohäuser arbeiten und oft höherwertige Fahrzeuge verkaufen.
* Du startest Piloten mit neuen Kunden, die unser Sales-Team gewonnen hat, und sorgst dafür, dass die ersten Fahrzeuge schnell und sauber verkauft werden.
* Du legst neue Accounts im CRM richtig an und holst alle nötigen Informationen beim Kunden in einem Zug ein.
* Du behältst deine Accounts analytisch im Blick, wertest Verkaufszahlen in Excel aus und steuerst nach, wo es hakt.
* Du sicherst die Abwicklung nach dem Verkauf: Dokumentenversand, Transport, Zahlung.
* Du bist täglich die Schnittstelle zu Inside Sales, Account Management, After Sales und Qualitätsmanagement – und löst Reklamationen selbst, statt sie weiterzureichen.
* Du baust Prozesse mit auf, die mit jedem neuen Kunden mitwachsen.

Was du mitbringst
-----------------

* Erste praktische Erfahrung im operativen Bereich (mind.1 Jahr) – Praktika und Werkstudententätigkeiten zählen auch
* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (z. B. als Automobilkaufmann/-frau) oder ein Bachelorstudium, etwa in BWL oder Wirtschaft
* Erfahrung in der Kundenkommunikation, z.B. aus Kundensupport, Reklamationsbearbeitung, Versand- oder Ticketabwicklung
* Proaktive, eigenständige Arbeitsweise: Du holst dir Informationen selbst, merkst sie dir und wendest sie beim nächsten Mal an
* Starke Selbstorganisation und sicheres Zeitmanagement – du priorisierst zwischen vielen parallelen Aufgaben
* Kommunikationsstärke intern wie extern und Freude daran, auf Kunden proaktiv zuzugehen
* Deutsch auf C2-Niveau

*Von Vorteil*

* Sicherer Umgang mit Excel und CRM-Tools wie Salesforce
* Analytische Arbeitsweise – Zahlen sind für dich Entscheidungsgrundlage
* Erfahrung in der Automobilbranche oder in einem Scale-up
* KI-affine Arbeitsweise – du nutzt Tools wie Claude, ChatGPT oder Copilot aktiv im Arbeitsalltag

Was dich bei uns erwartet
-------------------------

* Hybrides Arbeiten: 3 Tage Office, 2 Tage Homeoffice – plus 10 Tage „Work from Anywhere" pro Jahr
* 28 Tage Urlaub
* 2× jährliches Karriere- & Entwicklungsgespräch
* Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss
* Bezahltes Deutschlandticket
* FitX-Mitgliedschaft oder Urban Sports Club-Zuschuss
* Virtual Stock Options – du beteiligst dich am Erfolg
* Moderne IT-Ausstattung für dein tägliches Arbeiten
* Strukturiertes Onboarding mit Buddy-Programm und Social Events
* Gelebte Vielfalt: aktives Frauennetzwerk, Meditations- & Gebetsraum

*Bewirb dich jetzt – dein Lebenslauf reicht.*

title: Junior SEO Link Builder
location: Remote Scouts- Lahore- 256, Abdul Haque Road, Block H-2, Phase 2, Johar Town, Lahore, 54782
description:
*About Cedar Financial*

Cedar Financial (“Cedar”) is a renowned international financial services company, recognized for its expertise in cross-border ARM (Accounts Receivable Management) services. Our team is driven by a spirit of innovation, constantly seeking new ideas and ways to improve and evolve. We understand that complacency can be detrimental to business and as such, we are quick to embrace change and tackle challenges head-on. Our approach is not one of recklessness, but one of agility and strategic thinking. We focus on achieving results rather than simply completing routine tasks. Our goal is to provide our clients with exceptional services that help them achieve their financial goals.

*About the Role*

We are looking for a motivated Junior SEO Link Builder to grow the authority of Cedar’s websites by earning high-quality, relevant backlinks. Working with our Senior SEO Specialist, you will research link opportunities, run personalized outreach campaigns, build relationships with publishers and bloggers, and keep accurate records of every link earned. This role suits someone early in their SEO career who wants to learn white-hat link building and digital PR in a performance-driven team.

*Responsibilities*

*

*Prospecting:* Research and qualify link opportunities such as guest posts, resource pages, broken link building, unlinked brand mentions, and industry directories, using Ahrefs, Semrush, and Google search operators.

*

*Link Quality Assessment:* Vet prospect websites against Cedar’s quality guidelines: relevance, real organic traffic, Domain Rating / Domain Authority, spam signals, and outbound link patterns.

*

*Outreach:* Find verified contact details and send personalized outreach emails and follow-ups using tools such as Pitchbox, BuzzStream, Respona, or .

*

*Relationship Building:* Build and maintain relationships with bloggers, editors, journalists, and webmasters in finance, B2B, and technology niches.

*

*Content Coordination:* Work with the content team on guest post topics, briefs, and linkable assets. Make sure anchor text and target URLs follow the approved link plan.

*

*Digital PR Support:* Respond to journalist requests on platforms such as Qwoted, Featured, and Help a B2B Writer to secure brand mentions and editorial links.

*

*Tracking & Reporting:* Keep an accurate outreach tracker and link log (prospect, status, live URL, anchor text, DR, and any cost) and prepare weekly progress reports.

*

*Link Monitoring:* Monitor live links for removal or changes, identify lost and broken backlinks, and help reclaim them.

*

*Competitor Backlink Analysis:* Analyze competitor backlink profiles to find new link opportunities and gaps.

*

*Guidelines Compliance:* Follow Google’s spam policies and white-hat link-building practices. Avoid link schemes, private blog networks (PBNs), and other manipulative tactics.

*

*Citations & Listings:* Build and maintain consistent business citations and directory listings where applicable.

*Objective and KPI*

*Objective:* Increase the authority and organic rankings of Cedar’s websites by consistently earning relevant, high-quality backlinks through ethical, white-hat outreach.

*

*Links Acquired:* Number of live, quality backlinks secured each month against the target set (typically 10–20 per month).

*

*Link Quality:* Share of links that meet quality criteria: topical relevance, DR 30+, real organic traffic, and editorial, do-follow placement.

*

*Outreach Activity:* Qualified prospects researched and personalized outreach emails sent each week.

*

*Response & Conversion Rates:* Outreach reply rate and the rate at which prospects convert to live links.

*

*Referring Domain Growth:* Month-over-month growth in unique referring domains.

*

*Link Retention:* Share of acquired links still live after 90 days.

*

*Data Accuracy:* Link tracker and weekly reports kept complete, accurate, and current.

*Education, Experience, Qualifications & Skills*

*

0–2 years of experience in link building, SEO, digital PR, or outreach. Internship or freelance experience is welcome.

*

Basic understanding of SEO fundamentals, including backlinks, anchor text, do-follow vs. no-follow links, and domain authority metrics.

*

Familiarity with at least one SEO tool (Ahrefs, Semrush, or Moz) and with Google Sheets or Excel.

*

Highly organized and detail-oriented, able to manage a high volume of outreach and follow-ups.

*

Persistent and self-motivated, comfortable working to targets and handling rejection.

description:

Суть позиції це клієнтський сервіс та Retention. Задача: супроводжувати чинних користувачів, допомагати їм вирішувати технічні чи операційні складнощі у взаємодії з брокерською платформою та покращувати їхній клієнтський досвід, повертаючи у статус активних інвесторів в фондовий ринок USA.

⸻

🎯 Що ви будете робити:
Працювати з наявною базою клієнтів компанії через дзвінки, месенджери та email.
Спілкуватися з користувачами, уточнювати їхні запити та допомагати у вирішенні складнощів із платформою.
Пояснювати функціонал брокерського додатка та базові принципи роботи з фондовим ринком (після навчання).
Фіксувати результати комунікації та зворотний зв’язок у CRM за чіткими інструкціями.
Поступово виконувати план комунікацій із підтримкою команди та керівника по retention.

⸻

✅ Ви точно нам підійдете, якщо:
Впевнено спілкуєтесь англійською та італійською мовою на рівні вільного спілкування з носіями.
Великим плюсом буде знання ще однієї з європейських мов: польська, іспанська або німецька.
Вмієте зрозуміло висловлювати думки, емпатичні та не губитеся в діалозі.
Вам цікаво розвиватися у сфері інвестицій та фінансів (досвід не обов’язковий — ми всього навчаємо).
Важливо: не розглядаємо кандидатів, які працювали в сірих/чорних схемах або скам-проєктах.

⸻

💎 Що ви отримаєте:
Сумарний дохід: 50 000 - 70 000 грн./міс (фіксована ставка 30 000грн. + бонус за retention).
Формат: стабільний гібридний формат у Києві (Поділ), Хмельницькому, Чернівцях та Львові.
Лояльне ставлення до затримок через повітряні тривоги (безпека понад усе) та можливість віддаленого формату за результатами роботи.
Прозора компанія з європейською культурою і мінімальним рівнем плинності кадрів (≈3%).
Цільова аудиторія клієнтів — 25+, власники бізнесу, офісні працівники Middle/Senior+.

⸻

🔥 Шукаємо 5-ох людей у команду, тому діє реферальна програма. За успішну рекомендацію кандидата пропонуємо бонус 100$.

title: Junior Recruiter
description:
*Real people. Real service.*

At , we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first. Led by our core values of *G* enerosity, *R* espect, *I* nnovation, *T* eamwork, and GRIT, we’re dedicated to maintaining a supportive work environment that celebrates diversity and empowers everyone to reach their full potential. As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.

We are looking for a *Talent Acquisition Associate* to join our Human Resources Team! This individual will report into our Talent Acquisition Team Lead and will own full-cycle recruitment for assigned entry- and mid-level roles, supporting the hiring process from intake through offer and start. This includes sourcing, screening, and interviewing candidates, coordinating each stage of the hiring process, and maintaining accurate candidate records to support SupplyHouse’s talent acquisition goals. If you’re passionate about connecting people with the right opportunities, enjoy building relationships, and are excited to create a positive experience for candidates and hiring teams, we’d love to hear from you!

This *remote* position is open to individuals who live in, or are open to relocating to, the following states: Arizona, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

This position requires travel to our headquarters in Melville, NY 3 times per year for internal meetings and team building activities. We reimburse reasonable and necessary travel expenses, and you’re also welcome to work on-site anytime beyond these visits – our doors are always open.

*Role Type:* Full-Time, Non-Exempt

*Location:* Remote

*Schedule:* Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. with time zone flexibility

*Base Salary:* The expected starting salary for the position is *$45,514* *to $56,892* within a full position range of $45,514 to $68,271 annually. This range reflects the long-term earning potential for the role. Our starting pay practice is the minimum to middle portion of the range, depending on experience, qualifications, and internal equity, consistent with applicable law and it is rare for a new hire to start above the midpoint.

*Responsibilities:*

* Proactively build and manage a pipeline of qualified candidates using Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Handshake, university relationships, networking, AI-assisted sourcing tools, and other tools available to attract top talent
* Review applications and resumes, using AI-assisted screening tools as a first-pass filter within established company guardrails, while always applying independent human judgment before advancing or eliminating any candidate
* Conduct interviews via Zoom and complete detailed, thoughtful interview scorecards and evaluations
* Schedule and coordinate interviews, hiring events, and walk-in interview days as needed, to ensure a smooth, organized experience for both candidates and hiring managers
* Administer technical, creative, and personality assessments, as well as background checks, as needed or requested, to support hiring decisions
* Partner with hiring managers from intake through offer, and own candidate communication throughout the process by providing timely status updates, follow-ups, and respectful rejections
* Handle sensitive information with the utmost confidentiality and care, including performance insights, offers, negotiations, and disqualifications
* Maintain organized, up-to-date, audit-ready candidate records; apply consistent, compliant evaluation criteria and candidate data privacy practices, in line with EEO, work authorization, and pay transparency requirements; and track key recruiting metrics
* Represent SupplyHouse and promote its culture at university career fairs and other recruitment events
* Stay informed on recruitment trends, job boards, salary data, and AI-assisted recruiting tools to help the team remain competitive
* Draft and post job openings to the careers site, job boards, and university channels, and maintain accurate, up-to-date requisitions in Greenhouse
* Complete reference checks and support the offer process, including offer preparation, internal approvals, and handoff to HR for pre-boarding and onboarding
* Support the Talent Acquisition Team Lead and Manager with additional recruitment tasks and special projects as needed
* Partner with the Talent Acquisition Team Lead during job kick-off and recurring regroup meetings to understand requisition needs and hiring manager expectations
* Track and report recruiting metrics, including time-to-fill, funnel conversion, source effectiveness, and pipeline quality, reporting on a regular basis to hiring managers and the broader recruiting team, and consistently meet the recruiting targets set by TA leadership

*Requirements:*

* 0-2 years of relevant recruiting or related experience
* A genuine passion for providing an exceptional candidate experience
* Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple tasks and adapt to shifting priorities
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-volume, process-driven recruiting environment with high attention to detail
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including meeting facilitation, reference checks, offers, and rejections via Zoom, Slack, email, and phone
* Proficiency with Zoom, Slack, and MS365, including Microsoft Word and Excel

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Bachelors degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business, or a related field
* Prior experience in Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, or Recruitment
* Comfort learning and using AI-assisted recruiting tools (e.g., Greenhouse AI, Claude) within established company guardrails and processes

*Why work with us:*

* *We have awesome benefits* – We offer a wide variety of benefits to help support you and your loved ones. These include:

* Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, vision, and voluntary life insurance options
* 401(k) with up to 4% company match
* Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays
* Company-paid basic life insurance and long-term disability
* Discounted auto, home, and pet insurance programs
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Confidential mental health, financial planning, and legal support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* $750 annual professional development budget
* $25 monthly Grubhub credit
* Company rewards and recognition program
* And more!

* *We promote work-life balance* – ** We value your time and encourage a healthy separation between your professional and personal life to feel refreshed and recharged. Look out for our wellness initiatives and ask about our Flex-Time Policy!
* *We support growth* – ** We encourage you to embrace continuous learning and take on new challenges. In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide opportunities for career growth through our annual merit and bonus opportunities, hands-on training, diversity and inclusion initiatives, internal mobility options, and professional development budget.
* *We give back* – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee-nominated contributions, support for non-profit organizations, Volunteer Paid Time Off, and more.
* *We listen* – We value hearing from our employees. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage you to use it! We actively elicit feedback through our monthly town halls, regular 1:1 check-ins, employee listening initiatives, and company-wide ideas form to incorporate suggestions and ensure our team enjoys coming to work every day.

*Check us out and learn more at:* *!*

*Additional Details:*

* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis. SupplyHouse.com will not sponsor applicants for work visas.
* SupplyHouse.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
* To ensure fairness, all application materials, assessments, and interview responses must reflect your own original work. The use of AI tools, plagiarism, or any uncredited assistance is not permitted at any stage of the hiring process and may result in disqualification. We appreciate your honesty and look forward to seeing your skills.
* We are committed to providing a safe and secure work environment and conduct thorough background checks on all potential employees in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
* All emails from the SupplyHouse team will only be sent from an @supplyhouse.com email address. Please exercise caution if you receive an email from an alternate domain.

title: Junior Fleet Manager - Kfz-Schaden & Technik (m/w/d)
description:
*Your Role*
-----------

Als Fleet Manager im Bereich Kfz-Schaden & Technik übernimmst du eine zentrale Schlüsselrolle in unserem Kerngeschäft und hältst unsere Flotte kosteneffizient in einem makellosen Zustand. Mit deiner tiefen Fach- und Schadensexpertise steuerst du Reparatur- sowie Wartungsentscheidungen, verhandelst Schadenkataloge direkt mit OEMs und Remarketing-Partnern und wendest dein Know-how im dynamischen FINN-Umfeld an. Als interne:r Sachverständige:r und Ansprechpartner:in für alle schadenrelevanten Fragen schaffst du den Spagat zwischen technischer Exzellenz, fairen Kundenabrechnungen und maximaler Kostenoptimierung.

Your Mission
------------

*

Du bewertest und steuerst Reparatur-, Wartungs- sowie Schadensfälle eigenverantwortlich und identifizierst stets den technisch und wirtschaftlich optimalen Lösungsweg für FINN.

*

Du gestaltest und überarbeitest aktiv die Schadenkataloge sowie Ausflottungsvereinbarungen mit OEMs und Remarketing-Partnern (z. B. Buyback/Remarketing-Verträge), um den GPU und Unternehmenserfolg direkt positiv zu beeinflussen.

*

Du agierst als zentrale fachliche Ansprechperson für interne Stakeholder (Operations, Fleet, Customer Care) sowie externe Partner (Gutachter-Organisationen, Compounds, Anwälte).

*

Du überprüfst und verhandelst Reparaturkosten sowie Gutachten kritisch, um Einsparpotenziale konsequent zu heben und Fahrzeugausfallzeiten zu minimieren.

*

Du gewährleistest eine stets fair, transparente und nachvollziehbare Schadensabwicklung sowie -abrechnung gegenüber unseren Kund:innen.

*

Du nutzt Daten und Prozessverständnis, um schadenrelevante Abläufe kontinuierlich zu optimieren und die Flotten-Performance nachhaltig zu steigern.

Your Profile
------------

Must have:
----------

*

Fundierte technische Expertise im Kfz-Bereich (z. B. Kfz-Meister:in, Staatlich geprüfte:r Techniker:in, Kfz-Sachverständige:r oder ein Studium im Bereich Fahrzeugtechnik/Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen).

*

Nachweisbare praktische Erfahrung in der Reparaturkostenoptimierung, Fahrzeugbewertung, Gutachtenprüfung oder im technischen Flottenmanagement.

*

Hohe Affinität für digitale Tools und Prozesse sowie die Begeisterung, Fachwissen in einem hochdynamischen Scale-up-Umfeld gewinnbringend einzubringen.

*

Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse (B2-Niveau) für die tägliche Kommunikation in einem internationalen Team.

Nice to have:
-------------

*

Erfahrung in der Verhandlung oder Mitgestaltung von Rückgabestandards/Schadenkatalogen mit OEMs, Aufkäufern oder Leasinggesellschaften.

*

Praxiskenntnisse im Umgang mit Kalkulationssystemen (z. B. DAT, Audatex) sowie modernen Datenanalysetools.

WHY FINN
--------

*

*Shared Success (VSOP Finanzbeteiligung):* Wir gewinnen gemeinsam. Über unser *Virtual Stock Option Program* profitierst du direkt vom langfristigen Wertwachstum und dem Erfolg von FINN.

*

*Fuel your Growth (1.500€ Weiterbildungsbudget):* Stillstand ist keine Option. Mit deinem jährlichen *Development-Budget in Höhe von 1.500€* für *Fortbildungen und Seminare* entscheidest du selbst, wie du dich persönlich und professionell weiterentwickelst.

* *Family First (Kita-Zuschuss & Flexibilität):* Wir unterstützen dich und deine Familie. Profitiere von einem monatlichen *Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung* , exklusiven Zugängen zu Kita-Plätzen in *München* sowie maximaler Flexibilität, um Berufs- und Familienleben stressfrei zu vereinbaren.
*

**Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV):** Wir denken an deine Zukunft. FINN bezuschusst *deine *betriebliche Altersvorsorge** mit einem **starken Arbeitgeberanteil von 66 %*.*

* *Experience our Product (25% Auto-Abo Rabatt):* Werde selbst zum FINN-Driver! Du erhältst einen satten *Mitarbeiterrabatt von 25% auf dein Auto-Abo* oder nutzt alternativ unser attraktives *Fahrrad-Leasing (Bike-Leasing)*.
*

*Health & Mindset (Sport & Gesundheit):* Deine Energie ist unser Antrieb. Profitiere von einer subventionierten *EGYM Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft* für Fitness und Sport sowie professionellem Mental Health Support.

title: Junior SOC Analyst (m/w/d)
description:
Du hast erste praktische Erfahrung in der IT und willst jetzt in die operative IT-Sicherheit einsteigen und sehen, wie Angriffe in der Praxis ablaufen? In unserem Security Operations Center behältst du im Blick, was in den Systemen unserer Kunden passiert, ordnest Warnmeldungen ein und lernst von erfahrenen Analysten, worauf es ankommt.

Wir sind ein wachsendes Unternehmen und haben uns in der IT-Sicherheit schnell einen Namen gemacht. Wir arbeiten dich strukturiert ein, und erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen sind immer in der Nähe. Die Wege bei uns sind kurz, du übernimmst früh eigene Aufgaben und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.

## Worum es geht

* Sicherheitsrelevante Ereignisse im Security Operations Center beobachten
* Alerts, Logdaten und auffällige Aktivitäten analysieren
* Sicherheitsmeldungen erst einordnen und nach Dringlichkeit sortieren
* Bei der Dokumentation und Bearbeitung von Vorfällen unterstützen
* An Playbooks und internen SOC-Abläufen mitarbeiten
* Bei der Verbesserung von Erkennungsregeln und Prozessen mitwirken
* Aktuelle Bedrohungslagen und Entwicklungen im Bereich Cybersecurity beobachten

## Was du mitbringst

* Solides Grundverständnis von IT-Sicherheit, Netzwerken und Betriebssystemen sowie Interesse daran, wie Angriffe ablaufen
* Eine analytische und gründliche Art zu arbeiten
* Bereitschaft, dich in neue Tools und Prozesse einzuarbeiten
* Zuverlässigkeit, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Teamgeist
* Mindestens ein Jahr praktische Erfahrung in IT-Betrieb, IT-Administration oder IT-Sicherheit, z. B. aus einer Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker/in, einer Werkstudententätigkeit, einer Festanstellung oder einem mehrmonatigen Praktikum in einem Unternehmen
* Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einem SIEM- oder EDR-System (z. B. Wazuh, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel oder Microsoft Defender) sowie mit Windows- und Linux-Logs
* Deutsch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau (mindestens C1), da du im Ernstfall direkt mit unseren Kunden auf Deutsch kommunizierst und Berichte auf Deutsch erstellst
* Gute Englischkenntnisse für Fachliteratur und Tool-Dokumentation
* Eine gültige Arbeitsberechtigung für Deutschland zum Arbeitsbeginn. Ein Visumverfahren können wir für diese Stelle leider nicht begleiten.
* Bereitschaft, an mindestens zwei Tagen pro Woche in Heubach vor Ort zu arbeiten

*Zertifizierungen wie CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+ oder Microsoft SC-200 sind ein Plus.*

## Was wir bieten

* Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit
* Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung und feste Ansprechpartner, die dich begleiten
* Hybrides Arbeiten (Präsenz in Heubach an mindestens zwei Tagen pro Woche, sonst remote) mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die wir gemeinsam im Team rund um unsere Servicezeiten abstimmen
* 30 Urlaubstage
* Weiterbildungsbudget und Unterstützung bei Zertifizierungen
* Moderne Hardware- und Software-Ausstattung
* EGYM Wellpass für Sport und Ausgleich zum Job
* Vergünstigungen bei vielen bekannten Marken über unser Mitarbeiter-Vorteilsprogramm
* Kurze Wege und Mitsprache, wie es in einem Startup eben ist

## Über uns

RedCastle ist ein spezialisiertes Unternehmen für IT-Sicherheit und IT-Forensik mit Sitz in Heubach. Wir übernehmen Managed Security, Bedrohungserkennung, Incident Response und IT-Forensik für mittelständische Unternehmen, oft aus Logistik, Produktion oder dem Gesundheitswesen, die sich allein kaum verteidigen könnten. Du steigst bei uns dort ein, wo Sicherheit jeden Tag stattfindet.

## So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, relevante Zeugnisse und ein kurzes Anschreiben, in dem du uns sagst, warum dich IT-Sicherheit interessiert. Bitte nenne uns darin auch dein Deutschniveau, deine Arbeitsberechtigung für Deutschland und deinen frühestmöglichen Starttermin. Bewerbungen ohne Lebenslauf können wir leider nicht berücksichtigen. Wir schauen uns jede vollständige Bewerbung an und melden uns zeitnah bei dir.

title: Junior Data Analyst (Python) for an E-commerce company (US-based/Remote)
description:
Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We help individuals from around the world connect with great companies that are looking for their specific skill set. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located.

Our client is an e-commerce consultancy firm specializing in data analysis to enhance seller efficiency, helping online sellers boost profitability, streamline operations, recover lost revenue, and maximize advertising performance.

*About the Role*
We are looking for a Junior Data Scientist who enjoys figuring things out. You will help the team investigate problems in client accounts, dig into Amazon data, and surface insights that help drive financial recovery. This is an ideal role for someone early in their career who is organized, curious, and comfortable working in spreadsheets. You don’t need to know everything up front, but you should be eager to learn and able to work independently once trained.

*Responsibilities*

* Clean and normalize Excel, CSV, and Parquet datasets using Python and pandas.
* Reconcile Amazon claims against invoices, purchase orders, and payment records.
* Match inconsistent IDs while avoiding unsupported or ambiguous matches.
* Classify discrepancies using defined recovery and reconciliation taxonomies.
* Build pandas logic for underpayment checks, multi-currency analysis, and reversal matching.
* Investigate unexpected results and trace discrepancies back to their source data.
* Write pytest/conformance tests to validate critical data-handling logic.
* Determine when incomplete data is insufficient to support a recovery claim.
* Process and analyze multi-million-row datasets across approximately 170 vendor accounts.
* Generate accurate Excel, CSV, and PDF recovery reports for non-technical clients.
* Use AI tools as part of the daily workflow while validating outputs and results.
* Contribute to improving the reliability and repeatability of reconciliation processes.

*Requirements*

* Solid Python fundamentals, including files, lists, dictionaries, and data structures.
* Basic experience with pandas, including filtering, merging, and aggregation.
* Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to data validation.
* Ability to investigate data discrepancies and explain how conclusions were reached.
* Clear written English for client-facing findings and reports.
* Comfortable using AI tools to support coding, analysis, and problem-solving.
* Willingness to work with large and messy datasets.
* Ability to make careful decisions when data is incomplete or ambiguous.

Nice to Have
------------

* Basic SQL knowledge.
* Experience with Git/GitHub.
* Experience writing tests in pytest or another testing framework.
* Exposure to Amazon Vendor Central, chargebacks, deductions, or retail vendor operations.
* Experience working with Excel, CSV, or Parquet data at scale.
* Academic or personal projects involving Python/data analysis.

*Benefits*

* Remote Working for a US Company
* Exposure to new technology & trend
* Competitive Salary

title: Junior Expansion Account Executive

* Proven ability to meet or exceed performance goals (revenue, retention, or activity-based metrics)

* Highly organized with strong follow-through and attention to detail

* Self-motivated and resourceful, you take initiative to solve problems and develop your skills

* Experience selling SaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or related technologies
* Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
* Familiarity with qualification frameworks (BANT / MEDDPICC)
* Exposure to AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot) in a professional setting
* Prior experience supporting US based customers in a B2B environment

*Who Thrives in This Role*

* You take initiative and don’t wait for direction to move work forward
* You follow through on commitments and take accountability for results
* You stay resilient and maintain a positive, solutions-oriented mindset
* You are motivated by growth, both in your performance and your career
* You prioritize learning and actively invest in your own development

This role is well-suited for individuals early in their career, making a career transition, or looking for an opportunity where effort, consistency, and growth mindset directly translate into success.

*What Matters Most*

We value the behaviors that drive long-term success:

* Ownership and accountability
* Consistency and discipline
* Coachability and continuous improvement
* Curiosity and willingness to learn
* Drive to achieve meaningful results

Experience matters, but mindset and execution matter more.

*Compensation & Growth*

* Competitive base salary + uncapped commission
* Opportunity to grow and advance your career with a company at the forefront of AI-powered customer experience

*Nextiva DNA* (Core Competencies)

Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:

* *Drives Results* : Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and *simplicity* to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.
* *Critical Thinker:* Data-driven, *forward-thinking* individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work.
* *Right Attitude:* Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and *care* for customers and teammates.

*Total Rewards*

Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow Nexties to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office.

Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary, hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses.

title: Middle Product / Game UI/UX Designer (Gamification)
description:
Live Animations is a Ukrainian gamification company. We create and integrate games and gamified mechanics into mobile apps and digital products of major brands.

Our products are used by millions of people. Our partners include Silpo, Sense Bank, Nova Poshta, Uklon, Mastercard, Auchan, Kaufland, and other major Ukrainian and international brands.

We help businesses increase engagement, retention, and interaction frequency through gamification.

Who We’re Looking For
We’re looking for a designer who operates at the intersection of two worlds — Product Design and Game UI/UX.

Someone who is equally comfortable designing a clear user flow inside a banking or retail app and creating interfaces for quests, progression, rewards, or the game itself.

This is not a pure Game Artist role, where the main focus is on icons, characters, and game assets. It’s also not a traditional Product Designer role focused primarily on large design systems and standard native flows.

We’re looking for someone in between: a strong UX and product-thinking foundation combined with an understanding of game UI, modern game mechanics, and player motivation.

For us, it’s not enough to simply “design a screen.” You should understand what the user needs to see, what they should do next, and what will make them want to come back.

What You’ll Do
Design user flows, UX logic, and UI for gamified experiences — from wireframes to final polish.
Create interfaces for games and meta-game experiences: onboarding, progression, quests, rewards, achievements, leaderboards, and more.
Design mechanics that integrate naturally into existing mobile apps and digital products.
Create UI kits, components, game elements, icons, and work with 2D graphics.
Adapt game UI to a client’s brand guidelines without losing the feeling of a game.
Think about usability, engagement, motivation, and user behavior — and propose your own solutions rather than simply executing a ready-made brief.
Work closely with PMs, developers, game designers, and 2D/3D artists, taking your designs through to implementation.

What Matters to Us
4+ years of experience in UI/UX or Product Design.
Hands-on experience in gamedev, mobile games, or gamification — mandatory.
A portfolio that demonstrates both strong UX and strong visual design, rather than focusing on only one of these areas.
Understanding of mobile UX, game UI, and basic game design / gamification mechanics.
Strong Figma skills: components, auto layout, prototyping, UI kits.
Photoshop / Illustrator or other tools for working with 2D graphics.
A strong sense of composition, color, typography, and visual hierarchy.
The ability to explain and defend your design decisions, work with feedback, and independently explore strong solutions.
And yes — it’s important that you play games. You don’t need to know every Steam release, but quests, progression, rewards, boosters, and other core game patterns shouldn’t feel like abstract terms to you.

We’ll Be Especially Excited If You
Don’t wait for a detailed brief before you start thinking.
You might get a task as broad as: “We need to motivate users to come back every day.” You can break down the problem, research references, come up with several solutions, and explain why one approach is stronger than the others.
You work like this:
See a problem → analyze it → propose options → explain your reasoning → take the solution through to implementation.
You’re able to say not only “I can design this,” but also “Here’s how I would solve this problem — and here’s why.”

Opportunity to Grow into a Design Lead
Over time, this role may include coordinating the work of other designers.
That’s why it will be a strong plus if you can organize design work, define tasks, provide constructive feedback, and are interested in gradually taking ownership of the overall design direction.

What You’ll Get
Real products — millions of people will interact with your interfaces through the apps of major brands.
Unusual challenges — instead of endless standard screens, almost every project brings a new mechanic, brand, and behavioral challenge.
The intersection of Product Design, Game UI/UX, and Gamification — an opportunity to grow across several strong disciplines at once.
Impact on the product — we expect designers to participate in finding the right solution, not just execute tasks.
A strong team and room to grow — PMs, developers, designers, 2D/3D specialists, and an opportunity to gradually move toward a Design Lead role.
Flexibility — Full Remote or hybrid in Kyiv, 1–2 days per week in the office; 17 paid vacation days per year.

If you see yourself in this profile, send us your CV and portfolio.
We’re especially interested in projects where you’ve worked with both product UX and game UI or gamification.

We’d love to meet you and learn more about your work!

title: Graphic Designer - Malaysia
description:
About Efficient Living Group

Efficient Living Group is a growing ecommerce company with brands including Lifely, Little Lifely, and Cushie Home. We create products and customer experiences for modern homes and families across several markets.

Role overview

We are looking for a commercially minded Graphic Designer to create high-quality visual work across paid social, websites, email, organic content and product & campaign launches. You will turn briefs into clear, attractive, on-brand designs that help customers understand products, campaigns and take action.

This is not only a production role. We want someone who can contribute ideas, understand the purpose of marketing campaign, and improve creative through feedback and performance learning.

*Requirements*

What success looks like

* Produce engaging, on-brand content across multiple brands and channels.
* Create high converting static content and variations for acquisition, retention, and product & campaign launches.
* Mastering AI tools to generate high quality content with minimum AI slops.
* Improve customer journey through website design and CRO work with on brand conversion-focused design.
* Deliver accurate work on time with high adaptability to contingencies.

1. Static creative and campaign design
--------------------------------------

* Deliver high quality ads, campaign key visuals, organic posts, product graphics, and promotional assets on time.
* Work closely with Creative and Performance Marketing team to deliver high converting ads measure by ROAS and engagement
* Replicate winning ads across other brands and channel

2. Website, email, and CRO design
---------------------------------

• Create website banners, landing-page sections, email graphics, product visuals, and campaign modules.
• Support CRO tests with stronger layouts, hierarchy, calls to action, and product communication.
• Design for mobile readability, accessibility, and customer confidence.

3. Brand and visual quality
---------------------------

• Protect each brand’s visual identity across typography, colour, spacing, imagery, and tone.
• Bring strong judgement to image selection, product presentation, and visual storytelling.
• Reduce AI slops to maintain accuracy for furniture, home, family, and lifestyle products.

4. Briefs, delivery, and collaboration
--------------------------------------

• Understand briefs and ask clear questions when information is missing.
• Plan work across deadlines and flag risks early.
• Take ownership of smaller projects from concept through delivery.
• Give progress updates to Mansell and the wider marketing team.
• Work closely with creative, copy, ecommerce, performance marketing, brand teams, and external partners.
• Explain design decisions and respond professionally to feedback.

5. QA, file management, and improvement
---------------------------------------

• Check spelling, price, layout, product accuracy, links, sizing, and export quality.
• Maintain clean editable files and clear version names highly adaptable to contingencies.
• Review creative performance and use learnings to improve future work.
• Keep up with AI design, ecommerce, and social creative trends.

Required experience and skills

• Minimum 2 years of commercial graphic or digital design experience.
• Portfolio showing paid social, ecommerce, campaign, branding, or digital work.
• Strong Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Canva, or equivalent skills.
• Strong typography, layout, composition, colour, and visual hierarchy.
• Ability to create clear variations from a single brief.
• Understanding of social, website, email, and digital advertising formats.
• Good attention to detail, time management, and communication.
• Willingness to learn and accept direct feedback.

A design degree is useful but is not required when the portfolio and practical ability are strong.

Highly regarded / nice to have

• UI or UX experience.
• Landing-page or CRO design experience.
• Email design experience.
• Motion or short-form video experience.
• Furniture, home, family, lifestyle, or ecommerce experience.
• AI-assisted creative tools.

Tools and platforms

Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Canva, Higgsfield or other relevant tools.

What we are looking for

• Commercially aware and able to connect design choices to customer action.
• Creative, but disciplined about briefs, accuracy, and deadlines.
• Detail-oriented and proactive when a brief or project is at risk.
• Comfortable across several brands and channels.
• Collaborative, organised, and open to feedback.
• Interested in improving creative quality and production speed.

Example projects this role may own

• Paid-social static batch for a product or offer.
• Campaign key visual adapted across ads, email, website, and organic social.
• Landing-page hero and supporting sections.
• Product comparison or education graphic.
• CRO design test.
• Email layout or reusable design system.

Interview focus areas

• Turning a brief into useful design directions.
• Protecting brand consistency across formats.
• Designing for mobile and fast customer understanding.
• Responding to critical feedback.
• Organising files and competing deadlines.
• Using performance feedback to improve creative.
• One portfolio project from brief through result.

Practical assessment

Create one static paid-social concept and one landing-page or email adaptation from the same brief.

Proposed first 90-day goals

• Deliver a dependable flow of quality assets across paid ads, websites, email, organic content, and CRO.
• Produce at least 24 approved, useful design outputs, subject to agreed brief volume.
• Support at least 24 CRO or design tests where suitable opportunities exist.
• Meet agreed deadlines and quality checks consistently.

AI and the way we work

Lifely is pioneering the practical use of AI-generated content in marketing. We are not using AI as a novelty. We use it to help the team create, test, learn, and improve real marketing work across our brands.

We expect you to be passionate about learning, curious about new tools, and able to learn quickly. You will learn how to use AI tools in practical creative workflows, while applying strong human judgement to quality, accuracy, brand fit, product truth, and customer impact.

* Explore new AI tools and learn how they can improve creative production.
* Turn AI outputs into useful marketing assets, not unfinished experiments.
* Check every AI-assisted output for product accuracy, claims, copy, brand rules, and quality.
* Share useful methods and learnings with the wider creative team.
* Keep improving your creative judgement as the tools change.
