* Deliver accurate, on-brand work on time.

1. Content production
---------------------

* Repurpose UGC into paid ad content
* Leverage AI tools to produce AI generated content for paid channels
* Create engaging static, motion and reel ads for meta, instagram and other channels for evergreen and marketing campaigns
* Build strong hooks, pacing, captions, and calls to action
* Stay on top of content trend and AI knowledge

2. Production planning
----------------------

• Contribute to concepts, storyboards, shot lists, scripts, and production plans.
• Attend and support studio or in-house content sessions.
• Identify missing assets, production risks, and technical blockers early.
• Take the lead on smaller projects when required.

3. Performance and creative improvement
---------------------------------------

• Use CTR, CVR, CPC, ROAS, retention, and feedback signals to improve future edits.
• Create testable variations without changing the core message by accident.
• Work with media buyers and creative leads to understand performance.
• Improve the first seconds, clarity, pacing, and product demonstration.

4. Collaboration, QA, and delivery
----------------------------------

• Work closely with Mansell, designers, copywriters, ecommerce, performance marketing, and brand teams.
• Explain creative decisions, respond professionally to feedback, and revise quickly.
• Check spelling, captions, claims, product accuracy, audio, timing, links, ratios, and export quality.
• Prepare 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, and other required formats.
• Maintain clean editable project files and clear version control.

Required experience and skills

• Minimum 2 years of commercial motion, video editing, multimedia, or digital content experience.
• Portfolio showing short-form video, motion graphics, UGC, paid social, or product storytelling.
• Strong After Effects, Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or equivalent skills.
• Good understanding of timing, pacing, typography, composition, sound, and visual rhythm.
• Ability to create clear hooks and engaging first seconds.
• Strong Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Canva, or equivalent skills.
• Understanding of Meta, TikTok, Instagram, website, and ecommerce specifications.
• High attention to product, copy, claim, and export accuracy.
• Good time management, communication, and willingness to learn.

A design degree is useful but is not required when the portfolio and practical ability are strong.

Highly regarded / nice to have

• Product animation, 3D, Blender, Cinema 4D, or basic compositing.
• AI video and image tools with careful human review.
• Direct-response advertising or performance creative experience.
• In-house studio, UGC, or creator production experience.
• Furniture, home, family, lifestyle, or ecommerce experience.

Tools and platforms

After Effects, Premiere Pro, CapCut, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Higgsfield or other relevant tools.

What we are looking for

• Strong in visual craft and practical production.
• Able to make content clear and engaging quickly.
• Careful with product details, claims, copy, and brand rules.
• Comfortable moving between video, motion, static design, and production planning.
• Commercially aware and interested in improving creative performance.
• Organised across projects, versions, and deadlines.
• Proactive, collaborative, and comfortable with direct feedback.

Example projects this role may own

• Short-form paid-social video batch with several hooks and edits.
• UGC edit with captions, product demonstrations, and a clear call to action.
• Product launch video and matching static campaign assets.
• Studio production plan, shot list, and final edit package.
• Product feature animation or comparison video.
• Campaign concept adapted into Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and website formats.
• Motion template system for repeated product or offer content.

Interview focus areas

• Creating a strong first three seconds.
• Turning one concept into useful versions.
• Balancing creative quality with production speed.
• Protecting product accuracy in video and motion work.
• Using sound, captions, pacing, and visual hierarchy.
• Using performance data to improve the next edit.
• One project from brief through final output.

Practical assessment

Create one short-form video concept, one edited or storyboarded motion sequence, and one static adaptation from the same campaign brief.

Proposed first 90-day goals

• Produce at least 36 testable motion or multimedia outputs, subject to agreed brief volume.
• Develop around three testable angles or hooks each week.
• Support at least three studio or in-house production sessions.
• Use performance and feedback data to improve the next creative batch.

AI and the way we work

Lifely is pioneering the practical use of AI-generated content in marketing. We are not using AI as a novelty. We use it to help the team create, test, learn, and improve real marketing work across our brands.

We expect you to be passionate about learning, curious about new tools, and able to learn quickly. You will learn how to use AI tools in practical creative workflows, while applying strong human judgement to quality, accuracy, brand fit, product truth, and customer impact.

* Explore new AI tools and learn how they can improve creative production.
* Turn AI outputs into useful marketing assets, not unfinished experiments.
* Check every AI-assisted output for product accuracy, claims, copy, brand rules, and quality.
* Share useful methods and learnings with the wider creative team.
* Keep improving your creative judgement as the tools change.

description:
*About Us:*

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at *insightsoftware.com.*

*Job Description:*

*Product Owner – Regulatory Solutions*

at insightsoftware

We are looking for a *Product Owner* specializing in regulatory solutions — including ESG reporting, regulatory filing disclosures, and financial filing packages such as Solvency II — who can fully understand and analyze both internal and external customer needs and then articulate those needs to the development team via user stories. A member of the Product Management team, you’ll work closely with an agile team of Software and Quality Engineers, serving as the interface between our customers and the development team throughout the planning and software development process.

You will collaborate closely with internal customers (Product Management, Engineering, Support, Customer Success) and external customers — including regulated financial institutions and compliance teams — to understand regulatory business processes and identify how our solutions can address their filing and disclosure needs. Working closely with Product Managers across the EPM Suite on requirements definition, documenting proposed regulatory software solutions, and maintaining a prioritized backlog of issues.

The ideal candidate should be highly collaborative with the ability to lead cross-functionally and inspire our teams while remaining focused on results and value creation. You must possess a unique blend of regulatory domain expertise and technical savvy, a big-picture vision, and the drive to make that vision a reality. This role provides a great opportunity to work across the insightsoftware EPM Suite — bridging data collection and storage through to regulatory disclosure and filing — partnering with our technical teams to define, build, and deliver solutions for regulated financial institutions and compliance-focused customers.

*What will you do?*

* Integrate in the agile development team to drive successful product delivery and serve as the voice of the customer
* Run customer focus groups to collect feedback and update the roadmap with the feedback
* Collaborate with Product Managers to formulate our product vision, strategy, and roadmap
* Define and drive the product roadmap for regulatory solutions including ESG reporting, regulatory filing disclosures, and financial filing packages such as Solvency II, ensuring alignment with evolving compliance mandates and customer filing obligations
* Work cross-product across the EPM Suite to ensure tight integration from data collection and storage through to regulatory disclosure and filing, collaborating with adjacent Product Owners across consolidation, planning, and reporting
* Apply XBRL expertise to guide filing requirements, taxonomy mapping, and validation rules, ensuring our solutions meet current and emerging regulatory filing standards
* Work closely with Product Managers creating, reviewing, refining epics, features, stories and acceptance criteria to create and maintain a product backlog of maximum value that is aligned with product strategy
* Organize and refine feature requests, prioritize enhancements with Product Managers, and assist in managing the product roadmap.
* Own the product backlog for multiple products, balancing conflicting priorities to determine prioritization
* Own the release planning and sprint planning processes, including setting release and sprint goals, and successfully delivering on those goals
* Provide an active role in mitigating risks and issues impacting successful team completion of release and sprint goals
* Ensuring acceptance criteria are met with current release and conducting sprint reviews from a business/customer perspective.
* Producing documentation with Product Managers and Marketing to support development, launch, support, services, and sales and marketing initiatives
* Performing detailed product demonstrations for external and internal audiences to communicate the benefits of the solution
* Serving as a subject matter expert to assist with sales and support as needed

*How will you do it?*

* Drive & Grit – Operate in a fast-paced environment with a focus and determination to achieve high-quality results
* Strategic Thinker – determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends with the ability to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way
* Product Focus – Translate market and customer feedback into requirements, driving product delivery through an agile release process
* Customer Focused – passionate about creating value for our customers
* Cross-functional leadership – Lead and drive execution across Development, Product Management, Support, and Customer Success

*Are you a fit?*

Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree
* 5 years+ Proven success in product ownership or management roles
* 5 years+ Experience with agile software development practices (e.g., scrum, Kanban, Lean Agile) and tools
* 5 years+ years ability to negotiate a backlog with engineers and senior leadership
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority
* Ability to balance conflicting priorities and make critical decisions
* Knowledge of XBRL and its application in regulatory financial filings (e.g., ESEF, iXBRL, SEC/EDGAR), including taxonomy mapping, tagging, and validation
* Domain experience in financial regulatory compliance frameworks such as Solvency II, CSRD/ESG reporting, IFRS, or equivalent regulatory disclosure and filing requirements

Preferred qualifications:

* Certifications: Agile, Pragmatic Marketing, Project Management, Scrum Product Owner
* Experience in partnering with UX teams to design great solutions

description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Applied Science team builds models and tools that solve Ramp’s most critical problems: from underwriting businesses to combatting fraud to making spend management smarter. We’re deeply embedded in the business and provide a quantitative foundation for decision making.

As an Applied Science intern, you’ll be a fully integrated member of the team and own your project from start to finish. Working with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders, you’ll translate complex business needs into scalable machine-learning-driven solutions. This is a chance to apply ML concretely, ship code, and create genuine value for Ramp and our customers.

You will focus on exciting problems in areas like: credit, fraud, growth, or our core product.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- End-to-End ML: own the model lifecycle from data exploration and feature engineering to training, benchmarking, deployment, and monitoring

- State-of-the-Art AI: leverage the latest Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve novel problems and create new product capabilities for our customers

- Versatile Techniques: apply the right tools to the right problems, whether it’s deep learning, gradient boosting, or causal inference

- Rigorous Experimentation: quantify the impact of your work through A/B tests and other statistical methods

- Collaborate: partner closely with product and business leaders to translate models and insights into actionable strategy and user-facing features

WHAT YOU NEED

- B.S., M.S. or Ph.D. Student: currently pursuing a degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Math, Physics, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative fields with an expected graduation date between Dec 2027 - 2029. Graduate degrees are preferred, but not a must.

- Strong ML Fundamentals: solid understanding of the mathematical foundations of machine learning, statistics, probability, and optimization

- Strong Interest or Experience with AI: curiosity and drive to integrate cutting edge LLMs and agents into applied solutions

- Python Proficiency: good grasp of common Data Science libraries (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy, PyTorch, etc.)

- SQL Knowledge: experience wrangling data in a modern data warehouse (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Clickhouse)

- Practical Experience: track record of curating datasets and building/evaluating ML models

- Strong Communication: ability to clearly explain complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and use data to build a compelling narrative

- Bias For Action: a comfort with ambiguity and desire to ship solutions quickly then iterate

NICE TO HAVES

- Publications, Projects, or Previous Experience: relevant experience applying AI/ML and demonstrating your passion for the field

- Production ML Mindset: knowledge of software engineering best practices applied to ML including version control (Git), testing, and writing maintainable code

title: Design Systems Lead
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

How we build software is changing. Designers are building tools and agents, prototyping in code, and shipping directly into the product. More people can create software than ever before. That makes design judgment more important, not less.

We’re looking for a Design Systems Lead to build that judgment into the foundations of Ramp.

This is not just about maintaining a component library. It’s about making it possible for designers, engineers, and agents to build experiences that look, feel, and work like Ramp—without a designer driving every decision or the design systems team reviewing every change.

You’re a designer first, with the technical depth to guide architecture and get into the code. You have exceptional taste and strong opinions about typography, hierarchy, interaction, and motion. Just as importantly, you know how to turn that judgment into patterns, tools, and guidance that make everyone else’s work better.

You’re deeply curious about AI and already using it to change how you work. You build, experiment, inspect the results, and push past the demo. You can imagine a different way of building software—and lead a team toward it.

This role is for you if you’re excited by:

- Making great design reproducible. Raise the quality of Ramp’s product and encode what makes it good, so people and agents can produce coherent, usable experiences by default. The system should make excellent work easier, not make every experience look the same.

- Reimagining what a design system can be. Build beyond components and tokens into composition, interaction patterns, agent guidance, and evaluations. Connect exploration and production so the fastest way to build is also a path to great quality.

- Leading a team that multiplies everyone else’s impact. Create clear direction, ambitious goals, and a caring yet demanding environment. Inspire curiosity, develop people, and stay close enough to the work to help make it exceptional.

The opportunity is to raise the floor for everyone building at Ramp, while giving designers more room to make the most important experiences extraordinary.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead and develop the design systems team. Set clear priorities, ownership, and goals. Give direct, timely feedback, hold people accountable, and help them do the best work of their careers.

- Own the system’s vision and direction. Decide what to preserve, evolve, simplify, or replace based on what builders and customers need. Turn that direction into focused work the team can deliver.

- Elevate Ramp’s visual and interaction design. Raise the bar for typography, hierarchy, density, motion, responsive behavior, accessibility, and the states beyond the happy path.

- Make design judgment usable by people and agents. Translate principles into reusable patterns, reference experiences, composition rules, and guidance that produce better work without you in the room.

- Guide technical architecture with engineering. Shape everything from components and tokens to how agents discover guidance, compose interfaces, and check their work. Make sound tradeoffs between flexibility, coherence, performance, and ease of use.

- Stay hands-on. Build prototypes, work in code, and get into implementation details to test ideas, unblock the team, and understand where the system breaks down.

- Define and measure quality. Build repeatable evaluations grounded in real tasks. Measure whether builders can ship better work faster, with less rework—not just whether they use the tools.

- Improve the path from idea to shipped experience. Partner with engineering and AI teams on workflows that support fast exploration, useful iteration, and appropriate production safeguards.

- Earn adoption. Work alongside product teams, listen closely, teach through examples, and turn recurring questions and exceptions into improvements to the system.

- Keep the team moving forward. Experiment as models and tools evolve, share what you learn, and change direction when the evidence calls for it.

WHAT YOU NEED

- Experience leading and developing strong design or design engineering teams, with a track record of setting direction and delivering meaningful outcomes.

- Exceptional visual and interaction design skills. Your work shows a clear point of view, attention to detail, and an ability to make complex experiences feel simple.

- Deep systems thinking and experience building systems that other teams actually adopt. You can show how your work improved both their speed and the quality of what shipped.

- Strong technical fluency. You can prototype and build in code, understand front-end architecture, and work through implementation tradeoffs with engineers—not just hand off specifications.

- Active, hands-on use of AI in your design and building workflow. You understand where it helps, where it fails, and how to improve its output rather than accept it.

- Experience turning design principles into practical guidance, reusable patterns, and quality checks that work at scale.

- Strong product judgment and a habit of staying close to the people using what you build. You connect system decisions to real workflows and customer outcomes.

- The ability to create clarity in ambiguity, make decisions, give difficult feedback, and maintain momentum without losing the quality bar.

- Curiosity that borders on obsession about how AI changes software and how we build it—and the ability to ignite that curiosity in others.

NICE TO HAVES

- Experience building agent-usable design guidance, generation workflows, or evaluations for design quality.

- Experience building developer or designer tools that became part of other teams’ daily workflow.

- Experience leading a major design-system migration or company-wide change in how teams build.

- Experience evolving a system across platforms or connecting product and brand experiences.

- Founder or early-stage startup experience.

Legal at Airwallex sits at the heart of the decisions that shape how Airwallex grows. This team backs the visionary builders transforming Airwallex into a generational financial company, sharing the journey of product development and sales alongside our business partners. You’ll help shape a global licensing footprint most fintechs wish they had, while making sure our brand and data architecture stay best-in-class for customers entering the agentic economy and ready for its regulatory demands. The hard part is helping the business move fast on product, revenue, and new-market expansion without compromising the regulatory discipline that protects the moat.

It’s a team for lawyers, strategists, and regulatory specialists with commercial instincts, sharp judgment, and an obsession with customer-first outcomes. If you want to guide executive decisions and help build the licensing, structure, and judgment behind what comes next, this is where legal has real leverage.

As Senior Corporate Secretary, you will play a pivotal role in Airwallex’s governance structure, supporting our board and senior management, and ensuring robust compliance and best-in-class corporate governance across our global group. You will lead the full spectrum of company secretarial matters for licensed entities across multiple regions and jurisdictions globally. This role is based in Singapore.

- Handle the full spectrum of company secretarial matters for licensed entities across different regions

- Organizing and facilitating board, committee and general meetings, including preparing agenda, resolutions, minutes and presentation materials

- Maintaining and handling statutory filings and statutory registers

- Handling group entities’ corporate matters, including incorporation, restructuring, capital injection, winding down and audit support

- Ensuring timely and accurate regulatory filings

- Lead the company secretarial function across jurisdictions and coordinate and manage external service providers

- Maintain and enhance entity management systems and corporate records

- Advise the board and senior management on governance, risk management, and compliance matters

- Support the implementation of best practices in data protection, cybersecurity, and technology risk management

Minimum qualifications:

- Qualified lawyer (Singapore or common law jurisdiction)

- At least 10–15 years of relevant experience, including significant experience in a regulated financial services or fintech environment

- Proven track record in supporting boards and senior management in a global or regional corporate structure

- Experience in a listed business

- Prior experience managing multi-jurisdictional entities and complex group structures

- Deep understanding of corporate governance frameworks, regulatory filings, and compliance obligations

- Experience establishing and maintaining board and committee processes, corporate records and entity management systems

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; able to interact effectively with Board members, investors, regulators and cross-functional teams

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth global environment

title: Engineering Manager - Authentication & Authorisation
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to join our Authentication and Authorisation team where you'll be responsible for the strategy, delivery and outcomes for the Pleo’s product IAM.

This is a highly complex space with a legacy custom-built service and a future-state platform, currently being implemented in our Enterprise rewrite.

Success in this role means defining and executing a sensible migration path between SMB and Enterprise architectures and modernising our current auth capabilities while maintaining high security, compliance, performance and trust.

WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You’ll report to our VP of Engineering and you’ll lead, mentor and grow a team of 6- 10 software engineers. You’ll work closely with Product, Security, Compliance and Core Platform teams to align priorities and manage dependencies, and you’ll collaborate across the wider Backend & Infrastructure group to keep technical direction and platform standards coherent.

Ultimately, your role is to foster an environment where engineers can do their best work and grow - as individuals and as a team - by setting clear expectations, ensuring our ways of working enable delivery (rather than slowing it down) and holding a high bar for quality.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

As an Engineering Manager, you will:

- Own the vision, strategy and execution roadmap for identity, authentication and authorisation across SMB and Enterprise.

- Drive delivery and outcomes for the Authentication & Authorisation team, ensuring we build secure, scalable systems the whole platform can rely on.

- Successfully roll out a new identity platform across our Enterprise offerings.

- Define and execute a pragmatic migration strategy between the SMB legacy service and the Enterprise architecture.

- Update legacy auth services, reducing risk and technical debt while maintaining high security, compliance, performance and trust.

- Partner closely with Product, Security, Compliance and Core Platform teams to align priorities, unblock dependencies and keep delivery moving.

- Stay close to the technology and architecture, stepping into technical discussions to guide the team through complex trade-offs.

- Continuously improve how we build software - strengthening operational excellence, quality and ways of working.

- Hire, coach and grow a high-performing team, helping people develop while building trust and strong team dynamics.

WHAT YOU BRING

Must have

- Solid experience as an Engineering Manager (or equivalent people-lead role), with meaningful people leadership impact (including coaching and performance support).

- Strong hands-on technical depth in authentication and authorisation domains and standards (e.g. OAuth, SAML, OIDC) and modern identity platforms (e.g. Amazon Cognito, Auth0, Stytch) within a product centric organisation.

- Architectural credibility and a track record of guiding teams through technical complexity, including migrations and legacy constraints.

- Strong stakeholder management across engineering, product and risk-focused partners with clear and consistent communication.

- A bias for action: you can lead through ambiguity and still create momentum, rather than getting stuck in analysis

Nice to have

- Background as a software architect or staff-level engineer before moving into people leadership.

- Experience operating in security - or compliance-sensitive domains where trust and reliability are non-negotiable.

- Experience scaling teams (hiring and building clear ownership) while maintaining delivery quality.

WHY THIS ROLE IS A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You care deeply about people's leadership and you want your team to grow, thrive and ship great software together.

- You enjoy cross-team collaboration and you’re energised by aligning stakeholders to solve platform-wide problems.

- You like staying close to code and architecture enough to guide technical decisions, while still leading through people and outcomes.

This role is NOT a good fit for you if:

- You prefer roles where you can be removed from day-to-day delivery, team dynamics and technical decision-making.

- You’re looking for a well-defined problem space with a clear migration plan already in place.

- You’re uncomfortable with ambiguity, trade-offs and the reality of improving a critical legacy system while building the future state.

HOW YOU'LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 6 months, you’ll take ownership of the auth platform roadmap, build strong alignment across Backend & Infrastructure stakeholders and drive tangible progress on rolling out a new identity platform for our Enterprise offerings.
You’ll also strengthen the team’s delivery rhythm and operational excellence, ensuring we maintain trust, security and availability while moving quickly.

By 12 months, you’ll have delivered key migration and modernisation milestones, reduced legacy risk and clarified a sustainable path between SMB and Enterprise auth architectures. You’ll have grown the team where needed, strengthened technical ownership and helped create a high-performing environment where people can do great work and keep improving how we build.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

- Intro call: 30min chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

- Hiring Manager interview: 45-minute experience-based conversation with our VP of Engineering  to deep dive into (technical) leadership experience, achievements and complexity you’ve been used to.

- Pleo Challenge: A 60-minute presentation interview focusing on discussing one of your previous achievements.

- Final interview: A 30-minute leadership interview with our Chief Technical Product Officer assessing your behavioural skills and values.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we're looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

- CV writing and content: Using AI tools is completely fine, but CVs that read like generic templates often hide what actually makes you great. We’d love to see specific examples of impact, ideally in the format “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z”, plus context on the systems you worked with and the constraints you operated under.

- Application care: Every application is reviewed by a human. Taking time to answer application questions clearly (and tailoring them to this role) genuinely helps you stand out.

- Profile to role fit: This role is a strong match if you’ve led an engineering team in a product environment and you bring real depth in authentication and authorisation (for example, implementing or running platforms like Cognito/Auth0/Stytch, and working with standards like OAuth, SAML and OIDC). We’re also looking for someone who can lead through migration complexity, keep stakeholders aligned across platform/security/compliance and drive outcomes with a bias for action.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to join our Authentication and Authorisation team where you'll be responsible for the strategy, delivery and outcomes for the Pleo’s product IAM.

This is a highly complex space with a legacy custom-built service and a future-state platform, currently being implemented in our Enterprise rewrite.

Success in this role means defining and executing a sensible migration path between SMB and Enterprise architectures and modernising our current auth capabilities while maintaining high security, compliance, performance and trust.

WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You’ll report to our VP of Engineering and you’ll lead, mentor and grow a team of 6- 10 software engineers. You’ll work closely with Product, Security, Compliance and Core Platform teams to align priorities and manage dependencies, and you’ll collaborate across the wider Backend & Infrastructure group to keep technical direction and platform standards coherent.

Ultimately, your role is to foster an environment where engineers can do their best work and grow - as individuals and as a team - by setting clear expectations, ensuring our ways of working enable delivery (rather than slowing it down) and holding a high bar for quality.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

As an Engineering Manager, you will:

- Own the vision, strategy and execution roadmap for identity, authentication and authorisation across SMB and Enterprise.

- Drive delivery and outcomes for the Authentication & Authorisation team, ensuring we build secure, scalable systems the whole platform can rely on.

- Successfully roll out a new identity platform across our Enterprise offerings.

- Define and execute a pragmatic migration strategy between the SMB legacy service and the Enterprise architecture.

- Update legacy auth services, reducing risk and technical debt while maintaining high security, compliance, performance and trust.

- Partner closely with Product, Security, Compliance and Core Platform teams to align priorities, unblock dependencies and keep delivery moving.

- Stay close to the technology and architecture, stepping into technical discussions to guide the team through complex trade-offs.

- Continuously improve how we build software - strengthening operational excellence, quality and ways of working.

- Hire, coach and grow a high-performing team, helping people develop while building trust and strong team dynamics.

WHAT YOU BRING

Must have

- Solid experience as an Engineering Manager (or equivalent people-lead role), with meaningful people leadership impact (including coaching and performance support).

- Strong hands-on technical depth in authentication and authorisation domains and standards (e.g. OAuth, SAML, OIDC) and modern identity platforms (e.g. Amazon Cognito, Auth0, Stytch) within a product centric organisation.

- Architectural credibility and a track record of guiding teams through technical complexity, including migrations and legacy constraints.

- Strong stakeholder management across engineering, product and risk-focused partners with clear and consistent communication.

- A bias for action: you can lead through ambiguity and still create momentum, rather than getting stuck in analysis

Nice to have

- Background as a software architect or staff-level engineer before moving into people leadership.

- Experience operating in security - or compliance-sensitive domains where trust and reliability are non-negotiable.

- Experience scaling teams (hiring and building clear ownership) while maintaining delivery quality.

WHY THIS ROLE IS A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You care deeply about people's leadership and you want your team to grow, thrive and ship great software together.

- You enjoy cross-team collaboration and you’re energised by aligning stakeholders to solve platform-wide problems.

- You like staying close to code and architecture enough to guide technical decisions, while still leading through people and outcomes.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You prefer roles where you can be removed from day-to-day delivery, team dynamics and technical decision-making.

- You’re looking for a well-defined problem space with a clear migration plan already in place.

- You’re uncomfortable with ambiguity, trade-offs and the reality of improving a critical legacy system while building the future state.

HOW YOU'LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 6 months, you’ll take ownership of the auth platform roadmap, build strong alignment across Backend & Infrastructure stakeholders and drive tangible progress on rolling out a new identity platform for our Enterprise offerings.
You’ll also strengthen the team’s delivery rhythm and operational excellence, ensuring we maintain trust, security and availability while moving quickly.

By 12 months, you’ll have delivered key migration and modernisation milestones, reduced legacy risk and clarified a sustainable path between SMB and Enterprise auth architectures. You’ll have grown the team where needed, strengthened technical ownership and helped create a high-performing environment where people can do great work and keep improving how we build.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

- Intro call: 30min chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

- Hiring Manager interview: 45-minute experience-based conversation with our VP of Engineering  to deep dive into (technical) leadership experience, achievements and complexity you’ve been used to.

- Pleo Challenge: A 60-minute presentation interview focusing on discussing one of your previous achievements.

- Final interview: A 30-minute leadership interview with our Chief Technical Product Officer assessing your behavioural skills and values.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we're looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

- CV writing and content: Using AI tools is completely fine, but CVs that read like generic templates often hide what actually makes you great. We’d love to see specific examples of impact, ideally in the format “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z”, plus context on the systems you worked with and the constraints you operated under.

- Application care: Every application is reviewed by a human. Taking time to answer application questions clearly (and tailoring them to this role) genuinely helps you stand out.

- Profile to role fit: This role is a strong match if you’ve led an engineering team in a product environment and you bring real depth in authentication and authorisation (for example, implementing or running platforms like Cognito/Auth0/Stytch, and working with standards like OAuth, SAML and OIDC). We’re also looking for someone who can lead through migration complexity, keep stakeholders aligned across platform/security/compliance and drive outcomes with a bias for action.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Design Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

About Vercel:
Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:
AI Gateway gives developers one place to connect applications and agents to hundreds of models with one API key. It handles provider routing and fallbacks, unifies billing and observability, and lets teams manage spend and security controls across production AI workloads.

Designing this well is a systems problem. A developer should be able to choose the right model, make and verify a first request, diagnose a failed request, and configure routing, budgets, credentials, and security controls without losing sight of the application they are trying to build. The right interface might be in the dashboard, on the public model catalog, in the CLI, in an API response, or in code.

You will be the Design Engineer for AI Gateway, owning product design and frontend implementation across those surfaces. You will work with customers, a Product Manager, and engineers to understand the problem, explore solutions, build the production experience, ship it, and learn from what happens after launch.

AI Gateway is live, the model ecosystem changes every week, and the team can move from an observed problem to production quickly. This is a rare chance to use your product judgment, design craft, and code to shape a developer product and ship the experience yourself.

You will be the design owner embedded with a Product Manager and a dedicated engineering team. You will also have the Product Design team around you for critique, collaboration, and support. AI Gateway will be your main product area, with room to pursue design-led improvements across Vercel. You will report to the Design Team.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do:

- Own product design and frontend implementation for meaningful parts of the journey from discovering a model to making a first successful request and operating AI in production.

- Design and build production experiences across the website, dashboard, CLI, and APIs, choosing the right medium for each problem.

- Make models, providers, credentials, routing, budgets, logs, performance, privacy, and governance understandable, then create patterns that extend across new providers, modalities, and workloads.

- Talk directly with customers and use product data to understand problems, define success, make tradeoffs, and improve what ships.

- Own quality after launch, including visual and interaction craft, accessibility, performance, resilience, instrumentation, and edge cases.

- Use coding agents to explore and implement ideas quickly, while testing, debugging, and taking responsibility for what ships.

About You:

- Your work shows what you personally identified, designed, built, shipped, and learned after launch.

- You build production-quality web applications with React and TypeScript and can contribute confidently in a large, existing codebase.

- You bring strong visual and interaction craft and have made technical or data-rich products understandable without removing the control advanced users need.

- You can move between graphical interfaces, CLI workflows, API behavior, and implementation details, treating accessibility, performance, failure recovery, and instrumentation as part of the design.

- You use customer research and product data to make decisions, communicate your reasoning clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and change direction when the evidence changes.

- You use coding agents in your daily work, but you can explain, test, debug, and take responsibility for the code they help produce.

There is no required path into this role. You may come from product design, frontend engineering, creative development, or a career that does not fit a standard title. We care about the quality of what you have shipped and the judgment behind it.

Bonus If You:

- Have experience with developer tools, infrastructure products, model marketplaces, or observability experiences.

- Have worked with AI models, providers, inference platforms, guardrails, or AI application tooling.

- Have experience with APIs, command-line tools, structured product content, or agent-facing interfaces.

- Have built an application or agent with Vercel’s AI SDK or AI Gateway.

See the work:

- AI Gateway

- AI Gateway documentation

- Browse AI models

- AI model leaderboards

- Design Engineering at Vercel

Compensation & Benefits:

- Competitive compensation package, including equity.

- Inclusive Healthcare Package.

- Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

- Flexible Time Off.

- We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $208,000 - $312,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

About Calm

Calm is the leading mental health brand on a mission to make the world happier and healthier. Known for its flagship consumer app—ranked #1 in its category with over 180 million downloads and availability in ten languages across 190 countries—Calm helps people sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully through content and tools from experts and beloved celebrity voices. Building on this foundation, Calm has created a broader portfolio including evidence-based solutions like Calm Health, offered through employers, health plans and providers, designed to expand access to mental health and sleep support, boost benefits engagement, and drive positive health outcomes. Today, Calm supports more than 3,500 organizations and reaches over 42 million covered lives through Calm Health. Calm has been recognized as a TIME100 Most Influential Company and one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter. Learn more at calm.com.

What We Do

At Calm we believe in making relaxation, better sleep, and mindfulness accessible to the entire world, and we hope you will help us achieve our mission. The Product & Design team is responsible for delivering Calm to our customers, ensuring that it is easy to use, supports their goals, and maintains a high level of quality across web, iOS, Android platforms.

As a Senior Product Designer on our Consumer team, you'll shape experiences used by tens of millions of people to sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully. People often reach for Calm in their most vulnerable moments, so the craft of what we make (how it looks, moves, and feels) matters enormously.

This is a builder's role in the truest sense: you'll use AI and modern prototyping tools to move from insight to interactive prototype to shipped experience, not as a shortcut on quality, but to spend less time producing and more time on the judgment and detail that make an experience great. When anyone can generate a hundred screens in an afternoon, taste and judgment are the differentiators!

The heart of this role is balancing velocity and craft in service of making our users healthier and happier, and building intuitive, engaging and impactful experiences that drive acquisition, engagement and retention.  You'll partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, and Marketing, and set the standard for craft across iOS, Android, and web.  You will be a thought leader in design, helping to establish best practices and setting the bar for exceptional product design at Calm.

What You’ll Do

- Own end-to-end product design initiatives that cover the whole product experience (visual, interaction, motion, brand integration), to create thoughtful, high-quality user-centered mobile experiences.

- Prototype quickly in Figma and with AI and low-code tools like Replit, Lovable, and Claude, so you can get real, testable ideas in front of people early.

- Present your design work clearly and persuasively to cross-functional stakeholders (including senior leadership), give and take feedback well, anchoring your rationale to both user needs and business goals.

- Maintain strong attention to detail and collaboration through engineering implementation (build and QA) and post launch-iterations, to ensure high-quality execution.

- Use data and drive research to inform the experiences you build, and leverage performance insights to evolve your approach.

- Champion system-level thinking (improving how the team works and evolving Calm's design system) so the whole team works faster and smarter.

- Balance multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of execution.

Who You Are

- Experienced Product Designer: 7+ years of experience in UX and UI design with 5+ within consumer mobile and web applications.

- AI-native and tooling-fluent: Highly proficient in Figma for design, and already using AI and low-code tools (Replit, Lovable, Claude) to prototype and move fast, with the judgment to know when the output is good enough and when it isn't.

- Technical agility: Comfortable shipping small code changes without engineering support, bridging the gap between design and engineering by personally shipping copy and UI polish directly.

title: Sr. UX Designer, Security
description:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: https://cribl.io/

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help define and deliver Cribl security product experience. You will design for security practitioners across detection, alerting, investigation, triage, search, threat coverage, telemetry, and AI-assisted workflows.

This role requires a genuine security background and the ability to turn complex SOC workflows into clear, trustworthy experiences. You will partner with Product, Engineering, UX Research, and other designers to create a cohesive experience that works seamlessly with our other products across the entire Cribl platform.

As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

- Lead end-to-end design from problem framing and research through interaction design, prototyping, validation, and implementation.

- Design workflows for detection creation and management, alert review, investigation, triage, search pivots, threat coverage, normalization, and enrichment.

- Apply security judgment to evidence, provenance, confidence, severity, permissions, auditability, destructive actions, and operational risk.

- Design AI-assisted and agentic experiences that make intent, context, sources, capabilities, uncertainty, and user approval clear.

- Use Cribl’s design system and contribute reusable components, patterns, guidance, and interaction models when the work has broader value.

- Work expertly in Figma for exploration, prototyping, documentation, collaboration, and handoff, including libraries, variables, components, variants, and tokens.

- Partner with engineers, PMs and designers through ideation, development to support feasibility, accessibility, resilience, and high-fidelity implementation challenges.

- Share work early and often through critiques and working sessions. Give and receive specific, constructive feedback.

- Use research and product evidence to prioritize opportunities, evaluate concepts, and improve shipped workflows.

- Communicate design rationale, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical partners.

- We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.

If You’ve Got It - We Want It

- Required:

- 5+ years experience designing complex B2B software, enterprise platforms, or products for technical users.

- A security background, such as security product design, security operations, threat detection, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, SOC workflows, SIEM, EDR, SOAR, or a related discipline.

- Understanding of security practitioners’ realities, including noisy signals, incomplete evidence, time pressure, and high-consequence decisions.

- Strong product thinking and interaction-design skills, with the ability to make complex technical workflows simple without oversimplifying them.

- Experience designing AI-assisted, agentic, conversational, or other emerging interaction models.

- Expert Figma skills, including advanced prototyping and design documentation.

- Demonstrated expertise working in and contributing to design systems. You know when to use existing patterns and when to extend them thoughtfully.

- Understanding of AI tools and AI UX interaction models is required. You can design experiences where AI assists, recommends, generates, investigates, or takes action while preserving user understanding, control, and trust.

- Experience collaborating closely with Product and Engineering in an iterative and changing environment.

- Strong communication, facilitation, and problem solving skills, including the ability to make progress when information is incomplete.

- A portfolio with case studies that show your role, process, decisions, collaboration, and outcomes. Candidates will be asked to present and discuss previous work.

- Highly desired:

- Familiarity with research tools such as Dovetail, including transcripts, tagging, themes, repositories, and insights.

- Experience with security data, detections, alerts, investigations, threat intelligence, telemetry, data pipelines, or analytical workflows.

- Experience designing for roles, permissions, tenants, environments, or different levels of technical expertise.

- A plus

- Understanding of accessible product design and inclusive interaction practices.

- Familiarity with WCAG principles, keyboard interactions, focus management, semantic structure, color contrast, and accessible content patterns.

- Familiarity with OCSF, MITRE ATT&CK, KQL, Sigma, detection rules, threat intelligence, or related concepts.

title: Bundul - Product Design Intern
description:
Product Design Intern

Location: Remote / Flexible

Employment Type: Internship

Hourly Pay: $18.47

*About Bundul*

Bundul is reshaping how consumers manage and enjoy their subscription services. Managing

multiple renewal dates across streaming platforms and digital services can be stressful and

chaotic. Bundul solves this by consolidating all streaming subscriptions into a single,

predictable monthly bill—giving users full control to set their preferred billing start date or split

payments into two bi-weekly installments 15 days apart.

Beyond financial flexibility, Bundul serves as an all-in-one hub where users can discover

personalized TV show and movie recommendations alongside accessible personal finance

articles. We sit at the intersection of fintech and digital media, making subscription

management effortless and engaging.

*Role Overview*

We are seeking a thoughtful, user-focused Product Design Intern to help shape the next

evolution of the Bundul mobile app. In this role, you will work closely with our product and

engineering teams to design seamless, high-fidelity interfaces for both our core financial

management tools (payment scheduling, bill splitting, subscription tracking) and our lifestyle

content feeds (media recommendations and finance guides).

This internship offers hands-on experience taking features from concept to production, directly

impacting how users manage their money and media.

*Key Responsibilities*

● High-Fidelity UI & Prototyping: Craft polished, high-fidelity user interface designs,

visual assets, and interactive prototypes that accurately reflect Bundul's brand identity

and design standards.

● End-to-End Feature Design: Create wireframes, user flows, visual mockups, and

production-ready designs for new and existing mobile app features.

● Fintech & Content Interface Design: Design clear, intuitive UX/UI for complex billing

interactions (e.g., custom payment scheduling, 15-day split-payment flows) while crafting

engaging visual layouts for curated media and personal finance content.

● User Research & Usability Testing: Conduct qualitative user interviews and usability

tests to gather feedback on prototypes, iterating based on user behavior and analytics.

● Design System Maintenance: Help build, scale, and document Bundul’s mobile design

system in Figma, maintaining high-fidelity component libraries across iOS and Android platforms.

● Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product managers and software

engineers to ensure design feasibility, write clear design specifications, and participate in

seamless design handoffs.

*Qualifications & Skills*

● High-Fidelity Design Skills: Strong ability to create high-fidelity UI designs, UI

components, layout structures, and pixel-perfect mockups ready for developer

implementation.

● Background: Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree or program in UX/UI

Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Graphic Design, or a related field.

● Portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design aesthetics, high-fidelity mobile

app design samples (iOS/Android), and a clear user-centered design process.

● Tool Proficiency: Mastery of Figma for high-fidelity UI design, including auto-layout,

interactive components, variants, and design systems.

● Problem-Solving: Ability to take complex financial concepts (payment split logic, billing

cycle customization) and simplify them into clean, stress-free user interactions.

● Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to articulate design

rationale and present high-fidelity work to stakeholders.

*Preferred / Nice-to-Have*

● Knowledge of or interest in the streaming entertainment industry, subscription

management, or consumer fintech.

● Experience with micro-interactions, high-fidelity motion design, or tools like Lottie/Rive.

● Basic understanding of mobile design guidelines (Apple Human Interface Guidelines and

Google Material Design).

*What You’ll Gain*

● Real-World Impact: Your high-fidelity designs will be shipped directly to active mobile

users.

● Mentorship: Regular 1-on-1 feedback, design critiques, and career guidance from senior

product leaders.

● Cross-Disciplinary Exposure: Insight into how fintech logistics, media curation, and

product strategy intersect in a fast-paced environment.

● Flexible Work Culture: Remote-first work structure with flexible hours.

title: Visual Game Artist (2D, 3D and/or UI) (university credits) viking/history strategy game studio
description:
Do you dream of creating stunning visuals that bring history to life? Are you fascinated by the Vikings and the idea of designing art for a historically accurate game? Join GAMUCATEX, where you’ll play a key role in shaping the visual identity of our card-based strategy game set in a rich, historical universe.

We’re seeking *Visual Game Artists* who are passionate about storytelling through art and are ready to collaborate with a diverse team of artists, developers, and historians.

*About us*

Learn more about us on our company page on the hub.

Welcome to GAMUCATEX – the indie startup fueled by a burning passion to weave history into enchanting gaming experiences! While our heart is in Copenhagen, our diverse team spans the entire globe. We are passionate about Vikings, and you'll definitely have the opportunity to learn everything you're willing to know with us. Infused with an international flair, we thrive on collaboration, creativity, innovation, and pure passion. Always ready to lend a hand, we're dedicated to crafting games that invite you to an evening of entertainment. Our team consists of people from the industry, some new and some with years in it. We don't consider ourselves experts, but we are eager to learn and improve with our team. We always have a group of interns with us. Join us on this epic journey where gaming meets history!

*About our game*

Tectonicus is the game where great stories of the past come to light, while you get to uncover – and interpret – what happened. Live through the clashes of civilizations that shape the world, and write history as you play.

Tectonicus synthesizes the mechanics of turn-based strategy games with the history of the Vikings. To succeed, you are to use strategic thinking when placing heroes, commanders, and units on the board, as well as building synergistic decks that emphasize each faction’s unique strengths.

Apart from online and local PvP battles, Tectonicus will be featuring a full-scale story mode. The player will be called to restore the historical truth lost in contradicting accounts and theories, rewritten history, and scholars’ disputes by reincarnating significant battles and living through them as warlords across centuries.

*About your Department*

You will be part of our Art Department, which drives the artistic and narrative aspects of our games. This team consists of concept artists, VFX, technical, UI, 2D, and 3D artists, and animators, collaborating to create an engaging and historically grounded experience. We work closely with other departments, including Game Design, Development, and History, ensuring a seamless integration of art and gameplay.

As part of the Art Department, you’ll be working in a supportive and dynamic environment that encourages experimentation and innovation. You will be key in developing, picking, and choosing tasks from the Trello board. You can prioritize what aligns with your strengths and interests. We encourage you to challenge yourself and take on tasks that may be outside of your comfort zone.

*About your role*

You will be instrumental in creating the visual assets that define our game’s unique identity. This role will involve developing character designs, historical scenes, and UI elements, and ensuring a cohesive and immersive visual style. You’ll work closely with the Game Director, Art Director, and other team members to bring our historical vision to life.

*Responsibilities:*

*

Create visually striking and historically accurate art assets, including characters, environments, and UI components.

*

Develop concept art and illustrations to guide the game’s visual style.

*

Collaborate with the Art Lead and Game Director to ensure assets align with the creative vision.

*

Participate in weekly Art Meetings and contribute to brainstorming sessions.

*

Produce high-quality art for cards, icons, and gameplay UI elements.

*

Ensure that all assets meet technical requirements and maintain consistency with the overall art direction.

*

Occasionally, participate in live-streaming events to showcase the game and your work to our community.

*About you*

You have either graduated from or are currently pursuing studies in game art, digital illustration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in creating visually engaging assets, understanding design principles, and translating creative ideas into high-quality artwork.

You are a problem-solver at heart, capable of adapting your skills to meet the needs of the project and enhancing the visual experience to showcase our game’s unique features in ways that captivate players.

You are also a collaborative team player who thrives in a multidisciplinary and diverse environment. Our team includes game developers, narrative designers, historians, and business developers, so being able to bridge diverse expertise and contribute your unique perspective is essential.

It’s a bonus if you’re eager to get involved in cross-functional projects, such as collaborating on promotional materials, organizing visual showcases, or participating in events to present the game. As an indie studio dedicated to crafting unique gaming experiences, an interest in or knowledge of indie games and their artistic processes is highly advantageous.

*Skills and Requirements:*

*

You have a strong portfolio showcasing your expertise in visual art, including one or more (character design, environment art, and/or UI design).

*

You’re willing to adapt your art style to match the game’s visual identity and are open to feedback.

*

Strong understanding of art fundamentals and design principles.

*

Experience with tools like Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar software.

*

You are proactive about honing your skills, eager to learn, and staying updated on industry trends.

*

Ability to work in a team with diverse skill levels, backgrounds, cultures, and ethnicities.

*

You thrive in a collaborative environment and are comfortable working across disciplines.

*

Familiarity with creating art for card games or similar projects is preferred.

*Pluses:*

*

Previous experience in leading visual art projects.

*

Residing in Europe.

*

Knowledge of Unity or other game engines is a plus.

*

Experience with multiple disciplines in 2D, 3D, UI, animations, technical art, or VFX.

*

An interest in history or a background in historically inspired art is a big plus.

*Details*

This position can be either *full-time* *or part-time,* and you are requested to work between 20 -37 hours a week.

The position can be taken as a remote position or with some or no on-site days, or fully on-site.

Our internships are structured based on a Danish setup; they are unpaid in Denmark. This *position will be unpaid,* but will contribute to an ECTS-giving internship. We also offer other kinds of internships, such as virksomhedspraktik (Denmark). There will be 3 open positions in this role. We cannot guarantee a paid position afterwards.

Our offices are located in three locations: Copenhagen (Amager/Nørrebro and Frederiksberg).

title: Junior Product Marketing Manager
description:
