To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

We’re looking for inquisitive, collaborative UX Quantitative Research interns to bring statistical rigor to product decisions. Partnering with mentors across product, design, data, and engineering, you’ll craft surveys, model attitudes alongside usage data, and translate complex findings into compelling narratives for our teams. Expect real projects, supportive teammates, and opportunities to shape Pinterest experiences that are impactful, inclusive, and meaningful for our Pinners.

*What you’ll do:*

* Influence and evolve our product roadmap to help us fulfill our mission - to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love - using data and exploratory analysis to understand user behavior and trends, and identify opportunities for product innovation.
* Use surveys to gather insights about Pinner, Merchant, Creator, or Advertiser sentiments and preferences using survey methodologies and statistical/modeling based approaches.
* Explore the intersection of user attitudes and behaviors by combining surveys and log analysis
* Work cross-functionally to build and communicate key insights.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers to help build the next experiences on Pinterest.

*What we’re looking for:*

* This position requires current enrollment in a school or education program in which the individual is working towards a PhD in statistics, psychology, sociology, applied sciences, computer science or related field
* Obtain PhD in statistics, psychology, sociology, applied sciences, computer science or related field by June 2027
* Currently pursuing a PhD in statistics, psychology, sociology, applied sciences, computer science or related field.
* Experience with survey methodology, including experience developing surveys and analyzing survey data
* Demonstrated experience in descriptive, inferential, and multivariate statistics, and experimental design.
* Experience using Python, R, or SQL.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to tell a complete narrative using data.
* Ability to connect data analysis to real business problems, in order to impact business performance.

*We offer 2 internship start dates:*

* May 18, 2026 - August 7, 2026
* June 15, 2026 - September 4, 2026

*Relocation Statement:*

This position is remote and not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

title: Junior Full Stack Engineer – AI

Ship features end-to-end, from backend development through to the user interface.

Work across the stack, including *React, Node/Express, Postgres, and AWS*.

Start with close guidance and progressively take on greater independence and ownership.

Help build the platform's *AI pipeline from week one*.

Gain hands‑on experience with AI development and learn how AI-powered features are built and improved in production.

Trace and fix bugs in the *production environment*.

Work with tools including *Sentry, CloudWatch, and Postgres*.

*

Learn how production systems work by investigating real issues and understanding their underlying causes.

*

Develop strong debugging and problem‑solving skills through hands‑on production experience.

Learning & Engineering Growth
-----------------------------

*

Work closely with the CTO and receive *direct technical mentoring*.

*

Use code reviews as a learning tool, incorporating feedback and progressively contributing feedback to others.

*

Take increasing ownership of features and technical problems as your experience grows.

*

Develop toward *independent feature ownership* , with a clear path toward a senior engineering role.

*

Contribute to improving the time from starting a project to a *finished, submitted application* through reliable features, automation, and product improvements.

Requirements
------------

*

*1–3 years of professional experience as a Software Engineer* , or recent university graduation with strong technical projects.

*

*What you have built matters more than simply the number of years of experience.*

*

Solid fundamentals in *TypeScript and/or JavaScript*.

*

Curiosity and willingness to work across the full stack, including:

*

*React*

*

*Node / Express*

*

*Postgres*

*

*AWS*

*

Strong desire to learn how production software is built and operated.

*

High self‑motivation and the ability to dig into problems rather than wait for instructions.

*

Comfortable receiving feedback and using it to improve your technical skills.

*

*AI-native approach to software development* , with familiarity using tools such as *Claude Code or Cursor*.

*

*User-first mindset* , with a focus on building software that works for real people.

*

Strong curiosity, ownership, and willingness to take on increasing responsibility.

Nice to Have
------------

*

First experience with *AI tools or LLM APIs* , including university or side projects.

*

*German language skills at B1 level or above.* The product and customers are German‑speaking, while the team works bilingually.

*

A *side project, open‑source contribution, or other work built independently*.

Growth Path
-----------

This role is designed as a *springboard for your engineering career*.

You’ll start with significant mentoring and guidance from the CTO, then progressively move toward *independent ownership of complete features and technical problems*.

The goal is to help you grow into an engineer who can *ship independently, contribute to technical decisions, and take ownership of increasingly complex parts of the product* , with a clear path toward a senior engineering role.

*Direct mentoring from the CTO* , who already has one successful exit and will work closely with you on your development.

A *steep learning curve* across a modern technology stack, AI-native development, and real production systems.

*Real production ownership from day one* , with increasing responsibility over time.

*Competitive entry-level salary* and participation in company success.

*Clear development path toward a senior engineering role.*

*€2,000 annual professional development budget.*

Opportunity to work on a *scalable SaaS product* with clear market demand and genuine social impact.

*Short decision paths* and direct collaboration with the leadership team.

*

*Team events and optional workations.*

Our Culture
-----------

*Customer First · Complete Ownership · Ship, Learn, Repeat · One Team*

title: Data Security Engineer - Junior+
description:
*The Technical Data Protection* function is responsible for implementing and operating technical controls that protect the company’s sensitive, confidential, personal, financial, and payment data.

*Data Security Enginee* r will be responsible for the practical implementation, configuration, integration, and continuous improvement of DLP and other data protection technologies across endpoints, cloud platforms, collaboration services, data repositories, and business systems. The role will work closely with the Data Security Architect, SOC, IT, DWH, Infrastructure, Product, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance teams.

*Challenges that await you:*

* Implementing, configuring, and operating DLP controls across endpoints, cloud services, email, collaboration platforms, and data storage environments.
* Creating and maintaining DLP policies for personal, financial, payment, confidential, and other sensitive data.
* Integrating data classification and labelling with technical enforcement and monitoring controls.
* Developing detection logic based on data types, labels, content patterns, context, user behaviour, destinations, and business processes.
* Investigating DLP alerts and potential data leakage cases in collaboration with SOC, Legal, Privacy, HR, and relevant business teams.
* Tuning policies to reduce false positives while maintaining effective protection and monitoring coverage.

* Encryption, masking, and tokenisation solutions.
* Data access and activity monitoring.

* Python and Bash.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer
description:
CDW Government is seeking an experienced Senior UX/UI Designer to support the design and delivery of modern digital solutions. This hands-on individual contributor will lead human-centered design activities, create intuitive user experiences, and deliver production-ready design assets that improve public health technology and disease surveillance systems. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in UX, UI, human-centered design, accessibility, and design systems. This role partners with product managers, engineers, public health subject-matter experts, and government stakeholders. The designer will also mentor peers through design critiques, facilitate workshops, and promote practical UX standards across project teams.

*What You Will Do*

• Lead the end-to-end UX and product design process, from discovery through implementation, for enterprise and public health applications.

• Plan and facilitate stakeholder interviews, user interviews, contextual inquiry, journey mapping, design-thinking workshops, ideation sessions, and co-creation workshops.

• Translate complex public health workflows and business processes into clear, intuitive digital experiences.

• Create personas, journey maps, information architecture, task flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity interface designs.

• Develop and maintain a scalable design system based on the U.S. Web Design System or a comparable enterprise design system.

• Create reusable Figma component libraries with documentation, usage guidance, specifications, and developer handoff details.

• Partner with front-end developers to maintain design fidelity and support successful implementation.

• Conduct usability testing and turn qualitative and quantitative findings into practical design recommendations.

• Promote accessible and inclusive design, including Section 508 and WCAG compliance.

• Participate in design reviews, sprint reviews, progress updates, readouts, and stakeholder presentations.

• Mentor junior designers through collaborative coaching, critiques, and knowledge sharing.

*What We Expect of You*

• Bachelor's degree in human-centered design, human-computer interaction, UX/UI design, product design, interaction design, graphic design, information design, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience may be considered.

• 10+ years of professional experience in product design, UX design, UI design, human-centered design, or a related field.

• Current human-centered design certification and a current UX certification from a recognized organization or training provider.

• Certified ScrumMaster or equivalent Agile certification or training.

• Formal training or demonstrated experience in Section 508 compliance and WCAG accessibility standards.

• Expert proficiency with Figma for design, prototyping, component libraries, and developer handoff.

• Demonstrated experience creating, documenting, and governing enterprise design systems using USWDS or a similar component-based system.

• Strong knowledge of responsive design, usability, interaction design, visual design, information architecture, and user research methods.

• Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, and stakeholder-engagement skills.

• Experience working within Agile or Scrum software-development teams.

• Experience supporting public health, government, or healthcare technology initiatives, is a plus.

• Understanding of state, tribal, local, and territorial public health operations and workflows, is a plus.

• Familiarity with disease surveillance, infectious-disease reporting, case management, epidemiology workflows, and public health modernization, is a plus.

• Experience with public health surveillance platforms such as NBS, EpiTrax, or Maven, is a plus.

• Experience supporting the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention or another federal public health agency, is a plus.

• Familiarity with public health interoperability standards and data-exchange initiatives, is a plus.

title: Strong Middle, Senior UI/UX Designer
description:
Опис вакансії
Про продукт
Visita — це marketplace-платформа для запису клієнтів до бізнесів у сфері послуг, а також B2B-кабінет для самих бізнесів.
З одного боку, продукт має B2C-частину, де клієнти можуть знаходити бізнеси, обирати послуги, майстрів і записуватися онлайн. З іншого боку, є B2B-кабінет, через який бізнес керує своєю роботою: записами, клієнтами, послугами, співробітниками, розкладом, налаштуваннями, аналітикою та сповіщеннями.
Кого ми шукаємо
Ми шукаємо Strong Middle / Senior Mobile UI/UX Designer з досвідом роботи над складними digital-продуктами: marketplace, SaaS, B2B-платформами, CRM, адмін-панелями, кабінетами користувачів або dashboard-інтерфейсами.
Основне завдання — адаптувати фіналізовану desktop web-версію B2B-кабінету під mobile та tablet web-формати.
Нам потрібен дизайнер, який зможе не просто перенести desktop-інтерфейс на менші екрани, а грамотно переосмислити UX-логіку для mobile/tablet: навігацію, таблиці, календар, форми, фільтри, картки, модальні вікна, стани та складні сценарії управління.
Основне завдання
Підготувати адаптацію B2B-кабінету Visita під два ключові формати:
mobile web;
tablet web.
Це не розробка двох окремих продуктів з нуля, а адаптація існуючої desktop-логіки та дизайн-системи під відповідні breakpoint’и.
При цьому важливо зберегти продуктову логіку, зручність роботи та зрозумілу структуру інтерфейсу для власників бізнесу, адміністраторів і операторів.
Що потрібно буде робити
Вивчити поточну desktop web-версію B2B-кабінету та UX-специфікацію.
Розібратися в логіці продукту: marketplace + B2B-кабінет.
Зрозуміти, як B2B-налаштування впливають на B2C-частину продукту.
Адаптувати ключові екрани під mobile та tablet breakpoint’и.

title: UI Technical Designer — Unreal Engine 5 UI Implementation
description:
We are seeking a *UI Technical Designer* to turn UX/visual direction into implementable, production-ready UI specifications and prototypes for Unreal Engine 5. This role bridges design and engineering by defining flows, interaction behavior, navigation rules, and component standards that ship reliably across platforms and input methods.

Responsibilities
----------------

* Define UI flows, user journeys, and interaction models for in-game screens and features, and produce clear, implementable specs
* Build and maintain a scalable UI component system, including patterns, components, variants, and states, that supports consistent implementation
* Author detailed behavior rules covering navigation/focus order, back behavior, input handling expectations, error/empty/loading states, and edge cases
* Collaborate daily with client engineers and UI artists to ensure designs are feasible, performant, and consistent in-engine
* Support iteration and polish through review of implementations, provide actionable feedback, and adjust designs based on technical constraints and playtest/QA findings

Requirements
------------

* 3+ years of experience with a strong UI/UX foundation and proven experience shipping digital products or game UI
* Expert-level proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, auto-layout, reusable libraries, and handoff-ready documentation
* Ability to create implementation-ready documentation such as annotated layouts, interaction notes, state diagrams, and acceptance criteria
* Familiarity with UMG concepts, including layout, anchors, scaling, and widget states/animations, sufficient to design within engine realities
* Understanding of focus-based navigation and multi-input requirements, including controller and keyboard/mouse
* Experience designing responsive UI for multiple resolutions/aspect ratios and safe-area considerations
* English proficiency at B2 level or higher

Nice to have
------------

* Experience with UI systems/framework conventions used in Unreal, such as screen stacks, activatable views, and common navigation patterns
* Experience with localization-aware design, including string expansion, truncation rules, and dynamic layouts
* Understanding of accessibility/readability considerations such as contrast, font sizing, and couch-distance UI
* Experience working on live products with rapid iteration and frequent releases

Benefits
--------

* International projects with top brands
* Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers
* Healthcare benefits
* Employee financial programs
* Paid time off and sick leave
* Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses
* Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses
* Global career opportunities
* Volunteer and community involvement opportunities
* EPAM Employee Groups
* Award-winning culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek and LinkedIn

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

* Cross-Medium Adaptation: Proven ability to translate brand DNA perfectly across varied formats, from digital social media kits to corporate pitch decks and print materials.
* Brand System Architecture: Strong organizational skills to develop clear brand guidelines, style guides, and structured asset libraries for wider team use.

*Additional requirements*

* Strong dedication to visual consistency and functioning as a true brand gatekeeper.
* Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot independently and deliver high-quality assets.
* Portfolio showcasing branding work (logos, identity systems, guidelines) must be included in the CV

On this project, contributors can earn up to *$40 per hour equivalent* , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

description:
*Job Description:*

Pluralsight is on a mission to shape the future of tech upskilling, and our brand is how the world meets that mission. As a Senior Graphic Designer - Multidisciplinary, you'll bring ideas to life across the full Pluralsight experience: brand, campaigns, web, digital, events, presentations, and motion. You'll choose the approach and medium that best solves each creative problem.

This role blends leadership with craft. You'll set creative direction, mentor other designers, and raise the quality bar for the team, while spending a significant part of your time concepting, designing, and producing work yourself. Everyone on our creative team is a maker. We're looking for someone with exceptional visual taste and conceptual thinking who knows what great looks like and stays curious enough to learn when the work calls for something new. You'll join a collaborative, inclusive team where learning is part of the job and your work has real impact.

*What you'll do*

* Concept, art direct, and create work across Pluralsight's marketing, including integrated campaigns, web and landing pages, digital advertising, social, events, presentations, and motion
* Turn marketing strategies, audience insights, and creative briefs into distinctive concepts and polished visual solutions
* Own high-impact projects from first idea to final delivery, setting the visual direction while staying close to the work
* Build and evolve scalable visual systems and templates that keep our brand consistent and leave room for creativity
* Present your concepts and explain the thinking behind your design decisions, connecting them to audience needs and business goals
* Mentor designers and guide agencies and contractors through clear feedback and hands-on collaboration
* Partner with Marketing, Product, Sales, Customer teams, Content, Events, and developers to bring ideas to life

*What you'll bring*

* An exceptional portfolio that shows strong visual taste, conceptual thinking, and versatility across brand, campaigns, digital, web/UX, presentations, events, motion, or content
* Deep command of design fundamentals, including typography, composition, hierarchy, color, imagery, and visual storytelling
* Advanced skills in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, plus curiosity to learn new tools, including AI-enabled creative workflows
* Strong digital design skills, with an understanding of responsive design, usability, accessibility, and modern web experiences
* Clear, confident communication, with the ability to advocate for creative decisions and build trusted relationships with stakeholders at every level
* Comfort with ambiguity, the ability to juggle multiple priorities, and the judgment to know when a project needs exploration and polish versus speed and iteration

*Multi-level Hiring Notice*

We are hiring two positions one at a mid-level and one at a senior-level. The title and level for which you will be hired will be dependent on qualifications and experience. Applications submitted to this posting will be evaluated against both levels based on the following minimum experience requirements:

* *Mid-Level Minimum Qualifications* : 5+ years of related experience; or 3+ years of related experience with an advanced degree (Master's/Doctorate).
* *Senior-Level Minimum Qualifications* : 8+ years of related experience; or 5+ years of related experience with an advanced degree (Master's/Doctorate).

* While Pluralsight operates under a remote and hybrid work model, we believe that in-person connection and collaboration are important. Recurring travel to our HQ near Dallas may be required depending on the role and team member location.
* This is a remote role; however, applicants located within 45 miles of our Westlake/Dallas, TX office should expect to work on-site Tuesday through Thursday, with remote flexibility on Mondays and Fridays. This approach enables more effective collaboration, quicker decision-making, and a stronger culture, while still providing flexibility.

*Why you'll love working here*

* We work in a blended environment that supports collaboration, flexibility, and connection across teams.
* We are mission-driven, shaping the future of tech upskilling and delivering impact that matters.
* We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging, where everyone can contribute and thrive.
* We are always learning, creating an environment where you can take on new challenges, expand your skills, and grow with purpose.
* Benefits include competitive compensation, bonus eligibility, comprehensive medical coverage, unlimited PTO, wellness reimbursement, professional development funds, and more.

*About us*

Pluralsight provides the only learning platform dedicated to accelerating the technology skills and capabilities of today's tech workforce. Thousands of companies, government organizations and individuals around the world rely on Pluralsight to support critical technology skill development in areas that are crucial to innovation including artificial intelligence, cloud computing, cybersecurity, software development, and machine learning. We offer highly curated content developed by vetted technology experts, industry leading skill assessments, and hands on, immersive learning experiences designed to help individuals skill-up faster.

We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

* *Mid-level:* $76,000.00 - $100,000.00
* *Senior-level:* $91,200.00 - $120,000.00

title: UX Researcher | India
description:
About AnswerLab

AnswerLab helps pioneering leaders Own the Unknown, transforming uncharted territory into clarity, direction, and competitive advantage. We build strategic insight through deep human understanding and validating future possibilities with real people in real contexts. We believe that the future of experience strategy relies on continuous learning and cross-functional expertise, enabling us to guide clients through unprecedented challenges across every phase of the product lifecycle.

Role Summary

As a UX Researcher, you will join our Rapid Research program, a dedicated, embedded research team that delivers fast, high-quality insights (typically within 1–2 weeks) to a major global technology client.

Rapid Researchers are based across the US, EMEA (UK, Zurich), and APAC (India, Korea), providing global research coverage for the client's key audiences, including General Populations, Content Creators, Teens, and accessibility-focused populations.

This remote role is based in India and adds dedicated coverage and Hindi-language research capabilities to the program, enabling the team to conduct research with both Hindi and English-speaking participants, and to better support stakeholders across the region and in other international markets, including US-based stakeholders.

You'll spend the majority of your time leading Rapid Research studies end-to-end, with the opportunity to contribute to longer-form Custom Research projects (e.g., diary studies, benchmarking, or focus groups), as needed.

You are passionate about research: you love learning new methods, testing new tools and technologies, and thinking deeply about the human-centered issues we face as researchers. You see yourself as a partner to stakeholders, bringing them into the research process and listening closely to their needs.

You're proactive, adaptable, and organized, with time management skills to keep multiple fast-moving studies on track simultaneously. Rapid Researchers are typically prepping their next study while fielding and reporting on the current one.

Ideal candidates have at least 4 years of hands-on experience leading research studies and partnering with stakeholders or clients throughout the research process.

Key Responsibilities

1. Rapid Research Delivery

* Lead Rapid Research studies end-to-end, delivering fast, high-quality insights within a 1–2 week (or accelerated 1-week sprint) timeframe.
* Consult on research methodology and scope, and develop kickoff/alignment documents and moderator guides
* Moderate remote and in-person interviews (In-Depth Interviews, unmoderated studies, heuristic evaluations) with Viewers, Creators, Teens, or accessibility-focused participants
* Conduct literature reviews and competitive analyses as needed
* Deliver end-of-day session summaries during fielding and lead key-takeaway alignment with stakeholders
* Analyze findings and develop final reports (slide decks of ~30 slides, or written docs) with clear, actionable recommendations
* Present findings in stakeholder readouts

2. Client Stakeholder Partnership

* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders, bringing consultative guidance to every study.
* Provide consultative guidance and proactively recommend solutions to keep research moving forward
* Coordinate closely with the recruiting team on participant screening and scheduling, flagging special or advanced recruit needs early
* Support Hindi-language studies and localization needs, serving as a regional point of contact for India specific research questions

3. Program & Process Excellence

* Keep projects on track and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Rapid Research program.
* Keep projects on schedule and within scope, managing multiple concurrent studies at different stages (prep, fielding, reporting)
* Explore creative solutions to research challenges, including recommending improvements to internal processes or best practices
* Continue developing your research and consultative skills, and contribute to AnswerLab's knowledge library and internal training initiatives
* Contribute to Custom Research projects (2+ week timelines) as a nice-to-have, such as focus groups, diary studies, benchmarking, surveys, card sorting, contextual inquiry, or Critical User Journey (CUJ) audits

Key Relationships

* Reports to: Research Manager (UK-based)
* Close collaboration with: UX Research peers across all markets (APAC, EMEA, US), Research Manager (US-based), Project Manager
* Client engagement: Active coordination with client stakeholders

Knowledge, Skills, & Experience

We know outstanding candidates come from a range of backgrounds. We are looking for people with the personal characteristics to thrive in a growing, client-focused, purpose-driven business. The ideal candidate will meet many of the criteria below.

Experience

* 4+ years of hands-on experience conducting qualitative UX or market research, including experience leading studies end-to-end
* Native/fluent fluency in Hindi and business-level fluency in English, with the ability to moderate research sessions and write deliverables in both languages
* Experience partnering with clients/stakeholders in a consulting or agency environment, or an equivalent research background
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities across concurrent studies, and meet fast-moving deadlines

Research Craft

Skilled in core Rapid Research methodologies:

* In-depth interviews
* Unmoderated studies
* Heuristic evaluation
* Literature review
* Competitive analysis

Familiarity with a broader range of methodologies is a nice-to-have:

* Focus groups
* Diary studies
* Benchmarking
* Surveys
* Card sorting
* Contextual inquiry
* Critical User Journeys
* Strong presentation skills, including building decks and presenting results and recommendations to senior stakeholders

Organization & Communication

* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy and completeness
* Exceptional time management skills with the ability to prioritize effectively across competing demands
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal abilities
* Comfortable using online/remote research tools (e.g., Google Meet, Zoom, dscout, GSuite)
* Responsive, service-oriented, and client-focused in all interactions

Mindset & Values

* Curious, enthusiastic, and energized by a fast-paced, problem-solving environment
* Self-motivated, quick learner who thrives with minimal supervision
* Collaborative team player with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through
* Committed to inclusive, empathetic collaboration and contributing to a workplace where diverse talent thrives

Education

Undergraduate and/or advanced degree, preferably in:

* Experimental Psychology
* Cognitive Psychology
* Human Factors
* Human-Computer Interaction
* Or a related field with a foundation in research-based design

Additional Requirements

Willingness to collaborate across multiple time zones (e.g., APAC, EMEA, and US-based partners), which may occasionally require scheduling flexibility and extended hours to meet project deadlines

Ability to work at a computer for extended periods of time

Location Eligibility

Home-based/remote, located in India, with up to 15% travel (including occasional in-person sessions at regional lab spaces)

Must be comfortable leading projects independently and collaborating virtually across APAC, EMEA, and US time zones, which may occasionally require schedule flexibility

Candidates must have current work authorization in India; AnswerLab cannot sponsor visas for this role.

No staffing or recruiting agencies.

description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 676,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

About the team

Legal at Airwallex sits at the heart of the decisions that shape how Airwallex grows. This team backs the visionary builders transforming Airwallex into a generational financial company, sharing the journey of product development and sales alongside our business partners. You’ll help shape a global licensing footprint most fintechs wish they had, while making sure our brand and data architecture stay best-in-class for customers entering the agentic economy and ready for its regulatory demands. The hard part is helping the business move fast on product, revenue, and new-market expansion without compromising the regulatory discipline that protects the moat.

It’s a team for lawyers, strategists, and regulatory specialists with commercial instincts, sharp judgment, and an obsession with customer-first outcomes. If you want to guide executive decisions and help build the licensing, structure, and judgment behind what comes next, this is where legal has real leverage.

What you'll do

As Counsel, Product Legal (Yield), you will be the lead counsel for Airwallex’s Yield product. You will help scale the product in existing and new markets by providing legal, regulatory and strategic advice across the full product lifecycle, including product design, licensing, regulatory engagement, partner arrangements, customer terms, disclosures, launch execution and product integration.

You will work closely with the global Yield Product team and partners across Product, Regulatory Legal, Regulatory Compliance, Licensing, Risk, Product Marketing, Operations and other functions. You will coordinate advice across multiple jurisdictions and help translate complex legal and regulatory requirements into practical, commercially minded solutions that enable responsible product growth.

This role is based in San Francisco or New York City.

Responsibilities:

- Act as a trusted business partner to the Yield Product teams and other stakeholders responsible for launching and developing the Yield product.

- Support Product stakeholders throughout the entire product lifecycle by advising on the legal and regulatory aspects of new product ideas and enhancements to existing products, from ideation through launch and expansion.

- Coordinate with local counsel across jurisdictions such as Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong, the U.S., the U.K. and the European Union to determine and develop optimal paths to market from a legal and regulatory perspective.

- Translate legal and regulatory advice into actionable solutions that can be integrated into the product development process, including product requirements, customer terms, disclosures and launch-readiness materials.

- Identify synergies and efficiencies in product development across jurisdictions as Yield scales into new markets, and develop practical legal frameworks, playbooks and processes that support repeatable product launches.

- Collaborate with Regulatory Compliance, Product Marketing, Licensing, Risk and relevant regulated partners, including banks, broker-dealers, custodians and investment managers, to support product governance, partner arrangements and ongoing product changes.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

- JD (or equivalent law degree) and active bar membership in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

- 5+ years of post-qualification experience, at least some of which was gained at a top-tier law firm.

- Experience advising on investment products, discretionary or non-discretionary management, broker-dealer arrangements, custodial relationships, investment-management structures or related customer disclosures and documentation.

- Strong regulatory advisory and/or product counseling experience with a reputable law firm, financial institution or fintech, including at least three years advising on wealth-management products.

- Proven experience as a solution-oriented lawyer who enjoys working strategically with non-lawyers to support commercial outcomes.

- Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Marketing, external counsel and senior stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions.

- Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-jurisdictional legal workstreams, prioritize competing demands and take ownership of advice from product ideation through launch and expansion.

Preferred qualifications:

- In-house legal experience gained in fintech, financial services, wealth management, asset management, securities, brokerage or another regulated financial-services environment.

- Experience working across relevant securities, investment-adviser, investor-protection, fiduciary, suitability or equivalent regulatory frameworks in multiple jurisdictions, subject to the specific scope of the Yield product.

- Experience building scalable legal playbooks, product-governance processes, launch checklists or other tools that improve legal efficiency and help teams move quickly with sound judgment.

- Comfort operating in environments with high standards, fast iteration cycles and evolving priorities, with a curious, collaborative and ownership-oriented approach.

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

In this role you'll work closely with a team of brand designers and design ops, collaborate cross-functionally with PMM, Product Design, Web, and Social, and partner with external agencies on bigger productions. title: Brand Designer
description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.

At Greenlight, we're here to make the day-to-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.

We are looking for a *Brand Designer* with a passion for creative storytelling and experience working within a design system on a wide range of activations. In this role, you will partner closely with the Design team to build and grow Greenlight’s visual brand identity across all of our marketing, advertising, and product touchpoints. You’ll be responsible for creating work that connects with families, clearly communicates all our product offerings, brings surprise & delight, and differentiates Greenlight in the competitor space.

Your day-to-day:
----------------

* Concept and design engaging visual assets across Greenlight’s brand and product ecosystem to support customer acquisition, engagement, and retention efforts.
* Work on a range of creative projects like marketing and product launch campaigns, website landing pages, emails, social media content, in-app content, company swag, presentation decks, direct mailers, and more.
* Leverage motion to engage viewers and support storytelling.
* Drive consistency and cohesion across the brand, building upon guidelines and identifying opportunities for fresh visual expression.
* Collaborate with marketing and product managers, creative directors, strategists, copywriters, designers, and cross-functional teams to ensure your work delivers on the creative brief and meets business objectives.

What you’ll bring to the team:
------------------------------

* 1-3 years of design experience at a creative agency or in-house at a design-led company.
* A dynamic portfolio showcasing diverse design skills: layout, typography, color, form, motion, storytelling, and brand systems.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work within brand guidelines
* Strong visual and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment
* A strong grasp on contemporary design aesthetics, trends, and interest in emerging technologies.
* Advanced design skills in Figma. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign). Working knowledge of AfterEffects is a big plus.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Nice to have: ability to design for print and create press-ready mechanical files

Not sure this one’s for you? Don’t count yourself out. Show us what you’ve got and we’ll reach out if there’s a great fit.

Our stance on salaries:
-----------------------

Greenlight provides a competitive compensation package with a market-based approach to pay and will vary depending on your location, experience and skill set. The total compensation package for this position will also include a discretionary performance bonus, equity rewards, medical benefits, 401K match, and more. Greenlight conducts continuous compensation evaluations across departments and geographies to ensure we are keeping our pay current and competitive.The estimated base pay range for this position in (NY, CA, WA): $85,000- 110,000
The estimated base pay range for this position in (CO): $85,000 - 100,000 *Who we are:* It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" People who bring their real selves to the table and push the people around them to do the same. We win by never hesitating to jump in, offer a hand, or share the credit, because we know we're stronger together than apart. And through all of it, the mission stays the thing we measure ourselves against: are we doing right by the families counting on us? description:
*Welcome to the good side of tech 👋*

You might know us as *ZnanyLekarz* in Poland or *Doctoralia* in Spain. Globally, we are Docplanner.

We build technology that helps people live longer, healthier lives. Our products connect patients with doctors, power clinical workflows, and support healthcare systems used by millions of people every month.

Engineering at Docplanner is about building reliable, scalable systems with real human impact. What we ship affects patients, doctors, and clinics in everyday, high-stakes situations - which means quality, judgment, and long-term thinking matter.

In 2026, we are accelerating delivery across multiple product areas by changing how we build - leveraging AI-assisted development to increase engineering effectiveness and raise the bar on how we design, ship, and evolve systems.

*And why should you join us?*

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to help people live longer, healthier lives, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self. You can decide to work fully remote, or work hybrid with our offices located in Barcelona or Warsaw. This will be dependent on the final team allocation.

*Our challenges*

Our Engineers may join teams working on these areas and challenges:

*Marketplace & Search*

Build the next-generation marketplace system by owning the end-to-end journey from agentic discovery to rebooking. You’ll leverage AI search and AI onboarding funnels to unlock new demand and transform one-off bookings into continuous care loops.

*Practice Management Systems (PMS)*

Build the next generation of software to help doctors globally. Unify the current fragmented reality and leverage AI to reinvent the way to help doctors focus on what matters most: treating the patient.

*AI-powered Clinical Tools (Noa Medic)*

Design AI-native clinical workflows that move beyond simple scribing to replace end-to-end administrative tasks. You'll build deep PMS/EHR embeddings that become an indispensable daily habit for medical professionals.

*Patient & Data Integrations (Noa Patient)*

Move beyond the booking button to build a proactive healthcare partner. You'll create the smart connections that blend someone's medical past with their live health data, crafting an AI experience that actually keeps patients coming back. Turn raw data into advice people can use, making Docplanner the one health app they can't live without.

Internally, these challenges map to some of our most ambitious and high-impact initiatives.

*Role Overview*

At Rehire, we are partnering with a US-based data engineering and cloud technologies company to find a *Junior SRE Engineer* to join its Reliability Engineering team. You will be embedded with the SRE function of a financial services client, supporting a regulated consumer-lending platform on AWS with hundreds of microservices and event-driven pipelines, where reliability directly impacts customer trust and compliance.

This is a unique opportunity to grow in an environment where AI is already part of day-to-day operations, including an AI SRE co-pilot, purpose-built AI agents for incident triage and monitoring, and a formal AI governance program. Working under the guidance of senior engineers and architects, you will help operate, improve, and learn from this AI-driven reliability program.

*Key Responsibilities:*

· Support incident response as a shadow or secondary responder, using AI-driven detection, correlation, and root-cause analysis tools.

· Help build incident timelines from metrics, logs, traces, and deploy history, and document postmortems and corrective actions through to closure.

· Help operate and monitor AI SRE sub-agents (incident summarization, monitor-gap detection, usage attribution), flagging anomalies for senior review.

· Build and maintain Datadog monitors, dashboards, and SLO definitions as code using Terraform, and support SLI/SLO and error-budget reviews for critical customer journeys.

· Help reduce alert noise with AI/ML-assisted detection (anomaly, outlier, and forecast monitors, dynamic thresholds) and run recurring monitor-hygiene reviews.

· Support the day-to-day reliability of AWS workloads (ECS/Fargate, EKS, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, ALB, SQS/SNS, Step Functions).

· Identify capacity, saturation, and cloud cost anomalies, and help attribute spend and telemetry volume to owning teams and services.

· Write automation in Python and Bash against platform APIs (Datadog, AWS, GitHub, PagerDuty, Jira) and contribute Terraform modules through pull requests.

· Help integrate reliability controls and AI-assisted checks into CI/CD pipelines, and create runbooks progressively automated toward self-healing.

· Participate in architecture, reliability, and AI-risk reviews, learning how compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, SOX, GLBA) apply in a regulated environment.

*Requirements:*

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

· 1–3 years of experience in SRE, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform, or production-support engineering.

· Advanced English (oral and written). *REQUIRED*

· Hands-on exposure to *AWS* (or an equivalent hyperscaler) across compute, networking, storage, and managed database services.

· Exposure to at least one observability platform ( *Datadog preferred* ; Grafana/Prometheus, New Relic, CloudWatch, or ELK/OpenSearch also relevant).

· Foundational understanding of SLI, SLO, and error-budget concepts.

· Foundational knowledge of containers and orchestration (Docker, ECS, or Kubernetes) and serverless execution models.

· Beginner-to-intermediate experience with Infrastructure as Code ( *Terraform preferred* ; Ansible or CloudFormation acceptable).

· Scripting experience in Python, Bash, or similar, including consuming REST APIs and parsing JSON.

· Basic Linux troubleshooting and networking fundamentals (DNS, TLS, load balancing, timeouts, and retries).

· Comfort with Git, pull-request workflows, and CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, or similar).

· Familiarity with incident management and on-call concepts (severity models, escalation policies, PagerDuty or Opsgenie).

· Experience in product engineering services, enterprise software, or fintech is a plus.

· Awareness of compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, SOX, GLBA) is a plus.

*Key Competencies:*

· Automation mindset: you would rather automate a task the second time you do it than the tenth.

· Good judgment to escalate early instead of sitting on an uncertain production signal.

· Clear written communication: you can explain an incident, a metric, or a trade-off to someone who was not in the room.

· Curiosity about LLM-based assistants and agents applied to operations, and about how to verify that their output is correct.

*Preferred Certifications (not required):*

· AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or an Associate-level AWS certification.

· HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate.

· Datadog Fundamentals or an equivalent observability certification.

· Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or KCNA.

*About the Position:*

· Work Schedule: US shift presential at Guadalajara, Mexico.

· Work Modality: Full-time contractor basis.

· Competitive Salary Paid in USD.

title: UI/UX Designer - Clearance Required
description:
Overview
--------

LMI is seeking an experienced *UI/UX Designer* to support the delivery of next-generation software capabilities for U.S. Army modernization initiatives. *This position requires an Active Secret security clearance.*

Working closely with Product Owners, Software Engineers, Technical Program Managers, Scrum Masters, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Army stakeholders, you will design intuitive, mission-ready user experiences that enable Soldiers to quickly understand information, make informed decisions, and execute operations in dynamic environments.

You will be responsible for translating complex operational workflows, command and control processes, and mission requirements into modern, user-centered interfaces that perform in real-world Army environments. Drawing on commercial UX best practices and human-centered design principles, you'll help ensure cloud-native, AI-enabled software is not only powerful, but also intuitive, efficient, and trusted by operational users.

Join a high-performing software team delivering next-generation capabilities that directly support U.S. Army modernization. As a UI/UX Designer, you'll shape how Soldiers interact with mission-critical software by transforming complex operational workflows into intuitive, efficient, and visually compelling user experiences. Working alongside Product Owners, Technical Program Managers, Engineering Leads, Software Engineers, AI specialists, and Army stakeholders, you'll directly influence the usability of cloud-native, AI-enabled software deployed across enterprise cloud and Tactical Edge Compute (TEC) environments. Your work will help deliver software that enables faster decision-making, improves operational awareness, and enhances mission effectiveness for Army organizations worldwide.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

If you're passionate about human-centered design, modern user experiences, and building software that directly supports U.S. Army operations, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities
----------------

What You'll Do
--------------

* Lead UX/UI design for next-generation software capabilities supporting U.S. Army modernization initiatives.

* Collaborate with Product Owners, Technical Program Managers, Engineering Leads, Software Engineers, DevSecOps, Cybersecurity Specialists, and Army stakeholders to define user experience goals and design standards.

* Conduct user research, interviews, workshops, and usability studies with Army personnel to understand mission workflows, operational challenges, and decision-making needs.

* Translate complex operational processes into intuitive user journeys, task flows, information architectures, and interaction designs.

* Design wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, interactive prototypes, and production-ready user interface specifications.

* Develop and maintain a scalable design system including reusable components, typography, color standards, accessibility guidelines, and interaction patterns.

* Design intuitive interfaces that visualize operational data, geospatial information, Common Operating Pictures (COPs), task management, AI-assisted recommendations, and mission planning workflows.

* Partner closely with Software Engineers to ensure designs are technically feasible, performant, and optimized for secure cloud-native applications.

* Participate in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.

* Conduct usability testing with Army users and incorporate operational feedback into iterative design improvements.

* Create UX artifacts including user personas, journey maps, workflow diagrams, storyboards, and design documentation.

* Support customer demonstrations, executive briefings, pilot deployments, and operational evaluations through compelling interface prototypes and visualizations.

* Help establish scalable UX practices, design standards, and reusable design assets that support future software development efforts.

Qualifications
--------------

Required Skills
---------------

* *Active Secret security clearance is required.*
* Bachelor's degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

* 5+ years of experience as a UX/UI Designer, Product Designer, or similar role supporting complex software products.

* Experience designing modern web-based applications using user-centered design principles.

* Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous operational requirements into intuitive user experiences.

* Expertise with Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or comparable design and prototyping tools.

* Experience collaborating with Product Owners, Software Engineers, and cross-functional Agile teams.

* Strong understanding of user-centered design, interaction design, visual design, accessibility, and responsive design principles.

* Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies and the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

* Strong visual design skills with exceptional attention to usability, clarity, consistency, and information hierarchy.

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience presenting designs to technical teams and senior stakeholders.

Desired Skills
--------------

* Experience designing software products for the Department of Defense or other federal government customers.

* Familiarity with Army operations, Mission Command systems, Protection operations, or Command and Control applications.

* Experience designing geospatial applications, Common Operating Pictures (COPs), GIS-enabled interfaces, operational dashboards, or map-centric workflows.

* Experience designing user experiences for AI-enabled software applications, including decision support tools, generative AI capabilities, or intelligent workflow automation.

* Familiarity with cloud-native software architectures, containerized applications, DevSecOps practices, and secure software delivery methodologies.

* Experience collaborating closely with front-end engineers using React, TypeScript, or similar modern web technologies.

* Understanding of secure software deployment environments including RMF, Authority to Operate (ATO), and IL5/IL6 environments.

* Prior experience supporting operational military users, software fielding activities, or forward deployed engineering teams.

Target salary range: $92,000 - 158,000

Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

title: UI/UX Designer, Learning Team
description:
*Location preferred:* APAC, Brazil, or US

About ELSA
----------

ELSA is a leading innovator in English communication assessment technology, dedicated to transforming how people improve their English skills. Our flagship product, ELSA Speak, acts as a personal mobile coach, helping users enhance their communication abilities by providing real-time feedback on what they say (grammar and vocabulary) and how they say it (pronunciation and intonation). By leveraging advanced signal processing and generative AI, ELSA Speak identifies user errors and delivers precise, consistent and actionable guidance for improvement.

At ELSA, our vision is to be the global leader in teaching real-time, conversational English, with the aim of helping over 1.5 billion language learners worldwide. We are here to celebrate and empower every individual on the global stage to build confidence, be understood, and help share their story. Come join our very talented team of people working to make a difference using the power of AI, with our proprietary speech recognition technology!

About the Role
--------------

We are seeking a *UI/UX Designer* to join the Learn Team within ELSAs AI Department a cross-functional team shaping the future of learning experiences across ELSA product ecosystem.

Youll design intuitive, motivating, and data-informed learning interfaces, working closely with Learning Experience Designers, AI engineers, and Product Managers. The ideal candidate combines strong UX design skills with an understanding of learning design and pedagogy, creating user journeys that are not only beautiful but also educationally effective.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

1. Learning-Focused UX & Product Design
---------------------------------------

* Design and prototype learner journeys and interfaces that make complex language learning goals feel simple, rewarding, and intuitive.
* Apply learning experience principles to enhance engagement, flow, and comprehension.
* Conduct user research, usability testing, and data analysis to inform design decisions and improve learning outcomes.

2. Collaboration Across AI, Product, and Learning
-------------------------------------------------

* Work closely with Learning Experience Designers to translate pedagogical goals into user-centered product features.
* Partner with AI and Product teams to design experiences that integrate real-time feedback, personalization, and adaptive learning.
* Create design systems and guidelines to ensure consistent, high-quality learner experiences across platforms.

3. Data-Driven Design & Iteration
---------------------------------

* Use quantitative and qualitative data (engagement metrics, completion rates, UX tests) to measure and improve design effectiveness.
* Collaborate with the analytics and AI teams to visualize learner progress and feedback in meaningful ways.
* Iterate rapidly using tools like Figma, Figjam, Looker or Amplitude to validate design hypotheses.

Qualifications

*Required*

* *Bachelors degree in UI/UX Design, HCI, Interaction Design, Educational Technology, or a related field.*

* *Experience designing data-informed and user-centered workflows.*
* *Familiarity with learning psychology, instructional design principles, or digital education environments.*
* *Excellent visual design, communication, and storytelling skills.*

*Preferred*

* *Experience designing AI-powered or adaptive learning systems.*
* *Familiarity with language learning products or communication training.*
* *Understanding of localization and accessibility in global markets.*
* *Basic skills in motion design or micro-interaction prototyping.*

*Why Join ELSA*
---------------

* *Shape the future of *AI-driven English learning* , reaching billions of users globally.*

description:
We're adding to our team and searching for a UX Designer to contribute to this ongoing work. Convert creative and experience-oriented direction into practical UI specifications and prototypes built for Unreal Engine production contexts. This role serves as the connecting thread between design objectives and engineering implementation, mapping out interaction sequences, behavioral standards, navigation frameworks, and component structures that function consistently across a variety of platforms and input formats.

Responsibilities
----------------

* Establish UI flows, user journeys, and interaction sequences for in-game screens and features, shaping them into specifications ready for engineering work
* Develop and gradually broaden a versatile UI component library covering patterns, components, variants, and states to keep design implementation uniform
* Prepare comprehensive behavioral guidelines addressing focus and navigation flow, back-navigation handling, expected input behavior, error/empty/loading conditions, and various edge cases
* Maintain tight, ongoing collaboration with engineers on the client side and UI artists to verify designs stay realistic, performant, and consistent once integrated into the engine
* Manage continuous polish efforts by evaluating finished builds, sharing constructive feedback, and modifying designs based on technical boundaries and results gathered from playtesting or QA

Requirements
------------

* Two-plus years of applied experience built on strong UI/UX capabilities, reflected in having shipped digital products or gaming interfaces
* Wide-ranging skill with Figma, encompassing components, variants, auto-layout, reusable libraries, and documentation suited for engineering handoff
* Competent at delivering implementation-ready assets, such as annotated screen designs, interaction overviews, state diagrams, and well-specified acceptance criteria
* Direct familiarity with the particular constraints and processes tied to constructing UI within Unreal Engine
* Understanding of fundamental UMG concepts, including layout, anchoring, scaling, and widget states/animations, sufficient to design within actual engine limitations
* Awareness of focus-driven navigation approaches along with the capacity to support various input types, such as controller and keyboard/mouse
* Established background designing UI that scales properly across differing resolutions, aspect ratios, and safe-area demands
* Adequate communication skills paired with English fluency at B2 level or higher, enabling accurate understanding of business needs and their translation into agentic architectures

Nice to have
------------

* Familiarity with UI framework standards particular to Unreal, including screen stacks, activatable views, and typical navigation methods
* Background factoring localization considerations into design, including handling text expansion, truncation, and adaptable layouts
* Awareness of accessibility and readability aspects, including contrast, font sizing, and interfaces built for couch-distance use
* Experience contributing to live products marked by quick iteration and consistent release patterns
* Introductory familiarity with AI Assistant tools
* Prior background working in the Gaming industry

title: Team Lead - Sales Development
description:
*Who are we and what do we do?*

BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.

With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.

Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.

*Location: This is a fully remote position, open to candidates residing anywhere in India.*

*Role in a Nutshell*

As a Team Lead - Sales Development at BrowserStack, you will lead a dynamic and growing Sales Development team in a fast-paced environment. Reporting to the Manager - Sales Development, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of the sales pipeline by driving top-of-funnel activity and nurturing a team of Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to ensure they reach their full potential. You’ll be a key contributor to the company’s growth, working in a start-up-like atmosphere that encourages innovation and agility, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

This hands-on leadership role requires a strategic thinker passionate about coaching and developing high-performing sales teams, optimizing processes and aligning sales strategies with the company’s overall business goals.

*Desired Experience*

* 7-10 Years of Sales Development Experience: A proven track record in Sales Development, particularly in SaaS or B2B technology sales. A strong understanding of the sales development lifecycle and experience leading a high-performing team of SDRs/BDRs.
* Experience Selling Complex Technology Products: Demonstrated ability to understand and sell sophisticated, technology-driven solutions, and navigate long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.
* Leadership Experience: At least 2+ years of experience managing a team of junior Sales Development Representatives or Business Development Representatives. A natural leader with strong team-building and mentoring skills.
* Proficiency in Sales Tools & Platforms: Expertise in prospecting tools and platforms such as Salesforce, Outreach or SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and data enrichment tools. Strong understanding of lead generation, data cleansing, and prospecting best practices.
* Process-Oriented & Analytical Mindset: Ability to identify inefficiencies, troubleshoot challenges and create process improvements. Skilled at using data to inform decisions, evaluate team performance, and optimize strategies.
* Excellent Communication & Collaboration Skills: Ability to communicate effectively with team members, stakeholders, and leadership. Comfortable collaborating cross-functionally and working within a team-based environment to achieve company goals.
* Highly Motivated & Results-Driven: Passionate about driving results, taking ownership, and inspiring a team to meet or exceed sales development targets.

*What Will You Do?*

* *Lead & Manage the Sales Development Team:* Oversee day-to-day operations of the Sales Development team, ensuring high performance, consistent execution, and alignment with business objectives. Foster a collaborative and goal-oriented environment.
* *Recruit, Train & Develop:* Hire, train, and coach a team of highly driven and motivated Business Development Representatives (BDRs). Provide ongoing mentorship to improve team members' skills in prospecting, communication, and lead qualification.
* *Optimize Sales Development Processes:* Continuously assess the efficiency and effectiveness of the sales development process. Identify areas of improvement and implement best practices to optimize the team’s performance.
* *Monitor Performance Metrics:* Set and monitor team KPIs, ensuring they meet or exceed lead generation, prospecting, and pipeline contribution expectations. Use data to analyze trends, diagnose bottlenecks, and improve team productivity.
* *Coaching & Developing Talent:* Provide regular coaching on tools, processes, and strategies. Ensure BDRs stay updated on the latest product features, industry trends, and selling techniques to increase their ability to convert leads into opportunities.
* *Salesforce & CRM Management:* Ensure accurate documentation of all sales activities, customer interactions, and lead information in Salesforce. Develop and maintain reporting dashboards to track progress.

title: Staff Product Manager - Email Growth
description:
About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, including agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel processes over 4 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.

Our People
----------

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark — and we get to help make that happen.

Role Overview
-------------

HighLevel is looking for a Staff Product Manager - Growth to drive activation, feature adoption, product-led expansion, and retention across the entire Email Charter. In this role, you will be responsible for turning new and existing agencies into active email power users by optimizing onboarding funnels, designing viral product-led growth (PLG) mechanics, running continuous experimentation programs, and directly linking email feature adoption to customer lifecycle value and ARR.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

*1.* *Optimize Activation & Onboarding Funnels* Design frictionless onboarding journeys that accelerate time-to-value for agencies and sub-accounts configuring email templates, sending campaigns, and launching sequences.

*2.* *Drive Product-Led Growth (PLG) & Viral Expansion* Implement PLG loops, feature discovery nudges, template sharing ecosystems, and in-app monetization/upsell prompts to expand email usage across sub-accounts.

*3.* *Build & Scale Experimentation Pipeline* Establish a high-velocity A/B testing framework covering onboarding flows, feature paywalls, pricing tiers, and campaign setup wizards to continuously improve conversion rates.

*4.* *Track Product Analytics & Campaign ROI* Define and monitor core activation funnels, usage decay metrics, and feature retention cohorts, demonstrating a clear correlation between email usage and platform retention.

*5.* *Execute Cross-Functional Growth Strategy* Partner closely with Product Marketing, Growth Engineering, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to deploy targeted growth campaigns and adoption initiatives.

-----------------------

-------------

*

*Funnel Analysis:* Map and analyze the end-to-end user journey for Email Marketing, identifying key friction points and drop-off stages in onboarding.

*

*Experimentation Cadence:* Establish a structured experimentation backlog and launch initial A/B tests on onboarding and feature discovery flows.

*

*North Star Alignment:* Define clear growth metrics (e.g., Activation Rate, Campaign Creation Velocity) and align stakeholders.

First 12 Months
---------------

*

*Activation Lift:* Achieve measurable, double-digit increases in new user email activation rates within their first 14 days.

*

*PLG Expansion:* Successfully launch template-sharing and feature-discovery growth loops that drive viral adoption across sub-accounts.

*

*Retention Impact:* Demonstrate a direct positive impact on sub-account retention and platform lifetime value (LTV) driven by email feature engagement.

Requirements
------------

*

*Experience:* 8+ years of Product Management experience with a dedicated focus on Growth, PLG, funnel optimization, or monetization in B2B SaaS platforms.

*

*Experimentation Mastery:* Proven track record of designing and executing high-velocity A/B and multivariate testing programs that yield statistically significant growth.

*

*Analytics Expertise:* Deep mastery of product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Heap, etc.), cohort analysis, funnel tracking, and SQL/data visualization.

*

*Growth Instincts:* Strong product intuition paired with a highly analytical, hypotheses-driven operational methodology.

*

*Cross-Functional Leadership:* Ability to lead matrixed growth teams across engineering, marketing, design, and analytics.

Nice-to-Have
------------

*

*MarTech Growth:* Prior experience driving growth or product-led adoption within marketing automation, CRM, or agency management platforms.

*

*Pricing & Packaging:* Experience optimizing pricing tiers, feature gating, or usage-based monetization models.

From day one, you will have hands-on ownership of product areas, using customer insights and quantitative analysis to identify opportunities and shape product decisions.
