At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

AS A SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER OF CAPACITY PLANNING, YOU WILL:

- Own the capacity planning program end-to-end — from demand forecasting and resource modeling to procurement coordination and delivery tracking across Snowflake's multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP)

- Drive cross-functional alignment between Engineering, Infrastructure, Finance, and Cloud Provider teams to ensure capacity meets projected growth, seasonal demand spikes, and new product launches

- Build and improve forecasting models and frameworks that translate business growth signals, customer onboarding patterns, and workload trends into actionable infrastructure capacity plans

- Establish governance and review cadences — own weekly/monthly capacity reviews with engineering leadership, surface risks and tradeoffs, and drive decisions on resource allocation and prioritization

- Identify and mitigate capacity risks proactively — monitor utilization trends, flag bottlenecks, single points of failure, and lead constraint resolution before they become customer-impacting

- Partner closely with engineering teams to understand workload characteristics, architecture changes, and new feature launches that affect capacity requirements

- Drive efficiency and optimization programs — identify opportunities to reduce waste, improve utilization, and right-size infrastructure spend without compromising performance or availability

- Develop dashboards, metrics, and reporting that give leadership real-time visibility into capacity health, spend trajectory, and delivery timelines

- Influence infrastructure strategy by providing data-driven recommendations on cloud provider mix, reserved vs. on-demand strategy, and long-term capacity investments

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Required:

- 7+ years of experience in technical program management, infrastructure planning, capacity management, or a related discipline at a cloud-scale technology company

- Demonstrated experience managing programs across multiple cloud providers (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP)

- Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts: compute, storage, networking, containerization, and resource orchestration

- Experience with demand forecasting, resource modeling, and data-driven decision-making at scale

- Proven ability to drive cross-functional programs spanning engineering, finance, and operations with VP/Director-level stakeholders

- Excellent communication skills — ability to synthesize complex technical and financial data into clear executive-ready narratives

- Strong program management fundamentals: dependency tracking, risk management, milestone governance, and stakeholder alignment

Preferred:

- Experience with infrastructure capacity planning at hyperscale (10K+ node deployments or equivalent)

- Familiarity with cloud cost management and FinOps principles

- Experience with data platforms, data warehousing, or database infrastructure

- Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tools (Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent)

- Background in building or improving automated capacity planning systems and tooling

- Experience operating in a fast-growth, high-ambiguity environment where priorities shift quickly

SNOWFLAKE VALUES WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

- Get It Done — You thrive on turning ambiguity into executable plans and delivering outcomes, not just status updates

- Own It — You treat the capacity program as yours end-to-end, anticipating risks rather than reacting to them

- Integrity Always — You make data-driven recommendations even when they're uncomfortable, and communicate tradeoffs transparently

- Think Big — You don't just plan for today's scale — you build the frameworks that prepare Snowflake for 10x growth

COMPENSATION

In addition to base salary and bonus, this role is eligible for equity in the form of RSUs and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), ESPP, generous PTO, and more.

WHY SNOWFLAKE?

- Join one of the fastest-growing enterprise technology companies in the world

- Work on infrastructure that powers AI and data workloads at global scale

- Collaborate with world-class engineering talent across Menlo Park, Bellevue, and beyond

- Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and benefits that support you and your family

- A culture that values ownership, speed, and delivering results

- Align with Sales leadership: Serve as the primary marketing partner to two RVPs (South EMEA & META), co-developing quarterly go-to-market plans, aligning marketing investment to pipeline targets, and maintaining a tight feedback loop between field activity and sales outcomes.

- Oversee events across the portfolio: Ensure your team delivers a compelling calendar of regional field events, Snowflake-led programmes (World Tour, Data for Breakfast), and third-party sponsorships. - Manage budget and operations: Maintain visibility and financial discipline across the team's consolidated budget. Ensure accurate forecasting, spend tracking, and ROI analysis.

- Collaborate cross-functionally: Act as the connective tissue between the South & META field teams and EMEA-wide marketing functions — including PMM, Demand Generation, Partner Marketing, Strategic Events, Brand, and Content — to ensure consistent messaging, resource sharing, and seamless execution across programmes.

- 2+ years of direct people management experience, with a track record of leading and developing distributed teams across multiple countries.

- Strong executive presence with experience building trusted, peer-level relationships with senior sales leadership and influencing joint planning without direct authority.

- Highly collaborative, with a natural ability to align multiple marketing functions and stakeholders in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

This individual will partner closely with Corporate Accounting, Tax, Payroll, Legal, FP&A, external auditors, and local accounting firms to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting and compliance with local statutory requirements. Primary Responsibilities

1. International Accounting & Month-End Close

- Own monthly close activities for assigned international entities.

- Prepare journal entries.

- Review trial balances and ensure completeness and accuracy and perform analytical reviews of monthly financial results.

- Prepare balance sheet reconciliations.

- Review P&L fluctuations and investigate unusual variances.

- Ensure compliance with US GAAP and Corporate Accounting Policies. Support local GAAP adjustments where applicable.

- Coordinate month-end close with Shared Services (Tekion India) and Corporate Accounting (US).

2. Balance Sheet Reconciliations

- Responsible for timely reconciliation of all the balance sheet accounts for International Entities. Ensure all reconciliations are completed, reviewed, and supported within close timelines.

- Manage monthly intercompany accounting, prepare transfer pricing entries, coordinate cross-border allocations

- Investigate and resolve intercompany differences.

- Prepare monthly Intercompany Reconciliation packages.

- Coordinate settlement of intercompany balances.

- Support transfer pricing implementation.

4. Compliance Calendar Management

- Develop and maintain a centralized compliance tracker covering various items like VAT filings; GST filings; Payroll filings; Corporate tax returns; Transfer pricing deadlines; Annual statutory audit; Annual accounts; Board approvals; Annual returns; Director filings; Regulatory filings; Business licenses; Local registrations etc. Monitor deadlines and ensure timely completion.

5. Statutory Audit Coordination

- Serve as primary accounting contact for local auditors and also support Corporate Audit, as needed

6. Transfer Pricing

- Coordinate with Corporate Tax and advisors for TP documentation, Intercompany agreements, Recharge calculations, Cost-plus computations, Benchmark studies, Annual TP filings & TP audit support. Ensure accounting aligns with transfer pricing policies.

7. Payroll Accounting

- Partner with Payroll team to: Review payroll journals, Reconcile payroll accounts, Ensure statutory deductions are recorded, Support payroll audits

8. Financial Reporting

- Prepare Monthly reporting packages, Flux analyses, Balance Sheet review packages, Corporate reporting requests & External reporting schedules

9. Process Improvements

- Drive automation and standardization by Developing SOPs, Improving close processes, Automating reconciliations, Reducing manual journal entries, Enhancing internal controls, Supporting NetSuite optimization

10. New Entity Setup Support

- Support expansion into new countries by assisting with Accounting setup, NetSuite configuration, Bank account setup, Compliance calendar creation First statutory filings

11. Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with Corporate Accounting, Tax Consultants, FP&A, Payroll, Legal, Treasury, HR, External Consulting Firms & External Auditors

Key Deliverables

- The successful candidate will:

· Complete month-end close within corporate timelines.

· Achieve 100% on-time statutory filings.

· Maintain accurate balance sheet reconciliations with no aged unreconciled items.

· Resolve intercompany differences before close.

· Coordinate timely completion of all statutory audits.

· Maintain a centralized global compliance calendar.

· Ensure transfer pricing compliance and supporting documentation.

· Support successful external audits with minimal audit adjustments.

· Standardize accounting and compliance processes across all international entities.

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Commerce.

- 5–7 years of accounting experience.

title: Junior Designer
description:
📍 *London - Hybrid.* 2 days per week in our London office, 3 days remote / work from home (40 hour week)

Goodlord’s mission is to be the gold standard platform for renting, and we’re looking for a Junior Graphic Designer to join our Marketing team and help us achieve this.

This is a genuinely junior, entry-level opportunity for someone looking to start and build their career in graphic design.

You don’t need years of professional experience. You might have developed your design skills through a Graphic Design or Visual Arts degree, an internship or placement, freelance projects, or other practical design work. What matters to us is that you already have good design fundamentals, can show us examples of your work, and are excited to keep learning.

Working closely with and learning from our Graphic Designer, you’ll become an important part of our day-to-day creative delivery. You’ll work across campaigns, social, digital, reports, content and events - sometimes creating something new and sometimes taking an established idea and adapting it brilliantly across different formats.

There’ll be lots of variety, lots to learn and plenty of opportunity to develop your craft.

No two days are ever the same at Goodlord, so what you’ll be up to will vary. We also move quickly, which means priorities can change, and you’ll need to be comfortable adapting when they do (we’ll support you!).

*The day-to-day stuff*

*

Turning clear briefs into polished, on-brand creative across social, digital, email, web, reports, marketing collateral and events

*

Taking campaign creative and adapting it across different formats and channels while keeping everything visually consistent

*

Creating and updating everyday marketing materials, documents and templates

*

Using Adobe Creative Suite, including Illustrator, InDesign and Photoshop, alongside template and emerging AI design tools

*

Working closely with our Graphic Designer and the wider Marketing team to understand what they need and bring briefs to life

*

Taking feedback on your work, iterating and continually developing your skills across layout, typography, hierarchy and composition

*About You*

You should apply if you:

*

Are at the beginning of your graphic design career and looking for an opportunity where you can learn, develop and get exposure to lots of different types of design work

*

Have good design fundamentals, including typography, layout, visual hierarchy, colour and composition

*

Have practical experience using Adobe Illustrator, InDesign and Photoshop

*

Can show us examples of your design work through a portfolio - this could include university projects, internships, placements, freelance work or other relevant projects

*

Enjoy actually making things! You’re happy taking a brief and turning it into something polished, rather than needing every design decision mapped out for you

*

Are organised and comfortable managing different pieces of work and changing priorities

*

Are curious, open to feedback and keen to learn from an experienced designer

*

Have a Graphic Design/Visual Arts degree or equivalent practical design experience - we care much more about what you can do than one particular route into design

It would also be great, although definitely not essential, if you have:

*

Some exposure to a fast-paced tech, SaaS or agency environment

*

An interest in video editing, motion graphics or simple animation

*

Experimented with AI tools as part of your creative process

-------------------------------------
*Why you'll love being a Goodlordian*
-------------------------------------

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

*

*Grow with Goodlord:* your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

*

*Your well-being matters:* bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

*

*25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days:* We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

*

*Supporting your family:* we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

*

*Our team:* we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

------------
What’s next?
------------

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.

** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

*No agencies please* - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

title: Digital Design and Social Media Internship
description:
The Digital Design & Social Media Intern will serve as a creative coin of 8 Cents in a Jar, helping bring our mission, programs, and impact to life through strong visuals and storytelling. This role creates engaging digital content, supports our social media presence, and helps tell the stories of the students, families, partners, and communities we serve. We’re looking for someone who can turn ideas into content that connects, makes financial education feel relevant, and inspires people to take action.

The Digital Design & Social Media Intern will serve as a *creative coin of 8 Cents in a Jar* , helping bring our mission, programs, and impact to life through strong visuals and storytelling. This role creates engaging digital content, supports our social media presence, and helps tell the stories of the students, families, partners, and communities we serve. We’re looking for someone who can turn ideas into content that connects, makes financial education feel relevant, and inspires people to take action.

If you enjoy storytelling and dabbling in design, then you’ll love to:

Mission, Marketing & Creative Support

* Become familiar with our mission, programs, and Economic Succession approach and understand how your creative work contributes to economic mobility across Central Florida.
* Work directly with the team on storytelling, communications, marketing, community outreach, and special creative projects.
* Learn the goals and direction of our programs and translate what is happening behind the scenes into content people can understand, connect with, and share.
* Bring fresh ideas to the table and help us think creatively about how we communicate financial education, economic mobility, and our impact.
* Work independently with minimal supervision while staying organized and adaptable in an ever-changing nonprofit environment.

Digital Design & Marketing

* Design engaging graphics, flyers, presentations, program materials, social media content, and other branded assets using Canva and other creative tools.
* Support digital marketing campaigns across email, social media, web, and other platforms to reach students, families, volunteers, partners, donors, and supporters.
* Create and edit short-form videos, Reels, graphics, photos, and other visual content for social media, programs, events, and campaigns.
* Help maintain a consistent 8 Cents in a Jar look, feel, voice, and brand across digital and printed materials.
* Organize photos, videos, templates, graphics, and other creative assets so great content can be easily found and repurposed.
* Support updates to website and digital content as needed.

Social Media & Creative Content

* Help develop and execute social media strategies that increase awareness, engagement, and growth.
* Schedule and publish regular program updates, stories, announcements, partner highlights, impact moments, and success stories.
* Help plan and lead content days, including developing storyboards and shot lists so we capture the content we actually need.
* Attend select programs and events to capture photos, videos, interviews, behind-the-scenes moments, and participant experiences.
* Develop creative campaigns that make financial education and Economic Succession relevant, relatable, and shareable.
* Monitor social media engagement and basic performance metrics to understand what is connecting with our audiences and inform future content.
* Stay current on digital trends and bring ideas for how 8 Cents in a Jar can use them authentically rather than simply following what everyone else is doing.

Storytelling & Communications

* Turn program experiences, interviews, testimonials, participant accomplishments, partnerships, and impact data into compelling stories.
* Write and schedule newsletters, social media captions, stakeholder communications, and other short-form content.
* Help develop student, family, alumni, volunteer, partner, and donor stories that demonstrate the impact of our work.
* Work with program staff to identify the stories worth telling and gather the information needed to tell them well.
* Repurpose strong stories across multiple platforms so one great moment can become a social post, email, graphic, video, website feature, or impact story.
* Protect the dignity and privacy of the people we serve by following organizational expectations for consent, photography, storytelling, and participant information.

Our Must-Haves Include:

* Currently enrolled in a college or university program, preferably in Marketing, Communications, Graphic Design, Digital Media, Public Relations, or a related field preferred, but not required at all.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* A creative eye and willingness to experiment with storytelling, design, video, and digital content.
* Familiarity with major social media platforms and how content differs across them.
* Experience with creative and digital tools such as Canva, Affinity, Adobe Creative Suite, Mailchimp, Wix, or similar platforms. You don't have to know them all.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating with a small, fast-moving team.
* Comfortable receiving feedback, making revisions, and learning as you go.
* Passion for financial education, economic mobility, youth development, community impact, or simply using your creative talents to do some good.

You Receive:

* $16.80 per hour. And yes, if you have a creative project you're passionate about that connects to personal finance or our mission, bring it to us. With approval from the Executive Director, we may be able to fund it.
* You work from home, and we work from home. You must reside in Central Florida and have reliable transportation for select programs, events, and content days. Some may happen on evenings or weekends, but don't worry, you'll have input on the schedule.
* Real work for your portfolio. You'll have opportunities to create content, campaigns, designs, and stories that are actually used by the organization.
* Access to great financial resources. Listen, we talk about money, so your money has got to be right, or at least you need the desire to make it right...for you.
* Room to create. We have a brand and a mission, but we're not looking for someone to simply copy and paste. We want your ideas, your creativity, and your perspective.

description:
*Who we are*

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

*About the role:*

As a Senior Product Designer, you will be responsible for executing high-quality designs for our financial products, ensuring they are intuitive, accessible, and effective. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor junior designers, and champion user-centred design within the organisation. This role requires a strategic mindset, deep UX/UI expertise, and the ability to translate complex financial concepts into seamless user experiences.

*What you’ll do*

* Define and execute design strategies that align with business objectives and user needs.
* Lead the end-to-end design process, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and final UI execution.
* Conduct advanced user research, usability testing, and A/B experiments to validate and refine design solutions.
* Partner closely with product managers and engineers to ensure seamless implementation of designs.
* Design scalable UI components and contribute to our evolving design system.
* Advocate for accessibility (A11y) and inclusive design principles, ensuring our products serve a diverse user base.
* Create and refine micro-interactions and motion elements to improve user engagement and usability.
* Use data-driven insights to continuously improve the user experience and optimise for business impact.
* Mentor and guide junior designers, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.
* Stay ahead of fintech trends and best practices to drive product innovation.

*What you need to succeed*

* 3+ years in a senior product design role, with a strong focus on UX and a demonstrated ability to lead impactful projects
* Mastery of visual design, typography, grids, layout, and colour theory.
* Expertise in interaction design, information architecture, and user flows.
* Deep understanding of designing for both mobile and web platforms, ensuring responsive and adaptive experiences.
* Strong knowledge of behavioural psychology and how it influences user decision-making.
* Extensive experience conducting usability testing, user interviews, and heuristic evaluations.
* Ability to synthesise qualitative and quantitative insights into impactful design decisions.
* Familiarity with UX analytics tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Hotjar, etc.).
* Proficiency in atomic design principles and building scalable UI frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of motion design tools (Lottie, After Effects, Principle) to create dynamic user experiences.
* Experience mentoring and guiding junior designers.
* Ability to articulate design rationale and influence stakeholders across teams.
* Comfortable working in agile, fast-paced product teams.
* Figma mastery - deep experience with auto layout, design tokens, component variants, interactive prototypes, and scalable design libraries.
* Proven experience in fintech and/or SaaS environments, with a strong understanding of industry challenges and user behaviours.

*What you’ll get*

* A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will impact millions of users.
* Career growth opportunities.
* A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources.

*What to expect in the hiring process*

* Application & portfolio review: we look for strong UX case studies that showcase process, research, impact, and leadership.
* Preliminary phone call with the recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, interests, and expectations.
* Interview with a design team member: a discussion about your experience, approach to design, alignment with our mission, and a portfolio walkthrough.
* Design Challenge: an advanced exercise to assess problem-solving, UX/UI craft, and strategic thinking.
* Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership about your ability to think strategically, collaborate across teams, and drive business and user impact through design.

*How to apply:*

Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your best work - preferably with fintech or SaaS-related projects. Your portfolio should clearly demonstrate impact, including measurable improvements in user experience, business metrics, or engagement. We want to see end-to-end product thinking, including research, wireframes, prototypes, and final execution.

Location & Logistics

* Full-time

*Benefits*

* Salary between $85,000 and $110,000
* Medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you and family
* 401k
* Unlimited PTO

----------------

CodeHunter provides Zero Trust for Code, enabling organizations to determine whether software should be trusted before it runs. Founded in 2021, with roots in U.S. government research labs, CodeHunter analyzes the behavior and intent of software artifacts prior to execution. This helps enterprises prevent malicious code from running, reduce alert overload, and automate security decisions across development pipelines, endpoints, and enterprise environments. The company focuses on organizations that require high assurance, operational resilience, and auditable security controls.

title: Product Designer - Visual Craft & AI
description:
*About Envato*

At Envato, we empower creative pros to thrive.

We're here to help creatives bring their ideas to life, supercharge their workflows, and equip them with an unparalleled toolkit they can use anywhere. With unlimited access to world-class assets, innovative AI tools, and hands-on tutorials, we deliver what creatives need today - and are continually evolving our offering. As AI transforms the creative landscape, we’re committed to building what’s next for the future.

We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.

You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

*Have you made something beautiful because you wanted it to exist?*

Maybe you’ve built a small creative tool. Made an interface behave in a way we haven’t seen before. Used AI to turn an idea into something people can actually play with.

You’ve got a strong eye, ideas of your own and work to show for it. You might not have held a product design job yet.

We’re looking for a designer with exceptional visual craft, ideas of their own and the AI skills to turn them into working experiences. We’d like to see what you’re making.

*Make things for people who make things.*

At Envato, we’re building tools that help creative professionals find, generate and refine assets for their projects. We want those tools to feel as creative and considered as the work people make with them.

We’re looking for someone with fresh ideas who brings excellent visual craft and is already using AI to explore and build. You could be coming from uni, independent projects, freelance work or another creative discipline. We’re not fussed about your current job title or background, but what we do care about is raw design talent who can bring something different to the team.

What you could get your hands on
--------------------------------

* You might prototype how a filmmaker saves a character reference and uses it across different shots. Explore how arranging and playing video clips could help someone see a story coming together. Or use motion, imagery and interaction to make an AI capability easier to understand and more enjoyable to use.
* You’ll bring different approaches, make them interactive and try them with the team and customers. Then you’ll help develop the promising ones into experiences people can use.
* This is work on the core product, not a separate collection of experiments that never makes it into customers’ hands. This work matters.

Bring your eye. Build your product experience.
----------------------------------------------

* We want to see care in the typography, composition, hierarchy, motion and interaction. We’re interested in how you direct and work with AI.
* You should be curious about the person using what you’ve made, willing to share unfinished work, test things in the wild and able to change your approach when you learn something.
* You’ll work alongside experienced designers and engineers, with support on framing problems, testing ideas and getting work into the product. You won’t be expected to independently lead a whole product area from day one, but you will have real work to own, feedback to help you develop it and the opportunity to contribute things we haven’t yet thought of

*Show us what you’re making.*

To be considered, send us something you’ve built using AI, a finished product, prototype, website or interactive tool, and something that shows your visual craft. They can be the same project. Uni work, client work and independent experiments are all welcome.

Add a few lines about your contribution, the tools you used and the details you sweated

*Life at Envato*

• Flexible Working: remote-first across Australia or New Zealand with flexibility for you to manage work and life as you need
• Work from Anywhere: apply to work in another location for up to 3 months per calendar year.
• Connection Budget: an annual budget to connect with the team IRL where and when possible.
• Learning Budget: study leave and an annual budget for you to put towards your learning and development.
• Home Office Allowance: a contribution towards your set-up and a monthly allowance to support work from home costs.

• Volunteer Leave: 2 days per calendar year to volunteer and give back to the community.
• Parental Leave:20 weeks paid primary carer leave, and 6 weeks paid secondary carers leave.

description:
*About Envato*

At Envato, we empower creative pros to thrive.

*Designed by creative professionals, for creative professionals*

Envato is an all-in-one creative asset toolkit built to help creative professionals thrive. We bring together world-class creative assets and AI tools to help creatives find what they need, explore ideas, refine their work and keep their creative momentum going.

And that makes designing Envato a little different.

Our customers are designers, filmmakers, editors and creators. And so are we. We use the same kinds of tools, wrestle with the same creative problems and care about the same details as the people we're building for. That means we're designing for people with great taste, strong opinions and a very high bar for the tools they use.

So we're looking for a Product Designer with that same bar.

We care more about the work you can show and the judgement behind it, rather than how many years you've been a Product Designer or what your title is on your resume. We want someone with a visual point of view about what good looks like and the product thinking to know when, where and why to apply it.

*
*

The role: You'll help shape what Envato actually feels like to use
------------------------------------------------------------------

* You'll work on Envato's core app, helping creative professionals find, generate and refine assets for their projects.
* You'll get to take ideas from messy early thinking through to beautifully resolved experiences in the hands of our customers.
* You’ll help shape creative workflows that get people to professional results. That could mean helping someone adapt stock video or graphics with AI, keep characters and visual styles consistent across generated shots, or sequence video clips to see how a story comes together.
* You’ll make those capabilities easy to discover and use, connecting them around what someone is trying to create. The goal is to help people see what's possible, guide the result towards what they had in mind, and get to something they can actually use without unnecessary complexity.
* You'll prototype ideas quickly. UsingFigma, code, motion and AI assisted tools to turn ideas into something people can actually experience.
* You'll work closely with Product and Engineering to influence what we build, not just what it looks like after the decisions have already been made.
* You'll help evolve Envato's visual language inside the product, working with our Product Visual Lead and other designers to create experiences that feel distinctly Envato. We want your ideas and visual judgement in that conversation, not just your ability to apply what's already there.
* You'll work alongside engineers through implementation, writing code and resolving visual and interaction details so the experience holds up in the product.

What we're actually looking for: Taste. Craft. Curiosity. Product sense
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

* You make beautiful things, but you're not designing art for art's sake. You understand that this is a commercial product used by real people trying to get real work done.
* You understand UX fundamentals. You know when something needs to be beautiful, when it needs to disappear into the background, and when clarity beats cleverness.
* You can show us work where the details matter: typography, composition, hierarchy, motion and interaction. You can explain why you made something the way you did, not just show us the final screen.
* You're interested in new creative technology and you're already experimenting with AI, prototyping, design-to-code or whatever new tool helps you move faster and explore further.
* You like sharing unfinished work and can take on feedback without losing interesting ideas. And you can work with engineers and product people without needing everything translated into a perfectly formed design brief.

*Want to apply? Show us your creativity.*

* If you’re creatively obsessed, care deeply about craft and want to help shape the tools creative professionals use to do their best work, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Employer Brand Designer & Multimedia Producer

***********

Role Overview

The Employer Brand Designer & Multimedia Producer brings the organisation’s employer brand and Employee Value Proposition (EVP) to life through compelling visual design, multimedia content and creative storytelling. Working within HR and in close partnership with Employer Brand, Talent Acquisition, Communications, Marketing and other stakeholders, the role leads the creative execution of employer-brand initiatives across digital, social, recruitment and internal channels. The role combines graphic design, multimedia production, motion graphics, video and brand stewardship to deliver a consistent, distinctive and high-quality employee and candidate experience.
Key Responsibilities
Creative & Graphic Design
• Lead the graphic and creative design of employer-brand communications, campaigns and experiences.
• Translate the EVP and employer-brand strategy into engaging and distinctive visual concepts.

• Create infographics, illustrations, animations and visual storytelling assets that make complex information engaging and easy to understand.
• Develop creative concepts from initial brief and ideation through to final production.
• Adapt creative assets for different audiences, markets, formats and digital channels while maintaining brand consistency.
Video, Motion & Multimedia Production
• Create and edit video, motion graphics, animation and multimedia content that showcases the organisation, its people, culture, career opportunities and EVP.
• Produce engaging employee stories, testimonials, recruitment videos, social content, campaign assets and other multimedia experiences.
• Manage multimedia production from concept and storyboarding through editing, post-production and final delivery.
• Optimise video and multimedia assets for different digital platforms and formats.
• Explore new creative formats and production techniques to continually evolve employer-brand storytelling.
Visual Identity & Template Management
• Build, maintain and continuously improve a suite of employer-brand visual templates that enable consistent and efficient content creation.
• Develop templates for social media, presentations, recruitment campaigns, job marketing, events, digital content and other recurring requirements.
• Ensure employer-brand visual standards remain aligned with the broader corporate brand while addressing the specific needs of talent audiences.
• Provide guidance to stakeholders on the correct application of employer-brand templates and visual assets.
Creative Quality & Brand Governance
• Ensure creative quality control across employer-brand materials and campaigns.
• Review creative outputs for visual quality, consistency, accessibility, accuracy and alignment with brand standards.
• Act as a guardian of the employer-brand visual identity, helping ensure a coherent candidate and employee experience across channels.
• Establish practical creative standards and guidelines that enable teams and partners to produce consistently high-quality work.
• Provide creative direction and constructive design feedback to internal stakeholders and external partners where required.
Digital Experience Support
• Partner with the Digital & Experience Specialist and other stakeholders to support the visual design of careers websites, campaign landing pages and other digital experiences.
• Provide website and digital design expertise when required, including page layouts, visual assets, graphics, banners, icons and multimedia components.
• Apply UX and digital-design principles to ensure employer-brand creative works effectively across desktop and mobile environments.
• Collaborate with digital and technical teams to ensure creative concepts can be effectively translated into digital experiences.
EVP & Employer Brand Projects
• Support EVP and employer-brand projects from a creative and design perspective.
• Translate EVP themes, employee insights and employer-brand messaging into visual systems and campaign concepts.
• Develop creative approaches that communicate the employee experience authentically and resonate with priority talent audiences.
• Support employer-brand launches, activations, recruitment campaigns, events and internal engagement initiatives.
• Contribute creative thinking and visual expertise during project development and campaign planning.
Digital Asset & Visual Standards Management
• Manage the internal creative asset library, ensuring employer-brand files are organised, current, accessible and easy for stakeholders to use.
• Maintain master artwork, templates, photography, video, icons, graphics and other employer-brand assets.
• Establish and maintain appropriate naming conventions, version control and asset-management processes.
• Maintain visual standards and guidelines to support consistent application of the employer brand across the organisation.
• Coordinate with agencies and external creative partners when additional production support is required.
Skills & Experience
• Professional experience in graphic design, multimedia production, creative design, brand design or a related discipline.
• Strong portfolio demonstrating experience across digital design, brand communications, campaign creative and multimedia production.
• Advanced graphic-design capabilities, with strong knowledge of typography, layout, composition, colour, imagery and visual hierarchy.
• Experience creating infographics, animations, motion graphics and multimedia content.
• Strong video production and editing skills, including experience taking content from concept through post-production.
• Experience creating and maintaining visual templates and design systems.
• Strong understanding of brand identity and experience applying brand guidelines consistently across multiple channels and formats.
• Experience managing creative quality control and reviewing assets against established visual standards.
• Digital-design capability, with an understanding of designing for websites, landing pages, social platforms and mobile experiences.
• Ability to translate strategic concepts, EVP messaging and employee stories into engaging visual communications.
• Experience managing digital or creative asset libraries and maintaining effective version control.
• Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to interpret creative briefs and work collaboratively with both creative and non-creative stakeholders.
• Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
Desirable Technical Capabilities
Experience with a combination of the following would be advantageous:
• Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro and After Effects
• Figma or equivalent digital-design and prototyping platforms
• Motion graphics and animation tools
• Video editing, colour correction, audio editing and post-production
• Photography and video production
• Canva or enterprise template-management platforms
• Digital asset management systems
• Web and responsive design principles
• Basic understanding of HTML/CSS
• UX/UI and accessibility principles
• Generative AI and emerging creative technologies, with an understanding of responsible use in professional creative production
Key Competencies
• Creative Excellence - Produces distinctive, polished and engaging creative work while maintaining a consistently high standard of execution.
• Visual Storytelling - Transforms EVP themes, employee experiences, data and complex messages into clear and compelling visual narratives.
• Employer Brand Mindset - Understands how creative execution shapes candidate and employee perceptions and uses design to reinforce an authentic and differentiated employer brand.
• Brand Stewardship - Protects visual consistency while finding creative ways to evolve and activate the employer brand across different audiences and channels.
• Digital-First Thinking - Designs with the channel, audience, user experience and format in mind rather than simply adapting print-led creative for digital use.
• Collaboration - Works effectively with Employer Brand, HR, Talent Acquisition, Communications, Marketing, Digital, agencies and other partners to turn business requirements into strong creative solutions.
• Ownership & Delivery - Manages creative work from brief and concept through production, quality assurance and final delivery, balancing creativity with deadlines and business priorities.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Senior Graphic Designer
-----------------------

*
Function:* Graphic Design | Static & Motion Creative | Brand Design | Performance Marketing *
Responsibility:* Design and optimise high-performing static and visual creatives for leading ecommerce brands *
Reports to:* Head of Creative Strategy *
Location: Remote
Employment:* Full Time Contractor *
Salary: $2500 - $3000 per Month*

About:
------

We are seeking an experienced Senior Graphic Designer to join our growing team on a contractual basis. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role for a commercially-minded creative with an exceptional eye for detail, who understands the intersection between design, performance marketing, and ecommerce growth.

You will be responsible for designing and optimising high-performing static ads, carousels, and visual assets across Meta, TikTok, and other paid social platforms, helping some of the UK's fastest-growing ecommerce brands acquire customers and scale profitably.

Quality is non-negotiable in this role. Every asset you deliver should be polished, on-brand, and pixel-perfect. You'll work closely with our creative strategists, media buyers, video editors, and content creators to bring concepts to life, identify winning creative patterns, and continuously improve performance through testing and iteration.

The ideal candidate combines outstanding design craft with a strong understanding of direct-response advertising, and actively embraces AI tools to work smarter, explore more ideas, and raise the standard of their output, without ever compromising on quality.

Overview
--------

Launch With Us is one of the fastest-growing advertising agencies in the UK, specialising in ecommerce brands. Since our founding in 2021 by a team of seasoned leaders, we've rapidly expanded with a high-performing team of A-Players. Over the past year, we've successfully managed over £8 million in Meta and TikTok ad spend, delivering profitable results for renowned clients such as Khanum's, Lucy & Lola, Ovrload, DJK, Bubble Panda, and Watermans.

In 2024, we experienced significant growth as an agency, and the Senior Graphic Designer role will play a pivotal part in our continued expansion and the progression of our performance creative division.

You will join our talented production team, which serves as your creative division. We strategise, ideate, create, and optimise exceptional creative content, including UGC, high-production, design, and motion graphic ads. We pride ourselves on being a one-stop performance creative solution, acting as an in-house creative team for our clients.

*Requirements*

What You'll Need:
-----------------

* Design high-quality, performance-driven static and visual creatives across multiple ecommerce brands, owning each project from brief to final delivery.
* Deliver work to the highest possible standard, with meticulous attention to typography, layout, colour, composition, and detail.
* Ensure every asset aligns with each brand's identity, tone of voice, positioning, and commercial objectives.
* Create a wide range of assets including static ads, carousels, product imagery, landing page visuals, and light motion graphics.
* Optimise designs for Meta (Facebook & Instagram), TikTok, and emerging platforms, adapting formats and sizes to maximise engagement, conversions, and performance.
* Integrate AI tools into your day-to-day workflow for ideation, concepting, image generation, retouching, and producing creative variations at speed.
* Produce multiple creative variations for testing, using performance data and feedback to iterate on winning concepts.
* Collaborate with strategists, media buyers, video editors, and content creators to translate creative concepts into high-performing assets.
* Proactively identify emerging design trends, AI capabilities, and creative opportunities that improve campaign results.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and never compromising on quality.

*Attitude*

* Take full ownership of both your successes and failures.
* Uncompromising standards: nothing leaves your desk unless it's your best work
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to see the bigger picture
* Proactive, solution-oriented, and adaptable
* Curious and quick to adopt new tools and technologies, particularly AI
* Exceptional attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills
* Confident in building long-term relationships
* Ability to self-manage and prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment

*Experience & Skills*

* 4+ years of experience as a graphic designer, ideally producing performance-driven creative within ecommerce, DTC, or agency environments
* A standout portfolio demonstrating exceptional design quality and craft
* Expert proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator; experience with Figma, After Effects, or other motion tools is a plus
* Hands-on experience using AI tools within a design workflow (e.g. Adobe Firefly, Photoshop Generative Fill, Midjourney, ChatGPT), with a clear view on where AI adds value and where human craft matters most
* Deep understanding of Meta, TikTok, and paid social creative best practices
* Proven ability to create designs that drive engagement, conversions, and revenue
* Advanced knowledge of typography, layout, colour theory, photo retouching, and brand systems
* Strong understanding of performance marketing principles and creative testing methodologies
* Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently or as part of a team
* Excellent communication skills with fluent written and spoken English

*Benefits*

* Be part of a world-class team made up of high-performing individuals
* Gain deep insight into how high-growth ecommerce brands scale through performance creative and paid social
* Extra holiday – take your birthday off
* Structured training and development plans
* Monthly team incentives
* Kudos reward system to earn points and redeem vouchers from brands such as Amazon, Deliveroo, and Just Eat
* Christmas bonus based on performance and tenure

title: Graphic Designer / Apparel Artist
description:
This is a remote position.

Turn hand-drawn concepts and photographic references into print-ready artwork for a new apparel collection.

*Organization:* Confidential client in the retail/apparel sector; the name will be shared with shortlisted candidates before the client interview

*Location:* Remote - ideally candidates based in Palestine.

*Role Type:* Project-based | Consultant-contractor | Fixed term (target completion February-March 2027)

*Reports to:* Founder / Creative Lead

*The opportunity*

Our client is launching an apparel line and needs a designer to translate their personal vision into production-ready graphics. They are seeking a Graphic Designer/Apparel Artist to faithfully recreate approximately 75-80 designs from paper sketches and reference photos. In this role, you will convert raw source materials into clean, high-resolution art suitable for T-shirts and hoodies, working at a flexible pace of roughly *five designs per month.* This is primarily a redrawing and digitization role where accuracy to the original concept is paramount, with limited opportunities for creative improvisation on a small subset of pieces.

*About the organization*

Our client is an independent creator developing a niche apparel brand rooted in authentic, hand-crafted aesthetics. The project involves a specific library of 75-80 designs: roughly half are text-based typography work, while the remainder are image-based recreations of the founder's own photography and sketches. The goal is to produce a cohesive collection by early next year, ensuring each piece maintains the integrity of the original artistic intent while meeting professional printing standards.

*What you will do* *
*

* Convert approximately 75-80 source materials (sketches and photos) into polished, high-resolution, print-ready artwork.

* Faithfully recreate image-based designs from photographic references, staying as close to the original as intended.

* Handle text-based designs (~35-40 pieces), including typography selection and layout.

* Deliver each design in two versions: one optimized for light garments (white) and one for dark garments (black/dark).

* Manage a flexible workflow, targeting a pace of about five designs per month, scalable into a recurring arrangement.

* Collaborate via email, Dropbox, and calls to provide updates and receive feedback.

*What you bring* *
*

* Strong portfolio demonstrating both illustration skills and the ability to faithfully recreate existing artwork or photographic references.

* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and/or Photoshop (or comparable vector/raster tools).

* Expertise in photo-to-vector conversion, including tracing, refining, and simplifying while preserving likeness.

* Ability to deliver finished files in PNG/JPEG format, plus vector files (AI/SVG/PDF) where redrawing is required.

* Basic English communication skills sufficient to understand briefs and provide status updates.

*Helpful, but not essential* *
*

* Experience with apparel graphics, specifically understanding how prints sit on different garment types (tees vs. hoodies).

* Background in tattoo flash refinement, print reproduction, or similar faithful-redrawing disciplines.

* Capability to produce color separations if screen printing is adopted later.

* Willingness to contribute creative direction on the ~5-10 "open interpretation" designs.

-----------------------------------

*How the engagement works*

* Contracting party: You will contract directly with Apricot, which will manage contracting, invoicing/payroll, payments, and administrative support. Day to day, you will work with the client’s creative lead.

* For this project-based engagement, you are expected to submit a proposal including: (a) a per-design rate estimate for three tiers (text-only, close recreation, and open interpretation), and (b) a total project-based estimate to complete all ~75-80 designs over several months. Sample designs are expected within days to a couple of weeks of starting, with the full collection targeted for completion between February and March 2027.

* Planned check-ins are scheduled for month 1 and month 3 to see how the engagement is working and help address any issues.

*About Apricot*

Apricot is a nonprofit sourcing firm connecting displaced and underserved professionals from Palestine and the wider MENA region with global employment opportunities. We combine a clear social-impact mission with fast, high-quality recruitment delivery for international clients.

* *Enterprise Deal & Sales Support:* Partner directly with go-to-market teams during high-value sales cycles with Tier-1 financial services institutions (FSIs), providing deep product expertise during technical evaluations, InfoSec reviews, RFPs, and pilot-to-production transitions.
* *Customer Discovery & Rapid Prototyping:* Conduct structured customer discovery with institutional stakeholders and utilize AI-assisted tools to build early-stage prototypes, specifications, and testable artifacts to accelerate feedback loops ahead of full engineering cycles.
* *Competitive & Market Intelligence:* Track and analyze developments across capital markets technology, enterprise tokenization, and private/public blockchain ecosystems to inform product positioning and long-term roadmap decisions.
* *Repeatable Go-to-Market Assets:* Codify successful deployment motions into repeatable product narratives, demonstrations, and proof-of-concept frameworks for priority financial services use cases.

*Requirements*

* *Experience:* 5+ years of dedicated experience as a Product Manager, backed by a strong technical foundation in software development, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise platforms.
* *Traditional Finance (TradFi) Depth:* Substantive expertise within traditional financial institutions (banks, asset managers, custodians, payment networks, or fund operators), including a thorough operational understanding of trade lifecycles, post-trade workflows, settlement processes, and fund administration.
* *Enterprise Track Record:* Proven history of owning and shipping complex software products for enterprise customers, with direct experience supporting enterprise sales cycles, InfoSec reviews, technical evaluations, and RFPs.
* *Execution & Agency:* Demonstrated ability to independently turn discovery into specifications, wireframes/prototypes, and shipped features without requiring step-by-step guidance.

* *Stakeholder Communication:* Ability to engage credibly and independently in high-level technical and operational discussions with CTOs, Heads of Operations, and enterprise architects

* Familiarity with transaction privacy models, confidential computing, or selective disclosure mechanisms.

title: Product Manager | Growth
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Manager, Growth at Ramp, you’ll drive acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization across our product suite. You’ll identify opportunities to help more businesses discover Ramp, get value from our products, and expand their usage over time.

You’ll work closely with engineers, designers, marketers, and data scientists to develop and execute a growth strategy grounded in customer insight and experimentation. Your scope will include core product experiences and partner-led growth channels, with ownership from identifying an opportunity through launching, measuring, and scaling solutions.

You’ll identify opportunities to use AI to help businesses discover relevant Ramp products, reach value faster, and expand their usage over time. You’ll balance rapid experimentation with the accuracy, transparency, and customer trust required when building financial products.

Please note that this Product Management role will require you to be comfortable with working in-person at one of our NYC or SF offices at least 2 days/week

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Develop and execute a growth product strategy across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, helping businesses get more value from Ramp

- Own the roadmap, priorities, and execution for a defined growth surface area, from identifying opportunities through launching, measuring, and scaling solutions

- Lead the ideation, development, and launch of growth experiences, including AI-powered approaches to onboarding, product discovery, recommendations, and cross-sell

- Partner with engineering, design, marketing, and data science to deliver high-impact initiatives across core product experiences and partner-led growth channels

- Conduct customer research and analyze product metrics and feedback to understand where finance teams encounter friction and identify opportunities to improve adoption

- Define and track growth KPIs, design controlled experiments where feasible, and use results to distinguish incremental impact from underlying trends

- Evaluate AI-powered experiences for both growth impact and quality, including accuracy, relevance, and reliability; balance rapid iteration with safeguards for sensitive financial data, transparency, and customer control

- Turn successful experiments into durable product improvements and contribute to the practices that help Ramp’s product management function scale

WHAT YOU NEED

- BA/BS in mathematics, technical, or analytical field

- Minimum 4 years of product management experience, building technical products from ideation to launch

- Data-Driven Mindset – Fluency in crafting data-driven narratives. You enjoy writing SQL to answer your own questions and thrive on leveraging data to shape and communicate a strategic vision.

- Slope - We value slope over intercept; We’re looking for a high-growth team member who can be a future leader at Ramp

- Leadership & Collaboration – Proven ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams, inspire stakeholders, and lead initiatives from strategy through execution.

- Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on research and tools.

- Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments like Figma and Git.

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual membership

- 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

- Pet insurance

- In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

- Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

CANADA

- Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

- Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

- Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

- Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

- Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

UNITED KINGDOM

- Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

- Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

- Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

OTHER NOTICES

description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is building a dedicated function to drive its partnerships across the AI ecosystem — labs, AI-native companies, and the investor community — and convert those into real technical and commercial outcomes. This is a newly created, high-visibility role that sits at the intersection of strategic business development, product partnership, and ecosystem relationship-building.

Ramp is already embedded with key partners across the AI ecosystem, from working with leading labs on the latest models to serving as a design partner for emerging product capabilities. This role exists to deepen those relationships across every major lab and AI-native company, and turn them into something commercially meaningful.

There is no playbook for this.

This person will own and grow Ramp's most strategic relationships across the AI ecosystem, leading the technical side of those relationships end to end with partner product and engineering teams. The mandate spans product integrations, technical partnership strategy, deal-making, co-selling, and the creation of new revenue channels, pairing real product and engineering depth with commercial execution and ecosystem credibility.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Demonstrate technical depth to lead AI product and integration conversations end to end with partner engineering and product teams.

- Stay ahead of how leading AI companies are commercializing and going to market, and help Ramp move with them — and ahead of them

- Deep, trusted relationships at leading AI companies with the people who make decisions and influence direction — not just formal contacts

Near-term objectives could include inclusion in model-launch announcements and joint product-integration launches. Longer-term goals will incorporate adoption of integrations and revenue targets as distribution partnerships are executed.

title: Product Marketing Manager, Business Accounts
description:

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. By leveraging data-driven insights and creative strategies, we ensure Airwallex stands out in a competitive market. Our team is passionate about telling the Airwallex story and supporting the company's growth and success.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

This role is pivotal in delivering consistency and simplicity in our product positioning in the market, in addition to driving success in sales enablement, product launches, and go-to-market. This role is based in San Francisco, CA.

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.
