title: Partnerships Sales Intern
description:
💙 ABOUT BOUNCE...

Bounce is building cloud storage for the physical world, starting with the largest global luggage storage network in existence. Bounce’s marketplace connects travelers with 30,000+ small business locations worldwide for hyper-local short term baggage storage. With more locations globally than Burger King, and more locations in New York City than Starbucks, Bounce has served 3M+ users and stored 10M+ bags, and paid over $10M to small business partners.

To achieve this, Bounce is a fast-paced and scrappy team. We believe that experimentation fuels innovation, so we move quickly, testing new ideas and adapting in real time. If you’re ready to make an impact in a high-energy, close-knit, and collaborative environment - Bounce is the place where you can move fast, think big, and shape the future of travel. Join us as we make the world a lighter, more accessible place! Bounce has been named the Inc5000’s fastest-growing travel company in the USA in 2024 and is proudly backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, and Sapphire. (Learn more about Bounce's Series B HERE https://techcrunch.com/2024/11/12/bounce-grabs-19m-to-expand-its-traveller-convenience-network/ and also learn about our Japan Expansion HERE https://techcrunch.com/2024/11/12/bounce-grabs-19m-to-expand-its-traveller-convenience-network/)

ABOUT THE ROLE…

As part of Bounce's Partnerships Sales Intern, you'll join a new team built to launch a career in B2B sales, for 6 months. You'll own your own market, work a daily pipeline, and be mentored one-to-one by one of the two people who built this channel at Bounce. By the end of the intern programme you'll have run hundreds of B2B conversations, negotiated your own commercial terms, and have a track record you can point to.

Start date: January 2027
Duration: 6 months

WHERE YOU COME IN…

- You own outbound acquisition of partnerships in your market, from the first call to the partner's first booking

- You work a daily pipeline of leads that arrive already researched and qualified, so your time goes into conversations, not spreadsheets

- You run the discovery call, work out whether there's a real fit, and handle the follow-ups when people don't pick up first time

- You negotiate the commercial terms, onboard the partner and make sure they are producing with Bounce.

- You're accountable for accounts that produce, not accounts that you sign. Your target is clear: 100 new producing partners over the six months.

- You log what happens on every call, because the whole programme decisions are made on the data you’re collecting.

- You work closely with your mentor and manager, who qualified every lead you call and coaches you on the ones that go wrong.

YOUR PROFILE…

- Fluent in English and fluent Portuguese or French or Italian.

- Having some commercial experience is a plus (not mandatory), in an internship or otherwise

- You're comfortable on the phone and at volume, making you the most resilient person in the room — most calls won't be answered, and that doesn't slow you down

- You can hold a professional, credible conversation with a business owner or operations directors. These are B2B conversations with people running real companies.

- You're organized enough to work a list in order rather than cherry-picking, and honest enough to log the calls that went badly.

- Comfortable with rejection, and curious about why a "no" happened

- Nice to have: experience into travel, hospitality, property management or any B2B partnerships background.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Data serving)
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST.
We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source.

WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You will report to our Senior Manager of Data & AI Products, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will:

- Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination).

- Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance.

- Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature.

- Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure.

- Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas.

- Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols.

- Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services.

- Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy.

- Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails.

To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more!

WHAT YOU BRING

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure.

- A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs.

- Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources.

- Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning.

- Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka.

- Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based).

- AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment.

- Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two.

- The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement.

- Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments.

WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You are passionate about building systems that serve other engineers.

- You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements.

- You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You need to operate within very large and structured teams with clear hierarchy. This role sits within a small and specialist team with a lot of autonomy.

- You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team.

- You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them.

HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will:

- Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised.

- Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it.

- Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis.

- 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options.

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

2. Core skills test: An async AI-assisted programming test to assess your coding fundamentals.

3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute chat deep diving into your experience.

4. Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute system design interview focusing on your architecture, infrastructure and problem-solving skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

ABOUT THE ROLE

This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source.

WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

- Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance.

- Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature.

- Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure.

- Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas.

- Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols.

- Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services.

- Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy.

- Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails.

- A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs.

- Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources.

- Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning.

- Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka.

- Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based).

- AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment.

- Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two.

- The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement.

This role is a good fit for you if:

description:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to drive AI and systems strategy across the Service value chain, scheduling through invoicing, for the dealership users who actually repair vehicles. You'll own high-visibility capabilities that cut manual steps and review time for BDC agents, technicians, and service advisors, so they can spend their time on the work that actually needs a human.

This role is built for someone who thinks like a systems architect even though you're not writing the architecture yourself. You've shipped AI/ML product before. You understand how integrations and backend systems actually behave under load, not just in theory. And you bring enough seniority to set the framework, not just fill in a roadmap someone else built. Our team, known internally as the JiraHunters, values precision, attention to detail, and a relentless focus on solving hard problems properly the first time.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for AI/ML-powered Service capabilities across Scheduling, Repair Order Management, Parts Operations, Technician Workflows, and Invoicing

- Partner directly with ML/AI engineers to identify, prioritize, and productize AI use cases. You're in the room for the model conversation, not briefed on it afterward

- Define the success metrics that matter: accuracy, adoption, time saved, workflow efficiency, and hold the roadmap to them

- Design solutions that scale across dealership sizes, service volumes, and regional requirements without falling apart at the edges

- Set the systems design and framework standards other PMs on the team build against

- Use data to decide what to build next, not gut feel dressed up as a roadmap

WHAT YOU BRING

- 8+ years of Product Management experience owning customer-facing SaaS products

- 2+ years of hands-on AI/ML product management experience: building ML-powered features, working directly with data scientists or ML engineers, understanding the model lifecycle end to end. This is required, not preferred

- Strong systems design and product architecture skills. You can design a scalable, extensible technical solution and explain why it's the right one. Non-negotiable for this role

- Experience leading distributed onshore and offshore teams

- Strong business acumen and the judgment to prioritize ruthlessly when everything looks urgent

- Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to partner closely with ML/AI engineers, design, data science, and GTM

GOOD TO HAVE

- Experience in automotive service or aftermarket, or with dealer/OEM service workflows

- Understanding of diagnostic workflows, scheduling systems, or parts catalog systems

- Hands-on experience with LLMs, NLP, or recommendation systems

- Familiarity with responsible AI principles and model explainability

- Background in operations research, process optimization, or workflow automation

description:
AI AT ZAPIER

Job Posted: 2026-10-06

Location: Remote (US)

Hi there!

We're looking for a Sr. Product Marketing Manager to build enterprise GTM for Zapier's next chapter. Your first priorities include standing up enterprise GTM for Sidekick (our newest product), shaping our governance narrative, and equipping Sales to win on technical differentiators. As product and market signals evolve, you'll own positioning and packaging wherever Zapier Enterprise needs the most leverage. You'll report to Jane Zhang, Director of Product Marketing, and partner closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing leaders to bring enterprise Zapier to market.

- Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

- Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

- Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

- Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

- Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/

ABOUT YOU

- You've landed product-market fit for a new product before, turning pricing and packaging experiments into a repeatable motion that reached real customers and closed revenue

- You bring deep product and technical depth - you understand how an MCP or agent-based workflow works and can explain it in plain language for a C-level buyer

- You have 8+ years in product marketing with meaningful time supporting enterprise sales

- You're entrepreneurial at enterprise scale - you move quickly with the rigor enterprise deals require, and stay close to what buyers actually need

- You use data to form strong opinions from customer conversations, deal feedback, and packaging experiments, then bring a clear point of view into the room to drive decisions

- You're comfortable collaborating async, with clear written updates, tight docs, and strong follow-through

- You actively use AI tools to work more efficiently - ideally you've built automations yourself

- You're comfortable with enterprise buyers: shaping proposals, supporting demos, and turning customer feedback into product and GTM inputs - credible with both executives and end-users

THINGS YOU’LL DO

- Lead enterprise GTM strategy for new products like Sidekick, defining commercial packaging from design partnerships through to GA

- Help shape our enterprise ICP and motion into a focused, repeatable GTM

- Own our Governance story: how we position things like secure auths, identity management, and safety with agent use

- Shape our talk track around Zapier's differentiators like fluid determinism, and how they show up in the product

- Work with our customer advocacy team on case studies and proof points that make the platform tangible for enterprise buyers

- Bring product-level depth to competitive deals, grounding "why Zapier wins" in specific workflows and features

- Collaborate with PMMs across narrative and product on positioning, launches, and the stories that support enterprise deals

- Partner with product and sales to shape and close enterprise opportunities on new platform capabilities

- Translate product updates into field-ready materials with revenue enablement, and feed deal feedback back to product on commercial readiness

HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. Job Posted: 10/6/2026

Remote - EMEA Preferred in United Kingdom, Ireland; open to USA (EST Only) with EMEA employment experience

Hi there!

Zapier is looking for a People Business Partner with experience supporting GTM functions and employment standards in EMEA.

This role is for an intermediate to senior level People Business Partner who will own their portfolio end to end, with support from people team partners: organizational design, workforce planning, talent reviews, manager capability, performance, and complex employee situations.

Our People Business Partner and Employee Relations team currently holds deep expertise in Canadian and US employment practice, and we are deliberately hiring to broaden that. Experience advising on performance, exits, and complex employee matters across multiple EMEA countries is a core requirement.

As a member of the PBP-ER Team, you will also contribute to the effectiveness of how the team works using AI-enabled systems, and automation to make processes and day-to-day work more efficient and scalable. You don't need to be the team's AI expert, but you work in an AI-forward manner by default.

- You have 5+ years of experience as an HRBP or PBP, and are capable of working autonomously in a global team.

- You have experience with a varied set of client groups. GTM experience is an asset, but the role will flex across different client groups.

- You’re unfazed by a fast moving environment, and can stay flexible and solutions focused in ambiguous situations, or in time where priorities may change

- You build strong relationships and credibility with experienced stakeholders in order to coach them through HR challenges in their orgs, while balancing what is best for the individuals and the business.

- You are capable of being a trusted sounding board and partner to your leaders in matters of organizational design, workforce planning, talent reviews, and change management. Leaders don't just need you to facilitate; they value your perspective.

- You have advised and coached leaders on performance management, employee relations, and exits in multiple EMEA jurisdictions and can work collaboratively with employee relations partners and internal legal counsel through the process.

- You use AI in your day-to-day work for personal productivity and for sharper insight and analysis across your portfolio.

- You work effectively in a fully remote, distributed environment, and can flex across timezones when the work requires it.

THINGS YOU’LL DO

- Serve as the strategic People partner to leaders in Data and Product, and the team expert in EMEA HR Partner Experience.

- Partner with Centers of Excellence to design and roll out people initiatives that are useful, relevant, and well-connected to the needs of the business.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, content, and web partners to deliver cohesive, on-brand creative.

title: Senior 3D Designer
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA

URL: http://bit.ly/3kLhMdk

About Contra Labs
Contra Labs sits at the intersection of human creativity and AI. We partner with leading AI labs and product companies to improve their tools across design, video, development, and beyond. Our research is grounded in how top creatives actually work, studying the patterns behind what gets created, what gets chosen, and what resonates. We believe human input will always be at the center of net new creation, and our mission is to help shape technology so human creativity can be amplified to create what today is unimaginable.

By joining the Contra Labs network you gain access to paid projects with some of the most innovative companies building the next generation of creative and AI-powered tools.

How It Works
This is an application to join the network and be eligible for roles as they arise. Projects are staffed on an as-needed basis, typically 5 to 10 hours at a time, though some may extend into longer engagements. In unique cases, we may have full-time roles available as well. When a project matches your skill set, we'll reach out with details and timeline.

To Join the Network

-
Portfolio review - We'll assess your Contra profile and portfolio for strength in content design, with a focus on ad creative and performance-driven visual content.

-
Record a 30 second intro video - Share a quick 30 second introduction so we can get to know you.

-
Complete profile - Once you’ve applied, we recommend completing your profile for better job matches and setting up your wallet so you can get paid when a job comes through.

What You May Work On

-
Evaluate AI-generated 3D scenes, interactive environments, simulations, and spatial experiences for visual and technical quality

-
Provide clear, structured feedback on scene composition, lighting, materials, physical dynamics, asset integration, interaction, and overall visual coherence

-
Help define quality benchmarks and evaluation criteria for what great AI-generated 3D experiences should look and feel like

-
Identify common failure modes in AI-generated 3D work, from broken physics and interactions to poor spatial composition or inconsistent visual feedback

-
Create reference examples, prototypes, or "golden" outputs that demonstrate best-in-class 3D execution

-
Contribute to research exploring how AI models can better understand and generate interactive 3D experiences

What We're Looking For

- Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality 3D design, interactive environments, or spatial experiences

-
Strong understanding of 3D composition, lighting, materials, animation, and visual coherence

-
Ability to articulate creative and technical feedback clearly and constructively

-
Strong 3D design instincts and awareness of contemporary visual culture, 3D trends, and emerging digital aesthetics

-
Comfort working in fast-paced, experimental environments (experience with AI, 3D tools, or creative technology is a plus)

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/contra-senior-3d-designer

title: Junior Graphic Designer for Packaging & Listing Images (Detail-Obsessed | Amazon
description:
ABOUT USSkyve is a growing e-commerce company building brands for health, wellness, and lifestyle markets - primarily on Amazon. Our product focus area is in food supplements and “Better For You” foods. Our team is lean, ambitious, and committed to high standards of design and brand experience.
ROLE OVERVIEWWe’re looking for a Junior Designer who lives for details and pixel perfection. You’ll take 80/20 design concepts, rough wireframes, and existing brand guidelines - and turn them into polished, production-ready assets for display and print. If you naturally spot alignment errors, can’t ignore off-by-one-pixel margins, and quietly take pride in clean kerning and beautiful layouts, we want to talk.
Tasks
- Transform wireframes and creative direction into Amazon listing images and advertising assets

- Finalize, adapt, and maintain packaging designs across multiple brands & product variations (powders, capsules, pouches, bottles, etc.)

- Maintain template consistency and design systems for Amazon listings

- Prepare accurate, print-ready design files (bonus if you can also create the print-files handling dielines, layers, etc.)

- Assist with A+ Content, digital ads, and other branded visuals as needed

Requirements
- Obsessive attention to visual detail, layout, alignment, and font usage

- Solid experience with Canva (especially for template-based Amazon workflows)

- Proficiency with Adobe Illustrator (print prep, packaging, dielines)

- Experience with Midjourney and AI design tools (nice to have, not required)

- Strong organizational skills: able to keep file libraries, typographies, and assets tidy and up to date

- Can take direction, run with it, and deliver on time without micromanagement

- Self-motivation: You enjoy fixing the mess, optimizing templates, and getting every line, weight, and spacing just right

Benefits
- FLEXIBLE: Flexible working hours that fit around your studies

- REMOTE: Work from anywhere

- PORTFOLIO: Build your portfolio with real commercial projects

- ECOMMERCE: Develop specialized skills in e-commerce design

- COMPENSATION: Fair rates with potential for long-term collaboration

- LEARN: Opportunity to learn about online retail and product marketing

HOW TO APPLYPlease read carefully as applicants that do not fill this out will not be considered!
When you are prompted to upload your Cover Letter, please make sure the file includes the following information.

- What’s one design detail most people overlook, but you always notice?

- Please submit 1-2 portfolio examples (via a google drive folder link or similar) that best demonstrate your attention to detail in layout, spacing, alignment, and typography. Briefly describe (ideally via a loom.com video link, but text also ok) what you specifically refined or improved to get it "pixel perfect." Bonus if it's a design asset that is relevant to the responsibilities of this job (packaging with text, listing image, etc). Bonus if you can also share the "before" version.

- Mention your target hourly rate

Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.

We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.

Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.

We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.

Not your grandad’s bookie.

*👀 The Role*

*Title:* Junior Product Designer - Casino

*Team:* Product

*Location:* United Kingdom, Remote

As a Junior Product Designer in our Casino Design team, you’ll help shape the future of Midnite’s casino experience across both content and product. You’ll be responsible for creating high-quality casino game artwork and visual assets, including static imagery, animations, and videos, while also contributing to new casino features, product journeys, and user experiences.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, CRM, Marketing, and the wider Design team to create engaging, intuitive, and commercially impactful casino experiences for our players.

*You Will:*

*

Create compelling casino game artwork, promotional visuals, static imagery, animations, and video assets that feel distinctly Midnite.

*

Design player-facing casino experiences across discovery, game pages, promotions, journeys, and new product features.

*

Translate product opportunities, user needs, and business goals into clear, polished design solutions.

*

Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers from discovery through delivery, ensuring design intent is carried through into the final experience.

*

Support the evolution of Midnite’s Casino visual language, helping us build experiences that feel modern, premium, and easy to understand.

*

Prototype and communicate design ideas clearly using visuals, motion, interaction flows, and written rationale.

*

Balance creative quality with speed, using feedback, data, and experimentation to improve casino experiences over time.

*

Work across multiple formats and surfaces, from in-product journeys to campaign and promotional creative.

*The Next Midniter:*

*

Has 1+ years’ experience in product design, visual design, motion design, game art, or a closely related discipline.

*

Has a strong portfolio demonstrating visual craft, creative thinking, and polished work

*

Has a strong eye for composition, typography, colour, layout, and brand expression.

*

Has experience creating static imagery, animations, and/or video assets for digital products, campaigns, games, or entertainment brands.

*

Is proficient in modern design tools such as Figma or Adobe Creative Suite; experience with generative AI tools, After Effects, Rive, Lottie, or similar is a strong plus.

*

Understands product design fundamentals, including user journeys, interaction design, prototyping, and design systems.

*

Collaborates openly with Product, Engineering, Marketing, CRM, and other designers, communicating decisions and rationale clearly.

*

Brings energy, taste, curiosity, and a high bar for craft to the Casino Design team.

Has an interest in casino, gaming, entertainment, sports betting, or consumer products and is excited to help define what a modern casino experience should feel like.

Income protection to protect your earnings and give you peace of mind.

Salary sacrifice schemes for tech and holidays so you can spread the cost of the things you want.

Retail discounts and subscription perks across a wide range of brands.

Quarterly team socials to connect, celebrate and have fun together.

*

title: Junior Procurement Category Manager (f/m/x)
description:
*The role: What's in the Box*

This is an exciting entry point into strategic procurement at the HelloFresh Group! As a *Jr.* *Category Manager for European Herbs* , you will get hands-on experience in a live, high-impact category — supporting a portfolio of approximately £10m in annual spend across 6 European markets — with the close guidance and mentorship of an experienced team.

In this role, you will learn the full category management cycle for Herbs: supporting supplier relationships, assisting with tender processes, tracking cost and quality performance, and coordinating cross-functionally with Supply Chain, FSQA, and Product teams. Alongside day-to-day operational support, you will contribute to key strategic initiatives, including the rollout of our new cross-dock supply model in Europe and project support across Fruit Bags, Avocados, and Sustainability.

We are looking for someone analytically sharp, commercially curious, and eager to learn fast. You don’t need years of procurement experience — just the drive to learn, strong attention to detail, and a passion for fresh produce and supply chains!

*What you’ll do: The Recipe*

Category Management Support

* Assist with day-to-day procurement activities for the European Herbs category, including monitoring order status, tracking shortage responses, and assisting with quality coordination.
* Support the execution of the Herbs category strategy, gathering market data and helping track supplier performance and supply risks across 6 markets.
* Support tender processes for the category — assisting with data preparation, supplier briefings, and preliminary commercial analysis.
* Help maintain accurate cost reporting, invoice tracking, and administrative supplier data for the Herbs category.

Supplier Collaboration

* Act as a secondary point of contact for Herbs suppliers across Europe, helping manage routine operational queries and administrative follow-ups.
* Assist the Teamlead in preparing materials for supplier meetings, joint business planning sessions, and contract discussions.
* Track and report on supplier performance metrics (OTIF, quality, and sustainability KPIs), escalating potential risks proactively.

Cross-Functional & Strategic Projects

* Support the cross-dock supply chain pilot in Europe by helping coordinate communication between Procurement, Supply Chain Operations, and suppliers.
* Provide analytical and coordination support across strategic initiatives in Fruit Bags, Avocados, and Fruit & Sustainability.
* Collaborate with internal teams (Product, FSQA, Operations) to ensure procurement documentation and alignment remain smooth.
* Research and monitor market dynamics in herbs and fresh produce — such as seasonality, weather risks, and pricing trends — bringing valuable insights to team discussions.

*What you’ll bring: The Ingredients*

Education & Background

* Recently graduated from a Bachelor's or Master's program in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.
* Previous internship, placement, or academic project experience in an analytical or commercial environment is a plus (direct procurement experience is not required).
* A genuine interest in food, agriculture, or global supply chains — curiosity about where ingredients come from will serve you well here!

Skills & Mindset

* *Analytically Minded:* Comfortable working with data in Excel/Google Sheets, analyzing costs, and presenting findings clearly.
* *Organized & Proactive:* Strong attention to detail, ability to manage multiple small tasks, and eagerness to take initiative.
* *Commercially Curious:* Eager to understand how pricing works, why supply chains move, and how strategic decisions impact business outcomes.

title: Junior Data Scientist Greece
description:
*Junior Data Scientist, Greece*

*Role type:* Full time | *Location:* Greece (fully remote) | *Preferred start date:* ASAP

*ABOUT SATALIA*

Satalia builds enterprise-grade AI systems for WPP and its FTSE 100 client base. Led by WPP Chief AI Officer Daniel Hulme, we run as a decentralised organisation where engineers and scientists own their domains end to end. Our data scientists are also at the core of WPP Research , conducting frontier research and developing prototypes that evolve into tools used in production across WPP.

*THE ROLE*

Our current work includes:

*Agentic systems.* Developing long-horizon agents that plan, use tools, and collaborate. We also build the core infrastructure to ensure reliability and governance at scale, spanning context/memory, observability, traffic control, and continuous verification.

*Federated and privacy-preserving learning.* Training shared models when the data cannot move: federated LLM fine-tuning across independent data owners, and aggregation strategies that hold up under heterogeneous datasets.

*Identity intelligence.* Predictive and probabilistic modelling on large behavioural datasets: propensity and similarity models, and probabilistic record linkage across data sources.

*Geospatial intelligence.* Spatial statistics, geospatial feature engineering, and forecasting and optimisation over location data, plus computer vision on imagery.

*Synthetic data.* Generating realistic synthetic data with known ground truth to stress-test models and agents under controlled adversarial conditions.

You will work across these workstreams alongside senior data scientists, engineers, and domain experts across Satalia and WPP, building and testing models and agents that ship to production.

*WHAT YOU'LL DO*

· Explore multimodal datasets and buildthe features and pipelines that models depend on.

· Build and test models and agents under the guidance of senior data scientists.

· Write clean, tested, reviewed code that is ready to go to production.

· Learn quickly across workstreams and pick up new methods as the field evolves

*MUST HAVE*

· A degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, or a related quantitative field. An MSc or PhD is a plus.

· 0 to 2 years of experience in data science or machine learning, including internships or substantial academic projects.

· Solid foundations in statistics and machine learning for structured and unstructured data.

· Good Python skills and familiarity with the standard data science stack.

· Hands-on experience with embeddings and LLM-based solutions.

· Curiosity, a willingness to learn, and clear communication.

*NICE TO HAVE*

· Experience with temporal or geospatial data.

· Personal or academic projects involving agents, LLM fine-tuning, embeddings.

· Interest in marketing technology, ad tech, or audience modelling.

· Open-source contributions, publications, or competition results.

*WHAT WE OFFER*

· Healthcare benefits

· Remote working

· Flexible working hours

· Impactful projects

· Continuous learning and development

Satalia is home to some of the brightest minds in AI. If you're looking for a company that values autonomy and freedom and embraces a culture of inclusion and warmth, we'd love to hear from you.

We aim to respond to all applications within 2 weeks. If you have not heard from us within 2 weeks this means your application has been unsuccessful.

By applying to Satalia you are expressly giving your consent for the collection and use of your information as described within our Satalia Recruitment Privacy Policy.

Good luck!

title: Junior Business Development Executive
description:
About Aetherbloom
-----------------

Aetherbloom is a UK-led business process outsourcing and business support company. We work with UK organisations that need reliable administrative, customer service, operational and digital support. Our South African employees work remotely in roles aligned to UK business hours.

We are recruiting a Junior Business Development Executive to join our internal sales team and complete the Aetherbloom Sales Academy. The academy provides structured training, call practice, coaching and supervised live work during the first 12 weeks.

The role
--------

You will research suitable UK businesses, contact decision-makers and create qualified sales opportunities for Aetherbloom. You will use phone, email and LinkedIn, keep accurate records in HubSpot and work closely with the founders and sales lead while you develop your skills.

Previous B2B sales experience can help, but we do not require it. We will assess how well you communicate,prepare, learn, handle feedback, follow through and continue working after setbacks.

Key responsibilities
--------------------

*

Research UK SMEs, charities, professional services firms and founder-led businesses that fit Aetherbloom’s target market.

*

Identify and verify the appropriate decision-maker before making contact.

*

Make outbound calls and open clear, professional conversations with UK prospects.

*

Write concise, relevant prospecting emails and LinkedIn messages.

*

Ask questions to understand the prospect’s current workload, operational pressure, priorities, and buying process.

*

Qualify opportunities and book discovery meetings for the senior team.

*

Prepare complete meeting handovers so the senior team understands the business, the contact, the problem and the agreed next step.

*

Follow up prospects at agreed intervals and close inactive or unsuitable opportunities with a clear reason.

*

Record calls, emails, meetings, notes, outcomes and next steps in HubSpot on the same day.

*

Review your activity and conversion data with your manager and apply feedback to improve your performance.

What we are looking for
-----------------------

*

Clear spoken and written communication.
---------------------------------------

*

Good listening skills and the confidence to ask follow-up questions.

*

A willingness to make outbound calls and speak to people you have not met before.

*

Resilience when calls or messages do not lead to an immediate result.

*

The ability to take specific feedback and use it in your next attempt.

*

Curiosity about businesses and how they operate.

*

Reliable follow-through and accurate record keeping.

*

Self-motivation in a remote working environment.

*

Comfort working towards measurable activity and sales targets.

*

Professional judgement and honesty about what has and has not happened in the sales process.

Experience
----------

We welcome applicants from sales and from other customer-facing or target-driven roles. Relevant experience may include:

*

Customer service or contact centre work.
----------------------------------------

*

Retail or hospitality.
----------------------

*

Recruitment or resourcing.
--------------------------

*

Fundraising, membership sales, events or community outreach.

*

Account management or client support.
-------------------------------------

*

A role where you had to meet targets, influence people or generate your own opportunities.

A university degree, an existing UK client network and previous B2B sales experience are not required.

Training and development
------------------------

The first 12 weeks include structured training and supervised live work. Training covers:

*

Aetherbloom’s services, packages and target clients.

*

UK business communication and professional standards.

*

Prospect research and qualification.
------------------------------------

*

Cold calling and gatekeeper conversations.

*

Email and LinkedIn outreach.
----------------------------

*

Discovery questioning and listening.
------------------------------------

*

Objection handling and follow-up.
---------------------------------

*

Commercial value and package selection.
---------------------------------------

*

HubSpot CRM and pipeline management.
------------------------------------

*

Data protection, opt-outs and sales compliance.

You will receive regular call reviews, role-play practice, weekly coaching and clear development targets. The leve of supervision reduces as you demonstrate consistent performance and sound judgement.

How we measure progress
-----------------------

During the academy, we review both activity and quality. We look at:

*

Quality of prospect research and targeting.

*

Outbound activity completed and recorded correctly.

*

Decision-maker conversations.
-----------------------------

*

Qualified discovery meetings booked.
------------------------------------

*

Progress from first contact to qualified opportunity.

*

Call and message quality.
-------------------------

*

HubSpot accuracy and same-day record keeping.

*

Application of feedback and improvement over time.

*

Reliability, preparation and professional conduct.

Targets increase during the academy as your skills develop. We will give you the approved target schedule and commission terms in writing before you accept an offer.

Practical requirements
----------------------

*

Based in South Africa.
----------------------

*

Available to work hours aligned to the UK business day.

*

Reliable internet connection.
-----------------------------

*

Quiet and professional environment for business calls.

*

Suitable computer and headset for remote work.

*

Comfort using video meetings, CRM software and online communication tools.

Career development
------------------

Employees who complete the academy and demonstrate the required sales capability can progress into the Business Growth Partner role. Further progression can include senior individual contributor roles or sales management, depending on performance, business need and the employee’s strengths.

Selection process
-----------------

1. Application and CV review.
-----------------------------

2. Online information session.
------------------------------

3. Short prospect research exercise.
------------------------------------

4. Live sales exercise with feedback and a second attempt.

5. Final structured interview.
------------------------------

6. Reference checks and offer.
------------------------------

We use the same core assessment criteria for all candidates. We can make reasonable adjustments to the selection process where needed.

How to apply
------------

Apply with your CV and the application questions listed in the vacancy. Please answer the questions using your own examples. We are interested in what you personally did, what happened and what you learned.

Equal opportunity
-----------------

Aetherbloom considers applicants against the requirements of the role and the evidence provided during the selection process. The junior level describes the level of responsibility and development required for the role. It does not refer to age.

title: Junior Content Marketing Manager
description:
*Allow us to introduce ourselves*

Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over *260 employees* spread across *13 countries* (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from *+190 markets,* globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? *🚀*

Here at Appinio, we value *transparency* *in our recruitment process* , and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: *here*

*Your mission as a Junior Content Marketing Manager*

Your mission is to be the engine room of Appinio’s global content & brand function. You will turn strategy, research, and campaign ideas into high-quality, on-brand content across our digital channels and international markets — from copywriting and publishing to repurposing, optimisation and distribution. With a dotted line supporting our Organic Growth function, you’ll fuel SEO, AIO and discoverability, while keeping our core content engine running efficiently and reaching more ICP-fit audiences in a compelling way — ultimately contributing to measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

*What you’ll be doing*

* *Develop Best-In-Class Content:* Turn research, customer advocacy, brand pillars, business assets and new ideas into compelling content and integrated campaigns — from reports and blogs to email, social, landing pages, sales enablement and more — designed to maximise reach and impact.
* *Own Content & Brand Operations:* Keep our global content engine running smoothly, owning day-to-day operations, content governance and brand consistency across channels, while maintaining content libraries and infrastructure.
* *Coordinate Localisation:* Manage translation and localisation workflows with regional teams, ensuring content is adapted effectively for priority markets while maintaining a consistent global brand.
* *Optimise for Search & Discovery:* Work with Organic Growth to apply SEO, AIO and AI-search best practices across content, improving discoverability, organic reach and performance.
* *Connect Content to GTM:* Collaborate with GTM stakeholders to activate content across campaigns and channels, ensuring it reaches the right audiences and contributes to pipeline and revenue.
* *Report & Optimise Performance:* Track and report on content performance across key channels, using insights to identify what’s working, improve future content and maximise impact.

*You will thrive in this role if*

* You have 1–3 years of experience in content or digital marketing, ideally within a B2B SaaS or tech environment.
* You possess exceptional copywriting, editing, and proofreading skills in English with meticulous attention to detail.
* You are comfortable working with content management systems (HubSpot experience is a plus) and publishing platforms.
* You’re obsessed with how people search, how search trends are evolving, and how AI is changing the way content gets discovered — with a strong baseline understanding of SEO and AIO/GEO.
* You are highly organised, proactive, and eager to take ownership of content creation and operational workflows in a fast-paced setting.

title: Junior Quality Control Engineer
description:
*Junior Quality Control Engineer - Remote w/frequent travel (Must live in the United States)*

Intertek's *Clean Energy Associates* (CEA) serves as a trusted partner to some of the world’s leading solar project developers, owners and financiers, providing a range of services across the value chain. These services include quality assurance, supply chain management and traceability as well as technical support to clean energy projects.

CEA also serves clean energy equipment suppliers and manufacturers, helping them grow and navigate the key manufacturing challenges that are critical for their success. Intertek is continually innovating and evolving to reduce risk for consumers, brands and organizations in every sector and industry around the world.

We go beyond Testing, Inspection and Certification of products: we are a Total Quality Assurance Provider to industries worldwide. Our Purpose: Bringing quality, safety, and sustainability to life. Learn more @ www.intertekcea.com

*What are we looking for?*

The Junior Quality Control Engineer will conduct quality control audits and inspections at manufacturing sites, ensuring compliance with client standards and specifications during the production process of solar PV components. This role involves onsite monitoring, visual inspections, and documentation to ensure the quality and reliability of solar products. They will work closely with internal and external teams, leveraging a strong attention to detail and a focus on maintaining high standards in manufacturing environments

The Junior Quality Control Engineer could also engage in field work and be responsible for executing onsite solar PV projects including PV module testing, inspections, audits, commissioning verification, troubleshooting, etc. Candidate will be responsible for executing work within all technical, commercial, safety regulatory, and environmental requirements to meet or exceed client’s expectations.

The candidate should also be able to troubleshoot issues that may arise during testing, resolve conflicts, communicate effectively virtually with colleagues and coordinate work with client’s representatives onsite, be comfortable working in a group environment, and willing to put in extra effort to coordinate activities across time zones.

*Shift/Schedule:* Variable. This position will travel up to 75% of the time.

*Salary & Benefits Information*

In addition to competitive compensation packages, when working with Intertek you can expect benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, 401(k) with company match, generous vacation / sick time (PTO), tuition reimbursement and more.

*What you'll do:*

* Travel to manufacturing facilities to perform production quality control audits and inspections on solar PV products and components.
* Conduct visual inspections using established quality control checklists to ensure compliance with specifications.
* Verify Bill of Materials (BOM) and monitor inline production processes.
* Oversee pre-shipment inspections, packaging, and loading processes for finished products.
* Support internal and external laboratory testing efforts, ensuring alignment with client requirements.
* Generate and submit detailed QC reports promptly following audits.
* Address client-specific QC requests and provide additional services as needed within defined scopes of work.
* Collaborate with back-office teams to support cross-functional projects in quality control, finance, and operations.
* This position outline is a general guideline and does not represent all encompassing details. The position assumes that the incumbent has both the mental and physical requirements to carry out the above defined duties.

*Minimum Requirements & Qualifications:*

* B.S. in engineering or physics (4-year engineering/science degree)
* An understanding of the components and operation of PV modules and systems
* Experience with I-V Curve Tracing, Megger Testing, Infrared Scanning, Visual Inspection, Multimeter Use and safety practices while conducting inspections and/or commissioning work
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal); diligent record-keeping; proficient Microsoft Office and computer skills
* OSHA 10/30 certification, fall protection training, and training in arc-flash, lock-out/tag-out, and other special protective equipment and procedures desirable
* Ability to work outdoors in harsh conditions including but not limited to desert areas, winter conditions, nighttime work, long hours standing, climbing stairs and ladders
* Ability to wear personal protective equipment is required (including but not limited to; steel toed shoes, gloves, safety glasses, hearing protection, protective jacket or apron and arm guards)
* Intertek is not able to provide visa sponsorship or work authorization support for this position Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without current or future sponsorship
* Ability to travel out of town the majority of the time
* Valid driver’s license and reliable driving record
* *This is a remote position; however, applicants must reside in and be able to legally work in the United States*

*Preferred Requirements & Qualifications:*

* Experience in PV testing/inspection, O&M, or electrician experience with C&I and/or utility scaled PV systems
* Experience in interpreting EL images and/or I-V curve traces and/or testing PV modules and cells
* NABCEP certification

*Intertek: Total Quality. Assured.*

Intertek is a world leader in the Quality Assurance market, with a proven, high-quality business model and a global network of customer-focused operations and highly engaged subject matter experts. With passion, pace, and precision we work to exceed our customers’ expectations, while engaging with our employees to be 10X in their performance and professional growth.

Intertek is a drug-free workplace. As a condition of employment, certain positions may be required to pass a pre-employment drug test based on the type of work that will be performed.

description:

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We're looking for a highly organized, detail-driven Junior Project Coordinator to keep our creative and development teams moving. You'll own weekly sprint planning for our Design team, keep tickets moving by following up with stakeholders, and keep our project management workspace in Wrike accurate and up to date.

This is a great entry-level opportunity for someone looking to grow in project coordination. You'll work closely with designers, developers, and project managers, gaining hands-on experience with sprint planning and cross-functional collaboration. The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

This is a fully remote, part-time, standalone role at 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Pacific. You'll report to Krystal Perez, Project Manager, and support our Design and Software Development teams as well as our Project Managers. Within your first 60 days, you'll run the weekly sprint review independently and manage stakeholder follow-ups with minimal oversight.

--------------

Design Sprint Planning & Prioritization (Core Focus)
----------------------------------------------------

* Build and prioritize the Design team's weekly sprint using established guidelines.

* Lead a weekly call with brand project managers to review sprint priorities and discuss tickets planned for upcoming sprints.

* Spot-check dashboards and automated status updates to confirm they're pulling correctly.
* Draft routine internal updates, reminders, and announcements for review.

-----------

-----------

* Proactive Communication: Seeks clarification at the start of a task and flags blockers or deadline risks as soon as they arise.
* Responsiveness: Replies promptly to Slack messages and Wrike comments during working hours.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX DESIGNER, SEEKING

Product | Full-Time, Salaried | Reports to Head of Product

Company

Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

Location

Remote, anywhere in the USA (Las Vegas, NV strongly preferred)

Compensation

$90,000 to $140,000 base

Travel

Required for team weeks, user research, and quarterly planning in Las Vegas

About the Role

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We work at the intersection of technology, consumer psychology, and product design at the highest level. Our mission is to help people foster genuine relationships and find love, and to rethink how social platforms can advance human connection.

We are hiring a UI/UX Designer who combines three things: systems thinking, customer obsession, and an eye for emotionally rich interaction design. Dating is an emotional product. People act on emotion first and logic second, so our interface has to earn trust, build excitement, and guide each member toward the next right step.

You will work directly with the Co-CEOs and Head of Product, embedded in a cross-functional pod with a Product Manager, engineers, and a data engineer. Each pod owns a funnel, such as onboarding, and is measured on the sign-ups, engagement, and purchases it drives. You will design across web and native iOS and Android: onboarding, discovery, matching, messaging, profile, and subscription surfaces.

AI tools can now produce a basic, competent interface in minutes. That makes tool skill table stakes. We pay for judgment: understanding the member deeply, anticipating edge cases before they ship, and knowing when an experience should be fast and minimal and when it should be layered with motion, video, and texture that pull the member forward.

This role may also be a fit for candidates whose current title is UX Designer, UX/UI Designer, Product Designer, Interaction Designer, Visual Designer, Motion Designer, or Product Design Engineer. If your day-to-day is designing and shipping consumer experiences that real people love using, apply regardless of title.

What You'll Own

Customer Obsession & Research

* Spend real time with members: interviews, session recordings, support tickets, and beta groups of real users who test new work before it ships.

Systems Thinking & Edge Cases

* Design complete flows, including every state, error, empty screen, and edge case, so engineering builds it right the first time.
* Break big experience problems into small, shippable steps that build momentum.
* Work inside our design system and extend it cleanly when a new pattern is needed.

Emotional & Interaction Design

* Design for emotion and guidance: motion, video, fluid transitions, and layered texture that build excitement and lead members along the right path.
* Keep task moments such as settings, payments, and verification fast, clean, and effortless.
* Make the effect of member actions visible, so adding a photo, completing a profile, or verifying feels immediately rewarding.

Core Experiences You'll Shape

* Onboarding that takes a new member from download to a compelling profile in minutes.
* Conversational, AI-guided profile building that replaces long forms.
* Discovery and shortlisting flows that move members from browsing to real connection.
* Messaging as seamless as the best consumer apps, with rich media and video built in.
* Self-presentation tools that let members who value discretion show who they are with confidence.

Data-Driven Iteration

* Work from funnel and engagement data with your pod. Instrument what you ship and read the results.
* Prototype in Figma, Framer, or code (v0, Lovable, Cursor) and put ideas in front of real members within days.

Agentic Operating Model

* Use Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and comparable tools every day to explore more options and ship faster.
* Help build the design team's agent workflows and playbook so the whole team compounds.

Required Qualifications

* A portfolio of shipped consumer product work that shows exceptional UI/UX craft: typography, layout, motion, interaction, and polish.
* A consistent pattern of customer obsession across your career. Your case studies start with the user and end with what changed for them.
* Systems thinking. You anticipate edge cases, design every state, and see how one screen affects the whole journey.
* Proven ability to design for emotion, using motion, transitions, video, and visual texture with purpose.
* Relentless curiosity. You keep asking why until you understand the member, and you are always learning.
* Smart risk-taking. You try bold ideas, test them small, and learn fast.
* Three or more years of hands-on UI/UX or product design experience in consumer B2C, mobile, or subscription products.
* Expert Figma: component systems, auto-layout, prototyping, tokens, and multi-file library management.
* Daily, fluent use of agentic AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, or comparable), with enough technical and architectural fluency to direct AI toward results that scale. You will be asked to demonstrate this in the interview.
* Comfort working from funnel and engagement data (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Firebase, or comparable).

Preferred Qualifications

* Prior work in dating, social, marketplace, or subscription products.
* Motion design skills in tools such as After Effects, Rive, Lottie, or Principle.
* Front-end fluency (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) sufficient to ship small changes yourself.
* Experience running or partnering on customer beta programs.
* Public work we can see: portfolio, prototypes, Dribbble, Behance, or a personal site.
* Bachelor's degree in design, human-computer interaction, or a related field. We weigh the work most heavily.

Compensation & Benefits

title: Senior Product Designer, Growth
description:
******************
Join the Tilt team
******************

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide *,* we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

****************************************
The Opportunity: Senior Product Designer
****************************************

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer who does their best work bringing ideas to life. You'll own complex, high-impact product experiences across market-leading areas from Cash Advance to Credit Cards, taking them from concept through launch and iteration.

This is an individual contributor role for a designer who combines strong product thinking and UX fundamentals with exceptional visual and UI craft. You'll join a collaborative design team, building alongside our talented, tenured team of designers, product managers and engineers to turn product problems into polished, intuitive experiences. You love shipping, take pride in the details, and get energy from iterating, testing and seeing how customers respond.

-------------------------
How You'll Make an Impact
-------------------------

*

Own design for key initiatives from concept through launch, keeping a steady rhythm of shipping across new features, flow improvements and experiments.

*

Translate complex financial concepts into clear, approachable experiences, with a high bar for interaction design, visual design and overall quality.

*

Collaborate closely with our team of designers, combining their longer-range product thinking with your hands-on craft to shape what we build.

*

Design and run experiments with your product and data partners, from hypothesis through analysis, and use what you learn to shape what comes next.

*

Iterate on critical user experiences based on metrics, research and customer feedback, treating launch as the start of the work, not the end.

*

Partner with product and engineering to scope smartly, make thoughtful tradeoffs and bring people along on your decisions.

*

Build with and contribute to our design system, and use AI tools to transform the way we deliver user impact

----------------------
Why You're a Great Fit
----------------------

*

Significant experience designing and shipping complex digital products, ideally in fintech, financial services, commerce or another multi-stakeholder environment.

*

A portfolio showing strong UX thinking and polished visual and UI execution, including examples of iteration and the results your work drove.

*

Strong interaction design fundamentals, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to keep quality high while moving with momentum.

*

Hands-on experience designing for A/B tests and experiments, and knowing how to structure variants to get clear, useful results.

*

A strong grasp of product metrics like conversion, activation, engagement and retention, and a data-informed approach that blends quantitative and qualitative signals.

*

You thrive in close collaboration, bring a strong point of view, and like building on others' ideas as much as sharing your own.

*

Clear communication, and hands-on use of AI tools in your day-to-day work.

------------
Nice to Have
------------

*

Experience designing consumer financial products, including lending, banking, budgeting, payments, and more

*

Experience contributing to or evolving a design system.

*

Experience with analytics and experimentation tools like Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Optimizely.

-----------------------
What Success Looks Like
-----------------------

First 30 days: Get to know our customers, products and design system, build relationships with your partners, and ship your first work.

First 90 days: Own design across a set of key initiatives, shipping on a regular rhythm and running your first experiments. Trusted member to EPD partners in the problem space.

Over time: You're known for quality, momentum and measurable impact, and you play a key part in how the EPD team delivers on its biggest priorities.

-----------
Why Join Us
-----------

*

Own meaningful product experiences used by millions of people.

*

Ship often, test your ideas with real customers, and see the impact in the metrics.

*

Work closely with tenured, talented designers on a team that values strong craft, constructive debate and thoughtful collaboration.

*Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.*

-------------------------
*What you'll get at Tilt*
-------------------------

*

*Virtual-first teamwork:* The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

*

*Competitive pay:* We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

*

*Complete support:* Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

*

*Visibility is yours* : You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

*

*Paid global onsites* : Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

*

*Impact is recognized* : Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

--------------
*The Tilt Way*
--------------

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

*You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.*

title: Product Designer
description:
JTX is our trading app, and it runs on the fastest market infrastructure on Solana, which we also built. It’s live today, self-custodial, and native mobile apps are in development.

We’re looking for a Product Designer to focus mainly on JTX, but you’ll also have the chance to help with other Jito products as needed.

We’re a small team and have already found product-market fit. This shapes the way we work:

*

You’ll make real decisions, not just work through a backlog set by others.

*

We release features and learn from real user feedback, rather than getting stuck in endless debates.

*

Attention to detail is essential here. For a trading product, the small things make all the difference.

About the Position
------------------

You’ll work on UX and UI for both web and native mobile. Right now, our main challenge is making JTX feel clear and trustworthy at a glance, not just functional. You’ll also help keep things consistent between web and mobile, and pitch in on marketing design when needed.

You’ll work closely with engineering and product to make the most important decisions. If you’ve ever thought about how traders read a screen under pressure and want to create the product layer that makes speed tangible, this could be the right fit for you.

What You’ll Do
--------------

*

Design for JTX across web and mobile, including order entry, market data, charts, positions, execution visibility, onboarding, and wallet flows.

*

Take features from defining the problem through UX and final UI.

*

Own and improve the design system and token library that our engineers use.

*

Help with marketing design when needed, like landing pages, social assets, and launch materials.

*

Jump in on design work for other Jito products when the team needs extra help.

*

Release, observe real usage, and keep improving.

Requirements
------------

*

Strong product sense: you can explain why a decision is right, not just that it looks good.

*

You can spot issues with hierarchy and clarity on a busy screen and explain what’s causing them.

*

You’re comfortable working across research, UX, and UI, just like any early-stage product designer needs to.

*

You can work independently and bring the team in on important decisions, but not every single one.

*

You’re a true collaborator who communicates proactively and works well with engineering and product.

*

You’re comfortable giving direct feedback on others’ work and receiving it on your own. Here, critique is quick and specific, never personal.

*

You’re fluent in Figma and comfortable working directly with token-based design systems.

Preferred (not required)
------------------------

*

Experience designing consumer (B2C) crypto or fintech products, or hands-on experience as a trader.

*

Trading terminals, exchange or brokerage products.

*

Consumer fintech apps at scale.
-------------------------------

*

Data-dense or real-time interfaces, such as dashboards, analytics, or live data visualization.

*

Self-custodial wallets, Solana or EVM products.

*

Experience building or maintaining a token-based design system.

description:

Responsibilities
----------------

Peraton is seeking a *Front‑End Web Developer* to join our growing team supporting mission‑critical applications for government customers. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain intuitive, accessible, and highly performant user interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks and U.S. Web Design System (USWDS) components.
