title: Senior UX Visual Designer
description:
About Northbeam
---------------

Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi-touch attribution, MMM+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser-accurate first-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions.

We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast-moving, high-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey.

We're a remote-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

*About the Role*
----------------

We think about our product more broadly than most: Northbeam isn't only a web app. It's our data and our recommendations, delivered wherever our customers already work. Sometimes that's our platform. Sometimes it's an alert that lands in their inbox and shapes their day. Sometimes it's our data flowing into their own systems, or back into the ad platforms to make those platforms smarter. All of that is Northbeam, and all of it has to be designed.

As *Senior UX Visual Designer* , you'll be the person who makes it look like the best product in its category. Projects here start with our SMEs (our Media Strategists, CEO, Data Scientists and Engineers) and product team, who define requirements and work on an initial concept. You take it from there — fleshing it out, resolving the details, and bringing a level of visual craft that makes dense analytical software genuinely delightful to use. You'll work alongside product, media strategists, data science and engineering to ship.

*This is a hands-on individual contributor role reporting to our Chief Product and Design Officer.*

*What You'll Work On*
---------------------

* *AI inside the product.* Automated alerts that tell a marketer what needs attention before they ask, and interfaces where customers can shape their own views and pages through natural language. These are new surfaces that need a visual language invented for them.
* *Incrementality.* Making causal measurement feel approachable to someone who isn't a statistician through engaging and beautiful visualizations.
* *Actionable Data Insights.* A coherent visual experience across our web app, mobile, email, and the integrations that push our data into our customers' own tools and workflows.
* *The core data platform.* Complex, data-heavy interfaces that stay elegant as we add new capabilities for our customers.

*Your Impact*
-------------

* Take initial concepts from our subject matter experts and product team and develop them into resolved, high-fidelity design.
* Raise the visual bar across the platform — typography, color, layout, density, and the details that separate good software from forgettable software.
* Build and extend our design system so quality scales beyond any one screen.
* Design data visualizations that make complicated numbers immediately readable.
* Present work clearly to customers and executives, and give and receive critique well.
* Partner closely with our brand and marketing team on a coherent visual identity.

*What You Bring*
----------------

* 7+ years of product design experience, with solid B2B SaaS and enterprise work.
* *A visually outstanding portfolio.* We want to see your finished work that you’ve shipped with real command of typography, color, layout, and hierarchy.
* Real experience with complex, data-dense interfaces, including data visualization.
* Experience building or substantially shaping a design system.
* Experience taking a rough concept and making it visually exceptional
* Expert command of Figma and adjacent design tools.
* Experience using AI to expedite design processes and to enable SMEs across the organization to build designs to spec.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, including giving and receiving critique.

*Nice to Have*
--------------

* Marketing, advertising, or eCommerce domain experience.
* A background that brings craft and playfulness to utility software — game design, motion, entertainment, or a formal art/design education.
* Motion design and interaction work.

Base Salary Range
$185,000 — $210,000 USD

Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location.

In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup.

*Interview Process*
The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5-7 interviews total and requires around 5-8 hours of your time.

We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

This is a full-time remote opportunity for a product designer who wants to shape products from early problem definition through launch and iteration. You’ll work closely with product and engineering teams across web, mobile, widgets, and user-facing portals. The role combines product thinking, UX, visual design, prototyping, and design systems in a highly hands-on environment. You’ll contribute to products used by real customers every day, where thoughtful improvements can have a meaningful operational impact. The team values designers who are comfortable working independently, communicating asynchronously, and staying close to implementation. You’ll also have the opportunity to incorporate modern AI tools into your design workflow and explore faster paths from concept to working prototype.

Accountabilities
----------------

*

Own product design initiatives end to end, from defining problems and exploring solutions through validation, delivery, launch, and post-launch iteration.

*

Partner closely with product leaders, engineers, and designers to establish product direction and translate user needs into effective experiences.

*

Design across multiple surfaces, including desktop web applications, native iOS and Android experiences, embeddable widgets, and user portals.

*

Create and maintain high-quality Figma libraries, components, Auto Layout structures, variables, and design-system patterns.

*

Develop interactive prototypes and move beyond static mockups when a more realistic, testable artifact can accelerate learning and decision-making.

*

Collaborate closely with engineering throughout implementation, reviewing builds, identifying design drift, and balancing pixel fidelity with practical delivery needs.

*

Conduct user research and usability testing, incorporating customer feedback into product decisions and design improvements.

*

Communicate design thinking and decisions effectively through written specifications, feature presentations, recorded walkthroughs, Figma comments, and other asynchronous formats.

*

Manage priorities independently across multiple product areas while staying aligned with product leadership and evolving business needs.

*

Continuously refine mature product experiences while introducing new features without unnecessarily disrupting established user workflows.

------------
Requirements
------------

*

3+ years of professional product design experience, ideally within SaaS, software applications, or other product-focused environments.

*

Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, Auto Layout, variables, prototyping, and Dev Mode.

*

Ability to work across the full design spectrum, from early flow mapping and product exploration to polished, pixel-level interface design.

*

Strong product judgment with the ability to identify when a product concept or feature direction needs improvement before detailed design work begins.

*

Experience designing for data-dense desktop web applications as well as native mobile experiences.

*

Working knowledge of responsive design, accessibility, and established UX patterns for complex applications.

*

Experience conducting user research, usability testing, and translating feedback into actionable product direction.

*

Strong visual-design fundamentals, including typography, color, grids, layout, hierarchy, iconography, and illustration.

*

Strong attention to detail and the ability to recognize, articulate, and resolve visual inconsistencies.

*

Systems-oriented mindset with an appreciation for structured, documented, reusable design patterns.

*

Excellent written and asynchronous communication skills, with the ability to facilitate design discussions without relying heavily on meetings.

*

Self-directed and comfortable managing priorities without close supervision.

*

Adaptability to evolving design practices, AI-assisted workflows, prototyping tools, and modern product-development processes.

*

Comfortable working in a distributed environment with at least 4 hours of overlap with the core team.

--------
Benefits
--------

*

Full-time, fully remote position.

*

Flexible working schedule with required overlap of at least 4 hours with the core team.

*

Opportunity to work across web, native mobile, widgets, and user portals.

*

Highly hands-on role with ownership across the complete product design lifecycle.

*

Collaborative environment with close interaction between design, product, and engineering.

*

Opportunity to work with modern AI and LLM-assisted design workflows.

*

Exposure to mature, real-world software products where design decisions directly affect users' daily work.

*

Opportunity to contribute to and evolve established design systems and product experiences.

*

Distributed-team environment with a strong emphasis on asynchronous collaboration and written communication.

description:
--------
Overview
--------

As a Graphic Designer, you will help the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) Office of Minority Health (OMH) to meet its mission of providing national leadership, resources, and coordination to improve the health of racial and ethnic minority populations and American Indians and Alaska Natives and to eliminate health disparities. You will use your graphic design knowledge, skills, and abilities to produce materials that are more accessible to limited English proficiency (LEP) communities, helping HHS OMH to promote programs, initiatives and administration health priorities, empowering LEP communities to access HHS OMH materials independently, and making them more informed about important health and wellness issues. Join FWI in helping HHS OHM to communicate with LEP communities more effectively, thereby improving the health and wellness of millions of LEP Americans.

FWI is expanding rapidly and has been recognized as a 2024, 2025 and 2026 Top Workplace, offering excellent growth opportunities in a collaborative environment.

*Work Schedule and Location:*

*Remote* : This full-time remote position will work Monday through Friday, 8 am to 5 pm Eastern Time.

----------------
Responsibilities
----------------

* Support plain-language communications and accessibility outreach services across multiple platforms and formats (e.g., fact sheets, infographics, social media messages, television and radio public service announcements, etc.).
* Design infographics and other graphics for incorporation into HHS OMH materials.
* Provide graphic design support for and consultation on fact sheets, infographics, posters, brochures, and similar materials.
* Ensure all designs are aligned with HHS OMH brand guidelines and style guides.
* Recreate documents in Adobe InDesign.
* Make revisions to PDF documents according to Project Manager and HHS OHM direction promptly.

* Ability to juggle multiple graphic design and PDF layout tasks simultaneously in a deadline-driven environment.
* Must be eligible for an HHS Public Trust security clearance.

* Experience using human-centered design principles preferred but not required.
* Experience with HTML, CSS, and video editing software preferred but not required.
* Federal government, government contracting, or public health experience preferred but not required.

*FWI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets.*

Why Join Our Team

At FWI, we place the highest importance on creating an exceptional employee experience. You'll have opportunities to achieve your career aspirations through internal promotions, professional development, and other recognition and rewards programs. Join our team and take advantage of the many benefits we offer, including:

* Health Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Long-term and Short-term Disability Insurance
* Life Insurance
* 401(k) Plan
* Holiday Pay
* Paid Time Off

title: Graphic Designer and Finished Artist
description:
**********************************
Graphic Designer / Finished Artist
**********************************

*Full-time | Remote | Philippines | Australian Business Hours*

We are looking for a talented *Graphic Designer / Finished Artist* to join the creative team of an established Australian business supporting brands and retail environments.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys turning creative concepts and existing brand assets into polished, high-quality artwork across a range of retail touchpoints. You'll work across graphic design, artwork adaptation and print production, ensuring files are accurate, consistent and ready for production.

About the Role
--------------

You'll be responsible for taking approved creative assets and adapting them across different retail applications, including in-store collateral, signage, point-of-sale materials, banners, window graphics and other physical brand touchpoints.

The role has a strong focus on *finished artwork and print production* , so attention to detail and a good understanding of preparing artwork for print are essential.

You'll initially work closely with the creative team and receive support as you become familiar with the business, processes and requirements. Over time, you'll be expected to work more independently and take greater ownership of your projects, with the opportunity to grow into a more client-facing capacity.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Adapt and roll out creative artwork across multiple retail formats and touchpoints.
* Develop supplied brand assets into banners, signage, POS materials, in-store collateral and window graphics.
* Prepare accurate, high-quality, print-ready artwork.
* Ensure files are correctly set up for production, including crops, bleeds, colours and other relevant specifications.
* Work within established brand guidelines and maintain consistency across different assets.
* Review artwork carefully and identify issues before files move into production.
* Work through multiple rounds of feedback and revisions.
* Manage multiple artwork requirements while maintaining quality and attention to detail.
* Collaborate with creative and production teams to clarify requirements and deliver artwork on time.
* Contribute to campaign artwork and creative development when required.

What We're Looking For
----------------------

* Proven experience in *graphic design and/or finished artwork*.
* Experience working with print production and preparing print-ready files.
* Strong proficiency in *Adobe Creative Cloud* , particularly InDesign and other relevant Adobe design applications.
* Good understanding of artwork setup, including crops, bleeds, colour and print requirements.
* Experience adapting creative assets across multiple formats and applications.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of visual quality.
* Ability to work through feedback and revisions efficiently.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple pieces of artwork.
* Comfortable working from existing brand guidelines and creative direction.
* A proactive approach to understanding briefs and clarifying requirements when needed.
* Ability to work collaboratively while also becoming increasingly autonomous.

Nice to Have
------------

* Experience working in a *retail, agency, print, signage, display or similar environment*.
* Experience working with retail campaigns or in-store graphics.
* Experience developing branding or creative guidelines from scratch.
* Campaign creation and broader creative ideation experience.
* Experience working with production teams, suppliers or printers.
* Portfolio demonstrating strong artwork adaptation and print-production work.

What You'll Get
---------------

* Fully remote work setup
* Full-time employment
* Australian business hours
* HMO
* SIL / Christmas Shutdown
* Bonuses
* Company-provided *Apple Mac* for work

Recruitment Process
-------------------

The recruitment process will include interviews with the creative team, followed by a *practical technical assessment* using an example asset and template.

We're looking for someone who combines *creative design ability with strong execution and production skills* — someone who can take an idea or supplied asset and turn it into accurate, polished artwork that is ready to go to print.

*If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.*

title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor (Part-Time)
description:
Description
-----------

BlueTuskr is a full-service e-commerce growth agency built exclusively for e-commerce brands. We combine paid media, owned media, creative, and analytics to help our clients scale profitably. Our team is made up of specialists who are deeply invested in their craft — and in the success of the brands they serve.

This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well.

*The Opportunity*

We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands — emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative — and can explain exactly why each design choice was made.

You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow — to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency.

*This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week,* with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand.

What You'll Own
---------------

*Email & Retention Design*

* Design campaign and automated flow emails (newsletters, welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, etc.) that are on-brand and built to drive clicks and revenue
* Design mobile-first, with clear hierarchy, scannable layouts, and strong calls to action
* Prepare email-ready files and specs (image slicing, live text vs. image text, alt text, dark mode considerations) for clean builds in Klaviyo and other email platforms

*Web Creative & CRO Support*

* Design landing pages, homepage, and collection page sections, product page (PDP) modules, banners, and promotional assets for Shopify stores
* Partner with the CRO team to design test variations based on data, heatmaps, and hypotheses — not just personal taste
* Hand off dev-ready Figma files to our web developers, with desktop and mobile layouts, organized layers, and clear specs

*Social & Ad Creative*

* Design static social and paid ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and other channels
* Create ad variations and iterations to support creative testing
* Video editing for social and ad use (resizing, trimming, captions, simple motion) where needed

*Process & Quality*

* Follow each client's brand guidelines closely, and flag gaps or inconsistencies when guidelines are missing or unclear
* Apply design and e-commerce best practices (accessibility, contrast, legibility, load-friendly assets, platform specs)
* Present work with a clear rationale — why this layout, this hierarchy, this CTA — to internal teams and, when needed, clients
* Take feedback well, turn revisions around quickly, and keep work moving across multiple accounts and deadlines
* Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up concepting, copy-to-layout exploration, asset variations, and repetitive production tasks — while following client confidentiality and our AI use guidelines

Who You Are
-----------

Skills get you in the door. These are the qualities that make you right for this role:

* *An exceptional designer* with a strong eye for layout, typography, and color — your portfolio speaks for itself
* *Conversion-minded* — you think about what the customer needs to see, feel, and do next, not just what looks good
* *Detail-obsessed* — you catch the misaligned element, the off-brand color, and the typo before anyone else does
* *A clear communicator* who can explain the reasoning behind design choices and keeps the team updated without being chased
* *Excellent at managing your time* — you can juggle multiple clients and deadlines in a remote, async environment without dropping the ball
* *AI-curious and AI-capable* — you already use tools like Claude in your workflow and are excited to find new ways to work smarter
* *Adaptable* — you can shift between very different brand styles and still make each one feel right.

What Success Looks Like
-----------------------

In your first 90 days:

* You've learned the brand guidelines and design systems for your assigned client accounts
* You're consistently delivering email, web, and social designs on time with minimal revision rounds
* You've handed off at least one web project or CRO test variation to our Shopify dev team with clean, dev-ready files
* You've built AI into your workflow in a way that measurably speeds up production
* Internal teams trust your work and your reasoning, and come to you with ideas, not just requests

*Requirements*

Must-Have:

* 2–4 years of e-commerce digital design experience (email, website, social, etc.)
* A portfolio showing e-commerce work — ideally with context on goals and results
* Advanced proficiency in Figma
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
* Hands-on experience using Claude and/or other AI tools in a design workflow
* Experience designing for the web and supporting website creative (landing pages, site sections, PDPs)
* Strong understanding of conversion-focused design and e-commerce best practices
* Proven ability to follow and apply brand guidelines across multiple brands
* Strong written and spoken English for async communication with a U.S.-based team

Strong Differentiators:

* Video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar)
* Experience designing for Klaviyo or other email platforms
* Familiarity with Shopify themes and how designs get built
* Experience designing A/B test variations or working with CRO data
* Paid social ad creative experience (Meta, TikTok)
* Agency background preferred

*Benefits*

This role is fully remote.

Time Commitment and Availability

* Hours: 15 hours/week to start, with the opportunity to scale up as the role and client roster grow
* Availability: Between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. EST

*Compensation*

$20–25 USD/hour, based on experience and portfolio. This is a part-time, remote contractor role starting at 15 hours/week. Video editing experience is a strong plus and is factored into the rate.

*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Graphic Designer based in Ireland.*

Join a growing international technology environment where design plays a central role in shaping digital products and brands.
You’ll take ownership of a wide range of visual projects spanning marketing, product, social media, presentations, and digital communications.
The role combines strong hands-on graphic design expertise with opportunities to influence design systems, brand consistency, and creative direction.
You’ll collaborate closely with product, marketing, and creative teams to translate business goals into compelling visual solutions.
Your work will help strengthen established products while supporting the launch and development of new initiatives.
The environment values creativity, autonomy, open communication, and a willingness to tackle ambitious and unconventional challenges.
This is an opportunity to make a visible impact while continuing to grow your expertise within a collaborative, human-centered design team.

Accountabilities
----------------

*

Develop, manage, and deliver a broad range of graphic design projects from concept through final execution.

*

Contribute to promotional and marketing initiatives by developing creative concepts and visual assets aligned with business objectives.

*

Generate creative ideas for both product and marketing teams, translating concepts into engaging visual solutions.

*

Create, maintain, and scale design systems to ensure consistency and efficiency across projects.

*

Develop and update brand books, visual guidelines, templates, and other brand assets.

*

Design creative content for social media, presentations, infographics, and other digital channels.

*

Ensure the quality, consistency, and visual integrity of graphic materials in line with established guidelines and templates.

*

Participate in design decisions for both new and existing digital products.

*

Create vector icons and other visual elements as required across different projects.

*

Work closely with product, marketing, and creative stakeholders to understand objectives and deliver effective design solutions.

*

Analyze existing design solutions and their effectiveness, using insights to improve future creative work.

*

Optimize design processes and internal workflows to improve efficiency and scalability.

Requirements:
-------------

*

Strong professional experience in graphic design, with a portfolio demonstrating a high level of visual and creative execution.

*

Advanced proficiency in *Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, and Figma*.

*

Strong understanding of typography, including font selection and pairing, text hierarchy, readability, and visual balance.

*

Deep knowledge of composition, layout, visual hierarchy, and color theory.

*

Proven experience creating visuals for *social media, presentations, infographics, digital campaigns, and other digital materials*.

*

Experience creating raster graphics, including compositing and collage work.

*

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities effectively in a fast-paced environment.

*

Strong understanding of business context and the ability to connect design decisions with product and marketing objectives.

*

Excellent communication and analytical skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

*

Practical experience using *AI tools* as part of the creative or design workflow.

*

Strong sense of ownership and willingness to take responsibility for outcomes.

*

Curiosity and enthusiasm for solving unconventional design challenges.

*

Understanding of basic product or marketing metrics is considered a plus.

Benefits:
---------

*

*Fully remote:* Work from wherever you feel most comfortable and productive, with access to hubs in Kyiv and Warsaw.

*

*Paid time off:* 20 working days of paid vacation per year, along with public holidays and sick leave.

*

*Health insurance:* Medical coverage at leading clinics.

*

*Mental health support:* Coverage for psychological support through the Pleso platform.

*

*Benefit Cafe:* Monthly allowance that can be used toward hobbies, sports, personal interests, and other eligible activities.

*

*Professional development:* Individual learning budget for courses and other development opportunities.

*

*English learning:* Corporate English programs to support ongoing language development.

*

*Training and workshops:* Access to workshops and other learning initiatives.

*

*Online learning resources:* Access to an online library for continuous self-development.

*

*Career growth:* Structured career development opportunities, Performance Reviews, mentoring programs, and other tools to support professional growth.

*

*Team culture:* Team-building activities, workshops, corporate events, and opportunities to connect and celebrate together.

*

*Technology and innovation:* The opportunity to work with in-house capabilities for building technology solutions from the ground up.

*

*Automation:* Modern tools and automation designed to reduce repetitive work and create more time for creative and professional development.

*

*Autonomy:* A low-bureaucracy environment that encourages freedom of action, initiative, and ownership.

*

*Collaborative culture:* An open, positive, and supportive environment where ideas and feedback are encouraged.

*How Jobgether works:*
We use an *AI-powered matching process* to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
Why Apply Through Jobgether?

title: Marketing Graphic Designer
description:
Sunco.com is a leading online lighting retailer headquartered in Valencia, CA. Thanks to our amazing and talented employees, we are proud to be one of the largest online lighting retailers in the US. We deeply value our collaborative, open, and people-first culture and are invested in making Sunco a positive place where our team members thrive every day. With our new state-of-the-art distribution center in Georgia, we continue to expand our reach and enhance our ability to serve our customers with excellence and efficiency. Join us and be part of a dynamic team that is lighting the way to a brighter future.

We light up the world, literally. Customers have chosen Sunco to provide millions of LED lights and trust us for our exceptional customer service, eco-conscious product expertise, and unmatched value.

Note to applicants:
This is a full time role. We hire globally and welcome candidates from different countries and backgrounds. Regardless of location, this role requires your regular working hours to substantially overlap with 9:00 am to 5:00 pm Pacific Time (Valencia, California), Monday through Friday.

**About the role**

As a Graphic Designer on the Marketing team, you will bring the Sunco brand to life across every touchpoint. You will create digital assets for paid and organic social, display and banner ads, paid social ads, storefront, marketplace, and other marketing channels. You will help evolve and protect our visual identity through thoughtful logo work, style guide development, and consistent design systems.

You will sit on the design team, report to the Lead Designer, and collaborate closely with marketing, ecommerce, and marketplace teams. A key part of your role will be developing high performing PDP creative assets for our storefronts on Amazon and Shopify that clearly communicate product benefits and drive conversion. You will primarily work in digital but will also support print projects, including but not limited to trade show mechanicals, swag, and printed promotional material.

**What** **you'll** **do**

* Design landing page assets, and other campaign collateral with strong attention to hierarchy and UX best practices.

* Develop and maintain high quality PDP creative for Sunco storefronts on Amazon and Shopify, including product imagery, infographics, comparison charts, and benefit driven visuals.

* Work with the Lead Designer, marketplace, and ecommerce teams to ensure PDP assets are optimized for clarity, scannability, and conversion.

* Adapt designs for different marketplaces and placements while staying true to the core brand.

* Create social content for platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, and others as needed.

* Design digital assets for paid social, display ads, banner ads, retargeting, and other performance marketing campaigns.

* Help define and evolve the Sunco visual identity across channels and formats.

* Assist with the development of iconography, typography and style guide modifications for creative assets, ensuring all creative assets are aligned to brand standards and tell a consistent visual story.

* Occasionally Design and build mechanicals for swag, event graphics, signage, and other print promotional materials.

* Work closely with the Lead Designer to prioritize requests, manage timelines, and maintain a healthy workflow.

* Collaborate with copywriters, marketers, and product teams to understand project goals and translate them into effective visual solutions.

* Organize design files, maintain libraries, and follow naming and version control practices that support a growing team.

* Take and apply feedback constructively while advocating for best practices in design and user experience.

* Work closely with the Lead Designer to prioritize requests, manage timelines, and maintain a healthy workflow.

* Collaborate with copywriters, marketers, and product teams to understand project goals and translate them into effective visual solutions.

* Organize design files, maintain libraries, and follow naming and version control practices that support a growing team.

* Take and apply feedback constructively while advocating for best practices in design and user experience.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, visual communication, or a related field.

* Proven experience as a graphic designer, brand designer, or marketing designer with a portfolio that highlights both brand identity work and digital marketing assets.

* Demonstrated expertise in logo design and visual identity development, including style guide creation and system thinking.

* Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Adobe XDa plus) and familiarity with Figma (we use this for design boards and feedback).

* Experience designing for digital marketing channels, including social, email, web, and paid media, with an understanding of performance and UX considerations.

* Experience preparing print ready files and working with vendors for print materials, signage, and promotional items.

* Strong understanding of layout, typography, color theory, and visual hierarchy

* Familiarity with basic UX and UI best practices for web and mobile and an ability to design assets that support a clean, user-friendly experience.

* Experience designing PDP assets or ecommerce creative for platforms such as Amazon and Shopify is a strong plus.

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to interpret briefs, ask clarifying questions, and present your work.

* High attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast moving environment.

**Additional Requirements:**

* Availability to work between 9 AM to 5 PM Pacific Time

* Reliable internet access and a private remote workstation.

**How to apply**

* Please send or attach your resume to the application

* Kindly ensure that your resume is submitted in English, as applications with resumes in other languages will not be considered.
* Once your application is received and reviewed, we will be sending an email with questions and request for your portfolio

About the Company

Sunco Lighting is an online lighting retailer based in Valencia, CA. Thanks to our amazing and talented employees, today we are one of the largest online lighting retailers in the US. We value our collaborative, open, and people-first culture deeply, and we are invested in making Sunco a positive place where our team members thrive every day.

**Job Type:** Independent contractor, Full-time and fixed hours (requiring Pacific Time overlap), starting at $10 to $15 per hour . Depending on location and experience.

**DISCLAIMER:** This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills, efforts, requirements, or working conditions associated with the job. While this is intended to accurately reflect the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed as assigned.

Sunco Lighting Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and complies with Ban the Box laws, which prohibit us from inquiring about an applicant's criminal history until after a conditional job offer has been made. We also prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Sunco values privacy as a top priority. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of our application, please view our Sunco Privacy Notice

title: Midweight Graphic Designer - Amazon Brands
location: Remote, Hemel Hempstead, England, United Kingdom
description:
Founded in 2020, unybrands is the next-generation brand accelerator platform built to acquire, integrate, and scale digital-first consumer brands. Headquartered in Miami, with offices in New York, London, Berlin, and Shenzhen, our 240+ team brings deep expertise across e-commerce, brand management, consumer retail, operational scaling, and M&A.

Since inception, we have acquired 30+ brands across Pet Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Supplements, Baby & Juvenile, Garden & Outdoor, Sports & Fitness, and Home & Lifestyle — completing 20+ acquisitions and delivering 16 consecutive quarters of like-for-like organic growth post-integration.

Our competitive advantage lies in a fully integrated operating system purpose-built to transform digital brands into omni-channel category leaders. Powered by a proprietary technology stack built on NetSuite ERP with 200+ data integrations, our platform enables brands to thrive across marketplaces, direct-to-consumer channels, and brick-and-mortar retail.

We focus on acquiring digital-first brands within carefully selected verticals, then applying tailored value creation playbooks that drive growth through innovation, expansion, and automation. We believe the next generation of consumer brands will be built differently — and we're building the AI-enabled retail tech platform to help them consolidate and win.

*About the Role:*

We are seeking a Midweight Designer to support our growing portfolio of Amazon brands. In this role, you will create high-performing, conversion-driven visual assets across Amazon marketplaces - including product detail pages (PDPs), A+ Content, Brand Stores, and campaign visuals - as well as physical print assets like packaging and product inserts.

Working closely with our Amazon, Growth, and Brand teams, you will balance conversion-focused design with compelling visual storytelling to elevate our brand presence, drive sales, and launch new products successfully. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of design and problem-solving, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and can seamlessly manage multiple brands and competing priorities. While Amazon experience is not essential, a strong understanding of Amazon creative best practices would be a huge plus.

*Key Responsibilities:*

Amazon Creative Development:

• Design high-converting Amazon PDP image sets, infographics, A+ Content, and Brand Store assets.

• Create comparison charts, feature callouts, lifestyle imagery, and visual storytelling components.

• Support new product launches with impactful, launch-ready listing creative. Packaging & Print Design:

• Design and update physical product packaging, inserts, and instruction manuals.

• Prepare print-ready files and ensure technical specifications align with supplier standards.

Performance-Driven Design:

• Collaborate with Growth and Amazon teams to optimize assets using research, performance data and insights.

• Design variations for A/B testing and conversion rate optimization.

• Continuously iterate on existing creative to boost CTR (click-through rate) and conversion rates.

• Stay up to date with Amazon design trends, policy requirements, and technical guidelines. Brand & Portfolio Management:

• Maintain visual identity and consistency across multiple brands simultaneously.

• Translate core brand guidelines into Amazon-optimized creative executions.

• Support brand refreshes, listing overhauls, and packaging updates.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Workflow:

• Partner with Brand Managers, and Amazon Strategists to execute creative briefs.

• Work with Project Managers to track deliverables and meet project deadlines.

• Collaborate with Production teams for photoshoots, image retouching, and asset creation.

• Maintain organized design files, version control, and standard approval workflows.

*Qualifications & Experience:*

• 3–5 years of graphic design experience (eCommerce or Amazon background strongly preferred).

• A strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in Amazon PDPs, A+ Content, and packaging design.

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).

• Experience with Figma or equivalent collaborative design tools.

• Experience with packaging design and print production.

• Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, and conversion-oriented design.

• Proven ability to manage multi-brand workloads and tight deadlines with high attention to detail.

• Strong creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop effective solutions from briefs and challenges.

*Bonus Skills (Nice to Have):*

• Hands-on experience navigating Amazon Seller Central or Vendor Central.

• Experience with Amazon Brand Store design and custom layout modules.

• Motion graphics experience in Adobe Creative Cloud (After E[ects, Premiere Pro).

• Experience using AI tools for image generation and creative development.

• Photography or creative direction experience.

*What Success Looks Like*

• Stronger creative that improves Amazon conversion rates and customer engagement.

• Consistent and compelling brand presentation across Amazon listings.

• Faster creative turnaround times for launches, updates, and optimisation.

• Scalable creative systems that support multiple brands efficiently.

• Consistent, compliant packaging that meets print and production standards

Benefits:

* 25 days of annual leave + bank holidays
* fully covered dental and health insurance
* weekly lunch and office snack
* summer work from anywhere weeks
* cycle to work scheme
* and many more!

unybrands is an equal opportunity employer and considers all applicants for employment without any regard to race, skin color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, and age. Nor are applicants discriminated against based on disability or protected classes.

title: Senior Product Design Engineer
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Design Engineer based in India.*

Own core product experiences end to end, combining exceptional product design judgment with strong design engineering skills.
You’ll turn ideas and prototypes into production-ready components that are accessible, robust, and ready for engineers to use directly.
The role sits at the intersection of product design, frontend engineering, design systems, and interaction design.
You’ll build and evolve reusable primitives while continuously improving a shared open-source component library.
You’ll work with modern AI development tools to prototype quickly, explore ideas, and accelerate the path from concept to production.
The environment is remote-first and async, with a high degree of autonomy, direct feedback, and a strong emphasis on craft and thoughtful collaboration.
This is an opportunity to shape both the product experience and the design system behind a globally used scheduling platform.

Accountabilities
----------------

*

Own core product surfaces *from concept through production* , including booking flows, scheduling primitives, and team and enterprise experiences.

*

Translate product problems and hypotheses into high-quality designs, prototypes, and production-ready frontend components.

*

Build and test working prototypes using modern AI-assisted development tools such as *Claude Code, Cursor, and v0* , selecting the fastest approach for answering product and design questions.

*

Deliver components that product engineers can use directly, ensuring correct semantics, complete interaction states, accessibility, and production-quality implementation.

*

Design, engineer, and maintain custom components and primitives rather than relying on generic third-party UI libraries.

*

Continuously improve the shared component library by auditing existing primitives, identifying gaps, refining patterns, and contributing reusable components rather than creating one-off solutions.

*

Maintain consistency across *tokens, spacing, states, dark mode, motion, and interaction patterns* , ensuring every new product surface strengthens the overall design system.

*

Apply motion and animation thoughtfully, using it to clarify interactions and improve the experience without adding unnecessary complexity.

*

Own outcomes rather than simply delivering design artifacts by framing hypotheses, defining success criteria, supporting implementation, and evaluating results.

*

Maintain a high accessibility standard across all work, including *keyboard navigation, focus management, semantics, contrast, and motion preferences*.

*

Refine the details that elevate product quality, including empty states, error messaging, loading behavior, transitions, and other interaction nuances.

*

Collaborate openly with product and design leadership, sharing work early, incorporating feedback, and allowing technical and product constraints to inform design decisions.

*

Document design thinking and decisions through written documentation, prototypes, and recorded walkthroughs to support effective asynchronous collaboration.

Requirements:
-------------

*

Proven experience as a *product designer who has evolved substantially into design engineering* , with ownership of complex and ambiguous product areas from problem definition through launch and iteration.

*

Exceptional product design craft combined with strong frontend engineering skills in *HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and React*.

*

Demonstrated ability to independently turn product and design concepts into polished, working implementations without relying on another engineer to make ideas production-ready.

*

Strong experience designing and engineering *custom UI components and primitives* , rather than primarily consuming third-party component libraries.

*

Deep expertise in *headless primitive composition* , with experience using Base UI, Radix, or similar technologies; direct experience with open-source component systems is a strong advantage.

*

Strong understanding of *motion design principles* , including timing, easing, choreography, and the judgment to determine when animation adds value.

*

Daily experience using *AI-assisted development tools* such as Claude Code, Cursor, v0, or comparable solutions.

*

Deep familiarity with web standards and browser-native platform primitives, with the ability to understand what the browser already provides before introducing additional libraries.

*

Proven experience building and maintaining *design systems* , including understanding the distinction between reusable primitives, components, and product-specific patterns.

*

Strong accessibility knowledge covering *WCAG, ARIA, assistive technologies, keyboard interaction, focus management, and accessible design patterns*.

*

Ability to understand the technical architecture behind product experiences, including *APIs, data models, application state, and technical constraints*.

*

Strong written communication skills, with an emphasis on clarity and effective asynchronous documentation.

*

Collaborative and receptive approach to feedback, with a willingness to share unfinished work, challenge ideas constructively, and adapt designs based on input.

*

High-trust, high-autonomy mindset with the ability to thrive in a *remote and asynchronous environment* without constant supervision.

*

*Nice to have:* Open-source contributions or publicly available side projects demonstrating your design and engineering work.

*

*Nice to have:* Experience with scheduling, calendaring, time zones, or recurrence rules.

*

*Nice to have:* Familiarity with locale- and time-aware web APIs such as Intl.DateTimeFormat.

Benefits:
---------

*

*Competitive compensation:* $100,000–$150,000 annual salary, with the same salary range regardless of where you live.

*

*Equity:* Equity included as part of the compensation package.

*

*Fully remote:* Work from anywhere in the world.

*

*Async-first flexibility:* Work according to your own schedule and flow without unnecessary meetings or daily standups.

*

*High autonomy:* No micromanagement, with a strong culture of trust and ownership.

*

*Work-life flexibility:* Take time away for personal and family needs without requiring approval for every interruption.

*

*Paid time off:* 30 paid OOO days per year, regardless of where you are located.

*

*Team retreats:* Annual team retreats in different locations around the world.

*

*People-first culture:* Work in a stable, family-friendly environment focused on trust, kindness, and sustainable high performance.

*

*AI-enabled workflow:* Use modern AI development tools as part of the everyday product and engineering process.

*High-impact work:* Shape core product experiences and reusable design infrastructure used by a globally distributed user base.

*

*Design and engineering ownership:* Have meaningful influence over both the product experience and the underlying component system.

title: Sr. Product Designer
description:
*About us
* HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

*Our People
* With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

*Our Impact
* Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

*About the Role*

We are seeking a Senior Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product judgment and strong execution. You have spent 5+ years designing complex digital products and are ready to own meaningful work from early ambiguity through shipped outcomes.

As a senior individual contributor, you will partner closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners and other designers on cross-functional teams that own and improve key product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals and technical constraints to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate exceptional visual and interaction design judgment, practical systems thinking and the ability to carry work from discovery through delivery. You should care deeply about the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent.

Experience designing B2B SaaS, platform, CRM, workflow-heavy or SMB software experiences is highly valuable. Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is expected. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

----------------
*What You'll Do*
----------------

*

Own meaningful product areas from discovery through delivery, translating customer needs, business goals and technical constraints into clear experience direction

*

Partner with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners and designers to define, test and ship polished product experiences at scale

*

Use qualitative and quantitative insight to make design decisions and improve outcomes

*

Create wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, interaction specifications and production-ready documentation

*

Design clear workflows, edge cases and failure states that help customers complete complex tasks with confidence

*

Strengthen design-system adoption and help teams use shared patterns across surfaces, devices and locales

*

Lead through ambiguity by iterating quickly, using feedback well and raising quality through critique, pairing and clear rationale

*

Support junior designers and partner teams with practical design guidance

*

Collaborate effectively across US and India time zones in a 100% remote environment

-------------------------
*What We Are Looking For*

title: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning Platform
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll build and scale the machine learning platform that powers risk decisioning across Airwallex, helping teams develop, deploy, monitor, and improve models that protect every dollar moving through our platform.

You’ll design reliable data and model infrastructure, productionise machine learning workflows, and improve the speed and quality of experimentation and decisioning across the Risk Platform.

You’ll partner closely with machine learning engineers, data scientists, product managers, and risk specialists to turn complex fraud and risk problems into dependable systems.

You’ll be based in Singapore and work from the office five days a week.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

ESSENTIALS

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years focused on model training infrastructure, model serving systems, or MLOps platforms.

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Hands-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) and model training execution engines.

- Strong proficiency in core programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.

- Experience with distributed orchestration and workflow management tools (e.g., Kubernetes, Ray, Kubeflow Pipelines, Airflow).

- Solid understanding of GPUs, including GPU architecture, hardware acceleration, and GPU-based training or inference optimization.

PREFERRED

- Experience with model acceleration frameworks and Large Language Models (LLMs).

- Proficiency in performance profiling and bottleneck identification using tools like NVIDIA Nsight Systems for training and inference optimization.

- Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP) and building large-scale, low-latency production machine learning infrastructure.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

- You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

- You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

- You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

- You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office five days a week.

LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

Risk Platform builds the decisioning infrastructure that sits between Airwallex and every dollar that moves through it, protecting 150,000+ businesses moving over US$260 billion a year across 200+ countries and 90+ currencies, and deciding, often in milliseconds, whether a new signup is real, a payment is safe, or a login is who they claim to be. The hard part is that fraud evolves fast, and every decision carries a two-sided cost: miss an attack and money is lost, over-block and a legitimate business can't get paid. We build this with streaming pipelines processing billions of events a day, graph databases exposing coordinated fraud rings, ML models scoring every transaction, and LLM agents that triage alerts. You don't need a fintech background, just an appetite for adversarial systems problems where the scoreboard is measured in dollars. If you want to help scale one of the world's fastest-growing financial platforms safely, this is the team.

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Reliability
description:
WHO WE ARE

Atlan is building the context layer for enterprise AI. Enterprises are pouring money into AI and most of it dies in production because the AI does not understand the business context around the data. That is the problem Atlan solves.

Gartner has named context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and calls context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents, naming Atlan one of three vendors already building it. We are also the only vendor named a Leader across all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the foundation the context layer runs on.

Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on.

THE TEAM

You'll join the Reliability team, which runs a multi-agent AI SRE platform that is already live in production. Today, agents investigate incidents, remediate them, and resolve networking tickets across every tenant we run. A small core team built it and shipped it fast. The scope has now outgrown them.

Be clear on what this role is not. It is not an incident-command SRE seat. Our view is simple: if a human is fixing production by hand, the system has failed. It is also not a greenfield charter. You'll join a mature, opinionated codebase with documented architecture decisions and eval-gated pull requests, and you'll make it better.

Why now: the platform works, and the hardest problems are wide open. Making agent investigations accurate enough that engineers trust them without re-checking is a genuine frontier problem in agentic reliability. Other Atlan teams are lining up to put their own reliability metrics on the platform. What you build in the next year decides how far autonomous operations can go at Atlan.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Make investigation agents right, not just fast. Push root-cause accuracy toward the point where engineers trust the answer without re-checking it. Treat every wrong diagnosis as a class of failure to remove, not a one-off bug to patch.

- Grow auto-remediation coverage, safely. Take remediation from a handful of playbooks to dozens. Each one earns autonomy in stages: dry run before execute, human-approved before autonomous.

- Own the evals that decide when an agent can be trusted. Build and run fault-injection benchmarks and eval harnesses. Set pass marks before the run, report results with honest denominators, and validate the harness itself, not just the agent.

- Design the gates that let an agent write to production. Fail-closed checks, kill switches, approval flows and blast-radius limits. You start from the question "what happens when the agent is wrong?"

- Build new agents where the toil says they belong. Every agent maps to a category of toil it removes, and each one you ship should make the next one cheaper to build.

- Build the platform for other teams. Clean interfaces, guardrails and safe defaults, so teams beyond reliability can trust the platform on their own production. Your hiring manager owns cross-team alignment. You earn adoption through what you build.

- Ship the unglamorous fix when it matters. When something is on fire, you stop the bleeding first, then come back and remove the class.

WHAT MAKES YOU A MATCH

- You've lived operational toil. You've carried a pager, owned incidents end to end, or worked a support or escalation queue long enough to know which pain is worth removing and why. The toil was yours, not something you read about.

- You remove classes, not tasks. You can point to a recurring operational problem you made disappear, explain the category behind it, and tell us why you picked that one. Not a faster runbook. Gone.

- You start from the problem and measure by adoption. When you describe something you built, you reach on your own for who used it and what changed, with real numbers and real denominators. You won't call one success a rate. You can also name something you built that didn't get adopted, and what you learned.

- AI has changed how you work, structurally. You've rebuilt a core part of your own work end to end with AI, so it's different, not just faster. You've shipped an AI-native workflow that other people depend on. If you've architected agents that take action on their own, you describe the guardrails before the capability.

- You have failure-mode humility. You know what an agent being wrong on production costs, because you've been on the other end of it. You think in false-positive rates, rollback paths and blast radius.

- You build for someone else's production. Clean interfaces, documented failure modes, safe defaults. Experience getting other teams to adopt a platform you built helps, but the instinct matters more than the track record.

- You raise the bar in an existing codebase. You can join a high-rigor system, contribute at its standard quickly, and improve it rather than rewrite it.

- You write code when code is the right tool. We run deterministic code for routing, filtering and safety before any generative step. You think in systems and use agents as leverage, not as a replacement for judgment.

- Reliability work genuinely energises you. You see operational efficiency as mission-critical for a company whose product is trust in data and AI, not as a stepping stone to something else.

This probably isn't for you if you want to design the perfect autonomous platform before shipping anything, your instinct is to make toil faster rather than make it disappear, or you're fluent in agents but have never owned the consequences of one being wrong.

Working hours: We work best with overlap between roughly 11am and 8pm IST.

WHY ATLAN?

Joining Atlan means being part of a global movement to help data teams do their life’s best work. Here’s what you can expect:

- Competitive Compensation:  We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.

- AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.

- Health & Wellness: From Day‑1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in.

- Flexible Time Off & Leave Policies: We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact.

- Accelerated Growth & Learning: Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery.

- Global, Remote-First, High-Trust:  Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15+ countries, in a trust-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership over how you work.

More About Us

Atlan is building the shared context layer that enterprises need so AI can operate on trusted, governed context. The conversation has moved from data leaders asking:  “Can we trust the data in our stack?” to businesses asking: “Can we trust AI inside the business?”

We are the missing infrastructure for businesses becoming AI-forward - the connective tissue between their data stack, operational systems, and AI agents.

title: Flexible Brand Ambassador, London Stations (Commission Based)
description:
💙 ABOUT BOUNCE...

Bounce is building cloud storage for the physical world, starting with the largest global luggage storage network in existence. Bounce’s marketplace connects travelers with 30,000+ small business locations worldwide for hyper-local short term baggage storage. With more locations globally than Burger King, and more locations in New York City than Starbucks, Bounce has served 3M+ users and stored 10M+ bags, and paid over $10M to small business partners.

To achieve this, Bounce is a fast-paced and scrappy team. We believe that experimentation fuels innovation, so we move quickly, testing new ideas and adapting in real time. If you’re ready to make an impact in a high-energy, close-knit, and collaborative environment - Bounce is the place where you can move fast, think big, and shape the future of travel. Join us as we make the world a lighter, more accessible place! Bounce has been named the Inc5000’s fastest-growing travel company in the USA in 2024 and is proudly backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, and Sapphire. (Learn more about Bounce's Series B HERE https://techcrunch.com/2024/11/12/bounce-grabs-19m-to-expand-its-traveller-convenience-network/ and also learn about our Japan Expansion HERE https://techcrunch.com/2024/11/12/bounce-grabs-19m-to-expand-its-traveller-convenience-network/)

ABOUT THE ROLE...

Travellers drag their bags around London all day because they don't know there's another option. Bounce is looking for four Scouts/ Brand Ambassadors, two at King's Cross and two at Victoria, to tell them that option exists.

Bounce is the world's largest luggage storage network, with hundreds of locations in London and over 1.1 million bags stored in the city alone. Travellers book on their phone, drop their bags at a local shop or hotel, and get on with their day.

This is a self-employed, commission-only role. You earn 40% of the storage value of every booking that comes through your code, and you keep it whether or not the customer uses the discount. For example:

What an hour could look like (illustrative, not guaranteed):

- You speak to around 30 travellers

- 5 of them book (about 1 in 6)

- The average booking is three bags for the day, which earns you £5.40

- 5 bookings × £5.40 = £27 for the hour

WHERE YOU COME IN…

- Positioned around King's Cross or Victoria station and talk to travellers who are dragging suitcases around London

- Wear Bounce branded gear with your own QR code on it: travellers scan it, book a spot and get 10% off

- Find people with bags, help them get rid of them for the day, and get paid for it

- Decide when you go out and for how long, with no fixed schedule or minimum commitment

- Get set up with your own referral code, QR code, payout account and Bounce branded kit

- Start with a briefing on what to say, which spots work, and what to steer clear of

- Get commission paid out through our affiliate system, straight to your bank

YOUR PROFILE…

- You're happy starting conversations with strangers all day

- You're warm and quick on your feet, and travellers trust you inside five seconds

- Confident English. A second language is a real advantage, especially Spanish, Italian, French, Arabic or Mandarin

- Right to work in the UK, registered as self-employed or happy to register

- Self-motivated. Nobody is standing over you, so what you earn is down to what you put in

- Bonus experience, not a requirement: street sales, promotion, fundraising or tour guiding experience

- Good to know: this is a self-employed, commission-only arrangement, not employment.

title: Hardware Engineer (Electrical)
description:
Navi captures everything a pilot sees and hears. The Wave is how we do it — the hardware that lives in the cockpit, captures flight data, and streams it to the cloud in real time. You're building the next generation of that device.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a founding hardware role. You own the entire physical product — from bare-metal architecture through PCB design, ruggedized enclosure, embedded firmware, environmental certification, fleet deployment, and cloud integration. This is Version 2 of the Wave, and you are the definitive technical voice for every decision that shapes it.

The device has to survive cockpit environments — heat, vibration, RF noise — while continuously streaming high-bandwidth audio and telemetry over wireless networks without dropping a frame. It has to be deployable across hundreds of aircraft and manageable as a fleet. It has to meet certification standards for operating in aircraft. And it has to be built fast, because Navi is already live at flight schools and the U.S. Air Force and demand is accelerating.

If you thrive in high-autonomy environments and love building mission-critical edge devices that work in the real world — not on a bench — this is your role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead the end-to-end technical design of Navi's next-generation edge compute node — architecture, component selection, PCB layout, and mechanical enclosure

- Build hardware that is ruggedized for cockpit environments — thermal, vibrational, and environmental stress — and optimized for continuous wireless data transmission

- Architect real-time data pipelines for processing and streaming high-fidelity audio and complex telemetry from the edge to the cloud with minimal latency

- Own the hardware validation lifecycle — environmental testing, quality assurance, and securing regulatory and industry-specific certifications for hardware operating in aircraft

- Develop and oversee embedded firmware and edge processing logic — real-time operating systems, on-device compute, and fleet-wide OTA update infrastructure

- Guide the architecture of live cloud-based telemetry dashboards to ensure seamless data ingestion and real-time visibility from deployed devices

- Collaborate with software and ML engineers to ensure the hardware captures exactly what the intelligence layer needs to generate automated debriefs

ABOUT YOU

- 7+ years of experience in systems engineering, embedded edge compute, or connected hardware development — with a track record of bringing a complex device to market, not just prototyping one

- Deep understanding of electronics design — PCB schematics, microcontrollers, wireless communication modules (cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth)

- Experience collaborating with industrial or mechanical designers to build ruggedized enclosures that survive challenging thermal, vibrational, and environmental conditions

- Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++ or Python for edge applications, with experience running RTOS or embedded Linux

- Familiarity with edge-to-cloud architecture, device fleet management, and building scalable live data infrastructure

- Hands-on experience navigating rigorous hardware certification processes and environmental testing standards

- You own projects end to end in ambiguous, fast-moving environments — and you ship

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with edge processing and lossless streaming of high-bandwidth data — real-time audio, complex signal processing, or continuous telemetry

- Background building hardware for aviation, defense, or other safety-critical regulated industries

- Familiarity with avionics data formats, cockpit audio systems, or aircraft electrical environments

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Every piece of intelligence Navi generates starts with the Wave. The AI is only as good as the data the hardware captures — and in a cockpit, there are no second chances. A dropped audio frame is a missed instructor callout. A connectivity gap is a blind spot in the debrief. You're building the device that makes the entire platform possible, and it has to work perfectly every single flight.

WHAT YOU'LL GET

- Flight training — earn your pilot's license and build with true domain expertise

- Impact you can see — the device you build will be in cockpits at flight schools, airlines, and the U.S. Air Force

- A role that scales into hardware leadership as we grow

HOW WE WORK

- Find a way. We don't wait for permission or perfect information. Ideas come from anywhere regardless of title. Figure it out, ship it, iterate.

- Creativity over control. First principles over process. We'd rather have a creative solution that's 80% right today than a perfect one next quarter.

- Update fast. Come in with a hypothesis, throw it away when the data says otherwise. Ego has no place here.

- Intensity with focus. We work hard because the mission demands it. Clarity on what matters is how we make that sustainable.

AS A SENIOR DEAL DESK MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

- Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to Sales VPs and executive leadership on the structure, negotiation, and approval of complex, high-value transactions across Snowflake's Acquisitions and Enterprise accounts.

- Own and drive deal strategy for a portfolio of strategic opportunities, setting the analytical and commercial framing that enables Sales leadership to make confident decisions at speed.
