- Define, design, and continuously improve deal policies, approval frameworks, and escalation paths, serving as a primary voice on what good deal governance looks like at Snowflake.

- Synthesize deal concession data and commercial trends into structured insights that directly inform Finance and Sales leadership decisions.

- Mentor and develop junior Deal Desk team members, raising the overall capability of the team through coaching on deal structuring, commercial judgment, and stakeholder communication.

- Partner with Sales Enablement and Operations to drive adoption of improved deal processes across the field, influencing behavior at scale.

- Champion AI-assisted deal workflows and automation tooling to accelerate review cycles and free the team to focus on strategic judgment over process administration.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR DEAL DESK MANAGER WILL HAVE:

- 8+ years of experience in deal desk, commercial finance, contracts, or sales operations, with a demonstrated track record of owning complex deal cycles end-to-end.

- Ability to read, understand, and draft contractual business terms and conditions for complex, multi-year transactions.

- Deep understanding of revenue recognition principles and US GAAP, and their practical application in SaaS and consumption-based commercial models.

- Proven ability to influence executive-level stakeholders, with strong written and verbal communication skills that translate complexity into clarity across all levels of the organization.

- Experience defining or significantly evolving deal policies and approval frameworks within a high-growth organization.

- Ability to work across functional boundaries, building credibility and alignment with Legal, Finance, Sales, and Operations without formal authority.

- Strong analytical mindset with the ability to surface patterns in deal data and translate them into actionable guidance for leadership.

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

- Previous experience with complex contract negotiations and long enterprise sales cycles.

- Exposure to AI-assisted contract review or deal intelligence tooling.

- Background working cross-functionally on GTM transformation or commercial strategy initiatives.

- Experience scaling deal desk operations in a hypergrowth environment.

WHY JOIN OUR DEAL DESK TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Our Deal Desk team sits at the forefront of Snowflake's growth, working in close partnership with the Sales organization on the most complex and strategic transactions the company pursues. You'll operate at the center of every major deal, coordinating across Sales, Legal, Finance, and Operations to move opportunities from concept to close. In this role, you'll build relationships at every level of the company and have a direct line of sight to the decisions that drive Snowflake's revenue.

title: Junior Graphic Designer
description:
*At Murj, we do what we love and love what we do!*

Murj was founded in 2014 to solve a problem witnessed first-hand. Founder and CEO, Todd, worked with cardiology practices as an implantable cardiac device sales representative for Medtronic. He watched clinicians struggle to manage these sophisticated devices using outdated and inadequate tools. Having previously worked in product management at Apple, Todd knew that brilliant design can profoundly impact the user experience -- so why not design a better way to care for patients with implantable devices?

In Murj, Todd created an enterprise SaaS cardiac device management software solutions company that reimagines and transforms patient care through thoughtful design and a passion for quality and a commitment to customer satisfaction. Today, Murj continues this transformative innovation with intuitive, elegant, and imaginative technology solutions that improve the lives of cardiac care professionals and their patients.

*What Murj offers.*

Murj is for people seeking a fast-paced, ever-changing environment surrounded by a supportive team that works hard and strives for innovation and professionalism, with a steady diet of humility and camaraderie.

Every employee is treated like family, with love, respect, and responsibility. The individual and collective success of every employee is at the forefront of what we do and believe.

And in joining Murj, you are joining a community that believes in evolution and promotion from within; there is a high degree of opportunity for progression, creativity, and ownership.

From your first day at Murj, you are eligible for full medical, dental, and vision insurance along with an open vacation policy, more than 10 annual company holidays, and competitive compensation and equity participation, and a 401(k) after 3 months of service.

*How We Work at Murj*

Murj is the right place for people who excel in fast-paced, dynamic environments. Murj embodies a high-performance culture where every team member is expected to exceed expectations and take ownership beyond their role to drive our collective success.

Employees should be comfortable working independently and taking initiative to identify and address needs. This proactive approach is essential to thriving at Murj.

We believe in working hard together, with a shared sense of purpose and drive. We’re not afraid to ask tough questions, and we support each other in reaching for bold new ideas.

*Let us leave you with this.*

If this role sounds intriguing - we encourage you to apply. And we encourage applicants to embrace new challenges, as the right fit at Murj is often more about the person and the challenges they seek, not just what they have accomplished in the past.

*About The Role.*

Murj is seeking a resourceful and highly organized Junior Graphic Designer to help strengthen how our brand is created, maintained, and used across the organization. This role is about more than producing one-off designs. You will help us build a thoughtful, reusable system of brand assets, templates, and resources that enables teams to work efficiently while presenting Murj consistently.

Working closely with the Head of Graphic Design and Director of Marketing, you will support a wide range of creative needs, including presentations, marketing collateral, social graphics, video, and print materials. You will primarily work within Murj’s existing visual identity while contributing ideas that help the brand and its supporting resources evolve.

This role is well suited to someone who combines strong visual fundamentals with a systems-oriented mindset—someone who enjoys making great work, organizing it well, and finding solutions when the path is not already defined.

*What You’ll Do.*

* *Build and Manage Our Brand Asset Library:* Organize, maintain, and improve Murj’s shared library of graphics, templates, presentations, video elements, and other reusable creative resources. Establish practical systems for naming, versioning, finding, and using assets.
* *Steward Brand Guidelines and Templates:* Help maintain and expand the Murj brand guide, translating brand standards into useful templates and tools for teams across the organization. Support colleagues in using those resources effectively and consistently.
* *Create High-Quality Marketing Materials:* Design and refine presentations, campaign graphics, sales and marketing collateral, graphic elements, and other materials based on the needs of the design and marketing teams.
* *Support Social and Digital Content:* Create engaging, on-brand graphics for social media and digital campaigns, with an emphasis on developing reusable systems rather than rebuilding common assets each time.
* *Edit and Create Video Content:* Help clean up, edit, assemble, and prepare video content for marketing, social, sales, and internal use. Create titles, graphic elements, and simple motion treatments as appropriate.
* *Prepare and Refine Print Materials:* Produce polished, print-ready materials and ensure files meet visual, technical, and production requirements.
* *Explore Smarter Creative Workflows:* Help Murj evaluate and responsibly incorporate AI-enabled creative tools into its brand and asset workflows. Look for practical ways to improve efficiency while maintaining quality, accuracy, and brand consistency.
* *Support Website and Special Projects:* Contribute visual assets and design support for Murj’s upcoming website work and other cross-functional initiatives. This role is not primarily focused on product UI, but familiarity with web design or Figma is valuable.

*What Makes You a Great Fit.*

* *A Systems Mindset:* You enjoy organization, clear naming conventions, and turning one-off designs into scalable, reusable templates.
* *Resourcefulness:* Faced with an unfamiliar tool or assignment, you take the initiative to research, experiment, and figure it out.
* *Balanced Stewardship:* You collaborate smoothly with non-design stakeholders, incorporating their input while protecting brand consistency.
* *Versatility:* You easily switch contexts—moving between presentation decks, video edits, social graphics, and asset management without missing a detail.
* *Modern Workflow Curiosity:* You are excited to test new tools, automation, and AI features to work smarter and cut down on repetitive tasks.

title: Data Scientist
description:
-----------------------

-----------------------

We are seeking a Data Scientist to build production-ready applications. Our Data Science team develops practical machine learning applications to enable innovative and customer-facing product features.

-----------------------
In this role, you will:
-----------------------

* Own well-scoped projects from data exploration and feature engineering through modelling to deployment, with guidance from senior colleagues on larger or more ambiguous problems.

* Collaborate with data scientists, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver customer value.

-------------------------------------------------------

* Classification and regression models: (e.g., CatBoost, XGBoost, LightGBM)
* Time Series Analysis: (e.g., ARIMA, SARIMA, Prophet)
* Unsupervised Models: (e.g., clustering, anomaly detection such as Isolation Forest)

* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure (e.g., Docker/containers, CI/CD, GitHub Actions) and the ability to ship and maintain your own code.

title: Senior Software Developer
description:
The Senior Software Developer provides technical leadership within the development team, owning architecture and design decisions for their area, setting and upholding coding standards, and acting as the escalation point for complex technical problems. The role mentors junior and mid-level developers, leads code reviews, and represents the development team in solution design discussions with the Solutions Architect and Technical Business Analyst, while continuing to deliver high-quality, well-tested code and contributing to cross-team technical decisions.

*Owning Architecture and Design for Their Area* :

· Owns technical design and architectural decisions for a defined product area or system component.

· Ensures designs are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with broader system architecture and non-functional requirements.

· Documents key design decisions and trade-offs so they are understood by the wider team.

· Balances pragmatic delivery timelines against long-term technical health of the system.

*Setting and Upholding Coding Standards*

· Defines, documents, and evolves coding standards and best practices for the team.

· Leads code reviews, ensuring both technical correctness and adherence to agreed standards.

· Identifies recurring quality issues across the team and drives corrective action.

· Champions clean-code, testing, and documentation practices by example.

*Mentoring and Developing Junior and Mid-Level Developers*

· Actively mentors junior and mid-level developers through pairing, structured feedback, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

· Supports the ramp-up and skills growth of newer team members alongside team leads.

· Delegates appropriately-scoped work to grow others' capability rather than retaining all complex work.

· Creates or contributes to internal learning materials, guides, or onboarding documentation.

*Acting as Escalation Point for Complex Technical Problems*

· Serves as the go-to resource for complex technical issues, production incidents, and difficult defects within their area.

· Leads or supports root-cause analysis on significant incidents and ensures preventive action is taken.

· Balances hands-on problem-solving with enabling others to solve similar problems independently in future.

· Communicates technical risk and impact clearly to the team lead and relevant stakeholders.

*Contributing to Cross-Team Technical Decisions*

· Represents the development team in solution design discussions with the Solutions Architect and Technical Business Analyst.

· Provides technical input into cross-team initiatives, integration points, and shared platform decisions.

· Surfaces dependencies and risks that affect other teams or system components early.

· Advocates for practical, maintainable solutions in cross-functional design conversations.

*Delivering Working Software to Scope and Specification*

· Independently delivers complex features and technical work in accordance with approved specifications and acceptance criteria.

· Ensures own code meets the agreed Definition of Ready and Definition of Done.

· Leads by example in translating ambiguous requirements into clear, well-scoped technical work with the Product Owner/Business Analyst.

*Driving Estimation, Planning, and Sprint Delivery*

· Leads or strongly contributes to estimation sessions, providing technical judgement on complexity and risk for the team.

· Helps the team commit to realistic, well-understood sprint goals.

· Identifies and communicates delivery risks early, including those arising from technical debt or dependencies.

title: Junior Compliance Analyst
description:
As our Junior Compliance Analyst, you will act as the crucial link between our day-to-day business activities and regulatory governance. Working closely with the Head of Compliance & Regulatory, you will translate platform architectures, technical controls, and operational processes into structured, audit-ready compliance evidence

. Your daily responsibilities will centre on:

* *Audit Readiness & Evidence Management* : Collecting and organising technical control evidence across core security and regulatory frameworks, including ISO 27001, HIPAA, and PCI DSS.

* *Customer RFIs & Security Questionnaires:* Assisting with the completion and timely submission of customer security questionnaires, vendor assessments, and technical Request for Information (RFI) documents.
* *Technical Incident Support:* Supporting the compliance team during technical security incidents by capturing technical details and feed them into data breach assessment workflows and regulatory reporting timelines.
* *Compliance & Risk Tracking:* Maintaining governance records, administrative filings, risk registers, and standard operating procedures, whilst supporting the rollout of internal security training

*Requirements*

* *Strong Communicator & Translator* : Ability to communicate effectively with technical software engineers and translate complex technical security concepts into clear, formal compliance documentation.
* *Meticulous Attention to Detail:* Exceptional organisation, documentation, and record-keeping skills with an analytical mindset.
* *Collaborative Partner:* Proven ability to build positive working relationships across internal business, technical, and compliance teams.
* *Curious & Eager to Learn:* A strong desire to continuously learn and develop hands-on exposure across information security, data protection, and cloud governance frameworks.

Essential Requirements
----------------------

* *Educational Background or Equivalent:* A formal qualification (such as a degree, diploma, or certification) in Data Protection, Cybersecurity, Law/GRC, or demonstrable equivalent practical experience in a similar role.
* *Security Fundamentals:* A foundational, structured understanding of IT systems, information security principles, and cloud architectures

* *Evidence Collection Experience:* Direct experience or a clear understanding of how to collect, verify, and organise technical compliance evidence (such as system logs or configurations) within organised repositories (such as Confluence or SharePoint).

*Our Recruitment Process*

Thank you for your interest in joining the Natterbox team. We believe in transparency, structured feedback, and human-centred communication. Below is a clear outline of what you can expect during your candidate journey with us.

Our Communication Commitment
----------------------------

We respect the time and effort it takes to submit an application. All applicants will receive a response from us.

*Please note:* Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual, personalised feedback at the initial CV review stage.

Stage 1: Initial CV Review
--------------------------

Our People Team carefully reviews every CV against the core competencies and technical requirements of the role.

Stage 2: People Team Interview (30 Minutes)
-------------------------------------------

If your application matches our criteria, you will be invited to a 30-minute introductory call with a member of our People Team.

* What to expect: This is a two-way conversation to review your CV, discuss your background, and talk through how your skills and experience align with the role.

Stage 3: Department Manager
---------------------------

Candidates progressing to the next round will have a focused call with the Department Head.

* What to expect: A deeper discussion into the practical, day-to-day elements of the role, your technical diagnostics approach, and how you tackle customer support challenges.

Stage 4: Competency Stage Interview
-----------------------------------

What to expect: We will give you the details prior to your interview.

Stage 5: Final Executive Review
-------------------------------

The final stage is a call with a member of our Executive Team.

* What to expect: A high-level conversation focused on long-term career growth, alignment with Natterbox values, and our overall company vision.

🤖 Important Note on the Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)
-----------------------------------------------------------

We encourage our candidates to embrace modern tools and work smart.

* What is acceptable: It is completely fine to use generative AI (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or spelling/grammar assistants) to help refine, format, or polish your CV structure and application answers.
* What is not acceptable: We strictly ask that you do not use AI to generate or write answers on your behalf.

We value authenticity, genuine communication, and real problem-solving. Our multi-stage interview process is designed to deeply assess your individual skills and unique technical approach. Relying on AI to answer on your behalf during the application stages creates a disconnect during live conversations, and ultimately prevents us from getting to know the real you. Please ensure all submitted answers reflect your own words and honest experience.

*Benefits*

We offer a range of benefits to all our employees.

* *Competitive base salary - £28,00-£32,000 - depending on experience*
* 25 days holiday increasing to 30 days after 2 years (plus bank holidays).
* Access to Perkbox - Hundreds of handpicked retail discounts, wellness perks, and monthly freebies to support your lifestyle.
* Auto enrol pension
* Private Health care - after probation

*Please note: Candidates are required to have the permanent Right to Work in the UK. We are unable to accept applications from candidates who do not possess this, and we cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role.*

In this role, you will review food orders, monitor spending, coordinate with suppliers and work closely with facility dietary managers. Your focus will be to ensure facilities receive the supplies they need on time, in suitable quantities and within budget.

This opportunity would suit someone with purchasing or procurement experience in food service, catering, hospitality or healthcare who enjoys working with numbers, solving problems and building strong working relationships.

* The ability to investigate discrepancies and make practical recommendations.

*Key Skills*

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong critical thinking and problem-solving ability.
* Logical judgment and attention to detail.
* Ability to think “outside the box” and apply concepts across scenarios.
* Fast learner with quick mental processing.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented.

title: UI/UX Designer, Learning Team
description:
*Location preferred:* APAC, Brazil, or US

About ELSA
----------

ELSA is a leading innovator in English communication assessment technology, dedicated to transforming how people improve their English skills. Our flagship product, ELSA Speak, acts as a personal mobile coach, helping users enhance their communication abilities by providing real-time feedback on what they say (grammar and vocabulary) and how they say it (pronunciation and intonation). By leveraging advanced signal processing and generative AI, ELSA Speak identifies user errors and delivers precise, consistent and actionable guidance for improvement.

At ELSA, our vision is to be the global leader in teaching real-time, conversational English, with the aim of helping over 1.5 billion language learners worldwide. We are here to celebrate and empower every individual on the global stage to build confidence, be understood, and help share their story. Come join our very talented team of people working to make a difference using the power of AI, with our proprietary speech recognition technology!

About the Role
--------------

We are seeking a *UI/UX Designer* to join the Learn Team within ELSAs AI Department a cross-functional team shaping the future of learning experiences across ELSA product ecosystem.

Youll design intuitive, motivating, and data-informed learning interfaces, working closely with Learning Experience Designers, AI engineers, and Product Managers. The ideal candidate combines strong UX design skills with an understanding of learning design and pedagogy, creating user journeys that are not only beautiful but also educationally effective.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

1. Learning-Focused UX & Product Design
---------------------------------------

* Design and prototype learner journeys and interfaces that make complex language learning goals feel simple, rewarding, and intuitive.
* Apply learning experience principles to enhance engagement, flow, and comprehension.
* Conduct user research, usability testing, and data analysis to inform design decisions and improve learning outcomes.

2. Collaboration Across AI, Product, and Learning
-------------------------------------------------

* Work closely with Learning Experience Designers to translate pedagogical goals into user-centered product features.
* Partner with AI and Product teams to design experiences that integrate real-time feedback, personalization, and adaptive learning.
* Create design systems and guidelines to ensure consistent, high-quality learner experiences across platforms.

3. Data-Driven Design & Iteration
---------------------------------

* Use quantitative and qualitative data (engagement metrics, completion rates, UX tests) to measure and improve design effectiveness.
* Collaborate with the analytics and AI teams to visualize learner progress and feedback in meaningful ways.
* Iterate rapidly using tools like Figma, Figjam, Looker or Amplitude to validate design hypotheses.

Qualifications
--------------

*Required*

* *Bachelors degree in UI/UX Design, HCI, Interaction Design, Educational Technology, or a related field.*
* *46 years of experience in UI/UX, product design, or learning design, ideally in EdTech, SaaS, or mobile-first environments.*
* *Proven ability to prototype, test, and iterate learning-focused interfaces in tools such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.*
* *Experience designing data-informed and user-centered workflows.*
* *Familiarity with learning psychology, instructional design principles, or digital education environments.*
* *Excellent visual design, communication, and storytelling skills.*

*Preferred*
-----------

* *Experience designing AI-powered or adaptive learning systems.*
* *Familiarity with language learning products or communication training.*
* *Understanding of localization and accessibility in global markets.*
* *Basic skills in motion design or micro-interaction prototyping.*

*Why Join ELSA*
---------------

* *Shape the future of *AI-driven English learning* , reaching billions of users globally.*
* *Collaborate with a world-class team at the intersection of AI, product, and pedagogy.*
* *Contribute to a mission that helps people build confidence and communicate freely.*
* *Competitive compensation and benefits package.*
* *Flexible remote-first environment with opportunities for impact and growth.*

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
***************
*About Merapar*
***************

Merapar is a strong brand within the Media and Entertainment industry, growing very fast. TV is our first love, but we are rapidly expanding into new areas such as IoT, Data Management and Analytics.

Being part of our global professional services organisation, you have the chance to help build Merapar into an even better place to work.

Driven by passion, we help clients imagine, build and run strategic infrastructures, workflows and direct to consumer applications that bring content to users worldwide.

The people who work at Merapar are our most important asset, and we are an inclusive organisation that encourages difference. We invest in training and certification, for example in cloud technology and Agile methods. We believe in Agile management and development, and we support our self organising teams.

* We are customer focused >> Engage. Don’t ignore.
* We work as a team >> Work together. Don’t swim alone.
* We improve, learn and share >> Advance. Don’t stagnate.
* We encourage difference >> Be yourself. Don’t conform.
* We deliver quality >> Excel. Don’t settle.

-------------------
*About the project*
-------------------

We are building a new digital product for small and medium-sized businesses, such as sole traders, tradespeople and local service providers. Many of these businesses still run on a mix of phone calls, messages, paper notes and spreadsheets. Our product brings the customer side of their business together in one place, so they can:

* Attract customers: get discovered and manage new enquiries and leads
* Quote: create and send clear, professional quotes quickly, often from a phone on site
* Invoice and get paid: create invoices, keep track of what is outstanding and follow up on payments

The product will be available as a mobile app and as a web application for PC and Mac, used for admin, reporting and record-keeping. Because the product is at an early stage, you help lay the foundations and shape the experience, from the first concepts all the way to launch.

----------------
*About the role*
----------------

We are looking for a UX/UI Designer who loves turning everyday business tasks into something simple, clear and pleasant to use. You join a cross-functional team with a product manager, frontend and backend developers and a data engineer, and you are the person who makes sure the product makes sense to the people who use it.

-------------------------
*As a UX/UI Designer you*
-------------------------

understand how business owners really work, and you use that knowledge to design mobile and web experiences that save them time. You combine strong design skills with the ability to explain your choices clearly to developers, product people and stakeholders.

*You*
-----

* Do user research to learn how business owners find customers, quote for work and get paid, and use those insights to guide design decisions
* Create user flows, wireframes, mockups and prototypes for both mobile and web
* Design clear and efficient experiences for admin-heavy tasks, such as managing quotes, invoices and customer records
* Design trustworthy interactions for important moments, like sending a quote or recording a payment, so users always feel in control of what reaches their customers
* Build and maintain a consistent design system that works on both platforms
* Work closely with the product manager, developers and data engineer to shape the product direction, visuals and experience
* Make sure your designs follow brand guidelines and accessibility standards
* Keep improving designs based on user feedback and analytics

*You have*
----------

* Experience as a UX/UI or Product Designer, with a portfolio that shows your process as well as the end result
* A strong understanding of user-centred design principles
* Experience designing for both mobile and web
* Strong skills in Figma or similar design tools
* Experience with user research and usability testing
* The ability to explain your design ideas clearly, to technical and non-technical people
* A hands-on mentality: you are comfortable working in an early-stage product where not everything is defined yet
* An open mind and curiosity about new tools, including AI tools that can make design work faster
* Excellent English, spoken and written

*Nice to have*
--------------

* Experience designing data-driven features, such as dashboards, reports or customer records
* Experience with products for small businesses, or with quoting, invoicing or payment flows
* Experience setting up a design system from scratch
* Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS, so you know what is realistic for developers to build

---------------
*What we offer*
---------------

* A competitive salary based on experience and location
* The chance to shape a new product from the very start
* Real influence on the product and the way it looks and works
* Room to keep learning and growing
* A collaborative, cross-functional team with short lines of communication

----------
*Location*
----------

Netherlands.

--------------
*How to apply*
--------------

Send us your CV and a link to your portfolio. Tell us briefly about a project you are proud of and the design choices you made along the way.

We are an inclusive employer and keep working to increase diversity. We encourage applications from under-represented groups, including women and ethnic minorities, and we are happy to make accommodations for disability or neurodiversity during the interview process.

--------------------------------------
*Do you think we match? Get in touch!*
--------------------------------------

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Maud Mutsaars. If you have no questions and you’re excited about the role, please apply below.

title: UX/UI Designer III
description:
*Location:* Brasil (100% Remote or Hybrid for Serra Gaúcha Residents or Greater São Paulo area)

*Compensation Currency:* Brazilian Real (BRL)

*Contract:* Permanent Full Time (CLT) - 42h/week

*PLEASE ATTACH YOUR CV IN ENGLISH*

*People with disabilities are welcome at Cyncly!*

*About us*

Cyncly is a leading global provider of specialized visualization, sales, manufacturing and content software and solutions for the retail, design and manufacturing industries.

Cyncly was created to unite Compusoft, 2020 Technologies and their affiliate companies after their merger in 2021. The Company brings together more than 35 years of industry experience to provide a connected platform of configure, price, quote (CPQ) software, online space planning, computer-aided design (CAD) applications, business process management, manufacturing execution systems and enterprise resource planning (ERP). Cyncly serves more than 70,000 customers across 100 countries, with operations in North America, Europe, South America, Asia Pacific, and Africa.

At Cyncly, we are committed to fostering an increasingly diverse and inclusive environment where all voices are valued and celebrated. We prioritize representation from minority groups. We recognize that our unique approach and success stem from the wealth of perspectives brought by our diverse teams.

*About the Role*
This is a role for a designer who leads with evidence. As Cyncly’s UX Designer III, you will bring rigour and user insight into the heart of the product design process for one of our globally used design applications — a product used by professional designers, retailers, and manufacturers worldwide. Based in LATAM, you will be working within a globally distributed team, collaborating closely with the Head of UX Design, the Lead User Researcher, product managers, and data analysts across time zones.

This is a deeply hands-on UX role with a strong research orientation. You will plan and conduct your own discovery and evaluative research, synthesise findings into actionable design direction, and translate data signals into interaction design that is both intuitive and impactful. You are equally comfortable in a workshop, an analytics dashboard, and Figma — and you know how to connect all three.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Lead end-to-end UX design for product areas within a globally used design application — from discovery and problem definition through to validated, high-fidelity design and handoff.
* Plan and conduct mixed-method research independently — including user interviews, contextual enquiry, usability testing, surveys, and Jobs-to-be-Done studies — to inform and validate design decisions at every stage.
* Work closely with data analysts and product managers to interpret product analytics, behavioural data, and funnel metrics, translating quantitative signals into clear UX hypotheses and design responses.
* Synthesise research and data findings into actionable insights, journey maps, opportunity frameworks, and design principles that the wider global team can align around.
* Design clear, well-reasoned interaction flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes that reflect a deep understanding of user needs, task context, and business goals.
* Run collaborative design activities — including discovery workshops, assumption mapping, and concept validation sessions — with product and engineering stakeholders across the business.
* Contribute to the definition of UX success metrics and work with product and analytics teams to measure the impact of design changes post-release.
* Apply an inclusive and accessibility-conscious design approach, ensuring designs meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards for a diverse global user base.
* Partner with the Lead User Researcher to ensure consistent research practices and contribute to the growing research repository and knowledge base.
* Mentor and support less experienced designers in the team, modelling a research-informed design practice and helping to raise the bar for design quality and rigour across Cyncly.

*What We're Looking For*

* Solid experience in UX design, ideally within a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment, with a demonstrable track record of research-informed design practice.

* Strong proficiency in mixed-method UX research — including moderated and unmoderated usability testing, in-depth interviews, contextual enquiry, and survey design — with the ability to operate independently without a dedicated researcher.

* Proven ability to work with quantitative data: interpreting product analytics, behavioural funnels, heatmaps, and A/B test results to identify UX problems and opportunities.

* Expert-level proficiency in Figma — including complex flows, interactive prototyping, component usage, and design handoff documentation.

* Strong skills in synthesising research findings into clear outputs — including insight reports, journey maps, opportunity spaces, and design rationale — for diverse stakeholder audiences.

* Experience facilitating discovery and alignment workshops with cross-functional teams, including product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.

title: Enterprise UX/UI Designer
description:
The Enterprise UX/UI Design Lead is responsible for defining and designing intuitive, consistent, and modern user experiences across Whelen's enterprise applications, including the ERP platform, Customer Portal, and other internal and external business applications.

This role serves as the bridge between business processes, user needs, and technical implementation. The Enterprise UX/UI Design Lead will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, enterprise architects, developers, and other technical teams to translate business requirements and workflows into clear, usable, and visually consistent application experiences.

The role is responsible not only for creating UI mockups and prototypes, but also for establishing enterprise UX/UI standards, documenting expected application behavior, defining interaction patterns, and developing the visual and functional story that guides application development.
*UX/UI Design*

* Design user interfaces for enterprise applications including ERP, Customer Portal, administrative applications, dashboards, and other digital experiences.
* Create high-fidelity UI mockups that clearly communicate the intended application experience.
* Develop wireframes and low-fidelity concepts to rapidly explore design ideas with business and technical teams.
* Design responsive experiences appropriate for desktop, tablet, and mobile use where applicable.
* Ensure applications provide a consistent and intuitive user experience across modules and platforms.
* Improve existing application interfaces by identifying usability, navigation, workflow, consistency, and accessibility opportunities.

*Storyboarding and User Experience Design*

* Create storyboards that describe how users interact with applications and how workflows progress from beginning to end.
* Translate complex business processes into understandable user journeys and screen flows.
* Develop user journeys, workflow diagrams, navigation models, and interaction sequences.
* Design the "story" of an application so users can naturally understand what they need to do, where they are in a process, and what happens next.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows and reduce unnecessary user interactions.

*Business and Technical Collaboration*

* Work directly with business stakeholders to understand operational processes, user needs, challenges, and desired outcomes.
* Facilitate design sessions with business users, product owners, architects, developers, and other technical stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into practical user experiences and application designs.
* Work with development teams to ensure designs can be effectively implemented within the application's technical architecture.
* Participate in design reviews throughout the development lifecycle.
* Review implemented functionality to ensure it aligns with approved designs and intended user experience.
* Incorporate user and stakeholder feedback into iterative design improvements.

*Design Standards and Design System*

* Establish and maintain enterprise UX/UI standards for Whelen business applications.
* Define approved color palettes, typography, spacing, layout patterns, icons, controls, and other visual standards.
* Define standard application components such as:
* Navigation
* Forms
* Tables and grids
* Search interfaces
* Filters
* Dialogs and overlays
* Notifications
* Validation messages
* Buttons and actions
* Cards
* Tabs
* Wizards and multi-step workflows
* Dashboards
* Develop and maintain a reusable enterprise design system and component library.
* Establish standards for visual hierarchy, required fields, error states, warnings, status indicators, and user feedback.
* Ensure design standards support accessibility, usability, consistency, and maintainability.
* Work with frontend development teams to align design standards with reusable application components.

*Functional Design Documentation*

* Document the expected functionality and behavior of application screens and components.
* Produce functional UX/UI specifications that development and QA teams can use during implementation and testing.

Document:
* Screen purpose
* User interactions
* Field behavior
* Validation requirements
* Required and optional fields
* Navigation behavior
* Search and filtering behavior
* Error states
* Empty states
* Loading states
* Success and confirmation messages
* Role- or permission-based UI behavior
* Responsive behavior

* Maintain documentation showing how screens, components, and workflows are expected to operate.
* Support Product Owners and Business Analysts in translating UI designs into development stories and acceptance criteria.
* Provide visual documentation that supplements traditional business and technical requirements.

*Prototyping*

* Build interactive prototypes that allow stakeholders and users to experience proposed functionality before development begins.
* Use prototypes during requirements discussions and usability reviews to validate workflows.
* Demonstrate proposed interactions, navigation, transitions, and application behavior.
* Iterate designs based on feedback before development effort is committed.

*User Research and Usability*

* Engage with users to understand how they perform their work and interact with existing systems.
* Observe workflows and identify usability challenges within current applications.
* Facilitate usability reviews and design feedback sessions.
* Use feedback, workflow analysis, and application usage patterns to continually improve application design.
* Advocate for the end user while balancing business requirements and technical constraints.

*Design Governance*

* Participate in architecture and application design reviews where user experience is impacted.
* Review proposed application designs for adherence to enterprise UX/UI standards.
* Help establish governance for new application components and design patterns.
* Identify opportunities to reuse existing patterns rather than creating inconsistent application experiences.
* Maintain documentation describing approved enterprise design standards and patterns.

*Primary Deliverables*

* Typical deliverables produced by this role include:
* UI mockups
* Wireframes
* Interactive prototypes
* Application storyboards
* User journey maps
* Workflow diagrams
* Navigation models
* UX/UI functional specifications
* Enterprise UI standards
* Color and typography standards
* Application design guidelines
* Reusable component specifications
* Design system documentation
* Screen behavior documentation
* Usability recommendations
* Development design handoff packages

*Required Qualifications*

* Demonstrated experience designing enterprise, SaaS, ERP, or complex business applications.
* Strong experience with UX and UI design principles.
* Experience translating complex business processes into intuitive application workflows.
* Experience creating wireframes, high fidelity mockups, interactive prototypes, and design specifications.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and software developers.
* Strong understanding of modern web application design patterns.
* Experience developing or contributing to design systems and reusable component libraries.
* Ability to document detailed application behavior and interaction requirements.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain design decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience designing ERP, manufacturing, supply chain, customer portal, CRM, or other enterprise business applications.
* Experience working with React-based applications.
* Experience with Figma or similar modern design and prototyping platforms.
* Familiarity with component-based frontend development.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards and responsive application design.
* Experience working in Agile product development environments.
* Experience collaborating with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Enterprise Architects, and software engineering teams.
* Understanding of role-based and permission-based application experiences.

*Skills and Competencies
* The successful candidate should demonstrate strength in:

* User Experience Design
* User Interface Design
* Interaction Design
* Enterprise Application Design
* Visual Design
* Information Architecture
* Storyboarding
* User Journey Design
* Prototyping
* Design Systems
* Business Process Analysis
* Functional Documentation
* Requirements Translation
* Usability
* Accessibility
* Stakeholder Facilitation
* Cross-Functional Collaboration

*Role Relationships
* The Enterprise UX/UI Designer will work closely with:

* Business Stakeholders
* Enterprise Architecture
* Product Owners
* Business Analysts
* Software Architects
* Frontend Developers
* Backend Development Teams
* QA and Testing Teams
* Project and Program Management
* Security and Identity Teams

The position will serve as a central design resource helping ensure that enterprise applications provide a consistent, intentional, and high quality experience regardless of which development team or business area is responsible for the underlying functionality.

* Comply with the EH&S Policy and applicable regulatory and company EH&S rules and requirements
* Report to supervision conditions or practices that are either unsafe or that may adversely impact the environment, to ensure prompt resolution of potential hazards

* Actively support the organization’s efforts to meet or exceed EH&S goals and plans

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

*Enterprise Technology* plays a critical part in shaping the future of mobility. If you’re looking for the chance to leverage advanced technology to redefine the transportation landscape, enhance the customer experience and improve people’s lives, this is the opportunity for you. Join us and challenge your IT expertise and analytical skills to help create vehicles that are as smart as you are.

*Ford Pro* is a new global business within Ford committed to commercial customer productivity. Ford Pro delivers a work-ready suite of vehicles, accessories and services for virtually every vocation, backed by technology and engineered for uptime. A true one-stop shop, we offer a full portfolio of electrified and internal combustion vehicles designed to integrate seamlessly with the Ford Pro ecosystem, helping customers' businesses thrive today and into the new era of electrification.

*In this position...*

Ford Pro is looking for an experienced Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) to join our digital product design team.

The initial focus of this role will be the *Ford Pro App* , a key part of the Ford Pro digital ecosystem used by fleet managers and drivers to understand vehicle status, manage fleet operations and take action while on the move.

We are entering an important phase in the evolution of the app. As Ford Pro brings more of its products and services together, the app is evolving beyond its origins as a telematics companion toward a broader mobile experience connecting customers with capabilities across the Ford Pro ecosystem.

You will help shape that evolution.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) who is comfortable taking ownership of *large, ambiguous product problems, creating clarity where the path is not yet defined and turning complex customer* and business needs into simple, coherent experiences.

You will work as a strategic partner to Product and Engineering, helping define problems and influence product direction—not simply responding to requirements. You should be comfortable moving between *experience strategy, information architecture, user journeys, interaction design, prototyping and detailed production UI*.

This role requires strong systems thinking. Ford Pro is a large ecosystem of products, services, customer types, permissions, subscriptions and vehicle experiences. You will need to understand how those pieces connect and design experiences that work as part of a broader system rather than as isolated features.

While native mobile experience is highly valuable, we are ultimately looking for an exceptional product designer. This role may also contribute to web or cross-platform initiatives as the needs of the organization evolve.

This is a remote role, working closely with distributed Product, Engineering, Research, Data and Design teams.

Candidates who are in commuting distance to a Ford hub location may be required to commute to the office four or more days/ week.

*What you'll do...*

* Own complex product design work end-to-end, from problem definition and discovery through concept development, prototyping, validation, delivery and post-launch iteration.
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, taking ambiguous problems, creating structure and direction, and driving work forward without requiring continuous design oversight.
* Play a central role in the evolution and redesign of the Ford Pro App, helping rethink its experience, navigation, interaction model and product architecture.
* Help evolve the app from primarily a telematics companion into a broader mobile entry point to the Ford Pro ecosystem, connecting capabilities and journeys across Ford Pro.
* Design experiences that serve different customer types and contexts, including the distinct needs of fleet managers, administrators and drivers.
* Define and evolve information architecture, navigation and interaction patterns that can scale as additional products, capabilities and customer journeys are introduced.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Kyivstar.Tech is looking for a Graphic Designer to create high-quality visual content for our digital products and services. The primary focus of this role is developing graphic assets for product interfaces, landing pages, web experiences, product communications, and other digital touchpoints. You will also support marketing and brand initiatives when needed.

This is a hands-on creative role for a designer who combines strong visual craft with an understanding of digital products and modern production workflows, including confident use of AI-powered tools for ideation, visual exploration, and asset creation.

*About us*

Kyivstar.Tech is a Ukrainian hybrid IT company and a resident of Diia.City. We are a subsidiary of Kyivstar, one of Ukraine’s largest telecom operators.

Our mission is to change lives in Ukraine and around the world by creating technological solutions and products that unleash the potential of businesses and meet users’ needs.

Over 700+ KS.Tech specialists work daily in various areas: mobile and web solutions, as well as design, development, support, and technical maintenance of high-performance systems and services.

We believe in innovations that truly bring quality changes and constantly challenge conventional approaches and solutions. Each of us is an adherent of entrepreneurial culture, which allows us never to stop, to evolve, and to create something new.

What you will do
----------------

* Create high-quality graphic assets for digital products, including landing pages, web experiences, product interfaces, onboarding and promotional surfaces, banners, illustrations, and other visual content.
* Develop visual concepts that support product communication and help explain features, services, and value propositions in a clear and engaging way.
* Collaborate closely with Product Designers, Product Managers, content teams, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure that graphic materials support both product goals and user needs.
* Conduct visual research and develop references, mood boards, visual concepts, and storyboards to explore and communicate creative directions.
* Take ownership of graphic design tasks from initial concept and exploration through final production and delivery.
* Create and maintain reusable graphic assets, templates, visual libraries, and scalable approaches that improve consistency and production efficiency across products.
* Adapt visual materials across different digital formats, screen sizes, and communication channels while maintaining brand and visual consistency.
* Use modern AI-powered tools and workflows for visual exploration, concept generation, image creation and editing, production of variations, and acceleration of repetitive design tasks while maintaining creative control and quality.
* Explore new visual approaches, design trends, illustration styles, motion techniques, and emerging creative technologies that can improve product experiences.
* Support marketing, brand, partnership, and communication initiatives with graphic and promotional materials when needed.

Qualifications and experience needed
------------------------------------

* Professional Experience: 2+ years of experience in graphic, visual, brand, or digital design, preferably working with digital products, web experiences, or technology companies.
* Portfolio: Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality graphic design work across digital formats, such as landing pages, web graphics, illustrations, campaign visuals, product communications, or other digital assets.
* Visual Craft: Strong understanding of composition, typography, color, visual hierarchy, layout, imagery, and contemporary digital design principles.
* Conceptual Thinking: Ability to translate product ideas, business requirements, and communication goals into clear and compelling visual concepts.
* Tools: Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud and Figma, with the ability to efficiently prepare production-ready visual assets for digital environments.
* AI-enabled Design: Confident use of modern AI-powered creative tools and practices for ideation, image generation and editing, visual exploration, and production workflows, combined with the ability to critically evaluate and refine AI-generated results.
* Scalable Design: Experience creating reusable templates, visual libraries, and graphic systems within established brand guidelines.
* Collaboration Skills: Ability to work effectively with product designers, product managers, developers, content specialists, brand teams, and marketers in a collaborative environment.
* Languages: Strong written and spoken Ukrainian; Intermediate English or higher.

A plus would be
---------------

* Motion Design: Experience creating motion graphics and animations using tools such as Adobe After Effects.
* 3D: Familiarity with 3D tools and workflows for creating visual assets or adding depth to digital experiences.
* Advanced AI Workflows: Experience using AI beyond basic prompting — for example, maintaining visual consistency, generating controlled variations, combining AI-generated assets with traditional design workflows, or automating repetitive production tasks.
* Product Experience: Previous experience working within multidisciplinary digital product teams and understanding how graphic design supports UX/UI and overall product experience.
* Marketing Design: Experience creating digital advertising, social media, partnership, or other marketing materials across different channels and formats.

What we offer
-------------

* Office or remote — it’s up to you.
* Remote onboarding.
* Performance bonuses for everyone (annual or quarterly — depends on the role).
* We train employees: with the opportunity to learn through the company’s library, internal resources, and programs from partners.
* Health and life insurance.
* Wellbeing program and corporate psychologist.
* Reimbursement of expenses for Kyivstar mobile communication.

title: Freelance Graphic Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a versatile, highly skilled Graphic Designer with strong experience in logo design and visual identity to join the Tendem project (** and create high-quality visual assets for real-world use cases.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in logo design, branding, visual communication, typography, and layout to transform ideas into professional, polished creative assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, layout design, and creating diverse marketing materials.

What We Do
----------

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role
--------------

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Graphic Designer, you'll work across a variety of visual design tasks, with a particular focus on logo design, brand identity, and visual concept development. You may also work on layouts, infographics, social media templates, one-pagers, and other marketing and communication assets. We are looking for a versatile designer who can translate ideas and brand concepts into clear, distinctive visual solutions while maintaining a high level of craft and consistency across different formats.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Design distinctive, professional logos and visual identity concepts based on different brand requirements and creative briefs.
* Explore and develop multiple logo directions, using strong conceptual thinking to translate brand ideas into effective visual symbols and systems.
* Apply branding principles across different assets to maintain a consistent and recognizable visual identity.
* Create clean layouts, modern infographics, and clear visual hierarchies to ensure readable and engaging content.
* Design reusable templates for social media channels, marketing materials, and impactful one-pagers.
* Elevate everyday materials by working deeply with advanced typography, grid systems, and thoughtful composition.
* Transform raw data and concepts into professional, polished visual assets tailored to specific marketing and communication goals.
* Enforce design quality standards through systematic verification of visual alignment, color usage, and layout consistency prior to delivery.

Important note
--------------

Please submit your CV in English. *Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with relevant graphic design work. Portfolios featuring strong logo design and visual identity projects will be particularly important for this role.* Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.

This is project-based freelance work. Tasks are available only when projects are active. You may be invited to one or more projects depending on your profile and current opportunities.

How to get started
------------------

Simply apply to this post, complete the qualification process, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills — on your own schedule.

Requirements
------------

*Educational qualifications*

* At least 1-2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, digital design, or visual communications is desirable.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related creative fields is a plus.

*Academic and/or Professional Experience*

Candidates must have a strong portfolio demonstrating professional graphic design work, with relevant examples of logo design, branding, or visual identity development. We are particularly interested in designers who can demonstrate the ability to create original logo concepts and translate brand ideas into effective visual solutions. A broader portfolio showcasing formats such as social media graphics, marketing collateral, infographics, and one-pagers is also highly valued. We are looking for versatile specialists with an exceptional grasp of typography, visual composition, color, and grid systems. An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented approach is essential, along with the ability to work independently to solve visual challenges.

*Technical Skills (Essential)*

* Logo & Identity Design: Proven ability to develop original logo concepts and visual identities, from initial exploration through polished final execution.
* Branding: Strong understanding of brand identity principles, including typography, color, visual language, consistency, and practical application across different formats.
* Concept Development: Ability to interpret creative briefs and translate abstract brand ideas into distinctive, relevant, and visually effective concepts.
* Layout & Typography: Exceptional grasp of typography, precise grid systems, and visual composition to elevate everyday materials.
* Visual Asset Creation: Proven ability to structure information cleanly through modern infographics and compelling social media templates.
* Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma to handle a wide spectrum of visual tasks.
* Format Versatility: Seamlessly switch between designing impactful one-pagers and highly engaging digital templates, adapting to the constraints of each medium.

*Additional requirements*

* An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented mindset.
* Strong dedication to delivering visually polished, professional-grade assets.
* Self-directed work ethic with the ability to manage diverse visual tasks simultaneously.
* *Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with graphic design examples. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant graphic design cases, will not be considered.*
* English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations
-------------------------

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation
------------

On this project, contributors can earn up to *$45 per hour equivalent* , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

title: Marketing Designer (Fractional, 2-3 days/week)
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Marketing Designer (Fractional, 2-3 days/week) based in Israel.*

This is a high-impact opportunity for a Marketing Designer to define and elevate the visual identity of a fast-growing B2B SaaS business operating at the forefront of AI search optimization. As the first dedicated designer, you will have significant ownership over how the brand appears across websites, sales materials, advertising, social media, and product marketing. You will build and evolve a scalable design system while ensuring every customer-facing asset is polished, consistent, and effective. Working closely with the founding team, you will turn concise briefs into strong creative concepts and bring them through to production. The role combines strategic brand thinking with hands-on execution across digital and marketing channels. It is ideal for a designer with sharp visual instincts who enjoys autonomy, speed, and seeing their work reach senior marketing audiences.

Accountabilities
----------------

*

Own and evolve the company’s design system by auditing existing materials, identifying opportunities for improvement, documenting standards in Figma, and ensuring consistency across all marketing assets.

*

Design and develop landing pages and website sections in Webflow, taking projects from concept through to live publication.

*

Build and maintain a scalable sales presentation system in PowerPoint and Google Slides, including one-pagers, case studies, battlecards, and reusable templates that sales teams can edit confidently.

*

Produce high-quality advertising and social media creatives across LinkedIn, paid social, and display channels, creating multiple variations to support testing and performance optimization.

*

Create product mockups, feature graphics, and lightweight motion assets such as GIFs and simple animations for use across websites, presentations, campaigns, and advertising.

*

Manage publishing and asset handoffs independently, including Webflow CMS updates, email templates, and production-ready exports for sales and marketing teams.

*

Translate short briefs, business objectives, and messaging into compelling visual concepts, taking ownership of both the creative direction and final execution.

*

Partner directly with the founding team to establish a distinctive visual identity and make informed recommendations about when existing design approaches should be refined or fundamentally changed.

*

Work efficiently in a fast-moving environment, managing priorities independently and delivering polished creative work with minimal supervision.

*

Contribute to establishing the visual foundations of a growing category, helping shape how the business is perceived by customers and senior marketing decision-makers.

Requirements:
-------------

*

You have at least 4 years of professional design experience within B2B SaaS or at an agency serving SaaS clients.

*

Your portfolio demonstrates the ability to carry a cohesive brand identity across multiple formats, including websites, sales presentations, and advertising.

*

You are highly proficient in Figma and have personally designed and launched live websites using Webflow rather than working exclusively on design concepts.

*

You are fluent in PowerPoint and Google Slides and can create polished, reusable templates that other team members can easily adapt.

*

You have strong typography, composition, layout, and visual hierarchy skills, with exceptional attention to detail and a high standard for design quality.

*

You are fast, self-directed, and comfortable turning concise briefs into multiple strong creative directions without requiring extensive guidance.

*

You have a clear creative point of view and can confidently work within an existing visual system while also identifying opportunities to improve it.

*

You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment and managing your own priorities, deadlines, and production workflow.

*

Experience with motion design tools such as After Effects, Lottie, or Rive is a plus.

*

Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS is advantageous, as is familiarity with SEO or AI search optimization tools.

*

You should be comfortable collaborating with a distributed team and able to maintain at least four hours of overlap with US Eastern working hours.

Benefits:
---------

*

Fractional commitment of 2–3 days per week as an independent contractor, with the potential to transition to a full-time position as the workload grows.

*

Fully remote working arrangement with flexibility to work where you are most effective.

*

Compensation paid in USD.

Direct collaboration with the founding team and the opportunity to see your work reach the market quickly.

Significant ownership as the first dedicated designer, with the opportunity to shape the visual identity and design foundations of a growing business.

Opportunity to work in an emerging and rapidly expanding AI-focused market.

*

A fast-paced, execution-oriented environment with substantial creative autonomy and minimal bureaucracy.

Weekly priorities established with the founder, with ownership of the creative queue and execution from there.

title: Sr Packaging Designer– Games
description:
*The Opportunity:*

As a Sr Packaging Designer, you'll help shape the visual identity of some of the world's most recognizable games and entertainment brands. From the earliest concept sketches through final production, you'll create packaging, games content and supporting creative assets that connect with consumers and tell a compelling brand story.

You'll collaborate with cross-functional partners across Marketing, Product Design, Engineering, and our Asia development teams to bring innovative ideas to life. Whether you're presenting concepts to leadership, art directing photography, building 3D package mockups, or refining the smallest design detail, you'll play an important role in creating packaging that stands out on shelf and online.

We're looking for a designer who is equal parts creative thinker, visual storyteller, and collaborative teammate—someone who's excited to push ideas forward while balancing business objectives, consumer insights, and production realities.

*What Your Impact Will Be:*

* Design innovative packaging from concept through production for Mattel Games brands and licensed properties.
* Develop compelling visual storytelling that strengthens brand identity and drives consumer engagement.
* Create packaging and product graphics, digital assets for both retail and e-commerce experiences.
* Partner with Marketing, Product Design, Engineering, Copywriting, and Brand teams to bring cohesive creative solutions to life.
* Art direct illustration, retouching, and external creative partners.
* Create 3D package visualizations and physical mockups to communicate design intent.
* Collaborate closely with global development teams to ensure design quality from concept through production.
* Stay connected to consumer, design, entertainment, and cultural trends to inspire fresh creative solutions.

*What We’re Looking For:*

* 5+ years of experience in packaging, graphic, or consumer product design.
* Degree in Graphic Design, Industrial Design, Visual Communication, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Exceptional visual design skills with a strong portfolio demonstrating packaging and brand storytelling.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign).
* Experience with 3D visualization tools such as Adobe Dimension, Blender, or similar.
* Strong understanding of typography, color, composition, and consumer-focused design.
* Ability to balance creativity with production requirements and business objectives.
* Comfortable presenting ideas and receiving constructive feedback in a collaborative environment.
* Excellent communication, organization, and project management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Curiosity about trends in design, gaming, entertainment, culture, and retail.
* Passion for creating memorable experiences for consumers through thoughtful design.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. title: Freelance Graphic Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a versatile, highly skilled Graphic Designer with strong experience in logo design and visual identity to join the Tendem project (** and create high-quality visual assets for real-world use cases.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in logo design, branding, visual communication, typography, and layout to transform ideas into professional, polished creative assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, layout design, and creating diverse marketing materials.

What We Do
----------

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role
--------------

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Graphic Designer, you'll work across a variety of visual design tasks, with a particular focus on logo design, brand identity, and visual concept development. You may also work on layouts, infographics, social media templates, one-pagers, and other marketing and communication assets. We are looking for a versatile designer who can translate ideas and brand concepts into clear, distinctive visual solutions while maintaining a high level of craft and consistency across different formats.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Design distinctive, professional logos and visual identity concepts based on different brand requirements and creative briefs.
* Explore and develop multiple logo directions, using strong conceptual thinking to translate brand ideas into effective visual symbols and systems.
* Apply branding principles across different assets to maintain a consistent and recognizable visual identity.
* Create clean layouts, modern infographics, and clear visual hierarchies to ensure readable and engaging content.
* Design reusable templates for social media channels, marketing materials, and impactful one-pagers.
* Elevate everyday materials by working deeply with advanced typography, grid systems, and thoughtful composition.
* Transform raw data and concepts into professional, polished visual assets tailored to specific marketing and communication goals.
* Enforce design quality standards through systematic verification of visual alignment, color usage, and layout consistency prior to delivery.

Important note
--------------

Please submit your CV in English. *Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with relevant graphic design work. Portfolios featuring strong logo design and visual identity projects will be particularly important for this role.* Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.

This is project-based freelance work. Tasks are available only when projects are active. You may be invited to one or more projects depending on your profile and current opportunities.

How to get started
------------------

Simply apply to this post, complete the qualification process, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills — on your own schedule.

Requirements
------------

*Educational qualifications*

* At least 1-2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, digital design, or visual communications is desirable.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related creative fields is a plus.

*Academic and/or Professional Experience*

Candidates must have a strong portfolio demonstrating professional graphic design work, with relevant examples of logo design, branding, or visual identity development. We are particularly interested in designers who can demonstrate the ability to create original logo concepts and translate brand ideas into effective visual solutions. A broader portfolio showcasing formats such as social media graphics, marketing collateral, infographics, and one-pagers is also highly valued. We are looking for versatile specialists with an exceptional grasp of typography, visual composition, color, and grid systems. An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented approach is essential, along with the ability to work independently to solve visual challenges.

*Technical Skills (Essential)*

* Logo & Identity Design: Proven ability to develop original logo concepts and visual identities, from initial exploration through polished final execution.
* Branding: Strong understanding of brand identity principles, including typography, color, visual language, consistency, and practical application across different formats.
* Concept Development: Ability to interpret creative briefs and translate abstract brand ideas into distinctive, relevant, and visually effective concepts.
* Layout & Typography: Exceptional grasp of typography, precise grid systems, and visual composition to elevate everyday materials.
* Visual Asset Creation: Proven ability to structure information cleanly through modern infographics and compelling social media templates.
* Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma to handle a wide spectrum of visual tasks.
* Format Versatility: Seamlessly switch between designing impactful one-pagers and highly engaging digital templates, adapting to the constraints of each medium.

*Additional requirements*

* An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented mindset.
* Strong dedication to delivering visually polished, professional-grade assets.
* Self-directed work ethic with the ability to manage diverse visual tasks simultaneously.
* *Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with graphic design examples. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant graphic design cases, will not be considered.*
* English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations
-------------------------

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation
------------

On this project, contributors can earn up to *$40 per hour equivalent* , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.
