title: Marketing Designer
description:
Qdrant is an *open-source vector* search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations.

Trusted by global leaders like *Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom* , we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising *$50M in Series B* funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.

As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.

We are looking for a *freelance Marketing Designer* to join our design team and collaborate with our Visual Designer and Design Lead to help refine Qdrant’s visual identity across various marketing channels.

We want someone whose daily workflow is built around creative AI tools, who uses them to explore faster, produce more, and push ideas further than a traditional process allows, while maintaining a strong focus on the fundamentals: typography, spacing, and color. Art direction for AI-generated imagery is a key component of this position.

You'll help build and refine the internal AI tools and workflows that power our visual direction, then apply that direction across marketing assets, landing pages, ad creatives, email visuals, and event materials to keep the brand cohesive and polished.

-------------------
*What you will own*
-------------------

*

*AI tools & workflows:* Help build and refine the internal AI tools and workflows we use to scale our visual direction across the team.

*

*Marketing assets:* Design compelling visuals for campaigns, social media, blog posts, and presentations.

*

*Website & landing pages:* Design and update website pages, including marketing and campaign-specific landing pages.

*

*Ad creatives:* Design banner ads, LinkedIn creatives, and other performance marketing assets.

*

*Email design:* Develop eye-catching graphics and layouts for email campaigns.

*

*Event & conference materials:* Create slide decks, booth designs, and printed assets.

*

*Brand consistency:* Keep every marketing visual aligned with Qdrant's visual direction and guidelines.

-------------
*Who you are*
-------------

*

You have minimum 4 to maximum 8 years of experience designing marketing assets, websites, or both, ideally in a B2B or tech company.

*

AI is central to how you work. You use tools like Midjourney, Flora AI, Higgsfield, and Claude every day and can show us how they shaped real projects in your portfolio..

*

Experienced in designing websites or marketing assets, with a solid understanding of design principles and user interaction.

*

Proficient in Figma, with practical experience using an established design system.

*

You work fast without cutting corners. You're comfortable running several projects in parallel, switching between them easily, and you consistently ship polished work on tight timelines.

*This role is probably not for you if you need someone else to:*

*

Hand you a fully detailed brief before you can start exploring.

*

Tell you which AI tools to try or how to get better results from them.

*

Keep you up to date on new creative tools and techniques.

-------------
*Why join us*
-------------

*

A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

*

A competitive salary with additional perks.

*

Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture.

*

High ownership and real impact.

*

Open-source, engineering-driven culture.

*

Choose your own laptop equipment.

For US-based full-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy.

Qdrant is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If this role excites you but you don't check every single box, we'd still love to hear from you! We don't want to miss out on great people because of a checklist.

*Come build with us!
*

For information on how we handle your personal data, please refer to our Recruitment Privacy Policy

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
**Who We Are:**

At Bishop-McCann (BMC), we create experiences that move people. As a global event and experience agency, we partner with clients to design meaningful moments that connect, inspire, and drive impact.

Behind every experience is a collaborative team that values curiosity, accountability, and delivering exceptional results. We believe our people are at the center of everything we do.

**Who You Are:**

You are a hands-on designer with exceptional craft, strong conceptual thinking, and the confidence to own the work while making the people and ideas around you better. You can start with a strategy or creative brief, find the visual idea inside it, and build event identities and design systems with enough depth to live across stage, screen, environment, presentation, invitation, app, wayfinding, evening events, and activations.

You understand the why behind the work and consider the full attendee journey, not just the asset list. Creative Directors trust you with important work, producers know you will consider how something gets made, and account teams know you can hear the client behind the feedback and work within budgets. You present ideas with clarity and confidence, and you stay curious about AI, motion, technology, and emerging creative tools.

**The Role at a Glance:**

• **Title:** Senior Graphic Designer

• **Reports to:** Creative Director

• **Partners with:** Creative Director, ACD, Graphic Designers, Copywriters, Producers, Program Managers, Account Teams, New Business, Motion Designers, and Video Editors

• **Employment Type:** Full-Time, Exempt

• **Location:** Remote (U.S.), travel required for site visits, planning visits, and onsite events

• **Salary Range:** $80,000–$95,000

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Concept & Visual Direction**

• Develop original creative concepts, visual identities (logos, color, type, imagery, and graphics), and experience journeys for events, incentives, and new business opportunities.

• Create mood boards, concept decks, and visual storytelling that help clients understand and believe in an idea.

• Bring inspiration from culture, design, fashion, entertainment, hospitality, architecture, technology, and beyond the event industry.

**Experience & Creative Ownership**

• Own design workstreams from concept through final production with a high degree of independence.

• Translate creative concepts across the attendee journey, from pre-event communications to onsite environments, stages, screens, signage, wayfinding, digital experiences, and other touchpoints.

• Design across multiple experiential elements: digital, print, and environmental.

• Create signage and branding plans for hotels, and work with print, digital, scenic, and fabrication vendors.

• Partner with motion designers, editors, and Production to ensure the graphic, spatial, and moving worlds feel like one idea.

• Art direct and guide Graphic Designers and freelance talent working within an established creative direction.

• Understand the realities of physical production (scale, materials, fabrication, sightlines, screen formats, and technical requirements) and design with them in mind.

• Manage priorities across multiple programs and deadlines without sacrificing the quality of the work.

**Presentation & Partnership**

• Build compelling client presentations and pitch decks that sell the idea.

• Present creative thinking and design work directly to clients alongside Creative Directors and cross-functional partners.

• Hear the problem behind feedback and translate it into thoughtful solutions.

• Partner with Creative, Production, Planning, Account, and New Business from discovery and brief through execution.

**Craft, Mentorship & Innovation**

• Help uphold BMC design standards and push the quality of the work forward.

• Give clear, constructive feedback and mentor developing designers through the work.

• Explore AI and emerging technologies as creative collaborators for research, concept development, visualization, image generation, iteration, and storytelling.

• Help identify new tools, techniques, and capabilities that can make BMC's work smarter, more distinctive, or more impactful.

**Qualifications and Key Skills:**

**Required**

• 6+ years of professional design experience, ideally within events, experiential marketing, hospitality, entertainment, or a creative agency environment.

• A portfolio that proves concept, craft, and range across branding, presentations, print, digital, environmental, and event design.

• Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.

• Advanced PowerPoint skills and the ability to create sophisticated, compelling client and executive presentations.

• Fluency with generative AI tools such as Midjourney, ChatGPT, Claude, Adobe Firefly, or similar platforms, with a thoughtful point of view on how AI fits into the creative process.

• Strong understanding of print production, large-format/environmental graphics, file preparation, and production standards.

• Experience collaborating across motion, video, spatial design, production, and other creative disciplines.

• Experience directing other creatives and presenting work directly to clients and senior-level executives.

• Strong organizational skills and comfort navigating multiple clients, programs, deliverables, and deadlines.

• Willingness to travel as needed for client programs, presentations, and events.

**Preferred**

• B2B event experience (strongly preferred).

• Familiarity with Figma, After Effects, motion design, 3D, or spatial design.

**Key Competencies:**

• Conceptual and strategic thinking

• Design craft and visual systems

• Client presentation and storytelling

• Creative leadership and mentorship

• Managing multiple priorities

**Why Join Us:**

• A collaborative, people-first culture that values teamwork and connection.

• Opportunity to own creative concepts from first idea through onsite execution.

title: Digital Graphic Designer

You will join our Brand Identity team and work alongside creative colleagues across graphic design, art direction, photography and other areas of brand communication.

* Join a strong creative environment, where you work closely with colleagues across design, creative and marketing and have room to contribute with your creative perspectives within SELECTED’s established visual identity and creative direction.
* Enjoy flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home as part of our way of working.

You are a skilled Graphic Designer with a strong visual eye and a feel for what makes digital content engaging and on-brand. You enjoy turning creative direction into strong executions and take pride in the details that make the final result come together.

title: Sr. Product Designer
description:
--------
About us
--------

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes. To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

----------
Our People
----------

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

----------
Our Impact
----------

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

--------------
About the Role
--------------

We are seeking a Senior Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product judgment and strong execution. You have spent 5+ years designing complex digital products and are ready to own meaningful work from early ambiguity through shipped outcomes.

As a senior individual contributor, you will partner closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners and other designers on cross-functional teams that own and improve key product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals and technical constraints to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate exceptional visual and interaction design judgment, practical systems thinking and the ability to carry work from discovery through delivery. You should care deeply about the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent.

Experience designing B2B SaaS, platform, CRM, workflow-heavy or SMB software experiences is highly valuable. Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is expected. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

--------------
What You'll Do
--------------

* Own meaningful product areas from discovery through delivery, translating customer needs, business goals and technical constraints into clear experience direction
* Partner with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners and designers to define, test and ship polished product experiences at scale
* Use qualitative and quantitative insight to make design decisions and improve outcomes
* Create wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, interaction specifications and production-ready documentation
* Design clear workflows, edge cases and failure states that help customers complete complex tasks with confidence
* Strengthen design-system adoption and help teams use shared patterns across surfaces, devices and locales
* Lead through ambiguity by iterating quickly, using feedback well and raising quality through critique, pairing and clear rationale
* Support junior designers and partner teams with practical design guidance
* Collaborate effectively across US and India time zones in a 100% remote environment

-----------------------
What We Are Looking For
-----------------------

* 5+ years of relevant product design experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, platform, CRM, workflow-heavy or similarly complex digital product environments
* An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates product judgment, systems thinking, customer empathy, high-quality execution and measurable product impact
* Proven experience across the design lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content design and usability testing
* Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality
* Working knowledge of design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions
* Familiarity with AI-assisted design workflows, intelligent interfaces, modern design tooling and fast prototyping practices
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners and other designers
* Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions, incorporate feedback and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft
* Understanding of front-end implementation constraints and the ability to bridge practical gaps between design and code
* Curiosity about users, data, systems, new tools, emerging technologies and better ways for teams to work

------------
How You Work
------------

* You hold yourself to an unusually high bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality
* You move comfortably from customer insight and product strategy to detailed design execution
* You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer
* You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people
* You enjoy collaborating across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates
* You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care and momentum
* You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design

-------------
EEO Statement

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:

This is a senior individual contributor role embedded directly within product engineering and focused on strengthening security throughout the software development lifecycle. You will help secure enterprise products that are deployed across customer-managed environments as well as hosted offerings. The role combines threat modeling, secure coding, vulnerability management, security testing, and software supply-chain security. You will work directly with engineers and product leaders to identify risks early and turn security requirements into practical, scalable solutions. Your work will influence what gets designed, developed, tested, released, and ultimately deployed by customers. * Establish appropriate security review practices for AI-assisted software development, including assessment of AI-generated code and automated remediation workflows.

* Own software composition analysis and SBOM generation, including software provenance and licensing information required by customers and internal stakeholders.

* Collaborate with engineering, product, legal, and other stakeholders to continuously strengthen application security across the product portfolio.

* Recent hands-on experience with AI-assisted development or AI-enabled security tooling, ideally within the last six months.
* Strong understanding of threat modeling and the ability to collaborate with engineering teams during the design stage.
* Experience with static analysis, dynamic application testing, software composition analysis, dependency scanning, and security tooling optimization.
* Knowledge of identity and authentication technologies and protocols such as *OAuth, OIDC, SAML, and SCIM*.
* Experience with coordinated vulnerability disclosure, vulnerability triage, CVE processes, and customer-facing security advisories.
* Strong secure code review capabilities across web applications and APIs.
* Understanding of software supply-chain security, SBOM standards, dependency management, and license compliance.
* Experience with cryptographic reviews, security champion programs, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, or similar security frameworks is advantageous.
* Ability to communicate complex security risks clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders and influence senior engineers effectively.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the judgment to prioritize security risks according to business and technical impact.
* Ability to work independently across multiple product teams while collaborating effectively within a globally distributed organization.

Develop and own Certify's pricing strategy across all products and segments — balancing customer value, competitive dynamics, and revenue growth objectives.

*

Model pricing scenarios for new products, expansions, and enterprise deals — providing finance and sales with clear pricing frameworks that maximize deal velocity without leaving revenue on the table.

*

Design and test pricing experiments (e.g., value-based vs. usage-based models) informed by customer willingness-to-pay data, cohort analysis, and market benchmarks.

*3. Product Portfolio & Packaging Optimization*

*

Evaluate and optimize Certify's product portfolio to ensure packaging, bundling, and feature prioritization align with business goals and maximize revenue per customer.

*

Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities by analyzing product usage data, customer segments, and whitespace in the market — translating findings into actionable packaging recommendations.

*

Monitor product performance metrics continuously and make data-backed recommendations for improvements across pricing, packaging, and feature differentiation.

*4. Product Marketing & Messaging*

*

This is where research meets revenue. You won't hand off insights to a separate team — you'll own the translation of market intelligence into the positioning, messaging, and content that drives pipeline and closes deals.

*

Own Certify's product positioning and messaging framework — defining how each product and capability is described, differentiated, and sold across all buyer segments and personas.

*

Develop and maintain a full library of sales and marketing assets: battlecards, one-pagers, solution briefs, case studies, pitch decks, ROI calculators, and objection-handling guides — built from your own research and updated continuously as the market evolves.

*

Lead go-to-market launches for new products, features, and packaging changes — coordinating with Product, Sales, and Marketing to ensure launches land with clarity and drive measurable adoption.

*

Build and own Certify's buyer persona library — deeply understanding the motivations, objections, evaluation criteria, and success metrics of key decision-makers (health plan medical directors, credentialing ops leaders, procurement, IT, etc.).

*

Develop thought leadership content and market narratives — white papers, market sizing analyses, industry benchmarks — that position Certify as the authoritative voice in the PDM space and support demand generation efforts.

*

Partner with Marketing to ensure campaign messaging is grounded in validated market intelligence and resonates with target segments — bridging the gap between data and creative execution.

*

Support demand generation by identifying the highest-value market segments and building the research-backed targeting rationale that informs campaign strategy and ABM prioritization.

*5. Product Team Integration & Roadmap Influence*

*

This role has a uniquely close relationship with the Product team — functioning as the market-facing counterpart to Product's internal-facing focus. Where Product owns the what and how of the platform, you own the why and for whom — and the two must be deeply integrated.

*

Serve as the primary voice of the market inside product planning — bringing customer research, competitive data, and market sizing into roadmap discussions to ensure investment flows toward the highest-value opportunities.

*

Co-own the product discovery process with Product leadership — designing and running customer research programs (user interviews, surveys, advisory boards) that generate the qualitative and quantitative signals needed to prioritize effectively.

*

Translate product capabilities into market-ready value propositions for every significant release — working hand-in-hand with Product Managers to ensure new features land with clear messaging, adoption materials, and sales training.

*

Maintain a continuous feedback loop between Sales, Customer Success, and Product — capturing field intelligence, win/loss themes, and customer sentiment and synthesizing it into structured quarterly product input reports.

*

Define and track product marketing KPIs — feature adoption rates, enablement utilization, message resonance scores — and use these to continuously refine positioning and packaging recommendations.

*What Success Looks Like*

*

Market Intelligence Velocity: Weekly competitive briefings delivered to leadership; automated reporting pipeline live within 90 days.

*

Pricing Impact: Measurable improvement in ACV and win rates within 6 months of pricing strategy implementation; ≥2 pricing model updates per year informed by data.

*

Portfolio Clarity: 100% of product lines have a documented packaging and tiering rationale; portfolio reviewed and updated quarterly.

*

GTM Enablement: Competitive battlecards and pricing guides maintained for 100% of active competitors; ≥80% of sales reps rating intelligence materials as highly useful in quarterly surveys.

*

Product Marketing Coverage: Full positioning and messaging framework documented and live within 60 days; all major product releases launched with complete go-to-market packages.

*

Revenue Contribution: Research insights directly traceable to at least two new revenue-generating initiatives per year, including upsell opportunities or new segment entry.

*What you’ll need:*

*Must-Have Experience*

*

5–8+ years in competitive intelligence, market research, pricing strategy, or product strategy in a SaaS or technology-driven industry.

*

Demonstrated track record developing and deploying pricing models that improved win rates, ACV, or NRR in a B2B context.

*

Strong analytical skills — fluent in data and able to independently build financial models, analyze usage data, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative signals into crisp recommendations.

*

Background in healthcare SaaS, health plan operations, or provider data — familiarity with credentialing, network management, or regulatory compliance a strong plus.

*

Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams (Product, Sales, Finance, Marketing) and drive strategic decisions without direct authority.

*

Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills — able to distill complex market dynamics into clear, compelling narratives for senior leadership and board-level audiences.

*Preferred Experience*

*

Experience building or scaling a competitive intelligence function from scratch, including designing research processes, tooling, and reporting cadences.

*

Hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate research workflows — e.g., automated monitoring, LLM-powered analysis, or data aggregation pipelines.

*

Familiarity with usage-based or value-based pricing models, willingness-to-pay research methods, or conjoint analysis.

*Our Research & Culture Principles*

*

*Ground Truth First:* No insight without validation. You talk to customers, prospects, and the market — you don’t just read reports.

*

*Insight to Action:* Research without a recommended action is incomplete. You close the loop between intelligence and business impact.

*

*Low Ego, High Standards:* Nothing is beneath you — you dive into the data, own the details, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes.

*

*Prioritize Relentlessly:* The market generates infinite signals. You know which ones matter and focus your energy accordingly.

*

*Deliver A+ Work:* “Good enough” is not our bar. The quality of your research reflects on Certify’s credibility with customers, investors, and partners.

*Benefits of Working at Certify*

*

At Certify, we’re building with intention and taking care of the people doing the work.

*

Your well-being matters to us. We provide 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees. Our US-based team benefits from unlimited PTO, with at least two weeks off each year to recharge. In India, employees are supported with health insurance, statutory leave benefits, and additional wellness (menstrual) leave for women.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to do their best work, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

If you require reasonable accommodations during the application process, please contact recruiting@certifyos.com.

We are also committed to pay transparency and foster an open culture where compensation conversations are encouraged and respected.

title: Account Manager | Strategic
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Strategic Account Manager, you will be responsible for driving the strategy, growth, and overall health of a book of 8–12 of Ramp’s largest and most strategic customers. You’ll own the long-term relationship and be accountable for maintaining and growing revenue, driving product adoption, and ensuring your customers achieve meaningful business outcomes on Ramp.

You’ll build deep relationships across all levels of your customers’ organizations, from day-to-day operators to C-suite executives, and be skilled at managing complex stakeholder dynamics and product configurations. Internally, you’ll partner closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams at Ramp to strengthen our B2B relationships, coordinate strategic initiatives, and feed structured insights into our product roadmap and internal processes.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own a portfolio of 8–12 strategic Enterprise customers, with clear accountability for retention, expansion, and overall account health

- Maintain and grow revenue and usage within your book of business by identifying, pitching, and executing on upsell and cross-sell opportunities

- Build and execute detailed account and territory plans, including QBRs and executive reviews that highlight results, surface risks, and align on future growth

- Lead frequent customer conversations (status calls, roadmap discussions, upsell conversations, and QBRs) to ensure customers are achieving strong outcomes with Ramp

- Own end-to-end execution of renewals and expansions, from discovery and solution design through commercial negotiation and close

- Serve as a Ramp product expert, proactively uncovering workflow gaps and recommending solutions that save customers time and money, while guiding them toward deeper platform adoption

- Partner cross-functionally with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, CSMs, and Solutions to coordinate customer initiatives and deliver tailored, enterprise-grade solutions

- Provide structured feedback to product and leadership teams, translating customer needs and patterns into recommendations that shape Ramp’s Strategic and Enterprise roadmap

- Navigate and align internal and external stakeholders, including C-suite executives, investors, partners, and cross-functional teams

- Use data and analytics to inform your strategy, monitor account performance, and communicate impact and opportunities in a clear, grounded way

WHAT YOU NEED

- 9+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or a similar revenue-focused role

- 3+ years managing strategic Enterprise accounts (2,500+ employees or Fortune 1000) with proven commercial ownership

- Strong familiarity with Fintech, Payments, Finance/Accounting, or B2B SaaS products

- Demonstrated success negotiating and closing complex six-figure renewals and upsells

- Ability to understand and communicate complex product workflows, integrations, and technical configurations

- High fluency in financial value drivers — able to articulate ROI, payback periods, process modernization, and cost savings

- Deep sense of ownership with the ability to build processes, playbooks, and documentation from 0→1 as strategic customers push the limits of Ramp’s platform and require new, scalable solutions

- Strong executive communication and storytelling skills with the ability to influence cross-functionally and at the C-suite

- Consistent track record of hitting or exceeding revenue targets in fast-paced environments

- Operates with urgency, grit, and ownership; thrives in environments with innovation, change, and ambiguity

- Willingness to travel for customer on-sites, events, and internal team summits

NICE TO HAVES

- Experience in financial services sales or selling to finance teams (e.g., Office of the CFO, accounting, controllers, expense management).

- Experience at a high-growth startup

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

- In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: Business Development Manager, SME & Growth
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

ABOUT THE TEAM:

Airwallex aspires to serve the fastest growing businesses globally. The SME & Growth team focuses on bringing in new startups and small-to-mid-market businesses onto the Airwallex platform. You will leverage your skills in pitching, solutioning, and negotiating with customers to grow our business in the region while helping business owners, finance teams, and e-commerce teams improve their financial operations. We are looking for someone who has a passion for building relationships, selling, and negotiating, and a desire to revolutionize the way companies transact globally.

If you have a customer-first mentality, are solution-focused, obsessively curious about everything, and have the desire to make an impact and grow yourself, our market, and our customers, then you have found your calling!

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Identify high-potential prospects and use effective strategies to generate leads that drive revenue growth.

- Develop and implement scalable sales strategies to drive new customer acquisition.

- Identify and understand prospects' pain points to propose solutions, owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to close.

- Lead commercial negotiations to increase customer revenue.

- Develop strategies to maximize acquisition of new revenue and market share within a specified territory.

- Ensure the best onboarding process and customer experience for new customers, working cross-functionally to solve customer pain points and improve our product.

- Maintain a database of current and potential customers using our CRM.

REQUIREMENTS:

- 5+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a complex product with a track record of top performance.

- Passionate about sales with the ability to develop and execute strategies for a particular territory.

- Experience identifying and influencing key decision makers and stakeholders from finance managers to CEOs, with strong presentation and communication skills.

- Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving multiple products.

- Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment.

- Strong interest in technology/financial services and a deep understanding of the space.

- Success-oriented and are willing to "go the extra mile" in your work as needed to achieve results.

title: Director of Engineering - Traffic & Networking
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a visionary Director of Traffic and Networking to lead the group responsible for the very circulatory system of our global cloud infrastructure.

THE MISSION

Every query, every login, every byte of data in Snowflake's Data Cloud travels through the systems this team builds. The Traffic & Networking group is responsible for the ingress, egress, domain management, and internal networking layers that connect thousands of customers to Snowflake across public and private connectivity paths. We build and deploy software to enable seamless service-to-service and user-to-service communication across all traffic types spanning every environment and cloud provider Snowflake touches. Your goal is to ensure robust domain management, efficient traffic flow, and reliable connectivity while relentlessly improving product velocity, and operational efficiency.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

As a senior engineering leader at Snowflake, you will be expected to:

- Set the Strategic Vision: Define the roadmap for Snowflake’s networking foundation and be accountable for the execution of complex plans and deliverables.

- Scale Infrastructure: Guide your team in building software solutions that automate and scale networking across multiple cloud providers including AWS, Azure, and GCP.

- Drive Innovation: Lead projects from initial idea through design and implementation, collaborating with teams in the US, Ireland, Poland, and beyond.

- Technical Leadership: Provide deep technical expertise with a focus on high-performance, security, and the abstraction of complex cloud networking layers.

- Build the Team: Actively recruit, hire, and grow a diverse team of industry veterans and rising stars.

- Mentorship: Be responsible for the career development of your reports through continuous coaching and mentorship.

- Operational Excellence: Shift resources dynamically to respond to production issues and customer needs, ensuring high levels of reliability.

YOUR PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

We are looking for an exceptional leader who views infrastructure through a product development lens.

- Experience: 15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in engineering management leading leaders.

- Distributed Systems Expertise: Proven track record in designing systems and managing large-scale production infrastructure with a focus on networking, compute, or storage

- Cloud Fluency: Strong hands-on experience with cloud service providers.

- SaaS Background: Deep experience working at scale within a multi-tenant or multi-single-tenant SaaS model, handling billions of complex queries and massive traffic ingress/egress.

- Communication: Excellent collaboration skills to bridge the gap between complex networking requirements and cross-functional business goals.

- Education: BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

WHY JOIN THIS TEAM?

- Impact: You're actively evolving a network architecture, building new observability capabilities, modernizing legacy infrastructure, and designing the next-generation connectivity model across multiple clouds. Every Snowflake team depends on what this group ships. Infrastructure is our product.

- Growth: This role will push your technical and leadership boundaries in an environment that values practical decision-making and creativity.

- Security First: You will play a critical role in upholding Snowflake’s high standards for data security and confidentiality.

- Builder's Culture: We ship our own proxy infrastructure, our own service discovery, our own network automation. This is a build role for someone who wants to own the full traffic stack.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

title: Junior Designer (Packaging & Print - US)
description:
*Position Type:* Full-time

*Location:* Philippines (Remote)

*Work Schedule* : 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday, with a minimum four-hour daily overlap with US Eastern business hours (NYC). Remaining hours are flexible and may be split, provided the agreed overlap window is consistent and communicated to the team.

*About the Company*

Our client is a custom fine fragrance brand that helps customers create a scent that is uniquely their own. Through US retail studios and an at-home experience, customers explore core fragrances, personalize their blend, and name their scent. Saved formulas make it easy to reorder their custom fragrance.

With a growing eCommerce presence and a bold, modern, playful visual identity, the brand brings its personalized approach to fragrance, gifting, body products, and home fragrance. Its small creative team collaborates across packaging, retail experiences, campaigns, and digital channels.

----------------
*About the Role*
----------------

We are in search of a *Junior Designer* with a strong foundation in print production and packaging design to support our client's custom fragrance brand. Reporting to the Creative Team Lead Lead, you will primarily adapt existing designs and prepare accurate, *production-ready artwork for packaging, labels, and other print materials*. More than 90% of the initial work will involve adapting existing designs, with approximately 80–90% of the workload focused on print and packaging. You will also support printer and vendor coordination, with opportunities to develop digital and retail design skills and take on more creative ownership over time.

------------------
*Responsibilities*
------------------

*

*Print Production:* Prepare and check production-ready artwork with accurate bleeds, dielines, and printer specifications, ensuring files are ready for production.

*

*Design Adaptation:* Adapt existing layouts into color, size, and format variations efficiently while maintaining accuracy and brand consistency.

*

*Packaging Design:* Adapt labels, gift boxes, rigid cartons, and die-cut packaging formats under the Design Lead's direction and in line with the brand's visual identity.

*

*Printer and Vendor Coordination:* Work toward ownership of printer and production vendor communication, source vendors when needed, and coordinate artwork handoffs through to print.

*

*Digital and Retail Support: A* dapt existing designs for social content, email graphics, advertising assets, web banners, signage, and retail displays as needed, with guidance and training from the Design Lead.

*

*Campaign and Launch Support:* Prepare primarily print and packaging collateral, along with supporting digital assets, for seasonal campaigns and product launches.

*

*Asset Management:* Keep working files, versions, and final assets clearly organized and accessible; support photo retouching where skills allow.

*

*Creative Development:* Build familiarity with the brand and support occasional mixed-media, tactile, or original concept explorations as creative ownership develops.

*

*Collaboration and Delivery:* Follow creative direction, incorporate constructive feedback, and communicate progress and agreed deadlines.

---------------------------------
*Competencies and Qualifications*
---------------------------------

-----------
*Must-Have*
-----------

*

*2–5 years* of professional design experience, with a strong foundation in *print production* and preparing artwork for print.

*

Proficiency in *Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign* for everyday design and production work.

*

Solid print production knowledge, including *bleeds, dielines, and press-ready file* preparation.

*

Ability to adapt existing designs and prepare accurate print and packaging files, with willingness to learn digital and retail formats.

*

Experience with, or a strong interest in, product and packaging design.

*

Strong visual judgment, attention to detail, and brand consistency; an action-oriented approach and organized file and asset management habits.

*

Ability to execute straightforward adaptations and repeated asset variations accurately within practical deadlines.

*

Openness to learning and experimenting with AI-assisted creative tools; prior AI experience is not required.

*

Proficient written and spoken English; a collaborative, adaptable working style; openness to constructive feedback; and availability for a minimum four-hour daily overlap with US Eastern business hours.

*Nice-to-Have*

*

Motion design or light video editing skills using After Effects, Premiere, or CapCut.

*

Proficiency in Figma.

*

3D design or modeling skills.

*

Familiarity with eCommerce or direct-to-consumer brand environments.

*

Experience with digital creative, retail displays, or experiential design concepts.

*

Photo retouching skills; generative AI or AI-assisted asset creation experience; or experience with mixed-media and tactile exploration.

---------------
*What We Offer*
---------------

*

100% Remote Work

*

13th Month Pay

*

Healthcare (HMO)

*

Comprehensive Fringe Benefits package

*

Paid Service Incentive Leave (SIL)

*

Paid Philippines Holidays

*

Free Learning and Development Programs

---------------------
*Application Process*
---------------------

We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and we’re here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible.

The recruitment process includes a Recruiter Interview, Portfolio Review, and Client Interview with the Design Lead (Olivia). A short practical design task may be requested, subject to confirmation following portfolio review, with the aim of keeping it to approximately one hour. The final client stages will be confirmed, and we will keep you informed throughout the process.

title: Junior Software Engineer (Remote)
description:
Overview of the role

We’re on a mission to modernize insurance, making it simpler, more accessible, and customer-first. The insurance industry is a $1T market that’s remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here to change that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re building the future of insurance in Canada and beyond.

We're building a groundbreaking new product line that will transform the insurance broker experience through AI and machine learning. As an AI-Driven Full Stack Engineer, you'll be part of a team charting new territory - designing and implementing intelligent systems that automate manual processes and unlock powerful data-driven insights.

You will work across the stack, contributing to front end, back end, and AI/ML initiatives, while also participating in architecture discussions, release planning, and company-wide engineering initiatives. Our core stack includes *Python, React, Redux, PostgreSQL, n8n, LangChain/LangGraph and AWS* , and we are always open to adopting new tools and technologies that help us deliver better results.

What you'll be doing:
---------------------

* Develop full stack features for our AI-powered web application using Python, React, Redux, PostgreSQL and AWS
* Integrate AI models and APIs for tasks like document processing, data extraction, recommendation engines etc.
* Work closely with Sr. Engineers experienced in AI to seamlessly integrate models into production
* Stay current on emerging AI technologies/frameworks and explore new applications
* Build scalable, reliable backend services to fuel our AI workflows
* Create intuitive user experiences that surface AI-powered capabilities
* Participate in architecture planning, code reviews, and ideation sessions
* Take ownership of feature development end-to-end (once ramped up), coordinating with QA and other teams
* Engage in cross-team communication to help unblock dependencies and improve release flow
* Share ideas during quarterly planning to help shape what we build next
* Participate in company-wide initiatives such as hackathons, engineering guilds, and AI tooling experiments

What we are looking for:
------------------------

* Strong full-stack development skills with the ability to work across backend and frontend using *Python, React, Redux, PostgreSQL, and AWS*
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts from coursework, side projects, or work experience
* Passion for building intelligent applications that solve real-world problems
* Eagerness to learn, embrace ambiguity, and continually upskill in a rapidly evolving space
* Hands-on experience or projects interacting with AI APIs/models (e.g. prompt engineering)
* Self-starter with a career-driven mindset who thrives in an environment with autonomy and accountability
* Collaborative team player with low ego who is open to feedback and eager to help others
* Detail-oriented approach to problem-solving, especially in complex domains

Why join us:
------------

* Generous PTO - 20 vacation days
* A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe
* Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential
* An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry
* Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!)
* Access to stock options based on performance
* *Compensation:* The total target cash compensation for this role is *$80,000–$110,000 CAD* , based on experience. We’ll walk through the details together during the interview.

About PolicyMe
--------------

At PolicyMe, we are Canada’s leading digital insurance solution, offering straightforward and affordable financial protection for families from coast to coast. Our product suite includes Life Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance and Health & Dental Insurance, all tailored to Canadians' evolving needs. We also offer B2B2C solutions, partnering with organizations to provide seamless digital insurance options. Founded by a team of insurance experts and technology entrepreneurs, PolicyMe is committed to making insurance simpler and more accessible. Since our launch in 2018, we have grown exponentially, selling over $10 billion in insurance coverage to Canadians.

We are proud of the team we’ve built and are excited for those that are yet to join us. We operate with a remote-first culture, attracting top talent from across Canada. If you’re looking for a fast-paced, collaborative environment, working alongside incredibly ambitious yet humble humans, we may be the right place for you! To learn more, visit www.policyme.com.

Additional Notes
----------------

- Job Vacancy: This role reflects growth in our team and expanded operational scope. We’re hiring to support increasing demand and continue delivering an exceptional customer experience.

- Commitment to Equal Opportunity: PolicyMe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and provide fair consideration regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

- Accessibility Statement: We are committed to providing an accessible hiring experience. If you require accommodations during the application process, please indicate this in the “Additional Information” section of your application.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
PT Auditech Business Solutions adalah perusahaan penyedia solusi teknologi dan rekayasa perangkat lunak terintegrasi yang berfokus pada *digitalisasi proses bisnis* , *otomatisasi sistem* , serta *solusi teknologi informasi enterprise* berstandar tinggi. Kami berkomitmen membantu bisnis berkembang melalui arsitektur perangkat lunak yang andal, efisien, dan berskala besar.

Saat ini, kami membuka kesempatan bagi talenta teknis yang bersemangat, adaptif, dan berorientasi pada kualitas untuk bergabung sebagai *Junior Software Engineer* di tim kami.

*Pengembangan & Arsitektur Perangkat Lunak*
Merancang, membangun, dan memelihara aplikasi web serta sistem backend dan frontend yang responsif, modern, aman, serta memiliki performa dan skalabilitas tinggi.

*Integrasi Sistem & API*
Membangun RESTful API dan microservices, serta mengintegrasikan third-party services dan basis data pendukung agar aliran data antar-sistem berjalan seamless.

*Pemeliharaan Kode & Optimasi*
Melakukan code maintenance, refactoring, code review, troubleshooting, serta pengujian berkala untuk menjaga keandalan dan kebersihan basis kode (clean code).

*Kolaborasi Remote*
Bekerja secara mandiri maupun berkolaborasi erat dengan tim lintas fungsi secara jarak jauh, dengan mengedepankan efisiensi, transparansi komunikasi, dan ketepatan waktu.

Kualifikasi Utama
-----------------

*Keahlian Teknis (Hands-on)*
Memiliki kemampuan praktis yang kuat dalam software engineering secara menyeluruh. Terbuka untuk semua tingkat pengalaman/senioritas — penilaian berdasarkan kompetensi, logika, dan portofolio.

*Fondasi Pengembangan Web & Logika*
Menguasai dasar-dasar rekayasa web modern, algoritma pemecahan masalah, serta arsitektur perangkat lunak yang efisien.

*Problem Solving & Attention to Detail*
Memiliki analisis logika yang tajam, pemahaman menyeluruh terhadap alur data (user interface maupun backend logic), serta mampu menyelesaikan kendala teknis secara mandiri.

*Manajemen Kerja Remote*
Memiliki integritas tinggi, kedisiplinan mandiri (self-management), serta kemampuan komunikasi profesional di lingkungan kerja jarak jauh.

Menguasai atau berpengalaman dengan framework frontend/fullstack modern seperti *React* , *Next.js* , atau *Angular*.

Berpengalaman atau memiliki pemahaman solid dalam pengembangan backend berbasis *PHP (Laravel/Symfony)* atau bahasa lain seperti *Node.js* , *Python* , atau *Go*.

Memahami pengelolaan basis data relasional ( *MySQL/PostgreSQL* ), integrasi REST API, dan dasar-dasar query optimization.

Mengenal version control ( *Git* ), *Deployment/CI-CD* , atau kontainerisasi ( *Docker* ).

*Full Remote (Work From Anywhere)*
Fleksibilitas penuh dalam memilih lokasi kerja, mendukung keseimbangan kehidupan kerja (work-life balance).

*Subscription AI Premium*
Akses ke alat bantu pengembang berbasis AI (seperti Claude Code, Cursor, atau OpenAI Codex) untuk mendukung efisiensi koding dan eksplorasi teknologi.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
*
Join Colibri Digital
*

Born in the cloud, Colibri is one of the fastest-growing Cloud Consultancies in the UK. We are Select partners with AWS and our recent attainment of Gold competency with Microsoft proves our excellence in evolving cloud and data technologies.

Our culture is built around trust, continuous learning and technical excellence. You'll work alongside experienced consultants who are passionate about developing people and sharing knowledge, giving you the opportunity to accelerate your career from day one.
*
Please Note:
*

To be considered for this opportunity, you *must* :
* Have the unrestricted right to work in the UK ( *we are unable to offer visa sponsorship* for this position).
* *Be based in the UK and be able to travel to London* when required for team collaboration, training and customer engagements.
* *Have approximately 6–12 months' practical experience in industry* , ideally software engineering through a placement year, internship, graduate programme or similar commercial experience.
* Recent graduates *with relevant placement or internship experience* are strongly encouraged to apply.
*Appreciate if you can apply only if you fit the above criteria.

About the Role
*

We're looking for an ambitious *Graduate Data Engineer* to join our growing Data Engineering Practice.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone at the start of their career who is passionate about technology and wants to become a data engineering consultant.

During your first 12 months, you'll follow a structured development programme combining formal technical training, mentoring and hands-on engineering experience. You'll develop practical skills across SQL, Python, Git, Databricks, Azure and modern cloud data engineering before progressing into customer-facing consultancy work.

Initially, you'll take ownership of internal engineering initiatives including reporting, reusable frameworks, engineering assets and technical documentation. As your capability develops, you'll begin contributing to customer projects alongside our experienced consultants.

This role has been created to strengthen our internal engineering capability whilst providing an accelerated development pathway into consulting.
*What You’ll Be Doing*

* Develop and maintain internal reporting solutions that support operational and business decision-making.
* Build, maintain and improve reusable engineering frameworks, templates and accelerators.
* Produce high-quality technical documentation, standards and engineering guidance.
* Support the development of internal tooling that improves delivery consistency and engineering quality.
* Learn and apply data engineering best practices through structured mentoring and formal training.
* Work alongside experienced Data Engineers to understand cloud data platforms and modern engineering techniques.
* Participate in code reviews and technical knowledge sharing.
* Shadow customer workshops and consulting engagements.
* Gradually contribute to customer delivery projects as your technical capability develops.
* Continuously build your technical knowledge across Cloud, Data and AI technologies.

*What You'll Learn*
Our structured development programme will provide hands-on experience across:

* SQL
* Python
* Git
* Databricks
* Azure Data Services
* Data modelling
* ETL & ELT engineering
* CI/CD fundamentals
* Data engineering best practices
* Technical documentation
* Consulting and stakeholder management
* Customer delivery

*Requirements*

*Essential*

* Degree (or expected degree) in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics or another relevant STEM subject.
* Approximately 6–12 months' practical experience through a placement year, internship or graduate programme.
* Basic knowledge of SQL.
* Basic knowledge of Python.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Genuine enthusiasm for Cloud, Data Engineering and AI technologies.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Willingness to learn and continuously develop.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

*Desirable*

* Exposure to Azure, AWS or Databricks.
* Experience using Git or other version control systems.
* Understanding of relational databases and data modelling.
* Familiarity with ETL/ELT concepts.
* Experience gained through university projects, hackathons or personal development.
* The Ideal Candidate
* We're looking for someone who is:
* Curious and eager to learn.
* Passionate about technology.
* Comfortable asking questions and learning from experienced colleagues.
* Organised with excellent attention to detail.
* A natural problem solver.
* Collaborative and enjoys working within a team.
* Interested in building a long-term career in Data Engineering and Consulting.

*Working Pattern
*
This is a primarily remote role. However, you'll be expected to attend our London office and customer locations when required for collaboration, training, workshops and team events.
*What You’ll Get*

* Competitive salary.
* Structured graduate development programme.
* Dedicated mentoring from experienced consultants.
* Exposure to modern Cloud, Data and AI technologies.
* Opportunity to work alongside recognised technical experts.
* Clear career progression into a customer-facing Data Engineering Consultant role.
* Regular technical training and certification support.
* Flexible remote working with regular team meet-ups and socials.
* A collaborative culture focused on learning, innovation and technical excellence.

*
Why Join Colibri?
*
At Colibri Digital, you'll join a consultancy where learning is continuous, collaboration is encouraged and your development is genuinely invested in. You'll work on modern cloud technologies, solve complex customer problems and build a career alongside some of the industry's most experienced Cloud, Data and AI consultants.

If you're looking for more than just a graduate role, and want to kick-start a career in consulting, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Junior Business Analyst–Fish & Wildlife Ecological Services
description:
----------------
Responsibilities
----------------

Peraton is seeking a *Junior Business Analyst* with experience in federal environmental systems to support requirements analysis and stakeholder coordination on behalf of the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), part of the Department of the Interior, which manages fish, wildlife, and habitats across the United States, on a federal data integration program. You will work closely with the FWS BA SME to document workflows, develop user stories, and support approval tracking activities.

The Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.

*Work Location:* Remote

*Day to Day Responsibilities:*

* Support the FWS BA SME in documenting current-state FWS consultation workflows, decision logic structures, and template formats.
* Conduct detailed analysis of existing platform decision logic to identify all updates required for NOAA Fisheries species integration.
* Document FWS-specific user stories and acceptance criteria for UI updates, logic changes, and template modifications.
* Assist in facilitating FWS ES requirements workshops and capturing meeting notes, decisions, and action items.
* Support the development of pilot consultation scenarios for FWS-side consultation types.
* Assist in tracking FWS ES review and approval activities for deliverables requiring FWS sign-off.
* Support the development of FWS-facing training materials and job aids.
* Maintain traceability matrices linking FWS requirements to implemented features and test cases.
* Assist in compiling FWS-specific content for progress reports and the year-end final report.

--------------

*Basic Qualifications:*

* Bachelor’s degree and 2 years of professional experience, or a Master’s degree and 0 years of professional experience, or an Associate’s degree and 4 years of professional experience, or a High School diploma/equivalent and 6 years of professional experience.
* U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; all work must be performed within the United States.
* Experience supporting business analysis experience on federal IT programs.
* Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements documentation.
* Strong facilitation support and meeting documentation skills.
* Experience maintaining requirements traceability matrices.

*Preferred Experience:*

* Familiarity with FWS Ecological Services processes or Endangered Species Act Section 7 consultation workflows.
* Direct experience with the IPaC platform or FWS IT systems.
* Experience supporting federal environmental regulatory programs.
* Experience contributing to program status reports or monthly progress reports.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies.
* ECBA or CCBA certification.

The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

title: UI/UX Designer (12 mos. Contract)
description:
*Reports to:* Creative Lead
*Location:* Remote (U.S.); West Coast preferred or PST hours required.

*About the Role*

NETGEAR (Consumer division) is building an in-house creative team to own digital design work end to end. The team is small on purpose: a Creative Lead, a UI Designer, a Graphic Designer, and a copywriter.

This is the digital design seat, focused on the direct-to-consumer side of . It is a transactional storefront, so the work carries real conversion pressure. You will design and ship interface work for web, working inside an established atomic design system rather than starting from a blank canvas each time.

Our team owns the web UI system. You will be the person working in it day to day: building with it, extending it, and keeping it coherent as the site grows.

You will have access to website analytics and performance data, and you will work alongside our Lead of Consumer Insights, whose findings should feed directly into design decisions. Your job is to take what all of that tells us and make it show up in the interface.

Working inside an established system does not mean only assembling from what already exists. We expect you to spot where the system falls short of what a page actually needs, and to design new components that fit the existing logic rather than working around it.

Our app is owned by a separate product team. You will not design app screens, but you will work with them to keep web and app visually consistent.

*What you will do*

*

Design and ship UI across the consumer side of , from wireframe through to developer-ready handoff. The work spans campaign and product landing pages, category and listing pages, product detail pages, media and content pages, and the interface for our product finder tools.

*

Work in our atomic web design system: build with existing components, extend it where the system does not yet cover what a page needs, and keep new work consistent with what is already there.

*

Maintain our web Figma libraries, keeping components, variants, and tokens clean, documented, and usable by everyone touching the files.

*

Work with the front-end team who build and own the website itself: hand off designs in a state they can implement, check feasibility before committing to an approach, and review designs in staging before they go live.

*

Use website analytics and consumer insights research as inputs to design decisions.

*

Design new web components and suggest design improvements to our pages.

*

Collaborate with the Graphic Designer so that campaign work and site experience feel like the same brand.

*

Work closely with our Sr. Integrated Marketing Manager, who is responsible for global campaigns, so that site work lines up with what campaigns are driving.

*

Use AI tools as part of your workflow where they genuinely speed things up.

*

Give occasional design direction to other teams who maintain their own pages and want them to stay consistent with . Advisory, not production.

*

Work with the app team, who own the app UI system, to keep styles, icons, colours, and typography consistent across web and app.

*What we are looking for*

*

4+ years designing digital products or marketing interfaces. Direct-to-consumer ecommerce or consumer tech experience is a plus, but not a requirement.

*

Deep Figma skills, specifically with libraries: components, variants, auto layout, and tokens. You should be comfortable working inside an established system and maintaining its structure and documentation as you go.

*

Genuine interest in AI and a habit of testing new tools as they appear. We want someone who follows how AI is developing in design, particularly the AI capabilities landing in Figma, tries them properly rather than reading about them, and brings back what actually works.

*

A portfolio of shipped web work, with enough detail that we can see your reasoning and not just the final screens.

*

Current on UI patterns and conventions, with judgment about which trends are worth adopting and which are noise.

*

Able to ground design decisions in research and analytics, and to explain the reasoning behind them.

*

Comfortable presenting your own work. You will walk stakeholders through your designs yourself, explain the thinking behind them, and handle questions and pushback in the room rather than routing everything through the Creative Lead.

*

A working understanding of front-end implementation and a skill to design system components that a back-end team can develop.

*

A positive, curious attitude and a real appetite for learning. We support training on new tools, AI in particular.

*

Clear communication with engineers, product, and stakeholders who are not designers.

*Nice to have*

*

Prototyping and interaction design skills.

*

Familiarity with accessibility standards and how they constrain component design.

*How we work*

Fully remote, PST hours. The team works from a shared project board in and in short review cycles rather than long agency-style handoffs. You will have direct access to the Creative Lead and to partner teams, and you are expected to use it.

Tooling is provided, including Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, and a Magnific seat, so you are not funding your own AI tools. We support training on new tools, particularly AI.

*Company Statement/Values:*

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.

We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the Next Gear by living our values: we *Dare to Transform* the future, *Connect and Delight* our customers, *Communicate Courageously* with each other and collaborate to *Win It Together*. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.

We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity.

NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

In this hands-on role, you will lead end-to-end UX design, combining qualitative research, quantitative data, and interaction design to solve complex user problems. You will collaborate with product managers, researchers, data analysts, and engineers within a globally distributed team. Your work will turn user insights and product analytics into actionable design strategies, validated prototypes, and measurable improvements. Lead end-to-end UX design for product areas, from discovery and problem definition through research, validation, high-fidelity design, and developer handoff.

title: UI Technical Designer (Unreal Engine 5)
description:
We are seeking a *UI Technical Designer* to help translate UX/visual direction into implementable UI specifications and prototypes for Unreal Engine. In this role, you'll work between design and engineering, contributing to flows, interaction behavior, navigation rules, and component standards that ship across platforms and input methods.

Responsibilities
----------------

* Contribute to UI flows, user journeys, and interaction models for in-game screens and features; produce clear, implementable specs
* Help build and maintain a UI component system (patterns, components, variants, states) that supports consistent implementation
* Document behavior rules: navigation/focus order, back behavior, input handling expectations, error/empty/loading states, and common edge cases
* Collaborate regularly with client engineers and UI artists to ensure designs are feasible, performant, and consistent in-engine
* Support iteration and polish: review implementations, provide feedback, and adjust designs based on technical constraints and playtest/QA findings

* Basic understanding of Unreal UI constraints and workflows
* Familiarity with UMG concepts (layout, anchors, scaling, widget states/animations) sufficient to design with engine realities in mind
* Awareness of focus-based navigation and multi-input requirements (controller + keyboard/mouse)
* Experience designing responsive UI for multiple resolutions/aspect ratios and safe-area considerations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

Nice to have

* Exposure to UI systems/framework conventions used in Unreal (e.g., screen stacks, activatable views, common navigation patterns)

* Understanding of accessibility/readability considerations (contrast, font sizing, couch-distance UI)
