title: Terms of Reference: Layout and Production Designer
description:
NESsT is seeking an independent consultant or design studio to develop the visual concept, editorial layout, and final production files for a premium, photography-driven coffee table book featuring human-centered stories, enterprise profiles, and impact data. NESsTwill provide the approved English manuscript, publication structure, pre-selected photography, impact data, and brand assets. The selected designer will transform these materials into a cohesive publication for print and digital distribution.

Assignment type: Independent consultant or design studio
Location: Remote. Applicants based in Latin America and Central & Eastern Europe are particularly encouraged to apply.
Contract period: November 2–December 11, 2026
Submission deadline: October 18, 2026

Objective

The designer or studio will develop the visual concept, editorial layout, and final production files for an approximately 80–120-page publication. The design should be photography-driven, human-centered, contemporary, and appropriate for donor, investor, partner, and institutional audiences.

Scope of Work

* Develop a cohesive visual and editorial design system, including representative layouts.

* Design the complete 80–120-page publication, including covers, front and back matter, chapter openings, longform stories, profiles, photo-led spreads, and impact pages.

* Integrate NESsT-supplied photography, captions, credits, impact data, and brand assets.

* Create a limited number of simple publication-ready charts, maps, timelines, statistics, and callouts using approved NESsT data.

* Flow and copyfit the approved English manuscript and incorporate revisions through formal review checkpoints.

* Prepare final print-ready and digital files.

This assignment excludes substantive writing, copyediting, translation, photography commissioning, extensive image research or retouching, printing, physical proofs, shipping, and interactive digital formats.

Key Deliverables

* Approved visual and editorial design system and representative layouts.

* By December 1: a release-ready digital package containing the introduction, ten longform stories, associated impact pages, and supporting front matter.

* By December 11: the complete publication layout, one print-ready PDF, one optimized digital PDF, and organized editable source files.

Required Qualifications

* At least five years of professional publication or editorial design experience.

* Advanced proficiency in Adobe InDesign and relevant Adobe Creative Cloud applications.

* Strong experience with complete, long-form, multi-section print publications.

* Demonstrated ability to use typography, photography, pacing, and page composition to create a cohesive editorial narrative.

* Experience with photography-intensive publications, information design, commercial printing, color management, prepress, and production-file preparation.

* Strong attention to detail, file management, quality control, deadline management, and ability to work with a distributed international team.

Applicants must demonstrate substantial experience designing complete, long-form print publications. Experience limited to brochures, one-pagers, websites, presentation decks, social media assets, or short reports will not be sufficient on its own.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with nonprofit, foundation, social entrepreneurship, international development, ESG, or impact-investing organizations.

* Experience designing donor-facing impact communications and stewardship materials.

* Experience with coffee table books, museum publications, foundation reports, premium annual reports, or comparable publications.

* Ability to translate complex social, environmental, and economic impact narratives into compelling visual experiences.

Proposal Requirements

Applicants should submit a complete proposal that includes: a brief statement of interest and approach; three to five completed editorial publications, including at least two publications exceeding 60 pages and at least one photography-driven publication for a premium audience; portfolio details for each example; team composition, if applying as a studio; a fixed-fee budget with assumptions, exclusions, taxes, reimbursable costs, and third-party expenses; and confirmation of availability to meet the December 1 and December 11 deadlines.

title: Graphic Designer (12 mos. Contract)
description:
*Reports to:* Creative Lead
*Location:* Remote (U.S.); West Coast preferred or PST hours required.

*About the role*

NETGEAR is building an in-house creative team to own campaign, web, and social work end to end. The team is small on purpose: a Creative Lead, a UI Designer, a Graphic Designer, and a copywriter.

This work supports the Consumer-facing side of NETGEAR. You will be the main person responsible for execution and production across what the team makes: web assets, social, paid ads, campaign work, email templates, retail signage, and event booth graphics. In a given month you might move from a paid social set to a booth graphic to a product landing page.

Everything runs to established NETGEAR brand guidelines. The craft is in making distinctive work within those rules rather than around them.

You will also work with the Creative Lead on campaign concepts and help shape where the brand goes next. We are looking for someone who brings ideas, not only someone who executes them well.

*What you will do*

*

Design assets across web, social, paid ads, email templates, campaign work, retail signage, event graphics, and sales collateral, working from briefs and alongside the UI Designer and Creative Lead.

*

Contribute creative ideas. Bring concepts into campaign discussions with the Creative Lead, and propose directions of your own.

*

Adapt campaign concepts into full asset sets across formats, sizes, and channels.

*

Work to NETGEAR brand guidelines across everything you produce, applying them consistently and helping extend the system as new needs come up.

*

Prepare and hand off production-ready files for both screen and print.

*

Use AI tools as a working part of your process, for ideation, iteration, and production. Fluency is welcome, but a genuine interest in the tools and a willingness to build them into how you work matters more. What we do expect is the judgment to recognize when AI output falls short of the standard required and needs to be reworked by hand.

*

Collaborate directly with project stakeholders across marketing, product, and web, and incorporate their feedback into revisions.

*

Work closely with our Sr. Integrated Marketing Manager, who is responsible for global campaigns, so that what you produce fits the wider campaign plan.

*What we are looking for*

*

4+ years of professional graphic design experience, ideally in-house or brand-side. Consumer tech, DTC, or ecommerce experience is a strong plus.

*

A portfolio showing volume and range, not just showpiece work. We want to see campaign systems, social sets, and web assets, and hear what the constraints were.

*

Strong fluency in Figma. Most of our digital assets are designed there, so this is the tool you will spend most of your time in. Solid Adobe Creative Cloud skills alongside it.

*

Strong interest in AI, backed by practical experience using it in a design workflow. You should be following how the tools are developing, testing new ones as they appear rather than reading about them, and bringing back what actually works.

*

A sharp eye for detail. Spacing, alignment, typography, and colour handled precisely, and errors caught before they reach a stakeholder or a printer.

*

Ideas of your own. We want to see concept thinking in your portfolio, not only well-executed versions of someone else’s direction.

*

Comfortable working to an existing brand system rather than reinventing one per project.

*

A positive, curious attitude and a real appetite for learning. We support training on new tools, AI in particular.

*

Reliable under a queue. You can hold several projects at different stages and keep the status visible without being chased.

*Nice to have*

*

Video and motion. This is a direction we want to push, and the role may grow toward it over time, but we are hiring a designer, not a videographer. Any motion or editing experience is a real benefit, and familiarity with AI video and editing tools is especially so.

*

Print production experience: bleed, colour profiles, and preparing files to a printer’s spec. Useful from day one, but we can teach it if the rest is there.

*

Experience working alongside a design system or component library.

*How we work*

Fully remote, PST hours. The team works from a shared project board in and in short review cycles rather than long agency-style handoffs. You will have direct access to the Creative Lead and to stakeholders, and you are expected to use it.

Tooling is provided, including Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, and a Magnific seat, so you are not funding your own AI tools. We support training on new tools, particularly AI.

*Company Statement/Values:*

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.

We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the Next Gear by living our values: we *Dare to Transform* the future, *Connect and Delight* our customers, *Communicate Courageously* with each other and collaborate to *Win It Together*. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.

We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity.

NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Senior Product Manager - Workflow Core
description:
*About us*
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

*Our people*
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

*Our impact*
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

*About the Team*
----------------

The Workflows Module is the key component of HighLevel’s automation engine, enabling agencies and businesses to create powerful, automated workflows that enhance efficiency, save time, and improve outcomes. By integrating with multiple product areas within the HighLevel platform, the Workflows Module empowers users to streamline processes, nurture leads, and manage tasks seamlessly.

As part of the team, you’ll work on improving existing capabilities within workflows, conceptualizing new workflow features, and delivering solutions that drive adoption, activation, and business growth. The team is committed to optimizing user experience, increasing efficiency, and helping customers get the most value out of HighLevel.

About the Role
--------------

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Workflows Team. This role is perfect for a self-driven individual who is passionate about automation and SaaS products. As a SPM, you will help build impactful features and refine existing capabilities in the Workflows Module, making it easier for users to automate complex business processes.

You will work closely with Product Managers and cross-functional teams to understand user pain points, develop innovative solutions, and ensure seamless execution. You will play a critical role in driving product success by leveraging data, user insights, and collaborative teamwork.

*Your Responsibilities*
-----------------------

You will own key parts of the Workflows product experience across activation, builder usability, execution reliability, and long-term engagement. This includes identifying high-impact opportunities across the workflow funnel, simplifying complex automation journeys, and partnering with cross-functional teams to ship scalable improvements that help customers automate more of their business operations.

*

Workflow Funnel Optimization: Identify and close gaps from workflow creation to execution to improve activation and adoption rates across accounts.

*

Time to Value Acceleration: Drive initiatives that make it faster and easier for users to launch their first meaningful automation.

*

Retention & Engagement: Lead efforts to make workflows a sticky, high-usage product that users return to regularly.

*

Builder Simplicity & Usability: Champion ease-of-use by simplifying complex concepts, refining the UI, and reducing friction in critical paths.

*

Template & Entry Point Expansion:Launch iterative improvements to templates, hotlinks and suggested workflows to bridge intent and execution.

*

Support Insight to Product Fixes: Analyze support tickets and user feedback to identify and resolve common sources of confusion or setup failure.

*

Optimizing existing workflows, ensuring they are intuitive, scalable and aligned with customer needs.

*

Manage New Features: Managing workflow feature requests, tracking, prioritizing and ensuring timely execution of essential updates.

*

Cross Team Collaboration: Collaborating with other product teams (CRM, Reporting, Payments, AI, and Integrations) to ensure seamless cross-functional workflow improvements.

*

Tracking Metrics: Tracking performance metrics to identify usability bottlenecks, activation & adoption trends, and areas for optimization.

*

Staying updated on industry trends in automation, integrations, and no-code/low-code platforms to drive innovation within workflows.

Your Core Skills
----------------

*

Passionate about building intuitive and scalable workflow automation solutions.

*

Ability to deeply understand user problems, spot friction in product flows, and make thoughtful trade-offs between power and simplicity.

*

Comfort with digging into usage data, funnels, and support patterns to find actionable insights.

*

Understanding of product development lifecycle and experience working on SaaS products.

*

Strong analytical mindset to interpret user behavior, identify pain points, and optimize workflow functionalities.

*

Leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and drive initiatives forward.

*

Understanding of automation tools and workflow best practices to enhance user experience.

*

Ability to deconstruct complex software experiences and highlight good UX from bad UX.

*

Familiarity with workflow automation platforms is a plus.

*

A problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced, execution-driven environment.

*Experience*
------------

*

8+ years of Product Management experience ideally in SaaS or automation platforms

*

Proven track record of shipping complex, user-facing features in a fast-paced environment

*

Proven experience owning large-scale, customer-facing product platforms

*

Experience working on workflow automation tools or CRM platforms is a plus

Deep Understanding of:
----------------------

*

Workflow builders, automations and no-code or low-code platforms

*

Product funnels: activation, retention, and reducing time to value

*

Identifying friction points in UX and translating feedback/support data into product decisions

*

Cross-team platform work: enabling other product teams through triggers, actions, and integrations

*

Working with engineering on large-scale frontend + backend architecture (especially builder-like UIs)

*

Running feature discovery and validation loops with beta users

*

Partnering closely with design to simplify complex systems and reduce cognitive load

*

Writing clear, structured PRDs and communicating roadmap tradeoffs to stakeholders

*

Analyzing data from tools like Superset, Pendo or Tableau to inform product decisions

Why Should You Join Us?
-----------------------

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.

Join us at High Level, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

title: Sr. Product Manager - B2C and Events
description:
*ABOUT US*

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

*OUR PEOPLE*

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

*OUR IMPACT*

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that.

*ABOUT THE TEAM*

The B2C/Creators Product team at HighLevel is focused on building and scaling a world-class learning experience for our customers and their audiences. The platform currently serves over 1.1 million monthly active users, making it one of HighLevel's most widely adopted products. This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at scale while solving B2C-style learner experience problems within a B2B2C product ecosystem.

Events is one of the newest products in HighLevel's Memberships suite, currently in beta and being built from the ground up. It gives our customers a native way to create, publish and sell events — in-person, online and hybrid — with ticketing, RSVPs, paid and free registration, and attendee management, sitting directly alongside the contacts, communities, courses, credentials and automations they already run their business on. Organizers build and run their events from the Memberships admin; attendees live the whole thing inside Client Portal, next to the courses, communities and credentials they already sign in for.

*WHAT YOU'LL DO*

*

*Own and Shape the B2C & Events Roadmap* Partner with product leadership to help shape and execute the roadmap for HighLevel's B2C platform, serving 1.1M+ monthly active learners, with a focus on engagement, completion, and retention in a B2B2C environment.

*

*Close the Table-Stakes Gap, Then Go Past It –* Know the category cold. Get the expected capabilities right — ticket tiers, promo codes, capacity and waitlists, recurring and series events, refunds, embeddable widgets, calendar sync, wallet passes — and then decide deliberately where we go further than the incumbents rather than matching them feature for feature.

*

*Take Events from Beta to GA –* Own the beta exit criteria: the quality bar, the reliability bar, the feature completeness, and the adoption and revenue signals that tell us this product is ready to be sold broadly. Drive the program that closes those gaps.

*

*Build Ticketing, Checkout and Payments –* Lead paid, free and RSVP event types, multi-tier and multi-currency ticketing, checkout conversion, discounts, taxes, refunds and payouts — with the precision and trust a revenue-bearing flow demands, and with fee and payout terms that are a reason to choose us rather than a reason to resent us.

*

*Give Organizers Ownership of Their Audience –* Build the capability that most defines us against the category: every registration flows into the organizer's own CRM, segmentable, automatable and theirs to keep. Turn attendee data ownership from a talking point into the product's most obvious advantage.

*

*Own Event-Day Operations –* Events are judged on the day they happen. Own check-in and QR scanning, offline resilience at the door, guest lists and comp tickets, on-site sales, capacity enforcement and the operational tooling organizers depend on when things go wrong in real time.

*

*Own the Attendee Experience in Client Portal –* Client Portal is where the attendee side of Events lives, and you own it: how members find what is on, register and check out, hold their tickets, receive reminders and joining links, attend in person or online, and look back at what they have been to. Deliver that journey across both web and mobile, make events feel native to the portal rather than bolted onto it, and hold a phone-first bar throughout.

*

*Drive Distribution and Discovery –* Shape how events get found and filled: SEO-ready event pages, social and calendar syndication, embeddable listings, the Gokollab Marketplace, and the promotion tooling that turns an organizer's existing audience into attendance.

*

*Open the Platform –* Treat APIs, webhooks and integrations as a first-class surface rather than a premium upsell, so agencies and developers can build events into the workflows and client solutions they already sell.

*

*Champion UI/UX Excellence –* Partner closely with design and engineering to deliver interfaces that are intuitive, accessible, mobile-friendly and fast — for both the organizer building an event and the attendee registering for one.

*

*Talk to Organizers Constantly –* Run discovery with beta organizers, sit in on their setup, watch where they stall, and turn qualitative signal into a prioritized backlog. At this stage, direct customer contact is a primary input, not a supplement.

*

*Experiment and Optimize –* Design and analyze experiments across the funnel — event page conversion, registration completion, checkout drop-off, organizer onboarding — and iterate rapidly on evidence rather than opinion.

*

*Support Scale, Reliability and Trust –* Drive the platform work a live-event product demands: registration integrity, capacity and waitlist correctness, payment reliability, fraud and listing trust, and graceful behavior under the traffic spikes that come with a popular event going on sale.

*

*Collaborate Cross-Functionally –* Work across engineering, design, data, support, marketing and customer-facing teams to launch features, drive adoption, and close the loop on organizer feedback.

*

*Define and Own the Metrics –* Establish the success metrics for a product that does not yet have them — organizer activation, time to first published event, repeat-event rate, registration and checkout conversion, attendance rate, gross ticket volume and revenue per organizer — set the OKRs against them, and use them to steer the roadmap.

*

*Deliver Outcomes, Not Just Features –* Be accountable for measurable growth in events published, organizers activated, registrations processed and ticket revenue running through the platform.

*WHO YOU ARE*

*

*B2C Experience –* You have built and shipped impactful features for B2C platforms or content products, creating engaging end user experiences that drive activation, completion, and retention at meaningful scale.

*

*An End-to-End Owner –* You are comfortable owning the entire life of an event across two connected surfaces: the creator experience in the Memberships admin, where an organizer builds, prices, publishes, promotes and runs their event, and the attendee experience in Client Portal, where a member discovers it, registers, attends and looks back on it. You think in terms of the whole journey and the handoffs between those surfaces, not in terms of screens.

*

*UX-Attentive for Learning –* You bring a strong UI/UX sensibility focused on learner journeys, content discovery, progress tracking, and habit formation, with a track record of delivering intuitive and high-quality learning experiences.

*

*Experimentation-Minded –* You are comfortable running A/B tests and structured experiments to improve learner engagement and completion rates through rapid, evidence-based iteration.

*

*Learner-Centric –* You consistently balance business objectives with learner success, keeping learner needs, motivation, and outcomes at the center of product decisions.

*

*Customer-Obsessed –* You seek out organizers directly, run your own discovery, and can translate what you hear into product decisions without waiting for a research team to formalize it.

*

*Strategic and Execution-Focused –* You can contribute meaningfully to product vision while staying deeply involved in day-to-day execution to ensure ideas translate into real, measurable impact.

*

*Data-Informed –* You rely on behavioral data, funnel metrics, and cohort analysis to prioritize initiatives, validate assumptions, and guide product decisions.

*WHAT YOU'LL BRING*

*

7+ years of Product Management experience, with meaningful exposure to events, ticketing, marketplace, commerce or B2B2C SaaS products.

*

Proven track record of taking a product from early stage to scaled adoption, with clear ownership of the decisions that made it work.

*

Hands-on experience with monetization mechanics — checkout, pricing and packaging, payments, refunds, payouts and fee structure — and the operational realities that come with them.

*

Working knowledge of the events and ticketing category, including how platforms such as Eventbrite, Luma, Meetup and Cvent are positioned, priced and differentiated.

*

Solid understanding of UI/UX principles, with the ability to partner closely with design to deliver intuitive, accessible and high-quality journeys for two distinct user types: organizers and attendees.

*

Familiarity with SaaS and B2C platform growth levers, including user activation, engagement loops, retention, lifecycle optimization, and audience monetization.

*

Comfort operating with ambiguity, incomplete data and shifting priorities in a fast-moving, remote-first environment.

*

Bonus: You have worked on an events, ticketing or community platform and can clearly articulate your personal impact on organizer growth, conversion and revenue.

*WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US?*

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters.

Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.

Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

title: Manager, Product
description:
**********************
*Company Introduction*
**********************

Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.

Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.

*****************
*Job Description*
*****************

​Role Overview:

We are looking for a Product Manager to own and drive key product initiatives across discovery, delivery, and optimisation for a defined product area.

This role focuses on translating customer needs and business goals into clear product requirements, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality outcomes. The Product Manager will contribute to roadmap execution, support product discovery efforts, and ensure delivery aligns with customer value and business impact.

**************************
*Roles & Responsibilities*
**************************

*About Availity*

Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity, so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.

*About Availity India*

Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India team’s partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.

Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and spport products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.

*About the Role*

We are seeking a highly strategic and hands-on *Product Manager - Provider Data Management* to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of products that power provider data acquisition, enrichment, governance, quality, and distribution across the healthcare ecosystem.

This role is ideal for a *Data Product Manager* who thrives at the intersection of healthcare data, analytics, product innovation, and technology. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with large datasets, validating hypotheses through analytics, rapidly prototyping solutions, and leveraging AI and emerging technologies to solve complex provider data challenges.

The Product Manager will own the end-to-end lifecycle of provider data products and capabilities, collaborating closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Architecture, UX, AI, and Business teams to deliver high-value solutions that improve data quality, operational efficiency, provider experience, and customer outcomes.

*Key Responsibilities*

*Product Strategy & Vision*

* Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for Provider Data Management capabilities.

* Develop long-term vision for provider data products including:

* Provider Directory

* Provider Registry

* Provider MDM / Golden Record

* Network Intelligence

* Provider Data Quality

* Data Acquisition and Enrichment

* Identify opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and automation to improve provider data accuracy, completeness, and operational efficiency.

* Align product investments with business objectives, customer needs, regulatory requirements, and market opportunities.

* Establish measurable product outcomes and success metrics.

*Data Product Management*

* Act as the product owner for provider data assets, datasets, APIs, and data services.

* Define data product requirements, quality standards, governance models, and service-level expectations.

* Partner with Data Engineering and Architecture teams to design scalable provider data platforms.

* Drive creation and management of provider golden records and master data strategies.

* Define data sourcing, matching, enrichment, data lineage, and quality measurement capabilities.

* Balance business, customer, compliance, and technical requirements in product decisions.

*Customer Discovery & Domain Leadership*

* Build expertise in provider data management workflows and healthcare industry standards.

* Engage customers, payers, providers, internal stakeholders, and operational teams to uncover pain points and opportunities.

* Conduct market and competitive analysis across provider data vendors, directories, credentialing, and provider network management solutions.

* Translate customer problems into validated product opportunities and business cases.

* Serve as the internal subject matter expert for provider data strategy and capabilities.

*Innovation & Prototyping*

* Lead experimentation and innovation initiatives focused on provider data challenges.

* Create rapid prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and MVPs to validate hypotheses before full-scale investment.

* Leverage AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve:

* Provider search and discovery

* Data matching and identity resolution

* Data quality and enrichment

* Workflow automation

* Predictive insights

* Partner closely with engineering teams to translate prototypes into scalable products.

*Analytics & Data-Driven Decision Making*

* Be comfortable working directly with data to identify trends, opportunities, and product insights.

* Define KPIs measuring provider data quality, completeness, accuracy, coverage, and adoption.

* Use SQL, BI tools, dashboards, and analytics platforms to validate assumptions and guide prioritization.

* Perform root-cause analysis on data quality issues and operational bottlenecks.

* Drive product decisions through quantitative and qualitative evidence.

*Product Delivery & Execution*

* Lead product delivery from discovery through launch and continuous optimization.

* Create and maintain product requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and documentation.

* Prioritize and manage product backlogs based on customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility.

* Partner with Engineering, UX, and Data teams to ensure successful implementation.

* Drive execution through Agile methodologies and ensure high-quality outcomes.

*Stakeholder Management*

* Collaborate with executive leaders, healthcare domain experts, operational teams, engineering, and external partners.

* Communicate roadmap priorities, business cases, metrics, risks, and trade-offs effectively.

* Build alignment across competing stakeholder priorities through data-driven recommendations.

* Present product strategy, investment opportunities, and outcomes to leadership teams.

*Required Qualifications*

*Experience*

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Healthcare Informatics, Business, or related field.

* 10+ years of experience in Product Management, Data Product Management, or Product Ownership.

* 5+ years of experience working with data-intensive products, platforms, or analytics solutions.

* Demonstrated experience defining and managing data products, APIs, platforms, or large-scale datasets.

* Strong analytical mindset with ability to work directly with complex data.

* Experience leveraging metrics and experimentation to guide product decisions.

* Experience leading cross-functional teams through the entire product lifecycle.

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience with healthcare provider data, provider directory management, credentialing, provider networks, MDM, or healthcare interoperability.

* Experience with healthcare standards including:

* NPI

* FHIR

* HL7

* CAQH

* Provider Directory APIs

* Hands-on experience with:

* SQL

* Power BI/Tableau

* Data visualization tools

* AI-assisted analytics tools

* Experience building data platforms, master data solutions, or data marketplaces.

* Experience applying AI/ML techniques to data quality, matching, classification, and automation problems.

* Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and modern data architectures.

* MBA or advanced degree preferred.

*Key Skills*

*Product Leadership*

* Product Strategy

* Roadmap Development

* Opportunity Assessment

* Customer Discovery

* Outcome-Based Prioritization

*Data Product Management*

* Data Modeling

* Data Governance

* Master Data Management (MDM)

* Provider Data Management

* API Product Management

* Data Quality Management

*Analytics & Insights*

* SQL

* Data Analytics

* KPI Development

* Experimentation

* A/B Testing

* Data Visualization

*Innovation*

* Rapid Prototyping

* Design Thinking

* AI Product Management

* Machine Learning Applications

* Hypothesis-Driven Product Development

*Execution*

* Agile Product Management

* Backlog Prioritization

* Requirements Definition

* Cross-Functional Leadership

* Stakeholder Management

*Why Join Availity India?*

* *Meaningful impact* : Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.

* *Global exposure* : Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.

* *Learning and growth:* Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.

* *Flexible work experience* : Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models.

* *Holistic rewards:* Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.

* *Inclusive workplace* : Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.

* *Office experience* : For office-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night-shift transportation support.

*What to Expect from the Hiring Process*
Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offering discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.

*Equal Opportunity Statement*
Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.

*************
*Eligibility*
*************

*Video Camera Usage:*

Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.

Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.

title: Principal Data Engineer (RWE)
description:
India based role

1. Development of data processes for the automated ongoing generation of patient level data (the “data product”) to be used by various business stakeholders for a variety of purposes (e.g. dashboards, reports, studies).

2. Downstream manipulation of datasets after their onboarding from data vendors/partners from “raw” format as provided into useable data structures that will be used to carry out RWE studies, dashboards & other data outputs

3. Transform heterogeneous raw healthcare datasets into reusable data models supporting observational research and epidemiology studies.

4. Occasional conversion of bespoke / one-off datasets (e.g. biomarkers, mutations) to OMOP format (including an understanding of what can and cannot be converted to OMOP format, e.g. to allow analysis to be carried out on residual data that cannot be converted to OMOP).

5. Build FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) data pipelines and semantic data engineering frameworks to improve discoverability and interoperability of healthcare data assets.

6. Create AI-ready datasets that can support generative AI use cases.

Communication

7. Technical engagement with key stakeholders (e.g. epidemiologist, statisticians, market access/health economists) from outside the RWE programming team to ensure a full and detailed understanding of end-user requirement is created and carefully documented. This includes scoping discussions, business analysis and translation of verbalised end-user needs into actionable data structures

8. Detailed technical engagement with colleagues from within the RWE programming team to build data structures required for the generation of RWE study outputs and data products; also support those team members in creating the study outputs where the data engineer’s skillset can add incremental value

9. Liaison & ongoing interaction with IT department to ensure that raw datasets inbound from data partners are fit for the agreed purposes (as per bullet point 1 above)

10. Liaise, where required, with technical staff employed by analysis software vendors (databricks etc)

Documentation

11. Maintain clear documentation of data flows, schemas, pipelines, and processes to facilitate onboarding, troubleshooting and auditing.

Quality, Validation & Support

12. Design and carry out detailed testing (data validation and monitoring) approaches for data structures built by self or other members of team to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the data within the data product

13. Troubleshoot any issues encountered with data loading, extraction and transformation (ETL)

10. Work in collaboration with three other members of the Data Engineering team, taking on workload from others as and when required

Required Skills & Qualifications

Domain Expertise

· Strong understanding of Real World Data (RWD) / Real World Evidence (RWE) concepts.

· Ability to assess business requirements and recommend appropriate real-world healthcare datasets for analytical use cases.

· Deep understanding of healthcare data models and healthcare data ecosystems.

· Strong expertise in OMOP CDM v5.4, v6, including extensions.

· Knowledge of healthcare terminologies and standards such as:

o SNOMED CT

o RxNorm

o ICD-10

o LOINC

o HCPCS/CPT

Data Engineering

· Min 8+ years of hands-on experience in building scalable ETL/ELT pipelines.

· Expertise in:

o Databricks

o PySpark

o Spark SQL

o SQL

o Delta Lake

· Experience working with large-scale healthcare and patient-level datasets.

· Strong understanding of Semantic Data Engineering principles.

· Experience building FAIR-compliant data pipelines.

· Experience with cloud-based data platforms and distributed processing frameworks.

Analytics & Visualization

· Strong Power BI development and data modelling skills.

· Ability to create reusable analytical datasets for dashboards and studies.

· Experience designing AI-ready datasets and analytics data products.

Validation & Quality

· Experience implementing automated data quality frameworks.

· Strong data profiling, validation, and monitoring skills.

· Understanding of healthcare data quality assessment methodologies.

Collaboration & Communication

· Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

· Ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions.

· Experience working with cross-functional global teams.

Disease Area Knowledge

Exposure to one or more of the following therapeutic areas:

· Oncology

· Respiratory

· Immunology & Inflamation

· Infectious Diseases

Nice-to-Have Skills

· Working knowledge of R programming.

· Experience with sparklyR.

· Experience developing analytical applications using R Shiny.

· Knowledge of common observational research methodologies.

· Familiarity with OHDSI tools.

· Exposure to Azure Data Platform services.

title: Manager, Sales Development, Public Sector
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

You will serve as a front-line manager for Ramp’s founding Public Sector Sales Development Representative (SDR) team. This team will drive outbound prospecting and pipeline generation within a critical growth segment for Ramp: Public Sector.

You will build and evolve Ramp’s Public Sector go-to-market motion from the ground up. Key responsibilities include coaching and developing SDRs, setting team strategy, and partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and executive leadership to drive pipeline and business outcomes.

As a member of the Sales Leadership team, you will play a critical role in shaping, scaling, and refining Ramp’s Public Sector growth strategy.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build and scale the Public Sector SDR function, including team structure, playbooks, messaging, and operating processes.

- Define Ramp’s Public Sector competitive differentiation and develop resources to strengthen objection handling and go-to-market execution.

- Lead cross-functional initiatives with AEs and partners across Product, Sales, and Marketing to achieve company objectives.

- At least 2 years of quota-carrying individual-contributor sales experience, with a consistent record of exceeding goals.

- At least 3 years of experience building and leading sales development teams, with a demonstrated record of exceeding team goals.

- Success in fast-paced, results-oriented go-to-market environments (ideally within SaaS) and a history of outperforming quota in outbound sales.

title: Manager, Account Management, SME & Growth, CN
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

About the team

The SME & Growth Business team at Airwallex is a passionate group of collaborators and business champions dedicated to empowering small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to thrive in the global economy. We combine deep financial expertise with a growth mindset, working closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored solutions that streamline cross-border payments and unlock new revenue streams. As a team, we are driven by a desire to make a positive impact and are constantly innovating to find new ways to support the success of our SME customers

What you’ll do

As the Manager, Account Management, SME & Growth, CN, you will be the front-line execution leader of our post-sale growth engine. Leading a high-performing team of Individual Contributors (Account Managers or Customer Success Managers), you will execute the GTM strategy to drive product adoption, upsell/cross-sell, and long-term customer retention across our SME & Growth segment. You aren't just managing day-to-day account operations; you are coaching talent, optimizing account management playbooks, and driving revenue performance to scale our business in China.

This role is based in Shenzhen or Shanghai.

Responsibilities:

- People Leadership & Coaching: Directly lead, mentor, and scale a team of Account Managers or CSMs; foster a culture of high performance, continuous learning, and accountability.

- Strategy Execution & Revenue Growth: Operationalize the GTM strategy to maximize product adoption, expansion revenue (upsell/cross-sell), and customer retention within the SME & Growth customer portfolio.

- Client Engagement & Relationship Management: Act as an executive escalation point for key customer accounts, building trust with key client stakeholders to ensure Airwallex solutions deliver continuous value.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to channel customer feedback into product enhancements and streamline customer-facing processes.

- Performance & KPI Management: Set team and individual targets around revenue, product penetration, and customer satisfaction; track KPIs, conduct pipeline reviews, and implement tactical coaching to elevate team performance.

- Risk Mitigation & Issue Resolution: Proactively identify churn risks, handle complex customer escalations, and develop effective mitigation strategies.

- Culture & Values: Champion Airwallex’s operating principles and values, acting as a cultural advocate and role model for the team.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

- 6+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or Sales, with at least 3 years in team management or direct line leadership, ideally in Fintech, SaaS, Payments, or Tech platforms.

- Proven track record of leading front-line commercial/AM teams to achieve revenue and retention targets in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using data to guide team priorities, pipeline decisions, and performance coaching.

- Solid understanding of the fintech, cross-border payments, or digital commerce ecosystem.

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage mid-to-senior level decision-makers.

- Hands-on experience in account planning, portfolio management, and executing adoption playbooks.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience scaling teams in high-growth technology environments or cross-border trade/Fintech platforms.

- Proficiency with CRM and reporting tools (e.g., Salesforce, Looker, SQL).

- Familiarity with API-based payment products or complex SaaS solutions.

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Market Launcher, Sales Internship
description:
💙 ABOUT BOUNCE

Bounce is building cloud storage for the physical world. We started with the largest luggage storage network on the planet: 35,000+ local businesses in 4,000 cities across 100+ countries, where travelers can drop their bags and get on with their day. Now we're expanding into luggage delivery and our own 24/7 lockers.

We're a small, scrappy team with offices in Lisbon, San Francisco, and Tokyo. We move fast, test ideas early, and change course when the data tells us to. If you want to help make the world a lighter place, you'll fit right in.

Bounce was named the Inc 5000's fastest-growing travel company in the USA in 2024 and is backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, and Sapphire.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This comprehensive program offers hands-on experience in a fast-paced startup environment where innovation and ambition thrive. You’ll receive full training on our products, services, and sales techniques from day one, with structured guidance and mentorship from our experienced team. Throughout the year, you’ll build your skill set in lead generation, relationship management, and closing deals, all while developing a deep understanding of sales. Duration: 5 months

WHERE YOU COME IN

- You will be expected to cold call, email, and outreach to prospective clients

- Work closely with your manager to identify areas for expansion

- You are supplied with leads every month, but you are expected to deliver your own leads

- You are responsible for the full cycle of the sales from discovery call, sales pitch, close, creating the account, to onboarding the partner.

YOUR PROFILE

- Must be fluent in English and any other European language is a bonus

- High-energy individual with a strong desire to learn and achieve top results

- Comfortable with a high volume of sales calls & confidence in cold approaching businesses

- Comfortable with rejection / hearing "no"

- Charismatic, positive, “can-do” attitude over the phone and in-person

- Excellent communication, organisational, and problem-solving skills

- Strong work ethic who’s looking to contribute directly to the company’s success

- Confidence in face-to-face interaction and outside sales with local businesses

- Self-starter with the drive to self-manage and work towards goals

- Interest in Sales, Marketing, and startups

INTERVIEW PROCESS

1. Intro call with our Talent team to get to know you and share more about Bounce.

2. Hiring manager interview to explore your background and skills

3. Final interview with our Global Sales Manager

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Compensation

- €900 per month

- Commission (100% of target = €315 per month)

Benefits

- Meal allowance through Coverflex

- Commute allowance

- Gym membership

- Catered lunches twice a week, plus snacks and drinks in the office

LOCATION

You'll be based in our Lisbon office https://maps.app.goo.gl/J3JKiKMVaA2sghEg7.

LEARN HOW WE THINK AND WORK

- Visit bounce.com http://bounce.com

- Read about our Series B on TechCrunch https://techcrunch.com/2024/11/12/bounce-grabs-19m-to-expand-its-traveller-convenience-network/

- See why a16z invested in Bounce https://a16z.com/2022/04/26/investing-in-bounce/

title: Product Manager - Integrations
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Manager - Integration, you’ll bring hands-on accounting expertise into a product environment to shape integrations that match real finance workflows. You’ll sit in our Accounting Integrations team and help ensure spend data (expenses, receipts, VAT, categories) flows cleanly from Pleo into the accounting systems and ERPs finance teams rely on, with minimal manual work. This is a hybrid role at the intersection of accounting domain knowledge, product thinking and technical partner collaboration, where your judgement will directly influence what we build and how it lands for customers.

You’ll own a portfolio of integrations and partners, turning customer needs and operational edge cases into clear requirements and improvements delivered with internal teams and external developers. Success in this role shows up in higher export success rates, fewer configuration-related issues and integrations that finance teams can trust at month-end.

WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You’ll be part of the Accounting Integrations team, focused on connecting Pleo with the accounting systems and ERPs most used by European finance teams.
You will report to our Group Product Manager from Integrations and will work closely with Product and Engineering to define requirements, make sound accounting decisions and support delivery across many different systems and data models.
You’ll also collaborate with external development partners and ERP vendors building on Pleo’s APIs, acting as a key point of contact to keep implementations on track and aligned with customer workflows.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

As an Product Manager you will:

- Own a portfolio of accounting integrations and partner relationships, balancing customer needs, partner requests and internal priorities.

- Translate export, reconciliation and month-end close workflows into clear product requirements and integration behaviours.

- Partner with engineers to define data mapping and implementation details across multiple accounting systems, data models and APIs.

- Improve the integration set-up and configuration experience so customers can onboard successfully with fewer issues.

- Act as a trusted accounting domain expert, making pragmatic decisions that improve data quality and reduce manual work for finance teams.

- Support external partners and ERP vendors building on Pleo’s APIs, ensuring alignment on expectations, delivery and quality.

- Track and improve outcomes such as export success rate, adoption/activation and integration-related support volume.

WHAT YOU BRING

Must have

- Practical bookkeeping and finance process knowledge (expense coding, reconciliation and month-end close).

- Strong understanding of how accountants, bookkeepers and finance leads work day to day.

- A solid track record working with product teams from defining requirements through to delivery.

- Experience managing external partners or senior stakeholders and delivering through influence.

- Hands-on exposure to technology in a finance context (for example configuring accounting/ERP tools, working with integrations/data imports, or collaborating closely with technical teams).

Nice to have

- Experience with European accounting and ERP systems, and/or an accounting qualification.

- Partner negotiation experience and/or additional European languages.

- Working knowledge of APIs, data mapping or implementation projects.

WHY THIS ROLE IS A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You enjoy bringing real accounting expertise into product decisions and can explain complex finance concepts in a clear, practical way.

- You like owning problems end to end - from identifying the right solution to working with others to ship it.

- You’re motivated by improving workflows for finance teams and can connect day-to-day pain points to measurable outcomes.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You want a role where you control delivery directly, rather than delivering through internal teams and external partners.

- You prefer depth in a single system over context switching across many tools, markets and accounting practices.

- You’re looking for a purely accounting or purely technical role, without the “bridge” work in between.

HOW YOU'LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

Within your first 6 months, you’ll build a deep understanding of customer export and reconciliation needs and how Pleo’s integrations behave in practice, then take ownership of a defined portfolio of integrations and partners. You’ll identify the highest-impact improvements to the integration set-up experience and drive them to delivery with internal teams.

Within 12 months, you’ll be a go-to expert for integration and accounting decisions, with measurable improvements in export success rates and a reduction in configuration-related issues. You’ll help launch new or improved integrations by enabling internal teams and partners with the context and clarity they need to deliver well.

Over time, you’ll strengthen your product toolkit (requirements, trade-offs, delivery rituals) and build deeper technical fluency by working side-by-side with engineers on real integration complexity.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Please note: Applications for this role will close on Wednesday, October 13th to ensure our team has enough time to give every candidate's application the care and attention it deserves.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

- Intro Call (30 min): A conversation with a Talent Acquisition Partner to provide a high-level overview of Pleo and the role, confirm essential skills, and gauge initial alignment.

- Hiring Manager Interview (45 min): A discussion with your future manager to evaluate your functional expertise, past experience, and role fit.

- Pleo Challenge (60 min): A role-specific  "live session" based on a scenario or business dilemma completed with key stakeholders.

TRANSPARENCY IS IMPORTANT TO US

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we're looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

- CV writing and content: AI can be useful for structure, but generic AI-written CVs often hide your real impact. We’re more likely to engage when you share specific outcomes (for example: “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z”) and explain the context around your decisions.

- Application care: Our talent team reads every application. Taking a few minutes to tailor your answers and highlight the most relevant examples will genuinely help you stand out.

- Profile to role fit: This role is best suited to someone who can combine practical accounting knowledge with product thinking and proactive ownership. We’ll be looking for evidence that you understand finance workflows like reconciliation and month-end close, can translate those needs into clear requirements, and are comfortable collaborating with technical teams and external partners to deliver high-quality integrations.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.
