title: Senior Web Designer
description:
*Overview*

We're hiring a Senior Web Designer to lead how the websites we build look and feel.

You'll lead UI design for websites and eCommerce sites, from first concept through launch. You'll design homepages, navigation, page templates and the modular content blocks that hold a site together. You'll also build the design systems that let a family of brands share one foundation, and that a client's own team can keep using long after launch.

You'll design for a range of brands across consumer goods, healthcare, financial services, hospitality and retail. Expect a new brand to bring to life every few months, and launches you can point to. We're growing, and so is the work.

You'll turn brand, UX flows and content into high-fidelity, build-ready designs for desktop and mobile. You'll work closely with UX, strategy, development and marketing, and carry your design intent through build, QA and launch.

Our Experience team sits at the heart of every build. We're looking for a senior designer who can lead UI across projects, raise our standards, and help our design systems mature alongside the work.

We've been building our own AI tools since 2024, and we want a designer who's glad to bring AI into the work, from early exploration through handoff.

This is a senior, client-facing role. You can be local or remote, though we have a soft spot for folks in New England or the wider Northeast so we can get in a room now and then. You'll report to our VP of Experience.

*About Anchour*

Anchour is a creative agency of 40+ people focused on building unforgettable brands and digital experiences that help businesses punch above their weight.

We're headquartered in Maine and partner with small businesses and growing brands in industries like consumer goods, nutrition, fitness, financial services, hospitality and retail. Our work spans brand strategy, identity design, website design and development, content strategy, and full-service marketing.

We call ourselves Creative Pragmatists. Great work happens when smart people are trusted to do it. We've built a place where talented people have real ownership, real influence over direction, and the room to do the best work of their careers.

*What You'll Do*

* *Own website UI design from concept to launch.* Lead interface design across projects with little oversight. Turn brand identity, UX flows, and content into high-fidelity, build-ready designs for desktop and mobile, with WCAG 2.2 AA built in from the first artboard. Whether the brand system is ours or comes from another team, you translate it into a site experience that feels unmistakably on-brand.
* *Design the whole site.* Homepages, landing pages, navigation, footers and page templates. You art-direct photography, layout rhythm and motion, and you design for real content, not ideal content.
* *Build the systems behind the sites.* Page templates, modular content blocks and component libraries that hold up across breakpoints and in the hands of a client's content team. Typography, color, spacing and motion are documented as design tokens, so a client's team can extend the system long after launch without breaking it. Every state, variant and redline is accounted for.
* *Prototype to earn the yes.* Build high-fidelity prototypes of key pages and interactions, and get stakeholders to sign off before development starts.
* *Hand off so developers build it right.* Deliver organized, documented Figma files and implementation-ready specs, including for partners building in AEM or Shopify. Work side by side with our front-end developers, who build in WordPress and Shopify, through build and QA so the finished site matches what you designed.
* *Lead the work.* Be the UI lead on your projects. Make confident calls grounded in user needs, business goals, accessibility and what's buildable. Scope your design to the budget and timeline, and catch risks before they turn into rework.
* *Raise our standards.* Contribute to our design systems, documentation and reviews. Share what you know with the Experience and Creative teams, and help shape how we design and deliver.
* *Put AI to work.* Use our AI tools across your workflow, from early exploration to documentation to QA, and help the team build fluency over time.

*What We'd Like To See*

* *5+ years designing websites, including several full sites taken from concept through launch.* Homepages, navigation, page templates, the whole thing. *Agency or studio experience strongly preferred.* Your portfolio of live, shipped websites is the most important part of your application. Show us you can design a website.
* *Craft fundamentals.* Typography, color, layout, hierarchy and motion. You know how to make a website's interface feel inevitable.
* *Systems thinking.* You've built website design systems and component libraries that other people can pick up and extend. You design for the whole site, from homepage to footer.
* *Accessibility in your bones.* A strong grasp of usability and WCAG 2.2 AA, built into how you work.
* *Figma expertise.* Fluent in Figma and collaborative design workflows. Comfortable working with developers through build and QA, with a solid understanding of front-end fundamentals and how a CMS shapes design. Experience with Shopify or eCommerce is a plus, and so is designing for headless or enterprise CMS handoffs.
* *Ownership.* You scope to budget, juggle several projects at once, communicate early, and own the outcome.
* *A low-ego, curious teammate.* Collaborative, invested in making the work and the team better, and glad to bring AI into how you design.
* *Northeast-based, ideally.* We're a Maine company and we love getting our people in the same room, so New England or the wider Northeast is a big plus.

If most of your experience is designing inside apps or SaaS products, this probably isn't the right fit. We're looking for someone who designs websites day in and day out.

*Work Style*

* *You own your projects.* UI runs through you, and it's better for it.
* *You communicate before you're asked.* You get status, risks and decisions to the team early.
* *You partner across the room.* UX, copy, dev and marketing all come out stronger.
* *You design for the build.* You know how your choices land in development, and you plan for it.
* *You sweat the details.* Usability, beauty, accessibility and polish aren't optional.
* *You take the work seriously.* Not yourself.

*What You'll Get*

* *Competitive Salary.* We pay well for great work.
* *Flexible Work.* Hybrid out of Maine when you're nearby, remote when you're not, with time together in New England when it counts.
* *Retirement.* Savings plan with a 4% company match.
* *Premium Insurance.* Premium health, dental, vision and life insurance with generous coverage for our US-based team members.
* *Optional HSA.* An optional health savings account to set aside money on a pre-tax basis for medical expenses.
* *Home Office Setup.* A laptop plus 50% reimbursement for home office equipment.
* *Paid & Flexible Holidays.* 12 paid holidays throughout the year, including three flexible holidays.
* *Paid Time Off.* At least three weeks of paid time off per year.
* *Paid Leaves.* Paid parental, medical, bereavement and other types of leave.
* *Flexible & Summer Fridays.* Half-day Fridays throughout the summer, and a get-it-done-and-go mindset year-round.
* *Lifelong Learners Fund.* Cash for professional development like books, conferences and courses, plus team bonding fun.
* *Baby Bonding Bucks.* A $500 bonus to cover diapers, meals and other expenses for any employee welcoming a new child.

The Graphic Designer at Iterative Health will bring our brand to life through compelling visual design across digital, print, and marketing channels. This role will create high-quality, on-brand creative assets that support demand generation, commercial enablement, provider engagement, and corporate communications. Working closely with Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders, the Graphic Designer will translate complex clinical research and business strategy concepts into clear, engaging visual experiences that resonate with providers, sponsors, investors, and prospective employees.

This is a hands-on role for a creative, detail-oriented designer who can balance strong visual storytelling with speed, consistency, and execution across a growing organization.

*Freelance/1099 role until the end of the year with potential opportunity to extend into 2027. Expected approximately 20 hours/week.*

*Where You’ll Drive Impact*

* Deliver expert-level slide deck craftsmanship to develop, restructure, and polish pitch decks and presentations, in partnership with executive team and cross-functional leaders
* Design compelling visual assets that reinforce Iterative Health’s brand identity across marketing, corporate communications, and external-facing materials.
* Create creative assets for digital campaigns, email marketing, social media, website initiatives, and demand generation programs that drive awareness and engagement.
* Develop presentations, sales collateral, one-pagers, infographics, and other materials that communicate our value proposition and support commercial opportunities.
* Turn complex scientific, clinical, operational , information into accessible visual content that resonates with diverse audiences.

*What You Bring to the Team*

* 3–5 years of experience in graphic design, visual communications, brand design, or a related creative field, ideally at a high-growth AI, tech, or SaaS startup

* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Illustrator, InDesign, and Photoshop; experience with Figma and presentation design tools is a plus.
* Strong typography, layout, color, and visual storytelling skills, with a keen eye for detail.
* Ability to translate complex information into clear, visually engaging content
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to incorporate feedback and work effectively with cross-functional partners.

title: Principal Business Analyst
description:
JB5 Principal Business Analyst – P&C Product Our Purpose

At Majesco, we believe in connecting people and business to Insurance in ways that are Innovative, Hyper-Relevant, Compelling and Personal. We bring together the brightest minds to build the future of Insurance; a world where Insurance makes life and business easier, more connected and better protected.

About the Role

The Principal Business Analyst (JB5) in the P&C Product Organization is a senior individual contributor who drives high-quality business analysis, requirements definition, and end-to-end requirement quality across P&C products and capabilities such as Policy, Billing, Claims, Digital1st, and P&C AI.

In this role, you will work closely with Product Management, Product Owners, Architects, Engineering, QA, Services, Support, and customer-facing teams to translate product vision, strategy, and roadmap priorities into clear, testable product specifications, business journeys, and release-ready outcomes.

You will be expected to operate with a high degree of independence on complex, cross-domain initiatives across the P&C portfolio, while also acting as a product champion who can demonstrate, discuss, and clearly articulate features, functions, and underlying rationale to internal and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead business analysis for complex P&C domains and cross-product initiatives across policy lifecycle, rating, billing and payments, collections, claims, digital, and related carrier workflows, from discovery through solution definition and delivery support.
* Work closely with Product Management and Product Owners to translate product vision, strategy, and roadmap priorities into end-to-end business journeys, product requirements, and testable outcomes aligned to business goals.
* Partner with business consultants, business analysts, subject matter experts, and internal stakeholders to detail complex carrier journeys, operating models, and edge-case scenarios across varying customer landscapes.
* Produce and govern high-quality epics, user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, business rules, process flows, data mappings, and functional specifications for complex P&C capabilities and integrations.
* Create and maintain AS-IS and TO-BE process views, integration contracts, and scenario handling for complex P&C use cases including out-of-sequence changes, endorsements, cancellations, reinstatements, and other high-impact business events.
* Collaborate with P&C Architects and Engineering to validate feasibility, align requirements with reference architectures and product standards, and resolve requirement or design trade-offs across squads and product areas.
* Work with QA, UAT, and testing teams to translate release outcomes into end-to-end P&C journeys and test cases, improve scenario coverage, and strengthen requirement quality through the delivery lifecycle.
* Collaborate with Implementation, Support, Customer Success, and Production teams to analyze defect leakage, production issues, and customer feedback, and convert learnings into structured backlog improvements and stronger QA/UAT patterns.
* Act as a champion for the P&C product area by presenting capabilities in demos, supporting release readiness and field enablement, and clearly articulating business value and product rationale to broad audiences.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and productivity enhancement across P&C transactions, tools, and ways of working.
* Share BA best practices, templates, and patterns across the P&C Product Organization, and provide coaching, feedback, and mentoring to other BAs and cross-functional team members to improve overall analysis quality and team capability.
* Support project planning, status reporting, issue resolution, and broader roadmap execution effectiveness for the initiatives and product areas within scope.

What You’ll Bring (Must-Have)

* Strong experience as a Business Analyst in P&C insurance product development or implementation, with deep working knowledge across core P&C processes such as new business, endorsements, renewals, cancellations, reinstatements, billing and payments, collections, agency or producer management, claims, or related workflows.
* Proven ability to structure ambiguous business problems, break them into manageable parts, and translate product strategy into clear, actionable, and testable requirements for global engineering and QA teams.
* Demonstrated expertise in writing and reviewing user stories, use cases, process flows, data requirements, business rules, and end-to-end requirement artifacts for complex scenarios and integrations.
* Outstanding communication skills and the ability to connect, resonate, establish credibility, and influence a wide range of technical and non-technical stakeholders, including cross-functional teams without formal authority.
* Strong business and technical acumen, with the ability to understand vision and strategy, align analysis to product and portfolio goals, and drive the right level of detail from roadmap through delivery.
* Strong eye for business process improvement and innovation, with ideas for improving productivity, efficiency, and quality across key P&C transactions and customer journeys.
* Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills, a first-time-right quality mindset, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail.
* Ability and mindset to coach, mentor, and help develop other team members while contributing to broader organizational capability and delivery excellence.
* Comfort working across time zones with global, distributed teams, remaining accessible and effective in collaborative, fast-moving product environments.

Nice-to-Have

* Experience with Majesco P&C products or other market-leading P&C policy, billing, claims, or digital platforms.
* Hands-on experience with analytics, telemetry, or reporting on P&C operational and financial KPIs to validate assumptions, prioritize work, and refine requirements.
* Exposure to pre-sales, RFPs, product demos, customer advisory discussions, or other field-facing enablement activities in the P&C space.
* Familiarity with AI, automation, and emerging technology trends, and how they can improve P&C underwriting, billing, claims, service, and product workflows.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Insurance, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; Master’s degree preferred.
* 12+ years of total experience, with significant time in P&C Business Analysis or closely related roles within insurance product development, implementation, or insurance technology environments.
* Experience with SAFe or other scaled Agile development practices and processes; relevant BA or Agile certifications are an advantage.
* Strong understanding of P&C product, process, data, and digital ecosystem considerations, along with awareness of the insurance technology vendor landscape and key market trends.

Ways of Working

* Department/Team: P&C Product / Product Enhancement – Business Analysis.
* Level: JB5 – Principal Business Analyst
* Reporting to: Director or VP – Product Owner / Product Engineering.
* Location: Majesco offices (for example Mumbai, Pune, Morristown) or remote, depending on team setup and product line.
* Model: Work as part of cross-functional P&C Agile squads with global, distributed teams and collaboration across time zones.
* Travel: Limited, with occasional travel for customer workshops, PI planning, onsite design sessions, or internal product events as needed.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager - ML/AI
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

AS A SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER — ML/AI, YOU WILL:

- Own and drive complex, cross-team ML/AI programs end-to-end — from scoping and planning through execution and launch — across model infrastructure, inference pipelines, AI functions, Cortex AI services, and AI-powered application features

- Partner with ML Engineers, Research Scientists, Product Managers, and Engineering Leaders to define program roadmaps, surface dependencies, and build execution plans that account for the unique uncertainty and iteration cycles inherent to ML/AI development

- Coordinate cross-org launches for AI features that span ML infrastructure, application surfaces (Streamlit, Notebooks, Cortex Code), and core platform — ensuring all teams ship cohesively and on time

- Navigate the ambiguity of AI development — adapt program structures to handle model experimentation cycles, evaluation gates, accuracy/latency tradeoffs, and the non-linear nature of ML research-to-production timelines

- Establish program governance and reporting cadences — track milestones, risks, decisions, and engineering health with clarity and rigor, and proactively escalate to leadership when programs need intervention

- Drive cross-functional alignment between ML/AI engineering, product, design, infrastructure, security, and legal/compliance teams on AI feature launches, model deployment, and responsible AI practices

- Identify and resolve systemic execution bottlenecks — design lightweight processes and tooling-backed workflows that improve engineering velocity without adding overhead

- Own AI launch readiness — coordinate model evaluation sign-off, performance benchmarking, safety review, and documentation across engineering, product, and trust/safety teams

- Represent ML/AI programs to senior leadership with crisp, data-backed status updates and strategic recommendations that connect program execution to business outcomes

OUR IDEAL SENIOR TPM — ML/AI WILL HAVE:

Required:

- 5+ years of technical program management experience at a cloud or AI-native technology company, with a track record of owning cross-team programs end-to-end

- Demonstrated experience with ML/AI programs — you understand the ML development lifecycle (training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring) and can manage programs around its unique iteration patterns and uncertainty

- Strong technical depth — ability to engage meaningfully with ML engineers and research scientists on model architecture, inference infrastructure, evaluation metrics, and deployment tradeoffs

- Proven ability to operate in ambiguity — ML/AI programs don't follow predictable timelines; you know how to structure execution around experimentation cycles and adapt plans as signals emerge

- Experience managing programs spanning 4+ engineering teams with competing roadmaps and shared dependencies

- Excellent communication skills — you synthesize complex technical and research concepts into clear, actionable narratives for leadership, product, and cross-functional audiences

- Strong program management fundamentals: dependency management, risk frameworks, milestone governance, stakeholder alignment, and escalation discipline

Product Development Designer – Home Décor & Handicrafts
Junior Motion Designer (UK Remote)
description:
This is a remote position.
--------------------------

*About Project Slingshot*
Project Slingshot is a global nonprofit working to end factory farming. We do this by exposing the lies, cruelty and power of Big Ag through disruptive campaigns that cut through the noise, capture public attention and build unstoppable momentum for change.
Our work ranges from daily social content and celebrity partnerships to documentaries, outdoor advertising, websites, fundraising materials and larger global campaigns.
We're looking for someone who loves making things look and feel great, enjoys emerging creative trends, and wants to help create work that people actually stop scrolling for.
*The Role*
As our Junior Motion Designer you'll help make our work impossible to scroll past. You'll create the motion graphics and social-first edits that carry our campaigns across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and beyond - and in doing so, free up our senior creatives to focus on larger campaigns, films and creative development.
Most of your week will be spent animating, editing and adapting content for social. You'll also have opportunities to contribute to bigger projects, including documentaries, celebrity campaigns, outdoor advertising, websites, reports and global advocacy campaigns.
Because we're a small team, you'll work closely with our Chief Creative Officer, senior designer and editors, gaining exposure to a broad range of creative disciplines and helping shape work that reaches audiences all over the world.
This is an opportunity for someone who wants to grow fast, learn alongside experienced creatives, and bring fresh perspectives and ideas of their own. We care far more about what you've made than how long you've been making it.
*What You'll Do*
*Create motion graphics*

* Animate typography, graphics and brand assets for campaign and social content.
* Build simple, reusable templates for recurring content.
* Support larger campaign films with additional motion design where needed.
* Develop animations that feel polished, considered and on-brand.
* Keep project files tidy, organised and easy for the wider team to pick up.

*Edit engaging social content*

* *Create social-first edits for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and other platforms.*
* *Add captions, sound design, transitions and graphics.*
* *Adapt existing content into multiple formats and aspect ratios.*
* *Produce fast-turnaround content without compromising on craft.*
* *Help maintain a consistently high standard across all published content.*

**Stay connected to culture*

* Bring references, trends and ideas into the team.
* Keep an eye on emerging creators, editing styles, formats and platform behaviours.
* Help ensure our work feels contemporary, culturally relevant and creatively ambitious.
* Suggest approaches that feel unexpected or different from traditional advocacy communications.

*Support bigger projects*

* Assist with documentaries, campaign films and experimental creative projects.
* Work alongside experienced creatives and gradually take ownership of more ambitious work.
* Contribute ideas and creative thinking, not just execution.
* Take feedback well, act on it quickly, and use it to raise your craft.

Requirements
------------

*We'd love someone who:*

* Has a showreel or portfolio of motion and social-first video work they're proud of - from a placement, internship, freelance work, a studio, an agency, an in-house team or their own projects.
* Is comfortable using Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro.
* Has a strong eye for graphic design, typography, composition and pacing.
* Understands how motion graphics, sound design, music and voiceover can elevate a piece of content.
* Enjoys experimenting with new tools and workflows.
* Is curious about emerging creative technologies such as ElevenLabs, Runway and Midjourney.
* Is proactive, organised and happy sharing ideas in a small, fast-moving team.
* Pays close attention to trends and to what audiences are actually responding to right now.
* Is excited to join our mission to end factory farming.

*Success looks like*

* You are producing social-first edits and motion assets independently, to a consistently high standard.
* A set of reusable motion templates exists and is speeding up our recurring content.
* Senior creatives are spending more time on major campaigns and films because day-to-day output sits with you.
* You are bringing references, trends and ideas to the team, not only executing briefs.

Benefits
--------

*Location & Working Pattern*
Project Slingshot is a fully remote organisation. This role is UK-based, and you can work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection and reasonable overlap with UK working hours. There will occasionally be opportunities and expectations to travel for team meet-ups, campaign shoots, conferences and planning sessions. Travel costs will be covered by Project Slingshot.
*The Practical Details*

* *Location:* UK, remote, with some travel for in-person meetings
* *Reports to:* Chief Creative Officer
* *Compensation:* Annual base salary within the range of GBP 30,000-35,000.
* *Benefits:* Paid time off, paid holidays, pension contribution

*The Application Process*

* *Step 1:* submit your application here.

* You are also welcome to submit a cover letter.
* A link to examples of work or a portfolio

* *Step 2:* our team will review all applications and arrange initial screenings
* *Step 3:* shortlisted candidates will be invited to multiple round interviews, and final candidates may also be invited to a paid test exercise

*Equal Opportunity*
Project Slingshot is an equal opportunity employer. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and lived experiences. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and harassment-free environment where everyone feels valued and supported to do their best work. If you are interested in this role but do not meet every requirement listed, we still encourage you to apply.

title: Junior Business Development Executive
description:
About Aetherbloom
-----------------

Aetherbloom is not your average BPO. We are a female-founded digital business hub connecting South Africa's brightest professionals with leading UK clients, delivering customer experience, digital services, and operational excellence from Johannesburg to London. Our work is purpose-driven and our standards are high. We are building a team of professionals who are as invested in growth as we are. Aetherbloom supports UK businesses with dedicated remote talent based in South Africa. We work with founders, SMEs, charities and growing teams that need reliable support across administration, customer service, operations and other business functions.

The role
--------

We are hiring a Junior Business Development Executive to join our Sales Academy and develop into a Business Growth Partner. This role suits someone at the start of a sales career, or someone with the personality and determination to build one.

A polished sales background is optional. We care about nerve, grit, competitiveness, curiosity and follow-through. You should be comfortable backing yourself, speaking to people you have never met and making the next call when the last one went badly. You need enough confidence to ask for the conversation, enough self-awareness to take coaching and enough discipline to keep doing the work when the novelty wears off.

We will teach you the sales process. You will learn it by doing the job, with regular coaching, practice and feedback from the team.

Responsibilities
----------------

*

Research UK businesses and identify prospects that fit Aetherbloom.

*

Find the right decision-makers and a credible business reason to contact them.

*

Make outbound calls and start confident, professional conversations.

*

Write clear, researched outreach by email and LinkedIn.

*

Ask good questions, listen properly and identify genuine sales opportunities.

*

Book qualified discovery calls and pass useful context to the senior team.

*

Follow up consistently and keep your pipeline moving.

*

Keep HubSpot accurate and use coaching, call reviews and role plays to improve.

About you
---------

*

Confident speaking to new people, particularly on the phone.

*

Competitive and motivated by clear targets and measurable progress.

*

Persistent. Rejection may frustrate you, but it does not stop you.

*

Quick to learn and willing to try a different approach after feedback.

*

Proactive and comfortable creating your own next step.

*

A natural communicator who can also listen and ask useful questions.

*

Curious about businesses, people and how decisions get made.

*

Reliable, organised and willing to take responsibility for your own results.

Experience
----------

Previous B2B sales experience is welcome but not essential. Experience in customer service, retail, hospitality, recruitment, fundraising, telesales, events or another people-facing role can be useful. We will also consider applicants without direct sales experience who can show determination, initiative, confidence and a record of sticking with difficult goals.

Aetherbloom Sales Academy
-------------------------

The role includes structured sales training and hands-on coaching in UK B2B prospecting, cold calling, outreach, discovery, objection handling and pipeline management. Support is closer at the start and reduces as you become more capable. Progression into the Business Growth Partner role is based on how well you apply the training and handle the core sales responsibilities.

Applications
------------

Applications close on *Friday 23rd October 2026*

title: Junior Marketing Manager - Content & Growth (m/w/x) (geringfügig)

title: Senior UX / UI Designer (m/w/d)
description:
deine rolle
-----------

Als UX/UI Designer bei FoodGenius bist du nicht nur für ansprechende Interfaces zuständig, sondern vor allem für ein herausragendes Nutzererlebnis. Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklern und der Product Ownerin in einem agilen Scrum-Team zusammen. Mit Figma und anderen Tools entwickelst du User Journeys, führst Tests durch und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Produkte intuitiv und optimal auf die Bedürfnisse der Nutzer abgestimmt sind. Durch regelmäßigen Austausch im Design Team und enge Zusammenarbeit stellen wir sicher, dass UX / UI nicht nur ein Begriff, sondern eine gelebte Praxis ist.

Wir möchten, dass du mit uns wächst, deine Expertise weiterentwickelst und aktiv dazu beiträgst, unsere UX / UI-Prozesse auf das nächste Level zu heben. Deine Ideen sind gefragt, um unser Produkt stetig zu verbessern.

das wirst du tun
----------------

* Erstelle Personas, User-Journeys, Wireframes, Mockups und Prototypen zur Visualisierung von Design-Ideen.
* Leite daraus konkrete Interfaces ab, die an die Entwicklung übergeben werden.
* Arbeite dabei eng mit der Entwicklung und dem Marketing-Team zusammen.
* Führe A/B- und Usability-Tests durch, um die Nutzerfreundlichkeit zu optimieren.
* Identifiziere und implementiere Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten basierend auf Nutzerdaten und Feedback.
* Unterstütze bei Bedarf mit deiner UX / UI Expertise andere Produktteams und nimm an teamübergreifenden Initiativen teil.
* Arbeit mit Multibrand Design Systemen und deren Pflege

das bringst du mit

* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Design, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
* Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Entwicklung von Interfaces für Desktop und mobile Anwendungen.
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Figma.
* Erfahrung mit Usability-Tests, A/B Testing, Design Systemen und Datenanalyse.
* Sprint- Methodiken, wie z.B. Crazy 8s, Lightning Demos, How Might We, usw.
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Empathie und die Fähigkeit, effektiv im Team zu arbeiten.
* Kreatives Denken und die Fähigkeit, innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln.
* Bereitschaft, sich in verschiedene Aufgabenbereiche einzubringen und neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen.
* Fähigkeit, bestehende Produkte und Workflows zu analysieren, Probleme zu erkennen und die Nutzererfahrung daraufhin zu optimieren
* Erfahrung in der Gastronomiebranche sind ein Plus

das bieten wir dir
------------------

* Kreatives Arbeiten in familiärer Atmosphäre.
* Produkte und Ideen, mit denen wir einen langfristig positiven Impact für alle schaffen wollen.
* Ein faires und angemessenes Gehalt, das Deiner Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht.
* Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und berufliche Entwicklung.
* Ein motiviertes, herzliches Team, das Zusammenarbeit und Austausch schätzt und fördert.
* Wir bieten 100% Homeoffice oder hybrides Arbeiten in St. Wendel, du entscheidest
* 30 Tage Urlaub
* Zusätzlich bieten wir Team-Events, wie ein Sommerfest und eine Weihnachtsfeier

bewerbung

Wenn du Lust hast, unser Team zu bereichern und die Zukunft unserer Projekte mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung inklusive einem Portfolio! Bewirb dich bitte über unser Jobportal:

title: Staff UX Designer
description:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes for patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.

Our UX Designers thrive on solving hard problems. We deliver products and experiences by combining personal care with modern technology to give people the healthcare they deserve. We work closely to define emerging patterns, interactions, and visual systems from the ground up to solve problems that haven’t been solved yet. It’s an opportunity to not only design better healthcare software, but to design a whole new way to work.

We are seeking a talented and experienced Staff UX Designer to join our team and lead impactful design initiatives across our product suite. As a key member of the design leadership team, you will shape the quality of the user experience, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our products are intuitive, user-centered, and aligned with business goals. You will be responsible for solving complex design challenges, elevating design quality by mentoring other designers, and driving a user-first mindset throughout the organization.

If you are a design leader who thrives in a fast-paced, outcome-driven environment and has a passion for creating products that make a meaningful impact, we would love to meet you!

*As a Staff UX Designer, you will:*

* Provide leadership in introducing consumer-level experiences into the enterprise healthcare space, setting a new standard for design quality with a refined sense of taste.
* Lead the exploration and solutioning of undefined problem areas, driving innovation to tackle complex user and business challenges.
* Own and lead large-scale design projects, utilizing rapid prototyping and fast learning cycles to deliver impactful, scalable solutions.
* Bring differentiated expertise to elevate the overall design quality and introduce breakthrough experiences, pushing the team toward new levels of excellence.
* Establish yourself as a design leader by demonstrating mastery, strategic thinking, and confidence in making intelligent design decisions.
* Champion design excellence and innovation throughout the organization, influencing cross-functional teams and setting the standard for high-impact solutions.

*Success in this role looks like:*

* In the first 90 days, you have partnered with senior engineering to deliver multiple prototype iterations, which are now actively in the hands of end users. You have dramatically elevated the user experience and are setting a new benchmark for design excellence. Your deep collaboration with leadership and data science teams has been essential in weaving ML features into the design and breaking new ground.
* By six months, you have seamlessly integrated next-gen design patterns into the workflows of other designers and PMs. You’ve also incorporated these patterns and improvements into the Design System as a member of the Design System Team, while retiring or updating outdated patterns. You are now balancing the fine-tuning of next-gen experiences with launching new, high-impact projects, demonstrating your strategic vision and agility across the organization.
* Long term, you continue to lead groundbreaking exploration projects with substantial potential. You are working collaboratively with senior leadership and data science teams to drive strategic design advancements. As a key player in the Design System, you are elevating design quality, consistently pushing the envelope and setting new standards for excellence.

*You should get in touch if:*

* You have 7+ years of in-house design experience, including working autonomously with senior technical teams and integrating complex features like ML to deliver consumer-level, best-in-class experiences.
* You have a portfolio that demonstrates industry mastery (healthcare experience is a plus but not required), showcasing advanced expertise in interaction and visual design, with a track record of creating outstanding, next-level user experiences.

title: English to Ukrainian Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an English to Ukrainian Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content based in South Africa.*

This freelance opportunity is ideal for an experienced Ukrainian linguist with a strong background in localization quality assurance and language quality governance. You’ll serve as the primary linguistic quality expert for a major global technology client, ensuring consistent standards across user interfaces, marketing, product, legal, informational, and support content. Working closely with reviewers, post-editors, and client stakeholders, you’ll translate quality expectations into practical guidance and measurable improvements. You’ll lead calibration activities, coach linguists, manage escalations, and ensure arbitration decisions are evidence-based and aligned with client expectations. With approximately 24 hours of work per month, this remote engagement offers ongoing collaboration with global teams on high-visibility technology products. You’ll also contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues and strengthening localization practices across the language community.

Accountabilities
----------------

*

*Own localization quality standards:* Define and maintain a shared understanding of quality expectations for English-to-Ukrainian content across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support materials.

*

*Analyze client requirements:* Review style guide and glossary updates, assess their impact on content types and quality categories, and document changes and evolving expectations.

*

*Monitor client feedback:* Track corrections, feedback, and decisions from the client’s Language Manager during calibration sessions and quality discussions to ensure practical expectations are reflected in daily work.

*

*Drive community alignment:* Organize regular alignment roundtables and publish monthly quality reports covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, recurring errors, and arbitration outcomes.

*

*Coach and develop reviewers:* Provide individualized feedback using specific examples, conduct shadowing sessions, and deliver targeted training based on real quality and alignment data.

*

*Improve linguistic standards:* Identify recurring justification patterns and quality issues, develop evidence-based style guide proposals, and share cross-locale insights with the quality management team.

*

*Manage client communication:* Act as the primary linguistic point of contact for the client’s Language Manager, handling clarifications, quality discussions, escalations, and expectation tracking.

*

*Oversee arbitration quality:* Ensure that all arbitration cases submitted to the client are valid, well-documented, and supported by clear evidence.

*

*Monitor quality performance:* Take ownership of the locale’s review service score, including RQE audit results and alignment performance, while tracking error concentrations, severity trends, and consistency.

*

*Support continuous improvement:* Reduce recurring quality discrepancies, strengthen collaboration between reviewers and post-editors, and improve alignment with client standards over time.

Requirements
------------

*

*Relevant experience:* Three to five or more years of experience in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), senior language leadership, quality governance, or a closely related role.

*

*Client and stakeholder management:* Demonstrated experience serving as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration and escalation processes, and resolving linguistic disagreements professionally.

*

*Localization quality expertise:* Strong practical knowledge of localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, severity mapping, and quality audit methodologies.

*

*Style guide analysis:* Ability to interpret style guide and glossary changes, identify implicit client expectations, and apply appropriate quality tolerances across different content types, such as marketing, legal, and UI.

*

*Coaching and facilitation:* Hands-on experience delivering one-to-one reviewer coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting.

*

*Analytical skills:* Ability to identify error patterns, monitor severity drift and alignment scores, interpret quality data, and turn recurring issues into actionable improvements.

*

*Language proficiency:* Native-level Ukrainian and professional-level English, with excellent written communication and linguistic judgment in both languages.

*

*Communication and conflict resolution:* Strong facilitation, negotiation, stakeholder management, and evidence-based decision-making skills.

*

*Preferred experience:* Previous involvement in major technology localization programs and familiarity with calibration or alignment tools.

*

*Location eligibility:* Must be physically located in an approved country. Poland is an eligible location.

*

*Onboarding requirements:* Successful candidates must complete a background check and use the dedicated device provided for project work.

Benefits
--------

*

*Fully remote freelance work:* Work from an approved country without the need to commute to an office.

*

*Flexible, limited monthly commitment:* Approximately 24 hours of work per month, suitable for professionals seeking a part-time project engagement.

*

*Long-term collaboration:* Opportunity to build an ongoing professional partnership with global teams working on high-visibility technology products.

*

*Steady project volume:* An established scope of work designed to support continued engagement.

*

*Comprehensive onboarding:* Access to onboarding support and guidance to help you understand project expectations and workflows.

*

*Ongoing training:* Opportunities to strengthen localization quality, linguistic governance, and review practices.

*

title: Principal Architect
description:
*About Us*

Majesco isn’t just riding the AI wave – we’re leading it for the P&C, L&AH, and Pension & Retirement markets. Born in the cloud and built with an AI-native vision, we’ve reimagined the insurance and pension core as an intelligent platform that enables insurers and pension & retirement providers to move faster, see farther and operate smarter. As leaders in intelligent SaaS solutions, we’ve embedded AI and Agentic AI throughout our robust product portfolio of core, underwriting, loss control, distribution, digital solutions, and pension & retirement administration so our customer can reimagine their business with real-time business insights, optimized operations, and enhanced business outcomes. Everything we build is designed to strip away complexity and let our clients focus on what matters: delivering exceptional products, experiences, and long-term financial security for policyholders and plan participants.

In a world where change is constant, our native-cloud SaaS platform empowers insurers, MGAs, and pension & retirement providers with the agility to adapt to evolving risk, regulation, and market expectations, modernize operating models, and accelerate innovation at scale. With 1400+ implementations and more than 375 customers worldwide, Majesco is the AI-native solution trusted to power the future of insurance and pension & retirement. Break free from the past and build the future of insurance

At Majesco, this means joining a team leading the insurance and retirement industry through the AI revolution. You’ll collaborate with experienced leaders and global teams building and scaling AI-native solutions that solve complex, real-world challenges - where innovation moves from concept to production, decisions carry real weight, and execution matters. If you’re looking for a place where your expertise is trusted, your judgment is valued, and your work helps define what’s next for intelligent insurance and retirement technology, Majesco is where that work happens.

*Principal Architect - Majesco P&C*

*Job Summary:*

* The Principal Architect - Majesco P&C is responsible for defining and driving solution architecture for Majesco P&C customer implementations and modernization programs. The role translates business and technology requirements into scalable, secure and supportable solutions across Majesco Policy, Billing, Claims, Digital, Data and integration capabilities. The Principal Architect works closely with customers, Product, Engineering and Services teams to make sound architecture decisions, proactively manage technical risks, maximize product capabilities and ensure solutions are delivered with quality, predictability and long-term maintainability.

*Key Responsibilities:*

* Own end-to-end solution architecture for assigned Majesco P&C implementations, ensuring alignment with customer business outcomes, Majesco product capabilities and architecture standards.
* Define solution blueprints across Policy, Billing, Claims, Digital, Data, APIs, integrations and surrounding customer ecosystem components.
* Translate business, functional and non-functional requirements into clear architecture decisions, integration patterns and implementation guidance.
* Lead solution and design reviews, identifying architecture risks, dependencies, performance concerns and product gaps early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Drive a product-first approach by maximizing out-of-the-box capabilities, minimizing unnecessary customization and promoting reusable implementation patterns.
* Partner with Product Management and Engineering to evaluate solution gaps and determine appropriate configuration, extension, integration or product enhancement approaches.
* Work directly with customer architects and technology teams to explain architecture options, trade-offs, risks and recommendations.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to solution architects, technical leads and engineering teams throughout implementation.
* Promote automation, AI-enabled engineering practices, architecture standards and reusable assets that improve delivery quality and predictability.

*Essential Attributes & Capabilities:*

* Strong architectural judgment with the ability to simplify complex business and technology problems and make clear, outcome-oriented decisions.
* Excellent executive communication and customer engagement skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset with the ability to anticipate risks, drive decisions and lead through ambiguity without waiting for direction.
* Strong collaboration skills across Product, Engineering, Services, Delivery, Security, Cloud, Data and customer teams.
* Commitment to engineering quality, architecture governance and a 'do it right the first time' mindset while balancing delivery speed and business priorities.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and root-cause problem-solving skills across complex distributed systems.
* Ability to mentor and influence architects and engineering teams without relying solely on formal authority.
* Strong preference for standardization, reuse and automation over one-off or highly customized solutions.
* Hands-on understanding of agile product development and implementation delivery models.
* Customer-outcome and growth mindset with a strong focus on predictability, scalability, quality and long-term maintainability.
* Ability to work independently, remotely, and as part of a team.

*Technical Expertise:*

* Deep architecture experience with enterprise P&C insurance platforms; strong understanding of Policy Administration, Billing and Claims business capabilities and implementation patterns.
* Strong knowledge of Majesco P&C solutions is highly preferred, including Majesco Policy, Billing, Claims and related Digital, Data and integration capabilities.
* Proven experience designing cloud-native SaaS and distributed enterprise architectures, including microservices, APIs, event-driven integration, resiliency, scalability, observability and security.
* Strong understanding of integration architecture and technologies including REST APIs, asynchronous messaging/events, API management, identity and access management, OAuth/OIDC and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with public cloud architecture (AWS and/or Azure), containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevSecOps and modern application delivery practices.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, data migration/conversion, reporting/analytics integration and performance considerations for large-scale insurance implementations.
* Ability to define and assess non-functional requirements including performance, availability, scalability, security, recoverability and operational supportability.
* Working knowledge of AI/GenAI/Agentic AI architecture patterns, governance and practical application within software engineering and insurance business processes is preferred.

*Preferred Qualification & Experience:*

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* Typically 12+ years of enterprise technology experience, including significant solution/technical architecture experience.
* 7+ years of P&C insurance technology experience or comparable experience implementing enterprise insurance platforms strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience owning architecture for complex, multi-system enterprise implementation programs and engaging directly with customer architects, technology leaders and delivery teams.
* Prior experience with Majesco or another leading P&C core insurance platform is strongly preferred.

Service Monitoring & Operations

Incident & Problem Management

Change & Release Support
------------------------

---------------------------------
Operational Continuity & Recovery
---------------------------------

Process Improvement & Automation

* Support automation initiatives that reduce manual operational effort.
* Contribute to operational process redesign and service optimization projects.
* Recommend monitoring, alerting, and workflow enhancements.

--------------------------
Documentation & Governance
--------------------------

* Document incidents, service interruptions, recovery activities, and changes.
* Support audit, compliance, and governance activities.
* Ensure adherence to organizational operating standards and technology policies.

-----------------------
Performance & Reporting
-----------------------

* Produce operational metrics, service reports, and trend analyses.
* Monitor SLA, availability, incident, change, and operational performance indicators.
* Support leadership reporting and performance reviews.
* Identify actionable recommendations based on operational data.

----------------------------------------
Technical Leadership & Knowledge Sharing
----------------------------------------

* Serve as a senior escalation resource for operational support teams.
* Provide technical coaching and guidance to junior analysts.
* Share operational knowledge and best practices.
* Support onboarding and development of team members.

******************
Scope & Complexity
******************

* Independently manages complex operational issues and service events.
* Coordinates response activities across multiple technical disciplines.
* Supports mission-critical systems and business services.
* Exercises judgment within established operational and governance frameworks.
* Frequently addresses ambiguous technical problems requiring analysis and prioritization.
* Influences operational decisions through technical expertise and service impact assessment.

***********************
Required Qualifications
***********************

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 4+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure operations, systems administration, NOC operations, cloud operations, or technology support environments.
* Experience supporting enterprise production environments.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management processes.
* Experience using enterprise monitoring and operational management tools.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

************************
Preferred Qualifications
************************

* ITIL Foundation or related service management certification.
* Microsoft, AWS, Azure, Cisco, VMware, Linux, or platform-specific certifications.
* Experience supporting cloud platforms and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience with automation, scripting, monitoring platforms, and operational analytics.
* Experience in healthcare, revenue cycle management, or highly regulated environments.

title: Principal Lead- Product Owner
description:
*About Our Company*

Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.

Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

*Job Description*

The Enterprise Architecture Product Owner is responsible for managing and evolving the Enterprise Architecture operating model, products, governance processes, work management practices, and knowledge repositories. The role serves as the central coordination point for architecture planning, execution tracking, governance, process maturity, documentation standards, reporting, and continuous improvement. This role requires close collaboration with Enterprise Architects and Technology Leaders to improve adoption of architecture standards, governance processes, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps

The individual drives consistent adoption of architecture processes maintains operational discipline across architecture teams, and drives transparency through effective governance, metrics, Jira management, and executive reporting.

The ideal candidate combines strong product ownership, program management, and Agile delivery expertise with a solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture practices and governance. They are highly organized, process-driven, and experienced in Jira and Confluence administration, Scrum and Kanban methodologies, backlog management, story-point estimation, executive reporting, and documentation governance. The individual will drive operational excellence, process maturity, transparency, and adoption across the Enterprise Architecture function.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Own the roadmap, backlog, adoption strategy, and operational metrics for Enterprise Architecture products, services, and governance capabilities.
* Define, document, govern, and continuously improve Enterprise Architecture processes, standards, workflows, templates, and operating procedures.
* Serve as the owner of the Enterprise Architecture operating model, ensuring consistent execution of architecture governance, planning, review, and lifecycle management processes.
* Manage architecture work intake, prioritization, planning, capacity management, and execution tracking across the Enterprise Architecture team.
* Act as the Jira and Confluence subject matter expert, administering workflows, automations, dashboards, reporting, templates, and knowledge repositories.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices, including backlog management, story creation, story-point estimation, sprint planning, Kanban flow management, and milestone tracking.
* Establish and maintain architecture documentation standards, architecture artifacts, governance records, and knowledge repositories to ensure information is accurate, current, and accessible.
* Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and reports that provide visibility into architecture demand, priorities, capacity, risks, dependencies, progress, and business outcomes.
* Facilitate architecture governance forums, architecture reviews, planning sessions, retrospectives, and cross-functional working sessions.
* Drive accountability for maintaining accurate work items, status updates, milestones, architecture artifacts, and governance records within Jira and Confluence.
* Establish and track KPIs, maturity metrics, adoption measures, and performance indicators to assess the effectiveness of Enterprise Architecture services and governance practices.
* Prepare executive presentations, leadership communications, governance updates, status reports, and decision-support materials.
* Identify and implement process improvements, automation opportunities, and AI-enabled capabilities that enhance architecture planning, governance, reporting, documentation, and operational efficiency.

*Required Qualifications*

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 12+ years of overall experience in technology program management, Agile delivery, PMO, delivery management, or related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience as a Program Manager, Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, or similar role within a technology organization.
* Strong practical experience with Jira administration, including workflow configuration, automation, dashboards, filters, and reporting.
* Experience coordinating work across multiple teams and driving accountability without direct reporting authority.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder-management, and follow-up skills.
* Experience preparing executive dashboards, leadership presentations, status reporting, and decision-support materials.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain attention to detail, and operate effectively with senior leaders and architects.
* Broad understanding of enterprise technology domains, including cloud, networking, security, data, platform engineering, and AI, with the ability to collaborate effectively with architects across these areas.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Working knowledge of AWS cloud concepts and services.
* Familiarity with Enterprise Architecture practices, governance processes, and technology portfolio management.
* Experience with Confluence, Power BI, Jira and similar collaboration and reporting tools.
* Understanding of AI productivity tools and their practical application to workflow automation, reporting, and knowledge management.
* Experience establishing governance routines and operating processes for technology teams.
* Agile, Scrum, Jira, project management, or program management certification.

title: Sr. Product Manager - B2C and Events
description:
ABOUT US
--------

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

OUR PEOPLE
----------

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

OUR IMPACT
----------

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that.

ABOUT THE TEAM
--------------

The B2C/Creators Product team at HighLevel is focused on building and scaling a world-class learning experience for our customers and their audiences. The platform currently serves over 1.1 million monthly active users, making it one of HighLevel's most widely adopted products. This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at scale while solving B2C-style learner experience problems within a B2B2C product ecosystem.

Events is one of the newest products in HighLevel's Memberships suite, currently in beta and being built from the ground up. It gives our customers a native way to create, publish and sell events — in-person, online and hybrid — with ticketing, RSVPs, paid and free registration, and attendee management, sitting directly alongside the contacts, communities, courses, credentials and automations they already run their business on. Organizers build and run their events from the Memberships admin; attendees live the whole thing inside Client Portal, next to the courses, communities and credentials they already sign in for.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
--------------

*

*Own and Shape the B2C & Events Roadmap* Partner with product leadership to help shape and execute the roadmap for HighLevel's B2C platform, serving 1.1M+ monthly active learners, with a focus on engagement, completion, and retention in a B2B2C environment.

*

*Close the Table-Stakes Gap, Then Go Past It –* Know the category cold. Get the expected capabilities right — ticket tiers, promo codes, capacity and waitlists, recurring and series events, refunds, embeddable widgets, calendar sync, wallet passes — and then decide deliberately where we go further than the incumbents rather than matching them feature for feature.

*

*Take Events from Beta to GA –* Own the beta exit criteria: the quality bar, the reliability bar, the feature completeness, and the adoption and revenue signals that tell us this product is ready to be sold broadly. Drive the program that closes those gaps.

*

*Build Ticketing, Checkout and Payments –* Lead paid, free and RSVP event types, multi-tier and multi-currency ticketing, checkout conversion, discounts, taxes, refunds and payouts — with the precision and trust a revenue-bearing flow demands, and with fee and payout terms that are a reason to choose us rather than a reason to resent us.

*

*Give Organizers Ownership of Their Audience –* Build the capability that most defines us against the category: every registration flows into the organizer's own CRM, segmentable, automatable and theirs to keep. Turn attendee data ownership from a talking point into the product's most obvious advantage.

*

*Own Event-Day Operations –* Events are judged on the day they happen. Own check-in and QR scanning, offline resilience at the door, guest lists and comp tickets, on-site sales, capacity enforcement and the operational tooling organizers depend on when things go wrong in real time.

*

*Own the Attendee Experience in Client Portal –* Client Portal is where the attendee side of Events lives, and you own it: how members find what is on, register and check out, hold their tickets, receive reminders and joining links, attend in person or online, and look back at what they have been to. Deliver that journey across both web and mobile, make events feel native to the portal rather than bolted onto it, and hold a phone-first bar throughout.

*

*Drive Distribution and Discovery –* Shape how events get found and filled: SEO-ready event pages, social and calendar syndication, embeddable listings, the Gokollab Marketplace, and the promotion tooling that turns an organizer's existing audience into attendance.

*

*Open the Platform –* Treat APIs, webhooks and integrations as a first-class surface rather than a premium upsell, so agencies and developers can build events into the workflows and client solutions they already sell.

*

*Champion UI/UX Excellence –* Partner closely with design and engineering to deliver interfaces that are intuitive, accessible, mobile-friendly and fast — for both the organizer building an event and the attendee registering for one.

*

*Talk to Organizers Constantly –* Run discovery with beta organizers, sit in on their setup, watch where they stall, and turn qualitative signal into a prioritized backlog. At this stage, direct customer contact is a primary input, not a supplement.

*

*Experiment and Optimize –* Design and analyze experiments across the funnel — event page conversion, registration completion, checkout drop-off, organizer onboarding — and iterate rapidly on evidence rather than opinion.

*

*Support Scale, Reliability and Trust –* Drive the platform work a live-event product demands: registration integrity, capacity and waitlist correctness, payment reliability, fraud and listing trust, and graceful behavior under the traffic spikes that come with a popular event going on sale.

*

*Collaborate Cross-Functionally –* Work across engineering, design, data, support, marketing and customer-facing teams to launch features, drive adoption, and close the loop on organizer feedback.

*

*Define and Own the Metrics –* Establish the success metrics for a product that does not yet have them — organizer activation, time to first published event, repeat-event rate, registration and checkout conversion, attendance rate, gross ticket volume and revenue per organizer — set the OKRs against them, and use them to steer the roadmap.

*

*Deliver Outcomes, Not Just Features –* Be accountable for measurable growth in events published, organizers activated, registrations processed and ticket revenue running through the platform.

WHO YOU ARE
-----------

*

*B2C Experience –* You have built and shipped impactful features for B2C platforms or content products, creating engaging end user experiences that drive activation, completion, and retention at meaningful scale.

*

*An End-to-End Owner –* You are comfortable owning the entire life of an event across two connected surfaces: the creator experience in the Memberships admin, where an organizer builds, prices, publishes, promotes and runs their event, and the attendee experience in Client Portal, where a member discovers it, registers, attends and looks back on it. You think in terms of the whole journey and the handoffs between those surfaces, not in terms of screens.

*

*UX-Attentive for Learning –* You bring a strong UI/UX sensibility focused on learner journeys, content discovery, progress tracking, and habit formation, with a track record of delivering intuitive and high-quality learning experiences.

*

*Experimentation-Minded –* You are comfortable running A/B tests and structured experiments to improve learner engagement and completion rates through rapid, evidence-based iteration.

*

*Learner-Centric –* You consistently balance business objectives with learner success, keeping learner needs, motivation, and outcomes at the center of product decisions.

*

*Customer-Obsessed –* You seek out organizers directly, run your own discovery, and can translate what you hear into product decisions without waiting for a research team to formalize it.

*

*Strategic and Execution-Focused –* You can contribute meaningfully to product vision while staying deeply involved in day-to-day execution to ensure ideas translate into real, measurable impact.

*

*Data-Informed –* You rely on behavioral data, funnel metrics, and cohort analysis to prioritize initiatives, validate assumptions, and guide product decisions.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING
-----------------

*

7+ years of Product Management experience, with meaningful exposure to events, ticketing, marketplace, commerce or B2B2C SaaS products.

*

Proven track record of taking a product from early stage to scaled adoption, with clear ownership of the decisions that made it work.

*

Hands-on experience with monetization mechanics — checkout, pricing and packaging, payments, refunds, payouts and fee structure — and the operational realities that come with them.

*

Working knowledge of the events and ticketing category, including how platforms such as Eventbrite, Luma, Meetup and Cvent are positioned, priced and differentiated.

*

Solid understanding of UI/UX principles, with the ability to partner closely with design to deliver intuitive, accessible and high-quality journeys for two distinct user types: organizers and attendees.

*

Familiarity with SaaS and B2C platform growth levers, including user activation, engagement loops, retention, lifecycle optimization, and audience monetization.

*

Comfort operating with ambiguity, incomplete data and shifting priorities in a fast-moving, remote-first environment.

*

Bonus: You have worked on an events, ticketing or community platform and can clearly articulate your personal impact on organizer growth, conversion and revenue.

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US?
-----------------------

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters.

Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.

Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

EEO Statement:
