LEAD. STRATEGIZE. TRANSFORM.

SUMMARY

Frontier Engineering's mission is to engineer guaranteed customer outcomes on Snowflake, the trusted control plane for AI-first business. We bring Snowflake engineers, AI specialists, and industry experts together with customers to modernize their data foundations and put AI into production, delivering measurable ROI in weeks and months, not quarters and years. We operate through two transformation engines: Data Transformation, which helps customers migrate, modernize, consolidate, and govern the data foundation that AI depends on; and Agentic Transformation, which helps customers build agents, intelligent applications, and AI-powered workflows that reimagine how their business runs.

As our first Engagement Manager based in New Zealand, you will be Frontier Engineering's in-market leader for your accounts across both Data Transformation and Agentic Transformation, and the single point of accountability for engagement outcomes, from first conversation through scoping, contracting, delivery, and expansion. You will work hand-in-hand with New Zealand account teams and with our Australia-based Services Solution Managers and Sales Solution Architects as one team: you bring local customer intimacy, deal shaping, and delivery leadership; they bring commercial and technical scoping depth. Together you will sell, shape, and deliver Frontier Engineering engagements that turn into production outcomes: Snowflake consumption and realized customer value.

WHY THIS ROLE?

- Build a market: Be the founding Frontier Engineering Engagement Manager in New Zealand, shaping how Snowflake delivers outcomes for some of the country's most important organizations.

- Sell, shape, and deliver: Own the engagement lifecycle end to end, with clear line of sight from a customer's business problem to the value delivered in production.

- Work at the frontier: Lead engagements across both Data Transformation (migration, modernization, governance) and Agentic Transformation (agents, AI applications, intelligent workflows), bringing capabilities like Cortex, Horizon, Iceberg, and Openflow into production for customers.

- Grow with us: A clear pathway to Principal level for those who demonstrate portfolio ownership, deal engineering, and market leadership.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

SELL & SHAPE

- In-Market Pursuit Leadership: Be the local Frontier Engineering point of contact for New Zealand Account Executives; qualify opportunities with account teams and engage early with executive sponsors to identify the business problem worth solving.

- Discovery & Value Shaping: Lead customer discovery and journey workshops in New Zealand that align on use-case priorities, target outcomes, and the business case; anchor every engagement to measurable value (revenue growth, cost reduction, risk reduction, faster time to value).

- Deal Shaping in Partnership: Work with Services Solution Managers on commercial strategy, value-based pricing, proposals, and Statements of Work (SOWs), and with Sales Solution Architects on solution scoping and estimation. Pressure-test scope, assumptions, and estimates for deliverability and margin before contract, and support internal Deal Review and approval.

- Forecast & Pipeline: Contribute to and maintain an accurate bookings forecast and pipeline for your New Zealand accounts alongside your Services Solution Manager and account team partners.

- Account Expansion: Build services roadmaps with account teams and identify "white space" where new Snowflake capabilities solve customer business problems, turning point engagements into multi-phase transformation programs.

- Partner Ecosystem: Work with SI, GSI, and ISV partners in New Zealand on co-delivery and co-sell approaches, extending delivery capacity under Frontier Engineering standards.

DELIVER

- Sales-to-Delivery Ownership: Own the handoff from pursuit to delivery, ensuring delivery readiness and that what was sold is what gets delivered; lead engagement kick-off to align stakeholders on scope, roles, timeline, and success metrics.

- Integrated Execution: Lead engagements through go-live and close-out; manage Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), RAID logs, and critical-path scheduling to mitigate schedule variance across multi-workstream technical implementations.

- Scope Protection: Identify scope creep in real time and negotiate protective Change Orders that safeguard project integrity and customer trust.

- Financial Ownership: Own engagement financials, including revenue forecasting, budget burn-down, cost control, and high Estimate at Completion (EAC) accuracy, protecting margin while delivering customer satisfaction.

- Escalation Leadership: Serve as the initial point of escalation for customers, partners, and project teams; lead decision-making in high-pressure situations.

- Value Realization & Close-out: Drive knowledge transfer, final retrospectives, and value readouts; secure customer references and identify the next opportunity.

ADVISE & IMPROVE

- Executive Engagement: Engage C-level and VP stakeholders to create and execute services roadmaps that drive real business outcomes; communicate risks and wins with clarity and transparency.

- Voice of the Customer: Translate field-level technical blockers into actionable feedback for Snowflake Product and Engineering teams.

- Practice Contribution: Feed delivery learnings back into scoping and estimation with Sales Solution Architects, contribute to Frontier Engineering reusable assets and playbooks, and use AI-assisted workflows (e.g., Snowflake Cortex Code for SOW drafting and engagement summaries) to work faster and smarter.

- Operational Hygiene: Maintain accurate Salesforce and financial system data for your portfolio, and support utilization of delivery resources.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE

- Experience: Typically a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 6 years with a Master's degree, or equivalent experience.

- Sales & Delivery Background: 10+ years in a Sales and Services Delivery role interfacing with executives on complex technical implementation projects such as cloud data warehouse and data platform implementation, modernization, or AI/ML adoption.

- Track Record: Proven achievement of quantitative targets such as bookings, utilization, consumption, and delivery margin.

- Deal Shaping: Demonstrated experience leading discovery, shaping scope and value propositions, and closing services deals as part of a sales team.

- Execution Rigor: Hands-on mastery of project governance (WBS, RAID, critical path), change management, and project financials (EAC).

- Executive Presence: Ability to command a room of C-suite executives while holding technical credibility in deep-dives with engineering and data science teams.

- Domain Expertise: Direct experience across data platform modernization (data warehousing, migration, BI, cloud data platforms) and AI/ML or GenAI adoption, with the range to lead both data foundation and AI application engagements; able to pivot from a high-level architecture discussion to a detailed task breakdown.

- Collaboration Across Distance: Proven ability to work as one team with sales, pre-sales, and delivery colleagues across locations, building trust and alignment without relying on co-location, as a remote-based team member.

- Adaptability: Comfortable switching instantly between sales support, project governance, and hands-on crisis management, and managing multiple accounts and projects in parallel with a high degree of autonomy.

BONUS POINTS

- Established network across New Zealand enterprise, government, or the local SI and partner community.

- Big 5 or boutique strategy consulting experience.

- Experience in a technical advisory role such as solution architect or technical account manager.

- Hands-on project experience with the Snowflake AI Data Cloud or other cloud data platforms on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

- Experience building a services practice or team presence in a new market.

title: Product Design Intern
description:
About us:
---------

Kiva is a global nonprofit, founded in 2005, with a mission to expand financial access and help underserved communities thrive. Kiva unlocks capital for borrowers through crowdfunded loans supported by individuals around the world. Lenders on Kiva can start with as little as $25 to support causes that matter most to them, whether that’s gender equity and support for women, refugees, climate change, small businesses, agriculture, and more. Since our founding, over two million people have invested *over $2 billion* in real dreams and real opportunity, spanning more than *100 countries* and *over 5 million* borrowers.

As we work toward our mission, Kiva invests in building and retaining a global team of talent to add to our values-driven and digital-first culture. Our organization is supported by over 700 volunteers and 130+ full-time employees dispersed around the world, as well as within team hubs located in San Francisco, Nairobi, Bogota, and Bangkok. Kiva’s team is growing as we pursue exciting new opportunities to scale our impact and create a financially inclusive world.
*Kiva's values:*

Impact first - This is why we exist. This is the drumbeat we march to. Every day.

Extreme ownership - Own it; you, your relationships, your impact. Insist that others support you and hold you accountable.

Be curious and bold - Never stop learning. Question assumptions. Take Risks and dream big.

Inclusion. Equity. Diversity. - Without reservation and without caveat. In our hiring, in our workplace and in our impact in the world.

Honor and integrity - Do the most right thing in the most right way. Cherish diversity and respect each other.

Love and kindness always - Say what you mean. Mean what you say. And don't say it mean. Clarity. Courage. Kindness.

*Internship Program*

Since its founding, volunteerism has been an integral part of Kiva's foundation and success. As a Kiva Intern, you will contribute your passion, drive, ideas, and expertise to expanding our reach and impact while taking on immediate and significant responsibilities within your team. In addition to learning on the job, you'll partake in a variety of educational, social, and professional development workshops and events that will accelerate your professional growth while learning about Kiva and the non-profit, technology, and microfinance sectors.

Through this volunteer internship, we’re hoping to provide a high-caliber learning experience. With the completion of our internship program, you will take away many in-demand job skills. Additionally, all Kiva interns will gain exposure to foundational microfinance concepts and ongoing professional development tailored to your career goals. This position will also put you in contact with a wide array of employees around the world, giving you a jump start on networking opportunities.

This Kiva internship is a *6-month* , *part-time (24- 32 hours per week)* , *United States-based, remote volunteer position*.

*Placement Process*

Kiva places interns within most departments of the organization. During recruitment, we evaluate your application and interests to match you to a specific team that will leverage your talents while providing you with an opportunity to develop and grow.

Although Kiva Interns range in age and experience, a common theme among our participants is a "can do" attitude as well as a desire and willingness to dive in and get their hands dirty.

Role overview:
--------------

Joining *Kiva's Design Team* , you'll be reporting to our Principal Product Designer. Our Product Design team has worked on experiences for some of the biggest brands in the world, including Apple, Google, HBO, and Mastercard. Your work at Kiva will enable people across the world to do good and help each other. This role requires a high level of collaboration with our Product Management and Engineering teams. We're looking for curious, thoughtful, collaborative people who want to live their values.

We're looking for a *Product Design Intern* with a focus on UX design, strong UX writing, and a knack for systems thinking. Each day will be super collaborative: you'll work with an international team of Kivans, designing features for millions of users, running studies with our Principal Researcher, and contributing to Kiva's design system.

At this time, we can only consider applicants with authorization to work in the United States on a permanent, full-time basis; unfortunately, we cannot provide visa sponsorship.

Key responsibilities include:
-----------------------------

* Partner with our Principal Researcher on at least one research project, helping conduct user interviews, usability tests, and surveys, and turning what you learn into insights that shape product decisions
* Join a cross-functional team of engineers and a product manager to design and ship at least one feature tested live on Kiva.org, from early flows and wireframes through launch
* Build interactive prototypes in Figma to explore ideas, test with users, and communicate designs to your team
* Contribute to Kiva's design system by defining and shipping at least one new component or primitive alongside the system's design and engineering leads
* Share your work in weekly design critiques with the team, giving and receiving feedback and explaining your decisions to designers and non-designers alike

Preferred qualifications:
-------------------------

* At least 21 years of age or older by *January 12, 2027*
* Able to commit to the full 6-month term
* Strong UX writing skills: you can write clear, concise, brand-aligned copy
* Systems thinking: you can spot patterns and design reusable components
* Visual and interaction design: you can create polished, intuitive interfaces with a strong eye for detail
* Comfortable working on macOS
* Proficiency with standard design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud
* AI design tools: you can use tools like Figma Make, Claude, and ChatGPT to explore and prototype ideas
* Able to keep track of projects from handoff to completion
* Proactive, able to meet deadlines, and able to explain design decisions to non-designers
* Exceptional communicator with a knack for articulating design rationale
* Thrives in an iterative process that involves listening, adapting, moving fast, talking with users, incorporating feedback, and constantly collaborating

What we offer:
--------------

* Professional development and skills workshops
* Access to Kiva’s network of Kiva Fellowship and Internship Alumni
* Optional participation in Kiva’s Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) and social activities such as happy hours and coffee chats
* References are gladly given for successful participants

Kiva's Internship is a part-time volunteer position, however, to help offset some expenses, Kiva will provide a modest stipend o *f $800 a month* (before taxes) to its volunteers. Please note that the stipend is considered taxable income, and we expect interns to do their own research as to how this may affect their personal/tax implications.

*The weekly time commitment for a Kiva Internship is 24 - 32 hours per week, from January 12, 2027 - June 30, 2027. Please make sure you have the availability to commit for the entire internship period before submitting an application.*

A diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other is an integral part of Kiva's culture. We actively welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and a great place to work. Join us and help us achieve our mission!

We will only accept applications directly from candidates. Kiva will not be responsible for any recruiting agency fees, absent a formal agreement.

title: Junior Linux Systemadministrator (m/w/d)
description:
**Heinlein Support ist der Spezialist in Sachen E-Mail-Server und Linux im Rechenzentrum. Unser Wissen und unsere Erfahrung geben wir an der Heinlein Akademie, im persönlichen Consulting, beim individuellen Hosting und mit unserem E-Mail-Provider** [**mailbox**](https://mailbox.org/de/ "mailbox.org") **weiter. Zu unseren Kunden zählen neben Universitäten, Behörden und Unternehmen aller Größenordnungen, auch Provider und internationale Carrier.**

Im Geschäftsbereich Heinlein Hosting betreiben wir für mailbox, unsere Geschäftskunden und internationale NGOs hochverfügbare, individuelle Server-Infrastruktur und nutzen dafür eigene Technik in zwei Berliner Rechenzentren. Wir verstehen uns als Solution Hoster und betreiben kein Massengeschäft.

Du fühlst Dich auf der Linux-Kommandozeile zu Hause, begeisterst Dich für Open Source und möchtest Dein Wissen in der Praxis vertiefen? Ob nach Deiner IT-Ausbildung oder mit Erfahrung aus eigenen Projekten: Bei uns kannst Du Dich in anspruchsvolle Technologien einarbeiten und Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung übernehmen. Uns interessieren Deine bisherigen Erfahrungen und Projekte und was Dich an Linux und Open Source begeistert.

Als **Junior Linux Systemadministrator (m/w/d)** in Voll- oder Teilzeit wirst Du Teil unseres Hosting-Teams. Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen betreust Du unsere Infrastruktur von alltäglichen Aufgaben im Systembetrieb bis zu Automatisierung, Container-Plattformen und hochverfügbaren Datenbanken. Die Position ist am Standort Berlin angesiedelt. Unser hybrides Arbeitsmodell bietet Dir eine flexible Aufteilung zwischen mobilem Arbeiten und dem Austausch im Büro.

## Deine Aufgaben

* **Du hältst unsere Systeme am Laufen**: Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit unserem Team an der Administration und Überwachung unserer Linux-Infrastruktur. Dabei übernimmst Du alltägliche Aufgaben im Systembetrieb und gehst technischen Problemen auf den Grund.
* **Du automatisierst, was sich automatisieren lässt**: Du erstellst und pflegst Skripte und Ansible-Playbooks. Mit OpenTofu oder Terraform verwaltest Du unsere Infrastruktur über Code-basierte Werkzeuge.
* **Du sorgst mit uns für zuverlässige Deployments**: Du betreust und optimierst unsere CI/CD-Pipelines, beispielsweise in GitLab, und entwickelst unsere Abläufe nach dem GitOps-Prinzip mit weiter.
* **Du entwickelst unsere Container-Plattformen mit**: Gemeinsam mit dem Team baust und betreibst Du Kubernetes- und OpenShift-Cluster und überwachst deren Zustand. Du stellst containerisierte Anwendungen bereit und analysierst Fehler auf Pod- und Node-Ebene.
* **Du arbeitest an sicheren Systemzugängen**: Du installierst, konfigurierst und administrierst Keycloak sowie angebundene Verzeichnisdienste. Du bindest Anwendungen über OIDC, OAuth2 und SAML an, pflegst Identitäts- und Zugriffsrichtlinien und gehst Problemen bei der Anmeldung und Rechtevergabe auf den Grund.
* **Du hilfst, unsere Daten verfügbar zu halten**: Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und Betrieb hochverfügbarer Datenbank-Cluster sowie bei der Einrichtung und Überwachung ihrer Replikation zwischen Rechenzentren. Dazu gehören Performance-Analysen, Backup- und Restore-Tests sowie Tests von Failover-Szenarien.
* **Du übernimmst Verantwortung**: Du beteiligst Dich an der vergüteten Rufbereitschaft und hilfst, die Verfügbarkeit unserer Systeme auch außerhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten sicherzustellen.

## Dein Profil

* **Du bringst eine passende Grundlage mit**: Du hast eine IT-Ausbildung, beispielsweise als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, oder ein Informatikstudium abgeschlossen.
* **Du kennst Dich mit Linux aus**: Du bewegst Dich sehr sicher auf der Kommandozeile, insbesondere unter SUSE und Debian, und kennst die Grundlagen von Berechtigungen und Netzwerken.
* **Du hast erste praktische Erfahrungen gesammelt**: Container mit Docker oder Podman sind Dir vertraut. Du hast bereits mit Bash oder Python sowie Git gearbeitet.
* **Du verstehst die technischen Grundlagen**: Du bringst Basiswissen zu Kubernetes oder OpenShift, Infrastructure as Code und relationalen Datenbanken mit. Die Grundideen von Datenbank-Replikation und Werkzeugen wie Ansible oder OpenTofu sind Dir bekannt.
* **Du hast Dich mit Authentifizierung beschäftigt**: Du verstehst die Grundlagen von Single Sign-on, OAuth2 und Tokens und hast erste Erfahrungen mit Werkzeugen wie Keycloak.
* **Du willst dazulernen und denkst mit**: Du arbeitest Dich gerne in neue Technologien ein, gehst Fehlern strukturiert auf den Grund und behältst Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit im Blick.
* **Du bringst Dich ins Team ein**: Du kommunizierst klar, fragst nach und holst Dir aktiv Feedback. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
About the Job
-------------

The Opportunity
---------------

As a UI/UX Designer at Emetlab, you will craft the experiences that make complex AI data infrastructure feel effortless, intuitive, and unmistakably premium. Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company delivering expert-produced, rigorously validated datasets and end-to-end AI solutions to frontier laboratories, Fortune 500 enterprises, ambitious startups, and sovereign AI programmes across the globe.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end design process, from research and ideation through to high-fidelity interfaces and interaction design. You will shape how clients discover, configure, and receive datasets, how domain experts navigate contributor workflows, and how internal teams monitor quality assurance pipelines, ensuring every touchpoint feels polished, purposeful, and built for precision.

This is a rare opportunity to define the design language of a platform that operates at the intersection of AI and data infrastructure, where your work will set the standard for how world-class organisations experience the data partner behind their most advanced models.

What You'll Do
--------------

Own the end-to-end design process from user research, wireframing, and prototyping through to final high-fidelity UI and interaction design. Design intuitive, elegant interfaces for complex workflows including dataset configuration, contributor task management, quality review dashboards, and client delivery portals. Conduct user research, usability testing, and accessibility audits to ensure every design decision is grounded in real user needs across both client and contributor experiences. Develop and maintain Emetlab's design system, establishing visual patterns, component libraries, and interaction guidelines that scale with the product. Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Operations teams to ensure designs are technically feasible, well-implemented, and delivered with fidelity. Create information architecture and data visualisation design that makes complex quality metrics, pipeline statuses, and dataset analytics immediately comprehensible. Champion clarity and usability at every level of the design process, ensuring the platform is efficient and delightful for users ranging from AI researchers to domain experts across 120+ countries.

What You'll Need to Succeed
---------------------------

2+ years of professional UI/UX design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft across web and mobile applications. Strong command of design tools such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe Creative Suite, with experience building and maintaining design systems. Experience designing for data-rich environments, dashboards, or enterprise platforms where clarity and information hierarchy are critical. A refined eye for typography, colour, spacing, and visual hierarchy, with an instinct for creating premium, polished experiences. Experience thriving in fast-paced environments where you own the full design lifecycle and collaborate directly with engineers. A collaborative disposition, comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Data Operations teams to bring ideas to life. Genuine interest in AI, data systems, or building tools that empower expert communities is highly valued.

Role Details
------------

Employment Type: Full-Time and Part-Time positions available Location: Fully Remote Stage: Growth stage, operational

About Emetlab
-------------

Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company built on a single conviction: the quality ceiling of any AI system is determined by its training data, not its architecture or compute. We produce expert-crafted, rigorously validated training datasets across 12 specialised domains, delivered by a global network of over 5,000 vetted domain specialists spanning 100+ languages and 50+ specialisations. Beyond datasets, we offer end-to-end AI solutions including Fine-Tuning, RLHF & Alignment, Red Teaming, Model Evaluation, Data Annotation, Synthetic Data Generation, and Pre-Training Data Pipelines.

We are not a crowd-sourcing platform. We are the data partner that matches the ambition of the teams building the next generation of AI, delivering measurable results: 42% accuracy improvements, 3x faster time-to-production, and 99.4% regulatory precision.

Equal Opportunity
-----------------

Emetlab is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome dedicated individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We believe that extraordinary products are built by extraordinary teams, and extraordinary teams are built on inclusion, respect, and the understanding that brilliance has no single origin.

If you require accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to our team and we will ensure your needs are met with care.

Let's build the future of AI training data, together

* Synthesize research and data and craft compelling stories to communicate insights that will shape service and technology innovations.
* Collaborate closely with product owners, clinicians, program leadership, and end-users to identify needs, pain points, and opportunities to improve clinical workflows and care delivery processes across the product lifecycle.
* Create wireframes, prototypes, visual designs, and interaction patterns tailored to a range of stakeholders.
* Design and deliver customized, engaging, results-oriented interventions and workshops to improve organizational and team performance.
* Apply Human-Centered Design (HCD) principles throughout the design process, including empathetic interviewing, needs assessments, co-design facilitation, and iterative refinement informed by real-world clinical feedback.
* Ensure designs align with the broader platform design system, UX philosophy, and Total Experience (TX) goals — integrating employee, customer, and user experience considerations into cohesive, end-to-end design solutions.
* Participate in usability testing, user interviews, and field validation with both clinical staff and patients, then rapidly iterate based on findings.
* Support developers during implementation and maintain design fidelity throughout the product and delivery lifecycle.
* Coordinate with product managers to facilitate stakeholder and clinical user interviews; review mockups and prototypes to promote intuitive design and user impact.
* Work with engineering teams to define features that address specific clinical and operational user problems; build complex prototypes incorporating data or new technology as needed.
* Leverage analytics and data to track, measure, and make recommendations to optimize user interfaces, clinical workflows, and overall experience.
* Support design of data capture interfaces, dashboards, and reporting tools that meet both clinical care and program performance needs.
* Contribute to the evolution of design standards, accessibility compliance (508), and scalable design systems to support the broader program and enterprise.
* Create internal style guides for HTML and CSS to ensure consistent, predictable user experiences across platforms.
* Apply Agile best practices — including backlog participation and iterative delivery — to continuously improve and shorten the software development lifecycle.

Qualifications
--------------

* Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Human Factors, Health Informatics, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in UX/UI or product design, with demonstrated work in federal, healthcare, or clinical environments.
* Portfolio demonstrating enterprise application design — ideally in military, federal health, or business process improvement contexts.
* Working knowledge of Human-Centered Design (HCD) or Design Thinking processes, including needs assessments and co-design facilitation and demonstrated experience applying design thinking/HCD principles and tools to solve client challenges.
* Proficiency with design and prototyping tools including Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud.
* Strong foundation in visual design, interaction design, accessibility, and responsive layouts.
* Understanding of UX principles, patterns, and 508 compliance for secure government environments.
* Ability to analyze usage data and translate it into actionable product and design direction.
* Working knowledge of HTML and CSS; basic knowledge of JavaScript.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with engineers, product owners, clinicians, and both military and civilian stakeholders.
* *Ability to obtain public trust; must be a U.S. Citizen.*

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
------------------------

* Familiarity with Advana and War Data Platform, Preferred Databricks UI/UX development work.
* Experience with Total Experience (TX) design, integrating Employee Experience, Customer Experience, UX, and Service Design.
* Experience with Agile delivery practices including backlog management and iterative user-centered development.
* UX-related certification from Nielsen Norman Group, LUMA Institute, Human Factors International, GeneralAssembly, or equivalent.
* Active TS/SCI clearance or eligibility preferred, given program coordination with Federal intelligence partners.

Target salary range: $92,000 - $115,000.

Get started from USD 30 for 10 infographics submitted!

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Molecule and BIO.xyz are building the foundation of Decentralized Science (DeSci) — where biotech meets web3 to make scientific research community-owned, transparent, and faster to market.

Molecule provides the infrastructure to turn intellectual property (IP) into programmable, on-chain assets through our IP-NFT framework and evolving protocol stack. This enables researchers, patients, and communities to fund and govern biotech projects in new, open ways.

is the coordination and economic layer of DeSci, powering BioDAOs through funding, governance, and ecosystem alignment.

Together, we are creating a new model for scientific discovery — one where breakthroughs are owned and advanced by the communities that believe in them.

We’re looking for a senior Product Designer to shape the user experience and visual language of Molecule’s web and mobile products. You’ll turn product goals and complex requirements into clear, intuitive interfaces, and you’ll own the design system that keeps everything we ship consistent.

You’ll sit within the Product team and work closely with Engineering and Marketing. You’ll take work from first concept through to pixel-perfect execution and implementation. We move fast, so we value iteration over perfection, quick prototypes over long specs, and designers who are comfortable using AI tools to explore ideas and test them early.

This is a role for someone who is as comfortable in a component library as in a whiteboard session. It suits someone who wants to define what great product design looks like in a space where the rules are still being written.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
--------------

*

Design and refine the user experience and interfaces for Molecule’s core applications across web and mobile, working within the Product team from concept to launch

*

Own and expand Molecule’s Design System by building and maintaining a scalable, accessible component library that keeps every product consistent

*

Deliver polished, pixel-perfect UI components that improve usability and clarity and stay aligned with our brand

*

Write clear component documentation, UI specs, and usage guidelines so handoff from design to development runs smoothly

*

Partner with Frontend Engineers through implementation to make sure what ships matches what was designed

*

Apply WCAG standards and UX best practices to make our products inclusive and easy to use

*

Build interactive prototypes, often with AI-powered tools, to explore ideas and test them with users quickly

*

Iterate on designs based on user feedback, data, and evolving product needs

*

Lead and facilitate design work, including setting up frameworks, running brainstorms, and presenting and defending design decisions to stakeholders

*

Contribute to Molecule’s broader visual identity across product and communications, working with external design partners on brand assets where needed

WHO YOU ARE
-----------

*

You have 7+ years of professional product or UI design experience, ideally on complex products

*

You have built and scaled design systems and hybrid component libraries across teams, and your portfolio shows it, including component libraries and detailed UI documentation

*

You’re a Figma expert with hands-on experience managing a design system in it

*

You understand HTML, CSS, and front-end frameworks well enough to design for feasibility and speak engineering’s language

*

You have a strong grasp of interaction design for both mobile and desktop

*

You actively use AI tools and AI-enhanced workflows in your design process

*

You’re ego-free and collaborative. You seek out feedback and critique and keep pushing your craft forward

*

You’re self-sufficient. You own the design process end to end, manage feedback, and drive execution without micromanagement

*

You communicate clearly and can explain the reasoning behind your work to designers, engineers, and leadership alike

NICE TO HAVE
------------

*

You’ve shipped AI or agent-based product experiences

*

You build and test working prototypes yourself, picking the right tool for the question at hand

*

Experience with design tokens and front-end design implementation

*

Knowledge of user testing methodologies and iterative research practices

*

Experience working with external design or branding agencies

*

Background in web3, biotech, or decentralised science

WHY MOLECULE
------------

*

The chance to define the product experience of a category, building the interfaces through which researchers, patients, and communities fund and govern science

*

Real ownership in a young, fast-growing team where your voice shapes both the product and the company

*

A team that values substance over titles, speed over process, and people who’ve built their way up

*

Competitive compensation
------------------------

We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equality and weaving a community that values diverse perspectives and experiences and are actively seeking a diverse pool of applicants. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Gameplay Designer | Fully Remote
location: Remote, United States, Canada, Spain, Czech Republic
description:
*What we are looking for:*

Are you a gameplay designer with a passion for making games? Escape Velocity is looking for a Game Designer with strong scripting skills. You will be in charge of creating and implementing gameplay mechanics across the game, ensuring they are balanced and fun to play.

*What we will do together:*

* Develop and oversee multiplayer match mechanics and features.
* Work alongside other designers, artists, animators, and engineers to document, then implement these features in engine.
* Use our visual scripting tools to create complex and dynamic gameplay.
* Refine your implementation through playtest feedback and live data.
* Collaborate closely with leads and directors to channel the game the vision through your designs.

*What you will bring:*

* 3+ years of experience working on a multiplayer and/or live service game.
* At least one shipped AAA title.
* Expert knowledge of game scripting and expertise with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
* Vector math skills.
* A passion for competitive gaming, with professional understanding of current multiplayer action games.
* Strong creative and technical problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills.

*Interested… a bit about Escape Velocity:*

Escape Velocity is a team of passionate, talented developers working at a studio that offers excellent benefits, on what we believe is a once-in-a-career project with a committed publisher. But that doesn’t necessarily make us unique. What does make us special? We value the time, energy, and talent of our players and our colleagues. We want every hour spent developing and playing our games to be an incredibly rewarding and worthwhile use of your time. To that end, we are ‘Fully Remote’ and support team members nearly anywhere in the world. We prioritize honesty, even when that means sharing bad news. We strive to give everyone autonomy so they can determine how best to work and play, and we care more about what you bring to the game and studio than how many hours you’re clocking. We’re dedicated to building a culture of play, which not only makes us better game makers, but also strengthens the bonds between us all. We believe in constant improvement across all areas – from the game itself to our production design – and are constantly re-evaluating how we spend our time to ensure that we’re not wasting yours and we’re all always working on the most important things.

*A few benefits you can expect from us:*

* A generous PTO allowance

* Summer and Winter holidays studio closure (separate to PTO allowance)

* Private Medical & Dental Healthcare

* Private Mental Health scheme

* A generous annual Health & Wellbeing allowance

*Production*

* Design and refine materials, applying strong fundamentals in typography, layout, and visual hierarchy.

* Run every external-facing deliverable through the pre-publish audit checklist prior to release; own and refine the checklist itself over time.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Company Overview
----------------

Hello from Pinger! We’re a remote-first company headquartered in San Jose, California. Our market-leading communications apps, TextFree, Sideline, and Index, have been downloaded by hundreds of millions of iOS and Android users around the world. We’re profitable, growing, and having fun—and we’re looking for someone to join us!

The Role
--------

Pinger is seeking a talented and curious Senior Graphic Designer to join our Marketing team.

You’ll work with our Marketing, Growth, and Social teams, combining strong design fundamentals, original creative thinking, and demonstrable, hands-on expertise with generative AI to support the production of static and motion Marketing assets that effectively communicate our brand narratives across Pinger’s web properties, social profiles, in-app campaigns, and paid acquisition channels. You’ll also help Pinger develop smarter, faster, and more responsible AI-enabled creative workflows.

Responsibilities
----------------

* Conceptualize and develop high-quality static and motion assets for our brands’ digital properties in an inspired and visually arresting manner, including: websites and landing pages, app stores, in-app communications for lifecycle marketing and paid acquisition, social media, and other marketing media.

* Publish and update content in WordPress and support routine maintenance of marketing web properties.
* Create visual and motion assets for lifecycle and paid acquisition efforts.
* Create performance ads for YouTube, Meta platforms, and TikTok.
* Create motion and video content for organic social use, with particular emphasis on YouTube, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels.
* Adapt and resize ad/social creative for multiple dimensions, placements, markets, and file formats without compromising quality.
* Manage multiple projects and priorities while consistently delivering accurate, production-ready assets on schedule.
* Design with accessibility in mind, including legibility, hierarchy, color contrast, captions, and the needs of audiences across devices and platforms.

* Use generative AI as an integral part of the creative workflow to explore concepts, develop visual directions, create and edit imagery, generate variations, and accelerate production.

* Apply strong art direction and hands-on design craft to refine AI-assisted work, ensuring every final asset feels intentional, original, and consistent with Pinger’s brand standards.
* Review AI-assisted work for visual artifacts, factual inaccuracies, bias, inappropriate representation, brand risk, and potential intellectual-property concerns before publication.
* Build reusable prompts, reference libraries, templates, skills, and repeatable workflows that improve creative consistency and production efficiency across several departments.
* Evaluate emerging AI tools and recommend practical additions to Pinger’s creative toolkit based on quality, controllability, workflow fit, security, and commercial-use considerations.
* Follow company policies governing confidential information, customer data, intellectual property, model usage, representation, disclosure, and content provenance.

* Present concepts and works in progress to stakeholders, explain creative decisions, receive feedback constructively, and translate that feedback into thoughtful final work.

* Collaborate with Growth and Marketing partners to evaluate creative performance, identify patterns, and apply learnings to future concepts and iterations.

Qualifications
--------------

* 5+ years of professional graphic design experience, including a portfolio demonstrating strong conceptual exploration, brand design, website & landing page development, digital ad campaign work, and social media collateral.
* A bachelor’s degree in graphic design, art, visual communication, or a related discipline or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience designing marketing creative for consumer-facing mobile apps or subscription products.
* Advanced proficiency with Figma and experience working within shared design systems, component libraries, and collaborative creative workflows.
* Advanced proficiency with WordPress, HTML/CSS, and web-content publishing, and familiarity with different WordPress themes, editors, and creative tools.
* Advanced proficiency with AI creative tools or platforms, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Creatify, Midjourney, Runway, Adobe Firefly, Ideogram, Flux, and/or other comparable tools.

* Demonstrable experience using generative AI in professional creative work—not only prompting, but also directing, evaluating, compositing, retouching, and refining outputs into production-quality assets.
* A clear understanding of when AI improves a creative workflow—and when traditional design, illustration, photography, or production methods will produce a better result.
* Proficiency with AI video, voice, audio, and/or avatar tools.
* A commitment to responsible AI use, inclusive representation, accessibility, brand safety, and respect for intellectual property.
* Strong visual judgment and exceptional attention to detail, including the ability to identify subtle inconsistencies and artifacts in both AI and designer-generated content.

* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, and Premiere Pro.

* Strong motion design and short-form video skills, including an understanding of pacing, sound, hooks, platform conventions, and visual storytelling.

* Ability to move fluidly between divergent exploration and precise execution.
* Experience receiving a creative brief, asking smart questions, presenting a rationale, and carrying work from early concept through final production.
* Strong communication, presentation, organization, and project-management skills in a remote, cross-functional environment.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to continuously learn and grow as creative tools and practices evolve.

Nice to Have
------------

* Experience with the Kadence theme in WordPress
* Experience with App Store and Google Play Store creative, including screenshots, preview videos, and creative testing.
* Experience building AI-first creative production workflows.

Compensation
------------

* $100k - 130k, commensurate with experience. This role is also eligible for a target annual bonus equal to 30% of base salary.

Benefits
--------

We believe great work starts with a supportive environment at work and at home. Our benefits are designed to give you flexibility, financial security, peace of mind, and more time for what matters most.

* Remote-first workplace—do your best work from wherever you thrive
* Up to 30% bonus program that rewards your contributions and impact
* Equity opportunities that let you share in the company’s success
* 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents, plus company contributions to your HRA or HSA
* Monthly pet insurance reimbursement because furry family members matter, too
* Flexible Time Away policy to rest, recharge, and handle life’s important moments
* 11 company holidays, plus additional wellness days throughout the year
* Paid parental leave to welcome and care for a new family member
* Home-office setup support and internet reimbursement

Please submit a portfolio of your recent work with your resume. We'd especially like to see examples that demonstrate your creative process, including how you have used AI or other emerging tools to develop, refine or scale an idea. Clearly identify your individual contribution to collaborative projects and distinguish AI-assisted elements where relevant.

We're excited to meet you!
--------------------------

Salary: $100k - 130k DOE. This role is also eligible for a target annual bonus equal to 30% of base salary.

title: Product Security Analyst
description:
This role within the Vehicle and Connected Cybersecurity organization is responsible for hands-on operational monitoring and incident response for connected vehicle and cloud environments. As part of the Product Security Operations Center (PSOC) team, you will triage alerts, support investigations, and help drive timely resolution across vehicle telematics, embedded systems, and cloud-native application stacks. This role contributes directly to Ford’s continuous cybersecurity monitoring capability for connected vehicles and the cloud services that support them.

Reporting to the Manager of Monitoring Operations, this role focuses on alert triage, incident support, and continuous improvement of monitoring processes. We are seeking candidates with a solid cybersecurity foundation, including API security experience, along with embedded-vehicle exposure or a demonstrated aptitude and eagerness to learn. You will partner with cloud, vehicle, enterprise, incident-response, and global PSOC teams to help ensure effective investigation and resolution of security events affecting connected vehicles and the cloud services that power them.

*

*Operational Monitoring and Incident Response:* Perform daily PSOC alert triage and support incident coordination, containment, remediation, recovery, and closure.

*

*Cloud & Embedded Investigation and Resolution:* Support investigations of security events across cloud application stacks and embedded vehicle architectures using available logging and telemetry.

*

*Global PSOC Collaboration and Continuity* : Partner with PSOC teams across regions to deliver consistent monitoring, investigation, and incident-response services; maintain effective continuity and handoffs for active security events.

*

*Operational Improvement and Feedback Loop:* Surface operational friction points and provide feedback to help improve detection logic, tooling, and response workflows.

*Cross-Functional Partnership:* Collaborate closely with the Cyber Incident Response Team (CIRT), Product Development, and Enterprise IT to execute response playbooks and coordinate complex mitigations.

*

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Engineering, or related field.

*

2+ years in cybersecurity, security operations, or a related technical field.

*

Working understanding of incident response lifecycles, escalation, and incident management practices.

*

Experience with API security and exposure to cloud security operations on one or more major cloud platforms, including logging, monitoring, identity, and response workflows.

*

Embedded vehicle cybersecurity exposure, or a demonstrated aptitude and eagerness to learn.

*

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced 24x7 operations environment, including shift-based coverage.

*

Clear written and verbal communication for documenting incidents and coordinating with technical teams.

title: Business Lead
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Business Lead, you will be commercially responsible for the success of a new product at Ramp. The mandate is to do whatever it takes to grow the business. You will be expected to identify and resolve internal and external bottlenecks, often with limited guidance and support. You will set the strategy, prove out new bets, and influence how hundreds of go‑to‑market teammates sell and support the product. It’s an opportunity to run a “business within the business” at a meaningful scale while working directly with Ramp’s senior leadership.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Set the strategy: Define the target customer, value proposition, pricing, packaging, and GTM approach.

- Own the plan and results: Set goals, measure progress, and take action when the things are off track.

- Drive cross-functional execution: Align stakeholders from different teams around clear priorities and goals.

- Own feedback loops: Work with customers and turn feedback into product and go-to-market changes.

- Build for scale: Identify resource needs, create repeatable processes, and transition mature work to the appropriate long-term teams.

WHAT YOU NEED

- 5–10+ years in highly analytical, business‑driving roles

- A self-starter who will run through walls to get things done

- Exceptional analytical skills and command of data

- A systems thinker who understands how to build things that scale

- Strong communication skills and a team player

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual membership

- 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

- Pet insurance

- In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

- Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

CANADA

- Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

- Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

- Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

- Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

UNITED KINGDOM

title: Senior Software Engineer, Observability
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

The Infrastructure & Productivity team builds the technical foundation that enables Airwallex’s global engineering organisation to scale. Our customers are fellow engineers, and we make their work faster, safer, and more effective through reliable platforms, automation, and observability systems.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Observability team, you’ll build and operate the platforms that give engineering teams clear, timely, and actionable insight into the health and performance of Airwallex’s distributed systems. You’ll help reduce time to detect and resolve incidents, improve system reliability, and establish scalable observability practices across the company.

- Build and operate highly scalable observability platforms covering metrics, logs, traces, events, alerting, dashboards, and service health.

- Develop reliable software and platform capabilities that enable engineering teams to instrument, monitor, and troubleshoot their services with minimal friction.

- Establish and evolve observability standards, including telemetry collection, instrumentation, alert quality, SLOs, SLIs, service ownership, and operational readiness.

- Improve incident detection, diagnosis, and response through actionable alerts, intelligent correlation, service dependency visibility, and effective runbooks.

- Build self-service tools and paved paths that make best practices the easiest way for engineers to adopt observability.

- Partner closely with application, infrastructure, SRE, security, and product teams to understand operational challenges and deliver durable solutions.

- Improve the scalability, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of observability systems across multiple regions and environments.

- Participate in design reviews, technical planning, code reviews, incident response, and post-incident learning.

- Mentor engineers and contribute to a culture of ownership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

This role is based in SG or South Korea

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

ESSENTIALS

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating production systems.

- Strong proficiency in at least one backend programming language, such as Go, Java, Python, or Kotlin.

- Hands-on experience designing and operating distributed systems at scale.

- Practical experience with observability platforms and technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, ELK, or equivalent solutions.

- Strong understanding of metrics, logs, traces, alerting, service-level indicators, service-level objectives, and incident management.

- Experience with cloud-native environments, Kubernetes, containers, and public cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

- Experience with infrastructure as code and automated software delivery, using tools such as Terraform and CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong system design and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make sound technical decisions in complex and ambiguous environments.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively with globally distributed engineering teams.

- An ownership mindset and a commitment to improving systems rather than simply treating symptoms.

PREFERRED

- Experience building observability platforms or internal developer platforms used by multiple engineering teams.

- Experience with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, Loki, Tempo, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, Kafka, or similar technologies.

- Experience designing high-volume telemetry ingestion, storage, querying, aggregation, and retention systems.

- Familiarity with SRE practices, including on-call operations, incident response, postmortems, runbooks, and error budgets.

- Experience with service meshes, Kubernetes operators, or large-scale microservice platforms.

- Contributions to observability, cloud infrastructure, reliability, or open-source projects.

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

- You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

- You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

- You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

- You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

- You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

The Infrastructure & Productivity team at Airwallex builds the technical foundation that allows our global engineering organisation to scale. Our customers are our fellow engineers, and our mission is to make their daily work faster, safer, and more effective by managing the core platforms everyone relies on, from Kubernetes and Kafka to CI/CD pipelines and observability systems. The real challenge lies in keeping these global systems highly reliable and secure while simultaneously optimising cloud costs, automating manual support, and driving standardisation without slowing down product delivery. We operate under the philosophy that best practices should be the path of least resistance, not a forced mandate. If you're a systems thinker who wants to work close to the core of the company and directly shape how we build, deploy, and scale software worldwide, this is where that work happens.

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. title: Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics
description:

Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for an Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics to own the integrity, visibility and management of Airwallex’s payment costs, starting with card scheme fees and interchange fees across Visa and Mastercard.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will be the subject matter expert on scheme economics, translating complex and rapidly changing network rules into accurate system configurations, financial outcomes and business decisions. You will ensure we understand what every payment should cost, that those costs are accurately reflected across our systems and financials, and that we systematically identify opportunities to improve payment economics as we scale.

Over time, the remit will expand across other card schemes, local payment methods and the broader payments cost base.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own scheme economics and rule interpretation: Maintain deep expertise across scheme fees, interchange and network rules. Interpret scheme bulletins, operating regulations and fee schedules, translating changes into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

- Ensure accurate payment cost configuration: Translate complex scheme rules into fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic. Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure cost calculation, allocation and customer billing accurately reflect current network rules across markets and payment flows.

- Protect payment cost integrity: Establish robust governance, testing and controls across scheme configurations. Reconcile expected costs against actual network charges, identify anomalies and leakage, and drive root-cause resolution.

- Build granular visibility into payment economics: Develop robust models and analytics across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types, creating a clear view of unit economics, margin drivers and cost movements.

- Drive structural cost and margin optimization: Identify, quantify and execute opportunities to improve economics through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration, and other levers. Partner with Product, Finance and Commercial teams to prioritize the highest-value opportunities.

- Shape pricing and commercial decisions: Translate underlying payment economics into recommendations for customer pricing, product design, new market launches and commercial strategy, ensuring growth is supported by sustainable unit economics.

- Build scalable infrastructure and automation: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to strengthen cost engines, fee allocation logic, dashboards and automated controls. Apply AI and advanced analytics to accelerate rule interpretation, detect anomalies and surface optimization opportunities.

- Own complex scheme economics issues: Serve as the escalation point for scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions, working directly with Visa, Mastercard and other payment partners where required.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- 7+ years of relevant experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or related roles, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech.

- Deep knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules.

- Strong ability to operationalize complex payment rules, translating fee schedules and network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls.

- Experience with payment cost systems and controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations.

- Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modeling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs.

- Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to connect detailed payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimization.

- Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale.

- Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners.

ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is a global payments and financial infrastructure platform that helps businesses move money globally. Our products span payments, accounts, treasury, cards, spend management and more, giving businesses a simpler way to manage their financial operations across borders.

We’re building the future of global finance, and our People & Talent team plays an important role in helping Airwallex scale responsibly. We’re looking for thoughtful, hands-on operators who care deeply about employee experience and enjoy turning complex people processes into simple, effective solutions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As Manager, People Operations, EMEA, you’ll help deliver a high-quality employee experience across a growing and diverse region. You’ll combine hands-on operational ownership with process improvement, partnering closely with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Total Rewards, Workplace Experience, Legal and business leaders.

You’ll own core employee lifecycle processes across EMEA, support local compliance and benefits administration, maintain accurate people data, and help employees and managers navigate People-related questions. You’ll also contribute to the evolution of our regional operating model, identifying opportunities to improve, automate and scale the way we work.

This is a role for someone who is comfortable operating at both the detail level and the regional level: ensuring every onboarding, payroll input and employee query is handled well while also building better systems for the future.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead and develop the regional People Operations function; own end-to-end employee lifecycle operations (onboarding/orientation, background checks, HRIS data integrity, payroll inputs/changes, benefits and leaves, offboarding) for an EMEA footprint with ~400 employees, with a strong focus on delivery quality and compliance.

- Drive operational excellence by codifying and maintaining regional SOPs, managing the P&T JIRA helpdesk queue, and setting clear workflows and standards that are consistent with global guidance.

- Partner cross-functionally with Payroll, IT, and Compliance on accurate and timely transactions, audits, vendor coordination, invoicing/POs, and change control.

- Run regular data audits and quality checks, identify discrepancies and improve data integrity, reporting and governance.

- Support the administration and rollout of benefits across relevant EMEA markets, working with internal stakeholders and external providers.

- Provide operational support for employment changes, leave, probation, right-to-work processes, visas and other country-specific employee matters.

- Work closely with People Partners and Legal to ensure processes are delivered consistently and in line with relevant local requirements.

- Identify inefficiencies in manual workflows and drive process improvements, automation and appropriate use of AI.

- Support regional and global People projects, including implementation of new systems, policies and employee programs.

- Manage, prioritise and allocate work across People Operations support resources where applicable. Lead and drive a team-based, collaborative environment.

title: Organisational Design Consultant
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Organisational Design Consultant based in Canada.*

As an Organisational Design Consultant, you will help shape the organisational structures and operating models needed to sustain AI-enabled knowledge management capabilities within a complex enterprise environment. You will assess existing roles, responsibilities, and workforce capacity, identifying the changes required to support new digital services and AI-powered virtual agents. Working alongside a broader consulting team, you will translate strategic requirements into practical organisational designs, clear accountability frameworks, and actionable resourcing plans. Your work will ensure that content creation, governance, review, and maintenance are assigned to the right people with the appropriate skills and capacity. You will also help define emerging roles associated with AI oversight, performance, and continuous improvement. This is a focused, part-time engagement spanning approximately two to three months, requiring strong consulting expertise, executive-level stakeholder engagement, and an understanding of organisational change in a federal government environment.

Accountabilities
----------------

*

*Assess the current organisational structure:* Map organisational units, roles, reporting lines, and workforce capacity involved in knowledge creation and maintenance across tax, individual enquiries, and business enquiries. Identify formal and informal responsibilities and estimate the time currently dedicated to content-related work.

*

*Conduct organisational design analysis:* Compare the current state with the requirements of the target knowledge management operating model. Identify capability gaps, capacity constraints, unclear ownership, competing responsibilities, and single points of failure.

*

*Develop the organisational RACI matrix:* Create a detailed, role-level matrix defining who is Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, and Informed across the full content lifecycle, including authoring, subject matter review, legal and policy review, official-languages review, accessibility review, publication, periodic review, and retirement.

*

*Clarify staffing and accountability requirements:* Identify which positions need to be created, reassigned, or formally updated to ensure sustainable ownership of knowledge management activities.

*

*Design the target operating model:* Evaluate centralised, federated, and hybrid knowledge management structures. Explain the rationale, trade-offs, resource implications, and suitability of each option before recommending an approach.

*

*Develop role profiles and resourcing plans:* Draft position descriptions for new or amended roles, including knowledge managers, taxonomy stewards, content owners, and content authors. Define responsibilities, required competencies, estimated effort, and classification guidance.

*

*Define AI-era responsibilities:* Identify the roles needed to maintain AI-enabled knowledge capabilities, including virtual agent tuning and retraining, reviewing AI-generated or surfaced answers for accuracy, and managing feedback loops that translate AI failures into content corrections.

*

*Design the transition and change approach:* Establish a practical sequence for moving from the current organisation to the target model, including change management, training, communications, implementation risks, and staffing constraints associated with a federal government environment.

*

*Coordinate with the governance workstream:* Work closely with the Senior Business Consultant to ensure that the organisational design, governance framework, and RACI matrix are consistent and clearly establish accountability.

*

*Provide strategic stakeholder guidance:* Engage directors and executives to communicate organisational gaps, explain the implications of under-resourcing, and build support for the structural changes required to sustain the target capability.

Requirements:
-------------

*

*Professional experience:* At least 8 years of experience in organisational design, operating model design, workforce planning, organisational effectiveness, or a related consulting discipline.

*

*Demonstrated delivery experience:* Proven ability to produce organisational design deliverables that clients have implemented, including RACI matrices, target operating models, role profiles, and transition plans.

*

*Operating model expertise:* Experience designing operating models for functions that span multiple business units, particularly where responsibilities and ownership are shared, fragmented, or contested.

*

*Stakeholder management:* Strong engagement and communication skills at director and executive levels, including the confidence to explain capability gaps and advocate for the structural and staffing changes needed for long-term success.

*

*Analytical and problem-solving skills:* Ability to assess organisational structures, workforce capacity, role clarity, and resource requirements, translating findings into practical recommendations.

*

*Change and transition planning:* Ability to develop realistic implementation plans that account for organisational constraints, workforce readiness, training needs, and communication requirements.

*

*Collaborative consulting approach:* Comfortable working within a broader consulting team on a part-time, concentrated engagement, coordinating deliverables and maintaining alignment across workstreams.

*

*Government security eligibility:* Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Government of Canada security clearance.

*

*Knowledge management experience:* Prior experience designing operating models for knowledge management, content operations, or digital service functions is an advantage.

*Contact centre and automation expertise:* Experience with contact centre or shared services operating models is desirable, particularly where AI or automation has changed agent responsibilities and workforce requirements.

------------------------------

Not Your Typical Workplace:
--------------------------

Great talent doesn't stop at borders, and neither do the companies we work with. At WorkMotion, we're building the future of work: helping ambitious companies hire, onboard and manage the best people anywhere in the world, through smart, flexible workforce solutions. Remote-first, fast-paced, people-driven and globally connected, we empower businesses to build teams beyond borders. And we're looking for people who want to win while doing it.

More Than a Role
----------------

The UK and Irish markets are full of ambitious companies trapped by hiring borders. A London scale-up has found the perfect engineer in Lisbon but doesn't know how to employ her compliantly. A Dublin founder wants to put fresh funding into expanding to three countries by next quarter. As our Junior Account Executive UK & Ireland, your mission is powerful: Open up the world's talent pool to UK and Irish companies.

This is a Junior AE role, built for a top-performer who's ready to close their own deals, not by pushing a product, but by advising with substance and closing with confidence. You're confident in front of decision-makers, curious enough to ask the questions others don't, and ambitious about your numbers: hitting target is the minimum, outperforming it is what drives you. Your energy shows in your can-do attitude and follow-through, day in, day out.

*
Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity:*
--------------------------------------------

* Command Your Territory: Own the full sales cycle in he UK and Ireland, from first conversation to onboarded talent.
* Curious Questioner: Ask the second and third question. Uncover where, why and how fast a company is hiring, and what's at stake if compliance goes wrong.
* Champion Builder: Equip your HR champion with the arguments Finance, Legal and leadership care about, so decision-makers see the value, not just the price.
* Deal Momentum: Create urgency, negotiate with confidence and keep deals moving.
* Self-Made Pipeline: Roll your sleeves up and team up with the BDRs to go after the biggest opportunities in your territory.

*
What It Takes to Make an Impact Here…*
-------------------------------------

* Your Background: BDR/SDR experience in B2B SaaS, or another targetdriven, customer-facing role. You're self-driven, learn fast and know your numbers.
* Discovery Experience: You've led conversations to uncover a prospect's or client's needs, and you're eager to take them all the way to a signed deal.
* Outbound DNA: A cold call is a chance, not a threat. You know how to get a busy founder's attention, from a well-timed call after a funding round to a voice note they actually listen to.
* AI-Savvy & Organized: AI is a natural part of how you work, making you faster and sharper every day. And your HubSpot (or similar CRM) is always up to date.
* Coachable: You ask for feedback and put it into action the same day.
* Native-Level English: You communicate with ease and credibility, and you understand what makes UK and Irish buyers tick.

*Bonus Points If You Bring:*

* Experience with HR tech, payroll, EOR or other compliance-heavy solutions
* First closing experience, for example running your own demos or closing smaller deals
* Creativity in getting your foot in the door: find a smart way to reach the hiring managers directly, and show them why you're the right person for this role

*Not Your Typical Team:*
------------------------

We're a team of 26 sales minds, from BDRs, AEs and Team Leads to our CRM, Sales Enablement and Campaign Manager, based across Europe, Africa and the Middle East, a motivated, fully distributed crew that proves "remote" doesn't mean "disconnected." We don't just work together, we push, challenge and grow together. We share what works, celebrate each other's successes, learn from every win and loss, and jump in when a colleague needs a second voice to get a deal over the line. If you're looking for an environment where your ideas are welcomed, your voice is heard, and bold strategies thrive on collective brainpower and high-energy teamwork, you'll feel right at home.

*
The Perks of Being Here…*
