title: Junior System Design Professional
description:
Position Summary

The Associate Professional System Designer supports the planning, design, documentation, and implementation of wireless communication systems under the guidance of experienced designers and technical leaders. This position provides hands-on experience in public safety communications, distributed antenna systems (DAS), land mobile radio (LMR), and related wireless technologies while developing the technical, project coordination, and client-facing skills required to advance to a Professional System Designer role.

Key Responsibilities

•Assist in the design and development of in-building wireless communication systems, including Public Safety DAS, Commercial DAS, and LMR systems.

•Prepare and maintain system drawings using AutoCAD and other design software.

•Assist in the development of complete construction drawing packages and design documentation.

•Create and maintain Bills of Materials (BOMs) and equipment schedules.

•Support RF design activities, including coverage analysis, equipment selection, and design calculations.

•Coordinate with internal engineering teams, architects, consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders.

•Assist in the preparation and submission of design documentation required by authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs), radio system owners, and wireless carriers.

•Support field surveys, site assessments, system commissioning, and troubleshooting activities.

•Assist in responding to Requests for Information (RFIs) and design-related inquiries during construction.

•Maintain project records and ensure design documentation remains current throughout the project lifecycle.

•Learn and apply applicable codes, standards, and industry best practices.

Minimum Qualifications

•Associate degree or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Engineering Technology, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

•0 to 3 years of experience in telecommunications, wireless systems, electrical systems, low-voltage systems, or a related technical discipline.

•Basic understanding of telecommunications and wireless communication principles.

•Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

•Strong written and verbal communication skills.

•Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

What We Expect You to Have

•Fundamental understanding of RF and wireless communication concepts.

•Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and construction documents.

•Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.

•Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities.

•Self-motivated with a strong desire to learn and develop technical expertise.

•Attention to detail and commitment to producing quality work.

•Willingness to travel to project sites as required.

Preferred Qualifications

•Experience with or exposure to AutoCAD.

•Experience with or exposure to iBwave.

•Familiarity with Public Safety DAS, Commercial DAS, Wi-Fi, cellular, or LMR technologies.

•Exposure to BIM workflows, including Revit and Navisworks.

•Internship, co-op, military, or field experience in telecommunications or technical systems.

•Basic understanding of applicable fire, building, and electrical codes.

•Relevant industry coursework, certifications, or technical training.

Career Development Opportunities

The Associate Professional System Designer will receive mentoring and technical development opportunities in:

•Public Safety DAS Design

•Commercial DAS Design

•Land Mobile Radio (LMR) Systems

•RF Engineering Fundamentals

•AutoCAD and iBwave Design Tools

•Construction Documentation

•System Commissioning and Troubleshooting

•Industry Codes and Standards

•Client and Project Coordination

Successful performance in this role may lead to advancement to Professional System Designer and subsequent progression within the System Design Career Framework.

*Company Overview:*

Day Wireless Systems is the largest full-service wireless integrator in the West. We provide design, construction, licensing, sales, service, rentals, installation, and maintenance for a wide range of wireless voice, data, and video applications.

Founded in 1969, today we have 30 locations and 400+ employees in California, Oregon, Washington, Idaho, Wyoming, and Utah. Day Wireless employees enjoy the opportunity to grow and transfer within our many locations and business divisions.

*Disclaimer:*

Day Management Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

title: Junior Structural Designer
description:
This is a remote position.

Our client is looking for a *Junior Structural Designer* to join their growing engineering team and support structural steel design projects across the United States.

Our client is an established U.S.-based structural engineering firm specializing in steel connection design and engineering solutions for fabricators and detailers. Due to increasing project demand, they are expanding their team to support additional projects while maintaining high standards of technical accuracy and quality.

This opportunity is ideal for a detail-oriented professional with a background in engineering, architecture, construction, or technical drafting who is eager to develop specialized structural design skills. The selected candidate will receive hands-on training, collaborate directly with experienced U.S. engineers, and contribute to real construction projects.

----------------
Responsibilities

----------------

*

Develop structural steel connection designs, including shear, moment, and bracing connections, using specialized engineering software while meeting project specifications and applicable codes.

*

Design miscellaneous steel elements such as stairs, ladders, guardrails, handrails, and related components.

*

Read and interpret structural construction drawings, steel detailing plans, and technical models provided by clients.

*

Enter engineering information into design software and adjust bolt sizes, plate thicknesses, weld dimensions, and connection geometry to meet technical requirements.

*

Prepare structural calculation packages for review and approval by licensed U.S. engineers.

*

Support project estimating by reviewing drawings, counting structural members, identifying connection types, and entering information into an internal estimating tool.

*

Recognize unusual connection details, custom steel elements, or requirements outside standard project specifications and request engineering guidance when necessary.

*

Maintain accurate technical documentation and ensure calculations and designs meet established quality standards.

*

Collaborate with engineers and project stakeholders to complete assignments within established deadlines, communicating potential delays proactively.

*

Maintain strict confidentiality regarding client drawings, proprietary engineering methods, and project documentation.

*

Participate in ongoing technical training and apply feedback to improve design accuracy and efficiency.

*

Gradually assume greater responsibility for assigned projects and communicate directly with U.S. steel fabricators and detailers as experience develops.

*Work Distribution:* Approximately 80% structural steel connection and miscellaneous steel design and 20% project estimating and quoting.

Requirements
------------

*

Ability to interpret construction drawings or demonstrate a strong aptitude for learning technical drawing interpretation.

*

Strong computer skills and ability to learn specialized engineering software quickly.

*

Professional English proficiency (B2 or higher), both written and spoken.

*

Ability to communicate effectively with U.S.-based colleagues through video calls, email, and collaborative platforms.

*

Excellent attention to detail and commitment to technical accuracy.

*

Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

*

Reliability, punctuality, and ability to follow through on assigned responsibilities.

*

Willingness to receive feedback and follow technical guidance from licensed engineers.

*

Ability to perform repetitive, detail-oriented technical tasks while maintaining consistency and quality.

*

Strong time management skills and ability to work under occasional tight deadlines.

*

Availability to work during core Eastern Time collaboration hours and occasional paid overtime.

*

Interest in building a long-term career in structural design.

*Home Office Requirements:*

*

Personal laptop or desktop capable of smoothly running remote desktop applications.

*

A 27-inch monitor.

*

Uninterruptible power supply (UPS) to maintain connectivity during brief power interruptions.

*

Stable, high-speed internet connection and backup connectivity, such as a mobile hotspot.

*

Functional webcam and headset.

--------------
Qualifications

--------------

*

Technical degree in engineering, architecture, industrial design, construction technology, or a related field is preferred.

*

Educational background in civil or structural engineering is an advantage.

*

Previous experience or academic exposure to structural drafting, steel detailing, construction documentation, or engineering design is beneficial.

*

Familiarity with AutoCAD, Tekla Structures, SDS2, Revit, Bluebeam, or similar technical software is preferred but not mandatory.

*

Understanding of structural drawings, steel connections, or construction estimating is a plus.

*

Ability and motivation to learn specialized engineering software and internal design procedures.

*Previous professional experience in structural steel connection design is not mandatory. Training will be provided.*

Benefits
--------

*

*100% Remote:* Work from Latin America in a suitable home office or approved staffing partner's office.

*

*Full-Time:* 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday.

*

*Flexible Schedule:* Flexible working hours with mandatory availability from 9:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Eastern Time.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
Smadex is a performance advertising engine for mobile apps, enabling the world's leading marketers to grow across Mobile and Connected TV (CTV). Powered by AI models trained on real campaign outcomes, Smadex delivers profitable growth at scale. Headquartered in Barcelona, with teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, Smadex is a business unit of Entravision (NYSE: EVC).

The team
--------

You will join our core engineering team, a collaborative group of experienced engineers responsible for enabling complex data to be available in the real-time bidding platform for the Machine Learning models to use. We foster a fast-paced, supportive environment where knowledge sharing is key. We value autonomy and will provide the platform for you to grow your career while solving complex engineering challenges.

What are we looking for?
------------------------

We're looking for an enthusiastic Junior Data Engineer who is passionate about data pipelines and excited by extreme performance challenges. Your success will be measured by your ability to help build robust data pipelines, deliver high-quality features, and collaborate closely with the team while eagerly learning and applying your knowledge effectively.

What will you do at Smadex?
---------------------------

You will dive into a dynamic environment, tackling short-cycle tasks such as implementing complex data ingestion services, following a "you build it, you run it" philosophy. You will be expected to participate in code reviews, contribute to technical and architectural decisions, and collaborate in a fast-paced environment where every opinion counts.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Feature Ownership: Design, develop, and implement Data features for the Machine Learning models to use..
* Quality Assurance: Write clean, efficient, testable code and thoroughly test work locally and in a sophisticated staging environment.
* Operational Excellence: Monitor deployments and help ensure the stability, reliability and performance of production systems.
* Agile Collaboration: Collaborate with the team in an agile environment, participating in planning and reporting on progress.

Requirements
------------

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* 1-2 years of experience in Software or Data engineering
* SQL Knowledge
* Python or Java knowledge.
* Interest in Big Data, Machine Learning and Data Engineering.
* Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken)

What Will Make You Stand Out (Bonus Points)
-------------------------------------------

* Scala knowledge
* Experience with Key-Value stores and in-memory databases (e.g. Redis, Memcached).
* Familiarity with cloud environments, particularly AWS.
* Experience with Airflow workflows
* Experience in Big Data
* Experience with Spark

Our Tech Stack
--------------

* Languages: Python, Scala and bash.
* Frameworks: Spark
* Databases: MySQL, Redis
* Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Jenkins, Docker, Airflow
* Tools: Git, Jira, Notion

What We Offer
-------------

* Join a highly motivated and talented team in a fun and friendly work environment.
* Opportunity to work in a complex environment and gain experience from it.
* Directly add value to the business with the projects that you are assigned.
* Great compensation package.
* Top location at the heart of Barcelona with a rooftop terrace, Barbeque, and a fully stocked fridge.
* Great work-life balance: work from home (2 days per week) and flexible hours.
* Professional development with a LinkedIn Learning subscription and other training opportunities.
* Meal vouchers - Ticket Restaurant monthly allowance.
* Monthly gym allowance: Choose between DiR and Wellhub
* Monthly TGIF (Thank God It’s Friday) events and regular team-building activities.
* Ping-pong table and arcade machine.
* And more!

If you want to know more about us visit our website Smadex.com, and for a sneak peek of the cool stuff we build check this video out! And, if you are ready to take your career to the next level and tackle engineering challenges at a global scale, we encourage you to apply!

Please note that we do NOT provide VISA sponsorship. Candidates without a legal permit to work in Spain won't be considered.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
About the Job
-------------

The Opportunity
---------------

As a Junior Software Engineer at Emetlab, you will contribute to building the technology infrastructure behind elite AI training data that powers frontier models worldwide. Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company delivering expert-produced, rigorously validated datasets and end-to-end AI solutions to laboratories, Fortune 500 enterprises, ambitious startups, and sovereign AI programmes across the globe.

In this role, you will work alongside senior engineers to develop, test, and ship features across our data platform, contributor tools, and client-facing systems. You will gain hands-on experience with large-scale data pipelines, quality assurance automation, and the infrastructure that enables over 5,000 domain experts across 120+ countries to produce world-class training data. You will be trusted with meaningful work from day one, not sidelined with tasks that don't matter.

This is a rare opportunity to begin your engineering career at the intersection of AI and data infrastructure, where your contributions will be visible, valued, and directly tied to the quality of datasets that train the next generation of intelligent systems.

What You'll Do
--------------

Write clean, well-tested code that contributes to Emetlab's core platform, data pipelines, and internal tooling. Collaborate with senior engineers on the design and implementation of new features across our contributor platform, quality assurance systems, and client delivery infrastructure. Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving feedback that elevates the quality of the entire team's work. Assist in debugging, troubleshooting, and resolving issues across the platform with attention to detail and persistence. Contribute to building and improving automation that supports our multi-stage quality assurance processes and 98%+ accuracy benchmarks. Learn and grow rapidly by engaging with modern tools, frameworks, and AI-adjacent technologies in a production environment.

What You'll Need to Succeed
---------------------------

A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience through bootcamps, self-directed learning, or personal projects. Foundational knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript. Familiarity with web development fundamentals including APIs, databases, and version control with Git. A genuine desire to learn, improve, and take ownership of your growth as an engineer. Strong communication skills and a collaborative disposition, comfortable working within a team and asking thoughtful questions. Genuine interest in AI, data systems, or machine learning infrastructure is highly valued.

Role Details
------------

Employment Type: Full-Time and Part-Time positions available Location: Fully Remote Stage: Growth stage, operational

About Emetlab
-------------

Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company built on a single conviction: the quality ceiling of any AI system is determined by its training data, not its architecture or compute. We produce expert-crafted, rigorously validated training datasets across 12 specialised domains, delivered by a global network of over 5,000 vetted domain specialists spanning 100+ languages and 50+ specialisations. Beyond datasets, we offer end-to-end AI solutions including Fine-Tuning, RLHF & Alignment, Red Teaming, Model Evaluation, Data Annotation, Synthetic Data Generation, and Pre-Training Data Pipelines.

We are not a crowd-sourcing platform. We are the data partner that matches the ambition of the teams building the next generation of AI, delivering measurable results: 42% accuracy improvements, 3x faster time-to-production, and 99.4% regulatory precision.

Equal Opportunity
-----------------

Emetlab is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome dedicated individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We believe that extraordinary products are built by extraordinary teams, and extraordinary teams are built on inclusion, respect, and the understanding that brilliance has no single origin.

If you require accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to our team and we will ensure your needs are met with care.

Let's build the future of AI training data, together.

title: Junior Recruiter | Estheticians
description:
Junior Recruiter | Wax Specialist Talent Acquisition

Position Overview
-----------------

At *EWC Growth, smooth is just the start.* We’re one of the largest and fastest-growing franchisees of European Wax Center, with 52 centers across Connecticut, Florida, Illinois, Massachusetts + New York — and plans to continue growing.

We’re looking for junior level *Recruiter* to join our Talent Acquisition team with a primary focus on finding, engaging, and hiring *licensed + soon-to-be-licensed Estheticians and Cosmetologists for our Wax Specialist positions*.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their recruiting career who loves connecting with people, moves quickly, and has been exposed to hiring esthetician/cosmo talent. You’ll own candidate outreach and screening while building relationships with beauty schools, partnering with center leadership, and keeping our Wax Specialist pipelines moving.

What You’ll Do
--------------

*Recruiting + Candidate Management*

* Manage Wax Specialist recruiting across an assigned group of centers and markets.
* Review incoming applications and identify candidates who meet licensing, availability + location requirements.
* Conduct initial phone/video screens and evaluate candidates for experience, communication skills, availability, career goals + overall fit.
* Proactively source licensed Estheticians and Cosmetologists through job boards, social platforms, local communities + other creative channels.
* Maintain consistent candidate communication throughout the interview process.
* Coordinate interviews between qualified candidates and Center Sales Directors.
* Follow up quickly on interview feedback and next steps to keep candidates engaged.
* Maintain accurate candidate stages, notes, dispositions + activity within the ATS.
* Support offer and pre-employment processes in partnership with the broader Talent Acquisition team.

*Beauty School + Community Recruiting*

* Build relationships with *Esthetics and Cosmetology schools* across assigned markets.
* Develop pipelines of students approaching graduation and licensure.
* Coordinate career fairs, classroom presentations + other school recruiting events.
* Maintain relationships with instructors and career services teams to position EWC Growth as an employer of choice for new graduates.
* Think creatively about local sourcing through community groups, referrals + grassroots recruiting.

*Hiring Manager Partnership*

* Partner closely with *Center Sales Directors + field leadership* to understand staffing needs, scheduling gaps, and hiring priorities.
* Provide regular updates on applicant flow, interviews + pipeline health.
* Help identify centers experiencing applicant shortages and adjust sourcing efforts accordingly.
* Create a strong partnership between TA and the field by being responsive, organized + solutions-oriented.

What Success Looks Like
-----------------------

You’ll help ensure our centers have a consistent pipeline of qualified Wax Specialist talent by *moving candidates quickly, building relationships before we need them, and creating an experience that makes people excited to join EWC Growth.*

Success in this role means developing strong partnerships with center leadership, maintaining healthy candidate pipelines, increasing engagement with local beauty schools, and ultimately helping us put talented Wax Specialists behind the wax suites.

*Requirements*

What We’re Looking For
----------------------

* 1+ years of recruiting, staffing, HR, sales, customer service, or high-volume retail experience preferred.
* Bachelor's degree preferred, but not required.
* Previous exposure to beauty, spa, wellness, retail, hospitality, or service-based businesses is a plus.
* Interest in building a career within Talent Acquisition.
* Comfortable conducting multiple candidate conversations throughout the day.
* Strong written + verbal communication skills.
* Naturally organized and comfortable managing multiple open positions and priorities.
* Able to work with a sense of urgency without sacrificing the candidate experience.
* Comfortable using data to understand where recruiting efforts are working — and where additional attention is needed.
* Willingness to learn an ATS; previous experience with another ATS or HRIS platform preferred.
* Positive, curious + coachable with a willingness to jump in and learn.

*Benefits*

* Base salary range of $45,000-$50,000 + bonus per hire once 90-day guarantee is fulfilled!
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance + Pet Insurance for your furry friends!
* Monthly Work-from-Home & Cellphone Stipend
* 401(k) Plan
* Accrued PTO starting on day one of employment
* Paid Parental Leave
* Life & Disability Insurance
* 50% off of Retail Products
* Complementary Waxing

title: Junior Account Executive
description:
Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.

*Job Description*

As a Junior Account Executive on the Fusion team, you will take the next step in your sales career by owning opportunities from initial outreach through close. Fusion is built specifically for speech, occupational, and physical therapy practices, helping providers streamline operations and focus on patient care.

In this role, you'll manage a mix of inbound leads and self-generated opportunities while building the skills and commercial judgment needed to become a successful full-cycle Account Executive. You'll have the autonomy to identify target accounts, run your own territory strategy, and make informed decisions about which opportunities to pursue. Success is measured by the quality of your pipeline, your ability to convert opportunities into customers, and the revenue you generate.

--------------
What You'll Do
--------------

* Work a dedicated share of inbound marketing-qualified leads, with opportunity volume increasing as you ramp into the role.
* Build and maintain a consistent outbound pipeline through research-driven prospecting and personalized outreach.
* Identify, prioritize, and engage therapy practices that align with Fusion's ideal customer profile.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand operational challenges, business objectives, and buying readiness.
* Deliver product demonstrations that connect Fusion's capabilities to the needs of speech, occupational, and physical therapy providers.
* Qualify opportunities rigorously and make informed decisions about which opportunities to advance or disqualify.
* Manage smaller opportunities from first conversation through signed agreement.
* Collaborate with senior Account Executives on larger or more complex opportunities, providing clear customer insights and handoff information.
* Maintain accurate pipeline, activity, and forecast data within Salesforce.
* Leverage AI-powered tools and sales technologies to improve productivity, outreach effectiveness, and customer engagement.
* Partner closely with Marketing, Sales Development, and Customer Success to create a strong customer experience throughout the buying journey.

--------------
What You Bring
--------------

Required Qualifications
-----------------------

* 1+ year of experience in a Sales Development Representative (SDR), Business Development Representative (BDR), or similar sales role.
* Demonstrated success generating pipeline that resulted in qualified opportunities and revenue outcomes.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including confidence engaging prospects by phone, email, and virtual meetings.
* Ability to conduct research, identify customer needs, and tailor outreach strategies accordingly.
* Experience using Salesforce, Outreach, or similar sales engagement and CRM platforms.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and opportunities simultaneously.
* Curiosity, coachability, and a growth mindset with a desire to learn the full sales cycle.
* Experience using AI tools to improve productivity, or a strong interest in learning how to incorporate AI into daily work.

----------------------
Additional Information
----------------------

While we've outlined some key qualities we typically seek, it's essential to remember that there might be additional unique strengths and talents you possess that would make you an exceptional match for us, even if they're not explicitly mentioned. Studies have consistently highlighted the significance of this principle, particularly for individuals from disenfranchised backgrounds, including women and other marginalized groups. These individuals often hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement, unlike their male counterparts who are more inclined to apply when they meet around 60% of the criteria.

The message we want to convey is that taking a leap of faith and applying can be incredibly rewarding. Your distinct abilities and perspectives could be exactly what we need to create a more diverse and inclusive team. title: Junior Data Scientist (Remote - Pakistan)
description:
*📍 Location:* Pakistan (Fully Remote)

---------------------

Let us help you develop your career to become a data scientist.

*TensorOps* is an applied-machine-learning studio that helps organisations across Europe and North America design, train, and deploy production-grade GenAI systems. ---------------------

* *AI Copilots & Autonomous Agentic Systems* — from copilots in hospitals, financial advisor agents, and manufacturing bots

--------

* *Analyze Performance Data* — work with data generated by our AI models to measure their effectiveness, identify trends, and understand user behaviour.

---------

* An analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and great attention to detail
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau) is a plus
* A BSc or MS in a quantitative field such as Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline
* Based in Pakistan, with working hours that overlap with our European team

Why TensorOps?
--------------

* *Learn from the Best* — work alongside and learn from experienced ML engineers and researchers on high-impact projects. This is a unique opportunity for mentorship in the applied AI space.
* *Real-World Impact* — your analysis will directly influence project direction and help industry-leading clients understand the value AI brings to their business.
* *Grow Your Career* — you will gain hands-on experience with the most advanced AI technologies in the industry. We offer a clear path for professional development in a rapidly growing field.

*Ready to start your data science journey? Apply now!*

Minimum 3 years of experience in user interface and user experience design for web and mobile applications.

Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, Industrial Design, Visual Communication, Systems Engineering, or a related field.

Additional training or certifications in UX/UI Design, such as specialized courses in Figma, responsive design with HTML/CSS, or recognized programs like Google UX Design Certificate or Nielsen Norman Group UX Certification.

*Technical Skills:*

* Advanced proficiency in Figma for interface design, interactive prototypes, and collaboration with development teams.

* Basic knowledge of JavaScript to understand the implementation of interactive components.

* Experience working with Azure DevOps for task management and project tracking.

* Familiarity with GitHub for collaboration in development environments.

* Strong knowledge of HTML/CSS for responsive design and visual implementation.

* Ability to work in Agile/Scrum environments and collaborate with developers, product owners, and QA.

*Soft Skills:*

* Critical Thinking: Evaluate usability issues and propose creative and functional solutions.

* Effective Communication: Ability to explain design decisions to both technical and non-technical teams.

* Collaboration: Work seamlessly with cross-functional teams in agile environments.

* Empathy: Deep understanding of end-user needs.

* Time Management: Prioritize tasks and meet deadlines across multiple projects.

Benefits
--------

We offer a competitive package with several advantages. ​

title: UX/UI designer
description:
Do you want to make a difference and contribute to creating a better world? Are you interested in developing your skills and knowledge, while putting your ideals to work? Join us, we are a frontrunner in ethical banking and global impact investing, and we need people like you to make change happen.

We believe that money can change the world for the better. In fact, our organisation was founded on this belief. Our mission is to create a society that protects and promotes the quality of life of all its members with human dignity at its core.

We are looking to further grow and mature our design practice, improving the experience we offer to business and consumer clients across our digital touchpoints, and helping our organisation adopt a truly holistic approach to customer experience.

You will be joining at a moment of real change. The organisation is in the middle of a rebrand, restructuring how it thinks about customer journeys, and actively building a more mature design system, increasing the number of channels it supports, from mobile to internet banking, group websites and enterprise tools.

*How you will make a difference*

You will work closely with the UX design lead and a team of designers at an inflection point in an environment that is complex, fast-moving, and full of opportunity. Concretely, this means:

Translate our brand into digital experience

* Designing screens and flows across web and mobile touchpoints that bring our brand values and visual identity to life
* Find ways to creatively explore and craft visual elements while working fluently within our design tokens and systems as the foundation for that creativity, not a limit on it

Turn insights into visual storytelling

* Participate in ongoing strategic design efforts by, for example, translating research and service design insights into sketches, journey artifacts, data visualisation… to make those findings tangible for the wider organisation
* Join our design jam sessions

Champion visual quality and accessibility

* Hold our digital touchpoints to a high bar of visual craft and accessibility standards
* Craft design solutions that consider technical feasibility at the start, not as an afterthought, without needing to be asked for it
* Contribute to our design system, helping maintain consistency and scalability across all our digital channels (group website, mobile apps, internet banking, enterprise tools) as we continue our rebranding efforts

*What you will bring*

**

**

We are looking for someone who brings hands-on energy, a genuine curiosity for how things work from the customer's perspective, and the drive to bring our design work to the next level.

To be successful:

* You are versatile in design craft, from rough sketching to rapid prototyping and visual work
* You can translate design and brand principles into your work with ease, and can explain the reasoning behind your visual choices
* You are fluent in information architecture, visual hierarchy, layout, typography and colors and use them to make complex information clearer
* You know accessibility standards (WCAG) and apply them from the very first sketch
* You are comfortable sharing your work early, giving and receiving critique and iterating based on feedback and user testing
* You collaborate naturally with developers and understand enough front-end constraints to design for real implementation
* You can present your work to non-designers

Besides that:

* You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in visual design, communication design, interaction design or a related field and bring a solid grasp of design fundamentals you can apply and share within the team
* 4+ years of experience in digital visual design across both web and mobile with a portfolio that shows both polished visual craft and the UX thinking behind it. You are equally at home refining a component and sketching a flow
* You understand the conventions and constraints of each platform: responsive web design across breakpoints, and native mobile patterns
* Experience with design systems and rebranding projects is a plus
* You have strong sketching and visual storytelling skills. You can quickly illustrate customer journeys, scenarios and concepts so research and service design insights become tangible for colleagues across the organisation
* Proficient in Figma, our primary design tool
* You are curious, empathetic and eager to balance attention to detail and big-picture thinking. You enjoy getting hands-on and raising the bar for the whole team
* Are already located in the Netherlands

*Your future colleagues*

**

You will be joining the Center of Design where the UX team of eight UX/Service designers and a UX Team Lead work alongside external design collaborators, a researcher, CX specialist and proposition developers. Beyond the team, you will work closely with value stream leads, product managers, developers, testers, and subject matter experts from across the organisation. If you thrive on variety and cross-functional collaboration, you will feel at home here.

*An inspiring work culture*

**

The most important thing about working with us is that you are part of community that is changing the world for the better. We are constantly improving our work culture to create conditions where every person can thrive, so you are able to:

* find a sense of meaning in your work
* create positive energy and impact with your co-workers
* build mutual trust and respect in working relationships
* enjoy fulfilment at a professional and personal level

**

**

*A comfortable working environment*

**

Our award-winning sustainable head office is based in Driebergen-Zeist, the Netherlands at the Reehorst Estate, just a 3 minutes’ walk from the train station. Combined with working from home, it is an inspiring place to work and connect with your colleagues.

And of course, great remuneration and working conditions:

* a salary appropriate to the position, our remuneration policy and your experience between € 4,316 – € 5,395 gross per month for 36-hour work week
* A 13th month and 8% holiday allowance
* A labour contract for one year
* an attractive pension policy
* a mobility card (including free private travels)
* flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home
* reimbursement of a company bicycle to the max of € 1,500
* 27 holiday days with a 36-hour working week, plus the option of buying 2 weeks of extra holiday days
* extra leave to contribute to voluntary work
* a range of education and training opportunities
* the option to join our collective health insurance
* a working from home allowance per home office day
* suitable home office equipment up to € 750 every 5 years

**

*Sounds interesting?*

**

If you feel that you would be a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you by sending us your resume. Please include also a cover letter. Note that the hiring manager reads every cover letter. Imperfect and genuine beats polished and generic. Tell us why this role and Triodos Bank mission matters to you now, and how you use sketching or storyboarding to help others understand an idea. Feel free to include a photo of a sketch, rough is perfect.

If it interests you but you still have some questions, please connect via careers@triodos.com to discuss further (in a confidential meeting).

We will provide you with all the information about the position, employment conditions, and recruitment process, so you can make an informed decision about applying.

**

**

*The closing date for applications is: 23 October 2026*

Please note that the first round of interviews will take place on 4 November at our office in Driebergen.

We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if we receive enough suitable applications. So, apply soon!

**

**

*Who we are*

**

Triodos Bank is a leading expert in sustainable banking, founded in 1980 in the Netherlands, with branches in Belgium, Germany, the United Kingdom, and Spain.

Triodos Investment Management is a globally recognised leader in impact investing, that currently manages 20 funds invested in both Europe and emerging markets.

Triodos Regenerative Money Centre is our business unit launched in 2019 with the explicit goal of restoring and regenerating nature and society.

We are a certified B Corp since 2015. B Corp is a growing global community of successful and sustainable companies that create positive social impact and change.

We are also one of the founders of The Global Alliance for Banking on Values, a global network of independent banks using finance to deliver sustainable economic, social, and environmental development.

www.triodos.com | www.triodos-im.com | www.triodosfoundation.nl

title: UX/UI Designer III
description:
*Location:* Brasil (100% Remote or Hybrid for Serra Gaúcha Residents or Greater São Paulo area)

*Compensation Currency:* Brazilian Real (BRL)

*Contract:* Permanent Full Time (CLT) - 42h/week

*PLEASE ATTACH YOUR CV IN ENGLISH*

*People with disabilities are welcome at Cyncly!*

*About us*

Cyncly is a leading global provider of specialized visualization, sales, manufacturing and content software and solutions for the retail, design and manufacturing industries.

Cyncly was created to unite Compusoft, 2020 Technologies and their affiliate companies after their merger in 2021. The Company brings together more than 35 years of industry experience to provide a connected platform of configure, price, quote (CPQ) software, online space planning, computer-aided design (CAD) applications, business process management, manufacturing execution systems and enterprise resource planning (ERP). Cyncly serves more than 70,000 customers across 100 countries, with operations in North America, Europe, South America, Asia Pacific, and Africa.

At Cyncly, we are committed to fostering an increasingly diverse and inclusive environment where all voices are valued and celebrated. We prioritize representation from minority groups. We recognize that our unique approach and success stem from the wealth of perspectives brought by our diverse teams.

*About the Role*
This is a role for a designer who leads with evidence. As Cyncly’s UX Designer III, you will bring rigour and user insight into the heart of the product design process for one of our globally used design applications — a product used by professional designers, retailers, and manufacturers worldwide. Based in LATAM, you will be working within a globally distributed team, collaborating closely with the Head of UX Design, the Lead User Researcher, product managers, and data analysts across time zones.

This is a deeply hands-on UX role with a strong research orientation. You will plan and conduct your own discovery and evaluative research, synthesise findings into actionable design direction, and translate data signals into interaction design that is both intuitive and impactful. You are equally comfortable in a workshop, an analytics dashboard, and Figma — and you know how to connect all three.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Lead end-to-end UX design for product areas within a globally used design application — from discovery and problem definition through to validated, high-fidelity design and handoff.
* Plan and conduct mixed-method research independently — including user interviews, contextual enquiry, usability testing, surveys, and Jobs-to-be-Done studies — to inform and validate design decisions at every stage.
* Work closely with data analysts and product managers to interpret product analytics, behavioural data, and funnel metrics, translating quantitative signals into clear UX hypotheses and design responses.
* Synthesise research and data findings into actionable insights, journey maps, opportunity frameworks, and design principles that the wider global team can align around.
* Design clear, well-reasoned interaction flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes that reflect a deep understanding of user needs, task context, and business goals.
* Run collaborative design activities — including discovery workshops, assumption mapping, and concept validation sessions — with product and engineering stakeholders across the business.
* Contribute to the definition of UX success metrics and work with product and analytics teams to measure the impact of design changes post-release.
* Apply an inclusive and accessibility-conscious design approach, ensuring designs meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards for a diverse global user base.
* Partner with the Lead User Researcher to ensure consistent research practices and contribute to the growing research repository and knowledge base.
* Mentor and support less experienced designers in the team, modelling a research-informed design practice and helping to raise the bar for design quality and rigour across Cyncly.

*What We're Looking For*

* Solid experience in UX design, ideally within a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment, with a demonstrable track record of research-informed design practice.

* Strong proficiency in mixed-method UX research — including moderated and unmoderated usability testing, in-depth interviews, contextual enquiry, and survey design — with the ability to operate independently without a dedicated researcher.

* Proven ability to work with quantitative data: interpreting product analytics, behavioural funnels, heatmaps, and A/B test results to identify UX problems and opportunities.

* Expert-level proficiency in Figma — including complex flows, interactive prototyping, component usage, and design handoff documentation.

* Strong skills in synthesising research findings into clear outputs — including insight reports, journey maps, opportunity spaces, and design rationale — for diverse stakeholder audiences.

* Experience facilitating discovery and alignment workshops with cross-functional teams, including product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.

* Solid understanding of interaction design principles, information architecture, and usability heuristics, with a portfolio demonstrating their application in complex product environments.

* Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards and experience applying accessibility best practices within the design process.

* *Advanced English* — this is essential for day-to-day collaboration, research communication, and design presentation within a globally distributed team.

* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and working in a fast-moving, growth-stage technology environment, where priorities shift and structure is still being established.

*What we can offer you at Cyncly*

* National Medical Health Plan;

* National Dental Assistance;

* Maternity & Paternity extension leave;

* Life Insurance;

* Meal/ Restaurant allowance (Alelo Tudo);

* Home office allowance (if applicable);

* Education Platforms and training funding;

* Gympass, Zenklub (Health app) and Guapeco (Pet Plan);

* Annual Profit Sharing Program;

* Education allowance;

* DayOff as a birthday gift;

* Agreement with pharmacies, restaurants and theaters.

*Working for us*

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - come join us.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer (CRO)
description:
**************************
*About Lunar Solar Group:*
**************************

Lunar Solar Group is a high-impact advertising agency that collaborates with consumer-focused brands to identify growth opportunities and implement disruptive marketing strategies. We combine digital marketing expertise and a suite of creative services to help brands scale. As a globally recognized growth consultancy, technology studio, and full-service digital marketing agency, we solve complex growth challenges and build brands through proprietary technology, innovative strategy, channel expertise, and flawless execution. Lunar has built a track record of excellence across various verticals, including durable goods, consumer packaged goods, and SaaS. While highlighting potential growth opportunities for clients, Lunar itself continues to expand rapidly.

************

*Our Culture*
************

We’re a fast-moving, highly collaborative team of senior strategists, creatives, and technologists who push the boundaries of what performance creative can achieve. We value ownership, rigor, curiosity, and the confidence to challenge assumptions—with data.

Working at Lunar means operating at a high bar. We celebrate wins, learn quickly from failures, and invest deeply in our people. Whether remote or hybrid, our team shows up as thoughtful partners to one another and trusted advisors to our clients.

----------------
*About the role*
----------------

Lunar is hiring a Senior UX/UI Designer to help lead website and landing page design across our Shopify client roster. You'll own projects end to end: strategy, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, interactive prototypes and dev handoff.

Design at Lunar sits at the center of three areas of work:

*

*Onsite design:* full-site redesigns, homepages, PDPs, PLPs and carts for DTC brands on Shopify.

*

*Landing pages:* paid media landing pages and post-click funnels built in our no-code page builder.

*

*CRO test design:* A/B test variants and experiments, built from hypotheses with our CRO lead and shipped on a steady testing cadence.

This is a hands-on senior role with a strong CRO lens. You'll work closely with our CRO lead, turning test hypotheses into designs and test results into better-converting experiences.

You'll partner with strategy, paid media, creative, development and project management to tie every design decision to client growth goals.

-----------------

*What you'll own*.
-----------------

*

*Site design:* Lead UX/UI for full-site redesigns, homepages, PDPs, PLPs and carts, from discovery and IA through final UI.

*

*Landing pages:* Design landing pages and post-click funnels for paid traffic, from ad click to checkout.

*

*CRO partnership:* Partner with the CRO lead on site audits, hypotheses and test roadmaps. Design A/B test variants and help analyze results.

*

*Prototyping and handoff:* Build interactive prototypes in Figma or HTML/CSS that double as client presentations and developer handoff.

*

*Shopify execution:* Design responsive, mobile-first experiences that hold up in real builds, including sections, blocks, apps and theme constraints.

*

*Design systems:* Contribute to component libraries and page-builder section systems used across clients.

*

*Content hierarchy:* Shape page narrative and provide general copy direction for headlines, offers and buy box messaging.

*

*Client presentation:* Present concepts, share rationale behind design decisions, and fold in feedback without losing the lens of best practices.

*

*Dev collaboration:* Work with developers on feasibility, handoff, and QA.

*

*Process:* Improve design SOPs, file organization and workflows, including AI-assisted design and prototyping.

--------------
*Requirements*
--------------

*

5+ years of UX/UI design experience, focused on ecommerce websites and landing pages

*

Hands-on CRO experience: you've designed tests, read the results and can point to conversion impact

*

Shopify knowledge, including themes, sections, metafields/objects, common apps and how designs get built

*

Advanced Figma skills: auto layout, variants, components, tokens and prototyping

*

Agency or multi-client experience

*

A portfolio showing process and shipped ecommerce work, ideally with results

*

DTC or CPG brand experience (supplements, beverage, beauty, wellness) preferred

*

Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript preferred

*

Familiarity with GA4, heatmaps, session recordings and A/B testing tools such as Intelligems, Hotjar or Microsoft Clarity

*

Experience with landing page builders and direct-response page structure

*

AI proficiency a plus: experience using AI tools for design, prototyping or front-end code (e.g. Claude, Codex, Figma AI)

-------------
*Who you are*
-------------

*

A designer who measures good design by how it performs

*

Opinionated, and able to defend a point of view with rationale and data

*

Comfortable presenting to clients and senior stakeholders

*

Fast, organized and able to run several projects at once

*

Detail-obsessed through QA and launch

*

A clear communicator with developers, strategists and copywriters

*

Generous with feedback and interested in mentoring other designers

*

Curious about new tools and quick to put them to work

**********************************
*Top Reasons You’ll Love It Here:*
**********************************

*

Accelerated career growth and leadership opportunities.

*

Direct mentorship and collaboration with senior leaders across departments.

*

A talented, supportive, and passionate team that loves what we do.

*

Competitive benefits including 100% paid Medical, Dental, Vision, STD, LTD, and Life insurance.

*

401K with company match.

*

Generous PTO and holidays, plus a day off during your birthday week!

title: Middle UX/UI Designer - Back Office
description:
*Join Blossom!*

We are a U.S.-based company with over 20 years of experience dedicated to enhancing the satisfaction of credit unions and their members. We are committed to developing simpler and more innovative financial services that assist credit unions in serving their current members and attracting new ones. We are building the next-generation technology layer for credit unions.
www.blossom.net

We’re looking for a creative and user-focused Mid-Level UX/UI Designer with 3+ years of web design experience, who thrives in agile environments and is comfortable using AI tools to move faster from idea to interface. The ideal candidate applies Human-Centered Design from research to concept, builds accessible and user-friendly interfaces backed by a consistent component library, and works closely with developers to deliver high-quality designs on time.

*About the position*

Blossom builds core and digital banking, payments and hardware solutions for U.S. credit unions. Our back office products are the tools credit union staff use every day to run their operations, and as their priorities grow, so does the need for thoughtful, consistent design.

As a UX/UI Designer on our back office product line, you will share ownership of the design work with our current designer, turning UX objectives into clear, accessible interfaces for complex workflows. You will take ideas from research to high-fidelity prototypes, maintain our component library and work side by side with developers, using AI tools to accelerate ideation, prototyping and design-to-frontend delivery.

*Duties*

* Apply Human-Centered Design across the full process: research, problem definition, ideation, concept and validation.
* Translate UX objectives and business requirements into attractive, user-friendly and accessible interfaces for back office products.
* Build low-, medium- and high-fidelity prototypes to explore and validate solutions with stakeholders and users.
* Maintain and evolve a standardized component library to ensure visual and functional consistency across products.
* Use AI tools for ideation, prototyping and frontend generation, evaluating and refining their outputs to meet quality standards.
* Collaborate with developers during implementation to ensure designs are built as intended and reduce rework.
* Participate in agile ceremonies and deliver design work within sprint timelines.
* Work with product managers and stakeholders to prioritize design needs and communicate design decisions clearly.
* Share workload and knowledge with the current designer to ensure continuity and backup across products.

*Requirements*

* Professional degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, Interactive Design, Interface Design, Human-Centered Design or a related field.
* English level B2 or higher.
* 3+ years of experience in web design, including 1–3+ years designing web interfaces, apps or software.
* 2–3+ years of experience with graphic design and experience design tools.
* Solid UI design foundations: typography, color theory, visual hierarchy and Gestalt principles.
* Experience building low- to high-fidelity prototypes in agile environments.
* Experience creating and maintaining standardized component libraries.
* Knowledge of accessibility principles for digital interfaces.
* Confident use of AI tools for ideation, prototyping and frontend generation, including prompting, evaluating and refining outputs.
* Proficiency with Figma, Sketch, Adobe, Miro, Office and Google Workspace.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, BizAgi and Git (Sourcetree or GitHub Desktop).

*Preferred*

* Working knowledge of HTML and CSS.
* Experience designing for back office, enterprise or financial services products.

*Competencies*

* Assertive and effective communication.
* Creativity, innovation and initiative.
* Results, quality and service orientation.
* Self-management and collaborative work.

*Perks*

* 100% Remote Work – Work from anywhere during the contract period.
* Multicultural Environment – Collaborate with global teams.
* Learning & Exposure – Gain hands-on experience in a fintech/digital banking environment.
* Impactful Work – Contribute to data solutions that drive strategic decisions.

*Apply Now!*

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

*Enterprise Technology* plays a critical part in shaping the future of mobility. If you’re looking for the chance to leverage advanced technology to redefine the transportation landscape, enhance the customer experience and improve people’s lives, this is the opportunity for you. Join us and challenge your IT expertise and analytical skills to help create vehicles that are as smart as you are.

*Ford Pro* is a new global business within Ford committed to commercial customer productivity. Ford Pro delivers a work-ready suite of vehicles, accessories and services for virtually every vocation, backed by technology and engineered for uptime. A true one-stop shop, we offer a full portfolio of electrified and internal combustion vehicles designed to integrate seamlessly with the Ford Pro ecosystem, helping customers' businesses thrive today and into the new era of electrification.

*In this position...*

Ford Pro is looking for an experienced Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) to join our digital product design team.

The initial focus of this role will be the *Ford Pro App* , a key part of the Ford Pro digital ecosystem used by fleet managers and drivers to understand vehicle status, manage fleet operations and take action while on the move.

We are entering an important phase in the evolution of the app. As Ford Pro brings more of its products and services together, the app is evolving beyond its origins as a telematics companion toward a broader mobile experience connecting customers with capabilities across the Ford Pro ecosystem.

You will help shape that evolution.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) who is comfortable taking ownership of *large, ambiguous product problems, creating clarity where the path is not yet defined and turning complex customer* and business needs into simple, coherent experiences.

You will work as a strategic partner to Product and Engineering, helping define problems and influence product direction—not simply responding to requirements. You should be comfortable moving between *experience strategy, information architecture, user journeys, interaction design, prototyping and detailed production UI*.

This role requires strong systems thinking. Ford Pro is a large ecosystem of products, services, customer types, permissions, subscriptions and vehicle experiences. You will need to understand how those pieces connect and design experiences that work as part of a broader system rather than as isolated features.

While native mobile experience is highly valuable, we are ultimately looking for an exceptional product designer. This role may also contribute to web or cross-platform initiatives as the needs of the organization evolve.

This is a remote role, working closely with distributed Product, Engineering, Research, Data and Design teams.

Candidates who are in commuting distance to a Ford hub location may be required to commute to the office four or more days/ week.

*What you'll do...*

* Own complex product design work end-to-end, from problem definition and discovery through concept development, prototyping, validation, delivery and post-launch iteration.
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, taking ambiguous problems, creating structure and direction, and driving work forward without requiring continuous design oversight.
* Play a central role in the evolution and redesign of the Ford Pro App, helping rethink its experience, navigation, interaction model and product architecture.
* Help evolve the app from primarily a telematics companion into a broader mobile entry point to the Ford Pro ecosystem, connecting capabilities and journeys across Ford Pro.
* Design experiences that serve different customer types and contexts, including the distinct needs of fleet managers, administrators and drivers.
* Define and evolve information architecture, navigation and interaction patterns that can scale as additional products, capabilities and customer journeys are introduced.
* Apply strong systems thinking to understand dependencies across products, services, platforms, data and user roles and translate them into coherent end-to-end experiences.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering as a strategic partner, helping frame problems, identify opportunities, assess trade-offs and influence product direction.
* Partner with Research, Data/Analytics and other Design teams to understand customer behaviour and use qualitative and quantitative evidence to inform decisions.
* Translate customer needs, business objectives and technical constraints into clear user journeys, flows, wireframes, prototypes and production-ready designs.
* Maintain a high bar for interaction and visual design craft, creating intuitive, accessible and polished experiences across mobile and, where required, web.
* Work effectively with established design systems, while identifying where new patterns, components or interaction models are needed.
* Prototype at different levels of fidelity to explore ideas, test assumptions, communicate intent and accelerate decision-making.
* Define appropriate success measures with Product, Research and Analytics and use post-launch data and customer feedback to continuously improve experiences.
* Communicate design rationale clearly, using storytelling, prototypes and evidence to build alignment with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
* Facilitate workshops, design reviews and working sessions that help teams frame problems, explore alternatives and reach decisions.
* Collaborate closely with other designers, contributing to critique, sharing knowledge and helping raise the overall quality and consistency of the Ford Pro experience.
* Contribute beyond the immediate product area when needed, supporting cross-platform mobile and web experiences and broader Ford Pro initiatives.

*You'll have...*

*

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

*

6+ years of product design experience, with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of shipped digital products, excellent interaction and visual design craft, and the impact of your work.

* 3+ years of experience with Figma, prototyping and design systems, with a solid understanding of usability, accessibility, information architecture and modern product-design practices.
* 3+ years of experience designing complex digital products or ecosystems; experience with B2B, SaaS, enterprise or operational products is particularly valuable.
* 6 months + familiarity with emerging AI-assisted design and prototyping workflows is valuable, alongside strong systems-thinking skills and experience simplifying complex products, workflows, and ecosystems into clear, coherent customer experiences.

*Even better, you may have...*

* Master’s degree in UI/UX Design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCXI),Computer Science or a related field
* Native mobile design experience is preferred, including familiarity with iOS and Android patterns, although strong designers with web or cross-platform product experience will also be considered.
* Ability to move comfortably between strategic/system-level thinking and detailed interaction/UI design.
* Strong systems-thinking capability, with experience simplifying complex products, workflows or ecosystems into coherent customer experiences.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* A portfolio that clearly demonstrates your role, the problem you were solving, how you arrived at decisions and the impact of the work.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

* Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
* Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up childcare and more
* Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
* Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
* Tuition assistance
* Established and active employee resource groups
* Paid time off for individual and team community service
* A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
* Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

This position is a salary grade 7 or 8 and ranges from $99,600-$192,900.

Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.

For more information on salary and benefits, click here:

https://fordcareers.co/GSR

Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

* A strong communicator who works well with team leaders, colleagues, consultants and clients

* Stay current with *architecture, design trends and technology*
* Work within studio systems, standards and project documentation processes to support strong project delivery

*Requirements*

* Any *relevant architectural qualification*
* A strong portfolio that clearly demonstrates *design ability* , conceptual thinking and visual communication
* Ability to use a variety of *media and software* in the development and documentation of design projects
* Ability to *understand and formulate design decisions* and present them for discussion
* Strong creative problem-solving ability; both profiles explicitly refer to creative problem-solving skills.
* Good organisational skills, accountability and attention to detail
* A professional, flexible and collaborative approach to working within a team environment

*Advantageous*

* Experience working on *multi-disciplinary projects*
* Ability to mentor or guide more junior team members, (for more experienced applicants)

*What to Submit*

* Your *CV*
* A *portfolio* that clearly shows your role in each project
* Examples of work that demonstrate your *conceptual thinking, design development, visual communication and architectural judgement*

We are particularly interested in applicants whose portfolios show more than technical execution, we want to see how you *think* , how you *develop ideas* and how you *translate design intent into compelling architectural work*.

This role offers the opportunity to work in a highly creative studio where design quality, collaboration and professional growth are valued.

title: Founding Product Designer
description:
*This role is for one of Weekday’s clients
Salary range: Rs 3000000 - Rs 5000000 (ie INR 30 - 50 LPA)*

Min Experience: 5+ years
Location: Remote (India)
JobType: full-time

You are the founding product designer. You work directly with the founders and the founding engineer to build the product, take it to market, and improve it quickly from what real readers do.

You will own the visual design and much of the UX, with genuine creative freedom over how the product looks, moves and feels. You will shape the experience from the first screen a reader sees to the moment they close a chapter.

*Requirements*

What you will own.

– *The reading experience.* Typography, layout, the composer, streaming text, transitions, motion and the small details that make a digital product feel like a beautifully designed book.

– *The wider product.* Onboarding, discovering stories, the library, character interactions, episode endings, sharing and everything that surrounds the core reading experience.

– *Prototyping and exploration.* Taking rough ideas and turning them into something we can click, experience and test. You use AI and modern prototyping tools to explore quickly, but your taste determines what is worth keeping.

– *Design quality in production.* Working closely with the founding engineer to make sure what ships is as good as what was designed. You stay involved through implementation, test the real product and refine the details until they feel right.

– *The design foundations.* The visual language, interaction patterns and standards that future designers inherit.

We have strong product and design instincts ourselves, so this will be a close collaboration. We know how to give clear direction, make decisions quickly and leave room for the person doing the work to bring their own ideas. We expect you to push back when you think we're wrong.

You do not need to write production code. You do need to understand how digital products are built, prototype your ideas and care deeply about the quality of what ships.

*How we work*

The bar is a tier A consumer product: typography, interaction, motion, pacing and visual consistency all count, and we will push on every one of them.

We would rather have something clickable today than spend a week discussing how it might work. We expect you to bring ideas, defend your decisions and change your mind when there is a better answer.

AI is part of how we work. We want you using it to explore, prototype and move faster, without letting it make the design decisions for you.

You are never stuck alone: founders are available daily, the founding engineer works closely with you, and you will have the tools and support you need. We give honest feedback, trust people with responsibility and have no process that exists for its own sake.

*What we are looking for*

– *Exceptional visual and UX taste.* Your portfolio makes this obvious before you explain anything.

– *Extremely strong typography.* You understand hierarchy, spacing, line length, rhythm and readability. You notice details most people miss.

– *A real consumer product designer.* You have designed and shipped products end to end, not just created attractive concepts.

– *Strong interaction and motion instincts.* You know when animation makes something feel better and when it gets in the way.

– *AI first.* You use AI naturally to explore ideas, prototype interactions and move from a rough concept to something tangible at pace. You know where the tools fall short.

– *You prototype, not just design screens.* You want people interacting with your ideas as early as possible.

– *Comfortable starting from nothing.* You can build a coherent experience without a detailed spec, an existing design system or a competitor to copy.

– *Strong collaboration with engineers.* You understand implementation constraints, communicate clearly and stay involved until the experience is right.

– *Design judgement and independence.* You can explain why something works, challenge founders when you disagree and make decisions without waiting for instructions.

– *Genuine interest in consumer psychology.* Why people come back, what makes something feel good, and what makes them tell a friend.

– *You want unusually broad ownership* and a path to Head of Design as the business grows.

*Requirements*

Non negotiable: exceptional visual and UX taste, strong typography, and a portfolio of real consumer product work that demonstrates both.

Preferred: four or more years designing consumer products, experience at an early stage company, and having taken at least one product from concept to launch. None of these on its own will rule you out.

*Tools*

Figma, Claude Design, AI-assisted design and prototyping tools, and whatever else gets you from an idea to a working experience quickly.

We care about the quality of your thinking and what you produce, not which tools you use.

Must-have skills

Product Designer, UI/UX Design

Good-to-have skills

Interaction Design, Prototyping, Motion Design

* Apply responsive design principles and accessibility standards to create inclusive digital experiences.
* Present design concepts, explain design decisions, and incorporate feedback from stakeholders.
* Manage multiple design initiatives and deliver high-quality designs within agreed timelines.

----------------------------------
Required Skills and Qualifications
----------------------------------

* Proven experience as a Product Designer, UX/UI Designer, or in a similar product design role.
* Strong proficiency in *Figma* for wireframing, prototyping, UI design, and design systems.
* Strong understanding of UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, and visual design.
* Experience creating user journeys, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes.
* Knowledge of responsive web design, mobile-first design, and cross-platform user experiences.
* Experience conducting usability testing and incorporating user feedback into design improvements.
* Understanding of design systems, component libraries, and reusable UI patterns.

----------------
Preferred Skills
----------------

* Experience designing enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, or complex business workflows.
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and front-end development concepts.
* Experience with design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, FigJam, or similar tools.
* Understanding of product analytics, A/B testing, and data-driven design decisions.
* Experience designing AI-powered products, dashboards, or data-intensive interfaces.
* Knowledge of design handoff tools and developer collaboration workflows.

*CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization*

We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

*About Us*

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. *Together, we Make Amazing Happen.*

CDW is an equal opportunity employer.
