title: Staff Product Designer
description:
Talkiatry is looking for a *Staff Product Designer* to shape the future of mental health care experiences across multiple strategic product areas. You'll lead design work spanning our Clinical AI products, patient portal experiences, and design system evolution—helping define how patients interact with psychiatric care in both AI-assisted and human-centered contexts.

In this role, you'll divide your time across several high-impact areas: designing AI-powered experiences that support patients between sessions, improving core patient portal flows that help people access and manage their care, and serving as a craft leader who modernizes our design system and raises the visual quality bar across all Talkiatry products.

As a Staff designer, your impact will extend beyond any single product area. You'll work closely with product, engineering, clinical, and AI partners across multiple teams, bringing both deep craft and strategic thinking to ambiguous problems. You'll help establish interaction patterns for emerging technologies while also refining foundational experiences that serve patients every day.

We're looking for a designer who is energized by variety and ambiguity, capable of moving between AI-enabled experiences and core product flows, and equally passionate about interaction design, systems thinking, and exceptional visual craft.

------------------
*About Talkiatry:*
------------------

Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology-powered, in-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.

Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 750+ psychiatrists, 250+ therapists, and more than two million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.

---------
You will:
---------

*

Lead product design across multiple strategic areas, including Clinical AI experiences, patient portal flows, and design system evolution.

*

Design AI-powered experiences that support patients between scheduled psychiatry sessions, from early concepts through launch and iteration.

*

Define how patients interact with conversational AI, helping establish patterns for experiences that may not yet have conventional design precedents.

*

Improve core patient portal experiences, including intake flows, appointment management, visit preparation, and other touchpoints that help patients access and navigate their care.

*

Translate complex AI capabilities and limitations into intuitive, transparent, and trustworthy product experiences.

*

Partner deeply with Product, Engineering, AI/ML, Clinical, and other cross-functional teams across multiple product areas to shape product strategy and determine what we build.

*

Prototype and test interaction patterns—from conversational AI flows to traditional web and mobile experiences—to learn quickly and reduce uncertainty.

*

Advocate for patient needs while helping teams navigate safety, trust, accessibility, and usability considerations across both AI-powered and traditional product experiences.

*

Conduct user research and usability testing to validate design decisions and identify opportunities for improvement.

*

Use research, product data, experimentation, and qualitative feedback to continuously improve experiences after launch.

*

Bring exceptional interaction and visual design craft to all your work, from early product thinking through highly polished final execution.

*

Serve as a senior individual-contributor design leader, influencing product and design decisions across your areas of ownership and beyond.

*

Lead the evolution of Talkiatry's design system, defining the next generation of our visual design language and establishing patterns that scale across web, mobile, and emerging interaction models.

*

Raise the craft bar across the Product Design team through thoughtful critique, mentorship, collaboration, and high-quality example-setting.

---------
You have:
---------

*

*7+ years of product design experience* , including experience owning complex digital products from discovery through implementation and iteration.

*

A *portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking, interaction design, and exceptional visual/UI craft*. *A portfolio is required for consideration.*

*

Strong experience designing rich web and native mobile products.

*

Experience operating with a high degree of autonomy and leading design within ambiguous or zero-to-one product spaces.

*

Experience designing products where trust and transparency are critical to the user experience.

*

Strong systems thinking and the ability to design individual experiences while considering the broader product ecosystem.

*

Deep understanding of interaction design, information architecture, visual hierarchy, typography, layout, and responsive interface design.

*

Strong user research skills with the ability to independently plan and conduct user research, usability testing, and synthesize insights to inform design decisions.

*

Experience creating and evolving scalable design systems, or a strong point of view on how systems can improve both product quality and team velocity.

*

Strong prototyping skills and the ability to communicate complex interactions before they are fully built.

*

Experience collaborating closely with product managers and engineers and contributing meaningfully to product strategy, not just execution.

*

Strong communication and storytelling skills, including the ability to explain design rationale, facilitate productive critique, and influence senior cross-functional partners.

*

Curiosity about emerging technologies and a willingness to learn through experimentation when established design patterns do not yet exist.

---------------------------------------
We'd be especially excited if you have:
---------------------------------------

*

Experience designing conversational interfaces, chat-based products, voice experiences, or AI assistants.

*

Experience designing products powered by AI, machine learning, or large language models.

*

Experience establishing interaction patterns for emerging technologies where best practices are still being defined.

*

Experience in healthcare or regulated industries.

*

Experience helping establish or significantly evolve the visual language of a product or design system.

*

Experience designing patient-facing or consumer health products.

This role includes work on emerging AI experiences, but we don't expect candidates to have spent years designing AI products. Genuine enthusiasm for the space, strong foundational product-design skills, and evidence that you can thoughtfully tackle unfamiliar interaction problems matter more than having a particular AI job title on your résumé.

*Healthcare experience is not required, but is a plus.*

-----------------------------
Why Talkiatry's Product Team:
-----------------------------

*

*Make a meaningful impact:* Help build products designed to expand access to high-quality mental health care and improve the patient experience.

*

*Work across the product portfolio:* Move between AI-powered experiences, core patient flows, and design system work, with variety and strategic influence across multiple product areas.

*

*Shape an emerging product space:* Work at the intersection of mental health, product design, and AI, where many of the interaction patterns have yet to be invented.

*

*Join a talented, collaborative team:* Work alongside experienced people across design, product, engineering, clinical care, and operations who are motivated by a shared mission.

*

*Lead design system evolution:* Play a central role in modernizing our design system, raising craft standards, and shaping how Product Design grows at Talkiatry.

*

*Work remotely:* This role is remote within the United States.

*

*Comprehensive benefits:* Talkiatry offers medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company match, generous paid time off and company holidays, paid parental leave, and additional employee benefits.

*

*Keep growing:* Develop new skills and expand your impact as Talkiatry and the Product Design organization continue to grow.

*

*It all comes back to care:* We're a mental health company, and the well-being of our patients, providers, and team informs how we work.

Talkiatry participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. only after a job offer is accepted and Form I-9 is completed. For more information on E-Verify, please visit the following: EVerify Participation & IER Right to Work.

At Talkiatry, we are an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace and candidate experience. We strive to create an environment where everyone has a sense of belonging and purpose, and where we learn from the unique experiences of those around us.

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy or caregiver status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About RELEX Solutions
---------------------

RELEX Solutions is a fast-growing Finnish software provider for retail and CPG planning processes, helping our customers become faster, more effective, and more competitive. At RELEX, we care as much about our people as we do about optimising trade. You'll benefit from a high degree of autonomy, flat hierarchies, diverse development opportunities, and a culture built around work-life balance.

*About the role*
----------------

We are looking for a full-time Graphic Designer to join RELEX’s central Brand & Creative team. *This is a remote role within our global team, open to candidates currently based in Portugal.*

You will help bring the RELEX brand to life across marketing, sales, and the wider organization, creating thoughtful, high-quality design for a range of audiences and channels.

This is a varied role spanning digital campaigns, event materials, print, presentations, and other brand assets. We are looking for someone with a strong visual eye, sound design fundamentals, and a keen interest in imagery. You should be confident using AI image tools and writing effective prompts, while bringing the judgment needed to select, refine, and art-direct the results.

*What you'll do:*

* Create engaging, on-brand assets for digital campaigns, social media, advertising, presentations, sales materials, and internal communications.
* Design printed materials for events and other brand touchpoints, preparing accurate files for production.
* Collaborate remotely with colleagues across our global marketing and sales teams, as well as the wider RELEX organization, to turn briefs into effective visual work.
* Help develop imagery and visual concepts, from initial ideas and art direction through to final execution.
* Use AI image tools and prompting techniques to explore and create imagery that meets the brief and fits the RELEX brand.
* Maintain a consistent, high standard of design across channels while finding ways to make our brand more distinctive and effective.

*What you'll bring to the table:*

* 3+ years of graphic design experience, either in-house or at an agency, with a portfolio showing strong digital and print work.
* A strong grasp of typography, composition, colour, and visual storytelling.
* Experience designing for print, including production requirements and preparing files for suppliers.
* Strong skills in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
* Practical experience with AI image generation and prompt writing, paired with a discerning eye for image quality and suitability.
* An interest in imagery and ideally some experience shaping visual concepts or providing art direction.
* Attention to detail, strong collaboration and communication skills, and the ability to manage a varied workload across teams and time zones.
* Working proficiency in English.

*What we offer:*

* A position where you can help retailers and consumer goods companies to reach their ESG initiatives through increased supply chain efficiency, reduced food waste, and an empowered workforce
* An international focus with learning opportunities in a rapidly growing SaaS company
* A fun, ambitious, and committed marketing team where all the team members live in 10 different countries but still feel like a family
* A respectful and professional, yet easy-going atmosphere where individual thinking is encouraged
* Responsibilities and challenging projects from day one

*RELEX Portugal*
----------------

RELEXians can be found around the world, but here we’re based out of our central office in Lisbon, where we act as a true extension of the Finnish team. With the metro close by and multiple workspaces – including a lounge and filled fridge – our office is a great place to problem-solve, enjoy work, and then socialise with workmates! Your future teammates make our culture what it is, and we make sure they feel valued and appreciated with lots of activities and gatherings and of course, the genuine flexibility that’s on offer.

Across RELEX, our people are supported and rewarded. In Portugal, we go even further. As well as:

* The choice to work wherever and however you are most productive.
* 25 days of Annual Leave.

We also provide life and health insurance for you, your significant other and your children. We offer two paid volunteer or charity days a year, contribute to your monthly home internet and data allowance and host monthly fun, friendly and varied socials in the office. But that’s not all.

We’re on a journey with our pioneering technology and exciting growth, which is why we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone. We can’t wait to see what challenges you’ll overcome and what problems you’ll solve. Join us and work with the best. *Be curious. Be RELEX – Apply today.*

Being part of RELEX means being heard, feeling valued and knowing that you can be yourself because you belong. We believe in actions, not words, regarding diverse hiring and employment practices. We take DE&I seriously. We champion and benefit from global diversity. We’re creating and evolving our culture to welcome everyone and value every idea.

You can apply by sending your resume through the application form as soon as possible. Please note that we will fill this position as soon as we’ve found the right person, so we recommend that you act quickly.

If you have questions, Eva Pereira (eva.pereira@relexsolutions.com) is happy to answer them.

description:

title: Graphic Designer / Brand Designer (Boosters)
description:
*Boosters* — це українська продуктова компанія. Ми створюємо глобальні продукти в сферах EdTech, Productivity та Wellness, які несуть цінність для *55 мільйонів людей*. Для нас важливо будувати продукти з довготривалим впливом — системні, масштабні та здатні залишатися актуальними десятиліттями.

Можливо, ти вже бачила(ив) наші спін-оффи — Avrora та Promova.

Зараз ми шукаємо *Graphic Designer / Brand Designer* ** для розвитку бренду роботодавця *Boosters,* особливо в період після редизайну.

*Основний фокус ролі* — створення якісної візуальної комунікації як для зовнішньої аудиторії (кандидати, партнери, спільнота), так і для внутрішньої комунікації компанії. Додатково ця роль підтримує продуктові команди, допомагаючи з графічними матеріалами там, де це необхідно.

*Твоє майбутнє середовище:*

Наша головна перевага — це люди. Ми працюємо з тими, хто щодня прагне до самовдосконалення та задає високу планку гри. Ти працюватимеш у команді пліч-о-пліч із людьми, які по-справжньому драйвлять продукт і горять своєю справою з *Lead Product Designer Андрієм Жулідіним.*

*Саме в цій ролі ти отримаєш:*

* повну відповідальність за розвиток бренду Boosters. Ми лише на початку шляху після редизайну, і попереду ще дуже багато носіїв, форматів та точок контакту, які потребуватимуть оновлення або створення з нуля. Це можливість працювати майже з чистого аркуша, не підтримуючи готову систему, а формуючи її
* можливість не просто виконувати дизайн-задачі, а активно контриб’ютити в розвиток стилю, пропонувати власні рішення, розвивати візуальну мову бренду та безпосередньо впливати на те, яким буде Boosters у найближчі роки.

*Твоя зона впливу:*

* основний фокус ролі (близько 80% часу) — розвиток бренду Boosters через створення якісної візуальної комунікації. До цієї зони відповідальності входить:
- створення візуальних матеріалів для social media;
- дизайн для зовнішніх спецпроєктів і маркетингових ініціатив;
- розробка матеріалів для внутрішньої комунікації: презентацій, листівок, мерчу, оформлення івентів та інших корпоративних активностей;
- підтримка та розвиток візуальної мови бренду Boosters.

* інша частина ролі:
- підтримка продуктових команд у створенні графічних матеріалів, зокрема email-банерів, іконок, піктограм, ілюстрацій та інших графічних елементів, коли це необхідно.

*Для цього тобі знадобиться:*

* глибоке розуміння фундаментальних принципів графічного дизайну: типографіка, композиція, модульні сітки, колір, візуальна ієрархія;
* впевнене володіння Figma, Adobe Illustrator та Adobe Photoshop;
* базове володіння інструментами для motion-дизайну (After Effects або аналогами) для створення простих анімацій;
* розуміння принципів брендингу та побудови бренд-систем: уміння працювати в межах стилю й розвивати його;
* досвід створення шаблонізованих дизайн-систем і масштабованих бібліотек графічних матеріалів;
* розуміння особливостей дизайну для різних каналів: social media, презентацій, друкованих матеріалів, мерчу, email-комунікацій та веб;
* досвід підготовки макетів до друку та знання базових вимог різних технологій виробництва (поліграфія, мерч, сувенірна продукція);
* базове розуміння HTML/CSS або no-code/web-coding інструментів для автоматизації створення графіки буде перевагою;
* досвід використання AI-інструментів у дизайн-процесі (ChatGPT, Midjourney, Firefly, Flux, Figma AI тощо) для прискорення роботи та автоматизації рутинних задач.

*Твій шлях до команди Boosters:*

* Pre-screen з рекрутером (45 хвилин)
* Інтервʼю з Lead Product Designer (1,5 години)
* Тестове завдання
* Bar-raising (1 година)

*Ми пропонуємо:*

*Кар’єрний та персональний розвиток:*

* Планові performance review і розробка PDP
* Підтримка в розвитку твого персонального бренду в соцмережах Boosters і експертних медіа
* Профільні комʼюніті Genesis з безкоштовними курсами і можливістю нетворкінгу
* Бюджет на курси, конференції та вивчення англійської
* Техніка від компанії та оплата всіх необхідних сервісів для роботи

*Автономію та гнучкість:*

* Можливість обирати між роботою в офісі (Київ або Львів) та remote-first форматом (Україна та закордон)
* Гнучкий старт дня (з 8 до 11 ранку за Києвом)
* 20 дей-офів на рік, вихідні на державні свята та безлімітні лікарняні

*Турботу про здоров’я:*

description:
*Position Type: Part Time (2.5-3 days per week)*

-------------------
*About the Company*
-------------------

Our client is a modern parenting brand on a mission to make the messy moments of family life easier and more joyful. The brand creates thoughtfully designed, practical products that solve real problems for families. Since launching, they’ve grown a loyal community of parents who value simplicity, sustainability, and clever solutions. ----------------
*About the Role*
----------------

We’re looking for a *Senior Graphic Designer* to bring a modern, elevated, and cohesive visual identity to the brand across all digital touchpoints. This role is ideal for a highly creative and self-driven designer with experience in e-commerce, who can own and execute the brand’s creative direction across web, social, email, and performance marketing channels. You’ll work closely with the marketing team to ensure that every piece of visual content not only looks beautiful but also drives engagement and conversion.

------------------
*Responsibilities*
------------------

*

Design high-quality digital assets for social media, website, email, and paid ads

Maintain and evolve the visual identity across platforms, ensuring brand consistency and helping strengthen design systems as the brand grows

*

Create layouts and assets for seasonal campaigns, product launches, and promotions

*

Collaborate with the team to ideate and execute engaging storytelling visuals, while confidently recommending improvements and providing constructive design feedback

*

Handle basic video editing, including resizing for platform-specific requirements (e.g., in CapCut or Canva)

*

Ensure assets are optimized for both web and mobile, proactively identifying and correcting design inconsistencies or errors before final review

*

Stay updated on design and social media trends to bring fresh ideas to the table

--------------------------------
*Competencies and Qualifications
*
--------------------------------

*Must-Have*

*

3+ years of graphic design experience, ideally in an e-commerce or consumer brand

*

Proficiency in Canva and the ability to use AI tools to support design enhancements and additional creative needs

*

Experience designing for social media, web, email, and performance marketing

*

Strong portfolio showcasing modern, and conversion-driven design work

*

Ability to handle basic video editing tasks using tools like CapCut or Canva

*

Excellent eye for detail, layout, typography, and visual hierarchy

*

Comfortable taking ownership of design quality, making independent creative decisions with minimal art direction, and meeting deadlines in a remote setting

*Nice-to-Have*

*

Experience working with parenting, lifestyle, or DTC brands

*

Knowledge of motion graphics or more advanced video editing tools

*

Familiarity with platforms like Klaviyo, Shopify

*Key Qualities*

*

Collaborative: Effective communication and teamwork skills, thriving in remote and cross-functional environments.

*

Conscientious: Strong sense of ownership, reliability, and commitment to delivering high-quality work.

*

Detail-Oriented: Keen attention to layout, typography, and brand consistency, ensuring polished and precise designs.

*

Action-Oriented: Proactive approach to moving projects forward with efficiency and initiative in a fast-paced setting.

---------------------
*Application Process*
---------------------

We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and we’re here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible.

Typically, the interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Practical Test, but this may vary depending on the role. Throughout each stage, we’ll keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as we can, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us.

title: Principal Architect
description:
*About Us*

Majesco isn’t just riding the AI wave – we’re leading it for the P&C, L&AH, and Pension & Retirement markets. Born in the cloud and built with an AI-native vision, we’ve reimagined the insurance and pension core as an intelligent platform that enables insurers and pension & retirement providers to move faster, see farther and operate smarter. As leaders in intelligent SaaS solutions, we’ve embedded AI and Agentic AI throughout our robust product portfolio of core, underwriting, loss control, distribution, digital solutions, and pension & retirement administration so our customer can reimagine their business with real-time business insights, optimized operations, and enhanced business outcomes. Everything we build is designed to strip away complexity and let our clients focus on what matters: delivering exceptional products, experiences, and long-term financial security for policyholders and plan participants.

In a world where change is constant, our native-cloud SaaS platform empowers insurers, MGAs, and pension & retirement providers with the agility to adapt to evolving risk, regulation, and market expectations, modernize operating models, and accelerate innovation at scale. With 1400+ implementations and more than 375 customers worldwide, Majesco is the AI-native solution trusted to power the future of insurance and pension & retirement. Break free from the past and build the future of insurance

At Majesco, this means joining a team leading the insurance and retirement industry through the AI revolution. You’ll collaborate with experienced leaders and global teams building and scaling AI-native solutions that solve complex, real-world challenges - where innovation moves from concept to production, decisions carry real weight, and execution matters. If you’re looking for a place where your expertise is trusted, your judgment is valued, and your work helps define what’s next for intelligent insurance and retirement technology, Majesco is where that work happens.

*Principal Architect - Majesco P&C*

*Job Summary:*

* The Principal Architect - Majesco P&C is responsible for defining and driving solution architecture for Majesco P&C customer implementations and modernization programs. The role translates business and technology requirements into scalable, secure and supportable solutions across Majesco Policy, Billing, Claims, Digital, Data and integration capabilities. The Principal Architect works closely with customers, Product, Engineering and Services teams to make sound architecture decisions, proactively manage technical risks, maximize product capabilities and ensure solutions are delivered with quality, predictability and long-term maintainability.

*Key Responsibilities:*

* Own end-to-end solution architecture for assigned Majesco P&C implementations, ensuring alignment with customer business outcomes, Majesco product capabilities and architecture standards.
* Define solution blueprints across Policy, Billing, Claims, Digital, Data, APIs, integrations and surrounding customer ecosystem components.
* Translate business, functional and non-functional requirements into clear architecture decisions, integration patterns and implementation guidance.
* Lead solution and design reviews, identifying architecture risks, dependencies, performance concerns and product gaps early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Drive a product-first approach by maximizing out-of-the-box capabilities, minimizing unnecessary customization and promoting reusable implementation patterns.
* Partner with Product Management and Engineering to evaluate solution gaps and determine appropriate configuration, extension, integration or product enhancement approaches.
* Work directly with customer architects and technology teams to explain architecture options, trade-offs, risks and recommendations.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to solution architects, technical leads and engineering teams throughout implementation.
* Promote automation, AI-enabled engineering practices, architecture standards and reusable assets that improve delivery quality and predictability.

*Essential Attributes & Capabilities:*

* Strong architectural judgment with the ability to simplify complex business and technology problems and make clear, outcome-oriented decisions.
* Excellent executive communication and customer engagement skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset with the ability to anticipate risks, drive decisions and lead through ambiguity without waiting for direction.
* Strong collaboration skills across Product, Engineering, Services, Delivery, Security, Cloud, Data and customer teams.
* Commitment to engineering quality, architecture governance and a 'do it right the first time' mindset while balancing delivery speed and business priorities.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and root-cause problem-solving skills across complex distributed systems.
* Ability to mentor and influence architects and engineering teams without relying solely on formal authority.
* Strong preference for standardization, reuse and automation over one-off or highly customized solutions.
* Hands-on understanding of agile product development and implementation delivery models.
* Customer-outcome and growth mindset with a strong focus on predictability, scalability, quality and long-term maintainability.
* Ability to work independently, remotely, and as part of a team.

*Technical Expertise:*

* Deep architecture experience with enterprise P&C insurance platforms; strong understanding of Policy Administration, Billing and Claims business capabilities and implementation patterns.
* Strong knowledge of Majesco P&C solutions is highly preferred, including Majesco Policy, Billing, Claims and related Digital, Data and integration capabilities.
* Proven experience designing cloud-native SaaS and distributed enterprise architectures, including microservices, APIs, event-driven integration, resiliency, scalability, observability and security.
* Strong understanding of integration architecture and technologies including REST APIs, asynchronous messaging/events, API management, identity and access management, OAuth/OIDC and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with public cloud architecture (AWS and/or Azure), containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevSecOps and modern application delivery practices.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, data migration/conversion, reporting/analytics integration and performance considerations for large-scale insurance implementations.
* Ability to define and assess non-functional requirements including performance, availability, scalability, security, recoverability and operational supportability.
* Working knowledge of AI/GenAI/Agentic AI architecture patterns, governance and practical application within software engineering and insurance business processes is preferred.

*Preferred Qualification & Experience:*

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* Typically 12+ years of enterprise technology experience, including significant solution/technical architecture experience.
* 7+ years of P&C insurance technology experience or comparable experience implementing enterprise insurance platforms strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience owning architecture for complex, multi-system enterprise implementation programs and engaging directly with customer architects, technology leaders and delivery teams.
* Prior experience with Majesco or another leading P&C core insurance platform is strongly preferred.

description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll shape the next phase of Airwallex’s growth by building data science systems that improve how we acquire, activate, engage, retain, and expand customers globally.

- Design, deploy, and iterate on predictive models, personalization and recommendation systems, LLM-powered applications, incentive optimization frameworks, and causal inference models that drive measurable business outcomes.

- Partner with Growth, Marketing, Product, Sales, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to turn data and AI into clear recommendations, stronger investment decisions, and effective go-to-market strategies.

- Measure the causal impact of marketing and growth initiatives, identify what’s working, and translate those findings into action.

- Raise the technical bar for the data science team through hands-on leadership, mentorship, and a clear vision for longer-term direction.

You’ll be based in Seattle and work from the office three days a week.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

ESSENTIALS

- 7+ years of industry experience and an advanced degree, such as a PhD or MS, in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Engineering, the Sciences, Computer Science, or Economics.

- Expert knowledge of machine learning and statistical modelling for data-driven growth strategy.

- Hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining machine learning models in production-grade systems, including cloud-based services and real-time or batch pipelines.

- Strong experience with data querying languages such as SQL and scripting languages such as Python.

- Experience applying machine learning and statistical models to measure the causal impact of marketing or growth initiatives.

- Strong experience in AI harness and building AI agents.

PREFERRED

- Experience with schema design and dimensional data modelling.

- Experience communicating analysis and recommendations to leadership and cross-functional teams to influence strategy.

- Experience in technology, financial services, or a high-growth environment.

- Experience providing technical mentorship on machine learning and experimentation in an industry setting.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

- You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

- You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

- You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

- You're not precious about your ideas. You push hard for what you believe in, but you pivot fast when the data says otherwise.

- You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

Data Science at Airwallex is evolving from individual analyses and standalone models into scalable systems of decision and action. We bring together two complementary capabilities: DS Analytics, which improves decision quality and reduces decision latency, and DS Algorithm, which directly optimizes product and business outcomes in real time.

You’ll build systems of decision that help teams understand what changed, determine what to do next, and learn whether the action worked. This means owning the AI analytics harness around the analysis—including semantic layers, context retrieval, evaluation infrastructure, validation gates, and governance—so decisions remain reliable, contextualized, and trustworthy at scale.

You’ll also build systems of action that use machine learning and AI to shape product behavior, ranking, pricing, risk, allocation, and customer experiences. The work extends beyond training models to designing how intelligent systems reason, use tools, operate within guardrails, execute workflows, and measure their incremental impact.

As AI makes ad hoc analysis increasingly accessible, the remaining advantage is scale, scientific method, and rigor. You’ll structure ambiguous problems, design experiments, identify confounding factors, challenge misleading conclusions, and build production systems that produce reliable outcomes repeatedly—not just one-off answers.

The work is moving up the stack: from analysis to system, from model to harness, and from answering a question once to building something that answers it correctly over time. If you want to create data science systems that compound decision quality and turn intelligence into measurable action, this is where that work happens.

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Fraud Analyst
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Fraud Analyst to join Pleo’s Decision Intelligence team and help strengthen how we detect, prevent, monitor, and respond to fraud risk across our financial crime decisioning setup.

This is not a traditional Fraud Operations case-handling role. You will work closer to the decisioning layer: helping translate fraud patterns into rules, monitoring rule performance, supporting rule testing, reviewing alert behaviour, and making sure fraud controls remain effective, explainable, and proportionate.

You will join at an important stage as Pleo continues to mature its fraud and AML decisioning capability. The right person will help improve speed, resilience, and quality in how we create, test, deploy, monitor, and tune fraud rules.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

You will help operate and improve Pleo’s fraud decisioning capability, with a focus on card fraud and related financial crime risk scenarios.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Supporting the end-to-end fraud rule lifecycle: from rule proposal and analysis through testing, deployment, monitoring, tuning, and rollback.

- Working directly in, or closely with, decisioning tools and rule engines to support fraud detection logic.

- Analysing fraud patterns, alert trends, false positives, false negatives, and rule performance.

- Translating FraudOps insights and stakeholder requests into clear, structured rule proposals.

- Helping assess whether new rules or threshold changes are justified by data.

- Monitoring post-deployment rule performance and identifying when rules need adjustment.

- Supporting daily operational requests related to fraud controls, while ensuring changes are traceable and well documented.

- Partnering with FraudOps, AML, Product, Engineering, Data, Compliance, and Legal to make sure decisioning changes are aligned and risk-aware.

- Maintaining clear documentation for fraud rules, rationale, expected impact, testing outcomes, and monitoring results.

- Helping reduce single points of failure by building repeatable processes and stronger business continuity around fraud decisioning.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for someone who combines fraud domain knowledge with practical experience working in a decisioning environment.

You should have:

- Experience as a Fraud Analyst, Risk Analyst, Fraud Strategy Analyst, Fraud Rules Analyst, Decisioning Analyst, or similar.

- Hands-on experience with a decisioning tool, fraud rules engine, risk platform, or internal decisioning system.

- Experience creating, testing, monitoring, or tuning fraud rules, thresholds, scenarios, or risk logic.

- Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data to assess rule performance and fraud patterns.

- Good understanding of fraud typologies, especially card fraud, transaction fraud, account misuse, or payment fraud.

- Ability to balance fraud prevention with customer impact and operational workload.

- Experience working with false positives and understanding that good fraud controls require continuous monitoring and tuning.

- Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain rule logic, rationale, risks, and expected outcomes clearly.

- Comfort working cross-functionally with FraudOps, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Data teams.

- A structured mindset and appreciation for documentation, traceability, governance, and change control.

- Fintech, banking, payments, spend management, or regulated financial services.

- SQL or basic data analysis.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first 3 months, success would look like:

- You understand Pleo’s fraud decisioning setup and can confidently support day-to-day rule operations.

- Fraud rule requests are better structured, documented, and traceable.

- Rule changes are supported by data, clear rationale, and expected impact.

- Post-deployment monitoring is more consistent and visible.

- FraudOps and DI have a stronger operating rhythm for proposing, reviewing, deploying, and tuning fraud controls.

WHY JOIN US?

This is a rare opportunity to help shape a growing decisioning function from the inside. You will not just be reviewing fraud alerts, you will help define how fraud detection logic is built, governed, monitored, and improved.

You will join a team that is building the foundations for more scalable, data-driven, and resilient financial crime decisioning. If you enjoy working at the intersection of fraud strategy, operations, data, systems, and product, this role will give you real ownership and impact.

APPLY IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

You are analytical, structured, curious, and comfortable challenging assumptions. You know that fraud rules are never “set and forget.” You understand the importance of balancing risk reduction, customer experience, operational workload, and governance.

Most importantly, you have worked with decisioning tools or rule-based risk systems before and want to help build a stronger fraud decisioning capability at scale.

THE LOCATION

PLEASE NOTE: WE CAN HIRE ON A REMOTE, HYBRID OR IN-PERSON SET-UP IN ANY OF THE LOCATIONS LISTED ON THE ADVERT BUT YOU WILL NEED TO BE PHYSICALLY BASED IN THE COUNTRY OF YOUR CHOICE WITH A VALID RIGHT TO WORK. WE ARE UNABLE TO OFFER VISA SPONSORSHIP FOR THIS ROLE IN ANY OF THE LISTED LOCATIONS.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Snowflake is scaling fast across industries, and we need marketing leaders who can think strategically and execute with urgency. If you are energized by orchestrating programs, enabling the field, and amplifying the voice of the region to shape global impact, we’d love to meet you.

BUILD THE ALWAYS-ON ENGINE BEHIND SNOWFLAKE INGESTION

Snowflake’s ingestion products land customer data into the AI Data Cloud at petabytes scale, on a path to much larger scale. Those products run on a shared, always-on ingestion execution platform: a multi-tenant control plane that owns pipeline lifecycle, durable work queues, single-owner execution, step orchestration across control plane and compute, multi-tenant scheduling, source monitoring, and cluster topology.

You will build the substrate other ingestion teams ship on. Reliability, fairness, and efficiency at this layer multiply across ingestion products.

As a Software Engineer, you will own substantial platform work end to end: take a hard distributed-systems problem from design through production, make neighboring teams more successful, and raise the bar on correctness, isolation, and operability.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Design and ship core platform capabilities. Work on areas such as multi-tenant isolation, fair scheduling, ownership and placement, durable queues, source monitoring, or compute allocation. You own the work from design through production.

- Strengthen isolation and fairness. Build and evolve the primitives that let many products and pipelines share one platform safely: quotas, backpressure, resource accounting, and intelligent placement.

- Raise reliability and observability. Improve availability and latency for pipeline health, ingest APIs, and compute allocation. Instrument the system so behavior is visible and actionable.

- Build a clean platform surface. Give product teams a consistent way to express pipelines and processing steps, so they can ship on shared primitives rather than special-casing the stack.

- Scale the control plane. Design for more concurrent pipelines, higher ingest volume, and efficient use of compute and metadata as customer usage grows.

- Operate what you ship. This platform sits on the critical path for production ingest. You will participate in production support, improve observability, and automate operational work. Mentorship of junior engineers is part of the job. You will also work closely with engineers on larger platform bets.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 3–6+ years building and operating large-scale distributed systems or cloud infrastructure in production. You have shipped something hard that other teams depend on, not only application features.

- Track record of end-to-end ownership: you took an ambiguous, cross-cutting problem, wrote the design, landed the code, and lived with it in production. Comfortable operating above your level, influencing adjacent teams and helping sequence larger bets without waiting to be told what to do.

- Strong proficiency in Java (this codebase is Java-first). C++ or systems-level experience is a plus. You write concurrent, failure-aware code and you care about the invariants.

- Experience in at least one of: multi-tenant control planes, durable queues and at-least-once processing, distributed locking / leases / membership, cluster scheduling, or streaming/ingest execution engines.

- Instinct for correctness under failure. You think carefully about crashes, retries, redelivery, and exclusive ownership.

- Clear written and verbal communication. You can write a clear design for engineers on neighboring product teams, and you can hold a technical argument without ego.

- BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

BONUS POINTS

- Experience building internal platforms used by multiple product teams (orchestration, job/runtime frameworks, multi-tenant schedulers).

- Background in multi-tenant isolation and fairness: resource accounting, request throttling, quota systems, or load-aware placement.

- Hands-on with transactional or consensus-backed metadata stores (for example etcd, ZooKeeper, or Spanner-style systems).

- Familiarity with open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake), Kafka-style streaming, or warehouse scheduling.

- Performance work at scale: tail latency, memory and thread accounting, I/O batching, or cost-per-unit efficiency.

Your Opportunity
As a Principal Engineer, you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs.

You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.
Primary Responsibilities
- Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

- Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations

- Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling

- Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

- Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

- Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence

title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
DescriptionBlueTuskr is a full-service e-commerce growth agency built exclusively for e-commerce brands. We combine paid media, owned media, creative, and analytics to help our clients scale profitably. Our team is made up of specialists who are deeply invested in their craft â and in the success of the brands they serve.
This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well.

The Opportunity
We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands â emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative â and can explain exactly why each design choice was made.
You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow â to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency.
This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week, with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand.

What You'll OwnEmail & Retention Design
- Design campaign and automated flow emails (newsletters, welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, etc.) that are on-brand and built to drive clicks and revenue
- Design mobile-first, with clear hierarchy, scannable layouts, and strong calls to action
- Prepare email-ready files and specs (image slicing, live text vs. image text, alt text, dark mode considerations) for clean builds in Klaviyo and other email platforms
Web Creative & CRO Support
- Design landing pages, homepage, and collection page sections, product page (PDP) modules, banners, and promotional assets for Shopify stores
- Partner with the CRO team to design test variations based on data, heatmaps, and hypotheses â not just personal taste
- Hand off dev-ready Figma files to our web developers, with desktop and mobile layouts, organized layers, and clear specs
Social & Ad Creative
- Design static social and paid ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and other channels
- Create ad variations and iterations to support creative testing
- Video editing for social and ad use (resizing, trimming, captions, simple motion) where needed
Process & Quality
- Follow each client's brand guidelines closely, and flag gaps or inconsistencies when guidelines are missing or unclear
- Apply design and e-commerce best practices (accessibility, contrast, legibility, load-friendly assets, platform specs)
- Present work with a clear rationale â why this layout, this hierarchy, this CTA â to internal teams and, when needed, clients
- Take feedback well, turn revisions around quickly, and keep work moving across multiple accounts and deadlines
- Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up concepting, copy-to-layout exploration, asset variations, and repetitive production tasks â while following client confidentiality and our AI use guidelines
Who You AreSkills get you in the door. These are the qualities that make you right for this role:
- An exceptional designer with a strong eye for layout, typography, and color â your portfolio speaks for itself
- Conversion-minded â you think about what the customer needs to see, feel, and do next, not just what looks good
- Detail-obsessed â you catch the misaligned element, the off-brand color, and the typo before anyone else does
- A clear communicator who can explain the reasoning behind design choices and keeps the team updated without being chased
- Excellent at managing your time â you can juggle multiple clients and deadlines in a remote, async environment without dropping the ball
- AI-curious and AI-capable â you already use tools like Claude in your workflow and are excited to find new ways to work smarter
- Adaptable â you can shift between very different brand styles and still make each one feel right.
What Success Looks LikeIn your first 90 days:
- You've learned the brand guidelines and design systems for your assigned client accounts
- You're consistently delivering email, web, and social designs on time with minimal revision rounds
- You've handed off at least one web project or CRO test variation to our Shopify dev team with clean, dev-ready files
- You've built AI into your workflow in a way that measurably speeds up production
- Internal teams trust your work and your reasoning, and come to you with ideas, not just requests

Must-Have:
- 2â4 years of e-commerce digital design experience (email, website, social, etc.)
- A portfolio showing e-commerce work â ideally with context on goals and results
- Advanced proficiency in Figma
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
- Hands-on experience using Claude and/or other AI tools in a design workflow
- Experience designing for the web and supporting website creative (landing pages, site sections, PDPs)
- Strong understanding of conversion-focused design and e-commerce best practices
- Proven ability to follow and apply brand guidelines across multiple brands
- Strong written and spoken English for async communication with a U.S.-based team
Strong Differentiators:
- Video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar)
- Experience designing for Klaviyo or other email platforms
- Familiarity with Shopify themes and how designs get built
- Experience designing A/B test variations or working with CRO data
- Paid social ad creative experience (Meta, TikTok)
- Agency background preferred

This role is fully remote.
Time Commitment and Availability
- Hours: 15 hours/week to start, with the opportunity to scale up as the role and client roster grow
- Availability: Between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. EST
Compensation
$20â25 USD/hour, based on experience and portfolio. This is a part-time, remote contractor role starting at 15 hours/week. Video editing experience is a strong plus and is factored into the rate.

title: Associate Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for an *Entry-Level Software Developer* who treats artificial intelligence not just as an occasional tool, but as a core pillar of their daily engineering workflow. In this role, you won't just write code line-by-line; you will act as a "pilot" directing elite AI assistants. You will leverage *GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and modern AI coding environments* to dramatically accelerate feature delivery while personally owning the final code quality, architectural integrity, and testing rigor.

The ideal candidate has strong foundational computer science skills but excels at *code verification, system design, and prompt mechanics*. This is a perfect position for a junior developer eager to skip boilerplate assembly and focus on solving high-level logic, performance optimization, and product experience.

**

*WHAT YOU WILL DO*

* *AI-Augmented Development:* Deeply integrate tools like *GitHub Copilot* (for real-time inline generation and autocomplete) and *Claude Code / Cursor* (for agentic, multi-file code refactoring and debugging) into your daily lifecycle.
* *Code Verification & Review:* Critically analyze and thoroughly understand every single line of code generated by AI assistants before committing. Identify edge cases, logic gaps, or potential bugs introduced by AI outputs.
* *Feature Implementation:* Write clean, modular, and maintainable code in modern frameworks (e.g., Python, TypeScript, React, or .NET).
* *Testing & Quality Control:* Instruct AI tools to write comprehensive unit and integration tests. Manually validate code correctness and participate actively in peer code reviews.
* *Prompt Engineering for Code:* Craft, optimize, and document contextual prompt chains to solve complex algorithmic tasks or automate developer productivity tasks.

*WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR*

* *Education / Experience:* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a STEM major, or a coding bootcamp background with a strong portfolio of personal projects. *0–2 years of professional software engineering experience*.
* *Foundational Coding:* Strong grasp of core programming principles, data structures, object-oriented design, and asynchronous patterns.
* *AI Tool Fluency:* Demonstrated familiarity with modern AI coding assistants (such as *GitHub Copilot* , *Claude Code* , or *Cursor* ).
* *The "Verification Mindset":* The humility and discipline to know that AI-generated code cannot be trusted blindly. You must have the ability to debug, trace, and explain everything you ship.
* *Systems & Tools:* Comfortable using Git, GitHub/GitLab workflows, pull requests, and standard package managers.
* *Communication:* Ability to ask sharp clarifying questions about business requirements to turn them into precise prompts and code logic.

*WHAT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT*

* Experience working with Large Language Model APIs (e.g., Anthropic Claude API, OpenAI API) or building simple AI-powered features.
* Basic understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) or agentic workflows.

Founded in 2009, Knorex ( is a technology company that provides programmatic advertising products and solutions to marketers to connect in real-time to their desired audience worldwide. Through its flagship universal marketing platform, Knorex XPO unifies the connectivity to each of the major marketing channels including social media, search, connected TVs/OTTs, video, audio, display/native, and email, in one place, while simplifying execution and optimization across these channels through AI automation. Knorex operates across the US and APAC.

*Job Description*

We are looking for a motivated Junior Software Engineer to join our Real-Time Bidding (RTB) team and help develop and maintain our high-performance bidding engine.

Our RTB system processes bid requests from advertising exchanges in real time, making bidding decisions under strict latency requirements. You will work with experienced engineers to build reliable, scalable, and efficient backend systems while learning about programmatic advertising and real-time distributed systems.

This role is suitable for fresh graduates or engineers with up to one year of experience who have a strong foundation in programming, enjoy solving technical problems, and are eager to grow as backend engineers.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Develop, test, and maintain backend services and components of the RTB bidding engine.
* Implement new features and improve existing functionality under senior engineers' guidance.
* Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and well-tested code.
* Investigate bugs, troubleshoot technical issues, and help improve system reliability.
* Contribute to performance optimization to improve the bidding engine's latency, throughput, and resource efficiency.
* Integrate with external advertising platforms and internal services through APIs and messaging systems.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with team members to deliver features and improvements on time.
* Learn and apply new technologies, tools, and techniques to improve software quality and development productivity.

*Requirements*

* Bachelor's degree or final-year student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

* Proficiency in at least one programming language, with Go preferred.
* Good understanding of data structures, algorithms, and fundamental programming concepts.
* Basic understanding of programming concepts, software design principles, computer networks, HTTP, and client-server communication.
* Familiarity with Git and basic software development workflows.
* Ability to write readable code, test implementations, and debug problems systematically.
* Good problem-solving and analytical skills, willingness to learn and accept feedback, and ability to collaborate effectively.
* Ability to read and understand technical documentation in English.

*Nice to have*

* Experience developing backend services or REST APIs.
* Familiarity with Go, Linux, SQL.
* Basic understanding of concurrency, multithreading, or distributed systems.
* Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, or cloud platforms.
* Experience with personal projects, internships, or open-source contributions.
* Interest in high-performance computing, real-time processing, or advertising technology.

*Benefits*

* Competitive remuneration package including quarterly bonus and performance review opportunities.
* Full participation in mandatory insurance programs in accordance with Vietnamese Labor Law.
* Healthcare insurance package and annual health check-up.
* Comprehensive benefits scheme such as W3F (Work, Wellbeing, Welfare) Fund for courses, materials, personal health and wellbeing.
* Work from home benefits.
* You will have the advance to influence and drive the changes, at Knorex we welcome good ideas and accept any possibility to make our company great.
* We offer great learning opportunities; you will have exposure to cutting edge performance marketing and advertising technology.
* Opportunity to work cross-country and with a variety of projects of a different nature.

title: Junior Manual QA (Mobile Apps) | Inspirio
description:
Hi!
---

We are *Boosta, a holding tech company* that creates, develops, and invests in digital businesses with global potential. Today, we collaborate with over 800 specialists from different parts of the world, and millions of users use our products and services.

We are currently looking for a *Junior Quality Assurance Engineer for Mobile Apps* to join *Inspirio* , a project focused on the fast launch, development, and scaling of mobile applications.

Inspirio by the numbers:
------------------------

* 20+ applications in finance, health, wellness, and utility niches
* 5M+ downloads of our products
* 3x growth in active users over the past 12 months
* 35 core team members and a network of external partners

Your focus will include:
------------------------

* Testing mobile apps (iOS, Android) and web projects: running builds and releases through an approved checklist
* Finding and documenting defects, re-testing fixes
* Helping improve the team's test cases and checklists
* Daily collaboration with mobile and web developers and PMs: clarifying requirements, reporting blockers and risks
* Planning your own time, tracking actual and estimated time on tasks
* Using AI tools and building your own to speed up routine tasks

You’re our ideal candidate if you:
----------------------------------

* Testing fundamentals: test cases, checklists, equivalence classes, boundary values
* Basic experience testing mobile apps on iOS and Android and web projects (educational and pet projects count)
* Writing clear bug reports: steps, actual and expected results, severity, video or screenshot
* Using AI tools in work or study, understanding where they save time and where they make mistakes
* Jira or a similar task tracking system
* English sufficient to read documentation

Nice to have:
-------------

* Understanding how the web works: client and server, HTTP requests and responses, status codes, cookies, HTML and CSS basics
* Building your own AI tools or scripts to automate routine tasks, even small ones
* Understanding the difference between native and cross-platform apps and how it affects testing
* Finding and reading logs (Xcode console, Logcat, browser console)
* Browser DevTools: Console, Network tab
* Knowing different ways to get a build onto a device or simulator
* Test management systems, Postman, Charles

What to expect in our hiring process:
-------------------------------------

* Step 1: Pre-screen.
* Step 2: Test task.
* Step 3: Interview.
* Step 4: Final interview (optional).
* Step 5: Reference check.
* Step 6: Job Offer.

What you’ll get from working with us:
-------------------------------------

* A fast-paced, dynamic environment with daily challenges and opportunities for professional growth.
* Strong manager support and trust — no micromanagement.
* Learning & development: compensation for external courses, conferences, corporate library, mentorship (especially for juniors and career switchers), and many other opportunities.
* Remote work and flexible schedule — plan your day independently while considering team interaction hours.
* Option to work from the Kyiv office, Lviv or Warsaw coworking.
* 28 working days of paid vacation per year, up to 30 sick leave days with medical confirmation, plus all public holidays observed.
* Medical insurance and compensation for sessions with a psychologist.
* Ukrainian Victory Support program and other important social initiatives.
* We celebrate important moments together — we give gifts for special occasions in your life and career.
* Quarterly team buildings (online or offline).

About Inspirio:
---------------

Inspirio is a team operating at the fast pace of the mobile products market. We thrive on dynamics, launching new solutions, testing hypotheses, and seeing real results.

If you feel the same drive, send us your CV and join *Inspirio* — a team where inspiration turns into results.

title: Junior Data Analyst
description:

As a leading nonprofit health care provider, we deliver compassionate, high-quality care to the diverse communities of the Coachella Valley and San Diego County.
