title: Junior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
*Location:* Fully Remote (USA) · Timezone-aligned *Compensation:* 80k–100k + Equity + Quarterly Performance Bonuses
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Mission: Transforming Businesses for the AI Age
--------------------------------------------------

Many businesses still depend on disconnected software, spreadsheets, manual processes, and knowledge trapped inside individual employees’ heads. Lumion brings those systems and processes together so organizations can operate more intelligently and efficiently.

We are starting with trade and technical schools. Our platform powers the entire institution, from the first lead through enrollment, tuition payments, compliance reporting, graduation, and career tracking.

These schools prepare electricians, welders, nurses, technicians, and other skilled professionals who keep the country moving. By modernizing their operations, Lumion helps them serve more students and strengthen the skilled workforce.

The Opportunity: Learn How Software Will Be Built in the Future
---------------------------------------------------------------

This is a place to launch your career at the cutting edge of software development. You will learn how coding will be done in the future and become part of the wave changing how software is created.

Our stack and development processes are AI First. Claude Code and Codex are part of our normal workflow, with access to the latest frontier models without having to ration tokens or worry about usage limits. You will learn the workflows, judgment, and verification practices required to use these systems effectively and become a 100x developer.

Working at a startup also gives you the opportunity to wear different hats and see problems from engineering, product, customer, and business perspectives. You will gain experience that is difficult to find when working inside one narrow area of a larger company.

If you want a fast moving environment, the excitement of solving new problems, and the chance to look back proudly on helping build something significant, this is that opportunity.

The Role: Code at the Speed of Thought
--------------------------------------

Your work will span backend business logic, data models, APIs, integrations, administrative workflows, customer facing interfaces, and automated tests.

You will be a full member of the engineering team from day one and trusted with meaningful production work. Important assignments are not reserved for people with longer résumés. You will be held to the same standards for quality, communication, and follow through as every other engineer at Lumion.

What We’re Looking For
----------------------

Professional software engineering experience is not required.

*

*A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science is required.* The degree must be completed before your employment begins. Current students may apply if they will graduate before their start date.

*

*Evidence that you have put your programming skills into practice.* This can come from a capstone, internship, personal project, open source contribution, research project, freelance engagement, or another hands on project. We want to understand what you worked on, what you personally contributed, and what you learned.

*

*Confidence in at least one programming language.* You can build with it, debug it, and explain the logic behind your decisions. The language does not need to be PHP, and prior Laravel experience is not required.

*

*An understanding of web development fundamentals.* You are familiar with concepts such as HTTP, APIs, authentication, databases, browser interfaces, version control, and automated testing.

*

*Logical problem solving.* You can break an unfamiliar problem into manageable parts, investigate failures systematically, and work toward the underlying cause.

*

*Product judgment.* You consider the person using the software and connect technical decisions to the problem being solved.

How We Work
-----------

Lumion is a high trust team. We share context openly, keep our egos low, raise risks early, and ask questions when something does not make sense.

To show that you read the entire posting, tell us in your application what you would do with a golden banana. There are no wrong answers except not answering.

The Stack
---------

Our current application stack includes:
---------------------------------------

*

*Application:* PHP 8.4+, Laravel 12+, Livewire, Filament, Blade, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS

*

*Data:* MySQL, Redis, pgvector, and Pinecone

*

*Testing:* Pest PHP

Why Join Lumion Now?
--------------------

Lumion closed a $10.7 million seed round backed by TTV Capital and Tusk Venture Partners. More than 400 career schools use our platform to support over 150,000 students across 48 states and 29 industries.

Schools using Lumion see 47% more completed applications, a 73.6% application to enrollment rate, 91% on time tuition collection, and 21% higher student retention.

We have the capital and momentum to build something that lasts while remaining early enough for every engineer to influence the product and company.

Remote First
------------

This is a full time remote position. You must reside in and be authorized to work in the United States. Your normal workday must overlap by at least six hours with our Salt Lake City team.

Compensation and Benefits
-------------------------

*

*Salary:* $80,000 to $100,000 USD

*

*Equity:* Meaningful stock options

*

*Bonuses:* Quarterly performance based cash bonuses

*

*Time Off:* Unlimited paid time off

*

*Retirement:* 401(k)

*

*Health:* Health, dental, and vision reimbursement up to $537.50 per month

*

*Technology:* $200 monthly technology stipend

*

*Wellness:* $100 monthly wellness stipend

Salary: 80K - 100K USD a year

title: Junior Full Stack Developer
description:
*About Gruve*

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.

*About the Role*

Gruve is seeking a motivated and technically curious Fresh Graduate Full Stack Developer to join a team building and modernizing a remote instrument monitoring platform for hospitals and laboratories worldwide.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate who is interested in full-stack development, cloud technologies, IoT, AI, and modern software engineering. You will have the opportunity to work with technologies including React, TypeScript, .NET/C#, Python, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, and AI development tools.

You will work closely with experienced engineers and contribute to a greenfield cloud-native platform while gaining exposure to IoT connectivity, cloud applications, software packaging, AI agents, and automated testing.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Develop and maintain web applications using React and TypeScript.
* Support backend development using .NET/C# and/or Python.
* Build and integrate REST APIs and event-driven services.
* Assist with IoT and instrument connectivity using technologies such as MQTT, AMQP, and REST APIs.
* Develop and support lightweight applications for Windows/Linux environments.
* Assist with software packaging, application updates, version management, and deployment.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
* Work with Docker and cloud-based development environments.
* Assist with AWS-based application development and deployment.
* Explore and develop AI-powered engineering tools using technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, or similar frameworks.
* Assist with RAG applications using technical documentation and knowledge bases.
* Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
* Participate in code reviews, debugging, documentation, and troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with senior engineers across software development, cloud, IoT, AI, and DevOps.

*Basic Qualifications*

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Recent graduate or graduating student with 0–2 years of professional experience.
* Strong foundation in programming and software development concepts.
* Academic, internship, personal, or project experience with React, JavaScript/TypeScript, .NET/C#, Python, or similar technologies.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs and web application development.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub and software development workflows.
* Basic understanding of databases and SQL.
* Exposure to Docker, CI/CD, AWS, or cloud technologies through coursework or projects is a plus.
* Interest in AI development, IoT, and modern software engineering.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability and willingness to learn new technologies quickly.

*Preferred Qualifications*

These are *nice-to-have qualifications and are not required for fresh graduates* :

* Academic or personal project involving IoT or MQTT/AMQP.
* Experience with AWS, Docker, Terraform, or Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience with GitHub Actions or another CI/CD platform.
* Experience using AI development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code.
* Exposure to LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, RAG, or AI agents.
* Experience developing applications for Windows or Linux.
* Knowledge of software packaging, installers, or application update mechanisms.
* Familiarity with automated testing.
* Coursework or project experience involving medical devices, healthcare technology, IVD, or regulated software.
* Familiarity with React, TypeScript, .NET, Python/FastAPI, Next.js, GraphQL, or event-driven architectures.

*Salary Range*

$60,000 - $70,000 USD/Yearly

*C2C contractor opportunity for fresh graduates; no prior professional experience required; hired for a Gruve customer; no visa sponsorship available.*

‍

*Why Gruve*

At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Junior Customer Service Agent – Fraud Management (w/m/x)
description:
*Deine Rolle*

Erste Vorerfahrung im Bereich Fraud Detection, Risikomanagement oder im anspruchsvollen Customer Support.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
Smadex is a performance advertising engine for mobile apps, enabling the world's leading marketers to grow across Mobile and Connected TV (CTV). Powered by AI models trained on real campaign outcomes, Smadex delivers profitable growth at scale. Headquartered in Barcelona, with teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, Smadex is a business unit of Entravision (NYSE: EVC).

The team

You will join our core engineering team, a collaborative group of 8 experienced engineers responsible for maintaining and evolving the real-time bidding (Open-RTB) auction system that powers our entire business. We foster a fast-paced, supportive environment where knowledge sharing is key. We value autonomy and will provide the platform for you to grow your career while solving complex engineering challenges.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for a knowledgeable Software Engineer who is excited by complex technical challenges. Your success will be measured by your ability to deliver high-quality features , collaborate with the team, while sharing and applying your knowledge effectively.

What will you do at Smadex?

You will dive into a dynamic environment, tackling short-cycle tasks across the core platform following a "you build it, you run it" philosophy. You will be expected to participate in code reviews, contribute to technical and architectural decisions, and collaborate in a fast-paced environment where every opinion counts.

Key Responsibilities

* Feature Ownership : Design, develop, and implement new features for core products using NodeJS and Java.
* Quality Assurance : Write clean, efficient, testable code and thoroughly test work locally and in a sophisticated staging environment.
* Operational Excellence : Monitor deployments and help ensure the stability, reliability and performance of production systems.
* Agile Collaboration : Collaborate with the team in an agile environment, participating in planning and reporting on progress.

Requirements:

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* 2-4 years of experience in a software engineering role.
* Hands-on experience with Java or NodeJS.
* A solid theoretical foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.
* A genuine passion for technology and an eagerness to learn and grow professionally.
* Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken).
* Proficiency with Linux, Git, Docker, and Docker-Compose.
* Experience with testing tools and modern CI/CD frameworks.

What Will Make You Stand Out (Bonus Points):

* Experience with Key-Value stores and in-memory databases (e.g. Redis, Memcached).
* Familiarity with cloud environments, particularly AWS.

Our Tech Stack

* Languages: NodeJS, Java, Bash, Python
* Databases: MySQL
* Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Jenkins, Docker
* Tools: Git, Jira, Notion

What We Offer

* Integrate a highly motivated, young and dynamic team
* Great compensation package
* Top location at the heart of Barcelona with a rooftop terrace, Barbecue, and a fully stocked fridge
* Great work-life balance: work from home (2 days per week), flexible hours
* Meal vouchers - Ticket Restaurant monthly allowance
* Monthly gym allowance: Choose between DiR and Wellhub
* LinkedIn Learning and training opportunities
* Monthly TGIF events
* Regular team-building events
* Fun and friendly work environment with talented marketers and engineers from over 40 countries
* And more!

If you want to know more about us visit our website , and for a sneak peek of the cool stuff we build check this video out! And, if you are ready to take your career to the next level and tackle engineering challenges at a global scale, we encourage you to apply!

Please note that we do NOT provide VISA sponsorship. Candidates without a legal permit to work in Spain won't be considered.

title: Junior Sales Manager
description:
PLAYERSBEST is a leading affiliate and lead generation company working within the iGaming and finance verticals. We build high-end websites with quality content that helps customers make informed decisions while driving relevant traffic through both organic and paid search channels. The role combines hands-on partner management, commercial operations, and structured mentorship, offering a clear path toward becoming an independent Sales Manager.

* Coordinate with internal departments to ensure partner requirements and commercial commitments are delivered.

What we're looking for

* Ability to build and maintain professional relationships.

title: Junior Customer Support Specialist
description:
At Regnology our greatest asset is our people. We value diversity and foster an inclusive environment that supports learning, safety, and growth. By investing in our team, listening to customers, and encouraging creativity, we drive continuous innovation and improvement.
We offer a flexible, innovative environment where your ideas matter and your career can thrive.
Regnology is a global leader in regulatory reporting, helping financial institutions, regulators, and tax authorities improve data quality, efficiency, and cost savings. Our mission: to safeguard financial markets through smarter, future-ready solutions.

---------------
About this role
---------------

If you have a background in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, we'll help you turn that foundation into real-world expertise.

You don't need to know every banking regulation or reporting standard before you join. From Basel, IFRS, capital adequacy, and FATCA to regulatory reporting and risk management, we'll teach you what you need to succeed through structured onboarding, hands-on learning, and the support of experienced colleagues. We believe the best way to learn is by doing, with the right guidance every step of the way.

From day one, you'll be paired with a dedicated buddy and become part of a genuinely international team, collaborating with colleagues and clients across multiple countries and time zones as part of our global "Follow the Sun" support model.

This is more than an entry-level role, it's the beginning of a long-term career. As your knowledge and confidence grow, you'll have a clear path from Junior Support Specialist to Support Specialist and beyond, with opportunities to develop both functional and technical expertise and shape your career in the direction that suits you best.

----------------
*What you'll do*
----------------

Learn & Support

* Learn our regulatory reporting and risk solutions and the banking/finance concepts behind them, supported by a structured training plan and a dedicated buddy.
* Handle first-level client questions and functional inquiries, escalating more complex issues to senior team members as you build your expertise.
* Help investigate discrepancies in regulatory calculations under guidance from experienced Support Specialists.

Grow into troubleshooting

* Gradually take on business rule and configuration troubleshooting as your product knowledge develops.
* Get hands-on exposure to technical basics relevant to support (e.g. reading logs, user access, simple SQL queries), with training provided.
* Collaborate with technical teams to see how functional and technical issue resolution come together.

Contribute & build experience

* Contribute to our internal knowledge base and client-facing documentation as a way of consolidating what you learn.
* Take part in cross-functional initiatives to improve support processes and product features.
* Once ramped up, join the rotation supporting our global "Follow the Sun" model (with full training and support before any on-call responsibility) — working alongside teams across different regions to keep our clients supported around the clock.

---------------------------
Why we should decide on you
---------------------------

* A degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field — recent graduates are very welcome to apply.
* No prior professional experience required; internships or academic projects touching finance, banking, or data are a plus but not a must.
* Genuine curiosity about banking, regulation, and risk — we'll teach you the rest.
* Strong analytical mindset with a good affinity for numbers and structured problem-solving.
* Comfortable with, or curious about, technical troubleshooting (logs, configurations, basic SQL) — training provided.
* Good communication skills in English (B2/C1), written and verbal.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; familiarity with ticketing systems is a plus, not a requirement.
* Comfortable working with colleagues and clients across different countries, cultures, and time zones as part of a global team.
* Willingness to grow into occasional on-call/weekend coverage over time, as part of a global rotation — not required from day one.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and its potential application in a business environment.

--------------
Key Attributes
--------------

* Curious and eager to learn, with a structured and analytical approach.
* Calm and dependable, even when picking up something new under time pressure.
* Client-focused and collaborative, with a service-oriented mindset.
* Proactive about asking questions and improving how things are done.

*Why you should decide on us*

* Let’s grow together, join our market leading SaaS company – our agile character and culture of innovation enables you to design our future.
* We provide you with the opportunity to take on responsibility and participate in international projects.
* In addition to our buddy-program, we offer numerous individual and wide-ranging training opportunities during which you can explore technical and functional areas.
* Our internal mobility initiative encourages colleagues to transfer cross functionally to gain experience and promotes knowledge sharing.
* We are proud of our positive working atmosphere characterized by a supportive team across different locations and countries and transparent communication across all levels.
* Together we're better - meet your colleagues at our numerous team events.

To get a first impression, we only need your CV and look forward to meeting you in a (personal/virtual) interview!
Recognizing the benefits of working in diverse teams, we are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of gender, age, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, and sexual identity.
Are you interested? Apply now!

Apply now!

title: (Junior) Campaign Manager (m/w/d) – remote
description:

Als Campaign Manager*in bist du das Herzstück unserer Kundenprojekte: Du verbindest kreatives Marketing, strategische Beratung und operative Exzellenz, um Top-Brands und Arbeitgeber perfekt auf unserer Plattform und Social Media zu inszenieren. Dabei bist du für folgende Themenschwerpunkte verantwortlich:

Du bist Teil eines Teams, das diesen Anspruch jeden Tag in die Praxis übersetzt.

Was du bei uns findest:

Remote-first: Arbeite von dort, wo du am produktivsten bist!

*

Ownership statt Mikromanagement: Kurze Wege zum Founder-Team, echte Entscheidungsbefugnis, kein Wasserkopf.

Beteiligung am Erfolg: Du wirst am Unternehmenserfolg von StudySmarter beteiligt (Shares).

Gesundheit: Firmenrabatt über EGYM Wellpass für dein Training.

Team & Kultur: Regelmäßige Teamevents und Ausflüge, ein diverses und ambitioniertes Team.

Modernes Büro in München: Hochwertige Ausstattung, Terrasse – falls du doch mal vor Ort sein möchtest.

Verpflegung: Frisches Obst, Säfte, Porridge-Bar und eine Getränke-Flatrate im Büro.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:

Ми в пошуках *UI/UX Designer* , який відповідатиме за створення зручних і візуально привабливих інтерфейсів для мобільних ігор, поєднуючи візуальний дизайн, проєктування користувацьких сценаріїв та розробку інтерфейсних рішень для покращення ігрового досвіду й досягнення продуктових цілей.

Ця роль бере участь у створенні ігрових екранів, мета-систем, внутрішньоігрових подій, механік монетизації та інших елементів користувацького шляху. Працює у тісній взаємодії з геймдизайнерами, художниками та розробниками для створення цілісного ігрового досвіду.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
--------
Overview
--------

Lynker is seeking a talented UI/UX Designer to support the NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (SWPC) to lead the user experience and overhaul the interface design for *spaceweather.gov*. The IDEAL UI/UX Designer will be able to work a Hybrid schedule, working 2 days per week in office in Boulder, CO, and working the remaining 3 days per week from home. This role focuses entirely on user experience design, research, visual communication, and design system management. You will bridge the gap between complex space science—geomagnetic storms, solar flares, radio blackouts—and accessible visual products used by aviation controllers, power grid operators, satellite technicians, and the general public. You will create production-ready UI designs, visual assets, wireframes, and design specs for our software engineering team to implement.

----------------
Responsibilities
----------------

*Duties of the UI/UX Designer will include the following:*

*UI/UX Design & Scientific Visualization*

* *Information Architecture:* Restructure navigation, user flows, and site hierarchy so diverse personas (from commercial airline dispatchers to casual skywatchers) can quickly find critical alerts and data.
* *Complex Data UI:* Design intuitive visual layouts, dashboards, maps, and chart interfaces for real-time space weather data (e.g., K-index scales, aurora oval predictions, solar image feeds).
* *Wireframing & Prototyping:* Build low-fidelity sketches, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive Figma prototypes to validate feature ideas before handing off to developers.

*User Research & Testing*

* *User Advocacy:* Conduct user interviews, surveys, and usability testing with critical stakeholders (power grid operators, pilots, emergency managers, researchers) to understand their operational workflows.
* *Iterative Design:* Use analytics, feedback loops, and usability findings to refine designs and eliminate friction in high-stress monitoring environments.

*Design System & Accessibility*

* *US Web Design System (USWDS):* Build and maintain a unified Figma component library based on the US Web Design System and NOAA brand standards.
* *Accessibility First (Section 508):* Design inclusive interfaces adhering to WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines, ensuring color choices, visual hierarchy, and graph concepts translate well for all users.
* *Developer Handoff:* Provide clean, pixel-perfect design specifications, redlines, asset exports, and interaction notes to software engineers.

--------------
Qualifications
--------------

*The UI/UX Designer selected should have the following:*

* *Experience:* 3+ years in UI/UX design, visual design, or product design.
* *Portfolio:* Demonstrates UI/UX projects, design systems, data visual mockups, and user research processes.
* *Design Tools:* Mastery of Figma (components, auto-layout, interactive prototyping) or equivalent tools (Adobe XD, Sketch, Illustrator).
* *Accessibility Knowledge:* Strong understanding of WCAG 2.1 AA standards for visual design (contrast ratios, readable typography, colorblind-friendly data palettes).
* *Communication:* Ability to articulate design decisions clearly to scientists, program managers, and engineering teams.

*The Ideal UI/UX Designer will have the following:*

* Background or experience designing visual UI for scientific, meteorological, geospatial, or complex data monitoring dashboards.
* Experience applying or adapting component-based design systems (especially USWDS).

*Key Deliverables (First 90 Days)*

* *UX Audit & Research:* Complete a visual and structural audit of *spaceweather.gov* key user paths and compile a research summary of user pain points.
* *Figma UI Library:* Establish a standardized Figma design library aligned with USWDS guidelines for all future web products.
* *High-Fidelity Prototypes:* Deliver fully spec’d UI designs and interactive prototypes for updated high-priority alerts and aurora forecasting pages ready for engineering handoff.

*About Lynker*

Lynker is a growing, employee owned business, specializing in professional, scientific and technical services. Our continually expanding team combines scientific expertise with mature, results-driven processes and tools to achieve technically sound, cost effective solutions in hydrology/water sciences, geospatial analysis, information technology, resource management, conservation, and management and business process improvement.

We focus on putting the right people in the right place to be effective. And having the right people is critical for success. Our streamlined organization enables and empowers our talented professionals to tackle our customers' scientific and technical priorities – creatively and effectively.

Lynker offers a team-oriented work environment, and the opportunity to work in a culture of exceptionally skilled professionals who embrace sound science and creative solutions. Lynker's benefits include the following:

* Comprehensive healthcare for the employee at no monthly cost
* Healthcare benefit covers medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision
* Personal Time Off (PTO) Policy plus paid holidays
* Highly competitive compensation plan regularly calibrated against industry and location benchmarks
* 401(k) retirement plan with company-matching
* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) – we're all company owners!
* Flexible spending accounts
* Employee assistance program (EAP)
* Short- and long-term disability insurance
* Life and accident insurance
* Tuition assistance/Training/Workforce improvement reimbursement per year
* Spot bonuses for exceptional performance
* Annual Employee Recognition Awards with bonuses
* Employee Referral Program
* Free centralized, self-directed Learning Management System to learn at your own pace
* Personalized career growth plans for every employee

*Lynker is an E-Verify employer.*

*Lynker is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local laws*.

title: UX Designer
description:
*Czym będziesz się zajmować?*

* Projektowanie doświadczeń użytkownika (UX) dla aplikacji webowych i mobilnych.
* Tworzenie makiet, wireframe'ów oraz interaktywnych prototypów nowych funkcjonalności.
* Opracowywanie i rozwój architektury informacji dla rozwiązań cyfrowych.
* Projektowanie interfejsów użytkownika zgodnie ze standardami UX/UI oraz identyfikacją wizualną organizacji.
* Przygotowywanie i utrzymywanie komponentów oraz bibliotek elementów w systemie projektowym (Digital Style Guide).
* Prowadzenie analiz potrzeb użytkowników oraz rekomendowanie usprawnień w kanałach cyfrowych.
* Realizacja badań użyteczności oraz analiza wyników testów i opinii użytkowników.
* Współpraca z analitykami, programistami i interesariuszami biznesowymi przy projektowaniu i wdrażaniu rozwiązań.
* Weryfikacja zgodności wdrażanych funkcjonalności z przygotowanymi makietami i założeniami projektowymi.
* Udział w testach aplikacji oraz wsparcie procesu odbioru rozwiązań.
* Dbanie o spójność doświadczeń użytkownika pomiędzy aplikacjami i kanałami cyfrowymi.
* Analiza trendów rynkowych, rozwiązań konkurencji oraz wdrażanie najlepszych praktyk UX/UI.
* Przygotowywanie materiałów graficznych wspierających rozwój i promocję aplikacji, w tym materiałów publikowanych w sklepach mobilnych.
* Realizacja w okresie październik - grudzień.

*Kogo poszukujemy?*

*Must Have:*

* Doświadczenie w projektowaniu UX/UI: Minimum 5 lata pracy przy aplikacjach webowych lub mobilnych.
* Znajomość narzędzi projektowych: Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD – tworzenie makiet hi-fidelity i prototypów.
* Design System i heurystyki Nielsena: Umiejętność stosowania zasad użyteczności i spójności w projektach.
* Badania z użytkownikami: Planowanie i prowadzenie testów użyteczności przed i po wdrożeniu funkcjonalności.
* Analiza danych ilościowych i jakościowych: Weryfikacja intuicyjności procesów, identyfikacja punktów rezygnacji.
* Współpraca z zespołem developerskim i testerami: Definiowanie scenariuszy testowych, kryteriów akceptacji.
* Znajomość zasad dostępności (WCAG): Projektowanie rozwiązań inkluzywnych.
* Język angielski

*Nice to Have:*

* Umiejętność pracy z narzędziami analitycznymi (np. Hotjar, Google Analytics) – analiza zachowań użytkowników.
* Znajomość podstaw front-endu (HTML, CSS) – lepsze zrozumienie ograniczeń implementacyjnych.
* Projektowanie mikrointerakcji i animacji – poprawa doświadczenia użytkownika.
* Znajomość metod Design Thinking – prowadzenie warsztatów z interesariuszami.
* Doświadczenie w projektowaniu aplikacji mobilnych oraz rozwijaniu Design Systemów.

*Czego wymagamy?*

3 lata doświadczenia na podobnym stanowisku
Znajomości:

* Figma
* UX design

Języki:

* Polski
* Angielski

*Jakie warunki i benefity otrzymasz?*

* 20.2k–26.9k PLN netto/m (B2B)
* B2B - Elastyczne godziny pracy (100%)
* Praca zdalna: W całości

*Kim jesteśmy?*
Firma apreel powstała w kwietniu 2010 roku. W miarę rozwoju firmy i równolegle ze wzrostem poziomu zaufania klientów, jej działalność poszerzyła się o usługi Outsourcingu Specjalistów IT. Dziś to właśnie ten obszar stanowi główny filar działalności apreel.

title: Senior UI Designer
description:
----------
*Overview*
----------

We're hiring a Senior UI Designer to own how the digital experiences we build look and feel.

You'll lead UI across websites, eCommerce platforms, and digital products, from first concept through launch. You'll build the design systems, component libraries, and tokens that let a family of brands ship on one foundation, and that a client's own team can extend long after launch. We're growing, and so is the work.

You'll turn brand, UX flows, and content into high-fidelity, build-ready design, desktop and mobile. You'll partner with UX, strategy, development, and marketing, and carry your design intent through build, QA, and launch.

Our Experience team sits at the heart of every build, and we're looking for a senior designer who can lead UI across projects, raise our standards, and help our design systems grow up alongside the work.

We've been building our own AI tools since 2024, and we want a designer who's glad to bring AI into the work, from early exploration through handoff.

This is a senior, client-facing role. Local or remote, with a soft spot for folks in New England or the wider Northeast so we can get in a room now and then. You'll report to our VP of Experience.

---------------
*About Anchour*
---------------

Anchour is a creative agency of 40+ people focused on building unforgettable brands and digital experiences that help businesses punch above their weight.

Headquartered in Maine, we partner with SMBs and growing brands across industries like consumer goods, nutrition, fitness, financial services, hospitality, and retail. Our work spans brand strategy, identity design, website design and development, content strategy, and full-service marketing.

We call ourselves Creative Pragmatists. Great work happens when smart people are trusted to do it, and we've built a place where talented people have real ownership, real influence over direction, and the room to do the best work of their careers.

----------------
*What You’ll Do*
----------------

* *Own UI from concept to launch.* Lead interface design across projects with limited oversight. Turn brand, UX flows, and content into high-fidelity, build-ready design, desktop and mobile, with WCAG 2.2 AA in from the first artboard. Whether the brand system is ours or supplied by another team, you make it work in product.
* *Build the design systems behind the work.* Component libraries, interaction patterns, and responsive behavior across breakpoints. Tiered systems: global components reused everywhere, domain-specific ones for commerce and healthcare, controlled specialized pieces for the edge cases. Every state, variant, and redline accounted for.
* *Define the design systems that hold it together.* Typography, color, spacing, and motion as documented design systems, so a client's internal team can extend the system long after launch and not break it.
* *Prototype to earn the yes.* Build high-fidelity prototypes that pressure-test the key flows and get stakeholders to sign off before development starts.
* *Hand off so engineers build it right.* Organized, documented Figma files and implementation-ready spec packages, including for partners building in AEM or Shopify. Partner with developers through build and QA so the finished site matches what you designed.
* *Lead the work.* Serve as the primary UI lead on your projects. Make confident calls grounded in user needs, business goals, accessibility, and what's buildable. Scope your design to the budget and the timeline, and catch risks before they turn into rework.
* *Raise our standards.* Contribute to our design systems, documentation, and reviews. Share what you know with the Experience and Creative teams, and help shape how we design and deliver.
* *Put AI to work.* Use our AI tools across your workflow, from early exploration to documentation to QA, and help the team build fluency over time.

-----------------------
*What We’d Like To See*
-----------------------

* *5+ years of UI, product, or digital design, with a heavy emphasis on website design.* A strong portfolio of high-quality website interface systems and shipped work is key – show us you can design a website. Agency experience strongly preferred.
* *Craft fundamentals.* Typography, color, layout, hierarchy, and motion. You know how to make a website's interface feel inevitable.
* *Systems thinking.* You've built website design systems and component libraries that other people can pick up and extend. You design for the whole product.
* *Accessibility in your bones.* A strong grasp of usability and WCAG 2.2 AA, baked into how you work.
* *Figma expertise.* Fluent in Figma and collaborative design workflows. Comfortable working alongside developers through build and QA, with a solid understanding of front-end fundamentals. eCommerce (Shopify) experience is a plus, and so is designing for headless or enterprise CMS handoffs.
* *Ownership.* You scope to budget, juggle several projects at once, communicate early, and own the outcome.
* *A low-ego, curious teammate.* Collaborative, invested in making the work and the team better, and glad to bring AI into how you design.
* *Northeast-based, ideally.* We're a Maine company and we love getting our people in the same room, so New England or the wider Northeast is a big plus. And we want to hear from a real person, in your own words.

------------
*Work Style*
------------

* *You own your projects.* UI runs through you, and it's better for it.
* *You communicate before you're asked.* You get status, risks, and decisions to the team early.
* *You partner across the room.* UX, copy, dev, and marketing all come out stronger.
* *You design for the build.* You know how your choices land in development, and you plan for it.
* *You sweat the details.* Usability, beauty, accessibility, and polish aren't optional.
* *You take the work seriously.* Not yourself.

-----------------
*What You’ll Get*
-----------------

* *Competitive Salary.* We pay well for great work.
* *Flexible Work.* Hybrid out of Maine when you're nearby, remote when you're not, with time together in New England when it counts.
* *Retirement.* Savings plan with a 4% company match.
* *Premium Insurance.* Premium health, dental, vision, and life insurance with generous coverage for our US-based team members.
* *Optional HSA.* An optional health savings account to set aside money on a pre-tax basis for medical expenses.
* *Home Office Setup.* A laptop plus 50% reimbursement for home office equipment.
* *Paid & Flexible Holidays.* 12 paid holidays throughout the year, including three flexible holidays.
* *Paid Time Off.* Minimum three weeks of paid time off per year.
* *Paid Leaves.* Paid parental, medical, bereavement, and other types of leave.
* *Flexible & Summer Fridays.* Half-day Fridays throughout the summer, and a get-it-done-and-go mindset year-round.
* *Lifelong Learners Fund.* Cash for professional development like books, conferences, and courses, plus team bonding fun.
* *Baby Bonding Bucks.* A $500 bonus to cover diapers, meals, and other expenses for any employee welcoming a new child.

As a freelance packaging designer, you will transform creative ideas into compelling packaging concepts using a combination of design expertise and AI-powered creative tools. You will work on early-stage label designs, packaging variations, flavor extensions, and limited-edition concepts for consumer beverage products. Collaborating with key stakeholders, you will help accelerate the creative process by generating visual ideas quickly and adapting them to feedback. Your work will support strategic discussions, product innovation, and faster decision-making before designs move into final production. title: Graphic Designer
description:
About the Company
-----------------

You will join a serial entrepreneur-backed venture at an early and exciting stage of its development. With an international setup and a rapidly expanding geographic footprint, the Company is developing an ambitious vision for a new-generation entertainment platform combining gaming, social media, entertainment, and culture.

The venture builds on the founder’s knowledge, experience, and international network, with the ambition to rethink how the next generation discovers, creates, engages with, and experiences entertainment. Artificial intelligence (AI) and technology are expected to play an important role in enabling new products, experiences, and business models across these rapidly evolving consumer and creative ecosystems.

While the leadership team already brings together high-profile and experienced executives, you will join a genuine 0-to-1 entrepreneurial environment. The organization remains lean, fast-moving, international, and highly hands-on. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys building rather than maintaining - comfortable with ambiguity, energized by rapid growth, and excited to contribute to an ambitious international venture from its earliest stages.

About the Role
--------------

This is a 3-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of extension. Create a distinctive and consistent visual language across brand, marketing, social media, live events, campaigns and selected in-product content. You will turn ideas, stories and event moments into clear, energetic visual assets that work across formats and channels. This is primarily a graphic design role rather than a product or UX design position, although you will collaborate closely with product designers and engineers.

What You Will Do
----------------

* Brand Design: Apply and evolve the brand's visual identity across typography, colour, imagery, illustration, layout and graphic systems.
* Campaigns & Launches: Create key visuals and campaign assets for product launches, partnerships, sports, entertainment and cultural events.
* Social & Content: Produce adaptable graphics for social platforms, communities, editorial content, announcements and promotional activity.
* Live-Event Assets: Design event graphics, schedules, score or status cards, digital signage, overlays, presentation assets and rapid-turnaround live content.
* Product Graphics: Create badges, rewards, game assets, promotional modules, empty-state illustrations and other visual content used within the product.
* Motion & Multimedia: Develop lightweight motion graphics, animated social assets and video treatments when appropriate.
* Design Systems: Build reusable templates and asset libraries that allow teams to create consistent work quickly without reducing quality.
* Production Delivery: Prepare accurate, optimized files for web, mobile, social, print and display formats, including responsive variants and localization-ready layouts.
* Collaboration: Work with brand, marketing, product, game design, content, partnerships and engineering to translate briefs into effective visual outcomes.
* AI-Assisted Design: Use generative and AI-assisted tools responsibly for exploration, production and iteration while maintaining originality, consistency and human creative judgment.

Who We’re Looking For
---------------------

* Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating visual identity, campaigns, digital content and high-quality production across multiple formats.
* Graphic Design Fundamentals: Excellent typography, composition, colour, hierarchy, image treatment and attention to detail.
* Digital Fluency: Understands how designs behave across mobile screens, responsive web, social platforms and live digital environments.
* Tools: Strong working knowledge of Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud or equivalent professional design tools.
* Versatility: Can move between bold campaign work, structured information design, fast social assets and precise production tasks.
* Execution: Can take work from an ambiguous brief through concepts, feedback, final artwork and organized handoff.
* Communication: Presents ideas clearly, receives feedback constructively and collaborates effectively with both creative and technical colleagues.
* Delivery Judgment: Manages priorities and deadlines calmly while protecting brand consistency and production quality.

Nice to Have
------------

* Experience with sports, entertainment, gaming, social platforms, festivals or live events.
* Motion design skills using After Effects, Premiere, Rive or similar tools.
* Illustration, icon design, 3D, photo direction, retouching or video-editing capability.
* Experience creating design templates for distributed marketing or content teams.
* Awareness of accessibility, localization and performance constraints for digital assets.
* Experience using generative-image, video or design tools within a controlled commercial workflow.

What You’ll Gain
----------------

* Help define the visual character of an ambitious global social entertainment platform.
* Create work spanning product, campaigns, communities, live media and real-world events.
* Collaborate directly with product, game design, marketing, partnerships and engineering.
* Build a reusable visual system that grows with the Vibrez Universe brand and community.

Ready to create with us?
------------------------

Submit your application with a CV and portfolio showing relevant brand, campaign and digital work. Please explain your personal contribution to selected projects, the brief and constraints, and how the final design performed or was used.

description:

--------

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
----------

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.

We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on ourYouTube Channel orBlog Posts *Role Overview*

HighLevel is a powerful platform containing hundreds of interconnected capabilities across CRM, marketing, communications, automation, commerce, websites, calendars, reporting, and AI. That breadth creates enormous value - but it also introduces complexity. Users should not need to know which menu contains a capability, how every object in HighLevel is modelled, or which sequence of screens is required to complete a business task. They should be able to describe what they want to accomplish, receive an accurate answer, and safely complete the work.

Ask AI is the natural-language operating layer designed to make that possible. It allows agencies and businesses to ask questions, understand customer and operational data, generate content and assets, create product configurations, invoke specialised agents, execute supported actions, automate recurring work, and interact with HighLevel through text, voice, structured artefacts, and guided workflows.

For Ask AI to be dependable, it needs accurate and current context. HighLevel Knowledge Bases provide the shared intelligence foundation for Ask AI and the broader AI Employee ecosystem. They ingest and organise information from websites, FAQs, rich text, documents, tables, cloud files, and other approved sources so AI products can retrieve relevant information and produce grounded responses.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to own the long-term product strategy for this intelligence and assistance platform. This person will define the architecture, product principles, quality systems, developer model, governance, metrics, and commercial strategy required to make Ask AI the default way users understand and operate HighLevel.

This is not a generic chatbot, enterprise-search, or content-generation role. It is a senior individual-contributor product leadership role at the intersection of AI assistants, enterprise knowledge, retrieval systems, agent orchestration, workflow execution, CRM data, permissions, automation, developer platforms, and multi-tenant SaaS. You will influence multiple product and engineering teams, establish shared platform standards, and make foundational decisions that affect every AI product across HighLevel.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Define and drive the long-term product vision, strategy, roadmap, and platform architecture for HighLevel Knowledge Bases and Ask AI.
* Own the complete Ask AI experience, including chat, voice interaction, conversation history, memory, templates, artefacts, scheduled tasks, tools, actions, agent routing, browser interaction, feedback, permissions, approvals, auditability, usage, and lifecycle management.
* Own the Knowledge Base platform across source ingestion, extraction, parsing, chunking, embeddings, indexing, metadata, retrieval, re-ranking, citations, freshness, versioning, testing, permissions, and observability.
* Establish the product principles that determine how Ask AI answers questions, requests more information, retrieves knowledge, generates a plan, selects a tool, invokes an agent, asks for approval, executes an action, handles failure, and communicates results.
* Create a shared context model spanning user identity, agency, location, role, permissions, current interface, business profile, Brand Voice, memory, Knowledge Bases, CRM data, product configuration, and previous tool outputs.
* Develop a deep understanding of agency owners, marketers, sales teams, customer-service teams, operations leaders, administrators, and SMB employees who use HighLevel to perform daily work.
* Personally inspect Ask AI conversations, tool traces, Knowledge Base retrieval results, user feedback, support tickets, source-ingestion failures, incorrect answers, failed actions, and downstream customer outcomes.
* Partner closely with AI and engineering leadership on LLM orchestration, model routing, context management, prompt systems, tool invocation, agent planning, memory, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, caching, latency, evaluation, observability, and cost.
* Partner with platform and infrastructure teams on ingestion pipelines, crawlers, document processing, vector storage, structured-data retrieval, indexing, refresh jobs, multi-tenant isolation, scalability, reliability, and data retention.
* Define an evaluation architecture covering Ask AI responses, Knowledge Base retrieval, memory usage, tool selection, action accuracy, permissions, artefacts, latency, and cost.
* Build representative test datasets from real agency and SMB use cases across industries, account types, languages, data structures, and product workflows.
* Partner with HighLevel product teams to expose their capabilities safely through Ask AI using shared action, permission, approval, error, and result contracts.
* Establish a scalable onboarding model for product teams that want to contribute Ask AI actions, templates, skills, artefacts, or specialised agents.
* Advance integration between Ask AI and Agent Studio so custom agents can be discovered, selected, invoked, monitored, and improved from a unified Ask AI experience.
* Define the platform model for MCP tools, native product actions, external APIs, web search, browser execution, Knowledge Base retrieval, and other agent capabilities.
* Build robust observability and debugging experiences that show selected context, retrieved sources, model outputs, plans, tools, inputs, permissions, approvals, action results, errors, latency, and usage.
* Improve Knowledge Base quality-management workflows, including retrieval testing, source inspection, stale-content detection, crawl diagnostics, document-processing errors, conflict detection, and customer-facing recommendations.
* Define the architecture for reusable, inherited, bundled, and marketplace-distributed Knowledge Bases across agencies and locations.
* Partner with Design to simplify Knowledge Base creation, source addition, testing, maintenance, agent attachment, Ask AI onboarding, template discovery, approval flows, artefact interaction, and error recovery.
* Develop a coherent experience across Ask AI templates, open-ended prompting, guided questions, native skills, specialised agents, and scheduled tasks.

title: Physical Security Lead
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is hiring its first dedicated Physical Security Lead to build and run the program that protects our people, our leaders, our events, and our offices. Our footprint now spans a multi-floor New York headquarters, Ramp-managed offices, and a growing set of hubs across North America and Europe. Our leaders are increasingly visible on public stages.

You'll own three areas in roughly equal measure: executive protection, event security, and office security (access control, cameras, guards, and building security). Your job is to turn a set of strong vendors and partner teams into one measurable, risk-based program.

This is a high-ownership IC role on the Corporate Security team. It reports to the Director of IT & Corporate Security and is based at our NYC HQ. This is a physical security role; cybersecurity and information security are owned by other Ramp security teams. We aren't looking for a guard supervisor or a box-checker. We want someone who makes it safe for Ramp to move fast, host great events, and keep our leaders accessible.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build and run Ramp's executive protection program:

- Protective risk assessments and residential security reviews.

- Domestic and international travel security.

- Advance work for high-visibility appearances.

- Selecting, standing up, and managing our executive protection provider.

- Turn threat intelligence into protective action. Partner with Detection & Response to move from online threat and exposure monitoring to threat assessments, personal-information exposure reduction, and clear escalation playbooks.

- Own security for internal and external events, from all-hands and offsites to conferences, customer events, and executive dinners:

- Risk-tiered intake and written security plans.

- Coordination with venues and vendors.

- On-site leadership for the highest-risk events.

- After-action reviews.

- Set Ramp's global physical security standards for access control, video surveillance, intercoms, visitor management, and alarm monitoring. Tier them for headquarters, Ramp-managed offices, and flexible or serviced hub spaces.

- Build security into every new office, move, and expansion:

- Write the security design requirements and review drawings.

- Manage integrators through installation and acceptance testing.

- Partner with IT on network and identity integration.

- Manage the guard program and security vendors end to end: scope, post orders, SLAs and KPIs, budget, and quarterly business reviews. Own the security relationship with landlords and building management.

- Lead emergency preparedness and physical incident response:

- Emergency notifications, evacuation and shelter-in-place plans, and drills.

- Liaison with local law enforcement.

- Workplace-violence prevention, in partnership with People and Legal.

- Run physical access governance with IT. Tie access to joiner/mover/leaver events, run regular access reviews, and keep audit-ready evidence for physical security controls.

- Measure and report program health to leadership. Use AI and automation to scale the program without scaling headcount.

WHAT YOU NEED

- 6+ years in corporate or physical security, including 3+ years owning a security program or major workstream at a multi-site company. Executing someone else's program doesn't count toward this.

- Hands-on depth in at least two of the three areas (executive protection, event security, physical security systems such as access control and cameras) and solid working knowledge of the third.

- Experience administering or deploying enterprise access control and video platforms (e.g., Avigilon Alta/Openpath, Verkada, Genetec, LenelS2), and partnering with IT on networking and SSO.

- A track record of managing security vendors (guard, protection, integrator, event staffing) through contracts, SLAs, budgets, and performance reviews.

- Strong risk judgment. You size controls to the actual threat, explain the tradeoffs, and lead with "here's how we do this safely" rather than "no."

- Excellent writing. You can produce a crisp SOP, an event security plan, and a one-page executive brief.

- Willingness to work from our NYC office 4 days a week, travel 10–15%, support occasional evening and weekend events, and serve as primary on-call for physical security incidents (with the Director as backup and guard and vendor partners as on-site first response).

- Real, day-to-day use of AI tools in your work.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- ASIS CPP or PSP; formal executive protection training; first aid or Stop the Bleed certification.

- Experience at a high-growth tech, fintech, or financial services company with a high-profile founder or CEO.

- Experience writing security design standards for office buildouts and reading architectural or low-voltage drawings.

- Familiarity with physical and environmental control requirements in SOC 2, PCI DSS, or FedRAMP.

- A government protective, law enforcement, or military background, combined with corporate program ownership.

- An established network of protection, event security, and integrator vendors in NYC, SF, and internationally.

FAIR WARNING

- This is a builder role. Parts of the program exist today (vendors, a responsibility matrix, some SOPs). You'll turn them into a system.

- You're an IC who directs vendors and partner teams, not a manager of a security staff. You'll need to influence Workplace, Events, IT, Executive Assistants, People, and Legal without formal authority.

- Security at Ramp enables the business. Events still happen, offices stay welcoming, and executives stay accessible. Your job is to make that safe.

- Evenings, weekends, and travel come with the territory, especially around major events.

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual membership

- 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

- Pet insurance

- In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

- Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

CANADA

- Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

- Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

- Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

- Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

- Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

UNITED KINGDOM

- Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

- Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

- Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Growth
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Growth Engineering at Airwallex is building an AI-native platform that powers customer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion. We're developing scalable infrastructure, intelligent decision systems, and automation capabilities that connect product, sales, and marketing to drive measurable business outcomes.

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll play a critical role in defining the technical architecture and building the foundational systems that power Growth at scale.

- Drive technical strategy and architecture for critical Growth Engineering platforms, influencing engineering decisions across multiple teams and leading complex initiatives from design through production.

- Build scalable backend infrastructure, including high-performance APIs, distributed services, event-driven architectures, and real-time data processing systems that power growth automation and intelligent decision-making.

- Develop AI-native platform capabilities that transform customer signals, product usage, lifecycle events, and business context into personalized experiences, next-best actions, and automated workflows.

- Design for reliability and scale, establishing strong foundations for performance, fault tolerance, observability, security, and operational excellence.

- Translate ambiguous business challenges into technical solutions, partnering with Product, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, and engineering teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

- Elevate engineering excellence through architectural leadership, technical mentorship, thoughtful design reviews, and hands-on contributions to complex engineering problems.

US: You'll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

ESSENTIALS

About the role

As Finance Manager, UAE, you’ll take full ownership of finance for our UAE entity and act as Airwallex’s primary finance contact with the Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE). You’ll make sure our UAE financial reporting, prudential, and regulatory obligations are met accurately and on time, and you’ll be the person the regulator turns to on all financial reporting matters.

You’ll join the EMEA Finance team and work closely with Compliance, Treasury, Tax, FP&A, and local management. This is a role for someone who wants to build: our UAE operating model and reporting cadence are still maturing, so you’ll shape how finance runs in the market from the ground up.

What you’ll do

- Act as the designated finance contact with the CBUAE for all financial and prudential reporting, including regulatory returns, ad hoc information requests, and supervisory meetings.

- Own the preparation, review, and submission of CBUAE regulatory returns, working with Compliance on interpretation and the regulatory calendar.

- Monitor and report on regulatory capital, liquidity, and safeguarding of client funds, flagging risks early and recommending action.

- Own the monthly close and financial control procedures for the UAE entity, including journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and P&L reviews before submission to FP&A.

- Prepare financial performance, capital, and cash commentary for local board packs and management reporting.

- Lead the annual statutory audit under IFRS and liaise with external auditors and advisors to resolve issues.

- Oversee UAE Corporate Tax and VAT compliance with our Tax team and external advisors.

- Support new product launches in the UAE by making sure they’re reflected correctly in our reporting structure and regulatory submissions.

- Drive process improvement and automation across UAE finance, and collaborate with the wider Controllership team on department-wide projects.

- Responsibilities of the role may develop over time.

What you bring

- A professional finance or accounting qualification such as CPA, ACCA, CA, CFA, or equivalent.

- 8+ years of finance experience, including senior-level experience in a finance function, ideally within financial services, payments, or another regulated environment. Big Four experience is advantageous.

- Strong working knowledge of IFRS, regulatory capital requirements, and prudential reporting obligations for payment service providers in the UAE.

- Direct experience engaging with a financial regulator, ideally the CBUAE.

- Experience in a financial controlling role, with a track record of building and expanding finance capabilities in a growing organisation.

- Clear, confident communication with stakeholders at every level, including regulators, auditors, and boards.

- Comfort working independently and navigating ambiguity in a hyper-growth environment.

Regulatory requirements

Because this role is a regulated position, the successful candidate must meet the CBUAE’s Fit and Proper criteria, and any offer will be subject to regulatory approval. You’ll need to:

- Hold a clean regulatory and criminal record, with no past disciplinary action, dismissal for cause, or adverse findings by any financial regulator.

- Have no history of fraud, dishonesty, or material misrepresentation.

- Be financially sound: not an undischarged bankrupt, not subject to any insolvency proceedings, and with no outstanding unsatisfied judgments.

- Be resident in the UAE and able to dedicate sufficient time to the role, with a meaningful on-the-ground presence.

- Disclose any other directorships or roles you hold, so the CBUAE can confirm you have the bandwidth for this position.

The CBUAE will conduct background checks and may request references from previous regulators.
