title: Senior Creative Project Manager - Brand
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Creative Production studio team sits squarely within our Brand function working alongside our Brand Foundations team. You will report directly to the Director of Brand Strategy & Experience and join a tight-knit, highly experienced group of project management leads and producers.

In this role, you will lead our internal Creative Production studio team, the execution engine delivering all branded assets across Pleo, including campaign and performance assets, global adaptation and localization, event branding, content marketing, web, socials and lifecycle design. You will balance hands-on delivery with direct people management for a team of three in-house designers and copywriter, ensuring our creative output remains fast, scalable, and sharp across all touchpoints.

WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

Our Brand department is 13 people across two teams: Brand Foundations and Creative Production. You'll lead the four-person Creative Production studio, a senior copywriter, two senior designers and a motion designer, spread across our European offices. Day to day, you'll work alongside a peer project lead on Brand Foundations, a brand strategist, our producers, and internal partners in Events, Lifecycle, Performance Marketing, HR/People Ops and Legal, plus our media agency. Most of the studio's clients are internal teams across Pleo.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Senior Creative Project Manager, you will:

Creative Production & Operations

- Studio Ownership: Lead end-to-end execution across all creative production studio work streams, ensuring projects hit quality benchmarks, deadlines, and brand standards. This is also not just intake of brand requests but also spotting opportunities proactively for brand involvement and governance across the business.

- Project Management: Own intake of BAU requests, filtering and assigning work while acting as the bridge between requestors and the studio team. Define scope upfront and ensure the team has what it needs to execute. Contribute to project plans for integrated campaigns and large events and manage Creative studio kick-offs, status reporting, and timeline and milestone tracking.

- Core Output Focus: Oversee production for high-performing marketing assets, market localization and adaptations, event branding, and content marketing.

- Process & Integration: Partner closely with peer project leads, producers, and the Brand Foundations team to streamline intake briefs, cross-team handoffs, and resource sharing.

- Global Asset Delivery: Manage asset adaptation frameworks to keep our brand consistent across different regions and channels.

- Capacity Planning: Own and manage resourcing across internal teams and freelance support, balancing capacity against demand and prioritizing against business needs when demands compete.

- External agency partnerships: Serve as the lead creative point of contact for asset production with our media agency. Manage sprint-style monthly asset delivery in response to agency and internal performance team briefs, keeping output aligned with the media plan. Review final creative placements across Meta and LinkedIn to ensure assets display correctly on paid channels.

People Management & Leadership

- Direct Management: Line manage, mentor, and foster career growth for a cross-functional team of three  in-house designers and one copywriter overseeing their daily priorities and bandwidth.

Stakeholder Alignment & Strategy

- Cross-Functional Partner: Serve as the strategic operational bridge connecting the studio with Marketing, Events, HR/People Ops, and Legal.

- Leadership Alignment: Work closely with the Director of Brand Strategy & Experience and Associate Director of Brand Management to align studio output with broader brand goals and business priorities.

We launched our new brand in September, so this is a moment to build. The studio has the basics in place, but intake, briefing, project tracking and resourcing are still early. You'll set the ways of working that the studio runs on, and we'd love you to bring AI into how we plan, brief and produce.

WHAT YOU BRING

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

- In-House Brand Experience: Minimum 5-7 years of work experience. Solid background working in-house in a fast-paced brand function (tech, scale-up, or high-growth environment).

- People Leadership: Direct experience line-managing creative talent (designers/artworkers) based remotely in different offices in Europe with an empathetic, growth-oriented approach.

- Production Scope: Broad familiarity managing workflows across digital performance, multi-market localization, physical/virtual events, AI creative production, and employer branding.

- Culture Driver: Thrives in a peer environment working alongside other motivated and constructive senior PMs, producers, creatives, and strategists.

- Operational Skills: Mastery of modern project management tooling and AI-powered workflows (e.g. Asana, Notion, Jira, Slack).

- Project Management Experience: Strong hands-on project management experience in a fast-paced, delivery-focused environment, running multiple projects concurrently. Comfortable not just initiating projects, but staying a consistent presence throughout: managing delivery, and reassessing priorities and capacity as needs shift.

WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You love day-to-day production and get a kick out of turning an event brief into finished collateral within a week.

- You want to build how a studio works, from intake to resourcing, as much as you want to ship the work.

- You enjoy leading creatives, giving them clear briefs and keeping the work grounded in what the business needs.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You mainly want to work on big brand campaigns. We run around two a year, and they're produced with an external agency. The studio adapts those assets, but most of the work is events, performance creative and BAU requests.

- You prefer a predictable, planned workload. Last-minute requests are part of life on Brand.

- You haven't line-managed people yet. Direct people management of the studio team is a core part of this role.

HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

- Deliver the studio's day-to-day work to our speed and quality standards, in line with the new brand guidelines.

- Set best practice for how the studio takes in, briefs, tracks and resources work.

- Improve how we estimate and plan capacity, using AI where it makes sense.

THE LOCATION

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

- Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

- Hiring manager interview: A conversation with the Director about the projects you've delivered, the teams you've led and the kind of production work you enjoy most.

- Case study: You'll walk us through how you'd approach a creative production task. You'll present to the Director and a peer project lead, and possibly a member of the studio team.

- Final stage: Team-fit chat with one or two people from the studio

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired this role, we received an incredibly high volume of applications but only so many could be taken forward. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

- CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

- Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

- Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

description:

In this role, you will be the lead technical architect responsible for defining and driving our technical strategy for abuse prevention, detection, and response across the entire Snowflake ecosystem.

- Partner directly with product and engineering teams building Snowflake's newest and highest-risk surfaces (Snowpark user code execution runtimes, Data Sharing and Marketplace, AI/LLM services) to design and deploy robust anti-abuse controls from day one

- Architect and scale high-throughput, low-latency telemetry pipelines and risk-scoring engines capable of analyzing millions of queries, sessions, and data transactions across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP)

- Continuously model emerging abuse techniques, including trial compute abuse, cryptocurrency mining, bot-driven account creation, credential stuffing, and illicit network traffic routing

- Design intelligent mitigation systems that automatically throttle, challenge, or isolate abusive workloads and malicious actors with near-zero false-positive impact on legitimate enterprise workloads

- Raise the technical bar across the engineering organization through mentorship of staff and senior engineers, and influence architectural standards across adjacent platform teams

OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER, ANTI-ABUSE WILL HAVE:

- 12+ years of software engineering experience in distributed systems, cloud platform infrastructure, or security engineering, with significant time dedicated to anti-abuse, fraud detection, platform trust, or threat mitigation

- Proven track record architecting mission-critical, large-scale distributed services in Java, C++, or Python

- Deep experience designing controls for code-execution runtimes, multi-tenant compute environments, cloud APIs, or data platforms (e.g., mitigating compute hijacking, sandbox escapes, abuse of serverless functions, or network egress abuse)

- Demonstrated ability to build streaming event processing, anomaly detection, behavioral heuristic engines, or graph-based syndicate detection systems at enterprise scale

- Strong intuition for attacker economics and mechanics, with experience modeling threat vectors across account lifecycles (signup, trial, payment, execution, sharing)

- Exceptional ability to partner with product managers, infrastructure teams, and security researchers to embed safety controls into high-velocity product roadmaps

- Experience building anti-abuse systems for multi-tenant cloud platforms or SaaS-at-scale environments

- Familiarity with AI/LLM abuse vectors (prompt injection, model extraction, automated content generation for fraud)

- Track record of designing zero-trust or defense-in-depth architectures for compute runtimes

- Published research or industry contributions in fraud detection, adversarial ML, or platform trust and safety

- Experience operating detection and response systems across multiple cloud providers simultaneously

WHY JOIN OUR ANTI-ABUSE TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

The Anti-Abuse team works at the intersection of platform security, distributed systems, and adversarial thinking. You will own the technical strategy for protecting one of the world's fastest-growing cloud platforms from novel and evolving threats. title: Junior Product Designer
description:
is the world’s largest loyalty platform, providing easy-to-use reward programs that help scaling ecommerce brands transform one-time sales into repeat purchases from loyal customers. Over 100,000 brands use Smile to turn transactional purchases into passionate repeat shoppers.

We are looking for a Junior Product Designer at Smile, to help create thoughtful, intuitive experiences for merchants and their customers while building your skills across the full product design process. You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, and other designers to turn ideas and user needs into polished product experiences, with plenty of support, feedback, and opportunities to take on more ownership as you grow.

*This is a full-time remote role working Monday - Friday with a need for your schedule to overlap significantly with existing team hours (9 AM - 3 PM EST).*

*At this time, only applicants based in Canada will be considered.*

🌍 About the Design Team
-----------------------

Our design team is collaborative, curious, and focused on creating thoughtful experiences that make a real impact for merchants and their customers. Designers here don't just hand off mockups and wait to see what ships. We work closely with product and engineering, but you don't need permission to make the product better. With AI and modern tooling, if you spot a part of the experience that isn't good enough, you're encouraged to own it end to end: find the problem, shape the fix, prototype it, and, if you're up for it, push it to production yourself.

You’ll also get the chance to work on a product used by thousands of merchants and millions of shoppers worldwide, while being part of a flexible, remote-first team that values collaboration and continuous growth.

We want to cultivate designers who take initiative, and we'll back you when you do. We value strong craft, clear communication, openness to feedback, and a willingness to keep learning. As a growing team, there are lots of opportunities to build your skills, take on more ownership over time, and contribute to how design evolves at Smile.

🛠 What you’ll Work on
---------------------

* Support the end-to-end design process for product features, from early concepts and user flows through prototypes and final visual design
* Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and designers to turn user needs and business goals into thoughtful product experiences
* Contribute to Smile’s design system by creating, refining, and maintaining reusable components and patterns
* Support design needs across the business when needed, including our website, social media, sales materials, and other marketing initiatives
* Use AI tools throughout your design process, including turning designs into working prototypes that help engineers implement faster and closer to the intended experience

👋 What We’re Looking For
------------------------

* You don't need years of experience. Internships, freelance work, and personal projects all count. What matters most is your eye for craft, how you think, and that you're eager to learn and grow
* You have projects you can share: a website, a Figma file, a live project. Personal and side projects count just as much as client work. One great project that shows how you approach design is more than enough, and bonus points if it shows how you used AI along the way
* You're comfortable working in Figma, with a strong foundation in visual design, layout, typography, and UX principles. If you're exploring newer tools like Paper, Pencil, or Elyx, we're all for it
* You're already using AI in your design work or side projects, and you're excited to explore how it can improve the way we work at Smile
* You enjoy collaborating with others, asking questions, receiving feedback, and iterating on your work
* You’re curious, organized, and excited to continue developing your product thinking and design skills

✅ You'll Be Successful In This Role If You
------------------------------------------

* You take initiative. When you see something in the product that could be better, you go after it
* You approach design problems with curiosity and take the time to understand the user before jumping to a solution
* You communicate your thinking clearly and are comfortable sharing work in progress with teammates
* You’re open to feedback and use it to make your work stronger
* You balance attention to detail with the ability to move work forward and iterate.
* You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and are comfortable asking for support when you need it

⭐ Nice to Have (But Not Required)
---------------------------------

* Experience designing for SaaS, e-commerce, or other digital products
* Experience working within or contributing to a design system
* An interest in motion design, prototyping, or creating delightful product interactions
* Experience working on a remote or distributed team
* Some comfort with front-end code, or experience building with AI coding tools

🤝 You'll Enjoy Working With Us If You
-------------------------------------

* Are open to trying new things, being wrong, and learning from mistakes
* Prefer collaboration and shared success over individual heroics
* Want to move fast, deliver real value, and own the progress of your work
* Look for opportunities to improve how work gets done - for yourself and others

💰 Compensation & Benefits
-------------------------

* *Base Salary:* $85,000 - $95,000 CAD
* In addition, our generous total rewards package includes things like flexible vacation, a remote work allowance, and a monthly credit to use at any of the store 100,000+ stores that uses our software.
* Check out our careers page to learn more.

💛 Why Smile?
------------

Smile is a remote-first company built on trust, ownership, and continuous improvement. We believe great work happens when people feel supported, challenged, and empowered to do their best work.

You can learn more about our culture, values, and benefits on our careers page.

Our Commitment to Candidates:
At Smile, we understand that finding a new role is challenging and that self-doubt or imposter syndrome can prevent you from applying to a role, don’t let it! You have a ton to offer and we want you to feel encouraged to apply, even if you don’t check all of the boxes. If you are passionate about eCommerce and helping merchants grow through loyalty and reward, connect with us.
At Smile, we rely on a range of backgrounds, experiences, and ideas. We value diversity, and we’re proud to be an inclusive, equal opportunity workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Smile welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. title: Junior AI Motion Designer
description:
Привіт! Шукаємо *Junior AI Motion Designer* — людину, яка створюватиме AI-креативи для Meta Ads і допоможе кратно масштабувати наш продакшн без втрати якості.

*Universe* — ко-фаундингова IT-компанія, що вже понад 8 років створює tech-бізнеси та виводить їх на глобальний рівень.

Одна з наших команд розвиває цифровий продукт у сфері спорту з амбіцією стати брендом №1 для атлетів. Він допомагає людям ефективніше досягати спортивних цілей, і ним уже користуються сотні тисяч користувачів.

Ми плануємо кратно наростити кількість AI-креативів для Meta Ads, не знижуючи планку реалістичності та якості. Тому посилюємо продакшн одразу двома Junior AI Motion Designers, які зможуть стабільно створювати креативні паки й розвиватися разом із нашим AI-first підходом.

----------------------------------------
*Що буде у твоїй зоні відповідальності?*
----------------------------------------

• Створювати AI-відео та зображення через нашу внутрішню платформу, використовуючи Seedance, Kling, Nano Banana та інші актуальні моделі.

• Перетворювати сценарії від креативних маркетологів на сцени й точні промпти, зберігаючи консистентність персонажів у різних кадрах.

• Збирати готові performance-креативи в After Effects: працювати з динамікою, субтитрами, музикою, саунд-дизайном, safe zones і дисклеймерами.

• Доводити креативи до потрібного рівня якості через ітерації та правки, знаходячи баланс між реалістичністю, швидкістю й вартістю генерацій.

• Тестувати нові AI-моделі та інструменти одразу після їхнього виходу й оцінювати, як вони можуть покращити продакшн.

• Оптимізувати власний робочий процес: перевикористовувати паспорти персонажів і промпти, застосовувати готові скрипти, плагіни та Claude skills.

• Ділитися з командою вдалими підходами, промптами й новими форматами, які можна масштабувати на весь продакшн.

------------------
*Кого ми шукаємо?*
------------------

Важливо, щоб ти вже вмів(-ла) самостійно створити AI-креатив від промпту до фінального монтажу, уважно ставився(-лася) до якості й швидко навчався(-лася).

• Впевнено працюєш в After Effects: монтуєш, анімуєш і можеш використовувати базові плагіни та скрипти.

• Маєш практичний досвід генерації відео в Seedance, Kling, Veo або аналогах — не лише дивився(-лася) туторіали, а створював(-ла) власні роботи.

• Генеруєш зображення за допомогою Nano Banana, GPT Image, Seedream або інших актуальних інструментів.

• Умієш розкласти сценарій на окремі сцени, написати промпти й утримати консистентність персонажа в багатосценовому відео.

• Розумієш логіку performance-креативу: як працюють хук, основна частина та CTA, чому в ролику не має бути «мертвих» секунд.

• Маєш портфоліо з AI-креативами — гіперреалістичними UGC-відео, мувіками, анімаційними чи іншими багатосценовими роботами.

• Спокійно працюєш із детальними правками: чуєш бачення креативного маркетолога, аргументовано пропонуєш альтернативи й відповідаєш за дедлайни.

-------------
*Буде плюсом*
-------------

• Створював(-ла) скрипти або плагіни для After Effects чи Premiere — самостійно або за допомогою vibe-coding.

• Розумієш метрики performance-креативів — CTR, hook rate, hold rate, CPA — і хочеш аналізувати результати власних робіт.

• Стежиш за форматами TikTok і Reels, створював(-ла) органічний контент або цікавишся бігом та спортом.

------------------------
*Що буде з нашого боку?*
------------------------

• Сильний AI-first стек: внутрішня платформа для генерацій без обмежень на паралельні запуски, власні плагіни для After Effects і Claude skills для роботи з ТЗ та промптами.

• Усі необхідні інструменти й підписки за рахунок компанії, а також бюджет на тестування нових сервісів, якщо вони можуть покращити результат.

• Підтримка шести дизайнерів, з якими можна обмінюватися промптами, автоматизаціями й технічними рішеннями та швидше пройти онбординг.

• Пряма взаємодія з чотирма креативними маркетологами й можливість пропонувати власні формати та гіпотези для тестування.

• Прозорі очікування щодо якості й обсягу роботи та можливість перегляду грейду вже через 3–4 місяці, якщо ти швидко розшириш свою зону відповідальності.

• full-time співпраця у форматі contractor із можливістю працювати віддалено. Ми забезпечимо всі необхідні AI-інструменти й підписки, підтримку команди на онбордингу, регулярний обмін досвідом і простір для швидкого професійного росту.

--------------------------
*Як це — бути в Universe?*
--------------------------

Universe — це місце, де не потрібно чекати пів року, щоб перевірити сильну ідею. Ми швидко тестуємо нові моделі, дивимося на результат і масштабуємо те, що працює. Тут можна не лише виконувати задачі, а й змінювати підхід до продакшну інструментами, якими згодом користуватиметься вся команда.

Якщо тобі цікаво створювати AI-креативи на високому рівні реалістичності й рости всередині одно й обговорити, як твій досвід може посилити наш AI-продакшн і як ми можемо посприяти твоєму розвитку!

title: Junior Designer - Newton Baby
description:

Our expertise spans data science, performance marketing, product, and creative, and our work reaches millions of customers every day. It's a rare combination: the energy of a tech company, the stability of an industry leader, and the opportunity to build something truly significant. If you're energized by transformation, collaboration, and meaningful impact at scale, Ashley Digital is where ambition meets opportunity.

*To be considered for this remote opportunity, you must reside and be authorized to work within the United States.*

*Job Overview:*

We’re on a mission to help every family sleep better, starting with the littlest sleepers, and our Creative has to move as fast as we grow. We’re looking for a Junior Designer to join our growth creative team, focused on Newton Baby, our brand of breathable crib mattresses and baby sleep essentials. You’ll turn real parent and creator footage into scroll-stopping ad content that speaks to families at one of the most important moments of their lives. This is a hands-on, high-output role for someone who loves editing, thrives on fast iteration, and wants to help build the next generation of DTC advertising for a brand parents trust. You’ll take raw UGC and creator footage and shape it into finished ad variants, working from briefs, testing constantly, and keeping pace with a high-volume cadence of dozens of new ads and edits every week.

*What You'll Be Doing:*

* Design and edit static and video ad creative across our bedding and mattress brands, for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube

* Templatize evergreen creative for recurring requests, so the team can move even faster
* Partner with creatives, copywriters, and Directors to bring concepts and scripts to life across multiple brands
* Uphold each brand's identity — typography, tone, and visual style — while flexing between them

The responsibilities described above are not exhaustive. You may be asked, from time to time and as reasonably required by business needs, to perform other duties consistent with your skills and role, including work for or on behalf of our related entities. This job description does not constitute a contract of employment and may be modified at any time, subject to applicable law.

*How We'll Measure Success:*

* Volume and turnaround time on ad creative requests
* Assets shipped per week against backlog
* Creative performance (CTR, CPC, ROAS, ad spend) on shipped ads, in partnership with growth and media buying
* QA accuracy — low error and revision rate on everything you ship

*Skills & Qualifications*

What you’ll bring:

* 1–2 years of design and video editing experience (agency, freelance, or in-house)
* Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Premiere Pro, After Effects) and Figma
* Familiarity with CapCut, ElevenLabs, and other fast-turn social content tools
* A production mindset: you’re energized by high volume and quick turnarounds, and you favor iteration over perfection
* Strong organizational skills that let you juggle multiple asset requests without dropping a thread
* A portfolio that shows your range (required)

Nice to have:

* An instinct for what makes performance and DTC creative convert: hooks, pacing, and UGC style
* Experience editing UGC and creator content specifically for paid social
* Familiarity with baby, parenting, home, or other DTC e-commerce brands
* Basic motion graphics skills

title: Junior Sales Development Representative
description:
Eventbrite is disrupting a huge industry in desperate need of a shakeup. We're looking for a talented, driven and collaborative Business development manager to be the first point of contact for our sales efforts, generating demand and building a pipeline for our Account executives.

*A few examples of your responsibilities*

What we look for
----------------

* *Reasoning ability.* Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
* *Team spirit.* You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.

What we offer
-------------

* *An exceptional opportunity for growth*. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. If you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects.
* *Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.* You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
* *Competitive pay.* Typically, we offer individuals with limited experience a base salary of $70,173 to $91,661 in the US, with an additional performance-based variable compensation component. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. For individuals who demonstrate exceptional capability, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact.

*Commitment & contract*

Permanent. Full-time.

*Location*

Fully remote.

*The selection process*
-----------------------

If you pass our screening, we’ll invite you to a couple of interviews, designed to assess your motivation, ambitions, and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Interviews are a two-way conversation: a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to learn more about the company. Studies suggest that women tend not to apply for a job if their CV isn’t a perfect fit. Here, talent takes precedence over experience. So if you like the role and think you could be awesome at it in time, go ahead and apply.

Employees can participate in resource groups and we offer global programming and training throughout the year to support a diverse and inclusive workplace. Read more about our Diversity and Inclusion work for our team, culture, and community.

----------

This includes support in a remote environment, wellness allowance, Carrot family planning benefit, Origin Financial Planning service, and other offerings to ease the mind and body like Modern Health and BriteBreaks (generally the first Friday of every month off).

title: Junior Project Manager
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com.

Job Description:
----------------

*Role Overview*
---------------

As a Junior Project Manager at Fluence, you will support the successful delivery of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects across Ireland, the UK, and the wider EMEA region. Working within a global, cross-functional environment, you will assist Senior Project Managers throughout the full project lifecycle, from project initiation and engineering through construction, commissioning, and operational handover.

This role offers an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional to develop project management expertise within the renewable energy sector. You will gradually take ownership of smaller projects, system upgrades, and designated work packages while collaborating with engineering, procurement, finance, construction, and commissioning teams to ensure safe, high-quality, and on-time project delivery.

*2. Key Responsibilities*
-------------------------

* Support Senior Project Managers in the delivery of utility-scale energy storage projects across all project phases.
* Maintain project documentation, including project plans, schedules, risk registers, action logs, and punch lists.
* Coordinate deliverables across engineering, procurement, logistics, finance, legal, quality, and operational teams.
* Organize and facilitate project meetings, prepare agendas, document meeting minutes, and support customer reporting activities.
* Take ownership of assigned small-scale projects, customer change orders, plant upgrades, and project work packages.
* Monitor project schedules, milestones, and progress using project management tools and reporting processes.
* Support budget tracking, invoice reviews, purchase order management, cash flow forecasting, and cost control activities.
* Assist in identifying and managing project risks, scope changes, and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure compliance with Fluence health, safety, environmental, and quality standards.
* Conduct site visits to support construction, testing, commissioning, and energization activities.
* Partner with contractors, field teams, suppliers, customers, and other stakeholders to resolve project issues and maintain effective communication.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, lessons learned activities, and project management best practices.

*3. Required Qualifications and Experience*
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, or another relevant technical discipline.
* 1-2 years of professional experience in project coordination, project management, engineering, or construction.
* Experience within renewable energy, power generation, utilities, energy infrastructure, or industrial projects.
* Understanding of fundamental project management principles, including scope, schedule, budget, risk, and stakeholder management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience working with project scheduling tools such as MS Project or similar planning software.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, international, and cross-functional environment.
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly to project sites (approximately 25-30%).

*4. Additional Skills*
----------------------

* Knowledge of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), solar PV, wind energy, or high-voltage electrical infrastructure.
* Familiarity with construction site activities, commissioning processes, or utility-scale energy projects.
* Understanding of Irish and/or UK health and safety regulations and construction standards.
* Experience supporting subcontractor management, contract administration, supplier coordination, or quotation evaluations.
* Exposure to Primavera P6 or other advanced project scheduling tools.
* Relevant project management certification or progress toward certification (e.g., PMI CAPM, PRINCE2 Foundation, IPMA Level D).
* Strong organizational skills with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
* Experience working in matrixed, remote, or global project environments.

Our Culture
-----------

At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world.

Unleash Voices
--------------

We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress.

Customer Fluent
---------------

Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate.

Infinite Impact
---------------

We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come.

All In
------

We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success.

title: Junior Account Executive
description:
Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.

Job Description
---------------

As a Junior Account Executive on the Fusion team, you will take the next step in your sales career by owning opportunities from initial outreach through close. Fusion is built specifically for speech, occupational, and physical therapy practices, helping providers streamline operations and focus on patient care.

In this role, you'll manage a mix of inbound leads and self-generated opportunities while building the skills and commercial judgment needed to become a successful full-cycle Account Executive. You'll have the autonomy to identify target accounts, run your own territory strategy, and make informed decisions about which opportunities to pursue. Success is measured by the quality of your pipeline, your ability to convert opportunities into customers, and the revenue you generate.

What You'll Do
--------------

* Work a dedicated share of inbound marketing-qualified leads, with opportunity volume increasing as you ramp into the role.
* Build and maintain a consistent outbound pipeline through research-driven prospecting and personalized outreach.
* Identify, prioritize, and engage therapy practices that align with Fusion's ideal customer profile.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand operational challenges, business objectives, and buying readiness.
* Deliver product demonstrations that connect Fusion's capabilities to the needs of speech, occupational, and physical therapy providers.
* Qualify opportunities rigorously and make informed decisions about which opportunities to advance or disqualify.
* Manage smaller opportunities from first conversation through signed agreement.
* Collaborate with senior Account Executives on larger or more complex opportunities, providing clear customer insights and handoff information.
* Maintain accurate pipeline, activity, and forecast data within Salesforce.
* Leverage AI-powered tools and sales technologies to improve productivity, outreach effectiveness, and customer engagement.
* Partner closely with Marketing, Sales Development, and Customer Success to create a strong customer experience throughout the buying journey.

What You Bring
--------------

Required Qualifications
-----------------------

* 1+ year of experience in a Sales Development Representative (SDR), Business Development Representative (BDR), or similar sales role.
* Demonstrated success generating pipeline that resulted in qualified opportunities and revenue outcomes.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including confidence engaging prospects by phone, email, and virtual meetings.
* Ability to conduct research, identify customer needs, and tailor outreach strategies accordingly.
* Experience using Salesforce, Outreach, or similar sales engagement and CRM platforms.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and opportunities simultaneously.
* Curiosity, coachability, and a growth mindset with a desire to learn the full sales cycle.
* Experience using AI tools to improve productivity, or a strong interest in learning how to incorporate AI into daily work.

title: Junior SEO/Linkbuilder
description:

У нашому портфоліо — mobile- та web-застосунки і сервіси з мільйонною аудиторією, що охоплюють різні ніші: Health & Wellness, Mental Health, Astrology, AI, Utilities, Parental Control. А також розвиваємо власний R&D-центр.

Шукаємо *Junior SEO/Linkbuilder* у команду, що розвиває напрямок Data Intelligence. Команда розробляє сервіси здебільшого у сфері data search & intelligence, які допомагають користувачам знаходити інформацію, перевіряти дані та отримувати додаткові інсайти через спеціалізовані онлайн-інструменти. Наразі продукти працюють повністю у web-форматі, орієнтовані на глобальний B2C-ринок.

Якщо ти цікавишся SEO, хочеш розвиватися у сфері пошукового просування, вмієш працювати з контентом та активно використовуєш AI-інструменти - будемо раді знайомству!

Ми готові розглядати кандидатів із мінімальним досвідом або після завершення SEO-курсів. Для нас важливі твоє бажання навчатися, уважність до деталей та відповідальний підхід до роботи.

*Що потрібно буде робити:*

*

Комунікувати з підрядниками щодо розміщення зовнішніх посилань;

*

Самостійно займатися лінкбілдингом: шукати та аналізувати сайти-донори, домовлятися з вебмайстрами про розміщення гостьових статей і посилань;

*

Створювати та редагувати тексти, генерувати зображення й відео за допомогою AI-інструментів для потреб SEO-команди;

*

Публікувати статті в блогах продуктів компанії: форматувати контент, додавати ілюстрації, внутрішні та зовнішні посилання;

*

Працювати з форумами, тематичними спільнотами та коментарями на сайтах для просування продуктів;

*

Вести звітність, систематизувати інформацію та відстежувати результати виконаних завдань.

*Що ми очікуємо від тебе:*

*

Базове розуміння SEO та принципів пошукового просування сайтів;

*

Уміння працювати з текстами: створювати, редагувати, структурувати та адаптувати контент під різні завдання;

*

Знання англійської мови на рівні *B1+ або вище;*

*

Уміння формулювати ефективні промпти та використовувати AI-асистентів у роботі;

*

Упевнені навички пошуку інформації в інтернеті, її аналізу та систематизації;

*

Готовність працювати з повторюваними завданнями, зберігаючи уважність і якість виконання.

*
Буде перевагою:*

*

Досвід лінкбілдингу та розміщення зовнішніх посилань;

*

Досвід email-комунікації, зокрема листування англійською мовою;

*

Навички роботи з WordPress або іншими CMS;

*

Знайомство з SEO-інструментами (Ahrefs, Majestic, Screaming Frog тощо);

*

Інтерес до AI-технологій та автоматизації SEO-процесів.

*Твій шлях до позиції:*

[HR Interview > Tech Interview> Final Interview > Reference Check > Job Offer]

Щоб зосередитись на головному та реалізовувати свій потенціал – важливо мати зручні умови. Тому ми подбали про все: від можливостей для зростання до речей, які просто роблять щоденну роботу комфортнішою.

*
Щоб зростати:*

Ми підтримуємо твої амбіції і прагнення до нового:

*

покриваємо професійне навчання: курси, сертифікації, тренінги;

*

якщо без іноземної мови ніяк – компенсуємо і її;

*

оплачуємо участь у профільних конференціях, івентах і мітапах;

*

надаємо доступ до електронної бібліотеки;

*

і не забуваємо про регулярний перформанс-рев’ю, щоб бачити твій прогрес.

*
Щоб працювати комфортно:*

Маєш усе для фокусу на головному:

*

гібридний формат, де ти обираєш, як працювати – ремоут чи з офісу;

*

pet-friendly офіс у центрі Києва;

*

сніданки та перекуси в офісі;

*

сучасна техніка;

*

працевлаштування через ФОП;

*

конкурентна винагорода, що відповідає твоїм навичкам і досвіду.

*
Щоб залишатися в ресурсі:*

Піклуємося не лише про результати:

*

21 день відпустки та вихідні на національні свята;

*

100% оплачувані лікарняні;

*

медичне страхування після випробувального терміну;

*

Booking Club.

*Відчуваєш фомо-синдром? Приходь у Brainstack та реалізовуй свій потенціал.*

P.S. Термін розгляду CV до 7 робочих днів. Якщо ти не отримаєш відповідь від рекрутера протягом цього часу, це означає, що ми розглянули твоє резюме, але зараз у компанії немає вакансій, які відповідають твоєму досвіду та побажанням.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
Зарплата: до 160000 RUR (на руки)

Мы ищем Junior Data Engineer, который готов погрузиться в существующую инфраструктуру аналитики: разбираться в коде, оптимизировать пайплайны, исправлять баги и добавлять новые процессы. Стек уже настроен — ClickHouse, Airflow, API-интеграции, GitHub.

Но главное — это не просто поддержка. Мы находимся на этапе активного внедрения AI-решений в бизнес-процессы, и перед командой стоят амбициозные задачи по созданию больших продуктов с использованием LLM и RAG. У тебя будет возможность развиваться именно в этом направлении: участвовать в проектировании и интеграции ИИ-компонентов, работать с векторными базами данных, строить пайплайны для подачи контекста в модели.

*Обязанности:*

*

Поддержка и развитие ETL/ELT-процессов: Обеспечение бесперебойной работы существующих пайплайнов данных (ClickHouse, Airflow), исправление ошибок и мониторинг качества данных.

*

Работа с источниками данных: Настройка и поддержка интеграций с внешними источниками через API, а также обработка файлов, поступающих по электронной почте.

*

Администрирование инфраструктуры аналитики: Работа с базами данных (ClickHouse, PostgreSQL), оптимизация запросов и структуры хранения.

*

Автоматизация: Написание скриптов на Python для автоматизации рутинных задач по загрузке и трансформации данных.

*

Работа с Git: Ведение кода пайплайнов в системе контроля версий (GitHub), участие в код-ревью.

*

Участие в R&D проектах: Активное участие в создании и внедрении новых больших проектов компании, связанных с интеграцией AI/LLM в бизнес-процессы (под руководством старших коллег).

*Требования:*

*

Высшее образование;

*

Желательно дополнительное образование по соответствующему профилю;

*

Опыт работы: от 1 года до 3 лет коммерческой разработки или администрирования в области Data Engineering.

*

Язык программирования: Уверенное знание Python.

*

Базы данных: Практический опыт работы с ClickHouse (создание таблиц, оптимизация, работа с ReplacingMergeTree) и PostgreSQL.

*

Оркестрация: Опыт настройки DAG'ов в Apache Airflow.

*

Интеграции: Опыт работы с внешними REST API.

*

Инструменты: Уверенное владение Git.

*Будет преимуществом (плюсом):*

*

Опыт работы с LLM или фреймворками для работы с ИИ (LangChain).

*

Понимание концепции RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

*

внимание к деталям и аккуратность в работе с данными;

инициативность, способность самостоятельно решать задачи и предлагать улучшения;

аналитический склад ума;

системность в принятии решений;

умение работать в команде и взаимодействовать с аналитиками;

навыки приоритизации и ведения нескольких задач параллельно;

ответственность за результат.

Оформление согласно Трудовому законодательству РФ;

*

Работа в комфортабельном офисе, возможен гибридный график или полная удаленка по московскому времени (UTC + 3).

Дружный коллектив

Наличие свободной парковки;

*

title: Junior Customer Success Manager
description:

Trusted by over 4,000 clients across financial services, crypto, mobility, trading, marketplaces, education, and iGaming, including Bybit, Bitpanda, Wirex, Avis, Vodafone, Duolingo, and Kaizen Gaming.

Sumsub is recognized as a Great Place To Work® in the US and rated 4.5 out of 5 on Glassdoor. Our 1,000+ people around the world back it up, too: 92% are proud to be Sumsubers, and 90% say their work is interesting and challenging.

We’re looking for a *Junior Customer Success Manager* to manage a portfolio of business customers, help them get value from Sumsub’s products, and drive customer retention and account growth.

*What You Will Be Doing:*

*

Managing a portfolio of existing customers and acting as their main point of contact, understanding their business goals and building relationships with business and technical stakeholders.

*

Holding regular customer meetings and quarterly business reviews to discuss product usage, success metrics, plans for future periods and next steps for driving relationships.

*

Managing renewals and identifying potential churn risks, working with customers and internal teams to address them.

*

Identifying and developing upsell and cross-sell opportunities based on each customer’s needs.

Working with Sales, Solution Architects, Support, Product, and other internal teams to resolve customer issues and follow through on agreed actions.

Sharing customer feedback internally to help improve our products and customer experience.

*

Relevant experience in customer success, account management, business development, or a similar client-facing role in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, or crypto, involving ongoing customer relationships.

*

*

Ability to analyse customer usage and performance data and turn it into clear insights and recommendations.

*

Strong organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise across multiple accounts, take initiative, and follow through on commitments.

*

Advanced English, with the ability to confidently lead customer calls, present findings, and communicate clearly in writing.

*

Familiarity with KYC, KYB, AML, or fraud prevention would be a plus.

*

*Remote-first, trust-based culture.* Work from the place that works best for you. No mandatory office days, no attendance trackers. In some locations, we provide offices or coworking spaces, but the choice is yours.

*

*

*Work that matters.* Our mission is to build a digital world that is secure, accessible and inclusive for everyone. From fighting fraud to making online services easier and safer to use, your work will have a real impact on how people experience trust online.

title: Junior Developer Advocate (AI/Open Source)
description:
About NeverBlink
----------------

At NeverBlink we are on a mission to make knowledge graphs and ontologies accessible to the masses, making AI systems more useful and more aligned with human intent. We build infrastructure software – the new generation of data products to be used by top companies worldwide. We believe that open-source is the only way to reach this goal and we release as much as possible to the community.

Our tech is built on deep R&D done in collaboration with international partners. The work is partially funded from EU grants.

NeverBlink has an international team, with headquarters in Warsaw, Poland. We are a remote-first company. In this role, you will be expected to travel (also to Warsaw), but relocation is not required.

In short
--------

We are building a HuggingFace / npm for ontologies. Ontologies are what gives data meaning – the new wave of AI applications needs them badly. We capture this wave.

We are looking for a student or junior community enthusiast to join our team as a Junior Developer Advocate. You don’t need years of experience or an impressive resume. We care about your curiosity, drive, and willingness to learn. Your focus will be supporting our developer advocacy efforts: helping us engage the community, create content, and get our open-source software into the hands of AI & data developers.

Fully remote within the EU/EFTA, some travel, small team, lots of ownership.

What can we give you
--------------------

* We give you ownership over the process – it’s your ship. We give you tools to run it.
* Work on high visibility open source projects.
* Travel: scientific and technical conferences.
* Equity on top of the base salary.
* Flexible working hours.
* Fully remote work.
* Negotiable type of contract.
* Competitive salary – strongly dependent on your experience level and motivation.
* Regular team integrations (physical and virtual)

How we work
-----------

We are a small team, where we strongly prefer to give each team member ownership of a particular topic. There is no bureaucratic process. If you want to talk to the CEO/CTO, just hit them up on chat.

We are remote-first. You can work any hours that are the most convenient to you.

Our team members come from open source communities, academia, and tech. It’s a place where you’ll have access to some very smart folks that are a pleasure to work with.

How to apply
------------

Your resume is not our main focus – your work is. Please include links to your relevant work: OSS projects, organized community events, talks you gave, social media pages managed by you, scientific papers, or anything else that is relevant to interacting with communities.

You can put these links either in the resume, or in the dedicated application form field.

Rigid requirements (MUST have):
-------------------------------

* Fluent in English.
* Living in the EU or EFTA.
* Able to travel.

What we will look for (you don’t need to tick all boxes):
---------------------------------------------------------

* Good public speaker, experience in giving talks at technical or scientific conferences
* Can code, at least to a degree to be able to teach people basic programming
* Familiar with the open-source ecosystem (track record of OSS contributions preferred)
* Good writing skills, preferably demonstrated with blog posts, research papers, or other content
* Experience with operating social media profiles (especially engaging communities, not just blasting corporate propaganda)
* Experience in organizing physical events
* Very familiar with the data & AI spaces (e.g., agents, analytics, databases, graph analytics, ontologies)
* Experience building or growing a technical community

*NOT needed:*
-------------

* Formal education or an impressive resume. We are looking for people at all experience levels.
* Speaking Polish – we speak English only!
* Experience with ontologies – we can quickly teach you that, but if you know them, it’s a plus.

ecosio is a fast-growing, innovative service company and a leading provider of B2B integration, specialising in electronic data interchange (EDI), Web EDI and e-invoicing. ecosio is part of Vertex, Inc., a leading global provider of indirect tax solutions listed on Nasdaq (VERX).

Our brand slogan is Connections That Work as we believe strong connections are central to successful business relationships - both external and internal. We are technology lovers, set the highest standards for our solutions, and put innovative ideas first.

---------------

As a Junior SOC Analyst, you will be part of the Security Operations team, with a primary focus on monitoring and triaging security alerts across our infrastructure. You will investigate potential threats and support incident response, with guidance from senior SOC analysts and the security chapter. You will also contribute to detection engineering, threat hunting, security research, and security tool maintenance and integrations.

* Monitor security events and alerts from SIEM, endpoint protection, and network security tools
* Analyse and triage security alerts to identify potential threats and incidents
* Conduct initial incident response triage and escalate significant security events to senior SOC analysts and the security chapter
* Maintain security documentation and incident reports
* Build and maintain dashboards to support security monitoring and investigations
* Assist in developing, testing, and tuning security detections
* Support threat hunting activities and vulnerability assessments
* Support SIEM integrations and log pipeline maintenance
* Help maintain and tune security monitoring tools
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate and resolve security incidents
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of security operations processes
* Stay informed about emerging threats and attack techniques
* Contribute to threat intelligence gathering and analysis
* Support internal penetration testing and purple-team exercises

* Relevant degree in computer science, information security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Solid understanding of networking concepts, security protocols, and common attack vectors

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple priorities

*And nice to have...*

* Practical exposure to detection engineering and rule maintenance
* Understanding of incident response frameworks
* Familiarity with log analysis and security tooling

----------------------

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a UI/UX Designer based in Netherlands.*

Join a creative, remote-first gaming environment focused on developing engaging and visually compelling mobile games. In this role, you will design intuitive user interfaces and seamless player journeys that enhance the overall gaming experience. You will contribute to a wide range of in-game features, including game screens, HUDs, menus, stores, live events, and monetization systems. Working closely with game designers, artists, and developers, you will transform creative concepts into polished, user-friendly interfaces. You will help establish consistent design systems and UI component libraries while ensuring high-quality implementation across mobile platforms. This position offers the opportunity to influence product decisions, experiment with creative solutions, and contribute directly to player engagement and product performance. You will thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment that values autonomy, innovation, continuous learning, and meaningful contributions.

Accountabilities
----------------

* Design intuitive user flows and engaging interfaces for mobile games, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable player experience.
* Create wireframes, UI concepts, prototypes, and production-ready interface designs aligned with gameplay requirements and product objectives.
* Design and develop in-game screens, heads-up displays (HUDs), menus, stores, live events, monetization features, and other elements of the player journey.
* Build, maintain, and improve UI kits, component libraries, and design systems to ensure consistency, scalability, and efficient design workflows.
* Prepare and optimize visual assets for integration into game engines, ensuring technical requirements and production standards are met.
* Collaborate closely with game designers, artists, and developers throughout the production lifecycle to deliver cohesive and high-quality gaming experiences.
* Work with development teams to ensure accurate implementation of designs and maintain visual and functional quality within the game.
* Refine user flows and interface solutions based on project needs, team feedback, player behavior, and evolving product priorities.
* Apply UX principles and visual design best practices to improve usability, accessibility, engagement, and navigation across mobile interfaces.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of game systems and user experiences, supporting product goals and player satisfaction.

------------
Requirements
------------

* Proven experience in UI/UX design, particularly in designing interfaces and user experiences for mobile games.
* Strong understanding of UX principles, user journey mapping, interaction design, and the creation of intuitive user flows.

UX/UI & Visual Designer (Mid-level)
-----------------------------------

We are looking for a Mid-Level UI/UX & Visual Designer with strong mobile-first expertise who can create conversion-focused digital experiences and adapt them effectively across all screen sizes. The primary focus of this role is UI/UX design for content-heavy websites, landing pages, digital components, and A/B tests. Strong visual and graphic design capabilities are also required to support the role through the creation of logos, infographics, promotional materials, campaign assets, and other brand-related visuals when needed. The ideal candidate has strong foundational design skills, can work independently, and uses AI thoughtfully to accelerate research, ideation, prototyping, and production without compromising quality, originality, or professional judgment.

🎯What You’ll Do?
----------------

* Design mobile-first, responsive experiences for content-heavy websites, landing pages, promotional components, and A/B tests;
* Translate briefs, business requirements, and CRO hypotheses into clear, engaging, and conversion-focused design solutions;
* Prioritize content, interactions, usability, and conversion on smaller screens before expanding solutions to tablet and desktop breakpoints;
* Create logos and supporting brand assets for new and existing digital brands;
* Design infographics, promotional materials, campaign visuals, banners, icons, and other marketing assets;
* Create and maintain reusable Figma components, templates, and design-system elements;
* Prepare polished designs and clear specifications for development handoff;
* Collaborate with the Design Team Lead, PMs, developers, CRO, SEO, content, and other stakeholders;
* Research competitors, explore alternative solutions, and make informed design decisions;
* Manage multiple tasks and communicate proactively about progress, blockers, and deadlines;
* Review your work carefully before delivery and maintain consistent visual quality across different brands and projects.

🎯What We’re Looking For?
------------------------

* Tool Proficiency: Advanced Figma skills (Auto Layout, variants, components, prototyping), Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.
* UI/UX & Mobile Mastery: Strong mobile-first mindset with deep knowledge of user flows, information architecture, visual hierarchy, spacing, accessibility, and responsive behaviour.
* Graphic & Visual Design: branding, logo design, infographics, promotional assets, and campaign visuals fundamentals with a portfolio showing both UI/UX case studies and creative visual/branding assets (logos, marketing assets).

Be comfortable working with Claude, OpenAI Codex, Gemini, ChatGPT, Figma AI and other AI-related tools. This should be used to accelerate and improve already competent design process, not to replace it.
* Execution & Ownership: Comfortable with taking ownership over designing content-heavy and conversion-focused digital experiences. Ability to maintain consistency with established brand design systems, accessibility standards, and project requirements.
* Problem-solving skills: Ability to understand a problem, conduct relevant research, explore alternatives, and make informed design decisions independently. Ability to translate complex requirements into clear, intuitive, and visually engaging interfaces.
* Strong attention to detail: and the ability to evaluate work critically before delivery.
* Industry experience: affiliate marketing, digital media, or another conversion-focused environment.
Nice-to-have:

* Experience with motion design and Adobe After Effects.

🎯Our Core Values
----------------

* Passion & Curiosity
You are naturally curious and love understanding how things really work. You ask why, learn fast, and enjoy exploring the game behind the game: users, algorithms, markets, competitors, incentives, psychology, and technology.
* Performance & Action
You turn ideas into action. You ship, test, measure, and improve. You focus on outcomes, not activity, and you understand that real performance is measured by impact, not meetings, messages, or hours worked.
* Honesty & Ownership
You tell the truth early, take responsibility, and communicate clearly. You do not blame, hide, or wait. When something is unclear, you clarify it. When something is broken, you help fix it. When you own something, you drive it forward.

What’s in it for you?
---------------------

🌎 Freedom to work from wherever you perform best
Join a remote-first company designed around trust, ownership, and impact.

---------------------

Manage your schedule in an environment where results matter more than time online.

--------------------------

-----------------------------

You’ll have the space, support, and responsibility to grow fast if you are hungry to learn.

------------------------------------

We review compensation based on ownership, impact, and contribution.

⚕️ Health insurance after onboarding
------------------------------------

Comprehensive health coverage becomes active after your successful 3-month onboarding period.

🎉 Real connections beyond the screen
------------------------------------

You’ll have opportunities to meet teammates in person during company gatherings or to come visit our small office in Thailand.

Selection process

*About the Role*
----------------

We’re hiring a *UX/UI Designer* to create intuitive, visually polished, and user-friendly digital experiences across web and mobile products.

You’ll work across the full design lifecycle — from understanding user needs and mapping journeys to creating wireframes, interactive prototypes, high-fidelity interfaces, and scalable design systems.

You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to turn business requirements and user insights into digital experiences that are easy to use, accessible, and built for engagement.

This role is a strong fit if you combine *UX problem-solving with strong UI design skills* and enjoy taking products from early concepts through developer handoff and iteration.

*What You’ll Own*
-----------------

*UX Research & User Experience*
-------------------------------

* Conduct user interviews, usability testing, surveys, and behavioral analysis
* Identify user pain points, friction, and opportunities for improvement
* Translate research into user personas, journeys, flows, and actionable design recommendations
* Analyze user behavior using tools such as *Hotjar, FullStory, and Google Analytics*
* Design experiences that balance user needs with product and business objectives

*Wireframing & Prototyping*
---------------------------

* Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes
* Develop low-fidelity concepts through high-fidelity product designs
* Work primarily in *Figma* , with experience in Adobe XD or Sketch also valuable
* Rapidly iterate based on user testing, stakeholder feedback, and product requirements
* Clearly present and explain design decisions to stakeholders

*UI & Product Design*
---------------------

* Design clean, modern interfaces for web and mobile products
* Create responsive experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile
* Apply strong principles of:

* Typography
* Layout and spacing
* Color
* Visual hierarchy
* Interaction design

* Design intuitive onboarding, navigation, dashboards, workflows, and conversion paths

*Design Systems*
----------------

* Build and maintain reusable components and scalable design systems
* Establish consistent patterns for layouts, components, spacing, and interactions
* Maintain style guides and design documentation
* Ensure visual and functional consistency across products and features

*Accessibility & Usability*
---------------------------

* Apply *WCAG 2.1 AA* accessibility best practices
* Design with contrast, keyboard navigation, screen readers, and responsive behavior in mind
* Identify usability issues before they reach development
* Continuously improve experiences based on testing and product feedback

*Developer Handoff & Collaboration*
-----------------------------------

* Partner closely with product managers and engineers throughout the development lifecycle
* Prepare developer-ready specifications, assets, and documentation
* Use tools such as *Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin, or InVision*
* Review implemented features for design accuracy and consistency
* Participate in sprint planning, design reviews, critiques, and Agile ceremonies

*What Makes You a Strong Fit*
-----------------------------

* You think about the *user experience* , not just how a screen looks
* You have a strong eye for polished, modern UI
* You can explain the reasoning behind your design decisions
* You enjoy solving complex user and product problems
* You’re comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly
* You collaborate effectively with product and engineering teams
* You care about consistency, usability, accessibility, and detail

*Required Experience & Skills*
------------------------------

* *2+ years of professional UX/UI, Product Design, or Digital Product Design experience*
* Strong proficiency in *Figma*
* Experience designing responsive *web and/or mobile products*
* Strong understanding of:

* UX principles
* User flows
* Interaction design
* Usability
* Responsive design

* Experience creating:

* Wireframes
* Interactive prototypes
* High-fidelity interfaces
* Design systems

* Strong portfolio demonstrating both *UX thinking and UI execution*
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product managers, developers, and stakeholders
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Ability to work remotely during U.S. client business hours

*Nice to Have*
--------------

* Experience designing *SaaS products, mobile apps, or e-commerce platforms*
* Familiarity with HTML/CSS and frontend development concepts
* Experience with user analytics and behavior tools such as Hotjar or FullStory
* Experience conducting usability tests or user research
* Knowledge of A/B testing and conversion optimization
* Experience maintaining large or scalable design systems
* Familiarity with Agile product development environments

*What a Typical Day Looks Like*
-------------------------------

You may start by reviewing user feedback or analytics to identify UX improvements, then create wireframes or prototypes for an upcoming feature.

Throughout the day, you’ll collaborate with product managers and engineers, refine high-fidelity designs, update reusable components, review implemented features, and prepare designs for developer handoff.

You’ll continuously use feedback, testing, and product data to improve usability and create better experiences.

*In short:* you turn user needs and product requirements into intuitive, accessible, and visually engaging digital experiences.

*Key Metrics for Success*
-------------------------

* Improved usability and user satisfaction
* Reduced friction and user errors
* Increased task completion and engagement
* On-time delivery of design assets for development

If you:
