title: Senior Product Designer / UX Consultant (AI-Native)
description:
About the Role
--------------

We are looking for a hands-on, AI-native Senior Product Designer/UX Consultant to modernize complex operational workflows across approximately 70–80 major application routes and hundreds of functional interfaces.

This is *not primarily a visual design role*. The focus is on understanding existing workflows, uncovering undocumented business rules, simplifying user experiences, and delivering practical, implementation-ready designs.

The ideal consultant combines strong B2B SaaS product design experience, technical fluency, and advanced AI proficiency. You should be comfortable using AI to accelerate discovery, research, workflow analysis, prototyping, documentation, and engineering handoffs—while independently validating its output.

With approximately 20 hours per week, you must work autonomously, prioritize effectively, and deliver measurable improvements.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* *AI-Native Design:* Leverage AI throughout product discovery, workflow analysis, research synthesis, prototyping, and documentation. Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, usability, and completeness.
* *Workflow Modernization:* Analyze and simplify complex workflows across estimating, inventory, scheduling, invoicing, payments, and CRM while preserving critical legacy functionality and business rules.
* *UX/UI Design:* Create user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and developer-ready Figma designs covering interactions, validations, permissions, and edge cases.
* *Design Systems:* Establish reusable components and UX patterns for navigation, forms, tables, filtering, notifications, and error handling.
* *AI-Assisted Engineering Collaboration:* Produce structured specifications for engineers and AI coding agents. Collaborate on technical feasibility, implementation, and functional parity validation.
* *UX Research:* Conduct stakeholder interviews, usability reviews, and customer research to identify pain points and validate design decisions.
* *Prioritization and Delivery:* Develop a UX modernization roadmap, prioritize high-impact improvements, and deliver implementation-ready designs through safe, incremental releases.

Required Qualifications
-----------------------

* *B2B SaaS Experience:* Strong background designing complex ERP, CRM, field-service, or operational platforms with data-heavy workflows.
* *Legacy Modernization:* Proven experience simplifying established applications while preserving critical business rules, functionality, and user familiarity.
* *AI-Native Proficiency:* Extensive hands-on use of AI throughout discovery, workflow analysis, research, prototyping, and documentation—not just UI generation.
* *AI Tools & Validation:* Practical experience with Claude, ChatGPT, Figma AI, Cursor, or similar tools. Ability to structure AI workflows, validate outputs, and identify inaccuracies and missing requirements.
* *UX/UI Expertise:* Advanced Figma skills, including user flows, interactive prototypes, reusable components, design systems, and developer-ready specifications.
* *Technical Collaboration:* Experience working with React/frontend engineers, understanding API/data constraints, and producing specifications suitable for AI-assisted development.
* *Research & Problem-Solving:* Strong skills in user research, usability testing, complex workflow analysis, and identifying edge cases.
* *Autonomy & Communication:* Ability to independently prioritize, document decisions, and deliver high-impact results within a 20-hour workweek.

Preferred Qualifications
------------------------

* Experience with construction, flooring, remodeling, field-service, inventory, estimating, or invoicing software.
* Experience migrating legacy , jQuery, or Kendo interfaces to React.
* Familiarity with feature flags, incremental rollouts, and legacy functionality validation.
* Experience with AI-assisted coding, design-to-code workflows, or agentic AI tools.
* Understanding of accessibility and responsive design.

Initial Deliverables
--------------------

During the first phase of the engagement, you will:

* Analyze existing workflows and identify critical usability issues and undocumented business rules.
* Establish an AI-assisted discovery and design workflow that accelerates analysis, prototyping, and documentation.
* Develop a prioritized UX modernization roadmap aligned with engineering migration plans.
* Define reusable design patterns and component standards for the React application.
* Take one or two high-impact workflows from discovery through validated, implementation-ready designs.
* Establish structured documentation and handoff practices that support engineers and AI coding agents.

What Success Looks Like
-----------------------

* AI is consistently used to accelerate high-quality product design work.
* Complex workflows become simpler without losing critical business functionality.
* Engineers receive clear, complete specifications covering interactions, validations, permissions, and edge cases.
* Designs can be implemented reliably by engineers using AI-assisted development tools.
* Reusable patterns improve consistency and accelerate modernization.
* UX improvements produce measurable customer or operational benefits.
* Meaningful progress is delivered independently within approximately 20 hours per week.

Who We're Looking For
---------------------

A senior product designer who combines *complex B2B SaaS experience, strong UX judgment, technical understanding, and genuinely AI-native working practices*.

You should be able to demonstrate how you've used AI to solve real design problems, accelerate delivery, validate complex workflows, and collaborate with engineering teams.

*We are not looking for someone who simply uses AI to generate attractive screens. We need someone who uses AI to understand complex products, make better design decisions, and deliver accurate, buildable solutions faster.*

title: Motion Designer
description:
*This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.*

Our client is an integrated creative studio based in Columbus, Ohio, with a team of approximately 25 professionals. The studio specializes in brand strategy, visual identity, web design, and development for companies in AI, fintech, developer tools, and defense technology.

-------------
Role Overview
-------------

The Motion Designer will create motion design work across brand identity, product, web, and campaign projects. Working alongside design, strategy, and development teams, this individual will define how brand identities behave in motion, develop animated web case studies, prototype product interactions, and produce creative assets for campaigns, billboards, conferences, and digital screens.

This is a hands-on creative role with ownership from concept through final delivery. The ideal candidate combines strong motion design skills with systems thinking, collaborating with Design Directors, Creative Directors, developers, and clients to establish motion principles and deliver high-quality work across multiple formats.

--------
Location
--------

Fully Remote | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET/MT/PT

--------------------
Key Responsibilities
--------------------

Brand Identity & Motion Systems
-------------------------------

*

Conceptualize, design, and animate motion work across brand identity and visual identity projects.

*

Define how brand identities behave in motion through logo animations, typography, transitions, and easing curves.

*

Develop motion principles, guidelines, and toolkits as part of brand system deliverables.

*

Collaborate with Design Directors and Creative Directors to establish motion principles early in the creative process.

*

Create motion systems that client teams can extend and apply independently.

Campaign Motion & Asset Production
----------------------------------

*

Produce motion assets for launch films, social media cutdowns, and product announcements.

*

Develop asset libraries that maintain campaign consistency across formats and channels.

*

Adapt motion creative for different placements, screen sizes, and technical specifications.

*

Support motion design production for campaign initiatives from concept through final delivery.

Web Motion & Case Studies
-------------------------

*

Develop motion-led case studies for the studio's website and client websites.

*

Create animated hero loops and scroll-driven sequences that bring completed projects to life.

*

Collaborate with developers to translate motion concepts into web experiences.

*

Prepare production-ready motion specifications, Lottie files, and web animations.

Product Interaction & Prototyping
---------------------------------

*

Design and prototype interaction and in-app motion for digital products.

*

Create motion concepts for onboarding flows, micro-interactions, state changes, and other product interactions.

*

Develop prototypes that communicate intended interactions to clients and engineering teams.

*

Collaborate with designers and developers to support the implementation of motion concepts.

Large-Format, Event & Out-of-Home Motion
----------------------------------------

*

Create motion content for digital billboards, airport takeovers, and other large-format displays.

*

Produce animations for multi-screen installations and out-of-home advertising.

*

Develop keynote openers, conference booth content, and stage graphics.

*

Adapt motion assets to meet the requirements of different display formats and environments.

Creative Collaboration & Project Execution
------------------------------------------

*

Present motion concepts and completed work to clients, explaining the creative rationale behind design decisions.

*

Incorporate client feedback into revisions while maintaining the intended creative direction.

*

Coordinate with producers to manage timelines across multiple projects.

*

Collaborate with design, strategy, and development teams throughout the creative process.

*

Contribute to studio pitches, internal brand initiatives, and The Manifest.

--------------
Qualifications
--------------

Experience
----------

*

3+ years of professional motion design experience, ideally within a creative studio or agency.

*

Demonstrated experience developing motion work for brand identities or identity systems.

*

Experience producing motion assets across multiple formats and technical specifications, including video and large-format deliverables.

*

Experience working directly with clients and collaborating with designers and developers.

*

A portfolio demonstrating both motion systems thinking and finished creative work, including brand or identity motion projects.

Skills
------

*

Expert proficiency in Adobe After Effects, with strong working knowledge of Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite.

*

Strong understanding of typography, timing, pacing, and how motion supports a brand concept.

*

Ability to develop motion principles, guidelines, and systems for brand identity projects.

*

Ability to create motion concepts and animations across identity, product, web, and campaign work.

*

Ability to develop interaction and UI prototypes that communicate intended motion to clients and engineering teams.

*

Ability to adapt motion work across multiple formats, screen sizes, and technical specifications.

*

Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining creative quality.

*

Self-directed approach to creative execution, from initial concept through final delivery.

Preferred Experience & Skills
-----------------------------

*

Experience with 3D design and animation using Cinema 4D, Blender, or similar tools.

*

Experience prototyping interactions using Rive, Lottie, Principle, or ProtoPie.

*

Working knowledge of web animation technologies such as GSAP, CSS, WebGL, or creative coding.

*

Experience producing out-of-home advertising, digital out-of-home content, or event and stage graphics.

*

Sound design or video editing skills.

*

Familiarity with brands operating in AI, fintech, or developer tools.

-----------------------
What Success Looks Like
-----------------------

*

Motion design work is delivered across brand identity, product, web, and campaign projects.

*

Brand identity systems include motion principles, guidelines, and toolkits that clients can apply independently.

*

Campaign assets maintain consistency across formats and channels.

*

Web case studies incorporate motion-led storytelling through animated elements and scroll-driven sequences.

*

Product interaction prototypes clearly communicate motion concepts to clients and engineering teams.

*

Motion assets are adapted for video, digital billboards, large-format displays, and event environments.

*

Motion concepts are translated into production-ready specifications, Lottie files, and web animations through collaboration with developers.

*

Multiple project timelines are managed effectively without compromising creative quality.

*

Motion work is presented to clients with clear rationale and refined through feedback.

-----------
Opportunity
-----------

The Motion Designer will have the opportunity to work directly on client projects across brand strategy, visual identity, web design, and development. This role offers hands-on creative ownership, from establishing motion principles alongside creative leadership to delivering finished work across digital products, websites, campaigns, and large-format displays.

---------------------------------------------------------------

Fill in the application form

title: Freelance Graphic Designer (Reviewer) - AI Training
description:
-------------------
*About HumanSignal*
-------------------

Real-world data is the competitive edge in AI.

HumanSignal is a human data partner for companies building AI models and products. Our customers ship better AI, faster, because we partner with their researchers from real-world data creation to annotation to delivery.

We design and create datasets from scratch, recruit and manage the domain experts who evaluate model output, and run everything through our own platform, Label Studio, the open-source standard for data labeling and evaluation, used by over 1 million practitioners worldwide.

We specialize in the operationally complex: real-world data collection, multimodal pipelines, and multi-step workflows. Advanced ML and AI teams use our enterprise platform to run their own data factories, and our services team to extend their reach where in-house capacity runs out.

If you want to do work that materially shapes how the next generation of AI products gets built, we'd love to talk.

*About the Opportunity* *
* We're looking for graphic design professionals to rate the quality of design work, helping AI models learn what makes a design effective.

*Key Details*

* *Type:* Freelance, project-based opportunity
* *Project length:* 6 weeks, with new projects launching regularly
* *Compensation:* Paid per accepted task. On this project, you can earn the equivalent of up to $9 per hour, with pay rates varying by country of residence.

*What You'll Do*

* Rate design samples for typography, visual hierarchy, design execution, color, layout, and overall polish
* Follow detailed rubrics to keep your ratings consistent across high volumes of design samples
* Identify flaws in one slide within the overall design, from minor issues like font size to major ones that require a full reconstruction of the slide
* Edit the flawed slide using the other slides in the design as a reference, to build more cohesion across the entire design
* Flag edge cases and unclear examples

Please note: you won’t create your own designs. You’ll rate and edit the samples we provide, following our guidelines.

*What We're Looking For* *
*

Must-haves

* Education in design or arts (degree or certificate)
* 2+ years of experience as a graphic designer, SMM specialist, or marketing professional
* Strong grasp of composition, color theory, typography, visual hierarchy, and overall design effectiveness
* Exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain focus during repetitive tasks
* Openness to feedback and recalibration

Nice to have

* Design review, art direction or QA experience, with the ability to critique design objectively against industry standards
* Experience with Figma, Sketch, or other modern design tools
* Prior data annotation or AI training experience

*How It Works*

* Apply
* Register on our platform
* Confirm your identity
* Validate your skills
* Start earning on projects

*Why Join Us*

* *Work from anywhere:* fully remote, with just a laptop and a stable internet connection.
* *Set your own schedule:* work whenever suits you, alongside your current job, studies, or other commitments.
* *Get paid every week:* weekly payouts for the work you deliver.
* *Shape the future of AI:* your expertise helps train the AI tools people use every day.
* *More projects ahead:* once you're validated, get access to new projects that match your skills.

title: Product Designer : D3
description:
----------------------------------

Location: Bengaluru,Karnataka,India

----------------------------------

*Who are we?*

Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It’s no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around.

At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work.

This intelligence powers our entire product suite.

* Digital Adoption helps users get productive faster.
* Product Analytics uncovers friction and closes adoption gaps.
* Mirror allows employees to train in safe, simulated environments.

These are ur embedded with Whatfix AI Agents which supercharge creation, insights, and user guidance.

Our upcoming AI-first products are already creating a buzz in the market.

* Seek is an AI-native assistant that not only knows your business context but can also act across applications to get work done on your behalf.
* Whatfix Mirror 2.0 is the world’s only System plus Role simulation with a complete assessment to lead the Gen AI simulation category.

Together, these products reflect Whatfix’s commitment to building enterprise-ready AI teammates that maximize productivity and ROI. It gives users a unified, intelligent way to find answers across systems, apps, and knowledge silos and helps anyone looking to deliver fast and contextual answers.

Whatfix is bridging the gap between rapid technological change and human enablement—ensuring AI is not only embedded but also usable, trusted, and outcome-driven for every employee.

At Whatfix, we’re not just making software easier—we’re making AI work for people.

The company has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40+ countries.

*Customers* : 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions.

*Investors* : A total of ~$270 million USD has been raised as yet. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million USD led by Warburg Pincus, with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.

*Whatfix’s leadership is consistently recognized across top industry analysts and business rankings:*

* Won the 2025 AI Breakthrough Award for the Overall AI-based Analytics Solution of the Year
* Only DAP to be recognized as a “Leader” across various DAP reports for the past 5+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group.
* With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the “Top 50 Indian Software Companies” as per G2 Best Software Awards.
* Named a Gartner Customers’ Choice for DAP for the second year in a row (2024 and 2025)—the only vendor in the market to earn this distinction consecutively.
* We also boast a star rating of 4.6 on G2 Crowd, 4.5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a super-high CSAT of 99.8%
* Stevie Award winner in the category (Bronze): Customer Service Department of the Year – Computer Software - 100 or More Employees.
* Winner of the ISG Paragon Innovation Award in partnership with Sophos (customer) for the EMEA region and finalist in the Transformation Award category.
* RemoteTech Breakthrough Awards winner for “Software Asset Management Solution of the Year”

*These recognitions are matched by business performance:*

* Highest-Ranking DAP on 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ North America for Fifth Consecutive Year
* Listed on the Financial Times & Statista's High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2025 list.
* Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 – Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022-2023
* Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal

*Be one of the key Leaders in this awesome journey of building a billion-dollar company!*

*ABOUT THE ROLE*

Whatfix builds software that helps people work — guiding users through complex applications in real time, across web, mobile, and desktop. Our Digital Adoption Platform (DAP) powers how companies create, distribute, and manage in-app guidance at scale. As we go AI-native across the platform, the design problems are getting harder, more novel, and more interesting.

We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to own design for a core area of the DAP product. This isn't a role for someone who needs a defined process to operate. It's a role for someone who can hold a clear vision for where the product is going, think through what matters next, and ship work that matters right now.

You'll report to Supreeth KV, Design Lead for DAP, and work alongside other Product Designers to advance Whatfix’s Digital Adoption Platform. You'll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and UX Research in a cross-functional team structure.

This role is based in Bengaluru.

*WHAT YOU'LL OWN*

*Product Design Across DAP*

* Own the end-to-end design of features across DAP's guidance creation, distribution, and management surfaces — web, mobile, and desktop.
* Lead your domain from discovery through delivery: research, ideation, prototyping, specification, and handoff.
* Define and maintain design quality within your product area — interaction models, usability standards, and consistency with the broader design system.
* Scrutinize requirements. Push back when what's being asked for isn't the right thing to build.

*AI-Native Design Work*

* Design for AI-powered features where patterns don't yet exist. That means inventing interaction models, not adapting existing ones.
* Use AI tools actively in your own workflow — building functional POCs in code, running rapid experiments, pushing early versions to understand lived experience before it's polished.
* Help define what AI-native UX means for digital adoption: for the customers building guidance, and for the end users receiving it.

*Research and Experimentation*

* Lead qualitative and quantitative research for your product area.
* Favor real-world experimentation over controlled environments. Get something working, get it in front of real users, and learn from how it actually behaves.
* Synthesize findings into clear direction and present them to cross-functional partners and leadership with confidence.

*Collaboration and Mentorship*

* Operate as a peer in planning and prioritization conversations — contributing to how problems are framed, not just how they're solved.
* Mentor the junior designer joining the team. Share knowledge, give direct feedback, raise the bar.
* Contribute to shared design standards and the evolution of design practices on the team.

*WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR*

*Required*

* *4+ years of product design experience in SaaS or enterprise software. You're a Senior Designer — not a mid-level on the path to senior.*
* A portfolio that demonstrates owning complex problem spaces end-to-end: research, design decisions, tradeoffs, and shipped work.
* Active use of AI tools in your design workflow — building POCs, using LLMs for synthesis, working across Figma and code. Not aspirational. Current practice.
* Strong interaction and UX design fundamentals — you know when to follow conventions and when to break them.
* Ability to work effectively in ambiguity, on problems that don't have established answers.

*Nice to Have*

* Experience designing for enterprise SaaS platforms, particularly tools used by non-technical users or content authors.
* Familiarity with digital adoption, in-app guidance, workflow automation, or onboarding experiences.
* Experience designing agent management, AI-generated, or AI-assisted outputs.

*HOW YOU'LL SHOW UP*

* *You design to solve problems now.* You hold a vision for the future, build shared understanding for what's next, and ship in the present. Work stays connected to current OKRs, not some future state that keeps moving.
* *You experiment to learn.* A rough functional POC pushed to real users tells you more than weeks of structured testing. You're comfortable with that tradeoff.
* *You're clear and direct.* You can articulate what you're designing, why, and what you're trading off. You expect the same from the people around you.
* *You're a peer, not an executor.* You're in the room when problems are being framed, not just when solutions need to be drawn.
* *You're already working at the edge of AI.* You're not waiting for the tools to mature or the patterns to be established. You're building now, learning from what you ship, and helping define what AI-native design actually means in practice.

*#LI#Onsite*
*#WorkType: #Onsite*

*Perks & Benefits (India)*

* Best-in-class medical insurance coverage
* Free lunch & dinner buffet
* Doorstep cab drop facility
* Education sponsorship
* Internal job transfer & global mobility programs
* Scope to represent Whatfix at global events
* We also provide uncapped incentives, bonus plans and opportunities to employees (especially those in GTM teams) to travel to meet our global customers

*Note* :

* We strive to live and breathe our Cultural Principles and encourage employees to demonstrate some of these core values - Customer First; Empathy; Transparency; Fail Fast and scale Fast; No Hierarchies for Communication; Deep Dive and innovate; Trust, Do it as you own it;
* We are an *equal opportunity employer* and value diverse people *because of* and not in spite of the differences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
* At Whatfix, we deeply value *collaboration, innovation, and human connection*. We believe that being together in the office five days a week fosters *open communication* , strengthens our sense of community, and accelerates innovation—ultimately helping us achieve our goals more effectively. At the same time, we recognize the importance of *flexibility* in balancing personal and professional priorities. To support this, we offer the option *to work from home up to two days* per month.
* In any situation that requires additional flexibility, we’re open to *considering exceptions on a case-by-case basis* to ensure you’re supported in managing both work and life seamlessly.

title: Lead Brand & Creative Designer
description:
--------------
About Freehand
--------------

Most AI companies are building tools. We're building the worker.

Freehand is the AI Team that runs Accounts Payable and spend operations for the world's largest enterprises, negotiating rates, enforcing contracts, managing suppliers, processing payments, and reconciling data across enterprise systems. It's work that's always required armies of analysts, BPOs, and offshore teams to keep supply chains running.

The tech industry has spent years competing for a $16B software market. We're going after the $348B enterprises spend on labor instead, building the AI Team that doesn't promise incremental efficiency gains, but owns the outcome, with the ROI to prove it. Meta, Unilever, J&J, Pfizer, and Cardinal Health are already running parts of their operations on Freehand, and we're just getting started.

-------------

About the Role
-------------

We're looking for a *Lead Brand & Creative Designer* to elevate how Freehand looks, feels, and shows up in the market.

title: HMI Schematics Designer
description:
*ABOUT POWER FACTORS*

Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world’s renewable energy data.*

Power Factors’ Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company’s suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code.

* Outside China and India

*ABOUT THE ROLE*

As an HMI Schematics Designer on our SCADA Delivery team, you will design and update HMI schematics for the Unity SCADA platform. You’ll work from Technical Manager (TM) inputs and client-specific templates, making sure every schematic is accurate, consistent with client requirements, and delivered on time from first draft through final client approval.

*What you’ll do*

Ticket management

* Review and manage HMI schematics creation tickets submitted to the USIB Jira board by Technical Managers and Project Managers
* Verify tickets are complete: project type (PV, BESS, Hybrid), provisioning portal, client, applicable template, and any specific requirements
* Track tickets through the USIB Jira board stages

Input collection and coordination

* Gather the inputs needed to build schematics screens, such as SLDs and client-specific requests
* Work with TMs, PMs, and clients to resolve missing or unclear inputs before design begins

Schematics creation, review, and approval

* Create Unity SCADA HMI schematics from the provided inputs, client templates, and project requirements
* Review completed schematics internally and make any needed fixes
* Send schematics to the client for review and address comments until final approval
* Upload approved schematics to all required portals, including cloud and local instances provided to the client

Change requests and Unity Portal updates

* Review change requests from TMs and PMs on the USIB Jira board and implement the specified updates or corrections
* Review Unity Portal updates communicated by TMs and PMs to confirm schematics screens still operate correctly

AI-assisted engineering

* Use AI tools to speed up schematics design and review, and validate outputs for accuracy, completeness, and compliance before client delivery
* Use AI tools to check adherence to client-specific templates and standards, and help improve design quality and consistency over time

*REQUIREMENTS*

* Experience (or strong interest) in HMI/SCADA schematics design [add years of experience for the level you’re hiring]
* Familiarity with PV, BESS, and/or Hybrid project types [adjust by level]
* Ability to read and work from single-line diagrams (SLDs) and client templates
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and template consistency
* Clear written and verbal communication, including writing client-facing comments and change notes
* Comfort working in Jira-based ticket workflows
* Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders (TMs, PMs, clients) and chase down missing information
* Willingness to use AI tools in your daily engineering work and to check their output carefully
* Nice to have: experience with Unity SCADA

*LIFE @ POWER FACTORS*

We are an agile software development company – big enough to make an impact, but small enough to move quickly and execute in a growing industry. We are a team of bold and ingenious talents driven by results. We are passionate about making the world a better place. We seek fierce and humble people to help us achieve our ambitious plan.

*WHY JOIN US*

By joining the Power Factors team, you’ll be part of a dynamic group of innovative and driven individuals dedicated to making a positive impact. Every day, your work will directly contribute to advancing clean energy solutions and supporting global sustainability initiatives. Our culture runs deep and shows up in how we work together - committed, conscientious and collaborative. With many opportunities for professional growth, Power Factors is here to support your development as we lead the charge in transforming the energy industry.

*WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER*

Power Factors is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to engaging a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer based in India.*

Join a forward-thinking technology team building AI-powered healthcare software that supports critical clinical workflows and improves operational efficiency.
In this role, you will establish and lead a next-generation quality engineering practice, combining modern test automation with AI-driven testing methodologies.
You will take ownership of the QA strategy, architect the testing infrastructure, and build scalable frameworks that ensure software reliability, security, and performance.
Working with AI coding agents and advanced evaluation tools, you will help validate both traditional software functionality and the accuracy, safety, and dependability of AI-powered features.
You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and clinical experts to translate complex requirements into measurable quality standards.
Your work will directly contribute to delivering secure, reliable healthcare technology that supports emergency department professionals and their patients.
This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on quality engineering leader who values ownership, continuous improvement, and practical AI innovation.

Accountabilities
----------------

* *QA strategy and quality leadership:* Own the end-to-end quality assurance strategy, defining test plans, risk-based coverage targets, quality gates, and release readiness criteria across the software development lifecycle.
* *Test architecture and tooling:* Evaluate, select, and document the testing technology stack for user interfaces, APIs, integrations, performance, accessibility, and security. Record architectural decisions, alternatives, and trade-offs to establish a scalable, maintainable approach.
* *Automation framework development:* Build, maintain, and optimize automated test frameworks for web applications, APIs, and integrations. Establish clear standards that enable engineers and AI agents to extend test coverage reliably.
* *Clinical workflow validation:* Replace manual regression testing with automated coverage of critical healthcare workflows, including triage, clinical documentation, orders, and patient discharge.
* *Performance and reliability testing:* Develop load, stress, and soak tests that simulate realistic emergency department usage and peak traffic. Establish performance baselines and identify regressions before production releases.
* *CI/CD integration:* Integrate automated testing into continuous integration and delivery pipelines so that pull requests and builds receive fast, reliable feedback. Apply parallel execution and AI-assisted test impact analysis to improve testing efficiency.
* *Defect management and root-cause analysis:* Identify, document, prioritize, and resolve defects in collaboration with engineering teams. Investigate underlying causes and implement improvements that prevent recurring issues.
* *Exploratory and agile testing:* Lead exploratory testing for new features and complex clinical workflows. Contribute to sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, acceptance criteria, effort estimation, and release readiness decisions.
* *AI-assisted test engineering:* Use large language models to transform user stories, acceptance criteria, and clinical specifications into test scenarios, edge cases, and boundary conditions. Review and refine AI-generated outputs using sound testing principles and engineering judgment.
* *Agentic test automation:* Leverage AI coding agents, Playwright MCP, and automated planning, generation, and healing capabilities to create and maintain tests. Ensure AI-generated code meets the same quality and review standards as production code.
* *Intelligent failure analysis:* Apply AI-assisted locator healing, flaky-test detection, failure clustering, root-cause summaries, and defect routing to reduce maintenance effort and accelerate issue resolution.
* *Synthetic test data management:* Establish realistic, privacy-safe synthetic patient records and clinical scenarios as the standard for functional, performance, and AI evaluation testing. Use appropriate generation tools while ensuring that real protected health information is never exposed in test environments or AI prompts.
* *AI feature evaluation:* Build evaluation frameworks for AI-powered capabilities using golden datasets, scoring rubrics, model-based grading calibrated against human reviews, and regression gates triggered by changes to models, prompts, or knowledge sources.
* *AI safety and security:* Test AI features for hallucinations, clinical and coding inaccuracies, bias, privacy leakage, prompt injection, and unsafe behavior. Partner with clinical experts to define measurable acceptance thresholds for safe and reliable use in emergency care.
* *Quality metrics and continuous improvement:* Track escaped defects, test flakiness, execution times, test authoring efficiency, and maintenance effort. Communicate quality trends and demonstrate the impact of AI-assisted engineering practices.
* *Security, accessibility, and compliance:* Incorporate security scanning, accessibility checks, dependency analysis, and healthcare data protection requirements into testing workflows.
* *Knowledge sharing and collaboration:* Work closely with developers, product stakeholders, and clinical specialists to establish a quality-first culture and share reusable testing practices across engineering teams.

------------
Requirements
------------

* *Professional experience:* At least 5 years of professional QA or software testing experience, including a minimum of 3 years developing and maintaining automated testing solutions, ideally in a SaaS or web application environment.
* *QA fundamentals:* Strong understanding of testing methodologies, risk-based testing, test design techniques, defect lifecycle management, and software development lifecycle practices.
* *Programming skills:* Strong proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript and working knowledge of Python. Ability to write maintainable, reliable test code to the same standards expected of production software.
* *Test automation expertise:* Hands-on experience with modern automation frameworks, preferably Playwright, with Cypress or Selenium also considered. Demonstrated ability to build frameworks from the ground up, manage test data, maintain stable and efficient suites, and make well-reasoned tooling decisions.
* *AI-native engineering practices:* Regular, practical use of AI coding agents in test engineering, with concrete examples of how these tools have improved test creation, maintenance, or debugging. Ability to identify inaccurate, incomplete, or unreliable AI-generated output.
* *Testing AI-powered systems:* Understanding of how large language model applications can fail and experience evaluating non-deterministic outputs through evaluation datasets, scoring rubrics, model-based grading, and measurable pass thresholds.
* *Performance testing:* Practical experience with Locust, k6, JMeter, or comparable tools, including designing realistic workload models, interpreting performance results, and identifying bottlenecks.
* *API and integration testing:* Solid experience testing APIs and integrations, with the ability to validate contracts, data exchanges, and system behavior across interconnected services.
* *CI/CD and version control:* Experience integrating automated test suites into build pipelines and working with CI/CD tooling and Git-based development workflows.
* *Security and data quality awareness:* Understanding of secure testing practices, test data management, and the importance of protecting sensitive information in healthcare-related environments.
* *Communication and ownership:* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a proactive approach to identifying risks, and the ability to communicate quality concerns clearly to engineers, product managers, and leadership.
* *Remote and agile collaboration:* Experience working in fast-paced, agile, distributed teams across time zones, with the independence and accountability needed to deliver results in a remote environment.
* *Education:* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

*Nice to have:*

* Experience in healthcare technology or regulated clinical software, particularly electronic health records (EHR), Emergency Department Information Systems (EDIS), or ONC Health IT certification testing.
* Familiarity with HL7 v2, FHIR, and HIPAA requirements governing healthcare data, test environments, and privacy.
* Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation and AI observability tools such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, Ragas, Langfuse, or LangSmith.
* Experience building MCP servers, custom AI agents, or AI-assisted engineering tools.
* Knowledge of Playwright MCP and AI-driven test planning, generation, maintenance, and healing.
* Experience with performance tools such as Locust or k6 and security tools such as OWASP ZAP.
* Experience with accessibility testing, WCAG standards, visual regression testing, and automated accessibility tools such as axe-core.
* Familiarity with AI security testing, prompt-injection assessment, red-teaming, and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
* Experience with contract testing tools such as Pact and validation of healthcare interoperability interfaces.

--------
Benefits
--------

* *Competitive compensation:* Salary aligned with UK working hours, with an emphasis on fair and transparent compensation.
* *Remote flexibility:* Work remotely with flexibility designed to support work-life balance.
* *Global collaboration:* Work alongside talented professionals from diverse backgrounds and locations.

Senior / Staff Security Engineer
description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 30,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

At Linear, we are committed to quality. Security is an essential part of that quality — not a layer that we add later, but something we build in from the start. We have a foundational security program we're proud of but, as Linear evolves our product and scales into enterprise, there's meaningful work ahead: staying ahead of vulnerabilities as our attack surface grows, responding fast and cleanly when incidents happen, and hardening our product and infrastructure. As Security Engineer at Linear, you'll be operating in a high-autonomy role with real scope, doing hands-on security work across the product and infrastructure we build.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

Depending on your experience / skillset and our broader priorities, you could:

- Operate, automate, and extend vulnerability management end-to-end: triage, prioritize, and drive remediation across product, infrastructure, and dependencies, and keep the program’s SLAs meaningful rather than theoretical

- Run our bug bounty program: triage incoming reports, validate severity, work with engineering on fixes, and keep researcher relationships professional and responsive

- Lead product security testing: threat model new features (including AI/agent-facing surfaces), review designs and code for security-relevant risk, and do hands-on testing (manual and tool-assisted) rather than relying solely on scanners

- Be a primary responder for security incidents: lead investigation and containment, drive postmortems, and turn lessons into concrete hardening work

- Own meaningful chunks of our cloud/infra security posture on GCP/k8s/Postgres: harden configurations, close gaps surfaced by audits or scanning, and partner with infra engineering on secure defaults

- Build and maintain security tooling and automation, including using AI/LLM tooling to speed up triage, code review, and repetitive investigation work, so the program scales without linear headcount growth

- Partner with the GRC/Trust function: feed real findings into the risk register and control evidence, and help make sure compliance requirements reflect actual engineering practice

What we’re looking for

- A generalist, senior-level security engineer (5+ years across security engineering, with real depth in at least two of: vulnerability management, product/appsec testing, incident response, and cloud security). We need breadth, rather than a narrow specialist in any one of these.

- Hands-on and technical: you can read and reason about code (we use a lot of TypeScript), you’re comfortable in cloud environments (GCP a plus), and you can go deep on a finding rather than just filing a ticket for someone else to fix. You’re comfortable using AI coding/security tools as force multipliers (Linear Agent, Claude, Codex, etc).

- Calm under pressure: you can lead an incident from first alert through postmortem without needing to be told what to do next

- A builder: you’d rather write a script or ship a tool than repeat a manual process a third time

- A pragmatic risk-reducer: you optimize for actually reducing risk, not for checking a box or maximizing findings count

- Autonomy-oriented: comfortable setting your own priorities, working with significant independence, and knowing when to escalate

- A clear communicator: able to explain a technical finding to a non-technical stakeholder and write it up so it’s actually actionable

Our tech

This is a hands-on security engineering role. You'll be running tools, reading/writing code, building detections, working in our cloud environment, and partnering closely with the engineers who build our product. Our stack is fronted by Cloudflare and runs on Google Cloud with k8s, Postgres, and Node.

For day-to-day work, we use:

- Linear, GitHub, Slack, and Google Workspace for collaboration

- Claude and ChatGPT for general & engineering-specific AI tasks

- Vanta for compliance automation and evidence collection

Our security-specific tooling includes:

- GitHub Advanced Security

- RunReveal

- SentinelOne

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

- Competitive salary and equity

- Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

- Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

- Paid co-working space or desk

- Health coverage (based on country requirements)

- 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

- 4 months paid parental leave

- Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

- Regular team events and off-sites

- Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

- Read Me https://linear.app/readme a story about our mission

- Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear

- How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

- Why and how we do work trials https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear Linear blog post

- How we use AI in design https://designerfund.substack.com/p/ai-design-linear feature of Linear's design team

- Scaling our real-time sync engine https://linear.app/blog/scaling-the-linear-sync-engine talk by our cofounder, Tuomas Artman, at Linear's 2023 offsite

- Our recent tender offer: Sharing Linear’s growth with the people building it https://linear.app/now/sharing-growth-with-the-people-building-linear

Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

In this role, you will be a front-line manager to a group of Account Managers who are responsible for hunting, pitching, and expanding the existing customer base at Ramp.

You'll lead a group of 6-8 Account Managers, each carrying a book of 60-70 Enterprise customers with real latitude over how they grow it. This is a build role, not a maintain role: the playbooks, coaching systems, and performance bar you set are the ones this team runs on next year. Your ceiling is set by how well you turn individual AM judgment into a repeatable, scalable motion that grows the segment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build and run a high-performing team of 6-8 Account Managers - setting the bar for culture, morale, and daily execution.

- Get embedded in the relationships that matter. Engage directly with key customers and top accounts alongside your team, building trust and long-term partnership.

- Own the number. Manage quota performance and pipeline generation across your team to hit spend activation, product activation, retention, and expansion goals.

- Forecast and report team performance to senior leadership with clear-eyed visibility into what's working and what isn't.

- Hire and develop the next generation of AMs - training on product, buyer personas, competition, and tooling through role-plays, game film, and real deal work.

- Coach relentlessly. Run daily 1:1s, dissect call feedback, lead enablement sessions, and build career paths for every rep on your team.

- Turn what works into a system. Continuously refine team processes and tooling to improve output and efficiency as the segment scales.

- Represent Account Management cross-functionally, partnering with Sales, CX, CSM, Risk, and Product to remove blockers and drive outcomes.

WHAT YOU NEED

- Minimum 5 years of quota-carrying sales or account management experience as an individual contributor, with a proven, consistent track record of exceeding goals (new business or cross-sell/upsell experience mandatory)

- Minimum 5 years building and leading account management or sales teams, with a track record of exceeding goal (new business or cross-sell/upsell experience mandatory)

- Prior success in fast-paced, results-oriented GTM environments, ideally at SaaS or AI companies

- A genuine passion for hiring, with a thoughtful approach to talent development

- Ability to articulate contractual, technical, and financial value to customers, including C-Suite and executive leaders

- Strong track record negotiating, structuring, and executing complex agreements

- Proficiency with data analytics tools (Salesforce, Looker, Excel) and a bias toward using data to drive decisions

- Strong collaboration and influencing skills, backed by excellent communication and presentation ability.

- High agency and adaptability - no two days are the same, and the only constant is change

- Experience at a high-growth, top SaaS/AI startup

- Bachelor's degree from an accredited university

- Weekly coffee stipend

title: Brand Partnerships Manager
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is hiring a Brand Partnerships Manager to shape and accelerate our growth through strategic partnerships and collaborations.

You’ll build our brand partnerships strategy from the ground up: sourcing high-potential partners, developing relationships, structuring creative collaborations, and turning them into campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, and business growth.

Success in this role looks like building real, high-impact partnerships with tangible value for Ramp, our partners, and the audiences we reach together. The ideal candidate is a marketer who can also run a deal: you come up with the partnership, you know why it matters for the business, and you execute relentlessly to get it out the door. You should have an instinct for great ideas, a strong creative point of view, and a close read on what’s happening across media, sports, and culture. Most importantly, you’ve turned those ideas into campaigns that break through culture, get attention, and drive business outcomes.

Ramp is a place for people who move fast, take ownership, and are looking to do the best work of their careers. We want someone who can build this function out, bet on partners that matter, and create collaborations that move the needle and are unmistakably Ramp.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own Ramp’s brand partnerships program end to end: partner strategy, sourcing, negotiation, and execution.

- Find high-value partners across finance, sports, business, and media who can put Ramp in front of new audiences.

- Build a system for spotting and tracking emerging talent so we can place smart bets early. We sponsored Neal Shipley while he was still an amateur golfer, and TBPN in the very early days. We like spotting emerging brands and talent before everyone else does.

- Develop bold partnership concepts that tie into Ramp’s brand, product priorities, launches, and broader marketing campaigns.

- Lead deal strategy and negotiation, including pricing, asset packages, usage rights, exclusivity, deliverables, timelines, and contract terms.

- Work with teams across Ramp to run and test campaigns across paid, owned, and earned channels, so every partnership delivers both creative impact and business results.

- Manage active partnerships day to day. Keep deliverables on track, and keep finding new ways to work with existing partners so Ramp gets the most out of every relationship.

- Work closely with Ramp’s sales team to spot deals where a partner could help, and find timely, relevant ways to bring them in.

- Handle reporting for every partnership. Track delivery and performance, share what you’re learning, and recommend when to renew, expand, change, or end a deal.

- 5+ years of experience in brand marketing, influencer marketing, partnerships, or a related role.

- A track record of developing, negotiating, and executing high-profile brand, media, or strategic partnerships, ideally within a fast moving in-house team or at an agency. The ideal candidate has a builder mindset and is willing to challenge conventional approaches and take a first principles approach.

- Strong creative judgment, with the ability to spot culturally relevant ideas and turn them into partnerships and campaigns that earn attention.

title: Bilingual Account Executive, SME & Growth
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

About the team
Supporting bilingual customers is an important part of how the SME & Growth Business team at Airwallex helps small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) thrive in the global economy. We are a passionate group of collaborators and business champions who combine deep financial expertise with a growth mindset, working closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored solutions that streamline cross-border payments and unlock new revenue streams. As a team, we are driven by a desire to make a positive impact and are constantly innovating to find new ways to support the success of our SME customers across Canada.

What you’ll do
You will play a key role in helping Airwallex grow its presence with bilingual customers, particularly in Quebec and across Canada. You will establish meaningful and challenging conversations with C-level and company founders that lead you to establish strong relationships and close big deals with these companies. You will be fully responsible for prospecting leads, activating your network, and creating business connections across English- and French-speaking markets. In the long term, this role will have a hybrid in-office component.

This role is based in Toronto, Canada, with 3 days a week in our downtown office.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Implement a multithreaded outbound sales approach for prospecting leads, activating your networking and creating business connections

- Own the outbound sales process from end-to-end

- Be an expert in all aspects of the Airwallex platform, our customers, and our solutions

- Clearly communicate the challenges in the cross-border payments industry and the value of Airwallex solutions to empower companies to go global

- Negotiate partnership agreements and commercials contracts in conjunction with legal, finance and strategy through to execution

- Help craft and redesign processes to ensure Airwallex can move quickly and succeed at scale

- Be a team player and set the standard for our entire SME sales function

WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

- Fluency in both French and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

- 2 years of outbound sales in SaaS or high-tech growth companies

- A proven record of exceeding targets in outbound B2B sales and experience selling solutions ideally in our target verticals, including e-commerce, marketplaces, and SaaS/Technology

- Strategic thinker and able to drive 'partnership' conversations vs. 'sales' conversations - Solution Oriented

- A FIO (Figure It Out) attitude and are willing to do whatever is necessary to achieve results

- Experience building pipeline and closing business with customers in Quebec or other French-speaking markets in Canada

Preferred qualifications:

- B2B Fintech / Payments experience

- Experience selling into finance departments

- Experience working in a fast-paced environment, particularly in 0-1 mode (e.g., helped to launch and grow a new product or region)

description:

Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Total Rewards is central to how Airwallex attracts, motivates and retains talent across the Americas. As the first Total Rewards team member based in the region, you'll build the operating model for Americas rewards while partnering with a small, globally distributed team.

- Own the Americas Total Rewards program across the US and Canada, Brazil and Mexico, with end-to-end responsibility for compensation, benefits design and equity programs.

- Lead compensation planning, benchmarking and pay decisions, including salary structures, geographic differentials, market positioning, merit and bonus cycles, and offer guidance.

- Design benefits programs and lead plan renewals, broker negotiations and transition project management with local People Operations partners, balancing employee value, cost and regional requirements.

- Partner with the global Total Rewards team on US stock plan administration, including RSUs, ISOs, ESPP mechanics, vesting, taxation, grant execution, plan governance and clear employee communications.

- Lead global and regional Total Rewards projects, including the Americas rollout of the equity framework and IPO-readiness initiatives, from scoping and design through stakeholder alignment and implementation.

- Use market data, benchmarking and financial modeling to make recommendations, influence decisions and translate complex analysis for leaders, managers and employees.

- Partner closely with Talent Acquisition, People Partners, Payroll, Finance, Legal, Equity and executive leadership on compensation, organization decisions, systems, equity budgets, compliance and strategy.

- Build practical processes and documentation for Americas Total Rewards while working independently across time zones and helping establish a local operating model.

You'll work from our San Francisco office Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

ESSENTIALS

- 8+ years of experience in total rewards, compensation or benefits, including experience supporting employee populations across the Americas.

- Experience owning or building a complete Total Rewards program spanning compensation, benefits and equity.

- Experience designing benefits programs and managing plan renewals, including broker and insurance carrier negotiations; hands-on benefits administration isn’t the focus of this role.

- Strong compensation analytics capability, including market benchmarking, salary range architecture, geographic pay differentials, compensation cycles, modeling and projections.

- Experience making and communicating compensation decisions with senior leaders, People Partners, recruiters and employees.

- Working knowledge of US equity compensation and stock plan administration, including RSUs, ISOs, ESPP, vesting mechanics and the ability to explain these concepts plainly to non-specialists.

- Experience at a late-stage private, pre-IPO or recently public company, particularly through changes to an equity program or increased governance requirements.

- A track record of leading complex Total Rewards projects from design through implementation, bringing stakeholders with you and influencing without formal authority.

- Strong business partnering, judgement and communication skills, with the confidence to challenge decisions when they don’t align with strategy, data or compliance requirements.

- A builder mindset and the ability to work independently across time zones when there isn’t an established local playbook.

PREFERRED

- Experience supporting multi-region Total Rewards programs where the global framework is set outside your own time zone.

- Familiarity with compensation, equity and HR systems such as Carta, Shareworks, BambooHR or Workday.

- Experience using survey and benchmarking sources such as Radford, Compensia, Mercer or Aon.

- Experience with 401(k), ERISA, US pay transparency, benefits compliance or related US rewards requirements.

- Experience supporting IPO readiness, equity plan governance, tax reporting or SEC-related considerations.

- Experience building a Total Rewards function or major program from the ground up in a high-growth technology, fintech or payments company.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

- You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

- You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

- You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

- You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

- You come to the table with a point of view, not just a problem.

LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

People and Talent is where the people infrastructure of a genuinely global company gets built. Our company is growing fast across multiple regions, hiring in highly competitive markets, while many of the systems and programs themselves are still being designed. That means the job is not to run established processes well — it is to define what great looks like for a global fintech at this stage of growth, and then build it.

This is a team for the ambitious who want the resources and scope of a scaled business combined with the creative latitude of one still being shaped. If you want to influence how a truly global company hires, grows, and builds a talent dense organization, this is where people work becomes company-building work.

All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. title: GTM Partnerships Manager (Corp Sec & Accounting Firms), SME & Growth
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The GTM Partnerships team at Airwallex is focused on building and scaling partnerships that accelerate customer acquisition, deepen ecosystem reach, and unlock long-term growth. In Singapore, this role will support our SME & Growth segment by owning a curated, high-value portfolio of corporate secretarial and accounting firm partners.

Success in this role comes primarily from deep, hands-on management of your existing book, complemented by growing share of wallet with those partners and hunting new high-priority partners to fill any gaps.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As the GTM Partnerships Manager (Priority), you will own a curated portfolio of roughly 50–60 corporate secretarial and accounting firm partners in Singapore. The majority of your time will go toward managing and growing this existing book — deepening relationships, increasing share of wallet, and preventing churn — with the remainder spent proactively hunting new high-potential partners to fill any gaps in your portfolio.

This role is based in Singapore.

Responsibilities:

- Own and manage a curated portfolio of ~50–60 priority corporate secretarial and accounting firm partners through deep, 1:1 relationship management — the core focus of this role

- Grow share of wallet with existing partners through tailored campaigns, proposals, and co-marketing initiatives that drive incremental referral volume and conversion

- Prevent churn and reactivate dormant partners within your own book before they require broader escalation

- Fill gaps in your portfolio by proactively hunting and acquiring new high-potential partners through networking events, referrals, and your own sourced channels

- Host and represent Airwallex at networking, partner enablement, and client enablement events to build pipeline and strengthen existing relationships

- Own partner performance end-to-end — from referral generation through to conversion — partnering closely with sales, operations, and marketing to close the loop

- Negotiate partnership terms, incentive structures, and co-marketing commitments directly with partners

- Maintain accurate CRM records and forecast referral and revenue performance for your portfolio

- Contribute market and partner insights to senior GTM Partnerships stakeholders on how to strengthen the priority partner tier

WHO YOU ARE

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

- 5+ years of experience in channel partnerships, business development, or account management, ideally within or adjacent to the corporate secretarial, accounting, or professional services industry in Singapore

- Proven experience designing and executing tailored campaigns or partnership proposals for individual partners

- Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills, with a track record of closing and growing partner agreements

- Primarily a “farmer” mindset — skilled at deepening existing relationships and growing share of wallet — complemented by a “hunter” instinct for proactively prospecting and acquiring net-new partners to fill portfolio gaps, e.g. through networking events, referrals, or your own sourced channels

- Demonstrated ability to own numbers end-to-end, from referral generation through to conversion, and to work cross-functionally with sales, operations, and marketing to do so

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Preferred qualifications:

- Existing network of relationships within the corporate secretarial / accounting firm community in Singapore

- Comfortable hosting or leading networking, partner enablement, or client enablement events

- Familiarity with CRM tools and forecasting referral / revenue pipelines

- Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth technology or fintech environment

We provide trusted guidance across the business, strengthen our regulatory and compliance framework, and promote a culture of compliance, sound risk management, and ethical conduct across Airwallex.

The Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) team is a strategically important second-line function, responsible for Airwallex’s Global AML/CTF and Sanctions frameworks. As Airwallex expands into new markets and deepens its engagement with regulators and financial institution partners, the FCC team helps manage complex financial crime risks across a growing global business.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Global Sanctions Manager, you will have the unique opportunity to drive high-impact global initiatives to ensure Airwallex successfully navigates the world of economic sanctions as the business and compliance function continue to scale. As a truly global company building cross-border financial infrastructure, sanctions compliance is a critical component to our long term success. Come join a team where you will see the immediate impact of your work.

- Act as a Sanctions Subject Matter Expert (SME) and serve as the ultimate second-line escalation point for highly complex, ambiguous sanctions matches, special investigations, and potential block-and-reject reporting.

- Own and maintain Global Sanctions procedures and provide effective second-line oversight of sanctions controls implemented by first-line teams.

- Compile management information and develop comprehensive dashboards to track the health and effectiveness of the sanctions compliance program.

- Assist in the maintenance, tuning, and optimization of sanctions screening technologies, list management systems, and case management platforms to ensure alerts are accurate and efficient.

- Partner with Risk Product teams to design, evaluate, and implement product-specific sanctions controls that align with global regulatory requirements.

- Monitor global sanctions and export-control developments, translating complex regulatory changes into practical, scalable control enhancements and delivering targeted training across the business.

- Deliver tailored sanctions training and written regulatory updates to Global Airwallex teams, covering alert adjudication, escalation procedures, and critical policy changes.

- Lead responses to banking partners and other external stakeholders on sanctions-related inquiries and due diligence reviews.

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

- 7+ years of relevant experience, preferably at a fintech, payments company, or large financial institution specializing in sanctions.

- Demonstrated understanding of US sanctions and industry best practices pertaining to economic sanctions; knowledge of global regimes other than the US is a plus.

- Experience operationalizing sanctions controls in collaboration with technological teams, including experience managing lists.

- Strong project management skills and ability to multitask in a fast paced environment.

- Ability to understand and assess a wide variety of complex commercial transactions and products.

- Highly motivated self-starter, able to work independently while collaborating and coordinating as part of a global program.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to provide viable recommendations and solutions to audiences across different geographies.
