title: Product Designer
description:
B2B go-to-market software has historically been where design ambition goes to die.

The tools are powerful but joyless. Dense, generic, admin-heavy, and built for process more than delight. Meanwhile, the best product companies have raised everyone’s expectations for what business software can feel like: fast, opinionated, elegant, and genuinely useful.

AI gives us a chance to rebuild the category from first principles.

Mutiny is building the agentic GTM platform that helps revenue teams create the work they need to win. Sellers and marketers should not have to wait on five internal teams to move a deal forward. They should have a bench of AI teammates that understands the account, knows what good looks like, and gets sharper every week. We’re looking for a founding staff designer to define what that feels like.

This is not a role where you plug into a mature design system, clean product rituals, or a settled category. You’ll help invent the product language for AI-native GTM software: the interaction model, the creative standards, the feedback loops, the system, and the taste bar for what the agent produces.

The design problem

Our job is to make AI output that a great seller, marketer, or designer would actually be proud to put in front of a million-dollar account. That requires more than a chat box. It requires data, memory, taste, brand intelligence, workflow design, and a UI simple enough for every rep to use daily but powerful enough to support an entire revenue motion.

Some of the questions you’ll help answer

* How should a seller direct an agent without becoming the agent’s project manager?
* How do we make generated work feel on-brand without making it dull?
* What does editing look like when the object is not a static page, but an intelligent system that can regenerate, revise, explain, and learn?
* How do we give users confidence and control without burying them in settings?
* How do we turn taste into a system the product can improve over time?

What you’ll work on

*Product surfaces and flows

* Design focused parts of Mutiny’s product experience: creating assets, reviewing AI output, editing generated work, managing brand guidance, and helping users get from idea to finished work faster. You’ll work closely with senior design, product, and engineering, but your work will ship.

*Visual quality

* Make the product feel sharper, clearer, and more polished. This could mean improving layouts, hierarchy, typography, spacing, empty states, generated assets, or the small details that make software feel excellent.

*Systems and patterns

* Help build the components and reusable patterns that let the product move faster without becoming messy. You don’t need to have led a design system before, but you should be excited to think beyond one screen at a time.

*AI-native interactions

* Explore new UI patterns for working with agents, generated content, flexible canvases, and product experiences that learn from user preferences over time. You’ll help us figure out what feels intuitive, powerful, and not like every other chat-based AI product.

Who you are

We're looking for a designer who embodies the following

* Early career, high slope. You might be a new grad or a few years into your career. What matters most is that you learn unusually fast, care deeply about the work, and show signs of becoming excellent.
* Comfortable making reasonable decisions. You don’t need perfect information before moving forward. You ask good questions, use judgment, and can make progress even when the path is not fully defined.
* Strong product instincts. You care about how the thing works, not just how it looks. You notice when a flow feels confusing, when an AI output feels generic, when a screen is trying to do too much, or when a detail actually matters.
* Fast, open, and coachable. You show work early, take feedback seriously, and come back with something better. You want to be pushed, and you want to get very good.
* Energized by the pace. We work in person in New York City, five days a week, and the product is moving quickly. The right person will find that intense, clarifying, and fun.

This role is probably not for you

If these are the things that make you excited

* You want a mature design org with established rituals and clean handoffs.
* You prefer to receive scoped requirements rather than shape the problem.
* You believe business software just needs to be usable.
* You are interested in AI as a feature, but not as a new material for designing software.
* You want remote-first work. We work together in person in New York City because the product is being invented through fast loops between design, engineering, founders, customers, and the product itself.

Why Mutiny

Mutiny relaunched in April as an agent-first platform for GTM teams. Anthropic has showcased Mutiny as a leader in AI GTM, and customers including Uber, Rippling, Snowflake, GitLab, and Figma use Mutiny to create customer-facing work faster.

We’re backed by Sequoia, YC, Insight, and world-class GTM operators. More importantly, we’re building for a moment when the shape of work is changing fast and the design patterns have not been settled yet.

*If you want to help define what high-taste AI software feels like for revenue teams, this is that seat.

* Compensation Range: $160 - $220

title: Junior ui/ux product designer

title: Junior Designer - Newton Baby
description:
*THE BIGGEST NAME IN HOME. THE BOLDEST TEAM IN E-COMMERCE.*

Ashley Digital is the e-commerce engine behind Ashley Furniture Industries — one of the most recognized home brands in the world. As the world's largest manufacturer of home furnishings and the largest furniture store brand in North America, Ashley is in a category unto itself. Our team sits at the intersection of world-class retail and digital innovation, driving the e-commerce experience for millions of customers across every platform and touchpoint. If you’ve shopped online for a mattress in the last decade, there’s a good chance you’ve already experienced our award-winning Nectar Sleep and DreamCloud. We're a fast-moving, highly collaborative team operating at a transformational moment, and we're charged with shaping how people discover, explore, and buy home furnishings. Our expertise spans data science, performance marketing, product, and creative, and our work reaches millions of customers every day. It's a rare combination: the energy of a tech company, the stability of an industry leader, and the opportunity to build something truly significant. If you're energized by transformation, collaboration, and meaningful impact at scale, Ashley Digital is where ambition meets opportunity.

*To be considered for this remote opportunity, you must reside and be authorized to work within the United States.*

Job Overview:
-------------

We’re on a mission to help every family sleep better, starting with the littlest sleepers, and our Creative has to move as fast as we grow. We’re looking for a Junior Designer to join our growth creative team, focused on Newton Baby, our brand of breathable crib mattresses and baby sleep essentials. You’ll turn real parent and creator footage into scroll-stopping ad content that speaks to families at one of the most important moments of their lives. This is a hands-on, high-output role for someone who loves editing, thrives on fast iteration, and wants to help build the next generation of DTC advertising for a brand parents trust. You’ll take raw UGC and creator footage and shape it into finished ad variants, working from briefs, testing constantly, and keeping pace with a high-volume cadence of dozens of new ads and edits every week.

What You'll Be Doing:
---------------------

* Design and edit static and video ad creative across our bedding and mattress brands, for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube
* Transform UGC and creator footage into polished, on-brand ad variants
* Execute edit requests and fast iterations from the growth team
* Keep assets organized, well-named, and QA'd in Monday.com, Frame.io, and Aprimo
* Templatize evergreen creative for recurring requests, so the team can move even faster
* Partner with creatives, copywriters, and Directors to bring concepts and scripts to life across multiple brands
* Uphold each brand's identity — typography, tone, and visual style — while flexing between them

The responsibilities described above are not exhaustive. You may be asked, from time to time and as reasonably required by business needs, to perform other duties consistent with your skills and role, including work for or on behalf of our related entities. This job description does not constitute a contract of employment and may be modified at any time, subject to applicable law.

How We'll Measure Success:
--------------------------

* Volume and turnaround time on ad creative requests
* Assets shipped per week against backlog
* Creative performance (CTR, CPC, ROAS, ad spend) on shipped ads, in partnership with growth and media buying
* QA accuracy — low error and revision rate on everything you ship

* 1–2 years of design and video editing experience (agency, freelance, or in-house)

* Familiarity with CapCut, ElevenLabs, and other fast-turn social content tools
* A production mindset: you’re energized by high volume and quick turnarounds, and you favor iteration over perfection
* Strong organizational skills that let you juggle multiple asset requests without dropping a thread
* A portfolio that shows your range (required)

Nice to have:
-------------

* An instinct for what makes performance and DTC creative convert: hooks, pacing, and UGC style
* Experience editing UGC and creator content specifically for paid social
* Familiarity with baby, parenting, home, or other DTC e-commerce brands
* Basic motion graphics skills

title: Product Design Student Intern, Summer 2027
description:

--------

Powered by one of the largest global newsrooms in sports media, The Athletic brings sports fans the most comprehensive stories about the teams, sports and athletes they love. The mission of The Athletic’s internship program is meant to attract and develop the industry’s next stars. The intern will help shape our most informative coverage while helping to advance our goal to be the top destination for sports news around the world.

*About the Role*
----------------

The Athletic is accepting applications for its Leon H. Carter newsroom internship, a 12-week program either remote or based in New York City, which will run from *June 2027 to August 2027.* Dates of internship are subject to change.

The intern will be embedded on our Product Design team, which will expose the intern to every facet of the product development and design process. The mission of The Athletic’s internship program is to attract and develop the industry’s next stars. The intern will help shape our most informative coverage while helping to advance our goal to be the top destination for sports news around the world.

title: Junior Retention Manager - iGaming (Player CRM)
description:
Remote | Full-time | iGaming | Junior role | Player CRM and campaign operations
The opportunity
Start or grow your career in iGaming CRM by helping deliver player communication and retention campaigns. You will work with the practical details that make campaigns effective: accurate segments, clear timing, careful quality checks, and useful performance reporting.
You do not need to have owned a retention strategy before. Experience with CRM, email marketing, lifecycle campaigns, or marketing operations can give you a strong starting point; iGaming experience is a plus.
What you will do
-Support player journeys and CRM campaigns across email, SMS, push, and other channels used by the product.
-Help organize audience segments, campaign content, timing, and required setup with the relevant teams.
-Check campaign details before launch and follow up on issues that could affect the player experience.
-Track campaign performance and prepare clear summaries of key results.
-Help compare results across segments and campaigns and flag patterns worth investigating.
-Maintain campaign calendars, briefs, and documentation so the team can see what ran and what was learned.
-Gradually take on more campaign planning and optimization as you build product and CRM knowledge.
What makes this a strong starting point
You will learn how an iGaming product communicates with players and how CRM activity connects to engagement, retention, and long-term value. The work is close to real campaigns and real performance data, giving you a practical path toward owning larger campaigns and lifecycle journeys.
What you bring
-At least 6 months of practical exposure to CRM, email marketing, lifecycle campaigns, marketing operations, or a related field.
-Comfort working with spreadsheets and checking details carefully.
-Curiosity about campaign performance and willingness to learn basic metrics such as engagement, conversion, retention, and reactivation.
-Clear communication, organized follow-through, and care for the end-user experience.
-Previous iGaming experience is a plus, not a requirement. Familiarity with a CRM or marketing automation platform is useful; GR8 Tech is a plus. English at B1 level is required.

We are seeking a motivated Junior Support Engineer to help maintain the reliability and performance of a global digital testing platform. In this role, you will support cloud-based and on-premises infrastructure, troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues, and respond to incidents affecting critical services. You will work closely with technical teams and data center personnel across international locations to diagnose problems and restore service quickly. From monitoring alerts to customer-reported incidents, you will take ownership of support tickets and follow them through to resolution. This opportunity is ideal for an early-career IT professional eager to develop practical troubleshooting skills in a collaborative, fast-paced technical environment. You will also contribute to improving operational processes, documentation, and service reliability while learning from experienced engineering teams.

Triage and respond to incident and outage tickets generated by automated monitoring systems or customer reports.

Track support tickets through resolution, ensuring issues are handled within established service-level agreement (SLA) response times.

Collaborate with internal technical teams and escalate incidents appropriately when additional expertise is required.

Coordinate with global sites, data center technicians, and on-site support personnel to troubleshoot and recover unresponsive hardware and services.

Work with cloud and on-premises infrastructure teams to investigate technical disruptions and restore service.

Troubleshoot mobile device hardware, software, operating system, and network connectivity issues.

Document troubleshooting workflows, recurring problems, and operational playbooks to improve team effectiveness.

Support or recommend device deployments, upgrades, and ongoing maintenance activities.

Communicate clearly with customers, technical colleagues, and other stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle.

Between 0 and 2 years of experience in technical support or a comparable role.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent qualifications.

*

Basic knowledge of incident response involving network and software infrastructure.

Understanding of networking fundamentals, including LAN, WAN, VLANs, firewalls, switches, and wireless access points.

Familiarity with operating systems such as Linux, macOS, Android, and iOS.

Knowledge of command-line tools and Unix-like environments, including SSH, SCP, Bash, cURL, Vim, Python terminal tools, ping, and tcpdump.

Familiarity with collaboration and issue-tracking tools such as Google Workspace, Jira, Slack, and Zoom.

*

Understanding of service desks, SLAs, escalation procedures, on-call rotations, and common workflow practices such as sprints and Kanban.

*

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a systematic approach to identifying root causes and resolving issues.

*

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

*

A proactive, technology-oriented mindset and willingness to learn new tools, systems, and processes.

*

A customer-focused attitude and commitment to resolving support requests in a timely and effective manner.

*

Strong prioritisation and time-management skills, with the ability to assess requests according to urgency and business impact.

*

Willingness to cross-train with other IT team members and contribute to a broader shared knowledge base.

*

A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.

Opportunity to gain hands-on experience supporting global cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

Practical exposure to incident management, networking, mobile devices, and systems troubleshooting.

Collaboration with experienced technical and engineering teams across international locations.

title: Junior+ ML Engineer (Model Architecture, Training and Edge Optimisation)
description:
Full-time
Salary: $1000—$1,500/month, reviewed after 3 months based on delivery

Position is for recent university graduates majored in Machine Learning, Mathematics or related field.

Prior work experience is not required, but deep understanding of machine learning and mathematics under the bonnet is.

About CubicMind AI
CubicMind AI Ltd is a UK deep tech startup building a small plug-in device that operates any computer like a person: it reads the screen, listens to the user, and clicks and types to complete tasks. Everything runs on the device itself, with no cloud.

cubicmind-ai.com
We design our own models rather than wrapping someone else’s. That includes transformer and non-transformer architectures, built around what runs fast on edge hardware, and sometimes trained from scratch.
About the role
You will work on designing, training and optimising the models that power the device: screen understanding, action prediction and efficient on-chip inference.
This is research-heavy engineering. You will work on model architecture, training runs, attention and memory bottlenecks, low-bit compression, and getting models to run correctly on real hardware.

What you will do

* Design and implement new model architectures in PyTorch, both transformer-based and beyond
* Train models, sometimes from scratch, and run experiments to compare architectures
* Build training and evaluation pipelines on screen-understanding and computer-control data
* Profile latency, memory use and KV-cache behaviour on long, high-resolution screen inputs
* Compress models for edge chips using quantisation (INT8/INT4), pruning and distillation
* Export models to low-level runtimes and fix unsupported operators
* Work with our C++ team to get models running efficiently on the device

Requirements

* Deep architectural understanding of Transformers and Attention: you know the mathematical and operational differences between MHA, MQA, GQA, FlashAttention, and linear attention variants; you understand KV-cache scaling and memory access bottlenecks.
* Low-level PyTorch fluency: writing custom PyTorch modules, implementing non-standard forward/backward logic, vectorised tensor operations
* Experience with model training & convergence: stability tricks, learning rate schedules, gradient clipping, mixed-precision training (BF16/FP16), and diagnosing loss spikes or exploding/vanishing gradients.
* Mathematical foundation: comfortable with high-dimensional linear algebra, matrix calculus, multivariable optimization, and probability theory.
* Understanding of model compression: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) vs Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), outlier activations, etc
* Сommit full-time

Nice to have

* Experience with vision transformers or vision-language models
* Interest in non-transformer architectures (state-space models, linear attention, recurrent designs)
* Experience exporting to ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO or NPU toolchains
* Basic C++, enough to read inference code

What we offer

* Real ownership of the core models in a hardware product built from the ground up
* Work directly with the founder, with no bureaucracy
* $1000—$1,500/month depending on experience, reviewed after 3 months based on results
* Fully remote, judged on results, not hours logged. Flexible schedule

title: Junior Technical Support Engineer
description:
Everbridge, a global leader in critical event management, is seeking a *Junior Technical Support Engineer* to help customers resolve technical issues with Everbridge products. In this role, you’ll investigate and troubleshoot support requests, communicate clearly with customers, and guide each issue through resolution or a well-documented escalation.

This is an early-career opportunity for someone who enjoys solving problems, helping customers, and learning new technologies. You’ll work with customers, teammates, and internal technical teams while building expertise in Everbridge products and the systems they rely on.

This is remote/home based position to be based anywhere in Canada.

What you'll do:
---------------

* Respond to customer requests through support tickets, phone calls, and other supported channels.
* Manage assigned tickets from initial investigation through resolution or escalation, keeping customers informed along the way.
* Ask focused questions and gather the details needed to understand the issue, assess its impact, and identify possible causes.
* Troubleshoot and reproduce issues using available tools, logs, documentation, and test environments.
* Investigate common application, configuration, browser, network, and environment-related issues.
* Explain troubleshooting steps, findings, recommendations, and resolutions in clear language for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Keep complete, accurate ticket records, including customer communications, investigation steps, findings, and resolution details.
* Monitor and prioritize multiple requests according to urgency, severity, and customer impact.
* Escalate issues that need additional expertise, with clear findings and supporting documentation.
* Collaborate with peers, mentors, Engineering, and other internal teams to investigate and resolve customer issues.
* Use internal documentation, knowledge base articles, community resources, and support tools to resolve requests efficiently.
* Contribute reusable solutions and troubleshooting guidance to the Support knowledge base.
* Participate in the incoming support queue and provide phone coverage as needed.
* Join the on-call rotation and provide occasional after-hours or weekend support for critical incidents, high-impact events, or increased customer demand.

What you'll bring:

* 0–2 years of experience in technical support, help desk, customer-facing technology, or a related role.
* A bachelor’s degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, technical training, and practical experience.
* Experience providing customer service or technical assistance in a professional setting.
* Experience with SaaS products, web applications, or enterprise software.
* Exposure to APIs, single sign-on (SSO), networking, application troubleshooting, or related technologies.

Desired skills
--------------

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
* A customer-focused approach, with an emphasis on responsiveness, professionalism, and a positive support experience.
* Methodical troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* The ability to prioritize competing requests and manage multiple tasks.
* Sound judgment when working independently, including knowing when to seek help or escalate.
* The ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
* Foundational knowledge of PC operating systems and desktop troubleshooting.

* Basic understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP and common network components.
* Awareness of SaaS, cloud-hosted, and on-premises application environments.
* Familiarity with application logs and their use in troubleshooting.
* Foundational understanding of APIs, integrations, authentication, and SSO.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new products, technologies, support tools, and troubleshooting methods.

title: Junior Developer
description:
*1Password is growing.* We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

*About 1Password*

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We are excited to welcome a Software Developer to join our new Data Security team here at 1Password, whose mission is to safeguard 1Password’s foundation by designing, implementing, and maintaining cryptographic systems and practices that ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information across our products.

As part of our Security Department, the Developer will be partially responsible for the underlying cryptography across our products. You’ll build cryptographic libraries and implement the latest algorithms directly into our client applications with security, performance and usability in mind. You’ll develop proof-of-concepts and implement new industry specifications into code. You’ll also conduct code and design reviews to ensure good cryptographic hygiene and standards across our codebase.

*How we’re using AI today*

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

*What we're looking for:*

*

You have 0-2+ years of experience in software development.

*

You have a passion for and strong experience with security development best practices, coding standards, and design patterns.

*

You have a basic understanding of modern cryptographic algorithms, trade-offs and implementation considerations gained from real world experience.

*

You work well in a team environment with positive communications amongst a variety of technical and non-technical stakeholders.

*

You have proven experience in implementing testing methodologies and debugging techniques to ensure high-quality code.

*

You’re adaptable and resilient, thriving in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities.

*Bonus points for:*

*

Experience with implementing industry standards into new libraries or codebases.

*

Experience with Rust and/or Golang, or a demonstrated ability to pick up new languages quickly.

*What you can expect:*

*

Work with a small team of security developers who are specialists in Rust and Golang Security.

*

Develop cryptographic or other security libraries to share common security-critical code across our applications.

*

Assist in security design efforts or scoping initiatives for new features, particularly with heavy cryptographic components.

*

Assess and take appropriate steps to resolve new security vulnerabilities across our applications.

*

Implement new security features for the next generation of 1Password.

*

Demonstrate leadership in security development and act as a trusted point of contact for management and other developers.

*

Work with a variety of teams across our hybrid core architecture, including Design, Product and Product Engineering.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $100,000 USD and $140,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $85,000 CAD and $119,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

*Our culture*
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

*How we work with AI*
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

description:

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. *Tether Evolution* : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
------------

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?
---------------------------------------

About the job
-------------

The Keet engine team works on the core that makes Keet tick: connecting peers, replicating data, syncing rooms, and keeping calls and file transfers fast and reliable across every kind of network. We're looking for an organized, curious *Junior Project Manager* to help keep that work moving.

You'll work closely with a globally distributed team of senior engineers, help turn priorities into clear plans, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks between releases. This is a great role for someone early in their career who wants to grow into technical project or product management in a deeply technical, open-source environment.

Responsibilities
----------------

*

Track engine work across sprints and releases, keeping issues, milestones, and roadmaps current

*

Run or support stand-ups, planning sessions, and retrospectives across time zones (mostly async)

*

Coordinate between the engine team, Keet app/UI developers, and QA so dependencies are visible early

*

Write clear status updates, release notes, and meeting summaries

*

Help triage bug reports and user feedback, and route them to the right engineers

*

Spot risks and blockers early and help the team resolve them

*

Keep internal documentation and processes tidy and easy to follow

Requirements
------------

Mandatory:
----------

*

1–2 years of experience in project coordination, project management, or a similar role (internships and open-source involvement count)

*

Excellent written English communication; you can explain technical progress clearly and concisely

*

Highly organized, with strong attention to detail and follow-through

*

Comfortable working with engineers and learning technical concepts quickly

*

Experience with issue trackers and project tools (e.g. GitHub Issues/Projects, Jira, Linear)

*

Self-starter who thrives in a fully remote, async-first team

Preferred:
----------

*

Basic understanding of networking or distributed systems concepts (P2P, DHTs, NAT traversal, replication)

*

Familiarity with software development lifecycles, Git, and release processes

*

Some exposure to JavaScript/ or experience working alongside a dev team

*

Interest in privacy, decentralization, or open-source software

*

Agile/Scrum knowledge or a certification (PSM, CAPM, etc.)

*

Experience working across many time zones

*Important information for candidates*
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

*

*Apply only through our official channels.* We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

*

*Verify the recruiter’s identity.* All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

*

*Be cautious of unusual communication methods.* We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

*

*Double-check email addresses.* All communication from us will come from emails ending in *@* *or @*

*

*We will never request payment or financial details.* If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

*When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.*

title: Junior ASO Manager
Junior QA engineer
description:
*Skyeng — крупнейшая в Восточной Европе онлайн-школа английского языка.*

Мы ищем на постоянную работу Тестировщика, который поможет нам в тестировании многочисленного функционала сервиса - CRM системы, кабинетов пользователей и др.

Наш бизнес - это связывать учителей и учеников друг с другом, предоставляя им удобные инструменты для работы.

* Каждый год мы вырастаем в три раза и планируем это делать как минимум несколько лет.
* Мы операционно прибыльны, в нас инвестируют крупнейшие фонды.
* Нынешняя IT-команда составляет более 50 человек и постоянно расширяется.
* Мы предлагаем удаленную работу и платим выше рынка.

*Необходимый общий опыт в тестировании— не менее 6 месяцев.*

Вам будет необходимо проводить тестирование отдельных задач в тестовом и боевом окружениях, покрытие тест-кейсами функционала системы, проверки входящих баг-репортов из tech support. Мы ждем от вас желание понимать то, что вы делаете, в том числе предлагать свои варианты реализации там, где это необходимо.

Мы работаем в московском часовом поясе, разговариваем в Slack и в Hangouts, пишем документацию в Confluence, задачи складываем в Jira, код в GitHub, тест-кейсы и сьюты в Testrail.

*Что нужно, чтобы у нас работать:*

* Иметь опыт тестирования frontend-части клиентских приложений.
* Знать про граничные значения, типы вводимых данных, необходимость соответствия дизайн-макетам в тестировании.
* Понимать, что такое регрессия, smoke/UAT-тестирование, positive/negative тест-кейсы, тест-сьюты, тест-раны
* Обязательно хорошо ориентироваться в Chrome Devtools

*Условия:*

* Работа в самой большой онлайн-школе английского в Восточной Европе (если вам важны регалии).
* В Skyeng у вас будет большая свобода действий и широкий круг задач. Не соскучитесь.
* Мы предлагаем вам расти вместе со школой. Skyeng растет в 3 раза в год, сотрудники растут быстрее. Наши амбиции огромны, возможности для развития и творчества безграничны.
* Skyeng — это уникальное сочетание стабильности и движухи. Мы прибыльны и сами зарабатываем себе на развитие. Мы по-прежнему стартап с планами захватить мир, поэтому бежим быстрее паровоза.
* Мы дадим вам 50% скидку на обучение английскому в нашей школе.
* Если вы в Москве, то мы работаем из нашего нового крутого офиса на Таганской.
* Если вы не в Москве, то можно работать удаленно.

title: Junior Customer Service Representative
description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.

We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.

We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.

*Job Description*
-----------------

As a *Junior Customer Representative* , you will be the first point of contact for our customers, supporting them in *Polish and English* via phone and digital channels. This is a great opportunity to start your career in an *international financial environment* , gain valuable customer service experience, and grow within a structured organization.

What you will do
----------------

* Provide high-quality customer support for banking and card-related inquiries
* Handle incoming calls and written requests from customers in Polish and English
* Resolve customer issues during the first contact whenever possible
* Support customers with account-related questions, payments, billing and card services
* Escalate more complex cases to dedicated teams when required
* Maintain accurate documentation in internal systems
* Build positive and professional relationships with customers

What we are looking for
-----------------------

* Very good command of *Polish (C1)* and *English (B2)* both written and spoken
* Secondary education (high school diploma) – students and graduates welcome
* Customer-oriented mindset and willingness to learn
* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Basic computer skills (MS Office, ability to navigate systems)
* Ability to work with procedures and deadlines

Nice to have
------------

* First experience in customer service, call center or banking
* Interest in financial products and customer support

What we offer
-------------

* Stable employment in a recognizable international company
* Full onboarding and paid training
* Clear career paths and internal development opportunities
* Friendly, supportive team environment
* Competitive salary and benefits package

This role is designated as home-based remote.

Accessibility
-------------

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need adjustments at any stage of the application or hiring process, please contact your recruiter for guidance and support.

Total Rewards
-------------

U.S. Bank is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices in line with local regulatory and legal requirements. Our total rewards approach is designed to attract, retain, and support top talent while ensuring equal pay for work of equal value.

We offer a market-competitive compensation package that includes:

*

*Clearly defined salary ranges* aligned with industry benchmarks and internal equity standards.

*

*Performance-based incentives* for eligible employees (as defined by relevant plan rules), awarded through transparent, objective criteria that recognize both individual and company performance.

*

*Inclusive equitable benefits* that are accessible to all employees and focused around our 3 main pillars of financial wellbeing, health & wellness).

*

*Continuous development opportunities* including training, education support, and career progression pathways based on inclusive and transparent criteria.

*

*Employee recognition programs* that celebrate achievements and milestones for all.

We regularly review our compensation and benefits to ensure they remain competitive, inclusive, and responsive to employee needs and market trends. Further details of the compensation package will be provided upon application.

We encourage candidates to explore the full value of our offer, including monetary and non-monetary benefits, at Employee benefits and development | U.S. Bank | Elavon.

Closing Date
------------

Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.

We aim to provide timely updates throughout the process and encourage early applications to ensure consideration.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
Junior Media Buyer
Junior IT Recruiter
description:
This is a remote position.

Website:

Experience Required: 1–3 years

Work Arrangement: Work from Home

Employment Type: Full-time

Salary: ₹1.2-1.5 LPA for the initial 12 months + Incentives

Salary After 1 Year: ₹2.5 LPA + Incentives

*Role Overview*

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Junior IT Recruiter to manage recruitment for technical roles. The ideal candidate should have experience in sourcing, screening, and coordinating IT professionals across different technologies and experience levels.

The candidate should be comfortable working in a remote environment, managing multiple job requirements, maintaining regular follow-ups, and delivering quality candidate profiles within agreed timelines.

Key Responsibilities

*

Understand technical job requirements and candidate specifications shared by hiring managers or clients.

*

Source suitable IT candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, job portals, professional networks, employee referrals, social media, and internal databases.

*

Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on technical skills, relevant experience, project exposure, location, availability, notice period, and compensation expectations.

*

Conduct initial screening calls to assess candidates’ communication skills, technical background, job interest, and overall suitability for the role.

*

Source candidates for IT roles such as Software Developers, Full Stack Developers, Frontend Developers, Backend Developers, Java Developers, Python Developers, React Developers, Angular Developers, DevOps Engineers, Cloud Engineers, QA Engineers, Data Analysts, UI/UX Designers, Business Analysts, and other technical positions.

*

Coordinate interviews between shortlisted candidates and hiring managers.

*

Follow up with candidates and stakeholders for interview availability, interview feedback, selection updates, documentation, and joining status.

*

Share candidate profiles in the required format, along with relevant details such as current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, location, and availability.

*

Maintain accurate candidate records, job status, interview schedules, sourcing details, and recruitment trackers using Zoho Recruit, ATS platforms, Excel, Google Sheets, or other relevant tools.

*

Build and maintain a strong database of IT professionals for current and future hiring requirements.

*

Ensure a positive candidate experience through clear, timely, and professional communication throughout the recruitment process.

*

Assist with offer coordination, document collection, background-verification follow-ups, and joining formalities when required.

*

Meet assigned sourcing, submission, interview, and closure targets.

*

Stay updated on current IT skills, technology trends, recruitment practices, and sourcing methods.

Requirements
------------

*

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

*

1–3 years of experience in IT recruitment, technical recruitment, talent acquisition, or staffing recruitment.

*

Experience in sourcing and hiring candidates for technical and IT roles.

*

Basic understanding of IT technologies, skills, job titles, and technical recruitment terminology.

*

Familiarity with technologies such as Java, Python, .NET, React, Angular, Node.js, SQL, AWS, Azure, DevOps, testing, data analytics, and cloud platforms is preferred.

*

Strong experience using LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, job portals, Boolean search, social-media sourcing, and referral-based recruitment.

*

Familiarity with Zoho Recruit, ATS, HRMS, CRM, or recruitment-tracking tools will be an added advantage.

*

Good verbal and written communication skills in English.

*

Strong follow-up, negotiation, coordination, time-management, and stakeholder-management skills.

*

Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple open requirements, and meet deadlines in a remote work environment.

*

High level of professionalism, ownership, attention to detail, and confidentiality.

Benefits
--------

If you have a passion for IT recruitment, candidate sourcing, and connecting skilled professionals with the right opportunities, we encourage you to apply for the Junior IT Recruiter role at FyerX.

title: Junior affiliate manager (support)
description:
Junior affiliate manager (support)
Розглянемо без досвіду!
Remote!

Ми — холдинг сфері аффілейт-маркетингу у вертикалі Crypto, який вже 5 років успішно працює на ринку. У нас власний нетворк та медіабаїнг команди, сильна аналітика та перевірені партнерські зв’язки. Ми створюємо ефективні рекламні кампанії та залучаємо якісний трафік на ТОП оффери в крипто-нішi.
Наша команда — це професіонали, які знають, як робити гроші в арбітражі.

Ми пропонуємо:
Власний медіабаїнг та нетворк.
Відпочинок та турбота: оплачувані відпустки, лікарняні й додаткові вихідні за потреби.
Інноваційне середовище: робота в сучасній і добре організованій інфраструктурі.
Мотивуюча команда: дружня атмосфера, підтримка і співпраця з талановитими колегами, завжди готовими допомогти.
Бонуси та визнання: премії та заохочення за високі досягнення і проявлену ініціативу.

Твої обов’язки:

Підтримка партнерів – оперативне вирішення питань, допомога з технічними та фінансовими аспектами роботи.
Аналіз і оптимізація трафіку – контроль якості, виявлення неефективних каналів.
Моніторинг офферів – перевірка доступності, актуальності умов, лімітів.
Робота з виплатами – допомога партнерам в отриманні виплат, контроль за розрахунками.
Зворотний зв’язок – консультування партнерів щодо умов офферів, інструментів.
Вирішення спірних ситуацій – взаємодія з партнерами щодо відхилених лідів, лімітів, виплат.
Взаємодія з внутрішніми відділами – технічна підтримка, бухгалтерія, відділ трафіку.
Пошук рішень для підвищення лояльності партнерів – покращення умов, бонусні програми.

Від тебе очікуємо:

Вміння працювати з Excel на крутому рівні.
Відповідальність та пунктуальність.
Увага до деталей і високий рівень самоорганізованості.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
*Що варто знати про SKELAR?*

Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми в пошуку *UI/UX Designer* , який не просто малює, а вирішує бізнес-виклики через дослідження, ідеї та результативний дизайн. *Формат роботи - ремоут.*

*Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі:*

*

Проєктування ефективних маркетингових воронок;

*

Створення user-flow на цільових сторінках;

*

Генерація гіпотез та їх валідація через велику кількість A/B тестів;

*

Аналіз воронок прямих та непрямих конкурентів;

*

Аналіз поведінки користувачів через внутрішні інструменти аналітики;

*

Тісна взаємодія з сильною командою дизайнерів, розробників та аналітиків.

*Що для нас важливо:*

*

Від 2х років досвіду в продуктовій компанії на позиції UX/UI, Product або Growth дизайнера;

*

Досвід з вебом - must, досвід з мобільними застосунками - буде плюсом;

*

Володіння Figma на високому рівні;

*

Знання основ композиції, типографіки та кольористики;

*

Бізнес-орієнтованість: дизайн не заради краси, а в першу чергу задля зростання конверсії;

*

Вміння структуровано подати інформацію: результати дослідження, презентація концепту, ідеї для брейншторму;

*

Вміння аргументувати свої рішення.

*Що ти отримаєш разом з нами:*

— Внутрішні клуби за професійними напрямками: маркетинг, розробка, фінанси, рекрутинг;
— Тренінги, курси, відвідування конференцій;
— Просторі та сучасні офіси у Києві та Варшаві;
— Медичне страхування, корпоративний лікар.

*У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:*

*

*SKELAR Platform*. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

*

*Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури.* Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

*

*Ексклюзивна доменна освіта.* Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

*

*Вплив на системну допомогу Україні.* Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці — і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави.

*

*Екосистема для продуктивної роботи.* Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат — з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше.

*

*Турбота про щоденний комфорт.* Сніданки, обіди, доступ до спортивних тренувань в Києві або часткова компенсація занять у Варшаві, медичне страхування, оплачувані відрядження, якщо специфіка ролі передбачає такі поїздки, корпоративні знижки від партнерів.

*Більше розповімо на нашій зустрічі-знайомстві. Запрошуємо будувати the next big everything у SKELAR разом!*

title: UI/UX Designer
description:

customizable sportsbook. Three of our stars — Turbo Games, Turbo Sportsbook and Turbo
Platform combine over 5 years of experience in the iGaming sphere ⭐

and contribute to the development of our products. You will be
responsible for designing user-friendly, engaging, and visually appealing interfaces that
deliver seamless experiences across web and mobile. If you are passionate about design
systems, usability, and working on innovative digital products — we’d love to meet you.

* Develop UX/UI solutions for web and mobile interfaces (desktop, tablet,

* Prepare high-quality mockups, prototypes, and support developers during

implementation.

testing.

user flows).

We offer:

🚀 Why us?
If you are looking for a friendly and ambitious product company that:

* Uses modern technologies,
* Values initiative and independence,
* Is focused on the constant development of the team and the product

Then we are waiting for you! 🤝

title: UI/UX Designer - Cloud Platform
description:
Ingenico is the global leader in payments acceptance solutions. As the trusted technology partner for merchants, banks, acquirers, ISVs, payment aggregators and fintech customers our world-class terminals, solutions and services enable the global ecosystem of payments acceptance. With 40 years of experience, innovation is integral to Ingenico’s approach and culture, inspiring our large and diverse community of experts who anticipate and help shape the evolution of commerce worldwide. At Ingenico, trust and sustainability are at the heart of everything we do.

We are looking for a *UI/UX Designer* to contribute to the design of user interfaces for our strategic cloud platform, including payment applications and device management solutions.

This role focuses on *strong execution, collaboration, and consistent application of our design system across products.*

------------------
*Responsibilities*
------------------

* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and development teams to design intuitive, scalable user interfaces for our cloud product portfolio
* Contribute to the evolution and consistent application of the cloud product design system, ensuring alignment with UX/UI guidelines
* Work with design and development teammates to ensure designs are feasible, well-documented, and implemented accurately
* Participate actively in agile ceremonies (reviews, refinements, retrospectives), providing design input aligned with user and business needs
* Support shared ownership of the design system by applying standards and patterns consistently across teams
* Identify design and technical constraints and help document components, patterns, and foundations to improve reusability
* Apply accessibility best practices and contribute to reducing design and technical debt
* Create high-quality UI/UX deliverables, including wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that are ready for development
* Clearly communicate design decisions and rationale to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

--------------

title: UI /UX Graphic Designer
description:
This is a remote position.
--------------------------

As a Remote UX/UI Graphic Designer in this role, you will have a pivotal responsibility in designing visually captivating and user-friendly interfaces for our digital products. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers, and fellow designers, you'll be instrumental in crafting designs that elevate user satisfaction and foster increased user engagement.

Requirements
------------

The requirements for a UX/UI Graphic Designer typically include a combination of educational qualifications, technical skills, design expertise, and personal qualities. Here is a list of common requirements for this role:

1. Educational Background:
Bachelor's Degree: A bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Interaction Design, or a related field is often preferred. However, some candidates may enter the field with relevant certifications and experience.

2. Technical Skills:

* *Graphic Design Tools:* Proficiency in graphic design software such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Sketch, Figma, or similar tools.
* *Prototyping Tools:* Experience in using prototyping tools like Figma, Sketch, InVision, or Adobe XD to create interactive prototypes and mockups.
* *Coding Skills (Optional):* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript can be valuable for understanding front-end development constraints and collaborating effectively with developers.

*3. UI/UX Design Expertise:*

* *User-Centered Design:* A strong understanding of user-centered design principles and the ability to prioritize user needs and preferences in the design process.
* *UI/UX Design Principles:* Proficiency in UI and UX design principles, including layout, color theory, typography, information architecture, and usability.
* *Wireframing and Prototyping:* Skill in creating wireframes and interactive prototypes to visualize and communicate design concepts effectively.
* *Responsive Design:* Ability to design interfaces that adapt seamlessly to various devices and screen sizes.
* *Interaction Design:* Experience in designing user interactions and micro-interactions to enhance the user experience.
* *Usability Testing:* Familiarity with usability testing methods and the ability to conduct tests to gather insights for design improvements.

*4. Soft Skills:*

* *Communication:* Excellent communication skills to present and explain design choices, share feedback, and collaborate effectively with team members.
* *Collaboration:* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills to work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers, and other designers.
* *Problem-Solving:* Critical thinking and problem-solving skills to address complex design challenges and find innovative solutions.
* *Adaptability:* Flexibility to adapt to changing project requirements and a willingness to learn and grow in a rapidly evolving field.
* *Attention to Detail:* Meticulous attention to detail to ensure that designs are pixel-perfect and align with brand guidelines.

* A strong portfolio showcasing your previous work, including a variety of projects that demonstrate your design skills, creativity, and ability to solve real-world design challenges.

*6. Experience:*

* Relevant work experience in UX/UI design, with a portfolio that reflects your design expertise and accomplishments.

*7. Empathy:*

* The ability to empathize with users to understand their needs, frustrations, and motivations, which is essential for creating user-centered designs.

*8. Continuous Learning:*

* A commitment to staying updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and design best practices to keep designs fresh and relevant.

Benefits
--------

* *Competitive Salary:* Remote UI/UX Graphic Designers often receive competitive salaries, reflecting their specialized skills and expertise.
* *Flexible Work Arrangements:* Remote work arrangements that allow designers to work from the comfort of their own location, offering a high degree of flexibility and work-life balance.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
UX/UI Designer

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced UX/UI Designer to support the design and modernization of digital products and applications for a large-scale federal healthcare program.

The UX/UI Designer will create intuitive, accessible, and user-centered experiences for complex enterprise applications. This individual will collaborate with product owners, business analysts, developers, accessibility specialists, researchers, and program stakeholders to understand user needs and translate them into effective workflows, prototypes, interfaces, and production-ready designs.

Key Responsibilities

* Design intuitive, accessible, and responsive user experiences for enterprise web applications and digital services.
* Translate business requirements and user needs into user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interface designs.
* Conduct and support user research, stakeholder interviews, usability evaluations, and design validation activities.
* Develop personas, journey maps, user flows, information architecture, and interaction models.
* Create interactive prototypes to communicate and test design concepts.
* Work closely with product owners, developers, business analysts, and other stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
* Develop and maintain reusable design components, patterns, style guides, and design systems.
* Ensure designs comply with applicable accessibility requirements, including Section 508 and WCAG standards.
* Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate implementation of approved designs.
* Review implemented functionality and provide design feedback during development and testing.
* Analyze usability findings and translate feedback into actionable design improvements.
* Support responsive design across desktop, tablet, and mobile experiences as required.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
* Maintain UX/UI documentation and design specifications.
* Advocate for user-centered design principles and accessibility throughout the development process.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in User Experience Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Information Technology, or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5+ years of professional UX/UI or product design experience.
* Demonstrated experience designing complex web-based or enterprise applications.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating UX processes, interaction design, visual design, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs.
* Strong proficiency with Figma or comparable professional design/prototyping platforms.
* Understanding of user-centered design and usability principles.
* Experience conducting or supporting user research and usability testing.
* Experience working with design systems and reusable UI components.
* Understanding of responsive and accessible design principles.
* Experience collaborating closely with developers and Agile delivery teams.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Ability to meet applicable federal background investigation requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting federal government, federal healthcare, health IT, or other large-scale public-sector digital programs.
* Experience designing healthcare or clinical applications.
* Strong knowledge of Section 508 accessibility requirements and WCAG.
* Experience designing complex workflows for large enterprise platforms.
* Experience contributing to or maintaining enterprise design systems.
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and modern front-end development concepts.
* Experience working within Agile or SAFe environments.
* Knowledge of healthcare interoperability or healthcare technology environments is a plus.

**Disclaimer: This position is contingent upon ELYON’s receipt of contract award, Government acceptance of the proposed candidate, completion of required onboarding, and continued contract funding.**

Paid sick leave, Medical/Dental (optional), 401 (k) Retirement Plan (optional), Employer Paid Life Insurance, Employer Paid Short Term Disability, Optional Life Insurance.

ELYON International, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Middle UI/UX Designer (SaaS, Claude Design)
Product (UX/UI) designer
Senior UI / UX Designer
description:
*Job Description:*

*About Us*

We are a leading global media agency, shaping the future of content, advertising, and audience engagement across platforms. Our product organization powers innovative solutions for clients worldwide, leveraging data, technology, and creativity.

*Role Overview*

As a Senior UI/UX Designer for Dentsu, you will shape how users interact with AI-powered workflows and agent systems. This hands-on role focuses on designing conversational interfaces, agentic experiences, and self-service analytics tools that make complex AI behavior intuitive and trustworthy. You will work closely with AI engineers and data scientists to translate technical capabilities into effective end-user experiences.

*Key Responsibilities*

* *AI Product Experience Design:* Design end-to-end experiences for client-facing AI agent products, including conversational flows, agent handoffs, and multi-step automated workflows.

* *AI Interaction Patterns:* Define patterns for uncertainty and confidence communication, error and fallback states, latency handling, and human-in-the-loop moments.

* *Conversational & Analytics Design:* Create conversational interfaces and self-service analytics experiences that make complex data science outputs, including MMM, forecasting, and incrementality, accessible to non-technical users.

* *Design Systems:* Create and maintain reusable AI interaction components that accelerate future product deployments.

* *Cross-functional Collaboration:* Partner with AI engineers to understand system capabilities and constraints, ensuring designs are feasible, resilient, and accurately represent model behavior.

* *Research & Validation:* Lead discovery and user research with client stakeholders to validate concepts, identify friction, and inform the product roadmap.

* *Prototyping:* Produce high-fidelity prototypes to test agent experiences before engineering investment.

* *Accessibility:* Champion WCAG 2.2 AA standards, including screen-reader compatibility, keyboard navigation, and accessible handling of streaming and dynamic AI content.

* *Standards & Documentation:* Establish UX standards, documentation, and design rationale records for the AI product portfolio.

* *Global Collaboration:* Work effectively with distributed teams, including offshore engineering, across regions and time zones.

*Requirements*

*Must Have*

* 5+ years of UI/UX design experience, supported by a portfolio demonstrating shipped, complex digital products.

* Strong command of interaction design, information architecture, and usability principles.

* Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools, such as Figma.

* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present design rationale to executives, engineers, and clients.

* Demonstrated ability to work independently and own design decisions end to end.

* Comfort working with ambiguity and changing technical constraints.

*Nice to Have*

* Experience designing LLM-based products, including chatbots, copilots, or agent workflows.

* Familiarity with LLM concepts such as prompting, RAG, tool use, and model limitations.

* Background in media, advertising, or marketing technology.

* Experience designing analytics or business intelligence experiences, including dashboards and self-service data exploration.

* Experience contributing to or maintaining a design system at scale.

* Accessibility certification, such as IAAP CPACC or WAS, or experience conducting accessibility audits and assistive technology testing.

* Experience designing asynchronous, event-driven, or streaming interfaces.

*What We Value*

* User-first thinking and empathy for users navigating AI uncertainty.

* Attention to detail in interaction design and accessibility.

* Curiosity about how AI systems behave and how to design around their limitations.

* Ownership and accountability for design decisions and their impact.

* Strong communication and the ability to influence across disciplines.

* Pragmatic problem-solving and comfort with ambiguity.

* Collaboration across distributed teams and time zones.

* Passion for building trustworthy AI experiences that users understand and trust.

*Additional Information*

At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, Metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office.

The annual salary range for this position is $94,875 - $95,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.

Benefits available with this position include:

• Medical, vision, and dental insurance,

• Life insurance,

• Short-term and long-term disability insurance,

• 401k,

• Flexible paid time off,

• At least 15 paid holidays per year,

• Paid sick and safe leave, and

• Paid parental leave.

Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to, providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit

title: Visual Designer
description:
*Title: Visual Designer*
*Location:* 100% remote
*Contract length:* 6 months could extend
*Schedule:* 4 hours
*Pay:* 60-65/hr

*Top 3 technical or soft skills* you'd like to see that will lead you to request an interview

1. *Strong creative concepting and the ability to pitch ideas to varied audiences:* The role requires conceiving and presenting concepts that appeal to distinct prospective student groups (undergraduate, graduate, bachelor's completion, doctoral, certificates). I'd look for a portfolio that shows the thinking behind the work, including design rationale, not just polished final pieces. Experience working within a brand identity while still bringing fresh ideas is a strong signal.

2. *Print and digital production expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects):* The role centers on producing print- and publish-ready materials across recruitment collateral, advertising, and mixed media. I'd want cross-platform samples that show technical command, including familiarity with print specs and production workflows, since the designer provides printing and mailing specs to the production manager.

3. *Exceptional attention to detail with multi-project management under deadline pressure:* The posting explicitly calls for handling 15+ projects at once at varying stages of production. Evidence of time management, prioritization, and clear communication in a fast-paced, collaborative environment (for example, agency, in-house, or marketing team experience) would make a candidate stand out.

*How many years of experience?* At least two to five years of prior visual design experience

*Summary*

Working under the supervision of the Associate Director, Design, the Visual Designer will be part of the team that includes other visual designers, senior visual designers, production designer, and a creative director, as well as small group of student design interns (CO-OPs). The visual designer partners with multiple teams within Enrollment Management (EM) and joins the multimedia team to round out the creative team within the EM marketing group at client.

In this role, the Visual Designer will ideate and create on behalf of the University, working with the Creative Director, Associate Director, Design, and act as a support to senior visual designer(s). Projects will range from highly art directed to ones with more creative leeway while keeping within the brand identity of the University.

The Creative Team is responsible for conceiving, producing, and presenting content across the enrollment lifecycle for both digital and offline marketing vehicles. The Visual Designer must bring demonstrable experience in design across print and offline collateral; employ professional, proactive, and collegial communication; and be responsive, collaborative, empathetic, and flexible while working within an often fast-paced environment.

*Required Documents*

A cover letter, resume, and digital portfolio showcasing high-quality cross-platform examples.

*Qualifications*

Provide the minimum education, experience, and skills required to perform the job successfully.

* Education: Bachelor's degree required
* At least two to five years of prior visual design experience
* Must have a strong design acumen and creative concepting
* Exceptional attention to detail and ability to manage and prioritize multiple concurrent projects at varying stages of production
* Keen time management and communications skills
* Robust willingness to collaborate and strong interpersonal skills
* Ability to develop and effectively pitch creative concepts that appeal to a broad range of prospective student groups: undergraduate, graduate, bachelor's completion, doctoral, certificates, etc.
* Editorial design, art direction, and social media design experience a plus
* Additional creative software expertise (video, animation, audio, etc.) a plus
* An understanding of usability and user-centric design a plus
* Illustration, animation, and photography skills a plus

*Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities*

*Responsibility*

*Percent of Time*

* Produce top-tiered marketing materials for both print and digital formats that support student recruitment communication efforts, including admission recruitment materials for both graduate and undergraduate audiences, general awareness and program-/ audience-specific advertising, mixed media design
* Create concepts and designs for print and digital projects, and other special projects, producing them to be print- or publish-ready, as coordinated by production manager and aligned to media specifications
* Provide layouts and printed comps to marketing managers and partners for approval with clear and well-informed design rationale
* Partner closely with the multimedia, marketing management, social, and content teams on a multitude of projects.
* Utilize conventional design software Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, AfterEffects, etc.) to create concepts and designs for publications (print and digital) as assigned
* Successfully handle up to 15+ projects simultaneously under deadline pressure and with an exceptional attention to detail and ability to communicate effectively with colleagues
* Provide detailed printing and mailing specs to production manager to secure price estimates
* Act as liaison to the College of Art, Media, and Design (CAMD) and other schools and programs as needed.
* Mentor the student designers (CO-OPs), and make recommendations to Senior Designer for potential student intern candidates
* Part of team that advocates and upholds the client brand identity and is responsible for creating collateral that supports enrollment goals across a wide range of prospective students.
* Other duties as assigned
