title: Graphic Designer
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Graphic Designer based in the United States.*

We are seeking a versatile and experienced Graphic Designer to create impactful visual communications supporting healthcare, public health, marketing, and organizational initiatives. In this part-time contract role, you will transform complex information, data, and strategic concepts into clear, engaging, and visually compelling materials for diverse audiences. You will develop a wide range of creative assets, from executive presentations and branded marketing materials to social media graphics, website visuals, event collateral, and short-form videos. Working closely with leadership, marketing professionals, and multidisciplinary teams, you will help maintain a consistent visual identity while adapting creative content to different platforms and audiences. Your work will play an important role in communicating public health information accurately, accessibly, and with cultural sensitivity. This remote opportunity is ideal for a creative, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, manages shifting priorities effectively, and is passionate about using design to communicate meaningful ideas and advance health equity.

Accountabilities
----------------

* *Design executive presentations:* Create polished, brand-aligned presentations for leadership communications, organizational initiatives, conferences, program updates, and external engagements.
* *Translate complex information into visual stories:* Collaborate with executives and subject matter experts to identify key messages and transform technical content, strategic concepts, and data into compelling visual narratives.
* *Develop data visualizations:* Design charts, diagrams, infographics, timelines, process graphics, tables, and maps that improve understanding while preserving the accuracy and integrity of information.
* *Improve presentation quality:* Refine existing presentations through stronger storytelling, layout, typography, visual hierarchy, data visualization, and consistent brand application.
* *Create reusable templates:* Develop presentation and design templates that help teams produce materials efficiently while maintaining visual consistency and brand standards.
* *Produce marketing and brand assets:* Create high-quality creative materials for print, digital platforms, social media, websites, events, organizational communications, thought leadership, and program initiatives.
* *Maintain brand consistency:* Apply established visual identity guidelines across different audiences, programs, regions, and communication channels while adapting creative assets to specific needs.
* *Support visual identity development:* Contribute to the development of logos and visual identities for new programs, initiatives, and projects while ensuring alignment with the overarching brand.
* *Design digital and social media content:* Produce engaging graphics for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and other digital channels to communicate health information, organizational news, awareness campaigns, leadership perspectives, and program updates.
* *Create website and campaign visuals:* Develop website graphics, banners, campaign imagery, and other digital assets in collaboration with marketing and communications stakeholders.
* *Produce video and multimedia content:* Edit footage, incorporate typography and graphics, create simple motion graphics, and prepare short-form videos for social media, presentations, events, and digital storytelling.
* *Communicate public health information effectively:* Design accessible and understandable visual materials that communicate complex healthcare and public health topics without oversimplifying or distorting their meaning.
* *Apply inclusive design principles:* Consider health literacy, accessibility, readability, cultural responsiveness, and audience diversity. Represent individuals and communities with dignity while avoiding stigmatizing or stereotypical imagery.
* *Develop event and print materials:* Design conference graphics, community outreach materials, signage, banners, handouts, brochures, rack cards, display graphics, and other branded collateral.
* *Prepare production-ready deliverables:* Ensure print and digital files meet technical specifications, including bleed, resolution, color modes, sizing, formatting, and vendor requirements.
* *Review and quality-check assets:* Inspect proofs and final deliverables to identify design inconsistencies, formatting errors, and production issues before publication or distribution.
* *Coordinate projects and stakeholders:* Work closely with marketing, communications, executive leadership, program, operations, clinical, and public health teams to clarify objectives and deliver effective creative solutions.
* *Manage deadlines and changing priorities:* Respond efficiently to urgent requests, shifting project requirements, and time-sensitive organizational needs while maintaining quality and attention to detail.
* *Maintain organized design files:* Deliver well-structured source files, consistent naming conventions, and version-controlled assets to support collaboration and future updates.
* *Communicate project progress:* Provide proactive updates on timelines, dependencies, deliverables, and potential delays, incorporating stakeholder feedback and managing multiple revision rounds as needed.

------------
Requirements
------------

* *Professional design experience:* Demonstrated experience as a graphic designer or visual communications professional, with a portfolio showcasing a range of digital, print, presentation, and branding projects.
* *Presentation design expertise:* Strong ability to develop executive-level presentations and translate complex information into clear, engaging visual narratives.
* *Graphic design fundamentals:* Excellent knowledge of typography, layout, composition, color theory, visual hierarchy, and brand consistency.
* *Data visualization skills:* Ability to create effective charts, diagrams, infographics, process graphics, and other visual representations of complex information while maintaining factual accuracy.
* *Brand development experience:* Familiarity with applying brand guidelines across multiple communication channels and contributing to visual identity development for programs, initiatives, and campaigns.
* *Digital and social media design:* Experience producing creative assets for social media platforms, websites, digital campaigns, and organizational communications.
* *Video and multimedia capabilities:* Ability to edit short-form video, integrate typography and graphic elements, and create basic motion graphics is important for supporting multimedia projects.
* *Print production knowledge:* Understanding of print preparation requirements, including file resolution, bleed, color modes, dimensions, proofs, and production specifications.
* *Public health and accessible communication:* Ability to communicate complex healthcare, technical, or data-driven information in accessible formats, with sensitivity to health literacy and diverse audiences.
* *Cultural awareness and inclusive design:* Demonstrated judgment in creating respectful, culturally responsive visuals that represent communities accurately and avoid reinforcing stigma or stereotypes.
* *Technical proficiency:* Strong command of professional graphic design and presentation tools, with the ability to produce high-quality assets across print, digital, and multimedia formats.
* *Organization and attention to detail:* Excellent file management, version control, quality assurance, and project coordination skills, with a strong commitment to accuracy and consistency.
* *Communication and collaboration:* Ability to work effectively with executives, marketing professionals, technical experts, and cross-functional stakeholders, translating feedback into effective design solutions.
* *Flexibility and responsiveness:* Comfort managing several projects simultaneously, adapting to changing priorities, meeting tight deadlines, and incorporating multiple rounds of revisions.
* *Independent working style:* Ability to manage a part-time contract workload independently, communicate proactively, and deliver reliable results in a remote environment.
* *Creative problem-solving:* A proactive, resourceful mindset and the ability to recommend appropriate visual approaches based on project objectives, audience needs, and communication goals.
* *Location:* Ability to provide remote design services while based in the United States.

--------
Benefits

* *Fully remote arrangement:* Flexibility to work remotely from anywhere within the United States.
* *Part-time contract engagement:* An opportunity to contribute specialized design expertise through a flexible, project-focused working arrangement.
* *Creative variety:* Exposure to a broad range of projects spanning executive communications, branding, marketing, digital media, video, events, and public health education.
* *Meaningful impact:* The opportunity to use visual communication to support healthcare initiatives, improve public understanding, and advance health equity.
* *Cross-functional collaboration:* Work with leadership and multidisciplinary professionals across marketing, communications, clinical programs, operations, and public health.
* *Professional portfolio development:* Opportunities to build a diverse body of work across multiple formats, audiences, and communication channels.
* *Creative ownership:* The opportunity to contribute ideas, recommend visual strategies, and shape how complex information is communicated.

title: Product Designer
description:
****************
Product Designer
****************

At OpenSpace, we're redefining how the world's most complex projects are built. Our AI-powered Visual Intelligence Platform uses computer vision and spatial AI to give construction teams a real-time view of what's happening on-site, helping them build faster, safer, and with greater confidence.

But what truly sets us apart is our people. We hire curious, driven teammates who love solving hard problems, taking ownership, and making a real-world impact. Great people build great culture, and apparently it shows. Forbes has named OpenSpace one of America's Best Startup Employers five years in a row. Come see what all the fuss is about.

----------------------
Brief summary of role:
----------------------

We're looking for a Product Designer to join OpenSpace to work on Track, our progress tracking product. Track turns site captures into a task-by-task, trade-by-trade picture of what has actually been built. It's the kind of ground truth that field decisions, pay applications, and stakeholder communication all depend on.

You'll be the primary designer for Track, owning the full range of product design: framing ambiguous problems, information architecture and navigation, interaction and visual design, and data-dense interfaces, ex. executive-level dashboards, visualizations, and tables that make a complex construction schedule legible at a glance. Track is complex enough that it needs someone strong on structure and on visual craft, not one or the other. You'll work on a small and senior team alongside PMs, engineers, and directly with customers.

You'll report to the Product Design Manager and join a small, senior design team that covers the whole OpenSpace platform. The team critiques together, shares one design system, and leans on each other's judgment, so while Track is your focus, you won't be designing in isolation.

This role is remote, with a preference for candidates based in Bosnia and Herzegovina. You'll be joining a product and engineering group that spans the US, Poland, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Pakistan.

---------------------
What you'll be doing:
---------------------

* Working on Track, our AI progress tracking product. The product is data-heavy and genuinely complex, and it still has to feel simple and polished to use.
* End to end design: problem definition, information architecture, user flows, interaction design, and production-ready UI.
* Design data-dense interfaces: progress dashboards, charts, schedule and timeline views, and large tables.
* Make complex workflows easier: reduce steps, prevent errors, and design for everyone who touches this product, from a superintendent walking a site to an executive reviewing a portfolio.
* Build interactive prototypes to test concepts with customers and align the team before engineering commits time to them.
* Use AI tools as a normal part of how you design. We use Claude heavily, for exploration, prototyping, and research synthesis.
* Work fluently in Figma. Figma is where our design system lives and where most detailed design work happens.
* Work closely with engineers throughout: early on feasibility, and through implementation to make sure what ships matches the design.
* Contribute to the design team and the design system. Present your work in crit, give and receive feedback, and design new patterns where Track's needs go beyond the existing library.
* Conduct research: usability sessions, customer interviews, and site visits on active construction projects.

------------------------
What we are looking for:
------------------------

* 3+ years designing digital products, with end-to-end examples in your portfolio: the problem, your process, the decisions you made, and what shipped.
* Strong interaction and visual design skills, with demonstrated attention to states, edge cases, and detail quality.
* Strong UX fundamentals: user flows and task analysis, information architecture, usability heuristics, and accessibility. You can explain why a design works, not only show that it looks right.
* Experience designing data-dense interfaces such as dashboards, charts, large tables, or analytics tools.
* Fluency in Figma, including prototyping and component work.
* Fluency with AI tools. We use Claude daily. We're also looking for the judgment to choose the right tool for a problem instead of defaulting to one.
* A track record of close collaboration with engineers, and enough familiarity with how interfaces are built to discuss feasibility and constraints.
* Willingness to conduct research, and interest in learning a complex domain like construction.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and a collaborative approach to design. You'll be working remotely across time zones.

------
Bonus:
------

* Familiarity with construction scheduling, quantity takeoff, or progress billing workflows.
* Experience designing for both web and mobile.

------------
Why join us:
------------

* Be part of a high-growth company shaping the future of ConTech
* Work alongside a talented and collaborative team
* Competitive compensation package, including base salary and benefits
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth

OpenSpace welcomes employees from varied backgrounds and walks of life, and it’s reflected in our diverse community. OpenSpace is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment, without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: Web Designer
description:
*Web Designer*

*Position Type:* Full-Time, Remote
*Working Hours:* U.S Business Hours

About the Role
--------------

We’re looking for a skilled Web Designer to create polished, user-centered web experiences that balance visual quality with usability. You’ll translate briefs and product goals into wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes, ensuring designs are responsive, consistent, and ready for development.

Working closely with developers and stakeholders, you’ll own your designs from initial concept through implementation review. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented designer who takes pride in their work, communicates proactively, and can manage projects independently in a remote, asynchronous environment.

What You’ll Own
---------------

*Visual Design & Prototyping*

* Translate project briefs and product goals into clear, user-centered web designs.
* Create wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes to communicate design concepts before development begins.
* Balance visual appeal, usability, and business objectives across web experiences.

*Responsive Web Design*

* Design and refine layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
* Apply responsive design principles to deliver consistent experiences across devices.
* Consider how layouts and interactions translate into HTML and CSS.

*Design System Maintenance*

* Contribute to and improve the existing design system.
* Maintain consistency across components, typography, colors, spacing, and layouts.
* Use component libraries and reusable design elements to support efficient workflows.

*Developer Collaboration & Handoff*

* Work closely with front-end developers to ensure accurate design implementation.
* Provide clear specifications, assets, and guidance for layouts and interactions.
* Answer implementation questions and resolve design-related issues during development.

*Feedback & Iteration*

* Incorporate stakeholder and user feedback into design revisions.
* Refine designs efficiently while keeping the original project goals in focus.
* Ask clarifying questions and communicate potential blockers early.

*Design Quality Assurance*

* Review implemented pages against approved designs.
* Identify visual inconsistencies, layout issues, and usability concerns.
* Recommend fixes to maintain a high standard of design quality.

Required Experience & Skills
----------------------------

* Professional experience in web design, supported by a portfolio demonstrating strong visual judgment, layout skills, and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in a modern design tool such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
* Experience with component libraries, reusable components, and auto-layout workflows.
* Solid understanding of responsive design principles and how designs translate into HTML and CSS.
* Familiarity with UX fundamentals, including information architecture, user flows, accessibility, and usability.
* Strong written and spoken English for clear communication with distributed teams and stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines independently.
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to refine work based on feedback.

What Makes You a Strong Fit
---------------------------

* You take pride in producing polished, thoughtful design work and maintain high standards without constant supervision.
* You communicate proactively, clarify requirements early, and keep collaborators informed.
* You respond constructively to feedback and focus on delivering the best outcome for users and the business.
* You work effectively in an asynchronous environment and manage your workload reliably.
* You collaborate well with developers and understand the importance of accurate design handoffs.
* You take ownership of your designs from concept through final implementation review.

What Success Looks Like
-----------------------

* High-quality, user-centered web designs that align with project goals.
* Responsive layouts that deliver consistent experiences across devices.
* A well-maintained design system with reusable, consistent components.
* Clear handoffs that help developers implement designs accurately.
* Timely, thoughtful revisions based on feedback.
* Implemented pages that closely match approved designs and meet quality expectations.

Typical Day
-----------

You’ll begin by reviewing feedback and comments on active design files and prioritizing your work. Depending on project needs, you may refine a landing page, develop a reusable design component, or revise a product interface.

You may also meet with a developer to discuss a design handoff or clarify an interaction. Later in the day, you’ll review completed work for quality, update project notes, and document progress so teammates across time zones can continue smoothly.

Interview Process
-----------------

* Initial Screening
* Recruiter Interview
* Client Interview
* Offer & Onboarding

title: Sr Packaging Designer
description:
*The Opportunity:*

As a Sr Packaging Designer, you'll help shape the visual identity of some of the world's most recognizable games and entertainment brands. From the earliest concept sketches through final production, you'll create packaging, games content and supporting creative assets that connect with consumers and tell a compelling brand story.

You'll collaborate with cross-functional partners across Marketing, Product Design, Engineering, and our Asia development teams to bring innovative ideas to life. Whether you're presenting concepts to leadership, art directing photography, building 3D package mockups, or refining the smallest design detail, you'll play an important role in creating packaging that stands out on shelf and online.

We're looking for a designer who is equal parts creative thinker, visual storyteller, and collaborative teammate—someone who's excited to push ideas forward while balancing business objectives, consumer insights, and production realities.

*What Your Impact Will Be:*

* Design innovative packaging from concept through production for Mattel Games brands and licensed properties.
* Develop compelling visual storytelling that strengthens brand identity and drives consumer engagement.
* Create packaging and product graphics, digital assets for both retail and e-commerce experiences.
* Partner with Marketing, Product Design, Engineering, Copywriting, and Brand teams to bring cohesive creative solutions to life.
* Art direct illustration, retouching, and external creative partners.
* Create 3D package visualizations and physical mockups to communicate design intent.
* Collaborate closely with global development teams to ensure design quality from concept through production.
* Stay connected to consumer, design, entertainment, and cultural trends to inspire fresh creative solutions.

*What We’re Looking For:*

* 5+ years of experience in packaging, graphic, or consumer product design.
* Degree in Graphic Design, Industrial Design, Visual Communication, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Exceptional visual design skills with a strong portfolio demonstrating packaging and brand storytelling.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign).
* Experience with 3D visualization tools such as Adobe Dimension, Blender, or similar.
* Strong understanding of typography, color, composition, and consumer-focused design.
* Ability to balance creativity with production requirements and business objectives.
* Comfortable presenting ideas and receiving constructive feedback in a collaborative environment.
* Excellent communication, organization, and project management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Curiosity about trends in design, gaming, entertainment, culture, and retail.
* Passion for creating memorable experiences for consumers through thoughtful design.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. Also, interested in signing up for job alerts? Do so here!

*How We Work:*
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

* *We collaborate:* Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* *We innovate:* At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* *We execute:* We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

*Our Approach to Flexible Work:*
This role is an in-office role Monday-Thursday, and work from home on Fridays. We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

*Who We Are:*
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

title: Graphic Designer (Part-time Contract)
description:
Tucows Domains is the world’s largest wholesale domain registrar, responsible for maintaining the health, neutrality, and openness of an important—but largely invisible part of the Internet: the domain name system (DNS).

As part of Tucows—one of the world’s largest Internet companies—Tucows Domains has a rich history of helping make the Internet better, operating globally under the Ascio, Enom, Hover and OpenSRS brands.

We embrace a people-first philosophy that is rooted in respect, trust, and flexibility. We believe that whatever works for our employees is what works best for us. It’s also why the majority of our roles are remote-first, meaning you can work from anywhere you can connect to the Internet! Today, over one thousand people from over 20 countries are part of our team.

If this sounds exciting to you, join the herd!

-----------------------
*About the Opportunity*
-----------------------

We are redefining what an in-house agency is and are looking for a graphic designer to join the Herd. As an individual contributor within our marketing organization, your primary responsibilities will involve crafting visually appealing content and shaping the brand identity that supports our marketing efforts within the Domain Services line of business. This will include creating digital graphics, emails, newsletters, display channel ads, social posts, video content, and promotional materials that resonate with our audience and enhance our brand presence. *
*

This is a completely remote opportunity within the Greater Toronto Area with the expectation of attending onsite meetings, functions, and/or events upon request.

This is a part-time position (20-25 hours/week) for a 6-month contract to start.

------------
*Job Duties*
------------

The role involves collaborating with marketing team members and peers across the business, including sales, product management, and partners, to deliver quality designs. You will be responsible for the following:

* Partner on the development and ongoing evolution of a comprehensive brand book, documenting visual identity standards and usage guidelines for internal and external use.
* Conceptualize, create, and refine marketing campaigns and brand assets, digital and social assets, and more.
* Proactively research, test, and leverage emerging AI design tools, identifying opportunities to improve team efficiency and creative output
* Design requests for proposal (RFPs) to secure new business and presentation decks for business leaders.
* Create swag and design event collateral (banners, booth kits, conference signage, etc.).
* Develop video content, including sizzle reels, teaser videos, tutorials, and how-to demos.
* Work closely and collaboratively with product, design, business development, and marketing teams on brand-building and marketing campaigns, ensuring design and business objectives work seamlessly together.
* Effectively rationalize and communicate ideas and designs to key stakeholders and senior business leaders.
* Knowledge of print and digital design standards and specifications.
* Manage print files and liaise with external printers and vendors.
* Create accessible designs that comply with W3C and AODA.

-------------------------
*Qualifications Required*
-------------------------

* 3-5 years of experience as a graphic or visual designer at an advertising agency or in-house design team.
* Possess a certificate, degree, or diploma in graphic design or a related field.
* Provide a portfolio that demonstrates your design skills and conceptual thinking.
* Demonstrated ability leading the creative ideation process, from concept development through to execution.
* Experience contributing to brand development or brand evolution, with a strong understanding of how visual identity systems work across touchpoints.
* Display strong aesthetic skills and demonstrate a solid understanding of graphic design's core principles, including typography, layout/composition, grid systems, color, photography, iconography, etc.
* Experience in video creation (simple animation, motion graphics, storyboarding, prototyping, etc.).
* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, After Effects, and similar tools.
* Be adept at working collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

​​The hourly rate for this position is $40-$42/hour. Range shown in $CAD for Canadian residents. Other countries will differ. Range may vary on a number of factors including, but not limited to: location, experience and qualifications. Tucows believes in a total rewards offering that includes fair compensation and generous benefits.

Want to know more about what we stand for? At Tucows we care about protecting the open Internet, narrowing digital divide, and supporting fairness and equality.

We also know that diversity drives innovation. We are committed to inclusion across race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status. We celebrate multiple approaches and diverse points of view.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

We use AI-enabled tools throughout our recruitment process to help us work more efficiently and consistently. These tools support our hiring teams by organizing and reviewing information, while final hiring decisions are always made by people.

Tucows and its subsidiaries participate in the E-verify program for all US employees.

Learn more about Tucows, our businesses, culture and employee benefits on our site here.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
*The Role*

The Senior Graphic Designer is responsible for concepting and designing brand campaigns in partnership with other creatives across a wide range of disciplines: campaign development, editorial design, product design, brand identity development, motion graphics, experiential design and presentation design. You will work on projects as a sole graphic designer as well as leading small teams on projects that require more support.

As a curious, highly motivated & collaborative senior graphic designer you have a strong creative POV, an eye for both the big picture (and beyond) and the details. You don’t have a favorite medium because you like creating and problem-solving in them all, from print to digital, social to experiential. In addition to fully realized technical design skills, you have a refined design sensibility and are able to execute compelling, cutting-edge visual work for unique brands across all verticals.

*This role based out of our Wpromote x Giant Spoon NYC headquarters Tuesday through Thursday each week, with remote flexibility on Mondays and Fridays.*

* Unlimited PTO
* Extended Holiday break (Winter)
* Work from anywhere options*
* 100% paid parental leave
* 401(k) matching
* Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance
* Sponsored life insurance
* Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance
* Annual Class Pass Credits and more!

* Develops branding for campaigns ranging in scope from one-off logo design to project-specific assets to full brand systems meant to last for multiple years

title: CAD & Graphic Designer
description:
*About Us:*
Comfrt is one of the fastest-growing direct-to-consumer brands, dedicated to blending mental wellness, inclusivity, and elevated comfort into every piece we create. Our mission goes beyond clothing — we strive to build a community where everyone feels supported and seen.

*About the Job:*

We're looking for a talented CAD & Graphic Designer to bring the Comfrt vision to life through print, pattern, and graphic design. Will play a key role in developing seasonal collections, translating our brand handwriting into compelling prints and graphics across apparel, home and accessories categories.

*Responsibilities:*

* Design unique prints and patterns that align with the Comfrt aesthetic
* Develop graphic concepts across a range of apparel categories, including Logo, License and Non Logo content.
* Develop product packaging
* Collaborate with the design and production teams to brainstorm and develop new ideas
* Identify and interpret relevant fashion and market trends through research and social listening
* Maintain a strong understanding of the Comfrt brand aesthetic, customer, and market trends, with a sharp eye for color, print, pattern, and graphic direction relevant to the category.
* Conduct ongoing trend research across fashion, graphics, home, retail, and cultural spaces to help drive new print, pattern, and packaging concepts.
* Develop original graphics, prints, and repeat patterns while understanding how artwork translates across various product categories, materials, and fabrications.
* Partner with factories and cross-functional teams to provide clear artwork direction and ensure graphic execution, print quality, scale, placement, and application methods are commercially viable and aligned with design intent.
* Communicate directly with vendors, provide timely strike-off comments, and ensure artwork executes accurately
* Maintain organized digital files and archives of all designs
* Present artwork and communicate creative vision to cross-functional partners and senior leadership

*Requirements:*

* Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Illustration, or a related field — or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of experience in graphic and/or CAD design, preferably within apparel or a global retailer
* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign
* Strong eye for color, composition, typography, and concept development
* Possess a strong understanding of graphic and print application techniques across different fabric types, including limitations and opportunities within garment wash, dye, print, embroidery, and specialty applications.
* Understand factory production capabilities and application methods to proactively problem-solve during development and support efficient execution from concept through production.
* Versatile artwork range, with the ability to execute across a broad spectrum of design styles — from elaborate plaids, camo, watercolor, and scenic illustrations to simple dots, stripes, and clean graphics
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to work autonomously, take ownership of projects, and effectively manage workload with minimal oversight in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong time management and prioritization skills with the ability to adapt quickly to shifting business needs and timelines.
* Proven ability to multitask across graphic design, print development, packaging, trend research, and cross-functional collaboration while maintaining high quality execution.
* A collaborative, positive team player who is open to feedback and thrives with cross-functional partners
* Strong presentation and communication skills

*Portfolio Required — Please include a portfolio with your application showcasing your design range, color work, and concept development.*

*Why Join Comfrt?*

* Be part of a purpose-driven company that’s shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
* Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
* Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
* Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.

Comfrt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

title: Product Designer
description:
----------------------------------

----------------------------------

*Who are we?*

Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It’s no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around.

At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work.

This intelligence powers our entire product suite.

* Digital Adoption helps users get productive faster.
* Product Analytics uncovers friction and closes adoption gaps.
* Mirror allows employees to train in safe, simulated environments.

These are ur embedded with Whatfix AI Agents which supercharge creation, insights, and user guidance.

Our upcoming AI-first products are already creating a buzz in the market.

* Seek is an AI-native assistant that not only knows your business context but can also act across applications to get work done on your behalf.
* Whatfix Mirror 2.0 is the world’s only System plus Role simulation with a complete assessment to lead the Gen AI simulation category.

Together, these products reflect Whatfix’s commitment to building enterprise-ready AI teammates that maximize productivity and ROI. It gives users a unified, intelligent way to find answers across systems, apps, and knowledge silos and helps anyone looking to deliver fast and contextual answers.

Whatfix is bridging the gap between rapid technological change and human enablement—ensuring AI is not only embedded but also usable, trusted, and outcome-driven for every employee.

At Whatfix, we’re not just making software easier—we’re making AI work for people.

The company has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40+ countries.

*Customers* : 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions.

*Investors* : A total of ~$270 million USD has been raised as yet. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million USD led by Warburg Pincus, with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.

*Whatfix’s leadership is consistently recognized across top industry analysts and business rankings:*

* Won the 2025 AI Breakthrough Award for the Overall AI-based Analytics Solution of the Year
* Only DAP to be recognized as a “Leader” across various DAP reports for the past 5+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group.
* With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the “Top 50 Indian Software Companies” as per G2 Best Software Awards.
* Named a Gartner Customers’ Choice for DAP for the second year in a row (2024 and 2025)—the only vendor in the market to earn this distinction consecutively.
* We also boast a star rating of 4.6 on G2 Crowd, 4.5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a super-high CSAT of 99.8%
* Stevie Award winner in the category (Bronze): Customer Service Department of the Year – Computer Software - 100 or More Employees.
* Winner of the ISG Paragon Innovation Award in partnership with Sophos (customer) for the EMEA region and finalist in the Transformation Award category.
* RemoteTech Breakthrough Awards winner for “Software Asset Management Solution of the Year”

*These recognitions are matched by business performance:*

* Highest-Ranking DAP on 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ North America for Fifth Consecutive Year
* Listed on the Financial Times & Statista's High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2025 list.
* Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 – Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022-2023
* Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal

*Be one of the key Leaders in this awesome journey of building a billion-dollar company!*

*ABOUT THE ROLE*

Whatfix builds software that helps people work — guiding users through complex applications in real time, across web, mobile, and desktop. Our Digital Adoption Platform (DAP) powers how companies create, distribute, and manage in-app guidance at scale. As we go AI-native across the platform, the design problems are getting harder, more novel, and more interesting.

We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to own design for a core area of the DAP product. This isn't a role for someone who needs a defined process to operate. It's a role for someone who can hold a clear vision for where the product is going, think through what matters next, and ship work that matters right now.

*WHAT YOU'LL OWN*

*Product Design Across DAP*

* Own the end-to-end design of features across DAP's guidance creation, distribution, and management surfaces — web, mobile, and desktop.
* Lead your domain from discovery through delivery: research, ideation, prototyping, specification, and handoff.
* Define and maintain design quality within your product area — interaction models, usability standards, and consistency with the broader design system.
* Scrutinize requirements. Push back when what's being asked for isn't the right thing to build.

*AI-Native Design Work*

* Design for AI-powered features where patterns don't yet exist. That means inventing interaction models, not adapting existing ones.
* Use AI tools actively in your own workflow — building functional POCs in code, running rapid experiments, pushing early versions to understand lived experience before it's polished.
* Help define what AI-native UX means for digital adoption: for the customers building guidance, and for the end users receiving it.

*Research and Experimentation*

* Lead qualitative and quantitative research for your product area.
* Favor real-world experimentation over controlled environments. Get something working, get it in front of real users, and learn from how it actually behaves.
* Synthesize findings into clear direction and present them to cross-functional partners and leadership with confidence.

*Collaboration and Mentorship*

* Operate as a peer in planning and prioritization conversations — contributing to how problems are framed, not just how they're solved.
* Mentor the junior designer joining the team. Share knowledge, give direct feedback, raise the bar.
* Contribute to shared design standards and the evolution of design practices on the team.

*WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR*

*Required*

* *4+ years of product design experience in SaaS or enterprise software. You're a Senior Designer — not a mid-level on the path to senior.*
* A portfolio that demonstrates owning complex problem spaces end-to-end: research, design decisions, tradeoffs, and shipped work.
* Active use of AI tools in your design workflow — building POCs, using LLMs for synthesis, working across Figma and code. Not aspirational. Current practice.
* Strong interaction and UX design fundamentals — you know when to follow conventions and when to break them.
* Ability to work effectively in ambiguity, on problems that don't have established answers.

*Nice to Have*

* Experience designing for enterprise SaaS platforms, particularly tools used by non-technical users or content authors.
* Familiarity with digital adoption, in-app guidance, workflow automation, or onboarding experiences.
* Experience designing agent management, AI-generated, or AI-assisted outputs.

*HOW YOU'LL SHOW UP*

* *You design to solve problems now.* You hold a vision for the future, build shared understanding for what's next, and ship in the present. Work stays connected to current OKRs, not some future state that keeps moving.
* *You experiment to learn.* A rough functional POC pushed to real users tells you more than weeks of structured testing. You're comfortable with that tradeoff.
* *You're clear and direct.* You can articulate what you're designing, why, and what you're trading off. You expect the same from the people around you.
* *You're a peer, not an executor.* You're in the room when problems are being framed, not just when solutions need to be drawn.
* *You're already working at the edge of AI.* You're not waiting for the tools to mature or the patterns to be established. You're building now, learning from what you ship, and helping define what AI-native design actually means in practice.

title: Principal Product Manager, Core Network
description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

*What you’ll be part of:*

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values : High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

----------------------------------
**What you'll be responsible for**
----------------------------------

You will own the product strategy and evolution of the CPN Payments Engine — the core infrastructure that powers payment creation, routing, settlement, and lifecycle management across the network. You’ll define the long-term vision and roadmap for the engine, identifying opportunities to expand its capabilities while improving reliability, performance, and scale. Working across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and commercial teams, you’ll lead complex product decisions and investments that enable OFIs and BFIs to move money efficiently across an expanding set of corridors and rails, translating platform improvements into measurable network and business outcomes.

-----------------------
**What you'll work on**
-----------------------

*

Set the Payments Engine strategy: Own the long-term product vision and roadmap for payment creation, processing, routing, and settlement, aligning investments with CPN and Circle priorities.

*

Advance payment performance at scale: Establish the product strategy for improving success rates, latency, resilience, and processing efficiency, using data to identify systemic opportunities and prioritize investments.

*

Evolve API and protocol capabilities: Define the direction for OFI Payments APIs and BFI quoting and settlement protocols, balancing developer experience, interoperability, compliance, scalability, and network reliability.

*

Expand the capabilities of the network: Identify and lead investments that unlock new payment use cases, corridors, rails, and partner capabilities while building reusable infrastructure that scales across the network.

*

Shape observability and operational control: Define product capabilities for monitoring, alerting, exception management, and operational tooling that improve visibility into payment health and enable faster resolution of network issues.

*

Lead complex cross-functional decisions: Partner with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, BD, and other product leaders to navigate architectural and business trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and drive alignment on high-impact investments.

*

Establish product leadership for payment infrastructure: Develop frameworks, metrics, and product practices that improve decision-making across CPN, mentor other product managers, and serve as a subject matter expert on payment infrastructure across Circle.

-------------------------------
**What you'll bring to Circle**
-------------------------------

**Core requirements**
---------------------

*

10+ years of relevant experience, including significant Product Management experience building payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure products.

*

Deep experience owning platform or infrastructure products such as APIs, payment processing systems, settlement platforms, routing systems, or developer-facing capabilities.

*

Demonstrated ability to define product strategy and lead highly complex initiatives spanning multiple engineering and cross-functional teams.

*

Strong analytical and technical fluency, with the ability to use payment performance, reliability, and operational data to identify systemic issues and guide product investment decisions.

*

Track record of delivering measurable improvements to large-scale systems, including reliability, success rates, latency, scalability, operational efficiency, or customer outcomes.

*

Ability to evaluate complex technical and business trade-offs and translate them into clear product decisions, priorities, and long-term platform investments.

*

Strong cross-functional influence and communication skills, including the ability to build alignment with senior leaders and stakeholders across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and commercial teams.

**Preferred requirements**
--------------------------

*

Deep knowledge of payment networks, cross-border payments, settlement systems, correspondent banking, stablecoins, or blockchain-based financial infrastructure.

*

Experience with enterprise API products, two-sided networks, and compliance-forward payment systems, including concepts such as SLAs, payment lifecycle events, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or the Travel Rule.

title: Product Manager II
description:
*About Lokal:*

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a *house of focused apps,* many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the *Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts* they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

* *Emotional Well-being & Peer Support* – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
* *Astrology & Guidance* – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* *Edutainment & Skill Learning* – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* *Matrimonial Matchmaking* – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* *Agri Consulting* – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* *Local Jobs* – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* *Social & Community* – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
* *Advisory Services* – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a *discovery and access platform* : local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — *access changes lives*.

*We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.*

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

*About the Team:

* The Product Team at Lokal operates as the engine driving our “house of apps” model. We work at the intersection of deep Bharat user insights, cutting-edge AI, and business strategy. As a Group Product Manager, you will lead a squad of Product Managers and Product Analysts, taking end-to-end ownership of a major product vertical or portfolio of apps to scale engagement, monetization, and user retention.

*
Role Overview:*

We are hiring a Product Manager / Senior Product Manager to lead key initiatives. You'll own high-impact projects across pricing, growth, user retention, expansion, and platform strategy—working closely with cross-functional teams to scale Products at Lokal.

*Requirements*

*Responsibilities:*

* *Drive product strategy* to maximize conversion and retention through data-driven analysis of supply-side levers and their business impact.
* *Own and enhance payment systems* by improving payment success metrics, optimizing payment gateway (PG) integrations, and elevating the overall checkout experience.
* *Design and run pricing experiments* including default pricing, cohort-based pricing, discounting models, and repeat-user strategies to optimize revenue growth.
* *Collaborate with Marketing* to unlock and scale new acquisition channels while continuously optimizing performance.
* *Strengthen trust and user satisfaction* by defining and improving profile verification workflows and customer support processes.
* *Partner cross-functionally* with design, engineering, analytics, and business teams to execute, measure, and iterate on impactful solutions.
* *Own the product roadmap* , prioritizing initiatives based on business impact and user needs.
* *Conduct market research* to stay ahead of industry trends and incorporate insights into product strategy.
* *Develop retention strategies* to increase repeat revenue and long-term user engagement.
* *Analyze user behavior* and implement gamification mechanics to enhance user motivation and platform stickiness.

*
What We’re Looking For:*

* 3 - 6 years of experience in product management, preferably in consumer internet or marketplace products.
* Strong background in data-driven decision-making; must be mathematically sharp and investigative in approach.
* Educational background from top-tier institutes preferred.
* Prior experience in marketplaces or platforms with demand-supply matching problems is a strong plus.
* Ability to think strategically and also roll up your sleeves to execute.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

*Benefits*

* At Lokal, we act like owners who take initiative beyond job descriptions, get things done despite obstacles, and maintain a growth mindset focused on learning. We're outcome-driven with bias for action, believing speed matters in building products for billion Indians. Decision-making involves open debate followed by full commitment, and we operate on context rather than control - managers share the "why" while you own execution. We aim to be an all-star team that thinks big and takes calculated risks to achieve ambitious goals.
* Be part of a fast-growing startup with 100M+ downloads and a footprint across 1000+ towns & 250+ districts - huge scope for impact and learning.
* Opportunity for fast growth, professionally and personally, as you help expand into new areas and build things from scratch.
* Access comprehensive benefits, including insurance coverage, generous leave policies, ESOP buybacks, flexible work-from-home options, and more.

title: Principal Product Manager - Conversation AI
description:
About us
--------

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
----------

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
----------

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.

We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on ourYouTube Channel orBlog Posts *Role Overview*

For most SMBs, a customer conversation is not merely a support interaction. It is where a lead is qualified, an appointment is booked, a customer question is resolved, a sale is advanced, or a relationship is lost. Businesses receive these conversations across SMS, email, WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, live chat, and other messaging channels. Customers expect immediate, accurate, and context-aware responses — but most SMB teams cannot monitor every channel around the clock. HighLevel's Conversation AI product is designed to close that gap.

Conversation AI enables businesses to deploy AI agents that can answer questions, nurture and qualify leads, collect structured information, book and manage appointments, trigger workflows, follow up with inactive contacts, route conversations between specialised agents, and hand interactions to humans when appropriate. The product supports multiple ways of building agents — from guided forms and configurable prompts to visual conversation flows and AI-assisted agent creation. It also includes knowledge retrieval, multi-channel deployment, agent actions, routing, testing, analytics, logs, permissions, reusable snapshots, and APIs for deployment at agency scale.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to define the next generation of this platform. This person will own the long-term product strategy for Conversation AI and establish the architecture, product principles, quality systems, operating metrics, and commercial model required to make AI agents dependable across millions of real customer interactions.

This is not a chatbot feature-management role. It is a senior individual-contributor product leadership role at the intersection of AI agents, CRM, messaging infrastructure, workflow automation, knowledge retrieval, appointment scheduling, analytics, developer platforms, and agency-led distribution. You will be expected to influence multiple product and engineering teams, make difficult platform-level trade-offs, and turn Conversation AI into one of the most valuable and trusted products in the HighLevel ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities
-------------------

* Define and drive the long-term product vision, strategy, roadmap, and product architecture for HighLevel Conversation AI.
* Own the complete Conversation AI system, including agent creation, prompts, knowledge, actions, visual flows, channel deployment, routing, testing, monitoring, permissions, templates, APIs, and lifecycle management.
* Establish the product principles that determine when Conversation AI should answer, ask a clarifying question, take an action, transfer to another agent, follow up later, or hand the conversation to a human.
* Develop a deep understanding of agencies, SMBs, multi-location businesses, and conversation-heavy industries such as home services, legal, dental, medical and wellness, real estate, insurance, automotive, fitness, and professional services.
* Spend significant time reviewing real customer conversations, AI failures, support tickets, agent configurations, implementation challenges, and measurable customer outcomes.
* Translate ambiguous customer and platform problems into clear strategic choices, product requirements, decision documents, system models, phased roadmaps, and measurable success criteria.
* Partner closely with Engineering and AI leadership on LLM orchestration, model selection, context management, tool invocation, retrieval, re-ranking, latency, caching, reliability, evaluation, observability, data architecture, and cost.
* Build a scalable evaluation framework covering grounded accuracy, action accuracy, instruction adherence, safety, escalation quality, conversation quality, and business outcomes.
* Define testing and release standards for changes to models, prompts, retrieval systems, agent tools, routing logic, and conversation behaviour.
* Partner with Design to simplify the entire agent lifecycle — discovery, creation, configuration, training, testing, deployment, debugging, optimisation, and reuse.
* Create a coherent product experience across guided forms, prompt-based agents, flow-based agents, templates, snapshots, and Ask AI-assisted creation.
* Improve integrations between Conversation AI and Contacts, Conversations, Calendars, Workflows, Opportunities, Payments, Knowledge Base, Custom Fields, Custom Objects, and Reporting.
* Define the platform model for multiple agents, channel assignments, routing priorities, bot transfers, context preservation, and human handovers.
* Develop robust observability and debugging experiences that show conversation context, model responses, retrieved knowledge, tool calls, action inputs and outputs, latency, errors, and execution timelines.
* Define instrumentation across the complete product funnel, including agent creation, training, testing, deployment, first successful conversation, first successful action, ongoing usage, customer outcomes, retention, and expansion.
* Own product decisions involving privacy, data retention, access controls, consent, opt-outs, sensitive information, channel policies, model behaviour, and abuse prevention.
* Partner with Product Marketing on positioning, packaging, use cases, competitive differentiation, launch strategy, customer education, and agency enablement.
* Partner with Support, Implementation, Trial Experience, Account Management, and Affiliates to reduce setup friction, improve customer outcomes, lower support burden, and make Conversation AI easier to sell and implement.
* Partner with Finance and Revenue Experience on subscription plans, usage-based pricing, agency rebilling, AI costs, gross-margin targets, and commercially sustainable product limits.
* Influence product strategy across the broader AI Employee organisation, ensuring that Conversation AI works coherently with Voice AI, Ask AI, Knowledge Base, Agent Studio, Workflow AI, Reviews AI, and future AI products.
* Act as a senior product thought partner to Product, Engineering, Design, Data, GTM, and executive leadership.
* Mentor PMs and raise the quality of product thinking, AI evaluation, strategy, and decision-making across the organisation without relying on formal authority.

Ideal Candidate Profile
----------------------

* 12+ years of product management experience owning complex B2B SaaS, AI-agent, communications, CRM, workflow-automation, customer-support, or platform products. Scope and demonstrated outcomes matter more than a precise number of years.
* Prior experience operating as a Principal PM, Staff PM, Lead PM, product founder, or equivalent senior individual contributor responsible for a business-critical product or platform.
* Evidence of defining product strategy across multiple teams and delivering sustained business outcomes - not only shipping individual features.
* Strong understanding of AI-agent product design, including the difference between language generation and dependable execution of business tasks.
* Experience working with one or more of the following:

○ Conversational AI
-------------------

○ AI agents and tool use
------------------------

○ Customer-service automation
-----------------------------

○ CRM and customer communications
---------------------------------

○ Workflow or journey automation
--------------------------------

○ Knowledge retrieval and RAG
-----------------------------

○ Developer platforms
---------------------

○ Messaging or contact-centre products
--------------------------------------

* Technical fluency sufficient to make credible decisions with engineering teams about LLM behaviour, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, data models, latency, evaluation, observability, reliability, and model economics.
* Strong judgment around AI quality and trust — able to define how an AI system should be tested, monitored, debugged, and improved in production.
* Strong systems thinking — able to connect conversations, contacts, calendars, workflows, opportunities, knowledge, permissions, billing, analytics, and channel infrastructure into a coherent product.
* Ability to distinguish between a compelling AI demonstration and a product that can operate safely and reliably across millions of customer interactions.
* Experience simplifying technically sophisticated systems for non-technical customers.
* Strong understanding of multi-tenant SaaS and the operational requirements of agencies, franchises, multi-location businesses, or reseller ecosystems.
* Strong customer instincts and willingness to personally inspect conversations, logs, support issues, implementation problems, and product data.
* Commercial judgment across adoption, packaging, pricing, retention, AI costs, gross margin, and partner economics.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and multiple teams without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Excellent written communication — able to produce clear strategy documents, product requirements, architectural trade-off decisions, evaluation plans, executive updates, and launch narratives.
* High ownership, intellectual honesty, and execution velocity in a remote-first, high-context environment.
* Comfortable making difficult prioritisation decisions across customer experience, AI quality, revenue, platform extensibility, technical debt, compliance, and cost.

Bonus Points For
---------------

* Experience building production AI agents that use tools, APIs, workflows, or structured actions — not only conversational interfaces.
* Experience with LLM orchestration, prompt and policy layers, function calling, context management, memory, model routing, agent planning, or multi-agent systems.
* Experience building RAG or knowledge platforms involving embeddings, vector retrieval, re-ranking, source attribution, freshness, and evaluation.
* Experience building AI evaluation systems using test datasets, simulations, human review, production telemetry, and business-outcome measurement.
* Experience with messaging channels and infrastructure such as SMS, email, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram messaging, web chat, or contact-centre software.
* Experience with appointment scheduling, service marketplaces, lead qualification, customer support, or sales-assistant products.
* Experience building workflow automation products similar to HighLevel Workflows, Zapier, Make, HubSpot Workflows, Salesforce Flow, or customer-journey builders.
* Experience with APIs, webhooks, developer tools, reusable templates, marketplaces, or partner ecosystems.
* Experience building products for agencies, SMBs, franchises, local businesses, or multi-location operators.
* Experience with AI usage-based pricing, model cost management, gross-margin optimisation, subscription packaging, rebilling, or fair-use controls.
* Familiarity with metrics such as grounded-answer accuracy, containment rate, escalation rate, action success rate, conversation completion, booking conversion, lead conversion, response latency, P95/P99 reliability, cost per successful outcome, retention, and support-ticket rate.

Why Join HighLevel?
------------------

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in weeks rather than quarters.

Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognising that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well-funded and profitable company.

Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

Chief Compliance Officer, Ramp Advisory LLC
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is seeking an experienced Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) for Ramp Advisory LLC, our SEC-registered investment adviser. This is a high-accountability, build-and-own role. You will own and be accountable for the firm's compliance program in house, and be the gatekeeper who protects clients and the firm while keeping pace with how fast Ramp ships product. You will report to Ramp's Head of Compliance, with direct access to Ramp Advisory's senior leadership.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Serve as Ramp Advisory LLC’s designated CCO, with independent authority over the design, execution and effectiveness of the compliance program

- Act as the firm’s primary point of contact with the SEC, and represent the program, product and key compliance decisions with regulators

- Maintain the firm’s policies and procedures, Code of Ethics, and Form ADV and amendments, and conduct the annual compliance review

- Provide compliance advice and sign-off on marketing materials, customer disclosures, onboarding agreements and product changes

- Own books and records, communications monitoring, complaints handling, employee training, and access-person and personal-trading requirements

- Oversee key financial partners and vendors from a compliance standpoint

- Shape customer onboarding strategy, partnering with Product, Engineering and Customer Experience to build scalable controls and monitoring

- Build and maintain the firm’s anti-money laundering program

WHAT YOU NEED

- 8+ years in investment adviser compliance, including prior experience as a CCO or deputy CCO of an SEC-registered adviser

- Experience in the fintech space

- Deep working knowledge of the Advisers Act and SEC expectations

- Direct experience supporting SEC examinations and interfacing with regulators

- Experience overseeing custodian, broker-dealer or sub-adviser relationships

- Sound, independent judgment: the ability to make and defend compliance decisions in real time, grounded in regulatory guidance, and to hold a position with senior stakeholders

- AI fluency and demonstrated experience using AI and automation to build and scale compliance programs

- Comfort operating as a standalone compliance lead in a fast-moving environment

- Experience building controls and leading program design initiatives in partnership with engineering teams and cross-functional partners

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience building or scaling a compliance program at a high-growth company

- Experience with cash management or fixed income strategies

- Experience with digital or technology-enabled advisory models

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
