We're looking for an Employment Counsel to join Ramp's Legal team. This is a generalist employment role with broad scope. You will handle U.S. employment counseling as your base load, cover non-U.S. jurisdictions as needed, and own immigration and global mobility. You will partner directly with People, Talent, Total Rewards, Finance, Tax, Equity Admin, Compliance, and business leaders, and you will manage outside counsel in jurisdictions where we do not hold the expertise in house. We are a small, high-leverage team supporting a company that moves quickly, so you will cover a lot of ground and be trusted to run matters independently.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Day-to-day employment counseling: Advise People partners and managers on hiring, worker classification, compensation, leaves and accommodations, performance management, discipline, separations, and more

- Immigration and global mobility: Collaborate with the People team on the immigration program, including work authorization outside the U.S. Set and communicate the sponsorship policy, manage outside immigration counsel and case volume, and partner with Talent on offer-stage decisions. Support relocations, cross-border remote work requests, and business travel, and work with Finance and Tax on permanent establishment and mobility tax exposure

- Investigations: Collaborate with the People team on internal investigations and advise on findings and outcomes

- Disputes: Handle demand letters, agency charges, arbitrations, and litigation with outside counsel

- Agreements and templates: Own offer letters, employment agreements, separation and release agreements, contractor and consultant agreements, restrictive covenants, and the local-law variants of each

- Transactions: Support employment and immigration diligence, employee transitions, and post-close integration for M&A and new-market entry

- Build for scale: Produce manager training, policies, self-serve guidance, and repeatable processes as we expand in the US and globally

WHAT YOU NEED

- 8+ years practicing employment law, with a combination of top law firm and in-house experience at a high-growth technology company

- JD from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar (New York or California preferred)

- Deep U.S. employment counseling experience across the full employee lifecycle, including wage and hour, leaves and accommodations, investigations, performance management, and separations

- Working knowledge of employment law outside the U.S. and the judgment to triage a cross-border question quickly

- Hands-on experience with U.S. business immigration and global mobility, including running a sponsorship program and managing immigration counsel at volume

- Demonstrated ability to independently run multiple time-sensitive matters

- Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can turn an employment law question into guidance a manager can act on in one reading

- High judgment on sensitive and confidential matters, and the steadiness to advise on them under time pressure

title: Customer Success Manager, SME & Growth
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Own the first 90 days of the customer journey for new French customers, bringing them to their target level of activity as quickly as possible through clear plans, hands-on product configuration and fast blocker removal. You’ll lead onboarding from first KYC approval, working closely with Account Executives, Account Managers, KYC, Support, Risk and Product across a portfolio of customers with different levels of complexity. You’ll help customers configure and activate accounts, payments, FX, cards, Spend and payouts, while managing a proactive portfolio of partner-referred customers.

- Take ownership of each customer from first KYC approval, with a clear plan, milestones, owners and the revenue target defined at signature.

- Adapt the onboarding approach to the deal: use a scaled motion for smaller deals, a high-touch approach for larger ones, and partner with the Account Manager on enterprise onboardings.

- Guide customers through account set-up, payments, FX, cards, Spend and payouts based on their use case.

- Remove blockers quickly by coordinating with KYC, Support, Risk and Product, while keeping communication clear and proactive.

- Hand customers over to the Account Manager at day 90 with documented account status, adoption level and expansion signals.

- Reduce the time between first KYC approval and first live transaction.

- Bring each customer to the revenue target set at signature and spot at-risk onboardings early, escalating with context, impact and a proposed solution.

- Run a proactive, scaled motion for partner-referred customers, including onboarding follow-up, usage monitoring and risk detection.

- Keep partners informed about the progress of their referred customers and hand accounts that grow in value or complexity to the Account Manager.

- Contribute to onboarding playbooks, checklists and standard configurations by customer type.

- Keep Salesforce and onboarding tracking accurate and up to date, turning recurring friction into process improvements.

You’ll work from our Paris office a minimum of three days per week.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

ESSENTIALS

- Experience in onboarding, implementation, customer success or a comparable post-sale delivery role.

- Experience working in a high-pace, high-volume environment, handling multiple onboardings in parallel while maintaining quality and deadlines.

- Hands-on experience configuring a product with customers.

- A strong understanding of financial flows such as payments, FX, payouts, cards, invoicing or reconciliation, and the ability to speak credibly to Finance and Operations teams.

- A track record measured on customer outcomes such as activation, usage and time-to-live, rather than activity.

- Fluency in French and professional English.

- The ability to learn complex products quickly, explain them simply and work across teams without direct authority.

- A proactive, resilient and hands-on way of working.

PREFERRED

- Experience in fintech, payments, banking, FX or spend management.

- Accounting or finance knowledge.

- Experience with partner-referred customers.

- Familiarity with Salesforce and usage data.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

- You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

- You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

- You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

- You treat setbacks as information. You get back up quickly.

- You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability.

LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help our high-touch, Mid Market customers achieve success and maximise the value of Pleo’s solutions and be part of a dynamic and collaborative team as we scale our innovative expense management platform across the UK & Ireland

If you're excited about solving customer challenges, and driving growth through exceptional service and are passionate about Customer Success in the SaaS industry, then this is the opportunity for you!

WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You’ll report to our Director of CX and work closely with teams in CX, Onboarding, AM, Sales and Product. Our team of 30 is highly collaborative and dedicated to Customer Experience.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, your main markets will be UKI customers. You will:

- Nurture, support and process expansion for any opportunity from the customer base

- As a customer's trusted product advisor and business consultant advise them on how to create their ideal processes with the tool to optimise their value-add

- Own the adoption journey of your customer portfolio (after the onboarding phase)

- Collaborate across teams with different internal stakeholders such as product management, services & solutions, marketing, customer support, etc. to improve the entire customer experience

- Receive, qualify and triage all inbound communication from all communication channels; email, Intercom (web chat), and/or other performance marketing channels

- Cultivate key customers to become advocates of Pleo and the Fintech community

- Manage day-to-day operations and long-term business relationships with our customers

- Do everything in your power to prevent customers from leaving Pleo through measuring health scores, and product/feature adoption and acting proactively on those

- Optimise the product-market-fit by building the bridge between the customer's feedback and our product team

WHAT YOU BRING

You’ll thrive in this role if:

- You have 7+ years of prior experience in account management or sales or customer success roles

- You have an open mindset that always looks for the positive. Your customers and colleagues find your energy contagious

- You truly enjoy helping others move and improve. You love helping your customers scale and grow

- You love goals and objectives. You don't always need to be given tasks – you create your own tasks while chasing your targets, and it motivates you to reach them

- You love a fast-paced and dynamic environment, where you have different kinds of tasks - from customer calls to meetings with our product team

- This is a high volume, high velocity role. Being able to think and do things at scale is a huge plus

- You are a trustworthy person who always ensures that deadlines are reached, promises are kept, and you do what is expected of you

- You are empathetic. You have a strong ability to feel how others are doing. You are also able to communicate in a very empathetic way and touch people's emotions

- You are fluent in English

WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You enjoy building long-term relationships with high-touch, Mid Market customers and taking ownership of their success from adoption through expansion.

- You thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment and feel energised by balancing customer conversations, internal collaboration, and proactive problem-solving.

- You’re motivated by impact and outcomes — helping customers grow, spotting expansion opportunities, and turning feedback into meaningful product improvements excites you.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You’re not motivated by customer-facing work or influencing customer outcomes through proactive engagement and collaboration.

- You’re uncomfortable with project management or coordinating multiple initiatives at the same time.

- You’re not motivated by upselling, cross-selling, or optimising the long-term value of your customers’ accounts.

HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

- Lead customer adoption projects to drive impact in helping high-touch, Mid Market clients maximise the value of Pleo’s solutions.

- Collaborate with Customer Success and Product teams to improve customer experience processes and feedback loops.

- Grow your skills in relationship management and upselling strategies, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in customer success.

THE LOCATION

London, UK

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

2. A 30-45 minute call with the Hiring Manager

3. Our Pleo Challenge - an opportunity for you to showcase your ability in the form of a presentation and how you would approach the task at hand

4. Final Interview - Our Bar Raiser meeting - how would you raise the bar for us?

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a CSM, we received many applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

- CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

- Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager II to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help our SMB and Mid Market customers achieve success and maximise the value of Pleo’s solutions and be part of a dynamic and collaborative team as we scale our innovative expense management platform across the Nordics.

If you're excited about solving customer challenges, and driving growth through exceptional service and are passionate about Customer Success in the SaaS industry, then this is the opportunity for you!

WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You’ll report to our CX Manager and work closely with teams in CX, Onboarding, AM, Sales and Product. Our team of 30 is highly collaborative and dedicated to Customer Experience.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Customer Success Manager II, your main markets will be Nordics customers. You will:

- Nurture, support and process expansion for any opportunity from the customer base

- As a customer's trusted product advisor and business consultant advise them on how to create their ideal processes with the tool to optimise their value-add

- Own the adoption journey of your customer portfolio (after the onboarding phase)

- Collaborate across teams with different internal stakeholders such as product management, services & solutions, marketing, customer support, etc. to improve the entire customer experience

- Receive, qualify and triage all inbound communication from all communication channels; email, Intercom (web chat), and/or other performance marketing channels

- Cultivate key customers to become advocates of Pleo and the Fintech community

- Manage day-to-day operations and long-term business relationships with our customers

- Do everything in your power to prevent customers from leaving Pleo through measuring health scores, and product/ feature adoption and acting proactively on those

- Optimise the product-market-fit by building the bridge between the customer's feedback and our product team

WHAT YOU BRING

You’ll thrive in this role if:

- You have 5+ years of prior experience in account management or sales or customer success roles

- You have an open mindset that always looks for the positive. Your customers and colleagues find your energy contagious

- You truly enjoy helping others move and improve. You love helping your customers scale and grow

- You love goals and objectives. You don't always need to be given tasks – you create your own tasks while chasing your targets, and it motivates you to reach them

- You love a fast-paced and dynamic environment, where you have different kinds of tasks - from customer calls to meetings with our product team

- This is a high volume, high velocity role. Being able to think and do things at scale is a huge plus

- You are a trustworthy person who always ensures that deadlines are reached, promises are kept, and you do what is expected of you

- You are empathetic. You have a strong ability to feel how others are doing. You are also able to communicate in a very empathetic way and touch people's emotions

- You are fluent in English

WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You enjoy building long-term relationships with SMB and Mid Market customers and taking ownership of their success from adoption through expansion.

- You thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment and feel energised by balancing customer conversations, internal collaboration, and proactive problem-solving.

- You’re motivated by impact and outcomes — helping customers grow, spotting expansion opportunities, and turning feedback into meaningful product improvements excites you.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You’re not motivated by customer-facing work or influencing customer outcomes through proactive engagement and collaboration.

- You’re uncomfortable with project management or coordinating multiple initiatives at the same time.

- You’re not motivated by upselling, cross-selling, or optimising the long-term value of your customers’ accounts.

HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

- Lead customer adoption projects to drive impact in helping SMB and Mid Market clients maximise the value of Pleo’s solutions.

- Collaborate with Customer Success and Product teams to improve customer experience processes and feedback loops.

- Grow your skills in relationship management and upselling strategies, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in customer success.

THE LOCATION

Copenhagen, Lisbon, London

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

2. A 30-45 minute call with the Hiring Manager

3. Our Pleo Challenge - an opportunity for you to showcase your ability in the form of a presentation and how you would approach the task at hand

Manage timelines, dependencies, stakeholder alignment, and iterative feedback loops to ensure successful execution and behaviour change aligned to performance indicators.

- Run the enablement intake and calendar. Manage a single intake process for enablement requests, so every request comes with a clear why, an owner and a realistic lead time. Maintain a monthly enablement calendar visible to the whole GTM organisation.

- Drive adoption and behaviour change Move beyond content delivery to ensure programmes actually change how people work. Co-facilitate live sessions, develop supporting materials and e-learning, gather real-time feedback, and iterate quickly. Understand what reinforcement looks like and how to embed learning into ongoing work.

- Measure impact and report on ROI Build dashboards that track completion, engagement, and business outcomes. Connect enablement activity to commercial metrics (win rates, deal velocity, customer outcomes). Report transparently on what's working, what's not, and what we should double down on.

- Partner on content and validate quality Work with subject-matter experts to validate enablement content for accuracy, relevance, and fit-for-purpose. Gather field feedback from reps and managers, iterate rapidly, and ensure content lands with real sellers in real deals.

Build credibility through expertise and clear communication of impact.Partner with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Product Marketing, and Product to ensure enablement is aligned to commercial strategy and directly tied to business outcomes

- Diagnose and solve delivery challenges When a programme isn't landing or blockers emerge, help to diagnose the root cause, drive timely solutions, and escalate strategically to maintain momentum.

- Run onboarding. Coordinate GTM onboarding end to end and help reduce ramp time and time to first deal.

- Leverage technology and tools Use Sana Learn for platform management and content hosting. Work with Gong to analyse real calls and identify enablement gaps. Familiarise yourself with Hubspot for data. Explore how AI tools can accelerate content creation and personalised learning. To put things into context, we're currently scaling our mid-market and enterprise segment in various regions, and investing heavily in the skills, content, and infrastructure needed to support longer, more complex sales cycles. You can expect to work with tools including Hubspot, Gong, Sana, and AI-powered learning technologies.

WHAT YOU BRING

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- Enablement or GTM-adjacent experience 3–5 years in Sales Enablement, L&D, or Go-to-Market operations. Track record of owning programmes end-to-end and knowing what it takes to make learning stick. Or 5+ years of SaaS sales experience with a strong passion for coaching and developing others.

- Programme delivery capability Proven ability to manage complex programmes from design through adoption. You understand the difference between one-off training and systemic behaviour change. You think in phases: awareness → skill-building → reinforcement → measurement.

- Data and measurement mindset Comfortable with data analysis and dashboard reporting to analyse performance. Experience connecting enablement initiatives to commercial outcomes (deal velocity, win rates, customer retention). You care about ROI, not just completion metrics.

- Stakeholder management and communication Ability to build trust with commercial leaders and function heads. You communicate clearly, translate between technical and business language, and escalate smartly. You're credible with experienced sellers, not just through title but through expertise.

- Facilitation and coaching Comfortable delivering live programmes, providing feedback, and coaching managers through adoption challenges. You can present confidently to senior commercial audiences and engage experienced sellers.

- LMS and content creation tools Familiarity with Sana or similar LMS platforms. Comfort using content creation tools (Canva, Tella, Google Slides) to build professional learning assets.

- Sales stack familiarity Working knowledge of Hubspot, Gong, Cognism, LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Understanding of how these tools connect and where data lives. Experience integrating AI into Enablement programmes is a strong plus.

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You thrive in roles where you're both a trusted partner to commercial leaders and a hands-on builder of programmes and content.

- You're energised by the challenge of making enablement work—connecting the dots between content, adoption, behaviour change, and business outcomes.

title: Partner Solutions Engineer - VAR
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Our ‘get it done’ culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.

Snowflake is rapidly growing its Alliances & Channel Organization. title: Junior Graphic Designer
description:
**About the role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented, organized, and motivated **Junior Graphic Designer** to join our growing creative team at Manhead.

The Junior Graphic Designer will be responsible for executing and preparing merchandise artwork across **Tour, E-commerce, Retail, and Direct-to-Consumer (D2C)** platforms for our extensive roster of artists and brands.

Working closely with our Graphic Design, Apparel Design, and Production teams, this role will focus on executing established creative direction, preparing artwork for production, creating product mockups, building presentations, and ensuring all artwork meets Manhead's standards for quality, accuracy, and consistency.

A significant part of this role involves supporting production workflows, managing time-sensitive artwork setups, reviewing print proofs, and maintaining an accurate, organized artwork catalog across our artist roster.

**Attention to detail, organization, collaboration, and flawless execution are at the core of this position.** The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, can confidently manage multiple priorities, and understands the importance of delivering accurate work within tight deadlines.

A strong foundation in **apparel graphic design and production processes is essential** , along with a working knowledge of garment decoration techniques and the technical requirements needed to take artwork from approved design to finished product.

**What you'll do**

**Artwork Execution & Design Support**

* Execute artwork based on established creative direction, approved designs, and artist brand guidelines.
* Create accurate product mockups for apparel, accessories, and merchandise across Tour, E-commerce, Retail, and D2C channels.
* Build polished presentation decks and visual layouts for internal and client reviews.
* Make artwork revisions, adjustments, and updates based on feedback from the creative and account management teams.
* Resize, reformat, and adapt existing artwork for various products, garment styles, and production requirements.
* Ensure all artwork maintains brand consistency, accuracy, and the highest level of attention to detail.

**Production Coordination & Artwork Preparation**
-------------------------------------------------

* Work closely with the Production team to prepare and deliver time-sensitive artwork setups, ensuring all files meet production specifications and deadlines.
* Prepare accurate, production-ready artwork for screen printing, embroidery, specialty inks, and other garment decoration methods.
* Review print proofs for accuracy, including artwork placement, sizing, color, spelling, and overall execution, ensuring all details align with approved designs.
* Coordinate with Production to address artwork revisions, resolve technical challenges, and maintain efficient communication throughout the production process.
* Prioritize urgent artwork requests and proof approvals to support tight production schedules and avoid unnecessary delays.
* Ensure final artwork files are properly formatted, organized, and ready for production.

**Artwork Catalog Management**
------------------------------

* Maintain and regularly update Manhead's artwork catalog across our extensive artist roster.
* Ensure all artwork, revisions, approvals, and final production files are accurately organized, labeled, and easily accessible.
* Maintain consistency in file naming, version control, and artwork documentation.
* Ensure approved designs and final production artwork are properly archived for future reference, reorders, and ongoing merchandise programs.
* Work with internal teams to ensure the artwork catalog remains current, accurate, and complete.

**Collaboration & Project Management**
--------------------------------------

* Collaborate closely with the Graphic Design, Apparel Design, Production, and Account Management teams to ensure artwork and production needs are met.
* Serve as a reliable resource for cross-functional teams, responding efficiently to artwork requests and production-related needs.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, organization, and established deadlines.
* Communicate proactively regarding project status, outstanding artwork needs, potential challenges, and timelines.
* Maintain a positive, collaborative attitude and contribute to an efficient, solutions-oriented team environment.

**Qualifications**

* Previous experience working with graphics specifically for apparel and merchandise.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator and Photoshop.
* Strong understanding of typography, composition, color accuracy, and graphic layout.
* Working knowledge of apparel production processes, including screen printing, embroidery, and various decoration techniques.
* Experience preparing production-ready artwork and reviewing print proofs.
* Experience creating apparel mockups and presentation layouts.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality control.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain detailed artwork libraries, file structures, and version control.
* Ability to follow established creative direction and execute revisions accurately and efficiently.
* Ability to prioritize competing deadlines and thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-first mindset.
* A positive attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to learn and grow.
* An interest in music, fashion, and the merchandise industry.
* A portfolio demonstrating apparel graphics, production knowledge, and technical execution.

--------------------------
**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

We're looking for someone who is **highly organized, detail-driven, dependable, and takes genuine pride in their work.**

Someone who understands that even the smallest details matter, whether it's preparing a time-sensitive print file, catching an error on a proof, building an accurate product mockup, or keeping our artwork catalog organized and current.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working within established creative direction, takes feedback well, and knows how to balance quality with efficiency.

Above all, we're looking for a team player who is proactive, adaptable, and eager to support the creative and production teams in delivering exceptional merchandise.

**At Manhead, great design starts with a strong vision, but exceptional execution is what brings it to life.**

title: Senior .NET Engineer (UK)
description:
----------------
*What You’ll Do*
----------------

As a Senior .NET Engineer at Lateral, you will:

*

*Design and build scalable, resilient cloud applications* on *Azure* using C#, .NET and SQL, delivering solutions that are secure, high-performance, adhere to our Coding Standards and “just work”.

*

*Write clean, clear, and well-tested code,* embracing software craftsmanship principles to produce robust, reusable and maintainable systems. You will ensure a high bar for code quality through comprehensive unit tests and attention to detail.

*Take ownership of features end-to-end* , from initial concept through deployment. You’ll often drive substantial product features as the key developer alongside an architect or product designer.

*

*Mentor and support junior engineers* , leading by example in code reviews and pair programming. You will offer constructive feedback that helps others grow, fostering a thoughtful, kind, and continuously learning team culture.

*

*Provide technical leadership* in architecture and design discussions, advocating for simple, elegant solutions. You’ll challenge unnecessary complexity and focus on pragmatic results.

*

*Continuously improve the codebase* through refactoring and refinement, balancing new feature development with paying down technical debt. You’ll adopt an iterative approach of tweaking and constantly improving the software to keep the system simple, stable, and adaptable.

*

*Champion quality* , reliability and scalability by implementing best practices in cloud operations (monitoring, security, CI/CD).

*Example Projects You May Join:*

*

Build an AI-powered healthcare platform to help detect diseases earlier.

*

Launch a new fintech product from the ground up.

*

Scale a global SaaS commerce system with millions of products

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

*How We Measure Success In This Role*

*In the first two weeks*

*

You make your first meaningful contribution to the project

*

You communicate well async as well as in meetings

*In the first 3 months:*

*

You understand the system architecture well and can work independently or in teams on medium-sized features.

*

You design before you code (and produce design artifacts)

*

You have shipped code in Production, clean, tested

*

You communicate clearly, raising issues early and contributing to reviews.

*

You deliver what you commit to.

*After 3 months:*

*

You take ownership of larger features and improvements from start to finish.

*

You help others by sharing knowledge, spotting problems early, and improving processes or tooling.

*

You make decisions with both the codebase and business goals in mind.

*We measure success through:*

*

Evaluating results (what you’ve shipped)

*

Quality and reliability of your code.

*

Consistency in delivery.

*

Feedback from peers and leads.

*

Your ability to work independently and unblock others.

------------------------
*What We’re Looking For*
------------------------

We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

*

*7+ years* experience in software development

*

Deep expertise in *C#* and the *.NET* ecosystem, including: NET Core, ASP.NET Core and .NET 6 or later

*

Strong proficiency with *Entity Framework Core* and *MS SQL Server*

*

Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming *(OOP), Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), SOLID* principles.

*

Experience with to cloud-native and *distributed systems* , ideally including: Azure Service Fabric, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Redis, Azure Storage, Application Insights

*

Proven experience building robust, well-structured *APIs*

*

A *quality mindset* : unit tests, integration tests, automation, defensive programming

*

Excellent *problem-solving and debugging* skills with a hands-on, *proactive* attitude

*

Ability to *Design* before you code—express decisions through clear diagrams, validate assumptions early, and think through edge cases and trade-offs.

*

Ability to quickly understand the nature of the business and clearly communicate with stakeholders (clients, colleagues)

*

Strong *written and verbal communication skills* in English.

*

A commitment to *making a difference* , *continuous learning* , and *collaboration*

*Bonus points for:*

*

Experience with Large scale systems or datasets, Performance

*

Graph Technologies

*

Clarity in communication and design documentation.

*Extra bonus points for:*

*

Experience building Infrastructure

------------------------------
*Why You’ll Love Working Here*
------------------------------

*

*Real Impact:* You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

*

*Remote-First, Office Friendly:* Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.

We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

*

*An Outstanding Team:* Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

*

*Growth:* You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

*

*A Culture of Excellence:* We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

*

*Variety & Stability:* We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

--------------------------------
*This Role Might Not Be for You*
--------------------------------

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

*

*You prefer well defined structure.* If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

*

*Distributed work isn’t your thing.* If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

*

*Feedback doesn't excite you.* We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

*

*Change makes you uncomfortable.* We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

----------------------------------------------------------
*How to apply and what to expect in the interview process*
----------------------------------------------------------

*01. Your work*
Show us the work that reflects you at your best. We’ll look at depth, design thinking, and the logic behind your choices.

*02. Lateral team fit*
You’ll speak with our Talent team about your career direction, your motivators, and our plans ahead.

*03. Work trial*

You’ll tackle a take-home challenge that mirrors what we actually do.

*04.* *Engineering deep dive*
A collaborative session with our engineers.

*05. Project fit*
An interview focussed on prioritization, collaboration across disciplines, and how you handle the "messy middle".

title: Junior Payroll Assistant
description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

*Corporate Secretary* : Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

*Accounting & Bookkeeping* : Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

*FinTech payments* : Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

*Requirements*

Mission of the role
-------------------

To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines.

The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation.

Key outcomes In the first 6–12 months
-------------------------------------

Outcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency
-----------------------------------------------------

Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls.

Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month.

Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing
--------------------------------------------------

Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission.

Ensure *100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines* , including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements.

Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy.

Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness
------------------------------------------

Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries.

Consistently achieve a *CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month* while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day.

Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required.

Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement
---------------------------------------------------

Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues.

Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times.

*Must-have experience*

* Minimum *1–2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience*.
* Experience working in a *bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre* is preferred.
* Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of UK payroll processes, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and workplace pension processes.
* Experience with payroll software such as *BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar* is an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics.
* Practical experience or strong interest in using *AI tools, automation, and IT applications* to improve daily workflows.

*Must-have attributes*

*Ownership & Accountability:* Takes full responsibility for assigned payrolls and client accounts, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and proactively resolves issues or roadblocks.

*Humility:* Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required.

*Structured Thinking:* Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements.

*Data Driven & Attention to Detail:* Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients.

*Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way:* Able to communicate clearly and professionally when dealing with sensitive payroll issues, missing information, delays, or difficult client situations while maintaining a constructive client relationship.

*AI & Tech Savvy:* Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, automation, and technology to make payroll processes more efficient and effective.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

We will be looking for candidates who have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

*Ownership:* This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

*Humility:* There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

*Structured Thinking:* Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

*Attention to detail:* You'll be managing multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and workstreams. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing, inconsistent, or likely to cause an issue.

*Excellent listener and clear communicator:* We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

*The interview process*

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than *3 weeks from start to finish*.

*TA Screen / One-way Video Interview:* Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview to assess spoken and written communication, relevant UK payroll experience, motivation, and initial background.

*Technical Round:* A 30-minute interview and practical assessment with the Hiring Team to assess UK payroll knowledge, payroll processing experience, attention to detail, ability to work with payroll data, and understanding of UK payroll processes and deadlines.

*Soft Skills Round:* A 30-minute chat with a member of the leadership team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values, including ownership, humility, structured thinking, communication, and ability to handle challenging situations.

*Reference Verification:* Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

*Requirement for background screening*

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

* Your education
* Any criminal history
* Any political exposure
* Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

*Benefits*

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

*Humility and kindness:* Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

*Flexibility:* You’ll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

*Financial benefits:* We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

*Personal growth:* You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.
