title: Junior Customer Success Manager
description:
----------------
*About Motion 💡*
----------------

Marketing today runs on creative, and the teams doing it best understand that creative is both an art and a science. Rather than shipping ads and hoping they land, they build systems to understand what's driving performance, then turn those insights into repeat successes.

Motion is built to help teams do exactly that. Our platform helps marketing teams understand which of their online ads are performing best and why, so they can ship more winners across Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube.

We found product-market fit as an analytics platform, then dove headfirst into AI over the past couple of years, and that bet is paying off: our valuation has nearly tripled in two years, and we now help some of the world's top ecommerce and DTC brands and agencies, like Vuori, AG1, and HexClad, turn insights into results.

▶️ Learn more about the Motion product AND meet our new AI agent, *Runneth* 👋

----------------------------------------------------
*About the Junior Customer Success Manager role* *💜*
----------------------------------------------------

This role is built for people coming out of hospitality.

If you have run a packed section on a Saturday night, worked a hotel front desk when three things went wrong at once, or managed a floor where every table had a different problem, you already have the hardest part of this job. You read people fast. You keep twenty things moving without dropping any of them. You stay warm when it gets loud. You do not need to be told to hustle.

What you do not have yet is the software part. That is what we teach.
You will join our SMB customer success team and work with hundreds of small and mid-sized brands and agencies who use Motion and Runneth, our AI agent, to run their ad creative. Most of your day is written: Slack, email, and short screen-share calls. You will be paired with a senior CSM who shows you the product, the customers, and how we work, and the goal is for you to grow into a full CSM.

---------------------------
*What you'll actually do 🏆*
---------------------------

* *Run Runneth 101*. Teach new customers how to put our AI agent to work in their first week. Group sessions, one-on-one calls, and async walkthroughs. You will be the first human most of them talk to.
* *Work the signals*. Our systems flag customers who went quiet, are about to hit a limit, or got stuck. You reach out before they have to ask, the same way a good server refills the water before anyone looks up.
* *Bring accounts back*. Customers go dark for all kinds of reasons. You find out why, fix what you can, and get them using the product again.
* *Answer fast and clearly*. Customers hear back in hours, not days. You write short, plain messages that solve the problem and make people feel taken care of.
* *Keep the record clean*. Every customer conversation lands in HubSpot. The whole team runs on what you write down.
* *Become fluent in Motion and Runneth*. In your first 30 days you will use the product every day until you can explain it to anyone. Every CSM here uses AI as a daily working habit, and so will you, from day one.

----------------------------------------
*The honest part: this job moves fast 🏃*
----------------------------------------

The volume is real. You will talk to more customers in a week than most CSMs do in a month, and you will do most of it in writing. If you are a great talker but hate typing, this will be hard.

The product changes constantly. The thing you learned two weeks ago might be different today. You have to enjoy re-learning.

And you are starting from scratch on the software side. We will teach you, and your senior partner will be in it with you, but the first few months take real effort. People who do well here treat it like opening week at a new restaurant: a lot to learn, fast, and worth it.

*This role probably isn't for you if:*

* You want a job where someone tells you exactly what to do each day
* You want to stop learning once you are trained
* You think of customers as tickets to close instead of people to take care of
* You are not comfortable writing a lot, all day
* You want AI to stay a nice-to-have rather than a core working habit

----------------
*How we work 🗝️*
----------------

* *We're fast*. Customers hear back in hours, not days. Momentum is everything.
* *We're advocates*. We champion our clients internally and always work to understand their perspective.
* *We're authorities*. No professional masking, no generic playbooks. We show up with a real, informed point of view tailored to each client's business and goals.

------------------------
*Where this role goes 🚀*
------------------------

Associate CSM is a starting point, not a ceiling. We expect associates to grow into full CSMs, and how fast depends on you. From there, CS at Motion is a launchpad: Vamsi moved from CS into Product Management, Carissa moved into Creative Strategy and then chose to come back to CS. Whatever direction you grow, what you learn about customers here travels with you.

------------------------
*Our ideal fit brings ✨*
------------------------

* *2+ years in high-volume hospitality*. Server, bartender, host, front desk, shift lead, restaurant or hotel manager. You handled a big section or a busy floor and you were good at it.
* *Already moving toward tech on your own*. You did not wait for someone to hand you a path. Maybe you took a course, built a website for the restaurant, ran its Instagram, set up its booking or POS system, started a side business, or just got obsessed with AI tools. We want to hear about it.
* *You have built something from nothing*. A menu, a system, an event, a side hustle, a process the rest of the staff ended up using. Tell us what it was.
* *High agency*. You see a problem and handle it. You ask the question no one else is asking. You do not wait for permission to make things better.
* *You explain things clearly*. In writing, out loud, to someone who is frustrated or in a hurry.
* *You genuinely care about people*. You remember the regulars. You notice when something is off. You take it personally when a customer has a bad time.
* *Exceptional organization*. This role rewards people who run a tight system.
* *Bonus points* : any exposure to marketing, ecommerce, or a DTC brand (even as a customer who pays attention), or experience with Shopify, Meta ads, or a CRM.

---------------------------------
*What you'll love about Motion 💜*
---------------------------------

* *Compensation:* Competitive compensation including equity for all employees, health benefits from day one, a monthly health & lifestyle stipend, 20 days PTO, and a $1,500 work-from-home stipend
* *Remote-first, hybrid optional:* Team members across Canada, the U.S., and beyond, with office hubs in Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver, and Porto
* *Real momentum:* 2.5x YoY growth, $65M+ total raised ($30M Series B), and second-time founders. Several teammates chose to build with them again.
* *Low-ego, high-performing team:* Ranked #19 on G2's Best Canadian Software Companies for 2026
* *Connection:* Day-to-day on Roam, an AI-powered virtual office. In person, an annual team offsite and a summer company retreat.

*🌎 A note on location* : we're looking to hire someone based in Canada or the United States. Pacific time hours are a plus.

We use artificial intelligence (AI) in certain parts of our recruiting process at Motion, ranging from administrative and efficiency-focused support to, in some cases, conducting introductory interviews. Every AI interview is reviewed, and every hiring decision is made, by a (human) member of our team.

title: Junior Risk & Compliance Analyst
description:
*About Tradeify FX*

Tradeify is a fast-growing futures trading company built to help traders access the tools, technology, and opportunities they need to succeed. We combine a trader-first approach with modern technology to create a reliable, transparent, and engaging experience for our growing community.

Tradeify FX is our new team focused on the forex market, bringing that same approach to a global FX audience. We operate at the intersection of finance and technology, and we move quickly.

*About the Role*

We’re building out our FX offering for UK and European markets and need a detail-oriented junior hire to help keep it safe, compliant, and well-monitored. You’ll support the FX team’s day-to-day risk and compliance work: monitoring client and trading activity, checking it against our internal rules and applicable regulation, and producing the reporting that keeps leadership informed. It’s a strong first or second role for someone who wants a career in financial risk and compliance.

*What You Will Do*

*

Monitor FX accounts and trading activity for rule breaches, unusual behavior, and risk exposure

*

Review flagged accounts and escalate issues with clear, well-documented findings

*

Support KYC/AML onboarding checks, sanctions and PEP screening, and ongoing due diligence

*

Help maintain compliance policies, procedures, and controls aligned with UK and EU requirements

*

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly risk and compliance reports for management

*

Track regulatory developments from bodies such as the FCA and ESMA, and flag anything that affects the FX business

*

Support GDPR / UK GDPR compliance in how client data is handled and stored

*

Keep audit-ready records and help respond to internal reviews and regulator or partner requests

*

Work with the FX, Support, and Operations teams to resolve compliance queries quickly

*What We Are Looking For*

*

Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, law, business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

*

0-2 years of experience in risk, compliance, financial operations, or a similar analytical role (internships count)

*

Strong attention to detail and comfort working with data in Excel or Google Sheets

*

Clear written communication in English

*

Good judgment, integrity, and comfort handling confidential information

*

Ability to work independently, prioritize, and hit deadlines

*Nice to Have*

*

Basic understanding of FX markets, leverage, and retail trading concepts

*

Familiarity with MiFID II, UK Money Laundering Regulations, or EU AML frameworks

*

Exposure to a brokerage, prop trading, or other regulated financial services environment

*

Experience with SQL, dashboards, or reporting tools

*

Working toward a compliance qualification (e.g., ICA, ACAMS)

*

Additional European languages

*Why Join Tradeify*

*

Join a rapidly growing trading company at an exciting stage of its development, and help launch its new FX team

*

Get real ownership of day-to-day risk and compliance work for a brand-new division

*

Gain exposure to risk, compliance, product, and operations work instead of being limited to one area

*

See the direct impact of your work across the business

*

Learn from experienced risk and compliance professionals and senior team members while developing greater ownership and independence

*

Work in a remote-friendly, fast-moving environment

*

Receive competitive compensation and benefits

*

Help build a safe, trusted experience for Tradeify’s growing community of traders

*A Note on Our Hiring Process*

At Tradeify, we use AI-assisted tools as part of our recruiting process, which may include resume screening, application review, and candidate communication. We want all applicants to be aware of this upfront so you can make an informed decision about applying. Final hiring decisions are always made by a member of our team.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
About the Job
-------------

The Opportunity
---------------

As a Junior Software Engineer at Mimi Dental Clinic, you will contribute to building the technology that powers Ibadan's premier dental practice, serving over 15,000 patients with world-class care across more than two decades of continuous operation. Mimi Dental Clinic is a leading dental healthcare provider delivering exceptional, patient-centred care with warmth, precision, and integrity, backed by nearly 2,000 Google reviews and a 4.9-star rating.

In this role, you will work alongside senior engineers to develop, test, and ship features across our patient-facing platforms, clinical operations tools, and internal systems. You will gain hands-on experience with mobile application development, healthcare data systems, and the infrastructure that enables thousands of patients to access premium dental care seamlessly. You will be trusted with meaningful work from day one, not sidelined with tasks that don't matter.

This is a rare opportunity to begin your engineering career at the intersection of healthcare and technology, where your contributions will be visible, valued, and directly tied to the quality of experience that patients receive at one of Nigeria's highest-rated dental practices.

What You'll Do
--------------

Write clean, well-tested code that contributes to Mimi Dental Clinic's core platforms, patient-facing applications, and internal tooling. Collaborate with senior engineers on the design and implementation of new features across our mobile application, booking systems, and clinical operations infrastructure. Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving feedback that elevates the quality of the entire team's work. Assist in debugging, troubleshooting, and resolving issues across the platform with attention to detail and persistence. Contribute to building and improving automation that supports our patient scheduling, follow-up, and engagement workflows. Learn and grow rapidly by engaging with modern tools, frameworks, and healthcare technology in a production environment.

What You'll Need to Succeed
---------------------------

A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience through bootcamps, self-directed learning, or personal projects. Foundational knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript. Familiarity with web development fundamentals including APIs, databases, and version control with Git. A genuine desire to learn, improve, and take ownership of your growth as an engineer. Strong communication skills and a collaborative disposition, comfortable working within a team and asking thoughtful questions. Genuine interest in healthcare technology, patient experience systems, or digital health innovation is highly valued.

Role Details
------------

Employment Type: Full-Time and Part-Time positions available Location: Fully Remote Stage: Established, 20+ years operational

About Mimi Dental Clinic
------------------------

Mimi Dental Clinic is Ibadan's premier dental practice, founded in 2004 with a singular vision: to deliver world-class dental care with warmth, precision, and integrity. For over two decades, we have been the trusted choice for individuals and families seeking exceptional oral healthcare in a refined, comfortable setting. We provide a comprehensive suite of dental services including general dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, orthodontics, dental implants, oral surgery, paediatric dentistry, and emergency care.

We are not simply a dental clinic. We are the standard that others aspire to, serving over 15,000 satisfied patients with a 99% satisfaction rate, investing continuously in advanced technology, and building digital experiences that reflect the same commitment to excellence that defines every aspect of our care.

Equal Opportunity
-----------------

Mimi Dental Clinic is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome dedicated individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We believe that exceptional care is delivered by exceptional teams, and exceptional teams are built on inclusion, respect, and the understanding that brilliance has no single origin.

If you require accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to our team and we will ensure your needs are met with care.

Let's build the future of dental healthcare, together.

title: Junior Content Writer
description:
*Have a way with words? Turn your creativity into content that connects, engages, and drives results.
*

iQansoft is looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and enthusiastic *Junior Content Writer* to join our growing marketing team.

We're seeking someone who can transform ideas into clear, compelling, and audience-focused content across websites, blogs, social media, digital advertising, email campaigns, and video scripts.

The ideal candidate combines excellent English writing skills, creative storytelling, research abilities, and an understanding of SEO and digital marketing. We're particularly interested in writers who can adapt to different brand voices, think independently, and use AI-powered tools intelligently without compromising originality or quality.

This is an opportunity to expand your creative abilities, work across diverse industries, collaborate with marketing professionals, and develop practical expertise in modern content marketing.

*If you're passionate about writing, curious about new ideas, and eager to create content that makes an impact, we'd love to hear from you.
*

*Website Content & Copywriting*

* Create engaging, SEO-friendly content for websites, landing pages, and service pages that clearly communicates brand messaging, services, and value propositions.
* Write compelling headlines, subheadings, and calls to action (CTAs) that encourage audience engagement and conversions.
* Review and optimize existing website content for clarity, readability, relevance, and performance.

*SEO Content & Blog Writing*

* Research, write, and update original, informative, and well-structured blog articles aligned with target audiences and search intent.
* Apply on-page SEO practices, including keyword integration, heading structures, meta titles, meta descriptions, and internal linking.
* Collaborate with SEO specialists to align content with keyword strategies, editorial calendars, and organic growth objectives.

*Social Media Content & Creative Copy*

* Develop engaging captions, post copy, carousel content, creative hooks, and platform-specific messaging for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and other relevant channels.
* Adapt content to different audiences, brand personalities, and social media formats.
* Research emerging trends, suggest fresh content ideas, and collaborate with designers and video editors on creative campaigns.

*Advertising & Marketing Copy*

* Write persuasive, conversion-focused copy for Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other digital marketing campaigns.
* Develop variations of ad headlines, descriptions, primary text, and CTAs for creative testing.
* Translate customer pain points, product benefits, and campaign objectives into compelling promotional and lead-generation messaging.

*Email Marketing Content*

* Create engaging newsletters, promotional emails, customer communications, and lead-nurturing sequences.
* Write effective subject lines, preview text, and CTAs that encourage engagement.
* Tailor messaging to different target audiences, customer journey stages, and email marketing campaigns.

*Video Scripts & Storytelling*

* Develop engaging scripts and storytelling concepts for reels, promotional videos, explainers, product demonstrations, testimonials, and founder-led content.
* Create attention-grabbing hooks and structure scripts to communicate key messages clearly and concisely.
* Collaborate with designers, video editors, and animators to translate scripts into engaging visual content.

*AI-Assisted Content Creation*
------------------------------

* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude for brainstorming, research, outlining, and content refinement.
* Develop effective prompts and critically review, fact-check, edit, and humanize AI-assisted content.
* Maintain originality, accuracy, natural writing, and brand consistency while avoiding excessive reliance on AI.
* Stay informed about emerging AI tools and evolving content marketing practices.

*Content Research, Collaboration & Quality Assurance*

* Conduct independent research on industries, competitors, products, services, and target audiences.
* Collaborate with SEO specialists, designers, performance marketers, and other team members to support marketing objectives.
* Follow content briefs, editorial guidelines, and brand tone-of-voice requirements.
* Proofread and edit content for grammar, clarity, accuracy, and consistency.
* Manage assigned tasks, maintain organized content documents, incorporate feedback, and meet deadlines.

*Skills*
--------

* Excellent *English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills.*
* Strong *creative writing, storytelling, and copywriting abilities.*
* Ability to research topics and create clear, engaging, and original content.
* Ability to adapt writing styles for different brands, audiences, and platforms.
* Strong *attention to detail, communication, teamwork, and time management.*

*Knowledge*

* *Basic understanding of SEO, keyword research, and content optimization.*
* *Familiarity with digital marketing,* social media, and conversion-focused writing.
* Understanding of audience research, brand messaging, and content strategies.
* Familiarity with *AI writing tools and responsible AI-assisted content creation.*

*Expertise*

* *6 months to 2 years of relevant content writing or copywriting experience.*
* *Experience creating website content, blogs, social media posts, or marketing copy.*
* Ability to use *AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude to support content creation.*
* Experience *writing for international audiences, advertising campaigns, email marketing, or video scripts is a plus.*
* Familiarity with *SEO tools, Google Analytics, or email marketing platforms is an advantage.*

*Education & Qualifications*

* *Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.*
* Talented fresh graduates with strong writing skills and relevant portfolios are encouraged to apply.

Why Join iQansoft?
------------------

* *Remote Work:* Work from anywhere within the company's approved remote-work arrangements.
* *Creative Opportunities:* Work on diverse brands, industries, and marketing projects.
* *Learning & Development:* Expand your skills in content writing, SEO, digital marketing, and AI tools.
* *Supportive Team:* Collaborate with experienced marketing and creative professionals.
* *Career Growth:* Opportunities to learn, take ownership, and grow professionally.

title: Junior AI Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Du willst KI nicht nur ausprobieren, sondern damit unser gesamtes Company Setup smarter machen? Als Junior AI Engineer (m/w/d) entwickelst du AI-Automationen für unsere internen Prozesse, von Customer Service über Supply Chain bis Reporting, und bringst sie vom Prototyp bis in den produktiven Betrieb. Du verbindest unsere Systeme über APIs mit unserem Data Warehouse, machst Daten nutzbar und verbesserst deine Use Cases messbar. Dabei denkst du nicht in Einzelprojekten, sondern betrachtest Prozesse ganzheitlich, erkennst selbst, wo es Potenzial gibt, und arbeitest eng mit unseren Business-Teams zusammen.
Wenn du ein gutes Verständnis für Python, SQL und Cloud-Architekturen mitbringst, schon selbst etwas mit LLMs gebaut hast und dich schnelle Veränderungen eher anspornen als abschrecken, dann suchen wir genau dich!

*Deine Aufgaben*

* *AI-Automationen:* Du entwickelst und betreibst AI-Automationen für interne Prozesse wie Customer Service, Supply Chain und Reporting und begleitest sie vom ersten Prototyp bis in den produktiven Betrieb.
* *System-Integration:* Du verbindest interne und externe Systeme über APIs (z. B. Shopify, Zendesk/Resolvia, Sage/Anvyl, Klaviyo), bindest sie an unser Data Warehouse an und stellst die Daten unseren AI Agents zur Verfügung.
* *Prompt & Agent Engineering:* Du setzt Use Cases um, testest die Ergebnisse systematisch und verbesserst sie messbar in Qualität, Kosten und Latenz.
* *Prozessoptimierung:* Du verstehst unsere Prozesse im Detail, verbesserst sie und entwickelst neue interdisziplinäre Abläufe. Dein Ziel ist dabei immer, unser Company Setup als Ganzes weiterzuentwickeln.
* *Projektverantwortung:* Du identifizierst eigenständig neue Projekte und Verbesserungspotenziale, nimmst aber auch Anfragen aus den Teams auf. Im Schnitt steuerst du drei Projekte parallel und behältst sie über ein klares Meilenstein-Setup im Griff.
* *Enablement:* Du unterstützt unsere Business-Teams, baust interne Tools, dokumentierst Ergebnisse und hilfst deinen Kolleg:innen dabei, die Automationen selbstständig zu nutzen.

* *Studium & Ausbildung:* Du hast ein Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Informatik, Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich abgeschlossen. Ein starkes Portfolio (eigene Projekte, GitHub, Open Source) oder ein Quereinstieg mit nachweisbarer Praxiserfahrung zählt für uns genauso viel, der Abschluss ist also kein Muss.
* *Python & SQL:* Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Python (APIs/REST, Git, methodisches Debugging) und SQL und idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit BigQuery oder einem vergleichbaren Cloud Data Warehouse.
* *LLMs & AI Tooling:* Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs und AI Tools (Claude/OpenAI APIs, Agents, MCP, Cursor/Claude Code) und hast damit nicht nur gearbeitet, sondern schon eigene Lösungen entwickelt.
* *Cloud & Tools:* Du kennst dich mit Enterprise Cloud (z. B. Google Cloud oder AWS) und Deployment aus, inklusive Container und CI/CD. Erfahrung mit Shopify ist ein Plus.
* *Systemverständnis:* Du erfasst schnell, wie Datenflüsse laufen und Systeme zusammenhängen.
* *Eigeninitiative:* Du bringst eine Hands-on-Mentalität mit, nimmst offen formulierte Probleme selbst in die Hand und lieferst eine erste funktionierende Lösung.
* *Lernbereitschaft:* Du hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und bringst dir neue Themen gerne selbst bei, technisch genauso wie in den Business-Bereichen. In diesem Feld ändert sich jeden Monat etwas, deshalb zählt deine Lernfähigkeit für uns mehr als das, was du heute schon weißt.
* *Kommunikation & Stakeholder Management:* Du verstehst, was unsere Business-Teams wirklich brauchen, und erklärst technische Ergebnisse klar und ehrlich, auch dort, wo KI an ihre Grenzen stößt.
* *Sprache:* Du fühlst dich sicher in der englischen Kommunikation mit deinem Team (mind. C1 Level), bringst aber auch Deutsch-Kenntnisse (mind. B1 Level) mit.

Dich erwartet ein modernes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Du-Kultur von Tag eins. Wir glauben an flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsmethoden. Unsere Teams bestehen aus motivierten Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.

* Goodies für dich: Von Jobrad-Leasing über Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket bis hin zu betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (Arbeitgeberzuschuss 50%) - bei uns profitierst du von vielen Extras. On top gibt’s Mitarbeitenden-Rabatt in unserem Snocks Coffee und einen steuerfreien Sachbezug (50€ / Monat), den du flexibel für deinen Wocheneinkauf oder z.B. eine Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club einsetzen kannst.
* Arbeiten, wie’s zu dir passt : Du arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist. Remote ist Standard, aber wenn du doch mal Lust hast, ins Büro nach Mannheim, Hamburg oder Berlin zu kommen, gibt’s dafür ein Monatsbudget.
* Echte Flexibilität : Ob Workation mit Freund:innen oder Kolleg:innen, morgendliches Yoga oder eine Sport-Session mittags – bei uns kannst du Arbeit und Privatleben easy miteinander verbinden.
* Onboarding : Du startest nicht mit leeren Händen, sondern bekommst top Hardware, alles was du zum Arbeiten brauchst, und kannst dir im Welcome Shop coole Produkte von unseren Partnern & Friends aussuchen.
* Du weißt nicht weiter? Wir unterstützen dich mit unseren Weiterbildungsangeboten und individuellen Development Budgets! Und wenns nicht ums Berufliche geht, kannst du deinen Zugang zur Gesundheitsplattform nilo.health nutzen, um dir den Support zu holen, den du brauchst.
* Einfach (dir) mal was Gutes tun : Ob „Social Day“, um dich sozial zu engagieren, oder „Power Days“, wenn die Periode mal richtig zuschlägt – diese Tage gibt es on top zu deinem Urlaub.
* Alle zusammen: Wir sind ein Team aus A-Playern, die nach Wachstum streben, und leben den Team-Spirit bei unseren grandiosen SNOCKS Group Events oder einfach beim nächsten After-Work.
* Office-Leben : Bei uns wird’s nie langweilig: ob Tischtennis, Fifa oder Mario Kart nach der Arbeit, gemeinsames Kochen und Lunch, frisches Obst, Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine oder die Müsli-Bar. Und das Beste: Dein Haustier darf natürlich auch mit ins Office!
* Wir kleiden dich ein: Noch keine Produkte der SNOCKS Brands in deinem Kleiderschrank? Das ändern wir! Du erhältst jedes Jahr einen 360€ Gutschein von uns sowie weitere tolle Rabatte und Angebote wie bspw. Corporate Benefits.

title: Junior Publisher Manager
description:
💻 Про команду та продукт
Unative — один із продуктів Epom, AdTech-компанії, яка розвиває рішення для роботи з digital-рекламою. Unative — платформа для монетизації трафіку та роботи з паблішерами.
Ти приєднаєшся до Publisher Team, яка відповідає за залучення нових партнерів, розвиток партнерської мережі та збільшення обсягів монетизованого трафіку.

🎯 Твої майбутні задачі
Пошук та залучення нових паблішерів до рекламної мережі.
Розвиток партнерської бази та побудова довгострокових відносин із паблішерами.
Комунікація з потенційними партнерами, проведення переговорів щодо умов співпраці та монетизації.
Розвиток відносин із чинними паблішерами та пошук можливостей для збільшення обсягів їхнього трафіку.
Аналіз трафіку, джерел, GEO та потенціалу монетизації.
Підбір рекламних форматів та оптимальних умов співпраці залежно від типу трафіку й потреб партнера.
Робота з різними моделями монетизації: RevShare, CPM та іншими.
Запуск тестів із партнерами, аналіз результатів та пошук можливостей для масштабування трафіку.
Моніторинг основних показників трафіку, оцінка його якості та ефективності монетизації.
Взаємодія з командою для покращення результатів роботи з паблішерами.

💡 Наші очікування

Experienced

*CI/CD Pipeline Support*

*

Assists with the maintenance and minor configuration changes of existing CI/CD pipelines under guidance from senior engineers.

*

Monitors pipeline runs, flags failures, and helps triage straightforward build/deploy issues.

*

Follows documented runbooks and change procedures when making pipeline adjustments.

*

Escalates ambiguous or higher-risk pipeline changes to a senior engineer before proceeding.

*Monitoring & Alerting Assistance*

*

Helps configure and maintain basic monitoring dashboards and alert rules under supervision.

Performs first-line review of alerts and escalates genuine incidents promptly to senior engineers.

Documents recurring alert patterns and contributes observations to runbook improvements.

Learns the organisation's monitoring stack (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) and standard thresholds.

Assists with routine infrastructure tasks (e.g., environment provisioning support, configuration updates) under close supervision.

Follows infrastructure-as-code templates and change processes rather than making ad-hoc changes.

Documents steps taken and outcomes for tasks performed, to support knowledge transfer.

Builds working familiarity with core cloud services and infrastructure tooling used by the team.

*Access, Security & Platform Administration Support*

Assists with routine access management tasks (e.g., user provisioning/de-provisioning) following approved processes.

Escalates any anomalous access requests or potential security concerns immediately.

Actively works through onboarding materials, toolchain documentation, and internal platform guides.

Pairs frequently with senior DevOps engineers to build understanding of pipelines, infrastructure, and security practices.

Tracks own learning goals and progress with support from a mentor or the DevOps Lead.

Builds toward taking on progressively larger and less-supervised tasks.

*

Follows documented change management, security, and operational procedures without bypassing approval gates.

title: UX/UI Designer
location: Remote, New York, New York, United States
description:
About Ajaia
-----------

Ajaia is an AI implementation consultancy and product studio. We help organizations move from AI experimentation to measurable return on investment across four practices: AI Strategy and Advisory, Workforce Training and Enablement, Process Optimization, and Custom AI Development. Our work sits with executives and the people who do the actual work, and it is judged on whether something changed in production, not on whether a pilot looked good in a deck.

Position Overview
-----------------

Ajaia is hiring a UX/UI Designer to run discovery and design on client engagements and on Ajaia's own product suite. You will talk to the people who actually do the work, watch what they do rather than only what they say, and turn that into journeys, wireframes, and prototypes an engineer can build from. You will test the design against real users before a line of production code is written, and you will hold the standard for how everything Ajaia ships looks and behaves.

This is a hands-on seat: you do the research and the design yourself, rather than handing off between the two.

*Compensation:* $90,000 to $210,000 base, depending on experience, plus a performance bonus of up to 100% of base salary.

How we expect you to work
-------------------------

AI use is a core execution requirement at Ajaia, not optional tooling. You will use AI tools daily to move from interview notes to synthesis, from synthesis to wireframe, and from wireframe to something clickable. You are judged on what you keep from that process, not on how much of it AI produced.

Staying current with new design and prototyping tools is part of the job, and so is knowing when a shortcut needs your hand back on it before a user ever sees it.

What you will do
----------------

* Run discovery on client engagements: interview the people doing the work, watch them do it, and find the gap between what they say and what they actually do.
* Talk to users of Ajaia's own products the same way. The product suite is not exempt from the same rigor client work gets.
* Synthesize findings into what people actually need, stated separately from what they asked for, with the evidence for each.
* Design the solution: user journeys, wireframes, and prototypes that an engineer can build from without guessing.
* Decide where a human has to sign off inside a workflow, and design that checkpoint into the product rather than bolting it on afterward.
* Test designs with real users before code exists, not after.
* Push back on a stakeholder's feature list when the evidence points somewhere else, and explain why in terms they can act on.
* Own the design standard across Ajaia's product suite so a designer joining engagement three does not have to reinvent decisions made on engagement one.
* Prototype with AI tools as a default, not a novelty. Know when the AI-native path saves real time and when it produces something you have to rebuild by hand anyway.
* Hand off design work in a state an engineer can actually start from, and stay involved enough during the build to catch it when implementation drifts from the intent.

*Requirements*

* Runs discovery yourself: interviews, usability testing, and reading behavioral data.
* Moves from synthesis to a working prototype fast.
* Designs the human checkpoints into a workflow rather than bolting them on later.
* Comfortable holding a room when the evidence points somewhere a stakeholder does not expect.
* AI fluent: uses AI daily to research, synthesize, and prototype, and can tell good output from slop.
* Comfortable working directly alongside engineers through build.
* No minimum years required. We hire on the work.
* On-site in New York, with client-site travel for discovery work.
* A bachelor's degree is preferred and is not a requirement.

*Nice to have*

* A public portfolio or case studies we can look at before we meet.
* Experience designing AI-native workflows, including where a human checkpoint belongs.
* Consulting, agency, or professional services experience with concurrent clients.
* Comfort with lightweight front-end implementation.

*Benefits*

Competitive benefits.

Instead of applying surface polish, you’ll tackle core visual and structural challenges, building scalable design patterns, improving user journeys, and shaping how our web interfaces operate across devices. You’ll collaborate directly with product managers and developers, bringing visual clarity to complicated workflows and ensuring our web pages meet the high standards our users expect.

Day to day, you will:

* Design responsive, accessible web pages and interaction flows.
* Build, maintain, and evolve scalable web design systems and UI component libraries.
* Turn complex technical concepts and user requirements into intuitive visual experiences.
* Collaborate closely with developers to ensure implementation stays true to design intent.
* Test, iterate, and refine designs based on user feedback and real-world usage patterns.

-------------------
*What you’ll bring*
-------------------

* Attention to structure, layout systems, and interaction details.
* A systems-thinking mindset that prioritizes consistency and scalability over isolated fixes.
* Clear, articulate reasoning behind design decisions when collaborating with other teams.
* Strong self-direction and comfort taking ownership of end-to-end design initiatives.
* Genuine curiosity about how users interact with web pages.

------------------
*What you’ll need*
------------------

* A portfolio demonstrating complex Web/UI/UX projects delivered from concept to production.
* Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools like Figma.
* A strong understanding of modern web standards and responsive design.
* Experience creating and managing web design systems and UI component libraries.
* A track record of designing accessible, inclusive web interfaces aligned with WCAG standards.

-------------------------
*What success looks like*
-------------------------

Success means delivering web experiences that feel effortless, consistent, and visually refined. You’ll know you’re succeeding when complex user flows become clear, design components scale seamlessly across products, and both internal teams and end-users trust the quality of your work.

---------------------
*Why join JetBrains?*
---------------------

* Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
* Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
* Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.
* Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
* Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
* Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
* Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.
* Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.
* Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.
* Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.
* Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

*Some benefits may vary depending on location.

If this sounds like you, send us your portfolio and tell us about work you’re proud of.

#LI-DNI

*We are an equal opportunity employer*

We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the Recruitment Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
---------------
*Quick Summary*
---------------

Scale Kin’s brand across every channel: ads, landing pages, email, and video. Part production, part brand evolution, overall a generalist, for a company redefining homeownership.

------------
*Who we are*
------------

Kin makes life simpler, more affordable, and better for homeowners — especially in the places where climate risks, rising costs, and outdated systems make it harder. We start with smarter homeowners insurance and expand to everything homeowners need to thrive.

Using data, technology, and thoughtful human support, we’re building products that are clear, fair, and help homeowners feel confident — so homeowners aren’t left behind when they need help most.

Founded in 2016, Kin is a remote-first employer with Kinfolk across more than 35 states. We serve customers in 14 states (and counting). Our disciplined growth, strong customer satisfaction, and focus on long-term sustainability fosters outstanding growth, attracts marquee investors, and earns recognition and accolades, including:

*

Built In Chicago's Best Places to Work, Midsize Companies (2021-2026)

*

Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers (2026)

*

Inc. 5000 Fastest-Growing Private Companies

*

Forbes’ Fintech 50 (2023-2026)

*

Great Places to Work Certified (May 2024-May 2027)

Most importantly, we’re building Kin to be a place where people do meaningful work with real impact — for our customers, our communities, and each other. We're excited to tell you more about how you can contribute to our rapid growth, strong unit economics, profitability, and excellent customer ratings. To learn more about how we work and what we’re building, visit and see how we work.

-----------------
*The opportunity*
-----------------

As a generalist in brand and visual design, you’ll help us scale Kin’s brand as our marketing grows and our business evolves. Our output has expanded fast, and we need a designer who can productionize high-quality visual work across the channels and campaigns that bring homeowners to Kin.

This is a pivotal moment to join. Kin is repositioning from a home insurance company into a suite of products that make homeownership easier, which means new markets, new product launches, and new media channels. You’ll shape how all of it looks and feels to customers. Your work will influence the moments before a homeowner ever gets a quote: the ads, pages, and campaigns that build trust and make a growing set of products feel like one clear, confident offering. Along the way, you’ll help raise the bar for how visual design shows up across the team.

-----------------------
*Your responsibilities*
-----------------------

*

Design and productionize high-quality visual assets across every marketing channel: paid social, landing pages, lifecycle and email, organic social, and display.

*

Produce and edit video content for marketing and brand campaigns, from social cuts to longer-form pieces, and raise the bar for how Kin shows up in motion.

*

Own the visual execution of campaigns end to end, turning briefs from marketing and growth into polished, on-brand work that ships on deadline.

*

Partner with copywriters, growth marketers, and external vendors and agencies to bring concepts to life and keep quality consistent across every touchpoint.

*

Push Kin’s brand forward in your day-to-day work, not just executing briefs but evolving the visual language and proposing fresh directions as you go.

*

Shape Kin’s evolving visual language as we reposition from home insurance to a broader homeownership platform, so a growing set of products feels like one coherent brand.

*

Design and iterate on landing pages built for A/B testing, and use the results to sharpen what works.

*

Partner with our Brand Design and Design Systems leads to push and grow Kin’s brand design system, extending it into new areas as the brand evolves.

----------------------
*Success in this role*
----------------------

In your first 6–12 months at Kin, success is less about checking boxes and more about the impact you create. You’ll use your skills and judgment to take ownership of meaningful work, improve how we operate, and help move Kin’s mission forward. Along the way, you’ll deliver outcomes that make a real difference for both Kinfolk and the homeowners we serve.

By the end of your first year, you should feel confident in your role, trusted as an owner, and proud of the progress you’ve helped make.

*

You've defined your own way of working with marketing, growth, and other partners, turning open space into a repeatable process the team can rely on.

*

Marketing ships campaigns faster because you’ve productionized the visual work and built reusable assets and templates.

*

Kin’s brand looks noticeably more consistent and polished across every channel than it did before you joined.

*

The visual language for Kin’s repositioning beyond home insurance has taken shape and is showing up in live campaigns.

*

Landing page A/B tests driven by your design work have measurably improved conversion.

-------------------
*What you’ll bring*
-------------------

*

5+ years of visual design experience in a brand or marketing context, with a portfolio that shows polished work across digital channels.

*

Proven ability to produce and edit video content for marketing campaigns, from short social cuts to longer-form pieces, including light animation for end cards and in-video overlays.

*

Fluency in Adobe Creative Suite (including Premiere Pro and AfterEffects for video) and Figma.

*

Experience designing for paid social, landing pages, and lifecycle/email, with an understanding of what makes each channel perform.

*

A self-starter who can work across multiple mediums and manage several projects at once without heavy direction.

*

Experience designing landing pages for A/B testing and iterating based on results.

*Bonus if you have*

*

Illustration skills

*

Motion graphics experience

-------------
*How we hire*
-------------

We believe a great hiring experience should be clear, respectful, and human. We’ll accept applications for this position until November 6th, 2026. While our recruiting team uses AI tools for efficiency, resumes are still screened by Kin’s in-house recruiters, and candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are made by recruiters and hiring teams. Rest assured, real people make real decisions.

The hiring process and timeline for each role will vary, depending on the position. However, here are some things you can expect from us:

*

Prompt updates and feedback following interviews

*

Interviews with recruiters, hiring managers, and members of teams

*

Skills assessment relevant to the position, if applicable

*

Genuine, thoughtful human interaction at every step

--------------------
*How we support you*
--------------------

We offer a comprehensive, competitive benefits program, allowing you to choose the benefits that are best for you and your family, starting on the first day of the month following your start date.

*Core Benefits*

*

Competitive salary and company equity through Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), granted as part of our standard compensation package and based on role and level

*

401(k) with company match up to 4% of eligible earnings

*

Multiple medical plan options, plus dental and vision coverage

*

Company-funded HSA contributions (based on medical plan selection)

*

Company-paid life insurance and short-term disability

*Health & Wellbeing*

*

A variety of supplemental benefit options, including long-term disability, critical illness, accident, legal, and pet insurance

*

Access to mental health support and confidential counseling resources

*

Flexible PTO for exempt employees (most employees take 15–20 days per year), plus 8 company-observed holidays

*

Paid parental leave, including up to 14 weeks at 100% pay for birthing parents and 8 weeks at 100% pay for non-birthing parents

*Growth & Development*

*

Career mobility and internal growth opportunities across the organization

*

Professional development budgets for certifications, conferences, and learning available, subject to management approval

-------------
*How we work*
-------------

We don’t just hire for skills. We hire for alignment. Kinfolk bring diverse perspectives, but we’re united by a shared set of values that shape how we work and how we show up for each other and our customers.

*Run through walls, together* - Every one of us is responsible for creating the culture we want to work in. High performance. Low drama. Always respectful. We assume the best in each other and challenge ideas, not intentions. We show up, work hard, and play to each other's strengths — because that’s how great teams win.

*Raise the bar. Drop the ego* - Attitudes are contagious. Every one of us is responsible for creating the culture we want to work in. High performance. Low drama. Always respectful. Like professional sports teams, we win by working in sync. We show up, work hard, and play to each other’s strengths.

*Act like an owner* - We are owners, fully accountable for achieving Kin’s mission. That requires positive, proactive, big-picture thinking well beyond our job descriptions. Ask questions, Take ownership. Do the right thing, even when it‘s hard. Because when Kin thrives, so do you. And so do our customers.

*Operate lean. Deliver more* - We build efficiency into everything we do. Each dollar we save gets reinvested to deliver more to our customers: better pricing, more products, and new innovations. We work smarter by relentlessly prioritizing and using technology, including AI, to multiply our impact. Lean is about focus, not deprivation. Lean isn't a limitation — it's our competitive advantage.

*Keep asking ‘What if?’* - We value curiosity. To make insurance better for our customers, we experiment. We embrace insights. And we base decisions on data rather than assumptions. We see setbacks as opportunities for growth and are always learning and improving. Both individually and as a company.

---------------
*Where we work*
---------------

We are a remote-first company with offices in Chicago, IL and St. Petersburg, FL where teams can come together for collaboration.

For Sales Agents and Customer Service Agents: These roles sit in any of the following 32 states: AL, AZ, CO, FL, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MO, MT, NC, NE, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VT, VA, WA, and WI.

For all other positions, these roles can sit in any of the following 41 states: AL, AR, AZ, CA (exempt only), CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, IA, KS, KY, LA, MA, ME, MD, MI, MN, MO, MT, NC, NE, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VT, VA, WA, and WI. Please only apply if you are able to live and work full-time in one of the states listed above.

For remote technical positions located in Canada, we are only able to hire individuals who reside in Ontario. Applicants must be able to live and work full-time in Ontario to be considered.

State locations and specifics are subject to change as our hiring requirements shift.

----------------
*EEOC statement*
----------------

Kin is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We don't just accept difference – we honor it, nurture it, and celebrate it. We don’t discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Kin welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you require accommodation, please contact us by sending an email to careers@kin.com

title: Senior Visual Designer – Digital Content & Social Media
location: Remote, Mexico; Costa Rica; Brazil; Peru
description:
Senior Visual Designer – Digital Content & Social Media

Work Arrangement: 100% Remote
Eligible Hiring Locations: Mexico City, Costa Rica, São Paulo (Brazil), or Lima (Peru)
Employment Type: Full-time
Seniority Level: Senior
Compensation: To be confirmed

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Visual Designer to join an international content production team responsible for creating high-quality digital assets across two distinct brands.

In this role, you will transform content briefs, existing creative assets, image libraries, and brand templates into engaging visual content for websites, email campaigns, newsletters, social media, and short-form video.

You will work closely with content strategists, copywriters, and producers to deliver consistent, on-brand creative assets at scale, ensuring quality, accuracy, and timely execution.

This is a hands-on production design role focused on digital content adaptation, visual consistency, and multichannel asset creation, rather than developing new brand identities or creative concepts from scratch.

Key ResponsibilitiesDigital Content & Web Design

Design static hero banners and supporting imagery for blog content pages.
Create homepage banners and product listing page (PLP) tiles using existing assets and image libraries.
Adapt existing key visuals into multiple formats, sizes, and placements.
Optimize digital assets for web performance, including image dimensions, file sizes, export formats, and SEO-related requirements.
Maintain visual consistency across different digital touchpoints.
Email & CRM Design

Design email assets for pre-launch, launch, and post-launch eCRM campaigns.
Adapt email designs for different markets, including dark-market versions where required.
Create visually engaging newsletters using established templates.
Ensure email layouts are compatible with mobile devices and common email client constraints.
Collaborate with content producers to align visual assets with approved copy and campaign objectives.
Social Media & Motion Content

Produce social media assets across multiple formats, including static posts, carousels, stories, and reels.
Adapt visual concepts across channels while maintaining brand consistency.
Prepare graphics, stills, and on-screen text treatments for short-form videos of up to 10 seconds.
Use existing video footage and creative assets to support content production.
Apply platform-specific design requirements and specifications.
Creative Production & Collaboration

Manage content production packages from initial brief through final delivery.
Work across two brands, maintaining their individual visual identities and guidelines.
Produce clean, organized, and fully layered Photoshop (PSD) files.
Maintain accurate file naming, version control, and asset organization.
Collaborate with content strategists, copywriters, and producers to ensure alignment with content priorities and deadlines.
Review creative briefs, identify missing assets or feasibility concerns, and communicate potential issues proactively.
Deliver multiple batches of creative assets according to established production schedules.
Required Qualifications

Professional experience in visual design, digital content production, or multichannel creative design.
Advanced Adobe Photoshop skills, including retouching, compositing, image manipulation, and creating well-organized layered PSD files.
Strong working knowledge of Figma.
Excellent typography, layout, visual composition, and image-handling skills.
Proven experience adapting existing key visuals across multiple digital formats and dimensions.
Experience designing email marketing campaigns and working with responsive email templates.
Strong understanding of current social media formats, including reels, carousels, stories, and static posts.
Basic motion graphics or video editing skills using Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, or similar tools.
Experience working with established brand guidelines, preferably across multiple brands.
Understanding of web image optimization, including dimensions, file weight, export formats, and alt text.
Strong organizational skills and experience managing multiple deliverables within fixed deadlines.
Excellent attention to detail, file organization, versioning, and creative handover.
Ability to collaborate effectively with content strategists, copywriters, and production teams.
Willingness to work on projects within the tobacco industry.
Advanced English proficiency (C1 or higher), both written and spoken, with the ability to confidently lead client meetings, facilitate strategic workshops, deliver executive presentations, and communicate with international stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications

Experience producing digital content for regulated industries.
Advanced motion graphics or video editing capabilities.
Experience supporting high-volume, multichannel content production.
Familiarity with SEO best practices for digital imagery.
Experience adapting creative assets for different markets, audiences, or brand identities.
What We're Looking For

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly organized visual designer who enjoys hands-on creative production and can efficiently translate existing brand assets into polished digital deliverables.

The ideal candidate is comfortable managing multiple content packages, switching between distinct brand identities, collaborating with international teams, and delivering high-quality work under established timelines.

Please include a link to your professional portfolio when applying.

Position Details

Work Model: Fully remote
Employment Type: Full-time
Seniority: Senior
Eligible Hiring Locations: Mexico City, Costa Rica, São Paulo, or Lima
Compensation: 4,000 - 4500 dlls per month
If you have strong Photoshop and Figma skills, experience producing digital assets across web, email, and social media, and enjoy working in a fast-paced creative production environment, we encourage you to apply.

*Location:* Remote - Mexico, Costa Rica, Brazil, Peru

*Skills required for this job:*

* Adobe Photoshop
* Brand guidelines enforcement
* Creative project management
* Digital content production
* Email marketing design
* Figma
* Layout desing
* Motion graphics
* Social media design
* Typography
* Version control
* Video editing
* Visual composition
* Visual design
* Web content optimization

title: Senior Visual Communication Designer
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Visual Communication Designer based in the United States.*

We are seeking a talented, strategic, and hands-on designer who can transform complex business ideas into clear, compelling visual communications. In this role, you will partner directly with enterprise clients to understand their goals, identify communication challenges, and deliver thoughtful, high-quality design solutions. You will work across a diverse range of branded materials, including presentations, reports, marketing campaigns, videos, and other communication assets. Balancing creative concept development with detailed production work, you will help organizations communicate consistently and effectively within established brand systems. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced designer who combines exceptional visual craft with strong client consulting skills and business-minded thinking. You will also have the opportunity to leverage emerging creative technologies and AI tools to enhance design quality and efficiency in a remote, collaborative environment.

Accountabilities
----------------

*

Translate business objectives, complex ideas, and communication challenges into clear, engaging, and effective visual solutions.

*

You’ll work with established brand guidelines, an extensive photo library, and existing design systems while identifying opportunities to improve the visual identity across brands.

* Coordinate with print vendors and manage revisions through final production.

*Brand Consistency & Improvement*

* Maintain consistent visual standards across multiple brands.
* Apply established brand guidelines and design systems.
* Identify weaknesses in existing branding and recommend practical design improvements.

*Photo Library & Product Imagery*

* Source, retouch, and organize product and marketing photography using the company's digital asset library.
* Keep images properly tagged and organized so teams can find and reuse assets efficiently.
* Select and prepare imagery that fits each brand's visual identity and intended use.

*Communication & Workflow Management*

* Stay responsive in Slack throughout the Eastern workday.
* Acknowledge requests promptly, clarify essential details upfront, and share proofs directly in request threads.
* Coordinate with marketing, sales, and retail teams to keep projects moving without unnecessary follow-ups.

*AI-Assisted Design*

* Use AI-assisted tools where they improve speed and efficiency.
* Apply strong design judgment to ensure every final asset meets quality, brand, and production standards.

Required Experience & Skills
----------------------------

* 5+ years of professional graphic design experience across digital and print media.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating a range of digital marketing assets and print-ready design work.
* Excellent understanding of typography, visual hierarchy, layout, composition, and effective use of color.
* Ability to work within established brand guidelines while identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Experience with photo retouching, product imagery, and preparing assets for different platforms and formats.
* Ability to prepare accurate, production-ready print files.
* Strong time management skills and a proven ability to meet tight deadlines.
* Clear communication skills and consistent responsiveness in Slack during Eastern business hours.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple requests, and take ownership of deliverables.
* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, Affinity, Figma, Canva, or equivalent design tools.

Nice to Have
------------

* Experience with video editing or motion graphics.
* Familiarity with digital asset management systems.
* Interest in agriculture, hunting, drones, or related industries.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools in a professional design workflow.

What Makes You a Strong Fit
---------------------------

* You work quickly without compromising design quality.
* You can adapt to different brand identities and understand when consistency matters.
* You ask the right questions early to prevent unnecessary revisions.
* You take initiative, communicate clearly, and follow projects through to completion.
* You can balance everyday requests with larger creative projects.
* You welcome feedback and look for ways to improve existing designs and workflows.

What Success Looks Like
-----------------------

* Everyday design requests are delivered by the next business day.
* Larger projects have clear deadlines and are completed as agreed.
* Digital and print assets are polished, accurate, and ready for use or production.
* All brands maintain a consistent and recognizable visual identity.
* The photo library remains organized and easy for the team to navigate.
* Internal teams can rely on you for timely communication, dependable delivery, and strong design judgment.

-----------------

* Recruiter Interview
* Client Interview
* Offer & Onboarding

title: Principal Product Manager - Voice AI
description:
*About us*
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

*Our people*
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

*Our impact*
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.
We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Role Overview
-------------

For most SMBs, the phone remains one of the highest-intent customer channels. A call may represent a new lead, an urgent service request, a customer trying to book an appointment, a patient looking for help, a buyer asking a final question, or an existing customer who needs immediate support. When the call goes unanswered, the opportunity is often lost.

Most SMBs cannot staff every phone line, department, location, and language around the clock. Traditional IVRs frustrate callers, outsourced answering services lack business context, and human teams spend significant time handling repetitive conversations. HighLevel's Voice AI product is designed to change that.

Voice AI enables businesses to deploy intelligent phone agents that can answer inbound calls, initiate outbound calls, understand caller intent, hold natural conversations, answer questions from business knowledge, qualify leads, collect structured information, book appointments, trigger workflows, interact with external systems, route callers between specialised AI agents, transfer calls to humans, and complete follow-up actions.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to define and lead the next generation of this platform. This person will own the long-term product strategy, architecture, quality bar, evaluation system, commercial model, and operating metrics required to make Voice AI dependable across millions of real-world phone conversations.

This is not a prompt-management or chatbot-feature role. It is a senior individual-contributor product leadership role requiring deep systems thinking across AI, voice, telephony, automation, CRM, reliability, compliance, and business outcomes. You will influence multiple product and engineering teams, make platform-level trade-offs, and establish Voice AI as one of the most trusted and commercially important products in the HighLevel ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Define and drive the long-term vision, strategy, roadmap, and platform architecture for HighLevel Voice AI.
* Own the complete Voice AI lifecycle, including agent creation, prompts, system instructions, voice and model selection, knowledge, actions, testing, deployment, phone routing, inbound and outbound calling, transfers, analytics, permissions, APIs, billing, and optimisation.
* Establish the product principles that determine when a Voice AI agent should answer, ask a clarifying question, retrieve knowledge, take an action, transfer to another agent, transfer to a human, schedule follow-up, or end the call.
* Develop a deep understanding of agencies, SMBs, franchises, multi-location businesses, and call-intensive industries such as home services, healthcare and wellness, legal, real estate, automotive, insurance, financial services, fitness, hospitality, and professional services.
* Personally review real call recordings, transcripts, latency traces, action logs, failed calls, support tickets, customer configurations, implementation challenges, and measurable business outcomes.
* Translate ambiguous customer and platform problems into strategic choices, product requirements, system models, phased roadmaps, quality standards, and measurable success criteria.
* Partner closely with engineering and AI leadership on streaming architecture, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, voice activity detection, turn detection, interruption handling, LLM orchestration, tool invocation, context management, retrieval, caching, latency, reliability, model selection, and cost.
* Partner closely with Phone System and infrastructure teams on call routing, number provisioning, carrier integrations, Twilio and LC Phone behaviour, recording, transfers, forwarding, voicemail, call status, and telephony failure modes.
* Establish a scalable evaluation and release framework for model, prompt, voice, retrieval, action, routing, and infrastructure changes.
* Define production service expectations across call-answer rates, connection success, response latency, audio quality, uptime, action reliability, transfer reliability, and graceful degradation.
* Partner with Design to simplify agent creation, voice selection, prompt configuration, testing, deployment, debugging, analytics, optimisation, and reuse.
* Make Prompt Evaluator, Edit with AI, Prompt Optimiser, Web Call testing, phone testing, and production logs part of a coherent agent-quality workflow.
* Improve integrations between Voice AI and Contacts, Conversations, Calendars, Workflows, Opportunities, Knowledge Base, Payments, Custom Fields, Custom Objects, Phone System, and Reporting.
* Define the architecture and customer experience for multi-agent transfers, human transfers, context handoffs, specialist reuse, fallback behaviour, and merged post-call outputs.
* Develop observability and debugging experiences that expose call state, latency, transcripts, retrieved knowledge, model behaviour, tool calls, parameter extraction, action responses, transfers, carrier errors, and execution timelines.
* Define instrumentation across the full funnel, including agent creation, configuration completion, first test, first successful test, number assignment, first live call, first successful action, sustained usage, business outcomes, retention, and expansion.
* Define operational metrics for inbound and outbound Voice AI, distinguishing between dialling, connection, conversation, qualification, execution, transfer, and business-outcome success.
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Trust, and Security on consent, disclosures, voice cloning, recording, data processing, retention, outbound calling, sensitive information, fraud, abuse, and platform safeguards.
* Partner with Product Marketing on positioning, use cases, competitive differentiation, customer education, vertical templates, launches, and agency enablement.
* Partner with Support, Implementation, Account Management, Trial Experience, Affiliates, and agency-facing teams to reduce setup friction, improve deployment quality, and lower support burden.
* Partner with Finance and Revenue Experience on pricing, included usage, overages, agency rebilling, model costs, telephony costs, gross margin, budget protection, and sustainable commercial limits.
* Drive strategy across the broader AI Employee portfolio so Voice AI works coherently with Conversation AI, Knowledge Base, Agent Studio, Ask AI, Workflows, Calendars, and future AI-agent capabilities.
* Evaluate external models, voice providers, telephony vendors, infrastructure components, and potential strategic partnerships.
* Act as a senior product thought partner to Product, Engineering, Design, Data, GTM, Finance, Legal, and executive leadership.
* Mentor PMs and raise the quality of product strategy, AI evaluation, systems thinking, and decision-making across the organisation without relying on formal authority.

Ideal Candidate Profile
-----------------------

* 12+ years of product management experience owning complex B2B SaaS, Voice AI, conversational AI, communications, contact-centre, telephony, CRM, workflow-automation, or AI-agent products. Scope and demonstrated outcomes matter more than a precise number of years.
* Prior experience operating as a Principal PM, Staff PM, Lead PM, product founder, or equivalent senior individual contributor responsible for a business-critical product or platform.
* Evidence of defining strategy across multiple teams and delivering sustained customer and commercial outcomes — not only shipping individual features.
* Experience building or operating production AI-agent systems that interact with real customers and take actions inside business workflows.
* Strong understanding of the difference between an impressive voice demonstration and a reliable production calling product.
* Technical fluency across several of the following:

○ Speech-to-text and automatic speech recognition

○ Text-to-speech and voice models
---------------------------------

○ Streaming audio
-----------------

○ Voice activity and end-of-turn detection

○ Barge-in and interruption handling
------------------------------------

○ Noise and echo cancellation
-----------------------------

○ LLM orchestration and function calling

○ Context management and RAG/knowledge retrieval

○ APIs and webhooks
-------------------

○ Telephony, PSTN, SIP, or carrier infrastructure

○ Latency, reliability, observability, and cost

* Strong judgment around AI evaluation — able to define how voice agents should be tested, scored, monitored, debugged, and improved in production.
* Strong systems thinking — able to connect phone infrastructure, AI models, voices, prompts, CRM data, calendars, workflows, actions, permissions, reporting, compliance, and billing into a coherent product.
* Experience simplifying technically sophisticated systems for non-technical customers.
* Experience working with multi-tenant SaaS and the operational requirements of agencies, franchises, resellers, or multi-location businesses.
* Strong customer instincts and willingness to inspect recordings, transcripts, traces, failed calls, implementation issues, and support data personally.
* Commercial judgment across activation, retention, packaging, usage-based pricing, provider cost, telephony cost, gross margin, and partner economics.
* Ability to make difficult trade-offs between caller experience, latency, accuracy, reliability, extensibility, compliance, and cost.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and multiple teams without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Excellent written communication — able to produce clear strategy documents, product requirements, system models, evaluation plans, architectural decisions, executive updates, and launch narratives.
* High ownership, intellectual honesty, and execution velocity in a remote-first, high-context environment.

Bonus Points For
----------------

* Experience building production voice agents, contact-centre AI, automated receptionists, sales dialers, or customer-service voice automation.
* Experience with voice and AI platforms such as Twilio, ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Deepgram, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Connect, Genesys, Five9, Dialpad, RingCentral, or similar technologies.
* Experience with PSTN, SIP, WebRTC, IVR, call routing, caller identification, number provisioning, recording, voicemail detection, and carrier failure modes.
* Experience building real-time systems with strict latency and availability requirements.
* Experience designing agent tools, function calling, MCP integrations, workflow actions, or external API execution.
* Experience building automated evaluation systems using scenario generation, synthetic callers, human review, production telemetry, transcripts, recordings, and business-outcome data.
* Experience with appointment scheduling, lead qualification, customer support, call routing, outbound campaigns, or service-dispatch products.
* Experience supporting multilingual speech recognition and synthesis, accents, localisation, translation, pronunciation, or voice cloning.
* Experience with consent, AI disclosure, call recording, opt-out management, outbound-contact rules, trust and safety, or communications-platform abuse prevention.
* Experience building APIs, webhooks, developer platforms, reusable templates, marketplaces, or partner ecosystems.
* Experience building products for agencies, SMBs, franchises, local businesses, or multi-location operators.
* Experience with AI usage-based pricing, per-minute communication pricing, provider routing, model cost management, gross-margin optimisation, rebilling, or fair-use controls.
* Familiarity with metrics such as call answer rate, connection rate, time to first response, end-of-turn latency, barge-in success, speech-recognition accuracy, call completion rate, containment rate, transfer success rate, action success rate, appointment-booking conversion, caller sentiment, opt-out and complaint rate, P95/P99 latency, cost per call, cost per successful outcome, retention, and support-ticket rate.

Why Join HighLevel?
-------------------

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in weeks rather than quarters.

Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognising that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well-funded and profitable company.

Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.
