title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Applied Computing was founded in 2024 to build Orbital, a physics-informed foundation model for energyoperations. We’re live across oil and gas and petrochemicals, working towards our mission: sustainable abundancefor a growing planet.

The hydrocarbon industry keeps the world running. But its complexity has left operators tied to legacy systems,making critical decisions on less than 10% of available data. We built Orbital to change that. It’s a foundation modelbuilt specifically for energy that lets companies use AI at scale, harnessing all of their operational data and optimising in real time for any metric. Decisions get faster, operations get safer, and carbon intensity falls.

We’ve raised over $32 million, including one of the largest seed rounds for an AI company in the UK. We’re justgetting started.

The Role
--------

Product Manager’s are responsible for product adoption, usage and value-generation. This means deeply understanding users and their technical requirements and owning delivery for a core area of Orbital. This is a customer- and domain-led role: you’ll spend real time with operators in petrochemicals to understand how decisions actually get made today, and translate that understanding into product capabilities and features that change how their plant is run.

This is a product delivery role. You’ll work closely with AI researchers, ML engineers, full stack engineers, project managers and account managers to invent new capabilities that change how the energy industry is run.

What You’ll Own
---------------

* Deep understanding of users, their problems, what matters to them and how they make decisions
* Product strategy and roadmap for your area of Orbital
* Strong working knowledge of downstream operations and the workflows Orbital needs to fit into
* Prioritisation decisions, balancing customer feedback against hypotheses of what will best drive impact
* Requirements, specs, and acceptance criteria
* Ongoing iteration and testing with engineering and research colleagues
* Close relationships and feedback loops with customers and users
* Product, usage and utilisation analytics

Must-Have Qualifications
------------------------

* 5+ years as a Product Manager, ideally in enterprise B2B SaaS or deep-tech
* Experience with physics, chemistry, heavy industry, manufacturing or AI, UI/UX and workflows
* Direct experience in Oil & Gas or Energy, ideally downstream (refining, petrochemicals)
* A track record of inventing tech products
* Comfort operating with ambiguity, incomplete data, and evolving customer needs
* Clear, structured written and verbal communication — able to represent customer needs to a technical audienceand technical trade-offs back to customers

Nice to Haves (You’ll Learn)
----------------------------

* Experience building AI products – where the product is powered by in-house trained models
* Experience building agentic workflows and agentic product experiences
* Exposure to enterprise delivery environments
* Experience with process control, operations, or reliability engineering software

How We Work
-----------

* Process exists to serve delivery, not the other way around
* Pragmatism beats dogma; we adapt tools and rituals to reality
* We value clarity, speed, and ownership over perfect frameworks
* We iterate on process the same way we iterate on product

What This Role Is Not
---------------------

* Not a delivery or operations role tracking sprint mechanics — that’s Product Operations

• Not a Scrum Master
--------------------

* Not a passive requirements-taker; this role sets direction
* Not detached from the field — you’ll spend meaningful time with customers and operations teams

Core Responsibilities
---------------------

Customer & Domain Expertise
---------------------------

* Spend regular time with customers — onsite where useful — to learn about their problems and understand their world
* Represent the voice of the customer inside the company, and the voice of the roadmap to customers
* Build and maintain deep knowledge of downstream O&G operations and how operators make decisions today

Product Strategy & Roadmap
--------------------------

* Translate customer needs into new features, functionality, workflows and capabilities
* Ensure your area of Orbital is adopted, used and creating value for customers
* Translate downstream operational challenges — refining constraints, petrochemical process economics, safety and compliance — into a clear, prioritised backlog
* Make and defend prioritisation calls, balancing near-term customer commitments with platform durability

Cross-Functional Delivery
-------------------------

* Partner closely with research and engineering leads to scope, spec, and sequence work
* Daily calibration of where your research and engineering colleagues should be focused on
* In the details that matter - scoping requirements, testing hypotheses and iterating on the latest release
* Coordinate with customer-facing project managers so committed timelines reflect real product and engineering capacity

Communication & Stakeholder Management
--------------------------------------

* Communicate roadmap, rationale, and trade-offs clearly to leadership, engineering, and customers
* Surface risks and scope trade-offs early — no surprises
* Maintain artefacts such as roadmap documents, release notes, and customer-facing capability overviews

What Success Looks Like
-----------------------

First 60–90 Days
----------------

* You’ve spent meaningful time with downstream customers and can speak fluently to their operational priorities
* A clear, prioritised roadmap exists for your product area, understood by engineering and leadership
* You’re the go-to person for “why are we building this” in your area

6–12 Months
-----------

* Your product area ships features, functionality and workflows that measurably move customer-defined metrics — safety, uptime, margin, carbon intensity
* Customer-facing and internal project managers are aligned on what’s being built and why
* Your roadmap decisions are trusted by engineering, leadership, and customers alike

description:

Senior Product Manager - I

*About Trellix*
Trellix is a global company redefining the future of cybersecurity. The company’s comprehensive, open, and native cybersecurity platform helps organizations confronted by today’s most advanced threats gain confidence in the protection and resilience of their operations. Trellix, along with an extensive partner ecosystem, accelerates technology innovation through artificial intelligence, automation, and analytics to empower over 50,000 business and government customers with responsibly architected security. More at.

A Senior Product Manager for Endpoint Security leads cross-functional teams to design and deliver secure, scalable endpoint solutions that protect users and infrastructure from evolving cyber threats. They drive product strategy by aligning customer needs, market trends, and business directives into a unified roadmap, ensuring timely delivery and adoption of security capabilities.

------------------

------------------

*

Lead the strategy, design, and development of our endpoint products to meet company objectives founded on a thorough understanding of business unit strategies and objectives, the competitive landscape, and current and potential future business challenges.

*

Use a data-focused approach to ensure each initiative on our product roadmap delivers a meaningful impact to our business and users.

Voice of Customer – Partner with pre and post sales teams as well as Trellix partners to understand the customer pain points and translate that into product strategy and bring clarity to engineering teams for execution of that strategy.

Retirement Plans

Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage

Paid Time Off

Paid Parental Leave

*

Support for Community Involvement

title: Lead Financial Analyst, Strategic Business Partner – Product & Technology
location: Remote, Brazil, Canada, Colombia, France, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States
description:
*Summary*
---------

Join the Foundation in our ambitious project to empower people to create and share the sum of all human knowledge. We are looking for a Lead Financial Analyst to serve as the strategic business partner to our Product & Technology department, one of the most dynamic and fastest-growing parts of the organization, with a combined budget of more than $100M. You will also support other key areas of our work and, as the most senior analyst on the Financial Business Partner team, be responsible for driving improvements in financial planning, analytics, and our business partnership practices.

This is a business partnering role first and an FP&A role second. You will sit alongside product and engineering leaders, help them weigh investment tradeoffs before decisions are made, and turn roadmaps into financial plans. You will work directly with the Chief of Product and Technology (CPTO), the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), and the broader executive team. This is a chance to have an outsized impact on a mission-driven organization that operates one of the most visited websites in the world.

This role is remote and open to candidates between UTC-8 and UTC+1.

*Why this role*
---------------

* Be the trusted finance advisor to Product & Technology leadership, with a real voice in how we invest more than $100M in people, infrastructure, and partners.
* Work on infrastructure that serves more than 20 billion views per month.
* Drive projects with impact and executive visibility, including our CPTO and CFO.
* Shape the future of our business partner function by leading projects, setting standards, and mentoring other analysts.
* Join a collaborative, globally distributed team that values knowledge sharing.

*What you'll do*
----------------

*Be the Finance Partner to Product & Technology, and a second department*

* Act as the lead finance partner to department leaders and budget owners, providing analysis that informs prioritization and investment trade-offs.
* Join planning and roadmap conversations early as the voice of finance, raising tradeoffs and risks before commitments are made.
* Provide the financial voice in business strategy across our technical infrastructure and product development objectives.
* Translate roadmaps from teams like SRE, AI/ML, and Data Engineering into budgets, forecasts, and headcount and contractor plans.
* Lead annual budgeting, quarterly reforecasting, and multi-year planning for your departments.
* Facilitate on vendor spend optimization across cloud, hosting, software, and contractor support.

Plan for capital and technical accounting
-----------------------------------------

* Lead data center and infrastructure CAPEX planning, including capacity, hardware refresh, and depreciation impacts.
* Partner with Accounting on software capitalization, including project classification and capitalizable labor and contractor costs.
* Model total cost of ownership and build-versus-buy decisions, and communicate their financial impact clearly to non-finance leaders.

Deliver insight and reporting
-----------------------------

* Lead month-end close, forecasting, and variance analysis, with clear commentary on drivers, risks, and opportunities.
* Present resource plans and financial performance to senior leaders, including our CPTO and CFO.
* Build and maintain dashboards that connect spend to technical and product outcomes.

*Lead, mentor, and strengthen the business partner function*

* Coach and mentor FP&A analysts on modeling, analysis, and stakeholder partnership, including reviewing their work and helping them build executive-ready communication.
* Help set the standard for what good financial business partnership looks like, and share best practices across the team.
* Lead projects that improve the function, from scoping through roll-out, including streamlining multi-year financial modeling, departmental reporting, and business insights.
* Help manage our financial planning and reporting system, including documentation, process improvements, and new module roll-outs.

*What you'll bring*
-------------------

Required
--------

* Bachelor's degree plus 7+ years of experience in FP&A, financial business partnering, or corporate finance, including experience supporting a technology, engineering, or product organization. MBA or CPA preferred.
* Experience partnering with technical and product teams, and the curiosity to learn how they work.
* Experience working at a strategic level on business and organizational-wide goals.
* Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, and excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting to executives.
* A track record of building credibility with senior stakeholders and influencing without authority.
* Experience supporting multiple divisions or business units at once, mentoring or coaching other analysts, and leading process improvement projects.

Preferred
---------

* Tech-specific planning experience, such as data center or infrastructure CAPEX, software capitalization (ASC 350-40), headcount planning, and contractor or vendor spend.
* Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning.
* Finance business intelligence and reporting experience.
* Experience in a nonprofit, open-source, or mission-driven organization.
* An understanding of the free culture, free software, or online rights movements.

*Qualities that are important to us*
------------------------------------

* You love solving problems and understand the connections between micro decisions and the macro systems.
* You love deeply understanding business drivers and finding ways we can deploy resources for greater impact.
* You believe in the mission and enjoy collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders.
* You work well with distributed teams, both asynchronously and synchronously.
* You are proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, and adaptable in a fast-changing environment.
* You look for ways to simplify and standardize, and you can bring others along.
* You are a thoughtful mentor who enjoys raising the capability of those around you.

What Success Looks Like
-----------------------

* Product & Technology leaders involve you early and treat you as a thought partner, not a scorekeeper.
* Investment proposals arrive with clear, well-supported financial cases.
* Budgets and forecasts reflect the real roadmap, and variance commentary explains the why.
* FP&A analysts on the team are growing in skill and confidence through your coaching.
* The business partner function has stronger standards, tools, and processes than it did before you joined.

Travel Expectations:
--------------------

* *Frequency:* 2–3 trips per year (international and domestic).
* *Purpose:* Annual department offsite, strategy alignment with Product & Tech (P&T) leadership, and global community conferences.

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

title: Marketing and Growth Lead
description:
****************************************
Founding Product Marketing & Growth Lead
****************************************

*SynthioLabs | AI × Life Sciences*

-----------------
About SynthioLabs
-----------------

At SynthioLabs, we're building the next generation of AI-native products for life sciences. Our technology is transforming how pharmaceutical companies engage with healthcare professionals, support patients, understand their markets, and empower their field teams.
We're working at the intersection of cutting-edge AI, enterprise software, and healthcare—and we're looking for someone who can help tell that story to the world.

--------------
About the Role
--------------

We're looking for a highly creative, product-obsessed *Product Marketing & Growth Lead* to own how SynthioLabs shows up in the market.
This is not a traditional marketing role. We're looking for someone who can take a complex product, a customer insight, a technical breakthrough, or an interesting industry trend and turn it into content that people genuinely want to read, watch, and share.
You'll work directly with the founders, product, engineering, and design teams to build Synthio's brand, shape our product narratives, and drive organic growth through compelling storytelling and creative marketing.
We don't want someone who just executes a content calendar. We want someone who figures out what the content calendar should be, challenges conventional B2B marketing, experiments with new formats, and consistently finds ways to make our products and ideas stand out.

---------------
What You'll Own
---------------

1. Content Strategy & Creative Storytelling
-------------------------------------------

* Own Synthio's content strategy end-to-end, from identifying interesting ideas to creating, publishing, and distributing content.
* Proactively uncover stories worth telling across our products, customers, research, engineering work, and industry.
* Turn complex AI concepts and technical breakthroughs into simple, engaging, and memorable narratives.
* Create high-quality content across LinkedIn, blogs, product videos, case studies, thought leadership, and other emerging formats.
* Develop original content series, creative campaigns, and experiments that help Synthio stand out.
* Stay on top of what's happening across AI, technology, and life sciences, and identify opportunities for Synthio to contribute a differentiated perspective.

2. Product Marketing & Positioning
----------------------------------

* Develop a deep understanding of Synthio's products, capabilities, users, and competitive landscape.
* Own product positioning, messaging, and value propositions across our product portfolio.
* Translate product features into compelling stories about the problems we solve and the value we deliver.
* Work closely with product and engineering teams to understand new capabilities and turn launches into impactful marketing moments.
* Build product narratives, launch campaigns, demo stories, website content, and customer-facing collateral.
* Ensure our messaging is clear, differentiated, technically accurate, and consistent across channels.

3. Brand, Design & Creative Direction
-------------------------------------

* Partner closely with our design team to translate ideas into high-quality visual content.
* Conceptualize and drive the creation of product videos, animations, carousels, infographics, launch assets, and other creative formats.
* Bring strong creative judgment and a high bar for design, storytelling, and presentation.
* Help establish a recognizable visual and editorial identity for Synthio.
* Push the team to experiment with fresh formats rather than defaulting to conventional B2B marketing.

4. Organic Growth & Distribution
--------------------------------

* Own and grow Synthio's presence across relevant channels, particularly LinkedIn and other platforms where our target audiences engage.
* Think beyond publishing: develop distribution strategies that maximize reach, engagement, and qualified interest.
* Build founder-led and employee-led content programs that amplify our collective expertise.
* Experiment with new channels, communities, partnerships, and content formats.
* Track performance, understand what resonates, and continuously refine our content and growth strategy.
* Connect marketing efforts to tangible outcomes, including brand awareness, product interest, inbound conversations, and pipeline influence.

5. Customer Stories & Market Presence
-------------------------------------

* Work with customer-facing teams to identify compelling use cases, customer outcomes, and success stories.
* Transform customer insights and measurable results into strong case studies, testimonials, and market-facing narratives.
* Identify opportunities to amplify Synthio's work through industry events, research publications, product announcements, and creative campaigns.

* Experience in field services, IT asset management or workplace operations
* Experience running onshore and offshore teams across time zones

* Competitive compensation with insurance, health and wellness benefits

title: Senior UX/UI Designer
description:

Do you look at a clean, functional interface and immediately see ten ways to make it feel more premium?
Freebird® is a 9-figure DTC brand serving over 2 million customers and redefining grooming for the modern consumer. We've built one of the strongest paid acquisition engines in DTC. Now we're raising the visual and experiential quality of our digital product to match the brand we've built.
We're looking for a Senior UX/UI Designer with a strong emphasis on visual design excellence. We need someone who takes a good interface and makes it exceptional: someone who obsesses over typography, spacing, layout, colour, consistency, and the finer details that elevate a design from functional to memorable. UX knowledge and an understanding of user journeys are important. Visual design craftsmanship is where you must truly excel.
This role owns the Freebird design system, the UI across our digital surfaces, and the visual quality bar the whole team builds toward. You'll work closely with our Senior Director of Design and collaborate with product and engineering to ship work that looks and feels as good as it performs.
You'll report to the Senior Director of Design. This role is 100% remote. We require meaningful overlap with US working hours.
If you obsess over the details that make digital products feel premium, and you've been waiting for a seat where that craft is genuinely valued, this role is for you.
What You'll OwnSet the Visual Design StandardThis is the heart of the role.
- Create beautiful, polished, premium digital experiences that represent Freebird at its best across every touchpoint.

- Take good interfaces and make them exceptional through meticulous attention to typography, layout, colour, spacing, and visual detail.

- Apply a strong visual point of view that pushes design beyond execution and into craft.

- Maintain a consistently high quality bar across web and app surfaces without needing to be managed on the basics.

- Set the visual standard that the rest of the design team builds toward.

Build and Maintain the Freebird Design SystemThe design system is the foundation that holds the visual standard across everything.

- Own the component library, design tokens, and pattern documentation in Figma.

- Maintain version control and governance so the system grows predictably and consistently.

- Act as the consistency gatekeeper: reviewing team output, flagging deviations, and evolving the system as the product expands.

- Collaborate with engineers on implementation so that what's designed is what ships.

- Create clear specifications that enable smooth, low-back-and-forth implementation.

Lead UX Design with Strong Visual Judgment
- Design responsive, accessible experiences across desktop and mobile, led by strong visual instinct.

- Create user journeys, wireframes, and prototypes that are both functionally sound and visually sharp.

- Apply UX knowledge to make well-structured, user-centered design decisions independently.

- Validate and improve designs using product data and customer feedback after launch.

Ship Production-Ready UI at Senior Velocity
- Take stakeholder briefs to polished, production-ready designs within sprint cadence.

- Deliver complete handoffs to engineering: specs, interaction notes, edge-case coverage.

- Contribute to sprint planning and grooming by estimating accurately and delivering on commitments.

- Support design quality reviews so that what ships matches what was designed.

Contribute to the Design Culture
- Bring a strong visual point of view to critiques and team discussions.

- Support junior designers and help establish shared ways of working as the function grows.

- Present design decisions clearly and respond constructively to feedback at all levels, including from a CEO with strong design opinions.

What Success Looks LikeWithin your first 6-12 months:
-
Freebird's digital surfaces look and feel noticeably more premium than when you joined.

- A documented, scalable design system is used consistently across all digital touchpoints.

- Design handoffs are clean, complete, and require minimal clarification from engineering.

- You are the person the team goes to when the visual quality of something isn't right.

- Junior designers have a clear visual standard to work toward and structured feedback to guide them.

RequirementsWe're looking for an exceptional UI/UX designer with a strong emphasis on visual design. Outstanding craft is the requirement. Strong UX knowledge is the complement.

- 5+ years of professional UX/UI or product design experience, with a track record of delivering high-quality digital products end-to-end.

- A portfolio that demonstrates exceptional visual design quality across real digital products. We want to see your eye, your craft, and your attention to detail, not just your process.

- Proven experience building, maintaining, or significantly contributing to a design system used in a live product.

- Strong skills in visual design: typography, layout, colour, hierarchy, spacing, and the ability to create polished, premium interfaces.

- Solid UX knowledge: user journeys, information architecture, wireframes, and prototyping. Enough to make sound, independent design decisions.

- Solid understanding of accessibility principles and inclusive design (WCAG familiarity required).

- Advanced proficiency in Figma.

- Ability to work autonomously, communicate blockers proactively, and maintain momentum without waiting for perfect processes.

description:
---------------------------------------------------------------
Join Our Team as a Junior Product Owner at Hawk-Eye Innovations

---------------------------------------------------------------

Hi, I’m Steve Hardingson, Head of the Video and Graphics Value Stream at Hawk-Eye Innovations. Are you interested in working with the latest technologies in a fast-paced environment, with exciting career opportunities in a growing business?

At Hawk-Eye, we build technology that powers some of the most exciting and critical moments in sport, from instant replays and broadcast augmentation to officiating systems trusted by leagues, federations, broadcasters, and millions of fans worldwide.

Our Value Stream delivers the next generation of live video capture, broadcast infrastructure, and cutting-edge graphics generation that have revolutionised sports media. From ultra-low latency video capture and multi-angle replay servers to real-time broadcast graphics, data overlays, and augmented reality (AR) visualizations, we transform live, raw broadcast feeds into immersive fan experiences and critical video review assets.

We are looking for a Junior Product Owner to help drive our video and broadcast graphics products forward. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical execution and operational excellence. You will keep the technical depth and operational focus of an engineer while taking structured ownership of backlog definition, prioritisation, and delivery outcomes. Working across complex, real-time software-hardware integrated systems in live stadium and broadcast environments, you will directly impact how our world-leading video and broadcast platforms perform on the global stage.

*What You'll Be Doing*

*

*Product Definition & Backlog Ownership:* Act as the voice of broadcast operators, directors, and the business. Translate needs into epics, features, and user stories for small-to-medium changes, and maintain a prioritized backlog using data, value, and risk.

*

*Quality & Testing Coordination:* Define and coordinate QC activities (functional, video/audio stream integration, regression, and UAT). Lead defect detection, triage, validation, and root cause investigations to ensure our replay and graphics systems remain incredibly stable and reliable.

*

*Cross-Functional Delivery:* Work day-to-day with Software Engineering, Video Infrastructure, QA, TechOps, and UI/UX teams to align on scope. Participate fully in Agile ceremonies, monitor support channels, and coordinate third-line support within your scope.

*

*Deployment & Early-Life Support:* Create and maintain documentation, technical runbooks, and training materials. Support live studio pilots, staged roll-outs, and early-life support until video and graphics products are smoothly embedded in live, high-pressure match operations.

*

*Growth Toward Senior Product Ownership:* Build your capabilities across the full product lifecycle. With coaching from senior POs and Product Managers, you will begin shaping short-range roadmaps, defining OKRs, and handling increasing ambiguity.

*What We're Looking For*

*

*1–3 years of experience* in a product-related role (e.g., Associate Product Owner, Business Analyst, QA, Broadcast Operator, or similar) working on technically complex products.

*

*Strong technical grounding* with the ability to communicate effectively with software engineers, QA, and media operators across hardware-software integrated systems.

*

*Proven experience* coordinating QC/regression testing and managing defect resolution.

*

*Video & Media Comfort:* Basic understanding or experience working with video streaming, capture technology, media formats, or data-oriented products, with the ability to interpret basic operational telemetry.

*

*Excellent communication skills* and a proactive mindset to plan your own work, handle live environment ambiguity, and escalate risks appropriately.

*Bonus Points For*

*

Experience supporting product launches and creating technical documentation or tutorial content for broadcast teams.

*

Exposure to stakeholder engagement, prioritization frameworks, and roadmap contribution.

*

Experience working with products that combine software, high-performance video capture hardware, and graphics engines in high-pressure, live broadcast, or real-time sports environments (e.g., OB vans, master control rooms).

*Benefits & Perks*

*

*Annual Leave:* 25 days plus 8 public holidays

*

*Enhanced Pension Scheme:* 5% matching

*

*Flexible Working:* Hybrid model (2 days in the office per week)

*

*Wellness:* Complimentary Unmind app, onsite gym (Basingstoke)

*

*Exclusive Perks:* Access to sporting events and tickets, Sony Group Company discounts

*Equal Opportunity Employer*

We’re committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. Everyone is treated fairly, regardless of gender, race, religion, age, disability, or background. We want you to be your best and truest self here.

*Apply Today*

If you’re excited by the idea of solving real-world broadcast problems at scale and want to help shape the future of live sports video and graphics technology, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Business Analyst - Payments and Fintech
description:
We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our Payments & Fintech team. You will be the person who knows how our checkout and payments are really performing, why, and what to do about it.

You will combine strong data skills with a solid understanding of how an e-commerce business makes money: revenue, costs, margins and the trade-offs between conversion and risk. You will turn data into decisions, spot problems before they become expensive, and help shape what the product team builds next.

This is a junior-to-mid level role, ideal for someone with 4–5 years of experience who wants real ownership and experience across Product and Data teams, and grows into Business roles.

*What you'll do*

Performance monitoring and insights

*

Own the monitoring of payments and checkout performance: conversion, payment method adoption, drop-off rates, market share and other key KPIs, across markets, brands and devices.

*

Translate KPI movements into their business impact on revenue, costs and margin, and recommend actions.

*

Prepare regular business reviews (data, insights and slides) and present them to stakeholders and management.

Anomaly detection and alerting

*

Be the first line of detection for anomalies in payments and checkout, and coordinate investigations and resolutions with Product, Engineering and external partners.

*

Own our real-time alerting system for payments and checkout (currently Grafana/Prometheus): configure and maintain alerts, tune thresholds to reduce noise, and extend coverage as the business grows.

Business partnering

*

Join meetings with payment partners and internal teams, bringing data to the discussion and keeping the focus on what matters for the business.

*

Support the product team and business team in discovery: size opportunities, define success metrics and help with assessing the results of launches and complex A/B tests.

*

Scout the market and competitors for benchmarks, new payment methods and fintech trends.

AI and automation

*

Use AI tools to connect the dots across user data, payment data and other internal sources, uncovering insights that would be hard to find manually.

*

Build lightweight apps, automations and prototypes ("vibe coding") that make analysis faster and help the whole team work smarter.

*Who you'll work with*

You will sit in the Payments & Fintech team and work daily with:

*

Product team: to shape discovery, define metrics and measure what we ship.

*

Business team: to steer commercial decisions with data and support partner relationships.

*

Data Analytics team: to align on data sources, definitions and shared reporting.

You will also be in regular contact with payment service providers and other external partners.

*What you bring*

*

Data skills: you are proficient in SQL and comfortable manipulating and analysing large datasets with Python (or similar). You build clear, reliable reporting.

*

Business acumen: you understand how an e-commerce business works, from traffic and conversion to revenue, costs and profit, and you always ask "so what?" behind a number.

*

AI fluency: you use AI tools every day and are comfortable building apps, automations and prototypes with them.

*

Communication: you build clear slides and tell a story with data, and you are confident presenting to both technical and non-technical audiences.

*

Ownership: you follow an anomaly through to resolution and coordinate people across teams to get there.

Requirements

*

Degree in a STEM discipline (e.g. Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Physics).

*

4–5 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis or a similar analytical role.

*

Solid background in statistics (e.g. hypothesis testing, A/B test analysis, time series).

*

Previous experience in a high-traffic e-commerce or digital business.

*

Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have

*

Experience in payments, fintech, fraud or checkout optimisation.

*

Hands-on experience with monitoring and alerting tools (Grafana, Prometheus or similar).

*

Knowledge of the travel industry or online travel agencies.

*Perks of working with us* :

How we work together:

* An inclusive, friendly, and international environment (you’ll be working with colleagues from +10 countries and over 48 nationalities)
* Shorter working week (36h as full time), with a half working day on Fridays
* Flexible start and end of the working day, with core hours from 10:00 to 4:00 pm
* Possibility to work from anywhere for a period of time per year defined according to local regulations

How we learn together:

* Fri-Yays: half a day on Friday morning with a no-meeting mandate and dedicated to deep work, personal growth, learning and training and/or focus time.
* Professional and managerial skills development training paths, access to e-learning platforms such as O’reilly, Udemy, Coursera (depending on the department), and to our internal platform offering bespoke training content

Other perks:

* 2 paid days off per year for volunteering purposes
* Occasional social events to foster connections among colleagues
* Travel industry discounts and flash exclusive staff fares
* We support our employees through life's significant moments with leave options (e.g parental responsibilities, marriages, bereavements, relocations, etc.) in line with local laws.

Wish you were here? We do, too!

*Selection process steps** :

* Recruiter interview (30 minutes)

* 2nd interview (60min): final meeting with manager and their manager + live test
* Offer extended

(*Please note the process can slightly vary. The recruiter in charge will share more details when setting up the interview)

*Our commitment to celebrate diversity and generate belonging*

At the heart of our culture is a commitment to inclusion across race, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity or expression, and accessibility. We strongly believe in an equal opportunity space, which is welcoming and celebrates the uniqueness of everyone who works here. We value different lived experiences and respect viewpoints, as we know unicity drives innovation. We want to make sure our people reflect the communities across the world we help travel.

title: Junior Accountant

*Junior Accountant*

At Torani, we believe flavor has the power to bring people together and create moments of joy. As a Certified B Corporation, we’re committed to building a business that grows with purpose - supporting our communities, investing in sustainability, and creating an environment where people can learn, contribute, and thrive. As we continue growing toward our $1 Billion vision, we’re looking for curious, motivated team members who are excited to build strong foundations and grow their careers alongside us.

As a Junior Staff Accountant, you’ll play an important role in supporting the day-to-day accounting operations that help keep the business running smoothly. This is an ideal opportunity for someone early in their accounting career who is eager to learn, detail-oriented, and excited to build both technical accounting knowledge and business acumen in a collaborative environment. Working closely with the Accounting and Finance teams, you’ll support key processes including promotional spend reporting, broker commissions, fixed assets, reconciliations, and month-end close activities—while developing a deeper understanding of how accounting supports business decision-making.

At Torani, you won’t just learn accounting processes - you’ll learn how to work collaboratively, think critically, and continuously improve alongside a team that genuinely enjoys helping each other grow. If you’re energized by learning new things, solving problems, and contributing to meaningful work within a people-first culture, we’d love to meet you.

*Success Factors (First 12–24 Months)*

* *Accounting Operations & Team Support:* You became a reliable and collaborative member of the Accounting team by consistently supporting day-to-day accounting operations with accuracy, organization, and follow-through. Working closely with the Senior Accountant and broader Finance team, you helped support Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable activities including billing, credits, collections, and vendor payments, while contributing to smooth month-end and year-end close processes. Through journal entries, reconciliations, and attention to detail, you helped ensure financial records remained accurate, timely, and aligned with GAAP expectations.
* *Promotional Spend & Financial Accuracy Partner:* You helped strengthen the accuracy and visibility of promotional spend reporting by partnering closely with Sales and Finance teams. Through thoughtful account reconciliations and careful review of rebates and billbacks, you supported accurate tracking of liabilities and helped identify discrepancies before they became larger issues. Over time, you developed a stronger understanding of how promotional investments impact the business and how accounting supports informed financial decision-making.
* *Broker & Business Partnership Support:* You supported strong relationships with Torani’s broker partners by helping ensure commission calculations and payments were accurate and timely. Through responsiveness, consistency, and attention to detail, you contributed to a positive experience for both internal and external stakeholders. As your understanding of the business grew, you became increasingly confident navigating questions, resolving issues, and supporting processes that required collaboration across teams.
* *Fixed Assets, Audit & Compliance Support:* You built foundational experience supporting fixed asset accounting, audit preparation, and compliance-related activities. Partnering with the Senior Accountant, you assisted with project coding, asset tracking, capitalization, depreciation, and Oracle Projects maintenance while helping ensure alignment with company policies and accounting standards. During audit and tax cycles, you helped prepare supporting documentation, respond to requests, and maintain organized records that contributed to efficient and accurate reviews.
* *Communication, Learning & Continuous Improvement:* You approached your work with curiosity, ownership, and a willingness to learn. By proactively communicating updates, asking thoughtful questions, and staying organized, you helped maintain alignment across Accounting and Finance teams. Over time, you became more confident identifying opportunities to improve processes, strengthen accuracy, and support smoother workflows. Your growth mindset, collaborative approach, and attention to detail helped you build strong foundational accounting skills while contributing positively to the team environment.
* *Have Fun!*

*What You’ll Bring*

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance
* 3–5 years of relevant experience
* Foundational understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel
* Experience with ERP systems preferred
* Curious, adaptable, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to work standard business hours, with flexibility during month-end, year-end, or audit cycles as needed

*Why People Love Working Here*

*Why Torani*

* *Become an owner:* Every regular team member participates in Torani's Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), giving you the opportunity to share in the long-term success you're helping create. Profit Sharing, an annual bonus, and a 401(k) company match are just a few of the additional ways we celebrate and reward that success together.
* *Growing with purpose:* For more than 35 years, Torani has grown year after year. That growth creates opportunities to build new skills, work with new technologies, and take on new challenges to keep building our business.
* *Better together:* We work across teams, solve problems together, and support one another through both successes and setbacks.

*More to Love*

* *Healthcare that's fully covered:* We pay 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for our team members.
* *Celebrate together:* From Company Day and cultural heritage celebrations to team lunches and milestone celebrations, we make time to connect and celebrate.
* *The perks are pretty delicious:* Enjoy unlimited Italian sodas, flavored lattes, and plenty of opportunities to taste the products we're creating together.
* *And, of course, the essentials:* Competitive pay, paid time off, and a comprehensive benefits package to support you.

*Work Location:* San Leandro, Hybrid, 3 days on site and 2 days work from home.

*Salary Range:* $72,176 - $80,195

title: Junior/Middle .NET Developer (C#)
description:
Про компанію
Graphio.ai допомагає компаніям не втрачати виручку через збої у взаємодії між командами. Ми аналізуємо метадані наявних систем клієнта (через API) і заздалегідь показуємо, коли дії продажів, клієнтського успіху, юристів, фінансів, продукту та операцій розходяться, поки угоди не застопорилися, а продовження не зірвалися. Впровадження займає менш ніж два дні й не змінює робочі процеси клієнта.
Команда вже будувала й масштабувала бізнес: раніше ми створили платформу upSWOT, яку впровадили сотні фінансових організацій і яку згодом придбала Uptiq. Нас підтримують топменеджери з Experian, Mastercard, BambooHR, Brex, SAP, Workday та інших компаній.
Чим доведеться займатися
Розробляти й підтримувати бекенд-сервіси та REST API на C#/.NET (ASP.NET Core): онбординг клієнтів, інтеграції, збір метаданих, звіти та сповіщення
Будувати асинхронні процеси на RabbitMQ: черги, фонові задачі, повторні спроби, ідемпотентність
Працювати з MongoDB (операційні дані) та ClickHouse (аналітика й звіти): запити, схеми, індекси, міграції
Відповідати за автентифікацію, авторизацію та ізоляцію даних клієнтів
Писати юніт- та інтеграційні тести, брати участь у код-рев'ю
Стежити за сервісами на продакшені: логи, метрики, пошук першопричин проблем
Документувати сервіси та API
Що потрібно
1-2 роки досвіду бекенд-розробки (або еквівалентний досвід у реальних проєктах)
Міцні знання C# і .NET (ASP.NET Core, Web API)
Досвід створення REST API: авторизація, обробка помилок, пагінація, версіонування
Практичний досвід із MongoDB: схеми, індекси, агрегації, оптимізація запитів
Розуміння аналітичних баз даних, досвід із ClickHouse або готовність його вивчити
Досвід із чергами повідомлень і фоновою обробкою (RabbitMQ буде плюсом)
Розуміння асинхронної обробки, eventual consistency та механізмів повторних спроб
Основи безпечної розробки
Вміння працювати віддалено: чітка письмова комунікація, відповідальність, передбачуваний результат
Буде плюсом
Досвід із подієво-орієнтованою архітектурою та data pipelines
Робота з великими обсягами даних і оптимізація продуктивності
Observability: логування, метрики, трасування
Досвід у стартапах
Kubernetes або хмари (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Що пропонуємо
Зростання на реальних сервісах, якими користуються клієнти, з менторством від старших інженерів
Змістовні продуктові задачі: обробка метаданих, аналітика процесів, звіти та сповіщення
Атмосфера стартапу: мінімум бюрократії, швидкі ітерації
Віддалена робота, проста структура й високий рівень довіри
Зарплата: [вилка] (уточнюється за підсумками співбесіди й залежить від рівня)
Можливості зростання разом із масштабуванням команди
Умови роботи (щоб усе було прозоро)
Потрібен актуальний профіль у LinkedIn із зазначенням посади в Graphio.ai та прив'язкою до сторінки компанії (стандарти оформлення дамо під час онбордингу)
Команда бере синхронні відпустки чотири рази на рік, дати оголошуються заздалегідь; у критичні для компанії періоди відпустка може бути обмежена
Можна жити в Україні, але потрібно бути готовим до релокації з родиною до Європи чи США, якщо компанія попросить про це і це стане юридично можливим (обговорюється заздалегідь)
Потрібна гнучкість щодо графіка: іноді зустрічі можуть бути зарано або пізно через різні часові пояси
Як відгукнутися: надішліть резюме або посилання на профіль, і ми коротко зв'яжемося.

description:

*Read carefully before applying.*

Bridges for Enterprise (BfE) is a non-profit that provides pro bono advisory services to social innovators in the developing world. Through our flagship Incubation Programme, we support early-stage businesses with existing revenue and a clear mission to create social impact for their beneficiaries. The services are free of charge - and always will be - as we don’t believe that money should ever be a barrier for social entrepreneurs to receive additional support in scaling their ventures. As a non-profit established in 2015, we expanded rapidly to operate from five student chapters and developed a client base spanning over 30 countries. We collaborate alongside a growing network of over 200 professional mentors who provide strategic guidance to chapter teams and assistance to startups.

Effective UI/UX design in the rapidly changing web development landscape and remains a critical challenge to many organisations. This is no different for us at Bridges for Enterprise, a global nonprofit working with a range of local and global media channels and building a variety of tech applications to serve our community. As our repository of design guidelines and digital assets grows, we are looking for a passionate volunteer to join us in building our first UI design system and putting structure into creativity. The team is led by our UI/UX Manager, a senior product design professional with experience leading UI/UX teams of various scales. As we’re at the start of our digital transformation journey, you will help us design internal applications to automate certain parts of our manual processes, thus helping Bridges for Enterprise to have a larger social impact.

*At least 2 years of experience* in UI/UX or Product Design

Strong interest in digital design, UI and products

Sound organisational skills, teamwork and passion in learning

This is a remote project and there are no geographical restrictions for the role

Make a social impact with your professional skills while further developing them in the business context of an nonprofit incubator

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI, Design Systems, Accessibility)
description:
*The Opportunity*

Join the product design team of a US health benefits technology company as a senior product designer on the member experience. You will bring the core parts of a health plan to life for the people who use it, turning confusing healthcare moments into clear, accessible and trustworthy experiences across web and mobile. You will work embedded with scrum teams alongside product managers, engineers, business analysts and a UX research team. Fully remote from Latin America, US business hours, 6 month contract.

*What You'll Do*

* Plan, run and analyze user research, including interviews, surveys and usability studies, to understand user needs, behaviors and pain points and find where the experience can improve.
* Turn research insights and business requirements into user flows, wireframes, prototypes and high fidelity UI designs.
* Iterate on your designs based on user feedback, technical feasibility and business goals.
* Work in and follow the design system every day, and contribute new components, patterns and improvements back to it, partnering with engineering to keep design and code in sync.
* Design accessible experiences that meet WCAG 2.2 AA, and test your work with accessibility tools and assistive technology before handoff.
* Use AI tools to speed up exploration, prototyping, research synthesis and design review, and critically evaluate what they produce. Use AI assisted checks to catch design system and accessibility issues early.
* Create and maintain UI specifications and design documentation that keep the design consistent and make development easier.
* Collaborate with product managers, engineers, business analysts and other cross functional partners across the full product development lifecycle.
* Present design concepts and rationale clearly and persuasively to stakeholders.
* Stay current on UX and UI trends, best practices and emerging technologies.

*What You'll Bring*

* A strong portfolio that shows exceptional UI craft and the breadth and depth of your work against this role. A portfolio is required to be considered: share a link or upload it with your application.
* 5 or more years of UX design experience building products people find easy to use, on web and mobile.
* Experience applying and evolving a design system, including contributing components or patterns.
* Working knowledge of WCAG 2.2 AA and experience shipping accessible products.
* Experience using AI tools in your design workflow, with sound judgment about where they help and where they don't.
* Experience with user testing tools and with partnering with a UX research team to turn insights into actionable improvements.
* The ability to bring clarity to complex problem spaces using whiteboards, flowcharts, wireframes or other visual diagrams.
* The ability to explain design rationale, document decisions and deliver detailed specs engineers can build from.
* A strong understanding of grid systems, hierarchy, typography and color.
* Curiosity about using data to inform design.
* Attention to detail, an obsession with craft and openness to feedback.
* Resourcefulness, eagerness to adopt best practices and a drive to achieve design breakthroughs.
* A bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, Interaction Design or a related field.
* Excellent written and verbal English.

*What Sets You Apart*

* A desire to make a significant impact in healthcare.
* Experience designing for healthcare applications, insurance technology or enterprise products.
* Familiarity with healthcare regulations and standards such as HIPAA and WCAG, and how they affect design.
* Experience with design tokens or design to code workflows.

title: Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
*Що варто знати про SKELAR?*

Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми в пошуку *Product Designer (UI/UX)* , який не просто малює, а вирішує бізнес-виклики через дослідження, ідеї та результативний дизайн. *Формат роботи - ремоут.*

*Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі:*

*

Проєктування ефективних маркетингових воронок;

*

Створення user-flow на цільових сторінках;

*

Генерація гіпотез та їх валідація через велику кількість A/B тестів;

*

Аналіз воронок прямих та непрямих конкурентів;

*

Аналіз поведінки користувачів через внутрішні інструменти аналітики;

*

Тісна взаємодія з сильною командою дизайнерів, розробників та аналітиків.

*Що для нас важливо:*

*

Від 2х років досвіду в продуктовій компанії на позиції UX/UI, Product або Growth дизайнера;

*

Досвід з вебом - must, досвід з мобільними застосунками - буде плюсом;

*

Володіння Figma на високому рівні;

*

Знання основ композиції, типографіки та кольористики;

*

Бізнес-орієнтованість: дизайн не заради краси, а в першу чергу задля зростання конверсії;

*

Вміння структуровано подати інформацію: результати дослідження, презентація концепту, ідеї для брейншторму;

*

Вміння аргументувати свої рішення.

*Що ти отримаєш разом з нами:*

— Внутрішні клуби за професійними напрямками: маркетинг, розробка, фінанси, рекрутинг;
— Тренінги, курси, відвідування конференцій;
— Просторі та сучасні офіси у Києві та Варшаві;
— Медичне страхування, корпоративний лікар.

*У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:*

*

*SKELAR Platform*. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

*

*Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури.* Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

*

*Ексклюзивна доменна освіта.* Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

*

*Вплив на системну допомогу Україні.* Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці — і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави.

*

*Екосистема для продуктивної роботи.* Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат — з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше.

*

*Турбота про щоденний комфорт.* Сніданки, обіди, доступ до спортивних тренувань в Києві або часткова компенсація занять у Варшаві, медичне страхування, оплачувані відрядження, якщо специфіка ролі передбачає такі поїздки, корпоративні знижки від партнерів.

*Більше розповімо на нашій зустрічі-знайомстві. Запрошуємо будувати the next big everything у SKELAR разом!*

title: Product Designer (UI/UX)
location: Remote, New York, New York, United States
description:
About Ajaia
-----------

Ajaia is an AI implementation consultancy and product studio. We help organizations move from AI experimentation to measurable return on investment across four practices: AI Strategy and Advisory, Workforce Training and Enablement, Process Optimization, and Custom AI Development. Our work sits with executives and the people who do the actual work, and it is judged on whether something changed in production, not on whether a pilot looked good in a deck.

Position Overview
-----------------

Ajaia is hiring a Product Designer (UI/UX) to run discovery and design on client engagements and on Ajaia's own product suite. You will talk to the people who actually do the work, watch what they do rather than only what they say, and turn that into journeys, wireframes, and prototypes an engineer can build from. You will test the design against real users before a line of production code is written, and you will hold the standard for how everything Ajaia ships looks and behaves.

This is a hands-on seat: you do the research and the design yourself, rather than handing off between the two.

*Compensation:* $90,000 to $210,000 base, depending on experience, plus a performance bonus of up to 100% of base salary.

How we expect you to work
-------------------------

AI use is a core execution requirement at Ajaia, not optional tooling. You will use AI tools daily to move from interview notes to synthesis, from synthesis to wireframe, and from wireframe to something clickable. You are judged on what you keep from that process, not on how much of it AI produced.

Staying current with new design and prototyping tools is part of the job, and so is knowing when a shortcut needs your hand back on it before a user ever sees it.

What you will do
----------------

* Run discovery on client engagements: interview the people doing the work, watch them do it, and find the gap between what they say and what they actually do.
* Talk to users of Ajaia's own products the same way. The product suite is not exempt from the same rigor client work gets.
* Synthesize findings into what people actually need, stated separately from what they asked for, with the evidence for each.
* Design the solution: user journeys, wireframes, and prototypes that an engineer can build from without guessing.
* Decide where a human has to sign off inside a workflow, and design that checkpoint into the product rather than bolting it on afterward.
* Test designs with real users before code exists, not after.
* Push back on a stakeholder's feature list when the evidence points somewhere else, and explain why in terms they can act on.
* Own the design standard across Ajaia's product suite so a designer joining engagement three does not have to reinvent decisions made on engagement one.
* Prototype with AI tools as a default, not a novelty. Know when the AI-native path saves real time and when it produces something you have to rebuild by hand anyway.
* Hand off design work in a state an engineer can actually start from, and stay involved enough during the build to catch it when implementation drifts from the intent.

*Requirements*

* Runs discovery yourself: interviews, usability testing, and reading behavioral data.
* Moves from synthesis to a working prototype fast.
* Designs the human checkpoints into a workflow rather than bolting them on later.
* Comfortable holding a room when the evidence points somewhere a stakeholder does not expect.
* AI fluent: uses AI daily to research, synthesize, and prototype, and can tell good output from slop.
* Comfortable working directly alongside engineers through build.
* No minimum years required. We hire on the work.
* On-site in New York, with client-site travel for discovery work.
* A bachelor's degree is preferred and is not a requirement.

*Nice to have*

* A public portfolio or case studies we can look at before we meet.
* Experience designing AI-native workflows, including where a human checkpoint belongs.
* Consulting, agency, or professional services experience with concurrent clients.
* Comfort with lightweight front-end implementation.

*Benefits*

Competitive benefits.

title: Lead Visual Designer, Brand and Product
description:

*About Step*

Step's mission is to improve the financial future of the next generation. Millions of people use our banking and borrowing products to manage, build, and grow their money. Now that we're part of Beast Industries – the company behind MrBeast – we're poised for a new phase of growth to deliver financial literacy and tools at massive scale.

----------------
*About the Role*
----------------

At Step, design is one of our biggest competitive advantages.

We're looking for an experienced Visual Designer to define and evolve how Step looks and feels across every customer touchpoint. From our product and marketing campaigns to physical cards, merchandise, social media, and brand experiences, you'll own the visual identity that makes Step instantly recognizable.

This role sits at the intersection of brand, product, and marketing. You'll work closely with Product Design, Marketing, Engineering, and Leadership to ensure every interaction with Step feels cohesive, intentional, and unmistakably ours.

We're looking for someone who obsesses over typography, color, composition, illustration, motion, and craft. Someone who can zoom out to define the visual language for an entire company, then roll up their sleeves to design the details that bring it to life.

-------------------------
*In this role, you will:*
-------------------------

* Own and evolve Step's visual identity across every customer touchpoint, ensuring a cohesive experience across product, marketing, brand, and physical experiences
* Design compelling creative for product launches, lifecycle marketing, social media posts, advertising, web, email, and other customer-facing experiences including mobile-first email templates and assets (graphics, photos, GIFs, modular blocks)
* Produce high-impact static and motion assets for paid channels (social, search, display, CTV), following platform best practices. Iterate based on performance data and partner with media buyers to evolve and expand on what's working
* Partner closely with Product Design to ensure our visual language is consistently expressed throughout the app and product ecosystem
* Define, document, and maintain our brand guidelines, ensuring they evolve alongside the company while remaining easy for teams to understand and use

* Raise the quality bar across the organization through thoughtful critique, art direction, and mentorship
* Explore new visual directions, illustrations, motion, photography, and emerging creative trends that push the Step brand forward
* Help define how AI can accelerate creative exploration, production, and content creation while maintaining exceptional design quality
* Champion craftsmanship in every detail, from high-level creative direction down to the smallest production asset

--------------------------------------------
*You might thrive in this role if you have:*
--------------------------------------------

* Significant experience designing visual identities, marketing campaigns, and digital experiences for consumer brands
* Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft across branding, marketing, digital products, and storytelling
* Deep understanding of typography, layout, color, composition, illustration, photography, and motion
* Experience building and documenting visual identity systems that scale across teams and channels
* Strong understanding of how brand and product work together to create a cohesive customer experience
* An exceptional eye for detail and an instinct for when something feels "almost right" versus truly polished
* Comfortable moving fluidly between high-level creative direction and hands-on execution
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present ideas, explain creative rationale, and collaborate across disciplines.
* Uses AI as a creative multiplier—able to rapidly explore concepts, accelerate production, and improve creative workflows without compromising quality or originality
* Passionate about building brands people love and experiences people remember
* Must have a portfolio featuring examples of visual identity, brand, marketing, and digital design work

--------------------------
*Even better if you have:*
--------------------------

* Experience working on consumer fintech or other highly regulated consumer products
* Experience designing physical products such as payment cards, packaging, merchandise, or environmental graphics
* Experience with illustration, iconography, or motion design
* Experience creating design systems or visual languages that span both product and brand
* Experience art directing photography or video production
* Experience building AI-assisted creative workflows or internal creative tooling

-----------
*Logistics*
-----------

*Location:* Remote (US) or San Mateo, CA, with occasional travel for team offsites and key meetings

*Reports to:* Head of Design

*Education:* Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single qualification. Strong candidates rarely check every box, and we'd rather meet you than miss you.

---------------------
*How we're different*
---------------------

We stand for the side hustlers, the creators, the freelancers, and the investors — people who are not afraid to take on challenges, especially when it comes to their finances. Step is focused on disrupting the banking industry by delivering a differentiated, mobile-first consumer experience, and we operate like the customers we serve: customer obsessed, acting as owners, moving with urgency, and breaking the norm.

Step is a wholly owned subsidiary of *Beast Industries* , the media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson (MrBeast), the most-watched person in the world. Beast Industries spans digital media, consumer products, philanthropy, and new ventures, with an audience reach no consumer company has ever had — and Step is tasked with turning that reach into financial literacy and tools for the next generation at massive scale. With Beast's distribution and brand behind it, Step is positioned to scale significantly over the next 12 months, and joining now means helping shape that trajectory from the inside.

--------------------
*Come work with us!*
--------------------

Step is a remote-first company building banking for the next generation. We offer competitive compensation and stock options, generous medical, dental, vision, and company-paid life insurance, a 401k plan with Safe Harbor company matching, a flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays, 12 weeks paid parental leave with flexible return to work, and a company-provided technology package. If you're looking to join a fast-growing company with a strong mission and vision that puts people first, we want to meet you!

Step is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Step is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need an accommodation, please let us know at people@step.com and we'll work with you to provide appropriate support.

description:

*Job Type:* Full-time, Exempt

*Reporting To:* Creative Director

*Company:* JustFoodForDogs LLC

*Location:* Remote

*About JustFoodForDogs:*

JustFoodForDogs, the #1 vet recommended fresh food for dogs, is dedicated to helping pets live longer, healthier lives through real, whole-food nutrition. Founded in 2010, JustFoodForDogs revolutionized the fresh whole food movement for dogs when it opened the first open-to-the-public kitchen cooking food for dogs. All of our recipes are formulated by veterinarians and made with 100% human-grade ingredients. Today, consumers can find JustFoodForDogs at JustFoodForDogs retail locations, their favorite retailers and on-line at JustFoodForDogs.com. The company’s offerings include daily meals, shelf-stable products, supplements, and treats. To learn more about JustFoodForDogs, visit JustFoodForDogs.com

*Position Overview:*

We’re looking for a talented Graphic Designer to help bring the JustFoodForDogs brand to life across digital and retail experiences. Reporting to the Creative Director and collaborating closely with our Senior Graphic Designer, you’ll turn creative concepts into compelling designs across social, email, web, print, and in-store environments. You’ll work alongside our marketing, retail, ecommerce and creative teams, with the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how our brand shows up at every touchpoint.

*Key Responsibilities:*

* *Digital Design:* Create graphics for social media, email, web, and paid ads.
* *Retail Graphics:* Design in-store signage, menu boards, window graphics, and POP materials for our stores and retail partners.
* *Print:* Design collateral such as brochures, display sheets, and flyers. Understand how to create prepare press-ready files.
* *Packaging Design:* Support the development of packaging designs, with an understanding of production processes, print specifications, and final artwork preparation.
* *Design Concepts:* Collaborate with the Senior Graphic Designer and Creative Director to bring creative concepts to life, from mood boards and initial explorations to polished mockups.
* *Campaign Adaptation:* Resize and version campaign creative across digital, print, and retail.
* *Brand Consistency:* Apply brand guidelines across every touchpoint.

*Qualifications:*

* *Experience:* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field plus 2–4 years of professional graphic design experience.

* *Skills:* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) and Figma. Motion experience is a plus.
* *Production Knowledge:* Understanding of print production and digital specs across platforms.
* *Portfolio:* A mix of digital and print work, plus concept work that shows both creative thinking and production craft.
* *Strengths:* Strong attention to detail, takes feedback well, and manages multiple projects remotely on deadline.
