title: Brand & Marketing Designer
description:
*About RenewCO2*

RenewCO2 makes carbon-negative chemicals and fuels. Our electrocatalytic CO2 utilization technology runs on electricity, water, and waste CO2, and the product drops straight into existing industrial supply chains. Because the process is energy-efficient, our cost structure competes with fossil-derived incumbents rather than relying on a green premium.

We are venture-backed, and we have won grant funding from the U.S. Department of Energy, the National Science Foundation, DARPA, the New Jersey Commission on Science, Innovation and Technology, and Breakthrough Energy, among others. The technology is demonstrated at pilot scale with customers, and we are now building toward commercial scale.

The company started in the United States, where most of our R&D is executed, while product development and manufacturing happen in India.

Our customers are chemical, fuel, and materials producers across Asia, Europe, and North and Latin America. Your work has to hold up for a procurement team in Rotterdam, a process engineer in Houston, and a plant manager in Gujarat, not just one of them.

This role is based in Chikkaballapur, Karnataka, at Ohmium International, which builds green hydrogen electrolyzers at a gigafactory there. RenewCO2 has a joint development agreement with Ohmium: working beside a partner that already makes electrochemical stacks at volume shortens our path to manufacturing at scale.

*The role*

You will be the only designer at the company. Everything RenewCO2 puts in front of a customer, a partner, an investor, or a government reviewer passes through you: investor and capability decks, product one-pagers and spec sheets, the website, booths and signage, social assets, technical diagrams, report layouts, and the brand system holding it all together.

The hard part is not production. It is turning engineering reality into something a non-specialist understands and a specialist cannot pick apart. You will take a rough sketch, a CAD screenshot, or an Excel chart from an engineer and produce a figure that is accurate first and beautiful second.

You will also art-direct outside help. We are not building an in-house studio, so you will brief and manage illustrators, 3D artists, videographers, exhibit fabricators, and printers, and hold their work to our standard.

*What you will do*

*Decks and sales collateral*

• Design investor, partner, and capability decks end to end, including the dense technical slides. Those are the hard ones and they matter most.

• Build PowerPoint and Google Slides template systems with working masters, layouts, and theme colors that non-designers cannot easily break.

• Produce one-pagers, spec sheets, technical FAQs, and leave-behinds that fit real content into a fixed page.

*Technical illustration and data visualization*

• Draw process flow diagrams, system schematics, equipment cutaways, and plant layouts from engineering source material, checking accuracy with our technical team.

• Build charts from raw data: cost curves, comparison bars, mass and energy flow diagrams, with correct axes, correct units, and honest scales.

• Prepare figures for conference posters, technical papers, and government reports to the conventions those audiences expect.

*Website*

• Design and build pages in our CMS, and own the updates, with turnaround measured in hours.

• Hold the line on responsive layout, page performance, on-page SEO hygiene, and accessibility to WCAG 2.1 AA including color contrast.

*Brand system*

• Keep and evolve the RenewCO2 brand system: logo use, typography, color, icons, diagram and chart styles, photography direction, document templates.

• Maintain a component and template library, and an asset library organized well enough that other people find things in it.

*Social, campaigns, and events*

• Produce social and campaign assets, mostly for LinkedIn: statics, carousels, short motion pieces, event promotion.

• Design booths, banners, signage, and large-format graphics, and take them through print production and installation by our fabrication vendors.

*Vendor art direction*

• Write the brief, pick the vendor, and manage illustrators, 3D and CGI artists, video crews, exhibit fabricators, and print shops to schedule, budget, and quality.

• Review proofs, renders, and cuts, and give feedback specific enough to act on.

*What we need to see in your portfolio*

We read portfolios closely, and we care more about problem-solving than polish. Include these, and note what you personally did:

• A deck you designed end to end, not a template you filled. Show us the densest technical slide in it.

• A technical illustration you built from an engineer's rough sketch, a CAD screenshot, or a photograph: a process flow diagram, a system schematic, or an equipment cutaway.

• Charts you built yourself from raw data, with a note on where the data came from.

• A one-pager or spec sheet where real technical content, including a table, had to fit a fixed page.

• A website you designed and shipped, with a live link.

• A brand or template system you maintained that other people used correctly without you in the room.

*Required qualifications*

• Four to seven years designing in-house or at an agency, with real work for B2B, industrial, engineering, energy, or scientific clients. Consumer-only and social-only portfolios will not fit.

• Figma at an expert level: components, variants, auto-layout, and shared libraries other people build from.

• Illustrator for vector and technical illustration, InDesign for multi-page and print-ready layout, Photoshop for image work.

• Real mastery of PowerPoint and Google Slides. A large share of what we send out is a deck, and engineers will edit it after you hand it over.

• You can design and build in Webflow, WordPress, or something comparable, and you understand responsive layout, basic HTML and CSS, image optimization, on-page SEO, and WCAG 2.1 AA.

• Print production beyond exporting a PDF: CMYK against RGB, Pantone matching, bleed and safe areas, resolution for large-format booth graphics, packaging files for a printer, and checking a physical proof.

• You have art-directed outside vendors. You wrote the brief, picked the partner, held the schedule and budget, and gave feedback that improved the work.

• You can work with engineers and scientists. You ask the clarifying question, you respect what the data says, and you never make a diagram prettier at the cost of making it wrong.

• Disciplined file management: naming conventions, versioning, one source of truth. Sound handling of unpublished technical material under NDA.

• Strong typography and layout judgment, plus the ability to explain a decision in plain language to people who do not speak design.

• Fluent written and spoken English. Kannada or Hindi helps with local print and fabrication vendors.

*Strongly preferred*

• 3D visualization for equipment, skid, and plant renders in Blender, KeyShot, or SolidWorks Visualize.

• Motion design for short explainers and animated diagrams in After Effects or Rive.

• Familiarity with scientific figure conventions, and experience preparing figures for journals, conference posters, or government technical reports.

• Photography and video on site, in the lab and on the factory floor, including basic lighting and editing.

• Illustration range wide enough to define a visual language rather than borrow one.

• Front-end comfort past HTML and CSS, or experience with design tokens in a code base.

• Time at an early-stage company where you set the standard instead of inheriting it.

*What success looks like in six months*

• A deck and document template system in active use, with fewer off-brand files circulating each month.

• A refreshed website you can update yourself, quickly, without outside help.

• A library of accurate, reusable diagrams and charts that the commercial and technical teams pull from instead of rebuilding.

• A short vendor bench for print, illustration, 3D, and video, with known costs and lead times.

*Location, working pattern, and compensation*

Hybrid: two days a week on site in Chikkaballapur, the rest wherever you work best. A company shuttle runs from Bengaluru, so you do not have to relocate or drive the corridor yourself.

Compensation: ₹12–15 lakh fixed CTC, plus equity and benefits. No travel, though an extra on-site day sometimes comes up around a booth build or a print review.

*What to submit*

• A portfolio link or a PDF under 20 MB covering the six items above. Password-protected is fine, and include the password.

• Annotation on every piece: what you designed, built, or art-directed, and what a team, an agency, or a vendor did. If it is unannotated we will assume the least.

• For two projects, a few lines on the brief, the real constraint you worked against, and one decision you would make differently now.

• A live link to a website you designed, with a note on what you designed against what you built.

• Willingness to open a native file later in the process, whether a Figma library, an Illustrator diagram, an InDesign document, or a PowerPoint template, and walk us through how it is put together. Construction matters as much as output.

Do not send confidential or NDA-covered client work. Redact it or describe it. We will not ask you for unpaid spec work, and any exercise later in the process gets scoped and paid.

*How to apply*

Apply below through our careers page at

https://www.renewco2.com/caree...The application platform collects your CV, work samples, and a few short questions.

RenewCO2 is an equal opportunity employer. We judge candidates on what they have done and what they can do, and we welcome applicants of every background. If you need an accommodation at any stage, tell us and we will arrange it.

title: Lead Learning Experience Designer
location: Remote, Brazil, Canada, Colombia, France, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States
description:
The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a *Lead Learning Experience Designer* to create innovative, engaging, and accessible learning experiences that strengthen the capacity of volunteers and communities across the Wikimedia movement. You'll help contributors develop the confidence, skills, and knowledge they need to participate effectively, navigate Wikimedia’s communities and practices, and grow as contributors.

In this role, you'll partner with Foundation teams, affiliates, researchers, subject matter experts, and volunteers to understand learner needs, identify barriers to participation, and develop learning experiences that support contributors at different stages of their journey.

This role goes beyond traditional instructional design. You’ll think like a learning product designer, finding the right approach for each challenge, whether that means creating an online course on Wikimedia’s learning management system (LMS), WikiLearn, producing multimedia content, experimenting with emerging technologies, or embedding learning into existing experiences and workflows. You will do all this while ensuring the experiences you create are culturally responsive, accessible, and relevant to a global audience. This role is intended for an experienced individual who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and making decisions in complex, evolving environments.

Success in this role means being a curious, resourceful problem solver who understands how people learn, grow, and participate. You can think big about how learning can strengthen the Wikimedia movement, while also rolling up your sleeves to build, experiment, and iterate on solutions that make a meaningful difference.

*Responsibilities*

* Design and develop innovative digital learning experiences, capacity-strengthening resources, and performance support solutions for contributors across the Wikimedia movement.
* Partner with product teams, community groups, researchers, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs, contributor challenges, and opportunities to strengthen participation.
* Determine the right learning approach for each opportunity, whether that be a self-paced course, video, interactive experience, AI-enabled support, workshop, or embedded guidance.
* Develop learning experiences that support contributors in understanding new tools, workflows, policies, governance processes, and community practices across Wikimedia projects.
* Rapidly prototype, test and iterate on learning experiences, using modern authoring tools, multimedia, and AI tools.
* Apply learning science, user-centered design, and learning experience design methodologies to create engaging, effective, and inclusive solutions.
* Evaluate learning effectiveness using learner feedback, participation data, and other qualitative and quantitative insights, continuously improving content based on evidence and community feedback.
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the Foundation's learning strategy by staying current with learning technology, online learning, AI, and digital engagement, identifying opportunities to expand and strengthen learning offerings across the movement.
* Ensure learning resources reflect Wikimedia's values of openness, collaboration, equity, and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications
--------------

*Required*

* *Experience designing and developing digital learning experiences for diverse, global audiences.*
* *Demonstrated experience creating engaging e-learning, instructor-led, virtual, or blended learning solutions.*
* *Experience using a learning management system (LMS) to develop, organize, and publish learning content.*
* *Demonstrated ability to diagnose capability gaps, identify the right interventions, and rapidly design, build and improve learning experiences.*
* *Excellent written communication and content development skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.*
* *Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts.*
* *Commitment to accessibility, inclusive design, and culturally responsive learning practices.*

*Preferred*
-----------

* *Experience working with volunteer communities, open knowledge initiatives, nonprofits, or international organizations.*
* *Experience designing learning for multilingual audiences and collaborating across cultures and time zones.*
* *Experience creating learning in modern digital environments using tools such as Rise, Storyline, Camtasia, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, video editing tools, AI content generation platforms, or similar technologies.*
* *Experience partnering with product teams or using product design approaches, such as user research, experimentation, prototyping and iteration.*
* *Knowledge of experimentation methods, A/B testing, learning analytics, product analytics, and continuous improvement practices.*
* *Familiarity with Wikimedia projects, the Wikimedia movement, or open-source communities.*

**You'll Thrive in This Role If You...**

* *Think like a designer and builder, comfortable moving from identifying challenges to creating, testing and improving solutions.*
* *Are curious about how people learn, what motivates participation, and how to leverage modern methods and technology to create memorable learning experiences.*
* *Are energized by ambiguity and enjoy figuring out what needs to be built rather than waiting for a predefined assignment.*
* *Excel at collaborating with people from different backgrounds, languages, and areas of expertise.*
* *Balance creativity with evidence and structure, using data, research, and feedback to guide decisions.*
* *Care deeply about accessibility, inclusion, and creating learning that supports equitable participation.*
* *Are inspired by Wikimedia's mission to make knowledge freely available to everyone.*

*About the Wikimedia Foundation*

*The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.*

*The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.*

**As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. *The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries ***. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

*What you’ll be part of:*

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values : High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

------------------------------
What you'll be responsible for
------------------------------

You will own product areas within Managed Payments, Circle’s regulated payments infrastructure that enables PSPs, financial institutions, banks, and enterprises to use stablecoin-powered payment rails without operating crypto infrastructure themselves. You will define and evolve product capabilities that support managed pay-ins, payouts, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management across stablecoin and fiat endpoints. Working closely with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will translate complex customer and business needs into clear product priorities, lead cross-functional execution, and deliver measurable improvements to how customers move money across geographies and payment rails.

-------------------
What you'll work on
-------------------

*

Own the roadmap for product areas across managed pay-ins, payouts, fiat endpoints, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management, aligning priorities with customer needs and Circle’s goals.

*

Define and launch capabilities that expand Managed Payments across Circle’s regulated hubs, including new entities, corridors, payout methods, and geographic coverage.

*

Shape simple, reliable customer experiences for accepting funds, converting value, and disbursing globally across stablecoin and fiat rails, including integrations with CPN and other Circle systems.

*

Improve customer and operator workflows across onboarding, account setup, transaction visibility, reporting, exception handling, reconciliation, refunds, RFIs, and bulk payments.

*

Use customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify friction, prioritize investments, and measure improvements in reliability, efficiency, adoption, and customer experience.

*

Evaluate opportunities to support new payment rails, payout use cases, and digital assets based on customer demand, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and business priorities.

*

Lead complex cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, BD, and Product, navigating technical and business trade-offs and driving alignment from definition through launch.

---------------------------
What you'll bring to Circle
---------------------------

Core requirements
-----------------

*

4+ years of relevant experience, including product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, or similarly complex B2B products.

*

Experience owning product vision, roadmaps, and execution for B2B capabilities such as payments, pay-ins, payouts, settlement, treasury infrastructure, APIs, or financial operations.

*

Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex cross-functional initiatives spanning Engineering and partners such as Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, or commercial teams.

*

Strong analytical and technical fluency, with experience using customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.

*

Track record of delivering measurable improvements to customer experience, product adoption, operational efficiency, reliability, or business performance.

*

Ability to evaluate technical and business trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and translate complex requirements into clear product priorities and execution plans.

Preferred requirements
----------------------

*

Knowledge of cross-border payments, PSP infrastructure, settlement systems, correspondent banking, or other payment network concepts.

*

Familiarity with stablecoins, blockchain-based financial infrastructure, or crypto-enabled payment systems.

*

Experience with enterprise APIs, payment networks, or compliance-forward systems involving payment lifecycle states, reconciliation, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or SLAs.

---------------------
Why this role matters
---------------------

Managed Payments is a core part of Circle’s strategy to make stablecoin-powered payments accessible to businesses beyond crypto-native customers. Customers increasingly need complete payment programs that allow them to accept funds, manage balances, convert across assets, and disburse globally without assembling wallets, banking partners, liquidity providers, compliance systems, and payout networks themselves. As Senior Product Manager, you will help turn that complexity into an integrated customer experience and scale Managed Payments into a reliable, global, enterprise-grade product.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. title: Sr.Product Manager – Commerce Growth
description:
*About HighLevel*

*About us*
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

*Our people*
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

*Our impact*
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

*Role Overview*

HighLevel processes payments at significant scale for the businesses that run on our platform and yet only a fraction of the businesses we serve have adopted payments at all. The constraint is structural rather than one of awareness: adoption is decided by the agencies who serve these businesses, and they have never had a commercial reason to act. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager - Commerce Growth to close that gap and make payments adoption the fastest-compounding line in our Commerce business.

This role owns the adoption and monetisation charter for Commerce end to end. It spans partner incentive design, the growth mechanics that move a business from signing up to transacting consistently, the partner-facing surfaces those programmes live in, and the commercial model underneath them. It is a general-management role as much as a product one, you will own the unit economics, the programme budget, and the evidence that the investment is working.

This role is ideal for product managers who have built growth or partner programmes at scale, who are comfortable being measured on a commercial outcome rather than a feature list, and who bring the analytical rigour to distinguish growth that was genuinely caused from growth that would have happened anyway.

*What You'll Do*

*

Own the payments adoption charter end to end - the strategy, roadmap and operating plan that take adoption and transacting volume to a multiple of today's levels, and the commercial targets attached to them.

*

Design, launch and iterate partner incentive programmes that make adoption commercially compelling for the agencies who drive it including eligibility models, qualification logic, payout mechanics and the controls that keep the programmes durable and abuse-resistant.

*

Own the partner-facing product surfaces where these programmes are discovered, understood and acted on progress, earnings and next-best-action, designed to scale to tens of thousands of partners without manual support.

*

Own the unit economics: customer acquisition cost, payback period, contribution margin and programme budget - modelled, forecast, and defensible to Finance and leadership.

*

Build a disciplined experimentation practice - randomised tests, holdout groups and incrementality measurement so that pricing and programme decisions are evidence-led rather than intuition-led.

*

Apply growth-hacking rigour across the adoption funnel: segmentation, lifecycle triggers, in-product prompts and targeted campaigns, in partnership with Lifecycle Marketing, Community and Support.

*

Lead commercial conversations with our largest agency partners, where bespoke arrangements rather than self-serve programmes are what move the number.

*

Own the monthly performance narrative - adoption, retention, cost efficiency and programme health and the decision to scale, hold or retire each initiative.

*

Partner with Analytics, Finance, Risk and Commerce platform engineering on the measurement, controls and infrastructure the charter depends on.

*What Success Looks Like*

*

Payments adoption grows at a multiple of its current rate, with the uplift demonstrably attributable to the work rather than to underlying trend

*

Incentive investment pays back inside its target window, measured on contribution rather than headline revenue

*

Partners understand what they have earned and why, without needing to contact support

*

Programme abuse remains negligible and is contained by automated controls rather than manual review

*

Programme spend tracks forecast, with variance understood and explained

*Minimum Qualifications*

*

8–10 years of product management experience

*

Experience owning a growth, partner, referral or incentive programme where the commercial mechanic itself was the product

*

Comfort owning a commercial outcome end to end acquisition cost, payback, contribution margin and defending it to a finance audience

*

A track record of running controlled experiments and drawing the right conclusion from them, including the unwelcome one

*

Experience with payments, fintech, marketplaces or another business where unit economics are the product strategy

*Preferred Qualifications*

*

Experience in partner, reseller or franchise ecosystems where a third party not the end user makes the adoption decision

*

Familiarity with payment economics: processing rates, take rate, volume tiers, and how payment method mix affects platform monetisation

*

Experience designing abuse and fraud controls for a rewards, referral or affiliate programme

*

Background in vertical SaaS or platform businesses that monetise payments alongside subscriptions

*Who This Role Is For*

*

Product managers who think in unit economics, and who will hold the line when an initiative is popular but does not pay for itself.

*

PMs who treat commercial programmes as product surfaces with an interface, a rulebook and a feedback loop rather than a spreadsheet handed to marketing.

*

People energised by a very specific problem: getting tens of thousands of independent businesses to act on your behalf, repeatedly, at a price that makes sense.

*Why Should You Join Us?*

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.

Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

- Build and develop a high-performing engineering team, providing technical mentorship, coaching, clear expectations, and a culture of ownership, collaboration, and engineering excellence.

- Partner across functions, working closely with Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, and other engineering teams to translate ambiguous business problems into actionable roadmaps and technical solutions.

- Drive measurable business outcomes, leveraging experimentation, customer insights, and data to prioritize high-impact opportunities, accelerate iteration, and improve growth performance.

- Raise the engineering bar, establishing strong practices for system design, code quality, performance, reliability, security, observability, and operational excellence.

US: You'll work from our Seattle office three days a week.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

ESSENTIALS

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience leading engineering teams or complex technical initiatives, and a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

- Strong technical expertise in backend, frontend, or full-stack engineering, with experience designing, building, and operating scalable production systems using technologies such as Python, Java/Kotlin, React, or TypeScript.

- Proven technical leadership and execution skills, with a track record of leading complex engineering projects, making sound architectural decisions, managing technical tradeoffs, and delivering high-quality solutions.

- Demonstrated ability to lead and develop engineers, through mentorship, technical guidance, effective delegation, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

- Strong ownership, product judgment, and cross-functional collaboration, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, influence stakeholders, prioritize effectively, and translate business objectives into measurable engineering outcomes.

PREFERRED

- Experience building growth platforms, experimentation systems, customer segmentation engines, marketing automation, or product-led growth experiences.

- Experience developing AI-powered applications or agentic workflows, including LLM integration, tool orchestration, evaluation, and production observability.

- Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure such as AWS or GCP.

- Experience leading cross-functional engineering initiatives involving Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, or Revenue Operations.

- Experience establishing engineering processes, improving delivery predictability, and scaling team execution in fast-moving environments.

- Experience in high-growth technology companies, fintech, payments, or regulated environments.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

- You have high agency and ownership. You proactively identify high-impact opportunities, take accountability for outcomes, and empower your team to deliver.

- You're a technical leader who builds. You stay close to architecture and implementation, make sound technical decisions, and lead by example.

- You're pragmatic and outcome-oriented. You balance engineering quality, delivery speed, and business impact, prioritizing what moves the needle.

- You're comfortable leading through ambiguity. You bring structure to complex problems, set clear priorities, and make thoughtful decisions with incomplete information.

- You grow people and teams. You coach engineers, delegate effectively, create clarity, and build a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.

- You communicate proactively and influence effectively. You align stakeholders, surface risks early, navigate tradeoffs, and drive decisions across functions.

- You thrive in a global environment. You're comfortable leading and collaborating across distributed teams in APAC, EMEA, and the US.

LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

Growth at Airwallex is building a unified, AI-native growth system across product, sales, and marketing. Rather than applying AI to isolated tasks, we use customer context, machine learning, automation, and continuous learning to transform how Airwallex acquires, activates, converts, retains, and expands customers.

You’ll build high-traffic platforms, experimentation frameworks, and intelligent decision systems that turn signals—such as company profile, product usage, lifecycle stage, behavior, and intent—into personalized journeys, next-best actions, and measurable incremental value.

The work spans both human + AI and autonomous operating models: AI-native tools that increase the leverage of growth teams, alongside agentic workflows that can research opportunities, launch and optimize campaigns, orchestrate customer journeys, and measure outcomes within clear strategies and guardrails.

The challenge is to combine consumer-technology speed with the precision, trust, and regulatory complexity of global B2B finance. If you enjoy owning ambiguous problems end to end, prototyping quickly, measuring real business impact, and using every outcome to improve the next decision, you’ll help define how an AI-native global financial platform grows.

title: Senior Product Manager, Demand Growth
description:
💙 ABOUT BOUNCE

At Bounce we’re on a mission to make people’s journeys lighter, because we believe nobody should have to plan their day around their stuff.

We started with the largest luggage storage network on the planet: 35,000+ local businesses across 100+ countries, where travelers drop their bags and get on with their day. Now we’re going further, with luggage delivery and our own 24/7 lockers. Our goal is for “bounce it” to be the first thing people say when they arrive in a new city.

We’re a small, nimble team across Lisbon, San Francisco, and Tokyo. We move fast, test ideas early, and change course when the data tells us to. If you want to make travel lighter for everyone, come build it with us.

We were named the fastest-growing travel company in the US on the 2024 Inc 5000, and we’re backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, including a16z, General Catalyst, and 359 Capital.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Senior Product Manager, Demand Growth at Bounce, you will own two critical pods within the Demand cluster:

- Acquisition Pod — driving how users discover Bounce across SEO, AI discovery, paid marketing, and partnerships.

- Conversion Pod (CRO) — optimizing the end-to-end booking funnel to maximize conversion, revenue, and user intent capture.

THE MISSION

Your mission is simple: grow demand efficiently by improving both traffic quality and conversion performance.

You’ll translate Bounce’s growth strategy into data-driven product bets, partnering closely with engineering, design, data, SEO, and performance marketing. From landing page architecture and geospatial discovery experiences to checkout flows and experimentation frameworks, you’ll lead initiatives that directly drive GMV growth.

This is a high-impact role for a product manager who thrives at the intersection of growth, experimentation, and user behavior — someone equally excited about acquisition strategy and deep funnel optimization.

WHERE YOU COME IN

You own demand. From the first time someone hears about Bounce to the moment they pay.

That means three things:

- Top-of-funnel strategy. Figure out where our next users come from then build and scale new channels.

- Conversion rate optimization. You can spot where users experience friction, understand what’s causing it, and design solutions to remove it.

- Work closely with teams across all key acquisition channels, including paid, SEO, organic, and CRM.

YOUR PROFILE

- You’re AI-native. You ship with Cursor, Claude Code, or similar. You run analysis with LLMs. You've done this in a real job, not just for side projects.

- You prefer to stay hands-on as an individual contributor. Bounce keeps teams small, relying on an elite group of high performers rather than building large teams.

- You’ve worked as a Product Manager in a growth-focused role, owning both acquisition and conversion outcomes.

- You’re comfortable owning full-funnel metrics, from traffic and activation to conversion and GMV.

- You’re highly data-literate: able to run your own analysis, interpret results, and turn insights into product direction.

- You’re pragmatic and outcome-driven. Comfortable operating autonomously while collaborating deeply across functions.

What you will actually do

- Leverage AI heavily in every minute of your day.

- Run experiments. A lot of them. You already know how to prioritize them, read the results, and kill the losers fast.

- Build and scale new acquisition channels in your first year.

- Lift relative booking conversion rate by 15% in your first year.

- Pull your own data. Analyze it with AI tools, not by waiting on an analyst.

- Report into our Product leader and work closely with our Growth leader.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

- Intro call with our Talent team to get to know you and share more about Bounce

- Hiring manager interview with our Chief Product Officer, to go deeper on your experience and the role

- Team interview with an Engineering Manager and a Product Designer from the pod, to talk about how you work with engineering and design

- Product sense interview with our Head of Design, where you’ll work through a growth scenario live (no prep needed)

- Career deep dive with our Chief Product Officer, walking through your career to explore how it shaped you

- Meet our founder, Cody, to talk about our culture and how you like to work

BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION

Compensation

- Competitive salary paid over 12 months.

- Stock options vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff.

- Flexibility to shape your package: prioritize salary or opt for more stock options

Benefits

- Private health insurance

- Unlimited vacation

- Meal allowance through Coverflex

- Commute allowance

- Gym membership

- Catered lunches twice a week, plus snacks and drinks in the office

- Team trips twice a year & regular global get togethers

LOCATION AND WORK SETUP

- You'll be based in our Lisbon office https://maps.app.goo.gl/v77ACtryEC26f4Zh9.

- Flexible hybrid working with ‘work-from-anywhere’ weeks

OUR CORE VALUES

- Velocity is priority #1. The faster we ship, the faster we learn. One day sooner compounds.

- Be experiment-driven. Small hypotheses, small scopes, fast learning.

- Freedom with responsibility. You have the freedom to act, and we trust you to do what's best for Bounce.

- Own the outcome. Commit to the outcome, not the task.

- Think at scale. A small improvement shipped globally can beat a big one in a single city.

- Be scrappy. There are no experts, it's just us. If something needs doing, we figure it out.

- Strive for feedback. Care personally, challenge directly, and make feedback a habit.

- Relationships matter. We genuinely care about the people we work with. We build community, not just collaborate.

LEARN HOW WE THINK AND WORK

- Visit bounce.com http://bounce.com

- Read about our Series B on TechCrunch https://techcrunch.com/2024/11/12/bounce-grabs-19m-to-expand-its-traveller-convenience-network/

- See why a16z invested in Bounce https://a16z.com/2022/04/26/investing-in-bounce/

- LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/bounce/posts/?feedView=all

- Instagram https://www.instagram.com/bounce/?hl=en-gb

- TikTok https://tiktok.com/@bounce

title: Senior Consumer Duty Specialist
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

In this role, you will play a central part in assessing, questioning, and enhancing how customers experience Pleo. Drawing on deep regulatory knowledge, you will lead Consumer Duty initiatives, actively spot potential customer harm, examine what drives customer journeys, and ensure targeted remediation creates lasting, positive impact.

You'll need sharp analytical skills and the confidence to influence stakeholders, translating data and MI into decisive action. You will construct and manage dashboards and reporting mechanisms that illuminate emerging patterns, vulnerable customer risks, and key concerns, offering executive leadership clear visibility into operational gaps and necessary solutions.

Your contribution goes well beyond producing MI. You will conduct QA across complex complaint handling and sensitive customer interactions, manage Ombudsman cases, and speak up when evidence shows outcomes aren't meeting expectations. Collaborating across teams, you'll turn data-driven insights into practical improvements, drive projects to completion, and evaluate whether changes deliver real results for our users.

We're seeking someone who views Consumer Duty as a powerful driver of business improvement rather than a routine compliance exercise. You'll bring together technical understanding, rigorous analysis, and constructive challenge to investigate root causes, align key partners, deliver change, and prove that customer experiences are continuously getting better.

WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You'll work closely with teams across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, Technology, and other business functions.

The role will have broad exposure across the organisation, particularly when customer outcome risks or Consumer Duty-related remediation require cross-functional action.

You'll also work closely with senior stakeholders through Consumer Duty governance and reporting, helping translate detailed analysis into clear insights, risks, recommendations, and actions.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Consumer Duty Specialist, you will:

- Turn data into customer outcome insight: Build and own MI, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting that give the business a clear view of customer outcomes, trends, risks, and emerging areas of concern.

- Own Consumer Duty reporting: Produce monthly and quarterly Consumer Duty reporting, turning complex data into a clear story for senior leadership and Board-level audiences. You'll go beyond showing what happened to explain why it matters and what we should do about it.

- Identify customer harm: Use complaints, QA findings, customer feedback, vulnerable customer data, Ombudsman cases, and MI to identify potential customer harm, emerging risks, and systemic issues.

- Challenge the business: Where the evidence suggests customers aren't receiving good outcomes, you'll be expected to ask difficult questions, challenge assumptions, and ensure the issue is properly understood and addressed.

- Drive remediation and change: Work with stakeholders across the business to agree remediation plans, establish clear owners and timelines, and help drive Consumer Duty-related projects and improvements through to completion.

- Provide complaints QA: Conduct weekly quality reviews of complaints handled by the Complaints Manager, using findings to identify quality issues, customer risks, and wider trends.

- Manage Ombudsman activity: Act as the primary operational contact with the UK Ombudsman, managing referred complaints, responses, remedies, compensation, invoices, and related communications.

- Leverage AI and smart automation: Spot opportunities to apply automated tools and AI to scale and streamline Consumer Duty analytics, monitoring, and workflows. You will feel empowered to test emerging tech and eliminate repetitive manual work, maintaining proper critical evaluation and human governance whenever compliance risks or customer impacts are involved.

WHAT YOU BRING

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- Strong Consumer Duty knowledge: You understand the principles of Consumer Duty and how they translate into practical customer outcomes, particularly across complaints, customer support, vulnerable customers, and customer journeys.

- Strong data and MI experience: You know how to take complex data, build meaningful dashboards and reporting, and identify the insights that actually matter. You're comfortable working with data rather than simply consuming reports created by others.

- A customer outcome mindset: You're naturally curious about how customers are experiencing the business and are able to connect data, customer feedback, complaints, and operational activity to real customer outcomes.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: You can spot trends, anomalies, and patterns, investigate root causes, and determine whether an issue is isolated or potentially systemic.

- The confidence to challenge: You're comfortable questioning decisions, processes, and assumptions when the evidence suggests customers may be experiencing poor outcomes. You can challenge constructively and build relationships at the same time.

- A bias towards action: You don't believe reporting is the end of the process. You want to understand what needs to change, bring people together, and help make it happen.

- Project and remediation experience: You're comfortable managing actions, timelines, dependencies, stakeholders, and risks across cross-functional projects, particularly where there is a regulatory, customer, or operational outcome to deliver.

- An AI and automation mindset: You're naturally curious about how AI and automation can make processes more efficient, improve analysis, and free up time for higher-value work. You look for sensible opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and use AI to augment your thinking, while maintaining appropriate human oversight, critical judgement, and accountability — particularly where customer outcomes or regulatory decisions are involved.

WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You love using data to uncover things that others might not see.

- You want your analysis to drive real change, rather than sit in a report or dashboard.

- You enjoy asking "why?" and getting to the root cause of customer problems.

- You're comfortable challenging the business when the evidence tells you something isn't working.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You prefer to produce reporting without being involved in what happens afterwards.

- You're uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or having difficult conversations when customer outcomes aren't where they should be.

- You prefer working within a narrow functional remit rather than across multiple teams.

HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

- Build a deep understanding of our customer outcome data, existing Consumer Duty MI, complaints, vulnerable customer journeys, and current areas of risk.

- Take ownership of key Consumer Duty dashboards and reporting, developing a clear view of the metrics and insights that matter most.

- Establish strong relationships with stakeholders across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, and Technology.

- Lead the analysis behind Consumer Duty reporting and help shape how customer outcomes are presented to senior stakeholders and the Board.

Over time, you'll have the opportunity to shape how Pleo measures, understands, and improves customer outcomes, helping move Consumer Duty from a regulatory obligation into a genuine driver of better customer experiences and better business decisions.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

2. Meet the Hiring Manager: 1hr going through role in more depth.

3. Pleo Challenge: A case study were you talk us through how you'd solve a work appropriate challenge.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we advertised this role, we received a really high volume of applications but could only select so many. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

- CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

- Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

- Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE (OUTBOUND) — COMMERCIAL

At Snowflake, we are building the future of the data-driven enterprise. We are looking for a Sales Development Representative (Outbound) who thrives on the hunt — someone who creates pipeline from nothing, works at high volume, and knows how to qualify fast and move faster.

This is a pure outbound role targeting the commercial segment. There is no inbound queue to rely on. You will prospect cold, build your own account list when needed, and generate a consistent volume of high-quality meetings and opportunities for Account Executives. If you are motivated by the challenge of opening doors that aren't already open, this role is built for you.

The person we are looking for combines relentless outbound drive with sharp commercial judgement. You know how to find the right accounts, reach the right people, and quickly determine whether there's a real opportunity — or move on.

AS A SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE (OUTBOUND) AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

- Generate pipeline through high-volume outbound prospecting — cold calling, cold email, LinkedIn, and multi-channel sequencing

- Build and maintain your own target account lists using online research, intent signals, firmographic data, and competitive intelligence — with or without a pre-defined account set

- Meet and exceed activity and pipeline targets: 80+ meetings booked and 35+ qualified opportunities created per quarter

- Qualify and disqualify accounts quickly and accurately — identify fit, urgency, and buying potential without over-investing in low-probability accounts

- Engage commercial buyers with sharp, relevant messaging that connects Snowflake's platform value to their specific business context

- Partner with Account Executives to hand off well-qualified opportunities and support early deal progression

- Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene — accurate pipeline status, activity logging, and prospecting data to support forecasting and outreach effectiveness

- Develop strong working knowledge of Snowflake's data platform, key use cases, and competitive positioning to run credible outbound conversations

OUR IDEAL SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE (OUTBOUND) WILL HAVE:

- 2–4 years of outbound SDR or inside sales experience, preferably in a commercial or high-velocity segment

- Proven track record of high-volume cold calling and outbound prospecting

- Strong ability to self-source accounts and build prospect lists independently, using tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar

- Speed and discipline in qualification — knows how to quickly identify whether an account is worth pursuing and when to move on

- Experience with outbound sequencing and sales engagement platforms (Outreach or Salesloft preferred)

- Proficiency with Salesforce CRM for pipeline tracking and activity management

- Strong verbal communication skills with the confidence and resilience required for high-volume cold outreach

- Curiosity about data, AI, and the enterprise technology landscape

- Ambition to grow into an Account Executive role and readiness to earn that progression through consistent outbound performance

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

title: Software Development Test Engineer I
description:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

About the Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET-I) to join our Engineering team. As an SDET-I, you will contribute to building and enhancing test automation across our cloud-native applications, working alongside experienced engineers to strengthen quality engineering practices and support continuous delivery.

You will collaborate with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and DevOps teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle. This role requires solid programming fundamentals, a keen interest in automation, and a willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain automated test scripts for UI, API, and integration testing using established frameworks.

- Write reliable automated test cases using Java and automation tools such as Playwright.

- Build and execute API test suites using Rest Assured or equivalent frameworks.

- Contribute to the integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing.

- Collaborate with developers and senior SDETs to understand features, improve testability, and ensure product quality.

- Review functional and technical requirements, identify test scenarios, and create detailed test plans.

- Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing across distributed applications.

- Debug test failures, investigate root causes, and work with development teams to resolve defects.

- Improve and expand test automation coverage and execution reliability.

- Participate in sprint ceremonies, backlog grooming, and engineering discussions.

- Follow and adopt engineering best practices, coding standards, and team conventions.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.

- 1.5years – 3 years of experience in Software Development in Test or QA Automation.

- Solid programming skills in Java with a good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming principles.

- Working experience with Playwright or Selenium WebDriver.

- Hands-on experience in API testing using Rest Assured, Postman, or similar tools.

- Familiarity with test frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent.

- Basic understanding of software engineering principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies.

- Exposure to CI/CD concepts and tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.

- Good debugging and analytical skills.

- Experience using Git for version control and collaborative workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to microservices architecture and API-first development patterns.

- Basic familiarity with Docker and containerized environments.

- Awareness of cloud platforms such as AWS.

- Basic knowledge of relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and writing SQL queries.

- Familiarity with messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.

- Interest in observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Kibana.

What We're Looking For

Solid programming fundamentals with a genuine interest in quality engineering.

Eagerness to learn, adapt, and grow in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Attention to detail and a sense of ownership over assigned testing areas.

Curiosity to explore modern testing technologies and engineering practices.

Team-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently on assigned tasks.

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements

- 2+ years of professional software engineering

- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

- Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

- Regular use of an AI coding tool

- Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

- You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

- At least 10 hours a week, starting now

- A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms

- US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

- Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

- The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

- Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

title: Junior IT-Systemadministrator / IT-Support 1st & 2nd Level - Teilzeit (m/w/d)
description:
# Übersicht

* Wir bieten 2 Stellen in Teilzeit, je 20–25 Stunden pro Woche, flexibel verteilbar (Gehaltsangabe bezogen auf 25 Wochenstunden)
* Einsatzort: bevorzugt Region Bodensee, 100% Remote möglich
* Start: ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung
* Ideal für Berufseinsteiger nach der IT-Ausbildung oder Quereinsteiger mit langer IT-Praxiserfahrung

## Über uns

Die roza.digital GmbH ist ein IT-Dienstleister im B2B-Bereich mit Sitz in Stockach am Bodensee. Mit unseren Managed Services betreuen wir Unternehmen von Stockach, München und Köln aus – bundesweit und im gesamten DACH-Raum.

Unsere Kunden sind so vielfältig wie ihre IT: vom Handwerksbetrieb über die Steuerkanzlei bis zu Bau, Industrie, Maschinenbau, Medizin, Handel, öffentlichem Sektor und Gastgewerbe. Sie haben einen festen Servicevertrag und einen persönlichen Ansprechpartner statt einer anonymen Ticket-Hotline.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Support-Teams suchen wir zwei Kolleginnen oder Kollegen in Teilzeit, die Anwendern schnell und freundlich weiterhelfen.

## Deine Aufgaben

* 1st Level Support per Telefon, E-Mail, Ticket und Fernwartung: Anfragen aufnehmen, einordnen und möglichst direkt lösen
* 2nd Level Support für unsere Bestandskunden: Störungen an Arbeitsplätzen, Druckern, Netzwerk, Windows Server und Microsoft 365 analysieren und beheben
* Sauberes Arbeiten im Ticketsystem und nachvollziehbare Dokumentation von Lösungen
* Weitergabe komplexer Fälle an unsere Systemadministratoren, mit gut vorbereiteten Informationen
* Benutzerverwaltung: Konten, Postfächer, Berechtigungen und Lizenzen in M365 und Active Directory pflegen
* Einrichtung und Rollout von Notebooks, PCs, Smartphones und Peripherie, u. a. mit Intune und Windows Autopilot
* Unterstützung im Tagesbetrieb: Monitoring-Meldungen prüfen, Updates und Patches einspielen, Backups kontrollieren
* Mitarbeit in Projekten, z. B. M365-Migrationen oder Netzwerkumstellungen

## Technologien

**Das musst du mitbringen:**

* Windows 10/11 Clients: Einrichtung, Fehlersuche, Treiber, Drucker
* Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive/SharePoint sowie Erfahrung im Admin Center
* Windows Server, GPO, RDS / Terminalserver
* Active Directory / Entra ID: Benutzer und Gruppen anlegen und pflegen
* Netzwerk-Grundlagen: IP, DNS, DHCP, WLAN, VPN
* Fernwartungstools und Arbeit mit einem Ticketsystem, Erfahrung mit IT-Dokumentationen

**Diese Pluspunkte sind von Vorteil:**

* UniFi, OPNsense, VLAN
* NAS und Backup (Synology / QNAP)
* Erste Linux-Erfahrung (Debian/Ubuntu), Proxmox VE
* 3CX VoIP
* Branchensoftware wie DATEV, Lexware, Sage, DocuWare oder ERPNext
* Scripting (PowerShell, Bash) oder Automatisierung mit n8n

## Dein Profil

* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker (Systemintegration oder Digitale Vernetzung), IT-Systemelektroniker oder vergleichbar – alternativ ein IT-nahes Studium oder entsprechende Praxis
* Erste Berufserfahrung im IT-Support (ca. 1–2 Jahre), gerne bei einem Systemhaus oder MSP – auch motivierte Berufseinsteiger sind willkommen
* Freude daran, Anwendern zu helfen, und die Geduld, Technik verständlich zu erklären
* Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und der Wille, Neues zu lernen
* Zuverlässigkeit und saubere Dokumentation
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englisch für Fachdokumentation
* Zertifizierungen sind nicht nötig, aber ein Plus

## Wir bieten

* Unbefristete Festanstellung in Teilzeit mit 20–25 Wochenstunden und flexibler Verteilung auf die Woche
* Homeoffice-Anteil (bis zu 100%), sofern keine Vor-Ort-Termine anstehen (z.B. im Rahmen von großen Umstellungen)
* Notebook, Smartphone und aktuelle Hardware
* Strukturierte Einarbeitung
* Weiterbildung auf Firmenkosten
* Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung
* Firmenfitness / Wellpass
* Moderner Tech-Stack und Entwicklungsperspektive Richtung Senior Systemadministration
* 30 Urlaubstage

## Bewerbung

Klingt gut? Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen zu dir. Nenne uns gern deinen gewünschten Stundenumfang, deine Gehaltsvorstellung und deinen frühestmöglichen Starttermin.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter oder Behinderung.
